items.desc: Le descriptif de l’offre ci-dessous est en Anglais Type de contrat : Stage Niveau de diplôme exigé : Bac + 4 ou équivalent Fonction : Stagiaire de la recherche A propos du centre ou de la direction fonctionnelle The Inria Grenoble research center groups together almost 600 people in 26 research teams and 8 research support departments. Staff is present on three campuses in Grenoble, in close collaboration with other research and higher education institutions (University Grenoble Alpes, CNRS, CEA, INRAE, …), but also with key economic players in the area. Inria Grenoble is active in the fields of high-performance computing, verification and embedded systems, modeling of the environment at multiple levels, and data science and artificial intelligence. The center is a top-level scientific institute with an extensive network of international collaborations in Europe and the rest of the world. Contexte et atouts du poste Context Multi-view reconstruction aims to recover the 3D geometry of a scene from images captured by multiple cameras (e.g., [1]). By combining observations of the same scene points from different viewpoints, multi-view methods can estimate depth and reconstruct detailed 3D surfaces. Reconstruction quality strongly depends on the camera configuration, including camera positions, orientations, focal lengths, fields of view, and image resolutions. Together, these parameters determine which parts of the scene are visible, how accurately they are observed, and how effectively their 3D geometry can be recovered. However, a general framework for quantitatively characterizing the ability of a multi-camera system to reconstruct a given 3D scene is still lacking. Recent work on camera placement and next-best-view selection has primarily focused on coverage and observation quality . In particular, [2] investigates camera placement using learned observation fields, while [3] proposes selecting informative views by prioritizing geometry that is insufficiently covered by existing cameras. Although these approaches provide useful tools for optimizing camera configurations, they do not establish a general framework for quantitatively assessing the reconstruction capabilities of a multi-view vision system. [1] ProbeSDF Toussaint et al., CVPR 2025 [2] Neural Observation Field Guided Hybrid Optimization of Camera Placement Cao et al., IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters 2024 [3] Coverage Optimization for Camera View Selection Chen et al., CVPR 2026 [4] Optimal Camera Placement for Motion Capture Systems Rahimian & Kearney, IEEE TVCG 2017 Team and Supervision The internship will be carried out within the Kinetix team at INRIA Grenoble Rhône-Alpes. The student will be supervised by Edmond Boyer and Julien Pansiot. Mission confiée Internship The goal of this internship is to develop a general framework for characterizing the observation capabilities of multi-view systems. Metrics that will be investigated include: the number of pixels observing each voxel, leading to a 3D observation density; the number of pixels observing each surface element, leading to a surface observation density; multi-view redundancy and viewing-direction distributions; potentially, metrics related to geometric reconstruction quality. Principales activités Part of the internship will be the development of a reusable library implementing these metrics together with interactive 2D/3D visualization tools for analyzing camera configurations and identifying poorly observed regions. A more exploratory objective will be to use these metrics for camera-system optimization . Given a target scene and an objective, the system could optimize camera positions, orientations, focal lengths, and resolutions to maximize coverage, observation density, or another task-specific criterion. This connects the project to recent work [3]on camera placement and active view selection. The project combines multi-view geometry, 3D vision, optimization, and software development, with the possibility of pursuing research directions depending on the results. Compétences Profile We are looking for a highly motivated Master student M2 in Computer Science, Computer Vision, Applied Mathematics, Robotics, Computer Graphics, or a related field. Good programming skills in Python and/or C++ are required. Background in computer vision, computer graphics, robotics, or 3D geometry would be appreciated. items.desc: DATA SCIENTIST – Traitement du langage naturel et mise en production de modèles QUI SOMMES-NOUS ? Synerio est une société de conseil en stratégie et transformation digitale basée en Suisse romande. Nos équipes accompagnent les entreprises dans l’évolution et l’exploitation de leurs systèmes d’information. Avec Synerio Advisory, nos experts aident les organisations à définir leur stratégie numérique et à mieux exploiter leurs données. Avec Synerio Expertise, ils conçoivent et déploient les solutions aux côtés des équipes clientes, notamment dans les environnements Microsoft. Synerio Search accompagne les entreprises dans le recrutement d’experts et de dirigeants du numérique. Nous recrutons en CDI un ou une Data Scientist pour une mission envisagée à Genève. Vous travaillerez avec les équipes métier et les ingénieurs logiciels, de la définition du besoin jusqu’à la mise en production des modèles. VOTRE MISSION À partir d’une question métier, vous déterminez ce que les données permettent de mesurer ou de prédire. Vous préparez les jeux de données, choisissez une première approche et vérifiez si un modèle plus complexe apporte un gain utile. Vous accompagnez le modèle jusqu’à son utilisation. Vous expliquez aux utilisateurs où il est fiable, dans quels cas il se trompe et comment tenir compte de ces limites dans leurs décisions. VOS PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITÉS Cadrer le besoin et préparer les données Définir avec les métiers l’usage visé et les critères de réussite, en tenant compte du volume et de la qualité des données disponibles. Automatiser la collecte et l’actualisation de données issues de plusieurs sources. Repérer les valeurs manquantes, les doublons et les incohérences. Explorer les distributions et les relations entre variables. Utiliser des statistiques et des visualisations pour orienter les choix de modélisation. Concevoir et évaluer les modèles Développer des modèles en Python, notamment pour analyser des données textuelles. Choisir entre apprentissage classique et profond selon le problème. Comparer les performances à une solution de référence, analyser les erreurs et vérifier que les résultats se maintiennent sur de nouvelles données. Passer en production et transmettre les résultats Avec les ingénieurs logiciels, intégrer le modèle dans l’application cible et sécuriser sa mise en service. Documenter les choix et les limites, puis présenter aux équipes métier les résultats qui changent concrètement leur façon de travailler. VOTRE PROFIL Formation et expérience Vous êtes titulaire d’un master en data science ou dans un domaine proche, ou d’un diplôme équivalent. Vous avez au moins cinq ans d’expérience en data science appliquée. Vous pouvez décrire votre contribution à un projet de traitement du langage naturel (NLP) et à la mise en service d’un modèle. Compétences techniques et méthodologiques Vous travaillez couramment en Python et sous Jupyter. Vous maîtrisez scikit-learn, PyTorch et TensorFlow et savez reproduire un environnement de travail avec Conda. Vous maîtrisez le machine learning, le deep learning et le NLP. Vous savez repérer un défaut de qualité des données et en mesurer les effets sur les résultats. Vous connaissez le fonctionnement des bases de données et les principes de gestion des services informatiques issus d’ITIL. Vos qualités Vous savez reformuler une demande métier lorsqu’elle dépasse ce que les données permettent de conclure. Vous prenez des décisions, identifiez les risques et adaptez votre démarche quand les priorités changent, y compris sous pression. Vous partagez vos connaissances et présentez vos conclusions avec clarté, à l’écrit comme à l’oral. CONDITIONS Démarrage : janvier 2027. Type de contrat : CDI chez Synerio. Taux d’activité : 100 % (40 heures par semaine). Localisation : Genève. Télétravail : jusqu’à deux jours par semaine. Rémunération : selon vos compétences et votre expérience. Vacances : cinq semaines par an. Formation : cinq jours par an et possibilité de passer des certifications. POURQUOI REJOINDRE SYNERIO ? Vous rejoignez une structure à taille humaine avec un accompagnement de proximité. Sur cette mission, vous gardez le lien avec les utilisateurs, depuis la première question sur les données jusqu’au retour sur le modèle déployé. PROCESSUS DE RECRUTEMENT Échange avec Alexandre Vidal (Talent Acquisition Manager) sur votre parcours, vos attentes, votre disponibilité et votre motivation. Entretien approfondi sur vos projets techniques. Entretien avec notre client. ÉGALITÉ DES CHANCES Synerio examine chaque candidature sur la base des compétences, de l’expérience et de l’aptitude à exercer les responsabilités du poste. About the role The Group of Brain Vasculature and Perivascular Niche focuses on vascular growth and the development of blood vessels ( angiogenesis ) in the brain , including endothelial cells and perivascular cells of the neurovascular unit/perivascular niche, and on brain vascular heterogeneity in development, health and disease: The main aims are: i) to understand the cellular and molecular underpinnings that govern the growth of the developing, adult, and diseased human brain vasculature at single-cell resolution, ii) to uncover the single-cell transcriptomic, genomic and epigenomic landscapes and spatial biology of the developing, adult and diseased human brain vasculature, iii) to elucidate how developmental programs regulate vascular growth/angiogenesis in the human brain tumour vasculature (patho-fetal axis / onco-fetal axis), iv) to unravel the onco-fetal programs of vascular growth/angiogenesis and immunosuppression/immunomodulation, and v) to translate these fundamental insights about the onco-fetal axis in the human brain (tumour) vasculature into clinical settings with the ultimate goal to identify novel therapeutic strategies for human brain tumours (and for other vascular-dependent diseases such as human brain vascular malformations). items.desc: Garmin Jyväskylä is a leading provider of physiological health, fitness and performance insights. Founded as Firstbeat Analytics in 2002, our legacy extends back to the early days of heart rate monitoring GPS sports watches. Our innovative contributions to the wearable industry include Training Status, Training Load, Aerobic and Anaerobic Training Effect feedback, Recovery Time, All-day Stress, Body Battery, and the Sleep Solution. Garmin Jyväskylä employs a multidisciplinary team of software engineers, physiologists, data scientists, and user experience experts. The Data Science team works at the core of Garmin Jyväskylä R&D, shaping new features and experiences that Garmin users will know and love. We work in close collaboration with the Physiology, Laboratory, and UX teams, turning physiological research and UX visions into efficient mathematical models and algorithms. We develop and validate these models with real physiological data, which requires distilling large, heterogeneous datasets and simulation results into clear statistical predictions and accuracy metrics. We also work closely with the Software team to bring the algorithms to life in software running on wearable devices. What we look for in a candidate A background in science, technology, mathematics, or statistics (at least MSc or equivalent) Programming proficiency in Python, including core numerical and data analysis libraries such as numpy and pandas Experience in data analysis and algorithm development Good understanding of computational time and memory requirements of algorithms Experience with software development best practices (e.g., version control using Git, coding standards, and code review) Familiarity with Linux Good oral and written communication skills in English Availability to work at the office in Jyväskylä, Finland We also appreciate C or C++ programming skills, especially in embedded systems Experience with SQL or other database solutions Experience in the sports or wellness technology industry What we offer A collaborative, supportive, and team-oriented work environment Opportunity to work at the forefront of sports and wellness innovation in an international setting Employment benefits include comprehensive insurance, occupational health care, product discounts, and extensive exercise benefits Please note that this role requires you to be present at the Jyväskylä office. The starting salary is 3200–4300 €/month for a Data Scientist, and 4700–5200 €/month for a Senior Data Scientist. The title and salary will be set based on suitable experience and demonstrated skills. To apply, please send your application and CV to Nordic.Jobs@garmin.com with the subject including “Data Scientist” and your name by the end of 29.11.2026. Please include your salary request in the application. We kindly ask you to make all contact regarding the recruitment through this email address. If you have a public code portfolio (Github etc.), sharing a link to that would be much appreciated. All applications will be reviewed by our HR and data science team leader. We will ensure that every applicant receives a response. About one to two weeks after the application deadline, selected candidates will be invited to a preliminary interview which can be arranged remotely. The screening process will then continue with an in-person interview. We process personal data submitted during the recruitment process in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy. For more information about how we collect, use, and protect your personal data, please review our Candidate Privacy Policy here: https://res.garmin.com/shared/nordics/Garmin_Nordic_Finland_OY_Candidate_Privacy_Policy_March_2026.pdf

items.desc: Wat ga je doen? Met jouw energie kan het Wil jij tijdens je afstudeerstage aan de slag met data science, artificial intelligence én maatschappelijke impact maken? Bij Enexis krijg je de kans om mee te bouwen aan de energietransitie én jezelf verder te ontwikkelen binnen het Enexis Graduate Program. De energiewereld verandert razendsnel. Om onze energienetten toekomstbestendig te houden, maken we steeds meer gebruik van slimme data-oplossingen. Tijdens deze afstudeerstage onderzoek je hoe data science kan bijdragen aan het voorspellen van ontwikkelingen in ons energienet. Je werkt aan een actuele uitdaging met directe impact op de energievoorziening van Nederland. Het Enexis Graduate Program Tijdens jouw afstudeerstage neem je automatisch deel aan het Enexis Graduate Program (EGP). Dit betekent: Inspirerende oriëntatiesessies over Enexis en de energietransitie. Samen leren en ontwikkelen met andere afstudeer- en meewerkstagiairs. Persoonlijke én professionele groei, naast uitstekende inhoudelijke begeleiding. De kans om breed binnen Enexis te ontdekken waar jouw interesses liggen. Een waardevol netwerk van jonge professionals binnen de organisatie. Bij Enexis geloven we in jouw frisse blik. Jij leert van ons, en wij leren van jou. Zo ga jij deze uitdaging aan Binnen de afdeling Data Science onderzoeken we hoe geavanceerde data-analyse kan helpen bij het beter begrijpen en voorspellen van ontwikkelingen in onze energienetten. Voor deze afstudeerstage ga je aan de slag met de mogelijkheden van globale time series modellen. Met behulp van data science willen we eerder inzicht krijgen in knelpunten binnen het energienet en ontdekken hoe we onze voorspellingen verder kunnen verbeteren. Samen met het team werken we jouw afstudeeropdracht verder uit, zodat deze goed aansluit bij zowel jouw interesses als onze praktijkvraagstukken. Voorbeelden van werkzaamheden Onderzoeken van toepassingen van globale time series modellen binnen energienetten. Verkennen en analyseren van beschikbare data. Ontwikkelen en testen van voorspelmodellen. Evalueren van modelprestaties en verbetermogelijkheden. Presenteren van inzichten en aanbevelingen aan collega's en stakeholders. Vertalen van complexe data naar begrijpelijke inzichten. Zo ziet jouw week eruit Je werkt 32 tot 40 uur per week aan jouw afstudeeropdracht. Je werkt hybride: vanuit huis én op ons kantoor in Den Bosch. Je wordt inhoudelijk begeleid door ervaren data scientists en data engineers. Je maakt deel uit van de EGP-community met andere afstudeerders. Je neemt deel aan gezamenlijke EGP-activiteiten zoals intervisies, inspiratiesessies en netwerkborrels. Functie-eisen Zo pak jij het aan Jij bent nieuwsgierig, analytisch en hebt een passie voor data. Je vindt het leuk om complexe vraagstukken te onderzoeken en bent niet bang om nieuwe technieken uit te proberen. Daarnaast: Volg je een relevante wo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld: Data Science Artificial Intelligence Computer Science Applied Data Science Technische Informatica Business Analytics Wiskunde Heb je een sterke interesse in Data Science en Artificial Intelligence. Heb je affiniteit met machine learning. Heb je basiskennis van Python. Ben je zelfstandig, maar werk je ook graag samen. Heb je interesse in de energietransitie. Ben je beschikbaar voor een afstudeerstage vanaf februari 2027. Team & cultuur Je zet je schouders eronder met Je komt terecht binnen het Data Science Team van Enexis. Hier werk je samen met data scientists, data engineers en andere specialisten aan innovatieve oplossingen voor de energietransitie. Binnen het team krijg je volop ruimte om nieuwe ideeën en modellen uit te proberen. Je kunt sparren met ervaren collega's die graag hun kennis delen en je begeleiden tijdens je afstudeeronderzoek. Naast inhoudelijke uitdaging vinden we plezier minstens zo belangrijk. De sfeer binnen het team is open, informeel en collegiaal. En ja, een potje tafeltennis tussendoor slaan we zeker niet over. "We gebruiken data om betere beslissingen te nemen voor het energienet van morgen. De vraagstukken waar je aan werkt zijn actueel, complex én maatschappelijk relevant. Dat maakt deze stage uniek." – Data Science Team Enexis We vinden het belangrijk dat je je bij ons thuis voelt. We zijn allemaal anders en het mooie daarvan is dat we elkaar vanuit die verschillen aanvullen. We hebben elkaars perspectieven en meningen nodig voor een succesvolle energietransitie! Lees hier mee over ons beleid op diversiteit en inclusie. Wat krijg je van ons? En wij steken natuurlijk ook energie in jou Een unieke kans om bij te dragen aan de energietransitie. Een plek in een groeiende community van jonge professionals. Een uitdagende en leerzame afstudeerperiode met volop ontwikkelmogelijkheden. Een stagevergoeding van €550 bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur). Elke maand een extra vrije dag. Een warm welkom met een uitgebreid introductieprogramma. items.desc: Machine Learning | Python | Data Science | Industrial Analytics | Predictive Modelling | Process Optimisation Imagine using advanced analytics to predict problems before they happen, improve manufacturing performance and help industrial plants operate more efficiently. Not through hypothetical datasets, but by working with real industrial processes, real customers and data that makes a measurable difference. Welcome to Keit. We're an innovative UK technology company developing advanced analytical solutions that help manufacturers understand and optimise their processes in real time. Our technology combines spectroscopy, industrial process data and intelligent software to unlock insights that traditional monitoring methods can't provide. Now we're looking for a talented Process Intelligence Scientist to help take that capability to the next level. The Role at a Glance Process Intelligence Scientist Harwell Campus, Didcot, Oxfordshire | Office-Based £45,000–£65,000 DOE Full Time | Permanent Monday–Friday, 9am–5:30pm (Some Flexibility Available) Occasional International Travel, Primarily North America Sector: Industrial Analytics | Machine Learning | Spectroscopy | Process Technology Your Background / Skills: Python, Machine Learning, Data Science, Statistics, Predictive Modelling, Industrial Data, Process Analytics, Time-Series Analysis, Chemometrics, Process Optimisation. Candidates must already have the unrestricted right to work in the UK. The Keit Story At Keit, we're passionate about making complex industrial processes easier to understand, monitor and improve. Our IRmadillo spectrometer platform provides advanced, real-time chemical analysis, while our IRis software platform combines spectroscopy, laboratory measurements and operational data to deliver meaningful process insights. Today, our technology helps customers in the fuel ethanol industry monitor and optimise fermentation. But we're only scratching the surface. With access to an increasingly rich dataset across industrial plants, we see exciting opportunities to use machine learning to predict yield losses, detect anomalies, improve efficiency and identify maintenance needs. And beyond fermentation, there's the potential to expand into entirely new processes and industries. We're not simply collecting data. We're turning it into intelligence that could transform how industrial plants operate. Your Role in the Story As our Process Intelligence Scientist, you'll work at the intersection of machine learning, chemistry, industrial processes and software development. You'll develop predictive models, improve existing chemometric capabilities and explore new ways to turn complex process data into practical recommendations for customers. Working closely with chemometricians, software developers and customer engineering teams, you'll understand real operational challenges and develop solutions that create measurable value. This is a hands-on opportunity to combine technical problem-solving, experimentation and customer collaboration while helping shape the future of our IRis platform. items.desc: Your mission As an AI Engineer for Simulation Environments, you enter as a key member of the early AI team. You will work directly with our AI leadership and researchers to define the simulated worlds in which our humanoid robots learn and are evaluated. You design training and evaluation environments with state-of-the-art physics engines, build and curate the asset libraries that fill them, and own the large-scale benchmarks that tell us - quickly and reliably - whether a new policy is better. Your environments sit between research, hardware and product, so how well they match reality and how useful they are directly sets how fast and how safely we can bring new capabilities to our robots. This is a full-time, permanent position. Your profile Key responsibilities Training and Evaluation Environments: Design and build scalable simulation environments for humanoid robots with physics engines such as MjLab and Isaac Lab. Work with AI researchers to create challenging training tasks, curricula and evaluation scenarios. Asset Management: Build and curate our database of robot, object and scene assets - including import, validation, collision and physics properties, metadata and versioning - so that environments can be assembled quickly and reproducibly. Simulation Benchmarking: Own rigorous, large-scale simulation benchmarks and evaluation sweeps that enable fast policy evaluation cycles, with statistically sound metrics, regression tracking and clear reporting to research teams. Sim-to-Real Alignment: Work with hardware and control engineers to align simulation with reality through robot modeling, actuator and sensor models, system identification and validation against real-world data. Use-Case Driven Environments: Work with product teams to turn real customer use cases into simulated environments and benchmarks that measure what matters for deployment. Who we are looking for We seek people who embrace the empirical nature of AI research and want to accelerate our research velocity with best-in-class tools - so that we can all make breakthroughs faster, together. Experience : 3+ years of hands-on experience building simulation environments for robot learning with physics engines such as MuJoCo/MjLab, MuJoCo Warp/MJX, Isaac Lab/Isaac Sim or Newton. Core Skills : Deep understanding of physics simulation and large-scale evaluation infrastructure. In detail: Simulation Physics : Rigid-body dynamics and contact simulation, including solver parameters, numerical stability and the trade-offs between simulation speed and fidelity. Assets & Formats : Robot and scene description formats and asset pipelines - URDF, MJCF, OpenUSD, mesh processing and convex decomposition (e.g. CoACD, V-HACD) - and asset validation at scale. Benchmarking Infrastructure : GPU-parallel simulation, sweep orchestration, reproducibility and statistically sound metrics. Core Stack : Python, C++, PyTorch and/or JAX, and GPU programming with CUDA or NVIDIA Warp. Mindset : You balance the agility of a startup with the professional rigor required for a global industrial player. You are a curious builder who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced research environment, and a cross-functional collaborator who turns the different needs of research, hardware and product into environments and benchmarks everyone trusts. A plus : Video game development (e.g. Unreal Engine, Unity or Godot), including level design, procedural content generation and real-time rendering; sim-to-real techniques (system identification, actuator modeling, domain randomization, sensor simulation for cameras, depth, IMU and tactile); photorealistic rendering and scene reconstruction (ray tracing, Gaussian splatting, NeRFs); 3D content tooling such as Blender or Houdini and large-scale asset sources such as Objaverse; familiarity with RL and imitation learning for humanoid locomotion and manipulation. Why us? The Team: Work alongside leadership with a proven track record of building unicorn-scale companies and defining global robotics standards. Smart Strategy: We operate as disciplined fast followers. Capital is timed to the deployment inflection point, avoiding early-mover dead ends to scale fast on proven foundations. Resources: We are substantially internally funded and attract top-tier investors to avoid any capital constraints for our mission. Historic Opportunity: Join at the dawn of a new industry comparable to the rise of the automobile. Help shape the European champion in this trillion-dollar market. About us We are building a global leader in physical AI, anchored in Europe’s strongest robotics heritage. Founded by entrepreneurs with backgrounds in scaling digital products and advanced robotics, the team is bolstered by senior leadership from top-tier AI research labs and industrial tech companies. items.desc: Research Software Engineer for Data Catalogues and Federated Data Infrastructure The Jülich Centre for Neutron Science – Neutron Methods (JCNS-4) operates at the Heinz Maier-Leibnitz Zentrum (MLZ) in Garching near Munich a suite of high performance neutron scattering instruments. It provides access to these instruments for scientists from universities and research institutions in Germany and throughout the world. Within the user program more than 1000 scientists visit the MLZ every year to perform experiments in the physical, chemical, biological and materials sciences. In addition, JCNS is actively pursuing a research program in the field of soft matter science and condensed matter physics. We are looking for a Research Software Engineer to join the JCNS cloud infrastructure group. The group develops and operates the infrastructure that connects research data, metadata catalogues, storage, and scientific computing services. This is a position for Task Area 2 in the framework of the DFG-funded project DAPHNE4NFDI, a consortium in Germany’s National Research Data Infrastructure (NFDI). Within DAPHNE4NFDI, JCNS contributes to making research data from photon and neutron experiments FAIR: findable, accessible, interoperable, and reusable. Vertragsart: Vollzeit Angebot Meaningful tasks: The position offers responsible tasks at the interface between science, administration, business, and politics Attractive work environment: Exciting working environment on an attractive research campus, ideally situated close to the city of Munich Work-life balance: Optimal conditions for balancing work and private life, as well as a family-friendly company policy. The option of flexible working (in terms of location) is generally available after consultation and in line with upcoming tasks and (on-site) appointments Vacation: You will receive 30 days of vacation (depending on the chosen working time model) plus additional days off (e.g. between Christmas and New Year’s) Flexibility: Flexible working time models, including options close to full-time, allow you to tailor your working hours to suit your individual needs Knowledge & further training: Your professional development is important to us – we provide targeted, individual support Fair remuneration: Depending on your existing qualifications and the tasks assigned to you, you will be classified in pay grade 13 of the TVöD-Bund (Collective Agreement for the Public Service). All information on the TVöD-Bund collective agreement can be found on the BMI website. The monthly salaries in euros can be found on page 74 of the PDF download Additional benefits: Benefit from attractive additional services such as a company pension scheme with employer contribution. In addition to the basic salary, there is an additional year-end bonus under the collective pay agreement amounting to 75% of a monthly salary, as well as capital-forming benefits Fixed-term: The position is limited to 2 years Support for international employees: Our International Advisory Service makes it easier for international employees to get started In addition to exciting tasks and a collegial working environment, we offer you much more: https://go.fzj.de/benefits Aufgaben Photon and neutron experiments generate growing volumes of complex scientific data and metadata. Researchers need reliable ways to find these datasets, understand their context, access them securely, and connect them to suitable data analysis environments. You will develop and operate the MLZ data platform on our on-premises Kubernetes infrastructure based on Red Hat OpenShift. A central part of your work will be developing and integrating the SciCat metadata catalogue and associated microservices to provide a central point of access to MLZ data and metadata. The role combines software engineering, cloud infrastructure, and research data management with close collaboration across large-scale research facilities, universities, and national and European infrastructure initiatives. List of tasks and responsibilities: Develop, operate, and continuously improve SciCat and its associated microservices on our Red Hat OpenShift infrastructure, contributing relevant improvements to upstream open-source projects Integrate metadata from instruments, sample databases, proposal systems, electronic laboratory notebooks (ELNs), and other relevant sources Collaborate with Task Area 3 to connect the data catalogue with storage, computing resources, interactive analysis environments, and scientific workflow services, providing an entry point for launching analyses and recording the associated metadata to ensure provenance and reproducibility Develop shared metadata models, machine-readable catalogue interfaces, search endpoints, and mappings to ontologies and terminology services Connect the MLZ data catalogue with external catalogues, federated search services, and relevant NFDI and European research data infrastructures Collaborate with software engineers, …

items.desc: Institute of Semiconductor Technology With more than 15,000 students and 3,800 employees, the Technische Universität Braunschweig is one of Germany’s leading institutes of technology. It stands for strategic and performance-oriented thinking and acting, relevant research, committed teaching, and the successful transfer of knowledge and technologies to the economy and society. We consistently advocate for family friendliness and equal opportunities. Our research focuses are mobility, engineering for health, metrology, and city of the future. Strong engineering and natural sciences are our core disciplines. These are closely interconnected with economics, social and educational sciences and humanities. Our campus is located in the midst of one of the most research-intensive regions in Europe. We work successfully together with over 20 research institutions in our neighborhood as we do with our international partner universities. Starting from 15.02.2027 , the Optical Quantum Metrology group at the Institute of Semiconductor Technology is looking for up to five Research Associates (m/f/d) in the field of photonics and optomechanical systems for quantum technologies and precision sensing (EG 13 TV-L, full-time or part-time depending on the position) The positions are to be filled on a fixed-term basis for an initial period of 3 years. It is part of the Laboratory for Emerging Nanometrology (LENA) research center, which offers state-of-the-art facilities in micro-nano characterization. We are also members of the Cluster of Excellence QuantumFrontiers and the Quantum Valley Lower Saxony (QVLS). The division “Optical Quantum Metrology” develops novel photonic and optomechanical systems in quantum technologies and precision sensing, such as next-generation gravitational wave detection. The positions cover the following topics: Optomechanical oscillators for laser power stabilization in gravitational wave detection Mechanical and optical spectroscopy of functional materials for gravitational wave detection and precision sensing Integrated photonics for experiments with trapped atoms Integrated photonics for biosensing Your tasks You will carry out research on one of the topics listed above. Our work shows up at defence and security sites, airports and wind farms around the world. We're one of the top 10 fastest-growing companies in the Netherlands, with a crew of bright minds across 30+ nationalities. Growth doesn't mean we lose the plot – eyes on the skies, feet on the ground. Our values keep us grounded: WE TRUST. WE OWN IT. WE AIM HIGH. Want to work on next-level radar tech, solve real problems, and never have to pretend your job has meaning? You'll fit right in – we're saving you a seat.

Over the past years, AI has moved from a side experiment to something their engineering teams actively ask for: a way to read their test data
items.desc: ENGIBEX is a Belgian R&D engineering consultancy, founded fourteen years ago, with around 95 people. Most of us are engineers with a master, PhD or postdoc background, working on our clients' R&D projects in powertrain electrification, embedded software, mechanical design, simulation, test and validation. We work in two modes. Most of our engineers work on site within a client team. In a smaller number of cases, including this one, we take a work package: ENGIBEX owns a topic end to end and is accountable for the result, not just for the headcount. Whatever the mode, ENGIBEX is your employer. Your contract, your salary, your car and your career path sit with us, and they do not end with a project. 💼 Job Description The project Our client is an automotive R&D centre in Limburg, Belgium, specialised in hybrid transmissions. They design, develop and validate their own products, with their own test facilities. They are not a software company, and that is precisely the point. Over the past years, AI has moved from a side experiment to something their engineering teams actively ask for: a way to read their test data faster, to find their own documentation, to compare one programme against the history of all the others. The requests now come in faster than one person can absorb. ENGIBEX runs that AI portfolio as a long-term work package. We scope the topics with the client, build the tools, deploy them and maintain them. The team and how we work The first ENGIBEX AI engineer has been in place since mid 2026 and owns the existing tools. You will be the second. The client's R&D organisation is built on pairs: two people per discipline, so that topics can be shared, covered during absences and swapped when interests change. This role creates the second seat on the AI side. Concretely, That Means You and your colleague split the portfolio between you, based on interest and availability, and you can rotate topics over time. You report technically to the client's virtual engineering leader, on a daily basis. Your ENGIBEX business manager follows the project closely, with regular touch points, and formal project reviews with you and the client several times a year. You are not alone on an island: you have a peer on the same topics, an ENGIBEX technical network behind you, and the possibility to bring in additional ENGIBEX support when a topic needs it. What you will work on The scope grows with the demand. Today it covers three families of topics. Anomaly detection on test-bench data Transmissions are run through accelerated durability tests on dedicated test benches, instrumented with a large number of sensors. The goal is to detect a developing failure from the signals, early, while the test is still running. A model already exists and works offline on historical data. The current challenge is the step that nobody in the market seems to have taken on this kind of application: moving it online, so that it monitors a running test in real time, surfaces anomalies on a dashboard, and eventually raises alerts, without ever interfering with the test itself. That involves retraining on new transmission families, separating real anomalies from legitimate operational events, proving the accuracy to the test engineers who will rely on it, and then scaling it from one test bench to many. Internal LLM assistant The client runs an internal, retrieval-based assistant on their own technical documentation, used by several hundred engineers. It has no access to the internet and is fed entirely by internal documents. The work here is a mix of product and engineering: retrieval quality, document indexing, access management and permissions, new use cases requested by teams, deployment hygiene, and the unglamorous but decisive part, getting more people to actually use it. New AI tooling for the engineering teams This is the part that keeps growing, and where you will have the most freedom. Examples currently on the table: Comparing the requirements of a new programme against the history of past programmes, inside their requirements management platform, so that engineers stop rediscovering what was already decided. Predicting physical quantities in real time, such as component temperatures, from test or simulation data, to support calibration work. Applications around their simulation activities. You will not be handed a backlog of tickets. You scope the problem with the engineering teams, build the solution, deploy it, document it, and convince people to use it. Technical environment Language: Python, for everything. Data: sensor time series acquired with Vector CANape, stored in MF4, read in Python. Compute: an internal simulation cluster on Red Hat Linux with Slurm, plus a GPU workstation. Windows workstation with WSL for day to day work. Cloud: Azure for the LLM backbone. Reality check: the estate was built incrementally by different people over several years. Part of the job is to bring it to a proper engineering standard: a real …

items.desc: Facing the challenges of our time Help us grow and be more impactful! The Predictive Analytics group is offering a student project or internship to develop and validate an adaptive equipment-intelligence framework for semiconductor manufacturing using machine telemetry and high-frequency sensing. Using semiconductor die bonding as the experimental platform, the project will investigate whether acoustic emission and other sensor signals can provide robust information about equipment and process state across changing recipes and operating conditions. Machine-learning methods will be developed for: Quality prediction Anomaly detection and virtual metrology, with emphasis on generalization across recipes and operating conditions Uncertainty-aware adaptation using limited data from new process conditions The project will quantify which sensing modalities and signal representations remain informative under process changes and determine how much new data is required to adapt the monitoring system to a new operating regime. The project is intended for a minimum duration of six months and requires regular on-site work in Alpnach, Switzerland. Your Responsibilities Design and instrument an experimental setup for semiconductor die-bonding measurements. Exploration de l’utilisation des TSFMs pour la construction de surrogate models ou de world models. Analyse de la robustesse aux erreurs de mesure, aux dérives et aux changements de contexte. Définition de bonnes pratiques et recommandations pour l’utilisation des TSFMs dans les systèmes de gestion de l’énergie. items.card: YOUR TASKS Develop AI, data-driven, and environmental models to quantify groundwater–land–climate interactions and cascading impacts Utilize satellite Earth Observation, global datasets, and big-data analytics to assess environmental changes Publish research in leading peer-reviewed journals and present findings at scientific meetings and conferences Contribute to teaching and assist with other tasks as assigned by
items.desc: Research Associate (m/f/d) Institute for Geo-Hydroinformatics Remuneration EG 13 TV-L ID 27726WB9 Start of employment 01.01.2027 Application deadline 18.11.2026 Scopefull time and fixed term until 31.12.2030 The Institute of Geo-Hydroinformatics at Hamburg University of Technology (TUHH) is seeking a highly motivated PhD candidate to investigate groundwater dynamics and their interactions with land, climate, and environmental systems at regional to global scales. Groundwater is a critical component of the Earth system, supporting ecosystems, agriculture, and water security while interacting with land-surface and atmospheric processes. Increasing groundwater abstraction and climate pressure are, however, driving substantial changes in groundwater resources worldwide, with potentially far-reaching environmental consequences. The successful candidate will develop and apply advanced modeling and data-driven approaches to investigate groundwater variability and depletion and how these changes propagate through the terrestrial system. Potential research directions include interactions with land subsidence, soil moisture and evapotranspiration, vegetation dynamics, land-surface temperature, hydroclimatic extremes, and land degradation. The project will leverage artificial intelligence, satellite Earth Observation, global datasets, geospatial analysis, and environmental modeling to identify patterns, interactions, and potential critical thresholds in coupled groundwater–land–climate systems. YOUR TASKS Develop AI, data-driven, and environmental models to quantify groundwater–land–climate interactions and cascading impacts Utilize satellite Earth Observation, global datasets, and big-data analytics to assess environmental changes Publish research in leading peer-reviewed journals and present findings at scientific meetings and conferences Contribute to teaching and assist with other tasks as assigned by the Head of the Institute Collaborate with other universities and institutes through research visits YOUR PROFILE Requirements Completed scientific university studies (masters degree or equivalent), in particular environmental engineering, civil engineering, hydrology, ecohydrology, fluid mechanics, or a related field Desired knowledge and personal skills Proven experience in large-scale modeling, big data analytics, and satellite remote sensing Excellent communication skills in English (both oral and written) Commitment to international collaboration, teamwork, and student supervision, if required OUR OFFER Opportunity to obtain academic qualifications in the form of doctorate/opportunity for further academic qualification 30 day vacation per year (5-days a week) Good public transport connections Company pension scheme, capital-forming benefits Internal offers for health promotion and special conditions in gyms At the heart of TU Hamburg’s research, teaching and transfer of technology is the guiding principle of developing technology for people. The TU Hamburg sees itself in this context as a family-friendly and sustainable university with high performance and quality standards that strives for excellence in all its research fields. Interdisciplinarity, innovation, regionality and internationality are binding principles in our actions. With currently around 8.000 students, 110 professors and 1.650 employees, the TU Hamburg is characterised by short decision-making processes and close cooperation between the board, the institutes, the deans of studies, the research areas and the administration. We identify ourselves with a modern leadership culture and cultivate appreciative interaction. Note regarding the Standard Enquiry under Section 34a of the Hamburg Security Clearance Act: The department will submit an enquiry to the State Office for the Protection of the Constitution regarding any information it holds on the person selected in the recruitment process, provided that the legal requirements are met (information on the Standard Inquiry and data protection notices ). For further information please contact Eva Bayley, Phone: +49 40 30601 2871. We value diversity, therefore all applications are welcome, regardless of gender, gender identity, ethnic origin, nationality, age, religion and belief, disability, sexual orientation and identity or social background. The TU Hamburg stands for equal opportunities as well as appreciative and respectful cooperation. Notice for severely disabled persons and people with equal status. Please send your complete application documents (cover letter, curriculum vitae in table form, proof of completed training and/or university degree, job references or certificates of employment) via the online application system exclusively.

items.desc: Procuras dar um passo na tua carreira nas áreas de IT e Telecomunicações? Então chegaste ao sítio certo – à Smart! A tecnologia, a transformação e a inovação fazem parte do nosso ADN. Somos uma empresa de consultoria tecnológica com mais de 15 anos de experiência no desenvolvimento de soluções nacionais e internacionais em IT e Telecomunicações. Estamos à procura de um AI Engineer para integrar desafios tecnológicos relacionados com o desenvolvimento e implementação de soluções de Inteligência Artificial. Se tens experiência em desenvolvimento de software, Machine Learning e implementação de modelos de IA, queremos conhecer-te! O que vais fazer? Desenvolver e implementar soluções baseadas em Inteligência Artificial e Machine Learning. Conceber, treinar, testar e otimizar modelos de Machine Learning. Desenvolver aplicações e serviços utilizando Python e outras tecnologias de programação. Integrar modelos de IA em aplicações e sistemas existentes, através de APIs e outros serviços. Trabalhar com grandes volumes de dados para desenvolver e melhorar modelos inteligentes. Colaborar com equipas de Data Engineering, Data Science e Software Development. Monitorizar e avaliar o desempenho dos modelos, garantindo a sua fiabilidade, escalabilidade e eficiência. Contribuir para a evolução e melhoria contínua das soluções implementadas. O que procuramos? Formação superior em Engenharia Informática, Ciência de Dados, Matemática ou áreas similares. A partir dos 3 anos de experiência profissional em desenvolvimento de software, preferencialmente com Python. Experiência no desenvolvimento e implementação de soluções de Inteligência Artificial. Conhecimentos de Machine Learning e algoritmos de aprendizagem supervisionada e não supervisionada. Experiência com frameworks e bibliotecas como Scikit-learn, TensorFlow ou PyTorch. Conhecimentos de SQL e manipulação de dados. Experiência na integração de APIs e serviços. Conhecimentos de Git e boas práticas de desenvolvimento de software. Valorizamos também: Experiência com Deep Learning e Natural Language Processing (NLP). Conhecimentos de Cloud, nomeadamente Azure AI, AWS ou Google Cloud. Experiência com Docker, Kubernetes e CI/CD. Conhecimentos de MLOps e ferramentas como MLflow. Experiência com modelos de IA generativa e LLMs. O que oferecemos? Integração numa equipa tecnológica orientada para a inovação. Oportunidade de trabalhar com tecnologias emergentes de Inteligência Artificial. Acompanhamento próximo e possibilidade de evolução profissional. Participação em desafios tecnológicos com impacto real no negócio. Se procuras um novo desafio onde possas desenvolver soluções inteligentes e explorar o potencial da Inteligência Artificial, queremos conhecer-te! Envia-nos o teu CV!

items.desc: < Indietro AI Engineer Roma, RM, Italia Modalità Full Time Tipo di impiego Hybrid Requisiti Ogni progetto è diverso dal precedente. E la soluzione giusta raramente è la stessa. In Data-Driven.Ai stiamo portando l'intelligenza artificiale al centro dei nostri prodotti e processi e cerchiamo un/una AI Engineer che voglia costruirla con noi, dal primo prototipo alla produzione. Non partiamo dalla tecnologia ma dal problema: machine learning classico, deep learning, modelli linguistici o una combinazione di questi, applicati a testo, immagini, documenti, dati tabellari e serie temporali. Un ruolo in un team trasversale, con autonomia nelle scelte tecniche e un impatto diretto e visibile sui prodotti. Se ti incuriosisce l'AI nel suo insieme e ti diverte imparare qualcosa di nuovo a ogni progetto, o conosci qualcuno a cui succede, trovi l'annuncio completo qui sotto. Informazioni sull'offerta di lavoro Le aziende sono piene di dati e di informazioni destrutturate da cui spesso non riescono a trarre valore. Data-Driven.Ai sviluppa applicazioni «smart by design», con algoritmi in grado di produrre, aggregare e valorizzare i dati aziendali, e implementa dashboard e cruscotti decisionali per supportare con fatti concreti le scelte delle aziende. Data-Driven.Ai è alla ricerca di un/una AI Engineer , professionista con esperienza nello sviluppo di soluzioni di machine learning e AI, interessato/a a lavorare su progetti nati da esigenze di business molto diverse tra loro, che raramente si risolvono con lo stesso strumento. Entrerai a far parte di un team trasversale, dove ogni progetto è diverso dal precedente: il tuo compito sarà capire quale approccio funziona meglio, costruirlo e portarlo in produzione. Un'opportunità per lavorare su progetti sempre diversi, toccare con mano molte aree dell'AI e crescere come profilo completo. Ti Occuperai Di analizzare insieme al business e al prodotto i casi d'uso, valutando se e come l'AI può risolverli; scegliere l'approccio più adatto a ogni problema: modelli di machine learning classico, deep learning, modelli linguistici o una combinazione di questi; progettare, sviluppare e testare soluzioni AI end-to-end, dal prototipo rapido al servizio in produzione; lavorare con dati di natura diversa: testo, immagini, documenti, dati tabellari e serie temporali; integrare modelli e servizi AI, open source o di terze parti, in applicazioni, API e flussi aziendali esistenti; misurare la qualità delle soluzioni con metriche chiare e migliorarle nel tempo, curando affidabilità, costi e performance; tenerti aggiornato/a sull'evoluzione del settore e portare nel team nuove idee, strumenti e tecniche; collaborare con sviluppatori, data scientist e figure di prodotto, condividendo conoscenza e documentando il lavoro. Cosa cerchiamo? Cerchiamo persone con solide basi di machine learning, almeno un progetto AI portato in produzione e la curiosità di affrontare problemi nuovi senza una soluzione già scritta. In Particolare, Valutiamo laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria, Matematica, Fisica o discipline affini, oppure esperienza equivalente; [3+] anni di esperienza nello sviluppo di soluzioni di machine learning o AI, con almeno un progetto arrivato in produzione; ottima conoscenza di Python e dell'ecosistema per dati e ML (ad es. NumPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras); solide basi di machine learning: come si addestra, valuta e confronta un modello, e quando un approccio semplice è sufficiente; esperienza pratica con più di una famiglia di tecniche AI e capacità di passare dall'una all'altra in base al problema; familiarità con le buone pratiche di sviluppo software: Git, testing, API, container (Docker); capacità di spiegare le scelte tecniche anche a persone non tecniche; buona conoscenza dell'inglese tecnico, curiosità e autonomia. Costituiscono Un Plus esperienza con almeno un cloud provider (AWS, Azure o GCP) e con i relativi servizi AI; conoscenza di pratiche MLOps: versionamento di dati e modelli, monitoraggio, pipeline di deploy; contributi a progetti open source, side project o partecipazione a competizioni (ad es. Kaggle); esperienza in contesti in cui si lavora su più progetti in parallelo. Se non soddisfi tutti i requisiti ma il ruolo ti incuriosisce, candidati comunque: ci interessano soprattutto la curiosità e la voglia di imparare. items.desc: Cześć! W Wirtualnej Polsce wierzymy, że nie ma jednej drogi do sukcesu - liczy się to, co wniesiesz i jak będziesz działać. Kreatywność, odwaga i innowacyjność to nasze DNA. Działamy w obszarach mediów, reklamy i e-commerce, łącząc te elementy w sposób, który angażuje i inspiruje. Tworzymy, testujemy, wprowadzamy zmiany tam, gdzie mają sens. Budujemy rzeczy od zera i szukamy nowych rozwiązań. Nad czym pracuje nasz zespół? Ile warto zapłacić za wyświetlenie reklamy? Nasze modele odpowiadają na to pytanie miliardy razy dziennie. Budujemy mózg biddera RTB, który kupuje powierzchnię reklamową dla klientów e-commerce. Pracujemy w skali, która robi wrażenie: setki tysięcy zapytań na sekundę, dziesiątki miliardów decyzji ML dziennie, a cały proces inferencji musi zmieścić się w kilkudziesięciu milisekundach. To jeden z kluczowych produktów reklamowych WP, więc jakość Twoich modeli przekłada się na przychody i marżę. Jako Data Scientist masz pełny ownership: od postawienia hipotezy i analizy danych, przez trening modeli i testy A/B, po wdrożenie na produkcję i monitoring. Sam prowadzisz swój projekt od początku do końca bez przekazywania go dalej i czekania na efekty. Mierzymy się z trudnymi problemami z obszaru real-time ML, optymalizacji i statystyki, a narzędzia AI są naturalną częścią naszego codziennego warsztatu. Jeśli zależy Ci na realnym wpływie na produkt działający w dużej skali, to miejsce dla Ciebie! Jakie działania będą należeć do Ciebie? Projektowanie i wdrażanie modeli ML rozwiązujących problemy biznesowe (predykcja, ranking, modelowanie zachowań użytkowników). Tworzenie i wdrażanie algorytmów optymalizacyjnych oraz rekomendacyjnych (np. ustalanie stawek w aukcjach, alokacja budżetów, personalizacja treści), wprost przekładających się na kluczowe wskaźniki biznesowe (np. eCPM, CTR, przychód, LTV, zaangażowanie czytelników). Udział w projektach badawczo-rozwojowych (R&D) – sprawdzanie nowych metod ML/AI (np. modele sekwencyjne, LLM, RL), testowanie hipotez i przenoszenie najlepszych pomysłów na produkcję. Projektowanie i analiza testów A/B na ruchu produkcyjnym, umożliwiających precyzyjną ocenę wpływu modeli na biznes. Współpraca z zespołami inżynierskimi, produktowymi i biznesowymi oraz dzielenie się wiedzą w zespole. Jakie kompetencje są dla nas ważne? Minimum 3 lata doświadczenia komercyjnego w budowaniu modeli ML i wdrażaniu ich na produkcję jako Data Scientist, ML Engineer lub na podobnym stanowisku. Bardzo dobra znajomość Pythona i narzędzi takich jak PyTorch, LightGBM, XGBoost czy Polars. Umiejętność pisania czytelnego kodu i testów oraz doświadczenie w pracy z Gitem i w przeprowadzaniu code review. Doświadczenie w pracy z dużymi zbiorami danych z wykorzystaniem SQL (np. w ClickHouse lub StarRocks) oraz Apache Spark, PySpark lub podobnych narzędzi. Solidne podstawy z zakresu rachunku prawdopodobieństwa, statystyki i optymalizacji, zdobyte np. na studiach matematycznych, fizycznych, informatycznych lub pokrewnych. Umiejętność samodzielnego przekładania problemów biznesowych na zadania ML i jasnego przedstawiania wyników także osobom nietechnicznym. Znajomość języka angielskiego na poziomie B2, pozwalająca swobodnie korzystać z dokumentacji technicznej i publikacji naukowych. Mile widziane: Domena: AdTech/RTB (np. OpenRTB, DSP/SSP, Prebid/GAM) lub personalizacja na dużą skalę w mediach, e-commerce albo FinTechu. Rekomendacje i deep learning: modele sekwencyjne, retrieval i ranking, LLM. Metody decyzyjne: wnioskowanie przyczynowe (uplift, testy inkrementalności), bandyci kontekstowi, RL lub teoria aukcji. Produkcja ML: serving o niskich opóźnieniach (np. C++, ONNX, TensorRT, Triton Inference Server – wystarczy jedna z tych technologii) lub MLOps (Docker/Kubernetes, MLflow, Iceberg/Delta Lake, chmura). Badania: publikacje, open source z zakresu ML lub doktorat (także w trakcie). Co zyskujesz, dołączając do WP? Pracę u technologicznego lidera i partnera pierwszego wyboru – tworzymy treści, usługi i rozrywkę, które towarzyszą milionom Polaków każdego dnia Darmowy dostęp do naszych produktów, takich jak Pilot WP czy Audioteka -chcemy, żebyś czuł się częścią tego, co tworzymy ❤️ Worksmile i elastyczny pakiet benefitów - to Ty wybierasz, co jest dla Ciebie ważne Dostęp do bezpłatnych i anonimowych konsultacji psychologicznych Możliwość pracy hybrydowej - pracujemy 3 dni w biurze oraz 2 dni z domu łącząc swobodę pracy zdalnej z tym, co najlepsze w biurze Wydarzenia, które zbliżają - od sezonowych akcji (Dzień Dziecka to nasz ulubieniec!) po webinary o zdrowiu i neuroróżnorodności Możliwość rozwoju dzięki szkoleniom w ramach programu WP Akademia Szansę na nowe wyzwania i kierunki w ramach spółek WP Holding - wewnętrzne rekrutacje są na wyciągnięcie ręki

items.desc:
Lieu : Valence, France 
 Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance 
 Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​
 Nos engagements, vos avantages 
 Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée
 Un package de rémunération attractif
 Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes
 Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l’équilibre des collaborateurs
 Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu
 Votre quotidien 
En nous rejoignant à Valence, vous intégrez le centre de gravité mondial de nos activités avioniques hélicoptères. Il abrite également nos activités de services numériques. 
 Au sein du Centre de Compétences Systèmes Aéronautiques et Spécialités de la division Avionique de Vol (FLX), le poste est rattaché au département « Traitement du signal et Automatique ».
 Le département est en charge de la maitrise fonctionnelle des produits du type "capteurs de navigation" : on parle ici de capteurs (accéléromètres, gyromètres), de centrales de navigation (IRS) et de récepteurs GNSS (GPS, GALILEO, etc.).
 Ces produits offrent d'importantes perspectives de croissance, tirées notamment par :
 - La nécessité d'offrir aux aéronefs d'aujourd'hui et de demain des équipements embarqués toujours plus fiables, robustes et sécurisées, même dans des environnements complexes et contraints
 - L'orientation du marché vers des équipements plus compacts, plus digitaux, et dotés de fonctionnalités intelligentes, qui mènent à repenser les architectures matérielles et logicielles ainsi que les méthodes de conception.
 Intégré(e) à une équipe expérimentée et pluridisciplinaire, dont le mot d'ordre est la maîtrise technique des produits, vous participerez aux études fonctionnelles et au développement des équipements qui constituent le socle de nos solutions dans le domaine de la Navigation et ses capteurs de haute technologie.
 Le poste est basé à Valence (26), avec un travail en lien étroit avec les équipes réparties sur plusieurs sites (Valence, Châtellerault, Vendôme). Cette organisation implique des interfaces régulières, en présentiel (déplacements ponctuels) ou en distanciel, entre les différentes équipes.
 Le poste offre une flexibilité en matière de télétravail, permettant au candidat de travailler à distance selon un accord établi avec l’équipe projet et le responsable du département.
 Intégré à nos projets de développement, vos missions seront principalement axées sur la maturité technique des produits CAPTEURS :
 1) Vous participez à la définition, à la conception, ainsi qu’à la réalisation d’études et de simulations dans des domaines tels que la navigation inertielle, le GNSS, ou encore l’antibrouillage.
 2) Vous établissez les dossiers justificatifs des conceptions des produits attestant de la tenue « prédictive » des performances des produits (par analyse et/ou simulations rigoureuses).
 3) Par votre maîtrise technique, vous êtes l'interlocuteur privilégié des ingénieurs produits, électroniques et logiciels. A ce titre, vous les accompagnez tout au long des phases de mise au point, d’intégration continue, de vérification des performances ainsi que dans les conduites des Analyses de Causes Racines (RCA).
 4) Vous communiquez régulièrement sur l’avancement des projets, identifiez les risques et proposez les actions correctives nécessaires.
 5) Vous contribuez activement au développement des compétences en «Traitement du signal et Automatique» en participant à l’amélioration continue des pratiques et à l’enrichissement des savoir-faire de l’équipe. L’esprit d’initiative et l’engagement sont des qualités essentielles pour réussir dans ce poste.
 Pour exercer ces missions, vous pourrez vous appuyer sur les pairs du domaine présents au sein du service qui vous permettront d'acquérir progressivement votre autonomie sur les designs confiés.

items.desc:
Isomorphic Labs is applying frontier AI to help unlock deeper scientific insights, faster breakthroughs, and life-changing medicines with an ambition to solve all disease.
 The future is coming. A future enabled and enriched by the incredible power of machine learning. A future in which diseases are curtailed or cured starting with better and faster drug discovery. 
 Come and be part of an interdisciplinary team driving groundbreaking innovation and play a meaningful role in contributing towards us achieving our ambitious goals, while being a part of an inspiring and collaborative culture.
 The world we want tomorrow is the one we’re building today. It starts with the culture at this company. It starts with you. 
 About Iso 
 Isomorphic Labs (IsoLabs) was launched in 2021 to advance human health by building on and beyond the Nobel-winning AlphaFold system. Since then, our interdisciplinary team of drug discovery experts and machine learning specialists has built powerful new predictive and generative AI models that accelerate scientific discovery at digital speed.
 Our name comes from the belief that there is an underlying symmetry between biology and information science. By harnessing AI’s powerful capabilities, we can use it to model complex biological phenomena to help design novel molecules, anticipate how drugs will perform and develop innovative medicines to treat and cure some of the world’s most devastating diseases.
 We have built a world-leading drug design engine comprising AI models that are capable of working across multiple therapeutic areas and drug modalities. We are continually innovating on model architecture and developing cutting-edge capabilities to advance rational drug design.
 Every day, and with each new breakthrough, we’re getting closer to the promise of digital biology, and achieving our ambitious mission to one day solve all disease with the help of AI.
 Your Impact 
 You will join our newly formed Scheduling team to own and extend the systems that orchestrate compute allocation to complex machine learning workloads running on Kubernetes. You will be responsible for optimizing our compute footprint, ensuring that dynamic batch inference and large-scale training runs are scheduled reliably and efficiently.
 We are looking for an engineer who operates comfortably at the intersection of distributed systems and modern ML infrastructure. You will design systems that support large-scale, topology-sensitive workloads, optimize batch queuing frameworks and write custom Kubernetes controllers. items.card: You will join the AI & Technology Foresight unit within Business Area Networks. We are a community of nearly 400 researchers based across our main sites in Kista, Lund, and Paris. Our strength is the breadth of expertise we bring together: the
items.desc:
Join our Team
 Shape the future of sensing and wireless communication 
 What if the next generation of mobile networks could do more than connect people and devices? What if they could also sense, interpret, and understand the world around them?
At Ericsson, we are turning that vision into reality through Integrated Sensing and Communication (ISAC) research. Join us as a researcher and help develop the sensing and tracking technologies that will influence future 5G and 6G radio networks.
 About the Opportunity 
You will join the AI & Technology Foresight unit within Business Area Networks. We explore what comes next across Ericsson’s full technology portfolio—from antennas and radio systems to cloud, and turn promising ideas into real-world solutions. We are a community of nearly 400 researchers based across our main sites in Kista, Lund, and Paris. Our strength is the breadth of expertise we bring together: the capabilities to research, prototype, and build state-of-the-art mobile networks.
Within this environment, you will collaborate with experienced researchers and product teams to prove new concepts, challenge established thinking, and help set the direction for future radio network products. You will be part of Ericsson’s Integrated Sensing and Communication research program, where we research, develop, and validate advanced ISAC systems for 5G and 6G. You will work with one of the world’s most experienced teams in this field, contributing to research that connects theory, experimentation, and product development. Your work will focus on radar sensing, signal processing, and tracking in challenging environments; including dense urban areas and complex sea-clutter scenarios.
 What you will do 
• Conduct research in radar sensing, signal processing, detection, and tracking algorithms.
• Develop simulations and generate data for synthetic use cases focused on urban environments.
• Investigate methods for robust radar sensing and tracking in challenging urban scenarios.
• Explore extended-object radar trackers suitable for dense urban environments.
• Develop algorithms for tracking sea objects in the presence of dense sea clutter.
• Collaborate with product teams to integrate research results into Ericsson products in an efficient and optimized way.
• Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies in sensing design and wireless communication.
• Generate intellectual property in the ISAC area.
• Share knowledge and communicate results with stakeholders across research and product development.
 Skills you bring 
 • A recently completed PhD, or equivalent research experience, focused on radar detection pipelines, signal processing, or related fields.
• Strong understanding of radar sensing and the characteristics of different sensors, including sensor artefacts such as phase noise.
• Practical experience working with environmental clutter, with hands-on knowledge of sea clutter considered essential.
• Working knowledge of data fusion and end-to-end tracking pipelines.
• Experience developing and evaluating both point-object and extended-object tracking algorithms.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to connect theoretical research to practical prototypes and product solutions.
• A passion for innovation, curiosity to explore new approaches, and the confidence to turn ideas into demonstrable results.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the personal drive to challenge ideas respectfully, work across diverse teams, and deliver results.
 What happens once you apply? Click Here to find all you need to know about what our typical hiring process looks like.We encourage you to consider applying to jobs where you might not meet all the criteria. We recognize that we all have transferrable skills, and we can support you with the skills that you need to develop.Encouraging a diverse and inclusive organization is core to our values at Ericsson, that's why we champion it in everything we do. We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.

items.desc:
Your contribution to something big: 
You will contribute to an industrial research project focused on the development and optimization of heat pump systems. You will combine machine learning, data analysis, modelling, and experimental testing to develop predictive models based on experimental and field data, supporting the characterization and optimization of key parameters of the heat pump refrigeration cycle. Your main responsibilities will be: 
 Machine Learning Development: Develop, evaluate, and improve machine learning models using experimental and field data from heat pump systems. 
 Data Analysis & Modelling: Analyse data, model and simulate dynamic systems, and develop numerical approaches to address complex engineering problems. 
 Heat Pump Optimization: Support the development and optimization of refrigeration cycles and heat pump systems using data-driven and model-based approaches. 
 Predictive Models: Apply data-based methods to improve model-based concepts and support the analysis and optimization of constrained linear and nonlinear systems. 
 Experimental Testing & Data Acquisition: Define and prepare experimental data acquisition systems, conduct tests, and analyse the resulting data to support model development and engineering decisions. 
 Test Planning: Define and prepare structured test plans to generate high-quality experimental data for predictive model development and improvement. 
 Field Data Analysis: Use available field data to analyse heat pump performance and support the optimization of control parameters. 
 Machine Learning Assessment: Investigate the benefits, limitations, and risks of machine learning models, including their potential to reduce testing effort and support heat pump development.
What distinguishes you: 
 Education: University degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a comparable technical field. 
 Machine Learning: Good understanding of machine learning models and data-driven engineering methods, with the ability to apply them to engineering problems. 
 Programming: Good programming skills in Python and/or MATLAB for data analysis, modelling, simulation, or machine learning applications. 
 Modelling & Simulation: Understanding of dynamic systems, numerical modelling, and simulation, with the ability to analyse complex engineering problems using model-based and data-driven approaches. 
 Data Analysis: Experience working with experimental and/or field data, including data processing, analysis, and interpretation. 
 Testing & Experimentation: Understanding of testing methodologies and data acquisition, with the ability to prepare test plans and support experimental activities. 
 Digital Tools: Good knowledge of Microsoft Office tools, particularly Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and OneNote. Experience with MATLAB and/or Simulink in engineering or laboratory environments. 
 Problem Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a results-oriented mindset and attention to detail. 
 Working Style: Proactive and responsible, with the ability to independently organize your work, take ownership of assigned activities, and propose solutions. 
 Teamwork & Communication: Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a collaborative and Agile environment. 
 Languages: Excellent written and spoken English.

items.desc: Das AIT Austrian Institute of Technology ist Österreichs größte Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) . Unser Ziel ist es, wissenschaftliche Exzellenz in Innovation mit Wirkung zu verwandeln. Unsere internationalen Teams verbinden Spitzenforschung mit hoher Umsetzungskompetenz und schaffen messbaren Nutzen für Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft. Die Competence Unit Transformation Governance im Center for Innovation Systems and Policy befasst sich mit aktuellen und zukünftigen Anforderungen an Forschungs- und Innovationssystemen, sowie mit den Handlungsoptionen, die sich hieraus für die Forschungs-, Technologie- und Innovationspolitik und ihre Akteure ergeben. Wir konzentrieren uns einerseits auf Prozesse des Systemwandels („Transformation“) in Bereichen wie KI, Energie und Mobilität und andererseits auf potenziell disruptive Technologien und ihre möglichen Auswirkungen, insbesondere im Zusammenhang mit Digitalisierung und Dekarbonisierung von Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft. Dabei geht es auch um die Stärkung von Akteuren in den Sektoren öffentliche Verwaltung, Wirtschaft, Infrastruktur und Wissenschaft. Für den Standort Wien (Giefinggasse, 1210) suchen wir eine:n: Junior Scientist (w/m/d) AI Governance (Teilzeit: 25-30 h / Woche) CENTER FOR INNOVATION SYSTEMS & POLICY Sie arbeiten gemeinsam mit dem interdisziplinären KI Ethik- und Governance Lab an innovationspolitischen Fragestellungen im Kontext der Transformation von Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft , insbesondere an Themen der KI Governance. Sie wirken zunächst insbesondere im Kontext der AI:AT AI Factory Austria am Aufbau und an der Umsetzung der AI Governance Sie begleiten gemeinsam mit der AIT AI Taskforce den Aufbau und die Weiterentwicklung des neuen AIT AI Ethik Boards. items.desc: About the role: Join the Machine Learning department at Quantum Systems and contribute to autonomy and perception functions for our unmanned vehicles across air, land and sea domains. During this 12-month internship, you will work with experienced engineers on practical machine learning projects—from preparing sensor data, training and evaluating cutting-edge supervised models and improving the workflows on the cloud that bring our functions into real systems. Your project focus will depend on your interests, skills, and the team’s priorities. What is your Day to Day Mission: Our machine learning pipeline offers different internship areas of expertise including, but not limited to: Prepare, inspect, and curate datasets from cameras, LiDAR, telemetry, and other sensor sources. Support the development, training, and evaluation of machine learning and computer vision models. Help test and improve models for deployment on resource-constrained embedded systems. Contribute to reproducible training and evaluation workflows, including data and model tracking. Analyze results, document experiments, and share findings with colleagues across machine learning tasks, hardware, testing, and operations. Manage and extend our cloud services to automate and accelerate machine learning development. Develop and integrate AI agents that automate and streamline employee workflows across the development lifecycle. Improve the reliability, monitoring, security, and cost efficiency of our ML infrastructure. What you bring to the team: You are currently studying computer science, artificial intelligence, data science, or a related engineering subject, and are looking for a 12-month internship. You already have practical experience in machine learning and are interested in applying them to real-world systems. You can write Python and have used it for coursework, personal projects, or research. You are curious, analytical, and comfortable learning new tools and working through technical problems with a team. You communicate confidently in English and are able to explain your work and discuss ideas with colleagues. It is a plus if you have: Worked with a deep learning framework such as PyTorch or explored computer vision. Used Git and Linux, or worked with Docker, Kubernetes, cloud platforms, or GPU-based training. Handled image, geospatial, LiDAR, or other sensor data, or have an interest in simulation and synthetic data. Why Quantum-Systems: We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus. We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary. We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data. We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth. Our benefits: Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance. Mobile working: If it gets too turbulent for you in our office, you can get the necessary balance through mobile working. Stay active: With EGYM Wellpass, you get access to thousands of fitness and sports facilities — and of course, we subsidize the membership. Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia. Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together. Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored. Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Laim in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday. About us: Quantum Systems is a leading European deep-tech company for unmanned systems across air, land and maritime domains. We develop and scale integrated hardware, software and AI-powered solutions for mission-critical operations. By combining autonomous platforms with intelligent software and AI, Quantum Systems enables customers to operate, understand and act across domains. Our commitment: We are an open-minded company that not only values diversity, but actively promotes it. Regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation or disability, we firmly believe that the diversity of our employees is an essential part of our success. At our company, every voice is heard and every perspective is valued. We believe that our differences enrich us and help us to find creative solutions and generate innovative ideas. We pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment where all employees can reach their full potential.
