items.desc: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the Role As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained — both on the job and through formal programs led by a world-class Sales team — to take on your next role as a closing Account Executive. On a daily basis, you will build and work a portfolio of target accounts for our EMEA business in France: researching each account for commercial signal, prioritising which contacts to approach and in what order, and running a connected, multi-touch outbound motion that generates qualified pipeline rather than one-off meetings. This is a remote position open to candidates based in France and the United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CET. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role. You should apply if: You want to impact the industries that run our world: your efforts will result in real-world impact — helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and ensure workers return home safely. You are the architect of your own career: if you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less. You're excited by AI: you'll use cutting-edge AI tools every day and sell some of the most advanced AI in the physical operations space. You think several moves ahead: you'd rather build a real relationship across an account than force a single contact to a decision they're not ready to make. You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: one day you'll be researching a transport operator, the next a food distribution centre. Our best reps dig into the businesses they support to make a sharper case for why Samsara matters to them specifically. You treat rejection as a learning experience: in this role you will get hung up on and told no. You need the resilience to prepare, call again, and adjust. You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go further than you have before. In this role, you will: Research target accounts before outreach — pulling commercial signal out of public information (financials, news, hiring activity, compliance or safety pressure) to build a specific, defensible point of view on where Samsara adds value. Build and prioritise an account-level contact plan, identifying who to approach first across a range of stakeholders (e.g. MD, Operations/Transport Manager, Compliance/H&S, Finance) and being able to justify that choice. Run a connected, multi-touch outbound motion across phone, email and LinkedIn — using early conversations to gather information and multi-thread the account, not just to book a meeting at any cost. Read what a contact gives you on the call and adapt in real time — including recognising when the right move is to gather information and position a follow-up with someone else, rather than push for a meeting the contact can't actually commit to. items.desc: About the Role As a Prediction Model Expert, you bring deep expertise in AI forecasting, software development in Python, backed by a dissertation on prediction models or time series forecasting. You have hands-on experience with foundation models for forecasting, multi-modal prediction frameworks (can be across disciplines like medicine), cloud environments. You excel at building production-grade prediction engines that detect anomalies, forecast threats, and power proactive threat detection logic at compute scale. You will be one of Haste's first senior AI researchers pioneering prediction models that anticipate stealthy threats across HPC clusters, AI and quantum workloads before they strike. Key Responsibilities Predictive Model Development & Engineering: Designing, building, and deploying Machine Learning (ML) and Foundation models to forecast potential security breaches. Anomaly Detection & Behavior Analysis: Establishing "normal" baselines and flagging deviations that indicate malicious behaviour together with our security experts and research teams. Threat Intelligence & Forecasting: Analyzing historical data, threat intelligence feeds, to extract and predict future attack trends, emerging vulnerabilities, and malicious campaigns. Vulnerability & Risk Assessment: Scoring and prioritizing security vulnerabilities (e.g., predicting which CVSS vulnerabilities are most likely to be exploited) to guide risk-based view. Data Pipeline Construction: Managing the full lifecycle of data, including gathering, cleaning, and processing vast amounts of diverse data sources like network logs, indicators of compromise, and threat intel. Model Optimization & Maintenance: Continuously refining algorithms, hyperparameter tuning, and adapting models to combat "model drift" as attacker tactics evolve. Collaboration & Communication: Translating complex mathematical models into actionable insights, and producing research reports, white papers, or conference presentations. Why Join Haste? If you’ve ever wanted to build the world’s fastest threat detection and hunting platform for the future of compute, this is the place for you. If you want to build technology that pushes the boundaries of cybersecurity for HPC, AI, and quantum environments, this is where you’ll do the most meaningful work of your career. From detecting AI model poisoning mid-training to hunting quantum side-channel leaks and nation-state IP theft in HPC clusters. Haste mirrors the complexity of high-stakes compute infrastructure—HPC supercomputers, trillion-parameter AI workloads, quantum computers, and enterprise infrastructure—letting security teams detect, hunt, and analyze only relevant threats lightning fast. We are a EU funded, fast-growing cybersecurity startup securing compute for governments, research labs, and Fortune 500 enterprises. Our mission is to secure every compute-intensive workload from AI training to quantum simulations—revolutionizing cyber defense. What It's Like Working With Us Impact from day one: Your work shapes how we protect current and future infrastructure. Top Tier-experts: Join security veterans solving globally unique problems in threat detection for the future of compute. Fully remote, real ownership: We care about results, not clock-in times. Location: Remote (within Europe)

items.desc: About the Role You will be responsible for developing and deploying key autonomy functions within our interceptor platform, focusing on Guidance, Navigation & Target Tracking, or Control. From algorithm development and system integration to flight testing and field debugging, you will help deliver reliable autonomous capabilities in demanding operational environments. What is your Day to Day Mission: Depending on your background and expertise, your primary focus will be in Guidance, Navigation, or Control . You will take ownership of one of these areas while working closely with engineers across the broader GNC stack to deliver a reliable autonomous interceptor system. Guidance: Develop and deploy guidance algorithms that convert mission objectives and estimated vehicle and target states/predictions into feasible control commands. Develop predictive approaches that account for target motion and maneuvers. Navigation & Target Tracking: Develop and integrate state-estimation, sensor-fusion, and target-approaches that provide reliable states and short-horizon predictions, including sensor fusion and uncertainty modeling. Control: Develop and tune flight-control algorithms that translate guidance commands into stable, responsive, and feasible aircraft behavior across the operating envelope. Across all three focus areas, you will: Integration: Integrate algorithms with perception, flight-control, simulation, and operator systems through ROS 2, MAVLink, and related interfaces. Benchmarking and Validation: Validate performance through simulation, recorded-data replay, SITL/HITL, and flight testing. Field Debugging: Analyze real logs, reproduce failures, isolate root causes, and improve the system until it works not only on your machine, but in the field. What You Bring to the Team You’re structured, fast-moving, and a team player. You iterate fast and work with a high degree of autonomy. You love building things that last and analyze and fix root cause problems over applying short-term patches. Degree in robotics, aerospace, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, applied mathematics, computer vision, or a comparable technical field. Several years of hands-on experience in the field. We also consider relevant experience gained through student clubs, internships, or working-student positions. Strong fundamentals in guidance, control, vehicle kinematics and dynamics, state estimation, optimization, and dynamical systems, with deep expertise in at least one of these areas. Strong implementation skills in C++ or Rust and experience with ROS 2. Good understanding of coordinate frames, quaternions, NED/ENU conventions, timing, and filtering. Experience with interception or predictive guidance, PID or model-based control, trajectory optimization, or model-predictive approaches. Experience with PX4, ArduPilot, MAVLink, or similar flight-control ecosystems. Experience with system identification, flight-dynamics modeling, target tracking, or GNSS-denied navigation. Experience with simulation, SITL/HITL, flight-log analysis, structured flight testing, or multi-vehicle autonomy. Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you dont meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points. Why Join Quantum-Systems? Be at the forefront of next-generation Defence innovation . Work in a fast-paced, agile environment where your ideas make an impact. Collaborate with a team of industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary. Opportunities for individual and professional growth in a globally recognized organization. About us: Quantum Systems specializes in the development, design, and production of small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUAS). The company’s range of electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) sUAS are built to maximize range and versatility and to provide operators with a seamless user experience. By integrating cutting-edge software capabilities, like edge computing and real-time AI-powered data processing, Quantum Systems is building next-generation UAS for clients in the defense, security, and public sectors. How to Apply Please include as your cover letter: A detailed description of your hands-on projects , including photos, GitHub links, and videos, drawings.

items.desc: About the Role As an HPC Security Researcher, you bring deep expertise in high-performance computing, software development in C/C++ or Rust/Python, backed by a minimum MSc in HPC, Scientific Computing, or related discipline. You have hands-on experience with SLURM, AI workloads, advanced algorithms, parallel computer architectures, Linux, network protocols in high performance computing. You excel at modeling HPC threats— resource exhaustion, lateral movement across compute nodes, Slurm exploits—and translating them into practical security defenses. You will be one of Haste's first HPC security researchers pioneering defenses for supercomputing clusters alongside AI and quantum workloads. Key Responsibilities Investigating Threat Actors & Attack Vectors: Identifying, analyzing, and documenting threats targeting HPC systems and ecosystem trends and developments. Developing Defenses and Mitigations: Designing detection logic and mitigation methods for HPC-specific threats that do not significantly degrade performance. Security Modeling: Developing threat models for HPC infrastructures with Cyber threat intelligence input in adjacent technologies to predict potential attack paths. Developing HPC-Specific Detection Rules: Authoring custom security rules for monitoring tools (e.g., SLURM, PBS) to detect abnormal user behavior, such as suspicious logins, resource usage, and data transfers. Engineering Collaboration - Translating HPC security research into production-grade detection requirements for Haste's threat engine and HPC integration. Documentation & Reporting- Creating technical reports, whitepapers, and proof-of-concept exploits to document vulnerabilities and share findings within the organization, to the public or conferences. Securing Heterogeneous Environments: Designing security for complex, hybrid platforms integrating cloud, AI/ML workflows, and on-premise, bare-metal hardware. Requirements University degree in a relevant field. Current residence in Germany or Austria. Full-time availability from December 1, 2026, remote from Germany or Austria only. experience with SLURM

En tant que Junior Business Analyst, vous faites le lien entre le terrain et les solutions digitales. Vous comprenez les besoins des équipes opérationnelles, vous les traduisez en solutions concrètes (outils, automatisations, tableaux de bord, cas d’usage IA) et vous veillez à ce qu’elles soient vraiment adoptées. Vous êtes rattaché au Managing Director et travaillez en transverse dans les entités opérationnelles et les fonctions support. Vous contribuez ainsi à la performance opérationnelle, à la cohérence des pratiques et à la fiabilité des données, dans un environnement industriel structuré. Le Studio IA Le Studio IA est une équipe agile, créée pour accélérer la transformation digitale du groupe. Nous : identifions les tâches à faible valeur ajoutée qui peuvent être automatisées ou assistées par l’IA ; concevons et déployons des outils simples, utiles et adoptés par les équipes ; fédérons et fiabilisons les données dispersées pour mieux piloter l’activité ; testons rapidement, mesurons l’impact et industrialisons ce qui fonctionne. Vous arrivez dans une équipe à taille humaine, où chacun compte, où les idées circulent vite et où vous apprendrez au contact direct des projets. Votre mission Comprendre en profondeur les métiers et les processus opérationnels. Transformer les besoins des équipes en solutions digitales concrètes et pragmatiques. Identifier les opportunités d’automatisation et d’usage de l’IA. Contribuer à la fiabilité des données et au pilotage par les KPI. Garantir l’adoption réelle des outils et des nouveaux standards sur le terrain. Vos responsabilités principales 1) Analyse des besoins et des processus Aller sur le terrain, observer et interviewer les utilisateurs pour comprendre leurs pratiques et leurs difficultés. Cartographier les processus existants (as-is) et proposer des processus cibles (to-be). Identifier les écarts entre les processus définis et les pratiques réelles. Rédiger les besoins fonctionnels (user stories, spécifications, critères d’acceptation). 2) Studio IA : automatisation et cas d’usage Détecter, qualifier et prioriser les cas d’usage IA et d’automatisation avec les équipes métier. Conception, développement, tests et déploiement des solutions (IA générative, automatisation de tâches, low-code, scripts…). Mesurer les gains obtenus (temps, qualité, fiabilité) et partager les résultats. Assurer une veille sur les outils et les bonnes pratiques IA. 3) Data opérationnelle et pilotage Contribuer à la qualité, à la fiabilité et à la cohérence des données opérationnelles. Assurer le suivi et la mise à jour des KPI. Participer au développement et à la maintenance des tableaux de bord (Power BI ou équivalent). Aider la Direction et les équipes à exploiter les données pour la prise de décision. 4) Documentation, déploiement et accompagnement du changement Structurer et maintenir la documentation opérationnelle (intranet, DocLab ou équivalent) : procédures, instructions, modes opératoires. Former et accompagner les utilisateurs dans la prise en main des nouveaux outils et processus. Suivre l’adoption sur le terrain et ajuster les solutions selon les retours. Votre profil Diplôme de niveau Master (ingénieur, gestion, business analysis, data, informatique de gestion). Une première expérience (stage, alternance, premier emploi) en contexte industriel ou opérationnel est un plus. Intérêt marqué pour l’IA, l’automatisation et la transformation digitale. Sensibilité à la qualité, à la sécurité ou à l’amélioration continue. Prérequis (must-have) Très bonne maîtrise des outils digitaux et des données : Excel avancé, Power BI ou Tableau. Capacité d’analyse et de synthèse, esprit structuré, pragmatique et orienté solutions. Notions de développement ou d’automatisation (Python, VBA, Power Automate, SQL, low-code…). Aisance relationnelle pour dialoguer aussi bien avec les équipes terrain qu’avec le management. Autonomie, curiosité et rigueur. Usage concret des outils d’IA générative pour automatiser des tâches. Atouts Connaissance des méthodes de modélisation de processus (BPMN) ou des méthodes agiles. Capacité à « vendre » une solution sans l’imposer. Sensibilité aux enjeux QSE/HSE. Notre offre Un rôle à fort impact, au cœur d’une équipe IA naissante, où vous verrez concrètement le résultat de votre travail. Vous aurez une vraie autonomie, sans micro-management, et une vision transverse de l’entreprise. Vous évoluerez dans un domaine en pleine croissance (data, IA et digitalisation), avec un accompagnement pour monter rapidement en compétences. Un contrat à durée indéterminée. Un salaire en adéquation avec vos connaissances et votre expérience. Un package salarial complet : chèques-repas, assurance groupe, assurance hospitalisation, éco-chèques, ordinateur portable, smartphone avec …

items.desc: Op deze pagina: Dit ga je doen Dit krijg je Dit bieden we nog meer Dit vragen wij Hier kom je te werken Bijzonderheden Stel gerust je vraag Dit ga je doen Het antwoord op die vraag is een inkoppertje. Want ons Traineeship draait maar om één ding: dat jij je talenten als professional maximaal ontwikkelt en inzet! We halen alles uit de kast, met een programma op maat van jou! In twee jaar tijd krijg je volop de kans om kennis en ervaring op te doen en je soft skills te vergroten. Als IT-trainee data engineer bij IVO Rechtspraak werk je vanuit het IVO Datalab. Jij helpt dataproducten en -analyses te ontwikkelen en rechters en andere Rechtspraak-medewerkers datagedreven te werken. Je werkt op het snijvlak van data engineering, ML engineering en cloud engineering. Heel belangrijk dus! En dat is nog niet alles. De Rechtspraak wil flinke stappen zetten in datagedreven werken. Daar draag jij op allerlei manieren aan bij vanuit het IVO Datalab. Je kunt je creativiteit helemaal kwijt! Zo ontwikkel je pipelines (Infrastructure as Code) en koppelvlakken voor data ingestion en ben je betrokken bij de deployment van diverse dataproducten. Ook ben je bezig met cloud engineering. Samen met de Cloud Engineers van het lab doe je aan resource deployment en richt je de netwerkinfrastructuur vanaf scratch in. De eerste verkenningen zijn op een on-premise cloud, met later een transitie naar een private cloud. Een mooie gelegenheid om OpenShift en Azure Cloud beter te leren kennen. Word jij als data engineer blij van een rol met ruimte om initiatief te nemen? Waar je de techniek in kunt duiken en meer doet dan alleen de dagelijkse routine? Dan is dit jouw start. Dit krijg je €3579 Arbeidsovereenkomst voor bepaalde tijd met uitzicht op onbepaalde tijd 36 uur Dit bieden we nog meer Om te beginnen een leuke, informele werksfeer. We houden de lijnen graag kort! En je arbeidsvoorwaarden zijn prima geregeld volgens de CAO Rijk. Wat belangrijke punten op een rij: Contract: een jaarcontract voor 36 uur per week, met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband. Salaris: Je zit in schaal 9 (trede 0) en hebt een salaris van € 3.579,02 bruto per maand bij een werkweek van 36 uur Daarnaast heb je een Individueel Keuzebudget van € 590,54, waarmee je zelf je arbeidsvoorwaarden samenstelt. Koop bijvoorbeeld extra verlof, schaf een fiets aan of los je studieschuld fiscaal vriendelijk af. Doorgroeimogelijkheden: je functie zit vol mogelijkheden om je kennis verder uit te breiden en je persoonlijke ontwikkeling te stimuleren. En bij onze IVO Academie kun je allerlei trainingen en opleidingen doen. Werk-privébalans: je bent vrij om je werkdagen flexibel in te delen. Zo kun je deels vanuit huis werken. We dragen € 750 bij aan het inrichten van een comfortabele thuiswerkplek. Vakanties en vrije dagen: je hebt 26 vrije dagen op basis van een 36-urige werkweek. Gratis OV: je krijgt van ons een OV-chipkaart voor je woon-werkverkeer. Pensioen: je bouwt je pensioen op bij het ABP, een van de grootste pensioenfondsen van Nederland. Ook dat is dus goed geregeld. Leuke activiteiten: een teamdag, borrelmiddagen, een after summer-feest … er gebeurt van alles. Of organiseer ook zelf iets met je collega’s, van padel tot yoga of een pubquiz. Bekijk hier alle arbeidsvoorwaarden > Dit vragen wij Kun jij analytisch denken? gestructureerd te werk gaan? goed samenwerken? zorgvuldig en helder communiceren? Heb jij Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding met als richting software of informatica? maximaal 2 jaar werkervaring na je studie? een uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal, zowel in mondelinge als schriftelijke communicatie? een brede leergierigheid en de wil om jezelf te ontwikkelen? veel initiatief en houd je wel van een uitdaging? En, ben jij: een starter in de wereld van IT? Dan is ons IT-traineeship écht iets voor jou! Hier kom je te werken Over IVO Rechtspraak Bij IVO Rechtspraak werken rond de 1.000 bevlogen, trotse en betrokken professionals. Samen ontwikkelen en beheren we de digitale systemen voor de rechtspraak. Zo zorgen we dat rechtszaken iedere dag soepel verlopen. Onze kernwaarde integriteit is verweven in het DNA van al onze medewerkers. Van IT’er tot communicatieadviseur of beleidsmedewerker. Daarom vinden wij het ook belangrijk dat iedereen die bij ons werkt zich thuis voelt, plezier heeft in het werk en zichzelf kan zijn in een informele werksfeer. IVO Rechtspraak > Werklocatie IVO Rechtspraak Uniceflaan 1 3527 WX, Utrecht Jouw IT-traineeship Hoe kom je het snelste op vlieghoogte in een richting die bij jou past? We kijken er samen naar en maken een programma op maat voor je. In ieder geval is je IT-traineeship altijd een combinatie van werkervaring opdoen en leren. Juist dat maakt het zo waardevol! Je ontwikkelt je talenten in de praktijk door mee te werken in je team. Spannend? Geen zorgen, je collega’s, coach en je buddy helpen je. items.desc: Vos missions au quotidien Vous souhaitez rejoindre un Groupe bancaire international et participer au déploiement des solutions IA et Data science dans une grande banque? Rejoignez-nous! Vous intégrez la Direction Data&IA de la banque SG en charge de mettre en place des solutions data&IA pour la gestion des risques et l’optimisation des tâches bancaires. Pour apporter un maximum de la valeur à la banque, notre équipe doit mettre en œuvre le traitement intelligent de tâches en : Traitant la variabilité des données et demandes reçues (documents, mails, données struturées, etc.) Exécutant les tâches via l’agentique (appels d’API, mise à jour de données, task management, etc.) Livrant des bots conversationnels à usage interne ou clients Assurant une explicabilité parfaite des décisions prises (ou non prises) Problématique du stage de recherche : Les méthodes d’évaluations traditionnelles (labellisation, dataset d’évaluation, confrontation aux données validées par les processus) montrent des limites : la variété des cas devient infinie et les zones de risques de modèle sont difficiles à détourer, sont très variables. En tant que Data Scientist de recherche, vous êtes intégré à la direction data science et IA de la banque et concrètement, sous la supervision de votre tuteur, vous serez amené à : Documenter les problématiques d’évaluation des modèles rencontrées sur les différents projets Identifier comment le besoin d’évaluation a été traité sur chaque projet Identifier des approches possibles puis les tester sur les données de chaque modèle Produire des conclusions et des préconisations sur les méthodes d’évaluation à utiliser En interaction avec les équipes et le management de la direction nous attendons que vous : Soyez force de proposition Restituiez les résultats via des restitutions soignées Présentiez les travaux et ajuster les analyses en fonction de leurs retours Durée du stage : 6 mois. Et si c’était vous ? Vous êtes étudiant de niveau Bac+5 en École d'Ingénieur, École de Commerce ou Université avec une spécialité en data science-IA et un très bon bagage mathématique et statistique Vous savez concevoir des modèles data science et les améliorer Vous connaissez les langages de manipulation de la data Python et PySpark Vous savez restituer vos travaux via des solutions de DataViz (PowerBi, Streamlit) Vous avez une appétence pour l'environnement bancaire Vous êtes rigoureux, autonome et avez un fort sens de l’écoute des interlocuteurs Vous faites preuve de qualité de synthèse et de bonnes capacités de restitutions écrites et orales You're confortable in English ! Alors vous êtes notre candidat ! Plus qu’un poste, un tremplin Rejoignez-nous pour faire grandir vos ambitions ! Dès votre arrivée, vous serez intégré dans nos équipes et apprendrez chaque jour aux côtés de nos experts qui vous accompagneront dans vos missions. Progressivement, vous gagnerez en autonomie sur vos projets pour faire de cette expérience un vrai accélérateur de carrière. Vous découvrirez également toute la diversité de nos métiers, dans un secteur qui évolue et innove en permanence. A la fin de vos études, diverses opportunités pourront s’offrir à vous, en France et à l’international. Pourquoi nous choisir ? Attentif à votre qualité de vie et conditions de travail, vous bénéficiez d’avantages : Télétravail possible selon le rythme de votre service Prise en charge de 60% de votre titre de transport Billetterie à prix réduits de notre Comité d’Entreprise (concerts, cinéma, sport) Offre variée de restaurants d’entreprise et de cafétérias à tarifs compétitifs ainsi que des titres restaurants dématérialisés quand vous êtes en télétravail Créer, oser, innover, entreprendre font partie de notre ADN. Si vous aussi vous souhaitez être dans l’action, évoluer dans un environnement stimulant et bienveillant, vous sentir utile au quotidien et développer ou renforcer votre expertise, nous sommes faits pour nous rencontrer ! Vous hésitez encore ? Sachez que nos collaborateurs peuvent s’engager quelques jours par an pour des actions de solidarité sur leur temps de travail : parrainer des personnes en difficulté dans leur orientation ou leur insertion professionnelle, participer à l’éducation financière de jeunes en apprentissage ou encore partager leurs compétences avec une association. Les formats d’engagement sont multiples.

items.desc: How you can make your mark Are you a data-driven engineer who wants to improve complex offshore operations through automated decision support and practical software solutions? At DSE, we automate the boring and strengthen informed decision-making. We turn data and processes into meaningful tools that help optimise OE’s business. Act as a knowledgeable DSE partner for other departments by sharing expertise and inspiring the effective use of data-driven solutions. Your qualities You can make your mark as data science engineer if you have: An MSc degree in computer science, applied mathematics, econometrics, computational engineering, or a related engineering discipline, such as civil, offshore, dredging or applied physics. Experience in analyzing data and developing data-driven design-decision models using methods such as machine learning, engineering optimisation, constraint programming or advanced metaheuristic algorithms, discrete-event simulation, finite-element modelling. Experience in developing Python-based software is essential. Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, PySpark or Databricks is an advantage, but not required. A proactive attitude, the ability to collaborate effectively within the team and the wider organisation, and a strong curiosity and drive to learn. A good command of written and spoken English. We offer A dynamic environment: A job where you can make an impact, in an earth-moving company, as part of a diverse, international team of experts. Rewarding conditions: A competitive salary and much more, including holiday allowance, holiday entitlement of 31 days (based on a full-time contract), a non-contributory pension scheme, collective schemes such as company health insurance and travel allowance. items.desc: Wil je niet zomaar een IT-traineeship? En spreekt leren door te doen je aan? Als IT trainee Data Engineer werk je bij IVO Rechtspraak, de IT-dienstverlener van de Rechtspraak aan iets van betekenis. Samen met de collega’s in je team help je dataproducten en -analyses te ontwikkelen, zodat rechters en andere medewerkers van de Rechtspraak datagedreven kunnen werken. Spannend? Geen zorgen, je kunt rekenen op je collega’s en je buddy. Interessant? Zeker, want je ontwikkelt je ook persoonlijk. En dat samen met de andere IT-trainees, dus ook nog leuk! Wat ga je doen? Het antwoord op die vraag is een inkoppertje. Want ons Traineeship (https://www.werkenbijderechtspraak.nl/ivo-rechtspraak/traineeship)draait maar om één ding: dat jij je talenten als professional maximaal ontwikkelt en inzet! We halen alles uit de kast, met een programma op maat van jou! In twee jaar tijd krijg je volop de kans om kennis en ervaring op te doen en je soft skills te vergroten. Als IT-trainee data engineer bij IVO Rechtspraak werk je vanuit het IVO Datalab. Jij helpt dataproducten en -analyses te ontwikkelen en rechters en andere Rechtspraak-medewerkers datagedreven te werken. Je werkt op het snijvlak van data engineering, ML engineering en cloud engineering. Heel belangrijk dus! En dat is nog niet alles. De Rechtspraak wil flinke stappen zetten in datagedreven werken. Daar draag jij op allerlei manieren aan bij vanuit het IVO Datalab. Je kunt je creativiteit helemaal kwijt! Zo ontwikkel je pipelines (Infrastructure as Code) en koppelvlakken voor data ingestion en ben je betrokken bij de deployment van diverse dataproducten. Ook ben je bezig met cloud engineering. Samen met de Cloud Engineers van het lab doe je aan resource deployment en richt je de netwerkinfrastructuur vanaf scratch in. De eerste verkenningen zijn op een on-premise cloud, met later een transitie naar een private cloud. Een mooie gelegenheid om OpenShift en Azure Cloud beter te leren kennen. Word jij als data engineer blij van een rol met ruimte om initiatief te nemen? Waar je de techniek in kunt duiken en meer doet dan alleen de dagelijkse routine? Dan is dit jouw start. Een bijzonder IT-traineeship omdat... je leren en werken vanaf dag één combineert, onder persoonlijke begeleiding. je samen met andere IT-trainees niet alleen opleidingen volgt, maar ook leuke dingen doet. je onderdeel bent van een organisatie die inclusiviteit en diversiteit koestert. je werk onmisbaar is voor een rechtvaardige samenleving. Dit krijg je ervoor terug Om te beginnen een leuke, informele werksfeer. We houden de lijnen graag kort! En je arbeidsvoorwaarden zijn prima geregeld volgens de CAO Rijk. Wat belangrijke punten op een rij: Contract: een jaarcontract voor 36 uur per week, met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband. Salaris: Je zit in schaal 9 (trede 0) en hebt een salaris van € 3.579,02 bruto per maand bij een werkweek van 36 uur Daarnaast heb je een Individueel Keuzebudget van € 590,54, waarmee je zelf je arbeidsvoorwaarden samenstelt. Koop bijvoorbeeld extra verlof, schaf een fiets aan of los je studieschuld fiscaal vriendelijk af. Doorgroeimogelijkheden: je functie zit vol mogelijkheden om je kennis verder uit te breiden en je persoonlijke ontwikkeling te stimuleren. En bij onze IVO Academie kun je allerlei trainingen en opleidingen doen. Werk-privébalans: je bent vrij om je werkdagen flexibel in te delen. Zo kun je deels vanuit huis werken. We dragen € 750 bij aan het inrichten van een comfortabele thuiswerkplek. Vakanties en vrije dagen: je hebt 26 vrije dagen op basis van een 36-urige werkweek. Gratis OV: je krijgt van ons een OV-chipkaart voor je woon-werkverkeer. Pensioen: je bouwt je pensioen op bij het ABP, een van de grootste pensioenfondsen van Nederland. Ook dat is dus goed geregeld. Leuke activiteiten: een teamdag, borrelmiddagen, een after summer-feest … er gebeurt van alles. Of organiseer ook zelf iets met je collega’s, van padel tot yoga of een pubquiz. Bekijk hier alle arbeidsvoorwaarden > (https://www.werkenvoornederland.nl/over-de-rijksoverheid/arbeidsvoorwaarden) Wat jouw collega Hieu waardeert aan het traineeship Hieu heeft niet dezelfde functie als jij, maar kan je wel vertellen hoe het is om IT-trainee bij de Rechtspraak te zijn. Hij deelt zijn ervaringen graag met jou. “Met mijn manager kijk ik welke cursussen het meest waardevol zijn voor mij en mijn team. Voor de rest leer ik on the job met tools te werken, ik pas mijn kennis meteen toe. Mijn buddy begeleidt me bij het werk en geeft me tips. Ook mijn soft skills ontwikkel ik, via leiderschaps- en communicatietrainingen. Daar heb ik veel aan!” Hieu, IT-trainee test automation engineer Benieuwd naar de ervaringen van Trainee test automation engineer Hieu? Je leest het in zijn blog . Wat we van jou verwachten Kun jij: analytisch denken? gestructureerd te werk gaan? goed samenwerken? zorgvuldig en helder communiceren? Heb jij: Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding met als richting software of informatica? maximaal …

items.desc: About The Position As an AI & Data Analytics Engineer, you will work with technical data from our manufacturing processes, product and process development, and technical documentation. A key part of the role is understanding how data flows through our production environments, how it can be structured and analyzed, and how it can be used to create value for the organization. You will work with everything from data flows and pre-processing to analysis and visualization of production data. The role also includes exploring how advanced analytics, Machine Learning and AI can be applied to our processes and technical information. You will work closely with our production systems and data infrastructure, where Python, databases, data workflows and DCS data are important components. Experience of ABB 800xA is particularly valuable. As AI becomes an increasingly important part of our technical landscape, you will also contribute to developing and evaluating solutions based on Machine Learning and LLM-based AI. Cybersecurity and secure data handling are natural considerations throughout this work. Your Main Responsibilities Develop secure, robust and scalable data solutions for production environments. Collect, process, analyze and visualize technical and production data using Python, databases and data workflows. Work with industrial process and DCS data, including ABB 800xA. Explore and develop solutions using Machine Learning, advanced analytics and LLM-based AI. Design and evaluate data and AI workflows, including feasibility studies for new technical solutions. Ensure cybersecurity aspects are considered in data and AI solutions. Develop and maintain technical documentation, procedures and models to support system users. Your profile A Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, or another relevant technical field Experience with Python and data analysis Knowledge of databases and data workflows Experience with data processing and visualization Fluency in English, both written and spoken Experience or knowledge within the following areas is considered meritorious: DCS environments, particularly ABB 800xA Machine Learning and advanced data analytics Generative AI and LLM-based solutions Cybersecurity in data or industrial environments Working in Linux environments Who are you? To thrive in this position, we believe you are analytical, curious and solution-oriented. You enjoy working with complex technical challenges and are comfortable moving between detailed data analysis and a broader understanding of systems and processes. You have an interest in new technologies and enjoy turning ideas and possibilities into practical solutions. As the role involves collaboration with technical specialists and users across the organization, you are communicative and able to explain complex technical topics in a clear and accessible way. Sounds interesting? Please submit your application before the deadline on December 4th. The position might be filled before the application deadline. Contact Ola Litström Director Digitalization & Operation Technology ola.litstrom@hoganas.com Ebba Folkesson HR-generalist ebba.folkesson@hoganas.com Working at Höganäs We aim to offer a great and meaningful place to work where you can fulfill your potential and ambitions. We welcome all applicants and strive for diversity. We have a clear management philosophy, and just like us you believe that through collaboration and openness we develop as individuals and as a company. We see all employees, regardless of position, as leaders when we approach the challenges that the world - and we - face. Höganäs ambition is to lead the transformation to better meet the needs of tomorrow and become the preferred supplier of sustainable metal powder on a global scale – join us in our journey of sustainable change and towards net-zero climate emissions. More About Höganäs Founded in 1797, Höganäs is the world leader in the market for powders, with an annual capacity of 500,000 tonnes. Höganäs’ vision is to drive positive change through material innovation, with the ambition of becoming the globally preferred partner for sustainable powder materials. The company’s strength lies in its diverse backgrounds, perspectives and experiences, and Höganäs is committed to an inclusive and diverse workplace. Höganäs collaborates with customers across multiple industries to develop innovative solutions, including applications in automotive components, electric motors, brazing, surface coating, welding consumables and additive manufacturing. Operating 15 production centers worldwide and employing 2,200 people, Höganäs’ turnover for 2025 was 11,045 MSEK. Höganäs is owned by Lindéngruppen and FAM. www.hoganas.com Interested? Apply today!

items.desc: Our Mission As humans, there are few things more exciting than meeting someone new. At Tinder, we’re inspired by the challenge of keeping the magic of human connection alive. With tens of millions of users, hundreds of millions of downloads, 2+ billion swipes per day, 20+ million matches per day, and a presence in 190+ countries, our reach is expansive—and rapidly growing. We work together to solve complex problems. Behind the simplicity of every match, we think deeply about human relationships, behavioral science, network economics, AI and ML, online and real-world safety, cultural nuances, loneliness, love, sex, and more. Our Values Take the Lead: We don't ghost our work or each other. Just as users don't leave their matches hanging, we don't let each other down. Move Fast: We have a bias for action and urgency. Something that could be done tomorrow would be better if done today. Better Together: We keep connection at the heart of dating and at the heart of how we work. Just as our users are better when they connect with others, so are we when we collaborate. Real Talk: We say the hard thing the human way. Just as we ask our users to behave with kindness and candor in our community, we expect Team Tinder to do the same. Safety First: We act with integrity, transparency, and consistency so people feel safe—whether they're swiping, matching, or working alongside us. Spark Fun: We have fun to unlock creativity, fuel innovation, and help us build better experiences for daters. Where You’ll Work This is a hybrid role and requires in-office collaboration in Ghent three times per week. The Team Or Role As a Data Scientist Intern on Tinder’s Modes team in Ghent, you’ll help build new ways for people to meet on Tinder, from group and shared experiences to new modes of using the app. You’ll work with product, engineering, and data science partners to understand how members use these experiences, define how we measure success, and turn insights into product decisions. In This Role, You Will Design and execute A/B experiments to measure the impact of product features and algorithmic changes. Help build and improve the team’s experimentation and analytics tooling, including AI-assisted workflows, with a focus on standardization, automation, and clear documentation. Take a scoped analysis from question to recommendation, with guidance from your mentor. Collaborate with cross-functional partners in Data Science, Product, and Engineering to translate insights into actionable strategies. Present key findings and project outcomes to Product and Leadership teams during end-of-internship demos. Translate data insights into clear narratives and recommendations that inform product roadmaps and user experience improvements. Explore and analyze large-scale datasets to identify patterns, trends, and opportunities. You’ll Need Passion for using data and experimentation to solve complex problems. Intermediate to advanced SQL skills for data querying and analysis. Familiarity with / building to proficiency in Python. Strong foundation in statistics, probability, and experimental design (A/B testing, hypothesis testing). Clear written communication and a curious, fast-learning mindset. Comfort using AI tools (e.g., LLM-based coding and analysis assistants) as a regular part of your workflow, and the judgment to check their output. Currently pursuing a BS/BA, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Data Science, Economics, Statistics, Applied Math, or a related field. As Part Of Our Team, You'll Enjoy The hustle of a startup with the impact of a global business Tremendous opportunity to solve some of the industry’s most exciting problems Working with an extraordinary team of smart, creative, fun and highly motivated people Commitment to Inclusion At Tinder, we don’t just accept difference, we celebrate it. We strive to build a workplace that reflects the rich diversity of our members around the world, and we value unique perspectives and backgrounds. Even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications, we invite you to apply and show us how your skills could transfer. Tinder is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace where we welcome people of all sexes, gender identities, races, ethnicities, disabilities, and other lived experiences. items.desc: Vi har masser af idéer til, hvordan vi kan gøre marketing i NORMAL endnu hurtigere, smartere og mere effektiv. Vi har allerede udviklet vores egne PIM- og UGC-platforme, og nu vil vi bygge videre, udvikle nye værktøjer og automatisere flere af vores processer. Derfor søger vi en nysgerrig, teknisk stærk og lidt opfinderagtig MarTech & AI Specialist, der har lyst til at omsætte idéer og udfordringer til løsninger, der rent faktisk virker. Du bliver en vigtig del af vores nye MarTech-team, hvor du sammen med vores MarTech Lead skal være med til at udvikle fremtidens marketingværktøjer. Hvad skal du lave? Kort fortalt skal du være med til at gøre vores marketingarbejde smartere ved hjælp af teknologi, AI og automatisering. Du får mulighed for både at videreudvikle de løsninger, vi allerede har, og bygge nye værktøjer, der gør hverdagen lettere for dine kolleger. Og ja, måske også sende et par Excel-ark på pension undervejs. Dine Opgaver Bliver Blandt Andet At Drifte og videreudvikle vores eksisterende PIM- og UGC-platforme. Udvikle nye interne værktøjer, der automatiserer marketingprocesser og gør arbejdsgangene mere effektive. Bruge Claude og Claude Code til at udvikle funktioner, prototyper og digitale løsninger. Arbejde med API'er, integrationer og data, så vores forskellige systemer spiller bedre sammen. Samarbejde tæt med vores MarTech Lead om at finde nye muligheder, udforske idéer og omsætte dem til løsninger, der skaber værdi. Hvem er du? Du er nysgerrig, handlekraftig og teknisk stærk. Du kan lide at finde smartere løsninger og er ikke bange for at prøve dig frem – heller ikke når du skal lære noget nyt undervejs. Måske med lidt hjælp fra Claude. Du behøver ikke være klassisk softwareudvikler, men skal kunne læse, forstå og arbejde med kode. Vi forestiller os, at du har 1-3 års erfaring fra fx digital produktudvikling, teknisk marketing eller udvikling af digitale løsninger. For os er det vigtigere, hvad du kan bygge, end hvad der står på dit eksamensbevis. Vi Forestiller Os Desuden, At Du Har erfaring med at bygge digitale løsninger, interne værktøjer eller automatiseringer. Har arbejdet med API'er, integrationer og data og forstår, hvordan forskellige systemer hænger sammen. Kan gennemskue kode, logik og tekniske sammenhænge – også uden en 40-siders kravspecifikation. Bruger AI aktivt til at udvikle og bygge løsninger. Har praktisk erfaring med Claude, Claude Code eller lignende værktøjer. Kommunikerer godt på dansk og kan begå dig på engelsk. Hvem er vi? Vi er ikke så vilde med teknologi for teknologiens skyld. Vi foretrækker løsninger, der virker i virkeligheden, frem for dem, der kun ser fantastiske ud i PowerPoint. Vi kan godt lide at eksperimentere, tage ansvar og komme fra idé til handling – gerne uden alt for mange møder undervejs. Du bliver en del af et nyt MarTech-team i vores marketingafdeling, hvor ambitionerne er høje, beslutningsvejene korte, og der er gode muligheder for at sætte dit eget præg på både løsningerne og måden, vi arbejder på. Skal vi mødes? Vi er mere interesserede i, hvad du kan bygge, end hvad der står på dit CV. Så vis os meget gerne noget, du har lavet – det kan være et projekt, en prototype eller en smart løsning, du selv har fundet på. Det behøver hverken være stort eller perfekt. Vi vil bare gerne se, hvordan du tænker, og hvad du kan få til at ske. Stillingen er på fuld tid på vores kontor i Skanderborg med forventet opstart i januar eller februar 2027. Send din ansøgning snarest. Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet det rette talent. Stillingen er med reference til Mads Haulund, Martech Lead (maha@normal.dk). PS. Du må gerne bruge AI til din ansøgning, bare sørg for, at vi også kan mærke mennesket bag prompten 😉 Vi anbefaler, at du bekræfter SMS-kommunikation, så vi nemt kan komme i kontakt med dig i rekrutteringsprocessen.

items.desc: Outside Edge · St Albans · Hybrid (at least 3 days a week in the office) Full-time, permanent · £60k base + discretionary bonus https://outsideedge.io/ About us We’re a specialist analytics consultancy, building models and tools for predicting cricket matches around the world. Our technical team works across modelling, data, engineering and deployment, taking responsibility for its work from the first idea through to production. We share a goal of solving cricket. You’ll focus on modelling, with scope to get involved wherever your skills and ideas are useful. The role We’re trying to understand cricket better than anyone else. We have the best data available, and you’ll build the models that make the most of it. You’ll explore new ideas, test them rigorously and turn the strongest into useful prediction tools. AI is central to how we work. We use agents every day to help us plan, build, review and run our systems. That lets a small team take on work that would once have needed a much larger one, and lets each person cover far more ground. We’re still discovering the best ways to work like this, and we want people who’ll help shape it. Above all, we’re looking for the right person. Energy, ideas, a positive attitude and initiative matter more to us than any specific experience or skill on this list. What you’ll do Develop and improve the statistical and machine-learning methods behind our cricket models. Take ideas from exploratory analysis through to clear, well-tested production code, and review colleagues’ work. Use AI agents throughout your work, and help improve the team’s tools and workflows. Work closely with engineers and analysts to understand how your models perform in practice and where they could improve. What we’re looking for Ideally you’ll have: A postgraduate degree (MSc or PhD) in statistics, maths, physics, computer science or another quantitative subject. Relevant industry experience will also be considered. An ability to identify problems and opportunities, develop your own ideas and take responsibility for seeing them through. Strong Python skills and familiarity with the standard data science stack (e.g. pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch), including experience writing production code. A solid grounding in probability, statistics, regression and model evaluation, and the judgement to question whether a result stands up to scrutiny. Hands-on experience with AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor, including breaking down tasks, reviewing outputs and knowing when to challenge them. Good engineering habits, including Git, code review, testing and reproducible analysis. Clear communication, including the ability to explain modelling decisions to people who aren’t modellers. Nice to have: Experience with Bayesian modelling, such as hierarchical models in PyMC or Stan. Experience building or evaluating forecasting models or other predictive systems. Experience working with sports data or similarly noisy real-world data. Experience with C# or React. An interest in cricket, though you don’t need to be an expert. Why join us Challenging modelling problems, with your work used directly in our prediction tools. A small team where you’ll have real ownership and a say in technical decisions. The opportunity to help improve how we use AI across the business. The tools you need to do your best work. If there’s hardware, software or an AI tool that would help, we’ll generally get it for you. A discretionary, performance-related bonus that has typically matched or exceeded base salary. Regular team socials, private healthcare and paid conference attendance. How to apply Every application must include something you’ve built using AI. It can be a side project, a tool, an analysis or anything else that shows how you think. Share a link to a repo or demo or, if it can’t be shared publicly, a short write-up. Send this with your CV and a short covering note to careers@outsideedge.io, using the subject line “Member of the Technical Team: Data Science”. In your note, tell us about the project: what you set out to achieve, the decisions you made and what you learnt. We welcome applications from everyone, whatever their background.

items.desc: About The Role You will join a growing AI team of 19 talented colleagues with a shared mission: transforming data and AI into measurable business value for Flatpay and our merchants. We are hiring for two open roles in separate teams: fraud prevention and our meeting booker software tool. As a Data Scientist, you will design, build, and productionize data and Machine Learning powered products and pipelines that support business-critical processes across the organization. You will own the implementation of solutions together with colleagues from the AI team and the wider business. This includes understanding the underlying business problem, shaping the solution, building it, deploying it to production, and continuously improving it based on real-world performance. The role is ideal for someone who combines strong data and software engineering skills with the ability to communicate effectively with business stakeholders. You should enjoy turning ambiguous operational challenges into practical AI products that create measurable value. We are looking for someone who thrives in a fast-moving environment, takes ownership, and is comfortable engaging directly with stakeholders to pursue opportunities, align solutions with business needs, and continuously drive improvement. What You'll Do Design, build, and maintain production-grade AI products and pipelines using Python, Databricks, and MLflow. Work within one of our key focus areas: Fraud prevention: Build and maintain solutions that support our Fraud department, including alert automations, data pipelines and case tracking. You will help evolve our rule-based system into a true data-driven setup. Meeting booker software tool: Develop and maintain a software tool for the sales meeting bookers that includes automatically optimized routeplanning and AI-driven context analysis. Integrate models and AI applications with internal systems, APIs, and external platforms. Write clean, maintainable, and tested Python code, with monitoring, validation, guardrails, and fallback mechanisms appropriate to the use case. Evaluate solutions against relevant technical and business measures, including accuracy, reliability, latency, cost, and operational impact. Collaborate with data engineers and other technical teams to build on reliable, scalable, and well-governed data foundations. Work directly with stakeholders to understand processes, define requirements, and take solutions from proof of concept through production and ongoing improvement. Apply traditional machine learning and GenAI techniques, choosing the right approach based on the business problem, available data, and operational requirements. Who You Are We are hiring across several focus areas and do not expect you to have experience in all of them. We are looking for a strong technical foundation, a practical approach to problem-solving, and relevant experience in the area you would join. Required You have 2–4 +years of industry experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, AI Engineering, or a similar technical role. You have strong Python skills and write clean, maintainable, and tested code. You understand core machine learning concepts, including data preparation, model evaluation, and validation. You have hands-on experience building solutions with traditional machine learning, GenAI, or a combination of both. You are comfortable working with SQL and data processing libraries. You understand what it takes to move a solution from prototype to production, including testing, monitoring, and reliability. You communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders and can translate business needs into practical technical solutions. You take ownership, enjoy learning, and care about building solutions that create measurable business value. Nice to Have - Depending on Your Focus Area Relevant experience in one or more of the areas below is a plus. You do not need to cover every area. Fraud prevention: Experience handling large-scale financial data, rule- or ML-based fraud detection, software engineering concepts, imbalanced datasets and MCC software tool: Practical experience with software deployment, automated testing, CI/CD practices, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC). Experience with monitoring, observability, and troubleshooting distributed systems, including tools and practices for logging, metrics, tracing, and performance analysis. Experience with front-end development and design. Why Flatpay You’ll be joining an ambitious, metric-driven, and fast-growing fintech company that believes in the power of personal connections, both with our customers and in the way we work with each other Working on early-stage products where you’ll have a sizeable impact on what gets built A modern office with an international and vibrant work environment with free slush ice, an in-office gym, a fully equipped gamer room and plenty of other fun things at the office! If you’re ready to be part of this exciting journey, we would love to …

Depuis 26 ans, nous accompagnons les grands comptes dans la gestion, la gouvernance et la valorisation de leurs données. Description du poste : CENISIS recrute un Data & IA Quality F/H, à Lille, pour accompagner les équipes dans la gouvernance, la qualité et la valorisation des données tout en contribuant au développement des usages liés à l’Intelligence Artificielle Tes missions : En tant que Data & IA Quality F/H, tu joueras un rôle clé dans la gestion des données et l'accompagnement des métiers dans l'exploitation de la Data et des solutions d'IA. Tes principales responsabilités : Accompagner les équipes dans l’identification, la priorisation et le déploiement des cas d’usage liés à l’Intelligence Artificielle. Définir et mettre en œuvre les règles de gouvernance des données afin de garantir leur conformité et leur valorisation. Garantir la qualité, la fiabilité et la cohérence des données au sein des différents domaines métiers. Identifier les besoins des utilisateurs de données, les challenger et les accompagner dans leurs usages. Collaborer avec les équipes métiers, Data et IT afin d’améliorer la gestion et l’exploitation des données . Ton profil : Formation Bac+3/5 (Data, Informatique, Intelligence Artificielle, Ingénierie ou équivalent). Première expérience en Data Governance, Data Quality, Data Management ou Data Stewardship. Bonne compréhension des enjeux liés à la gouvernance et à la qualité des données. Connaissance des bases de données et maîtrise de SQL. Une connaissance des outils de Data Catalog (DataGalaxy, Collibra, Informatica...) est un plus. Sensibilité aux sujets liés à l’Intelligence Artificielle et à la valorisation de la donnée. Ton savoir-être : Excellent relationnel et sens du service. Rigueur et sens de l’organisation. Esprit d’analyse et de synthèse. Curiosité et appétence pour l’innovation. Autonomie et force de proposition Alors tu es partant(e) pour relever le défi ? N’hésite pas à postuler, ce serait le début d’une superbe aventure ensemble ! À compétences égales, tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap. En rejoignant CENISIS, tu bénéficies notamment : Prise en charge à 100 % des transports en commun ou indemnités kilométriques vélo. Charte télétravail co-signée par la direction. Prime de performance. Et évidemment, les avantages classiques : Tickets restaurant. Mutuelle d’entreprise. Le processus de recrutement : Chez Cenisis, le processus de recrutement s’adapte au contexte des missions et peut être accéléré en fonction des besoins : Première rencontre avec Camille ,Talent Acquisition. Deuxième échange avec ton futur Manager. Troisième échange avec Gilles, Head of Cenisis Academy et/ou Cédric, CEO.

items.desc: Huntsman is a global manufacturer and marketer of differentiated chemicals, with a diverse range of products that improve the quality of life for people around the world. Our products are used in various sectors including transportation, construction, and energy, to name a few. We are committed to innovation, sustainable development, and making a positive impact in the communities where we operate. At our Krakow Global Business Services (GBS) Hub, we provide essential services across multiple functions, including automation, finance, purchasing, human resources, supply chain, and more. We are currently seeking motivated and talented individuals to join our Internship Program About The Program This is an exciting opportunity to gain hands-on experience and develop your skills in a dynamic, global business environment. Our Internship Program offers exposure to various functions, enabling you to work alongside experienced professionals and contribute to real projects that have a direct impact on our business. Do you think you’re the right fit for this opportunity? Apply today! You can join as an Intern - Data Science Modelling, supporting the GR&A Data Science team throughout the modelling lifecycle and working on well-defined tasks under the supervision of senior colleagues In This Role, You Will Support data preparation and analysis. Contribute to documentation and process mapping. Support the ideation, development and evaluation of statistical and machine learning models. Contribute to forecasting and decision-optimization activities. Present results to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Write clean, version-controlled code and documentation in a collaborative environment About You You are currently pursuing or have recently completed studies in Data Science, Statistics, Physics, Economics or another related quantitative field. You have solid foundations in statistics, probability theory and machine learning fundamentals. You have practical exposure to Python. You have a strong quantitative mindset and enjoy working with statistical, mathematical or modelling problems. You can identify what is essential in a complex subject and communicate it clearly and concisely. You have strong attention to detail and mathematical rigour. You enjoy working collaboratively and discussing your ideas with others. You have excellent written and spoken communication skills in English. What We Offer Paid internship with a Civil Contract (Umowa zlecenie) for 6 months (with the possibility of extension). Initial training and continuous support working with experienced mentors and colleagues who will guide you throughout the Internship Program. Flexibility related to working hours (with a minimum of 20 hours/week and a maximum of 40 hours/week). Hybrid work policy allowing you to work both in the office and remotely. A friendly and stimulating atmosphere, with the possibility to work with experts in their field within a global company and the chance to develop your career based on your ambitions, while building a professional network. A modern office in the city center for a newly established Hub, with coffee/tea/fruit (and more) available to you. High-performing interns may be considered for future full-time positions within Huntsman. What next? If you would like to join an innovative, collaborative, and multicultural team, please apply now. Your application will be forwarded to a Talent Acquisition Partner, who will strive to get back to you as soon as they can. We understand that applying for a new job is a big decision and we will work hard to keep you updated and support you along the way. About Us At Huntsman, we pride ourselves on being a people-oriented organization. Our family-like atmosphere is cultivated by our diverse groups of team members around the world. We welcome the talent, experience and fresh ideas that employees at all stages of their careers, from interns to seasoned professionals, bring to Huntsman. In return, we offer you the opportunity to become an integral part of a dynamic, industry-leading company, where safety and ethics always come first.

I Deloitte AI & Data får du jobbe
items.desc: Deloitte er et av verdens ledende profesjonelle tjenestehus med over 470 000 ansatte globalt. I Norge er vi ca. 1600 medarbeidere som hjelper klienter med rådgivning, revisjon, skatt og juridiske tjenester. Hos oss jobber du i et inkluderende og mangfoldig miljø der vi setter pris på ulike perspektiver, kompetanser og bakgrunner. Er du nyutdannet, eller fullfører du snart studiene? I Deloitte AI & Data får du jobbe med spørsmål som betyr noe for virksomheter: Hvordan kan data brukes bedre? Hvor kan AI skape verdi? Og hvordan bygger vi løsninger som faktisk blir tatt i bruk? Vi hjelper virksomheter med å skape verdi med AI og data – fra strategi og dataplattformer til AI-løsninger og innsikt. Vi ser etter deg som er nysgjerrig, lærer raskt og har lyst til å bruke det du kan til skape impact that matters. Hva kan du jobbe med? Du vil bidra innenfor ett eller flere av disse områdene: AI Strategy & Governance: Finne ut hvor AI og data kan skape verdi, prioritere muligheter og bidra til en tydelig retning for virksomheten. Data Platform & Engineering: Bygge dataplattformer, arkitektur og datapipelines som gjør data tilgjengelige og anvendelige. AI Solutions & Insights: Bruke AI og analyse til å skape innsikt og utvikle løsninger som forbedrer beslutninger og arbeidsmåter. Hvem ser vi etter? Du er nyutdannet eller i ferd med å fullføre en relevant utdanning på masternivå (NHH, CBS, NTNU, BI, NMBU, UiO, UiB og anerkjente internasjonale universiteter). Du liker å forstå både hvilket problem som skal løses , og hvordan teknologi kan bidra . Du arbeider strukturert, stiller spørsmål og samarbeider godt med mennesker med ulik fagbakgrunn. Kanskje har du gjennom en internship, deltidsjobb, et studieprosjekt eller et eget initiativ brukt data eller AI til å løse et problem? Fortell oss gjerne hva utfordringen var, hva du selv bidro med , og hva resultatet ble. Erfaring fra en eller flere av punktene under er en fordel: Klassisk AI, AI-assistenter, agenter eller bruk av AI til å forbedre arbeidsprosesser Dataplattformer som Databricks, Snowflake eller Microsoft Fabric, og skytjenester som Azure, AWS eller Google Cloud Visualisering og innsiktsløsninger i for eksempel Power BI, Qlik, Tableau eller Power Platform Programmering, datamodellering og datatransformasjon med for eksempel Python, SQL, PySpark eller DAX Hvorfor Deloitte? Du får en bratt læringskurve fra start, støtte fra kolleger som vil at du skal lykkes, og mulighet til å jobbe med reelle problemstillinger i tverrfaglige team. Vi investerer i læring og utvikling gjennom blant annet Faglig Community og Deloitte University . Du blir del av et inkluderende miljø og et globalt nettverk som kan åpne nye muligheter. Arbeidssted: Oslo eller Bergen Søknadsfrist: Fortløpende Dersom du er nysgjerrig eller har spørsmål om stillingen er du velkommen til å ta kontakt med Victoria Dessen (458 63 586). For spørsmål om søknadsprosessen kan du kontakte Amalie Worm Andersen (amaandersen@deloitte.no).

items.desc: Vill du arbeta med avancerad dataanalys och machine learning i en samhällsviktig verksamhet där teknik, automation och framtidens energisystem möts? Vi söker nu en Data Scientist till ett långt konsultuppdrag inom utveckling av intelligenta beslutsstöd och prediktiva modeller för ett komplext och högteknologiskt driftområde. Om uppdraget Uppdraget är en del av ett större program kopplat till framtidens nordiska balanseringsmodell och utveckling av smartare, mer automatiserade stödsystem för drift och planering. Fokus ligger på att utveckla: Prognosmodeller Prediktiva och ordinerande modeller Beslutsstöd för drift och planering Applikationer för flaskhalshantering och budfiltrering Produktionssatta ML-lösningar med hög kvalitet och spårbarhet Du kommer arbeta genom hela ML-livscykeln – från analys och modellutveckling till deployment, övervakning och vidareutveckling i produktionsmiljö. items.desc: We are looking for you if you want to work at one of Hungary's leading telecommunications companies to help our clients navigate the digital world. Take the first step, bring your inspiring ideas and join our supportive and creative Data Scientist team. Be curious and responsible, work passionately and be open to development. Let’s reach our goals together, because at Yettel you can inspire true change while being yourself. Who are we? More than 1,800 colleagues working at nearly 130 locations across the country forming one big team and enjoying an unlimited experience. We have a lime heart and Yettel enables us to make our dreams come true. Join Yettel Hungary as Data Scientist Expert, be yourself and make a difference in the world. You will have the following responsibilities: Supporting business and marketing decisions with data-driven solutions, developing predictive models such as churn scoring to drive retention offers and product propensity scoring to realise additional value for our customers. Translating business needs into actionable ML and AI solutions across marketing, customer care, and network operations - including next best offer, customer lifecycle management, recommendation systems, and demand forecasting. Participating in generative AI projects , including working with LLMs , and custom NLP to build innovative solutions like customer service chatbots and automated interaction tools. Summarising and presenting analytical results , making findings clear and actionable for stakeholders. Managing production-ready code , documentation, and large-scale customer/transactional data assets according to agreed standards, ensuring transparency and traceability across all processes. Collaborating with data and MLOps engineers to ensure data science solutions remain reliable, high-quality, and scalable. You are the ideal candidate for our team if you have / are: BSc or MSc degree in Economics, Technology, Natural or Social Sciences. 2-3 years of relevant professional experience in data science or analytics. Intermediate knowledge of statistics, data analysis and machine learning techniques. Confident use of Python and SQL . Able to deliver projects independently or with light supervision. Excellent communication skills, able to present complex technical results clearly. Proficient level of English . Experience working in a consumer setting and marketing is a plus. You’ll feel at home in the Yettel team if you enjoy working collaboratively, take ownership of your work, think in a data-driven way, have a proactive mindset, and treat everyone with respect. At Yettel, we are relentlessly working to reshape the telco industry, which is why it’s important to us that you use AI tools at least at a basic level and confidently integrate them into your day-to-day work to become even more effective. Discover the opportunities offered by Yettel. #FlexibleWorking: We work in the nature-friendly and innovative Yettel House, and during the summer, the Garden Office is also available to us. In addition, we offer the possibility of working from home, with the number of home office days varying by department; in most roles, this is typically up to 6 days per month. #Health: We provide our colleagues with collective life and health insurance, paternity leave, and free advice in the areas of lifestyle, psychology, law and finance. Our office gym and saunas also await our employees. #Technology: It is natural that you will receive a company smartphone with unlimited internet, and we even offer discounted rates for your family and friends. #Learning: Trainings, courses and an online platform are also available so that you never stop developing! Our goal is to support you throughout your personal and professional career, while you are constantly learning new things! #YettelHQ: Our headquarter at Törökbálint is one of the most unique office buildings in the country, with a panoramic terrace, an outdoor sports field and an alternative garden office. #YettelBus: You can also get to Törökbálint with Yettel's buses, which are available to everyone. You don’t need to show any documents when boarding. These buses leave from several stations in the city: Népliget, Kelenföld, as well as Déli pályaudvar stations, and you can recognize them by the "Yettel bus - Yettel" sign on the front of the vehicles. Until then, please follow us for the best Yettel moments on Instagram and LinkedIn.

Strong communication skills and the ability to explain and document technical concepts clearly and effectively. Experience with Generative AI, LLMs, or AI agents is considered a plus. items.desc: ¡En Tecdata Engineering buscamos un/a ML Engineer | Forecasting & Mathematical Optimization! En Tecdata Engineering buscamos un/a Machine Learning Engineer para participar en un proyecto estratégico del sector bancario, colaborando en el desarrollo, análisis y mejora de modelos de Machine Learning orientados a la previsión de demanda, análisis de series temporales y optimización matemática . Buscamos un perfil con una sólida base analítica y experiencia práctica en Machine Learning tradicional, especialmente en entrenamiento, validación y optimización de modelos predictivos. Participarás en un caso de uso de gestión de efectivo para una entidad bancaria de primer nivel como Santander. La parte de productivización y MLOps también estará presente, aunque el foco principal estará en el conocimiento de modelos predictivos, series temporales y técnicas de optimización. Responsabilidades principales Diseñar, entrenar, validar y optimizar modelos de Machine Learning supervisado. Desarrollar y analizar modelos de forecasting para la previsión de demanda mediante técnicas de análisis de series temporales. Evaluar el comportamiento de los modelos, analizar métricas de rendimiento y proponer mejoras en su precisión y estabilidad. Aplicar técnicas de optimización matemática, programación matemática y heurísticas para resolver problemas de negocio y apoyar la toma de decisiones operativas. Combinar modelos predictivos con modelos de optimización para mejorar la planificación y asignación de recursos. Analizar y mejorar modelos existentes, evaluando diferentes algoritmos, variables y estrategias de entrenamiento. Participar en la adaptación y productivización de modelos en entornos corporativos. Colaborar en la implementación de pipelines de entrenamiento e inferencia utilizando Python, PySpark y Databricks. Trabajar con herramientas de seguimiento, versionado y gestión de modelos como MLflow. Aplicar buenas prácticas de desarrollo, testing, trazabilidad y monitorización. Colaborar con equipos de Data Science, Data Engineering, Plataforma y Negocio. Requisitos imprescindibles Entre 2 y 5 años de experiencia en Machine Learning, Data Science o desarrollo de soluciones analíticas. Titulación universitaria en Ingeniería Informática, Matemáticas, Física, Estadística, Data Science o similar. Experiencia sólida con Python avanzado aplicado a Machine Learning. Conocimientos prácticos de Machine Learning tradicional: entrenamiento, validación, selección y optimización de modelos. Experiencia con Series Temporales y Forecasting, especialmente en modelos de previsión de demanda. Conocimientos de Optimización Matemática, programación matemática, heurísticas o investigación operativa. Experiencia trabajando con modelos predictivos y análisis de métricas de rendimiento. Conocimientos de SQL para consulta, transformación y validación de datos. Experiencia con PySpark / Apache Spark. Conocimientos de Azure Databricks o plataformas analíticas equivalentes. Experiencia con Git y metodologías de desarrollo colaborativo. Español fluido e inglés técnico. Conocimientos valorables Experiencia en banca, sector financiero, retail o gestión de operaciones. Experiencia combinando modelos de forecasting con modelos de optimización. Conocimientos de MLOps y productivización de modelos de Machine Learning. Experiencia con MLflow para tracking, registro y gestión de modelos. Conocimientos de CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions u otras herramientas). Experiencia migrando notebooks y modelos experimentales a entornos productivos. Conocimientos de monitorización, testing y gobierno de modelos. Experiencia utilizando herramientas de IA generativa como apoyo al desarrollo. ¿Qué ofrecemos? Participación en un proyecto estratégico para el sector bancario. Incorporación a un entorno tecnológico con retos reales de Machine Learning y optimización. Trabajo con tecnologías como Python, Machine Learning, Databricks, PySpark y MLflow. Desarrollo profesional en proyectos de Data Science e Inteligencia Artificial. ¿Te interesa trabajar en proyectos donde los modelos predictivos y la optimización matemática tienen un impacto directo en la toma de decisiones? ¡Queremos conocerte!

Du beherrschst Python sehr gut und hast idealerweise Erfahrung in der Entwicklung produktionsreifer Anwendungen und Datenpipelines. items.desc: Das AIT Austrian Institute of Technology ist Österreichs größte Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) . Unser Ziel ist es, wissenschaftliche Exzellenz in Innovation mit Wirkung zu verwandeln. Gemeinsam mit unseren Partnerinnen und Partnern entwickeln wir Technologien und Lösungen für eine nachhaltige, resiliente und digitalisierte Zukunft und stärken damit die Wettbewerbsfähigkeit und technologische Souveränität Europas. Unsere internationalen Teams verbinden Spitzenforschung mit hoher Umsetzungskompetenz und schaffen messbaren Nutzen für Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft. Die Competence Unit Transformation Governance im Center for Innovation Systems and Policy befasst sich mit aktuellen und zukünftigen Anforderungen an Forschungs- und Innovationssystemen, sowie mit den Handlungsoptionen, die sich hieraus für die Forschungs-, Technologie- und Innovationspolitik und ihre Akteure ergeben. Wir konzentrieren uns einerseits auf Prozesse des Systemwandels („Transformation“) in Bereichen wie KI, Energie und Mobilität und andererseits auf potenziell disruptive Technologien und ihre möglichen Auswirkungen, insbesondere im Zusammenhang mit Digitalisierung und Dekarbonisierung von Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft. Dabei geht es auch um die Stärkung von Akteuren in den Sektoren öffentliche Verwaltung, Wirtschaft, Infrastruktur und Wissenschaft. Für den Standort Wien (Giefinggasse, 1210) suchen wir eine:n Junior Scientist (w/m/d) für AI Governance. items.desc: Kan du navigere i komplekse tekniske udfordringer, og har du erfaring med teknologier relateret til udvikling og drift af GenAI-løsninger? Og kan du blive ved, når det virkelig gælder? Så er du måske vores nye GenAI-specialist i PET’s IT-afdeling. Her udvikler og implementerer vi GenAI-løsninger, som understøtter PET's analytikere og efterforskere i arbejdet med at beskytte rigsfællesskabet. PET er i gang med en digital transformation. Vi styrker vores digitale kapacitet og udvikler både teknologien, fundamentet og måden, vi arbejder på, så vi står stærkere til at løse PET’s opgaver i en stadig mere digital virkelighed. Det kræver stærke IT-kompetencer hele vejen rundt; fra det, der skal virke i dag, til det, vi bygger for fremtiden Fra model til løsning, der virker AI & Machine Learning-teamet er i fuld gang med at udvikle og implementere GenAI-løsninger via vores GenAI-platform. Vi sigter højt og leder efter dig, der både kan arbejde teknisk med løsningerne og være med til at finde ud af, hvordan teknologien skaber reel værdi. Det betyder, at du kan komme ind forskellige steder i arbejdet. Nogle gange skal et behov afdækkes og oversættes til noget, der kan bygges. Andre gange handler det om at integrere en model med eksisterende systemer, afprøve et nyt framework eller forbedre den tooling, som resten af teamet bruger. Det interessante begynder ofte dér, hvor den oplagte løsning ikke helt passer til virkeligheden. For løsningerne skal fungere i vores air-gapped on-prem-miljø, hvor sikkerhed og robusthed er en grundlæggende præmis. Det stiller krav til både de tekniske valg og din evne til at finde en vej frem, når standardløsningen ikke kan bruges. Derfor søger vi en specialist, der bliver ved, også når noget viser sig mere udfordrende end forventet.
