Andre gange er den bedste løsning den mindst smarte, men den, der faktisk virker. El objetivo
items.desc: Buscamos un/a ML Engineer con experiencia en productivización de modelos de Machine Learning, previsión de demanda (Forecasting) y modelos de optimización para incorporarse a un proyecto del sector bancario. La persona participará en la industrialización de modelos ya desarrollados, trabajando para llevarlos a entornos productivos con garantías de robustez, escalabilidad, trazabilidad y mantenibilidad. El objetivo principal será transformar modelos analíticos en soluciones preparadas para producción, colaborando en la mejora de modelos de previsión de demanda basados en series temporales y modelos de optimización aplicados a la toma de decisiones operativas. Responsabilidades Productivizar modelos de Machine Learning existentes, adaptándolos a los estándares técnicos y operativos del entorno bancario. Analizar y mejorar modelos de forecasting y previsión de demanda basados en series temporales. Diseñar y adaptar pipelines de entrenamiento, inferencia y generación de predicciones. Trabajar con entornos Azure Databricks y PySpark. Evaluar estrategias de reentrenamiento, actualización de modelos y persistencia de artefactos. Participar en la optimización de modelos y decisiones operativas, incluyendo la optimización de denominaciones. Integrar modelos con MLflow y herramientas corporativas de gobierno y despliegue. Aplicar buenas prácticas MLOps: versionado, testing, CI/CD, monitorización y trazabilidad. Diagnosticar incidencias en producción y realizar análisis de causa raíz. Colaborar con equipos de Data Engineering, Data Science, Plataforma y Negocio. Documentar soluciones, decisiones técnicas y procedimientos operativos. Requisitos imprescindibles Entre 2 y 5 años de experiencia en Machine Learning, MLOps, Data Science Engineering o posiciones similares. Experiencia real llevando modelos de Machine Learning a producción. Experiencia con forecasting, series temporales o modelos de previsión de demanda. Conocimientos aplicados de modelos de optimización, programación matemática o heurísticas. Python avanzado aplicado a Machine Learning y productivización. Conocimientos de Machine Learning supervisado y validación de modelos. SQL para consulta, transformación y validación de datos. Experiencia con PySpark / Apache Spark. Experiencia con Azure Databricks o plataformas analíticas equivalentes. Experiencia con MLflow o herramientas similares de gestión y seguimiento de modelos. Git y herramientas de CI/CD como Jenkins o GitHub Actions. Buenas prácticas de desarrollo: modularización, testing, logging, control de errores y documentación. Titulación universitaria en Ingeniería Informática, Matemáticas, Estadística, Física, Data Science o similar. Español fluido e inglés técnico.

items.desc: ¿Te interesa llevar modelos de machine learning a producción de verdad, con criterios de escalabilidad, trazabilidad y negocio? En NTT DATA buscamos una persona con experiencia como ML Engineer para incorporarse a un proyecto relevante en un cliente de Barcelona. Formarás parte de un equipo que trabaja en la industrialización de soluciones de IA, conectando desarrollo, cloud y operación para que los modelos generen impacto más allá del entorno experimental. En NTT DATA encontrarás la escala y diversidad de una compañía tecnológica global, junto con equipos cercanos que comparten conocimiento, se apoyan y buscan hacer las cosas mejor. Trabajamos en proyectos que combinan tecnología, negocio e innovación, sin conformarnos con soluciones que solo funcionan sobre el papel. Tu reto: Convertir soluciones de machine learning en productos fiables, desplegables y sostenibles en un entorno Azure. Qué harás en tu día a día: Desarrollar, entrenar y evolucionar modelos de machine learning con Python . Diseñar y mantener pipelines de entrenamiento, validación y despliegue de modelos. Trabajar con servicios cloud de Microsoft Azure , especialmente en entornos de Azure Machine Learning. Aplicar prácticas de MLOps para asegurar versionado, reproducibilidad, monitorización y calidad de los modelos. Colaborar con perfiles de Data Science, Data Engineering, arquitectura y negocio para llevar casos de uso a producción. Optimizar el rendimiento, la mantenibilidad y la escalabilidad de las soluciones desarrolladas. Participar en decisiones técnicas y proponer mejoras sobre herramientas, procesos y arquitectura. Qué buscamos: Al menos 3 años de experiencia en desarrollo de soluciones de Machine Learning con Python. Experiencia práctica con Azure y, preferiblemente, con Azure Machine Learning . Conocimientos de ciclo de vida de modelos: entrenamiento, evaluación, despliegue y monitorización. Experiencia con herramientas y prácticas de MLOps: CI/CD, control de versiones, contenerización o automatización de pipelines. Capacidad para colaborar con equipos multidisciplinares y trasladar necesidades de negocio a soluciones técnicas. Interés por seguir profundizando en IA aplicada, cloud y operación de modelos. Qué encontrarás en NTT DATA: Un proyecto en el que tu trabajo ayudará a que la IA llegue a producción con impacto tangible. Espacio para crecer en especialización técnica, asumir retos progresivamente más complejos y compartir conocimiento con otras personas expertas. Una modalidad de trabajo híbrida en Barcelona , diseñada para combinar colaboración y flexibilidad. Acceso al paquete de beneficios de NTT DATA España . Una cultura en la que la cercanía, la colaboración y el respeto por las personas forman parte de la manera de trabajar. En NTT DATA creemos que toda persona es única y diferente y por ello apostamos por una cultura inclusiva que reconoce y valora la diversidad. Trabajamos día a día para crear un entorno en el que podamos explorar, vivir y potenciar nuestra propia singularidad. #WeAreAllUnique #YouMakeUsUnique Make THIS the place to GROW

items.desc: Internship details Periode: 4 – 6 maanden Uren: 32 - 40 Locatie: Amsterdam ITO office Start datum: Flexibel, eerste werkdag van de maand Als stagiair Data & AI draai je mee in het team wat verantwoordelijk is voor diverse projecten voor verschillende opdrachtgevers. Het Data & AI team focust zich voornamelijk op het verbeteren en/of automatiseren van bedrijfsprocessen middels het implementeren van technologische toepassingen bij klanten in diverse industrieën. Tijdens de periode doe je onderzoek naar een onderwerp wat jij interessant vindt en kun je gebruik maken van onze expertise en technologieën. Team: Het team binnen Data & AI bestaat uit ca. 200 collega’s. Je vaste begeleider is een senior consultant met veel ervaring in het vak. Daarnaast worden stagairs opgenomen in de Technology General Practice Interns – community van alle stagairs in de overkoepelende Technology General Practice– die je op weg helpt in de brede Accenture wereld. Dagelijkse taken: Tijdens jouw internship hebben we iedere week een meeting met de gehele community op ons kantoor. Verder ben je gedurende de dag bezig met jouw onderzoek, voer je taken uit zoals het ontwikkelen van een proof of concept (PoC), en netwerk je met collega’s om aan benodigde kennis te komen. Technologie: Binnen het domein Data & AI werken we samen met onze klanten om allerlei digitale technologieën te implementeren. Data: De waarde van data is cruciaal voor het creëren van extra waarde voor onze klanten en het ontwikkelen van oplossingen. Als Accenture hebben wij een Data-driven approach richting onze klanten om het onderscheid te maken. Geïnteresseerd? Reageer dan met jouw cv en motivatiebrief waarin je beschrijft waar je onderzoek naar wil doen. Je kunt jouw motivatiebrief toevoegen in ons Workday systeem. Wie wij zijn Dankzij ongeëvenaarde branche-ervaring, toonaangevende technologieën van onze ecosysteempartners en startups en het grootste delivery network ter wereld, bieden wij een krachtig scala aan mogelijkheden die kunnen worden afgestemd op de meest complexe behoeften van onze klanten. Met meer dan 100 innovation hubs wereldwijd helpen we klanten voortdurend te innoveren – snel en schaalbaar – zodat zij hun concurrenten voor kunnen blijven. Jij brengt innovatie, intelligentie en branchekennis samen met de nieuwste technologieën om klanten te helpen innoveren en hun bedrijf te transformeren. Technology is een van de vijf diensten die samen One Accenture vormen – de andere zijn Strategy & Consulting, Operations, Song en Industry X. Accenture is een wereldwijd bedrijf met een merk en reputatie van wereldklasse. Onze mensen zijn Change Makers en om hen als werkgever te ondersteunen, doen we vijf beloften: Werk flexibel, in een cultuur gebaseerd op vertrouwen Een mindset gefocussed op duurzaamheid en groei Een cultuur waarin Inclusion & Diversity voorop staat en waarbij echt om de mensen gegeven wordt Adviseer en transformeer onze klanten met technologie. Verbind je met een wereldwijd netwerk van 700.000 collega's Deze beloften komen tot uiting in onze uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden, waaronder: Loopbaanbegeleiding (en academische ondersteuning) aangeboden door je persoonlijk aangestelde supervisor Je krijgt een stagevergoeding van 500 euro per maand op basis van 40 uur per week Een reiskostenvergoeding als je niet beschikt over een studenten-ov Een laptop De mogelijkheid om hybride te werken en toegang tot elk kantoor van Accenture in Nederland. Sociale activiteiten zoals vrijdagborrels, sportevenementen en feesten Wat wij geloven Accenture is een werkgever die gelijke kansen biedt. Onze leiders zijn toegewijd aan het bouwen van een beter, sterker en rechtvaardiger bedrijf voor toekomstige generaties om positieve, langdurige verandering te creëren. Inclusie en diversiteit zijn fundamenteel voor onze cultuur en kernwaarden. We zetten ons in voor het creëren van een inclusieve omgeving voor al onze medewerkers. Onze rijke diversiteit maakt ons innovatiever en creatiever, waardoor we onze klanten en onze gemeenschappen beter van dienst kunnen zijn. Onze positie als partner van veel van 's werelds toonaangevende bedrijven, organisaties en overheden biedt ons zowel een buitengewone kans als een enorme verantwoordelijkheid om een verschil te maken. items.desc: Ready to put what you’ve learned during your studies into practice and tackle real-world challenges, helping a growing international Software as a Service company become more AI-enabled and data-driven? Join UNIwise as an AI & Data Analyst Intern at our headquarter in Aarhus - starting as soon as possible in early 2027, for approximately 20 weeks. What you will do We already have a number of internal AI tools in place and a clear, ambitious strategy to make even better use of AI across the business. You will assist our commercial AI Lead in developing new internal AI tools, while also maintaining and improving our existing tools and integrations, helping turn that ambition into effective everyday use. Alongside this, you will support our Finance Manager and CFO in delivering on our data and BI ambitions. This includes helping optimise our master data management and use of databases, as well as improving reports and dashboards, with the clear aim to be a more data-driven organisation. Your primary contact person will be our CFO and you will also work closely with our Finance team, our commercial AI Lead, the management team and colleagues in our administrative functions to connect technology and data with everyday business needs. In practice, your tasks will include: AI Tools – operations and development: Help maintain and further develop our internal AI tools and integrations. You will troubleshoot issues, build automations and workflows, help set up new tools and support colleagues adopting the tools. AI strategy and adoption: Support our commercial AI Lead and the rest of the organisation where relevant in driving and implementing our strategy for internal use of AI. This includes mapping processes where AI can save time or improve quality, testing solutions with colleagues and following up on usage and value. Master data management: Assist our Finance Manager in mapping and optimising master data management across our systems and improving our use of databases. BI and reporting: Help develop and optimise BI reports and dashboards that improve our reporting and make insights clear and useful for management and the wider organisation. Who we’re looking for You are enrolled in a higher education programme and can start an internship of approximately 20 weeks as soon as possible. There may be an opportunity to continue as a student assistant afterwards. Your field of study could be Business Intelligence, Computer Science, IT Architecture or a related programme, ideally in the Aarhus area. You are curious about AI and have experimented with tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or Copilot, and want to explore how technology and data can create value for colleagues. You can write simple scripts, work with databases or set up integrations - or are quick to learn. You are interested in data quality, data structures and BI, and enjoy turning data into clear, useful insights. You work in a structured and independent way, take initiative and follow tasks through, with the ambition to build solutions that remain useful after your internship. You communicate clearly in Danish and English and enjoy helping colleagues understand and use new tools. What you can expect from us Hands-on experience with internal AI tools, data management and BI tasks in an international SaaS company. Close collaboration with our Finance team and commercial AI Lead on practical business challenges. An internship with real responsibility and the opportunity to take ownership of tools and improvements. The opportunity to develop both your technical skills and business understanding. Delicious lunch scheme to fuel the energy throughout the day. A friendly and collaborative work environment and a culture built on trust that empowers creativity and encourages continuous learning professionally and personally. How to Apply Please submit your resume and a cover letter. Tell us about an AI tool, automation or BI project you have built or used, and the problem it helped solve. We hold interviews on an ongoing basis, so please apply as soon as possible and no later than 30 November 2026. For questions about the internship, please contact CFO Peder Dahl at peder.dahl@uniwise.dk. About Us UNIwise is a Danish EdTech company behind WISEflow, a platform for digital examinations and assessment. More than 150 higher education institutions in over 14 European countries use our solutions. In addition to WISEflow, we develop solutions including Originality, Marking Studio, AI-Assisted Feedback and Proctoring.

You will act as a bridge between technology and business needs, helping turn complex data and laboratory challenges into practical solutions that create measurable value. Ensure data integrity, compliance, and traceability across global laboratory systems. Collaborate with scientists, software engineers, and compliance experts to develop scalable, value-creating digital solutions. Design and maintain analytical dashboards and KPIs that provide actionable insights into laboratory performance. Has experience with data processing, analytics, and technologies such as Power BI, Databricks, Python, and SQL. Is comfortable communicating and collaborating in English. Enjoys combining hands-on data work with stakeholder engagement and translating business needs into technical solutions. Takes ownership of the solutions you build, including the support and updates needed after implementation. Thrives in a collaborative, agile, and fast-changing environment where you can take initiative and drive progress. items.desc: Job Description Veikkaus is embarking on its most significant transformation yet. As we prepare for the opening of the Finnish licensing market in 2027 and rapidly expand our international presence, data and AI are at the absolute core of our strategy. We are looking for a Data Scientist to contribute to the development of advanced personalization and recommendation models. In this key role within our Personalization team, you will design and implement machine learning solutions that enhance customer experience across our digital channels and drive measurable business impact. You will collaborate closely with fellow data scientists and engineers across the full machine learning lifecycle, taking a broad, hands-on role in data generation and exploration, model development, evaluation, and deployment. This is full-time, permanent position and located at Veikkaus headquarters in Pohjois-Haaga, Helsinki. To foster collaboration and effective teamwork we work in a hybrid model with three on-site days per week. Please note that this job requires a valid residence permit for all non-EU citizens. Your Responsibilities Will Include (but Are Not Limited To) Design, build, and optimize production-grade recommendation engines and personalization models Develop algorithms for dynamic content ranking, cross-sell/up-sell, churn prediction, and personalized player journeys in a responsible gaming context Build and connect the full production loop: from data and feature pipelines to real-time model serving, online A/B testing, and continuous optimization with engineering and product teams Take full ownership of your models across the entire lifecycle from data generation and investigation to deployment proactively finding ways to make the product better every day Build, monitor, and iterate on production ML workflows using modern MLOps practices (CI/CD for ML, model monitoring, feature stores) to ensure reliable, real-world performance Design and analyze rigorous A/B tests and experiments to quantify model performance and business impact. Leverage modern agentic coding tools and AI-assisted workflows to build and iterate faster, backed by a strong intuitive grasp of the underlying algorithms, data behavior, and production system architecture Translate business goals into technical metrics and actionable data science problems This role is for you if you Extensive experience (3+ years) in data science, with a strong focus on building and deploying recommendation systems or personalization solutions in production environments (e.g., e-commerce, gaming, media, AdTech). You also have hands-on experience with ML engineering practices, including building, orchestrating, and maintaining reliable end-to-end data and feature pipelines for training and inference. We Also Need You To Have Strong programming skills in Python and solid experience with modern ML frameworks (e.g. PyTorch, TensorFlow) Deep understanding of machine learning algorithms and techniques (e.g., collaborative filtering, two-tower retrieval models, gradient-boosted trees, learning-to-rank, and causal inference). Good SQL skills and experience working with large-scale data in cloud environments (e.g. Snowflake/BigQuery) Familiarity with MLOps concepts and tools (e.g., model versioning, CI/CD for ML, monitoring; experience with Azure/AWS/GCP is a plus) Strong business acumen and the ability to link technical work to business KPIs You have excellent problem-solving skills and a proactive, "can-do" attitude. You’ll face meaningful challenges and gain new skills while contributing to shared success – in Finland and beyond. We value curiosity and create space for it to thrive. Inspiring and supportive teammates you can rely on. The best ideas and world-class entertainment are built together – and Veikkaus thrives because of its people. Balanced and inspiring work life. items.desc: Department: Sustainability Data Solutions & AI Location: Bagsværd, Denmark Your impact begins here As an intern in Sustainability Data Solutions & AI, you will turn sustainability data into insight Novo can act on. You will develop a data analytics use case that combines energy and water data from source systems with global sustainability data, and help make that data cleaner, more reliable and easier to reuse. Working on real business challenges alongside experienced data analysts and engineers, you will see your work support decisions across the organisation. What You’ll Bring You are curious, analytical and motivated by using data and technology to solve sustainability challenges. You are a student, and you bring: A basic understanding of sustainability, environmental data or ESG topics, for example energy, water or greenhouse gas emissions. Experience with Power BI or another data visualisation or BI tool. Experience with at least one coding language, such as Python. An interest in AI, automation and advanced analytics, and in how they can be applied to sustainability challenges. A structured way of working with a clear eye for detail, and the ability to work independently while supporting those around you. The ability to explain data clearly to colleagues with less technical insight, with strong written and spoken English. Familiarity with data engineering, data pipelines or cloud-based analytics platforms, such as Databricks. Knowledge of statistical modelling, operational research or operations management. Experience with larger datasets, including data cleaning, transformation, validation or analysis. What You’ll Do You will contribute to real projects, taking ownership of selected tasks while supporting the wider team’s initiatives. Your work will help strengthen how sustainability data is collected, integrated, analysed and used across Novo. Develop a data analytics use case that combines energy and water data from source systems with global sustainability data, turning operational data into actionable business insight. Support the integration and automation of sustainability data in the Sustainability Data Foundation, including data pipelines and automated recurring reporting and data-quality controls in Databricks. Improve the quality, transparency and availability of sustainability data by creating clean, reliable and reusable datasets in line with the FAIR principles: Findable, Accessible, Interoperable and Reusable. Support the digitalisation of sustainability data and analytics by connecting sustainability information with relevant business and operational metrics. Contribute to BI solutions for reporting, forecasting and decision-making, as well as ad hoc analyses across sustainability data and technology. Who You’ll Work With You will join the Sustainability Data Solutions & AI team, part of the Sustainability Strategy and Insights department. The team of data analysts and data engineers drives data analytics on the sustainability agenda for Novo. The department has eight colleagues at headquarters, two in Poland and two in Bangalore, India, so you will work with colleagues across locations. You will also work closely with stakeholders across Novo who are helping to implement the sustainability strategy across the value chain. Your manager will be [insert hiring manager name]. You will move work forward by bringing technical depth and clear communication together, from deep dives into the data to conversations with colleagues who are less familiar with it. What You Can Expect Here You will work on real business challenges, with room to take ownership and make your voice heard. You will learn from experienced data and sustainability professionals, build practical skills in tools such as Databricks and Power BI, and see how data and AI are applied to sustainability across a global organisation. The pace is fast, and you will be supported to perform at your best. If allowed by your educational institution, the internship is paid at a fixed monthly base rate of DKK 15,900, plus a pension scheme (currently 10% employer contribution and 5% employee contribution). Start now Your impact begins today. If you are ready to turn sustainability data into insight and progress, apply for the Internship in Sustainability Data Solutions & AI by November 20, 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

items.desc: Data Scientist Focused on Revenue Management & Network Optimization At SAS, we're passionate about transforming aviation with cutting-edge technology. As part of our ongoing Digital & IT transformation, we are expanding our investments in AI, machine learning, advanced analytics, and data-driven decision-making to create smarter customer experiences and stronger commercial performance. As part of our AI Team, you'll shape the future of air travel by creating innovative, data-driven solutions that maximize revenue. You will work on one of the most challenging and rewarding problems in the industry: finding the right price, for the right customer, at the right time. Your work will ensure that the airline's Revenue Optimization remains scientifically robust, operationally scalable, and commercially impactful, directly shaping how revenue is optimized in a dynamic, competitive marketplace. Your responsibilities will center on turning business challenges into well-defined analytical problems and building end-to-end machine learning solutions that deliver measurable impact. You will design, train, and maintain models that power SAS's revenue optimization, ensuring they are accurate, scalable, and production-ready. A priority will be to deliver dynamic pricing, a groundbreaking shift in how SAS competes in the marketplace. Job Description You will join our Data team , currently in its growth phase, with a twofold challenge: industrializing a platform able to absorb massive real-time volumes (1,000,000 events per second), and turning that critical mass of information into tangible product value. This Role Deliberately Straddles Two Worlds Within the Data team, you build and harden the pipelines that feed the entire company. As reinforcement for our tech and product squads, you join pitches that call for genuine mathematical, statistical and algorithmic depth: designing, adapting and implementing the advanced algorithms behind the features we want to build and then shipping them to production yourself. This is a role for someone who dislikes the border between the notebook and the running service: you design the algorithm, you write it properly, you deploy it, you monitor it. Your Missions Build and operate the data platform (Data Engineer hat) Design and implement in Python data processing workflows, from development to production. Centralize and harmonize heterogeneous sources (Product, Finance, Marketing) to make data accessible and reliable for all Sekoia teams. Develop, test, and orchestrate pipelines (via Airflow). Act as a curator of the data, collecting and enriching the business data generated day after day by our automated sensors and our analysts. Monitor and guarantee the quality and back-end performance of production. Bring algorithmic value to the product squads (Data Scientist hat) Join a squad for the duration of a pitch to own the data science / algorithmic building block of the feature. Understand the business needs of our analysts and Product Managers, and translate them into an algorithmic methodology or a statistical learning model. Select, adapt or design the right algorithm, including when the answer isn't an off-the-shelf model: heuristics, statistical methods, graph algorithms, anomaly detection, and so on. Define the evaluation metrics and demonstrate that the solution genuinely answers the need, at our scale. Ship it and keep it running (MLOps hat) Deploy your algorithms to production for the long run, within a quality assurance process: automated testing, continuous integration, code review. Industrialize the model lifecycle: packaging, reproducibility, versioning, retraining, monitoring and drift tracking. Propose innovative solutions to ensure the resilience and performance of our processing under heavy load. Empower your colleagues by providing the tools they need to leverage high-quality data independently. Bring a critical eye and contribute to the team's growth (knowledge sharing, mentoring). 📍 The position is ideally based in Paris, or can be based in Rennes, with up to 3 remote days per week. Your Profile 🤩 We are excited to meet you if : You hold a Master's-level degree or above (MSc, engineering school, PhD) and have 3 to 5 years of professional experience combining data science and software development — or a data engineering background with a genuine appetite for algorithms. You are proficient in Python and its scientific ecosystem: pandas, scikit-learn, as well as SQL. You have strong skills in algorithms, complexity classes, optimization, and machine learning: you can reason about an algorithm before implementing it, and estimate what it will cost at scale. You are an engineer, not just a prototyper: you write tested, reviewed, maintainable code, and you are comfortable with continuous integration and software engineering best practices. You are a proactive "doer": autonomous and mature, you take ownership of your subjects rather than waiting for instructions. You are driven by efficiency and resilience, capable of building systems that stay performant under heavy loads. You are deeply curious about new trends in the data ecosystem and about technological change. You write and speak English fluently. 🚀 Bonus Point You have experience in cybersecurity You are comfortable with Spark (PySpark). You hold a PhD in computer science. 👀 Are you interested in this job but feel you haven't ticked all the boxes? Don't hesitate to apply, and tell us in the cover letter section why we absolutely must meet! items.desc: AI and data are becoming part of more business processes. To make sure that security keeps pace, we are looking for an AI Security Engineer to help us build and improve secure AI capabilities in our Cyber Defense Center (CDC). Your impact at NN You will help us adopt AI securely within CDC. You will bring together security engineering, platform integration, and AI expertise to support AI capabilities across CDC platforms and the security monitoring of AI services used throughout the organization. The day-to-day: what you’ll be doing Help design and deliver AI security initiatives across CDC platforms. Work with Detection Engineers, Threat Hunters, SOC analysts, and other colleagues. Build and maintain security monitoring for AI and data platforms. Look for ways AI workloads or their supporting infrastructure could be attacked or misused. Help build scalable ways to onboard AI and data platforms, such as Databricks or similar environments. Set up agreed logging and connect security-relevant data from AI platforms. Deliver your part of projects with support from senior engineers and the Product Owner. Make technical decisions within your area and raise those with a wider impact. Use and promote good engineering practices and help us improve how we work. Help adopt modern Azure services and emerging AI technologies. Document your work and share what you know with the team. You’ll have room to take ownership, shape technical solutions, and work with people across security and engineering. What Makes This a Good Place To Work Real AI security: Help build and secure AI capabilities that strengthen threat detection and investigation across the CDC. Room to learn and grow: Support for certification, training, and continuous development. Hybrid working that works: A strong home office culture, flexible time off, and a setup where you can work from home most of the time. We meet in the office once a week. People-first team: Down-to-earth colleagues, open communication, and no unnecessary formalities. No ego, no blame. Just real support. The tools you need: A company laptop and iPhone with a fully paid plan. Benefits that add up: Cafeteria up to 20,000 CZK, pension contributions, a MultiSport card, meal allowance, a discount on life insurance, and a contribution to home office expenses. Referral bonus: Up to 60,000 CZK for bringing new colleagues on board. Onboarding built around you: More in-person support during your probation period to help you settle in. What You’ll Bring 2-5 years of relevant experience. Professional knowledge of cloud and DevOps tooling. A good understanding of AI, LLM, and ML technologies and their security risks. Experience designing AI workflows and connecting them to business processes and third-party systems. Strong problem-solving and critical thinking skills. A responsible approach and the ability to follow through. The ability to make decisions within your technical area and flag those with a wider impact. Advanced English at C1 level. A university degree. What Happens After You Apply Send us your CV in English. If your experience looks like a good match, we’ll get in touch and keep the conversation going. You can expect three rounds: first, a chat with HR and the hiring manager to get to know each other and talk about the role; then, a technical interview with the Product Owner and members of the team; and finally, a short call with the CDC manager. At least one of these conversations will be in person, because even in the age of AI, we still prefer meeting people over pixels.

items.desc: Deloitte er et av verdens ledende profesjonelle tjenestehus med over 470 000 ansatte globalt. I Norge er vi ca. 1600 medarbeidere som hjelper klienter med rådgivning, revisjon, skatt og juridiske tjenester. Hos oss jobber du i et inkluderende og mangfoldig miljø der vi setter pris på ulike perspektiver, kompetanser og bakgrunner. I AI & Data Deloitte hjelper virksomheter med å skape verdi med AI og data – fra strategi og dataplattformer til AI-løsninger og innsikt. Vi ser etter deg som kan kombinere faglig kompetanse med forståelse for virksomhetens behov – og som vil være med på å utvikle løsninger som gir verdi i praksis. Vi ser etter deg som har relevant arbeidserfaring, er nysgjerrig og lærer raskt, og som ønsker å bruke kompetansen din til å skape impact that matters. Hva vil du jobbe med? Du vil bidra innenfor ett eller flere av disse områdene: AI Strategy & Governance: Hjelpe virksomheter med å identifisere verdifulle muligheter, prioritere initiativer og etablere retning og rammer for bruk av AI og data. Data Platform & Engineering: Utforme og bygge trygge, skalerbare dataplattformer, dataarkitektur og datapipelines som legger grunnlaget for analyse og AI. AI Solutions & Insights: Utvikle analyser og AI-løsninger som gir bedre innsikt, støtter beslutninger og forbedrer arbeidsprosesser. Hvem ser vi etter? Du har fullført en relevant utdanning på masternivå (NHH, CBS, NTNU, BI, NMBU, UiO, UiB og anerkjente internasjonale universiteter). Du har erfaring med å forstå et forretningsbehov og omsette det til en konkret leveranse . Du kan forklare hvilke valg du tok, hva du selv hadde ansvar for, og hvilken verdi arbeidet skapte. Avhengig av fagprofilen din har du erfaring med noen , men ikke nødvendigvis alle, av disse områdene: Klassisk AI, AI-assistenter, agenter eller bruk av AI til å forbedre arbeidsprosesser Dataplattformer og skytjenester som Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, Azure, AWS eller Google Cloud Innsikt og visualisering gjennom Power BI, Qlik, Tableau, Power Platform eller skreddersydde applikasjoner Programmering, datamodellering, datatransformasjon og datapipelines med for eksempel Python, SQL, PySpark eller DAX Som seniorkonsulent forventer vi i tillegg at du kan ta større ansvar for leveranser, gjøre faglige avveininger og bidra til å utvikle både løsninger og kolleger. Hvorfor Deloitte? Hos oss får du jobbe med reelle problemer, tverrfaglige team og virksomheter med ulike behov. Du får et inkluderende fagmiljø, tilgang til et globalt nettverk og tydelige muligheter for læring og utvikling – blant annet gjennom Faglig Community og Deloitte University . Arbeidssted: Oslo eller Bergen Søknadsfrist: Fortløpende Dersom du er nysgjerrig eller har spørsmål om stillingen er du velkommen til å ta kontakt med Victoria Dessen (458 63 586). For spørsmål om søknadsprosessen kan du kontakte Amalie Worm Andersen (amaandersen@deloitte.no). Du får muligheten til å jobbe i et selskap som hjelper andre aktører med sin grønne omstilling, samtidig som vi arbeider målrettet med egne ambisjoner innenfor både klima og miljø og samfunnsansvar. Som ansatt i Deloitte integreres bærekraft i arbeidshverdagen, og du får anledning til å bidra i ulike prosjekter og initiativer knyttet til dette. Som samfunnsaktør, arbeidsgiver og tjenesteleverandør har Deloitte et stort fokus på mangfold og inkludering. Vi ser at ulike perspektiver fremmer nytenkning, gir dypere innsikt og bedre beslutninger, og ikke minst mobiliserer potensialet til medarbeiderne våre! Vi ønsker derfor et stort mangfold blant søkere.

items.desc: Ausschreibungs-ID: ZE-0086-MCDCI-wmz-2026 Eintrittstermin: nächstmöglich Bewerbungsfrist: 29.11.2026 Entgeltgruppe: E 13 TV-H Befristung: 31.07.2027 Umfang: Teilzeit (50 %) Die 1527 gegründete Philipps-Universität bietet vielfach ausgezeichnete Lehre für rund 22.000 Studierende und stellt sich mit exzellenter Forschung in der Breite der Wissenschaft den wichtigen Themen unserer Zeit. Am Marburg Center for Digital Culture and Infrastructure (MCDCI) und am Institut für Medienwissenschaft ist im Drittmittelprojekt DiCi-Hub (Digital Cinema Hub): A Research Hub for Digital Film Studies zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt befristet bis 31.07.2027 eine drittmittelfinanzierte Teilzeitstelle (50 % der regelmäßigen Arbeitszeit) als Wissenschaftliche r Mitarbeiter in (Data Science) zu besetzen. Die Eingruppierung erfolgt nach Entgeltgruppe 13 des Tarifvertrages des Landes Hessen. Das MCDCI ist ein interdisziplinäres wissenschaftliches Zentrum, das digitale Methoden in den Geistes- und Sozialwissenschaften sowie die digitale Transformation von Gesellschaft, Kultur und Wissenschaft erforscht. Das MCDCI wird von der Philipps-Universität Marburg gemeinsam mit dem Herder-Institut für historische Ostmitteleuropaforschung – Institut der Leibniz-Gemeinschaft, dem Hessischen Landesarchiv, der Archivschule Marburg – Hochschule für Archivwissenschaft sowie dem Hessischen Institut für Landesgeschichte getragen. Das Projekt „DiCi-Hub (Digital Cinema-Hub): A Research Hub for Digital Film Studies“ wird von der VolkswagenStiftung im Rahmen der Förderinitiative „Weltwissen – Strukturelle Stärkung Kleiner Fächer“ gefördert und von der Philipps-Universität Marburg federführend in Kooperation mit der Filmwissenschaft der Universitäten Mainz und Frankfurt durchgeführt. Das Projekt entwickelt digitale Tools und Methoden für die filmwissenschaftliche Lehre und Forschung mit den Schwerpunkten Netzwerke (Marburg), Formate (Mainz) und Märkte (Frankfurt). Die Stelle bietet eine anregende kollegiale Forschungsumgebung, anspruchsvolle anwendungsbezogene Explorationen, vielfältige disziplinäre und transdisziplinäre Vernetzungen auf regionaler, nationaler und internationaler Ebene und eine aktive Unterstützung bei der Weiterentwicklung eines internationalen Profils. In Marburg ist das Projekt eingebunden in eine dynamisch wachsende Forschungsumgebung von verwandten Projekten und Institutionen, die sich rund um das „Marburg Center for Digital Culture and Infrastructure“ (MCDCI) gruppieren, mit dem eng kooperiert wird. Zu den Projekten gehören u. a. FID Media (media/rep/), NFDI4Culture und AVefi - Automatisiertes Verbundsystem für audiovisuelle Bestände über einheitliche Filmidentifikatoren. Ihre Aufgaben: Anwendung datenwissenschaftlicher Methoden im Projekt DiCi-Hub Pflege und Aufbereitung von Forschungsdaten Mitarbeit an wissenschaftlichen Publikationen Beratung der Projektmitarbeiter*innen in datenwissenschaftlichen Methoden Mitarbeit an Open Educational Resources Es handelt sich um eine Projektstelle, die nicht nach 2 Abs. 1 WissZeitVG befristet wird. items.title: ML Engineer (Fully Remote)
items.card: In this role, you will bridge the gap between research and production, taking models out of notebooks and packaging them into versioned, production-ready artifacts served behind standardised APIs. You will own inference performance, cost, and output provenance across cloud, on-premise, and fully air-gapped environments. For this role, you need to be located in Malta or willing to relocate. Key Responsibilities
items.desc: We are seeking an ML Engineer specialising in Python to package, serve, and operate AI capabilities across our client's shared platform. Their customers rely on fast, defensible answers across massive volumes of unstructured text, documents, audio, and video for critical missions in defence, intelligence, and law enforcement. In this role, you will bridge the gap between research and production, taking models out of notebooks and packaging them into versioned, production-ready artifacts served behind standardised APIs. You will own inference performance, cost, and output provenance across cloud, on-premise, and fully air-gapped environments. For this role, you need to be located in Malta or willing to relocate. Key Responsibilities Production Serving: Package models as immutable, versioned artefacts, deploy them onto shared runtime infrastructures (e.g., Triton, vLLM), and expose them behind standards-compliant contracts. Benchmarking & Model Selection: Evaluate and select models using a centralised testing framework with reproducible runs, clear task metrics, and complete documentation. Performance & Cost Optimisation: Manage inference latency, throughput, dynamic batching, quantisation, and GPU placement to keep performance high and cost accountable. Observability & Operations: Instrument dashboards, trace request pipelines, monitor for quality/drift, and participate in on-call rotations for served capabilities. Constrained & Offline Delivery: Prepare ML pipelines and OCI artefacts for unattended execution in air-gapped customer environments with strict audit and provenance constraints. Requirements Depth in at least one key domain: Language & NLP, Speech & Audio, Vision & Document AI, or Agentic & LLM Systems. Advanced production skill in Python (3.12+, uv, PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers) with a proven track record of reading, adapting, and evaluating model implementations. Hands-on experience with production model serving (vLLM, NVIDIA Triton), FastAPI, and streaming OpenAI-compatible API contracts. Experience deploying GPU workloads on Kubernetes (node selection, autoscaling, scheduling constraints) and managing observability (tracing, latency percentiles, GPU utilization). Strong evaluation hygiene with task-appropriate metrics (F1, mAP, WER, BLEU/COMET, DER), regression gating in CI, and experiment tracking. Firm grasp of ML provenance, reproducible builds, and immutable artefact packaging (OCI model supply chain). Benefits Fully Remote Set-Up Company equipment and a home office budget Relocation Support Education and experience Passionate about EU Security and Defence.

items.desc: Description de l’offre Pour le compte de notre client, un groupe d’investissement indépendant alliant expertise financière et innovation technologique, nous recherchons un Business Analyst IA orienté terrain, disposant d’une expérience concrète de Claude en environnement professionnel. Rattaché à l’équipe Technologie, vous travaillerez au contact direct des équipes métiers pour intégrer l’IA dans leurs activités quotidiennes. Ce poste opérationnel implique une utilisation intensive de Claude : comprendre les besoins, expérimenter, configurer des solutions, tester leur efficacité et accompagner leur adoption. Nous privilégions un profil junior, vif et agile, avec une pratique concrète de Claude, une bonne communication et l’envie d’apprendre et d’agir sur le terrain. Une connaissance de la finance constitue un atout. Le poste est basé à Genève, avec une présence régulière sur site et une possibilité de télétravail selon les modalités convenues. Il est proposé en Try & Hire, avec une perspective de CDI. Missions principales Travailler au quotidien avec les équipes métiers pour comprendre leurs activités et identifier les usages de l’IA les plus utiles. Utiliser et configurer Claude de manière intensive pour améliorer les processus, faciliter l’accès à l’information et automatiser certaines tâches. Concevoir, tester et ajuster des instructions, des projets et des workflows adaptés aux besoins des utilisateurs. Transformer les initiatives individuelles en solutions fiables, partagées et réutilisables. Formaliser les besoins métiers et coordonner leur mise en œuvre avec les ingénieurs. Accompagner les utilisateurs sur le terrain, recueillir leurs retours et diffuser les bonnes pratiques. Contribuer à la gestion des accès, des permissions et de la confidentialité des données avec l’équipe Technologie. Nous recherchons un profil respectant les critères suivants: Une expérience concrète de Claude en environnement professionnel, avec des exemples de réalisations et l’envie d’en faire un outil central de votre quotidien. Un esprit vif, curieux et agile, capable de comprendre rapidement les besoins métiers et de les traduire en solutions opérationnelles. Une communication claire et le goût du terrain, pour collaborer avec les équipes et accompagner les utilisateurs. De l’autonomie, du pragmatisme et une aisance technique pour explorer des données et dialoguer avec les ingénieurs. Des notions de développement, de bases de données ou de Git sont appréciées. Une connaissance de la finance constitue un atout. Une maîtrise du français et un niveau d’anglais B2 minimum.

If you do have a student travel product, you receive a maximum of €9.20 per workday as travel contribution. You can apply via https://hcme.catsone.nl/careers or by sending an email to hr.admin.support@landcros.eu including your CV and a short motivation.

items.desc: Shape confidence in technology, risk and digital transformation Programme Overview On the Technology Risk Graduate Programme, you’ll shape the future with confidence by helping organisations identify and manage the technology risks that matter. You’ll work in collaborative teams, using data, technology and insight to support responsible innovation across areas like cloud, AI and cybersecurity. Along the way, you'll study towards a professional qualification relevant to your role, helping you build the skills, knowledge and experience needed for a successful career. Problem solving — identify technology risks and support the development of practical, effective solutions. Inclusive collaboration — work with diverse teams and stakeholders to evaluate systems and deliver outcomes. Critical thinking and judgement — assess risks, controls and evidence to form sound conclusions and recommendations. Adaptability — respond to evolving technologies, regulations and client environments with confidence. Digital fluency — understand and apply concepts across areas such as cloud, AI, cybersecurity and data. What You Will Be Doing Work on IT audits and risk engagements that assess technology environments and support better business decisions. Analyse risks and controls across areas such as cybersecurity, cloud, data and emerging technologies. Collaborate with teams and clients to evaluate systems, identify issues and deliver practical recommendations. Build your skills through hands-on project work, learning key frameworks, tools and regulatory requirements.

What you'll be doing Exploring large, messy administrative datasets and judging whether they can answer the question being asked Building statistical and machine learning models, including NLP on free text records where it helps Writing clean, version controlled Python or R that colleagues can read, rerun and extend Querying and shaping data with SQL on Amazon Athena and S3 Working with data engineers on the features, tables and pipelines your models depend on Turning results into clear outputs for non technical audiences, from short briefings to interactive dashboards Quality assuring your own and others' work through code review, testing and peer checks What we're looking for Essential: Strong Python or R for analysis and modelling (pandas, scikit-learn, or tidyverse and tidymodels) Confident SQL on large datasets Experience on AWS, especially Athena, S3 or SageMaker A practical grasp of machine learning and statistical methods, including when not to use them Git-based workflows, with code review and reproducible analysis as normal practice Explaining technical findings to senior and non-technical stakeholders Eligible for SC clearance Nice to have: Working in JupyterLab or RStudio on a shared cloud platform NLP or text classification Building apps or dashboards (Shiny, Streamlit or similar) Experience in the public sector or another highly regulated setting where data protection and auditability matter Why this role Your work will feed into decisions with real public impact. You'll join a team that treats good engineering practice as part of good data science, on a modern open-source stack. ENGAGEMENT DETAILS This engagement is offered outside IR35, reflecting the genuine independence and expertise the role requires. Key terms: Rate: Competitive Outside IR35 - engaged as an independent contractor via your own limited company or umbrella Initial contract length: 6 months, with extensions expected subject to performance and project progression Hybrid working - a mix of remote and on-site with the client as the engagement requires Start date: to be agreed. We are looking to move quickly for the right person

I AI & Data Deloitte hjelper virksomheter med å skape verdi med AI og data – fra
items.desc: Deloitte er et av verdens ledende profesjonelle tjenestehus med over 470 000 ansatte globalt. I Norge er vi ca. 1600 medarbeidere som hjelper klienter med rådgivning, revisjon, skatt og juridiske tjenester. Hos oss jobber du i et inkluderende og mangfoldig miljø der vi setter pris på ulike perspektiver, kompetanser og bakgrunner. I AI & Data Deloitte hjelper virksomheter med å skape verdi med AI og data – fra strategi og dataplattformer til AI-løsninger og innsikt. Vi ser etter deg som kan kombinere faglig kompetanse med forståelse for virksomhetens behov – og som vil være med på å utvikle løsninger som gir verdi i praksis. Vi ser etter deg som har relevant arbeidserfaring, er nysgjerrig og lærer raskt, og som ønsker å bruke kompetansen din til å skape impact that matters. Hva vil du jobbe med? Du vil bidra innenfor ett eller flere av disse områdene: AI Strategy & Governance: Hjelpe virksomheter med å identifisere verdifulle muligheter, prioritere initiativer og etablere retning og rammer for bruk av AI og data. Data Platform & Engineering: Utforme og bygge trygge, skalerbare dataplattformer, dataarkitektur og datapipelines som legger grunnlaget for analyse og AI. AI Solutions & Insights: Utvikle analyser og AI-løsninger som gir bedre innsikt, støtter beslutninger og forbedrer arbeidsprosesser. Hvem ser vi etter? Du har fullført en relevant utdanning på masternivå (NHH, CBS, NTNU, BI, NMBU, UiO, UiB og anerkjente internasjonale universiteter). Du har erfaring med å forstå et forretningsbehov og omsette det til en konkret leveranse . Du kan forklare hvilke valg du tok, hva du selv hadde ansvar for, og hvilken verdi arbeidet skapte. Avhengig av fagprofilen din har du erfaring med noen , men ikke nødvendigvis alle, av disse områdene: Klassisk AI, AI-assistenter, agenter eller bruk av AI til å forbedre arbeidsprosesser Dataplattformer og skytjenester som Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, Azure, AWS eller Google Cloud Innsikt og visualisering gjennom Power BI, Qlik, Tableau, Power Platform eller skreddersydde applikasjoner Programmering, datamodellering, datatransformasjon og datapipelines med for eksempel Python, SQL, PySpark eller DAX Som seniorkonsulent forventer vi i tillegg at du kan ta større ansvar for leveranser, gjøre faglige avveininger og bidra til å utvikle både løsninger og kolleger. Hvorfor Deloitte? Hos oss får du jobbe med reelle problemer, tverrfaglige team og virksomheter med ulike behov. Du får et inkluderende fagmiljø, tilgang til et globalt nettverk og tydelige muligheter for læring og utvikling – blant annet gjennom Faglig Community og Deloitte University . Arbeidssted: Oslo eller Bergen Søknadsfrist: Fortløpende Dersom du er nysgjerrig eller har spørsmål om stillingen er du velkommen til å ta kontakt med Victoria Dessen (458 63 586). For spørsmål om søknadsprosessen kan du kontakte Amalie Worm Andersen (amaandersen@deloitte.no). Du får muligheten til å jobbe i et selskap som hjelper andre aktører med sin grønne omstilling, samtidig som vi arbeider målrettet med egne ambisjoner innenfor både klima og miljø og samfunnsansvar. Som ansatt i Deloitte integreres bærekraft i arbeidshverdagen, og du får anledning til å bidra i ulike prosjekter og initiativer knyttet til dette. Som samfunnsaktør, arbeidsgiver og tjenesteleverandør har Deloitte et stort fokus på mangfold og inkludering. Vi ser at ulike perspektiver fremmer nytenkning, gir dypere innsikt og bedre beslutninger, og ikke minst mobiliserer potensialet til medarbeiderne våre! Vi ønsker derfor et stort mangfold blant søkere.

items.title: IT Applications & AI Specialist
items.card: responsabilità: sviluppare, gestire e ottimizzare soluzioni e flussi basati sull’ecosistema Microsoft 365 , con particolare riferimento a SharePoint, Power Automate, Power Apps, Teams e agli strumenti di collaborazione e automazione aziendale supportare le diverse funzioni aziendali nell’analisi delle esigenze e dei processi, individuando e sviluppando soluzioni digitali, automazioni e applicazioni basate
items.desc: Da oltre 25 anni offriamo sui mercati globali cosmetici Made in Italy . Progettiamo, sviluppiamo, produciamo e confezioniamo in-house . La produzione è effettuata dalla nostra azienda italiana di Siziano (Pavia-Milano Sud). Sostenibilità, qualità, innovazione e sicurezza sono per noi valori chiave. Per la sede di Lugano siamo alla ricerca di un/a IT Applications & AI Specialist che contribuisca allo sviluppo e all’evoluzione dell’ecosistema digitale aziendale, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni Microsoft 365, alle applicazioni interne, all’automazione dei processi e ai progetti di Intelligenza Artificiale . La persona lavorerà a stretto contatto con le diverse funzioni aziendali, raccogliendone le esigenze e traducendole in soluzioni tecnologiche concrete. Avrà un ruolo sia operativo sia progettuale nello sviluppo, nell’integrazione e nel mantenimento delle applicazioni aziendali, contribuendo alla digitalizzazione dei processi e alla realizzazione di progetti innovativi per il business. Principali responsabilità: sviluppare, gestire e ottimizzare soluzioni e flussi basati sull’ecosistema Microsoft 365 , con particolare riferimento a SharePoint, Power Automate, Power Apps, Teams e agli strumenti di collaborazione e automazione aziendale supportare le diverse funzioni aziendali nell’analisi delle esigenze e dei processi, individuando e sviluppando soluzioni digitali, automazioni e applicazioni basate sull’Intelligenza Artificiale in grado di migliorare l’efficienza operativa, l’integrazione dei dati e l’esperienza degli utenti partecipare allo sviluppo e all’evoluzione delle applicazioni gestionali aziendali , contribuendo all’integrazione di funzionalità AI, API, flussi di dati e soluzioni di automazione a supporto delle diverse aree di business seguire, dal punto di vista tecnico e applicativo, lo sviluppo del progetto digitale dedicato al settore cosmetico , collaborando alla definizione delle funzionalità, alla realizzazione delle soluzioni, ai test e alla relativa integrazione nell’ecosistema aziendale garantire il corretto funzionamento delle soluzioni sviluppate, gestendo attività di manutenzione, aggiornamento, test, troubleshooting, documentazione tecnica e supporto agli utenti, anche in collaborazione con partner e fornitori esterni Requisiti richiesti: conoscenza dell’ecosistema Microsoft 365 e capacità di sviluppare o configurare soluzioni basate su SharePoint, Power Automate e Power Apps competenze di programmazione, preferibilmente in Python , e familiarità con API, database, integrazioni tra sistemi e tecnologie di sviluppo moderne conoscenza dei principi e degli strumenti di Intelligenza Artificiale, automazione e analisi dei dati , con interesse per la loro applicazione concreta nei processi aziendali capacità di analizzare le esigenze del business e tradurle in requisiti funzionali e soluzioni tecniche sostenibili, scalabili e semplici da utilizzare buona conoscenza della lingua inglese, autonomia operativa, capacità di problem solving e attitudine alla collaborazione con interlocutori tecnici e non tecnici Requisiti formativi e professionali preferenziali: laurea o diploma a indirizzo informatico, ingegneristico, scientifico o formazione equivalente esperienza nello sviluppo, nella migrazione o nell’integrazione di applicazioni e flussi all’interno dell’ecosistema Microsoft 365 esperienza nella gestione del ciclo di vita di un’applicazione, dall’analisi dei requisiti allo sviluppo, test, rilascio, manutenzione e supporto agli utenti familiarità con Microsoft Power Platform, Azure, Git, SQL, servizi cloud, API REST e strumenti di versionamento del codice esperienza, anche maturata attraverso progetti personali, formativi o professionali, nello sviluppo di soluzioni AI, chatbot, assistenti digitali, sistemi di automazione o applicazioni basate su modelli linguistici approccio pragmatico e orientato alla soluzione, curiosità verso le nuove tecnologie e capacità di operare contemporaneamente su attività di sviluppo, integrazione e supporto applicativo capacità di lavorare in team e di collaborare in modo trasversale con le diverse funzioni aziendali, comprendendone At a glance Term: 6 months, starting between December 2026 and February 2027 Location: Marseille, France (coworking with a sea view, hybrid) Stack: TypeScript · Next.js · React · Python · SQL · LLM APIs · PostgreSQL · BigQuery · Node.js · Pipedrive API · PostHog · AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex)
items.desc: 6-month internship in Marseille, France: agents, TypeScript & outbound. Starting December 2026 to February 2027. At a glance Term: 6 months, starting between December 2026 and February 2027 Location: Marseille, France (coworking with a sea view, hybrid) Stack: TypeScript · Next.js · React · Python · SQL · LLM APIs · PostgreSQL · BigQuery · Node.js · Pipedrive API · PostHog · AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) About Influentials Influentials is a creator marketing platform and managed service built to help brands scale creator content. More than 16,000 creators are directly connected and verified on our platform, and more than 500 brands, including McDonald's, Disney, Samsung, ALDI and Volvo, have run over 5,000 campaigns with us. We're headquartered in Rotterdam, Netherlands and building our tech hub in Marseille, France. How we build AI is both how we build and what we build. We practise agentic engineering on a modern TypeScript stack: AI agents write most of the code, and humans specify and review everything that goes live. We merge hundreds of PRs each month, and our velocity keeps accelerating. We're not tied to one tool (Claude Code today, Codex before), and we adopt new practices as they land, like cloud coding agents and agent loops. The job is changing fast right now, and you'll learn it with us. Our next step is international: the UK, Scandinavia and France. We're looking for a GTM & growth engineer intern to build the machine that gets us there. Go-to-market as engineering We treat GTM as a systems problem, not a creative writing exercise: pipelines, enrichment, sequencing, attribution. It's the same technical work as any full-stack engineer, backend and frontend, applied to growth instead of product features: pipelines and APIs, tools for our team, and small full-stack apps that brands use. You'll sit between sales, marketing and engineering, write TypeScript, Python and SQL, build AI agents that run in production, and measure what they bring. No-code is fine for a quick test; anything that lasts is built in code. This is AI engineering, not machine learning: agents, tools, prompts and evals built on top of existing LLMs. No model training. What you'll build This is an internship: you're here to learn, working alongside the CTO and the sales team. These are the projects you'll contribute to: 01. Free tools that bring brands to us. Small free apps on our website, built on our creator data and LLMs. You'll build them and measure how many brands they bring to the platform. 02. An AI agent that spots brands doing influencer marketing. Build an agent that analyses social media content (our creators' posts, captions and hashtags) to detect sponsored content and the brands behind it, then scrapes those brands' websites to enrich them. That's an intent signal: score these brands so the sales team calls the right ones first. 03. Pages built from our data. Public research pages generated from our creator data, that brands find on Google and in AI assistants. 04. Outbound sequences. Email sequences to brands, personalised with our creator data and research done by AI agents, A/B tested against clear conversion targets. 05. The creator acquisition engine. Our system finds creators and contacts them by email. Add AI analysis of their content to target the right creators, and improve deliverability and conversion. 06. CRM and attribution, from first contact to invoice. Leads pushed to Pipedrive in one click, deal stages in sync, and dashboards that show which source brings which revenue. You won't do all six. With the CTO, you'll pick one, ship it, measure it, then move to the next. Technical challenges AI agents you can trust: evals on real social content to measure what the LLM gets right, and keeping cost and latency under control. APIs in the real world: rate limits, retries, webhooks. Deliverability: SPF, DKIM, DMARC, domain warm-up, bounces. Data pipelines: from GTM tools (CRM, email, enrichment) to BigQuery, without losing data quality. Experiments: A/B tests that are statistically sound, not "it felt better". What success looks like Month 1: you've learned the stack and the data, your first change is in production, and you've picked your first project with the CTO. Months 2–3: your first project is live and measured. Months 4–6: a second project, plus a weekly GTM dashboard the team actually reads, documented so it keeps running after you leave. Who you'll work with You'll work directly with Matthieu, our CTO, who cares as much about business and product as about code, and with our sales and partnerships leads. The rest of the team is in Rotterdam: weekly video calls with sales, campaign management and product, in English, with no travel needed. You'll be one of the first people in our Marseille tech hub, with a real scope and someone next to you to help you get there. items.desc: Zie jij snel hoe iets slimmer kan? Ben je nieuwsgierig naar AI en nieuwe technologie? En vind je het leuk om niet alleen mee te kijken, maar zelf met ideeën en oplossingen te komen? Dan zoeken we jou! Bij BOS Innovatie & Projecten van Aeres Hogeschool werken we aan het verbeteren en vernieuwen van onze onderwijslogistiek. Denk aan alles wat achter de schermen nodig is om onderwijs goed te organiseren: van planning en roostering tot diplomering, stages en tentamens. Wat je gaat doen Je gaat tijdens je stage aan de slag met een echte verbeteropdracht binnen Aeres Hogeschool. Bijvoorbeeld: hoe kunnen we een planningsproces slimmer maken? Kan een aanmeldproces eenvoudiger? Waar doen we nog onnodig handmatig werk? En kan AI of automatisering dat slimmer overnemen? Je Gaat uitzoeken hoe een proces nu werkt. praten met de collega's die ermee werken. ontdekken waar het slimmer, makkelijker of sneller kan. oplossingsrichtingen onderzoeken en deze ook toetsen onderzoeken. kijken wat AI en technologie daarin kan betekenen. waar mogelijk jouw oplossing ook echt testen. Geen opdracht die alleen in een verslag verdwijnt dus. Als jouw idee werkt, gaan we het ook echt gebruiken. Wie ben jij Je volgt een mbo- of hbo-opleiding die hierbij past. Welke opleiding dat precies is, vinden we minder belangrijk dan jouw nieuwsgierigheid en manier van denken. Je bent geïnteresseerd in AI en technologie. Je vindt het leuk om dingen slimmer te maken. Je denkt in oplossingen en durft buiten de gebaande paden te denken. Je stapt makkelijk op mensen af. Je stelt vragen en durft je mening te geven. Je kunt zelfstandig werken én samenwerken. items.desc: Introductie Onze visie? ‘To advance the world through the power of people and Microsoft’. Elke dag zetten onze mensen zich in om met de nieuwste Microsoft-technologie onze klanten te helpen transformeren. Door de combinatie van een brede expertise van onze talentvolle mensen en een enorme passie voor Microsoft kunnen we onze klanten wereldwijd vooruithelpen op technologisch vlak en creëren we geweldige ervaringen & oplossingen Binnen het Technical Advisory (TA) team adviseren wij organisaties over de strategische inrichting van hun IT‑landschap. Wij helpen klanten niet alleen bij hoe technologie wordt ingericht, maar vooral bij welke keuzes zij maken om technologie duurzaam te laten bijdragen aan hun langetermijndoelstellingen. Data & Artificial Intelligence ontwikkelen zich snel tot strategische capaciteiten binnen organisaties. Veel organisaties experimenteren met AI, maar missen duidelijke richting, samenhang en sturing. Hierdoor ontstaan versnipperde oplossingen, onduidelijk eigenaarschap en toenemende complexiteit in het IT‑landschap. In deze afstudeerstage onderzoek je hoe organisaties Data & AI strategisch organiseren: welke keuzes zij maken, hoe zij deze vertalen naar operating modellen en governance, en hoe dit landt in de inrichting van het IT‑landschap. Kom Ons Joinen Avanade is een internationaal IT-consultancybedrijf, waarbij mens en IT de krachten bundelen. Je zult jezelf herkennen in de 450 collega’s die rondlopen, maar ook zeker in de 40 andere stagiaires die jaarlijks stagelopen bij Avanade. We hebben veel passie voor en plezier in het werk dat we verrichten en hechten waarde aan een gezellige sfeer op de werkvloer. Met ontzettend veel talent voor Microsoft-technologie, is Avanade een unieke club waar veel ruimte is voor ontwikkeling. Gezamenlijk met de andere stagiaires vorm je een enthousiaste groep & community binnen Avanade. Je kan meedoen aan veel leuke activiteiten zoals kennissessies tijdens de lunch, koffiemomenten met consultants en werkborrels! Daarnaast bieden we een aantal soft skilltrainingen speciaal voor de groep interns en mogelijkheid tot het behalen van een Microsoft certificaat. Je komt te werken binnen het Technical Advisory team: een multidisciplinair team van consultants dat organisaties adviseert bij complexe vraagstukken rondom IT-strategie, architectuur en digitale transformatie. We opereren op het snijvlak van businessdoelen en technologische keuzes en combineren analytisch en strategisch denkwerk met pragmatische, hands-on realisatie. Binnen het team staat kennisdeling en inhoudelijke begeleiding centraal en werk je samen met ervaren adviseurs. Je wordt actief betrokken bij lopende klantvraagstukken en krijgt de ruimte om jouw onderzoek te verdiepen én te vertalen naar concrete adviezen, ontwerpen en toepasbare oplossingen voor de praktijk. Wat zal je doen? Tijdens deze afstudeerstage doe je onderzoek naar hoe organisaties richting geven aan Data & AI als enterprise capability. De focus ligt op het maken van bewuste strategische keuzes en het vertalen daarvan naar concrete inrichting, governance en sturing. Mogelijke Onderzoeksvragen En Denkrichtingen Zijn Onder Andere Welke strategische keuzes maken organisaties bij het positioneren van Data & AI binnen hun IT‑ en organisatiestructuur? Hoe vertaal je deze keuzes naar een target operating model voor Data & AI (rollen, verantwoordelijkheden, besluitvorming)? Hoe richt je governance in om samenhang, schaalbaarheid en beheersbaarheid te waarborgen? Hoe balanceer je centrale strategie met decentrale uitvoering en innovatie? Welke architectuur‑ en platformkeuzes zijn bepalend voor de langetermijnontwikkeling van Data & AI binnen het IT‑landschap? Je combineert literatuuronderzoek met praktijkgerichte analyses, interviews met stakeholders en het uitwerken van conceptuele modellen. Het resultaat is een onderzoeksrapport met strategische en toepasbare aanbevelingen die organisaties helpen om Data & AI duurzaam te organiseren. Qualifications Vaardigheden en ervaring: Je bent een WO-masterstudent en op zoek naar een afstudeerstage per september 2026. Je hebt interesse in Data, AI, digitale transformatie en IT-strategie. Je hebt affiniteit met thema’s als betrouwbaarheid, ethiek, governance en compliance rondom AI. Je bent nieuwsgierig naar hoe organisaties technologie bestuurbaar en schaalbaar inrichten Over Jou Je bent communicatief vaardig in zowel Nederlands als Engels. Je werkt zelfstandig en gestructureerd en vindt het leuk om complexe vraagstukken te analyseren. Je bent nieuwsgierig, kritisch en gemotiveerd om theorie en praktijk met elkaar te verbinden.

items.desc:
Introduction
 The Business Engineering team within Operational Excellence supports manufacturing and operational organizations in improving performance, resource utilization, and decision-making. As part of this team, you will help explore how artificial intelligence and advanced analytics can solve real operational challenges in a high-tech manufacturing environment. This Business Analytics | Data Science internship: AI-driven operations, offers the opportunity to work directly with stakeholders, analyze complex processes, and develop practical solutions that create measurable impact. You will contribute to turning operational data into actionable insights while supporting continuous improvement initiatives across the organization.
 Your assignment
 As an intern, you will join the Business Engineering team and contribute to projects that combine operational excellence, data analytics, and artificial intelligence. During this , you will investigate operational challenges, develop proof-of-concept solutions, and assess how these solutions can be scaled and embedded into daily operations. You will interact with business stakeholders, operational teams, and analytics specialists to ensure solutions deliver practical value. Your main responsibilities will be:
 Identify operational challenges that could benefit from AI or advanced analytics solutions.
 Analyze business processes, operational data, and stakeholder needs.
 Translate business questions into structured analyses and data-driven recommendations.
 Develop and test AI-driven prototypes, forecasting models, or decision-support solutions.
 Evaluate proof-of-concept solutions and assess industrialization opportunities.
 Present insights, findings, and recommendations to stakeholders across the organization.
 Document outcomes and support knowledge transfer within the Business Engineering team.
This is a bachelor's/master's (non-thesis) internship for minimum 5 months, minimum 4 days per week (preferred 4 days on-site). The start date of this internship is as of February 2027.
 Your profile
 To be suitable for the internship, you:
 Are pursuing a master's degree, or are a final-year bachelor's student, in industrial engineering, data science, applied mathematics, operations management, business analytics, computer science, or a related engineering discipline.
 Have an analytical approach and enjoy translating complex challenges into structured solutions.
 Have experience with data analysis and programming tools such as Python, SQL, R, or business intelligence platforms.
 Are collaborative and can effectively engage with different stakeholders, from operational teams to technical specialists.
 Are proactive, curious, and comfortable working on open-ended problems with practical business impact.
The internship is ideal for students who enjoy combining technical analysis with business understanding. Throughout this internship, you will gain exposure to operational decision-making, stakeholder management, and applied AI in a complex manufacturing environment.

It's an open, hands-on problem at the intersection
items.desc:
Static analysis helps engineers find software defects early — and there's a real opportunity to push it further with modern AI. As a Software Engineering Intern with the Wireless Technologies & Ecosystems team, you'll explore how the latest large language models can be combined with established static analysis techniques to improve how issues in code are detected.
It's an open, hands-on problem at the intersection of program analysis, software security, and applied AI — with plenty of room to experiment and make a visible contribution. If you enjoy reasoning about code and applying AI to practical engineering problems, we'd like to meet you.
The Wireless Technologies & Ecosystems team builds tools and infrastructure that help engineers develop high-quality software. In this internship, you'll investigate how AI — in particular large language models (LLMs) — can enhance static code analysis, working alongside experienced engineers in static analysis and applied AI.
You'll help prototype approaches, evaluate how well they work, and build tooling to measure and compare results. Because this is an open problem with no established playbook, you'll have the freedom to experiment with different techniques and see your ideas tested against real engineering questions.
Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
Hands-on programming experience in C and/or C++ — you have actively written, debugged, or analyzed C/C++ code (e.g. in a university project or thesis) and are comfortable with the fundamentals: pointers, memory allocation, and structs. (You do not need to be a C++ expert.)
Proficiency in at least one scripting language, Python strongly preferred.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and the ability to reason clearly about unfamiliar code — we care more about how you think through a problem than about a memorized answer.
Good written and spoken English.
Coursework, projects, or interest in static code analysis, program analysis, or software security.
Familiarity with large language models (LLMs) and generative-AI tooling, and an intuition for where AI-based approaches help and where they don't.
Familiarity with modern AI developer tools (e.g. LLM-assisted coding assistants).
Exposure to open-source software development tools.
A collaborative, curious, and self-driven attitude — comfortable working on an open problem where the right answer is not known in advance.

items.desc:
As part of our team, you will own the robotics AI architecture and technical hypotheses, selecting world-action and video-action models, VLA policies, embodied reasoning, or classical planning according to task, data, and execution constraints.
 You will design heterogeneous systems that connect learned models with Code-as-Policy programs, Graph-as-Policy structures, and reusable skills. You specify state and action representations, interfaces, execution checks, as well as recovery behavior.
 Additionally, you will implement and adapt models and agentic robot programs. You investigate predictive dynamics, imitation learning, reinforcement learning, or feedback-driven skill refinement, then justify your choices with baselines and ablations.
 You will also define evaluation across simulation and physical rollouts, including held-out tasks, embodiment transfer, intervention rate, latency, recovery, and repeatability. In doing so, you distinguish first-attempt success from results achieved through retries.
 Furthermore, you will collaborate closely with the deployment engineer to turn the architecture into a functioning embodiment. Together, you diagnose model, planning, or control failures and revise the design based on measured robot behavior.
 Using the Agentic AI Software Factory, you will drive implementation and experiments while validating generated code and experimental conclusions. You maintain reproducible artifacts, versioned skills, and accountable release decisions.
Education: completed Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Machine Learning, Control Engineering or a related field

 proven expertise in action grounding, temporal consistency, uncertainty, and failure recovery

 demonstrated own code or model contributions, supported by meaningful baselines and measured hardware outcomes
 terminology familiarity or model-API integration alone is insufficient
