items.desc: Ce sujet de stage est rattaché au lab'Innov d'Aubay. il s'agit de la cellulle d'innovation du groupe Aubay. Tu pourras intervenir sur des projets en mode R&D adoptant une approche agile. À Paris ou à Lyon, nous te proposons des sujets Innovants notamment sur l’IA, la Data, le numérique responsable ... et encore pleins d’autres à découvrir ! ici, nous te proposons le stage "Data Quality Challenge" Et si on rendait la donnée irréprochable ? Benchmarke les algorithmes les plus récents – des statistiques classiques aux modèles de diffusion – pour imputer les valeurs manquantes et détecter les anomalies. LE SUJET : La qualité de la donnée est un élément essentiel en entreprise : pour la prise de décisions, un pilotage efficace, ou être le point de départ d'un projet réussi. C'est pourquoi le Lab'Innov d'Aubay en a fait un axe de recherche majeur, adossé à une thèse en cours sur le sujet. Ta mission : explorer et confronter trois familles d'approches – méthodes statistiques, réseaux profonds et modèles de diffusion – pour imputer les données manquantes et détecter les anomalies. L'objectif n'est pas seulement la performance : nous cherchons la solution la plus sobre et la plus rapide, capable d'être industrialisée dans nos pipelines de données. Tu travailleras au cœur d'une équipe R&D, avec un vrai sujet ouvert, des moyens de calcul et la liberté de proposer tes propres pistes. TA CONTRIBUTION : Il te faudra : • Établir un état de l'art structuré des trois familles d'algorithmes (statistiques, profonds, diffusion) pour l'imputation et la détection d'anomalies. • Concevoir un protocole d'évaluation commun mesurant performance, robustesse, temps de calcul et consommation énergétique. • Implémenter et comparer des algorithmes représentatifs de chaque famille sur des jeux de données de référence. • Identifier les conditions dans lesquelles les modèles de diffusion apportent un gain réel face à des méthodes plus simples – et à quel coût. • Restituer tes résultats à l'équipe et contribuer aux publications / livrables du Lab'Innov. POUR TOI : • Une immersion dans un projet de recherche. • La maîtrise de modèles de pointe (dont les modèles de diffusion) sur un cas d'usage concret, pas un exercice d'école. • Une compétence très recherchée : savoir évaluer et industrialiser un modèle, pas seulement l'entraîner. • Un livrable valorisable (benchmark, article, soutenance) et une porte d'entrée vers un CDI chez Aubay. Mots clés : Data Quality, Imputation, Détection d'anomalies, Modèles de diffusion, Deep Learning, Stack technique : Benchmark, R&D, Thèse, Frugalité numérique Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, Pandas / NumPy, modèles de diffusion, Git, Jupyter / MLflow QUI ES-TU ? Tu es en dernière année d'école d'ingénieur ou équivalent, et tu recherches un stage de fin d'études de 4 à 6 mois , pour démarrer entre février et avril 2027. Tu es une personne motivée, dynamique et autonome. Avec un attrait pour la R&D et l'innovation. Tu aimes le travail en équipe. Opportunité de CDI à la fin du stage.

items.desc: Jouw werkzaamheden Hoe je samen met ons vooruit gaat Goods-to-Person (GtP)-oplossingen met Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs) worden steeds belangrijker binnen logistieke automatisering. Bij het ontwerpen van zo’n oplossing moeten keuzes worden gemaakt over de magazijnlayout, het aantal robots, de inrichting van werkstations, verkeersstromen, bufferplaatsen en de aansturing vanuit WMS/WCS. Deze keuzes beïnvloeden elkaar en zijn in een vroege projectfase lastig integraal te beoordelen. Met de komst van AI en moderne 3D-technologie kunnen we zelf realistische emulatieomgevingen ontwikkelen. Daarmee willen we concepten niet alleen berekenen, maar ook zichtbaar maken, aansluiten op onze eigen software en met representatieve orderdata beproeven. Je ontwerpt en bouwt een configureerbaar 3D-emulatiemodel van een GtP-pickingomgeving. In deze virtuele omgeving rijden merk-onafhankelijke AMRs tussen opslaglocaties en pickingstations. Op de werkstations worden de pickhandelingen van operators gevisualiseerd en verwerkt. De omgeving moet integraal kunnen samenwerken met algoritmes uit ons WMS/WCS en met een dataset van orders en orderregels. Zo ontstaat een experimenteeromgeving waarmee verschillende systeemconfiguraties herhaalbaar kunnen worden uitgevoerd, geobserveerd en vergeleken. Jouw vaardigheden Jouw kijk op vooruit gaan Je bent bijna klaar met een hbo- of wo-opleiding in ICT & Technology, Industrial IT, Software Engineering, Industriële Automatisering, Game/Simulation Technology of een vergelijkbare richting. Je hebt aantoonbare interesse in softwarearchitectuur, 3D-ontwikkeling, simulatie/emulatie en logistieke automatisering. Je kunt zelfstandig ontwerpen en realiseren, maar zoekt actief afstemming met software-engineers, projectteams en eindgebruikers. Kennis van .NET, SQL, API-koppelingen, versiebeheer en een 3D-engine is een pré. Belangrijker is dat je nieuwe technieken snel eigen maakt. Je werkt gestructureerd, test je aannames en kunt technische keuzes helder onderbouwen. Wat wij jou bieden Zo helpen we jou vooruit Je werkt aan een tastbaar en visueel resultaat dat direct aansluit op actuele vraagstukken binnen magazijnautomatisering. De combinatie van 3D, AI, AMRs, logistieke processen en WMS/WCS maakt dit een brede opdracht met ruimte voor zowel onderzoek als softwareontwikkeling. Een fijne, informele werksfeer en begeleiding op maat door enthousiaste professionals Volop ruimte voor jouw innovatieve ideeën Een afstudeerplek met veel afwisseling binnen een netwerk dat volop in beweging is (Door)groeimogelijkheden na het afronden van je opdracht Flexibele werktijden

items.desc: From Data to Decisions. From Platform to Value At Hilti, our Data Science Interns turn complex data into meaningful insights that power our digital products and customer experience. In this role, you’ll design experiments, build models, and work hands-on with large-scale data to shape real business decisions. Embedded in a highly skilled engineering community, you’ll gain end‑to‑end exposure, from hypothesis testing to production-ready solutions, without the typical barriers of slow processes or limited impact. This is a full‑time internship position. Start date is flexible. Duration for at least 6 months. No travel is foreseen for this position. What You'll Do As a Data Science Intern, you’ll work at the intersection of advanced analytics and real-world business needs. You will participate in discovery phases to understand business requirements, identify data-driven opportunities, and translate them into actionable use cases. Your daily work involves designing experiments, testing hypotheses, and developing statistical or machine learning models using Python. You’ll be embedded in an experienced team of data engineers and data scientists, benefitting from pair programming, version control, and a fully established CI/CD environment. You’ll work with diverse data sources-internal, external, structured, and unstructured-and assess what is relevant for each use case. You will help shape strategies for data collection, integration, and retention, and will collaborate closely with domain experts across the company. A key part of the role is communicating complex insights into clear, business-friendly language. You’ll support stakeholders in adopting data science methods, run statistical validations, and guide teams through agile delivery using Scrum. Throughout your internship, you’ll contribute to impactful, production-oriented solutions that enable better decisions across Hilti’s digital business. What You’ll Bring Enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, or similar throughout the full internship duration Hands-on experience with Python and SQL with exposure to cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS Basic knowledge of software engineering practices (e.g. architecture basics, version control, CI/CD). Ability to communicate complex analytics clearly Strategic problem-solving mindset What’s In It for You Benefits At Hilti, you’ll join a family-owned company that thinks long term, invests in its people, and trusts individuals to make a real impact. From day one, you'll take ownership of meaningful work, contribute to business success, and be supported in creating your future through continuous learning, development opportunities, and diverse career paths. Some of the benefits of building your career with us include: A diverse global headquarters community of more than 2,100 colleagues representing 70 nationalities. items.desc: Since the year 2000, OEC has grown globally to more than 1,000 employees with a double-digit revenue increase nearly every year. We provide a lively culture, employee rewards and recognition, and the opportunity to develop and implement innovative technology solutions. OEC builds the software that dealers, repair shops, suppliers, and automakers use to find, price, order, and stock auto parts. Applied AI/ML is OEC's AI & Machine Learning team. We work with product teams across the business to frame a problem, build the data science and ML behind it, ship it to production, and prove the value with real measurement. We work horizontally across the organization, with teams in Mechanical, Supply Chain, Collision, and International, primarily supporting in-product use cases. You'll join a small team of applied scientists and ML engineers across Europe and the US, and you'll report to the head of Applied AI/ML. This is a mid-level individual contributor role with end-to-end ownership. Success in this role means you improve business metrics across our product lines and make a real, meaningful impact on the organization. Our projects cover a wide range of problems, so we'll match your first projects to your background. You don't need experience in every area below. If you meet most of the requirements and the work interests you, please apply. What You'll Do Work on the kinds of problems we take on, depending on your background: Search and ranking: semantic search, learning to rank, and personalized ranking to help shops find the right part faster. Classification and matching: map parts to industry-standard part types and match attributes across catalogs. Forecasting: forecast parts demand so dealers stock the right parts. Customer and partner analytics: predict churn and early-tenure dropout, segment customers, and learn which suppliers and parts perform best. Anomaly detection: find fraud, bots, and suspicious usage. LLMs and agents: use LLMs when they're the right tool, with evaluation that measures output quality against a clear rubric. A/B testing: help teams design and analyze A/B tests with enough statistical power to detect real effects, so we can measure and improve our products. Recommendation engines: build recommendation services for partners, customers, and internal teams. Work with a product team early to understand the problem, check the data, and decide whether AI/ML is a good fit for the problem statement. Work on your models in production, including feature pipelines, training pipelines, deployment, drift monitoring, and retraining. Measure impact with techniques such as offline evaluation, shadow mode, A/B tests, and causal methods before a change goes live. Present results and tradeoffs to product and business stakeholders in terms they use, such as conversion, GMV, retention, and fill rate. Write documentation and teach the product team how to support what we built, so they can own it after handoff. Work with the Applied AI/ML team to improve best practices, evaluate new tools, and bring new ideas to the table. What You Bring At least 3 years of applied data science or machine learning experience. At least one model that you took to production and that moved a measurable business metric. Strong Python and SQL, with production-quality code, testing habits, and version control. A solid base in statistics and machine learning, and good judgment about when a simple approach is enough. Hands-on experience in at least one of the problem areas above, such as ranking, recommendation, classification, forecasting, or churn modeling. Experience building data pipelines and deploying models on a cloud ML platform, such as Amazon SageMaker, Azure ML, or Databricks. We use AWS (including SageMaker), Airflow, and MLflow. Equivalent tools also count as experience. Comfort with large, messy transactional and behavioral data. Clear written and spoken English. Experience explaining tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders. Nice to Have Master's degree or PhD in a quantitative field. Search relevance or recommender systems in e-commerce or a marketplace, including learning to rank, embedding-based retrieval, or candidate generation with re-ranking. Power analysis and causal inference methods. LLMs in production and evaluation harnesses for LLM output. Real-time model serving and low-latency inference, in addition to batch scoring. Experience with experiment design and offline evaluation. Amazon SageMaker Terraform, infrastructure as code. Retail media, sponsored placement, or advertising relevance. Automotive, automotive e-commerce, or B2B parts and supply chain, including complex product catalogs and taxonomies. Knowledge of industry standards such as ACES, PIES, or PCDB, or of OE catalogs. Arvostamme suuresti uteliaisuutta ja innostusta uuden oppimiseen. Meillä sinulla on mahdollisuus olla mukana vaikuttamassa koko Goforen Data & AI-tiimin kasvutarinaan. Goforella on seitsemän toimistoa Suomessa (Tampere, Helsinki, Turku, Lappeenranta, Jyväskylä, Oulu, Kajaani). Töitä voit tehdä joustavasti etänä tai hybridi-mallissa asiakasprojektien tarpeet huomioiden, ja työ voi myös vaatia matkustamista Suomen sisällä. Monipuolisissa projekteissa teemme läheistä yhteistyötä erityisesti data- ja pilviasiantuntijoiden kanssa. Pääset altistumaan tekoälyn ja koneoppimisen lisäksi mm. data-aiheisiin sekä pilviympäristöihin ja sovelluskehitykseen liittyviin projekteihin. Juuri nyt yhteisömme etsii joukkoonsa innokasta ja osaavaa tekoälyasiantuntijaa. Etsimme AI-asiantuntijaa, jonka päätehtävä on luoda arvoa asiakkaillemme tekoälyyn ja dataan liittyvissä projekteissa, kuten koneoppiminen, tekoäly ja tekoälymallien implementointi ja integrointi eri ratkaisuihin. Goforella pääset kehittämään aidosti ihmisiä auttavia ratkaisuja, jotka hyödyntävät koneoppimis- ja data-analyysimenetelmiä (esim. luonnollisen kielen ymmärtäminen, konenäkö, ennustaminen, deep learning, data-analyysit, generatiivinen tekoäly). Tekoälyasiantuntijana toimit asiakasrajapinnassa ja suunnittelet esimerkiksi, miten tekoäly- ja koneoppimismenetelmiä voidaan eri tilanteissa hyödyntää. Suunnittelet ja toteutat ratkaisuja ja menetelmiä sekä PoC-hengessä että tuotantokäyttöön. Rakennat prototyyppejä tai tuotannollisempia sovelluksia käsillä olevan liiketoimintaongelman ratkaisemiseen tai kehittyneen analytiikan käyttämiseen esim. tiedolla johtamisessa. Projekteissamme voidaan esimerkiksi tehostaa asiakkaan ydintoimintaa hyödyntäen generatiivista tekoälyä agenttien muodossa, implementoida laadunvarmistus tuotantoympäristöihin konenäköpohjaisessa ratkaisussa, tunnistaa poikkeamia dynaamisissa ympäristöissä esim. IoT-datan perusteella, kehittää asiakkaan kumppanina ratkaisuja kokeilusta tuotantoympäristöön. Tällä hetkellä palkkaamme suoraan projektiin. Tämä tarkoittaa, että meillä on jatkuva rekrytointi, mutta ennen tarjouksen tekemistä pyrimme löytämään sinulle ensimmäisen projektin sen perusteella, mitä olemme keskustelleet kanssasi rekrytointiprosessin aikana. Uskomme, että tämä parantaa työntekijäkokemusta, sillä voimme tarjota projektin heti, kun aloitat Goforella. items.desc: Contesto e obiettivo del ruolo Sice Previt opera nei settori delle costruzioni e degli arredi su misura di alta gamma, gestendo attività che spaziano dalla preventivazione e dalla progettazione fino alla produzione e alla realizzazione delle commesse. Per supportare l’evoluzione dei propri processi, l’azienda ricerca un Forward Deployed AI Engineer da inserire in un percorso di crescita dedicato allo sviluppo e all’integrazione di soluzioni software e di intelligenza artificiale. La figura opererà a stretto contatto con le funzioni aziendali coinvolte nelle diverse fasi della commessa. Partendo dall’osservazione delle attività e dall’analisi dei flussi informativi, contribuirà a individuare opportunità di miglioramento e a trasformarle in soluzioni utilizzabili nel contesto operativo. Ambiti di attività I progetti potranno riguardare la preventivazione, la gestione delle commesse, la progettazione tecnica, gli acquisti e la produzione. Tra le iniziative previste rientrano lo sviluppo di applicazioni di intelligenza artificiale, l’integrazione dei sistemi aziendali e il progetto di sviluppo del MES (Manufacturing Execution System). Il MES è il sistema informatico che supporta la gestione operativa della produzione, consentendo, per esempio, di monitorare l’avanzamento delle lavorazioni, raccogliere dati dai reparti e garantire la tracciabilità delle attività. La figura contribuirà inoltre all’integrazione del MES e degli altri sistemi industriali con l’ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning), il sistema gestionale che organizza le informazioni relative a commesse, ordini, acquisti, materiali e altri processi aziendali. L’obiettivo è assicurare continuità e coerenza dei dati tra pianificazione, progettazione e produzione. Principali responsabilità Affiancare preventivisti, project manager, progettisti, personale IT e reparti produttivi nell’analisi dei processi e dei bisogni operativi. Contribuire alla definizione dei requisiti funzionali e tecnici delle nuove soluzioni. Sviluppare, configurare e integrare applicazioni software e strumenti di intelligenza artificiale. Collaborare alla realizzazione del MES e allo scambio di dati tra MES, ERP e altri applicativi aziendali, insieme ai referenti interni e agli eventuali partner tecnologici. Realizzare prototipi e verificarli su casi d’uso reali, raccogliendo il riscontro degli utenti. Supportare il rilascio delle soluzioni, la documentazione tecnica e il miglioramento successivo alla messa in esercizio. Contribuire alla valutazione dei risultati in termini di efficienza, qualità dei dati e riduzione delle attività ripetitive. Requisiti Esperienza nello sviluppo di applicazioni software, anche in ambiente web, e conoscenza dei principi di integrazione tra sistemi, con l’utilizzo dei seguenti linguaggi C#, Python, AL, T-SQL, Power Automate, Powershell, Power BI; Buona familiarità con database (prevalentemente MS SQL Server), API (Application Program Interface) e Data Analysis (BI); Interesse ed esperienza pratica nell’applicazione dell’intelligenza artificiale a processi o strumenti aziendali, sia tramite API sia in locale; Capacità di comprendere esigenze operative e tradurle in requisiti e soluzioni tecniche; Attitudine al confronto con interlocutori di funzioni diverse; Flessibilità, curiosità e apertura a rivedere le soluzioni proposte sulla base delle evidenze raccolte sul campo. Laurea magistrale in Ingegneria o Informatica Competenze preferenziali Costituiscono un valore aggiunto la conoscenza dei sistemi ERP e/o MES, processi manifatturieri, strumenti CAD/CAM e contesti produttivi che operano su commessa. Non è richiesta una conoscenza pregressa di tutti i software e i processi di Sice Previt. Cosa offriamo Inserimento in un ruolo trasversale, con collaborazione diretta con le funzioni tecniche e produttive. Partecipazione a progetti di digitalizzazione e intelligenza artificiale applicati a processi aziendali reali. items.desc: En Vermont Solutions buscamos un/a ML Engineer que se incorpore a nuestro equipo para participar en la industrialización de soluciones de Machine Learning en el sector bancario , trabajando en modelos de previsión de demanda y optimización aplicados a la gestión de efectivo. Tu principal reto será transformar modelos existentes en soluciones robustas, escalables y mantenibles, asegurando su integración y funcionamiento en entornos productivos. 💻 ¿Cuál será tu reto? Productivizar modelos de Machine Learning, especialmente de forecasting (previsión de demanda) y optimización. Diseñar y mantener pipelines de entrenamiento, inferencia y generación de predicciones con Python, PySpark y Databricks. Analizar y mejorar modelos existentes, buscando el equilibrio entre precisión, rendimiento y eficiencia operativa. Implementar buenas prácticas de MLOps: versionado, trazabilidad, testing, CI/CD y monitorización. Trabajar con herramientas como MLflow para la gestión y seguimiento del ciclo de vida de los modelos. Diagnosticar incidencias en producción y proponer mejoras técnicas. Colaborar con equipos de Data Engineering, Data Science, Plataforma y Negocio. 🔎 ¿Qué buscamos? Entre 2 y 5 años de experiencia en Machine Learning, MLOps o ingeniería de soluciones de datos. Experiencia llevando modelos de Machine Learning a entornos productivos. Conocimientos de forecasting, series temporales y previsión de demanda. Experiencia o conocimientos aplicados de modelos de optimización. Formación universitaria en Ingeniería Informática, Matemáticas, Física, Estadística, Data Science o similar. Conocimientos sólidos de Python, SQL, PySpark y Apache Spark. Experiencia con Azure Databricks, Git, CI/CD y MLflow. Español fluido e inglés técnico para trabajar con documentación especializada. ⭐ Además, valoraremos: Experiencia con librerías como Scikit-learn, LightGBM, Prophet, Nixtla o StatsForecast. Conocimientos de optimización matemática, heurísticas e investigación operativa. Experiencia con Azure y soluciones MLOps corporativas. Conocimientos de Kafka y arquitecturas de procesamiento de datos. Familiaridad con herramientas de IA para el desarrollo, como GitHub Copilot. Experiencia en banca, finanzas, retail u otros entornos operativos. 🤝 ¿Cómo nos gustaría que fueras? Capacidad analítica y orientación a la resolución de problemas. Mentalidad práctica y orientación a llevar soluciones a producción. Autonomía, iniciativa y criterio técnico para tomar decisiones. Comunicación clara y facilidad para trabajar en equipo. items.desc: About The Role Go Car’s proposition to customers is a credit repair product, whereby we have developed the ability to confidently underwrite customers who are generally not served by other lenders. We use a combination of data science, technology and direct personal interaction at all stages of the customer lifecycle to ensure from first contact through to end of term that we’re providing the right product and generating the right outcomes for customers. The Data Scientist role is responsible for extracting meaningful insights from complex data sets to inform strategic decision-making and drive business performance, with a particular focus on credit and pricing. The role combines statistical analysis, machine learning and data engineering techniques to solve business problems, improve processes, and support a data-driven culture across the organisation. Using PowerBI, the role holder will enable colleagues across the business to gain valuable insights into their department’s performance and make decisions that both drive the performance of the business and achieve good outcomes for our customers. Responsibilities Collect, clean, and validate large, structured and unstructured data sets from multiple sources Develop and deploy statistical models, machine learning algorithms, and predictive analytics solutions Translate business challenges into analytical problems and actionable insights Design and implement data pipelines and workflows to support analytics and reporting Communicate findings through compelling visualisations, dashboards, and presentations to non-technical stakeholders Collaborate with cross-functional teams Continuously monitor model performance and refine solutions to improve accuracy and impact Ensure data governance, privacy, and compliance with relevant regulations (e.g. GDPR) and apply the principles of Consumer Duty Stay up to date with emerging tools, techniques, and trends in data science and AI What you need Strong knowledge of statistical methods, machine learning, and predictive modelling Advanced SQL and Excel Proficiency in programming languages such as Python or R Solid experience with data visualisation tools – preferably Power BI Familiarity with big data technologies (e.g. Spark, Hadoop) and cloud platforms (e.g. Azure, AWS) Understanding of data engineering principles and ETL processes Analytical thinking and problem-solving mindset Strong attention to detail and data accuracy Ability to communicate complex insights clearly to non-technical audiences Curiosity and continuous learning mindset Collaborative approach with strong stakeholder engagement skills At least 3 years of demonstrable experience in a data scientist role (financial services is preferred) Substantial experience focusing on credit performance and pricing is preferred MSc in relevant field is preferred In return we offer Competitive salary Work-life balance – 37.5 hours per week, hybrid working from our Portsmouth or Warrington office with a level of flexibility that enables you to have a good work-life balance 25 days’ holiday plus bank holidays and a day off for your birthday (FTE) Wellbeing support – market leading EAP including 24/7 advice line, counselling for you and your immediate family, menopause support and virtual GP appointments, paid leave when you need it most (company sick pay, time off for medical appointments, emergency dependent leave, compassionate leave and fertility treatment leave) Financial support – financial coaching & support through our EAP, a discount platform access, car sharing scheme, discounted gym memberships, free flu vaccinations Positive culture with a sociable atmosphere, casual dress code, food and drinks provided in the offices at great business park locations We encourage applications from people from all backgrounds to join our team at Go Car Credit. Just as our customers come from diverse backgrounds, so do we, and we treat our team and our customers as individuals – with respect and fairness. If this sounds like the role for you, please get in touch. If this sounds like the role for you and you’d like to take advantage of working for a growing company, send your CV and a covering note to Careers@GoCarCredit.co.uk

items.desc: Good to know: you can easily save this vacancy using the print button at the top of the page. After the closing date, this vacancy will be removed from our website. Your work will impact Eneco’s trade result and contributes to a smarter, cleaner energy system. Deploying your model makes real world impact – often the same day! Working in a high-paced environment with a team professionals. Why choose Eneco? The world around us is changing fast. Eneco is a frontrunner in the energy transition by integrating new sustainable energy sources and innovative ways of storing and managing energy. At the same time, customer needs are evolving rapidly, and so must we. Within Eneco Trading, our international trading division, we aim to be a leading player in the European energy market, delivering flexibility and grid stability through sustainable energy. At the core of this mission lies our commitment to using advanced analytics to operate and optimize our complex and diverse asset portfolio. Do you want to help us shape a sustainable future? Then we're looking for you! You will work in a company that is large enough to get things done and diverse in people and technology, yet agile and innovative enough to move fast. At Eneco, anyone with a sharp mind and a positive attitude can make a difference. What You’ll Do As a Quant in the Flex Optimization team, you’ll work on data driven solutions that maximize the value of Eneco’s steerable asset portfolio by optimizing their flexibility across short-term power and ancillary markets. Your work will impact Eneco’s trade result and contributes to a smarter, cleaner energy system. You will build optimization strategies, bidding algorithms and machine learning models that operate in fast-moving, real-time energy markets (such as real time trading applications for Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS)). You will work side by side with other quants and traders to see where analytics can add most value. We aim to have a fast feedback loop of deploying, learning and adjusting, meaning that there is a strong focus on ownership and scalable automation of processes. Deploying your model makes real world impact – often the same day! You will be working with large and growing datasets, so a continuous effort to improve forecasting, modelling, and decision support tooling is essential to stay ahead. Apart from developing these applications you will also play a pivotal role to productionize those in a robust and reliable manner. Is this about you? You have a quantitative MSc or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Econometrics or a related quantitative field. You bring 3 years of hands-on experience in a quantitative role within a business context. Prior experience in (energy) trading is a plus. You have strong quantitative problem-solving skills and experience developing algorithms or analytical models. Experience with (non-)linear optimization is a plus. You have a strong background in Python development: you know how to write clean and modular code and implement unit tests and proper monitoring. You have experience building and deploying scalable applications and/or algorithms in the cloud, including working with streaming data. Experience with our tech stack (Azure Cloud, Databricks, Kubernetes, Airflow, Snowflake and Kafka) is a plus. You understand underlying business problems, can distinguish between main and secondary issues and are able to translate these into robust, data-driven solutions. You proactively identify opportunities for improvement, take ownership and have the drive to get things done. You’ll be responsible for Developing and maintaining data-driven applications for cross-market optimization, bidding and decision-making; using techniques ranging from mathematical optimization and machine learning to heuristics and other quantitative methods. Driving automation and scalability, identifying where manual processes can be streamlined and operationalized. Identifying new ways to add value with analytics in close collaboration with the traders to deliver integrated, high-impact solutions This is where you’ll work You will work within the Flex Optimization team as part of the value chain Trading & Structuring, right next to Rotterdam-Alexander station. A complex, dynamic environment where moving markets, ever-changing positions, new technologies, and the law of inhibiting head start create a challenging field of tension which requires a lot of initiative and insight. We interact quickly with each other in an informal, transparent and collegial atmosphere. In a rapidly changing energy landscape, you and your team will shape the energy transition. A tough job, with challenging but achievable targets. What We Have To Offer Gross annual salary between €80.000 and €107.000 Including FlexBudget, 8% holiday allowance, and depending on your role a bonus or collective profit sharing. items.desc: A sustainable, profitable, and enjoyable future for dairy farmers by combining robotization, engineering, and farming expertise. This is what we believe in. This journey began over 75 years ago with the dream of two brothers in Maassluis. Since then, we have become an innovative global leader in automated systems for dairy farmers worldwide. With 2,500 specialized professionals, we continuously work on new agricultural revolutions. We still do this from our Campus in Maassluis, the building with the highest achievable sustainability standards in the Netherlands, while also operating around the world. Our goal is to ensure that dairy farming remains attractive for future generations. Job Description How can we make sure ESG risks and opportunities are at the core of our international expansion decisions? And what role can AI play in this? During this internship, you will work at the intersection of Sustainability, ESG, Commercial Strategy, and Artificial Intelligence. Your challenge is to design, build, and validate an AI-supported ESG Market Entry Assessment Agent that helps Lely evaluate the ESG impacts, risks, and opportunities of entering new geographical markets. You will translate an existing ESG market-analysis methodology into a practical AI workflow and create a prototype that supports experts in making well-informed decisions. By combining sustainability knowledge with AI capabilities, you will contribute to a project that can directly influence how Lely evaluates future growth opportunities around the world. Your responsibilities include: Translating the existing ESG market-analysis methodology into agent instructions and workflows Structuring and validating relevant internal and external ESG knowledge sources Building and configuring the ESG Market Analysis Agent in Copilot Studio Developing IRO scoring, materiality assessment, and target-at-risk logic Connecting country-specific findings to the Lely ESG framework Testing and validating AI-generated assessments against existing expert assessments At the end of your internship, you will deliver a validated prototype ESG Market Analysis Agent that can assess a defined country and market-entry scenario and produce a source-based Lely IRO assessment, including: Materiality scoring; ESG target exposure analysis; Mitigation and adaptation recommendations; A market-entry recommendation; Recommendations for further implementation. Practical information Educational or Graduation internship both possible Duration: Approximately 20 weeks Education level: HBO or WO Start date: To be agreed upon Qualifications You are enthusiastic about sustainability and curious about how AI can support better business decisions. You enjoy transforming complex information into structured insights and are comfortable combining research, analysis, and technology in a practical project. We are looking for someone with: A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Global Studies, Sustainability, Sustainable Business, or a related field Affinity with ESG, sustainability frameworks, and responsible business practices Affinity with AI, Copilot, and emerging AI applications Strong analytical thinking skills and a structured way of working Experience with research and source validation Good communication skills in English; Dutch is considered an advantage Additional Information At Lely, we offer you an educational and dynamic internship experience at one of the most innovative organizations in the Netherlands. You’ll become part of a driven team and have plenty of opportunities to further develop your talents. An international working environment An internship allowance of €650 per month based on a 40-hour work week A student apartment if your commute is too long Our modern Lely Campus gives you daily access to extensive sports facilities: an indoor gym, outdoor padel courts, a basketball and volleyball court, as well as table tennis and foosball. You can join Hyrox workouts or sign up for personal training – and challenge your colleagues during an active break. Enjoy fresh coffee and tea from our in-house barista, made with milk straight from our farm, and a healthy, affordable company restaurant. A free shuttle bus takes you to and from the metro station in Maassluis, ensuring your workday starts and ends smoothly. We’re also proud that our dedication and vision have been recognized with the Rotterdam Entrepreneur Award 2025!

items.card: In this role, you will curate multimodal cardiovascular datasets, develop methods to integrate imaging and clinical information, and design AI agents that gather evidence, use analytical tools and support clinical reasoning. Working closely with cardiologists, you will evaluate these systems for accuracy, reliability, interpretability and clinical relevance. You will also contribute to research publications, present
items.desc: The Division of Informatics, Imaging and Data Sciences within the Faculty of Biology, Medicine and Health invites applications for a Research Associate to develop multimodal agentic AI for clinical decision support in cardiology. The project will integrate cardiac imaging, ECGs, clinical reports and other patient information to develop AI systems that interpret clinical evidence, identify missing or conflicting information, and recommend appropriate next investigations for clinician review. In this role, you will curate multimodal cardiovascular datasets, develop methods to integrate imaging and clinical information, and design AI agents that gather evidence, use analytical tools and support clinical reasoning. Working closely with cardiologists, you will evaluate these systems for accuracy, reliability, interpretability and clinical relevance. You will also contribute to research publications, present findings at conferences and support the development of future funding applications. The successful candidate will work under the supervision of Dr Jinming Duan, collaborating with colleagues in the BHF Manchester Centre of Research Excellence and clinical teams at Wythenshawe Hospital, part of Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust. You should hold, or be nearing completion of, a PhD in computer science, artificial intelligence, medical image analysis, biomedical engineering, applied mathematics or a related discipline. You will have strong Python programming skills, practical experience in deep learning, and the ability to design and critically evaluate AI methods. Experience with multimodal learning, large language models, AI agents or medical imaging would be advantageous. Clear communication, effective collaboration and a commitment to rigorous, reproducible research are essential. British Heart Foundation Manchester Centre of Research Excellence The British Heart Foundation (BHF) has been awarded one of its prestigious Centres of Research Excellence (CRE) to The University of Manchester. This competitive award recognises the internationally leading position of cardiovascular science at our University and provides £4M over the next five years to further develop this excellence. The University has matched the BHF investment with £4M of its own money. This £8M total commitment represents the most significant initiative in cardiovascular research in Manchester this century. The Centre is interdisciplinary, involving not only basic cardiovascular scientists and clinicians, but colleagues in inflammation biology, data science, computer science and engineering. The BHF is one of the largest charitable funders of heart and circulatory research in the world. BHF funds around half of all the cardiovascular research performed in the UK and focuses its resources on scientifically excellent projects with a potential to benefit the health of people with, or at risk of, cardiovascular disease. BHF funded research has delivered many key advances for patients and their families, many of which are detailed on the BHF website. What you will get in return: Fantastic market leading Pension scheme Excellent employee health and wellbeing services including an Employee Assistance Programme Exceptional starting annual leave entitlement, plus bank holidays Additional paid closure over the Christmas period Local and national discounts at a range of major retailers As an equal opportunities employer we welcome applicants from all sections of the community regardless of age, sex, gender (or gender identity), ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation and transgender status. All appointments are made on merit. Our University is positive about flexible working – you can find out more here Hybrid working arrangements may be considered. Please be aware that due to the number of applications we unfortunately may not able to provide individual feedback on your application. Please note that we are unable to respond to enquiries, accept CVs or applications from Recruitment Agencies. Any recruitment enquiries from recruitment agencies should be directed to recruitmentservices.people@manchester.ac.uk Any CV’s submitted by a recruitment agency will be considered a gift. items.desc: 🚀 Buscamos Machine Learning Engineer con foco en Forecasting, Optimización y MLOps para un proyecto estratégico en banca ¿Te motiva llevar modelos de Machine Learning a producción y que tengan impacto real en decisiones operativas? ¿Has trabajado con series temporales, previsión de demanda y Databricks? En Axpe Consulting buscamos un/a Machine Learning Engineer para incorporarse al área de Datos e Inteligencia Artificial de una entidad financiera de referencia. Participarás en la industrialización de un caso de uso de gestión y optimización de efectivo, transformando modelos ya desarrollados en soluciones robustas, trazables, escalables y mantenibles. 🎯 ¿Cuál será tu misión? Llevar a producción modelos de previsión de demanda y de optimización, con criterio técnico para entenderlos, validarlos, retarlos y mejorarlos. Entre tus principales responsabilidades estarán: 🔹 Productivizar modelos de Machine Learning existentes, adaptándolos a los estándares técnicos, operativos y de gobierno de la entidad. 🔹 Analizar los modelos de previsión de demanda basados en series temporales y proponer simplificaciones y mejoras orientadas a producción. 🔹 Definir estrategias de reentrenamiento, frecuencia de actualización, persistencia de artefactos y estabilidad de los modelos. 🔹 Implementar pipelines de entrenamiento, inferencia y predicción en Databricks y PySpark. 🔹 Integrar los modelos con MLflow y otras herramientas corporativas de registro, gobierno y despliegue. 🔹 Productivizar modelos de optimización matemática aplicados a decisiones operativas. 🔹 Aplicar buenas prácticas de MLOps: versionado, testing, CI/CD, monitorización, logging y documentación. 🔹 Resolver incidencias en modelos y pipelines productivos con análisis de causa raíz. 🧩 ¿Qué buscamos? ✔️ Entre 2 y 5 años de experiencia en Machine Learning, MLOps o Data Science Engineering. ✔️ Experiencia real llevando modelos de Machine Learning a producción. ✔️ Experiencia con modelos de forecasting, series temporales y previsión de demanda. ✔️ Conocimientos aplicados de optimización matemática (programación matemática, heurísticas, restricciones de negocio). ✔️ Python avanzado, SQL y Apache Spark / PySpark. ✔️ Experiencia con Databricks (Azure Databricks o equivalente) y MLflow. ✔️ Git y CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions o similares). ✔️ Titulación universitaria en Ingeniería Informática, Matemáticas, Física, Estadística, Data Science o similar. ✔️ Español fluido e inglés técnico. 💡 ¿Qué valoraremos especialmente? Experiencia con librerías de forecasting como Nixtla (StatsForecast, MLForecast), LightGBM, Prophet o scikit-learn. Experiencia migrando notebooks y prototipos a soluciones productivas, en Microsoft Azure y en procesos batch de predicción y optimización. Y experiencia en sectores como banca, finanzas, retail u operaciones. 🏦 ¿Qué encontrarás? ✨ Proyecto estratégico en una entidad financiera de primer nivel. ✨ Modelos con impacto directo en procesos operativos. ✨ Stack moderno: Databricks, PySpark, MLflow y Azure. ✨ 100% remoto. Si te motiva convertir modelos en soluciones reales en producción, ¡queremos conocerte! 🚀

También contarás con una herramienta de acceso flexible a tu sueldo con opción de anticipos y reducciones fiscales en gastos de comida, transporte público, guarderías y formación. - Employee Experience: Te brindaremos el apoyo y la guía que necesitas para alcanzar tu máximo potencial sintiéndote escuchado/a y acompañado/a en todo momento. - Cultura de respeto a la diversidad: Impulsamos la inclusión sociolaboral y nos comprometemos con los principios de igualdad y de tolerancia cero frente a todo tipo de discriminación. - Sostenibilidad: Formaras parte de una empresa que aboga y promueve el uso de energías limpias y la transición energética a través de la reducción de huella de carbono para un futuro mejor. ¿Construimos el futuro? ¡Únete a SAMPOL!

items.desc: Who We Are Oliver Wyman is a global management consultancy working across all areas of industry, financial services, government, and non-profit organizations. Clients approach us with their most significant challenges, and we assemble teams of experts to address each facet of these complex issues. Together, we create breakthroughs that lead to remarkable impact. The Oliver Wyman Data and Analytics ( DNA ) team is a dynamic and rapidly growing group of quantitative analytics specialists, collaborating closely with colleagues across the firm to cover a global footprint, working across multiple industries including, but not limited to, Financial Services, Climate & Sustainability, Energy, Retail, and Transportation. In addition to high-impact analytics projects, the DNA team has a dedicated R&D function made up o f Re search Fellows and DNA colleagues . The R&D team explore s how new tools and ideas across data science, analytics and AI can be applied in industry . Our Values We believe in the power of diverse perspectives and collaborative teams to drive innovation. Our team comes from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences, and we embrace the unique skills and insights they bring to our work. At Oliver Wyman and within DNA, we are proud of the values we uphold that guide us every day in how we work and collaborate. Notable DNA projects include: Developing an NLP-based machine learning toolkit to predict credit rating downgrades using news articles – click here for more information Exploring novel GenAI architectures and validation methods for customer-facing tools in the financial sector Modelling portfolio decarbonization strategies leveraging advanced analytics techniques for large European banks Identifying supply chain risks by combining multiple live data feeds, and developing and applying a bespoke AI based risk methodology – click here for more information Why Join us? If you’re excited by challenges and eager to make a meaningful impact, we look forward to welcoming you aboard! Who Can Apply? Unser Team unterstützt von der Definition der AI & Data-Strategie über die Implementierung groß angelegter Datenplattformen und Visual Analytics Programme bis hin zu Einführung smarter "Age of With"-Lösungen. Sichere unseren gemeinsamen Erfolg und mach mit uns den Unterschied: als Praktikant AI & Data Engineering (m/w/d) . Standorte: Berlin , Düsseldorf , Frankfurt (Main) , Hamburg , Hannover , Köln , München und Stuttgart . Dein Impact: Als Praktikant AI & Data Engineering (m/w/d) arbeitest du direkt an einer Lösung, die beim Kunden im Einsatz ist: einer Cloud-Datenplattform mit AI-gestützter Dokumentenverarbeitung und einer Web-Applikation, mit der Fachbereiche ihre täglichen Entscheidungen treffen. Entwicklung: Du baust mit uns Features entlang des gesamten Stacks – Datenverarbeitung in Python und SQL, Web-Applikationen (z. B. Flask/Streamlit) und AI-Komponenten wie LLM- und OCR-basierte Automatisierung. Verantwortung: Du übernimmst eigene Aufgabenpakete – vom Verständnis der fachlichen Anforderung über die Umsetzung bis zum Test und zur Übergabe an den Kunden. Kundennähe: Du bist bei Terminen mit dem Fachbereich dabei, nimmst Anforderungen auf, zeigst Zwischenstände und übersetzt Feedback in konkrete Verbesserungen. AI-Driven Development: Du arbeitest von Tag eins mit AI-Coding-Assistenten (z. B. GitHub Copilot) und hilfst uns, diese Arbeitsweise im Projekt weiterzuentwickeln. Cloud & IaaS: Du bekommst praktischen Einblick in eine moderne Cloud-Datenarchitektur (AWS: S3, Glue, Athena, Lambda) und lernst, wie Infrastruktur bereitgestellt, betrieben und weiterentwickelt wird. Dein Skillset: Fortgeschrittenes Studium in (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Data Science, (Wirtschafts-)Ingenieurwesen,Statistik, Naturwissenschaften oder in vergleichbaren Studiengängen Solide Python-Grundlagen und erste SQL-Kenntnisse aus Studium, Praktika, Werkstudententätigkeiten oder eigenen Projekten Erste Berührungspunkte mit Web-Applikationen (z. B. Flask, Streamlit, FastAPI) oder Lust, dich hier schnell einzuarbeiten Interesse an AI-gestützter Softwareentwicklung und ein Grundverständnis von Cloud-Konzepten (IaaS, Storage, Compute; Vorerfahrung mit AWS, Azure oder GCP ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung) Reisebereitschaft sowie Deutsch (C1) und Englisch sehr gut in Wort und Schrift Deine Chance: Echte Verantwortung für eigene Aufgabenpakete innerhalb unserer Projekte, die du selbständig bearbeitest Persönliche:r Mentor:in in deinem Team, der/die dir mit Rat und Tat zur Seite steht und dich mit umfassendem Know-how unterstützt Ein chancenreiches und internationales Umfeld, das dir einmalige Einblicke in die Arbeit des weltweit größten Prüfungs- und Beratungsunternehmens bietet Work-Life-Balance in einem innovativen Unternehmensumfeld, das dir Gesundheitstage, Mitarbeiter:innen-Events und vieles mehr bietet Bereichsübergreifendes Networking im Deloitte Student Network mit exklusiven Vorträgen und regelmäßigem Austausch beim Praktikant:innen-Stammtisch Vielfältige Gestaltungsspielräume und aktive Förderung einer inklusiven Unternehmenskultur – u. a. durch unsere Diversity & Inclusion Mitarbeiter:innen-Netzwerke Deine Verfügbarkeit: Als Praktikant:in bist du ab Oktober 2026 idealerweise für einen Zeitraum von mindestens vier Monaten verfügbar. Bist du bereit? Mach mit uns den Unterschied! Unser Recruiting-Team freut sich auf deine Bewerbungsunterlagen (CV sowie Abitur-, Hochschul- und Arbeitszeugnisse) über unser Online-Formular. Ein Anschreiben und ein Bewerbungsfoto sind bei uns nicht erforderlich. Gleiche Chancen für alle: Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen, die so vielfältig sind wie wir – unabhängig von Alter, Behinderung, ethnischer Herkunft und Nationalität, Geschlecht, Religion, sexueller Orientierung oder sozialer Herkunft. Noch Fragen? Alle Infos zu unserem Bewerbungsprozess findest du in unseren Bewerbungs-FAQs . Dein Kontakt bei Fragen rund um Karrierethemen Unser Team Talent Acquisition – Aleksandra, Anja, Julia, Lea, Lisa, Silja und ihre Teams – unterstützt dich gerne bei allen Fragen rund um deine Karriere bei Deloitte. Du erreichst uns per E-Mail unter career@deloitte.de oder telefonisch unter +49 211 87724111. Job-ID: 50440

items.desc: ¿Quieres llevar tus habilidades en Data, Analytics & IA al siguiente nivel? Descubre el poder de SDG: Líderes Globales en Datos e Inteligencia Artificial SDG Group cuenta con una sólida capacidad en IA, con más de 200 especialistas multidisciplinarios, incluidos especialistas en industria y negocio, data scientist, data architect y data engineer. Con experiencia en más de 70 clientes y más de 100 casos de uso, ofrecemos soluciones de IA adaptadas a diversas industrias, con más de 50 aceleradores tecnológicos, marcos y herramientas para acelerar la implementación de IA. A través de SDG iLabs, impulsamos la innovación experimentando con las últimas tendencias en IA. Tenemos fuertes alianzas con Microsoft, Google y AWS, y somos reconocidos a nivel mundial como líderes destacados en servicios de datos e IA. Experimenta lo que realmente significa ser especialista en Inteligencia Artificial. Si te apasiona la Inteligencia Artificial , ¡únete a SDG Group! ➡️ ¿Cómo será tu día a día? 🔹 Desarrollo de soluciones de IA end to end : Participarás en la creación de soluciones de inteligencia artificial desde el entendimiento del problema hasta el desarrollo de sistemas productivos. 🔹 Proyectos de Innovación en IA : Participarás en proyectos de IA desde optimización, probabilidad y algoritmos más tradicionales, hasta proyectos de IA generativa aplicando LLMs y Transformers. Trabajarás con tecnologías avanzadas en la nube, incluyendo AWS, GCP y Azure, y utilizarás plataformas como Azure Databricks, Azure Machine Learning, Amazon SageMaker, Google Vertex AI y OpenAI para desarrollar soluciones de vanguardia. 🔹 Industrialización de sistemas IA: Llevarás a cabo iniciativas de industrialización de sistemas de Inteligencia Artificial, utilizando una perspectiva de ingeniería y con metodología AIOps, para garantizar escalabilidad y fiabilidad. 🔹 Definición de plataformas y sistemas en la nube: Colaborarás en la definición de plataformas y sistemas de analítica avanzada en la nube para cubrir las necesidades de la ciencia de datos a gran escala. Conoce, fórmate y utiliza las herramientas y plataformas más avanzadas disponibles en las diferentes nubes para soluciones de ciencia de datos y AIOps. ➡️ ¿Qué te hará triunfar en esta posición? 🔹 Titulación técnica : Ingeniería Informática, Ingeniería de Telecomunicaciones, Matemáticas, Estadística y/o similares. 🔹 Experiencia profesional: A partir de 4 años de experiencia en ingeniería de Inteligencia Artificial. Experiencia en un rol similar, con experiencia práctica en la construcción y despliegue de soluciones de IA escalables para plataformas cloud. 🔹 Experiencia en consultoría : Experiencia previa en consultoría de datos y analítica o similares. 🔹 Lenguajes y tecnologías : Experiencia en tecnologías como Python, XGBoost, TensorFlow, Keras, Pandas, OpenCV, scikit-learn, Azure AI, AWS SageMaker, Google Vertex AI, Apache Airflow, Docker, Kubernetes... 🔹 Habilidades comunicativas : Nivel alto de comunicación tanto en español como inglés. Valoramos también: 🔹 Máster o doctorado : En áreas de big data o inteligencia artificial o campos relacionados 🔹 Experiencia práctica con modelos de IA Generativa : LLMs, Hugging Face, OpenAI, Transformers, Google Vertex AI, y similares. 🔹 Desarrollo de proyectos de IA : experiencia en la creación y desarrollo de proyectos de IA en el ciclo de vida de las soluciones y las prácticas de AIOps. 🔹 Certificaciones : Certificaciones relevantes en plataformas de IA. ¿Qué nos hace diferentes? Aquí no somos una empresa más... ¡somos un equipo que va a por todas! En SDG Group, somos una consultora global enfocada exclusivamente en Datos e Inteligencia Artificial. 🔹 La tecnología y los datos son nuestra esencia. Ofrecemos aprendizaje y crecimiento continuos, dándote el poder de desarrollar tus habilidades y mantenerte a la vanguardia de la innovación en IA. 🔹 Tú marcas el ritmo. Olvídate de estructuras rígidas. Semestralmente, te sentarás con tu responsable para hablar de tus logros, nuevos retos y… ¡ajustes salariales en base a resultados! 🔹 Desde el minuto 1, formarás parte del equipo de IA. Como AI Engineer, estarás en el centro de proyectos transformadores, ayudando a clientes líderes en la industria a construir e implementar sistemas de aprendizaje automático e IA en entornos reales y complejos. Trabajarás en diversas industrias, aplicando análisis predictivo, aprendizaje profundo y tecnologías de vanguardia para resolver desafíos empresariales y desbloquear nuevas oportunidades. 🔹 Aprenderás de referentes. Te codearás con cracks de la IA (tanto técnicos como de negocio), que compartirán su conocimiento y celebrarán tu crecimiento. 🔹 Somos una empresa con propósito. Creemos en la diversidad y la inclusión como motores de la creatividad, lo que nos permite superar cualquier desafío. items.desc: Ihre Karrierechance bei BRL Es kommt drauf an – wo und mit wem man arbeitet! Für einen Zeitraum von 6 Monaten suchen wir an den Standorten Berlin, Essen, Hamburg und München Praktikanten (m/w/d) für eine europaweite Beratertätigkeit im Bereich Data Science & Artificial Intelligence. Ihr Aufgabenfeld Ermittlung und Extraktion relevanter Informationen aus relationalen Datenbanken (Big Data) Evaluierung verschiedener Methoden und Tools für Data Analytics und Data Mining Analyse von Geschäftsprozessen und Erarbeitung von Optimierungspotentialen Unterstützung bei der Konzeption und Aufbau von Business Intelligence (BI) und Big Data Plattformen sowie der Auswahl von Speichertechnologien Das bieten wir Ihnen Ihre Vorteile bei BRL BRL Risk Advisory Services Immer auf Kurs Willkommen bei den Risk Advisory Services (RAS) von BRL – dem Partner für Risikomanagement, Corporate Governance und Strategieberatung. Wir unterstützen einen breiten Mandantenstamm, vom größeren Mittelstand bis hin zu global agierenden Konzernen, und sind international ausgerichtet. Als ein interdisziplinäres Team, arbeiten wir mit Leidenschaft daran, unsere weltweit tätigen Mandanten bei der Identifikation, Steuerung und Vermeidung potenzieller Risiken in allen Geschäftsbereichen und im IT-Umfeld zu unterstützen. Wir lieben es, gemeinsam mit ihnen Risiken und Chancen zu identifizieren, diese an der Unternehmensstrategie auszurichten sowie zu bewerten und steuern. Unsere Arbeit ist herausfordernd, denn sie erfordert ein tiefes Verständnis für die Prozesse in Unternehmen, insbesondere im Hinblick auf die hohe Relevanz von IT, Data Science, KI und Informationssicherheit. Wir arbeiten eng mit unseren Mandanten zusammen – oft direkt vor Ort – um ihre individuellen Bedürfnisse zu verstehen und maßgeschneiderte Lösungen zu entwickeln. Unsere Arbeit findet intern wie extern als Team statt – wir setzen auf eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Mandanten, um ihre Herausforderungen gemeinsam anzugehen und zu lösen. weiterlesen... Erfolg definieren wir durch die Findung umsetzbarer und pragmatischer Lösungen für unsere Mandanten, die wir zeitgerecht und effektiv liefern. Wir helfen nicht nur bei der Identifizierung von Problemen, sondern auch bei der Implementierung von Lösungen – ein Versprechen, das wir unseren Mandanten geben und das wir halten. Unser Qualitätsanspruch ist hoch, denn wir wissen, dass unsere Mandanten ebenso hohe Ansprüche haben. Wir streben danach, höchste Qualität termingerecht zu liefern, um das Vertrauen unserer Kunden zu gewinnen und zu halten. Die flachen Hierarchien bei BRL ermöglichen eine direkte und offene Kommunikation, auch in einem jungen, dynamischen, internationalen und multikulturellen Team. Wir setzen auf Flexibilität und fördern individuelle Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Bei uns gibt es keine starren Hierarchien, sondern einen familiären Charakter, der eine enge Zusammenarbeit und persönliche Entwicklung ermöglicht. Unsere Trainingsprogramme und Entwicklungsmodelle bieten eine solide Basisausbildung innerhalb von 2-3 Jahren, gefolgt von einem individuellen Karriereweg. Wir fördern den Berufseinstieg während oder nach dem Studium durch Praktika und Werkstudiums—Tätigkeiten, die eine steile Lernkurve bieten und eine ernstgemeinte Chance bieten, den Beruf und den Arbeitgeber genau kennenzulernen. Die multidisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit auf Projekten, oft in enger Abstimmung mit Bereichen wie z.B. Wirtschaftsprüfung und Steuern, ermöglicht es uns, ganzheitliche Lösungen anzubieten und unsere Kunden bestmöglich zu unterstützen. Willkommen bei BRL Risk Advisory – hier finden Sie nicht nur einen Arbeitgeber, sondern eine berufliche Heimat, die Sie fordert, fördert und unterstützt.

items.desc: Ready to take the next step in your career and make your mark in the financial world? At Vontobel, we believe diverse perspectives drive innovation and success. That’s why we’re excited to welcome passionate, ambitious, and curious students into our Early Careers Internship Program. Whether you’re fascinated by finance, technology or IT-security, this program offers you the chance to collaborate with a dynamic team, receive personalized support, and contribute to projects that truly matter. Over 6 months, starting on 1 March 2027 , you’ll gain hands-on experience and insights into the financial industry while building lasting connections in a globally recognized investment firm. What would your role be? As part of the internship, you will: Contribute to exciting and modern projects related to AI Security solutions. Use and extend your knowledge of AI security threats, vulnerabilities, and attack techniques. Elaborate on the AI Architecture from the security point of view, strengthening your present knowledge of cloud security principles and controls. Support key initiatives and software development activities within the AI-Security team. Collaborate with other engineering teams related to AI specific initiatives. Collaborate across teams to tackle challenging technical problems. Learn from industry leaders through mentorship, workshops, and networking events. What are we looking for? What You Bring We are seeking highly motivated students that share our values: Ownership: You are curious and get involved. You ask why a process works the way it does, offer to help where your team needs it, and see your own projects through from start to finish. Tenacity: You are driven and self-dependent. When the data doesn’t add up or the first approach fails, you look for another way and you come back with an answer. Foresight: You are a pro-active self-starter with a can-do mentality. You spot what’s coming and you take the initiative to solve it before it becomes a problem. What Sets You Apart AI literacy: You use AI tools to research, analyze and draft faster, and you double-check their output before you rely on it. Collaboration: You work well with others and build your network. You reach out to colleagues beyond your own team, learn how other parts of the bank work, and share what you find. What You Need To Apply You are enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program, or graduated within the last two years, in finance, technology or a related field. You have a genuine interest in the financial sector. You are fluent in English, written and spoken. German, French or Italian is a plus. You hold a valid work permit for the location you are applying to. What do we offer? At Vontobel, we strive to create an inspiring environment where you can thrive. Here’s what you can expect: Prime Zurich location: Modern collaboration spaces, and free on-site canteen offering freshly prepared lunches to keep you energized. Supportive and inclusive culture: Be part of a friendly, diverse team that values individuality and collaboration in an open-office setting. Tools for success: Access the latest technology and resources to excel in your role. Networking opportunities: join our NextGen community and meet other interns for lunch. Flat hierarchy and innovation: Collaborate at all levels and contribute to exciting projects in an agile, future-focused work environment. Paid internship: we offer standardized salary for all early career interns including free lunch. The application period for the 2027 Early Careers Internship Program runs from 5 to 15 November . As applications are reviewed on a rolling basis and positions may close early, we encourage you to apply early. You may submit a maximum of two applications across all internship positions. Why Vontobel? At Vontobel, you are building better futures for our clients and society, as well as for yourself. As a family-owned and publicly listed company with over 2,000 professionals based in 29 locations globally and headquartered in Zurich, we’re committed to long-term thinking and sustainability. Our diverse team values unique perspectives, and we hire individuals determined to deliver in a dynamic and changing world. Even if you don’t meet all the criteria, we encourage you to apply if you’re enthusiastic about the role. Do you want to be Vontobel? Thank you for applying to Vontobel. We will carefully review your application and will respond to you in a timely manner. At Vontobel, we are an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity. We value the many voices within our teams and are committed to creating an environment where everyone who wants to be part of our performance culture can be themselves. It is based on mutual respect and zero tolerance for any form of discrimination. If you have any …

In this role, you will work as part of the central Data team, collaborating closely with other product analytics professionals as well as alongside CRO to shape and scale company-wide experimentation standards. 👉 POSITION BREAKDOWN Own
items.desc: Eldorado.gg is a leading marketplace for in-game items, accounts, and services, founded in 2018. Built by a team of 200+ professionals who care about speed, security and user experience. We support 400+ games such as Roblox, League of Legends and Fortnite, attracting more than 10 million monthly visits and reaching a global audience every day. We value bold ideas, move fast and continuously push the boundaries of digital trading. Join us and be part of a team where your work makes a real impact! As we scale from ~200–250 to 500+ A/B tests per year, we’re looking for a Data Scientist (Experimentation) to raise the quality and velocity of experimentation. You will run rigorous analysis on high-impact tests while building the standards, processes, and enablement so product teams can confidently evaluate simpler experiments themselves. In this role, you will work as part of the central Data team, collaborating closely with other product analytics professionals as well as alongside CRO to shape and scale company-wide experimentation standards. 👉 POSITION BREAKDOWN Own deep analysis of high-risk, high-impact, or ambiguous A/B tests and deliver clear recommendations. Define, validate, and standardize metrics, guardrails, and success criteria across experiments. Build the experimentation framework: design standards, sample size guidelines, metric rules, interpretation practices, and review criteria. Educate and coach product managers and designers so they can close simpler tests independently (target: majority of low-complexity tests without Data team involvement). Enforce standards through reviews, office hours, templates, and documentation. Partner with Data Engineering / Analytics Engineering on tracking, events, and instrumentation. Identify bottlenecks and improve experiment velocity and quality without sacrificing rigor. Shape the long-term experimentation operating model with product and data leadership. 👉 WHAT MAKES YOU A GREAT FIT 3+ years of experience in product analytics or data science, ideally in marketplaces, e-commerce, or high-velocity product environments. Strong SQL skills - comfortable with complex queries, CTEs, window functions, and aggregations over large datasets (BigQuery preferred). Hands-on experience with product analytics event tracking, tracking implementation, and event instrumentation. Experience with regression analysis and statistical modeling. Solid understanding of A/B testing methodology, experimental design, power analysis, and metrics design. Ability to design and standardize metrics, guardrails, and success criteria. Strong communicator who can teach non-technical stakeholders (product managers, designers) and enforce analytical standards. Fluency in English and Lithuanian. 👉 NICE TO HAVE Experience scaling experimentation programs in marketplaces. Track record of enabling self-serve analytics for product teams. 👉 OUR DATA STACK Airbyte for data ingestion. Dagster for orchestration. Google BigQuery for storage and warehousing. dbt for data modeling and transformation. GrowthBook for A/B testing. Lightdash for visualization, semantic layer. Amplitude for product analytics. 👉 PERKS & BENEFITS Growth opportunities: Access to an internal library, latest tools and technologies, professional conferences, and mentorship to level up your skills, opportunities for internal career growth. Health & wellbeing: Private health insurance after the probation period, additional sick days (no doctor’s note needed), and the option to join free volleyball games at Delfi Arena with colleagues. Office perks: Free parking, a fully stocked kitchen, Friday bun breakfasts, and a gaming room (table football, driving simulator, PS5, Xbox One); we’re pet-friendly and love team activities from game nights to sports events. Additional time off: Extra vacation days added annually (+1 day per year), with a cap of up to 10 additional days. Equity opportunities: Top-performing employees have the opportunity to be included in the generous company’s stock options program. Extra perks: Monthly top-ups for your Eldorado.gg account after probation, gifts for important life events, partner discounts, and referral bonuses. Hybrid work model: Built around an office-first mindset - 4 days in-office (Simbiocity, Vilnius) and 1 day remote. 👉 GROSS SALARY The salary range for this position is 4000-7000 Eur gross per month, depending on your experience. 👉 WHAT TO EXPECT NEXT Shortlisted candidates will be contacted by our Talent Acquisition team and invited to complete the following stages: HR interview, hiring manager interview, test task.

items.desc: Vil du være med på å bygge plattformene som gjør AI mulig i praksis? Kunstig intelligens og maskinlæring stiller nye krav til infrastrukturen som ligger i bunn. Hos Accenture får du være med på å bygge, drifte og videreutvikle moderne plattformer som gjør det mulig å ta AI-, ML- og dataløsninger fra utvikling til sikker og stabil produksjon. Du vil jobbe i skjæringspunktet mellom plattform, infrastruktur, automatisering, data og AI, i tett samarbeid med utviklingsteam, arkitekter, sikkerhetsmiljøer og AI- og datafaglige miljøer. Vi ser ikke etter noen som kan alt. Kanskje er Kubernetes og OpenShift din hjemmebane. Kanskje har du mest erfaring med automatisering og Infrastructure as Code, data- og ML-plattformer eller datasenter og private cloud. Har du et godt teknisk fundament og spisskompetanse innen ett eller flere av områdene, vil vi gjerne høre fra deg. Viktig krav for stillingen: Norsk statsborgerskap er et krav for denne stillingen. Søkere må kunne gjennomføre nødvendig norsk sikkerhetsklarering. Slik kan arbeidshverdagen din se ut: Som AI Platform Engineer vil du jobbe med infrastrukturen og plattformtjenestene som AI-, ML- og dataarbeidslaster er avhengige av. Rollen kombinerer praktisk plattformutvikling og drift med automatisering, optimalisering og videreutvikling av moderne teknologimiljøer. Du vil blant annet: Bygge, automatisere og drifte moderne infrastruktur- og plattformtjenester for AI-, ML- og dataarbeidslaster Etablere og videreutvikle Kubernetes-baserte plattformer, eksempelvis Red Hat OpenShift Automatisere provisjonering, konfigurasjon og endringer gjennom Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD og GitOps Tilrettelegge for data- og ML-arbeidsflyter, inkludert MLOps, modellutrulling og datapipelines Optimalisere compute-, GPU-, nettverks- og lagringsressurser for krevende arbeidslaster Samarbeide med sikkerhets-, nettverks-, utviklings- og AI-miljøer for å sikre stabile, skalerbare og sikre plattformer Ivareta identitet, tilgang og datastyring på tvers av plattformen Hvem ser vi etter? Det finnes flere veier inn i denne rollen. Du kan komme fra platform engineering, DevOps, infrastruktur, Kubernetes- og containerplattformmiljøer, data/ML eller automatisering. Det viktigste er at du har solid teknisk forståelse og relevant praktisk erfaring innen ett eller flere av områdene. Vi ser særlig etter praktisk erfaring med: Plattform og infrastruktur: Infrastruktur-, Kubernetes-, data- eller ML-plattformer Automatisering og Infrastructure as Code: Eksempelvis Ansible eller tilsvarende teknologier CI/CD og GitOps: Git og automatiserte prosesser for utvikling og utrulling Programmering og scripting: Python eller andre relevante programmerings- og skriptspråk Data og maskinlæring: Forståelse for MLOps, datapipelines, modellutrulling og annen relevant data- og ML-teknologi Sikkerhet og tilgang: God forståelse for sikkerhet, identitet, tilgang og sikker håndtering av data Infrastrukturforståelse: Forståelse for samspillet mellom compute, nettverk og lagring Det er en fordel om du har erfaring innen ett eller flere av følgende områder: Utvikling og optimalisering av AI/ML-arbeidslaster for GPU-baserte miljøer High-Performance Computing (HPC) for data- eller ML-intensive arbeidslaster Plattformtjenester for maskinlæringsmodeller LLM-baserte løsninger, agent engineering eller plattformtjenester for AI-agenter Sovereign AI, isolerte eller air-gapped AI-miljøer Sikker håndtering og styring av sensitive data, modeller og AI-tjenester Kjenner du deg igjen i deler av den tekniske profilen, men ikke alt? Vi vil fortsatt gjerne høre fra deg. Vi er opptatt av kompetansen du allerede har, men også av nysgjerrighet, potensial og ønsket om å utvikle deg videre innen moderne AI- og datainfrastruktur. Hvorfor vi tror du vil trives hos oss: Hos Accenture får du jobbe med komplekse teknologimiljøer og utfordrende problemstillinger, samtidig som du får gode muligheter til å utvikle deg videre. Gjennom vår omfattende læringsplattform kan du utforske nye fagområder, fordype deg i det du allerede kan og ta relevante sertifiseringer. Når du begynner hos oss, får du en Career Counsellor som støtter deg i karriereutviklingen og hjelper deg med å utforske nye muligheter og fagområder. Vi legger til rette for fleksibilitet og en arbeidshverdag som kan kombineres med livet utenfor jobb. Du blir også en del av et inkluderende faglig og sosialt miljø, med aktiviteter og møteplasser både på og utenfor kontoret. Oslo-kontoret ligger sentralt ved Rådhuset, med blant annet treningsrom, sykkelparkering og gode kollektivmuligheter. I tillegg tilbyr vi forsikringsordninger, ansattrabatter og tilgang til hytter i Hemsedal. Hos oss skal det være rom for å være den du er. Vi ser etter engasjerte mennesker som brenner for faget sitt. Interessert? Har du spørsmål om stillingen eller ønsker å vite mer? Ta gjerne kontakt med Recruiting Senior Analyst Emelie Lundberg på emelie.lundberg@accenture.com. Vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg!

items.desc: Based in Manchester, this permanent role sits within Manchester City’s 1st Team Analysis department and helps turn football data into better decisions. Working with the Football Intelligence Data team, you will develop models and insights that inform recruitment, training and match strategy, while helping football practitioners understand what it takes to perform at the highest level. Who We Are Manchester City is a football club rooted in East Manchester, with a story that began in 1880 and continues to grow today. Built on resilience, belief and togetherness, success on the pitch is driven by the moments and memories shared with millions of Fans around the world. City is known for its bravery, its determination to the very end and its strong connection to where we come from. With Mancunian roots and a global outlook, we are shaped by our Fans and driven by a long-term vision, from developing future talent to supporting the communities we call home. Together, we are creating the next chapter, the City way. Within our 1st Team Analysis department, we work across performance analysis and football intelligence to support better decision-making on and off the pitch. By combining technical expertise, football understanding and collaborative ways of working, the team develops practical insight for Manchester City and the wider City Football Group network. The Role As a First Team Data Scientist, you will research and build data science solutions that help football practitioners and decision-makers answer important questions about performance and recruitment. Your work will turn complex information into clear, useful insight that can support the way teams prepare, perform and develop. You will develop statistical and machine-learning models that deepen our understanding of what it takes to perform, contributing to quantitative approaches across technical, tactical and physical areas of football. You will explore patterns and trends, identify meaningful features, test ideas and make predictions that can inform training programmes and match strategies. Working alongside data scientists, analysts and colleagues across multidisciplinary teams, you will communicate your findings to both technical and non-technical audiences. You will manage your work against agreed plans, contribute to shared project outcomes and bring curiosity, imagination and practical problem-solving to new football performance challenges. What You’ll Bring A Masters or equivalent industry experience in a quantitative discipline such as mathematics, statistics, physics, computer science or a related subject. Experience designing and training complex statistical models. Proficiency in Python for data analysis and model development. Experience working with structured and unstructured data sources, including spatio-temporal data. Clear and effective communication skills, including the ability to present technical findings to non-technical audiences. Proven ability to collaborate with other data scientists and across multidisciplinary teams. Why Choose Us Working at Manchester City means being supported to do your best, with the flexibility and encouragement to look after your wellbeing. We are committed to helping our people learn, grow and thrive in a culture built on collaboration, openness and hard work. As part of our team, you will receive 26 days’ annual leave plus a day off for your birthday, private healthcare and dental cover, and an annual discretionary bonus. You will also have access to a Health Cash Plan, Employee Assistance Programme with 24/7 GP support, and a company pension and life assurance. Manchester-based employees also benefit from free on-site parking, complimentary breakfast and lunch, and access to a range of sports and leisure clubs. You can enjoy a range of additional benefits, including cycle to work, Give As You Earn, discounted match tickets, savings in the City Store, a free City+ subscription, stadium tour discounts, and wider retail and lifestyle offers. How to Apply If this role sounds like it is for you, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please submit your application via our careers site by 16 November 2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as you can. We work with a select group of agency partners and do not accept unsolicited applications. Any CVs submitted without prior agreement will be treated as a direct application. Equal Opportunities City Football Group promotes equal opportunities in employment and we positively welcome applications from all candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation. We will screen all applicants and select candidates whose skills and experience seem to meet our needs.
