For our client from the financial sector, we are currently looking for 4 specialists for the position of AI Analyst. Service delivery model: Hybrid, Poznań / Wrocław / Warszawa, minimum 40% from the office Start Date: ASAP Cooperation type: B2B, through Hays Poland Project Description The services focus on designing, developing and implementing AI and GenAI solutions supporting business processes and data-driven initiatives. The scope combines AI engineering, large-scale data processing, GenAI, LLMOps and business analysis. An important element of the cooperation is the ability to assess where AI can create genuine business value and where changing or optimizing the underlying process is a more appropriate solution. Technology environment Python ML/AI frameworks GitHub Copilot Genie Code or similar tools Azure Databricks GenAI / LLM LLMOps Knowledge bases Skills MCP Scope of services Design, develop and implement AI/GenAI solutions supporting business processes. Build data-driven solutions processing large volumes of data in Azure Databricks, with particular emphasis on GenAI capabilities available within the platform. Design and implement LLMOps pipelines. Experiment with new capabilities within the Databricks ecosystem. Prepare analyses, prototypes and recommendations addressing specific business needs. Translate business needs into practical solutions, particularly those leveraging AI. Identify scenarios where AI can improve operational processes and situations where redesigning the process is a more effective approach than implementing AI. Support data teams in developing AI best practices and strengthening a data-driven approach. Collaborate with business stakeholders on implementing AI-based solutions and business process automation. Required competencies Strong practical knowledge of tools such as GitHub Copilot, Genie Code or similar solutions. Ability to identify and implement AI solutions in operational processes, including the ability to recognize when process transformation is preferable to applying AI. Very good knowledge of Python and ML/AI frameworks. Experience working with large volumes of data, including unstructured data. Ability to translate business needs into concrete solutions, particularly AI-based solutions. Knowledge of designing end-user solutions based on generative AI and language models, including testing, harness and alignment. Experience delivering projects end-to-end, from problem analysis through solution implementation. Ability to explain complex concepts in a simple and understandable way. Practical knowledge of building, structuring and using knowledge bases. Practical skills in defining skills and MCP. Nice to Have Experience with Databricks One, AI/BI Dashboards & Genie and Databricks Apps. Experience with conversational data systems. Experience in optimizing processes and data processing for small language models. The cooperation is carried out between independent businesses (B2B model) and covers the performance of services within the agreed project scope. The Contractor independently organizes and manages the manner in which the services are performed, taking into account the project requirements, security obligations, and the necessary communication with the client. items.desc: Cobalt Fairy is a digital innovation company dedicated to enriching the digital world through ebooks, audiobooks, and innovative digital products, including FairyMail, our email marketing platform currently in its Early Adopter phase. We are currently looking for an AI Solutions & Automation Specialist to help us leverage AI across Cobalt Fairy and FairyMail. This role focuses on identifying opportunities, designing and implementing AI-powered workflows, automating repetitive processes, improving internal efficiency, and supporting team members in adopting AI tools that create measurable value. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys solving problems, experimenting with emerging AI technologies, building practical solutions, and helping teams work smarter. Core responsibilities Map workflows and convert business pain points into clear, ranked automation opportunities. Prototype and productionize AI workflows across internal tools, APIs, dashboards, content systems, and communications platforms. Build the priority automations, including meeting intelligence, cross-tool reporting, monitoring/alerts, and research pipelines. Can frame ambiguous problems, prioritize by value/risk, prototype quickly, and distinguish a demo from a reliable workflow. Can interview stakeholders, map processes, challenge assumptions, and find unrecognized opportunities. Demonstrates confidentiality, security awareness, data minimization, ethical restraint, and sound escalation instincts. Ability to work independently under tight deadlines, take initiative, and collaborate effectively as part of a team. Strong analytical, problem solving and critical thinking skills. Commitment to continuous learning and staying current with AI and technology trends. Fluent in Greek and English; can explain technical tradeoffs to non-technical teammates and document systems clearly. What we offer Fully remote & flexible working hours High ownership & autonomy; you'll have the freedom to identify opportunities, propose solutions, and shape how AI and automation are used across the company. Build the function from the ground up; you'll be the first person dedicated to AI solutions and automation, with the opportunity to establish processes, tools, standards, and best practices. Direct impact on the business; your work will directly influence how our teams operate and how we develop FairyMail and other digital products. Experimentation & innovation; freedom to test new AI tools, models, platforms, and approaches and turn promising ideas into practical solutions. Access to real business problems and data; rather than working on isolated technical projects, you'll work directly with teams across the company to identify and solve operational challenges. Opportunity to grow with the role; as our use of AI and automation expands, there is room for the position and its responsibilities to evolve with it. Collaborative, international environment; work with a remote team across different functions and contribute to a growing digital company. Location Anywhere there is a wi-fi connection. Work from home, in your PJs or in your hometown’s library, as long as you ensure the quality of work and comfortable working space. Schedule As a full-time position, we calculate a total 40-hour work week but with flexible working hours. Your attendance however on occasional morning meetings is to be considered as mandatory. items.desc: We are looking for young talent willing to combine writing their thesis with working as a student assistant in one of our departments. We firmly believe that this combination provides the candidate with the best opportunity to experience what working for Ortec Finance is like. The length of this program is typically 7 months but can be tailored to the candidate's preferences. During the application process, R&D Labs will explore relevant quantitative thesis topics to work on during your internship. In addition, based on your ambitions and interests, we match you to one or more departments to work for us as a student assistant. Starting dates are flexible, with the earliest possible start in December 2026. Who are you? We Are Looking For Candidates who are creative; who like problem solving; who are able to bring theory into practice. And, preferably with expertise in one of the following areas: Quantitative Finance/Econometrics Applied mathematics Computer Science Other quantitative studies This position is only open to students that are in their last stage of their Master of Science (MSc). What do we offer? Our organization employs highly educated people who invest in their careers. Our corporate culture is open and informal; we are always receptive to good ideas. We offer you plenty of room to fully apply your talents and highly value an entrepreneurial spirit. In addition, we provide you with a salary based on the ratio, internship and student assistantship. You will be based at either our Rotterdam or Amsterdam office. Flexibility in working from home or at the office. Possibility to grow within the company. Master students receive 1.597 euro (gross month allowance) based on a combined function of two days as a student assistant and three days internship. R&D Labs Since its establishment, Ortec Finance has put innovation through applied scientific research and IT developments on the forefront. Our research and innovation activities are concentrated within the Ortec Finance R&D Labs where we have strong ties with academic institutions. We work and experiment with both new modelling approaches and IT techniques and concepts in order to research their applicability to investment decision-making. R&D Labs aims to be the linking pin between Ortec Finance and the scientific research community. It performs innovative, high-quality research with a strong practical focus. We collaborate with students, academics and external parties to design the future of investment decision making. Who is Ortec Finance? Working at Ortec Finance means working somewhere else. It means working in a world where colleagues meet, gather knowledge and where likeminded peers are always willing to help each other. Where the organizational culture is friendly, flat and non-political. Working at Ortec Finance also means working in a continuously innovating world where science, academics and mathematics dominate, since models are key in helping Ortec Finance’ clients with complex financial decisions. Because that’s what we love: giving our clients the best advice possible. Where the daily job is very in-dept, based on evidence and relevant for society. It means a job that matters. Where the learning curve is steep; we learn something new every single day. And we need to, because continuous innovation is key. Especially in a fin tech world. We don’t necessarily follow all conventions. Because yes, we are a bit rebellious too. Ortec Finance is the leading provider of technology and solutions for risk and return management. It is our purpose to enable people to manage the complexity of investment decisions. We do this through delivering leading technologies and solutions for investment decision-making to financial institutions around the world. Our strength lies in an effective combination of advanced models, innovative technology and in-depth market knowledge. More at www.ortecfinance.com. More information or to apply? For more information regarding this position please send an email to: Recruitment@ortec-finance.com. To apply, please use the application button to send us below documents: CV list of grades cover letter (including preferred start date). We hope to meet you soon! We model and map relevant uncertainties to help you monitor your goals and decisions. Established by foremost experts in the fields of Econometrics and Technology in 1982, we have garnered an exceptional reputation for reliability. Serving over 600 clients across more than 20 countries, we play a pivotal role in enhancing our clients' investment decision making, and managing their uncertainty.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere. Introduction to the Team Join the Product & Technology Analytics team within our rapidly growing B2B division and play a critical role in shaping the future of our business! As a Data Scientist II, you'll be at the forefront of data-driven decision-making, driving strategic initiatives and unearthing valuable insights to fuel our growth. This role offers the exciting opportunity to influence product development, optimize commercial performance, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to impact our bottom line, all while working on cutting-edge challenges in the dynamic intersection of technology and travel. In This Role, You Will Drive impactful insights: Perform deep-dive analysis and statistical tests to uncover key performance drivers for our partners, translating findings into actionable recommendations. Transform data into value: Extract, transform, and combine data from diverse sources to build robust models and analyses. Translate business needs into analytical solutions: Collaborate with stakeholders to define and scope analytical requests, framing business problems into solvable analytical tasks. Visualize and communicate data stories: Create clear, compelling visualizations that translate data into meaningful insights and drive data-driven decision-making. Develop and maintain scalable reporting: Automate frequent reporting tasks by building scalable dashboards that provide ongoing performance visibility. Build business cases with data: Develop data-driven business cases to support stakeholder goals and strategic initiatives. Experience And Qualifications You have at least 2+ years of analytical experience in a data-rich commercial environment such as online travel, e-commerce, or banking. You're a strong communicator, capable of translating complex analyses into easily understandable insights for diverse audiences. You're proficient in SQL, with the ability to write queries from scratch, find relevant data, and interpret existing code. You're proficient in web analytics, with the ability to use web analytics tools such as Google analytics or Adobe Analytics. You're experienced with data visualization tools like Tableau, enabling you to create compelling and insightful dashboards. Experience evaluating product impact using experimentation frameworks and causal inference methods (e.g., A/B testing, quasi-experiments). You're a collaborative team player with a proven track record of delivering data-driven insights and recommendations that have driven positive change. Python is a nice to have! The total cash range for this position in Madrid is €43,000.00 to €60,500.00. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to €69,000.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role. Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, available budget, and an individual’s knowledge, skills, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future. Learn more about life at Expedia Group at https://careers.expediagroup.com/life. You can find the benefits for this location and any collective agreement that may apply here. items.desc: CrowdFarming es una empresa tecnológica. Conectamos a 3.500 agricultores en 15 países con más de 500.000 hogares en toda Europa a través de productos que hemos construido nosotros: nuestro marketplace, CrowdSender (nuestro TMS) y Farmeneur, la plataforma donde los agricultores gestionan sus datos agronómicos y acceden a los servicios que les damos. En el equipo de Sustainability & Impact llevamos años construyendo nuestro programa de agricultura regenerativa. Hoy trabajamos con 100 agricultores, con un protocolo científico sólido y datos agronómicos sobre sobre 10.000 hectáreas en 6 países. El programa está demostrado y es la base de lo que queremos escalar, pero necesitamos construir nuestro propio producto digital. Tu misión inicial será crear el software con el que corre el programa: las herramientas con las que los agrónomos recogen datos en campo, el sistema que normaliza los analíticos de laboratorio (distintos por país) y los convierte en planes de acción concretos para cada agricultor, y los dashboards con los que modelamos las tendencias y defendemos nuestras cifras de impacto con rigor de auditoría. Todo conectado con Farmeneur y el marketplace, y con la IA integrada donde de verdad ahorra tiempo o mejora decisiones. Construyes sobre la misma infraestructura que Farmeneur y pasas por los mismos estándares y revisiones de código que el resto del equipo tech. [Vídeo: Conoce al equipo] ⚠️ Buscamos a alguien que construya Buscamos a una persona que piense en producto, que asuma los retos de principio a fin (esto no es un rol de IT de soporte esperando a que lleguen tickets) y que use la IA como palanca para multiplicar lo que hace. Tres rasgos que nos importan de verdad: Creador, no picacódigo. Entiendes el problema y buscas soluciones; para entregar productos que se usen, no esperas que alguien te diga exactamente que botón quiere y en dónde. Pragmático, autónomo, end-to-end, y con criterio para decidir dónde está el reto, qué construir y cómo. El dato en el centro. Te mueves con soltura en pipelines, APIs e integraciones, análisis y BI/dashboarding. Conviertes un dataset desordenado en algo que un agricultor entiende a la primera. IA’s best friend. Ya trabajas con herramientas de IA en tu día a día porque te hacen mejor, y sabes llevar a otros a adoptarlas. Conviertes un “aquí podríamos usar IA” en algo que el equipo acaba integrando de verdad. 🧰 Qué necesitas para tener éxito imprescindible 3-4 años de experiencia como desarrollador/a, trabajando tanto en back como en front. Node.js (también valen Express o NestJS). Angular 15 o superior (AngularJS no cuenta). TypeScript (incluyendo linters para asegurar la calidad del código). Desarrollo de APIs REST y conexión a APIs de terceros. Git (Bitbucket, GitHub o GitLab). Español o inglés con comodidad plena de trabajo. Suma puntos: Bases de datos: al menos dos de MongoDB, DynamoDB y PostgreSQL (la más importante es Mongo). AWS (Lambda, S3, EC2, ECS…). Testing (Jest, Jasmine, Karma o Cypress). Experiencia en empresa con producto propio, o en equipos con diseño/UX y producto. Señales de seniority: mentoring, revisión de código, decisiones de arquitectura o liderazgo técnico. Background o curiosidad activa por agronomía, biología de suelo o ciencia ambiental. 👉 Por qué CrowdFarming, y por qué ahora Somos líderes en la venta directa de producto ecológico a nivel europeo. Founders muy implicados, con los pies en el suelo pero ambición enorme. Y un momento claro: pasar de estar presentes en 31 países a competir de verdad en cada uno de ellos con los grandes supermercados . 👉 Lo que te ofrecemos Pocas veces vas a poder aplicar lo que sabes de tech, dato e IA a una misión tan tangible: construir desde cero la plataforma sobre la que corre la agricultura regenerativa europea, con ownership real y la posibilidad de ver tu código traducido en decisiones de manejo en una finca en Sicilia o en Murcia. Lo demás también: contrato indefinido, flexibilidad real, formato híbrido en Madrid, y los típicos perks de una empresa que entiende que las personas que la forman son su activo más valioso. 🌱 Si has llegado hasta aquí No nos importa que tu CV encaje al milímetro. Nos importa cómo piensas, qué has construido y si tienes ganas de tener impacto real tanto en el negocio como en los suelos europeos. Valoramos las trayectorias que se salen del guion y a quien no espera que le digan cómo hacer bien su trabajo: alguien que asume la responsabilidad end-to-end y habla de dato más que de cosas etéreas. Si quieres construir la columna digital de la agricultura regenerativa europea, modelar el dato que hoy no sabe modelar casi nadie y meter IA en la forma de trabajar de un equipo científico, queremos conocerte.

items.desc: Ready for a challenge? Then Just Eat Takeaway.com might be the place for you. We're a leading global online delivery platform, and our vision is to empower everyday convenience. Whether it's a Friday-night feast, a post-gym poke bowl, or grabbing some groceries, our tech platform connects tens of millions of customers with hundreds of thousands of restaurant, grocery and convenience partners across the globe. About This Role We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer with passion for using machine learning to create intelligent applications. As a Machine Learning Engineer, you will be part of the Pricing Data Team inside the User Behavior Data Team under the umbrella of Data and Analytics pillar with 500+ data engineers, analysts, scientists. You will collaboratively design, build and will focus on evolving existing machine learning and AI capabilities across the platform, improving those capabilities, and innovating new ones for the future. As a member of the Pricing Data Team, you will develop solutions to estimate demand price elasticity and generate counterfactuals through simulation, finally optimize consumer pricing policy to ensure a reliable, efficient, and revenue generated service. These are some of the key components to the position: Design, develop, and train data science models to solve complex business problems, taking full end-to-end ownership from initial prototyping to production deployment. Communicate the complexities of ML systems (e.g.,e.g., algorithmic choices, latency vs. accuracy trade-offs) effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Build and maintain a strong network across the Data and Engineering organizations to ensure ML systems integrate seamlessly with the wider platform. What will you bring to the team? Strong experience in machine learning, specifically developing ML infrastructure platforms for consumer pricing and policy-related products. Hands-on experience developing data science models (predicting and causal modelling) using Python libraries such as pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, and TensorFlow. Proficiency in Python and a strong understanding of software engineering principles (object-oriented design, design patterns, testing) applied to ML. Demonstrable experience designing and operating ML systems in production (beyond notebook-based training), including familiarity with serving patterns such as REST APIs, batch inference, and event-driven architectures. Ability to work independently and solve complex problems, with a proven track record of productising and deploying models using cloud-native ML platforms (e.g., AWS SageMaker, GCP Vertex AI). Familiarity with orchestration, tracking, and containerisation tools, particularly Airflow, MLflow, and Docker. Solid Understanding of data engineering fundamentals (e.g., SQL, distributed data processing) to debug and optimise data flows. items.desc: Das Deutsche Krebsforschungszentrum (DKFZ) ist eines der größten Krebsforschungszentren Europas. „Forschen für ein Leben ohne Krebs“ ist unsere Mission und hierfür arbeiten unsere Weltklassewissenschaftler:innen gemeinsam mit allen Mitarbeitenden. Wir erforschen, wie Krebs entsteht, erfassen Krebsrisikofaktoren und suchen nach neuen Strategien, die verhindern, dass Menschen an Krebs erkranken. Wir entwickeln neue Methoden, mit denen Tumore präziser diagnostiziert und Krebspatient:innen erfolgreicher behandelt werden können. Jeder Beitrag zählt – ob in der Forschung, in der Administration oder der Infrastruktur. Das macht unsere tägliche Arbeit so bedeutungsvoll und spannend. Die Abteilung „Medizinische Bildverarbeitung“ (Medical Image Computing – MIC) entwickelt Methoden und Softwarelösungen an der Schnittstelle von medizinischer Bildgebung, künstlicher Intelligenz, Cloud-Technologien und moderner Forschungsinfrastruktur. Für den Betrieb und die Weiterentwicklung unserer verteilten Bildgebungs- und Analyseplattformen suchen wir ab Januar 2027 eine:n motivierte:n Softwareentwickler:in / Research Software Engineer (m/w/d) für medizinische Bildgebungs- und Analyseplattformen . Kennziffer: 2026-0222 Unsere Plattformen basieren auf dem Open-Source-Toolkit Kaapana, einer Kubernetes-basierten Plattform für medizinische Datenanalyse, KI-Workflows sowie föderierte Analyse- und Lernszenarien. Auf dieser gemeinsamen technischen Basis betreiben wir mehrere standortübergreifende Forschungsinfrastrukturen, die lokale Instanzen an den beteiligten Standorten mit zentralen Komponenten verbinden. Zwei aktuelle Beispiele: RACOON (Radiological Cooperative Network) ist die bundesweite Bildgebungsplattform des Netzwerks Universitätsmedizin (NUM). RACOON verbindet lokale Standorte an den deutschen Universitätskliniken mit zentralen Komponenten in RACOON-CENTRAL und unterstützt multizentrische Forschungsprojekte, klinische Studien, strukturierte Befundung, Annotation, KI-gestützte Bildanalyse und die standardisierte Nachnutzung radiologischer Daten. RACOON-AI ist die zentrale KI-Plattform innerhalb dieser Infrastruktur. NCT IDAI (Image Data and Analysis Infrastructure for NCT) stellt die gemeinsame Bildgebungs- und Analyseinfrastruktur für das Nationale Centrum für Tumorerkrankungen bereit und verbindet die NCT-Standorte für standortübergreifende onkologische Forschung. Die technischen Aufgaben sind in beiden Infrastrukturen ähnlich. Im Wesentlichen unterscheiden sich die angebundenen Standorte und die fachlichen Anwendungsfälle. Ihr Schwerpunkt ergibt sich aus Ihrem Profil und dem Projektbedarf. Wichtiger Hinweis zum Profil der Stelle: Diese Position ist keine Data-Science-, Modelltraining- oder Promotionsstelle. Der Schwerpunkt liegt auf robuster Softwareentwicklung, Plattformbetrieb, Methodenintegration, Support und technischer Koordination innerhalb produktiv genutzter, standortübergreifender medizinischer Forschungsinfrastrukturen. Die Stelle richtet sich an Bewerber:innen, die Forschungssoftware in nutzbare Plattformkomponenten überführen, containerisierte Dienste betreiben, KI-Methoden in reproduzierbare Workflows integrieren und technische Fragestellungen gemeinsam mit den beteiligten Standorten, deren IT-Teams und Projektpartnern lösen möchten. Ihre Aufgaben: Weiterentwicklung unserer Plattformen durch Softwareentwicklung im Open-Source-Toolkit Kaapana Integration, Bereitstellung und Pflege von KI-Methoden, Analyse-Workflows und containerisierten Anwendungen Unterstützung der Methodentranslation aus dem Medical Image Computing in die Infrastruktur an den beteiligten Standorten Softwaretechnische Integration von Werkzeugen und Konzepten zur Verarbeitung multimodaler medizinischer Daten, einschließlich Bilddaten, strukturierter klinischer Daten und weiterer forschungsrelevanter Datenquellen Technische Unterstützung multizentrischer Forschungsprojekte, klinischer Studien und medizinischer Use Cases Betrieb, Wartung, Monitoring und Fehleranalyse der lokalen und zentralen Plattform-Instanzen Second-Level-Support für IT-Ansprechpersonen und lokale IT-Teams an den angebundenen Standorten Weiterentwicklung und Wartung von Plattformkomponenten im Umfeld von Kubernetes, Helm, Docker/Podman, Apache Airflow, OpenSearch, dcm4chee, S3, Keycloak, Prometheus/Grafana und webbasierten Nutzeroberflächen Erstellung und Pflege technischer Dokumentation, Betriebsanleitungen und Support-Materialien Teilnahme an Projektmeetings, technischen Abstimmungen und Workshops Präsentation der Plattform bei Veranstaltungen, Vernetzungsformaten und Projekttreffen Mitwirkung an Reporting, Planung und technischer Koordination Ihr Profil: Sie passen besonders gut zu uns, wenn Sie Freude an robuster Forschungssoftware, verteilten Infrastrukturen und der Zusammenarbeit mit klinischen, wissenschaftlichen und technischen Partnern haben. Zwingend erforderlich sind: Abgeschlossenes Masterstudium in Informatik, Medizininformatik, Data Science, Mathematik, Physik, …

items.desc: Are you passionate about digital signal processing and wireless communication? Do you want to become a part of a cross-disciplinary development group with dedicated and experienced colleagues? Would you like to leave your mark on future technology choices in Kamstrup within wireless communication? Here Is What The Job Entails As our intern, you will become part of our technology projects, where we investigate and develop new intelligent radio systems. You will be involved in several phases of the projects with tasks ranging widely from concept development to analysis and simulation of performance to actual prototyping. More specifically, you will be: Working with digital signal processing (DSP) Developing tools for testing new radio technologies and protocols Preparing mathematical analyses and simulation using Python Working with prototype implementation on radio development boards, possibly in C++, VHDL, MatLab, C#, etc. Exploring Software Defined Radio (SDR) platforms and the GNU Radio framework. During your internship, you will have the opportunity to work with different projects and in different areas depending on your interests and aspirations. Moreover, you will work with dedicated and experienced colleagues who will support your personal and professional development through close collaboration and continuous sparring. Meet your future team As our intern in Tech Lead, you will become part of our technology development team consisting of 6 dedicated employees. Here, you will participate on equal terms with your colleagues in a cross-disciplinary development group who are developing and shaping the wireless communication systems of the future for remote reading of utility meters. The department has a good working environment, where you will discover that both freedom with responsibility and personal development are in focus. The team has extensive experience with employing interns and has, over time, had more than 20 interns. Several of the former interns are still employed at Kamstrup. Did you know? We are all interested in technology and go on team events where we have, among other things, had guided tours of the parking garage beneath Dokk1 in Aarhus, the robotic warehouse at Proshop, and the waste incineration plant in Lisbjerg. Less About Us, More About You We are looking for an enthusiastic student who is eager to apply up-to-date theoretical knowledge and contribute to the development of wireless technologies at Kamstrup. During the internship, you will collaborate with the team on a variety of tasks and technical areas, including some you may not have encountered before in your studies. Therefore, a can-do attitude and a willingness to learn are important to us. Of course, we will support and guide you throughout the process. In order to succeed, we imagine that you: Are currently studying Electronics, Software Technology or a related degree Have a professional interest in, particularly, electronics, mathematics, communication theory, and software development Are thorough and structured and are excited by seeing your ideas become reality Can work independently and possess a critical mindset with the aim of finding the best solution Value collaboration and proactively seek professional sparring with your colleagues on your own initiative As we are an international organisation it is important that you are fluent in English and Danish. Isomorphic Labs is applying frontier AI to help unlock deeper scientific insights, faster breakthroughs, and life-changing medicines with an ambition to solve all disease.
 The future is coming. A future enabled and enriched by the incredible power of machine learning. A future in which diseases are curtailed or cured starting with better and faster drug discovery. 
 Come and be part of an interdisciplinary team driving groundbreaking innovation and play a meaningful role in contributing towards us achieving our ambitious goals, while being a part of an inspiring and collaborative culture.
 The world we want tomorrow is the one we’re building today. It starts with the culture at this company. It starts with you.

 Isomorphic Labs (IsoLabs) was launched in 2021 to advance human health by building on and beyond the Nobel-winning AlphaFold system. Since then, our interdisciplinary team of drug discovery experts and machine learning specialists has built powerful new predictive and generative AI models that accelerate scientific discovery at digital speed.
 Our name comes from the belief that there is an underlying symmetry between biology and information science. By harnessing AI’s powerful capabilities, we can use it to model complex biological phenomena to help design novel molecules, anticipate how drugs will perform and develop innovative medicines to treat and cure some of the world’s most devastating diseases.

 Every day, and with each new breakthrough, we’re getting closer to the promise of digital biology, and achieving our ambitious mission to one day solve all disease with the help of AI.

You’ll prepare, present and gain agreement on proposals among stakeholders and then influence teams to execute - leveraging strong communication skills. You’ll follow up, problem-solve, close loops in a timely fashion and drive initiatives to completion.

items.desc:
MEET DEEPL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.




WHAT SETS US APART

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/deepl/,Instagram https://www.instagram.com/deepl_official/, and our Blog https://www.deepl.com/en/blog.



MEET THE TEAM BEHIND THIS JOURNEY

DeepL is not just a translation tool; we are building the Operating System for Global Communication. We are the rare AI company that builds the entire stack in-house: from training next-gen LLMs on our own NVIDIA DGX SuperPODs to delivering real-time Language AI to over 300 million users and 200,000+ businesses globally.


The Identity and Access Management team owns DeepL's full identity stack: organisation, group, account, consent and session management, SSO federation, SCIM provisioning, and the OIDC provider, for both internal and external users. It is the foundation every DeepL product relies on to authenticate and authorise users securely and at scale. When identity is unavailable, no one can log in, so reliability and performance sit at the heart of everything the team does.


We don't hire engineers to simply maintain legacy endpoints or close Jira tickets. We hire Missionaries who understand that a perfect AI model is useless if a Global Enterprise can't provision it securely to 50,000 employees. You will contribute across the Identity services, shipping features that create delightful, frictionless experiences for both external customers and internal engineering teams.




YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Ship Features, Not Just Code: You will build well-scoped features from first commit to production. You won't just write functions in isolation; you will check that your code solves the actual user problem, works in production, and is covered by solid tests.

You will take part in code reviews and design discussions, and follow and help improve our shared standards. You ask for help early, and you speak up with questions or ideas when you think there is a better way.

 - Leverage Modern Tooling: You will use AI-assisted tools (like Copilot and Claude) to handle boilerplate and refactoring, allowing you to focus on logic and product value. We value engineers who use the best tools to ship faster.

 - Build for Quality: You will write well-tested, production-ready code that your team (and your future self) will thank you for. You understand that "speed" doesn't mean "sloppy"—it means building reliable software that doesn't break at 2am. You will participate in incident response, learn from postmortems, and help the team raise the bar on code quality and operational health.
   


QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR

 - Ownership and Reliability: You take responsibility for what you ship. You write tests, monitor your code in production, and follow through when things go wrong. You're proactive about flagging issues and asking for help when you need it, and you treat each incident as an opportunity to learn.

 - Strong Engineering Fundamentals: You have a solid grasp of data structures, algorithms, and clean coding principles. You can take a complex logic problem and break it down into small, solvable pieces. You are curious about what it takes to build and operate reliable, high throughput services, and keen to learn this hands-on.

Vi søger derfor en Data Scientist, der kan hjælpe os med at bringe forskellige datakilder sammen og omsætte dem til ny viden, konkrete indsigter og dataprodukter, som kan bruges af vores kunder
items.desc: I HOFOR har vi store mængder data fra vores drift, kunder, forbrug og rapportering. Data, der hver for sig fortæller noget, men som kan skabe langt større værdi, når vi kobler dem, analyserer dem og bringer dem i anvendelse. Vi søger derfor en Data Scientist, der kan hjælpe os med at bringe forskellige datakilder sammen og omsætte dem til ny viden, konkrete indsigter og dataprodukter, som kan bruges af vores kunder og interne samarbejdspartnere. Skab indsigt i kundernes adfærd og forbrug Du bliver en del af Kundeområdet og får en central rolle i at skabe mere værdi af de mange data, vi allerede har. Vi arbejder med store mængder drifts-, kunde-, forbrugs- og rapporteringsdata og ser et stort potentiale i at kombinere dem på nye måder. Du skal være med til at udvikle nye og bedre dataprodukter, der gør data anvendelige for andre. Det kan være indsigter og løsninger, der giver vores kunder en bedre forståelse af deres forbrug og kan bidrage til mindre forbrug af vand og varme. Dine primære opgaver vil blandt andet være at: Kombinere og analysere data fra forskellige datakilder Identificere mønstre, sammenhænge og nye anvendelsesmuligheder i data Udvikle analyser, modeller og dataprodukter, der omsætter data til viden og handling Skabe ny viden om forbrug og forbrugeradfærd, som kan bidrage til mindre forbrug Udvikle analyser, visualiseringer og dashboards i Power BI Samarbejde tæt med dataeksperter, IT og faglige miljøer på tværs af HOFOR om at bringe data i anvendelse Skarp analytiker med interesse for mennesker, kunder og data Du kan have flere indgange til rollen. Måske er du uddannet inden for datascience, statistik, økonomi, matematik, sociologi eller et lignende område. Du har gode analytiske evner og er ikke kun optaget af at analysere og rapportere, men også af hvordan data kan omsættes til viden og løsninger, som andre kan bruge. Du er nysgerrig og går gerne bag om tallene, udfordrer antagelser og søger efter forklaringer og nye løsninger. Samtidig kan du bevæge dig mellem det tekniske og det forretningsmæssige og er nysgerrig på de behov, som kunder, kolleger og HOFORs forskellige forsyninger har. Vi forestiller os, at du: Har relevant erhvervserfaring fra en Data Scientist-rolle eller en tilsvarende datafaglig funktion Har praktisk erfaring med data og kan tage en opgave fra rå data og forskellige datakilder til en analyse, model eller et dataprodukt, som andre kan anvende Har erfaring med kvantitativ analyse og databehandling Har erfaring med Python og SQL Power BI (udvikling og drift) Kan formidle komplekse analyser på en enkel og forståelig måde Er god til at skabe relationer Det er en fordel, hvis du har kendskab til SAP, Microsoft 365-platformen eller lignende datakilder Dine dygtige kolleger er klar til at byde dig velkommen Du bliver en del af Kundeløsninger og får dygtige og engagerede kolleger omkring dig. Vi kombinerer høj faglighed med et godt kollegialt fællesskab, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og deler viden på tværs af organisationen. Vi har et fleksibelt arbejdsmiljø og giver plads og mulighed for hjemmearbejde. Hos os er der plads til dig og til, at du har et bæredygtigt arbejdsliv. Du kan læse mere om vores medarbejdergoder her. Sådan bliver du vores kollega Er du klar til nye muligheder, så ser vi frem til at høre fra dig senest den 20. november 2026. Vi vil gerne gøre det nemt for dig at søge vores stilling. Du skal derfor ikke skrive en ansøgning, men blot sende dit CV, hvor du sætter nogle ord på din motivation for at søge stillingen. Du kan finde inspiration til at skrive et motiveret CV her. Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler og afslutter rekrutteringsprocessen, når den rette kandidat er fundet. Har du spørgsmål til jobbet, er du velkommen til at kontakte områdechef Ditte Bergholdt Asmussen på tlf. 3445 8350 eller mail: ditasm@hofor.dk. Søg stillingen ved at klikke på "Søg stillingen".

items.desc: 6G ISAC : Étude et évaluation d'algorithmes de détection et de localisation par signaux OFDM Quel sera votre environnement ? Vous intégrerez l’équipe de recherche et développement de l’activité Réseaux et Connectivité de b<>com, dont l’expertise est reconnue dans le domaine des réseaux d’accès radio. Au sein de cette équipe pluridisciplinaire, l’encadrement sera assuré par des ingénieurs expérimentés spécialisés dans le développement de systèmes embarqués télécom critiques, avec qui vous interagirez au quotidien. Quelle sera votre mission ? Dans le cadre de ses activités de recherche sur les réseaux mobiles de nouvelle génération (6G), b<>com mène des travaux sur les technologies ISAC (Integrated Sensing and Communication), qui visent à exploiter les signaux radio à la fois pour les communications et pour la détection, la localisation et le suivi d'objets dans l'environnement. L'objectif de ce stage est d'étudier les techniques de sensing radio reposant sur les signaux OFDM, notamment ceux utilisés dans les systèmes 5G, et d'évaluer leur potentiel pour des applications de détection et de suivi de cibles mobiles, telles que les drones. Les travaux porteront principalement sur l'analyse de l'état de l'art des algorithmes de sensing basés sur OFDM, ainsi que sur l'identification des principaux verrous scientifiques et technologiques associés : détection de cibles à faible signature radar, gestion des trajets multiples et des interférences, estimation des paramètres de distance et de vitesse, compensation des effets liés à la mobilité ou encore exploitation de mesures issues de plusieurs émetteurs et récepteurs dans des configurations multistatiques. Vos principales missions seront les suivantes : Réaliser un état de l'art des approches de sensing radio basées sur OFDM, en particulier dans le contexte des systèmes 5G NR et des futurs réseaux 6G Identifier et analyser les principaux défis algorithmiques liés à la détection, à la localisation et au suivi de cibles mobiles, notamment dans des configurations bistatiques ou multistatiques Étudier et comparer les solutions proposées dans la littérature pour répondre à ces défis, en considérant leurs performances, leur complexité et leurs conditions d'application Implémenter et évaluer par simulation une sélection d'algorithmes représentatifs, afin d'en caractériser les performances dans différents scénarios de propagation et de mobilité Identifier les pistes d'amélioration et les perspectives d'expérimentation sur les plateformes radio logicielles (SDR) de b<>com Ce stage vous permettra de contribuer à des travaux de recherche appliquée à la croisée du traitement du signal, des communications sans fil et des technologies 6G, au sein d'une équipe spécialisée dans le développement et le prototypage de solutions radio avancées. items.desc: DESCRIPTIF DU POSTE L’employeur Le CASD est un groupement d’intérêt public composé de six membres : le GENES, l’INSEE, le CNRS, HEC Paris, l’École Polytechnique et La Banque de France. Son siège social est situé sur le campus de Saclay, au 5 avenue Henry le Chatelier à Palaiseau. L’essentiel de son activité est réalisé dans les locaux de son établissement secondaire, situé au 76 avenue Pierre Brossolette à Malakoff, où sont localisées les équipes. Le CASD a pour objet principal d’organiser et de mettre en œuvre des services d’accès sécurisé pour les données confidentielles à des fins non lucratives de recherche, d’étude, d’évaluation ou d’innovation, activités qualifiées de « services à la recherche », principalement publiques. Il a également pour mission de valoriser la technologie développée pour sécuriser l’accès aux données dans le secteur privé notamment. Le CASD permet aux utilisateurs dûment habilités (chercheurs, Data Scientists, consultants, etc.) de traiter à distance, via des terminaux dédiés (les « SD-Box ») déployés sur leur lieu de travail habituel, les données confidentielles produites notamment par l’INSEE et la statistique publique, avec des moyens de calcul puissants, et dans le plus strict respect de la législation et des règles de sécurité. Outre les données socio-économiques et de la statistique publique, le CASD met à disposition des utilisateurs habilités des sources issues du domaine de la santé. A cet égard, le CASD met en œuvre une politique de suivi de la qualité et de la sécurité du dispositif déployé et de son mode de fonctionnement : il est certifié conforme aux référentiels ISO 27001 (management de la sécurité de l’information), ISO 27701 (management de la protection de la vie privée), HDS (Hébergeur de Données de Santé), Europrivacy (label européen de protection des données au sens de l'Art. 42 du RGPD) ; il est homologué au référentiel de sécurité du Système National des Données de Santé (SNDS) et conforme au code de bonnes pratiques de la statistique européenne ; enfin, il s’est engagé dans une démarche de mise en conformité avec les exigences de la norme ISO 9001 (management de la qualité). Le CASD est composé de 42 collaborateurs répartis en 3 services : le Service Project Management, le Service IT et Data Science, et le Service Data Management. Outre ses collaborateurs recrutés en propre sur contrat de droit privé, dont certains sont des fonctionnaires en détachement, le CASD dispose de personnel mis à disposition par les membres du GIP. Poste et missions Au sein du service ITDS, et sous la supervision du Responsable du pôle Data Science, le/la titulaire du poste partagera son temps de travail selon les missions suivantes : · Conception, implémentation et exploitation des infrastructures Data Science (big data et Intelligence Artificielle) · Conception, implémentation et suivi de projets métiers du service tels que la gestion de la confidentialité des imports/exports de résultats, l’analyse des sessions utilisateurs pour détection de comportement suspect · Maintenance adaptative, corrective et évolutive des outils de gestion de métadonnées, contrôle de qualité, et d’analyse et visualisation des données développés au sein du service · Conseil et support utilisateur avancé sur l’utilisation d’outils de Data Science au sein de l’environnement sécurisé (comme Spark, LLMs, Torch et DuckDB) · Conception, implémentation et exploitation d’une plateforme Data Science orientée cloud. Participer à la surveillance, l’optimisation des performances et le maintien à l’état de l’art de la plateforme · Potentielle participation à la construction d'infrastructures européennes L’infrastructure informatique du CASD repose sur des serveurs d’application sécurisés hébergés dans deux datacenters certifiés, accessibles uniquement via un ensemble de boitiers informatiques d’accès dédiés appelés « SD-Box » installés dans les organismes partenaires. Ce dispositif permet aux utilisateurs extérieurs de travailler à distance sur les données confidentielles, dans de très bonnes conditions et avec des moyens de calcul puissants, sans que ces données individuelles ne sortent jamais des serveurs sécurisés. L’infrastructure informatique du CASD est par conséquent caractérisée par un besoin important en matière de sécurité et de puissance de calcul. Cette infrastructure est en constante évolution et nécessite de nombreux développements pour se maintenir à l’état de l’art en termes de sécurité tout en permettant de fortes performances à un nombre croissant d’utilisateurs. Le/la titulaire du poste participera au développement de l’infrastructure sur ses composants plus spécifiquement requis pour les projets datascience : GPGPUs, cluster de calcul, plateforme de qualification de modèle ajusté (fine-tuning). Le CASD étant une structure en forte croissance, aussi bien en termes de projets utilisateurs, de développement de son activité, que de données accueillies, le périmètre du poste est susceptible …

items.card: Service à compétence nationale et directement rattachée au Ministre des armées, l'Agence Ministérielle pour l’Intelligence Artificielle de Défense (AMIAD) est responsable de la mise en œuvre de la politique ministérielle en matière d'IA. Nous travaillons en collaboration avec toutes les entités du Ministère et sur de nombreux domaines d'activité (systèmes d’armes, opérations, renseignement, commandement, soutien et
items.desc: Service à compétence nationale et directement rattachée au Ministre des armées, l'Agence Ministérielle pour l’Intelligence Artificielle de Défense (AMIAD) est responsable de la mise en œuvre de la politique ministérielle en matière d'IA. Nous travaillons en collaboration avec toutes les entités du Ministère et sur de nombreux domaines d'activité (systèmes d’armes, opérations, renseignement, commandement, soutien et administration) D'ici 2027, nous nous appuierons sur plus de 300 collaborateurs, principalement au sein du pôle technique situé à Bruz, près de Rennes, mais également au sein du campus de l’Ecole Polytechnique pour les activités de recherche académique. Vous souhaitez donner du sens à votre activité ? Vous avez à cœur de contribuer à la montée en puissance de l’activité IA ministérielle et à la souveraineté de la France dans le domaine de l’IA pour soutenir les forces armées ? Vous recherchez un environnement de travail stimulant et innovant ? Alors postulez et rejoignez l’AMIAD, l’Agence Ministérielle pour l’IA de Défense. Les capacités de calcul des systèmes embarqués permettent désormais de déployer des modèles d'IA de plus en plus ambitieux en termes de complexité d'architecture et d'empreinte mémoire. Les modèles embarqués ne se limitent plus au traitement du signal : des modèles génératifs, agentiques ou de fondation sont déployés au plus proche capteur pour rendre des services de plus haut niveau. Dans certains secteurs critiques tels que l'industrie et la défense, un modèle d'IA peut révéler de nombreuses informations stratégiques si des compétiteurs sont en mesure de le récupérer et de l'analyser. Il est notamment possible de déterminer le domaine d'emploi, la performance du modèle, les données utilisées pour l'entraînement ou comment modifier les entrées pour leurrer et induire les résultats en erreur. Plusieurs approches existent pour protéger un modèle d'IA, notamment en chiffrant le modèle dans une enclave et en le déchiffrant avant son chargement dans la mémoire physique. Cependant, le modèle est présent en clair sur l'architecture de calcul pendant le temps d'inférence, ce qui le rend accessible par une attaque numérique ou physique. Une autre approche est de chiffrer les poids du modèle en utilisant une fonction mathématique permettant d'effectuer l'exécution sans effectuer de déchiffrement : l'inférence s'exécute donc directement sur le produit chiffré. Cette méthode introduit cependant un surcoût à l'exécution, la méthode de chiffrement ajoutant de la complexité calculatoire par rapport au modèle en clair. Ce surcoût en performance peut rendre le modèle inutilisable dans un contexte embarqué, pour lequel les ressources de calcul sont dimensionnées au plus juste et les applicatifs nécessitent des traitements basse-latence, voire temps-réel. Missions principales : L'objectif de ce stage est d'explorer les compromis entre la performance d'un modèle d'IA requise par l'applicatif et l'application de mécanismes de protection du modèle dans un contexte d'emploi potentiellement sensible. Les travaux pourront inclure : Des approches de protection partielle du modèle, Une méthodologie pour évaluer les performances et construire plusieurs compromis performance-protection Une stratégie pour déployer dynamiquement la variante d'un modèle la plus adaptée au contexte opérationnel (besoin de performance vs exposition au risque adverse). La technologie de chiffrement du modèle d'IA est fournie pour réaliser ce stage. Un cas d'usage issu d'un projet structurant du Ministère des Armées reposant sur l'IA et la robotique sera identifié afin de construire les hypothèses de travail et de valider les approches proposées. Ce stage s’adresse à un(e) étudiant(e) en dernière année d’école d’ingénieur/master informatique, avec un profil orienté Intelligence Artificielle et en recherche opérationnelle. Ce stage nécessite la maîtrise du langage Python et des techniques d’aides à la programmation par IA. Un intérêt pour la recherche est également souhaité. Stage de 6 mois, à partir de février 2027. Nos avantages En rejoignant le ministère des Armées, vous accédez à de nombreux avantages : Restauration collective sur place avec contribution employeur ; protection sociale complémentaire ; Deux lignes de bus STAR (80 et 90) desservent le site ; Stationnement sur le site ; Prestations sociales, culturelles, de loisirs et de tourisme : rendez-vous sur le site www.igesa.fr

items.desc: Group Audit Data Science Intern At a glance Would you like to use data science to investigate real questions about risk, controls and banking processes? During this six-month internship, you will develop a data-science project from initial research question to analysis and results. You will work as part of the Group Audit Data Analytics team and receive guidance from experienced data scientists throughout the internship. The purpose of Group Audit is “ being the messenger that makes the better bank ”. A main part of our purpose is achieved by executing audits. Audits are short research projects, executed within one and a half to three months. These projects have three phases, preparation and orientation, fieldwork, and reporting. Group Audit helps the bank understand whether important processes and controls work as intended and comply with internal policies and external requirements. Our Data Analytics team uses data science techniques to help auditors identify patterns, risks and areas that merit further investigation. Your job During your internship period, you will be treated as a colleague of the Data Analytics Department of Group Audit. In addition, you will be responsible for the set-up and execution of a Data Science project. With support from the team, you will: Translate the (research) objectives of an audit into a data science project. Explore, prepare, and engineer the required data for the analysis. Setup a data science project in Databricks. Discuss your approach and findings with data scientists and audit colleagues; Communicate your results clearly, including uncertainties and limitations; Contribute ideas and ask questions throughout the project. By doing so you will learn what it is like to support auditors in their risk-based audit approach in a highly complex environment. You will work with experienced data scientists and data analysts. Therefore, you do not need previous experience in banking or audit. You will have a named supervisor and a regular check-in to discuss progress, questions and learning goals. If you are interested and (more importantly) there is time, you are more than welcome to participate in supporting an audit with Data Analytics. We have a couple of projects available: Developing a network-analysis approach to identify relevant connections or patterns. Evaluating and improving an existing similarity-analysis method. We will agree on the final project based on current audit needs, available data and your learning objectives. Your profile You are pursuing a Master Level degree in a field that includes data-science methods. You are looking for opportunities to learn new things, and topics. You can analyse an unfamiliar (research) question, identify what is most relevant, and discuss appropriate next steps with the team. You enjoy collaborating with people from different professional backgrounds and are willing to share your ideas, listen to others and ask for input when needed. You can communicate your questions, approach and findings clearly in English. You have experience with Python, SQL, Databricks, network analysis or similarity methods. You are available to start in December, we are happy to discuss the exact starting date with you. You are enrolled at a Dutch university/higher level education for the entire duration of your internship. are available for approximately six months, ideally for 36 hours per week. If your university programme requires a different arrangement, we encourage you to discuss this with us. What we offer An internship allowance of €750 per month, based on a 36-hour work week. A work laptop to support your development and daily tasks. A hybrid working environment, and flexibility to coordinate work with university classes and projects. An informal and multicultural environment among top professionals. Membership in the Young ABN AMRO Community, giving you access to social events, networking opportunities, workshops, and activities to help you integrate into the bank and connect with other young professionals and interns. And not to forget, a fantastic team. Interested Working at ABN AMRO means working on projects that matter. And for that, we need people who can make a difference. People like you! Interested but unsure whether you meet every point? We encourage you to apply. We are interested in your potential, your motivation to learn and the perspective you would bring to the team. Please send your CV and a motivation letter in English explaining your interest in this internship. Please also provide your learning goals and availability. Questions are welcome at it.stages@nl.abnamro.com.

items.desc: Som AI-affärsutvecklare hos B3 Cloud får du hjälpa våra kunder att identifiera möjligheter, utveckla arbetssätt och skapa konkret värde med AI. Du kombinerar teknisk kompetens med verksamhetsförståelse och ett starkt driv att ta idéer vidare till lösningar som gör skillnad. Du arbetar nära kundernas verksamheter för att förstå deras behov, kartlägga processer och identifiera var AI kan skapa störst nytta. Det kan handla om att effektivisera arbetsflöden, automatisera återkommande uppgifter eller utveckla helt nya sätt att arbeta. Du har förmågan att bedöma när AI är rätt lösning och när andra förändringar behövs för att nå önskat resultat. I rollen leder du workshops, inspirerar och vägleder kunder i deras AI-utveckling. Med din tekniska bakgrund kan du själv utforska, testa och demonstrera AI-lösningar, exempelvis AI-agenter, automatiserade flöden och lösningar med generativ AI. En viktig del av rollen är också att driva affären framåt. Du bygger och utvecklar kundrelationer, identifierar nya affärsmöjligheter och deltar aktivt i säljdialoger. Genom att kombinera din tekniska förståelse med ett affärsmässigt perspektiv hjälper du kunder att se möjligheterna med AI och omsätta dem till konkreta initiativ och uppdrag. Vi tror att du är nyfiken, initiativrik och handlingskraftig. Du har lätt för att skapa förtroende och bygga långsiktiga relationer, samtidigt som du drivs av att identifiera nya möjligheter och utveckla affärer. Du trivs i mötet mellan teknik, människor och affärer och tar gärna initiativ till att driva idéer framåt. Vi söker dig som: har minst 5 års erfarenhet av verksamhetsnära IT-utveckling, där du har arbetat med att identifiera behov, utveckla arbetssätt och omsätta idéer till tekniska lösningar. har praktisk erfarenhet av AI-utveckling och förmåga att självständigt ta fram prototyper samt testa och demonstrera AI-baserade lösningar. har god teknisk förståelse för generativ AI, stora språkmodeller (LLM), AI-agenter och automatisering. har erfarenhet av Microsofts ekosystem , exempelvis Copilot Studio, Power Platform eller Azure AI-tjänster. är van vid att kartlägga processer, identifiera verksamhetsbehov och omsätta dem till konkreta förbättringsförslag. har god förståelse för integrationer, API och automatiserade arbetsflöden. kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska i tal och skrift, då det krävs i det dagliga arbetet. Meriterande: Konsultvana , med erfarenhet av kunddialog och att omsätta verksamhetens behov till tekniska lösningar. Erfarenhet av att leda workshops, hålla utbildningar eller inspirera kunder kring AI och digitalisering. Vilka är vi? Vi är B3 Cloud, ett härligt gäng med specialistkunskaper inom molntjänster utspridda i Göteborg och Stockholm. Vi tror på att dela kunskap, stötta varandra och ständigt utvecklas tillsammans – både som team och som individer. Som en del av B3 Consulting Group har vi resurser, kompetens och stöd i ryggen samtidigt som vi bibehåller dynamik och flexibilitet med korta beslutsvägar. Vi är stolt över att vara del av en verksamhet som präglas av inkludering och en strävan efter att ha en positiv påverkan på samhället, människor och miljön. Vi värdesätter olikheter och erfarenheter och arbetar kontinuerligt med inkludering och kultur för samarbete och respekt. Vi erbjuder: Frihet och flexibilitet att påverka din utveckling, arbetstider och uppdrag Kompetensutveckling genom utbildningar, certifieringar och lunchföreläsningar Konkurrenskraftig lönemodell och en otroligt flexibel samt förmånlig RAM modell. En givande företagskultur med konferensresor, AW:s och wellness-aktiviteter Vår ambition inom AI På B3 Cloud bygger vi nu upp flera starka erbjudande inom AI, med utgångspunkt i det vi redan kan väl: molnet, Microsofts plattformar och nära samarbete med kundernas verksamheter. Som AI-affärsutvecklare blir du en central del av den här satsningen. Du får möjlighet att påverka hur vårt AI-erbjudande växer, vilka områden vi satsar på och hur vi arbetar framåt. Här finns utrymme att testa nya idéer, dela kunskap med kollegor i hela B3 och bygga något tillsammans från tidigt skede.

items.desc: About the job We are expanding our R&D team within our Cellular IoT units and the digital group is looking to recruit a junior SoC Verification Engineer. In this position you will be involved in the development of Nordic Semiconductor's next generation of world-leading ultra-low power chips, with focus on RTL design, IP integration and verification. We are also embracing AI-driven methodologies to increase verification efficiency, coverage closure and quality. Nordic's digital designers have expertise in various low-power short- and long-range wireless standards and low-power microcontrollers. Using cutting-edge design techniques to achieve high performance at extremely low power is of paramount importance. We operate as focused individuals on highly specialized projects, and come together as a cohesive team, in which our skill-sets, passions and expertise feed into our enhanced collective excellence. Key responsibilities SoC/IP subsystem verification planning, test infrastructure development, functional verification. Embedded C code or writing CPU-centric tests using C code. Coverage definition, implementation and analysis. Test bench and test case generation using Verilog, SystemVerilog & UVM. Reading, understanding and debugging RTL written in HDLs (Verilog, SystemVerilog) and root-cause analysis. Applying AI based tools and techniques to improve verification productivity, e.g. AI-assisted test and testbench generation, intelligent regression management, automated failure triage and accelerated coverage closure. Key Qualifications MSc in electrical engineering or equivalent, or Bachelor with industrial experience. Strong knowledge of coverage-based verification, assertion-based, and formal verification techniques. Solid working knowledge of HDLs such as Verilog, SystemVerilog and/or VHDL, including SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA). Good debugging skills. Programming background in low-level and script-based languages, e.g. C, C++, Python, Perl is a plus. Interest in, or experience with, using AI tools (e.g. LLM-based coding assistants) in the verification workflow. Fluent English language skills (written and oral). Personal Skills We are looking for a team-oriented colleague with good collaboration skills and the ability to work autonomously. You have good methodical and problem solving skills, you enjoy new tasks and are excited by the opportunity to make a difference. We hope that you are curious to learn, eager to try out new things (including emerging AI technologies), and continuously improve, while acknowledging that failure is an important part of learning. Working for Nordic Working at Nordic, you will be inspired and supported to develop yourself. Our teams enjoy a professional and informal working environment. We value and encourage the continuous development of skills and expertise to the highest levels. We are proud of our Norwegian heritage, our highly skilled international workforce, and our world-leading innovation. We offer a variety of tasks and projects, and the possibility to work alongside some of the world’s most renowned experts within their field. We encourage our employees to question the established and innovate while expecting professionalism, commitment, and the will to learn. Benefits Competitive salary with bonus plan (Short term incentive + Long term incentive) Insurance plan Regular Finnish annual vacation + Paid year end break (24th-31st Dec) Flexible working hours Family friendly policies Employees' sports and social club, multiple social activities throughout the year Practical details Location: Tampere, Finland Please note that this position might be subject to a background check.

items.desc: L'offre en un coup d'oeil L'unité Centre de Recherche En Acquisition et Traitement de l'Image pour la Santé Type de Contrat IT en contrat CDD Temps de Travail Complet Lieu de Travail 69621 VILLEURBANNE Durée du contrat 6 mois Date d'Embauche 04/01/2027 Rémuneration à partir de 3175 euros bruts mensuels selon expérience Date limite de candidature : mercredi 25 novembre 2026 23:59 Description du Poste Les Missions Le projet PRODROM-ND vise à développer des outils pour l’analyse de données multimodales (imagerie, données cliniques, omiques) des formes prodromiques (c’est-à-dire précédent l’apparition des symptômes de la maladie) de différentes maladies neurodégénératives. L’un des axes de travail du projet concerne le développement de modèles par apprentissage profond pour la détection de biomarqueurs d’imagerie sensibles aux signaux faibles associés aux formes prodromiques, en particulier la présence d’anomalies subtiles dans les données d’imagerie. L’objectif est de dresser un état de l’art des modèles de détection d’anomalies non supervisés (UAD pour Unsupervised Anomaly Detection) pour la neuroimagerie, définir un cadre d’évaluation standardisé et reproductibles de ces méthodes pour différentes maladies neurodégénératives, adapter les modèles existants, si besoin, aux spécificités de la problématique clinique et obtenir une première évaluation des performances de ces modèles qui servira ensuite de base pour le développement de modèles plus robustes et sensibles aux anomalies subtiles caractéristiques des stades précoces de ces pathologies. L’équipe MYRIAD du laboratoire CREATIS a développé une expertise forte en modèle UAD pour la neuoirmagerie et développé plusieurs modèles originaux Dans ce contexte la mission de la personne recrutée s’organisera autour de quatre axes principaux. Prendre en main les modèles d’UAD développés au laboratoire CREATIS et les regrouper dans une librairie de code unifiée. Sélectionner les modèles d’UAD pour la neuoimagerie les plus pertinents de la littérature et les intégrer à la librairie de code UAD Adapter les modèles UAD aux spécificités des données de neuroimagerie (aspect tridimensionnel, apprentissage de représentations dédiées, prise en compte de données cross-sectionnelles ...) Elaborer, en collaboration avec les autres partenaires du projet PRODROM-NN, une étude de comparaison des performances des différents modèles d’UAD de l’état de l’art et/ou développés par les différents partenaires dans des conditions expérimentales fixées et reproductibles. Ce travail nécessitera de centraliser quelques bases de données publiques et de définir des métriques de performance adaptées aux spécificités des anomalies neurodégénératives prodromales. L'Activité Effectuer une analyse de la bibliographie scientifique afin de dresser l’état de l’art des modèles UAD les plus performants en neuroimagerie. Développer la librairie de modèles UAD en unifiant les codes disponibles des différents modèles du laboratoire et de la littérature. Proposer des stratégies d’adaptation des modèles développés aux spécificité des données de neuroimagerie. Evaluer la faisabilité technique et calculatoire. Mettre en place un benchmark sur des cohortes publiques multi-sites de maladies neurodégénératives incluant des données précoces. Contribuer à la vie académique du groupe et du projet PRODROM-ND en participant et en faisant des présentations lors de séminaires, de clubs de lecture, de réunions. Contribuer à la diffusion des résultats de recherche par des publications scientifiques et la mise à disposition d'outils en libre accès Votre Profil Compétences Formation en informatique avec une spécialisation en traitement de données de neuroimagerie. Maîtrise de Python et des librairies de deep learning comme PyTorch ou TensforFlow Maîtrise de Git et des pratiques de développement collaboratif. Expérience en développement de modèles UAD pour la neuroimagerie Capacité à analyser la littérature, à évaluer des outils disponibles et à les transformer en solutions utilisables par une équipe de recherche. Rigueur, autonomie, qualité de documentation et aptitude à travailler avec chercheur·ses, ingénieur·es et doctorant·es dans un contexte multidisciplinaire Une présélection sera réalisée sur la base du CV, de l’expérience, des compétences et de la lettre de motivation. Les candidats présélectionnés seront convoqués pour une audition. Les candidatures doivent comprendre les documents suivants : Un Curriculum Vitae complet, Une lettre de motivation, exposant les intérêts de recherche du candidat en lien avec le projet, Le contact d'une ou deux personnes référentes, Si possible, une ou deux lettres de recommandation, Les relevés de notes de Master (M1 et M2) ou équivalent, ainsi que tout certificat pertinent. items.desc: We are a growing SaaS start-up with an international team, operating on the intersection between two of the world's most fascinating industries - global shipping and global travel. Over 90% of global trade depends on ships, and the shipping industry depends on the 2 million seafarers who operate them. What most people don't know is there's a complex, mission-critical travel operation going on 24/7 to bring seafarers to the ships where they're needed, when they're needed. That's called crew logistics, and without it, global trade wouldn't function. But it's an operation often built on manual processes and legacy systems, meaning high-stress for operators, an unreliable experience for seafarers, and poor outcomes for the industry. That is until Tilla enters the scene. Backed by strong investor support, with more than 10,000 crew changes executed in the platform each year across over 600 vessels globally, our platform is a game changer in crew logistics, streamlining collaboration between operators and seafarers, making crew operations more humane, efficient, and cost-effective. Join us on the next chapter of our growth journey and tackle this overlooked yet critical global challenge: every crew change, optimized and digital. Your mission Build and maintain the Travel services that get seafarers onto the right flights, shipping well-tested features across our TypeScript stack as part of the Travel team. You'll start by taking pressure off the team by solving bugs, serving customer requests and leading investigations, and progress into owning Travel services of your own. Keeping travel operations dependable / by resolving bugs and customer requests quickly and properly Investigating and fixing bugs across the Travel services, reproducing each scenario before changing any code Handling day-to-day technical requests from customers and colleagues, and explaining what went wrong in plain terms Adding logging and metrics to what you build, and following runbooks when alerts fire Unlocking the product roadmap / by shipping well-defined features end to end Building features across the frontend (React, Next.js) and backend (NestJS, GraphQL, Prisma) in Linear sprints Breaking work into clear steps, surfacing assumptions early, getting feedback on technical decisions and keeping progress and blockers visible Writing unit and integration tests, and acting on code review feedback Building depth in a sensitive domain / by growing into ownership of Travel services Learning how flight bookings, fares and travel aggregation work, and how they connect to crew changes Taking ownership of a Travel service module over time, including its uptime, bug rates and resolution times Sharing what you learn through clear pull request descriptions and team documentation You should have Experience: early-career professional experience as a software engineer, building web applications across both frontend and backend. Experience: working knowledge of TypeScript and React, and some exposure to Node.js backends. Familiarity with any of Next.js, NestJS, GraphQL, Prisma, Apollo Client, React Query, ShadCN, AWS (Lambda, SQS, RDS, ECS), Jest or Playwright is useful; we don't expect all of it. Experience: exposure to GDS systems (like Amadeus) or travel aggregator platforms is a plus. A high degree of ownership: you take a task from ticket to production and see it through. Sound engineering fundamentals: readable code, sensible tests, and systematic debugging. Technical depth and curiosity: you want to understand how the wider system works, not only the part in front of you. A genuine interest in travel and flight booking, and a willingness to learn the industry in depth. The ability to explain technical issues simply to customers and non-technical colleagues. Clear, proactive communication about progress, risks and blockers. A collaborative approach: you work well with other engineers, ask for help when it's the quicker route, and act on feedback. Experience or interest in early-stage or growth-stage startups. Fluency in English. Other languages are a plus. Based in EMEA or LATAM, with good working-hours overlap with the rest of the Travel team. Why Join Us? Tackle a unique industry challenge with global impact Be part of an international, mission-oriented, supportive and fun team Do your best work, with leading-edge AI tools for all team members Benefit from support and budget for your learning and development We believe that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success at Tilla. We make hiring decisions based on your experience and skills. Therefore, we welcome applications from all members of society, regardless of age, gender, disability, sexual orientation, race, religion or belief.

EDG offers the opportunity to work on innovative technologies, solve complex technical challenges, and contribute directly to product quality and continuous improvement. Position overview We are looking for an enthusiastic Product Development Engineer to become part of our Edge Devices Group (EDG), for the team in charge of Non-Volatile Memory (NVM) technical customer support. Collaborate with cross-functional teams in the development of DFMEA (Design Failure Mode Effect Analysis), DFT (Design For Testability), DFM (Design For Manufacturability) deliverables. Continuously improve product quality and reliability through test development and use of Generative AI. Develop and maintain a strong understanding of product functionality. Support the development of software and hardware tools, leveraging AI automation. Build collaborative relationships with Design, Validation and Firmware Teams. Work with Quality Assurance teams on customer returns to establish root cause and corrective action. Collaborate with the marketing application engineering team to manage application notes, risk assessment, and datasheet errata. Preferred Qualifications Experience with memory technology such as NAND, SSD, eMMC, UFS. Familiarity with Linux environments and AI scripting (Claude Code, Python). Fundamental understanding of quality tools (8D, root cause analysis).
