items.desc: The company Belenos Clean Power Holding AG is a spin-off of the Swatch Group AG. Our goal is to pave the way for the industrialization of a new type of high energy density Lithium ion battery, which offers an optimal balance between safety, cost, performance and sustainability. Job description We are currently looking for an Electronics Research & Development Engineer to join our R&D team. In this role, you will contribute to innovative research and development projects, combining your technical expertise, industrial experience and knowledge of electrochemistry. You will be involved in the entire development process, from initial calculations and system design to hardware, firmware and software development, prototyping, testing and final implementation. Your Responsibilities Design and develop electronic systems integrating precision measurements and power control on a single board. Develop and optimize LED lighting solutions for optical charging applications, including optical and thermal simulations prior to prototyping. Design communication architectures enabling multiple microcontrollers to interact efficiently over a shared bus. Develop robust and reliable electronic systems designed for long-term operation in production environments. Implement FPGA-based solutions to synchronize measurement channels and manage parallel control processes. Design and develop automated cycling systems for climatic chamber testing, covering the complete data acquisition chain, from high-speed measurements and database storage to data analysis and reporting. Design and dimension solutions in power electronics, battery-powered measurement systems and embedded Linux applications. Profile You hold a degree in Electronics Engineering, Microengineering, Physics, or a related technical field. You are equally comfortable working with an oscilloscope, developing Python scripts, and designing complex multilayer PCBs. You demonstrate strong analytical and problem-solving skills, approaching technical challenges with precision and a solid engineering mindset. You are passionate about turning innovative ideas into practical, functional solutions and seeing your designs come to life. Professional requirements You have knowledge of microcontrollers, System-on-Module (SoM), System-on-Board (SoB), FPGA, C/C++, Python, VHDL, KiCad, SPICE and Embedded Linux. Languages Good command of French and English; knowledge of German would be an asset. items.desc: Founding Engineer | AI Infrastructure Startup for Biopharma | Full-Time | Up to £150K + Founding Equity About the Company Our client is an AI infrastructure company transforming how commercial decisions are made across the global pharmaceutical and biotechnology industries. The team unites cutting-edge AI research with decades of pharmaceutical industry leadership in portfolio strategy, competitive intelligence, forecasting, and business development. The company builds custom, proprietary AI infrastructure that replaces legacy research vendors and noisy manual workflows with real-time, automated intelligence. Their platform continuously monitors global data sources - including clinical and regulatory milestones, deal flow, hiring, epidemiology, scientific congresses, and HCP research - slashing deliverable turnaround times by over 90% and empowering top-10 global biopharmas to act on verifiable, traceable insights. Backed by top-tier venture capital, they build forward-deployed systems engineered directly into client environments, pairing high-impact AI capabilities with enterprise-grade data security and governance. About the Role Reporting directly to the founders, the Founding Engineer will be a core builder shaping the architectural foundation, data ingestion pipelines, and agentic workflows from the ground up. This is a high-horsepower, hands-on role designed for an exceptional full-stack/systems builder who can write clean production code across the entire stack, architect reliable data infrastructure, and translate complex client requirements into shipped features. You will help design the core multi-source ingestion engine, implement autonomous AI agents and structured LLM extraction pipelines, and ensure enterprise-grade security and document traceability across all platform features. Key Responsibilities Build and scale data pipelines that continuously ingest, clean, and process global biopharma data (clinical trial registries, regulatory filings, congress readouts, and market research). Implement agentic workflows, inference pipelines, and structured extraction using Pydantic AI and modern foundation models—prioritising absolute document traceability and zero-hallucination accuracy. Develop end-to-end capabilities from clean database schemas in PostgreSQL and performant FastAPI endpoints through to responsive Next.js/React frontends. Work alongside the co-founders to unpack client requirements, design custom modules to solve specific commercial biopharma workflows, and ship reliable software in fast iteration cycles. Maintain SOC 2–aligned cloud architecture on AWS, incorporating fine-grained role-based access control (RBAC), robust test suites, and strict client data isolation. Skills & Competencies Strong end-to-end capabilities spanning Python/FastAPI backend services, PostgreSQL schema design, and modern TypeScript/React interfaces. Practical experience integrating LLMs and building AI agents, structured validation (Pydantic / Pydantic AI), and document parsing pipelines where verifiable provenance is critical. A strong bias toward shipping; comfortable building 80/20 solutions to validate workflows quickly before hardening them into production-grade infrastructure. Confident communication skills, comfortable breaking down complex technical trade-offs and gathering functional requirements directly from non-technical stakeholders. Proven ability to rapidly master unfamiliar, complex data spaces (such as clinical trial phases or pharmaceutical licensing structures) and turn them into clean data models. Qualifications & Experience 3-5 years of hands-on software engineering experience building and scaling production software in modern Python and TypeScript environments. Solid experience across the core stack: Python (FastAPI), PostgreSQL, TypeScript (Next.js / React), and AWS. Practical experience working with LLMs, retrieval systems, and AI agent frameworks in production. Strong academic credentials or concrete evidence of top 1% technical ability (e.g., First Class / Distinction degrees in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or Engineering from leading institutions; competitive programming achievements; or standout early-career contributions). Prior experience in early-stage startups, forward-deployed engineering, or building data-heavy B2B SaaS products is highly desirable.

items.desc: Junior AI Engineer Start jouw carrière als Junior AI Engineer bij een innovatieve softwareorganisatie in de omgeving van Utrecht. In deze functie werk je op het snijvlak van data en technologie en zet je AI actief in om werkzaamheden te automatiseren, processen te verbeteren en bij te dragen aan de ontwikkeling van een modern dataplatform. Je komt terecht in een datateam dat verantwoordelijk is voor het ontwikkelen, beheren en verder professionaliseren van een nieuw dataplatform. Samen met ervaren Data Engineers zorgen jullie ervoor dat data op een betrouwbare, efficiënte en schaalbare manier wordt verwerkt en beschikbaar wordt gesteld voor verschillende toepassingen. Wat voor impact maak je als Junior AI Engineer? Jij zorgt samen met jouw team ervoor dat data wordt ontsloten, getransformeerd en beschikbaar wordt gemaakt voor analyses en andere toepassingen. Je werkt mee aan de verdere ontwikkeling van een modern dataplatform, waarbij je AI actief inzet om jouw werkzaamheden slimmer en efficiënter uit te voeren. Binnen de organisatie speelt AI een belangrijke rol. Jij gebruikt AI-tools bijvoorbeeld bij het schrijven en controleren van code, het uitvoeren van analyses en het automatiseren van dagelijkse werkzaamheden. Ook krijg je de mogelijkheid om je verder te verdiepen in AI-agents en nieuwe technologieën. Je hoeft nog niet alle technieken te beheersen, maar hebt wel een goede basis in Python en SQL en weet hoe je AI praktisch kunt toepassen. Je werkt mee aan het ontwikkelen, beheren en optimaliseren van dataoplossingen. Je ondersteunt bij het verwerken, structureren en transformeren van data. Je zet AI-tools actief in om werkzaamheden te automatiseren en ontwikkelprocessen te verbeteren. Je onderzoekt hoe nieuwe AI-technologieën kunnen bijdragen aan efficiëntere werkprocessen. Je werkt samen met ervaren Data Engineers en ontwikkelt jezelf verder op het gebied van Data Engineering, AI en automatisering. Jij bent iemand met: Een HBO- of WO-opleiding richting Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Informatica, HBO-ICT, Computer Science of een vergelijkbare studie. Minimaal 1 jaar relevante werkervaring. Een goede basis in Python en SQL. Aantoonbare ervaring met het praktisch toepassen van AI in jouw dagelijkse werkzaamheden. Affiniteit met data, automatisering en nieuwe technologieën. Een analytische en probleemoplossende mindset en de ambitie om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen binnen AI en Data Engineering. Wat krijg jij daarvoor terug? Een salaris tussen €3.287 en €4.263 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur. De mogelijkheid om mee te bouwen aan een modern dataplatform. Begeleiding en kennisoverdracht van ervaren Data Engineers. De mogelijkheid om deel te nemen aan het AI Champions-initiatief en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen op het gebied van AI. Mogelijkheid tot hybride werken, met twee vaste kantoordagen per week. Een uitdagende functie binnen een innovatieve en toekomstgerichte softwareorganisatie met volop ontwikkelmogelijkheden. Klaar om jouw IT-carrière naar een hoger niveau te tillen? Solliciteer nu of contacteer Richie Haster via 06 39521849 of rhaster@visservanbaars.nl.

items.desc: Data Scientist | Machine Learning | Madrid (Híbrido) Estamos buscando profesionales de Data Science para incorporarse a un nuevo proyecto en Madrid, donde podrán participar en el análisis avanzado de datos y el desarrollo de soluciones basadas en estadística y Machine Learning. ¿Cuáles serán tus responsabilidades? Explorar, analizar y preparar conjuntos de datos para extraer información relevante. Formular hipótesis y diseñar experimentos que permitan dar respuesta a problemas de negocio. Desarrollar, entrenar y evaluar modelos estadísticos y de Machine Learning. Seleccionar métricas y validar el rendimiento de los modelos. Analizar aspectos relacionados con sesgos, explicabilidad y robustez. Interpretar resultados y comunicar conclusiones, transformándolas en recomendaciones de negocio. Colaborar en la industrialización y puesta en producción de los modelos desarrollados. ¿Qué buscamos? Conocimientos y experiencia trabajando con Python y/o R. Base sólida en estadística y probabilidad. Conocimientos de Machine Learning y desarrollo de modelos predictivos. Experiencia o conocimientos en Deep Learning, NLP y/o series temporales. Conocimientos de Feature Engineering, experimentación y visualización de datos. Capacidad para evaluar e interpretar modelos, así como comunicar resultados. Pensamiento analítico, autonomía y orientación a negocio. Valoraremos perfiles con diferentes niveles de experiencia, siempre que cuenten con una buena base técnica y motivación por seguir desarrollándose en el ámbito de Data Science. Ubicación y modalidad de trabajo 📍 Madrid. 🏢 Modelo híbrido Si te interesa trabajar en proyectos donde los datos, la estadística y la inteligencia artificial se convierten en soluciones reales de negocio, ¡nos encantará conocerte! #DataScience #MachineLearning #Python #DataScientist #Madrid #ArtificialIntelligence

Vi udvider vores kapacitet og søger nuto nye kollegaer, der som eksperter i AI, algoritmer og software vil være med til at drive udviklingen af Forsvarets dronekapaciteter fremad. items.desc: AI Engineer – Content Quality As an AI Engineer for Content Quality, you will collaborate with engineers to build, execute, and iterate on agent orchestrations, automated workflows, and system integrations that power content quality processes. This role focuses heavily on Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, agent skills, AI orchestration, and Google’s internal infrastructure. This position is ideal for a highly motivated builder who is eager to learn, comfortable working from technical specifications, and deeply committed to the quality and reliability of what they ship. You’ll gain hands-on experience building systems that use cutting-edge AI technologies to automate complex workflows. Responsibilities: Agent Orchestration & Automated Workflows Build and improve AI agent orchestrations that automate content quality workflows and reduce the need for manual intervention. Develop automated workflows that leverage LLMs, tools, and agent chaining. Collaborate with engineers and domain specialists to design and refine workflow logic. Create and maintain clear workflow documentation so domain specialists can understand, tune, and improve processes.Iterate on workflows based on performance, quality, and operational feedback. Integration & MCP Development Develop integrations between AI models and external platforms using Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and similar frameworks. Build primarily in Python, with an emphasis on reliable and maintainable integrations. Work with APIs, HTTP, REST, and client-server architectures. Implement robust error handling, retries, and failure recovery to ensure reliable integrations. Maintain and update integrations as underlying systems, APIs, and tools evolve. Develop and maintain agent skills and tool integrations. Use CLI-based development tools, including the Gemini CLI, to improve development, debugging, and testing efficiency. Implement monitoring and audit logging to ensure agent actions are traceable, observable, and queryable. Help build reliable systems that can be monitored and maintained at scale. Requirements: Technical Skills: Proficiency in Python. Basic understanding of SQL and the ability to write simple queries. Familiarity with: API integrations HTTP and RESTful APIs Client-server networking LLM APIs Prompt engineering Structured outputs Tool use and agent chaining Understanding of AI/ML frameworks and emerging protocols such as Model Context Protocol (MCP). Ability to understand technical specifications and translate them into reliable implementations. Google Ecosystem & Development Tools Experience with, or a strong willingness to learn, Google internal tools such as: PLX, Buganizer, Jet Ski Comfortable working with CLI-based development tools, including the Gemini CLI. Willingness to learn new internal infrastructure and development environments quickly. Professional Skills: Comfortable working from a provided technical specification and implementing solutions accurately with guidance from senior engineers. Strong attention to detail and commitment to code and workflow quality. Ability to balance speed, quality, and reliability in a fast-changing environment. Strong communication and collaboration skills. Clear, structured thinking and strong problem-solving abilities. Self-motivated and eager to learn and grow in the field of AI engineering. Comfortable working in a collaborative environment and incorporating feedback from engineers and domain specialists.

items.desc: ¿Te gustaría trabajar en una empresa multinacional, consolidada y referente en el sector del ocio a nivel nacional e internacional? ¡ CIRSA es tu compañía! ¡Buscamos un/a Data Scientist especializado/a en Power BI para para nuestras oficinas ubicadas en Terrassa! Tu misión será transformar datos complejos en información útil para la toma de decisiones, mediante la creación de modelos semánticos robustos, dashboards de alto rendimiento y análisis avanzados. Trabajarás en colaboración con las diferentes unidades de negocio y los equipos técnicos para convertir sus necesidades en soluciones analíticas escalables, fiables y fácilmente interpretables. ¿Qué podemos ofrecerte? ⌚ Flexibilidad horaria y política híbrida de teletrabajo. 🤝 Bonus referral por referenciar a una persona que cumpla con el perfil que buscamos. ¡Tu recomendación es garantía extra de calidad! 💳 Paquete de retribución flexible con beneficios en tributación: tarjeta restaurante, seguro médico, bono transporte, formación o guardería. 📚 Formación continua con un amplio catálogo de cursos a tu alcance. ✅ Programa de Becas CIRSA para formarte en lo que quieras. 🌱 Empresa comprometida socialmente a través de la ESG. 🧘 Programas de wellbeing: risoterapia, alimentación saludable, yoga… 🚴 Clubes deportivos CIRSA: running club, bike club y pádel club, donde podrás competir en torneos internos y contra otras empresas. ¿Qué harás con nosotros? Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener informes interactivos, dashboards corporativos y cuadros de mando estratégicos en Power BI. Construir modelos de datos eficientes, escalables y correctamente documentados, aplicando buenas prácticas como el modelo estrella, la definición de relaciones y la gestión adecuada de la granularidad. Crear y optimizar medidas avanzadas en DAX, asegurando el rendimiento, la precisión y la consistencia de los cálculos. Gestionar datasets, actualizaciones incrementales, gateways y conexiones con diferentes fuentes de datos. Desarrollar análisis descriptivos, diagnósticos y predictivos que permitan identificar tendencias, oportunidades y áreas de mejora para el negocio. Utilizar Python o R para el tratamiento avanzado de datos, la automatización de procesos y el desarrollo de modelos de machine learning. Colaborar con el equipo de Data Engineering para garantizar la calidad, disponibilidad y trazabilidad de los datos. Participar en la definición y optimización de procesos ETL/ELT de ingesta, transformación y carga de datos. Recoger requerimientos de áreas como Producto, Operaciones, Finanzas o Marketing y convertirlos en modelos analíticos y métricas estandarizadas. Documentar las metodologías, los supuestos y los resultados de los análisis de forma clara y comprensible para interlocutores técnicos y no técnicos. Impulsar la adopción de las soluciones desarrolladas, asegurando que las personas usuarias comprendan los indicadores y puedan utilizarlos en la toma de decisiones. Garantizar el cumplimiento de los estándares de gobernanza, seguridad, calidad y protección de los datos. ¿Qué te hará triunfar en la posición? Formación universitaria en Estadística, Matemáticas, Ingeniería, Informática, Economía Cuantitativa o disciplinas afines. Experiencia de entre 1 y 3 años en posiciones de Data Analyst, Data Scientist, BI Specialist o similares. Dominio avanzado de Power BI Desktop y Power BI Service, con experiencia sólida en DAX y modelado de datos. Conocimientos de SQL y Python o R aplicados al análisis y procesamiento de datos. Se valorarán conocimientos de Power Query, Microsoft Fabric y/o entorno Azure Data. Experiencia trabajando con grandes volúmenes de datos y desarrollando soluciones de BI orientadas a negocio. Se valorarán certificaciones oficiales en Power BI o Microsoft Azure. Si eres una persona apasionada por los datos, la visualización y el análisis, y quieres seguir desarrollando tu carrera profesional, ¡inscríbete! CIRSA es una compañía implicada con la igualdad de oportunidades. Por ello, nos responsabilizamos de que nuestros procesos de selección se lleven a cabo en igualdad de condiciones y sin discriminación por razón de nacimiento, edad, raza, sexo, orientación sexual, religión, estado civil, opinión o cualquier otra condición física, personal o social protegida por las leyes.

Backed by the European Investment Fund and connected to a network of more than 400 institutional investors in 22 countries, the business
items.desc: Title: AI Builder, Alternative Finance Location: Madrid, Spain (hybrid) Who are we recruiting for: Our client is a fast-growing alternative financing platform based in Madrid, specialising in debt and capital solutions for companies and infrastructure projects across Europe. Backed by the European Investment Fund and connected to a network of more than 400 institutional investors in 22 countries, the business arranges corporate and project finance from €5M to €75M, with a strong focus on renewable energy and sustainability, alongside mobility, data centres, real estate and industrial assets. With its model proven in market, the platform's next step is to make the analysis, presentation and distribution of every financing operation run on product rather than manual effort. The business is now looking to appoint two AI Builders: finance professionals who understand alternative credit from the inside and can build the methodologies, processes and tools behind it, then lead the operations that run on them. What will you be doing: Turn the analysis and structuring of €5M to €75M financing operations into repeatable methodologies, models and tools used across the team every day. Design and build AI and automation workflows that take a deal from borrower onboarding through credit assessment to investor distribution. Own the operations behind the tools you build, making sure they work in practice and keep improving. Translate credit, structured finance and project finance know-how into product requirements, working alongside the product, processes and development teams. Standardise how financing proposals are prepared and presented to institutional investors, reducing friction and turnaround time. Build data, reporting and monitoring processes across the portfolio, from origination to post-close. Work directly with the founders on how the platform scales its operating model. Identify where manual work can be removed and make the case for change with clear numbers. Are you the ideal candidate? 1-3 years' experience in credit analysis, structured finance, project finance, debt advisory, credit rating or a similar finance role. Understanding of debt products, credit risk and how financing operations are structured and executed. A builder by instinct: you already use Python, SQL, advanced modelling, automation or AI tools to make your own work faster, without being a career software developer. Proven ability to turn a manual process into a system that others use without you. Comfortable owning operations, not only delivering tools. Exposure to renewable energy or infrastructure finance is a plus. Analytical rigour combined with a product and commercial mindset. Excellent communication skills, able to work with credit, product and technical stakeholders. Fluent Spanish and English are essential; Italian would be an advantage. Comfortable in a small, entrepreneurial and fast-moving environment. What's in it: A role that doesn't exist in a bank or rating agency: real ownership of product and operations from day one. Direct exposure to the founders and to institutional investors across Europe. The chance to shape how mid-market companies and infrastructure projects in Europe access financing. Clear career progression tied to what you build and how the platform scales. A collaborative, entrepreneurial environment at the intersection of finance, technology and the energy transition. Who we are: Executive Integrity is a global executive search and recruitment consultancy focused on building talent for a more sustainable world, specialising in Green Technology and Renewable Energy sectors. We donate a proportion of all profits to Friends of the Earth International, supporting initiatives that promote environmentally sustainable and socially just societies.

Construct ML/AI components: Produce software parts, services, and APIs that add machine learning and AI functionality to existing applications. What We're Looking For Education: BSc, MSc, or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Mathematics, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience in practice. Experience: 2+ years of professional experience in software engineering, machine learning engineering, or AI development, with practical experience developing ML models or AI-powered applications. Software engineering: Strong Python programming skills, including software build, testing, debugging, version control, and collaborative development practices. Machine learning: Hands-on experience developing, training, and evaluating supervised learning models using frameworks such as scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar. Generative AI: Experience building applications using LLMs, including timely query formulation, structured outputs, RAG, and tool calling. ML/AI evaluation: Understanding of model evaluation methodologies, performance metrics, and approaches to validating AI outputs. ML specialization: Practical experience in at least one area such as recommender systems, time-series modeling, unsupervised learning, or reinforcement learning. Data processing: Strong SQL skills and experience retrieving, transforming, and validating data from analytical databases and APIs. Production ML: Familiarity with model deployment, inference services, monitoring, and ML lifecycle management. Cloud & infrastructure: Working knowledge of cloud platforms (e.g., GCP, AWS, Azure), containers, CI/CD pipelines, and ML development environments. Nice to have Experience in mobile gaming, digital entertainment, or large-scale consumer applications. Experience developing recommendation or personalization systems. Familiarity with agentic workflows, AI agents, or advanced LLM applications. Experience with model serving, distributed computing, or performance optimization. Experience working with managed ML platforms such as Vertex AI. Familiarity with Bayesian modeling, causal inference, or simulation techniques. Important Information for Applicants CV Language: Please submit your CV in English. Hybrid Working Policy: This role follows a hybrid working model, requiring attendance at our Barcelona office 3 days per week. This job description may have been reviewed and enhanced using AI-assisted tools to improve clarity, consistency, and inclusivity. All final content, role requirements and hiring decisions remain subject to human review and approval by Aristocrat. Humanoids is een team van rond de 40 UX designers en AI engineers. Vanuit Rotterdam, Amsterdam en bij onze opdrachtgevers werken we aan apps, webapps, tools en platforms. Humanoids is open voor talent en we nemen twee keer per jaar nieuw talent op in onze traineeships. We trainen hen samen en dat maakt Humanoids uniek in tech! Momenteel zoeken weer weer nieuwe kandidaten voor ons AI / Development Traineeship wat start in februari 2027. Wat is het Humanoids AI / Development Traineeship? Onze traineeships zijn speciaal ontwikkeld voor hoogopgeleiden. We bieden onze talenten een traineeship van 1 jaar aan. De nadruk binnen het AI / Development Traineeship ligt op front-end development met gebruik van de modernste technieken, zoals React, GraphQL & Typescript. Omdat wij veelzijdige developers kweken, raken we alle disciplines aan. Dat betekent dat je ook belangrijke dingen meekrijgt van back-end development en mobile / app development. En natuurlijk maakt AI engineering een heel belangrijk onderdeel uit van je werk. Je kunt zo als developer het gehele spectrum overzien en je werk beter doen. Het traineeship bestaat uit een crash course van 6 weken waarin je je praktische Development skills operationaliseert en daarna 12 maanden werken. Tegelijk komen we iedere week een volle dag samen voor ons trainingsprogramma en wordt je door onze mensen actief begeleid. Na traineeship willen we graag voor langere tijd samenwerken en zorgen dat jij een senior wordt met top-perspectieven op de arbeidsmarkt. Met andere woorden: Dit traineeship draait om jou. Geen enkel bedrijf wat "normale" UX of Development posities aanbiedt investeert zoveel in talent als Humanoids. Daar zijn we trots op en we doen dit graag! Achtergrond Bij Humanoids willen wij een team van specialisten bouwen van de hoogste kwaliteit. Daarom bieden we traineeships waar we al onze specialistische vakkennis in hebben gegoten, speciaal voor hoogopgeleiden. Bij Humanoids investeren we ontzettend veel in onze mensen, omdat we ervan overtuigd zijn dat de kwaliteit van ons bedrijf begint bij de specialisten en we graag willen bijdragen aan een duurzame tech arbeidsmarkt. Over jou Je hebt serieuze development ambitie; Je bent hoogopgeleid. items.desc: Description Starling is the UK's first and leading digital bank on a mission to fix banking! We built a new kind of bank because we knew technology had the power to help people save, spend and manage their money in a new and transformative way. We're a fully licensed UK bank with the culture and spirit of a fast-moving, disruptive tech company. We're a bank, but better: fairer, easier to use and designed to demystify money for everyone. We employ more than 3,000 people across our London, Southampton, Cardiff and Manchester offices. Our technologists are at the very heart of Starling and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment that is all about building things, creating new stuff, and disruptive technology that keeps us on the cutting edge of fintech. We operate a flat structure to empower you to make decisions regardless of what your primary responsibilities may be, innovation and collaboration will be at the core of everything you do. Help is never far away in our open culture, you will find support in your team and from across the business, we are in this together! The way to thrive and shine within Starling is to be a self-driven individual and be able to take full ownership of everything around you: From building things, designing, discovering, to sharing knowledge with your colleagues and making sure all processes are efficient and productive to deliver the best possible results for our customers. Our purpose is underpinned by five Starling values: Listen, Keep It Simple, Do The Right Thing, Own It, and Aim For Greatness. Hybrid Working We have a Hybrid approach to working here at Starling - our preference is that you're located within a commutable distance of one of our offices so that we're able to interact and collaborate in person. Our Data Environment Our Data teams are aligned to divisions covering the following Banking Services & Products, Customer Identity & Financial Crime and Data & ML Engineering. Our Data teams are excited about delivering meaningful and impactful insights to both the business and more importantly our customers. Hear from the team in our latest blogs or our case studies with Women in Tech . We are looking for talented engineers at all levels to join the team. We value people being engaged and caring about customers, caring about the code they write and the contribution they make to Starling. People with a broad ability to apply themselves to a multitude of problems and challenges, who can work across teams do great things here at Starling, to continue changing banking for good. About The Role The ML Projects team is at the forefront of bringing cutting edge machine learning to the core of what we do at Starling. As a software engineer on the ML Projects team you will work with other engineers and data scientists to design, implement and maintain features that make use of machine learning models under the hood. This could mean anything from creating a brand new ML-powered feature from scratch to seamlessly integrating a new model into our core banking platform. You might find yourself designing robust infrastructure and pipelines or discovering a completely new approach to a complex problem. We believe in empowering our engineers to take ownership and drive solutions from ideation to launch. This means you'll have the autonomy to shape your own path, identify challenges, and collaborate with colleagues across teams to deliver impactful solutions across a range of technologies. Requirements We are looking for a skilled software engineer who thrives on building and scaling complex systems. You should have a proven track record of delivering robust, multi-technology applications within an enterprise environment. We're open-minded when it comes to hiring and we care more about aptitude and attitude than specific qualifications. We are very open about how we deliver software. We believe in clean coding, simple solutions, automated testing and continuous deployment. If you care enough to find elegant solutions to difficult technical problems, we'd love to hear from you. The main part of our Tech Stack is listed below, we don't ask that you have experience in all of this, but if you do, that's great! Python Java, which makes up the majority of our backend codebase JavaScript, particularly React, which makes up our frontend Postgres and SQL AWS & GCP - we're cloud-native TeamCity for CI / CD (lots of teams are releasing code 15-20 times per day!) Terraform Prometheus and Grafana If you have built and deployed complex Python applications or have hands-on experience with generative AI and LLMs, we would be especially keen to talk. We are moving fast in the AI space and want people who are excited to help us define what comes next. Interview process Interviewing Is a Two Way Process And We Want You To Have The Time And Opportunity To Get To Know Us, As Much As We Are Getting To Know You! Our Interviews Are Conversational And We Want To Get The Best From You, So Come With Questions …

items.desc: AI Development Intern / LIA – MyTrueLook™ MyTrueLook™ utvecklar en AI-baserad tjänst inom beauty där användaren laddar upp ett eget foto, väljer en makeup- eller skönhetsstil och får stilen applicerad digitalt samtidigt som personen fortfarande ska se ut som sig själv. Vi är nu i en aktiv utvecklingsfas och söker en LIA-student som vill arbeta praktiskt med AI-utveckling tillsammans med vårt tekniska team. Du kommer att arbeta nära Jerry, som ansvarar för den tekniska utvecklingen och även blir din handledare under praktiken. Det här är inte en praktik där du enbart följer arbetet från sidan. Vi söker dig som redan har en teknisk grund och vill bidra direkt till utvecklingen av en verklig AI-produkt. Arbetsuppgifter kan bland annat vara: • utveckling och förbättring av AI-funktioner • arbete med bildbehandling och generativ AI • integration av AI-modeller och API • förbättring av kvalitet och identitetsbevarande i genererade bilder • testning och utvärdering av olika modeller och tekniska lösningar • felsökning och optimering av befintlig kod • backend- och API-utveckling • dokumentation och teknisk kvalitetssäkring • arbete med prestanda, stabilitet och skalbarhet Vi söker dig som studerar inom exempelvis: • AI och Machine Learning • Software Development • Data Science • Computer Science • Fullstack- eller backendutveckling med tydlig AI-inriktning Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av flera av följande områden: • Python • JavaScript eller TypeScript • Git och versionshantering • REST API • AI- och ML-modeller • Computer Vision • bildgenerering eller bildbehandling • molntjänster och GPU-baserad AI-infrastruktur Erfarenhet av generativ AI, diffusion models, ControlNet, LoRA, face recognition, face embeddings eller liknande tekniker är särskilt intressant. Det viktigaste för oss är dock inte en lång lista av tekniker. Vi vill se vad du faktiskt har byggt. I din ansökan vill vi därför gärna att du skickar: • CV • utbildning och LIA-period • länk till GitHub, portfolio eller tidigare projekt om det finns • en kort beskrivning av ett tekniskt projekt där du själv har utvecklat en större del • vilka delar av AI-utveckling du helst vill arbeta med Om MyTrueLook™ MyTrueLook™ utvecklas av Jepela Sverige AB. Vårt långsiktiga mål är att bygga en skalbar internationell AI-plattform inom beauty där användaren kan gå från inspiration till ett personligt resultat och i framtiden även vidare till produkter, behandlingar och bokningar. Produkten är fortfarande under utveckling. Som LIA-student kommer du därför in i ett skede där dina tekniska insatser kan få direkt betydelse för den färdiga tjänsten.

items.desc: Offerta di tirocinio – Sviluppo software e Intelligenza Artificiale Progetto Appalti S.r.l. , nata nel 2017, è una società di consulenza specializzata in materia di appalti pubblici. Nell’ambito di un progetto di innovazione e digitalizzazione dei propri processi aziendali, ricerca un profilo junior da inserire in un percorso di tirocinio formativo , interessato/a allo sviluppo software e alle applicazioni dell’Intelligenza Artificiale, con possibilità di inserimento in azienda. Descrizione del progetto e del ruolo La risorsa sarà coinvolta nello sviluppo di programmi che sfruttino l'intelligenza artificiale finalizzati a supportare e ottimizzare i processi aziendali legati alla partecipazione alle gare d’appalto. Il progetto prevede l’utilizzo di tecnologie di Intelligenza Artificiale, Machine Learning e Natural Language Processing (NLP). Il tirocinante avrà l’opportunità di affiancare il team aziendale nelle diverse fasi di sviluppo del progetto, acquisendo competenze pratiche e confrontandosi con applicazioni concrete delle più recenti tecnologie digitali. Attività previste La risorsa, affiancata da personale esperto, sarà coinvolta nelle seguenti attività: Sviluppo software: supporto alla progettazione e allo sviluppo di funzionalità applicative, attraverso l'utilizzo di linguaggi di programmazione e strumenti di sviluppo. Intelligenza Artificiale e NLP: approfondimento e sperimentazione di strumenti di IA per l'analisi e la comprensione di documenti testuali, con particolare riferimento ai requisiti contenuti nei bandi e nei capitolati di gara. Sperimentazione di modelli e strumenti IA: utilizzo e test di librerie, framework e servizi di Intelligenza Artificiale per l'estrazione di informazioni, la classificazione dei contenuti e il supporto alla generazione di testi. Gestione dei dati: supporto all'organizzazione, all'archiviazione e alla gestione delle informazioni aziendali attraverso database e sistemi di gestione dei dati. Test e miglioramento: verifica del funzionamento delle funzionalità sviluppate, analisi dei risultati e individuazione di possibili miglioramenti. Ricerca e innovazione: studio e approfondimento di nuove tecnologie e strumenti digitali applicabili ai processi aziendali. Requisiti richiesti Cerchiamo una persona curiosa, motivata e interessata a misurare competenze acquisite nel settore dell'informatica e dell'Intelligenza Artificiale in un contesto di impresa. È richiesto: Possedere conoscenze di programmazione. Avere interesse per il mondo dell'Intelligenza Artificiale, del Machine Learning e del Natural Language Processing. Avere familiarità, anche a livello introduttivo o didattico, con strumenti e tecnologie per lo sviluppo software. Conoscere i principi di base della gestione dei dati e dei database costituisce un elemento preferenziale. Non è richiesta una precedente esperienza lavorativa nel settore: il tirocinio è rivolto anche a candidati alla prima esperienza, desiderosi di mettere in pratica le conoscenze acquisite durante il percorso di studi. Completano il profilo Curiosità e interesse per le nuove tecnologie, in particolare per l'Intelligenza Artificiale. Attitudine all'apprendimento e disponibilità ad approfondire autonomamente nuovi strumenti e linguaggi. Proattività, precisione e spirito di iniziativa. Buone capacità logiche e di problem solving. Attitudine al lavoro in team e al confronto con professionalità e competenze differenti. Cosa offre Progetto Appalti Un'esperienza di tirocinio formativo all'interno di un contesto aziendale dinamico, con la possibilità di partecipare concretamente a un progetto di innovazione tecnologica. Il percorso consentirà di acquisire esperienza pratica nello sviluppo di soluzioni software basate sull'Intelligenza Artificiale, applicando le conoscenze universitarie a un progetto reale e approfondendo il rapporto tra tecnologia, gestione documentale e settore degli appalti pubblici.

items.desc: About The Job Support the analytics team in turning raw data into actionable insights that help the business make data‑driven decisions Your Main Activities Are Gather, clean, and validate data from internal systems Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA) and generate descriptive statistics Create and maintain dashboards/reports using Power BI, Tableau or Looker Assist in building simple predictive or forecasting models (for example, linear regression, time‑series) under supervision Document data sources, data‑quality checks, and analytical procedures Support ad‑hoc queries from business units and present findings in clear, visual formats Profile And Skills To Success Pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering or a related field Good knowledge of English, both oral and written Proficiency in Microsoft Excel Introductory knowledge of a programming language for data analysis (Python – pandas, NumPy; or R) Introductory knowledge visualisation tool (Power BI) Understanding of data‑cleaning techniques and data‑quality concepts Strong analytical and problem‑solving mindset Communication skills – able to translate technical results into business language Attention to detail Analytical ability and ability to work with large data sets Collaboration, open to feedback and continuous learning Why joining BNP Paribas? BNP Paribas, The European Leader In Banking And Financial Services In Europe, Operates In 64 Countries And Has Nearly 180,000 Employees. The Group Is Structured Around Three Operating Divisions. Its Business Lines Cooperate Closely, As Part Of Our Integrated Model, To Meet The Needs Of All Our Clients In a Coordinated Manner Corporate & Institutional Banking (CIB), connects corporate clients needing financing and institutional clients looking for investment opportunities; Commercial, Personal Banking & Services (CPBS), brings together all the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialised businesses; Investment & Protection Services (IPS), combines a unique continuum of products and services across protection, saving, investment and real-estate. Our presence in Portugal In Portugal since 1985, BNP Paribas today has more than 9.700 employees, distributed across the Group's 10 business entities established in the country. Its presence also extends to 11 excellence centres providing value-added services to various countries where the BNP Paribas Group also operates. Diversity and Inclusion Commitment BNP Paribas´ Ambition Is To Cultivate An Open And Responsive Environment For All That Encourages Collaboration And Interaction. We Demonstrate Our Commitment By Actively Contributing To The Group’s Diversity And Inclusion Strategy And Goals, In Line With The United Nations Sustainable Development Goals. As Part Of Our Local Corporate And Social Responsibility - Diversity & Inclusion Strategy, BNP Paribas Portugal Is Committed To Promote a fair and unbiased recruitment process and offer professional development opportunities to all employees; Celebrate diversity and advocate for inclusion, both externally and internally, encouraging employee’s participation, creating space for different voices to be heard. To foster the effort of BNP Paribas Portugal, multiple initiatives and events take place throughout the year where our people can find out more on the importance of diversity inclusion at the workplace and in our society. Remote Working Conditions At BNP Paribas, we embrace a Smart Working framework based on trust, autonomy and collaboration. Within this framework, eligible employees can benefit from flexible remote working options adapted to our hybrid working environment. To ensure a comfortable and efficient working setup, eligible employees are provided with both office and home equipment, are entitled to an equipment allowance and can benefit from exclusive partnerships to purchase additional items at reduced prices. Commitment towards work/life balance Supporting employees in a hybrid way of working while providing them with the means to maintain a work-life balance is an essential dimension of our Smart Working program. At BNP Paribas, we care about our employees’ wellbeing and promote a culture of good integration between work and personal life. To find out more on why you should join BNP Paribas please read our Employee Value Proposition and our Career path page. Please note that only applications submitted in English will be considered. In case you are selected for this role, further documentation will be requested to support your hiring process.

items.desc: Buscamos un AI Engineer para incorporarse al equipo de la Plataforma de Datos e IA de Jungle y asumir el diseño, la implementación, la operación y el mantenimiento de las soluciones de inteligencia artificial generativa del grupo sobre Google Cloud Platform: agentes, asistentes y capacidades de IA integradas en los productos digitales del grupo, tanto aplicaciones internas como webs. Es un perfil híbrido de ingeniería y producto. La persona trabajará bajo el criterio técnico del Lead Data & AI Engineer y será la responsable de que las soluciones de IA lleguen a producción y se mantengan en ella con calidad medida, coste controlado y usuarios reales. Tan importante como construir es operar y mantener lo construido, incluido lo que hayan desarrollado proveedores externos. Trabajarás sobre Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (antes Vertex AI) y el ecosistema de IA de Google Cloud, con modelos servidos dentro de la Unión Europea, y en contacto directo con los equipos de negocio que usan las herramientas. Te incorporarás a Jungle , una consultora que transforma negocios desde un modelo integrado que conecta diseño, comunicación y tecnología para generar diferenciación y un impacto medible en el negocio de nuestros clientes. Acompañamos a las compañías desde la construcción de marca y la activación cultural hasta la experiencia digital, el desarrollo web y e-commerce, eliminando la fragmentación entre agencias creativas, consultoras y proveedores tecnológicos. Responsabilidades principales Desarrollo de agentes e IA generativa sobre GCP • Diseñar, construir y desplegar agentes con Agent Development Kit (ADK) sobre Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, incluidos sistemas multiagente, uso de herramientas y memoria. • Integrar y combinar los distintos modelos disponibles a través de las APIs de Model Garden (Gemini, Claude y modelos abiertos), eligiendo el adecuado para cada tarea por calidad, latencia y coste. • Implementar capas de recuperación y grounding sobre el dato y la documentación corporativa. Agentes gestionados de Google Cloud • Utilizar los agentes gestionados que ofrece Google Cloud, como los agentes de datos y de análisis conversacional sobre BigQuery, y decidir con criterio cuándo usar lo disponible y cuándo construir a medida. IA integrada en productos digitales • Exponer las capacidades de IA como servicios propios sobre Cloud Run, con APIs, autenticación y control de consumo, e integrarlas en las aplicaciones y webs del grupo en coordinación con Jungle Apps y Webs. • Participar en el diseño de la experiencia de usuario de las funcionalidades de IA dentro de cada producto. Monitorización, operación y mantenimiento • Monitorizar las soluciones en producción: trazas, latencia, errores, consumo de tokens y coste por solución, con alertas definidas. • Mantener y evolucionar lo desplegado: cambios de versión de modelo, cuotas y límites, entornos de desarrollo y producción, integración y despliegue continuo. • Asumir soluciones construidas por terceros y dejarlas documentadas, mantenibles y bajo titularidad de Jungle. Evaluación y calidad • Definir conjuntos de evaluación y métricas objetivas para cada solución, y aplicarlos antes de cada despliegue y de cada cambio de modelo. • Medir precisión, alucinación y cobertura, y recoger el feedback de los usuarios para priorizar mejoras. Seguridad y uso responsable • Aplicar el marco de uso responsable de IA del grupo, el control de acceso por identidad y la residencia del dato en la Unión Europea. • Proteger las soluciones frente a exposición de dato personal, inyección de instrucciones y fuga de información entre compañías del grupo, en coordinación con Ciberseguridad y dentro del sistema certificado bajo ISO 27001. items.desc: On behalf of World famous ICT company-Huawei, we are looking for Optical Device Researcher. Huawei is a leading global provider of information and communications technology (ICT) infrastructure and smart devices. With integrated solutions across four key domains – telecom networks, IT, smart devices, and cloud services – we are committed to bringing digital to every person, home and organization for a fully connected, intelligent world. At Huawei, innovation focuses on customer needs. We invest heavily in basic research, concentrating on technological breakthroughs that drive the world forward. It is now the world's largest supplier of telecommunications equipment, serving more than one-third of the world's population in more than 170 countries and regions. Huawei's end-to-end portfolio of products, solutions and services are both competitive and secure. Through open collaboration with ecosystem partners, we create lasting value for our customers, working to empower people, enrich home life, and inspire innovation in organizations of all shapes and sizes. Huawei France Research Centers are responsible for advanced research in the fields of network design, applied mathematics, machine learning, and parallel computing to create and design the innovative technologies and software platforms for our Brand. Founded in 2010, Shield Lab leads the research of cryptography and security in Huawei France Research Centers. We identify key security problems that challenge traditional security fundamentals in emerging ICT applications, such as 5G/6G mobile networks, cloud computing and mobile internet services as well as for new Agentic AI network and application scenarios. We conduct leading-edge research projects, and deliver innovative outputs in the area of cryptography and security that help our corporation to establish competitiveness in enterprise, consumer and operator markets. Position Summary: We are expanding the team by recruiting a talented, highly motivated researcher in AI, cybersecurity and standardization. Candidates should have solid knowledge in AI/AI Agents, security protocols, trust mechanisms and attestation protocols, a passion in researching problems with real-world potential and impact, and good experience for standardizing security protocols in international bodies (IETF, ISO, ETSI, ITU-T, IEEE, 3GPP, TCG). Internationally competitive salary package will be offered to a qualified candidate. Duties & Responsibilities: Formulate research problems based on real-world security requirements and independently conduct high-quality research. Design and develop prototypes; deliver research results and provide competitive solutions. Standardize security protocols and trust mechanisms at international bodies. Collaborate with colleagues for standardization activities. Participate and standardize related technologies in security and trust for AI Agent at various international bodies, including IETF, ISO, ETSI, ITU-T, IEEE, 3GPP, TCG. Prepare standardization documents Write code. Participate in collaborations with industrial and academic partners. Publish related papers in top conferences/journal/White papers and/or apply high quality patents. Desired Skills & Experience Hold M.Sc or Ph.D. degree in Mathematics, Cryptography, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related field. Have one or more years of work experience in areas related to network or system security, applied cryptography, confidential computing, trusted computing. Have one or more years of work experience in areas related to AI Agent security (authorization, authentication, discovery), Remote attestation and privacy-preserving communication protocols. Standardization experience in international bodies, like IETF, ISO, ETSI, ITU-T, IEEE, 3GPP, TCG. Strong systems background: C/Rust/Go/C++/Python, TEE (SGX/SEV/TDX), attestation, PKI, TLS. Good understanding of LLM agent architecture, MCP, A2A. Self-motivated with strong sense of responsibility. HUAWEI Technologies France SASU (“HUAWEI”) respects your privacy and is committed to the protection of your personal data. Your personal data included in the application may be processed by HUAWEI. items.desc: I HOFOR har vi store mængder data fra vores drift, kunder, forbrug og rapportering. Data, der hver for sig fortæller noget, men som kan skabe langt større værdi, når vi kobler dem, analyserer dem og bringer dem i anvendelse. Vi søger derfor en Data Scientist, der kan hjælpe os med at bringe forskellige datakilder sammen og omsætte dem til ny viden, konkrete indsigter og dataprodukter, som kan bruges af vores kunder og interne samarbejdspartnere. Skab indsigt i kundernes adfærd og forbrug Du bliver en del af Kundeområdet og får en central rolle i at skabe mere værdi af de mange data, vi allerede har. Vi arbejder med store mængder drifts-, kunde-, forbrugs- og rapporteringsdata og ser et stort potentiale i at kombinere dem på nye måder. Du skal være med til at udvikle nye og bedre dataprodukter, der gør data anvendelige for andre. Det kan være indsigter og løsninger, der giver vores kunder en bedre forståelse af deres forbrug og kan bidrage til mindre forbrug af vand og varme. Dine primære opgaver vil blandt andet være at: Kombinere og analysere data fra forskellige datakilder Identificere mønstre, sammenhænge og nye anvendelsesmuligheder i data Udvikle analyser, modeller og dataprodukter, der omsætter data til viden og handling Skabe ny viden om forbrug og forbrugeradfærd, som kan bidrage til mindre forbrug Udvikle analyser, visualiseringer og dashboards i Power BI Samarbejde tæt med dataeksperter, IT og faglige miljøer på tværs af HOFOR om at bringe data i anvendelse Skarp analytiker med interesse for mennesker, kunder og data Du kan have flere indgange til rollen. Måske er du uddannet inden for datascience, statistik, økonomi, matematik, sociologi eller et lignende område. Du har gode analytiske evner og er ikke kun optaget af at analysere og rapportere, men også af hvordan data kan omsættes til viden og løsninger, som andre kan bruge. Du er nysgerrig og går gerne bag om tallene, udfordrer antagelser og søger efter forklaringer og nye løsninger. Samtidig kan du bevæge dig mellem det tekniske og det forretningsmæssige og er nysgerrig på de behov, som kunder, kolleger og HOFORs forskellige forsyninger har. Vi forestiller os, at du: Har relevant erhvervserfaring fra en Data Scientist-rolle eller en tilsvarende datafaglig funktion Har praktisk erfaring med data og kan tage en opgave fra rå data og forskellige datakilder til en analyse, model eller et dataprodukt, som andre kan anvende Har erfaring med kvantitativ analyse og databehandling Har erfaring med Python og SQL Power BI (udvikling og drift) Kan formidle komplekse analyser på en enkel og forståelig måde Er god til at skabe relationer Det er en fordel, hvis du har kendskab til SAP, Microsoft 365-platformen eller lignende datakilder Dine dygtige kolleger er klar til at byde dig velkommen Du bliver en del af Kundeløsninger og får dygtige og engagerede kolleger omkring dig. Vi kombinerer høj faglighed med et godt kollegialt fællesskab, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og deler viden på tværs af organisationen. Vi har et fleksibelt arbejdsmiljø og giver plads og mulighed for hjemmearbejde. Hos os er der plads til dig og til, at du har et bæredygtigt arbejdsliv. Du kan læse mere om vores medarbejdergoder her . Sådan bliver du vores kollega Er du klar til nye muligheder, så ser vi frem til at høre fra dig senest den 20. november 2026. Vi vil gerne gøre det nemt for dig at søge vores stilling. Du skal derfor ikke skrive en ansøgning, men blot sende dit CV, hvor du sætter nogle ord på din motivation for at søge stillingen. Du kan finde inspiration til at skrive et motiveret CV her . Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler og afslutter rekrutteringsprocessen, når den rette kandidat er fundet. Har du spørgsmål til jobbet, er du velkommen til at kontakte områdechef Ditte Bergholdt Asmussen på tlf. 3445 8350 eller mail: ditasm@hofor.dk. Søg stillingen ved at klikke på "Søg stillingen". Hos os får du plads Vand, varme, hverdag. I HOFOR sikrer vi forsyningen i hovedstadsområdet. Men vores ansvar rækker længere: Vi skaber fremtidens bæredygtige byer. Det kræver overskud, og derfor giver vi dig plads. Plads til at forfølge de store ideer og til at hente de små. Plads til at dyrke de faglige detaljer og til at tegne de store linjer. Plads til at hjælpe hinanden og til at tænke nyt, når der er brug for det. Vi har plads til flere og til, at du kan være med. HOFOR. Hos os får du plads. Til fællesskab, udvikling og et bæredygtigt arbejdsliv. Inkluderende kultur og rekruttering I HOFOR arbejder vi på at skabe en inkluderende kultur, og vi leder efter dygtige kollegaer uanset udseende, køn, kønsidentitet, seksuel orientering, etnicitet, religion, handicap, alder osv. Vi vil gerne skabe lige muligheder for alle samt sikre en retfærdig rekrutteringsproces. Undlad venligst at vedhæfte et billede.

items.desc: Deloitte bietet führende Prüfungs- und Beratungsleistungen in Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Consulting und Advisory - für nahezu 90 % der Fortune Global 500® und zahlreiche private Unternehmen. Wir liefern innovative Denkansätze, lösen komplexe Herausforderungen und fördern nachhaltiges Wachstum. Mit rund 470.000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit eröffnen wir hervorragende Karrierechancen - getragen von einem starken „Wir“ und einer Vielfalt an Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten. Du willst im Bereich Consulting – Artificial Intelligence and Data Kunden helfen, strategische Entscheidungen zu AI & Data zu treffen? Unser Team unterstützt von der Definition der AI & Data-Strategie über die Implementierung groß angelegter Datenplattformen und Visual Analytics Programme bis hin zu Einführung smarter "Age of With"-Lösungen. Sichere unseren gemeinsamen Erfolg und mach mit uns den Unterschied: als Praktikant AI & Data Engineering (m/w/d) . Standorte: Berlin , Düsseldorf , Frankfurt (Main) , Hamburg , Hannover , Köln , München und Stuttgart . Dein Impact: Als Praktikant AI & Data Engineering (m/w/d) arbeitest du direkt an einer Lösung, die beim Kunden im Einsatz ist: einer Cloud-Datenplattform mit AI-gestützter Dokumentenverarbeitung und einer Web-Applikation, mit der Fachbereiche ihre täglichen Entscheidungen treffen. Entwicklung: Du baust mit uns Features entlang des gesamten Stacks – Datenverarbeitung in Python und SQL, Web-Applikationen (z. B. Flask/Streamlit) und AI-Komponenten wie LLM- und OCR-basierte Automatisierung. Verantwortung: Du übernimmst eigene Aufgabenpakete – vom Verständnis der fachlichen Anforderung über die Umsetzung bis zum Test und zur Übergabe an den Kunden. Kundennähe: Du bist bei Terminen mit dem Fachbereich dabei, nimmst Anforderungen auf, zeigst Zwischenstände und übersetzt Feedback in konkrete Verbesserungen. AI-Driven Development: Du arbeitest von Tag eins mit AI-Coding-Assistenten (z. B. GitHub Copilot) und hilfst uns, diese Arbeitsweise im Projekt weiterzuentwickeln. Cloud & IaaS: Du bekommst praktischen Einblick in eine moderne Cloud-Datenarchitektur (AWS: S3, Glue, Athena, Lambda) und lernst, wie Infrastruktur bereitgestellt, betrieben und weiterentwickelt wird. Dein Skillset: Fortgeschrittenes Studium in (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Data Science, (Wirtschafts-)Ingenieurwesen,Statistik, Naturwissenschaften oder in vergleichbaren Studiengängen Solide Python-Grundlagen und erste SQL-Kenntnisse aus Studium, Praktika, Werkstudententätigkeiten oder eigenen Projekten Erste Berührungspunkte mit Web-Applikationen (z. B. Flask, Streamlit, FastAPI) oder Lust, dich hier schnell einzuarbeiten Interesse an AI-gestützter Softwareentwicklung und ein Grundverständnis von Cloud-Konzepten (IaaS, Storage, Compute; Vorerfahrung mit AWS, Azure oder GCP ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung) Reisebereitschaft sowie Deutsch (C1) und Englisch sehr gut in Wort und Schrift Deine Chance: Echte Verantwortung für eigene Aufgabenpakete innerhalb unserer Projekte, die du selbständig bearbeitest Persönliche:r Mentor:in in deinem Team, der/die dir mit Rat und Tat zur Seite steht und dich mit umfassendem Know-how unterstützt Ein chancenreiches und internationales Umfeld, das dir einmalige Einblicke in die Arbeit des weltweit größten Prüfungs- und Beratungsunternehmens bietet Work-Life-Balance in einem innovativen Unternehmensumfeld, das dir Gesundheitstage, Mitarbeiter:innen-Events und vieles mehr bietet Bereichsübergreifendes Networking im Deloitte Student Network mit exklusiven Vorträgen und regelmäßigem Austausch beim Praktikant:innen-Stammtisch Vielfältige Gestaltungsspielräume und aktive Förderung einer inklusiven Unternehmenskultur – u. a. durch unsere Diversity & Inclusion Mitarbeiter:innen-Netzwerke Deine Verfügbarkeit: Als Praktikant:in bist du ab Oktober 2026 idealerweise für einen Zeitraum von mindestens vier Monaten verfügbar. Bist du bereit? Mach mit uns den Unterschied! Unser Recruiting-Team freut sich auf deine Bewerbungsunterlagen (CV sowie Abitur-, Hochschul- und Arbeitszeugnisse) über unser Online-Formular. Ein Anschreiben und ein Bewerbungsfoto sind bei uns nicht erforderlich. Gleiche Chancen für alle: Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen, die so vielfältig sind wie wir – unabhängig von Alter, Behinderung, ethnischer Herkunft und Nationalität, Geschlecht, Religion, sexueller Orientierung oder sozialer Herkunft. Noch Fragen? Alle Infos zu unserem Bewerbungsprozess findest du in unseren Bewerbungs-FAQs . Dein Kontakt bei Fragen rund um Karrierethemen Unser Team Talent Acquisition – Aleksandra, Anja, Julia, Lea, Lisa, Silja und ihre Teams – unterstützt dich gerne bei allen Fragen rund um deine Karriere bei Deloitte. Du erreichst uns per E-Mail unter career@deloitte.de oder telefonisch unter +49 211 87724111. Job-ID: 50440

Hybrid, där majoriteten av arbetstiden är på kontoret. Konsulten ska kunna vara på plats på kontoret 3 dagar i veckan. Om teamet Vårt uppdrag är att göra innehåll som är tillgängligt för alla, oavsett var i landet man bor eller vem man är. Hos oss arbetar du med en av Sveriges mest uppskattade streamingtjänster, som dagligen används av miljontals människor i både stora och små stunder i livet. Du blir en del av ett engagerat och tvärfunktionellt team som arbetar med ny teknik i en kreativ och utvecklande miljö. Där samarbetar vi för att förstå våra användare och utveckla våra tjänster. Hos oss får du kombinera teknisk utveckling med problemlösning, och dina insikter blir en del av hur vi utvecklar streamingtjänsten. Om uppdraget Som dataanalytiker kommer du att utforska och analysera data för att skapa insikter som driver produktutvecklingen framåt. Du kommer att ingå i vårt Konto-team, där vi utvecklar och förbättrar ett gemensamt kontoskapande som används i alla våra tjänster. Det är ett strategiskt viktigt område för oss, med stor påverkan på användarupplevelsen och vår fortsatta tillväxt. Teamet är korsfunktionellt, och idéer och initiativ uppmuntras och tas vidare i arbetsgruppen. Gruppen består av dig som analytiker samt utvecklare, produktägare, designers och UX. Samtidigt ingår du i vårt analysteam, där vi arbetar nära varandra och delar ansvar för vår gemensamma datadomän. I rollen arbetar du längs hela analyskedjan. Du bygger, underhåller och vidareutvecklar datamodeller i dbt, säkerställer datakvalitet, implementerar tracking och tar fram och kommunicerar insikter. Du tar initiativ till förbättringar och bidrar aktivt till att utveckla teamets arbetssätt, verktyg och analysförmåga. Du är en naturlig brygga mellan data och verksamhet och trivs med att samarbeta nära olika team, roller och kompetenser. I din roll som analytiker använder du AI som en integrerad del av ditt analysarbete. Du använder den för att utforska frågeställningar, utveckla lösningar och bygga verktyg som gör data och insikter mer tillgängliga. Du kombinerar teknisk nyfikenhet med statistisk förståelse och gott omdöme. Du kan granska och validera AI-assisterade analyser och ser var tekniken skapar verkligt värde och driver nya sätt att arbeta med data. Du har hög teknisk kompetens och god förståelse för systemutveckling, teknisk arkitektur och dataflöden. Du kan sätta dig in i hur information rör sig mellan olika system, förstå tekniska beroenden och samarbeta nära utvecklare för att skapa hållbara analyslösningar. Du analyserar data strukturerat och följer upp resultat på ett sätt som gör dem användbara i beslut. Du kommunicerar insikter genom storytelling och visualisering och gör komplex data begriplig och användbar för olika målgrupper. Du arbetar datadrivet, till exempel med hypotesdriven produktutveckling och A/B-testning. Du trivs i nära samarbete med andra och söker olika perspektiv. Skallkrav Vi söker dig som: Behärskar SQL och Python Har erfarenhet av datamodellering och semantiska lager, samt kännedom om verktyg som till exempel Git, BigQuery och dbt Ligger i framkant när det gäller AI-verktyg och hur AI kan användas i analysarbetet Har erfarenhet av att använda LLM:er som en del av ditt analysarbete, samt god förståelse för deras styrkor och begränsningar Har praktisk erfarenhet av att bygga analysflöden med LLM:er Har erfarenhet av explorativ analys och av att arbeta hypotesdrivet med data Har erfarenhet av att arbeta med datakvalitet, validering och felsökning Är van vid att visualisera och kommunicera data, till exempel med visualiseringsverktyg eller egenbyggda gränssnitt för analys Meriterande Erfarenhet av utveckling (FE och/eller BE) Erfarenhet av att arbeta med realtidsdata, stora mängder eventdata eller strömmande data Erfarenhet av användarnära digitala tjänster och streamingtjänster

items.desc: AI Engineer – OCR & Intelligent Document Processing Rome, Italy | €65,000–€80,000 gross per annum | Permanent, Full-Time Help us solve one of the most challenging problems in financial document automation. We are looking for an experienced AI Engineer with strong hands-on OCR expertise to help design, build and deliver intelligent document-processing technology for a global enterprise SaaS business. The challenge is significant: processing complex, inconsistent and often highly detailed invoices, extracting accurate financial information and transforming documents into reliable, structured data. We need someone who understands how to turn AI and OCR technology into dependable, production-ready software. If you have spent at least three years professionally developing AI/ML solutions, have genuine OCR experience and enjoy solving difficult engineering problems, we'd love to hear from you. The engineering challenge You will play a key role in developing an intelligent invoice-processing application capable of handling documents with different layouts, formats, languages and levels of complexity. The solution must go beyond simply reading text. It needs to recognise, interpret, extract and validate critical financial information accurately. You will help: Design and build AI-powered OCR and Intelligent Document Processing (IDP) solutions. Develop document understanding, classification and data-extraction pipelines for complex invoices. Extract and validate invoice headers, line items, financial values, tax details and other structured information. Improve extraction accuracy, confidence scoring and exception handling across inconsistent document formats. Evaluate and integrate OCR, Machine Learning and LLM technologies where they deliver measurable improvements. Take solutions from development through testing, deployment and continuous improvement within enterprise SaaS applications. What we're looking for Essential experience Minimum three years of professional, hands-on AI/Machine Learning engineering experience. Strong commercial OCR or Intelligent Document Processing experience , including building or significantly improving real-world document-extraction solutions. Experience with technologies such as Azure AI Document Intelligence, Azure AI Services, AWS Textract, Google Document AI, Tesseract or equivalent. Strong Python development skills and experience building AI-powered applications and APIs. Experience measuring and improving model accuracy, extraction quality and production performance. Ability to understand complex business requirements and translate them into reliable technical solutions. You should be comfortable taking technical ownership, evaluating different approaches and explaining why a particular solution will work in a commercial environment. Experience that would really stand out OCR or AI development involving invoices, financial documents, purchase orders or other complex transactional records. Experience extracting complex tables, line items and structured financial data. Knowledge of document layout analysis, computer vision or custom-trained extraction models. Experience integrating LLMs into document-processing workflows. Experience working with Azure cloud services and production SaaS platforms. A degree or Master's in AI, Machine Learning, Computer Science, Data Science or a related technical discipline is desirable. Equivalent substantial industry experience will also be considered. Why this opportunity? This is a chance to tackle a genuine engineering challenge rather than simply integrate existing AI APIs. You will help shape how intelligent document-processing technology is designed and delivered, with a direct impact on the accuracy, efficiency and scalability of enterprise financial workflows. We are looking for someone who enjoys building, experimenting, evaluating and improving AI solutions — and who wants to see that technology solve meaningful business problems. The opportunity Location: Rome, Italy Salary: €65,000–€80,000 gross annually Employment: Permanent, Full-Time Experience: Minimum three years' commercial AI/ML engineering, with substantial hands-on OCR experience Interested? We would particularly like to speak with engineers who have already delivered OCR, document intelligence or AI-powered data extraction solutions in commercial environments. If that sounds like your background, we'd welcome your application. Tell us about an OCR or document-processing solution you've built, the challenges you faced and how you improved its accuracy or performance. #AIEngineer #OCREngineer #DocumentIntelligence #OCR #Python #MachineLearning #RomeJobs

In this role, you will deploy and scale LLMs to streamline business processes and assist engineering R&D. You'll work at the intersection of ML, software infrastructure engineering, and enterprise systems, by developing integration and automation solutions that enable teams across the organization to operate more efficiently. What You´ll Do · Deploy and maintain open-weights LLMs on cloud and local cluster. · Scale deployments to serve a large number of users within the organization. · Be up-to-date with new model releases, to keep our deployment state of the art. · Connect LLMs to specific use cases, helping users across the organization to automate their work routine. · Analyze the effectiveness of models on automation tasks. · Embed security and privacy in the automation pipeline, to safeguard sensitive content. Requirements What You'll Need · 3+ years of professional experience in software engineering · Experience working with LLM APIs, both open-weight and proprietary · Familiarity with LLM applications, including tools, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and routing · Experience with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, and modern software delivery practices · Understanding of security and privacy considerations in enterprise environments · Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and non-technical teams Nice to have · Knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar interoperability standards · Experience with AI governance, observability, or operational monitoring · Proficiency with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), and high-performance computing environments (Kubernetes, SLURM). · Experience in evaluating ML models. Who You Are You thrive in fast-paced environments where ambiguity is part of the challenge, and you can turn it into defined goals. You take ownership seriously and move things forward without waiting for perfect conditions. You know how to balance structure with flexibility without losing focus. Above all, you measure success by outcomes and take pride in getting things done.

items.desc: Vi söker en driven och nyfiken konsult inom AI, automation och Finance Transformation för ett spännande uppdrag hos en av våra kunder i Stockholm. Uppdraget passar dig som brinner för att omsätta ny teknik till konkreta förbättringar och som trivs bäst när du får gå från idé till test och faktisk lösning. Kunden är i en fas där de vill utforska hur AI och automatisering kan effektivisera och förenkla arbetssätt inom financeorganisationen, exempelvis inom redovisning, controlling och administrativa processer. Du kommer i stället att arbeta nära verksamheten, identifiera problem och möjligheter, förstå processerna och sedan testa olika lösningar. Det kan exempelvis handla om leverantörsfakturahantering, informationsöverföring mellan system, repetitiva arbetsmoment eller delar av redovisnings- och controllingprocesserna. Du behöver vara bekväm med att växla mellan ett större perspektiv och väldigt hands-on arbete. Ena dagen kanske du diskuterar vilka financeprocesser som har störst potential för automatisering och nästa dag testar du själv prompts eller bygger ett konkret automatiserat arbetsflöde. Uppdraget startar i december 2026 eller januari 2027 och löper under cirka sex månader. Placering är i Stockholm och arbetet sker i hybridform, med önskemål om närvaro på kontoret några dagar i veckan. Vi tror att du har Praktisk erfarenhet av AI och processutveckling inom Finance God förståelse för generativ AI och hur tekniken kan användas i det dagliga arbetet. Förmåga att förstå processer end-to-end och identifiera vad som kan effektiviseras eller automatiseras. Erfarenhet från exempelvis Business Control, Finance Transformation, redovisning, verksamhetsutveckling eller liknande. Förmåga att snabbt gå från problem → hypotes → test → fungerande lösning. Förmåga att dokumentera och implementera nya arbetssätt så att verksamheten själv kan ta dem vidare. Vem är du? Som person är du idérik, inspirerande och lösningsorienterad. Du ser möjligheter där andra ser manuella och tidskrävande processer och tycker om att testa dig fram för att hitta bättre sätt att arbeta. Du är hands-on och prestigelös, samtidigt som du är kommunikativ och trygg i dialogen med både finance, verksamhet och tekniska personer. Du har lätt för att skapa förtroende, få med dig organisationen och framför allt se till att idéer faktiskt blir verklighet. En viktig del av uppdraget kan även vara kunskapsspridning inom AI. Det kan exempelvis innebära att ta fram ett enklare internt upplägg eller ett slags "AI-körkort" med konkreta exempel på hur AI kan användas i vardagen. Målet är inte bara att skapa lösningar, utan också att hjälpa organisationen att bygga upp sin egen AI-kompetens. Ansök idag! Låter det som ett uppdrag för dig? Välkommen med din ansökan redan idag! Vid frågor kontakta Sara Paulsson 070-792 75 99, sara@clarify.se. Om Clarify Vår specialistkompetens omfattar Interim, Executive Search och Rekrytering av roller som CFO, ekonomichefer, controllers och specialister inom redovisning. Vi arbetar inom alla branscher och fokuserar på att bygga långsiktiga relationer som skapar värde för både våra konsulter och kunder. Vi på Clarify har ett genuint intresse för människor och drivs av att skapa framgång – både för individer och våra kunder. Med vår långa erfarenhet, som sträcker sig tillbaka till 80-talet, är vi experter på att lösa utmanande och komplexa interims- och rekryteringsuppdrag inom ekonomi och finans. Vad Clarify erbjuder dig som interimskonsult Marknadsmässiga marginaler och full transparens i dialog och samarbete Spännande uppdrag hos väletablerade företag och snabbväxande aktörer Löpande stöd, coaching och rådgivning Nätverkande på event och aktiviteter för att få möjligheter att utöka ditt nätverk Varmt välkommen till vårt nätverk! Om du är intresserad av att bli en del av Clarifys nätverk och få tillgång till uppdrag uppdrag via oss, tveka inte att höra av dig!
