items.desc: Future Horizons sta attualmente supportando una società tecnologica italiana nata all’interno di un famoso Gruppo bancario e divenuta realtà indipendente nel 2019, che ha come obiettivo quello di sviluppare soluzioni innovative per il mondo bancario e finanziario. Negli ultimi anni si sono distinti per un forte investimento strategico nell’ambito dei dati e dell’intelligenza artificiale, creando un Competence Center AI di gruppo focalizzato sull’applicazione concreta di tecniche avanzate di Machine Learning e AI a supporto dei processi core bancari. Il contesto in cui opera è caratterizzato da elevati requisiti di affidabilità, sicurezza e compliance, rendendo l’innovazione tecnologica particolarmente sfidante e di grande valore. Il progetto nasce dalla necessità di costruire un presidio solido, strutturato e continuativo sul territorio italiano, capace di supportare in modo diretto e integrato le esigenze di business delle diverse aree del gruppo. In questo contesto, il cliente ha avviato un vero e proprio programma di Data Science e AI, non limitato a una singola iniziativa progettuale ma pensato come un percorso articolato su più use case, domini applicativi e tecnologie. Il programma coinvolge ambiti quali marketing analytics, supporto alle funzioni di controllo, automazione dei processi, modelli predittivi avanzati e casi d’uso di Generative AI basati su Large Language Model. L’approccio è fortemente orientato alla sperimentazione controllata , alla ricerca applicata e alla messa in produzione di soluzioni scalabili e monitorabili nel tempo. Future Horizons quindi cerca un Data Scientist che affiancherà i team del cliente all’interno del programma di Data Science e AI, contribuendo attivamente alle diverse fasi dei progetti. Il consulente opererà a stretto contatto con il Competence Center AI, supportando le attività di data engineering, data exploration e data preparation, nonché lo sviluppo di modelli di Machine Learning sia supervised che unsupervised, in linea con le esigenze dei diversi stakeholder interni. Il ruolo prevede inoltre il supporto alla realizzazione di use case di Generative AI basati su LLM, collaborando allo sviluppo di soluzioni prototipali e alla loro evoluzione verso contesti produttivi. Attraverso lo sviluppo di API, script e componenti applicative, il consulente contribuirà a rendere operativi e manutenibili i modelli nel tempo, con l’obiettivo di aumentare il livello di maturità tecnica e industriale delle soluzioni AI del cliente. Competenze Richieste: Solida esperienza nello sviluppo di soluzioni di Data Science utilizzando Python come linguaggio principale; Ottima conoscenza di SQL e capacità di lavorare su basi dati strutturate e semi-strutturate; Padronanza delle principali tecniche di Machine Learning e Data Mining , sia supervised che unsupervised. Esperienza nell’utilizzo delle principali librerie Python per l’analytics e il Machine Learning, come pandas, numpy e scikit-learn . Conoscenza dei principi di modellazione predittiva e valutazione delle performance dei modelli . Esperienza, anche progettuale, nell’utilizzo di Large Language Model e nella realizzazione di use case di Generative AI . Familiarità con concetti e strumenti di MLOps , inclusi deployment e monitoring dei modelli. Conoscenza di framework e architetture Big Data , come Spark, Hadoop o Kafka . Esperienza nell’utilizzo di ambienti cloud, containerizzazione con Docker e sistemi Unix . Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese e capacità di lavorare in team multidisciplinari in contesti complessi. Dettagli Contrattuali: Sede di lavoro: Hybrid Remote (1/2gg a settimana on site a Torino) Tipologia Contrattuale: Consulente Autonomo Libero Professionista (Partita Iva) Engagement: Full Time Durata: Ingaggio iniziale di 6 mesi, con alta probabilità di estensioni progettuali

items.desc: Si pour vous l’intelligence artificielle est avant tout un levier pour créer des interactions fluides, utiles et humaines , alors on est fait pour être ensemble ! Envie d’en savoir plus ? Au sein des équipes Bouygues Telecom Services, vous intégrez une cellule dédiée à l’innovation et à la transformation des parcours de Relation Client par l’intelligence artificielle . En tant que Développeur / Créateur d’Agents IA Voix et Chat, vous êtes en charge de concevoir, développer et faire évoluer des agents conversationnels intelligents destinés à interagir avec les clients sur les canaux voix et digitaux. Votre rôle est clé pour garantir des interactions automatisées performantes, naturelles et alignées avec les exigences de qualité, de satisfaction client et de performance opérationnelle. Votre mission consiste à : Concevoir et développer des agents conversationnels IA (voix et chat) basés sur des technologies d’IA générative ; Définir et implémenter des parcours conversationnels répondant aux besoins métiers et aux attentes clients ; Utiliser des frameworks et plateformes de développement , notamment des solutions low-code comme Illuin ; Tester, analyser et optimiser en continu les agents IA afin d’améliorer la compréhension, la pertinence des réponses et le taux de résolution ; Enrichir les connaissances et scénarios conversationnels pour garantir des réponses cohérentes, adaptées et conformes aux standards de la relation client. À travers ces missions, vous contribuez directement à transformer la relation client en proposant des interactions intelligentes, performantes et centrées sur l’expérience utilisateur, au cœur des enjeux d’innovation. Votre profil : Vous justifiez d’une expérience en développement d’agents conversationnels , de chatbots, de voicebots ou plus largement de solutions basées sur l’intelligence artificielle. Vous possédez de solides bases en Python et JavaScript , et êtes à l’aise avec l’utilisation des API, des services web et les enjeux d’intégration au sein de systèmes existants. items.desc: Jouw baan Bij CZ werken we met betekenis, daadkracht en als één team. We nemen verantwoordelijkheid, tonen lef, blijven leren en maken impact. Samen zetten we ons elke dag in voor toegankelijke en betaalbare zorg voor iedereen. In Jouw Rol Ontwikkel en onderhoud je beleid, richtlijnen en standaarden op het gebied van data governance en AI governance. Vertaal je interne en externe ontwikkelingen, wet- en regelgeving en toezichteisen naar concrete werkwijzen, processen en activiteiten. Adviseer je management, productteams en stakeholders over verantwoord gebruik van data en AI. Werk je samen met data-eigenaren, data stewards, architecten, security-, risk- en privacyspecialisten om governance praktisch toepasbaar te maken. Help je teams bij het implementeren van governance-kaders en stimuleer je een cultuur waarin verantwoord datagebruik vanzelfsprekend is. Signaleer je kansen en risico's rondom de inzet van AI en denk je mee over hoe CZ nieuwe AI-mogelijkheden veilig en beheerst kan realiseren. Draag je bij aan het vergroten van de AI- en data-volwassenheid binnen de organisatie. Monitor je de naleving van governance-afspraken en stuur je op continue verbetering. Jouw team Jij bent van groot belang Je komt terecht binnen het centrale team dat verantwoordelijkheid draagt voor de verdere ontwikkeling van data- en AI-governance binnen CZ. Samen werken we aan de fundamenten die nodig zijn om data en AI verantwoord en effectief in te zetten. Je werkt intensief samen met collega's uit verschillende disciplines, waaronder architectuur, security, compliance, risk, privacy, data management, dataplatformteams en businessdomeinen. De vraagstukken waaraan je werkt hebben vaak impact op meerdere afdelingen en raken direct aan de strategische ambities van CZ op het gebied van data, AI en digitale innovatie. De omgeving waarin je werkt is dynamisch en volop in ontwikkeling. Dat vraagt om mensen die kunnen schakelen tussen strategie en uitvoering, verbinding kunnen creëren en energie krijgen van verandering. Jouw voordelen Dit krijg je van ons Arbeidsvoorwaarden Data- en AI-governance zijn volop in ontwikkeling. Je stapt dus niet in een volledig uitgekauwde rol, maar krijgt ruimte om kaders, beleid en werkwijzen verder vorm te geven. Je houdt je niet alleen bezig met bestaande data governance, maar bouwt ook mee aan hoe CZ verantwoord omgaat met AI. Je krijgt volop ruimte om te leren en te groeien, met toegang tot de CZ Campus en een vergoeding voor relevante opleidingen en trainingen. Je reist op een manier die bij jou past, met een reiskostenvergoeding of een NS Business Card. Ook stimuleren we duurzaam reizen met een aantrekkelijke fietsregeling. Bij CZ werk je hybride: deels vanuit huis en deels op kantoor. In overleg met je leidinggevende werk je ongeveer 50% van je contracturen thuis. We ondersteunen je met een goede ergonomische thuiswerkplek én een internetvergoeding van € 2,50 netto per thuiswerkdag. Bekijk het complete aanbod Jouw profiel Dit neem je mee naar onze organisatie HBO+ of WO werk- en denkniveau. Minimaal enkele jaren ervaring met data governance, AI governance, datamanagement of een vergelijkbaar vakgebied. Ervaring met beleidsontwikkeling én praktische implementatie binnen complexe organisaties. Kennis van governance- en datamanagementprincipes, zoals DAMA-DMBOK, datakwaliteit, metadata, data lineage en dataclassificatie. Affiniteit met AI, Generatieve AI en ontwikkelingen rond verantwoorde AI. Begrip van relevante wet- en regelgeving en de vertaling ervan naar uitvoerbare maatregelen. Sterke adviesvaardigheden en het vermogen stakeholders mee te nemen in verandering. Je bent analytisch sterk en houdt oog voor praktische toepasbaarheid. Je verbindt mensen, creëert draagvlak en brengt structuur in complexe vraagstukken. Ervaring binnen een sterk gereguleerde omgeving, zoals zorg of financiële sector, is een pré. Onze vragen Een motivatiebrief is niet nodig, in plaats daarvan ontvangen we graag jouw antwoord op de volgende drie vragen: Geef een voorbeeld van beleid of governance-kaders die je hebt ontwikkeld én succesvol geïmplementeerd. Welke ontwikkelingen zie jij rond AI governance en wat betekenen die voor organisaties zoals CZ? Beschrijf hoe je stakeholders met verschillende belangen hebt meegenomen in een governance- of verandertraject en draagvlak hebt gecreëerd. Ons sollicitatieproces Zo leren wij jou kennen en jij ons Bij CZ vinden we een objectief en eerlijk selectieproces van groot belang. Focus op competenties en skills en daarbij een match vinden tussen jouw kwaliteiten en de best passende functie. Dit doen we via een sollicitatieprocedure die daar bij aansluit. Ontdek het hier! Heb je vragen over deze vacature? Neem dan gerust contact op met Martijn via email martijn.musters@cz.nl. Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld . Mail Wil je meer informatie over de vacature of CZ? Bel of app (graag zelfs!) dan met Janneke van Loon (Recruiter), op telefoonnummer …

items.desc: Why Faculty? We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here. We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence. Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology. AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen. Why the Faculty Fellowship? Artificial Intelligence is the defining technology of our age, but it is only valuable when applied to the real world. Since 2014, Faculty has helped over 500 PhDs, postdocs and engineers transition into high-impact careers in data science and machine learning. How It Works 2 Weeks of Intensive Training: Learn to apply your advanced technical knowledge to real-world data science problems. 6 Week Paid Placement: Tackle a commercial data science project with a host company (paid at the London Living Wage). Demo Day Finale: Present your work to 100+ guests and industry leaders from across the UK and Europe. Where our alumni go : Our alumni have gone on to shape the future at companies like Google, Meta, Tesco, and AstraZeneca, as well as disruptive startups like PhysicsX and Orbital Witness. We are also incredibly proud that a high percentage of fellows choose to continue their journey internally, joining the Faculty team permanently. This intensive, eight-week programme bridges academia and real-world impact, embedding you directly into high-stakes commercial environments. You will apply advanced machine learning techniques to solve complex, ambiguous problems for our clients, turning theoretical knowledge into high-value deployable solutions. It is a fast-paced launchpad designed to accelerate your technical growth, build exceptional commercial acumen, and empower you to shape the future of artificial intelligence in an ambitious, forward-thinking tech community. Who We're Looking For You hold a finished PhD or Master’s degree in a STEM subject, complemented by a strong foundation in data science or machine learning. You possess a high level of mathematical competence alongside solid experience with theoretical concepts like hypothesis testing, Bayesian inference, and neural networks. You demonstrate strong programming skills, particularly in Python, and feel comfortable navigating core data science coding libraries. You bring an entrepreneurial mindset, showing the resilience and autonomy needed to structure your own project plans and hit critical deadlines. You can communicate complex technical ideas clearly, adapting your language seamlessly for both technical peers and non-technical partners. You thrive in fast-paced, ambitious environments, showing curiosity and a relentless drive to learn and deploy new technologies. If your eligibility is based on a visa, just pop the details of your situation into your application so we can review it. To learn more about your options, check out www.gov.uk. Please keep in mind that Faculty is unable to provide or reimburse accommodation and travel expenses. Our Timelines 17th November 2026 (17:00 BST): Application Deadline. Mid November: Coding tests sent via email. End of November: Interviews held remotely online. 18th December: Final notifications sent to all applicants. Damit ist Progroup einer der größten Produzenten von Wellpappen­rohpapier und Wellpapp­formaten auf dem europäischen Markt. Das sind deine Aufgaben KI-Anwendungen: Du entwickelst und betreibst KI-gestützte Assistenzsysteme für Produktion und Technik nach dem Prinzip „Fragen statt Suchen“. Datenanalyse: Du erschließt und strukturierst Prozess-, Qualitäts- und Betriebsdaten und schaffst belastbare Datengrundlagen für datenbasierte Entscheidungen. Prozessmodelle: Du entwickelst, validierst und optimierst Modelle für Papiereigenschaften, Chemikalieneinsatz und Wasserkreisläufe. Handlungsempfehlungen: Du leitest aus Prozessdaten konkrete Maßnahmen ab und machst komplexe Zusammenhänge für Produktion und Technik verständlich nutzbar. Regelungskonzepte: Du überführst validierte Modelle gemeinsam mit Produktion und Automatisierung in Steuerungs- und Regelungskonzepte. Prozessoptimierung: Du analysierst Qualitäts- und Prozessabweichungen, planst Versuche und identifizierst Verbesserungspotenziale. Wissenstransfer: Du arbeitest eng mit Produktion, Technologie, Instandhaltung und IT zusammen und rollst erfolgreiche Lösungen standortübergreifend aus. Das bringst du mit Qualifikation: Du hast ein Studium der Verfahrenstechnik, Papiertechnik, Automatisierungstechnik, Informatik, Data Science, Physik, des Wirtschaftsingenieurwesens oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Berufserfahrung: Du verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrung in einer technischen Funktion der Prozessindustrie, idealerweise in der Papier- oder Zellstoffindustrie. Datenkompetenz: Du hast umfangreiche Erfahrung in der Analyse und Interpretation großer Prozess-, Qualitäts- oder Produktionsdatensätze. Modellierung: Du entwickelst datenbasierte Modelle sicher und bringst diese erfolgreich in den operativen Betrieb. KI & Statistik: Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse in Data Science, Machine Learning, Statistik und Versuchsplanung. Python & Datenbanken: Du arbeitest sicher mit Python, Datenbanksystemen und Werkzeugen zur Datenanalyse und Visualisierung. Prozessverständnis: Du denkst analytisch, arbeitest eigeninitiativ und begeisterst dich für prozesstechnische Zusammenhänge und neue Technologien. Deine Vorteile bei uns Faire Bezahlung, die sich lohnt: Dein Einsatz wird mit einer attraktiven Vergütung belohnt. Zukunft gesichert: Du arbeitest in einem wachstumsstarken Unternehmen mit langfristiger Perspektive. Sicher arbeiten – von Anfang an: Deine Sicherheit steht bei uns an erster Stelle. Du erhältst von uns hochwertige Arbeitsbekleidung und Schutzschuhe (u.a. der Marken CWS, UVEX). Zeit zur Erholung: Mit 30 Tagen Urlaub pro Jahr sorgen wir dafür, dass du ausreichend Zeit zum Abschalten und Auftanken hast. Stressfrei zur Arbeit: Kostenfreie Parkplätze direkt am Standort ersparen dir die tägliche Parkplatzsuche. Gesundheit im Fokus: Mit unserer zusätzlichen Gesundheitsversicherung erhältst du ein Budget von 300 €, das du ganz nach deinen Bedürfnissen einsetzen kannst. Nachhaltig mobil unterwegs: Mit dem „JobRad“ kannst du dir und sogar deiner Partner*in ganz bequem dein Wunschfahrrad leasen und dabei Kosten sparen. items.title: Finance Data Scientist
items.card: About The Role This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of finance, technology and data. You will be part of a diverse, commercially focused and data-driven team, helping improve financial planning, forecasting and performance analysis. Your work will provide greater transparency around business performance and help senior stakeholders make well-informed strategic decisions.
items.desc: Job Requirements At Siemens Healthineers, we pioneer breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably. We are looking for a Finance Data Scientist to join our Magnetic Resonance business and help us turn complex financial and operational data into insight that makes a real difference. This is an opportunity to combine finance, data science, analytics and business strategy, working with colleagues across Finance, operations and the wider business to enable smarter decisions and sustainable performance. About The Role This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of finance, technology and data. You will be part of a diverse, commercially focused and data-driven team, helping improve financial planning, forecasting and performance analysis. Your work will provide greater transparency around business performance and help senior stakeholders make well-informed strategic decisions. What makes this opportunity different is its breadth. You'll be able to combine financial understanding with data science, analytics, automation and AI, using technology to solve real business problems rather than working with data in isolation. Whether you are developing analytical models, simplifying a finance process or translating complex data into a clear business recommendation, you will have the opportunity to see how your work contributes to growth, profitability and better decision-making. What You'll Be Doing Lead initiatives to simplify, standardise, automate and digitalise finance processes, reducing manual work and improving productivity and data quality. Develop practical digital solutions using Microsoft 365, Power Platform, Copilot agents, workflow automation and other approved technologies. Design and develop management information, dashboards and KPI reporting for Finance and operational stakeholders. Build and maintain statistical and machine learning models, bringing together information from different systems to uncover actionable insights. Develop data products and support greater adoption of self-service analytics across the organisation. Translate Finance and business requirements into effective analytical and digital solutions. Support the development and monitoring of manufacturing and financial performance indicators and provide analytical support for business improvement initiatives. Help strengthen data quality, security and accessibility while ensuring solutions are scalable, maintainable and appropriately governed. Establish effective support and maintenance approaches so the tools you create deliver sustainable, long-term value. Act as a Finance subject-matter expert, applying sound judgement when validating outputs from models, dashboards and AI tools before they are used to inform business decisions. Work Experience You'll be someone who is curious about both how the business performs and how technology can help it perform better. We're Looking For a Combination Of The Following Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience using data to understand business or financial performance. The ability to interpret financial performance, challenge assumptions and clearly explain the drivers behind variances to Finance and non-Finance colleagues. Experience analysing and improving business processes and leading or contributing to digital transformation projects. Strong project management, documentation and process-management skills. Confidence communicating and collaborating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Experience with Microsoft Copilot or AI-enabled automation. Experience with SAP or another major ERP platform. Knowledge of SAP S/4HANA, including FI/CO, product costing or material ledger, would be advantageous. Knowledge or experience of SQL, Python, Snowflake, data modelling or data engineering concepts. Experience with Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Automate, Power Apps or Power Query. Experience using Power BI and data visualisation to make complex information accessible and meaningful. Just as importantly, you'll bring a collaborative, solution-focused mindset. You'll be comfortable connecting Finance, IT and business teams, combining accounting rigour with analytical curiosity and looking for practical opportunities to make processes and decisions better. You don't need to see yourself as an expert in every technology listed above. If you can bring strong foundations, curiosity and the motivation to learn, we'd be interested in hearing what you could bring to the role. Benefits Competitive base salary 26 days annual leave with the option to buy up to 10 and sell up to 5 Up to 10% matched pension contributions BUPA Private Medical Bonus & Share Save Scheme Free to use on-site gym 2 paid volunteering days a year Beyond the benefits package, this role offers the opportunity to work across Finance, data and technology, engage with stakeholders across the business and use advanced analytics, automation and AI …

Prezentovat své návrhy a reportovat výsledky před klienty (často i v angličtině ). Spolupracovat s ostatními specialisty, kreativci, analytiky a stratégy. 👀 Jak si tě představujeme: Máš alespoň 2 roky praxe ve správě výkonnostních kampaní. AI nástroje jako Claude nebo Gemini využíváš na repetitivní úkoly, pro hlubší analýzy dat a máš nastavené vlastní automatizace, skills nebo artefakty. Máš v malíku nástroje jako jsou Google Ads, Meta, Sklik, Bing a další. DotiDot a Mergado jsou výhodou. Umíš pracovat s GA4 a Looker Studiem. Jsi komunikativní , umíš si stát za svou prací a dobře argumentovat před klientem. Dokážeš tvořit strategii a vyhodnocovat kampaně na míru klientovi. Samostatně řídíš svěřené kampaně, které máš možnost konzultovat se seniorními specialisty. Neseš odpovědnost za výsledky svěřených kampaní a dodáváš je v dohodnuté kvalitě a termínech. Analytické a strategické myšlení využíváš denně při své práci na kampaních a s AI nástroji. Angličtina ti nedělá problém a zvládneš komunikaci i s native speakerem. 💙 Proč jsme ta správná volba Budeš spolupracovat s dynamickou digitální agenturou Marketup na kampaních pro velké klienty. Máme AI focus skupiny , kde ti dáme prostor pro tvoje nápady a inovace pod vedením našich zkušených AI specialistů. Věříme v otevřenou týmovou kulturu. Posuneme tvoje automatizace a práci s AI na další level. Máme hybridní formu spolupráce a kanceláře na Andělu v Praze. Vzdělávání a rozvoj soft i hard skills je pro nás důležité, a proto rádi podpoříme tvou odbornost školením, kurzem, konferencí či workshopem. Rádi tě uvidíme na společných neformálních akcích, protože work-life balance pro nás není jen fráze. Dočetl/a jsi až sem a říkáš si: „Tohle je přesně pro mě“? Přidej se k nám do Media Teamu!

items.desc: Jouw veld van expertise Als MLOps Engineer speel je een cruciale rol in het creëren van machine learning-omgevingen die waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Je werkt aan het bouwen en deployen van ML-platformen, het opzetten en beheren van ML-modellen, en het verzekeren van veilige toegang tot data. Zo zet jij een goed ingericht, veilige ML-omgeving op die de basis vormt voor data-gedreven inzichten. Dit doe je met tools zoals Databricks en/of Azure ML. En met behulp van MLFlow beheer je de volledige cyclus van ML-modellen. Jouw expertise zorgt ervoor dat experimenten soepel verlopen, en dat alles van staging tot productie optimaal draait. Wat jij kunt doen als exper Door jouw expertise wordt de kracht van ML optimaal ingezet in een stabiele en veilige omgevingen bij diverse klanten, denk bijvoorbeeld aan de zorgsector of pensioenfonds. Daarnaast kan jij intern waarde toevoegen door kennis te delen en uit te breiden via workshops, kennis sessies en focusavonden. Waar je op kunt bouw Plan zelf je reis naar werkgeluk en vorm jouw eigen ultieme carrière in overleg met je Employee Success Manager Aandacht voor work-life balance, bijvoorbeeld de mogelijkheid om 32 uur per week te werken. Wij geloven niet in hokjesdenken. Daarom hebben wij géén functiehuizen, salarisschalen of vaste profielen. Direct een contract voor onbepaalde tijd. Benieuwd naar wat we jou nog meer beloven ? Klik hier. Azure opdrachten bij grote bedrijven in technisch complexe en hybride omgevingen. Een team van meer dan 80 senior en gespecialiseerde collega’s die hun kennis met je delen. Mogelijkheden om te verbreden of te verdiepen binnen data of daarbuiten. Of om gewoon nóg beter te worden in wat je doen. Welke bouwstenen neem je mee Minimaal een afgeronde HBO-opleiding Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring met ML.Vaardigheid in Python, PySpark, SQL, en Bash Scripting. Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal, zowel in woord als geschrift. Kennis van Data Engineering is een sterke pré (Azure DevOps, Azure Data Factory, Fabric, Databricks).

items.desc: Hudson River Trading (HRT) is seeking highly motivated full-time students to join our Data Science Summer Internship Program. Data is a cornerstone of HRT’s trading strategies, serving as the raw fuel that powers research, automated trading, and risk management. While Algorithm Developers focus on statistical modeling and Software Engineers focus on the systems that power our trading, HRT Data Scientists focus on extracting useful information from the vast volume of data available in the world. Data Scientists are responsible for normalizing and validating vendor data, extracting features from quantitative and textual data, applying rigorous quality checks, and investigating methodologies for providing the highest quality data for research and trading. What to Expect A hands-on introduction to data, modeling, and engineering practices in the algorithmic trading industry Independent data investigation projects in Python using open-source libraries such as pandas and polars Opportunities to learn all about HRT's research and trading infrastructure, even in areas you may not be working in directly Technical project work and mentorship, with the opportunity to gain a deeper understanding of global financial markets Plenty of opportunities to connect with fellow interns, participate in team events, and explore the unique culture, food, and experiences that make each HRT office location and cities special Qualifications You are a full-time student pursuing a degree in a STEM field — a computer science background is not required Programming experience with Python at the level of “Python for Data Analysis” by Wes McKinney A curiosity for working with data and finding insights Independent data projects, kaggle competitions, and such are a plus Exceptional attention to detail Strong communication skills We offer a weekly base salary offer in addition to a competitive signing bonus, company-paid housing, meals, and other perks. New York: Weekly base salary of 5,800 USD London: Weekly base salary of 4,350 GBP We do not allow multiple applications. Please apply to the ONE role you are most interested in and we will consider you for all open positions when reviewing your application. Culture Hudson River Trading (HRT) brings a scientific approach to trading financial products. We have built one of the world's most sophisticated computing environments for research and development. Our researchers are at the forefront of innovation in the world of algorithmic trading. At HRT we welcome a variety of expertise: mathematics and computer science, physics and engineering, media and tech. We’re a community of self-starters who are motivated by the excitement of being at the cutting edge of automation in every part of our organization—from trading, to business operations, to recruiting and beyond. We value openness and transparency, and celebrate great ideas from HRT veterans and new hires alike. At HRT we’re friends and colleagues – whether we are sharing a meal, playing the latest board game, or writing elegant code. We embrace a culture of togetherness that extends far beyond the walls of our office. Feel like you belong at HRT? Our goal is to find the best people and bring them together to do great work in a place where everyone is valued. HRT is proud of our diverse staff; we have offices all over the globe and benefit from our varied and unique perspectives. HRT is an equal opportunity employer; so whoever you are we’d love to get to know you. items.card: you will help determine which approaches work best, designing and executing experiments that influence critical architectural decisions. You will work closely with senior technical stakeholders, exploring emerging technologies and translating experimental findings into scalable, production-ready systems. Key Responsibilities AI/ML Experimentation: Design, develop, and execute large-scale experiments to evaluate AI
items.desc: The Opportunity We are working with a highly successful, globally established organisation that is making significant investments in Artificial Intelligence and next-generation technology. The company is building a sophisticated, enterprise-wide AI platform designed to transform how its engineering and technology teams develop, deploy, and leverage AI-powered solutions. We are seeking an Applied AI Engineer to join a specialist AI Architecture team responsible for shaping the technical direction of this platform. This is a highly technical, hands-on position combining AI engineering, experimentation, software development, and systems architecture. Rather than simply implementing existing AI solutions, you will help determine which approaches work best, designing and executing experiments that influence critical architectural decisions. You will work closely with senior technical stakeholders, exploring emerging technologies and translating experimental findings into scalable, production-ready systems. Key Responsibilities AI/ML Experimentation: Design, develop, and execute large-scale experiments to evaluate AI technologies, architectures, and engineering approaches. Establish clear hypotheses, benchmarks, success criteria, and reproducible results. LLM & Agentic AI Systems: Investigate and evaluate advanced AI capabilities, including Large Language Models (LLMs), agentic workflows, tool orchestration, and AI execution frameworks. Retrieval & Context Engineering: Explore and optimise retrieval systems, embeddings, context management strategies, and techniques for improving AI application performance. AI Platform Development: Design and contribute to production-grade AI infrastructure, including evaluation frameworks, retrieval services, model routing, and monitoring capabilities. Performance Optimisation: Assess AI system performance, scalability, reliability, and efficiency, identifying opportunities to improve architecture and execution. Technical Research & Evaluation: Investigate emerging AI tools, frameworks, and methodologies, providing evidence-based recommendations on technology selection and architectural direction. Architecture & Engineering Collaboration: Work closely with platform architects and engineering teams to translate research findings into practical, scalable solutions. Technical Documentation: Produce clear technical reports, experimental findings, and recommendations that inform platform strategy and engineering decisions. Required Skills & Experience Strong software engineering background, with advanced proficiency in Python . Hands-on experience developing AI/ML applications, infrastructure, or supporting systems. Solid understanding of machine learning fundamentals, including statistical learning, classical ML techniques, transformers, and modern LLM architectures. Experience with AI-related infrastructure such as retrieval systems, evaluation frameworks, model monitoring, or sandbox execution environments. Strong understanding of systems programming, performance optimisation, and scalable software architecture. Familiarity with modern AI development approaches, including agentic systems, tool orchestration, embeddings, and context engineering. Ability to design rigorous technical experiments, establish benchmarks, interpret results, and communicate findings effectively. Understanding of AI platform architecture and the ability to translate research and experimentation into practical engineering decisions. Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with a willingness to explore technically complex problems where established solutions may not exist. The Ideal Candidate We are particularly interested in engineers who combine strong software engineering capabilities with a research-oriented mindset . You may currently be working as an Applied AI Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, AI Platform Engineer, Research Engineer, or Software Engineer specialising in AI infrastructure. You enjoy understanding how technologies work beneath the surface, challenging assumptions, benchmarking alternative approaches, and building solutions grounded in measurable results. You are equally comfortable conducting technical experiments and developing robust, production-quality software.

items.desc: We offer you an Ocean of Possibilities. Join our family. About Us The Research, Development & Innovation department of Damen helps the company to become the most sustainable and digitally connected shipyard in the world. We give support to the business in the development of an innovative product portfolio and offer pro-active advice with the aim of further improving the quality and performance of the Damen products and services. The RD&I department is divided into Research, Development, and Enabling Technologies branches. There are eight research teams. Damen invests substantially in its own internal R&D projects. Moreover, we are also very active in collaborative R&D projects with industry partners, as well as academia and knowledge institutes, both nationally and internationally. The role As a student working for the automation research team, you will work on novel technologies related to autonomous shipping. This includes both full autonomy and captain support systems, which are steppingstones towards full autonomy. Autonomous shipping is a relatively broad knowledge area, including topics such as vessel dynamics and control, sensing and sensor fusion, collision avoidance, remote command and control, simulations, human-machine interfacing, and development of modular hardware and software to make it all work together. Depending on your background we will together choose the best topic for you to work on. We can accommodate both internships and graduation projects for MSc students. Key Accountabilities You will be responsible for answering a specific research question (e.g., what sensors to use for autodocking), or for the development of a tool for RD&I (e.g., set up an autonomy simulator in ROS). You may perform simulations, or work with our static sensor setup, model boat in a water basin, or our full-size test vessel, depending on the specific assignment. We are curious to hear what sparks your interest! You will have one of our researchers as your daily supervisor, who will make sure the executed work fits Damen’s expectations. Skills & Experience At least several skills/experiences from the following list are required to be considered: Master student with a strong background in a topic from the following list: control, robotics, mathematics, mechatronics, (embedded) software, HMI design; Proficient in simulation skills (e.g. Python), robotics control (ROS), and/or other low-level language skills (I.e., C, C++); Hands-on experience with technology such as W-band radar, longwave infrared and/or standardized protocols (I.e., NMEA); Able to work with algorithms, tracking and fusion, and calibration processes; All work is conducted in English, therefore fluency is required; You are available for a minimum of six months and able to work on site in Gorinchem, where all assignments for this team take place. What We Offer An internship/ graduation fee and travel allowance will be paid for the duration of the assignment. A pleasant and dynamic, international work environment with informal atmosphere Mentoring at academic level will be available throughout the internship. Other Please provide a motivation letter that includes your preferred starting date and availability. The assignment is available year round, so we are flexible! Also, let us know what topic you want to take on – either as an internship or thesis project, as we have multiple areas of expertise. Without mentioning this, we cannot take your application into consideration. Are you ready to sail into your new adventure at Damen? Don’t hesitate, send us your motivation letter and resume here. Due to housing issues we cannot accept international students that do not have accommodation in the Netherlands yet. Recruiter Liselotte van Veenendaal Email liselotte.van.veenendaal@damen.com Please apply through the Apply Button. Due to GDPR reasons we cannot accept applications by email.

items.desc:
Introduction 
 Within ASML’s EUV Factory organization in Veldhoven, the team is responsible for managing and reviewing customer infrastructure documentation required before system installation. These documents describe critical requirements related to utilities, facilities, cooling, power, and other installation interfaces. Today, reviewing and validating these large document packages is a manual process that can take up to three weeks and requires extensive expert effort. Because even small mistakes can lead to quality risks, delays, and significant costs, the team is looking for opportunities to improve both speed and accuracy. During this internship, you will explore how Artificial Intelligence can help automate document reviews and support faster, more reliable decision-making.
 Your assignment 
 In this internship, you will investigate how AI can be applied to automate the review of customer requirement documentation. You will develop a proof of concept that demonstrates how AI can identify inconsistencies, implementation errors, and review findings that currently require significant manual effort. Working closely with stakeholders across multiple teams, you will evaluate where automation adds value and where expert review remains necessary. Your main responsibilities will be:
 Develop a proof of concept for AI-supported document review
 Build Python-based solutions to detect inconsistencies and errors
 Evaluate which review activities can be automated and which require expert input
 Validate the performance and reliability of AI-generated review results
 Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and feedback
 Deliver recommendations for scaling and implementing the solution
 This is a bachelor/master (non-thesis) internship for minimum 5 months, minimum 4 days per week (4 days on-site, flexibility where needed). The start date of this internship is as of February 2027.
 Your profile 
 To be suitable for the internship, you:
 Are pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
 Have experience with Python programming
 Have knowledge of AI, machine learning, or AI-powered development tools through projects, coursework, or personal initiatives
 Are analytical, independent, and proactive in driving your work forward
 Have strong attention to detail and are comfortable working with technical documentation
 Communicate clearly in English and collaborate effectively with different stakeholders
 Other requirements you need to meet: 
 You are enrolled at an educational institute for the entire duration of the internship, and you are at least 18 years old at the start of the internship; 
 If you are a non-EU citizen, studying in the Netherlands, your university is willing to sign the documents relevant for doing an internship (i.e., Nuffic agreement); 
 You attach your cover letter with a clear motivation on why you are interested in this internship assignment in particular; 
 You need to be located in the Netherlands to be perform your internship. In case you are currently living/studying outside of the Netherlands, your application shows the willingness to relocate.

Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to access such controlled technology prior to beginning work. items.desc:
Introduction
 The Leveling department within Development and Engineering at ASML develops advanced wafer measurement solutions that support nanometer-level accuracy in semiconductor manufacturing. This internship focuses on improving the understanding of machine failures through data-driven analysis of event logs. You will help transform complex and noisy machine data into meaningful insights that support system reliability and performance. Your work will contribute to identifying recurring failure patterns and enabling more effective failure classification. This internship offers the opportunity to combine artificial intelligence, machine learning, and data mining in a highly innovative engineering environment.
 Your assignment
 During this internship, you will develop methods to analyze machine event logs and identify patterns related to machine failures. You will design and evaluate machine learning approaches that classify failure modes and uncover valuable insights from historical machine data. The results of your work may support engineers in understanding failure behaviour across multiple systems and improving future diagnostics. 
 Your main responsibilities will be:
 Develop algorithms to clean, compress, and structure noisy machine event data.
 Identify recurring failure signatures using data mining and machine learning techniques.
 Build and evaluate supervised and unsupervised classification models.
 Validate findings using historical data and expert feedback.
 Investigate similarities and differences between failure patterns across machines.
 Assess the practical value of the proposed solution for engineering use cases.
 Present results and recommendations to engineers and researchers.
 This is a master's thesis/non-thesis internship for a minimum of 6 months, 5 days per week (3 days on-site). 
 The start date of this internship is as of February 2027 or earlier, depending on your availability.

 Are pursuing a master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Electrical Engineering, Systems & Control, or a related technical field.
 Have experience with Python and machine learning techniques.
 Have knowledge of data analysis, classification methods, feature engineering, and model evaluation.
 Are analytical and enjoy solving complex technical challenges using data.
 Are collaborative, proactive, and able to communicate technical findings clearly.
 This internship is based in the Eindhoven region of the Netherlands. You will work closely with experienced engineers and researchers while contributing to meaningful challenges in the semiconductor industry. The assignment provides an opportunity to apply your academic knowledge to real-world engineering problems and gain hands-on experience in artificial intelligence, machine learning, and data-driven decision-making. items.desc:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Applied AI Engineering team helps organizations turn frontier AI capabilities into safe, reliable, and high-impact production systems. We work with customer executives, product and engineering teams, security leaders, and transformation teams to identify valuable opportunities, accelerate technical implementation, and scale what works.

Enterprise deployments are defined by complexity rather than any one industry: existing architectures, diverse data environments, security and governance requirements, multiple stakeholder groups, and organization-wide change. We turn lessons from these deployments into better products and reusable patterns for customers everywhere.

About the Role

As an Applied AI Engineer, you will partner directly with Digital Native companies to design, build and deploy AI-powered products and systems. Working alongside customer product and engineering teams, you will take ideas from early experimentation through evaluation, production launch and scale, connecting technical decisions to user experience and measurable business impact.

You will write and debug code, build evaluation systems, resolve complex integrations, and guide decisions involving model behavior, reliability, latency, cost, safety, security, governance, and operational readiness. Success is measured by production systems, sustained adoption, and meaningful customer impact—not simply activity or successful demonstrations.

This is a rare opportunity to work on consequential real-world deployments at the frontier of AI while directly influencing how OpenAI’s products evolve.

This role is based in London. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees

In this role, you will:

 - Partner directly with Digital Native customers to identify high-value opportunities and translate them into technical architectures, implementation plans, evaluation strategies, and measurable success criteria.

 - Design, build, and deploy AI systems that solve important customer problems and produce measurable business outcomes.

 - Work hands-on in code to build prototypes, evaluation harnesses, reference implementations, integrations, and production accelerators.

 - Make sound technical decisions across models, agents, retrieval, tools, data, reliability, observability, latency, cost, safety, security, and governance.

 - Diagnose complex implementation challenges, reproduce failures, test hypotheses, and drive blockers toward resolution.

 - Help customers progress from promising prototypes to reliable production systems, sustained adoption, and scaled impact.

 - Partner closely with customer engineering teams and OpenAI Product, Research, Engineering, Security, and go-to-market teams, translating deployment experience into high-signal product feedback.

 - Create reusable architectures, tooling, playbooks, and technical guidance that accelerate future enterprise deployments.

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

 - Have a demonstrated track record of designing, building, and delivering AI or machine-learning systems in enterprise environments, including taking systems from prototype to production. Relevant backgrounds may include applied AI or ML engineering, forward-deployed engineering, software engineering, customer engineering, solutions architecture, or technical consulting.

 - Can point to substantial personal contributions in code, architecture, evaluation, debugging, or production engineering—not only program or stakeholder management.

 - Are highly proficient in Python and comfortable working across an AI application stack; experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, or another relevant language is valuable.

 - Understand how to evaluate AI systems systematically using representative data, graders, production signals, and human judgment.

 - Have navigated enterprise production requirements such as integrations, reliability, observability, security, privacy, data governance, performance, and cost.

 - Can connect technical decisions to customer workflows, adoption, and measurable business outcomes.

 - Communicate with clarity and credibility across hands-on engineers, technical leaders, security teams, product leaders, and executives.

 - Bring high agency, strong technical judgment, and end-to-end ownership in ambiguous environments.

 - Learn quickly, challenge assumptions constructively, and collaborate with humility; experience in a particular industry or with OpenAI products is not required.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. Assist in maintaining the governance resource library. Keep policies, standards and guidelines current, version-controlled and updated. Role Qualifications and Requirements: 1+ years of experience in data governance, data quality or metadata management, or in working with data in a data analyst, business analyst or similar role. Strong attention to detail and good organisation. Reliable at tracking actions and following through. Able to work with a wide range of stakeholders, and to escalate early when something is unclear or at risk. Curious, open to change and quick to learn new tools and ways of working. Nice to have: Awareness of DAMA-DMBOK, GDPR, the EU AI Act, or other frameworks. A DAMA CDMP Fundamentals certification is a plus. items.desc:
ABOUT US
 Teton is redefining the role of healthcare workers through cutting-edge AI technology and a great product experience. As populations grow older and staff shortages increase, healthcare systems are under pressure. Our mission is to decrease the cost of healthcare while improving the quality of care.
 Our product enables care teams to intervene, prevent and operate more efficiently. Our ambient sensors in resident rooms capture activity, sleep, respiration, gait and more. These signals are used both to react fast to risk events, like falls, and for long-term health analysis, so care teams can take action.
 Teton is scaling fast, operating in the Nordics, the UK, DACH and the US. We recently raised a $20M Series A. You can expect travel to the US to meet users and team members.
 We focus relentlessly on product excellence and user experience, deploying solutions at speed that make a tangible difference for carers. We are an aspiring meritocracy, biased towards action and always striving to raise the bar. If you are driven by impact, speed and levelling up, this might be the place for you.
 The position is onsite at our office in London, United Kingdom. If you are looking for a 9-to-5 job, perform best with structure and struggle to deal with unknowns, this is not for you. We believe close collaboration within a hard-working, high-agency team enables the fastest and most efficient iteration cycles, helping us build an impactful product that healthcare professionals truly love to use.
 THE JOB
 We're looking for a talented and driven Software Engineer to join our Mobile team, building the tools that care workers rely on during every shift. Our app runs 24/7 in care facilities, delivering real-time alerts and monitoring residents. This isn't a typical app dev role. You'll work across the full stack, from React Native UI to backend infrastructure, in an environment where reliability directly impacts patient safety.
 In this role, you will focus on:
 Feature Development: Own features end-to-end, from design discussions through implementation to production rollout across multiple markets and languages.
 Reliability & Debugging: Keep our real-time alert pipeline rock-solid. Debug push notification delivery on Android and iOS, investigate ANR issues, and troubleshoot weird bugs in care environments with unreliable Wi-Fi.
 Backend, Infrastructure & Systems: Work across backend services, databases, cloud infrastructure and internal platforms to support the systems our app depends on. You will not just consume APIs; you will help shape, improve and fix the systems behind them.
 Testing & Validation: Build automated test coverage (e.g. Maestro for E2E) across a range of devices and OS versions. Validate that alerts arrive when they must.
 Developer Experience: Improve shared components, internal tooling and build pipelines so the team ships faster with fewer surprises.
 QUALIFICATIONS
 Strong TypeScript skills. This is the language for everything we build.
 Solid experience with React Native and Expo in production.
 Comfortable working across the stack: you've touched databases, queues or cloud infrastructure, not just UI.
 Experience with native iOS or Android development (Kotlin/Swift) is a strong plus, as we occasionally need to go below the managed Expo layer.
 Familiarity with real-time systems, push notifications or TanStack is a plus.
 AWS or equivalent cloud platform experience.
 Previous startup experience and/or shipping a product where you owned the outcome.
 Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work both independently and in a team.
 WHAT WE OFFER
 Participation in our warrant program (stock options).
 A small team where your decisions directly shape the product.
 A London-based office with close collaboration, no async-only culture.
 Work on software that healthcare workers depend on every day. The impact is tangible and immediate.
 JOIN OUR TEAM
 We're looking for individuals who share our vision and value ownership and entrepreneurship over a conventional job.
 At Teton, you'll have the chance to make a real impact with your work.
 If you're ready for more than just a job, come aboard and be part of our mission to transform healthcare.

items.desc: Hoe ga je #meerbetekenen als Data Scientist Bij HumanTotalCare geloven we dat de echte waarde van AI niet alleen zit in wat het kan, maar vooral in het vermogen van onze professionals om het betekenisvol in te zetten. Wij zetten de mens centraal, in alles wat we doen. In multidisciplinaire teams werken we samen aan data en AI oplossingen die bijdragen aan de gezondheid en inzetbaarheid van werkend Nederland. Als Data Scientist / AI Engineer in het R&D team van HumanTotalCare vertaal je complexe vraagstukken naar oplossingen die impact maken. Je werkt aan het ontwerpen, bouwen en optimaliseren van AI-oplossingen die onze organisatie en professionals helpen om slimmer, sneller en effectiever te werken. Denk aan toepassingen voor beslisondersteuning binnen verzuimprocessen, capaciteitssturing, interventieadvies, het verminderen van administratieve lasten en generatieve AI voor professionals. We bouwen zelf waar kan, en schakelen ook met externe leveranciers om gericht te versnellen. In intensieve samenwerking met eindgebruikers en andere stakeholders zorg jij ervoor dat onze AI-producten van hoog niveau zijn en van grote waarde voor de organisatie. Daarbij ben je betrokken bij het volledige proces: van analyse en modelontwikkeling tot implementatie, monitoring en doorontwikkeling. Je zorgt dat onze producten betrouwbaar, veilig en schaalbaar zijn, en na implementatie robuust draaien in productie. Je weet hiervoor de weg in onze Azure AI services en MLOps infrastructuur en kunt benoemen wat je nodig hebt om kwaliteit te leveren. Je monitort de performance van modellen en zoekt actief naar optimalisaties in samenwerking met de eindgebruikers in onze business. Met wie ga je #meerbetekenen Je wordt onderdeel van het R&D-team, een veelzijdig team waarin kennis, data, wetenschap en technologie samenkomen. Het team bestaat uit ongeveer 15 collega's, waaronder Data Scientists, AI- en Machine Learning Engineers en Consultants op het gebied van Research & Business Development. Binnen het team combineren we inhoudelijke expertise met een pragmatische aanpak. We helpen elkaar vooruit, delen kennis, vieren successen en dagen elkaar uit om continu te verbeteren. Wij werken voor en met al onze merken; ArboNed, HumanCapitalCare, Mensely en Focus - in totaal ruim 2.200 collega's met één gezamenlijk doel: een gezond, gemotiveerd en competent werkend Nederland. Zij zetten zich dagelijks in voor ruim 65.000 werkgevers en 1,5 miljoen werkenden. Een schat aan kennis, expertise en data. Daarnaast werk je samen met collega's van IT&Care, waaronder Data Engineers, Software Developers, Cloudspecialisten en Architecten. Zij zorgen voor onze infrastructuur en voor de opschaling in productie. En stem je regelmatig af met onze collega's van de stafafdelingen zoals Medische Zaken, Juridische Zaken, Kwaliteit en HR. Samen maken we het verschil voor onze werkmaatschappijen. Wat is écht leuk aan deze baan Van idee naar impact – jouw oplossingen worden daadwerkelijk gebruikt door professionals en klanten. Werken met interessante data – Je werkt met rijke en diverse datasets, variërend van procesdata en verzuimdata tot vragenlijsten, vrije tekst en platformgebruik. Veel ruimte voor initiatief – Je krijgt veel ruimte om initiatief te nemen en nieuwe ideeën uit te werken. We blijven bij R&D experimenteren met nieuwe technieken; we maken ruimte voor exploratie. Technische diepgang – je werkt met machine learning, Azure, generatieve AI en moderne data-oplossingen. Diversiteit aan professionals – je werkt samen met een grote diversiteit aan professionals op het vlak van arbeid en gezondheid – denk aan Bedrijfsartsen, Arbeidsdeskundigen, Psychologen, Veiligheidskundigen, Organisatiekundigen en nog veel meer. Leuk team - Je wordt onderdeel van een hecht team en neemt elke dinsdag deel aan de R&D-dag met updates, demo’s en innovatiesessies. Bouwen aan de toekomst – je helpt mee om AI binnen HumanTotalCare verder vorm te geven. Is er ook iets minder leuk We zijn eerlijk: soms zien we kansen die sneller ontwikkeld kunnen worden dan de organisatie kan implementeren. Dat vraagt om geduld, samenwerking en overtuigingskracht. En soms lastige keuzes. Maar zo werken we wel aan oplossingen met impact op de dagelijkse praktijk, en daar doen we het voor. Wat neem je mee Nieuwsgierigheid en proactiviteit zijn essentieel. Je bent op de hoogte van de nieuwste AI-technologieën en experimenteert graag met toepassingen. Je denkt in oplossingen die echt bijdragen aan de praktijk. Je vindt het leuk om anderen mee te nemen in nieuwe ontwikkelingen en kunt complexe materie begrijpelijk maken. Verder vragen we: een afgeronde WO-opleiding in Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics of een vergelijkbare richting; minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als Data Scientist, AI Engineer, ML Engineer of in een vergelijkbare functie. ervaring met het ontwikkelen en implementeren van machine learning-oplossingen; sterke programmeervaardigheden in …

items.desc: What Quadrants is Quadrants is an open-source translation layer that turns ordinary Python into optimized machine code at runtime, across CPU (Arm64, x86) and GPU (AMDGPU, CUDA, Metal, Vulkan) backends. CUDA is the primary target, with x86 the strong runner-up, especially for real-time simulation. The others drive adoption and support fast prototyping for research. The ambition is explicit: build the best “Python compiler” in the world for physics and performance-critical numerical computing. We are fully committed to it, and we intend to beat leading alternatives like Nvidia Warp, Numba, or Triton. It’s a standalone project with its own roadmap, built in the open. Genesis, our physics simulator, is its first and top-priority user, the source of its hardest workloads and its benchmarks. But Quadrants is general-purpose infrastructure for anyone writing performance-critical numerical Python, not an internal tool that happens to be public. The bet: high-performance code should feel natural to write. Engineers write plain Python in a NumPy or PyTorch style, and Quadrants makes it fast. The role You own Quadrants end to end: the API, the IR and lowering, the optimization passes, the numerical primitives, and the roadmap. Our ultimate objective: engineers write for readability and maintainability, never for performance. They write the version of an algorithm they are most comfortable with, and Quadrants rebuilds it into kernels that run as if an expert had hand-tuned them. Performance is the compiler’s job, not theirs. Getting there is a frontier problem, part research and part engineering, and we intend to define the state of the art on it, relentlessly pushing the limit further. It calls for two things at once: the low-level GPU and compiler skill to make a single kernel optimal, and the ability to keep the whole system coherent as it grows. The core tradeoff is settled: usability comes first. When usability and performance collide, usability wins, unless the cost is severe. We will limit what the system supports to go fast (static shapes and fixed-size allocation baked into kernels, say), but never the convenience of the API itself. Experts who want maximum performance and full control over the generated code get lower-level escape hatches, down to inline assembly, C, or PTX. What you’ll own API & authoring experience. The surface that physics and numerical-computing engineers write against, and, as an open-source library, the product’s face to the world. Idiomatic, natural to Python users, never a separate language bolted onto Python. Clean decorators, legible constraints, sharp errors, real escape hatches. IR, lowering & backends. A stable IR that lowers to multiple backends, with room to grow and the door kept open for differentiable simulation. Today the computation graph is expressed through Quadrants’ own constructs. Recovering it automatically from ordinary Python is hard, and a long-term goal rather than today’s reality. Optimization. Turn naive code into strong execution plans: vectorization, register and shared-memory usage, barriers and atomics, cooperative threading, dead-buffer and redundant-traffic elimination, dropping needless synchronization. Move low-level optimization off users and into the platform. Primitives. Cholesky, eigendecomposition, matmul, reductions, solver kernels. Each owned with its correctness, benchmarks, and regression tracking. Watching Genesis and the compiler together. Hunt for performance wins on both sides, in Genesis and in Quadrants itself. Propose API changes that cut duplication, improve readability, and reduce platform-specific special-casing. Less to maintain, more that simply works. The project as a product. Benchmark real workloads, track performance over time, catch regressions early. Stay close to users (Genesis first), find friction and missing abstractions, drive adoption, set direction. Who you are You reason about whole systems and have taste for where complexity should live. You measure before you optimize, and you reach for memory traffic and launch overhead before FLOPs. You have opinions about API design. You write tests and benchmarks as you go, not afterward. The ground that judgment stands on: GPU. What optimal looks like and why: access patterns, registers, shared memory, barriers, atomics, threading. CPU intuition a plus. Python & API taste. Idiomatic Python. A feel for what’s natural to Python users. APIs that free users rather than constrain them. Compilers. The path from authoring to kernels (IR, lowering, optimization), weighed against maintainability. And how you work: proactive and largely self-directed. You fetch context across the company instead of waiting for it. You’re comfortable talking to the engineers who use what you build, and at ease designing in the open for users you’ll never meet. Ready to grow into leading a small team (a couple of people, near term). What great looks like People adopt Quadrants from outside Genesis. …

Le tout branché sur les logiciels de gestion Sage que les PME utilisent déjà. Nos produits SaaS sont pensés nativement pour l'IA, et ils tournent déjà chez les clients. Le poste Un assistant qui répond sur les données comptables réelles des entreprises, là où une réponse fausse a un prix. Tu le rends juste, mesurable, sûr et sobre en coûts. Et tu fais parler les données d'usage de toute la plateforme. Tu n'as pas de ligne produit : tu portes l'IA et les données de Sage Experience pour toutes les lignes. Côté IA : tu développes le cœur des modules IA qui s'appuient sur nos services MCP : Ask, l'assistant IA qui répond sur les chiffres de l'entreprise ; la création d'écrans sur-mesure ; et les workflows qui automatisent les tâches. Côté données : tu mets en place le suivi de toute la plateforme, de la collecte des données jusqu'à leur analyse. Usage des outils IA, mais aussi usage de la plateforme en général : tu as la liberté de choisir quoi mesurer et comment, pour sortir les statistiques qui aident vraiment l'équipe produit à décider. Les évaluations, le suivi des coûts et toute la chaîne de données sont à construire : c'est toi qui les poses. Ce que tu vas faire Construire les évaluations des fonctions IA, jouées dans la CI à chaque modification, pour qu'aucune évolution ne dégrade une réponse Améliorer la qualité des résultats : instructions, outils exposés aux agents, analyse des échecs et des retours utilisateurs Développer en TypeScript le cœur des modules IA : conversation et contexte, moteur des workflows, génération de pages et de documents, streaming et reprise sur erreur Tenir les garde-fous : confirmation humaine avant toute écriture dans un logiciel, journalisation de chaque appel, protection contre l'injection de prompt, isolation entre organisations Tenir les coûts et challenger les modèles : suivi de la dépense, optimisation des tokens, comparaison des modèles sur nos évaluations, opportunité de modèles auto-hébergés Mettre en place la collecte des données d'usage sur toute la plateforme : plan de marquage, schéma d'événements commun à toutes les lignes, pseudonymisé et sans contenu métier, conforme au RGPD Construire les flux et le modèle de données analytiques, de la collecte jusqu'à l'entrepôt, avec leurs contrôles de qualité Définir les indicateurs de suivi de la plateforme : adoption, activation, rétention, usage par fonctionnalité et par ligne, usage et coût des outils IA Construire les tableaux de bord et analyser les données pour sortir des statistiques utiles : ce qui marche, ce qui bloque, où investir L'équipe Tu rejoins une équipe de 10 à 15 personnes. Product Builders et développeurs travaillent ensemble au quotidien, sur une même stack : TypeScript, Node ou Bun côté serveur, React côté client. Tu travailles avec toutes les lignes produit. Toi Tu as mis en production des applications à base de grands modèles de langage : appels d'outils, agents, MCP, streaming. Tu sais dire comment tu as mesuré la qualité d'une fonction d'IA, et tes évaluations bloquent la CI quand ça régresse. Tu connais les risques : injection de prompt, y compris par les données, fuite de données. Tu confies les calculs aux outils, jamais au modèle. Tu raisonnes par la mesure sur les coûts et le choix des modèles. Tu as déjà construit une chaîne de données de bout en bout : collecte d'événements, flux, modélisation, entrepôt, tableaux de bord. Tu es solide en SQL et en modélisation analytique, à l'aise en Python ; tu définis un indicateur avant de l'écrire, et tu en connais les biais. Tu codes en TypeScript, avec des tests automatisés. Un plus : avoir servi des modèles ouverts (serveurs d'inférence, GPU), ou une première approche des données de gestion (ERP, comptabilité). Pas besoin d'être expert : l'équipe et les experts métiers sont là pour ça. Ce poste n'est pas pour toi si tu n'as jamais livré de fonction d'IA générative en production, ou jamais construit une chaîne de données jusqu'à son analyse. Ici, l'IA tourne chez de vrais clients, sur leurs vrais chiffres. Lieu du poste : Télétravail hybride (92800 Puteaux)

Wir freuen uns über Deine Bewerbung – sehr gern auch, wenn Du noch nicht „fertige:r Clinical Data Scientist“ bist und den Weg mit uns gehen möchtest. Deine Aufgaben : Eigenständige Planung und Durchführung von Forschungsprojekten inkl. Studiendesign, Ethik, Protokoll, Datenschutz. Datenkuratierung und -harmonisierung, DSGVO-konformer Umgang mit Gesundheitsdaten. Datenanalysen mit Verfahren der Statistik und Data Science sowie Interpretation der Ergebnisse. Absolvent eines verwandten Studiengangs mit abgeschlossenem Master; idealerweise mit Bezug zu medizinischen Fragestellungen. Erfahrung in wissenschaftlichem Arbeiten und Interesse an Themen der digitalen Medizin und Data Science. Kenntnisse in Statistik, Data Science und Programmierung (R, Python) Engagierte, strukturierte, selbstständige, sorgfältige Arbeitsweise und Teamfähigkeit. Sicherer Umgang mit gängigen Office-Tools. Sehr gute Sprachkenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch (Wort und Schrift). items.desc: Company: TELEPASS Location: Milano, IT Data Scientist In Telepass stiamo rivoluzionando il modo di muoversi, offrendo soluzioni digitali integrate per una mobilità sempre più veloce, intelligente e sostenibile. Siamo parte di un ecosistema innovativo che semplifica la vita delle persone: dai pagamenti del pedaggio ai servizi di mobilità urbana, fino a soluzioni assicurative e fintech. Entrare in Telepass significa contribuire attivamente alla trasformazione digitale della mobilità. Siamo alla ricerca di un/una Data Scientist a supporto del nostro team Marketing & CVM che si occuperà di: Creazione e maintenance modelli (prototipazione, valutazione, messa in produzione e monitoring) per rispondere ad esigenze di business Progettare ed eseguire analisi statistiche per aiutare Telepass a creare prodotti e campagne di marketing Fornire un pensiero critico sul ciclo completo di raccolta, controllo, pulizia e utilizzo dei nostri dati Creare e gestire asset di dati (KPI, tabelle, report, strumenti di visualizzazione dei dati...) per contribuire a rafforzare l'impatto del processo decisionale basato sui dati all’interno del Gruppo Collaborare con stakeholder di business per comprendere requisiti e tradurli in soluzioni data driven Requisiti : 2+ anni di esperienza nel ruolo Conoscenza avanzata di almeno un linguaggio di programmazione tipicamente usato in ambito dati (Python, R,..) Conoscenza avanzata del linguaggio SQL Esperienza in ambito BigData (uso di piattaforme dati, interrogazione dati di tipo BigData) Autonomia e comprovata esperienza nella risoluzione di problemi aziendali mediante modelli di ML o analisi avanzate e di rigore statistico Laurea magistrale in ambito STEM (statistica, data science, ingegneria, informatica, matematica, ecc.) o corsi post-laurea equivalenti Ottime capacità di comunicazione e di veicolare risultati di analisi complesse in modo chiaro a tutti i livelli di stakeholder Attitudine a lavorare in team, a costruire relazioni e alla gestione degli stakeholder Ottime capacità organizzative, attenzione ai dettagli e ragionamento analitico Nice to have : Esperienza con tecnologie cloud (GCP, AWS, MS Azure), in particolare con GCP (BigQuery, VertexAI) Conoscenza di framework MLOps ed esperienza nel portare modelli statistici/ML in produzione Esperienza nell'analisi di dati assicurativi e dati geospaziali Inquadramento, retribuzione e benefit L’inquadramento e il trattamento economico saranno definiti in coerenza con il CCNL applicato (CCNL Filiera Autostrade, Sezione speciale 3 “Attività di supporto e servizio all’utenza, alla viabilità integrata e alla gestione dei sistemi di pedaggiamento”) e con l’esperienza della persona selezionata. RAL : € 36.000 - 40.000 Benefit : Buoni pasto elettronici Credito welfare (flexible benefits) Counselling psicologico Fisioterapista in sede Polizza sanitaria integrativa Previdenza integrativa Cashback per i servizi di mobilità Telepass Programmi di formazione customizzati Orario flessibile e lavoro ibrido La sede di lavoro è Milano (ibrido)

items.desc: Remarkable people, trusted by clients to design and advance the world. Wood is recruiting for a Project Engineer - Graduate to join its Projects team focusing on engineering, procurement and construction of complex plants in the Chemical, Petrochemical and Energy industries. The position will be based in Corsico (Milan) office, with the possibility to work from home up to two days per week. #LI-Hybrid The Role You will assist the Senior Project Engineer in the coordination of the engineering team, and you will prepare multidisciplinary documents which require interaction with several technical disciplines. You will attend technical project reviews with Client, such as P&ID review, HAZOP, 3D model review, and ensure all Client’s comments will be captured in the design. You will also be assigned to construction site, to give technical assistance during the erection of the plant. International mobility and availability to be assigned is essential in the context of our business. Our Clients and Projects Designing the future. Transforming the world. You will be working for major international clients in the energy market and material market, and you will be part of a team results focused that will provide technical solutions. What we can offer Meaningful and interesting projects delivered to leaders of industry across chemical, petrochemical, oil&gas and emerging energy sectors Flexible working arrangements that balance client, team and individual needs offering hybrid working where relevant Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion ; we are an organisation actively committed to diversity and inclusion across our business Compensation – details provided at the end of the job advert Benefits package ; Free shuttle bus from Metro station to the office, company canteen, biannual free medical check-up, free company parking, extra-working accidents insurance Commitment to continued professional development; development plans that are tailored to your individual needs and interests Global connections ; join experts around the world who are at the leading edge of our industry, shaping the standards of our profession The key objectives for this role are: Mechanize and update the P&IDs, from the first process issue up to the issue for construction and “as built” Prepare the Equipment List, the Line List, the Fluid List, the Tie-in List Coordinate with other project engineers in Wood Global Execution Center (India) Prepare Material Requisitions for filters, special items and other miscellaneous equipment, and coordinate with Vendors Prepare the Hazardous Area Classification and the Fire Hazardous Area Support the Senior Project Engineer or Engineering Manager in the technical coordination of the engineering disciplines Attend project review with Client Attend project review with Client Assigned to construction site We are looking for newly graduates , but at Wood, we are committed to equal opportunities and welcome all talented individuals to consider joining our team. So even if you don't match every statement below but feel you have some of the experience, knowledge or skills needed for this role, we encourage you to apply. It will take all of us working together to deliver solutions to the world’s most critical challenges. Expected: MSc in mechanical, chemical or energy engineering Self-motivation, flexibility, a proactive outlook and good communication skills Fluent in English / good Italian Availability to be relocated abroad is essential Compensation and compliance: Contract & Classification Contract type: Permanent Collective Agreement (CCNL): Industria Metalmeccanica (CNEL C011) Job Classification level: Impiegato, consistent with role requirements and applicable CCNL Compensation Gross Annual Salary: the initial gross annual salary will be € 32,604.60, paid in 14 instalments The compensation package will include applicable CCNL elements and company benefits Variable pay and additional benefits will be detailed during the selection process Equal Opportunities This job opportunity is open to all individuals, in compliance with the principle of equal opportunities and non-discrimination, in accordance with applicable regulations Transparency & Offer Determination At the end of the selection process, the Company reserves the right to make an offer with a job level and/or gross annual salary different from what is indicated in this job posting, consistently with the candidate’s professional experience and technical and soft skills.
