Un enjeu central sera le transfert des performances obtenues sur données synthétiques vers des conditions réelles. Missions principales : 1. Analyse et diagnostic : Étudier l’état de l’art des méthodes
items.desc: Présentation de l'agence Service à compétence nationale et directement rattachée au Ministre des armées, l'Agence Ministérielle pour l’Intelligence Artificielle de Défense (AMIAD) est responsable de la mise en œuvre de la politique ministérielle en matière d'IA. Nous travaillons en collaboration avec toutes les entités du Ministère et sur de nombreux domaines d'activité (systèmes d’armes, opérations, renseignement, commandement, soutien et administration) D'ici 2027, nous nous appuierons sur plus de 300 collaborateurs, principalement au sein du pôle technique situé à Bruz, près de Rennes, mais également au sein du campus de l’Ecole Polytechnique pour les activités de recherche académique. Vous souhaitez donner du sens à votre activité ? Vous avez à cœur de contribuer à la montée en puissance de l’activité IA ministérielle et à la souveraineté de la France dans le domaine de l’IA pour soutenir les forces armées ? Vous recherchez un environnement de travail stimulant et innovant ? Alors postulez et rejoignez l’AMIAD, l’Agence Ministérielle pour l’IA de Défense. Vos missions Au sein de l'équipe capteurs, notre stagiaire participera au développement et à l’évaluation de modèles d’apprentissage profond pour l’estimation de l’échelle d’une scène et de la distance des objets. Un enjeu central sera le transfert des performances obtenues sur données synthétiques vers des conditions réelles. Missions principales : 1. Analyse et diagnostic : Étudier l’état de l’art des méthodes d’estimation de profondeur, d’échelle et de distance à partir d’images, notamment pour l’observation en extérieur et à longue portée. 2. Recherche et développement : · Entraîner et évaluer des modèles d’estimation de profondeur et de distance à partir des données synthétiques disponibles. · Étudier et mettre en œuvre des méthodes d’adaptation de domaine pour le transfert synthétique-réel. · Fine-tuner les modèles sur des données réelles disposant de mesures de distance de référence (LRF). · Étudier la robustesse et la capacité de généralisation des approches proposées. 3. Évaluation : · Définir les métriques et protocoles d’évaluation sur données synthétiques et réelles. · Comparer les différentes stratégies d’entraînement et d’adaptation au domaine réel. · Analyser les performances et identifier les principaux cas limites. Votre profil Ce stage s’adresse à un(e) étudiant(e) en fin de deuxième année ou de dernière année d’école d’ingénieur, avec un profil orienté Intelligence Artificielle / Deep Learning ou un fort intérêt pour le domaine. Une bonne maitrise de la programmation python est attendue. Stage de 6 mois, à partir de février 2027. Join elite teams developing cutting-edge robotics and computer vision solutions that power Prime Air drones and revolutionize warehouse automation. items.desc: HET BEDRIJF: Als AI Engineer kom je terecht in een internationale groep met een miljardenomzet en een vijftigtal bedrijven verspreid over Europa, maar werkt tegelijkertijd binnen een klein, ondernemend en hands-on AI-team. Zo combineer je de slagkracht en mogelijkheden van een grote internationale organisatie met de wendbaarheid van een klein team, waar ideeën snel worden omgezet in concrete AI-producten. De organisatie gelooft sterk in ‘human first, tech enabled’. AI wordt niet ingezet om mensen te vervangen, maar om repetitief en administratief werk weg te nemen, zodat medewerkers opnieuw meer tijd kunnen besteden aan waar ze echt het verschil maken: menselijke interactie. Het centrale AI-team ontwikkelt oplossingen voor tientallen bedrijven binnen de groep en werkt daarbij als een soort interne AI-startup. Vandaag bestaat het team uit Data & AI Engineers, Product Owners en een AI Lead. Samen bouwen ze toepassingen die rechtstreeks geïntegreerd worden in de systemen van duizenden gebruikers in Europa. Om de groei verder te ondersteunen, kijken we uit naar een extra AI Engineer. JOUW ROL: Geen afgebakende tickets die over de muur worden gegooid. Als AI Engineer krijg je end-to-end ownership en ben je betrokken bij de volledige lifecycle: businessvraag → concept → technische oplossing → development → deployment → integratie → monitoring → optimalisatie. Je werkt onder andere aan: Nieuwe features: je ontwikkelt bestaande AI-producten verder, integreert nieuwe LLM-modellen en verbetert functionaliteit, evaluations, performance en betrouwbaarheid. Nieuwe AI-producten: samen met de Product Owner en business vertaal je nieuwe ideeën naar een technisch concept, bouw je POC's en zet je succesvolle experimenten om in echte producten. Implementaties: je integreert bestaande AI-producten bij nieuwe Boutiques en zorgt ervoor dat alles technisch als één geheel werkt. Operations: wat je bouwt, blijft ook van jou. Je monitort toepassingen, onderzoekt problemen en zorgt dat oplossingen ook na go-live betrouwbaar blijven draaien. Technisch bouw je voornamelijk Python-code en API's bovenop LLM's in een cloudomgeving. Je werkt onder andere met Python, OpenAI, REST API's, Azure, Docker, CI/CD, FastAPI en Langfuse. En AI gebruik je niet alleen in wat je bouwt. Ook development zelf gebeurt sterk AI-assisted, met tools zoals Claude, Cursor en Codex. We zoeken dus iemand die AI als versneller kan inzetten, maar zelf voldoende technische bagage heeft om kritisch te blijven over wat er wordt geproduceerd. JOUW PROFIEL: Je hebt minstens 3 jaar relevante ervaring binnen software-, data- of AI-engineering. Je hebt een sterke kennis van Python en LLM's. Je hebt ervaring met een cloudomgeving, CI/CD en containerisatie/Docker. Ervaring met FastAPI, Azure en Langfuse is mooi meegenomen, maar geen vereiste. Je denkt end-to-end en wilt begrijpen wat je bouwt, waarom je het bouwt én hoe je het betrouwbaar naar productie brengt. Je bent pragmatisch en kritisch: je weet wanneer iets good enough is en wanneer het nodig is om dieper te graven. Je werkt zelfstandig, neemt ownership en hebt weinig behoefte aan micromanagement. Je bent nieuwsgierig naar AI en blijft graag experimenteren met nieuwe modellen, tools en technieken. Je communiceert helder en vlot in het Nederlands en Engels. AANBOD: Je krijgt ownership over de volledige AI-lifecycle en ziet je oplossingen ook écht gebruikt worden door duizenden medewerkers in Europa. Je werkt in een klein, technisch sterk AI-team met de slagkracht van een internationale groep. Je krijgt veel autonomie, werkt met moderne technologieën zoals Python, OpenAI, LLM’s, FastAPI, Azure en Docker en geniet van 2 dagen thuiswerk en flexibele uren. Verwacht een ondernemende cultuur met korte lijnen, weinig hiërarchie en veel ruimte om te experimenteren. En ook naast het werk is er sfeer: maandelijkse barbecues, open kwartaalmeetings en een jaarlijkse innovation contest. Benieuwd naar meer? Stuur je cv naar marte@cartiere.be of bel +32 3 343 94 91 voor meer informatie. Bekijk onze website www.cartiere.be voor meer vacatures.

items.desc: The role This is not a blank page R&D job. You inherit working prototypes and make them reliable, secure and scalable. You decide what gets hardened, what gets rebuilt and what gets replaced by a better tool. You work directly with the founder: they keep prototyping new ideas, you decide what is ready for production. What you'll do Make it reliable: error handling, retries and rate limits, so no workflow fails silently. Make it visible: monitoring and alerts, so we know a flow broke before a recruiter or client does. Structure the data: one clean data model that is the single source of truth for candidates, clients and vacancies. Secure it: credentials out of the workflows, proper access control and GDPR compliant data retention. Measure AI quality: test sets for AI output, versioned prompts and cost per run tracking. Make it last: version control and documentation, so the system never depends on one person. Build, rebuild or buy: decide per workflow, and integrate vendor tools where they beat our own. Own the production gate: nothing becomes business critical without your sign off. What we're looking for At least 2 years experience in backend, data or automation engineering, including systems other people relied on every day. Strong Python, SQL and REST APIs. Hands-on experience with workflow tools like n8n, Make or Zapier, and the judgment to know when a flow belongs in code. Experience running LLM APIs in production: prompt management, output validation and cost control. You think in failure modes: what breaks at ten times the volume, and what happens when the model returns nonsense. You can explain technical tradeoffs to non technical people, and you're comfortable saying "this needs rebuilding". Nice to have Experience with CRMs/ATS Familiarity with GDPR and the EU AI Act as they apply to recruitment. Cloud experience (Azure, AWS or GCP) and infrastructure as code.

items.title: Ingénieur R&D IA Générative – Géométrie 3D & Modélisation (F/H)
items.card: Vos missions Développer des technologies de modélisation 3D : concevoir un modeleur sémantique capable de prendre en charge des maillages générés par IA, en s'appuyant sur les technologies polyédriques existantes. Contribuer aux workflows de design génératif : développer des solutions de segmentation par IA permettant de reconstruire des structures cellulaires à partir de maillages globaux. Développer et entraîner
items.desc: Au sein de la division R&D de Dassault Systèmes, vous rejoindrez l'organisation Generative Geometry, qui développe les technologies de modélisation 3D de nouvelle génération en combinant intelligence artificielle, optimisation, simulation et automatisation. Vous intégrerez l'équipe Polyhedral Core, spécialisée dans le traitement des données polyédriques : données issues de scans 3D, modèles triangulés, maillages de simulation et maillages générés par intelligence artificielle. Votre objectif sera de contribuer au développement de nouvelles solutions de modélisation basées sur l'IA générative, intégrées à la plateforme 3DEXPERIENCE, avec notamment des applications autour du design génératif et des workflows automatisés pilotés par des agents intelligents et des LLM. Vos missions Développer des technologies de modélisation 3D : concevoir un modeleur sémantique capable de prendre en charge des maillages générés par IA, en s'appuyant sur les technologies polyédriques existantes. Contribuer aux workflows de design génératif : développer des solutions de segmentation par IA permettant de reconstruire des structures cellulaires à partir de maillages globaux. Développer et entraîner des modèles d'IA : mettre en œuvre les entraînements nécessaires et intégrer les modèles dans l'architecture interne dédiée à l'entraînement des modèles (Data Product). Participer aux nouvelles approches de modélisation agentique : intégrer les composants développés dans des workflows automatisés, orchestrés à terme par des agents intelligents guidés par des LLM. Collaborer avec les équipes applicatives : accompagner l'intégration de ces technologies au sein des solutions CATIA, SIMULIA, DELMIA et des différents workflows métiers. Vos Qualifications Vous êtes diplômé d'une école d'ingénieur ou d'un doctorat en informatique, mathématiques appliquées ou dans un domaine scientifique équivalent. Vous disposez de connaissances en Machine Learning et IA générative, idéalement appliquées à la géométrie ou à la modélisation 3D. Vous maîtrisez les langages Python et C++. Vous possédez de solides bases en mathématiques, géométrie et structures de données polyédriques. Vous faites preuve d'un bon esprit analytique et appréciez les problématiques scientifiques et techniques complexes. Nous rejoindre c'est aussi Intégrer une entreprise scientifique au cœur de l’innovation technologique, portée par une forte croissance depuis plus de 40 ans Principaux avantages et bénéfices : Environnement multiculturel Cadre de travail convivial axé sur le bien-être et la santé (salles de sport & de musique, conciergerie…) Engagement en faveur de la diversité et de l’inclusion Politique dynamique de développement de carrière : plan de formation, mobilités internes, etc Inclusion statement As a game-changer in sustainable technology and innovation, Dassault Systèmes is striving to build more inclusive and diverse teams across the globe. We believe that our people are our number one asset and we want all employees to feel empowered to bring their whole selves to work every day. It is our goal that our people feel a sense of pride and a passion for belonging. As a company leading change, it’s our responsibility to foster opportunities for all people to participate in a harmonized Workforce of the Future.

TELUS Digital AI Community: Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of more than one million contributors from diverse backgrounds who help customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. This role is well suited to someone who enjoys structured problem-solving, analysing data and system behaviour, identifying quality issues, and working closely with product, engineering, data science, and operations stakeholders. Investigate discrepancies between expected and actual product outputs and work with relevant teams to define and track resolution actions. Review and quality assure labeled datasets to ensure accuracy, consistency, completeness, and adherence to defined guidelines. Validate AI-generated labels and model outputs, identifying misclassifications, edge cases, data-quality issues, and improvement opportunities. Analyse model and classification performance using appropriate measures, including precision, recall, accuracy, F1 score, and confusion matrices. Support validation activities for machine learning models and AI-assisted workflows, including models hosted on platforms such as Google Vertex AI. Work with Data Scientists and Machine Learning Engineers to improve labeling guidelines, training-data quality, validation processes, and model performance. Contribute to the evolution of internal tools, quality frameworks, validation processes, and operating practices as labeling workflows become increasingly automated. Required Skills and Experience 3+ years of relevant experience in a product analyst, data analyst, data quality, QA, product operations, data labeling, or similar role in a technology-driven environment. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with exceptional attention to detail and consistency. Comfortable working with data using tools such as SQL, spreadsheets, dashboards, or similar analytical tooling. Experience working with large datasets, data-quality processes, testing, validation, or business-rule assessment. Ability to investigate issues end-to-end, identify patterns and root causes, and communicate findings clearly. Understanding of core machine-learning concepts and workflows, including the importance of high-quality training data and model validation. Familiarity with classification problems and/or data annotation, labeling, or taxonomy-based workflows. Strong written and verbal English communication skills. Ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and to manage changing priorities. Preferred Skills and Experience Experience analysing transaction data, merchant data, categorisation systems, or other financial-data classification problems. Experience with data labeling, annotation, model validation, or AI-assisted labeling workflows. Familiarity with model-evaluation concepts and metrics, including precision, recall, F1 score, accuracy, and confusion matrices. We are a technology and data driven group implementing a scientific approach to investing. Combining data, research, technology, and trading expertise has shaped QRT’s collaborative mindset which enables us to solve the most complex challenges. Devenir consultant chez NEO2 Digital c’est : être acteur de sa carrière en ayant des possibilités d’évolutions multiples (métier, secteur, région), faire partie de la tribu et avoir un suivi managérial fort. En rejoignant nos équipes en tant que Data Scientist / AI Engineer, vous interviendrez chez l’un de nos clients, au sein de l’équipe digital marketing, sur une mission basée en région parisienne. Vous serez en charge des missions suivantes : Faire le lien avec les équipes métier du digital marketing, comprendre leurs besoins et représenter l’équipe auprès d’elles. Développer, mettre en œuvre et maintenir des modèles de machine learning (détection d’anomalies, moteur de recommandation de destinations, etc.). Concevoir et implémenter l’ensemble du pipeline ML, du réentraînement au déploiement et au monitoring des modèles. Surveiller et améliorer en continu les modèles en production, en garantissant des déploiements à faible latence et le respect des standards internes. Travailler dans l’écosystème Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, suite Vertex AI) pour le développement et le déploiement des modèles. Utiliser Terraform (infrastructure as code), Docker (conteneurisation) et GitHub Actions (CI/CD) pour des solutions robustes et scalables. Participer aux cérémonies d’équipe (stand ups, sessions de refinement) et intervenir à la fois sur de nouveaux sujets et sur l’existant. Profil recherché Vous maîtrisez Google Cloud Platform (niveau confirmé) et BigQuery (niveau avancé). Vous maîtrisez Terraform, SQL, UNIX et le scripting Perl/Shell (niveau avancé). Vous êtes à l’aise en développement Python full stack, Docker et Git (niveau confirmé). Vous avez de l’expérience dans la mise en production de modèles de machine learning (MLOps). Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre autonomie et votre capacité à communiquer avec des interlocuteurs métier variés. Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et souhaitez évoluer dans un environnement dynamique. Vous avez envie de rejoindre une structure à taille humaine offrant visibilité, responsabilité et proximité avec les équipes métiers. Vous parlez couramment anglais et français (bilingue). Si vous souhaitez évoluer dans une entreprise à taille humaine et que cette aventure vous tente, contactez-nous vite !

items.desc: Location: Rheine We develop digital products and services for monitoring, diagnosing, and optimizing industrial systems. Our data‑driven solutions combine deep domain expertise with modern software architecture and excellent experience. To strengthen our team, we are looking for an experienced Machine Learning Engineer (MLOps) (m/f/d) Your Mission As a Machine Learning Engineer (MLOps) you will help turn complex data into reliable insights that drive smarter decisions. You will design and optimize data pipelines and MLOps workflows that transform raw data into valuable insights. Working with modern Azure technologies, including Azure Databricks, you will ensure reliable, secure, and high-quality data throughout its lifecycle. By monitoring, improving, and documenting data solutions, you will help keep our analytics and AI applications running smoothly. Your Responsibilities Collaborate with data scientists, data engineers, and software developers to design, build, and maintain data pipelines. Implement MLOps practices to streamline the deployment and management of machine learning models. Develop and optimize ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes for ingesting, processing, and transforming raw data into usable formats. Work closely with Azure services, including Azure Databricks. Ensure data quality, reliability, and security throughout the data lifecycle. Monitor and troubleshoot data pipelines to ensure smooth operations. Track data lineage and maintain documentation for data assets. Participate in code reviews and contribute to best practices for data engineering and MLOps. Your Profile Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field. Strong coding skills in Python and SQL. Experience with big data technologies such as Hadoop and Spark. Familiarity with Azure services, especially Azure Databricks and Azure Data Factory. Knowledge of MLOps principles and practices. Background in software development and version control (Git). Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail. Effective communication and collaboration skills. Nice-to-Have Experience with Databricks platform. Experience in condition monitoring or other physical data processing industry Familiarity with feature engineering and serving. Understanding of data governance and access controls. Why Join Us Opportunity to work on cutting-edge projects at the intersection of data engineering and machine learning. Collaborative and inclusive work environment. Competitive compensation and benefits package. Professional growth and development opportunities. What We Offer A responsible role with significant creative freedom Work on technically challenging and future-oriented products Close collaboration with experienced experts in hardware, software, and cyber security International environment with short decision-making paths Opportunity to take on leadership responsibilities as part of your professional and personal development Our Promise Flexible working hours and home office opportunities Attractive compensation package including tax‑free benefits (e.g., Sodexo meal vouchers and fuel vouchers) Height-adjustable desks in small offices (2–3 people) Strong commitment to sustainability (solar power, waste separation, orchard meadow, etc.) Bicycle leasing via BusinessBike Table soccer and table tennis for breaks Unforgettable company parties Contact Interested? We look forward to receiving your application! If you’re passionate about machine learning and keen to transform out models into product ready features, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now and let’s build the future together. This Is Us As part of the Burckhardt Compression Group, we are a global leader in the field of automated condition monitoring and the protection of people, the environment, and critical machinery. For decades, we have specialized in intelligent monitoring systems for rotating equipment, with a focus on reciprocating compressors and gearboxes. We supply products and services to the most demanding markets. With sales partners worldwide, our team of experts delivers reliable and efficient solutions that keep industrial operationgs running safely. At our locations in Rheine (Germany) and Houston (USA), 115 motivated employees work in an international environment.

items.desc: Unsere DNA Wir sind eine innovative digitale Gutscheinplattform, die mit über 500 top Marken wie Amazon, Google, Apple, IKEA und Zalando & Co zusammenarbeitet. Als führender Multi-Brand Gutschein hat Wunschgutschein den Markt disruptiv über die letzten Jahre aufgerollt und erobert! Unter den Marken Wunschgutschein in Deutschland und Wishcard im europäischen Ausland sind wir an mehr als 120.000 stationären POS aktiv und aktuell mehr als einem Drittel der Deutschen ein Begriff. So konnte Wunschgutschein bis jetzt mehr als 100 Millionen Gutscheine verkaufen und befindet sich als unangefochtener No.1 Geschenkgutschein weiterhin auf dem Wachstumspfad. Der WUNSCHGUTSCHEIN ist das perfekte Geschenk für jeden von privaten Anlässen hin zu Mitarbeiterbindung und - motivation sowie der Kundenbindung und - gewinnung. Zur Verstärkung unseres Finance-Bereichs suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die den Einsatz von Künstlicher Intelligenz und Automatisierung strategisch wie operativ vorantreibt. Im Mittelpunkt steht die Entwicklung neuer Lösungen nicht die Pflege bestehender Reports. Die Grundlage dafür ist gelegt: SSAS-Cubes für Verkauf, Einlösungen und Einkauf, etablierte Power-BI-Dashboards, ein intern gesteuertes Data Warehouse sowie weitgehend automatisierte Reportingprozesse. Darauf aufbauend verfolgen wir zwei eigenständige Initiativen: Automatisierte Anomalieerkennung: Ein Regelwerk, das Auffälligkeiten in den täglichen Daten systematisch identifiziert, statt dass sie manuell gesucht werden müssen. KI-gestützter Monatsabschluss: Intelligente Analyse- und Prüfprozesse, die das Controlling von wiederkehrender Routinearbeit entlasten. Die Position ist neu geschaffen und berichtet direkt an die Leitung Finance. Du übernimmst damit keine reine Umsetzungsrolle, sondern gestaltest maßgeblich mit, welche Prozesse automatisiert werden und auf welche Weise. Dein Spielfeld Dein Ziel: Manuelle Prüf- und Aufbereitungsarbeit konsequent in Regeln, Modelle und Agenten zu überführen und damit Freiräume für Aufgaben zu schaffen, die fachliches Urteilsvermögen erfordern. KI und Agenten in den Regelbetrieb überführen. Du bringst agentenbasierte Analysen in den produktiven Einsatz und setzt Large Language Models gezielt dort ein, wo sie echten Mehrwert schaffen. Wo deterministische Logik die bessere Wahl ist, setzt du konsequent auf diese. Über Technologie-Stack und Budget entscheidest du mit. Monatsabschluss gezielt entlasten. Als eigenständigen Schwerpunkt entwickelst du gemeinsam mit dem Controlling ein KI-gestütztes Modell, das wiederkehrende Prüf- und Analyseschritte übernimmt von Abstimmungen und Plausibilitätsprüfungen über Vollständigkeitskontrollen bis hin zu Abweichungsanalysen. Auf Basis historischer Abschlüsse lernt das Modell, was im Normalbereich liegt und was einer Erläuterung bedarf. Automatisierte Datenüberwachung etablieren. Du konzipierst und implementierst ein Regelwerk, das die täglichen Daten parametrisiert über alle Kanäle und Datenquellen hinweg prüft. Die Schwellenwerte kalibrierst du in enger Abstimmung mit den Business Partnern. Das Team befähigen. Du gestaltest Automatisierungslösungen so, dass die Business Partner sie eigenständig nutzen können. Ziel ist ein Team, das Auffälligkeiten aufdeckt und kritisch hinterfragt, statt Auswertungen abzuarbeiten. Erkenntnisse bewerten und Maßnahmen anstoßen. Du identifizierst Auffälligkeiten nicht nur, sondern ordnest sie fachlich ein: Was sind die Ursachen, wie relevant ist der Befund, welcher Handlungsbedarf ergibt sich? Deine Erkenntnisse teilst du mit den Segmentverantwortlichen und erörterst mit Controlling und Geschäftsführung, ob und wie gegengesteuert werden muss. Das macht Dich aus Mehr als drei Jahre Berufserfahrung in Analytics Engineering, Data Engineering oder Business Intelligence mit klarem Schwerpunkt auf Automatisierung und KI-Anwendungen statt auf Reporting. Nachweisbare Umsetzungserfolge. Du hast mindestens eine Automatisierungslösung in den Produktivbetrieb gebracht, die zuverlässig und unabhängig von dir läuft inklusive Fehlerbehandlung, Monitoring, Versionierung und Dokumentation. Dieser Praxisnachweis ist uns wichtiger als jede Zertifizierung. Fundierte technische Kenntnisse: sicherer Umgang mit Python und SQL sowie praktische Erfahrung mit SSAS bzw. multidimensionalen Datenmodellen und Power BI. Praxiserfahrung mit LLMs und KI-Agenten in Geschäftsprozessen verbunden mit einem fundierten Urteil darüber, wo ihr Einsatz sinnvoll ist und wo nicht. Ausgeprägtes Geschäftsverständnis und hohe Eigeninitiative. Du willst verstehen, warum sich eine Kennzahl verändert, bevor du eine Regel dafür definierst. Du bewertest Befunde eigenständig und erkennst Automatisierungspotenziale proaktiv, statt auf Anforderungen zu warten. Kommunikationsstärke und Freude an Wissensvermittlung. Du bereitest Beobachtungen so auf, dass Segmentverantwortliche fundierte Entscheidungen treffen können, und benennst klar, wenn eine Zahl noch nicht belastbar ist. Kolleginnen und …

items.desc: What We Do The inbox was never built to run a business. Orders get missed, RFQs go cold, and every line gets retyped into the ERP by hand, one email, one PDF, one WhatsApp message at a time. We built AI Coworkers that do most of the repetitive work nobody wants to do instead: they read what comes in, sort it, draft linked actions, and post clean entries straight into the customer's systems of record. The team approves; Hoshii does the rest. Our Blind Spot We are the ones driving, train-riding and flying to customers, running the workshops, and staying up past the demo to make the PoC actually work, and we can't scale that forever. We are looking for a Forward-Deployed AI Engineer to become the technical face of Hoshii in front of the companies who actually run on our product: someone who can walk into a customer's office, understand exactly where the manual pain lives, build a working proof of concept in days rather than weeks, and take it all the way to production, then stay accountable for it once it's live. You'll follow Amazon's "you build it, you run it" principle: whatever you ship for a customer, you own operationally too. You will join the founding team building the AI Coworker that operations teams actually run their order desk on. Key Responsibilities Run on-site and remote discovery directly with customers: map their order-to-cash workflows, identify the real pain points behind the stated requirements, and translate them into technical scope. Build and demo working proofs of concept fast, iterating directly with customer stakeholders rather than through a requirements document. Own end-to-end deployment: integrate Hoshii's agents with the customer's ERP/CRM systems, configure the workflow, and take it live in production. Follow the "you build it, you run it" principle: stay accountable for what you deployed, monitor it in production, and be the first responder when something breaks for that customer. Feed field learnings back into the product roadmap: you're often the first to see where the product breaks down against a real workflow, and that signal needs to shape what we build next. Work closely with our channel partners to keep the underlying integrations reliable across every customer running on their systems. Write clean, tested, maintainable code: you're not just configuring, you're building. Your Profile We are looking for team players with a growth mindset, an entrepreneurial spirit, and genuine comfort being the person in the room with the customer: Strong fullstack coding and debugging skills, comfortable moving across frontend, backend, and infra as the deployment demands, with proven experience building and shipping production software (Python, Javascript/Typescript, or similar). Proven experience building and running GenAI PoCs end-to-end: prototyping fast with LLMs/agents, then hardening what works into something a customer can actually run in production. Solid understanding of systems and how they integrate (APIs, data pipelines, microservices, event-driven architectures) and the judgment to know where deep integration is worth the effort and where it isn't. A pragmatic 80/20 instinct: you ship the 20% that unblocks the customer's real problem instead of gold-plating the other 80%. (Experience working directly with customers: PoCs, technical scoping, on-site deployments, or a similar consulting/pre-sales-adjacent engineering background. Familiarity with ERP/CRM systems is a strong plus. Genuinely product-minded: you instinctively separate what a customer says they want from what they actually need, and you enjoy shaping the roadmap, not just executing it. Excellent communication skills in English and German (C1 or above); Swiss German is a strong plus. Comfortable with regular travel to customer sites across DACH. Strong sense of ownership: you treat what you deploy as yours to run, not just to hand off. What We Offer Autonomy and Ownership: You're in charge of your time at Hoshii; decide what you want to do, align with the team, and go for it! Stock Options: Ever owned your impact? Well, at Hoshii you get stock options, allowing you to get something back from our collective success story. A World-Class Team: We're a team of servant leaders who work hard and put customers first; we hail from top companies and universities, and we hold ourselves to the highest standards. Amazing Office Location: We have a lakeside location in Zürich with cozy corners to relax, fostering a comfortable environment where you can thrive. How To Apply Send an email to ayoub@hoshii.ai with your CV, your GitHub/GitLab link, and a short introduction about yourself. Subject: Job Application: AI Engineer (Forward-Deployed)

items.desc: TL;DR We’re looking for a Finance AI Specialist to work cross-functionally across our product and commercial teams as a domain expert. You’ll shape how Grasp’s agents handle deal work and engage with leading private equity firms, investment banks and consultancies to drive adoption by translating product capabilities into real-world use cases. Why Grasp Grasp delivers first-move intelligence for deal teams. The best deals are won before a process starts, and Grasp makes sure our customers get there first. Our agents continuously read the market and catch what others miss - the founder with no successor, the new CFO with PE experience, the quiet contract win with a Fortune 500 customer - so our customers can make the call before anyone else and win deals competitors never saw coming. Grasp is already used by 300+ of the world's leading private equity firms, investment banks and consultancies, including Triton, Bain & Company, PwC and EY. We're growing 4x per year, have offices in Stockholm, London, and soon New York, and are backed by renowned investors such as Octopus Ventures and Yanno Capital. Role Finance AI Specialists bring deal expertise into our product and our customer work. Our users are deal teams in private markets and their alpha comes from analysing vast numbers of companies across scattered and unstructured data, to find the diamonds in the rough before anyone else does. You’ll understand the full deal cycle, turn it into concise product requirements, and help customers leverage Grasp to gain an edge on the competition. Your responsibilities will include: Product development: You’re the deal expert in the room when we build. You define what good output looks like, test and build features before customers see them. Product roadmap: turn what customers teach you into what we build next. Shape the product roadmap with our CPO by scoping new features and workflows anchored in clearly defined customer problems. Customer adoption: Partner with our Account Executives to land and grow customers. Run trials and expert trainings with senior deal professionals, co-build workflows on their live processes, and be willing to go the last mile to win the deal. Forward deployed: Work embedded with deal teams at our largest accounts, designing tailored workflows, connecting Grasp to how they work and growing the relationship. Skills And Requirements Have 1-3 years of full-time experience in investment banking, strategy consulting or private equity, ideally at a top-tier firm such as McKinsey, BCG or Bain, a bulge bracket investment bank or a leading private equity fund. Bring real ownership and entrepreneurial drive. You go beyond your role, take on problems before anyone asks and get things done without waiting for direction. Command the room with MDs and partners: ask the right questions, read what they need and adapt as the conversation moves. Know how deals are sourced, screened and executed, and judge analysis with the critical eye of an experienced banker or investor. Be genuinely curious about AI and how it will change the financial industry. You use the tools every day and can lead the conversation on AI with senior clients. Additionally, we think you will thrive in this role if you: International exposure to deal making outside of Nordics is a plus, not a requirement. This role suits someone with a bias to action, who doesn’t wait for a brief or a sign-off to start. What we offer A seat at a fast-growing startup scaling globally that is reshaping how dealmaking is done with AI. Unmatched exposure to senior dealmakers at leading PE firms, banks and consultancies, early in your career. Competitive compensation, including stock options. Work directly with our CPO, our founders and a team of former bankers and consultants.

items.desc: In a few words Position: Mid-Level Backend Developer – AI Labs Location: Madrid (Chamberí area). Want to know more? 👇 INSUD PHARMA operates across the entire pharmaceutical value chain, providing specialized knowledge and experience in scientific research, development, manufacturing, sales, and marketing of a wide range of active pharmaceutical ingredients (API), finished dosage forms (FDF), and branded pharmaceutical products, adding value to human and animal health. The activities of INSUD PHARMA are organized into three synergistic business areas: Industrial (Chemo), Branded (Exeltis), and Biotech (Bionanopharma), with over 10,000 professionals in more than 50 countries, 20 state-of-the-art facilities, 15 specialized R&D centers, 12 commercial offices, and more than 35 pharmaceutical subsidiaries, serving 1,150 customers in 96 countries worldwide. INSUD PHARMA believes in innovation and sustainable development. Ready to be a #Challenger? What are we looking for? 🔎 We are AI Labs team, the applied AI department at Insud Pharma. We are a team of 30 professionals (AI Engineers, Data Scientists, Backend Engineers, DevOps Engineers, and Product Managers) working across the full breadth of the company, building products and systems that directly inform and shape decision-making. We are looking for a Mid-Level Backend Develope r with solid technical foundations and hands-on experience building backend applications. You will develop and maintain reliable services that power real-world AI-driven products across Clinical, R&D, manufacturing, and other domains, working closely with Data Scientists, Product Managers, and DevOps Engineers. You will take ownership of well-defined backend features, from implementation and testing through deployment and maintenance, with support from senior engineers on architecture and complex technical decisions. We are seeking someone curious about engineering challenges, committed to writing maintainable code, and comfortable delivering independently within an agreed scope. You will contribute to technical discussions, ask for support when needed, and develop your skills through collaboration and feedback. How the team works: AI Labs operates with a startup mindset within Insud Pharma. The department is young, and the culture reflects that: flat, collaborative, and fast-moving . You will work alongside Data Scientists, AI Engineers, DevOps Engineers, and Product Managers who are equally committed to delivering high-quality work. We hold regular demo days where teams present their work, as well as whiteboard sessions where we tackle problems together. The cross-disciplinary dynamic is genuinely strong. The office is located in central Madrid (Chamberí, near Eloy Gonzalo), well connected and situated in a vibrant part of the city. The challenge! items.desc: Internship – Procurement & AI Ben jij een ondernemend persoon met affiniteit voor Procurement, Supply Chain, Artificial Intelligence en Power BI? Ben je op zoek naar een uitdagende stage waarin je zelfstandig werkt en meedenkt over de mogelijkheden binnen Procurement en de toekomstige wereld van AI. Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou! De stage Als stagiair ben jij onderdeel van het team Procurement Transport en Energy. Wij zijn verantwoordelijk voor de inkoop van alle transport over weg en water, en alle warehouses. En voor alle energie die de 2 brouwerijen binnen HNS, in Zoeterwoude en Den Bosch nodig hebben. In deze stage ligt de focus voornamelijk op het laten functioneren en ontwikkelen van de Supply Chain binnen de mogelijkheden van AI en Power Bi om processen te verbeteren en verder te automiseren. Ontwikkeling van proces verbeteringen; Diverse taken zijn complex en raken veel deelgebieden. Deze kunnen verbeterd worden om sneller en met minder fouten te werken Procesverbeteringen implementeren; je krijgt de ruimte en verantwoordelijkheid om mee te denken over het optimaliseren van onze werkwijze. Support; ondersteuning van de Category Specialisten (4 FTE) bij diverse werkzaamheden binnen source to contract governance structuur Aanspreekpunt naar andere afdelingen m.b.t. het ontwikkelingen van dashboards; je staat in contact met interne stakeholders en mogelijk leveranciers; je bent een schakelpunt tussen hen en de brouwerij. Andere activiteiten binnen de Procurement afdeling. Je werkt samen in een team waarin veel ontwikkelingen plaatsvinden en waarin jouw hulp erg waardevol zal zijn voor je collega’s. Het is een functie met verantwoordelijkheden en vol met uitdagingen waarin je veel aspecten van de afdeling leert kennen. Tijdens je stage krijg je alle ruimte om HEINEKEN als organisatie te leren kennen, niet alleen binnen jouw eigen afdeling, maar ook daarbuiten. We geven je het vertrouwen en de vrijheid om te werken als een echte ondernemer. Bij HEINEKEN halen we de buitenwereld graag naar binnen en staan we open voor nieuwe, frisse ideeën. Natuurlijk zorgen we daarbij voor de begeleiding die bij jou past. De unieke jij! Wij geloven dat iedereen unieke talenten heeft en zijn daarom op zoek naar jou! Energie, drive en de wil om te groeien: bij HEINEKEN geloven we dat dát het verschil maakt. Daarnaast neem jij ook het volgende mee: Voor deze meewerkstage zoeken wij een kandidaat die: Een universitaire studie of HBO volgt in de richting van Logistiek, Supply Chain, of Data Analytics volgt en zich momenteel bevindt in de eindfase van zijn/haar studie Het leuk vindt met veel verschillende teams samen te werken tot 1 oplossing Zelfstandig is en een echte ‘hands on’ mentaliteit heeft Ervaring middels werken met AI en Power Bi is een must Zelfs als je denkt dat je niet aan alle criteria voldoet, moedigen we je aan om te solliciteren. Een stage is de perfecte kans om te leren en te groeien! Zo kan jouw stagedag eruitzien Op maandagen starten we met de afdeling en bespreken we de plannen voor de week. Je werkt aan je eigen projecten, hebt contact met collega's uit verschillende teams en schuift aan bij meetings. Soms deel je informatie met leveranciers, en in geval van risico's, schuif je aan bij vergaderingen om die te voorkomen. Tussen de middag lunch je samen met collega's of maak je een wandeling door Leiden. In de middag werk je zelfstandig verder aan lopende opdrachten of ondersteun je bij activiteiten binnen het team. Je hebt besprekingen om je verbeter voorstellen af te stemmen. Ook zijn er regelmatig bijeenkomsten voor stagiairs, netwerkmomenten en andere events, waardoor er altijd iets te beleven is naast je dagelijkse werkzaamheden Voorwaarden vanuit HEINEKEN Je bent gedurende de volledige stageperiode ingeschreven bij een onderwijsinstelling en kan hiervoor een bewijs van inschrijving van het huidige studiejaar aanleveren tijdens je onboarding. In het geval je geen-EU nationaliteit hebt dien je als stagiair(e) ingeschreven te staan bij een Nederlandse onderwijsinstelling. In geval van wel-EU nationaliteit mag je als stagiair(e) ook ingeschreven staan bij onderwijsinstellingen buiten de EU. Je woont gedurende de volledige stageperiode in Nederland. Houd er rekening mee dat HEINEKEN geen huisvesting verzorgt. Je bent in het bezit van een geldig Burgerservicenummer (BSN). Onze stagevoorwaarden Tijdens jouw stage bij HEINEKEN werk je in een inspirerende en dynamische omgeving, waar leren en groeien centraal staan. Samen b(r)ouwen we stap voor stap aan jouw toekomst. Daarnaast bieden wij jou: Een full time, startend op 1 februari 2027 De duur van de stage is 5 of 6 maanden (dit gaat in overleg met jouw nieuwe stagebegeleider) Jouw thuiskantoor staat in Leiden, maar bezoeken aan Zoeterwoude of Den Bosch behoren daar ook toe Bij HEINEKEN werken we volgens een hybride model, waarbij we gemiddeld drie dagen per week op kantoor werken en twee dagen vanuit huis Je ontvangt een stagevergoeding van €650 bruto per …

items.desc: Vill du vara med och omsätta AI från idé till verklig nytta? Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av AI, automation och Microsofts ekosystem och som vill utveckla smarta lösningar som förenklar och effektiviserar komplexa arbetsflöden. Här får du en verksamhetsnära roll där du kombinerar teknisk utveckling med problemlösning, rådgivning och möjligheten att påverka hur AI används i praktiken. Om tjänsten: Som AI-agentutvecklare blir du en del av ett mindre team hos ett stort och etablerat bolag inom energibranschen. Verksamheten befinner sig i en spännande utvecklingsfas där AI och automation får en allt viktigare roll i att effektivisera arbetssätt och skapa bättre förutsättningar för projektverksamheten. I rollen arbetar du med att identifiera möjligheter till automatisering och utveckla AI-baserade lösningar som förenklar både administrativa och tekniska processer. Du kommer framför allt att arbeta inom Microsofts ekosystem, med verktyg som Copilot Studio och Power Platform, för att bygga AI-agenter och automatiserade arbetsflöden som integreras med verksamhetens befintliga system. Det kan exempelvis handla om att utveckla AI-agenter som granskar tekniska specifikationer, identifierar avvikelser eller genererar dokument utifrån befintliga riktlinjer och mallar. Andra användningsområden är att automatisera hanteringen av omfattande informationsunderlag, sammanställa riskanalyser och skapa bättre struktur i projektplanering och prioritering. Det här är en roll för dig som tycker om att kombinera teknik med verksamhetsförståelse. Du förväntas inte bara utveckla lösningarna, utan också vara med och identifiera behoven, föreslå lämpliga tekniska angreppssätt och driva arbetet hela vägen till en fungerande lösning. Du kommer även att stötta verksamheten genom rådgivning, workshops och kunskapsöverföring. Du får stor frihet att planera och driva ditt arbete självständigt, samtidigt som du samarbetar nära kollegor och olika delar av organisationen. Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter: Identifiera och analysera processer som kan effektiviseras genom AI och automation. Utveckla, implementera och vidareutveckla AI-agenter med hjälp av Microsoft Copilot Studio och Power Platform. Utforma tekniska lösningar, integrationer och automatiserade dataflöden. Automatisera hantering och granskning av teknisk dokumentation och projektadministration. Driva utvecklingsarbetet från behovsanalys och idé till färdig lösning. Agera tekniskt stöd och rådgivare samt hålla workshops för verksamheten. Vi söker dig som: Har flera års relevant erfarenhet av AI-utveckling, automation, systemutveckling eller liknande områden. Har praktisk erfarenhet av att utveckla och implementera AI-agenter och automatiserade arbetsflöden. Har goda kunskaper inom Microsofts ekosystem, särskilt Copilot, Copilot Studio och Power Platform, inklusive Power Automate och Power Apps. Har förståelse för systemintegration, datahantering och teknisk lösningsarkitektur. Är van vid att arbeta verksamhetsnära och omsätta behov och utmaningar till konkreta tekniska lösningar. Har förmåga att självständigt driva utvecklingsarbete från idé till implementation. Det är meriterande om du har: Erfarenhet av Python, RPA eller Azure och molnbaserade lösningar. Arbetat med stora datamängder, teknisk dokumentation eller komplexa informationsflöden. Erfarenhet från energibranschen, elkraft eller annan tekniskt komplex verksamhet. För att trivas i rollen tror vi att du är en nyfiken och lösningsorienterad person som gärna tar egna initiativ. Du tycker om att utforska nya möjligheter, identifiera förbättringsområden och omsätta idéer till lösningar som gör verklig skillnad. Du är trygg i din tekniska kompetens och har förmågan att självständigt driva ditt arbete framåt, även när vägen till den färdiga lösningen inte är helt utstakad. Samtidigt är du ödmjuk, lyhörd och samarbetsorienterad. Eftersom rollen innebär många kontaktytor är det viktigt att du kan förklara tekniska lösningar på ett pedagogiskt sätt och skapa förståelse och engagemang hos andra. Om Friday: På Friday brinner vi för att ge dig som tech-talang en riktigt bra start och fortsatt utveckling i karriären. Genom oss får du möjlighet att arbeta hos spännande företag där din kompetens och ditt engagemang gör skillnad. Vi värdesätter långsiktiga relationer och vill vara en partner som stöttar dig i din fortsatta utveckling. Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

items.desc: Lieu : Toulouse, France Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. Nos engagements, vos avantages Notre savoir-faire technologique Notre attention portée à l’équilibre des collaborateurs Un environnement inclusif et bienveillant Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu (Thales Solidarity, indice CAC 40 ESG…) Votre quotidien En rejoignant le site de Toulouse, vous intégrez un site regroupant nos solutions de cyberdéfense souveraines pour faire face aux menaces informatiques croissantes et nos activités de services numériques permettant d’opérer les systèmes d’informations critiques de nos clients et de les accompagner dans leur transformation numérique sécurisée. Dans un centre de calcul haute performance (HPC), l’optimisation de code améliore l’efficacité et réduit les coûts de calcul. L’IA, notamment les modèles de langage à grand contexte, permet d’automatiser cette optimisation pour des bases de code complètes et multi-langages. Le stage vise à définir et mettre en œuvre un système IA capable d’analyser automatiquement un code source, puis de générer des suggestions d’optimisation à deux niveaux : une première analyse et des améliorations plus poussées incluant des pistes de parallélisation. Le système exécute ce processus sous forme de jobs SLURM pouvant durer plusieurs heures, en particulier sur GPU. Il s’intègre aussi à un monitoring multi-agents qui teste et valide les optimisations proposées. Le travail consiste à structurer un pipeline complet IA (analyse + génération), mettre en place un environnement local compatible grand contexte (plus de 20k tokens), assurer l’orchestration SLURM en période creuse, puis explorer un monitoring éventuel avec exécution et validation “live”. Votre profil Votre priorité est d'effectuer un stage de 6 mois ? Vous avez l’ambition de perfectionner vos connaissances en informatique et en IA ? Vous souhaitez découvrir l'IA générative et les outils de monitoring ? Vous Préparez Un Diplôme D'Ingénieur Ou Un Équivalent Bac +5 Et Vous Avez De L'expérience Sur le développement en Python, C/C++ ou Java la gestion des jobs HPC (SLURM), l'optimisation de code. Votre curiosité, votre proactivité, votre prise d'initiative et votre rigueur sont des atouts que l'on vous reconnait ? Alors ce poste est fait pour vous ! Tous nos stages sont conventionnés et soumis à une gratification dont le montant est déterminé selon votre niveau d’études.Le poste pouvant nécessiter d'accéder à des informations relevant du secret de la défense nationale, la personne retenue fera l'objet d'une procédure d’habilitation, conformément aux dispositions des articles R.2311-1 et suivants du Code de la défense et de l’IGI 1300 SGDSN/PSE du 09 août 2021. Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

items.desc: You'll make Volta's AI pipeline production-grade at enterprise scale: multi-tenant, observable, cost-efficient and configurable per customer without code changes. You'll take parsing, matching and LLM orchestration services that already work and make them work for fifteen enterprise customers at once. You report to the Head of AI. Turn the Core into configuration: design the tenant configuration model (prompts, schemas, matching rules, thresholds, feature switches) so onboarding a new enterprise customer is configuration plus evaluation, not a code change Make multi-tenancy real: per-tenant data separation across services, storage, caches, knowledge bases and traces Scale the pipeline: Cloud Run services for ingestion, API, parsing and matching that absorb bursts of orders and large documents, with queues, idempotency and retries that don't re-run the whole pipeline Make it observable: every LLM call traced and costed in Langfuse, trace IDs carried onto orders, alerts on stuck orders and quality regressions Keep cost per order under control: model choice per step, caching, batching, cost dashboards per customer Ship safely: replay and regression tests in CI for prompts and schemas, versioned prompts and configs, gradual rollout per tenant Make accuracy a release gate: plug per-customer evaluation harnesses into the delivery pipeline, with the data scientists Make it secure: treat prompts, model outputs, tools and data flows as untrusted attack surface, and enforce it with automated guardrails, least-privilege access and continuous red-teaming in CI/CD Backend engineer who moved into AI systems: 4+ years building production backend services in Python, at least one or two on LLM-powered systems in production Distributed systems done right: queues, async processing, idempotency, retries, back-pressure, concurrency on shared databases Multi-tenant SaaS: you've designed or operated a system serving many customers with real isolation requirements Observability first: you've instrumented services with tracing and metrics and used them to debug production Config over code: you've built systems driven by versioned configuration, feature flags or rules, and kept them understandable Must have: strong Python (FastAPI or similar), typing, tests; production LLM orchestration (structured outputs, tool calling, retries and fallbacks, prompt versioning); containerised services on Cloud Run, GKE, EKS or ECS; tracing and LLM observability (Langfuse, OpenTelemetry or similar); items.desc:
Introduction
 At ASML in Veldhoven, the System Delivery Management team plays a key role in coordinating the delivery of highly complex systems. The team works across multiple business functions to support operational decision-making, improve visibility into potential risks, and enhance collaboration. As data volumes and operational complexity continue to grow, there is an opportunity to leverage artificial intelligence to support faster and better-informed decisions. In this internship, you will help design and demonstrate an AI-powered solution that enables operational teams to work more effectively. This internship offers the opportunity to contribute to a real business challenge with visible impact.
 Your assignment
 During this internship, you will explore how artificial intelligence can support operational processes and decision-making within System Delivery Management. You will investigate business challenges, identify opportunities for automation and prediction, and develop practical AI solutions. The ultimate goal is to design and demonstrate an AI-powered System Delivery Control Tower that helps teams make faster and better-informed decisions. 
 Your main responsibilities will be:
 Analyze current operational workflows and identify improvement opportunities
 Investigate how generative AI and intelligent agents can support decision-making
 Design and develop AI-powered prototypes to address operational challenges
 Build and evaluate AI agents that support information gathering and action tracking
 Explore methods to predict operational risks and improve readiness assessments
 Translate technical findings into practical recommendations for stakeholders
 Present results, demonstrations, and improvement proposals to stakeholders
 This is a master thesis/non-theses internship for minimum 6 months, minimum 4-5 days per week (3 days on-site). The start date of this internship is as of February 2027.
 Your profile
 To be suitable for the internship, you:
 Are pursuing a master's degree in Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, or a related engineering field
 Have hands-on experience with artificial intelligence through academic projects, research, internships, or professional experience
 Have a strong technical and analytical mindset
 Are proactive, collaborative, and comfortable engaging with different stakeholders
 Can translate technical concepts into practical business value
 This internship is particularly suitable for students who enjoy solving complex problems and creating innovative AI-based solutions. During this internship, you will work closely with experienced professionals while gaining exposure to operational strategy, advanced analytics, and digital transformation initiatives. Your contribution can help shape the future of AI-enabled operational decision-making at ASML.
 Other requirements you need to meet: 
 You are enrolled at an educational institute for the entire duration of the internship, and you are at least 18 years old at the start of the internship; 
 If you are a non-EU citizen, studying in the Netherlands, your university is willing to sign the documents relevant for doing an internship (i.e., Nuffic agreement); 
 You attach your cover letter with a clear motivation on why you are interested in this internship assignment in particular; 
 You need to be located in the Netherlands to be perform your internship. In case you are currently living/studying outside of the Netherlands, your application shows the willingness to relocate. 
 This position requires access to controlled technology, as defined in the United States Export Administration Regulations (15 C.F.R. § 730, et seq.). Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to access such controlled technology prior to beginning work. Business demands may require ASML to proceed with candidates who are immediately eligible to access controlled technology. 
 Inclusion and diversity 
 ASML is an Equal Opportunity Employer that values and respects the importance of a diverse and inclusive workforce. It is the policy of the company to recruit, hire, train and promote persons in all job titles without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, or gender identity. We recognize that inclusion and diversity is a driving force in the success of our company.
 Need to know more about applying for a job at ASML? Read our frequently asked questions .

items.desc:
Job Description: 
 Envie de déployer vos ailes ? Et si votre aventure commençait avec nous ? 
 Quel que soit le métier de vos rêves, nous avons peut-être le stage qu’il vous faut ! 
 Vous êtes étudiant(e) et à la recherche d'un stage ou d'une année de césure vous permettant de valider votre diplôme et qui fera décoller votre carrière ? Imaginez-vous au cœur d’une entreprise reconnue à l’international, implantée sur tous les continents du monde et riche d’une diversité de parcours, d’expertise et de culture.
 Tournée vers le digital, à la pointe de la recherche et de l’innovation, vous avez l’opportunité de faire partie de cette aventure passionnante.
 Votre mission, si vous l'acceptez : 
 Une offre de stage intitulée « Stage en Intelligence Artificielle pour le centre d'Essais en vol et intégration (F/H) » vient de s'ouvrir au sein de Airbus Commercial Aircraft sur son site de Toulouse. Vous rejoindrez le département « Digital Test Means » du Centre d'Essais en Vol et d'Intégration, au sein de l'équipe Intelligence Artificielle (IA).
 Votre stage consistera à concevoir, implémenter et évaluer des approches de certification et d'estimation de l'incertitude (notamment via la prédiction conforme et les réseaux de neurones Lipschitz) appliquées à des modèles d'IA critiques en computer vision pour la chaîne de mesure et les essais en vol.
 Ce stage, d'une durée de 6 mois , débutera idéalement en premier semestre 2027 (cette période est indicative et pourra être ajustée).
 Vos principales missions consisteront à : 
 Réaliser un état de l'art approfondi et explorer les méthodes de prédiction conforme (Conformal Prediction) appliquées aux réseaux de neurones profonds.
 Mettre en œuvre des approches de quantification de l'incertitude indépendantes de la distribution (Distribution-Free Uncertainty Quantification) afin de générer des ensembles de confiance garantis (ex. à 90 %) adaptés à la complexité des données d'entrée.
 Développer et expérimenter des techniques de robustesse et de certification algorithmique (notamment via des réseaux de neurones Lipschitz ou des garanties théoriques formelles).
 Appliquer, benchmarker et valider ces approches sur des cas d'usage industriels concrets en vision par ordinateur (computer vision), tels que des systèmes d'OCR (Reconnaissance Optique de Caractères) ou de comparaison d'images pour les essais aéronautiques.
 Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes d'essais, les physiciens et les data scientists pour intégrer ces briques fiabilisées au sein de la chaîne de traitement de bout en bout.
 Votre tuteur ou tutrice vous accompagnera tout au long de votre stage, vous aidant à développer vos compétences et à atteindre vos objectifs professionnels.
 Ce stage vous permettra notamment de développer les compétences suivantes :
 Expertise théorique et pratique en Conformal Prediction et en quantification de l'incertitude dans les réseaux de neurones.
 Maîtrise des méthodes de robustesse certifiée et d'explicabilité/fiabilisation des modèles d'IA (réseaux Lipschitz, bornes de confiance).
 Expérience opérationnelle du déploiement d'algorithmes d'IA sur des données réelles et critiques de vision par ordinateur (OCR, analyse d'images).
 Compréhension approfondie des processus de mesure, d'instrumentation et d'essais en vol dans l'industrie aéronautique.
 Méthodologie de travail transverse en R&D industrielle combinant rigueur mathématique et implémentation logicielle.
 Votre carte d’embarquement pour cette aventure : 
 Vous êtes actuellement en Master 2, 5ème année d'école d'ingénieur ou équivalent (Bac+5), spécialisé en Intelligence Artificielle, Mathématiques Appliquées, Informatique ou Data Science.
 Vous possédez idéalement les compétences suivantes :
 - Compétences techniques :
 Solides fondations en mathématiques appliquées (probabilités, statistiques, optimisation) et en Machine Learning / Deep Learning.
 Maîtrise des frameworks de Deep Learning et du développement Python (PyTorch, TensorFlow, etc.) ainsi que des bibliothèques de Computer Vision (OpenCV, etc.).
 Connaissances en quantification de l'incertitude, robustesse algorithmique ou prédiction conforme (une expérience en laboratoire de recherche appliquée ou lors d'un projet industriel est un plus).
 Une familiarité avec les environnements industriels complexes (aéronautique, spatial, automobile) constitue un atout apprécié.
 - Soft Skills :
 Autonomie, curiosité scientifique et rigueur méthodologique.
 Excellent esprit d'équipe, aisance relationnelle et fortes capacités de communication écrite et orale.
 Orientation utilisateur et pragmatisme : profil « doer » passionné par la résolution de problèmes techniques complexes de bout en bout.

Job Description: 
 Ready to join one of our Graduate Programs in Spain? 
 AIRBUS offer more than 70 vacancies for our full time graduate program in Spain #Discover I 2027 2028 Starting date March 2027 until February 2028. 
 We are looking for recent graduates from different disciplines interested in developing their professional career in the aeronautical sector. The current context demands different ways of looking, thinking and relating.
 The selection process will be during October 2026 until January 2027. 
 What does this internship consists in? 
 Together with Camilo José Cela University, Airbus has developed an exclusive program (Discover) designed for those interested in the best training in new areas of knowledge essential to be able to develop as professionals of the future.
 You will have the opportunity to study a Master, organized in three training blocks, that will allow you to Discover the skills most in demand today. It will be combined with an 11 month internship at Airbus in an area related to your degree, where you can learn and complete your academic background.
 The start of the internship will last 11 months (August disabled for all purposes). It is a full time experience (40 h/week), in which you will receive an attractive study grant.
 Internship Job Description: 
 Monitor project milestones: Track the development lifecycle of AI initiatives within the Repairs department to ensure on-time delivery.
 Gather business requirements: Shadow and interview repair team to translate their daily operational pain points into functional AI features.
 Own project documentation: Create clear user guides, workflow diagrams, and technical documentation for the deployed AI repair tools.
 By the end of this internship, you will have acquired the following core competencies:
 End-to-End AI Deployment: Practical knowledge of how AI models move from data preparation to operational use.
 Agile Methodology (User Stories): Ability to test, benchmark, and audit AI outputs against expert human diagnostics.
 Smart Operations (Repairs): Deep understanding of repair process and KPIs and workflows optimization.
 Change Management: Skills to bridge the gap between technical teams and end-users, facilitating AI adoption in the field.
 Deploying AI solutions within operations, combining hands-on technical validation in BRAIN and MAIA with data tracking in SAP. 
 Required skills #AirbusDiversit

 - Degree in Data Analytics & Visualization.
 - AI & Prompt Engineering Basics
 - Data Management.
 - Level B2 English.
 - General knowledge in ERP & Logistics Systems
 Skills valued:
 - Analytical and problem solving skills.
 - Team spirit and great collaboration skills.
 - Ability to work in complex and international environments.
 Why should you apply? 
 - Foster your professional development with a strong academic background and an in-depth collaboration in AIRBUS projects.
 - Expand your network within the aeronautical industry.
 - Meet our people working with passion and determination to make the world a more connected, safer and smarter place.
 - Be part of our diversity and teamwork culture that propel us to accomplish the extraordinary on the ground, in the sky and in space.
 For any inquiries concerning this selection process, please contact us at randstad-airbus@randstad.es

Job Description: 
 A vacancy for a Reliability, Maintainability and Testability (RMT) Engineer has arisen within Airbus Defence & Space in Getafe (Madrid).
 Reliability, Maintainability and Testability (RMT) is a major core process of Support Engineering and Integrated Logistic Support. The RMT process is fully integrated with design, development and verification processes. One of the main functions and roles of RMT is to participate in development activities to ensure “Design to Services”.
 RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Establish and agree with the Design Office and Suppliers the RMT Requirements and ensure that they are implemented in the design.

items.desc:
ANYbotics is a fast-growing tech company dedicated to shaping the future of mobile robotics across multiple industries. Join our highly talented and motivated team of more than 190 people and work on cutting-edge robot technology. We are open to internships all year round and post regularly.
 
We’re always looking for passionate, curious, and motivated interns to join our mission.
 
This is your chance to collaborate with world-class experts, gain real-world experience, and make meaningful contributions in a fast-paced, interdisciplinary environment.
 
 


We’re always looking for passionate, curious, and motivated interns to join the Advanced Technology team. We explore emerging technologies and transform them into practical innovations that shape the future of robotics at ANYbotics. We bridge cutting-edge research with real-world industrial applications by rapidly validating new ideas, building prototypes, and transferring successful technologies into our products. Working closely with leading universities, startups, and internal engineering teams, we tackle challenging problems in robotics, AI, computer vision, and autonomous systems to create the next generation of industrial inspection robots.
 
The Opportunity
We are looking for a Reinforcement Learning for Robotic Navigation intern to join our Advanced Technology team and contribute to advancing ANYmal's mobility capabilities. Utilizing the latest reinforcement learning techniques and simulation tools, we define, train, and integrate ML models into ANYmal to safely and robustly navigate challenging industrial environments. 
Your role includes evaluating and fine tuning state of the art RL-based navigation & locomotion policies  in simulation and on real quadruped robots. This internship provides a profound and impactful opportunity to work at the forefront of machine learning in robotics, playing a significant role in shaping ANYmal's autonomous capabilities and contributing to real-world applications. 
You will work closely with Robotics experts and research partners who will provide you with guidance and mentorship. The preferred starting date is September 2026, and the full-time paid internship lasts six months.
 

Your Contributions:
Project Support: Work closely with our engineers and researchers on active projects across the entire software stack, from application software to autonomy stack and low-level software.
 Algorithm Implementation: Design, implement, test, and validate new algorithms and features in core software areas.
 Testing & Infrastructure: Contribute to the continuous improvement of our testing infrastructure, simulation environments, and CI/CD pipelines to ensure the robustness and reliability of the ANYmal platform
 Code Development & Testing: Write clean, efficient, and well-documented C++ and Python code for real-time operation on the robot. Contribute to our robust testing and simulation infrastructure
Your Profile:
Education: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD program in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical field.
 Foundational Knowledge: Solid academic knowledge and proven ability in one or more areas relevant to mobile robotics, such as Control Theory, Machine Learning, Computer Vision.
 Programming Skills: Strong proficiency in Python and/or C++ (Modern C++ is highly valued).
 Software Development Skills: Experience with Git, Docker, and AI-assisted software development tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot).
 Collaboration: Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively in our highly interdisciplinary, English-speaking environment.
 Attitude: A hands-on, proactive, and analytical attitude towards complex problem-solving and eagerness to learn rapidly.
Bonus points, a few extra things that would make us especially excited about your application:
You have trained AI models on GPUs and have explored CUDA or other GPU-accelerated computing frameworks.

 You know and worked with Robotics Middleware (ROS/ROS 2).

items.desc:
Mission 
 The Cryogenic Electron Microscopist will be responsible for the operation, maintenance and troubleshooting of specialized scientific equipment, including one Glacios and three Titan Krios microscopes, within the cryo-EM core facility of the Dubochet Center for Imaging (DCI). 
 Main duties and responsibilities 
 As part of the DCI team, your responsibilities will include: 
 Cryo-EM sample preparation 
 Data acquisition for single-particle analysis (SPA) and cryo-electron tomography (cryo-ET) 
 On-the-fly and offline data processing, advanced image processing 
 Structure determination and interpretation 
 As a cryo-EM support, you will provide technical and scientific support to researchers from EPFL, UNIL as well as external customers, advising users throughout the different stages of their projects, from experimental planning and data acquisition to image processing and structure determination. You will also contribute to the continuous development and improvement of the DCI cryo-EM platform, helping to ensure a high level of service, reliability and performance for its users. 
 Profile 
 Ph.D. in tructural biology or related field with experience in Cryo-EM 
 At least one year of hands-on experience in cryo-EM, including instrument operation, facility support, training, data acquisition, data processing and/or cryo-ET 
 Experience with cryo-EM image-processing software such as cryoSPARC, IMOD/eTomo, and Scipion 
 Experience with SPA and/or cryo-ET workflows is desirable 
 Good understanding of cryo-EM data acquisition and processing workflows 
 Excellent communication skills in an English-speaking environment 
 Strong motivation to explore new research domains 
 We are looking for a person who is: 
 Service-oriented, proactive, and enthusiastic 
 Practical and hands-on, with the flexibility to thrive in a dynamic, service-oriented platform 
 Comfortable with change and able to adapt quickly to evolving priorities and workflows 
 Reliable and committed to delivering high-quality results for all types of users and customers 
 Collaborative, with clear communication skills and a constructive team spirit 
 Able to work independently while contributing effectively to a team environment 
 We offer 
 The position is based in the campus of EPFL and UNIL in Lausanne, Switzerland, and is available from 01 January 2027. It will initially be offered as a one-year contract, with the possibility of renewal.  When Microsoft experiences a significant service outage, customers expect more than service restoration. They want to understand what happened, why it happened, what Microsoft has done to address it, and what measures have been implemented to prevent recurrence.
 The Incident Communications and Coordination (ICC) team is responsible for developing Microsoft's customer-facing Post Incident Reports (PIRs), one of the most important deliverables produced following major service incidents. These reports are a critical component of Microsoft's commitment to transparency, accountability, and customer trust.
 We are seeking a Mission Critical Incident Analysis Engineer to lead the investigation, development, and publication of customer-facing PIRs for high-impact Microsoft 365 service incidents. This role combines service engineering, incident analysis, stakeholder management, investigative research, and technical communication.
 Success in this role requires someone who is naturally curious, highly analytical, comfortable engaging senior engineering teams, and capable of transforming complex technical investigations into clear and trustworthy customer communications.
 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 You will actively seek to develop an understanding of key learnings, insights and best practices that can be applied to improve development and operations of the system, platform, or product components and features. 
 You will develop foundational technical knowledge, judgment, and decision making in crisis situations to contribute to mitigation plans and assist with resolving, reducing, or mitigating the impact of a crisis by engaging with necessary teams and escalating to appropriate stakeholders as instructed.

You’ll tackle real-world challenges by contributing to
items.desc:
You will build the foundational data infrastructure that powers cutting-edge AI applications leveraging LLMs, retrieval systems, workflows, and emerging agentic architectures.
 You will design and maintain scalable data pipelines, manage secure data environments, and prepare data for AI-driven systems while collaborating with cross-functional teams and clients. You’ll tackle real-world challenges by contributing to the development of next-generation AI systems and grow as a technologist by working alongside diverse experts across industries.
 You will design and build the scalable, reproducible data components essential for machine learning, agentic, and autonomous AI systems. You’ll assess data landscapes, apply data quality fundamentals, and prepare data for AI solutions. Additionally, you’ll learn to translate simple hypotheses into engineered features, manage secure data environments, and contribute to R&D initiatives focused on innovating and scaling next-generation AI capabilities.
 Your work will help solve some of the most complex and high-impact challenges facing clients across industries. Collaborating across QuantumBlack, AI by McKinsey and QuantumBlack Labs teams, you’ll help develop innovative AI capabilities and scalable enterprise solutions. You’ll help build robust data foundations for scalable, production-ready AI systems. Your contributions will directly support the firm’s ability to accelerate AI adoption, solve complex business problems at scale, and enable clients to achieve meaningful, lasting impact.
 You’ll be based in Copenhagen or Stockholm as part of our global Data Engineering community. Working in cross-functional Agile teams, you’ll collaborate closely with Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, and industry experts to deliver AI solutions. By partnering with clients from data owners to C-level executives you’ll help solve complex problems that drive tangible business value and begin to build your skills as a client-facing technologist.
 You will a unique opportunity to grow at the forefront of AI, data engineering, and emerging agentic technologies. You’ll develop expertise at the intersection of technology and business by tackling diverse challenges in the evolving AI landscape. Working alongside multidisciplinary teams, you’ll gain a holistic understanding of how data engineering enables advanced AI while collaborating with some leading AI and data experts in the industry.
 Degree in Computer Science/Engineering, or equivalent experience
 Experience in a data-focused role (internships, academic projects)
 Ability to write clean, well-documented code in a modern programming language, with a strong preference for Python and SQL
 Interest in or exposure to data engineering in the context of Agentic AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, or Business Intelligence across different types of data formats (structured vs unstructured) and processing methods (streaming vs batch)
 Familiarity with commonly used data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, PSQL, etc.), cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and engineering tools (Pandas, Spark, dbt, LangChain, etc.)
 Exposure to modern software development practices, including version control (Git) and foundational concepts in DevOps and MLOps/LLMOps and CI/CD principles
 Exceptional time management in a complex and largely autonomous work environment
 Willingness to learn quickly and adapt to different project situations and tech stacks
 Experience using coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, etc.) is a plus
 Business level language fluency skills, both verbal and written, in English and local office language(s)
