 About us
 At Mercedes-Benz Cars, we're passionate about developing the next generation of talent. Our Undergraduate Programmes are designed to give you the opportunity to learn, grow and make a real impact from day one, while helping shape the future of mobility through innovation, sustainability and exceptional customer experiences.
 We believe great careers start with the right support, which is why you'll be encouraged to explore new ideas, build valuable skills and learn from experienced colleagues across the business. Together, we create an inclusive environment where everyone feels they belong, can contribute confidently and reach their full potential. Our culture is built on respect, equal opportunity and the belief that diverse perspectives make us stronger, helping us deliver better outcomes for our customers, colleagues and communities.
 About our IT undergraduate programme
 We’re looking for two motivated undergraduates, currently studying IT, Business Analysis or Project Management, to join our dynamic IT team and ready to make an impact from day one. You’ll get hands-on experience across meaningful projects, building your commercial awareness, analytical thinking, and stakeholder skills while helping deliver real business value.
 Some of the skills you can expect to gain:
 · Practical business insight gained from real-world challenges
 · Sharp commercial awareness and an understanding of what drives performance
 · Clear, confident, and professional communication skills
 · The ability to think strategically and make informed decisions
 · A deep understanding of our industry and how it’s evolving
 What's in it for you
 As well as the opportunity to work in a collaborative environment, with a great team and culture, you will receive:
 · Thirteen-month programme based in our offices in Milton Keynes
 · A competitive salary
 · 25 days holiday per year, plus bank holidays
 What you'll bring
 · Currently studying a degree with an expected 2:1 grade or above that has focus on IT, Business Analysis or Project Management
 · Currently studying a degree that enables you to complete a year in industry before you graduate
 · Organised, detail-focused, and proactive
 · Excel-savvy with strong digital skills
 · Clear communicator and collaborative team player
 · Curious, adaptable, and eager to learn
 · Confident taking initiative and solving problems
 · Passionate about technology and innovation

items.desc: Vos missions au quotidien Vous souhaitez intégrer un groupe international et multiculturel ? Rejoignez-nous ! L'équipe développe des solutions fondées sur l'IA générative et les systèmes agentiques, depuis l'expérimentation et le Proof of Concept jusqu'à leur industrialisation. items.desc: Vos missions au quotidien Au sein de Société Générale, vous rejoindrez la Direction des Risques. La Direction des Risques est au cœur de l'activité du Groupe avec pour principale mission de contribuer au développement des métiers et de leur rentabilité par la mise en œuvre de l'appétit au risque. L'équipe RISQ/MDL/MOD développe des solutions innovantes basées sur l'intelligence artificielle afin de transformer et d'innover les procédures de modélisation du risque de crédit. Les équipes de modélisation produisent de nombreux documents réglementaires et méthodologiques qui nécessitent l'analyse de données, l'application de frameworks internes et la rédaction de rapports techniques. Ces travaux mobilisent un temps important et nécessitent un haut niveau de rigueur afin de garantir la conformité réglementaire. Dans ce contexte, nous développons une nouvelle génération d'outils s'appuyant sur l'IA générative pour automatiser la production de ces documents tout en conservant un contrôle humain sur les résultats. Au cours de ce stage, vous participerez à la conception et au développement d'une plateforme d'IA permettant de générer automatiquement des documents de modélisation à partir de données, d'analyses et de référentiels méthodologiques. Vos missions incluront notamment : Participer à la conception fonctionnelle et technique de l'outil Développer des composants Python dédiés à l'automatisation des analyses et de la génération documentaire Concevoir et optimiser des prompts pour les modèles d'IA générative Développer des interfaces utilisateurs facilitant l'utilisation de l'outil par les modélisateurs Mettre en œuvre des mécanismes de contrôle qualité et de validation des résultats générés Participer aux phases de test, de recette utilisateur et d'amélioration continue Contribuer à la documentation technique et fonctionnelle de la solution Réaliser une veille technologique sur les dernières avancées en IA générative et agents IA Technologies et environnement : Python ; Streamlit; LLM ; Git / GitHub ; API et services Azure IA; Prompt Engineering Durée du stage: 6 mois. Et si c'était vous ? Profil recherché Vous êtes étudiant en dernière année d'école d'ingénieur, université ou master spécialisé en Intelligence artificielle, Data Science ou Informatique Compétences appréciées : Bon niveau en Python Connaissance en IA générative et LLM Intérêt pour le développement de produits IA Goût pour l'innovation et l'expérimentation Bonne autonomie et esprit d'équipe Plus qu'un poste, un tremplin Rejoignez-nous pour faire grandir vos ambitions ! Dès votre arrivée, vous serez intégré dans nos équipes et apprendrez chaque jour aux côtés de nos experts qui vous accompagneront dans vos missions. Progressivement, vous gagnerez en autonomie sur vos projets pour faire de cette expérience un vrai accélérateur de carrière. Vous découvrirez également toute la diversité de nos métiers, dans un secteur qui évolue et innove en permanence. A la fin de vos études, diverses opportunités pourront s'offrir à vous, en France et à l'international. Pourquoi nous choisir ? Attentif à votre qualité de vie et conditions de travail , vous bénéficiez d'avantages : Télétravail possible selon le rythme de votre service Prise en charge de 60% de votre titre de transport Billetterie à prix réduits de notre Comité d'Entreprise (concerts, cinéma, sport) Offre variée de restaurants d'entreprise et de cafétérias à tarifs compétitifs ainsi que des titres restaurants dématérialisés quand vous êtes en télétravail Créer, oser, innover, entreprendre font partie de notre ADN. Si vous aussi vous souhaitez être dans l'action, évoluer dans un environnement stimulant et bienveillant, vous sentir utile au quotidien et développer ou renforcer votre expertise, nous sommes faits pour nous rencontrer ! Vous hésitez encore ? Sachez que nos collaborateurs peuvent s'engager quelques jours par an pour des actions de solidarité sur leur temps de travail : parrainer des personnes en difficulté dans leur orientation ou leur insertion professionnelle, participer à l'éducation financière de jeunes en apprentissage ou encore partager leurs compétences avec une association. Les formats d'engagement sont multiples.

Il a également pour
items.desc: La Direction Actuariat Groupe est composée de trois pôles : Provisionnement Vie, Provisionnement Non-Vie et Analyse de Modèle. Le pôle Analyse de Modèle a pour mission principale la validation indépendante du modèle interne de SCOR utilisé pour le calcul du SCR du Groupe et des entités européennes, le développement de la gestion du risque de modèles à SCOR incluant la validation de ces modèles. Il a également pour mission d’assurer une veille actuarielle continue, de mener des études permettant l’implémentation dans le Groupe des nouvelles méthodologies ou normes réglementaires, de mettre en œuvre des méthodes et procédures normalisées d’évaluation et gestion des risques pour l’ensemble du Groupe. Au sein de cette équipe, le poste porte principalement sur les activités de validation des risques P&C. Il contribue également aux travaux transverses d’AI Assurance, de gestion du risque de modèle et de mise en conformité de SCOR avec l’EU AI Act. Sous la supervision du responsable de Model Analysis, vous intervenez principalement en appui du responsable de la validation P&C et vous contribuez également aux travaux transverses d’AI Assurance. 1.Validation des risques P&C - mission principale Vous contribuez à la préparation, à l’exécution et à la documentation des travaux de validation indépendante des risques P&C du modèle interne de SCOR. Vous analysez et vous examinez de manière critique les méthodologies, hypothèses, données, calibrations, résultats, limites et jugements d’experts utilisés pour la modélisation des risques P&C. Vous réalisez des analyses quantitatives, des tests indépendants et des revues de sensibilité ou de matérialité afin d’étayer les conclusions de validation. Vous contribuez à la rédaction des rapports de validation, à la formulation des constats et recommandations, ainsi qu’au suivi des plans d’action associés. Vous participez aux cotés du responsable de la validation P&C à la coordination des travaux, la préparation des échanges avec les équipes propriétaires de modèles et la présentation des conclusions aux instances de gouvernance. 2.AI Assurance et gestion du risque de modèle - contribution transverse Vous réalisez des revues indépendantes de scorecards et vous contribuez à la validation de modèles et systèmes d’intelligence artificielle, en formalisant les analyses et conclusions dans des livrables de validation. Vous concevez, exécutez et documentez des campagnes de tests portant sur les champs, règles de gestion, workflows et calculs implémentés dans OpenPages pour l’inventaire des modèles et la conformité à l’EU AI Act. Vous analysez et fiabilisez l’inventaire des modèles et systèmes d’IA, notamment la qualité des données, la cohérence des classifications, le suivi des anomalies et les plans de remédiation. Vous contribuez aux échanges avec les équipes Tech & Data, Legal, Risk Management et métiers pour le recueil des besoins, le cadrage des évolutions, la priorisation et le suivi des actions. Vous participez au développement et à l’amélioration d’assistants IA destinés aux équipes de Group Actuarial afin d’automatiser certaines tâches récurrentes et de faciliter l’accès à l’information. Cette mission offre une exposition combinée à la validation actuarielle des risques P&C, à la gouvernance des modèles, à l’intelligence artificielle, à la réglementation européenne et à la transformation digitale, dans un environnement international. Formation Vous êtes diplômé(e) d’une école d’ingénieur, d’actuariat ou d'une formation universitaire équivalente, avec u ne spécialisation en actuariat, statistiques, data science ou modélisation des risques . Une spécialisation ou une expérience en P&C et/ou en intelligence artificielle est un plus. Expérience/Compétences Bonne compréhension des problématiques de modélisation des risques. Une première exposition aux risques P&C, à la tarification, au provisionnement ou au capital économique constitue un atout. Solides compétences en statistiques, analyse de données et modélisation, avec une approche rigoureuse de la résolution de problèmes. Bonne maîtrise de Python et de son écosystème Data Science (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-Learn, etc.). Une expérience de R, SQL ou des outils de visualisation de données est un plus. Capacité à analyser, tester et challenger de manière critique des méthodologies, hypothèses, données et résultats de modèles, puis à documenter des conclusions claires et traçables. Connaissances en intelligence artificielle, machine learning et IA générative. Une familiarité avec les LLMs, le prompt engineering ou des outils tels que Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI ou OpenAI constitue un atout. Intérêt pour la validation indépendante, la gouvernance des modèles, le Model Risk Management et les exigences de l’EU AI Act. Vous testez les solutions, vérifier la qualité des réponses et intégrer les retours des utilisateurs. Vous documentez les développements et présenter les solutions aux équipes. Profil recherché Formation Bac+4/5 en école d’ingénieurs, université ou école de commerce, avec une spécialisation en IA, data ou systèmes d’information. Bonnes connaissances en IA générative et intérêt pour le développement d’assistants ou agents IA. Bonne maîtrise d’Excel et de PowerPoint. Intérêt pour les activités d’une direction financière : finance d’entreprise, pilotage de la performance, audit, contrôle interne, gestion des risques et compliance. Rigueur, autonomie, capacité d’analyse et aptitude à comprendre les besoins métiers. Une première réalisation d’assistants ou agents IA serait appréciée. items.desc: AI Engineer AI Engineer (AI Platform & Data Engineering) Location: Remote, Spain Candidates must be based in Spain and have the existing right to work in Spain. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship or relocation support for this role Salary: EUR 60,000–70,000 per annum (depending on experience) Overview of Position Speedcast delivers highly customizable, mission-critical communication solutions for remote sites worldwide. Our Data Engineering team operates a modern lakehouse platform — Kafka streaming, Iceberg on S3, a cloud query layer, and time-series databases on AWS — and we are building AI-powered products and internal tools on top of it. As an AI Engineer on the platform side, you will build and operate the infrastructure that makes AI applications reliable in production: the data pipelines that feed them, the embedding and retrieval layers behind them, and the services, APIs, and monitoring around them. This role carries a strong data engineering component — you will cross-function with the wider team on platform duties, contributing to ingestion pipelines, data quality, and operational excellence across our data systems. The successful candidate is a strong software and data engineer who is excited by the LLM application stack, cares about reliability, security, and cost, and is capable of working independently while collaborating closely with colleagues across Data Engineering, Data Science, and DevOps. What you will do Design, build, and operate the pipelines that power AI applications: document and data ingestion, chunking and embedding pipelines, vector stores, and retrieval services. Productionize LLM-powered applications as reliable services: APIs, containerised deployments, observability, cost monitoring, and access control. Integrate AI workloads with the data lakehouse platform — streaming (Kafka) and batch sources, query layers, and time-series stores. Build and maintain evaluation, logging, and feedback infrastructure for AI applications in production. Contribute to core data engineering duties: developing and maintaining data pipelines, ensuring data quality and reliability, and improving platform performance and efficiency. Implement security, privacy, and governance best practices for AI systems handling company data. Collaborate with data scientists, AI engineers, software engineers, and business stakeholders to deliver AI-driven solutions. Participate in Agile ceremonies, backlog grooming, sprint planning, and prioritisation activities. Evaluate and support the adoption of new AI platform technologies, tools, and architectural approaches. What we need from you 3–5 years of experience in software engineering or data engineering, with hands-on exposure to AI/LLM application development. Commercial experience with Python and strong SQL skills (any major SQL dialect). Experience developing and maintaining data pipelines in production. Experience integrating foundation model APIs (e.g., Amazon Bedrock, Anthropic, OpenAI) into applications or services. Hands-on experience with AWS services (e.g., Lambda, Step Functions, S3, ECR, Glue) and AWS security best practices. Experience containerising applications using Docker. Experience building and operating APIs and backend services. Understanding of data quality, data governance, and data engineering best practices. Experience using Git for source control and working within Agile/Scrum environments. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Even better if you have Experience with streaming platforms: Confluent Kafka, Avro/Schema Registry, Kafka Connect, or Apache Flink. Experience with lakehouse architectures: Apache Iceberg, Parquet, medallion patterns, and dbt. Experience with query engines such as Dremio and time-series databases such as TimescaleDB. Experience with vector search (pgvector or dedicated vector databases) and retrieval infrastructure at scale. Experience with agentic frameworks, tool use, or the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Experience with Infrastructure as Code (e.g., CloudFormation, Terraform) and CI/CD pipelines. Experience with cost monitoring and optimisation of cloud and AI workloads. Good understanding of GDPR and data governance principles. Advanced AWS expertise, including relevant AWS certifications. Working at Speedcast At Speedcast, we want people that like adventure. Who are motivated by work that takes uncommon ingenuity and thinking outside the box. Who relish the idea of working in an industry undergoing massive transformation. If you want to be part of a global team responsible for connecting the world, then you're in the right place. We're always pushing forward, never standing still. When people rely on you and your team to stay connected, it brings everyone closer together. We're united by the adrenaline of high-stakes projects and our love of getting the job done right. You will experiment, learn and grow here, right alongside us, …

items.desc: Application Process & Requirements: Interview Process Technical roles: Our technical roles' process includes submitting a CV and short written statement, 1-2 skills assessments such as technical interviews and take-home coding tests and 2-4 interviews, including a conversation with leadership. We tailor this process as needed for each role and candidate. If you're applying to our technical roles, this privacy policy applies. Non-technical roles: Our non-technical roles' process includes submitting a CV, 2-4 interviews including a conversation with leadership and sometimes presentation or take-home task assessments. While our interviews follow civil service requirements, we do not require answering in STAR or other rigid formats. We recommend preparing to speak about your past career experience and how you would approach problems you would face in your AISI role. Nationality Requirements & Visas Technical roles: we can hire almost all nationalities and sponsor visas. Non-technical roles: you must meet civil service nationality requirements (by having Commonwealth citizenship, indefinite leave to remain, EU settled status, or meeting some other criteria). National Security Vetting Requirements vary by role and not all roles require vetting; check each job ad. Counter Terrorism Check (CTC) and Security Clearance (SC) vettings usually require 2+ years of recent UK residency . Developed Vetting (DV) clearances usually require 10+ years. Technical Salaries On technical job ads, you'll see our total packages include a "base salary" and a "technical talent allowance". This is civil service terminology. The technical talent allowance is part of your total salary and paychecks; there are no restrictions on how you spend it. About the AI Security Institute The AI Security Institute is the world's largest and best-funded team dedicated to understanding advanced AI risks and translating that knowledge into action. We’re in the heart of the UK government with direct lines to No. 10 (the Prime Minister's office), and we work with frontier developers and governments globally. We’re here because governments are critical for advanced AI going well, and UK AISI is uniquely positioned to mobilise them. With our resources, unique agility and international influence, this is the best place to shape both AI development and government action. The deadline for applying to this role is Sunday 29th November 2026, end of day, anywhere on Earth. Team Description The Human Influence (HI) team focuses on the ways in which AI can influence or have a decisive negative impact on decisions made by humans or other AI systems. A substantial class of AI risk operates through social influence on people or other AI agents. AI systems can persuade others to change their beliefs and to take action; can build trusting relationships with people in order to exploit them; can extract private information from them; and can hold delegated ownership of high-stakes decisions. These can play out in both human-AI and multi-agent AI contexts. Our work is highly interdisciplinary, drawing on methods from computational social science, AI safety and security, cognitive and behavioural science, machine learning, and data science. Typical projects include running rigorous human-AI interaction studies and randomised controlled trials, building evaluations and benchmarks that track AI capabilities across model releases, eliciting model capabilities through fine-tuning and self-play, and developing datasets to monitor real-world risk exposure and severity. On our team, you will have: The opportunity to run large-scale studies, including RCTs, AI model evaluations, large scale data analytics, red teaming, and human participatory methods. The opportunity to engage with government officials, ministers, regulators, policymakers, frontier lab employees, and the wider research community to advance AI safety. Access to API credits for auto graders/agentic workflows and large compute budgets, as well as funds for human user studies. The opportunity to work with world-class talent. The opportunity to lead-author and co-author academic publications, conference papers, preprints, blog posts, and to disseminate work via talks and posters. Some examples of our work include : The largest-ever study on the [persuasive capabilities of conversational AI] (https://www.science.org/doi/10.1126/science.aea3884); A large-scale study on [how people use and follow personal advice from AI chatbots] (https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.15352); A longitudinal study on how [anthropomorphic AI facilitates human-AI relationship building] (https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.01991). Role Description We are looking for an ambitious and exceptional Research Scientist to join the Human Influence team. This could be in a sub-team lead or independent contributor role. As a Research Scientist, you will lead and contribute to research programmes that shape our understanding of how frontier AI systems influence people. …

items.desc: Role Overview Mass photometry — a technique developed at the University of Oxford for measuring the mass of individual particles in solution with a specialised microscope — is at the heart of what Refeyn does. Since spinning out in 2017, we've grown mass photometry from an academic breakthrough into a technology now widely used in biological research and increasingly adopted across the bioprocessing industry to develop and characterise drugs. Join Refeyn's 10-person software team building the applications behind our mass photometry instruments — from instrument control and automation to data analysis, visualisation, and reporting. You'll work across the full development lifecycle, closely with product, UX/UI, and the wider R&D team. Key responsibilities for this role include: Support the full software development lifecycle: planning, design, development, testing, deployment, and continuous improvement. Build and enhance: desktop and embedded user interfaces that are highly usable and tightly integrated with system and device logic automated instrument control, calibration routines, and failure-mode detection tools for analysing measurement data and interpreting results statistically Investigate, debug, and resolve complex software and system issues. Manage source code and branching strategy, and review teammates' pull requests. Collaborate across engineering and with stakeholders to translate technical and operational requirements into reliable, maintainable solutions. We are ideally looking for someone with the following skills and experience: Python (OOP), plus Rust or C++, and modern development practices. GUI development experience (Qt, PySide6, QtQuick/QML) and a good eye for usability. items.desc: Date de publication : Nov 06, 2026, 11:31AM Durée du contrat : 6 mois Contexte : Le Harness Engineering consiste à concevoir un environnement au sein duquel un agent d'intelligence artificielle non déterministe se comportera de manière autonome et fiable, permettant de franchir l'espace séparant le simple prototypage agentique à la production industrielle. En particulier on s'intéressera au cas du Streaming Telemetry dans les réseaux IP afin de concevoir un harnais permettant la supervision et reconfiguration autonome d'équipements de routage de manière fiable et contrôlable par un agent. Enjeux : La mise au point d'un tel harnais et son déploiement en production soulèvent de nombreux enjeux liés notamment à la sécurité ou à l'observabilité. Dans ce stage on s'intéressera plus particulièrement à l'enjeu du long-running, c'est à dire la capacité de faire fonctionner l'agent de manière fiable (reprise après erreur, persistance d'état, etc.) sur une longue durée (plusieurs jours). Les différentes missions de ce stage seront : Réaliser un état de l'art sur le Harness Engineering. Proposer des améliorations aux approches existantes ou de nouvelles approches. Proposer une architecture, implémenter un prototype et évaluer ses performances sur un ensemble de scénarii réseaux. Profil Bac+5 Bonnes connaissances/compétences en IA Agentique. Autonomie, pro-activité, capacité à mettre ses idées en pratique. Capacité à formaliser ses idées et résultats et à les communiquer efficacement. La Direction OrangeInnovation Networks définit et pilote la stratégie et la politique réseau du groupe, organise et coordonne les travaux d'architecture de bout en bout couvrant terminaux, réseaux, plates-formes de service et système d'information. Elle assure la prise en compte de la stratégie du groupe dans les standards (en lien avec des partenaires industriels ou académiques) et les produits des industriels choisis par le groupe. Elle assure la conception des solutions et briques techniques réseaux pour les pays. Au sein d’Orange Innovation Networks, la direction Wireline Networks Infrastructures (WNI), définit et pilote la stratégied'évolution des réseaux fixes ainsi que la politique d'équipement du Groupe pour les domaines concernés en : fournissant aux entités des architectures optimisées soutenant les entités opérationnelles des filiales dans l'implémentation des évolutions du réseau pilotant les travaux de recherche et d’anticipation pour préparer le Groupe aux évolutions tendancielles et en rupture sur le réseau. L'équipe ROUTING est en charge de proposer en normalisation, évaluer et recommander aux entités opérationnelles du groupe les solutions relatives au plan de contrôle et aux protocoles de routage des réseaux IP/MPLS. L'équipe travaille aussi sur les outils de monitoring et sur les aspects sécurité du domaine. Date de début souhaitée : Feb 01, 2027, 12:00AM Chez Orange, seules vos compétences comptent. Quel que soit votre âge, genre, origine, parcours, religion, orientation sexuelle, handicap, neuroatypie, ou apparence, nous encourageons activement la diversité au sein de nos équipes, car elle constitue une force pour le collectif et un vecteur d’innovation. Orange est une entreprise handi-accueillante : n’hésitez pas à nous faire part de vos besoins spécifiques.

items.desc: Nous recherchons un(e) ingénieur de recherche en génie industriel dans le cadre du projet de plateforme d’accélération industrie du futur Quatrium au sein du département Ingénierie Mécanique et du laboratoire Roberval. Missions Développer et structurer des activités de recherche autour de la plateforme Quatrium, en particulier sur la conception et l’exploitation d’un jumeau numérique d’atelier industriel connecté, afin d’explorer de nouvelles approches de pilotage intelligent, d’optimisation et de résilience des systèmes de production. Contribuer à la conception, l’expérimentation et la validation de méthodes innovantes (jumeaux numériques, simulation, intelligence artificielle), tout en assurant leur transfert vers des démonstrateurs industriels. Activités Concevoir et développer un jumeau numérique de la plateforme Quatrium, synchronisé avec les équipements réels (machines, cobots, AGV, systèmes d’information) Définir et implémenter des modèles multi-niveaux intégrant géométrie, physique et comportement des systèmes de production et règles de gestion et contraintes d’ordonnancement Développer et expérimenter des approches avancées de pilotage (ordonnancement dynamique, simulation a évènements discrets, optimisation sous contraintes, apprentissage par renforcement) pour la décision en environnement incertain Concevoir des scénarios expérimentaux et démonstrateurs basés sur les résultats de recherche Participer à l’intégration et à l’évolution des équipements de la plateforme (robotique, convoyage, AGV, systèmes d’information) Évaluer les performances des approches proposées (robustesse, réactivité, efficacité globale) Mettre en œuvre et piloter les démonstrations Assurer le lien avec les partenaires industriels et académiques Contribuer à la diffusion des résultats (publications scientifiques, conférences, workshops, événements Quatrium) Participer à la veille technologique et à l’évolution de la plateforme pour correspondre aux besoins des industriels Anticiper les changements et leurs impacts métiers et proposer des évolutions applicatives (fonctionnelles ou techniques) Informations complémentaires Dates pour candidater Du 04/11/2026 au 03/12/2026 Type de contrat et date prévisionnelle de recrutement Contrat à durée déterminée – pourvoi immédiat et jusqu’au 30/06/2029 Salaire mensuel brut Selon expérience et financement Volume horaire 37 heures et 30 minutes / semaine - 1 607 heures / an Environnement et contexte de travail La personne recrutée est rattachée au département ingénierie mécanique (IM) et au Laboratoire Roberval. Elle s’inscrit dans les activités de l’équipe « Systèmes Intégrés : Produit-Process » et contribue au développement de thématiques de recherche autour du jumeau numérique, du pilotage intelligent et de l’industrie 5.0. Ce recrutement se fait dans le cadre du projet Quatrium financé par le FEDER, la région Hauts-de-France, l’UTC et la fondation UTC. La plateforme Quatrium vise à accompagner les PME/ETI dans leur transformation digitale vers des systèmes industriels plus durables et résilients. Elle constitue également un support expérimental pour des activités de recherche autour des systèmes de production intelligents. La personne recrutée est amenée à échanger très régulièrement avec les partenaires du projet et plus généralement avec les différents acteurs concernés par celui-ci. Elle est dotée d’une bonne capacité d’adaptation aux différents interlocuteurs et sait faire preuve de professionnalisme dans la communication écrite et orale. Des déplacements ponctuels sont à prévoir dans le cadre du projet pour des réunions et des événements dans la région Hauts de France. items.desc: The University of Rostock offers a diverse, varied and challenging position in a tradition-conscious, yet innovative, modern and family-friendly university in a lively city by the sea. At the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Science, Institute of Physics, Working Group of Quantum Technology, subject to allocation of funds, we are filling the following position as of 01.01.2027 on a temporary basis ending on 30.06.2029: Research Assistant (m/f/d) - Experimental Physics Start date as of 01.01.2027 Working hours full-time with 40 hours Remuneration pay group 13 TV-L Location Rostock Tender number P 128/2026 Limitation limited until 30.06.2029 Application time 2026-11-18 Please do not hesitate to contact us for further information: HR department: Kati Barth Phone number: 0381/498-1312 E-mail: Department: Prof. Dr. Friedemann Reinhard Phone number: 0381/498-6840 E-mail: We are looking for a postdoctoral scientist to join our quantum technology group as soon as possible, for a project on scanning probe imaging using novel optically readable spin qubits under ambient and cryogenic conditions. One key goal of this work will be to push single-spin scanning probe microscopy towards atomic resolution by reducing the sensor-sample distance. This will employ contact-mode imaging using low-friction 2D materials like boron nitride as an atomically thin lubricant. THESE ARE YOUR TASKS: Specifically, the work will comprise: deposition of ordered arrangements of fluorescent molecules on boron nitride by wet-chemistry and sublimation processes encapsulation of molecules in boron nitride by stamping assembly of multilayer heterostructures use of encapsulated fluorescent molecules as scanning probes in a planar scanning probe setup near-field microscopy of plasmonic nanostructures and near-field energy transfer by scanning fluorescent molecules and NV centers in diamond translation of these results into a cryogenic scanning probe setup. Design and construction of an integrated scanning probe head for operation under cryogenic conditions. publication of the results and dissemination in talks on national and international conferences acquisition and further development of the skills required to independently lead a research group and to conceive, develop and carry out research projects independently THIS MAKES YOU A GOOD FIT: completed university degree (state exam, diploma, master's degree or comparable degree) in a STEM subject, peferably physics, and with preferably excellent results PhD degree in physics with at least very good results strong background in design and construction of electronic systems, e.g. for transport measurements or microwave control of excitations strong background in design and construction of cryogenic experiments, preferably in the area of transport or scanning probe physics strong background in device assembly from 2D materials and other low-dimensional systems, or clear potential and willingness to build expertise in these domains excellent academic track record ability to cooperate in a diverse team and in an interdisciplinary environment willingness to investigate scientific questions in depth and search for fundamental understanding of phenomena fluent English language proficiency, and willingness to build basic proficiency in German WE AS AN EMPLOYER: Equal opportunities are important to us. We welcome applications from suitable severely disabled people or people from traditionally underrepresented groups. We aim to increase the proportion of women in research and teaching and therefore encourage suitably qualified women to apply. We welcome applications from people of other nationalities or with a migration background. items.desc: Job Purpose The Kuehne Climate Center develops and implements solutions that transform logistics from a major source of emissions into an enabler of an effective climate transition. By decarbonizing logistics and supply chains and enabling the logistics required for industrial transformation, we aim to achieve durable, measurable, and meaningful climate impact. To achieve systemic impact at the scale of entire industries, countries, or regions, KCC is establishing a dedicated Scaling Team. Working closely with the Applied Research and Impact Delivery functions, the Scaling Team will evaluate the economic and ecological viability of potential solutions, develop business and implementation models for scaling, and mobilize the partners, financing, and operational structures required to implement solutions at scale. What you will do As Supply Chain Modelling Expert at KCC, you will develop quantitative supply chain and business models that help evaluate, design, and scale innovative logistics solutions for climate transformation. Working under the guidance of the Scaling Team Leader and in collaboration with colleagues across KCC, you will turn supply chain data, technical concepts, and economic assumptions into robust analyses and practical business models. Your work will help determine which solutions are economically and ecologically viable, how they should be designed and implemented, and what is required to achieve meaningful climate impact at scale. In particular you will Develop quantitative supply chain and business models for innovative, climate-friendly logistics and supply chain solutions, evaluating their economic viability, ecological impact, and potential for large-scale implementation Conduct techno-economic and financial analyses , including capital and operating cost modelling (CapEx/OpEx), investment requirements, net present value (NPV), internal rate of return (IRR), break-even analyses, and sensitivity and scenario assessments, comparing proposed solutions with existing industry practices Analyse and model supply chain networks , including transport and logistics structures, network optimization, infrastructure and location choices, capacity requirements, material and product flows, and greenfield or brownfield development options Develop cost projections and business models along supply chains , assessing cost curves, economic incentives, value creation, and investment requirements for different actors and network components, and identifying conditions for commercially viable solutions Collect, structure, and analyse supply chain, market, and operational data , including data from regions with limited information availability, using transparent assumptions, uncertainty ranges, and scenario-based approaches to develop robust and credible models Develop and improve modelling methodologies and tools , including reusable supply chain model blueprints, standardized data and process interfaces, and digital modelling approaches such as digital twins, ensuring models can be adapted and used by regional teams and local partners Translate modelling results into decision-ready insights and recommendations , providing transparent, quantitative evidence on business viability, investment requirements, supply chain performance, and climate impact. Clearly communicate assumptions, uncertainties, and trade-offs to support the Scaling Team Leader's portfolio assessments and scaling strategies, as well as decisions by internal and external stakeholders Collaborate with the Scaling Team Leader and colleagues in Applied Research and Impact Delivery, contributing analytical expertise throughout the development of innovative solutions, from initial opportunity assessment to pilot validation and planning for implementation at scale You‘re good at Working analytically and quantitatively , translating complex supply chain, technical, and economic questions into structured models and meaningful results Developing and applying financial and business models , understanding cost structures, investment economics, business viability, and the conditions for commercially sustainable solutions Analyzing and modelling logistics and supply chain systems , including networks, transport flows, capacities, infrastructure requirements, and operational trade-offs Using quantitative modelling and analytical tools , working confidently with complex datasets, financial spreadsheets, optimization models, and other relevant software tools Dealing pragmatically with incomplete and uncertain data , developing sound assumptions, testing different scenarios, and communicating the limitations and robustness of analytical results Thinking systemically and creatively , understanding how economic, technical, environmental, and operational factors interact and influence the scalability of solutions Translating complex analytical results into clear, actionable recommendations , making models and their conclusions accessible to non-technical …

items.desc: Date de publication : Nov 06, 2026, 12:00AM How would you like to work in IT, toying with cutting edge technologies and enjoying your life? At Orange Services, it’s possible! As one of the largest IT Hub within Orange Group, we are working internationally for both Orange corporate functions and country operations. Through a unique combination of know-how and expertise, our teams provide a broad range of IT & Business Solutions. Come closer to #LifeAtOrange! What we’re looking for We are looking to expand the Voice Portal team with a highly motivated, innovative and results-oriented Intermediate Developer who will help us keep a fast, reliable voice experience on Orange TV, while also keeping an eye on best practices, clean code and the onboarding of newcomers. Voice Portal is working on the voice assistant on the Orange set-top box. People talk to the television — find a programme, change channel, control volume or playback, ask for a recommendation — and the platform turns that into an action. It serves several countries, including France and Spain, and the team works in an Agile way with colleagues across countries. The business services are written in Kotlin with Quarkus. The real-time voice path — sign-in, the live session, speech recognition, the language model and spoken replies — is written in Go with Fiber. The platform runs in Docker and Kubernetes on Google Cloud, with Redis and Firestore behind the services. If you are willing to know more, we will be happy to invite you to for a chat. Who you are You are an experienced application developer passionate about latest technologies. You are able to work comfortably in a fast-changing environment on interesting technical challenges. You have a passion for efficiency, performance and continuous improvement. You enjoy growing and integrating team members and proactively support their continuous improvement. What you’ll be doing Turn a spoken request into a television action: understand the intent and return the right command to the set-top box. Build and evolve the Kotlin services (business logic, commands, content search, the content dictionary and analytics) and the Go services (sign-in, live session, speech and language) Connect speech recognition, the language model and speech synthesis, and keep each country’s behaviour correct. Ship high-quality, well-tested, secure and clean code, on REST APIs and on the live session with the set-top box. Join design discussions on new voice features and make sure they fit the platform reliably. Take an active part in backlog grooming, sprint planning and implementation. Own coding, testing and debugging through the life of a feature, including how it behaves once it is deployed. What you need to know/have 3+ years building backend services, with a clear view of how APIs and several services work together Professional experience with Kotlin or Java, on Quarkus, Spring or a similar framework Experience with Go, or a genuine readiness to write it day to day on the voice path A solid grasp of REST and HTTP, and comfort with real-time communication such as WebSockets or gRPC Practical experience with a document database, and a good sense of how to shape data for a service Comfortable with Git Working knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes Good communication skills in English (we enjoy chatting with our international colleagues) Nice to have Experience with voice or conversational products (speech recognition, text-to-speech, language models, prompts) Familiarity with Google Cloud (Kubernetes, Firestore) Practical experience with Redis Familiarity with monitoring and observability (Prometheus, OpenTelemetry) Experience working in an international Agile team (Scrum) Previous practice with GitLab CI/CD and Helm What’s in it for you: Performance Bonuses – based on your results & the company’s; Loyalty Bonuses, if you extend your stay; Electronic Meal Tickets - as you imagine; Medical & Life insurance for you - facilities for your family, too; #WFH & Flexible hours; Professional GSM subscription; Personal GSM subscription, also [because we believe in communication!]; Special grants on Smartphones & devices; discounts for Orange products & services; Development Platforms - Orange Learning, Trainings, Career Counselling, Coaching & Career plan mentoring; Wellbeing Programs – we support your Zen; Orange Services is about bringing together people and technology. items.desc: If you are an enthusiastic professional interested in being part of a fast-growing company with strong engineering and research culture, we are looking for a passionate FPGA Engineer to join our team and help us build the next generation of automotive connectivity and computing platforms. Disruptive mobility tech companies like Technica are driving the changes in electronics architecture that the industry needs to accelerate the arrival of the software-defined vehicle (SDV) era, and in this context our ability to deliver rapid prototyping hardware products is more critical than ever. FPGA technology plays a key role in enabling the flexibility, performance, and real-time capabilities required by these new architectures. Technica is a product-oriented company, that continuously reinvest to stay ahead of the curve, and our interdisciplinary team is focused on the development of company own products roadmap and on innovative R&D electronics development projects with major customers. We’re looking for someone with at least 2 years of hands-on FPGA development experience who wants to take real ownership of technical challenges and grow within a highly multidisciplinary environment. We value people who are curious to dig deep into how our hardware products work and are comfortable navigating complex electronic designs. Someone who is self-driven, takes initiative, and is not afraid to explore unfamiliar problems, challenge assumptions, or step beyond the boundaries of the role when needed. Just as importantly, we are looking for a strong team player who works closely with the development team and helps move topics forward. MAIN FUNCTIONS Design, develop, simulate, and test FPGA modules for automotive connectivity and computing applications. Implement FPGA firmware for in-house hardware platforms, with a strong focus on functionality, reliability, maintainability, and scalability. Participate in the complete FPGA development lifecycle, from requirements and architecture definition through implementation, simulation, integration, and validation. Work closely with hardware engineers in the development of FPGA-based electronic assemblies, including schematic reviews, FPGA-related component selection, pinout definition, and layout constraints. Collaborate with hardware, software, and system engineers to integrate and validate FPGA designs within complete products. Perform laboratory testing, debugging, and optimization of FPGA designs and hardware platforms. Use simulation and on-chip debugging tools to identify and solve functional and timing-related issues. Create and maintain technical documentation for FPGA modules, interfaces, architectures, and test procedures. Contribute to improving FPGA development, verification, and automation methodologies within the team. Take ownership of assigned technical topics, proactively identify blockers, propose solutions, and drive them through implementation and validation. Develop prototypes and proof-of-concepts to evaluate new technologies, architectures, and ideas. Support product launch by aligning generated technical documentation to sales and customer-facing field support teams. WHAT WE OFFER A clear opportunity for professional growth in FPGA and digital hardware design, working on increasingly complex architectures and products. A truly cross-functional engineering environment where FPGA, hardware, software, embedded systems, and system engineering work closely together. Full flexibility to manage hybrid work model, depending on the tasks. Company culture oriented to research engineering and a clear reinvestment mindset in research and know-how acquisition. Opportunity to work at the forefront of innovation in automotive industry within a company working as pure R&D partner for main European OEMs. High diversity of state-of-the-art projects with technologies 3-4 years beyond what is currently in series production vehicles. Opportunity to work in an international environment within a diverse team. International mobility options are available to discuss case-by-case. 30 working days as holidays, with full flexibility to manage them. Private health insurance. Regular team building activities with specific company budget. Opportunity to further expand your training, from personal abilities to technical areas. For additional information in case you want to know more about us, check our website: https://technica-engineering.de/en/ SKILLS Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronics Engineering, Telecommunications Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field. 2-4 years of hands-on experience in FPGA design and development. Desirable experience with AMD/Xilinx or Altera/Intel FPGA devices and their associated development environments, such as Vivado or Quartus. Solid working knowledge of VHDL, and desirable basic know-how of Verilog and/or SystemVerilog. Know-how of FPGA simulation tools such as ModelSim, QuestaSim, Vivado Simulator, or equivalent. items.desc: About Bota Systems Bota Systems AG is a Zürich-based ETH spin-off building high-precision 6-axis force-torque, torque and tactile sensors — a sensing platform for physical AI. Our customers are engineers, and they judge us by how clearly and accurately we explain what our products do. We are hiring a Technical Content Marketing Engineer who understands our products in depth and turns that knowledge into content that informs customers and helps our business development team win. The role You own our technical content end to end: what customers see on our website, on social media and in every datasheet and presentation. You make sure it is accurate, current and compelling. Key responsibilities Website and landing pages Keep our website content accurate, clear and up to date. Create and maintain landing pages for products, applications, campaigns and events. Make sure all online material always reflects the current versions of our products (specs, datasheets, CAD files, software, manuals). Social media Plan and fill our social media channels (especially LinkedIn and YouTube) with regular, high-quality technical content. Turn product releases, customer applications and R&D work into posts, videos and short stories. Video, educational content and trade fairs Create and edit videos for our channels: product demos, tutorials, application showcases and customer stories. Build online educational content (e.g. tutorials, webinars, how-to guides, learning series) that helps engineers understand and use force-torque sensing. Produce all support material for trade fairs and events: booth graphics, banners, demo videos, brochures and handouts. Graphics and visual material Keep our graphic material current: product images, renders, diagrams, brochures and presentation templates. Ensure a consistent look and message across all channels. Sales enablement Create content for our business development engineers: presentations, application notes, case studies, demo videos and one-pagers. Work closely with them to understand what customers ask and produce material that answers it. Use state-of-the-art tools, including AI-based content, design and video tools, to produce content quickly and at high quality. Product understanding Learn our products in depth — how they work, how they are integrated and where they add value. Work with R&D to translate technical features into clear customer benefits. What success looks like after 12 months Website and all online material fully aligned with current product versions. A steady, planned publishing rhythm on social media, with growing reach and engagement. A library of product, tutorial and educational videos in active use by customers and our team. Dedicated landing pages for key products, applications and target segments, generating leads. A complete, up-to-date sales enablement library that business development engineers use every week. Ready-to-use trade fair kit and refreshed, consistent graphic material across all channels. Who you are Must have Engineering degree (mechanical, mechatronics, electrical, robotics or similar). Ability to understand complex technical products in depth and explain them simply. 2+ years creating technical content, product marketing or technical documentation. Strong writing skills in English. Hands-on with design tools and with video recording and editing, and with AI tools for content creation. Experience maintaining websites or landing pages in a CMS. Nice to have Background in robotics, sensors or automation. Experience with HubSpot, SEO and web analytics. 3D rendering or CAD experience (e.g. SolidWorks, KeyShot). German language skills. A small, ambitious team at the forefront of Physical AI and Robotics. Competitive salary and stock options.

items.desc: Location: Central London (3 days in office) Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent Experience Level: Specialist (3-7 Years) Salary Band: £55,000 - £75,000 depending on experience This role would also be considered on a remote basis, with travel to our London Office once a week. What is Androlabs? Androlabs is the first pharmaceutical company that is entirely dedicated to men. Founded in February 2021 and headquartered in London, Androlabs is a fast-growing and ambitious scaleup company. Our medicines are commercialised in 20+ countries throughout Europe, the UK and Australia. What is our mission and how do we work? Gender disparities in health awareness and access to routine check-ups and treatment can result in excess preventable deaths and illness. Globally, nearly twice as many male deaths are considered preventable compared to females, contributing to the concerning statistic that men live, on average, five years less than women. At Androlabs, our mission is to close the male life expectancy gap by tackling these issues head-on. We partner with healthcare professionals who treat patients daily and lead initiatives to raise awareness of men’s health, improve education, and remove barriers to care. We have already launched the first-ever men’s health pub, developed a leading patient education platform, built a HCP zone with CPD-accredited learning, convened scientific advisory committee meetings with 17 of Europe’s top KOLs, and facilitated publications that have evolved the field of men’s health treatment. By putting patients first and adopting a science-led approach, we are reshaping the traditional pharma model to deliver better outcomes across men’s health. We are a diverse team of ~40 people are based across 7 countries, and speak more than 14 languages. We are profitable, growing, and have big ambitions to create a world-leading men's health company that makes a difference in society. At Androlabs, our core values— Knowledge and Transparency, Agency, First Principle Thinking & Humility —guide our actions every day. They shape our daily operations and interactions. Whether it’s empowering a colleague with the right information, proactively addressing challenges, or embracing feedback, we live these values every day to ensure that Androlabs is a place where innovation thrives, and excellence is the norm. Androlabs is part of Tithonia Group, an entrepreneurial life sciences company Requirements The Role We are looking for a hands-on, scientifically rigorous Medical Affairs professional to build the foundation of our global medical affairs capability in men's health. Medical Affairs at Androlabs is entering a new phase. Our market presence is growing, our KOL and advocacy network is expanding, and the business needs dedicated Medical Affairs capacity to move from reactive support to planned, structured, high-quality execution. You will own the global medical activity calendar, build and maintain our KOL and advocacy framework in partnership with country teams, develop and review medical and scientific content directly, and establish the medical information and training infrastructure that our portfolio growth demands. This is a hands-on, builder role for someone who wants to shape something from the ground up. Solida padronanza di tecniche ML: classificazione, regressione, clustering, validazione e tuning. Esperienza con SQL e database relazionali (es. PostgreSQL, MySQL) o data warehouse (BigQuery). Familiarità con strumenti di version control (Git). Conoscenza base di concetti di Deep Learning (TensorFlow o PyTorch). Capacità di visualizzazione dei dati con librerie o strumenti BI (Matplotlib, Seaborn, Tableau, PowerBI). Buona conoscenza della lingua italiana (livello B2 minimo). Ottime capacità comunicative e di presentazione. Orientamento al problem solving e al lavoro in team. Disponibilità Full-time. Conoscenze gradite o che potresti apprendere con noi Framework avanzati di Deep Learning: PyTorch, TensorFlow. Tecniche e strumenti per NLP e LLM (RAG, Transformers, Hugging Face). Strumenti MLOps: MLflow, DVC, Kubeflow, Vertex AI, SageMaker. Creazione di pipeline dati con Airflow/Composer. Conoscenze di modelli generativi (Diffusion, GAN) e computer vision. Cloud platform: GCP, AWS, Azure. items.desc: Location: Coatbridge, hybrid Contract: 12-month fixed-term contract, full time Reports to: Finance Director DwyerOmega is a global leader in precision sensing, monitoring, and control technologies. Our portfolio spans pressure, temperature, flow, level, humidity, and gas detection solutions, serving industrial processing, building services, life sciences, utilities, manufacturing, and energy markets worldwide. We are looking for a curious and motivated Graduate Data & AI Analyst to make data easier to find, trust and use across our Sensors Business Unit. This is an exciting opportunity to work across Sales, Operations, Finance, Engineering and Quality, using data analysis, AI and automation to solve real business problems and improve how teams work. About the role You will help build practical AI tools, dashboards and automations that save colleagues time, improve decision-making and create a more reliable source of business information. You will also support the organisation and governance of quality documents, part numbers and price lists, helping to ensure that important information is accurate, accessible and properly controlled. Key responsibilities Design and build practical AI tasks, agents and workflow automations. Identify repetitive activities and develop reliable, documented solutions. Test AI outputs for accuracy and introduce appropriate controls and safeguards. Analyse technical and business data, including trends and Statistical Process Control (SPC). Create clear charts, reports and dashboards for non-technical audiences. Support Sales and Finance teams with data analysis and automation. Establish and maintain trusted sources for quality documents, part numbers and price lists. Improve SharePoint structures, naming conventions, metadata and permissions. Remove duplicate and outdated information while maintaining version control. Deliver practical training, guidance and coaching to help colleagues use AI effectively. Your first year Your development will be structured around three key stages: Months 1–3: Learn the business, map existing data sources and improve SharePoint organisation. Months 4–6: Develop trusted data sources and deliver your first dashboards and reports. Months 7–12: Roll out AI workflows across additional teams and deliver regular AI and productivity sessions. You will receive training in ERP systems, data tools and AI development, with the opportunity to progress into a Data & AI Analyst role and, subsequently, Senior or Lead positions. About you You will have: A degree, or be due to graduate soon, in data science, statistics, mathematics, engineering, computer science or a related subject. A good grounding in statistics and data analysis. Confidence using Excel and working with large datasets. Practical experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot or Claude. The ability to explain data and findings clearly to non-specialists. Strong organisational skills and a methodical approach to documentation and version control. Good written, presentation and interpersonal communication skills. A curious, practical and self-motivated approach to problem-solving. Desirable experience SharePoint or Microsoft 365, including Power Automate, Power BI or Teams. Programming or scripting using Python, SQL or VBA. SPC, Six Sigma, Lean or quality management systems such as ISO 9001. A manufacturing, engineering or quality environment, including a placement or internship. Building AI agents, prompts or workflow automations through university or personal projects. You should be willing to travel occasionally to sites in the UK, Austria and the US. Why join DwyerOmega? This is an opportunity to take real responsibility from the outset, working on projects that will be used across the business. You will gain valuable experience at the intersection of data, AI, manufacturing and business improvement, supported by a structured development plan and experienced colleagues. If you are excited by the potential of data and AI to make work simpler, smarter and more effective, we would love to hear from you. Apply now for immediate consideration.

items.title: AI Operations Specialist
items.card: The role Road builds the software behind electric vehicle (EV) charging. Charge point operators (CPOs), the companies that own and run charging stations, run their networks on our platform, and our own brand E-Flux gives EV drivers and businesses the charge cards and app they use to charge. items.desc: About Road Road empowers companies across the EV ecosystem with the technology and services they need to grow and deliver seamless charging experiences. We provide the critical infrastructure that the EV charging ecosystem depends on. We do this through a purpose-built software platform supported by our unique expertise and world-class customer service. Road currently serves over 200.000 customers and 20% of the Dutch market and we have firmly set our sights on repeating this success internationally including France. We exist at the intersection of cleantech and fintech and our mission is to make EV charging effortless for everyone. The role Road builds the software behind electric vehicle (EV) charging. Charge point operators (CPOs), the companies that own and run charging stations, run their networks on our platform, and our own brand E-Flux gives EV drivers and businesses the charge cards and app they use to charge. Our AI agents already answer a large share of these customers' questions by chat and phone: Vera, the support agent for E-Flux drivers and business customers, agents for partner brands that offer charging under their own name, and a growing set of phone agents that answer driver helplines on behalf of CPOs on our platform. As AI Operations Specialist you make these agents resolve more questions, and resolve them well. You join the AI team in Business Operations and report to the AI Operations Lead. This is a starter role that you grow into. In your first months you learn how EV charging, roaming and billing work and how our agents are put together. After that you take on your own focus areas, such as a topic, a process or a single agent, and see each improvement through from analysis to measured result. We believe in fast-tracked ownership. Team members who joined resolving individual customer interactions quickly scaled within months into developing end-to-end customer solutions, directly integrating with our MCP server, proprietary APIs and core data systems. What you'll do Raise the automation rate (about 40% of your time). Analyse conversations and calls, find where agents get stuck and fix it with better procedures (the step-by-step instructions an agent follows), knowledge articles and data connections. Pick up improvement requests from our support team and from automated quality checks. Phone and partner agents (about 25% of your time). Help roll out AI phone agents to more of our partners, work with Business Support to turn a partner's requirements into how the agent helps their customers, review calls and improve routing and instructions, test new agents before go-live, and use performance insights to improve each agent and show partners what it delivers. Connectors and platform (about 20% of your time). Build and maintain the data connectors and MCP tools that give agents safe, scoped access to our platform, within our security rules. Support Product Development, customers and partners who build agents on Road's MCP server. Quality and insights (about 15% of your time). Keep an eye on high-risk topics and agents, act on what reports and insights show, and work with the team on the customer satisfaction of AI-handled conversations. What you bring Between 0 and 4 years of work experience, for example in customer support, operations, consulting or data analysis. Ideally you have a higher professional (HBO) or university degree. Experience with EV charging, energy or SaaS is a plus, not a requirement. You are analytical and structured: you read through conversations, spot patterns and turn a messy process into clear instructions and if-then logic. You are technically curious and want to learn APIs, n8n, MCP and AI tools such as Claude. You don't need to be a developer, but JSON or a workflow tool doesn't put you off. You think about risk: what an agent may see and do, and where a person should take over. You finish what you start and test before you ship. You speak and write English fluently, at business level. Dutch is a strong plus, but not required. You work from our Amsterdam office, live in or near the Randstad and have an EU work permit. If you are looking for remote or hybrid work by default, this role is probably not a fit. items.desc: La mission de Dassault Systèmes est de fournir aux entreprises et aux individus des jumeaux virtuels de mondes réels, leur permettant d'imaginer des innovations durables qui harmonisent Produit, Nature et Vie. Avec les « 3D UNIV+RSES », septième génération de représentation du monde développée par Dassault Systèmes en plus de 40 ans d'innovation, l'entreprise associe jumeaux virtuels, intelligence artificielle générative et modèles scientifiques du monde industriel pour donner corps à une économie générative, où innovation et durabilité avancent de concert. Dans le domaine des Sciences de la Vie et de la Santé, cette vision prend une dimension singulière : Dassault Systèmes est pionnier des jumeaux virtuels du monde vivant, de la cellule à l'organe jusqu'au patient, avec l'ambition de faire du jumeau virtuel le socle d'une médecine plus prédictive, personnalisée et préventive. Imaginez modéliser et comprendre le corps humain dans son intégralité, comme nous l'avons fait dans l'aérospatial avec le Boeing 777… Cette ambition prend aujourd'hui forme grâce à l'IA et aux compagnons virtuels qui accompagnent scientifiques et cliniciens dans leurs découvertes. Souhaitez-vous contribuer à cette transformation du secteur de la santé, à la croisée des sciences de la formulation et de l'Intelligence Artificielle ? Les produits formulés — médicaments, cosmétiques et autres mélanges complexes — se caractérisent par des propriétés critiques telles que la solubilité, la stabilité ou la biocompatibilité, traditionnellement évaluées via des campagnes expérimentales longues et coûteuses. Nos solutions BIOVIA Formulation et le ML Workbench associé offrent déjà aux scientifiques des outils pour modéliser et prédire ces propriétés. En s'appuyant sur cette pile technologique, ce stage explore comment l'Intelligence Artificielle / le Machine Learning peuvent aller plus loin, en agissant comme un conseiller intelligent qui accompagne les scientifiques de la formulation dans leur prise de décision. Vos missions Prendre en main la pile technologique utilisée en interne pour la science de la formulation (BIOVIA Formulation, ML Workbench et outils associés), ainsi que les modèles de données de formulation sous-jacents Concevoir et prototyper un conseiller IA/ML capable d'appuyer les décisions relatives aux propriétés des produits formulés (solubilité, biocompatibilité, stabilité, etc.), en s'appuyant sur les modèles, données et workflows existants Benchmarker les approches ML / IA pertinentes (modélisation prédictive, chémoinformatique, méthodes génératives ou de recherche augmentée) applicables aux données de formulation Explorer si et comment un tel conseiller pourrait être exposé et orchestré via le framework d'agents IA de Dassault Systèmes, et évaluer la faisabilité d'un accès aux outils d'intelligence de formulation par des agents Collaborer avec les scientifiques de la formulation, les data scientists et les architectes de plateforme pour valider l'approche et recueillir des retours Documenter l'exploration et livrer un démonstrateur de preuve de concept, accompagné de recommandations pour la suite du développement Vos Qualifications Actuellement en Master 2 (ou équivalent école d'ingénieur / université) en Data Science, Chimie computationnelle, Chémo informatique, Science des matériaux, ou domaine connexe Vous avez de bonnes compétences en programmation Python ; familiarité avec les frameworks de ML (ex. scikit-learn, PyTorch) Vous avez des connaissances ou un fort intérêt pour la science de la formulation / chimie physique (solubilité, biocompatibilité, etc.) appréciés Vous faites preuve de curiosité pour les agents IA et les outils basés sur les LLM Vous êtes autonomie, rigoureux.se et une bonne capacité à synthétiser et documenter des explorations techniques Vous avez le sens de la communication ; à l'aise dans un environnement pluridisciplinaire et international Nous rejoindre c'est aussi Intégrer une entreprise scientifique au cœur de l’innovation technologique, portée par une forte croissance depuis plus de 40 ans Principaux avantages et bénéfices : Environnement multiculturel Cadre de travail convivial axé sur le bien-être et la santé (salles de sport & de musique, conciergerie…) Engagement en faveur de la diversité et de l’inclusion Politique dynamique de développement de carrière : plan de formation, mobilités internes, etc Inclusion statement As a game-changer in sustainable technology and innovation, Dassault Systèmes is striving to build more inclusive and diverse teams across the globe. We believe that our people are our number one asset and we want all employees to feel empowered to bring their whole selves to work every day. It is our goal that our people feel a sense of pride and a passion for belonging. As a company leading change, it’s our responsibility to foster opportunities for all people to participate in a harmonized Workforce of the Future.

items.desc: Job Description This role puts you at the heart of the business, working side by side with our underwriters to develop solutions that really matter. Bringing together data science and AI engineering, it has a clear goal: making a measurable difference to underwriting. As one of the first hires into our new Underwriting Analytics function, you will be working in one of the most exciting parts of the business, with a real opportunity to make an impact. At first, most of your focus will be on understanding the problems underwriters face and developing practical solutions that lay the foundation for analytics. Over time, the role will move towards more analytical solutions, making the most of the data you have helped develop. This is work at the forefront of insurance, and our ambition is to become market leading in how we use data and AI to support underwriting. Responsibilities Start with the underwriting problem. Spend time with underwriters, portfolio managers and product heads to understand their challenges first-hand, and agree which problems are worth solving and what success looks like. Develop the right solution. Use analytics and technology to solve each problem, choosing the simplest approach that works, whether analysis, automation, an AI workflow, a statistical or machine learning model, or a third-party product. Apply AI and automation to underwriting workflows. Use large language models, document AI and automation to turn unstructured information, such as submissions, emails and documents, into structured data, and to take repetitive manual effort out of underwriting processes. The data these tools capture will power the analytics that follow. Build prototypes that prove value. Develop working prototypes in collaboration with underwriters, and use their feedback to shape solutions that work in practice. Hand over to central teams to deliver. Pass successful prototypes to our central data and technology teams with clear requirements, results and success measures, then support them through delivery and adoption. Apply data science to underwriting decisions. B uild statistical and machine learning models, such as segmentation, triage and propensity models, that help underwriters select risks, manage referrals, refine appetite and monitor portfolio performance. Turn portfolio and market data into insight. Analyse broker flow, quote-to-bind conversion and portfolio performance, and track changes in rates, terms and conditions to spot shifts in the market early. Share what you find in plain language, so underwriting teams and senior management can see where to focus and when to act. Help set the AI foundations for the future. Shape how the new function grows, and keep up with developments in data science and AI so we can bring the best ideas into underwriting. Qualifications Essential Statistics and machine learning. You have applied statistical and machine learning methods, to real business problems, and can design analyses and experiments that measure impact. Python and SQL. You write clean, well-structured Python and SQL, use version control and testing as standard, and are comfortable working with large, imperfect datasets. AI and large language models. You have built applications or prototypes using large language models, including prompt design, structured outputs and retrieval, and evaluated how well they work. Unstructured information. You have turned unstructured information, such as documents, spreadsheets or emails, into structured data, and checked how accurate the results were. From problem to prototype. You have taken a business problem from first conversation to a working prototype that people tested or used, and measured the difference it made. Working with delivery teams. You have handed over models or prototypes to engineering or technology teams and supported them through delivery. Explaining technical work. You can explain to non-technical colleagues how a model or tool works, how well it performs and where its limits are. Desirable Data science experience in pricing, claims, exposure management or portfolio management, in insurance or another financial-risk setting. Knowledge of specialty or Lloyd's market insurance is helpful but not essential, as long as you are curious about how underwriting creates value and can learn the domain quickly. Training or fine-tuning models for text and document tasks when prompting alone is not enough. Experience as a product owner, or of working in agile teams alongside engineers and business users.
