items.desc: Tradition is the interdealer broking arm of Compagnie Financière Tradition and one of the world's largest interdealer brokers in over-the-counter financial and commodity related products. CFT is represented in over 28 countries, employing over 2,500 people. Tradition’s goal is to provide superior client services. It believes its business success is a direct reflection of its employees and recruits. As such, teamwork, creativity, reliability and integrity are components of a work ethic taken very seriously since the company was founded in 1959. Tradition is currently seeking to appoint a Forward Deployed AI Engineer to be based within the Lausanne office. Main responsibilities within the Forward Deployed AI Engineer position include: Work closely with teams across the business to understand their workflows, identify opportunities where the platform can add value, and scope solutions end to end. Map and analyse existing processes, working collaboratively with process owners to redesign workflows, automate suitable activities, and deliver measurable improvements. Own solutions through the full delivery lifecycle, from initial discovery and design through to build, deployment, iteration and ongoing improvement based on real-world feedback. Build applications, AI agents and agentic workflows using the platform and on-premises LLMs served via vLLM. Support the deployment and adaptation of the platform across multiple regions, taking into account differences in infrastructure, regulatory and compliance requirements. Establish and maintain deployment pipelines and CI/CD processes for AI applications, ensuring reliable and repeatable releases. Monitor application health, model performance and platform usage, identifying opportunities to improve reliability, performance and scalability. Deliver demonstrations, walkthroughs and training sessions, supported by clear and practical documentation to drive adoption across the business. Capture learnings and feedback from deployments and feed these back into the core platform, helping to continuously improve the solution and streamline future implementations. Key skills, experience and competencies required to be successful in this role: Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field 2+ years of post-graduation experience- as a software engineer, in a role where you worked directly with stakeholders or end users. Strong software engineering fundamentals and strong Python. You write code that other people can pick up, run, and maintain Strong stakeholder management skills : you can run a discovery conversation, ask the questions that matter, push back on a request that won't work, and translate a vague business problem into a scoped piece of work Autonomy in scoping and owning projects. You set your own priorities, drive progress toward broader team goals, and see work through to adoption rather than simply handing it over to others. A structured way of thinking about processes: you can take a workflow apart, see which steps carry the value and which are there by habit, and propose a better design rather than automating the existing one as it stands Experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation Familiarity with application/system monitoring and observability tools (e.g. Prometheus, Grafana or similar) Comfortable building against LLM APIs and consuming models served via vLLM (no deployment/ops experience required) Desirable: Experience with AI agent frameworks such as Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, or similar Familiarity with visual workflow orchestration platforms (e.g. n8n, Langflow) Familiarity with JavaScript and developing small front-end applications Available to start immediately Tradition do not accept agency CV’s. Please do not forward CV’s to our employees or Talent team. Tradition are not accountable for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. The Talent team will reach out to trusted agents when required. Please note, due to the large volume of applications for this position, only suitable candidates will be contacted. If you have not heard from us within 14 days, unfortunately, your application has been unsuccessful. Tradition welcome all suitable applications and are an equal opportunity employer who value diversity. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications and merit. By applying for this role, you agree that we may retain your details on our system for a period of 6 months and may contact you for any future vacancies that may arise within the Tradition Group.

items.desc: Job Summary Join EIT's AI and Robotics team to build AI agents that help scientists plan and carry out research. Our LifeAI platform connects models, scientific tools, data and compute so researchers can investigate questions, run analyses and review results. You will build agent skills, tool integrations and evaluations, initially for protein design and enzyme engineering. Your work will help agents propose workflows, explain their assumptions, execute reviewed plans and produce candidates and evidence for experimental testing. Reporting to the Lead Software Engineer, you will work with scientific product managers, researchers and platform teams. You will build on EIT's existing agent framework and scientific tools, with programme scientists providing domain guidance and scientific review. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on making AI useful in research. Requirements Key Responsibilities Turn scientific objectives and constraints into agent instructions, tool inputs and candidate checks, working with scientists and product managers Build agent workflows that retrieve relevant evidence, propose design steps and explain assumptions, uncertainties and decisions requiring scientific review Integrate scientific tools, models and calculators; validate inputs, interpret outputs and handle failures Connect workflows to data storage, compute, approval and progress-reporting capabilities, working with the data and platform teams Implement candidate generation, filtering and ranking against agreed criteria. Prepare sequences and supporting results for scientist review and experimental testing, including gene synthesis where required Build workflow-specific reference cases and regression checks using shared evaluation tooling. Compare permitted models and configurations for task quality, completion, speed and cost Investigate failures in reasoning, tool use and execution; improve agent instructions, context handling and code using evaluation results and scientist feedback Record input references, tool and model versions, parameters and output locations so results can be inspected and reproduced Write tested, maintainable code, contribute to reviews and support deployed workflows. Reuse components as scientific programmes expand Essential Knowledge, Skills, And Experience If you meet most of these, we'd like to hear from you. You have shipped multi-step agentic workflows with tool integrations and context management You have built reusable agent skills or tool interfaces, for example with MCP You write APIs and data-handling code with automated tests and version control You have integrated tools or services and handled invalid inputs, asynchronous execution and partial failures You can turn examples and failure cases into repeatable evaluations. You use evaluation results to change how an agent behaves, not just to report on it You can work with domain experts and turn unfamiliar requirements into testable software Desirable Knowledge, Skills, And Experience These are optional; you do not need to meet them to apply. Familiarity with protein design, enzyme engineering, computational biology or scientific software Experience integrating sequence or structure analysis, molecular modelling or protein-design tools Experience with literature retrieval, evidence-linked reporting or scientific data formats Familiarity with workflow engines, containers, cloud or HPC compute, and data-access controls Benefits We offer the following salary and benefits: Enhanced holiday pay Pension Life Assurance Income Protection Private Medical Insurance Hospital Cash Plan Therapy Services Perk Box Electric Car Scheme -- Why work for EIT: At the Ellison Institute, we believe a collaborative, inclusive team is key to our success. We are building a supportive environment where creative risks are encouraged, and everyone feels heard. Valuing emotional intelligence, empathy, respect, and resilience, we encourage people to be curious and to have a shared commitment to excellence. Join us and make an impact!

items.desc: Agentic Engineer (Medior) Build, ship and run software with AI, as part of a team Department Product Engineering · Role Agentic Engineer (Medior) · Location Amsterdam · Work arrangement Hybrid (50%) · Hours 0.8 to 1.0 FTE · Software that works in production, built with AI and owned by you Do you see AI as a way to get more done, but know that the output still has to be correct? Therapieland is looking for an Agentic Engineer who builds, ships and runs software for our platform as part of a FLOW team, with AI doing a large share of the execution. You work across the stack and have depth in at least one area. You understand the problem, give AI the right context, and verify the result before it reaches a client or professional. About Therapieland Mental healthcare is under pressure. Demand keeps growing, and waiting times are the result. At Therapieland we are working on a different outcome: our digital solutions help organisations organise value-driven mental care around the person. Every day we support professionals and their clients in mental health care (GGZ) and the social domain. We develop inspiring, intelligent and connecting psychology on demand. Samen mentaal veerkrachtig (together, mentally resilient). As part of Visma, we embrace new technology, AI first, to make mental healthcare smarter, more personal and more scalable. The role of the Agentic Engineer Therapieland builds in FLOW: small teams that take a problem from discovery to a measured outcome in production, with as few handovers as possible. A FLOW team brings together a product manager, a product designer and engineers, and works closely with customer success, marketing, the helpdesk, and the clients and professionals who use our platform. AI now produces much of the code, tests and infrastructure that engineers used to write by hand. That changes what one engineer can deliver. It does not change the need to understand the problem, choose the right approach and know whether the result is correct. That is where you spend most of your time. Good input produces good output. As a medior you work independently. You own standard solutions end to end, help own and improve the team's agentic tooling, and stay accountable for what you build. Our platform is regulated e-health, so speed never overrides our security, privacy and clinical safety standards, including ISO 27001 and NEN 7510. AI executes; people remain accountable. Your responsibilities Deliver outcomes with your team: you help shape solutions from discovery onward, build them, ship them, and stay involved until their effect is measured. You own regular changes from acceptance criteria to monitoring in production. Build with AI, and improve how the team does it: you use our internal agentic tooling daily and, together with other engineers, maintain and improve its workflows, skills, context and MCP connections. You create new workflows where the team needs them. Own quality from the start: you define acceptance criteria before building, challenge the context you give AI, and recognise output that looks correct but is subtly wrong. You build verification, harnesses and evals into team workflows. Run what you build: you make sure your systems are monitored on the shared tooling and stay healthy. When something breaks in a system you own, you fix it and use what you learned to improve the design. Work across the stack, with depth: you work in at least three of front-end, mobile, backend, data and APIs, and infrastructure, and you build depth in one area: quality engineering, cloud and infrastructure (Google Cloud), front-end and mobile, or backend and data. Make good decisions, and help others make them: you propose designs and record decisions. When someone else has to decide, you bring two or three options with their pros and cons and your preference. Architecture questions go to the weekly architecture task force, with a proposal. Who are you? Engineering experience across the stack: at least three years as a software engineer, with production work in at least three layers of the stack. You have a higher professional education, preferably in a software-related field. An AI-native way of working: you use agentic tooling every day, know where it fails, and can give examples of errors you caught in AI output. You can explain every change you commit. Analytical and critical thinking: you investigate problems independently and evaluate code, tooling and test results objectively. Collaboration and feedback: you pair and spar with colleagues, give direct and constructive feedback, and ask for it in return. You align early on dependencies. Clear communication: you explain to product managers, designers and colleagues what is and is not possible, and come with alternatives rather than only a no. You write clearly, because context and decisions are written down. Excellent command of English; Dutch is a plus. Security and privacy by design: you apply security and privacy in your own solutions and …

items.desc: AI & Automation Engineer Student Assistant We are looking for a curious and technically skilled student with an interest in AI, automation, and digital business development. The position is for 15-20 hours per week and focuses on developing AI-powered tools and automations that improve workflows across the organisation. Based at the New Works headquarters in Copenhagen, you will become part of a passionate team working in an international design company, with the opportunity to turn new technologies into practical solutions that make a real difference. About the Position As part of the Digital Business Development team, you will contribute to developing and implementing AI-driven solutions across New Works. Working with live business data across our ERP, product information system, helpdesk and project tools, you will identify opportunities to improve workflows, reduce manual tasks and create more efficient ways of working. Reporting to the Head of Digital Business Development, you will work across Sales Support, Operations, Marketing and Product Development, turning business needs into practical solutions. The position is for 15-20 hours per week, with flexible working hours to accommodate your studies and exam periods. Your responsibilities will include Working closely with different departments to understand their daily workflows and identify opportunities for improvement through AI and automation. Translating business needs into practical solutions, from defining the problem to developing and implementing a working tool. Building AI agents, tools and integrations that connect AI to live business data, including orders, stock, product information, customer emails and internal tasks. Developing and implementing automated workflows that reduce manual work, improve efficiency and save time across the organisation. Writing, testing and maintaining reliable code in accordance with company AI policies, security requirements and data protection guidelines. Supporting colleagues in adopting new tools and documenting solutions to ensure they can be maintained and further developed. Your Profile You are currently studying computer science, software engineering, data science or a related field, with at least one year remaining of your studies. You have experience writing and deploying code in Python, TypeScript or similar programming languages. You have a good understanding of version control, testing and responsible data handling. You have experience building applications, tools or agents using Large Language Models (LLMs), preferably solutions that have been used by others. You are familiar with AI tool calling, context management and connecting language models to external data through APIs or MCP. You are curious about how businesses operate and able to translate technical concepts into clear, practical solutions. You are proactive, structured and comfortable taking initiative, asking questions and exploring new approaches. Experience with ERP, PIM or helpdesk systems, or an interest in physical products and B2B businesses, is considered an advantage. Why Work at New Works A part-time student position of 15-20 hours per week, with flexibility to accommodate your studies and the opportunity to gain hands-on experience in AI, automation and digital business development. You will have the opportunity to develop and implement real solutions while gaining insight into how technology can support an international design company. We offer a collaborative and informal working environment, great breakfast and lunch at Meyer’s restaurant in the building, flexible working hours, beautiful surroundings, friendly colleagues and good coffee. About New Works New Works is found where contrasts meet and enrich one another. Our collection explores the dialogue between opposites, balancing sculptural forms with everyday function and contemporary expression with lasting appeal. We collaborate with an international circle of designers and artisans who share our fascination with honest materials, refined craftsmanship, and thoughtful design. Together, we create furniture, lighting, and objects designed to be lived with and cherished over time. How to apply Please send your CV, a short introduction about yourself and, most importantly, something you have built with AI: a link, a repo or a short description of what it did and what it changed, to Oliver@newworks.dk. Please present your documents in English or Danish. Kindly note that we only consider applications sent directly to Oliver@newworks.dk, and do not review applications submitted via LinkedIn. The position is open for immediate hire, with the aim of onboarding the right candidate as soon as possible. If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact our Head of Digital Business Development, Oliver Kubicki, at (+45) 27 26 68 95.

items.desc: Werk mee aan een nieuw internet. Niet als toeschouwer, maar als bouwer van de technische fundering. Upod is net gelanceerd. De volgende stap: Upod toegankelijk maken voor AI-agents en LLM's, op een manier die privacy-first blijft. Daarvoor bouwen we een MCP (Model Context Protocol) server, en jij bouwt die mee, direct samen met ons tech team. Utonomy ontwikkelt technologie gebaseerd op een nieuw protocol van de uitvinder van het world wide web (Solid, van Tim Berners-Lee) dat mensen weer controle geeft over hun persoonlijke data. Daarmee leggen we de basis voor privacy-first producten, eerlijke AI en een Europees alternatief voor Big Tech. De grove richting van de MCP staat vast: AI-agents moeten op een veilige, privacy-respecterende manier met Upod-data kunnen werken. De concrete invulling, architectuur en scope bouwen we samen met jou uit. Taken Dit is geen meekijk-stage. Je bouwt mee aan een systeem dat nog niet bestaat, met directe begeleiding. Ontwerpen en bouwen van de MCP-server voor Upod, samen met Martijn (co-founder) Uitdenken van API-structuur, scopes en autorisatie, met privacy-by-design als uitgangspunt Testen van de MCP-integratie met LLM's en AI-agents Documenteren van architectuurkeuzes en implementatie Meedenken over de bredere toekomst van personal AI agents op Upod Ideaal voor studenten informatica, AI, data science of software engineering met interesse in protocollen en API's. Vereisten Je bent een self-starter die goed gaat op: Het krijgen van vrijheid én verantwoordelijkheid, met directe begeleiding van een founder Zelf meedenken over architectuur, niet alleen uitvoeren wat is opgeschreven Snel schakelen tussen zelfstandig bouwen en samen sparren Ruimte om te experimenteren, ook als iets de eerste keer niet werkt We zoeken geen "perfect CV". Wel echte technische nieuwsgierigheid en de wil om iets nieuws te bouwen. Je: volgt een hbo- of wo-opleiding in informatica, AI, data science of vergelijkbaar hebt ervaring met API's en minimaal één programmeertaal (bijvoorbeeld Python, TypeScript/Node) bent minimaal 5-6 maanden beschikbaar bent pro-actief, technisch nieuwsgierig en leergierig spreekt en schrijft goed Nederlands en Engels Benefits Benefits Stagevergoeding (marktconform) Kantoor in hartje Utrecht + hybride werken Directe, inhoudelijke begeleiding, geen tussenlagen Echte verantwoordelijkheid over een technisch fundament, niet een side-project Netwerk en ervaring waar je jaren later nog profijt van hebt Kansen om na je stage betrokken te blijven Waarom dit een uitzonderlijke stage is Je bouwt een technisch component dat bepaalt hoe AI straks met Upod werkt Je zit dicht op de besluitvorming, direct samen met de co-founder die dit begeleidt Je bouwt mee aan een nieuw protocol-ecosysteem, niet aan een geïsoleerde feature Je leert protocollen, architectuur en privacy-by-design in de praktijk, niet uit een tutorial Geef in je motivatie aan: welke ervaring je al hebt met API's, protocollen of AI-integraties wanneer je kunt starten wat je wilt leren over MCP, AI-agents of privacy-by-design Geen lange brief nodig, vertel ons vooral waarom jij dit wilt bouwen en wat je al hebt gebouwd.

items.desc: AI Engineer (AI Platform & Data Engineering) Location: Remote, Spain Candidates must be based in Spain and have the existing right to work in Spain. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship or relocation support for this role Salary: EUR 60,000–70,000 per annum (depending on experience) Overview Of Position Speedcast delivers highly customizable, mission-critical communication solutions for remote sites worldwide. Our Data Engineering team operates a modern lakehouse platform — Kafka streaming, Iceberg on S3, a cloud query layer, and time-series databases on AWS — and we are building AI-powered products and internal tools on top of it. As an AI Engineer on the platform side, you will build and operate the infrastructure that makes AI applications reliable in production: the data pipelines that feed them, the embedding and retrieval layers behind them, and the services, APIs, and monitoring around them. This role carries a strong data engineering component — you will cross-function with the wider team on platform duties, contributing to ingestion pipelines, data quality, and operational excellence across our data systems. The successful candidate is a strong software and data engineer who is excited by the LLM application stack, cares about reliability, security, and cost, and is capable of working independently while collaborating closely with colleagues across Data Engineering, Data Science, and DevOps. What You Will Do Design, build, and operate the pipelines that power AI applications: document and data ingestion, chunking and embedding pipelines, vector stores, and retrieval services. Productionize LLM-powered applications as reliable services: APIs, containerised deployments, observability, cost monitoring, and access control. Integrate AI workloads with the data lakehouse platform — streaming (Kafka) and batch sources, query layers, and time-series stores. Build and maintain evaluation, logging, and feedback infrastructure for AI applications in production. Contribute to core data engineering duties: developing and maintaining data pipelines, ensuring data quality and reliability, and improving platform performance and efficiency. Implement security, privacy, and governance best practices for AI systems handling company data. Collaborate with data scientists, AI engineers, software engineers, and business stakeholders to deliver AI-driven solutions. Participate in Agile ceremonies, backlog grooming, sprint planning, and prioritisation activities. Evaluate and support the adoption of new AI platform technologies, tools, and architectural approaches. What We Need From You 3–5 years of experience in software engineering or data engineering, with hands-on exposure to AI/LLM application development. Commercial experience with Python and strong SQL skills (any major SQL dialect). Experience developing and maintaining data pipelines in production. Experience integrating foundation model APIs (e.g., Amazon Bedrock, Anthropic, OpenAI) into applications or services. Hands-on experience with AWS services (e.g., Lambda, Step Functions, S3, ECR, Glue) and AWS security best practices. Experience containerising applications using Docker. Experience building and operating APIs and backend services. Understanding of data quality, data governance, and data engineering best practices. Experience using Git for source control and working within Agile/Scrum environments. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Even better if you have Experience with streaming platforms: Confluent Kafka, Avro/Schema Registry, Kafka Connect, or Apache Flink. Experience with lakehouse architectures: Apache Iceberg, Parquet, medallion patterns, and dbt. Experience with query engines such as Dremio and time-series databases such as TimescaleDB. Experience with vector search (pgvector or dedicated vector databases) and retrieval infrastructure at scale. Experience with agentic frameworks, tool use, or the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Experience with Infrastructure as Code (e.g., CloudFormation, Terraform) and CI/CD pipelines. Experience with cost monitoring and optimisation of cloud and AI workloads. Good understanding of GDPR and data governance principles. Advanced AWS expertise, including relevant AWS certifications. Working at Speedcast At Speedcast, we want people that like adventure. Who are motivated by work that takes uncommon ingenuity and thinking outside the box. Who relish the idea of working in an industry undergoing massive transformation. If you want to be part of a global team responsible for connecting the world, then you're in the right place. We're always pushing forward, never standing still. When people rely on you and your team to stay connected, it brings everyone closer together. We're united by the adrenaline of high-stakes projects and our love of getting the job done right. You will experiment, learn and grow here, right alongside us, every single …

items.desc: En tant que stagiaire au CEA, vous aurez l'opportunité de travailler au sein d'un environnement de recherche de renommée mondiale. Nos équipes sont composées d'experts passionnés et dédiés, offrant un cadre propice à l'apprentissage et à la collaboration. Vous aurez accès à des équipements de pointe et à des ressources de recherche de premier ordre pour mener à bien vos missions. Éventuellement, les travaux menés donneront lieu à une publication scientifique. Contexte : La Direction de la Recherche Technologique (DRT) du CEA a pour mission de développer des solutions innovantes et d’interagir avec les acteurs industriels pour valoriser ces technologies. Le laboratoire LIIIM (Intelligence Intégrée Multi-capteurs) possède une expertise en perception de l’environnement grâce à sa maîtrise de différents capteurs (caméra, LiDAR, RADAR, infrarouge) appliquée à des domaines tels que l’automobile, la robotique ou les drones. Le stage consistera à : Prendre en main les différents capteurs disponibles. Mettre en place un algorithme de calibration en utilisant des méthodes à base d'IA. Adopter une méthode scientifique rigoureuse pour valider la pertinence des algorithmes proposés. Cette plateforme permettra d'acquérir une base de données utilisant les deux modalités dans le cadre de la détection de gestes. Cette base de données pourra potentiellement être mise à disposition de la communauté scientifique. Ce dataset servira ensuite à développer des méthodes de perception bénéficiant des 2 modalités. Qu'attendons-nous de vous? Participer à la mise en œuvre d’une plateforme d’acquisition combinant un RADAR et une caméra. Contribuer au développement d’outils permettant de réaliser la calibration à base de méthodes d’IA. Évaluer la pertinence des résultats obtenus. Ce travail permettra la création d’un dataset multimodal RADAR/caméra pour détecter des mouvements ou gestes de personnes. En collaboration avec les chercheurs de l’équipe, le candidat développera des algorithmes d’IA pour la calibration en tenant compte des spécificités des données de chaque capteur. Il devra faire preuve d’un esprit critique et mettre en œuvre les outils permettant de déterminer la qualité des solutions proposées. Dans un second temps, le candidat participera à la création du dataset. Le stagiaire pourra ensuite mettre en évidence l’intérêt de la double modalité RADAR/caméra, un travail qui pourra faire l’objet d’une publication scientifique. La plateforme développée au cours de ce stage pourra faire l’objet d’un démonstrateur présenté lors de conférences scientifiques ou à des industriels. # Cea-List Profil du candidat Profil : Bac +5 Ecole d'ingénieur en informatique Localisation du poste Site Grenoble Localisation du poste France, Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes, Isère (38) Ville Grenoble Critères candidat Langues Anglais (Courant) Diplôme préparé Bac+5 - Diplôme École d'ingénieurs Possibilité de poursuite en thèse Non

The fastest growing part of our business is Herman , our AI agent for mortgage origination. Herman reads documents, checks them, and works a credit file the way an analyst would, inside the regulated workflow of a real bank. It runs on sovereign EU infrastructure, because our clients cannot send mortgage data anywhere else. Phase by phase, it automates more of the origination process: first employed borrowers, then the self-employed, and onward. This is not a chatbot bolted onto old software. It is agentic software doing real work in a regulated environment. A passionate and engaging team of around 30 stellar Fintech operators works vigorously to transform European mortgages by enhancing efficiency and alleviating borrower anxiety. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and Motive Ventures, we have raised EUR 14 million, placing Oper at the forefront of revolutionizing mortgages in Europe. Oper currently has offices in Zürich, Switzerland, and Antwerp, Belgium. Your Mission We are looking for an AI-Native Business Analyst to join our Customer Success team. You will work with one of our biggest clients owning the delivery work that turns their business needs into a configured, live Oper platform. As we continue to grow, you will expand into a broader portfolio of lenders, becoming the trusted delivery partner who guides them from kickoff to value. This is a role for someone who genuinely enjoys structuring messy problems, sitting in a workshop with bankers and product owners, and translating what they hear into something concrete the engineering team can build and the customer can run. It is also a role for someone who is AI-native , who uses modern AI tooling as a core part of how they think, write, and ship. Tasks Capture and structure customer requirements You will be the bridge between what the customer wants and what Oper delivers. Run discovery workshops with business and IT stakeholders at our customers Capture functional and business requirements in clear, well-structured documentation Map requirements to Oper's product : identify what works out-of-the-box, what needs configuration, and what genuinely needs engineering Translate business needs into user stories and functional specifications the squad can act on Manage stakeholder expectations throughout the project lifecycle Analyze integration points Our customers run on complex banking stacks. You will figure out how Oper plugs in cleanly. Review technical API documentation from core banking systems, CRMs, and online banking platforms Work with Oper engineering to identify and define integration points Document data flows, contracts, and edge cases so nothing surprises us at go-live Make smart, pragmatic recommendations on what to integrate now vs. later Configure workflows and deliver value You will own the hands-on configuration work that makes Oper work for each customer. Configure mortgage products, business rules, and customer journeys inside the Oper platform Validate that configurations match the agreed scope and pass acceptance testing Lead training sessions for end users and customer champions Stay close to the customer through go-live and early adoption, then hand over cleanly to the Customer Success team Work AI-native We expect you to use modern AI tooling as a real lever, not a curiosity. Use AI tools to scaffold documentation, draft specs, summarize workshops, and accelerate analysis, automate processes,… Identify where AI compounds your work and where it does not, and design your workflow accordingly Help us push the bar on what an AI-native delivery function looks like at Oper Requirements We are looking for someone with a consulting background who is ready to go deep on a product and an industry, and who loves technology: 2 to 3 years of experience in consulting (Big-4, boutique strategy/tech, or implementation consulting). You love structuring problems : messy customer conversations come out of your hands as clean documents, frameworks, and next steps You genuinely enjoy customer and end-user interaction : workshops energize you rather than drain you Technical affinity : you are comfortable reading API documentation, understanding integration patterns, and configuring software. You do not need to code, but you should not be afraid of anything technical either. AI-native : you can name the tools, the workflows, and the concrete recent examples where AI gave you real leverage. You see AI as a default part of how you work. Action-oriented, with a knack for getting things done in ambiguous situations Comfortable in a fast-growing, evolving SaaS environment 🌍 Languages Fluent in English (required) Bonus qualities Familiarity with the European mortgage market or …

items.desc:
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion, dedication, and a no-excuse mindset to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish. Smart people and inspiring, innovative technologies are the norm here.
Our team is responsible for validating the RF performance of top-notch, monolithic cellular transceivers. We are looking for a motivated RF engineer with strong programming skills to join our PLL validation efforts. This is a hands-on role where you will verify that our new silicon designs meet specifications, working in an agentic engineering flow where you direct AI agents across specs, code, lab setups and data, while staying accountable for the result. Join us and leverage your passion for RF excellence to enable the world's most innovative mobile devices.
As an RF PLL Silicon Validation Engineer, you will own the bring-up and characterization of frequency generation subsystems in market-leading transceivers. Your work style is collaborative and proactive, driving technical solutions across interdisciplinary teams. You will work in an agentic work flow, you scope the problem and define pass/fail criteria, delegate implementation and execution to AI agents, and verify every result against the specification.
Proficiency in Python programming. Hands-on experience with AI coding assistants or agents, together with the judgement to verify their output, is a major plus.
Hands-on experience with standard lab equipment (Spectrum Analyzers, Oscilloscopes, Power Supplies) and board-level troubleshooting.
Ability to process and analyze data using libraries like NumPy, Pandas, or Matplotlib.
Solid foundation in RF and mixed-signal theory, particularly regarding PLLs, LNAs, Mixers, and oscillators.
Familiarity with RF measurement concepts such as Phase Noise, Harmonics, IP3, and Noise Figure.
Understanding of cellular standards (5G NR, LTE)
Master's or PhD degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent with a focus on RF/Analog circuits or Signal Processing.

items.desc:
Job Description: 
 Envie de déployer vos ailes ? Et si votre aventure commençait avec nous ? 
 Quel que soit le métier de vos rêves, nous avons peut-être le stage qu’il vous faut ! 
 Vous êtes étudiant(e) et à la recherche d'un stage ou d'une année de césure vous permettant de valider votre diplôme et qui fera décoller votre carrière ? Imaginez-vous au cœur d’une entreprise reconnue à l’international, implantée sur tous les continents du monde et riche d’une diversité de parcours, d’expertise et de culture.
 Tournée vers le digital, à la pointe de la recherche et de l’innovation, vous avez l’opportunité de faire partie de cette aventure passionnante.
 Votre mission, si vous l'acceptez : 
 Une offre de stage intitulée « Stage en Gestion de Produits de Données / Operations Data Product (h/f) » vient de s'ouvrir au sein de Airbus sur son site de Toulouse. Vous rejoindrez le département « Excellence Opérationnelle (OED) » en charge d'apporter son soutien aux Opérations, de maximiser la valeur ajoutée grâce aux solutions d'analyse et d'IA, et de fournir des données fiables et conformes pour répondre aux défis stratégiques de l'entreprise.
 Votre stage consistera à faire le lien entre la feuille de route des fondations de données (data foundations) et les besoins d'analyse et d'IA pour l'ensemble des domaines métiers des Opérations (Achats, Supply Chain, Fabrication, Qualité), en contribuant à la définition, la consolidation et la visualisation de la roadmap de l'Operations Data Analytics & AI Factory.
 Ce stage, d'une durée de 6 mois , débutera idéalement au premier semestre 2027 (cette période est indicative et pourra être ajustée).
 Vos principales missions consisteront à : 
 Recueillir et analyser activement les besoins et attentes des utilisateurs métiers (Business Owners, Data Custodians) en matière de données opérationnelles.
 Identifier et cartographier les interdépendances entre les applications sources fournissant les données et les applications métiers consommatrices, avec l'appui des Data Product Owners.
 Proposer une méthode de consolidation et de structuration des informations pour la feuille de route (roadmap) intégrée.
 Rechercher, concevoir et mettre en œuvre des solutions visuelles et ergonomiques pour communiquer efficacement la roadmap de la Factory auprès des parties prenantes (métiers, Data Office, IM).
 Mettre en place un système de gestion des versions de la roadmap ainsi qu'un processus méthodologique pour sa diffusion et sa mise à jour continue.
 Votre tuteur ou tutrice vous accompagnera tout au long de votre stage, vous aidant à développer vos compétences et à atteindre vos objectifs professionnels.
 Ce stage vous permettra notamment de développer les compétences suivantes : 
 Maîtrise du cycle de vie et du management de produits de données (Data Products) dans un environnement industriel d'envergure.
 Compétences en gestion de projet transverse et méthodologies agiles (Scrum, SAFe) appliquées à la data et à l'IA.
 Capacité à concevoir des visualisations stratégiques et des roadmaps pour aligner les équipes techniques (IM, architectes de données) et les directions métiers opérationnelles.
 Votre carte d’embarquement pour cette aventure : 
 Vous êtes actuellement en Master 1, Master 2 ou dernière année d'école d'ingénieur ou de commerce (Bac+4 / Bac+5) en gestion de projet, ingénierie, informatique, data management ou un domaine équivalent.
 Vous possédez idéalement les compétences suivantes : 
 - Compétences techniques :
 Compréhension des enjeux de modélisation, de structuration et d'intégration de données.
 Connaissance ou expérience pratique des méthodologies de gestion de projet (Agile, Scrum, SAFe).
 Capacité à définir, documenter et diffuser une démarche méthodologique ou des spécifications fonctionnelles.
 - Soft Skills :
 Esprit très structuré, grande rigueur d'analyse et forte capacité de synthèse.
 Proactivité, curiosité industrielle et force de proposition face aux défis complexes.
 Excellentes qualités relationnelles et sens prononcé du travail en équipe multiculturelle.
 - Langues :
 Anglais : Courant / Négociation (usage quotidien dans un contexte international).
 Français : Courant / Avancé.
 Notre processus de recrutement : 
 Votre candidature sera analysée attentivement par notre équipe de recrutement. Si votre profil correspond à nos attentes, vous serez invité(e) à réaliser un entretien vidéo. Suite à cette étape, si votre candidature est retenue, elle sera alors proposée au manager pour un entretien.

items.desc:
Grow with us
 About the Opportunity 
Ericsson is Europe’s leading network technology company and a global pioneer shaping the 6G era. Our 6G vision will transform business and society in the 2030s through secure, efficient, and sustainable communications.
Video already accounts for 75% of mobile data traffic. In an AI-enabled world of immersive experiences, digital twins, autonomous systems, and generative media, advanced video coding is indispensable. To deliver these services on a global scale, video compression and standards must keep advancing in efficiency, flexibility, and sustainability.
Join our international team of world-class researchers at the forefront of both advanced signal processing and neural network–based compression. You will invent, implement, and evaluate algorithms that power next-generation video coding standards shaping the technology stack of 6G and AI-native media.
 What You Will Do 
• Invent novel video coding tools (signal processing and neural approaches) to improve video coding performance and efficiency as well as invent ways to increase robustness and flexibility of video coding standards. 
• Implement inventions in software (C++/Python) and run large-scale evaluations.
• Contribute to global video coding standardization such as JVET/MPEG, author patents and publications.
• Collaborate with researchers and engineers across Ericsson as well as leading industry and academia experts globally. 
• Be working in a dynamic team with opportunities for learning, taking on new responsibilities, impacting ways of working, and much more.
 The Skills You Bring 
 We welcome outstanding graduates, postdocs, and experienced researchers passionate about video coding innovation who:
• Hold an M.Sc. or Ph.D. in a relevant technical field.
• Are exceptional problem solvers with a passion for innovation.
• Write high-quality, efficient code and are strong in C++ and/or Python.
• Are curious, collaborative, and able to communicate complex ideas clearly.
 Nice to have: 
• Experience in video coding and processing.
• Experience in signal processing and neural networks applied to compression or video processing.
• Familiarity with standards such as H.265/HEVC and H.266/VVC.
• Contributions to standardization, publications, or talks at conferences/industry events.
 Why join Ericsson: 
• Be part of Europe’s leading tech company at the forefront of 6G and global standards.
• Work with a top-tier international research team and have your work validated and recognized on the world stage.
• Have a real impact at scale with your innovations targeting billions of devices and a large share of global data traffic. 
• Grow in a dynamic environment with strong mentorship, learning opportunities, and real impact.
• Perform at your best, enabled by a healthy work-life balance and a commitment to long-term, sustainable progress.
 Location: for this job opportunity is Stockholm Sweden. For exceptional candidates other locations may be considered
 How to apply: 
Send your application and describe how your experience and skills will advance state-of-the-art video coding for the AI-enabled 6G world.
 What happens once you apply? Click Here to find all you need to know about what our typical hiring process looks like.We encourage you to consider applying to jobs where you might not meet all the criteria. We recognize that we all have transferrable skills, and we can support you with the skills that you need to develop.Encouraging a diverse and inclusive organization is core to our values at Ericsson, that's why we champion it in everything we do. We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.

items.title: STAGE - IA pour la calibration de modèles d’interconnexion - F/H
items.card: vos missions Découvrir les principes de la modélisation des interconnexions en microélectronique et leur impact sur les performances des circuits. Comprendre les travaux réalisés lors du précédent projet et identifier les pistes d'amélioration. Prendre en main les outils et données utilisés dans les flows de caractérisation électrique. Générer et analyser des jeux de données. Étudier l'influence de paramètres
items.desc:
Chez STMicroelectronics, nous sommes convaincus que la technologie est un moteur d’innovation et a un impact positif pour les entreprises, les personnes et la société.
 En tant qu’acteur mondial des semiconducteurs, nos technologies de pointe et nos composants électroniques sont invisibles mais au cœur du monde d’aujourd’hui.
 Rejoindre ST, c’est intégrer une entreprise internationale riche de plus de 115 nationalités, présente dans 40 pays, et rassemblant plus de 50 000 talents passionnés et engagés, tous unis par la volonté de créer et d’inventer la technologie de demain.
 Innover demande bien plus que des compétences techniques : cela nécessite des personnes inspirantes, qui savent collaborer avec respect et enthousiasme. Des collaborateurs animés par la passion, prêts à remettre en question le statu quo, à faire avancer l’innovation et à révéler leur plein potentiel.
 Venez vivre cette aventure avec nous et contribuez à construire un futur plus intelligent et plus durable, en alliant responsabilité et innovation. 
 Notre technologie commence avec vous.
 Au sein d’une équipe d’automatisation développant des outils pour la modélisation SPICE en microélectronique, vous contribuerez au développement de nouvelles solutions d’intelligence artificielle appliquées à la modélisation technologique.
 L’extraction des parasites (PEX) permet de caractériser les capacités et résistances parasites associées aux structures d’interconnexion et joue un rôle essentiel dans la qualité des modèles utilisés pour la simulation des circuits. La construction et la calibration de ces modèles reposent sur de nombreuses simulations de référence afin d’évaluer l’impact des paramètres de modélisation et des variations de procédé sur les performances électriques extraites.
 Dans le cadre de la poursuite de travaux autour de l’utilisation de l’intelligence artificielle pour le PEX, ce stage vise à développer un surrogate model basé sur des Graph Neural Networks (GNN) capable de reproduire rapidement les résultats de simulations de référence et d’assister les modélistes dans l’étude et la calibration des paramètres de modélisation.
 A propos de vos missions 
 Découvrir les principes de la modélisation des interconnexions en microélectronique et leur impact sur les performances des circuits.
 Comprendre les travaux réalisés lors du précédent projet et identifier les pistes d'amélioration.
 Prendre en main les outils et données utilisés dans les flows de caractérisation électrique.
 Générer et analyser des jeux de données.
 Étudier l'influence de paramètres technologiques sur les caractéristiques électriques des interconnexions.
 Concevoir et développer un modèle d'Intelligence Artificielle capable de reproduire le comportement observé dans les simulations.
 Évaluer les performances et la robustesse du modèle sur des cas représentatifs.
 Collaborer avec les experts modélisation afin de valider les résultats obtenus et orienter les développements.
 Présenter les conclusions et recommandations issues du stage.
 A propos de vous 
 Vous êtes étudiant(e) en dernière année d’école d’ingénieur.
 Vous possédez de solides bases en machine learning, intelligence artificielle ou science des données.
 Vous maîtrisez Python et avez une première expérience avec des frameworks tels que PyTorch ou TensorFlow.
 Vous appréciez les problématiques à l’interface entre développement logiciel, analyse de données et modélisation scientifique.
 Vous faites preuve de curiosité, d’autonomie et d’esprit d’initiative.
 Vous disposez de bonnes capacités d’analyse et d’un goût pour la résolution de problèmes complexes.
 Une connaissance du domaine de la microélectronique, de la modélisation SPICE ou des simulations physiques constitue un plus.
 Vous disposez d’un bon niveau d’anglais technique, à l’écrit comme à l’oral.
 ST est fière d’être certifiée parmi les 17 entreprises mondiales « Global Top Employers 2025 » et d’être la première et unique entreprise de semi-conducteurs à recevoir cette distinction. ST a été distinguée dans ce classement grâce à sa démarche d’amélioration continue, se démarquant notamment par son engagement en matière d’éthique et d’intégrité, de sens et de valeurs, d’organisation et de gestion du changement, ainsi que par sa stratégie commerciale et ses performances. En France, ST a également obtenu la labélisation Happy Trainee 2025. 
 Nous cultivons un environnement de travail inclusif et diversifié, où la discrimination n’a pas sa place. Notre ambition est de recruter et de fidéliser des talents reflétant la richesse des sociétés dans lesquelles nous évoluons.
 Nous nous engageons à l’équité dans le développement des carrières, les opportunités professionnelles et la rémunération.
 Chez ST, nous encourageons les candidats qui ne remplissent pas forcément tous les critères à postuler, car nous croyons en la richesse des parcours variés et offrons de réelles opportunités d’apprentissage et d’évolution. La diversité, l’équité et l’inclusion …

items.title: PhD Student Position in Fabrication and Characterization of Plasmonic Crystals for Solar Energy
items.card: responsibilities As a PhD Student, you will be expected to: Assume full responsibility for your PhD dissertation; Perform research in close collaboration with other lab members and international collaborators; Design and execute experiments; Analyze and interpret experimental results; Write scientific articles for publication in peer-reviewed journals; Present at international conferences; Contribute to teaching,
items.desc:
Mission 
 We are seeking a candidate with experience in preparation and experimental characterization of nanostructured materials to join our SNSF project “Coupled oscillations in plasmonic crystals”.
 In this project, we focus on the effects of coupling of plasmonic oscillations in metallic micro-/nanostructures. It might be possible to achieve plasmonic crystals featuring broad frequency bands of extraordinary optical transmission (EOT) in the UV-VIS-NIR spectral range. The insights from this project will have considerable impact on the fields of photovoltaics, flat screens and flexible displays, as well as energy efficient OLED lighting, electrochromic devices and energy-efficient insulating glazing.
 Research Group SCI-ENAC-AS: Nanotechnology for Solar Energy Conversion
Prof. Andreas Schüler 
 In our research group, we develop novel micro- and nanostructured smart materials for active and passive solar energy applications being integrated into the building envelope. We focus on thin films, because these allow covering a large surface area with a small quantity of raw material - and we focus on their electronic and optical properties, because these closely interrelated properties are most important for the use of solar energy.
 https://www.epfl.ch/labs/sci-enac-as/ 
 Main duties and responsibilities 
 As a PhD Student, you will be expected to:
 Assume full responsibility for your PhD dissertation;
 Perform research in close collaboration with other lab members and international collaborators;
 Design and execute experiments;
 Analyze and interpret experimental results;
 Write scientific articles for publication in peer-reviewed journals;
 Present at international conferences;
 Contribute to teaching, coach Master students and provide basic administrative support.
 Profile 
 An excellent Master’s-level degree in Micro-/Nanotechnology, Physics, Materials Science, Energy, or a related quantitative field
 A strong background in several of the following fields: reactive magnetron sputtering, electron-beam lithography, UV-VIS-NIR spectrophotometry, ultra-high vacuum scanning tunneling microscopy (STM), and/or photoelectron spectroscopies (XPS, UPS)
 A sincere interest in micro-/nanostructures, electronic and optical material properties, plasmonics and solar energy
 Proficiency in English (French is a plus)
 Strong motivation for academic research, critical thinking, independence, good self-management skills, and excellent team spirit
 Interest in a career involving research and teaching is an asset
 We offer 
 A stable position for up to 4 years in order to complete your PhD;
Term of employment: 1-year fixed-term contract (CDD), renewable for 4 years
 An international research environment
 Individual and intensive supervision of your PhD project
 Financial support in accordance with EPFL doctoral student conditions
 The opportunity to work on innovative materials in a laboratory with a cutting-edge equipment 
 Information 
 Your application should include:
 CV
 Motivation letter
 Diplomas
 Transcripts/grades from Bachelor’s and Master’s studies
 If you are successful, you will need to enrol in one of the EPFL doctoral school programs in parallel. Please check this page for additional information. Please note that this is a separate application process necessary to be eligible to complete your PhD at EPFL. Potential doctoral program for this position: EDEY, EDCE, EDMX, EDPY
 Expected start date : May 1st, 2027. An alternative start date may exceptionally be agreed upon by mutual agreement.
 Application : Application deadline is November 30, 2026. Apply through the EPFL job opportunities webpage . Only applications submitted through the online platform are considered. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
 For any further information, please contact nanosolar.jobs@epfl.ch

items.desc:
Mission 
 The Institute of Mathematics at the Ecole Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne (EPFL) invites applications for a full-time Bernoulli instructorship in algebra.
 Profile 
 Bernoulli Instructors are expected to teach algebra courses at all levels, notably algebraic geometry. The initial teaching load is light, corresponding to half the teaching load of regular faculty, and gradually progresses to the latter. 
Bernoulli Instructors are expected to develop and sustain an excellent independent research program. They are welcome to collaborate and encouraged to interact with members of the Institute, but they maintain full research independence.
 Bernoulli Instructors must have a PhD in Mathematics by the starting date, and must teach in French, English or both.
The EPFL actively aims to increase the presence of women amongst its employees, and women candidates are strongly encouraged to apply.
 We offer 
 The term of the position is two years, with the possibility of extension for another two years. 
EPFL salaries for Bernoulli instructors are highly competitive. In addition, instructors receive a substantial yearly budget for travel expenses and other expenditures.
 Informations 
 Contact:
 For further information, please contact Ms Carole Weissenberger, Secretary of the Institute of Mathematics (carole.weissenberger@epfl.ch) 
Applicants should include a cover letter, curriculum vitae, publication list, research plan, teaching record including evaluations, and arrange for three letters of recommendation to be sent to carole.weissenberger@epfl.ch with the subject “Bernoulli instructorship in algebra” (please also include the names and email addresses of the letter writers in the cover letter).

items.title: PhD Student Position in Numerical Modeling and Design of Plasmonic Crystals for Solar Energy
items.card: responsibilities As a PhD Student, you will be expected to: Assume full responsibility for your PhD dissertation; Perform research in close collaboration with other lab members and international collaborators; Design and execute experiments; Analyze and interpret experimental results; Write scientific articles for publication in peer-reviewed journals; Present at international conferences; Contribute to teaching,
items.desc:
Mission 
 We are seeking a candidate with experience in numerical modeling of nanostructured materials to join our SNSF project “Coupled oscillations in plasmonic crystals”.
 In this project, we focus on the effects of coupling of plasmonic oscillations in metallic micro-/nanostructures. It might be possible to achieve plasmonic crystals featuring broad frequency bands of extraordinary optical transmission (EOT) in the UV-VIS-NIR spectral range. The insights from this project will have considerable impact on the fields of photovoltaics, flat screens and flexible displays, as well as energy efficient OLED lighting, electrochromic devices and energy-efficient insulating glazing.
 Research Group SCI-ENAC-AS: Nanotechnology for Solar Energy Conversion
Prof. Andreas Schüler 
 In our research group, we develop novel micro- and nanostructured smart materials for active and passive solar energy applications being integrated into the building envelope. We focus on thin films, because these allow covering a large surface area with a small quantity of raw material - and we focus on their electronic and optical properties, because these closely interrelated properties are most important for the use of solar energy.
 https://www.epfl.ch/labs/sci-enac-as/ 
 Main duties and responsibilities 
 As a PhD Student, you will be expected to:
 Assume full responsibility for your PhD dissertation;
 Perform research in close collaboration with other lab members and international collaborators;
 Design and execute experiments;
 Analyze and interpret experimental results;
 Write scientific articles for publication in peer-reviewed journals;
 Present at international conferences;
 Contribute to teaching, coach Master students and provide basic administrative support.
 Profile 
 An excellent Master’s-level degree in Physics, Optics, Micro-/Nanotechnology, Materials Science, Energy, or a related quantitative field
 A strong background in several of the following fields: theory of light-matter interaction, computer simulations using the method of Finite Differences in the Time Domain (FDTD), determination of optical material constants by multiangle UV-VIS-NIR ellipsometry, and/or characterization by UV-VIS-NIR spectrophotometry
 A sincere interest in micro-/nanostructures, electronic and optical material properties, plasmonics, and solar energy
 Proficiency in English (French is a plus)
 Strong motivation for academic research, critical thinking, independence, good self-management skills, and excellent team spirit
 Interest in a career involving research and teaching is an asset
 We offer 
 A stable position for up to 4 years in order to complete your PhD;
Term of employment: 1-year fixed-term contract (CDD), renewable for 4 years
 An international research environment
 Individual and intensive supervision of your PhD project
 Financial support in accordance with EPFL doctoral student conditions
 The opportunity to work on innovative materials in a laboratory with a cutting-edge equipment 
 Information 
 Your application should include:
 CV
 Motivation letter
 Diplomas
 Transcripts/grades from Bachelor’s and Master’s studies
 If you are successful, you will need to enrol in one of the EPFL doctoral school programs in parallel. Please check this page for additional information. Please note that this is a separate application process necessary to be eligible to complete your PhD at EPFL. Potential doctoral program for this position: EDEY, EDCE, EDMX, EDPY
 Expected start date : May 1st, 2027. An alternative start date may exceptionally be agreed upon by mutual agreement.
 Application : Application deadline is November 30, 2026. Apply through the EPFL job opportunities webpage . Only applications submitted through the online platform are considered. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
 For any further information, please contact nanosolar.jobs@epfl.ch

items.desc: Date de publication : Nov 05, 2026, 3:50PM Durée du contrat : 6 mois Votre rôle : Rejoignez-nous en tant que stagiaire Data Analyste IA LLM, où vous aurez l’opportunité de contribuer à des projets stratégiques et variés au sein de notre équipe. L’objectif du stage est d’enrichir la connaissance et la maitrise de nos parcours autour de l’adresse pour la Commande Livraison des offres Fibre.Dans une démarche exploratoire, vous mobiliserez l’IA pour obtenir une vision de bout en bout de ces parcours et identifier des cas d’usage à valeur ajoutée. Vos missions : Vous mobiliserez des méthodes d’IA en local, dans le respect des normes d’Orange de sécurité afin de mettre en place le croisement des données d’adresse en vision de bout en bout et de proposer des simplifications. Vous contribuerez à enrichir les analyses et les rapports existants sur le parcours adresse. Vous aiderez à contribuer au croisement de plusieurs sources de données et à la réflexion sur des modèles de scoring. Vous contribuerez à la création d'un Dashboard Adresse en vision commande de bout en bout. Il présentera les différentes étapes, des filtres adaptés et sera alimenté mensuellement pour les besoins de BR de la direction. Vous aiderez à la prise de décision stratégique et business en proposant des plans d’actions en lien avec vos analyses (portefeuille, multi-canalité...). Vous identifierez les acteurs Orange permettant d’avoir les bonnes pratiques de sécurité interne à l’usage de ses nouvelles technologies. Vous cherchez un stage de 6 mois à compter du 1er Décembre 2026 Vous êtes actuellement en formation BAC+4/+5 (Statistiques – Informatique), université, école d'ingénieur ou école de commerce (avec une spécialisation data). Vous avez déjà expérimenté l’utilisation de modèles de langage (LLM) exécutés en local et souhaitez explorer leur apport par rapport aux méthodes classiques. Vous aimez rechercher des solutions face aux problématiques d’études exposées, donner du sens à vos analyses et les communiquer à tous les niveaux de l’entreprise. Vous êtes rigoureux et organisé. Vous faites preuve de beaucoup d'autonomie. Vous êtes doté d’un bon relationnel et appréciez le travail en équipe. Vous faites preuve d'écoute active, vous savez reformuler les besoins des clients et vous avez un esprit analytique. Vous êtes orienté client et avez le sens du service. Vous savez vous adapter aux différents publics. Vous êtes curieux de nature et vous intéressez aux nouvelles technologies. Avoir une expérience dans l'extraction, la valorisation et la visualisation des données serait un plus. Compétences Vous maitrisez les analyses par outils d’Intelligence Artificielle Vous disposez de compétences avancées concernant l’utilisation de l’IA et des méthodes en rupture Vous maitrisez les outils de requêtage et de Data Visualisation (Power Bi, cartographies, Excel / VBA/LLM en local..) Au-delà des compétences techniques, nous valorisons également les talents de communication, la capacité à écouter et à agir en conséquence sont de véritables atouts. Votre esprit d’initiative, votre sens du collectif et le respect de la confidentialité des données sont indispensables. Ce stage vous permettra de développer des compétences en communication et d’analyse qui seront de véritables atouts dans la poursuite de vos études et de votre parcours professionnel. Vous rejoignez une petite équipe et travaillerez en proximité avec d’autres data analystes déjà en poste. Une aide à la prise en main des outils internes est assurée. Vous travaillez sur les outils les plus demandés du marché (Power BI, LLM en local...) La direction Parcours Commande Livraison adresse plusieurs centaines de milliers de commande mensuellement. Elle est responsable de la performance du processus de bout en bout. Elle travaille en transverse avec les équipes SI, Data/IA, métier et processus Date de début souhaitée : Dec 01, 2026, 12:00AM Chez Orange, seules vos compétences comptent. Quel que soit votre âge, genre, origine, parcours, religion, orientation sexuelle, handicap, neuroatypie, ou apparence, nous encourageons activement la diversité au sein de nos équipes, car elle constitue une force pour le collectif et un vecteur d’innovation. Orange est une entreprise handi-accueillante : n’hésitez pas à nous faire part de vos besoins spécifiques.

items.desc: Role Purpose As Student.com expands across the US, we are looking for an experienced, hands-on AI Infrastructure Coder to take ownership of the infrastructure including AI and platform services that underpin our business. Your primary responsibility will be to keep our platforms secure, reliable, resilient and cost-effective, with particular focus on security, disaster recovery and business continuity. You will establish clear ownership, strengthen operational processes and move our approach from reactive problem-solving towards proactive prevention and continuous improvement. Working closely with our CTO and engineering colleagues, you will combine technical leadership with practical delivery. This role will suit someone who enjoys building and improving infrastructure, takes responsibility for its performance and understands how reliable technology supports customer experience and commercial growth. Business Context Student.com’s platform connects students with accommodation providers and supports the booking journeys, partner relationships and internal operations that drive our business. As we grow, we need infrastructure that can support increasing demand, enable safe and efficient development, and minimise disruption to students, landlords and commercial partners. You need to help support AI initiatives specifically providing infrastructure for agentic systems and knowledge of supporting models of cloud platforms like AWS & GCP. This role will provide dedicated ownership of those foundations, reducing the operational burden on other engineers and allowing them to focus on customer-facing features, partner integrations and future platform capabilities. Requirements Key Responsibilities Infrastructure Ownership & Technical Leadership Own the infrastructure and platform engineering roadmap, prioritising improvements in line with business needs, technical risks and available resources. Design, build, maintain and improve secure, scalable cloud infrastructure. Establish clear infrastructure standards, operating procedures and technical documentation. Identify and address infrastructure technical debt, operational weaknesses and dependencies on individual team members. Provide practical technical guidance and mentor colleagues in infrastructure and operational best practice. Manage relevant infrastructure suppliers and services, reviewing performance, suitability and cost. Platform Reliability & Incident Management Take ownership of production infrastructure reliability, availability and performance. Establish meaningful service measures and targets, with monitoring and reporting that make platform health visible. Improve observability, logging, monitoring and alerting so issues can be identified and addressed early. Lead infrastructure incident response, coordinating technical investigation, recovery and stakeholder updates. Conduct constructive post-incident reviews, identify underlying causes and ensure agreed improvements are completed. Improve redundancy, capacity planning and performance to reduce avoidable disruption and support growth. Help define sustainable arrangements for incident escalation and out-of-hours support. Security & Risk Management Own infrastructure security controls and work with engineering colleagues to embed security into platform design and day-to-day operations. Strengthen identity and access management, applying least-privilege access and appropriate authentication controls. Maintain effective processes for patching, vulnerability remediation, secrets management and secure configuration. Protect infrastructure, systems and data through appropriate network controls, encryption and monitoring. Identify and communicate technical risks, recommending proportionate improvements based on their potential business impact. Support security reviews, supplier assessments and relevant audit or compliance requirements. Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity Own the technical disaster recovery approach and contribute to wider business continuity planning. Agree recovery priorities, recovery time objectives and recovery point objectives with relevant stakeholders. Implement and maintain backup, restoration and failover arrangements for critical systems and data. Test recovery procedures regularly, document the results and resolve identified gaps. Maintain clear recovery runbooks so the business can respond effectively to significant disruption. Identify single points of failure and reduce reliance on individual systems, suppliers or people. Automation & Developer Experience Drive the adoption and improvement of Infrastructure as Code, ensuring changes are repeatable, version-controlled and reviewable. Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines that support safe, efficient deployments and reliable rollback. Improve consistency across development, testing and production environments. Reduce manual administration and operational effort through practical automation. Provide tooling and documentation …

items.card: The role London CIV is investing in AI and automation to make it easier for colleagues across the organisation to do their jobs, from streamlining routine processes to building intelligent digital assistants. items.desc: About London CIV London CIV is the investment pool for the Local Government Pension Schemes (LGPS) of London and Buckinghamshire local authorities. Authorised and regulated by the FCA, the pool is owned by all London boroughs, the City of London and Buckinghamshire (also known as London CIV's Partner Funds). The pool provides a broad investment offering across public markets through its Authorised Contractual Scheme (ACS), alongside a range of private markets funds. London CIV also provides Partner Funds with investment strategy and Strategic Asset Allocation (SAA) advice, alongside specialist pension advisory and support through LGPS PASS (Pension Advisory and Support Services). As of 30 September 2026, assets under management stood at c.£65 billion. The role London CIV is investing in AI and automation to make it easier for colleagues across the organisation to do their jobs, from streamlining routine processes to building intelligent digital assistants. This contractor role sits at the heart of that programme, working alongside London CIV's Data & AI team to design, build and deploy AI-powered solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Platform and Microsoft Fabric. You'll take priority use cases from concept through to live deployment, partnering with business analysts, users and technical stakeholders across teams including Investment Management, Operations & Processing, Data/Finance & Risk, People, Client & Commercial and Governance to ensure solutions are secure, well-governed and genuinely useful. What you'll be doing AI & Automation Solution Delivery Design, develop, test and deploy AI-powered solutions using Microsoft Copilot Studio and Power Platform. Build and maintain intelligent agents, conversational AI experiences and automated business processes. Apply appropriate security, governance, compliance and responsible AI practices to every solution. Support solution architecture, documentation, testing, deployment and ongoing maintenance. Systems Integration Integrate AI solutions with Dataverse, SharePoint, Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, SQL and other business applications. Support database-related activities Troubleshoot application and system issues, including code fixes and SQL scripting. Coordinate releases and maintain application change history. Stakeholder Engagement & Continuous Improvement Work with business analysts, users and technical stakeholders to identify AI opportunities and translate requirements into practical solutions. Identify opportunities to use AI, automation and low-code technologies to improve business processes. Provide technical support, troubleshooting and knowledge sharing across AI, Copilot and Power Platform initiatives. Work closely with development, infrastructure and technical support teams. Professional Standards Demonstrate the behaviours and standards that contribute to a strong organisational culture. Maintain high standards of professionalism at all times. Proactively engage across all London CIV teams, ensuring clear and timely communication on progress and priorities. Be available for occasional out-of-hours support, including weekday evenings when required. What we're looking for Essential Proven experience with Microsoft Power Platform, particularly Power Apps and Power Automate. Proven experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio, including building, configuring, testing and deploying Copilot agents. Experience with Dataverse, including table design, relationships, business rules, security and governance. Experience with Azure, including Azure Functions, Logic Apps, Service Bus and Azure DevOps. Experience with API integration and enterprise application integration. SQL database experience, including SQL scripting. Power BI experience. Understanding of AI governance and responsible AI practices. A strong technical communicator, confident working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. A strong personal commitment to professionalism, integrity, and equality, consistent with the Nolan Principles of public life. Desirable Experience developing advanced AI agents using generative AI, custom topics, autonomous agents and orchestration capabilities. Experience with low-code application platforms. What we offer This is a contract engagement (inside IR35) for an initial term of 6 months with the potential to extend up to 12 months, subject to programme needs. You'll work on a hybrid basis, with 3 days per week in our London office. We are committed to building an inclusive team and welcome applications from all backgrounds. If you need any adjustments during the recruitment process, just let us know.
