items.desc: Are you interested in transforming industrial biotechnology through data and looking for a new job opportunity? Would you like to develop innovative technology with superb colleagues who are top experts in their fields? Do you want to work at the interface of research, digital technology, and industry? VTT might be just the place for you. VTT is one of the leading applied research organisations in Europe. What unites us are curiosity, a passion for learning, and a purpose: to solve the biggest challenges of our time and turn them into sustainable growth and well-being. Our cross-disciplinary community of over 2000 brilliant minds from 55+ different nationalities focuses on creating impact through science-based innovation. Get to know us further by exploring VTT's tech & infra . Join us as Data Engineer! We are now looking for a Data Engineer to join our Research Digital Enablers team. In this position, you will design, implement, and maintain scalable data management and integration solutions for industrial biotechnology research. You will be working closely with industrial biotechnology and food research field and you will connect laboratory, process, analytical, and computational data and help ensure that research data can be collected, managed, and reused efficiently throughout its lifecycle. Our team, works on supporting research digitalization. Together with researchers, laboratory professionals, platform engineers, and AI experts, we build reliable, interoperable, and FAIR-aligned data ecosystems that strengthen reproducibility, enable advanced analytics and AI, and accelerate science-based innovation. Your responsibilities as Data Engineer: Design and implement data pipelines linking laboratory instruments, bioprocess systems, analytical platforms, computational environments, and data management services. Automate the collection, validation, transformation, and delivery of experimental and process data to enable insight and impact. Develop APIs, integrations, metadata practices, and reusable data services. Build and maintain scalable data processing environments for biotechnology research and real-time bioprocess decision support. Improve interoperability between research infrastructures, platforms, and digital services. Implement data quality controls and traceable data flows in line with FAIR principles and responsible research data management as well as data reutilization Help make data gathering and management compatible with machine learning and AI applications. Enable process monitoring, optimization, trend analysis, anomaly detection, and scientific discovery through high-quality data and metadata. Act as the technical hands-on expert on data pipelines, integration, and platforms for biotechnology research digitalization. Collaborate with multidisciplinary experts to translate research needs into secure, maintainable, and practical technical solutions. Who we are looking for: You have strong experience in data engineering, data architecture, and delivering production-quality data solutions. You have good hands-on skills in Python or comparable programming and scripting languages.You have experience with APIs, ETL/ELT pipelines, workflow automation, databases, and data integration technologies. You understand metadata management, data governance, data quality, and FAIR principles. You have experience with version control, and you understand CI/CD practices. You are able to collaborate across research, laboratory, software, data, and AI disciplines. You have a relevant higher-education degree or equivalent experience in data engineering, software engineering, or a related field. We appreciate: Familiarity with laboratory information systems, research instruments, sensors, bioprocess data, and related data formats Experience with or equivalent knowledge of biotechnology. Knowledge of scientific data lifecycles and research data management practices. Experience with cloud-native or container-based data platforms and modern platform engineering practices. Understanding machine-learning data needs Experience supporting AI-enabled workflows Familiarity with global standards for trusted data sharing and other data space initiatives. As a person, we hope that you are: A curious and collaborative problem solver who enjoys turning complex research needs into robust technical solutions. You work in a flexible and independent manner, communicate clearly across disciplines, and take a long-term perspective on maintainability and reuse. We appreciate passion for learning and the ability to find beyond-the-obvious solutions. With VTT, you’ll enjoy: Visionary work in technology. You will work at the intersection of industrial biotechnology, digital research infrastructure, data engineering, and AI, creating solutions that support sustainable growth and positive impact. Fascinating projects and an excellent research environment. You will contribute to cutting-edge academic research and applied customer …

Using novel AI, we are revolutionising the publishing industry and have a track record of building things that others have ruled out as impossible. Leading names from around the world rely on our product every day, including The Times, Le Monde, The Guardian, Vogue and many more. About the Role: You will work closely with our Product team and Data Scientists to define and execute on the future path for our products. Key Responsibilities: Work closely with senior engineers to design, build, and maintain back-end services and systems that support our AI-powered products, all whilst meeting launch deadlines. Assist in the development and optimization of scalable, high-performance systems to support large volumes of data and machine learning models. Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code while following best practices and coding standards. Contribute to the deployment and integration of back-end services, ensuring that they work seamlessly with front-end and data science systems. Help improve the architecture and functionality of our back-end systems, focusing on performance, reliability, and scalability. Assist with debugging and troubleshooting technical issues, providing solutions to enhance system performance. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify system needs and contribute to continuous improvements. Continuously learn and apply new technologies and techniques to improve back-end infrastructure and processes. Strong knowledge of programming languages such as Python, Java, or Node.js, and experience with back-end frameworks. Familiarity with databases (SQL and NoSQL) and experience in building and optimizing data storage solutions. Understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices architecture, and best practices for back-end development. Familiarity with version control systems such as Git. Experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and deploying applications in a cloud environment. A passion for solving problems with technology and working to deliver efficient, scalable solutions. A proactive, results-driven mindset with the ability to work independently and learn quickly. Preferred Requirements: Experience in a fast-paced SaaS or tech environment, focusing on building and scaling back-end systems. Understanding of security best practices for back-end development. Knowledge of machine learning concepts and the ability to collaborate with data scientists to optimize AI models. Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively within cross-functional teams. Benefits: Our employees enjoy free breakfast every day, coffee, drinks and snacks all day, everyday. Every Monday, Wednesday and Friday, we order food for our weekly team lunches where everyone gets together for an hour of fun. We have regular team events (dinner, bowling, karting, poker nights, board-games etc.) for our team to get to know each other outside of work. Professionally, we host in-house conferences and an annual summer camp for all our global employees who are flown to and hosted in London. We ensure that all our employees also get pension contributions, the latest tech, generous annual leave and an amazing office with a balcony overlooking Notting Hill.

items.desc: DHL Express - a company that connects people! What makes DHL great? Our People! We know each employee’s individual contributions make us the #1 Express Delivery and Logistics Company in the world. Distinguished as No.1 World’s Best Workplace™ by Great Place to Work and Fortune Magazine DHL Express is committed to maintaining an environment that empowers every team member to make the greatest possible impact on our business. Our corporate culture is about personal commitment – to our business, to each other and to our global communities. DHL is dedicated to being a great place to work. DHL Express is looking for a Road & Capacity Scientist in Diegem. Road & Capacity Scientist is responsible for designing, analyzing, and optimizing DHL’s road network using advanced modeling, optimization tools, and data science techniques. This role translates operational data into actionable network decisions that improve cost, service, asset utilization, and customer experience across linehaul, hubs, and first/last mile operations. As DHL’s processes are increasingly underpinned by data, this role is a key contributor to business process optimization and network transformation. They will extract meaningful insights, identify predictive opportunities, and develop automation possibilities that support better decision-making across the European ground network. The role will identify, develop, and implement analytical models, prototypes, and best-practice methods for business users, ensuring that modeling outputs are practical, implementable, and aligned with business objectives. They will serve as the bridge between network design, operations, technology, and data science, helping optimize processes, systems, and methods using relevant operational data. How will you contribute to the success of DHL? Execution of data analytics projects with very limited or no guidance from a supervisor/project lead. Analysis of the business processes as well as the derivation of problem areas and analytical requirements. Sourcing initial cleansing and preparation of large amounts of data. Identification and collection of required data, as well as data cleansing. Develop statistical/mathematical models (e.g., time series analyses, operations research methods, machine learning). Develop implementation data pipelines. Modify data analysts' code to prepare for deployment. Clarify data needs and take action with the IT organization. Support the identification of more efficient ways to store, source, query, and activate data. Deploy best practices to optimize processes, systems, and methods using relevant data. Support the definition of project contents, deliverables, and timelines of data analytics projects in terms of data needs. Source, prepare, pre-analyze, and cleanse data as per business needs. Largely independent preparation and presentation of results and implications of Data Analytics projects. Manage contact with internal and external customers on data analytics topics at the work and specialist level and with middle management in the context of current and future analytics projects. Support in onboarding and coaching junior data science and engineering colleagues as part of the project. Actively contribute to team responsibilities and support business development activities on request. Produce accurate outcomes of analytics tasks and communicate as such (accurate does not imply success). Manage contact with internal and external customers on data analytics topics at the work and specialist level. Manage contact with middle management in the context of current and future analytics projects. University degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Computer Science or related natural sciences / technical degree, or comparable qualification. More than 4 years of experience working in data science, mathematics, statistics, research, and/or IT. Knowledge of machine learning, statistics, data visualization, and cleansing techniques, as well as data pipelining and big data technologies. Experienced in analyzing complex datasets and building mathematical models, also in a practical context. Having programming skills and/or experience in scripting languages (Python, R, or Java) and good experience in working with databases (relational, big data) and data pipelines. Ability to produce creative and analytical solutions based on clear and thorough analyses of complex processes and business relationships. Comfortable explaining complex analytical and technical content to various audiences. Energetic and success-oriented problem solver. Independent work ethic, integrity, and loyalty, positive “can-do” attitude" Fluent in English, written & spoken. items.desc: Détails de l’offre Poste proposé Biostatisticien.ne Descriptif L'ÉTABLISSEMENT : Le CHU de Limoges a trois missions de service public : les soins, l'enseignement, la recherche et l'innovation. Nos personnels exercent au sein de 5 hôpitaux (le CHU Dupuytren 1, le CHU Jean Rebeyrol 1, le CHU Dupuytren 2, l'hôpital de la mère et de l'enfant et le Centre de gérontologie Chastaingt ) et d'un Centre de biologie et recherche en santé. Le CHU de Limoges recrute un.e Biostatisticien.ne pour l'unité fonctionnelle de recherche clinique en pharmacologie et toxicologie. LE POSTE : Mission principale : Élaborer les plans d'analyse statistique des protocoles de recherche clinique, préparer les données, assurer leur traitement statistique au moyen des outils informatiques et statistiques adaptés aux études cliniques, et participer à la rédaction des rapports d'analyse statistique des études cliniques et des publications. Êtes-vous un vrai team player, porté par des valeurs fortes ? Êtes-vous curieux·se et déterminé·e, avec l’envie d’apprendre chaque jour ? Êtes-vous du genre à relever les défis sans hésiter ? Alors vous êtes au bon endroit. Rejoignez Wavestone et exprimez votre potentiel dans un environnement stimulant et collaboratif, où l’on transforme les défis d’aujourd’hui en opportunités de demain. Description du poste L’intelligence artificielle redéfinit aujourd’hui les métiers, les processus et les modèles opérationnels des organisations. De la banque à l’industrie, en passant par le luxe, les dirigeants cherchent désormais à passer de l’expérimentation à l’impact : où l’IA crée-t-elle réellement de la valeur et comment transformer durablement l’entreprise ? En rejoignant Wavestone, vous accompagnerez de grandes organisations françaises et internationales dans cette transformation, à la croisée de la stratégie, de l’IA et des enjeux métier. Dès vos premières missions en tant que Consultant·e Junior / Analyst , vous serez intégré·e à une équipe projet et contribuerez directement aux réflexions et aux transformations de nos clients. Vous pourrez notamment intervenir sur : l’identification et la priorisation de cas d’usage IA à fort potentiel ; la transformation de processus métier grâce à l’IA générative et aux agents IA ; la définition de stratégies et feuilles de route IA ; l’accompagnement de directions métiers dans l’adoption et le passage à l’échelle de l’IA ; l’évaluation de la valeur et des bénéfices générés par les investissements IA ; la transformation des organisations, métiers et modes de travail à l’ère de l’IA ; la conduite du changement et l’acculturation des collaborateurs et dirigeants . Vous développerez ainsi une double compétence recherchée : comprendre les possibilités offertes par l’IA et savoir les traduire en transformations concrètes pour les entreprises. Vous n’avez pas besoin de choisir votre secteur avant de postuler. items.desc: Job Advert Power Module Applications Engineer Europe /Germany / Austria / Italy / Belgium /Remote We are seeking enthusiastic and skilled Application Engineers in Germany to join our Product Group Team, providing technical application support across our Dynex and TSC bipolar and IGBT product ranges. These products are deployed in a wide range of sectors, including industrial motor drives, automotive, renewable energy systems, HVDC, power generation and storage, and rail traction/locomotives . The role involves offering technical expertise to our customers – from initial enquiries and solution proposals, through to troubleshooting during testing and application. You will also contribute to product development, customer validation and the wider promotion of our power semiconductor technologies. Key Responsibilities Deliver application and field support for power semiconductor products across multiple sectors. Perform circuit-level simulation, characterisation and evaluation of modules using PLECS and SPICE tools. Develop and maintain PLECS/SPICE-compatible numerical models for product evaluation, enhancement, and external proposals. Monitor market demands, specifications and emerging trends in power semiconductor products. Conduct in-depth analysis and benchmarking of state-of-the-art devices, including datasheet interpretation, simulation and experimental testing. Build and evaluate customer-oriented application circuits, supporting prototype validation in line with international standards. Support sales teams with product promotion and provide technical input to product development. Produce high-quality technical documentation, including test reports, application notes, and datasheets. Deliver written and verbal technical reports and presentations. Contribute to peer-reviewed research publications and international conference proceedings. Regular European travel Knowledge, Skills & Experience Strong knowledge of power semiconductor devices (IGBTs, MOSFETs, diodes) and their characteristics. Solid understanding of power electronic circuit topologies (buck, boost, buck-boost, inverters). Hands-on experience in power system design, power converter principles, simulation, and testing . Proven track record in hardware design and development of power converters in at least one of: industrial motor drives, automotive, rail traction, HVDC, renewable energy. Proficiency with PLECS and SPICE simulators at a professional level. Experience with Matlab/Simulink, Altium, LabVIEW an advantage. Bilingual, with professional-level proficiency in English. Interpersonal Skills Effective communicator, able to explain complex technical concepts clearly. Strong collaborator with experience working across internal and external project teams. Skilled at building and maintaining professional relationships. Confident in presenting to technical and non-technical audiences. Able to work independently and as part of a team, with flexibility to meet business needs. Excellent time management skills. Education & Qualifications A bachelor’s degree (or above) in microelectronics, solid-state electronics, materials engineering, power electronics, physics, or a closely related discipline. The roles are based in Europe, ideally in German, Austria, Italy or similar region and are primarily home-based with remote working. Please note, there is up to 20% European travel required, with quarterly visits to Lincoln, UK. Please note: if you are shortlisted, you will receive an email inviting you to attend an interview. Please be aware that the invitation may appear in your spam or junk folder.

A particular focus of the position will be the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of
items.desc: Data Analyst / Bioinformatician for Proteomics and Metabolomics The Max Planck Institute for Terrestrial Microbiology in Marburg is one of the world’s leading research institutions in the field of microbiology. Around 220 employees and approximately 125 guest scientists from a wide range of countries work together to investigate the fundamental principles of microbial life. An exciting opportunity has arisen within the Max Planck Institute for Terrestrial Microbiology, and we are actively seeking qualified candidates to fill the following vacancy as soon as possible. The institute has established state-of-the-art Proteomics and Metabolomics Core Facilities that provide advanced mass spectrometry-based technologies for the quantitative and qualitative analysis of proteins, metabolites, and other small molecules in biological systems. Both facilities support a broad range of research projects by combining cutting-edge analytical technologies with specialized expertise in mass spectrometry, data analysis, and method development. Søk senest tirsdag 15. desember PhD Research Fellow in Systems Engineering - AI tools for early validation and development of complex integrated systems Do you want to contribute to the development of knowledge, insight and solutions that are relevant to society and working life today and in the future? Some of tomorrow's most innovative systems are shaped by weather, ocean currents and thousands of design choices. How do you know that the design will work before it is built? Help engineers find out with the use of AI. We are looking for a PhD research fellow in Systems Engineering. About the position Do you want to help engineers design data-intensive systems where huge amounts of data and a vast design space make early decisions hard? Join us as a PhD research fellow at the Department of Science and Industry Systems, campus Kongsberg. Start: May 2027 (at the latest August 2027). You will be part of SFI CELECT (https://www.celect.no) - the Centre for Effective Engineering and Learning in Complex Systems - whose vision is to do more with less, and faster. The centre, funded by the Research Council of Norway, brings together Norway's leading industrial companies and 30 PhD candidates across USN, NTNU and the University of Agder. You will also join the Industrial Research School in Complex Systems (INRESCOS). Campus Kongsberg sits at the heart of one of Norway's strongest technology clusters, with world-leading companies in maritime, defence, aerospace, energy and subsea technology. Research and industry work side by side - giving you a unique network and strong career opportunities in industry or academia. The position is a three-year educational position with pure organised research training. A four-year appointment with 25% career-advancing may be considered. You must apply for and be admitted to the doctoral programme in Technology (https://www.usn.no/forskning/doktorgradsutdanning/vare-ph-d-utdanninger/teknologi/) (Systems Engineering) within three months of starting. The programme includes courses of about six months (30 ECTS), an independent thesis, research dissemination, a trial lecture and a public defence. Your main supervisor will be Professor Kristin Falk. Your workplace will be shared between campus Kongsberg and one or several CELECT partner companies: depending on the project, you will spend between 3 and 30 months located at a company's premises. You are expected to be present at campus or at the company during ordinary working hours. About the doctoral project The aim of this PhD is to develop AI-supported design methods and tools that enable early validation of complex, data-intensive integrated systems. Data-intensive systems have huge design spaces, and their behaviour emerges from many interacting factors. Design and operation become intertwined - and today's methods catch problems too late. In this PhD you will develop AI-supported design assistance: methods and tools, backed by digital twins, that help engineers explore large design spaces and validate systems early. Questions you could explore: How are data-intensive systems designed and validated in industry today? How can AI and digital twins support early design decisions? You will help shape the final research questions together with your supervisors and industry partners. The PhD project is part of SFI CELECT (https://www.celect.no), headed by Professor Kristin Falk. Industrial cases will be selected among CELECT partners such as Kongsberg Maritime, Kongsberg Defence & Aerospace, Siemens Energy, H. Henriksen, Umoe Mandal and cDynamics. Using industry as your laboratory, you will work alongside engineers and systems architects on real development projects. This position is one of several related CELECT PhD positions at USN: it focuses on early design and validation, and complements positions on life-cycle management of long-living systems (PhD1.4), early systems integration in systems-of-systems (PhD1.5) and competence development for industry (PhD5.1). You will be part of the Norwegian Industrial Systems Engineering Research Group (NISE (https://www.usn.no/english/research/our-research-centres-and-groups/technology/norwegian-industrial-systems-engineering-research-group/)). The department includes Lund Nano Lab, a central and shared facility for the production of materials and components on the nanoscale. The department is also strongly involved in undergraduate education, not least in the civil engineering programme ‘Technical Nanoscience’ at LTH. The division hosts the research group of Prof Vanya Darakchieva whose research over the past twenty years on the fabrication and advanced characterization of wide- and ultra-wide bandgap semiconductors has been at the international forefront. https://portal.research.lu.se/en/persons/vanya-darakchieva/ Work duties As a teaching assistant, your duties may vary and should provide insight into the academic world at the faculty where you are studying. items.desc: The Department of Chemistry , with more than 200 employees, is one of the largest departments at Stockholm University. The Research spans all areas of chemistry such as analytical chemistry, physical chemistry, materials chemistry, inorganic and structural chemistry and organic chemistry. The research projects are many from theory to experiment, from basic research to more applied projects often focusing on sustainable chemistry but also advanced analytical methods of chemicals and materials. The department has a very well-developed research infrastructure with state-of-the-art equipment with qualified support from staff scientists. The department also hosts the Bachelor's degree programme in chemistry and three Master's programmes: analytical chemistry, sustainable chemistry, and organic chemistry. PhD programmes are conducted in five areas: analytical chemistry, physical chemistry, materials chemistry, inorganic chemistry and organic chemistry. More information about us, please visit: Department of Chemistry. Project description The position focuses on pharmaceutical nanotechnology within analytical chemistry, integrating the development of therapeutic delivery systems with quantitative characterization of their physicochemical properties and biological interactions. The research aims to establish how the composition, structure, and surface properties of nanoparticles and polymeric biomaterials influence drug loading, release, stability, and transport in biological environments. The work includes nanoparticle-based carriers, functional polymers, hydrogels, and electrospun nanofibrous materials for the delivery of small-molecule drugs and biological therapeutics, including peptides, proteins, and nucleic acids. Particular emphasis will be placed on developing analytical approaches and experimental models to investigate controlled release, diffusion through extracellular matrices, and cellular uptake. The research will be conducted in collaboration with academic, clinical, and industrial partners. Main responsibilities The researcher will independently plan, conduct, and develop research in pharmaceutical nanotechnology within the group. Main responsibilities include the synthesis, formulation, and functionalization of nanoparticles and polymeric biomaterials for therapeutic delivery, as well as the development and application of analytical methods to evaluate their performance. The work involves physicochemical characterization of delivery systems, quantitative analysis of drug loading and release kinetics, and investigation of material degradation, therapeutic transport, and interactions with biological components. This includes developing hydrogel-based models of extracellular environments and conducting cell-based studies to assess cellular uptake and biocompatibility. The researcher will contribute to the development of experimental protocols, reproducible analytical workflows, and laboratory practices. Responsibilities also include supervising and training students, supporting doctoral researchers, coordinating collaborative research activities, and contributing to applications for external research funding. The successful candidate is expected to disseminate results through peer-reviewed publications and conference presentations and to contribute actively to the scientific development of the research group. Qualification requirements Researchers are appointed primarily for purposes of research and must hold a Swedish doctoral degree or an equivalent degree from another country. Assessment criteria In the appointment process, special attention will be given to research skills within pharmaceutical nanotechnology and to the relevance and quality of previous research in the development and analytical characterization of therapeutic delivery systems. Applicants must demonstrate experience in the preparation and physicochemical characterization of polymeric biomaterials or nanoparticle-based delivery systems, together with experience in quantitative investigation of drug release, molecular transport, or material–biological interactions. A demonstrated ability to plan and conduct research independently, critically analyse experimental data, and communicate results through peer-reviewed publications is required. Particular merit will be given to experience in: Synthesis and functionalization of biocompatible and biodegradable polymers, including polymer–drug conjugates and polyelectrolyte complexes. Preparation and characterization of hydrogels and electrospun nanofibrous materials for pharmaceutical or biomedical applications. Development of nanoparticle-based systems for the delivery of biological therapeutics, including peptides, proteins, or nucleic acids. Quantitative studies of release kinetics and therapeutic diffusion in hydrogels or models of extracellular matrices. Cell-based evaluation of delivery systems, including cellular uptake and biocompatibility. Research collaboration across …

items.desc: Toumetis Job Description Graduate Analyst Salary £35,000 About our Company Our mission at Toumetis is to deliver intelligence that can transform business operations and enable new revenue via the application of machine learning. We combine experience in applied machine learning, frontend development, data engineering, and cloud computing to help Fortune-1000 companies bring elegant IoT solutions to life, surfacing unique insights to predict and prevent problems and improve organisational performance. Our engineers, developers and data scientists share a passion for innovation and are dedicated to providing our customers with solutions that enable new insights that revolutionise business processes. We have a friendly working environment with flexible hours, WFH (1-2 days in the office P/W), regular social events, great coffee and snacks, free parking, ride to work scheme, bike racks, shower facilities and you will be supplied with a MacBook Pro. Our main office is based in the heart of the wonderful and vibrant city of Bristol around the corner from the SS Great Britain and one of the street artist, Banksy’s infamous works. It is only a short stroll to Cargo and the Harbourside area which boasts a tremendous array of bars, restaurants, cafes and other assorted nice places all ripe for a lunch break visit or relaxing after work. About our Role This is an exciting opportunity for someone who has either recently graduated or has 1-2 years commercial experience, to join a team working on a project considered cutting edge by Utility companies across the world. There will be a steep learning curve within the field of Electrical Engineering, and whilst we don’t expect you to have knowledge of this as you start, the ability to learn quickly, and an interest in the area is vital! The Analyst role will be to review the three-phase voltage and current waveforms, time-series data, that are captured and displayed on the Cascadence platform. Cascadence presents the data in a particular classification that has been determined by the machine learning algorithms. The role will either validate the classification is correct or assign the appropriate classification. The Analyst position will also utilise knowledge of electrical power engineering and circuit analysis to develop models to better understand the performance of the systems that are being measured. As the Cascadence platform evolves, the role of the Analyst will also evolve. There will be new event classifications, additional data requirements such as event point-on-wave determination and spectral energy and frequency content determination. Additional duties such as interfacing with the clients may also be required. Experience you will gain You will become proficient in utilising our Cascadence platform. This will include the ability to visually associate patterns in the waveforms and apply various transforms to validate the classifications. You will be able to understand and explain the taxonomy of the event classifications. There may also be a need to train and supervise junior staff. You will become proficient in the development of documents, spreadsheets and presentations. This role will focus around good interpersonal skills and require some public speaking. You'll also have access to company paid training services as we're keen for you to grow your skills. Experience you should have A degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics, or other related STEM background will be highly advantageous Solid writing and presentation skills Some experience with Python would be advantageous A drive to succeed and learn on the job. This position can offer multiple routes of progression within the company. Interested in the role? For a confidential discussion about this role, or if you feel your skillset would be of benefit to the Toumetis team but doesn’t match a specific job spec, please get in touch with our Talent Acquisition team - george.wrightson@Toumetis.com.

Through innovation in editorial workflows and publishing technology, we help global research communities discover, evaluate, and disseminate knowledge that advances science and improves lives. About the Role We are looking for an Associate Publisher to manage a portfolio of social sciences journals. In this role, you will work closely with editors, editorial boards, societies, and research communities to develop and grow successful journals. You will combine market insight, data analysis, relationship building, and publishing expertise to help shape portfolio strategy and identify new opportunities for growth and innovation. Responsibilities Follow market developments in publishing and research and identify needs and opportunities for your journals and the communities they serve. Grow journal content through portfolio development, acquisitions, and exploration of new content formats, extensions, and channels. Negotiate and manage contractual relationships with journal editors. Manage the editorial fees budget. Build and maintain relationships with editors, editorial boards, research institutes, societies, funding bodies, and other members of the research community. Contribute to wider STMJ and cross-business projects, including new products, services, business models, and process improvements. Requirements Experience in publishing, ideally in scholarly journals, is preferable but not essential. Evidence of setting goals, achieving them, and making a positive impact on a journal or programme. Excellent networking and communication skills in English. Ability to adapt to change, manage multiple responsibilities, and work effectively both independently and collaboratively across cultures, locations, and organisational levels. Working Pattern Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive. Every piece of technology we run is being rewritten as we speak. We are doing it with a small, senior, very fast AI development team working shoulder to shoulder with our business leads. Now we are opening a handful of seats for young builders who want to grow faster than any graduate scheme, bootcamp, or big-tech ladder could ever let them. We don't care if you are 16, 25 or 30, whether you are self-taught, hacking in high school, or finishing a degree at TU Delft or TU/e—we care about what you have built and how fast you solve hard problems. The HelloPrint AI Residency is how you start. It is a permanent role from day one: your first year is a structured residency where you rotate across our most important AI projects, build alongside the team and learn at full speed. After that, you keep growing - in the direction where you have the most impact. What you will actually do: You will not get a training plan, a sandbox project or six months of shadowing. From week one, you build real things that real customers and colleagues use, on the projects that matter most to the company. You sit next to the founders, next to the engineers who are rebuilding our platform, and next to the business leads who own the outcomes. You get a lot of freedom and real responsibility, plus honest, direct guidance and feedback from people who have built this before. The kind of work you could be on in your first months: Agentic Commerce: making HelloPrint discoverable and orderable through AI assistants, so a customer can order business cards from inside a chat. AI Design Studio: letting customers create a print-ready design from a single sentence. AI-first customer service: replacing classic ticketing with agents that resolve questions, check artwork and handle orders end to end. Internal agent swarms: automating finance, purchasing, pricing and operations work that today still takes people hours. Whatever you spot next: if you see something we should build, you pitch it, and if it is good, you build it. We work with almost every modern framework and model, and we change our tools the moment something better appears. You will ship, measure, throw away and ship again - every week. Job Requirements Who you are: You are a builder before anything else. You have shipped things nobody asked you to build: an app, an agent, a bot, a tool your friends actually use, a side business, an open-source contribution, a weird experiment that taught you something. You probably have more GitHub commits, demos or deployed projects than most people twice your age. You are extremely curious and extremely critical. You read the new model release the day it drops and try it that evening. You question every assumption, including ours, and you can explain why. You are never satisfied with "it works" — you want to know why it works, and how it could be ten times better. You want to get better every single day, and you treat feedback as fuel rather than criticism. You take ownership: when something breaks, you fix it; when something is unclear, you go and find out. You have a solid grasp of backend and software fundamentals (Python, APIs, databases) or the raw learning capacity to pick them up in weeks. You will probably recognise yourself in most of this: You build with AI every day: Claude, Cursor, Lovable, agents, APIs, whatever gets you there fastest. You can show us concrete proof of work, not just tell us about it. You move fast without being sloppy, and you care about the details the customer sees. You are comfortable not knowing the answer, and you find it quickly. You communicate clearly in English, in writing and out loud. What we do not require: a degree, a minimum age, years of experience or a perfect CV. If you are still in school or university, we will make it work around that. What you get: The honest pitch: you will learn more here in one year than in five years almost anywhere else , because you will be building real systems for a real company that is reinventing itself, with the people who are leading that change. A contract from day one. The Residency is your first year at HelloPrint, not a trial period or an internship. Direct access to the founders and to a senior AI development team who review your work and push you. Ownership from day one: your name on projects that change how a €100M+ company runs. The best tools, no budget debates: the newest models, coding agents and frameworks, as …

items.desc: Vos missions au quotidien Vous souhaitez intégrer un groupe international et multiculturel ? Rejoignez-nous ! Au sein du groupe Société Générale, vous rejoindrez la Direction des Systèmes d’Information de la Banque de Grande Clientèle et Solutions Investisseurs (GBIS), qui accompagne la transformation digitale de la Banque de Financement et d’Investissement. Vous intégrerez l’équipe ACE – AI Capabilities & Engineering, chargée de concevoir et d’industrialiser des capacités d’intelligence artificielle au service de la transformation de notre direction. L’équipe développe des solutions fondées sur l’IA générative et les systèmes agentiques, depuis l’expérimentation et le Proof of Concept jusqu’à leur industrialisation. Elle intervient dans un environnement où les enjeux de sécurité, de qualité, d’adoption, d’observabilité et de passage à l’échelle sont essentiels. Au sein d’ACE, le programme AI for Non-Developers vise à transformer les pratiques quotidiennes des fonctions IT telles que Business Analysts, Product Owners, Agile Masters, Project Managers, Testeurs... L’objectif est de faire de l’IA un véritable outil de travail quotidien, permettant de transformer les réunions, documents, besoins et décisions en livrables structurés, évalués, traçables et réutilisables. Concrètement, vous serez amené à : Concevoir et améliorer les skills IA Participer à la conception fonctionnelle de nouveaux skills IA adaptées aux métiers non-développeurs. Recueillir et analyser les besoins des Business Analysts, Product Owners, Agile Masters, Project Managers, testeurs, architectes et autres communautés IT. Participer à la rédaction des spécifications fonctionnelles des skills et de leurs différents modes d’utilisation. Tester les skills sur des cas d’usage représentatifs, analyser les résultats et documenter les anomalies ou axes d’amélioration. Organiser des expérimentations et des phases bêta avec les communautés utilisatrices. Exploiter les retours des utilisateurs pour améliorer en continu les skills existants et identifier de nouveaux besoins. Participer à l’enrichissement du catalogue de skills afin de couvrir progressivement de nouvelles populations et de nouveaux usages. Produire et maintenir les contenus de formation Produire et maintenir le curriculum de formation AI for Non-Developers. Rédiger des handbooks, guides pratiques, fiches réflexes et supports pédagogiques. Concevoir et maintenir un corpus d’exercices réalistes permettant aux utilisateurs de se former sur des situations proches de leur activité. Mettre à jour les supports en fonction des évolutions des skills et des retours des premières cohortes. Veiller à la qualité, à la cohérence, à la traçabilité et au versionnement des contenus produits. Créer les contenus et les supports post-formation Concevoir des démonstrations courtes présentant l’utilisation des différents skills. Produire des tutoriels, guides pas-à-pas et contenus vidéo. Transformer les questions récurrentes des utilisateurs en mini-FAQ ou contenus de support réutilisables. Maintenir des supports permettant aux utilisateurs de se remettre rapidement à niveau après leur formation. Participer à la capitalisation des bonnes pratiques et des cas d’usage développés par les équipes. Contribuer à l’animation des communautés Participer à l’organisation des sessions des communautés AI for Non-Developers. Produire et diffuser les comptes-rendus, décisions et actions issus des sessions. Travailler avec le réseau de champions pour collecter les besoins et les retours du terrain. Assurer le suivi des demandes et leur transmission vers le backlog des skills. Contribuer à valoriser les cas d’usage et les bonnes pratiques développés par les différentes équipes. Et si c’était vous ? Vous préparez un Bac+4/5, en Ecole d'Ingénieurs ou Université avec une spécialisation en intelligence artificielle, transformation digitale, systèmes d’information, gestion de projet, business analysis, product management ou ingénierie pédagogique. Vous avez une forte appétence pour l’IA et les outils numériques, de solides qualités rédactionnelles, un intérêt pour la formation et la conduite du changement, ainsi qu’une réelle capacité à expérimenter et à travailler avec des interlocuteurs variés. Vous faites par ailleurs preuve de curiosité, d'une bonne capacité d'organisation et avez un esprit d'initiatives développé. You're fluent in English ! Vous êtes notre candidat idéal ! Pensez à accompagner votre CV de votre planning de formation ! Plus qu’un poste, un tremplin Rejoignez-nous pour faire grandir vos ambitions ! Dès votre arrivée, vous serez intégré dans nos équipes et apprendrez chaque jour aux côtés de nos experts qui vous accompagneront dans vos missions. Progressivement, vous gagnerez en autonomie sur vos projets pour faire de cette expérience un vrai accélérateur de carrière. Vous découvrirez également toute la diversité de nos métiers, dans un secteur qui évolue et innove en permanence. A la fin de vos études, …

items.desc: Job Description HelloPrint is rebuilding the entire platform: new frontend, new pricing engine, new content engine, new product engine, everything ready for an agentic future. No one on the team writes code manually for what these systems handle. You'll work inside this rebuild, under the direction of our founding team (Hans, CEO, and Michael, CIO/Chief AI Officer), executing on high-leverage AI problems with real commercial impact, visible immediately in revenue or cost. There's no management layer between you and the outcome. You build, you ship, you measure, you move to the next problem. What you will build: The opportunity surface is large: 14 markets, 600,000 customers, a platform being rebuilt in parallel across four core engines. You'll work on problems from areas like: Dynamic pricing and margin optimization across markets. Agentic procurement: supplier selection, ordering, quality management. Customer journey automation from configuration to post-delivery. Intelligent content and SEO infrastructure at platform scale. Predictive demand and inventory across the supplier network. Internal tooling that multiplies the output of every team. Before you read further HelloPrint is on a mission to become the world's leading infrastructure for customizable printed products. From our offices in Rotterdam and Valencia, 100+ professionals from 20+ nationalities are building an AI-first company that scales output faster than headcount. We're at EUR 100M revenue and aiming to disrupt a trillion-dollar industry. Every hire we make needs to help get us there. Commercial instinct first, engineering second. You think about what something is worth before you think about how to build it. Full-time in Rotterdam. Five days a week, in the building where the transformation is happening. You have been building since before it was a career. Side projects, tools, systems nobody asked for. The obsession came first. You ship continuously. You ship fast and you ship real systems. Not prototypes, not demos. You are more than just an engineer. You understand product decisions, user impact, and design tradeoffs. You do not need a PM to translate the business problem for you. Job Requirements Who you are: You've built and shipped real production systems, not just contributed to someone else's. You're comfortable with ambiguity and don't need a fully specified brief to start. You care about what your work is worth, not just whether it works. You want to build inside a company that's already proven, not another 0-to-1 bet. You do not think of yourself as an AI engineer. You think of yourself as someone who solves hard problems and builds the systems to prove it. The engineering is the method. The obsession is the identity. items.desc: Vos missions au quotidien Au sein de Société Générale, vous rejoindrez la Direction des Risques. La Direction des Risques est au cœur de l’activité du Groupe avec pour principale mission de contribuer au développement des métiers et de leur rentabilité par la mise en œuvre de l’appétit au risque. L'équipe RISQ/MDL/MOD développe des solutions innovantes basées sur l'intelligence artificielle afin de transformer et d’innover les procédures de modélisation du risque de crédit. Les équipes de modélisation produisent de nombreux documents réglementaires et méthodologiques qui nécessitent l'analyse de données, l'application de frameworks internes et la rédaction de rapports techniques. Ces travaux mobilisent un temps important et nécessitent un haut niveau de rigueur afin de garantir la conformité réglementaire. Dans ce contexte, nous développons une nouvelle génération d'outils s'appuyant sur l'IA générative pour automatiser la production de ces documents tout en conservant un contrôle humain sur les résultats. Au cours de ce stage, vous participerez à la conception et au développement d'une plateforme d'IA permettant de générer automatiquement des documents de modélisation à partir de données, d'analyses et de référentiels méthodologiques. Vos missions incluront notamment : Participer à la conception fonctionnelle et technique de l'outil Développer des composants Python dédiés à l'automatisation des analyses et de la génération documentaire Concevoir et optimiser des prompts pour les modèles d'IA générative Développer des interfaces utilisateurs facilitant l'utilisation de l'outil par les modélisateurs Mettre en œuvre des mécanismes de contrôle qualité et de validation des résultats générés Participer aux phases de test, de recette utilisateur et d'amélioration continue Contribuer à la documentation technique et fonctionnelle de la solution Réaliser une veille technologique sur les dernières avancées en IA générative et agents IA Technologies et environnement : Python ; Streamlit; LLM ; Git / GitHub ; API et services Azure IA; Prompt Engineering Durée du stage: 6 mois. Et si c’était vous ? Profil recherché Vous êtes étudiant en dernière année d'école d'ingénieur, université ou master spécialisé en Intelligence artificielle, Data Science ou Informatique Compétences appréciées : Bon niveau en Python Connaissance en IA générative et LLM Intérêt pour le développement de produits IA Goût pour l'innovation et l'expérimentation Bonne autonomie et esprit d'équipe Plus qu’un poste, un tremplin Rejoignez-nous pour faire grandir vos ambitions ! Dès votre arrivée, vous serez intégré dans nos équipes et apprendrez chaque jour aux côtés de nos experts qui vous accompagneront dans vos missions. Progressivement, vous gagnerez en autonomie sur vos projets pour faire de cette expérience un vrai accélérateur de carrière. Vous découvrirez également toute la diversité de nos métiers, dans un secteur qui évolue et innove en permanence. A la fin de vos études, diverses opportunités pourront s’offrir à vous, en France et à l’international. Pourquoi nous choisir ? Attentif à votre qualité de vie et conditions de travail , vous bénéficiez d’avantages : Télétravail possible selon le rythme de votre service Prise en charge de 60% de votre titre de transport Billetterie à prix réduits de notre Comité d’Entreprise (concerts, cinéma, sport) Offre variée de restaurants d’entreprise et de cafétérias à tarifs compétitifs ainsi que des titres restaurants dématérialisés quand vous êtes en télétravail Créer, oser, innover, entreprendre font partie de notre ADN. Si vous aussi vous souhaitez être dans l’action, évoluer dans un environnement stimulant et bienveillant, vous sentir utile au quotidien et développer ou renforcer votre expertise, nous sommes faits pour nous rencontrer ! Vous hésitez encore ? Sachez que nos collaborateurs peuvent s’engager quelques jours par an pour des actions de solidarité sur leur temps de travail : parrainer des personnes en difficulté dans leur orientation ou leur insertion professionnelle, participer à l’éducation financière de jeunes en apprentissage ou encore partager leurs compétences avec une association. items.desc: Ce sujet de stage est rattaché au lab'Innov d'Aubay. il s'agit de la cellule d'innovation du groupe Aubay. Tu pourras intervenir sur des projets en mode R&D adoptant une approche agile. À Paris ou à Lyon, nous te proposons des sujets Innovants notamment sur l’IA, la Data, le numérique responsable ... et encore pleins d’autres à découvrir ! ici, nous te proposons le stage "Explainable Aubay Intelligence" Comprendre ce que « pense » un modèle d'IA, détecter ses biais et le piloter de l'intérieur pour une IA plus éthique. SUJET : Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, DALL·E : les modèles texte-image sont partout. Mais ils reproduisent — et parfois amplifient — les biais sociétaux contenus dans leurs données d'entraînement. Comment corriger cela sans ré-entraîner des modèles géants à coups de millions d'images ? Les dernières avancées en interprétabilité ouvrent une voie plus fine, plus éthique et bien plus éco-responsable : identifier à l'intérieur du modèle la « direction » responsable d'un comportement, puis piloter le modèle le long de cette direction — à l'inférence ou dès l'entraînement. Ton stage se situe exactement à cette frontière : faire dialoguer diagnostic des biais et pilotage interprétable, sur un terrain d'application concret et spectaculaire, la génération d'images. TA CONTRIBUTION : • Explorer l'état de l'art des méthodes d'évaluation et de correction des biais dans les modèles de diffusion, et en tirer un cadre de travail solide. • Construire ton propre benchmark pour mesurer, comparer et objectiver les résultats. • Expérimenter, itérer et améliorer en continu tes approches de correction. • Partager tes résultats : présentations à des publics experts comme néophytes, articles et démos internes. Tu es acteur du sujet de bout en bout : tes choix orientent réellement la suite des travaux. POUR TOI : • Travailler sur des modèles de pointe, dans un domaine qui bouge chaque semaine. • Découvrir la posture recherche appliquée : lire des papiers, les implémenter, les challenger. • Donner du sens à ta technique en apportant une véritable dimension éthique et responsable à l'IA générative. • Repartir avec un portfolio concret (benchmark, expérimentations, présentations) et une expertise XAI rare sur le marché. Mots clés : IA générative, éthique, modèles de diffusion, explicabilité, recherche appliquée Technologies : Python, PyTorch, modèles de diffusion (Stable Diffusion), Hugging Face QUI ES-TU ? Tu es en dernière année d'école d'ingénieur ou équivalent, et tu recherches un stage de fin d'études de 4 à 6 mois , pour démarrer entre février et avril 2027. Tu es une personne motivée, dynamique et autonome. Avec un attrait pour la R&D et l'innovation. Tu aimes le travail en équipe. Opportunité de CDI à la fin du stage.

items.desc: About the role: On behalf of our client, DATAHEAD is looking for a hands-on AI Engineer. You will work with large volumes of operational data including vehicle telemetry, GPS and location data, routes, driver activity, transport orders, customers and external data sources. We are looking for an AI Engineer to help build AI-powered and data-driven solutions for the logistics industry. Our goal is to help transport companies reduce operational costs, improve fleet efficiency, automate daily processes, and scale their operations through GPS data analytics, machine learning, and AI. Responsibilities Analyze large volumes of GPS, vehicle, and driver behavior data to generate actionable insights. Develop data models, algorithms, and intelligent solutions using Python. Build and improve eco-driving, fuel optimization, and fleet performance solutions. Contribute to developing AI agents that automate transport management, communication, and operational workflows. Collaborate with Product Owners, engineers, and customers to identify challenges and develop practical solutions. Help define the product vision, technical roadmap, and development priorities. Requirements Strong Python programming and data analysis skills. Experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, or AI development. Ability to work with large datasets and identify the most valuable insights. Strong problem-solving skills and a business-oriented mindset. Ability to translate complex data into practical solutions that deliver measurable value. Experience or understanding of the logistics, transportation, or fleet management industry would be a strong advantage. Ability to work independently and take ownership of solutions from concept to implementation. Fluent in English and Lithuanian Why This Role? This is an opportunity to contribute to building intelligent logistics solutions from an early stage, influence product direction, and work on real operational challenges. The long-term vision is to create an AI-powered logistics intelligence platform that enables transport companies to manage larger fleets with greater efficiency and lower costs. Vilnius-based office and hybrid work possibilities. Gross salary range is 5000- 6500 EUR/month. This search is being delivered exclusively by DATAHEAD. Apply directly or message me confidentially to discuss.

items.desc: Le développement de solutions d’intelligence artificielle appliquées aux Contrôles Non Destructifs a été identifié comme un axe stratégique pour renforcer la compétitivité d’Intercontrôle et accompagner l’évolution de ses métiers. La mise en œuvre de ces approches soulève toutefois plusieurs enjeux structurants : gestion de volumes importants de données, adaptation des outils d’annotation aux besoins métier, traçabilité et versionnement des jeux de données, suivi des expérimentations, reproductibilité des entraînements, gestion et comparaison des versions de modèles, dans la continuité des bonnes pratiques aujourd’hui regroupées sous le terme de MLOps. Ces enjeux dépassent donc la seule performance des algorithmes. Ils nécessitent de structurer progressivement l’ensemble du cycle de vie de la donnée et des modèles d’IA, depuis l’acquisition et l’annotation jusqu’à l’entraînement, l’évaluation et l’exploitation. L’objectif est de disposer d’un socle commun permettant de capitaliser sur les développements IA, de les rendre réutilisables et de faciliter leur passage du prototype à un usage industriel. Dans ce contexte, Intercontrôle souhaite développer un POC logiciel permettant d’éprouver ces pratiques, d’en valider la pertinence sur des cas d’usage concrets et de disposer d’un démonstrateur capable d’en illustrer la valeur auprès des utilisateurs et des différentes parties prenantes. Le stage aura pour objectif de concevoir et développer un POC logiciel dédié aux problématiques de computer vision appliquées aux Contrôles Non Destructifs. items.desc: Ce sujet de stage est rattaché au lab'Innov d'Aubay. il s'agit de la cellule d'innovation du groupe Aubay. Tu pourras intervenir sur des projets en mode R&D adoptant une approche agile. À Paris ou à Lyon, nous te proposons des sujets Innovants notamment sur l’IA, la Data, le numérique responsable ... et encore pleins d’autres à découvrir ! ici, nous te proposons le stage " Watermarking : Signature de l'IA " Créé un système permettant de marquer les IA pour lutter contre la désinformation. LE SUJET : La multiplication du texte et de l'image générés par IA rend nécessaire la possibilité de distinguer un contenu artificiel d'un contenu humain. Le watermarking — l'insertion d'un signal imperceptible mais détectable dans un contenu généré — est aujourd'hui la réponse technique la plus étudiée à ce problème, aussi bien pour les modèles de langage que pour les modèles de diffusion. Cette question a désormais une portée réglementaire en Europe : Depuis le 2 août 2026, l'AI Act impose que les contenus générés par IA soient détectables comme artificiels, avec des solutions techniques « effectives, interopérables, robustes et fiables ». Il n'existe aujourd'hui pas de méthode respectant ces 4 critères. Le but du projet est donc la construction d'une pipeline permettant de respecter ces nouvelles réglementations nécessaires à une IA éthique. TA CONTRIBUTION : En partant de la nouvelle réglementation européenne, il faudra définir un pipeline d'expérimentation pour chaque modalité en intégrant des métriques précises à un cadre juridique global. Il faudra aussi, après une recherche approfondie sur les différentes méthodes trouver différentes combinaisons, proposer une approche innovante permettant de mettre à jour les modèles d'IA existants. POUR TOI : Tu travailleras sur un sujet d'actualité (législation d'août 2026) avec des technologies de pointe dans un objectif de transparence et d'éthique. Mots clés : Watermarking ; LLM ; Modèles de diffusion ; AI Act Stack technique : Pytorch, Python, modèles de diffusion QUI ES-TU ? Tu es en dernière année d'école d'ingénieur ou équivalent, et tu recherches un stage de fin d'études de 4 à 6 mois , pour démarrer entre février et avril 2027. Tu es une personne motivée, dynamique et autonome. Avec un attrait pour la R&D et l'innovation. Tu aimes le travail en équipe. Opportunité de CDI à la fin du stage.

items.desc: #StormYourCareer Rejoins STORM GROUP et construis ta carrière avec nous ! Détecte les menaces invisibles et révolutionne l’analyse comportementale du SOC Au sein du Security Operations Center (SOC) d’un grand compte, nous recherchons un(e) Data Scientist Cybersécurité / SOC . Ton rôle consistera à renforcer les capacités de détection des cybermenaces par l’exploitation avancée des données de sécurité, en concevant des modèles prédictifs et d’analyse comportementale pour isoler les signaux faibles et optimiser la réponse aux incidents. Ton futur environnement Tu évolueras au cœur du Security Operations Center d’une infrastructure d’envergure. En interface directe avec les analystes SOC, les ingénieurs SIEM et les spécialistes de la Threat Intelligence, tu interviendras sur des flux massifs de journaux d’événements. C’est le cadre idéal pour appliquer le Machine Learning et la Data Science à la lutte contre les cyberattaques, tout en industrialisant des modèles au sein d’architectures de données distribuées. Tes missions clés Modélisation & Détection Avancée des Menaces (Mode DATA & IA) : Concevoir, développer et entraîner des modèles de détection d’anomalies sur des volumétries massives de journaux de sécurité (logs réseau, système, identité et applicatifs). Développer et déployer des algorithmes d’analyse comportementale des utilisateurs et des entités (UEBA) pour identifier les compromissions de comptes et les mouvements latéraux. Mettre en œuvre des modèles de scoring et de priorisation dynamique des alertes afin de réduire le bruit et le taux de faux positifs pour les analystes. Réaliser l’ingénierie des caractéristiques (feature engineering) sur des jeux de données complexes et fortement déséquilibrés. Évaluer rigoureusement les performances des modèles à l’aide de métriques adaptées à la détection d’intrusions (précision, rappel, ROC-AUC, taux de faux positifs). Industrialisation & Collaboration SOC (Mode RUN & MLOps) : Assurer l’industrialisation, le déploiement et le monitoring continu des modèles en production (MLflow, Docker, Kubernetes). Collaborer au quotidien avec les analystes SOC et les équipes d’investigation pour qualifier les détections et réinjecter les retours terrain dans l’entraînement des algorithmes. Mener une veille active sur les nouvelles techniques d’attaque répertoriées dans le cadre de référence MITRE ATT&CK. Ton profil Formation : Diplôme d’Ingénieur ou Bac+5 en Data Science, statistiques, informatique décisionnelle ou cybersécurité. Expérience : Tu justifies d’une expérience de 3 à 5 ans en Data Science et Machine Learning, idéalement appliquée aux cas d’usage de la cybersécurité ou de la détection de fraude. Expertise Data Science & IA Impérative : Maîtrise des algorithmes de détection d’anomalies (Isolation Forest, autoencodeurs, One-Class SVM) et de l’apprentissage sur données déséquilibrées. Pratique confirmée de l’écosystème Python Data Science (Python, scikit-learn, PyTorch, pandas, numpy). Culture Cybersécurité & Données Massives : Bonne compréhension du fonctionnement d’un SOC, des typologies de menaces et de la matrice MITRE ATT&CK. Connaissance des architectures distribuées et des outils volumétriques (SQL, Spark, Kafka). Familiarité avec les solutions SIEM (Splunk, Elastic, Microsoft Sentinel) et le suivi de cycle de vie ML (MLflow). Langues : Anglais professionnel opérationnel. Tes atouts Esprit d’Analyse et Goût pour l’Investigation : Curiosité intellectuelle pour traquer les anomalies statistiques au sein de flux de données brutes. Rigueur Méthodologique : Précision scientifique indispensable dans la validation des métriques de détection et la gestion des faux positifs. Sens du Travail d’Équipe : Aisance relationnelle pour vulgariser les choix algorithmiques auprès des analystes sécurité opérationnels. Nos avantages Remboursement des titres de transport à hauteur de 75%. Tickets restaurant pris en charge par STORM GROUP à hauteur de 50% (10,5€ / jour). Accès Gymlib / Wellpass (sport et bien-être). Contrat Santé / Prévoyance mis en place auprès de la compagnie Alan. Formation continue : Accès à Udemy Business. Prime de cooptation, prime d’intéressement et de participation. Deux à trois jours de télétravail par semaine. 5 raisons de nous rejoindre Parcours sur mesure : Co-construis une trajectoire professionnelle unique, adaptée à tes ambitions. Missions Stratégiques : Interviens sur des projets d’envergure, en parfaite cohérence avec ton expertise. Suivi Dédié : Bénéficie d’un pilotage annuel structuré pour garantir ta progression continue. Excellence Continue : Développe tes compétences au quotidien au sein d’un écosystème exigeant. Performance Durable : Évolue dans un cadre où l’exigence métier respecte ton équilibre de vie.

 Skills

Develop and spatially enrich high-resolution synthetic household populations for selected case-study cities by
items.desc:
Mission 
 Connecting urban systems, human behaviour, and well-being: How can cities reduce resource use and carbon emissions while maintaining or improving human well-being? How do changes in urban provisioning systems influence citizens’ perceptions, behaviours, and everyday choices? And how do these individual changes translate into changes in resource demand and material and energy flows across urban systems?
 The Laboratory for Human-Environment Relations in Urban Systems (HERUS) at the School of Architecture, Civil and Environmental Engineering (ENAC), EPFL, investigates how urban systems transform towards sustainability. A key challenge is understanding how changes in urban infrastructure and provisioning systems can be aligned with low-carbon futures, social acceptance, and human well-being.
 Within a planned interdisciplinary research project in collaboration with the University of Freiburg im Breisgau, Germany, we investigate how transformations of urban provisioning systems can contribute to low-carbon futures and improved human well-being at the city scale.
The PhD project will examine how urban planning interventions and changes in provisioning systems influence citizens’ perceptions, behavioural choices, and subjective well-being. A central aim is to connect these social and behavioural dimensions with socio-metabolic research, investigating how individual behaviours translate into changes in resource demand and material and energy flows across urban systems.
 The successful candidate will work in close collaboration with our partners at the University of Freiburg, as well as with the HERUS research team. 
 Main duties and responsibilities 
 Develop an interdisciplinary framework connecting urban provisioning systems, resource flows, citizens’ behaviour, perceptions, and well-being.
 Conduct a systematic review of urban interventions and demand-side options across key services, including housing, mobility, and public amenities.
 Develop and spatially enrich high-resolution synthetic household populations for selected case-study cities by integrating micro-census, survey, and socio-metabolic data.
 Design and conduct empirical research, including surveys, discrete choice experiments, interviews, and stakeholder workshops, to investigate citizens’ preferences and perceptions and support the co-design of urban interventions. 
 Analyse how behavioural changes translate into changes in resource demand and urban socio-metabolic profiles. 
 Conduct research in close collaboration with the HERUS team and project partners under the co-supervision of Prof. Claudia R. Binder and Dr. Maria Anna Hecher.
 Publish research findings in international peer-reviewed journals and present them at scientific conferences.
 Contribute to teaching and student supervision at EPFL (20%).
 Profile 
 An excellent MSc degree in Social Sciences, Environmental Sciences, Environmental Systems Sciences, Sustainability Science, Geography, Urban Planning, or a closely related interdisciplinary field.
 A strong interest in connecting social and behavioural perspectives with biophysical and material dimensions of urban systems.
 An interest in socio-technical transitions, human-environment interactions, sustainability science, and/or urban systems.
 Experience or strong interest in quantitative or mixed-methods research, such as survey design, statistical analysis, or choice modelling, as well as spatial data analysis and micro-data modelling.
 Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, strong communication and teamwork abilities, and the capacity to work independently.
 A high level of motivation for problem-driven interdisciplinary research.
 Excellent written and spoken English. Knowledge of French and/or German is a strong asset, particularly for empirical fieldwork.
 We offer 
 A PhD position for up to four years within an interdisciplinary and international research environment at EPFL.
 The opportunity to work at the intersection of urban sustainability, human behaviour, socio-metabolic research, and spatial analysis.
 Close collaboration with researchers at HERUS and the University of Freiburg.
 The opportunity to develop an independent research profile while contributing to a broader interdisciplinary research project.
 Structured doctoral training through EPFL doctoral programs and close research mentorship.
 Informations 
 The selection process involves multiple stages, and short-listed candidates will be requested to apply to a specific EPFL Doctoral Program to qualify for a PhD at EPFL, i.e. EDCE.

 A motivation letter: A statement (max. one page) where you outline why you want to join this group, what your specific interests are, how your skills can contribute to the mission of the HERUS laboratory and how you think you can advance in your own academic/scholarly pursuit while being a part of the team.

 Step into a world of endless possibilities, together let’s leave something for the future! 
 At IIT, we are committed to advancing human-centered Science and Technology to address the most urgent societal challenges of our era. We foster excellence in both fundamental and applied research, spanning fields such as neuroscience and cognition, humanoid technologies and robotics, artificial intelligence, nanotechnology, and material sciences, offering a truly interdisciplinary scientific experience. Our approach integrates cutting-edge tools and technology, empowering researchers to push the limits of knowledge and innovation. With us, your curiosity will know no bounds.

 You will be working in a multi-disciplinary group, where people with different backgrounds collaborate, each with their own expertise, to support IIT research activity.
 Within the Rehab Technologies INAIL IIT (https://rehab.iit.it/it/) research unit, your main responsibilities will be:
 Design, optimize and test electronic boards for actuation control, sensors, signal conditioning, communication and power management, for cutting-edge medical robotic devices.
 Generate detailed technical documentation for board production, cabling and testing.
 Collaborate with other engineering disciplines (mechanical, software and control) to ensure the successful integration of their designs in the system.

 Good knowledge of the English language
 Familiarity with the Microsoft Office Suite

 Proven experience in the field of electronic systems development.
 Experience with robot electronics will be a big plus.

 Ability to work in a challenging and international environment
 Capacity to work autonomously and collaboratively in a highly interdisciplinary environment
 Possess analytical reasoning skills and a growth mindset

items.desc: Lead On is een digitaal marketing agency voor klanten en medewerkers die hun groei serieus nemen. We combineren strategie met performance en vertalen cijfers naar échte impact. Dat doen we met een team van mensen die goesting hebben om bij te leren, passie hebben voor digitale marketing, initiatief nemen en elkaar scherp houden zonder in te boeten op een gezonde work-life balance. AI verandert marketing sneller dan ooit. Wij willen daar niet naar kijken, maar mee vooroplopen. Daarom zoeken we iemand die AI niet alleen gebruikt, maar weet hoe je er echte resultaten mee boekt, voor onze klanten én voor ons eigen team. Wat ga je doen? Je zoekt, test en implementeert AI-toepassingen die campagnes slimmer, sneller en beter maken Je bouwt AI-workflows en automatisaties uit voor o.a. contentcreatie, rapportering, data-analyse en campagnebeheer Je zet AI in om content op schaal te maken (tekst, visuals, video) zonder in te boeten op kwaliteit en merkidentiteit Je helpt klanten zichtbaar worden in AI-zoekmachines zoals ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity en Google AI Overviews (GEO/AEO) Je volgt nieuwe ontwikkelingen op de voet en vertaalt ze naar concrete kansen voor onze klanten Je deelt je kennis met het team via kennissessies, en zorgt dat iedereen mee is Je adviseert klanten over hoe ze AI slim kunnen inzetten in hun marketing Kan jij enkele eigenschappen afvinken? Passie voor digital marketing én voor alles wat met AI te maken heeft Je werkt dagelijks met tools zoals ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Midjourney of gelijkaardige, en weet hoe je er het maximum uithaalt Prompting, AI-agents en automatisatietools zoals Make, Zapier of n8n klinken je bekend in de oren Performance marketing, het optimaliseren van de customer journey en marketing automation zijn geen onbekend terrein Je hebt een business-mindset: AI is voor jou geen speeltje, maar een middel om groei te realiseren Je bent kritisch en weet waar AI sterk is, maar ook waar de menselijke toets onmisbaar blijft Data, technologie en de nieuwste digitale ontwikkelingen, daar word je gelukkig van Je experimenteert graag, durft te falen en leert snel bij Ervaring met platformen zoals Google Ads, Meta Business Manager, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, MailChimp of WordPress is een sterke troef Basiskennis van no-code, API’s of een beetje scripting is een bonus Een goeie pen is een bonus Je bent een teamplayer, maar ook alleen sta jij je mannetje/vrouwtje Je kan complexe technologie eenvoudig uitleggen en klanten overtuigen van je ideeën en visie Je spreekt Nederlands en woont in België Wat kan je verwachten? Geen micromanagement of vaste recepten. Wel vertrouwen, ownership en ruimte om impact te maken. Een competitief loonpakket, afgestemd op je ervaring Een rol met echte impact: jij mee bepaalt hoe Lead On AI inzet, intern én bij klanten Budget en ruimte om te experimenteren met nieuwe AI-tools en technologieën Je zult professioneel groeien. We werken met je samen om de juiste ontwikkelingskeuzes te maken voor je carrière, in een domein dat volop in beweging is Vanaf de eerste dag maak je een verschil. Heb je een goed idee? Dan helpen we je graag om dat uit te werken Flexibele werkuren en een thuiswerkdag Je maakt deel uit van een cultuur waar je trots op kunt zijn. We zijn vriendelijk en inclusief, en we ondersteunen je vanaf het moment dat je bij ons komt werken Een hecht team waar vertrouwen, flexibiliteit en respect centraal staan Twijfel je of je voldoende punten kan afvinken? Geen paniek, cultuur en attitude zijn voor ons minstens even belangrijk. In een domein dat elke maand verandert, is leergierigheid misschien wel de belangrijkste skill. We investeren in mensen, niet alleen in resultaten.
