items.desc: About The ICRC Since 1863, the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC) has worked to preserve human dignity and relieve suffering caused by war and armed violence. In collaboration with our Red Cross and Red Crescent partners around the world, we do everything we can to deliver life-saving aid, reconnect families and locate missing people – helping those who need it most, regardless of who they are and what side of the front line they are on. We engage with authorities and armed forces on all sides, often confidentially, pressing for access to detainees to improve their living conditions and urging compliance with international humanitarian law to protect non-combatants, including from digital threats. Purpose of the Role Digital technologies, and Artificial Intelligence (AI) in particular, are rapidly transforming the ICRC’s operations and the way we work. Keeping pace with this change requires our staff to build new skills. Through this 12-month traineeship, the AI Learning Associate supports the ICRC’s plans to upskill its workforce in AI. Main Duties & Responsibilities Contribute to the design, testing and organization of AI learning activities for all staff, such as webinars, e-learning modules, workshops and reverse mentoring. Curate publicly available learning resources to keep the digital skills learning channel up to date. Support the moderation of the AI community and maintain other knowledge management systems. Work with delegations to support their local learning plans. Contribute to the design and testing of personalized learning recommendation mechanisms based on user profiles, skills, competencies and learning pathways. Analyze user needs, learning pathways and usage patterns to support the development of AI-assisted learning experiences. Collaborate with Learning & Development, Information Technology and other stakeholders to prototype, document, test and improve AI-supported learning solutions. Additional Duties Follow up on work-related messages and correspondence. Understand field and operational objectives and key developments in the ICRC’s strategy. Understand the International Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement. Represent the ICRC professionally in all activities, meetings and communications. Actively seek opportunities to grow your skills and knowledge. Education & Experience Required University degree in Learning Technologies, Information Management, Data Science, Computer Science or a related field. Up to 2 years of professional experience. Excellent command of English and French; Spanish is an asset. Experience with advanced use of AI tools and prompt engineering, including using AI to support learning activities. Familiarity with Python or a similar programming language. Experience with Power BI, version control (Git) and integrating AI models into applications through APIs is an asset. Desired Profile & Skills Strong analytical and organizational skills, including data storytelling. Experience managing stakeholders in a multicultural environment. Excellent communication, active listening and problem-solving skills. Team player with strong collaboration skills. Motivated by humanitarian work. Additional Information Location: Geneva, Switzerland Activity rate: 100% Start date: January 2027 Length of assignment: 12 months Visa/permit: Legitimation Card - Provided Gross monthly salary: CHF 3'934 (paid in 13 installments) Application deadline: Monday, 16 November 2026 Please note: This traineeship is open to candidates with a maximum professional experience of two years, of which no more than one year is in a full-time paid position after completion of studies. Please note that the finalization of this recruitment is subject to the validation of the 2027 budget. The ICRC values diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates. Are you ready to explore the next chapter of your career? Apply now! For more information about working at ICRC HQ, please click here. Our Values At the ICRC, we value impact, collaboration, respect, and compassion. We seek candidates who demonstrate behaviors based on these shared values. items.desc: At AAU Energy, a fixed-term position as Research Assistant in Artificial Intelligence for Power Electronics Design, is open for appointment from January 1, 2027, or soon hereafter. The duration of the position is 2 years. Your work tasks Your work will include developing, training and evaluating machine-learning models based on circuit data, board geometries, simulation results and design images. You will develop surrogate models that approximate thermal and electromagnetic solvers, enabling faster evaluation of design alternatives. The position may also involve computer vision for recognizing circuit structures, component placements and printed circuit board geometries from photographs or other images. In addition, you will investigate graph-based methods for representing circuit relationships, evaluating design rules and generating or testing hypotheses for circuit designs. You will contribute to the development and verification of agentic workflows, where artificial intelligence systems combine models, tools and design rules to reason through and support electronics design tasks. You will prepare datasets, document computational workflows, validate model performance and share results with colleagues working in artificial intelligence, power electronics, semiconductors and software development. The position is offered within the research field of Artificial Intelligence for Power Electronics Design and contributes to AAU Energy’s focus areas of Digital Transformation and Artificial Intelligence, and Energy Efficiency in Components and Systems. The Research Assistant will be affiliated with the Section of Power Electronics System Integration and Materials. Your competencies You have a relevant master’s degree in computer science, electrical engineering, electronics, artificial intelligence or a related field, and you are interested in working at the intersection of machine learning and power electronics design. You have a solid foundation in applied machine learning. Familiarity with electronic systems, including printed circuit boards, circuit topologies, components and the physical principles that influence electrical, thermal and electromagnetic performance, will help you engage with the engineering context of the role. You have practical experience developing, training and evaluating machine-learning models, and you can translate complex engineering challenges into data-driven methods suited to a research environment. You are comfortable working with structured and unstructured engineering data, including circuit representations, board geometries, simulation data and images. Experience with computer vision, graph-based machine learning or graph neural networks will support your work with methods that interpret circuit layouts and geometries, reason about relationships between components, and generate or assess design hypotheses. You are interested in developing surrogate models that approximate thermal and electromagnetic simulation tools while maintaining sufficient accuracy for use in electronics-design workflows. You work systematically with model validation, data quality and reproducible experiments, and you understand that artificial intelligence methods for engineering need to be technically robust as well as useful to domain specialists. You communicate clearly in English, both in writing and dialogue, and you work well in a multidisciplinary environment where colleagues with expertise in artificial intelligence, power electronics and software development collaborate closely. You take responsibility for your tasks, ask constructive questions when assumptions need clarification, and contribute with curiosity and sound technical judgement to the development of new methods for intelligent electronic-system design. Who we are AAU Energy is a research department at Aalborg University dedicated to the development of clean and sustainable energy systems. Our activities cover electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technologies, and we work closely with industrial partners and other academic environments to address real-world energy challenges. The department is located in both Aalborg and Esbjerg, and this position is based at the Aalborg campus. AAU Energy employs around 250 staff members at different career stages and from a broad range of national backgrounds. This creates an international and interdisciplinary research environment with many opportunities for collaboration and knowledge sharing. English is widely used as the working language in research and teaching, which makes it straightforward for international colleagues to integrate. We offer access to advanced laboratory and workshop facilities and an environment where you can develop your academic profile through research, teaching and collaboration with both Danish and international external partners. As a workplace we value a collegial and inclusive culture with room for professional discussion, initiative and mutual support in …

items.desc: Req ID: 531879 Chez Alstom, nous avons une connaissance pointue des réseaux de transport et comprenons ce qui conduit les individus à les emprunter. Des trains à grande vitesse, métros, monorails et tramways aux systèmes intégrés, services, infrastructures, et solutions de signalisation et de mobilité numérique, nous offrons à la diversité de nos clients le portefeuille le plus vaste du secteur. Chaque jour, plus de 80 000 collaborateurs dans le monde qui ouvrent la voie à des solutions de mobilité plus vertes et plus intelligentes pour relier les villes, réduire l’empreinte carbone et remplacer la voiture. Sujet du stage : Étude et comparaison de méthodes de Machine Learning pour données de simulation et d'essais. La création de modèles à partir de données issues de simulations numériques ou de mesures expérimentales présente un grand intérêt pour la compréhension des phénomènes physiques et la prédiction de nouveaux cas de fonctionnement. L'objectif du stage est d'évaluer différentes méthodes de Machine Learning disponibles dans les bibliothèques Python PyTorch et scikit-learn, afin d’identifier leurs domaines d’application, leurs besoins en données et leurs performances sur différentes problématiques. Le stage consistera également à développer des fonctions génériques permettant de préparer et mettre en forme les données afin de faciliter l'utilisation de ces méthodes. Nous proposons un stage de niveau Bac+5 pour un profil en mathématiques appliquées, informatique ou data science. Développement du sujet : Les activités de cette étude seront les suivantes : Analyse des méthodes disponibles dans PyTorch et scikit-learn ; Mise en place de fonctions génériques de préparation des données ; Mise en œuvre et évaluation des différentes méthodes ; Comparaison des performances et identification des cas d'utilisation adaptés ; Rédaction d'un rapport de synthèse. Export des modèles vers un format standard (ONNX) ; Développement d'un wrapper C/C++ permettant la réutilisation des modèles exportés dans des applications externes ; Évaluation sur différents cas d'application (thermique, batteries, modèles récursifs, PINN). Il n’y a pas que les passionnés de trains qui s’épanouissent chez nous. Nul doute que vous ressentirez beaucoup de fierté lorsque vous monterez dans l’un de nos trains avec votre famille ou vos amis. Si vous aimez le challenge, nous serions ravis d’échanger avec vous ! Remarque importante En tant qu’employeur présent dans plus de 63 pays, nous souscrivons au principe d’égalité d’accès à l’emploi et valorisons la diversité. Nous nous sommes engagés à créer un environnement de travail inclusif pour tous. Job Type: Stage/Apprenti

items.desc: Vous êtes passionné(e) par les données, l’Intelligence Artificielle et les applications de l’informatique au domaine de l’Energie ? Rejoignez l’équipe du AI Hub de Schneider Electric, qui accompagne l’ensemble du Groupe dans la réalisation d’applications avancées de gestion de l’énergie et d’automatisation. Ce stage consiste à étudier et développer une solution de routage intelligent capable de sélectionner automatiquement le modèle d’IA le plus adapté à chaque tâche afin d'améliorer les performances, les coûts et les temps de traitement. Le stagiaire comparera les solutions existantes, concevra un prototype et évaluera sa pertinence sur des données industrielles Schneider Electric en tenant compte de la performance et de la facilité d’intégration. Missions : Compléter l’état de l’art de l’équipe sur les méthodologies de routage des modèles de langage, établir un panorama exhaustif des solutions et acteurs existant, et permettre une évaluation adaptée. Définir une architecture combinant une méthodologie scientifique pertinente, une intégration des données, et une intégration dans l’environnement cloud de Schneider Electric. Mettre en œuvre un prototype en Python, avec des composants testables, observables et réutilisables. Construire et appliquer un protocole comparant l’évaluation classique « sur banc d’essai » aux résultats du routage, et discuter des résultats avec les experts (Data Scientist, DevOps). Présenter les résultats aux équipes du AI Hub et aux Lines of Business propriétaires des données. Contribuer en fonction des résultats, à la rédaction d’un article scientifique pour une conférence internationale. Ce stage vous permettra d’acquérir une expérience pratique de recherche et de développement en Intelligence Artificielle agentique appliquée à des données industrielles réelles. Il vous permettra également d’apprendre des pratiques de programmation de qualité industrielle, d’expérimentation reproductible, d’observabilité et d’évaluation avec des experts métier. items.desc: Le département SEQUOIA (Services, Economie, Questions hUmaines, Outils innovants et IA) de la R&D, intervient en appui de la direction Marketing de la Branche Commerce d’EDF. Dans ce département, le groupe E7C est spécialisé en analyse de données de consommation, et en modélisation statistique dans le but de concevoir des nouvelles offres de fourniture ou des services. Nos missions sont de : Mettre en place des panels de clients pour collecter des courbes de charge (globale ou sur des usages spécifiques) : des compétences en sondage, ou en dimensionnement de panels sont alors requises. Modéliser des profils de consommation. Développer des algorithmes pour faire de l’estimation/prévision de consommation. Estimer l’impact d’une offre ou d’un service sur la consommation des clients. Ce stage s’inscrit dans un projet, dont l’objectif est de recueillir et valoriser les données clients. Par ailleurs, un volet méthodologique du projet identifie et développe des traitements innovants et créateurs de valeur pour la relation client et les offres à partir des courbes de charge au pas de temps des compteurs communicants (Linky et Gazpar), mais aussi à pas de temps fin (seconde). Contexte du stage : Le département SEQUOIA de la R&D a pour ambition de devenir un acteur de référence en matière de foundation models. A ce jour, les méthodes en cours de développement sont spécialisées pour la prévision et l’imputation de séries temporelles (voir par exemple le modèle TS-ICL : https://github.com/EDF-Lab/ts-icl). Les méthodes d’inférence causale sont fréquemment utilisées pour répondre à des problématiques autour de l’énergie : quel est l’effet d’une rénovation énergétique sur la consommation électrique du client ? Comment réagit le client face aux changements d’offres tarifaires ? Cependant, les algorithmes traditionnels montrent parfois des limites lorsqu’il est question de travailler sur des données de courbes de charge haute fréquence (séries temporelles de consommation électrique individuelles). Le stage comportera plusieurs phases : État de l’art des méthodes envisagées et montée en compétences : Se familiariser avec les méthodes usuelles d’inférence causale. Explorer les causal foundation models ainsi que les méthodes de génération de données synthétiques causales associées, les comparer aux algorithmes traditionnels. Porter un regard critique sur ces méthodes. Capitaliser ses résultats. Prise en main des données Jeu de données public de courbes de charge avec effet causal simulé. Données de courbes de charge EDF avec effet causal réel et inconnu. Mise en œuvre Implémenter les méthodes identifiées lors de la revue de littérature en Python. Certains modèles traditionnels sont codés en R. Adapter ces méthodes à notre usage et à nos données. Réaliser un benchmark des différentes méthodes. Capitalisation des travaux effectués Rédaction d'un rapport, code python/R accompagné d'une documentation, co-rédaction d'article scientifique. La R&D propose ce stage de fin d’études, à destination d’étudiants en écoles d’ingénieurs ou Master 2, spécialisés en Statistique/Data Science/Econométrie/Deep Learning/IA. Ecoles : Ecole Polytechnique, ENSTA, Ecole Nationale des Ponts et Chaussées, IMT Atlantique, CentraleSupélec, Ecole des mines, Télécom Paris, ENSAE, ENSAI, Paris School of Economics et Toulouse School of Economics Compétences : Connaissances théoriques en statistique, Machine Learning et en Deep Learning. Capacité à comprendre et synthétiser des articles complexes. Goût pour la R&D, l’inférence causale et les foundation models.. Modélisation de séries temporelles. L’étudiant sera amené à utiliser principalement le langage de programmation Python et ponctuellement R. Dates : à partir de février/mars 2027 (flexible) et pour 6 mois Lieu du stage : EDF Lab Paris-Saclay – Recherches et Développement, 7 Bd Gaspard Monge, 91120 Palaiseau. Contacts : Yanis REMMACHE (Ingénieur Chercheur), mail : yanis.remmache@edf.fr Philippe CHARPENTIER (Ingénieur Chercheur Expert), mail : philippe.charpentier@edf.fr Merci d’envoyer un C.V et une lettre de motivation sur ces e-mails. Horaires : 35 h / semaine

items.desc: About The Job A vos côtés, partout en France, depuis plus de 100 ans ! Chez Danone, grandir, on y prend goût. C’est pourquoi nous sommes présents dans le quotidien des Français grâce à ses 26 marques de produits savoureux pour se faire plaisir tout en prenant soin de soi et des siens. Avec plus de 8 000 Danoners répartis sur 13 sites de productions, 7 entrepôts, 3 sièges et un centre de R&D, Danone travaille continuellement à l’élaboration et au développement de produits iconiques dans vos cuisines, supermarchés, restaurants, cafés ou encore pour des établissements de soins et des pharmacies. Certifiée Bcorp et Happy Trainees, Danone ne cherche pas à être la meilleure entreprise au monde, mais une entreprise meilleure pour le monde. Nous nous efforçons de proposer le meilleur à nos consommateurs comme à nos collaborateurs. L'équipe Normes IFRS au sein du département Consolidation & Reporting Groupe est responsable de l'analyse des évolutions réglementaires et comptables ainsi que de leur déploiement au sein du Groupe. Dans un contexte d'accélération des technologies IA, l'équipe cherche à repenser ses méthodes de travail et à développer de nouveaux outils permettant de gagner en efficacité et en pertinence. TES MISSIONS CHEZ DANONE Ce stage se déroulera à Paris, dans notre siège social à partir du 4 janvier 2027, pour une période de 6 mois. Hugo Masson, IFRS Manager , au sein de l’équipe Consolidation & Reporting Groupe , t’accompagnera pour grandir au quotidien et t’épanouir dans tes missions Participer à l’automatisation et à l’optimisation des processus de veille réglementaire et normative à l’échelle du Groupe. Développer des outils basés sur l’intelligence artificielle afin de faciliter l’analyse, la synthèse et le partage des publications des normalisateurs, régulateurs et cabinets d’audit. Tester, évaluer et déployer de nouveaux outils d'intelligence artificielle (Copilot, modèles de langage, agents IA, outils de recherche avancée) afin d'identifier les cas d'usage à forte valeur ajoutée pour améliorer l’efficacité des processus de l’équipe. Concevoir et prototyper des solutions innovantes (IA générative, assistants, agents, automatisations) destinées à transformer les méthodes de travail de l'équipe Consolidation & Reporting Groupe Contribuer à la structuration, à l’exploitation et à la valorisation des données utilisées par l’équipe Consolidation & Reporting Groupe. LES + DE CE STAGE Jusqu’à 2 jours/sem de télétravail Prise en charge intégrale de ton abonnement de transport en région parisienne/lyonnaise ou remboursement partiel/intégral de tes frais kilométriques sur nos sites de production. L’accès au programme ""Vendredi je grandis"" un programme de développement et d'accompagnement sur mesure chaque vendredi après-midi, couvrant des sujets tels que la carrière, les soft skills et les hard skills. Stage Une gratification allant de 1 300€ (Bac+4 et césure) à 1 500€ (Bac+5) brut/mois. Une opportunité unique d’appliquer les technologies IA les plus récentes à des problématiques stratégiques de Finance Groupe. Une forte autonomie pour proposer, tester et déployer de nouveaux cas d’usage. Une exposition à des sujets internationaux au contact des équipes Finance Groupe, Digital et Data. Avantages du site cantine, restaurant au dernier étage, salle de sport, parking vélos About you Pour faire de grandes choses ensembles, nous recherchons pour ce poste quelqu’un de Disponible à partir de janvier 2027 pour une durée de 6 mois De niveau Bac+4/5 en école d’ingénieur, université ou formation spécialisée en data, intelligence artificielle, informatique ou transformation digitale Curieux, autonome et force de proposition, avec une forte appétence pour l’innovation et les nouvelles technologies. À l’aise avec les outils de traitement de données et d’automatisation. Une première expérience ou des projets personnels impliquant l'utilisation de l'IA générative ou du machine learning seraient un plus. Intéressé par les applications concrètes de l’intelligence artificielle générative dans un environnement Finance d’un groupe international. Capable de vulgariser des sujets techniques et de collaborer avec des interlocuteurs aux profils variés. About us Pendant ton stage, tu préfères prendre des notes ou des initiatives ? 90% de nos stagiaires et alternants estiment que Danone offre un environnement de travail propice à l’évolution professionnelle grâce aux responsabilités, à l’autonomie et aux formations accordées (source Happy Trainees). REJOINDRE DANONE C’EST… Rencontrer des Danoners aux personnalités singulières, profils divers et aux parcours professionnels variés Grandir dans des environnements différents sites de production, bases logistiques, centre de recherche et innovation ou encore sièges sociaux Se construire un parcours de carrière sur mesure, adapté à ta personnalité, tes compétences et tes envies Apprendre grâce à des missions responsabilisantes, riches et apprenantes. Nos Danoners ont la parole ! …

For more information please visit: https://www.brunel.ac.uk/about/our-history/home Description of College The College of Engineering, Design and Physical Sciences at Brunel University of London delivers world-leading research, interdisciplinary innovation, industry engagement, and excellence in engineering, computing, design, mathematics, and physical sciences education. Description Of Role And Essential Person Specification We are seeking a highly motivated Research Assistant or Research Fellow to contribute to CLIMABUILD, a Horizon Europe research project developing innovative methodologies, artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled digital technologies and decision-support solutions to enhance the resilience, sustainability and climate adaptability of buildings and the wider built environment. Brunel plays a leading role in research activities spanning resilience and sustainability assessment, computational modelling, lifecycle analysis, digital decision-support systems, knowledge graphs, participatory technologies and stakeholder engagement. Working closely with the Principal Investigator and international consortium partners, the successful candidate will: Develop, apply or support mathematical, computational and data-driven approaches for assessing the resilience, sustainability and lifecycle performance of buildings and infrastructure. Contribute to AI-enabled digital solutions, including Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), knowledge graphs, digital twins and intelligent decision-support tools. Investigate climate adaptation and low-carbon renovation strategies through lifecycle assessment, scenario analysis, uncertainty evaluation and multi-criteria optimisation. Support the development, integration and validation of innovative methodologies and digital tools, working with project partners and Living Labs. Contribute to scientific publications, project deliverables, stakeholder engagement and research dissemination. Applicants should hold a relevant degree in Civil, Environmental, Building or Infrastructure Engineering, Computer Science or a closely related discipline. Appointment at Research Fellow level will require a PhD or equivalent research experience. Essential competencies include analytical and computational skills, programming experience (e.g. Python, MATLAB or R), knowledge of resilience, sustainability or lifecycle assessment, and familiarity with AI technologies, including LLMs. Good communication skills and the ability to work independently, with appropriate supervision according to grade, within an international and interdisciplinary team are essential. The appointment will be made at Research Assistant or Research Fellow level, depending on the successful candidate's qualifications and experience. We offer a generous annual leave package plus discretionary University closure days, excellent training and development opportunities as well as a great occupational pension scheme and a range of health-related support. The University is committed to a hybrid working approach. Closing date for applications: 1 December 2026 If you have any technical issues please contact us at: hrsystems@brunel.ac.uk Brunel University London has a strong commitment to equality, diversity and inclusion. Our aim is to promote and achieve a fully inclusive workforce to reflect our community.

items.desc: We help the world run better At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed. What You'll Build Enterprise agents increasingly process personal data across documents, conversations, and business tools. In this context, personal data protection is difficult: an agent must respect the purpose, permissions, and recipient constraints governing each use. The internship will investigate how to detect privacy risks before information is released or an external action is executed, testing whether signals from a language model's internal representations provide measurable benefits beyond input/output filters and explicit policy enforcement. The internship will be part of a project investigating on the following research questions. Under which conditions do model-internal signals improve the detection and prevention of: unauthorized personal-data disclosure beyond external monitoring and policy enforcement, while preserving task performance and acceptable latency? misalignment against constraints set to personal data processing? This Central Question Can Be Broken Down Into Detection: Can internal representations predict an impending violation beyond what is already observable from the input, policy context, and proposed action? Intervention: Does targeted steering improve the privacy–utility trade-off? items.desc: Description De L'entreprise CS, filiale du groupe Sopra Steria, est un acteur technologique de référence dans la conception, l’intégration et l’exploitation de systèmes critiques. Présents dans 7 pays avec plus de 2 600 collaborateurs passionnés, nous intervenons au cœur des enjeux de souveraineté, de sécurité et de performance, dans des secteurs stratégiques tels que la défense, le spatial, l’énergie, l’industrie, le transport, l’aéronautique et la cybersécurité. Notre différence ? Une expertise unique en systèmes temps réel, des solutions souveraines et durables, et une culture d’innovation forte, portée par 15 % de notre chiffre d’affaires investi en R&D. Nous accompagnons nos clients dans la réussite de leurs programmes les plus complexes, du contrôle aérien à la lutte anti-drones, en passant par les systèmes nucléaires et les centres de contrôle satellites. En rejoignant CS, vous intégrez une entreprise humaine et innovante. Nous livrons bien plus que des systèmes, nous bâtissons la confiance. Nous allons au-delà des besoins exprimés, nous préparons les défis de demain. Plus que de simples experts, nous façonnons l’innovation. Explorer, observer, sécuriser l’espace de demain. Avec 50 ans d’expertise, notre Business Unit Espace est un partenaire de confiance des agences spatiales, maîtres d’œuvre et opérateurs de satellites à travers l’Europe.Forte d'un savoir-faire reconnu, elle contribue activement à renforcer la performance, la sécurité et l’innovation de l’écosystème spatial. Nos équipes apportent leur expertise sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie des missions : observation de la Terre, systèmes de navigation et de télécommunication, sciences et exploration interplanétaire, surveillance et sécurité de l’Espace. Portées par l’IA et nos solutions souveraines, nous repoussons chaque jour les frontières technologiques des programmes spatiaux européens. Rejoindre cette Business Unit , c’est façonner le futur de l’espace aux côtés d’experts passionnés. Description Du Poste Nous recrutons un(e) Stagiaire Ingénieur(e) R&D afin de mener des travaux sur l’estimation de la largeur des rivières par approche d’intelligence artificielle (IA) . Vous rejoignez notre Business Unit Espace , au sein de notre agence Space Processing & Intelligence , spécialisée dans le traitement et l’hybridation des données spatiales . Vos missions Au sein de l’équipe Hydrologie Spatiale et encadré(e) par vos référent(e)s techniques, vous développez un modèle d’apprentissage supervisé permettant d’estimer les largeurs de rivières à partir d’images satellite, élément crucial pour la mesure de débits. CS GROUP dispose d’une méthode déterministe de calcul de largeurs de rivières à partir de masques d’eau mais la complexité de certains cours d’eau, notamment en zone tropicale, limite la précision du modèle. L’objectif de ce stage R&D est de surpasser les performances actuelles via une approche IA et pour cela =, vous devez : Effectuer l’état de l’art des méthodes et datasets existants. Créer un jeu de données pour l’entraînement et l’évaluation. Évaluer et prendre en main la méthode déterministe actuelle, MIRROWRS. Développer et entraîner la méthode supervisée. Évaluer les performances du nouveau modèle. L'environnement technique Python, GeoPandas, Rasterio PyTorch, OpenCV, MLFlow, etc pour la partie IA Les plus de ce stage Intégrer une communauté scientifique dynamique autour de l’hydrologie continentale, des données spatiales et des enjeux environnementaux liés à l’eau Monter en compétences en développement métier avec Python Découvrir les aspects R&D en entreprise Possibilité de poursuivre en CDI à l’issue du stage Qualifications Vous êtes en dernière année d'école d'ingénieur ou diplôme universitaire équivalent, vous recherchez un stage de fin d'études de 6 mois. Vous avez une très bonne connaissance du langage Python et de ses principales librairies scientifiques (GeoPandas, PyTorch, etc.) ainsi que des notions de Git. Vous êtes autonome , curieux(se) et rigoureux(se) ? Alors vous êtes la pépite que nous recherchons ! Informations supplémentaires Rejoignez une entreprise où l’humain, l’innovation et l’impact se rencontrent. Chez CS, nous offrons : Une expérience collaborateur enrichissante, portée par un environnement de travail conçu pour favoriser la flexibilité, l’autonomie et le bien-être au quotidien. Un parcours d’intégration complet pensé pour embarquer chaque talent dès le premier jour et une Academy pour développer vos compétences, enrichir votre expertise et construire les parcours professionnels qui vous ressemblent. Un engagement sociétal fort : plus de 3 000 associations soutenues, une politique handicap active, une culture inclusive, une démarche de numérique responsable, et des partenariats comme Elles bougent pour inspirer les talents féminins de demain. …et bien d’autres avantages à découvrir en nous rejoignant ! Présents dans 7 pays avec plus de 2 600 collaborateurs passionnés, nous intervenons au cœur des enjeux de souveraineté, de sécurité et de performance, dans des secteurs stratégiques tels que la défense, le spatial, l’énergie, l’industrie, le transport, l’aéronautique et la cybersécurité. Notre différence ? Une expertise unique en systèmes temps réel, des solutions souveraines et durables, et une culture d’innovation forte, portée par 15 % de notre chiffre d’affaires investi en R&D. Nous accompagnons nos clients dans la réussite de leurs programmes les plus complexes, du contrôle aérien à la lutte anti-drones, en passant par les systèmes nucléaires et les centres de contrôle satellites. En rejoignant CS, vous intégrez une entreprise humaine et innovante. Nous livrons bien plus que des systèmes, nous bâtissons la confiance. Nous allons au-delà des besoins exprimés, nous préparons les défis de demain. Plus que de simples experts, nous façonnons l’innovation. Explorer, observer, sécuriser l’espace de demain. Avec 50 ans d’expertise, notre Business Unit Espace est un partenaire de confiance des agences spatiales, maîtres d’œuvre et opérateurs de satellites à travers l’Europe.Forte d'un savoir-faire reconnu, elle contribue activement à renforcer la performance, la sécurité et l’innovation de l’écosystème spatial. Nos équipes apportent leur expertise sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie des missions : observation de la Terre, systèmes de navigation et de télécommunication, sciences et exploration interplanétaire, surveillance et sécurité de l’Espace. Portées par l’IA et nos solutions souveraines, nous repoussons chaque jour les frontières technologiques des programmes spatiaux européens. items.desc: Vacancy Notice 2033 INTERPOL is the world’s largest international police organization, with 196 Member Countries. Created in 1923, it facilitates cross-border police co-operation, and supports and assists all organizations, authorities, and services whose mission is to prevent or combat international crime. INTERPOL strives to achieve a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcomes applications from individuals with diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. To achieve our Diversity goals, we encourage applications from women and nationals of under/unrepresented member countries who are passionate about our mission. INTERPOL’s recruitment process is merit-based hence all hiring decisions are made considering the applicant’s qualifications and the needs of the Organization. Job Title: Data Scientist Reporting To: Assistant Director Location: Lyon Type of contract: Project Fixed-term Contract Duration (End date): 31 December 2027* Grade: 4 Number of post(s): 1 Level of Security screening: Enhanced Deadline for application: 18 November 2026 11.00 PM (Singapore Time) Conditions applying for all candidates Only professional experience for which candidates can provide official proof of employment will be considered. Candidates could be requested to provide copies of such official documents prior to interviews/test. This position is financed by a third-party, external to the Organization with funding provided by the donor. Although there is a commitment from the donor, the appointment may be terminated prior to indicate official end date of project, should the external funding for this position no longer be available. This position also carries, in principle, no expectation of renewal. Any potential subsequent extension will be subject to the terms of the Organization’s Staff Manual, to satisfactory performance and to availability of funds. Tests/interviews in connection to this selection procedure will take place approximately 3-4 weeks after the deadline for applications. Applicants are kindly requested to plan their availability during this period accordingly, in case they are short-listed. Selected candidates will be expected to report for duty approximately two to three months after receiving an offer of employment at the latest. INTRODUCTION OF POST Context and Mission The Executive Directorate for Police Capabilities (EDPC) designs and oversees all INTERPOL’s police capabilities, including criminal databases. Within this framework, the Operational Support and Analysis Directorate (OSA) empowers law enforcement officers to respond to international crime in real time. Specifically, the Criminal Analysis Sub-Directorate (CAS) leverages Project INSIGHT, a modern analytical platform designed to harness the power, security, and scalability of INTERPOL’s infrastructure. This initiative aims to make criminal intelligence analysis more efficient and effective for the benefit of all member countries. The Data Opportunity INTERPOL databases serve as an invaluable global repository, containing millions of records contributed daily by member countries via a secure communications system. These datasets include information on suspects and wanted people, fingerprints, DNA profiles, stolen motor vehicles, firearms, lost or stolen travel documents, etc. While these resources are vast, maximizing their potential requires the application of up-to-date analytical tools and methodologies to transform raw data into actionable intelligence. The Role The Data Scientist will provide advanced analytical support to help users generate actionable insights from these large-scale datasets, both within the core INTERPOL databases and through the Project INSIGHT platform. The successful candidate will translate complex data into compelling graphical, numerical, and narrative formats. We seek an interdisciplinary professional who integrates techniques from diverse scientific and computer science disciplines to solve complex data problems. Collaboration and Impact The post holder will collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to continuously refine data science models and outputs. Critical thinking and problem-solving skills are essential for interpreting data and uncovering hidden solutions within massive datasets. This role requires a passion for optimizing data processing workflows and extracting high-value outputs that directly support INTERPOL’s General Secretariat crime and operational support units, as well as member countries worldwide. Primary Duties In the order of importance, indicate main duties and activities performed by the post holder: supervisory responsibility, taking decisions, etc. DUTY 1: Source and analyze big data sets As a Data Scientist, deliver the best possible analysis including the use of artificial intelligence/machine learning that provides insights, prediction and direction to end-users. Provide big data analysis expertise to help solve complex data problems. Analyze various formats of data, …

Examples include: Comparing project information across PMO tools and reporting sources. Identifying missing or incomplete information. Automatically notifying data owners when discrepancies are detected. Automated reminder and notification workflows. As organizations increasingly adopt digital and AI-enabled ways of working, there is an opportunity to reduce manual governance activities through automation while simultaneously improving the quality and consistency of governance information. items.desc: Overview: We help UK consumers recover money lost through mis-sold financial products. Our work includes managing claims, processing financial documentation and supporting customers throughout the claims process. We operate at scale, with legal and operations teams working across multiple locations. Technology plays a central role in how we work, with AI already being used to process incoming correspondence, interpret documents and streamline operational workflows. We are looking for someone to take ownership of this capability and help develop it further. The role: You will own the business's AI and automation capabilities, overseeing the models, prompts and workflows that process incoming documents, interpret information and determine the appropriate next steps. These systems are central to day-to-day operations. Their accuracy, reliability and performance directly affect how efficiently cases progress and how quickly customers receive updates. You will be responsible for maintaining and improving these systems, ensuring they are robust, well documented and continually evolving. You will also identify new opportunities to introduce AI and automation across the business. You will work closely with the CTO and development team, who are responsible for the wider technology platform and its ongoing development. Your focus will be on the AI and automation layer, ensuring its outputs integrate effectively with the wider platform and deliver tangible operational improvements. Key responsibilities Lender response categorisation Own the end-to-end pipeline that reads, classifies and routes every lender response: acknowledgements, holding letters, final responses, offers, rejections and DSAR data packs. Maintain the categories, rules and confidence thresholds that decide what goes straight through and what goes to a person. Investigate misclassifications quickly and fix the root cause, not just the case in front of you. Postal scan categorisation Run the OCR and document classification pipeline for scanned post: document type, client, lender and claim matching. Improve extraction on poor scans, handwriting and multi-page bundles. Keep unmatched and low-confidence items in a clear exception queue, cleared within an agreed turnaround. Prompts, models and evaluation Own the prompt library: version control, documentation, change history and review for every production prompt. Build and maintain test sets of anonymised real documents, so every prompt or model change is measured before it ships. Monitor accuracy, drift, latency and cost, and choose and tune models against those measures. Manage provider dependencies, rate limits and fallbacks, so the pipeline keeps running when a provider has an outage. ﻿ Automation and integration Build and maintain the automations that move documents and data between the AI layer, the case management system and the client portal. Work with the development team so AI outputs (claim status, document type, next step) show correctly in the client portal. Spot the next manual processes worth automating and build the case for them with operations. Governance and compliance Make sure AI processing of client data meets UK GDPR, our data protection policies and the standards expected of a regulated legal and claims business. Keep a clear audit trail of what each model decided, on what input and with which prompt version. Write and maintain runbooks, so no system depends on one person's knowledge. Working with the business Turn needs from the legal and claims teams into system changes, and explain AI behaviour in plain English. Report to the CTO on performance, incidents and the roadmap. Skills and experience Essential 3+ years building production software, including at least 2 year shipping LLM or machine learning systems that real users rely on. Strong prompt engineering backed by evaluation: you can show how you measured a prompt and improved it, not just that you wrote it. Hands-on document AI: OCR, document classification and data extraction (for example Azure Document Intelligence, AWS Textract, Google Document AI or open-source tools). Python or TypeScript, REST APIs and SQL. Workflow automation and integration (for example Power Automate, Make, n8n, or custom queues and webhooks). Experience with major LLM providers' APIs (for example OpenAI, Anthropic or Azure OpenAI), including cost and rate-limit management. A track record of picking up an existing, partly documented system and becoming its owner fast. Working knowledge of UK GDPR and of handling sensitive personal and financial data. Clear communication with non-technical colleagues.

items.desc:
Who we are
 About Stripe
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. 
 About the team
 The Internationalisation team builds the platform that helps Stripe products work naturally across languages and markets. We create and operate the infrastructure that enables Stripe teams to localize product interfaces, services, and written communications while delivering consistent, high-quality experiences to users around the world.
 We work closely with our sister Localization team and its language experts, as well as with product and service engineering teams integrating localized content. Together, we combine engineering, automation, and linguistic expertise to help Stripe build products that feel native to each market.
 What you’ll do
 You will design, implement, and maintain Stripe’s internationalisation platform at scale, including the developer and user experiences around it. You’ll help teams continuously localize their products while improving the quality, speed, reliability, and efficiency of Stripe’s localization processes.
 This role combines backend and platform engineering with emerging LLM technology. Depending on the project, you may build end-to-end functionality for internal customers, evolve production LLM systems, develop quality-evaluation capabilities, improve platform reliability and observability, or lead migrations from legacy localization infrastructure.
 Responsibilities
 Design and build internationalisation infrastructure that supports diverse content surfaces, including backend services, product interfaces, and written communications.
 Integrate localization into Stripe’s software-development and content-production workflows, enabling teams to ship translated experiences continuously and safely.
 Build and maintain integrations with translation-management systems, LLM services and external localization providers.
 Evolve Stripe’s existing production LLM capabilities to improve translation quality, market relevance, turnaround time, and operational efficiency.
 Develop automated quality checks and human-evaluation workflows that combine LLM-driven automation with expert linguistic judgment.
 Maintain a high bar for reliability through effective testing, monitoring, alerting, and operational processes.
 Own ambiguous, high-impact initiatives end to end—from research and experimentation through implementation, launch, measurement, and iteration.
 Who you are 
 We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. 
 Minimum requirements
 Strong coding skills in any programming language (we understand new languages can be learned on the job so our interview process is language agnostic)
 Experience developing reliable infrastructure, platform, or backend-service solutions.
 Strong product judgment and a commitment to building high-quality user and developer experiences.
 Ability to own ambiguous work end to end and make progress through research, experimentation, and iteration.
 Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in a collaborative, cross-functional environment.
 Preferred qualifications 
 Experience building or operating production LLM or machine-learning systems.
 Experience evaluating LLM output or combining automated systems with expert human review.
 Familiarity with internationalisation, localization, translation, or content-management workflows.
 Experience with CI/CD systems, developer platforms, or workflow infrastructure.
 Backend engineering experience building services using programming languages such as Java, Ruby, or Go.
 Experience building internal platforms that ultimately support customer-facing products.

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
 The Position
 As an Observability DevOps Engineer within our Digital Operations and Reliability team, you optimize and automate the deployment and management of platform and cloud-based services. In this role, you drive cost-effectiveness, scalability, and security throughout the digital product lifecycle. You collaborate with a global team to evolve our systems from reactive troubleshooting to proactive site reliability engineering, accelerating developer velocity and reducing system downtime to deliver seamless healthcare solutions. 
 Your Responsibilities 
 Automate Software Delivery: Drive the design, implementation, and maintenance of efficient Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines to streamline software deployments. 
 Manage Infrastructure as Code: Deploy and manage application underlying infrastructure using modern Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles and maintain stable, version-controlled configurations. 
 Embed Observability Frameworks: Implement robust monitoring and observability solutions (such as Grafana Cloud) to measure and optimize the availability, scalability, and performance of software platforms. 
 Integrate Lifecycle Security: Drive the adoption of DevSecOps practices by implementing security controls and infrastructure hardening throughout the development and deployment cycles. 
 Collaborate Globally: Partner with cross-functional architects and developers to translate high-level product strategies and business requirements into concrete development tasks. 
 Foster Technical Innovation: Stay at the forefront of industry trends and emerging technologies, keeping documentation clear and providing technical mentorship to engineering colleagues. 
 Who You Are 
 You are a proactive, growth-minded engineer who thrives on solving complex, ambiguous technical challenges and enjoys sharing knowledge within an international team environment. 
 Professional Experience: You bring 3 to 7 years of experience in the software development lifecycle, preferably within a multinational or healthcare corporate environment, backed by a technical degree or equivalent practical experience. 
 CI/CD & Source Code Expertise: You demonstrate strong hands-on experience with source code management tools (such as GitLab, GitHub, or Bitbucket) and configuring automated deployment pipelines. 
 Infrastructure & Cloud Capabilities: You hold practical knowledge of Infrastructure as Code and configuration management tools (such as Terraform, Ansible, Vault, or Consul) along with experience in containers or Kubernetes environments. 
 Monitoring & Observability Proficiency: You possess a solid understanding of centralized observability and monitoring systems (such as Grafana Cloud, Splunk, or LogicMonitor). 
 Communication & Collaboration: You bring essential effective oral and written communication skills in English, with the flexibility to work effectively across multiple time zones and travel occasionally. 
 At Roche, you’ll thrive in a culture that values different perspectives and creates a place of belonging, where we challenge ourselves to excel and achieve strong results, together. 
Where pay transparency applies, details are provided based on the primary posting location. For this role, the primary location is Madrid. If you are interested in additional locations where the role may be available, we will provide the relevant compensation details later in the hiring process. 
 Who we are
 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
Let’s build a healthier future, together.

items.desc:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
 The Position
 Das ist Dein Wirkungsfeld 
 Unser Bereich Facilities & Engineering + SHE am Standort Penzberg ist für eine
 bedarfsgerechte und wettbewerbsfähige Verfügbarkeit der Gebäude, technischen Anlagen und Systeme verantwortlich. Wir bringen unser Know-How in Projekte ein und schaffen so die Voraussetzung für einen effizienten technischen Betrieb. Unsere Kultur ist geprägt von hohem Vertrauen, Mut, Leidenschaft, wertschätzenden Miteinander, Offenheit und dem Streben nach stetiger Verbesserung.
 Das erwartet Dich 
 ● Terminplanung : Du stimmst Kalibrierfenster mit der Produktion und dem Wartungsplanungsteam ab, übernimmst die Einsatzplanung im Kalibrierteam und hältst Freigabezeiten verbindlich ein.
 Gegebenenfalls sind gelegentliche Kalibriereinsätze am Wochenende erforderlich. 
 ● In-situ Kalibrierung: Du führst geplante und außerplanmäßige Kalibrierungen (auch im Rahmen von Projekten) an unterschiedlichen Messstellen (u. a. Temperatur, Druck, Durchfluss, pH-Wert, Leitfähigkeit, O₂, o. dgl.) direkt im Produktionsumfeld (Schwarz- und Weißbereich) nach DIN/ISO- und GMP-Standards durch. 
 ● Anpassung : Bei Bedarf nimmst du „smarte“ Justagen und messtechnische Feinabstimmungen und deren Dokumentation vor. 
 ● Dokumentation : Du erfasst Messergebnisse direkt in einem automatisierten System für eine lückenlose Nachvollziehbarkeit. 
 ● Referenz-Handling : Du arbeitest mit rückführbaren Normalien sowie Messgeräten und stellst deren regelmäßige Pflege sicher. 
 ● Teamwork & Qualität : Du teilst dein Know-how im Team, fungierst als Vorbild für deine Kolleg:innen im Tagesgeschäft und sicherst gemeinsam unsere Qualitätsstandards. 
 Das bringst du mit 
 Abgeschlossene technische Berufsausbildung (z. B. als Elektroniker für Automatisierungstechnik oder Betriebstechnik, EMSR-Techniker, Mechatroniker oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation).
 Eine Weiterbildung zum Techniker oder Meister ist für erweiterte Aufgaben (z. B. Arbeitsplanung, Ursachenanalyse, Optimierung von Kalibrierverfahren o. dgl.) ausdrücklich willkommen.
 Praktische Erfahrung in der Kalibrier- und Messtechnik bringst Du idealerweise mit, Kenntnisse im regulierten GxP-/GMP-Umfeld sind von Vorteil.
 Fundiertes Verständnis und breit gefächerte Kenntnisse physikalischer Messgrößen in der Mess- und Kalibriertechnik.
 Sicherer Umgang mit dem PC sowie Bereitschaft zur Einarbeitung in spezifische Systeme (z. B. SAP/PM).
 Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse für den Arbeitsalltag sind für Dich eine Selbstverständlichkeit.
 Eine präzise, regelkonforme Arbeitsweise, hohes Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsbewusstsein sowie Kundenorientierung, Termintreue und Teamgeist zeichnet Dich aus.
 Zusätzliche Informationen 
 Diese Position ist auf 2 Jahre befristet.
 Deine Bewerbung 
 Ganz pragmatisch: 
 Bitte lade online nur Deinen Lebenslauf hoch.
 Zum aktuellen Zeitpunkt benötigen wir kein Motivationsschreiben, Zeugnisse oder Ähnliches.
 Bitte beachte vor Absendung der Bewerbung, dass im Nachgang keine weiteren Dokumente hinzugefügt werden können.
 Bewerbung möglich, solange die Stelle ausgeschrieben ist.
 Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!
 Your contact to us! With people. For people.
 Do you need further support?
 Please have a look at our FAQs, you will find them via https://careers.roche.com/global/en/faq .
 Who we are
 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
 Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

items.desc:
Job Description Summary 
The Drug Safety Scientist is a member of the Drug Safety & Risk Management (DS&RM) team, supporting proactive safety surveillance and risk management activities. The Drug Safety Scientist performs pharmacovigilance activities and prepares high-quality, submission-ready regulatory and safety documents within established timelines and in compliance with GE HealthCare business requirements, standard operating procedures, and applicable global and local regulatory requirements. 
The role provides scientific support to Medical Directors for the assessment of safety data from clinical trials and post-marketing experience and supports the EU QPPV in maintaining inspection readiness. Daily activities involve planning, conducting meetings, database searching, aggregate safety analysis and case level review, writing, and project management/coordination of strategic safety documents including aggregate reports (including PSURs/PBRERs, PADERs, IND-related reports, and DSURs). The Drug Safety Scientist partners closely with Medical Directors, the QPPV, internal cross-functional stakeholders, and external vendors to ensure timely and effective delivery of safety surveillance and risk management activities.
GE Healthcare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to improve lives in the moments that matter. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.
 Job Description 
 Primary responsibilities 
 Performs safety signal detection and evaluation using safety data and analytical tools to identify and assess potential signals, authors safety review documentation, and partners with cross-functional Safety Review Teams to develop data-driven recommendations and actions.
 Apply data analytics and visualization tools to create and interpret trending analyses, investigate significant changes in reporting patterns, and communicate actionable safety insights
 Authors, reviews, and coordinates high-quality safety content for clinical development and post-marketing regulatory documents, including clinical study protocols, DSURs, RMPs, Safety
 Management Plans, clinical study reports, PSURs/PBRERs, and medical expert statements.
 Gathers, analyzes, and evaluates relevant scientific and safety information to support the development and maintenance of reference safety information within Company Core Documents, including the CCDS and CCSI.
 Collaborates with PV Scientists and Medical Directors to provide scientific and medical input to responses to safety-related questions from regulatory authorities.
 Prepares or facilitates writing of accurate, medically sound and submission ready statements, safety assessments and benefit-risk evaluations within agreed time frames.
 Performs Medical Reviewer of Individual Case Safety Reports.
 Serves as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Global Pharmacovigilance and cross-functional teams on applicable ICH, EU, US, and other international clinical and post-marketing safety regulations, guidelines, and product-specific safety information.
 Other activities, special projects and assignments may be assigned where required. As a result, the percentage of time spent across roles for which the employee is responsible for or assisting others will vary depending on project assignments and the requirements within the department.
 Assist in creating and maintaining standard operating procedures and working practices to ensure inspection readiness and compliance with regulations and guidelines.
 Specific Qualifications: 
 Experience in drug safety risk management and pharmacovigilance (safety signal detection, data mining techniques, preparation risk management plans, aggregate reports and company core safety information). Relevant experience in clinical development or medical affairs in industry or with service provider will be considered.
 Highest Level of Education achieved : 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Life Sciences, Biological Sciences, Business/Data Analytics, Pharmacy, Nursing, or a related healthcare discipline.
 Required Competence/Work Experience/Skills: 
 Working knowledge in FDA, EU, ICH guidelines, initiatives and regulations governing pharmacovigilance.
 Minimum of 3+ years of validated experience working in safety &/or scientific activities in at least 3 of the following areas: Post-Marketing Surveillance (including signal detection & evaluation). Periodic Safety Reports (deliver strategy, preparation and authoring), DSURs, INDs, including data analysis
 Knowledge of safety systems (Argus & Veeva)
 Preferred Competence/Work Experience/Skills: 
 Good medical writing skills and ability to analyse safety data.
 Good communication skills.
 Good knowledge of PV regulations
 Strong ability to leverage AI and emerging digital tools to improve data analysis, automation, and operational efficiency.

items.title: Aircraft Control -Test engineer
items.card: Job Description: Airbus Commercial Aircraft is looking for an Aircraft Control - Test engineer (f/m) to join our Control Modelling, Simulation & V&V department based in Toulouse, France. ​You will be part of an integrated team and will work collaboratively with system designer teams and V&V test teams to coordinate the maturity testing activities of Aircraft control systems (Auto-flight ATA22, Flight Control ATA27)
items.desc:
Job Description: 
 Airbus Commercial Aircraft is looking for an Aircraft Control - Test engineer (f/m) to join our Control Modelling, Simulation & V&V department based in Toulouse, France. 
 ​You will be part of an integrated team and will work collaboratively with system designer teams and V&V test teams to coordinate the maturity testing activities of Aircraft control systems (Auto-flight ATA22, Flight Control ATA27) on a simulated platform (VSIM-D) on one or several programs. 
 Your working environment: 
 Global capital of aeronautics and European capital for space research, Toulouse is a dynamic city in the southwest of France served by an international airport. Ideally located between the Mediterranean sea and the Atlantic ocean and close to the Pyrenees mountains, it offers plenty of options for outdoor activities! 
 How we care for you: 
 Financial rewards: Attractive salary, agreements on success and profit sharing schemes, employee savings plan abounded by Airbus and employee stock purchase plan on a voluntary basis. 
 Work / Life Balance: Extra days-off for special occasions, holiday transfer option, a Staff council offering many social, cultural and sport activities and other services. 
 Wellbeing / Health: Complementary health insurance coverage (disability, invalidity, death). Depending on the site: health services center, concierge services, gym, carpooling application. 
 Individual development: Great upskilling opportunities and development prospects with unlimited access to +10.000 e-learning courses to develop your employability, certifications, expert career path, accelerated development programmes, national and international mobility. 
 You will be part of a supportive team who will support you upon your arrival with a specific learning path and all along your journey with us. 
 This position will offer the opportunity to discover/extend your knowledge on Aircraft Control systems and their development working in close collaboration with the designers. 
 The maturity tests are an essential step in the V&V process to ensure maturity of the final products. They allow testing and identifying/correcting potential defects in early stages of the development before the official test campaign. 
 Your challenges: 
 Prepare, perform Tests and associated analysis and investigation on simulated platform 
 Coordinate maturity tests activity on simulated platform: testing roadmap, workload estimation, test results report all along the development and for the dedicated milestones (ex: Flight Clearance) 
 Work in close collaboration with Design team and other testing teams 
 Participate to Testing tools development: Define & update Testing Tools needs, follow-up development and validation 
 Define, update and validate Testing Usage Domain 
 Support V&V manager/leader activities 
 Your boarding pass: 
 System Design and Development 
 Aircraft Control System knowledge 
 Test execution 
 Negotiation level of English (+ French will be a strong additional asset) 
 Knowledge which would facilitate job mission: 
 V&V Referentials (ARP4754, DO178 …) 
 Requirements and V&V management process 
 Required-based / Model-based engineering process (RBE/MBE) 
 Configuration process (GIT) 
 Change process (JIRA, Trackdev) 
 Designers evidences / documents 
 SAO/SCADE/SQUID-NG process 
 Tests management (MAGIC, LTM, JIRA XRAY, FTA-NG …) 
 DevOps 
 Test means (VSIM-D, SIMPA/OSMA, A/C 0 …) 
 This position requires a security clearance or will require being eligible for clearance by the recognized authorities.
 Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

items.desc:
Job Description: 
 Zur Unterstützung der Abteilung Test Means sucht Airbus Operations eine/n: 
 Electrical Lab Test Means Design & Build Engineer (d/f/m) 
 Als Lab Test Means Designer sind Sie verantwortlich für den Entwurf, die Spezifikation, Realisierung und Verifizierung der elektrischen Komponenten unserer Labor-Testeinrichtungen. Diese Prüfeinrichtungen werden später von Testingenieuren, Testpiloten und weiteren Kunden genutzt, um neue Flugzeugsysteme oder -funktionen zu integrieren und zu validieren. Wir decken alle Arten von Laborprüfständen ab – von Avionik- und mechanisch-physikalisch-hydraulischen Prüfständen bis hin zu virtuellen Plattformen. 
 Dein Standort 
 Bremen ist eine charmante, geschichtsträchtige Stadt im Nordwesten von Deutschland. Sie ist nicht nur eine der grünsten Städte des Landes, sondern bietet auch wunderbare Sehenswürdigkeiten, eine reiche Kultur, urbanes Flair und kulinarische Köstlichkeiten. Die Stadt ist auch ein großartiger Ort für Küstenliebhaber, da sie nur eine Autostunde von der Nordseeküste entfernt liegt. 
 Unsere Benefits für dich 
 Faire Vergütung & Extras: Attraktive Vergütung und individuelle Zusatzleistungen, z. B. betriebliche Vorsorgemodelle, Mobilitätsangebote (bspw. Fahrradleasing) oder Mitarbeitervorteile bei kooperierenden Unternehmen gemäß unseren jeweils gültigen Richtlinien. 
 Zeit für dich (und deine Angehörigen): 30 Tage Jahresurlaub gem. Tarifvertrag (35h/Woche); Vereinbarkeit von Familie & Beruf (Gleitzeit, mobiles Arbeiten, Teilzeit, Jobsharing, Sabbatical) 
 Weiterkommen leicht gemacht: Ausgezeichnete Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und internationale, konzernweite Entwicklungsperspektiven 
 Wohlfühlen am Arbeitsplatz: Betriebsarzt; umfassendes Gesundheitsangebot (Sportkurse, Präventionsangebote, uvm.), Kantine und Cafeteria, teils standortnaher Kindergarten 
 Vielfalt verbindet: Arbeiten in einem diversen Umfeld, mit mehr als 140 Nationalitäten, in dem Austausch, Unterstützung und Vielfalt gelebt wird 
 Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten 
 Sie dimensionieren und konzipieren neue Prüfeinrichtungen und -komponenten oder modifizieren und modernisieren bestehende Prüfstände, um auf Änderungen an den Flugzeugsystemen von Airbus zu reagieren. 
 Sie erarbeiten technische Lösungen sowie Konzepte, wenden elektrotechnische Konstruktionsprinzipien und Vorschriften an und stellen eine termingerechte, kosteneffiziente und qualitativ hochwertige Umsetzung sicher. 
 In Zusammenarbeit mit einer internationalen Abteilung an den Standorten Hamburg, Bremen, Toulouse und Filton integrieren Sie Technologien aus Forschungsprojekten in bestehende und neue Testanlagen – beispielsweise standardisierte Protokolle zur Kopplung von Prüfeinrichtungen, umfangreiche Tools zur Datenerfassung und -analyse, virtuelle Testumgebungen usw. 
 Sie leiten elektrische Designanforderungen und -lösungen aus Flugzeugspezifikationen und Systemtestanforderungen ab. 
 Sie erstellen technische Spezifikationen für Zukaufteile, unterstützen die Beschaffung und überwachen die Leistung der Lieferanten. 
 Sie tragen zur digitalen Transformation von Airbus bei, indem Sie neue Komponenten und Technologien einführen sowie bestehende Tools und Ressourcen anpassen. 
 Sie unterstützen den laufenden Betrieb der Prüfstände und übernehmen die Fehlersuche und -behebung (Troubleshooting). 
 Gewünschte Qualifikationen und Kenntnisse 
 Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Elektrotechnik, Elektronik oder vergleichbar – oder eine äquivalente Berufserfahrung / Qualifikation als Meistertechniker bzw. Industriemeister 
 Eine abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung als Elektriker/Elektroniker ist von Vorteil 
 Erste praktische Erfahrung in der Arbeit an elektrischen Anlagen 
 Erfahrung in Architektur, Design und Aufbau von Labor-Testmitteln (Lab Test Means) 
 Erfahrung in der Fehlersuche, Störungsbeseitigung und Fehlerursachenanalyse 
 Vertrautheit mit Vorschriften und Normen wie DGUV, VDE-Richtlinien und europäischen Richtlinien 
 Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse; Französischkenntnisse sind ein Plus 
 Freude an der Arbeit in einem agilen, dynamischen Umfeld 
 Bereitschaft zu regelmäßigen Dienstreisen nach Hamburg 
 Hohe Eigenmotivation, Engagement und eine proaktive Arbeitsweise 
 Erfüllen Sie nicht jedes Kriterium zu 100%? Kein Problem! Airbus fördert Ihr persönliches Wachstum mit maßgeschneiderten Entwicklungsangeboten. 
 Bringen Sie Ihre Karriere auf das nächste Level und bewerben Sie sich jetzt online!

Job Description: 
 Responsibilities - your mission 
 This position is in the Airline Operations Intelligence team whose main mission is to gather airline operational data from multiple sources, transform and augment it. It is then delivered to the Airbus internal departments such as aircraft program, engineering, marketing and strategy either as data products, or as reports or as dashboards. The quantity of data is in the big data perimeter with billions of data lines being analyzed.
 Your contribution will need to be perfectly in line with the project guidelines and ways of working. 
 You will create/maintain/optimise data pipelines, respecting state of the art practice. 
 You will create/maintain/optimise BI dashboards 
 You will create/maintain/optimize AI agents. 
 Most of your developments will be done on the Skywise/Palantir Foundry platform. 
 This role requires a very good understanding of distributed computations, data architecture and state of the art data engineering. 
 You will be joining a team of developers organised in Agile Scrum. 
 Your initiatives, reliability and ability to drive the project with your colleagues will determine your responsibilities and scopes over the years as we are flexible with these 
 Requirements - our ideal candidate will have 
 A master degree in engineering or computer science. 
 Several years (3+) of working experience as a data engineer with proven records of enormous data volume manipulation. 
 Excellent level in Python, pySpark and distributed computation. 
 Excellent understanding of AI solutions 
 Good understanding of time series processing 
 Qualifications/experience/knowledge of the airline industry is a major advantage. 
 Qualifications/experience/knowledge of data science is a major advantage. 
 English must be fluent. 
 We are looking for a candidate that is reliable and delivers without multiple reminders, that we can trust in sharing success but also difficulties and mistakes, that is willing to drive and take initiatives and share their knowledge. We are also looking for someone that values colleagues for their strengths. We also value very much the behaviour in a team including ability to contribute to a nice to work in atmosphere, to help colleagues and constructively push the team to improve. 
 Benefits - what’s in it for you 
 The chance to work in a multicultural environment. 
 The opportunity to grow your skills and capabilities thanks to our Airbus learning offer (digital solutions, classroom sessions, certified training....) and career opportunities across the globe. 
 A hybrid working model, allowing you to combine onsite and offsite work. 
 A modern office at Parque das Nacoes, well connected to public transportation. 
 A motivated and fun crew to grow and build and shape the GBS together. 
 An intense and exciting onboarding experience. 
 Work in a balanced environment: Beyond the many benefits offered to its employees, joining Airbus is also the guarantee of a respectable work-life balance. items.desc:
Job Description: 
 An opportunity for an Electrical & Wiring Manufacturing Engineer has arisen within Airbus Defence and Space , Getafe (Madrid). 
 The selected candidate will join the Manufacturing Engineering (ME) Team within the MRTT (Multi Role Tanker Transport) Program . Our multidisciplinary engineering team interfaces directly between Design Office and Production, driving the industrial conversion of civil A330-200 aircraft into world-class tanker variants across all MRTT Final Assembly Lines (FALs). 
 You will reinforce our industrialization and shop-floor enablement activities, playing a decisive role in defining robust industrial sequences, testing solutions, and technical dossier creation for electrical harnesses, wiring installations, and aircraft systems. 
 RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Industrialize Electrical & Wiring Dossiers: Define and deliver integrated Manufacturing Dossiers, technical wiring check job cards, and work orders across Series, Retrofit, Working Parties, and FTB (Flight Test Bed) aircraft. 
 Lead Production & Workshop Enablement: Support the electrical workshop (TPAP) and aircraft assembly lines (AG-2) with harness and control unit reworks, off-aircraft/on-aircraft troubleshooting, and automated wiring test data generation. 
 Resolve Technical Nonconformities (NCs): Investigate shop-floor discrepancies, author actionable nonconformity resolutions (HNCs), track design engineering changes (ERCs), and implement corrective job cards to eliminate bottlenecks. 
 Define Test Tooling & Industrial Means: Specify, adapt, and validate electrical test equipment, tooling, and PDU emissions in direct collaboration with the Test Means department. 
 Drive Design-to-Manufacturing Concurrence: Partner with the Design Office and external suppliers in model revisions (including F927 and wiring reviews) to integrate industrial constraints early into product definitions. 
 Foster Continuous Improvement & EHS: Implement Lean manufacturing standards, line balancing, and digital tool optimization, actively participating in SQCDP panels while strictly upholding environmental, health, and safety regulations. 
 SKILLS 
 Is your profile aligned to the following list of skills? Apply! We are looking forward to know you: 
 Education: Aerospace, Telecommunications or Industrial Engineering degree,with deep knowledge of electrical systems/installations. 
 Experience: At least 2-3 years of proven experience in Manufacturing Engineering specialised in wiring, within the aerospace, defense, automotive, or naval sectors. 
 Soft skills: Strong team spirit and collaborative mindset across cross-functional organizations, positive and constructive approach to conflict resolution, accountability, and strong KPI/performance focus. 
 Highly motivated, proactive, and result-oriented mindset , with a strong enthusiasm and commitment to the role. 
 Languages: Advanced / Professional lev el in English & Spanish (both written & spoken). 
 Technical knowledge: In-depth understanding of manufacturing and wiring processes, Lean Manufacturing principles, and root-cause analysis methodologies. Proficiency in CAD/CAM and engineering tools (such as CATIA, SAP, EPD, Sidie, or SNT or similar). 
 Valuable / Nice to have: Previous manufacturing engineering experience in electrical systems or EWIS within the aerospace industry. 
 Working knowledge of automated continuity measurement systems and electrical test equipment. 
 Hybrid working model: On-site presence is essential for this role due to close collaboration with manufacturing operations; remote work is limited to a maximum of 1 fixed day per week , agreed upon with the manager. 
 WHICH BENEFITS WILL YOU HAVE AS AIRBUS EMPLOYEE? 
 At Airbus we are focused on our employees and their welfare. Take a look at some of our social benefits: 
 Vacation days plus additional days-off along the year. 
 Attractive salary. 
 Hybrid model of working when possible, promoting the work-life balance. 
 Collective transport service in some sites. 
 Benefits such as health insurance, employee stock options, retirement plan, or study grants. 
 On-site facilities (among others): free canteen, kindergarten, medical office. 
 Possibility to collaborate in different social and corporate social responsibility initiatives. 
 Excellent upskilling opportunities and great development prospects in a multicultural environment. 
 Special rates in products & benefits.
