Job Description: 
 In order to support our structure development team, Airbus Aerostructures is looking for an 
 Airframe Design Approver (d/f/m) 
 Are you motivated to work in an international environment where collaboration is key? Here, you will be part of our dedicated team of development engineers in the fuselage area for the primary/secondary structure of all our commercial Airbus aircraft programs and their derivatives. You will therefore be involved with your expertise from the concept study through detailed design to certification. 
 This role is also available with reduced weekly hours and an adapted scope of tasks. 
 Your location 
 You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy. 
 Our Benefits for You 
 Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines. 
 Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities. 
 Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives. 
 Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations. 
 Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA. 
 Your tasks and responsibilities 
 Guarantee product quality and airworthiness by taking full responsibility for design approval according to established processes 
 Develop and optimize metal, composite, and hybrid components and assemblies with regard to weight, cost, performance, manufacturing, and assembly requirements. 
 Collaborate in multifunctional teams alongside structural analysis, production, program, project, configuration, and systems functions to achieve optimal technical solutions. 
 Evaluate design changes, estimate implementation efforts, and ensure full compliance with regulations, design principles, and guidelines. 
 Manage engineering partner and supplier activities, serving as their key technical contact. 
 Drive digitalization and automation innovations actively, taking all relevant regulations and stakeholders into account. 
 Desired skills and qualifications 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Aerospace or Mechanical Engineering (or a related discipline), or equivalent practical experience
 Initial experience in structural design 
 Solid understanding of metal, composite, and hybrid design principles, including manufacturing/assembly requirements and tolerance definition. 
 Practical knowledge in project management and motivation to work with agile methodologies. 
 Hands-on proficiency with CATIA V5, VPM and a PLM tool. 
 Collaborative mindset and strong communication skills to align diverse stakeholders, foster continuous improvement, and achieve team goals. Interest in both detailed work and the big picture. 
 Ideally experience in AI within the work context 
 Business-fluent communication skills in English; German proficiency is considered a strong plus.

items.desc:
Lieu : Toulouse, France 
 Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance 
 Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​
 Nos engagements, vos avantages 
 Notre savoir-faire technologique
 Notre attention portée à l’équilibre des collaborateurs
 Un environnement inclusif et bienveillant
 Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu (Thales Solidarity, indice CAC 40 ESG…)
 Votre quotidien 
Votre destination pour une maîtrise totale du ciel ! De la conception à l'installation, nous créons des systèmes de contrôle aérien de pointe ! Nous rendons l'accès à l'espace aérien fluide, équitable et durable. 
 Les orages ont un impact majeur sur la circulation aérienne. Lorsqu’un avion contourne une cellule orageuse, il quitte sa trajectoire prévue et augmente la charge de travail des contrôleurs aériens. Dans ce contexte, vous contribuez au développement d’un outil de prévision permettant d’anticiper les situations de surcharge des contrôleurs afin d’aider les responsables opérationnels à prendre les mesures adaptées. 
 En nous rejoignant, vos missions sont : 
 Modélisez les cellules orageuses et leur évolution temporelle dans un secteur de contrôle,
 Intégrez des données de trafic réel et les trajectoires des vols dans le modèle développé,
 Identifiez les vols susceptibles de modifier leur route pour contourner les zones orageuses,
 Analysez l’impact des déroutements sur la charge de travail des contrôleurs aériens,
 Évaluez les situations de surcharge et contribuez à l’amélioration des capacités d’anticipation opérationnelle. 
 Votre profil 
 Vous souhaitez effectuer un stage d'une durée de 6 mois minimum. Vous effectuez une formation de niveau Bac+5 en école d’ingénieur ou en formation universitaire de niveau Master 2, à dominante informatique ou intelligence artificielle.
 Vous avez des compétences en :
 Développement logiciel
 Modélisation algorithmique
 Intelligence artificielle
 Analyse de données
 Autonomie, rigueur, bon relationnel et curiosité technique sont des atouts que l'on vous reconnaît ? Alors ce poste est fait pour vous ! 
 Mot de l'équipe 
 Vous serez intégré au sein d’une équipe polyvalente qui regroupe des expertises métiers et techniques.
Tous nos stages sont conventionnés et soumis à une gratification dont le montant est déterminé selon votre niveau d’études. 
Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

items.desc:
About the job 
 Make global business travel simpler for colleagues, candidates and guests, balancing individual needs with company policy. As a Corporate Travel Coordinator in Bristol, you’ll provide hands-on support across Graphcore’s global travel operations.
 You’ll help employees and guests arrange journeys through our online booking tool and offline travel agents. Well-organised travel for candidates and new joiners will help create a positive first impression of Graphcore. You’ll also coordinate group travel that brings colleagues together for company events. Day to day, you’ll answer visa questions, arrange airport transfers and manage travel expense approvals. You’ll support the Travel Manager with ad-hoc projects and initiatives.
 Beyond travel, you’ll support the wider Chief Financial Officer’s team with administrative tasks. You’ll book training courses, support onboarding and help our Graphcare committee.
 The team and culture 
 You’ll join a growing travel team, supporting colleagues through the shared Travel inbox and Slack. You’ll take ownership of requests, respond promptly and use calm judgement when priorities change.
 You’ll stay informed about travel trends, policies and global mobility updates. Professional development and learning resources will help you build your skills.
 What we’re looking for 
 At least two years’ experience in a similar travel coordination support role in business travel and travel support.
 Calm judgement under pressure and the ability to adapt when travel plans or priorities change.
 Clear, empathetic and professional communication, with a focus on travellers’ needs.
 Strong organisation and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities independently.
 Proficiency in Microsoft Office and a willingness to learn travel booking tools.
 A proactive approach to teamwork, with the confidence to make decisions and take responsibility.
 Benefits 
 Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility
 Generous leave: Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work
 Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension
 Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success
 Workplace experience: Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day
 Peace of mind protection: Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones
 Electric Vehicle Scheme: Choose an electric vehicle and lease it through salary sacrifice
 Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme and dental cover
 We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.
 We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.
 Sponsorship 
 Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa applications for this role.
 Access to controlled technology 
 Some roles at Graphcore involve access to technology subject to U.S. export control regulations. Depending on the role, we may need to assess whether export authorisation is required, taking account of factors such as work location, citizenship and immigration status. Where authorisation is required, this may affect whether or when you can start the role. We’ll explain any relevant requirements during the recruitment process.
 Join the Team at Graphcore 
 Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.
 As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.
 Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings together deep expertise to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful progress in AI compute.
 Put your coordination skills to work keeping Graphcore’s global teams moving. Apply now to join our travel team in Bristol.

Who we are 
 Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards. 
 As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously. 
 We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.

 Stay up-to-date with the latest developments in robotics and mechanical design to incorporate cutting-edge technologies into our products.
 You should apply if you 
 Hold a bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field (Master’s preferred).

 Have experience with FEA, simulations, and mechanical stress analysis tools.
 Have hands-on experience with prototyping and testing.
 Are familiar with manufacturing processes such as CNC machining, 3D printing, sheet metal manufacturing and injection molding.
 Have excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and within a team.
 Have strong communication and collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams.
 Have experience with robotics, automation, or mechatronics systems is highly desirable.
 Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields

 Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward

At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn’t work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about

items.desc:
This is a graduate position within the QUEST programme, funded by the EOSC4ALL project of the European Commission. It is open to recent graduates in computer science, engineering or a related field. You do not need to tick every box or have every skill listed below, if you are motivated to learn, we encourage you to apply.
 Join CERN's Storage and Data Management Group and help evolve the storage systems behind the Large Hadron Collider (LHC), while learning large-scale storage, cloud-native technologies and open-source software with the support of an experienced team.
 You will work on CERNBox, the cloud storage used by the whole CERN community, from scientists to administrative staff. Your main task is to help make it interoperable with research infrastructures across Europe, through the Open Cloud Mesh (OCM) standard, and easy to deploy anywhere using Kubernetes. You will also explore how AI can help users find and use their data.
 If you enjoy open standards, open source and building tools that many institutions can adopt, this is the place for you! You will be supported by experienced colleagues and learn from the whole team.
 Your responsibilities 
 Develop and integrate backend and frontend software components.
 Package and deploy interoperable services in distributed environments.
 Support CERN community: you will join our operations team, troubleshooting incidents and supporting users.
 Contribute your code, features and fixes back to the CERNBox open-source projects, working alongside a broader open-source community.
 Work with partner institutions and research infrastructures across Europe to test, validate and refine these tools together.
 Support users and partner teams as they adopt these tools, helping with troubleshooting and guidance.
 Explore and prototype AI/ML capabilities for CERNBox, working with users to identify practical use cases. Prior AI/ML experience is welcome but not required.
 Your profile 
 Experience with backend development in Go, and an interest in full-stack development.
 Comfortable working in Linux environments and troubleshooting software and systems.
 Familiarity with frontend development, ideally using JavaScript/TypeScript and Vue.js.
 Software development experience from studies, projects, internships or open-source contributions, with a willingness to take ownership of features and to collaborate with others.
 Ability to collaborate with users, technical teams and external partners.
 Interest in open-source software, distributed systems and interoperability.
 Skills 
 Backend: Go and API development.
 Frontend: Modern frameworks such as Vue.js or similar technologies.
 Systems: Linux, troubleshooting and software integration.
 Cloud-native technologies: Containers, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm and CI/CD pipelines are an advantage.
 Collaboration: Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
 Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
 Eligibility criteria: 
 You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .
 You have a professional background in Computing Engineer (or a related field) and have either: a Master's degree with 2 to 6 years of post-graduation professional experience;
 or a PhD with no more than 3 years of post-graduation professional experience.
 You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

 Gestión de siniestros recobrables NO CONVENIO.

 Trasladar instrucciones al proveedor y velar su cumplimiento.

 Estudio de los protocolos y normativas establecidas y plantear, en su caso, mejoras de estos.
 Proponer también ideas para mejorar la simplificación de procesos o de cualquier otro aspecto que aporte valor.
 Tus habilidades y experiencias

 Licenciatura / Grado en Administración de empresas, económicas, derecho o similares.
 Experiencia demostrada de al menos 2 años en recobros a través del convenio SGR y en tramitación de recobros NO CONVENIO.
 Experiencia en herramientas de Office 365.
 Proactividad en la toma de decisiones, orientación al cliente y resolución de problemas.
 Habilidades comunicativas, relacionales y de trabajo en equipo.

items.desc:
Job Summary 
 Zurich Insurance Europe AG is looking for a Personal Lines Agent in Wexford to join on a 12 month fixed term contract. 
 The role itself will focus on understanding what matters to Zurich customers; Meeting customer demands is a key part of our roles. 
Zurich offers you the ability to expand your knowledge base and create a career within General Insurance. 
 This role may be available part-time or full time. This is because we want the best people for our roles, and we recognise that sometimes those people aren’t available full-time. Please talk to us at interview about the flexibility you may need. 
 Your Role 
 As a Personal Lines Agent your main responsibilities will include, but not necessarily be limited to, the following: 
 -Deliver telephone-based support to customers on all aspects of general insurance underwriting 
 -Respond to customer queries relating to our products (home, motor & van) in a timely and efficient manner – striving to exceed quality customer service 
 -Retain current customers in line with challenging business targets 
 -Identify upsell opportunities for additional policy benefits 
 -Contact targeted renewals to drive retention targets 
 -Build rapport & relationship with our potential and existing customers 
 -Identify cross-selling prospects for additional products and arrange follow-up calls with customers for future sales opportunities 
 -Focus on the achievement of challenging service levels with customer centricity crucial to all processes 
 Your Skills and Experience 
 As a Personal Lines Agent your skills and qualifications will include: 
 -Excellent phone manner & communication skills 
 -Good IT Skills (use of MS Office Products) 
 -Minimum of 2 H5's or higher level C3's in the Leaving Certificate (or equivalent) or Third Level Qualification (minimum level 6 standard) or relevant work experience Experience in similar work environment – dealing with customers 
 -Experience within the insurance industry would be an advantage 
 -Completed or be in the process of completing CIP as a minimum and / or ACII qualification 
 -Demonstrate excellent verbal & written communication skills 
 -Have attention to details, ability to interpret data and ability to follow work through 
 -Have the ability to prioritise and manage own work while considering the greater impact on the team 
 -Have an enthusiastic, professional, positive and flexible approach that includes the ability to self-motivate 
 -Build rapport with our customers quickly & put the customer at the centre of everything we do 
 -Be resilient in the nature of our work and adapt to changing conditions 
 -Have good negotiation skills to close renewal offer & be target focused. 
 -Have quick learning capabilities and an aptitude for understanding the variable elements of insurance products 
 -Demonstrate solution focus in approach to work and dealing with stakeholders 
 Additional Information 
 Position is Wexford-based but occasional travel may be required to other Zurich locations. 
 If you value an exciting and varied working environment and meet the above requirements, then our recruiter is looking forward to receiving your application by clicking on the button “Apply online”. 
 Who We Are 
 Zurich is one of Ireland's leading insurance companies providing a wide range of general insurance and life insurance products and services. The company employs over 1,000 people across its locations in Dublin and Wexford. 
 Zurich is a strong brand – with our 53,000 employees worldwide form the basis of our success, helping our customers in 210 countries and territories to understand and protect themselves from risk. In order to deliver our services, we offer our employees flexible working models and interesting opportunities for further training & development. As a Zurich employee you benefit from a multitude of advantages as well as a strong culture, characterized by acceptance, diversity and team spirit. 
 At Zurich, we foster a culture of diversity and inclusion. Our purpose and values are designed to protect, inspire confidence and help our employees reach their full potential. We value and defend what is right and promote opportunities for equity among our professionals, regardless of gender, disability, LGBTQ +, race, ethnicity, generations, belief, etc. Join Zurich and be part of this culture. Together we are committed to delivering on our purpose - Let’s Create a Brighter Future Together!

Ils·Elles
items.desc:
Mission
 Avec plus de 100 apprenti·es en formation dans une douzaine de professions, l’EPFL est une entreprise formatrice à part entière.
Quel que soit l’apprentissage choisi à l’EPFL, les apprenti·es réalisent leur formation professionnelle dans un environnement hors du commun composé de laboratoires de recherche dans des domaines aussi variés que l’ingénierie, les sciences exactes et l’architecture. Ils·Elles bénéficient de tout le dynamisme et la diversité d’un campus universitaire qui leur offre de nombreuses perspectives, d’avantages et possibilités d’épanouissement personnel.
 À l’École polytechnique fédérale de Lausanne (EPFL), vous avez la possibilité de vous lancer dans un apprentissage passionnant dans le domaine de l’automatisation, comme automaticienne ou automaticien. 
 🎥 Rencontre avec Maël, apprenti Lab 
 Principales tâches et responsabilités
 À l’EPFL, l’apprentie automaticienne ou l'apprenti automaticien découvrira un métier complet mêlant mécanique, électronique et informatique industrielle. Il ou elle participera à la fabrication de pièces mécaniques, aussi bien par usinage manuel que sur machines-outils. La formation comprendra également le câblage et le montage de platines électriques, ainsi que l’installation, la mise en service et le dépannage de machines automatisées, notamment de robots et de systèmes robotisés.
L’apprenti·e sera amené·e à concevoir des composants mécaniques et à réaliser des prototypes à l’aide d’outils de modélisation 3D (CAO) et d’impression 3D. Il ou elle développera et programmera des automates industriels (PLC) et participera à l’intégration de systèmes automatisés spécialisés, incluant des capteurs intelligents, des entraînements électriques et des robots.
Au fil de sa formation, l’apprenti·e apprendra à analyser le fonctionnement global d’une installation, à diagnostiquer et corriger des pannes, à optimiser les performances et à appliquer les normes de sécurité et de qualité.
L’environnement de travail est innovant et en constante évolution, au cœur de la recherche de pointe. L’automatisation progressant rapidement, l’apprenti·e aura l’opportunité de se familiariser avec les technologies émergentes tout en développant des compétences concrètes, interdisciplinaires et très recherchées dans un secteur passionnant et tourné vers l’avenir.
 Cette année, nous publions une place d'apprentissage dans l’atelier SV-IN (School of Life Sciences – Infrastructure) – L’atelier SV-IN assure la maintenance, la réparation et le suivi technique des équipements scientifiques de la Faculté des sciences de la vie (SV) de l’EPFL - https://www.epfl.ch/schools/sv/sv-in/ 
 Profil
 Afin de compléter la procédure de postulation, merci d'ajouter à votre postulation : 
 lettre de motivation
 curriculum vitae avec indication de références
 copie de vos bulletins scolaires des 3-4 derniers semestres
 copies de vos certificats, diplômes obtenus, attestations de stages
 Nous offrons
 En devenant apprenti·e à l’EPFL, vous bénéficierez de :
 un environnement de travail exceptionnel
 6 semaines de vacances quel que soit votre âge
 un salaire supérieur aux propositions du canton
 une aide une aide au financement des trajets en transports publics 
 l’accès aux modules de formation spécifiques, proposés par l’EPFL aux apprenti·es, pour travailler sur l’autonomie, la responsabilisation et le succès de l’apprentissage
 l’accès au centre sportif et aux différentes activités qui y sont proposées
 Informations
 Date d'entrée en fonction : 16 Aout 2027
 Nous organiserons des stages de sélection au cours du premier trimestre.
 Durée : 4 ans

items.desc:
Voor onze team in regio Mechelen te ondersteunen zijn we vandaag op zoek naar een FLYING AUDICIEN - VLIEGENDE AUDIOLOOG. 
 Voor onze hoorcentra en verkooppunten in de regio van Mechelen zoeken we versterking. Als flying audicien/vliegende audioloog vlieg je uit naar verschillende locaties. Met jouw expertise lever je een toegevoegde waarde aan elk team waar je neerstrijkt. Zo draag jij bij aan onze ambitie om voor onze klanten de meest geschikte hooroplossing te vinden.
 Met je diploma Audiologie (BA of MA), een RIZIV nummer op zak én een stevige portie empathie sta jij te popelen om iedereen die onze hoorcentra binnenkomt, verder te helpen.
 Herken jij je hierin:
 Jij brengt een pak ervaring als audioloog/audicien binnen in ieder team. Je ziet snel waar verbeteringen mogelijk en zinvol zijn, en deelt enthousiast best practices met het team. 
 Dag in dag uit hetzelfde traject? Nee dankje! Werken in wisselende omgevingen is wat jou gelukkig maakt. 
 Je bent je bewust van groepsdynamiek. Ieder team heeft z’n eigenheid maar jij vindt makkelijk je plek binnen elk team. 
 Oog voor detail, dat heb jij. En dat zal van pas komen bij het uitvoeren van verschillende geavanceerde audiometrische testen om de meeste geschikte hooroplossing voor te stellen.
 Nieuwe technieken zoals remote fitting toepassen, daar word jij helemaal warm van vanbinnen. 
 Verantwoordelijkheid nemen is voor jou een evidentie. Wij kunnen op beide oren slapen, jij volgt het gehele proces op van A tot Z.
 Nog steeds enthousiast? 
Weet dat je komt werken bij de marktleider van hooroplossingen in België, met meer dan 270 hoorcentra in België en meer dan 70 jaar expertise, die op zijn beurt behoort tot de Sonova Group, de belangrijkste fabrikant van hooroplossingen ter wereld.
 Bovendien bieden wij je:
 Een contract van onbepaalde duur met start zo snel mogelijk.
 Extralegale voordelen zoals maaltijdcheques, ADV-dagen, groepsverzekering en hospitalisatieverzekering, een GSM, een flex income plan, een laptop en een bedrijfswagen.
 Verder krijg je ook een gepersonaliseerd ontwikkelingsplan met kwalitatieve coaching en feedbackmomenten om je professionele vaardigheden te ontwikkelen.
 De garantie dat je écht een verschil kan maken voor mensen met gehoorverlies. Hoe geweldig is dat?
 #LI-TW1 
 #Lapperre

 Strong understanding of data warehouse concepts , data modeling, and structured data workflows.
 Proficient in SQL and working with large, complex datasets.
 Experience integrating data from ERP systems including SAP and MES platforms .

 Ability to work independently and collaboratively with technical and business teams.
 Strong attention to detail and a structured approach to problem solving.

• Understanding of data governance concepts, data validation tools, or metadata management practices.
• Exposure to CI/CD practices or scripting using Databricks CLI or APIs.
• Previous experience in a manufacturing environment or with industrial data systems.

items.desc:
Your contribution to something big: 
 You will contribute to an industrial research project focused on the investigation and characterization of sustainable materials for air-to-water heat pump applications. You will combine experimental work, data analysis, and model-based methods to evaluate materials and components, supporting the development of improved acoustic and functional performance. Your main responsibilities will be: 
 Material Investigation & Characterization: Investigate, characterize, and analyze materials for heat pump applications, evaluating relevant material properties and their potential impact on system performance. 
 Acoustic Characterization: Perform acoustic characterization of materials and components, assessing their behaviour and contribution to the acoustic performance of heat pump systems. 
 Sustainability Assessment: Investigate and assess material sustainability based on available databases, material properties, and applicable sustainability requirements. 
 Simulation & Model-Based Methods: Apply model-based methods and simulation tools to analyse and support improvements in acoustic performance. 
 Experimental Testing: Prepare experimental setups, perform testing activities, and carry out data acquisition to support material and component evaluation. 
 Test Planning: Define and elaborate structured test plans and experiments to evaluate the acoustic properties and performance of components used in heat pump systems. 
 Data Analysis & Documentation: Analyse experimental and simulation data and prepare clear technical documentation, translating results into relevant insights to support engineering decisions.
What distinguishes you: 
 Education: Master's degree or PhD in Materials Science, Materials Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Physics, or a comparable technical field. 
 Material Expertise: Knowledge of material characterization, including relevant material properties and sustainability-related requirements. 
 Acoustic Knowledge: Good understanding of acoustic principles and wave propagation, with an interest in applying this knowledge to engineering applications. 
 Testing & Experimentation: Understanding of testing techniques and methodologies, with experience in preparing experimental setups, performing tests, and defining structured test plans. 
 Data Acquisition & Analysis: Experience with data acquisition and analysis, with the ability to interpret experimental results and support technical conclusions. 
 Technical Knowledge: Understanding of rotating machines and experience working with hardware and/or laboratory testing activities. 
 Digital Tools: Good knowledge of Microsoft Office tools, particularly Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and OneNote. Experience with MATLAB and/or Simulink for engineering, testing, or simulation activities. 
 Working Style: Structured, proactive, and detail-oriented, with the ability to take responsibility for your own work and independently propose solutions. 
 Teamwork & Communication: Strong communication and organizational skills, with the ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary engineering team.

Your contribution to something big: 
 You will contribute to an industrial research project focused on the development and optimization of heat pump systems. You will support the evaluation of innovative designs, components, and material applications through laboratory testing, with a strong focus on refrigeration circuits, system performance, efficiency, sound, and control logic. Your main responsibilities will be: 
 Refrigeration System Testing: Plan and perform development tests on refrigeration circuits and components, considering system operating envelopes and focusing on product performance, efficiency, sound, and control logic. 
 Test Planning & Execution: Create structured test plans, prepare laboratory activities, execute development tests, and document results in accordance with applicable standards and internal requirements. 
 Component Validation: Test and validate refrigeration components and technical concepts to support the development of efficient and reliable heat pump solutions. 
 Heat Pump Performance Assessment: Evaluate heat pump requirements and system behaviour to support the development and optimization of new technical concepts and solutions. 
 Technical Specifications: Create, review, and interpret technical specifications for refrigeration components and support their application within heat pump systems. 
 Laboratory Testing : Prepare test setups, handle samples, and use laboratory equipment and data acquisition tools to conduct development testing. 
 Test Data Analysis: Analyse and interpret experimental results, identify relevant findings, and clearly document conclusions to support engineering decisions. 
 Technical Documentation: Document test procedures, results, and findings, ensuring accuracy, traceability, and clear communication within the development team.
What distinguishes you: 
 Education: Master’s degree or PhD in Mechanical Engineering, Physics Engineering, or a comparable technical field. 
 Thermodynamics & Fluid Mechanics: Strong knowledge of thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, and refrigeration systems. 
 Refrigeration Systems: Good understanding of the specification, calculation, design, and testing of refrigeration systems and components. 
 Testing & Experimentation: Experience handling samples, preparing test setups, and conducting tests in a laboratory environment. 
 Data Analysis: Ability to analyse and interpret test results and translate findings into clear technical conclusions and documentation. 
 Standards: Knowledge of European standards applicable to refrigeration systems and heat pumps is considered a plus. 
 Digital Tools: Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools, particularly Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and OneNote. Experience with MATLAB and/or Simulink in engineering or laboratory environments. 
 Problem Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a results-oriented mindset and strong attention to detail. 
 Working Style: Proactive and responsible, with the ability to independently organize your work, take ownership of assigned activities, and propose solutions.

 Experience with hardware procurement, contract negotiations, large-scale device provisioning, refresh, return, and retirement processes .

Als Digital Solutions Engineer (w/m/div.) bist du verantwortlich für den Entwurf und das Design der gesamten Software- und Datenarchitektur von der Datenquelle bis zur finalen Anwendungsoberfläche, wobei du die Technologieführung bei der Auswahl passender Datenbanken, Frameworks und Schnittstellen übernimmst.
 Du implementierst robuste Datenpipelines für strukturierte Datenextraktions-, Transformations- und Ladeprozesse, entwickelst moderne Full-Stack-Webanwendungen und automatisierst sich wiederholende Prozesse mithilfe von robotergestützter Prozessautomatisierung oder modernen Low-Code-Tools, wie zum Beispiel Automation Anywhere, Outsystems oder n8n.

 Du steuerst und koordinierst externe technische Spezialistinnen und Spezialisten, beispielsweise für komplexe Modelle der Künstlichen Intelligenz oder die IT-Sicherheit, und integrierst deren „Blackbox“-Komponenten sicher, reibungslos und nahtlos in unsere bestehende IT-Architektur.

 Erfahrungen und Know-how : nachweisbare Erfahrung im Entwurf von End-to-End Software- und Datenarchitekturen, praktische Expertise in der Full-Stack-Webentwicklung (im Bosch-Kontext idealerweise JS, Angular, Node.js oder Python-Backends) und der Entwicklung von REST-APIs, Erfahrung im Aufbau und Betrieb von Datenpipelines (ETL/ELT) sowie in der Anbindung von Quellsystemen (z. B. SAP, SQL, NoSQL), fundierte Kenntnisse im Bereich DevOps, insbesondere mit Containerisierung (Docker) und CI/CD-Pipelines (z. B. via Azure DevOps), praktische Erfahrung in der Prozessautomatisierung mit RPA-Tools (z. B. ¿Quiénes somos? 
 Telefónica Servicios Audiovisuales (TSA) es la compañía del Grupo Telefónica creadora de soluciones audiovisuales broadcast desde 1993. 
 Con sede central en España y oficina en Latinoamérica, TSA destaca por su carácter internacional ofreciendo servicios y soluciones broadcast y multimedia en cualquier parte del mundo. Ofrecemos soluciones de consultoría, diseño e integración de proyectos audiovisuales broadcast end-to-end, soluciones integrales para la producción de televisión, proyectos de innovación como los basados en IA y servicios de plataformas de video DTH, IPTV, OTT, emisión de canales, etc. Nuestros proyectos y servicios se complementan además con formación, coaching y soporte con diferentes niveles de servicio. 
 También gestionamos el mayor telepuerto totalmente privado de España, mediante el cual se distribuyen más de 700 canales de televisión y radio, además de ofrecer accesos a Internet, Starlink, LAN, Voz IP y datos. 
 Nuestra experiencia se ha forjado a lo largo de los años a través del diseño, ejecución y soporte de numerosos proyectos y servicios, tanto propios como de nuestros clientes. 
 Creemos en la orientación al cliente, la innovación y la flexibilidad, y nuestro compromiso es promover soluciones tecnológicas para nuestros clientes, que se ajusten a las necesidades cambiantes de un mundo audiovisual en constante evolución. 
 Misión 
 La principal misión será dar soporte y acompañamiento a las Unidades de Negocio, asegurando el seguimiento económico de las distintas líneas de actividad y la gestión integral de las licitaciones públicas, aportando información y análisis para facilitar la toma de decisiones de la Dirección, las funciones a realizar serán: 
 ¿Cuáles serán tus principales funciones? 
 Gestión integral de licitaciones públicas: preparación y presentación de la documentación administrativa en las plataformas electrónicas de contratación, control de plazos, atención a requerimientos y subsanaciones, y seguimiento de adjudicaciones. 
 Coordinación con las distintas áreas implicadas para la recopilación de la documentación exigida en las ofertas y en las propuestas de adjudicación. 
 Seguimiento de la cartera e ingresos de arrastre, así como de la contratación y la venta nueva y su devengo en ingresos, por Unidad de Negocio. 
 Consolidación de arrastre y venta nueva para la elaboración de la previsión de cierre del ejercicio (forecast) y de las estimaciones de cierre oficiales. 
 Seguimiento presupuestario y control de costes; elaboración y análisis de los cierres mensuales frente a presupuesto y previsión de cierre, con análisis cualitativo de las desviaciones. 
 Elaboración de reporting de gestión y cuadros de mando para el equipo de Dirección. 
 Interlocución entre las Unidades de Negocio y el área de Control de Gestión para garantizar la integración y coherencia de la información. 
 Impulso de la automatización y digitalización de los procesos de reporting y de las tareas recurrentes del área 
 ¿Qué necesitamos de ti? 
 Idiomas: 
 Valorable inglés nivel intermedio, mínimo B1 (hablado y escrito). Deseable C1. 
 Experiencia: 
 Se valorará experiencia en control de gestión, análisis financiero y gestión de licitaciones públicas realizando las siguientes funciones: 
 Planificación y seguimiento presupuestario, control de costes y análisis de desviaciones. 
 Elaboración de previsiones de cierre (forecast), estimaciones de cierre y reporting de gestión. 
 Preparación y presentación de ofertas en licitaciones públicas. 
 Interlocución con Unidades de Negocio y equipos de Dirección. 
 Conocimientos Técnicos: 
 Valorable conocimiento en herramientas de análisis y gestión empresarial, así como en contratación pública, tales como: 
 Excel avanzado (tablas dinámicas, fórmulas avanzadas, Power Query). 
 SAP. 
 Herramientas de visualización y automatización (Power BI, Power Automate, macros/VBA o similares). 
 Plataformas electrónicas de contratación pública y normativa de contratación del sector público (Ley 9/2017, de Contratos del Sector Público). 
 Herramientas de IA generativa aplicadas a la productividad (p. ej., Microsoft Copilot). 
 Fundamentos de control de gestión: presupuestación, cuenta de resultados, costes y rentabilidad. 
 Aptitudes: 
 Alta capacidad analítica y visión de negocio. 
 Excelentes habilidades de comunicación e interlocución, con capacidad para trabajar de forma transversal y generar red con las diferentes áreas. 
 Rigor, atención al detalle y capacidad de organización para gestionar plazos y prioridades. 
 Mentalidad de mejora continua y orientación a la automatización y la digitalización. 
 Actitud positiva, proactividad y trabajo en equipo. 
 Curiosidad, ganas de aprender y compromiso. 
 Ventajas de formar parte de nuestro equipo: 
 Contrato Indefinido. 
 Cuidamos la flexibilidad , posicionándonos como referente en nuevas formas de trabajo , horarios, jornadas y medidas de conciliación. 
 Disponibilidad de activar el plan de pensiones …

items.desc:
En Movistar Plus+ buscamos un/a Jefe/a de Compra de Derechos para liderar la adquisición de contenidos de producción ajena y contribuir de forma decisiva a la estrategia de contenido de la plataforma.
 Buscamos un perfil con sólida experiencia en la industria audiovisual, visión estratégica del negocio y gran capacidad de negociación, que quiera participar en un entorno dinámico, transversal y orientado a resultados.
 ¿Qué harás en esta posición? 
Liderarás la adquisición de contenidos de terceros para la plataforma, conciliando las necesidades de programación con los principios de negocio de Movistar Plus+, y definiendo en cada caso la mejor estrategia de negociación. Además, tendrás un papel relevante en el desarrollo de alianzas 360, identificando oportunidades y riesgos asociados a la compra de derechos.
 Entre tus principales responsabilidades estarán la gestión de la relación con distribuidores nacionales e internacionales, la coordinación con las distintas áreas implicadas en el proceso de adquisición hasta la firma de contrato y emisión del contenido, la definición de modelos económicos y la planificación presupuestaria de adquisiciones. También impulsarás el seguimiento de KPIs de rendimiento y la elaboración de informes ejecutivos que apoyen la toma de decisiones, así como la coordinación y gestión de equipos.
 Qué buscamos 
Profesionales con al menos 8 años de experiencia en la industria audiovisual , gestionando la adquisición de contenidos de distintos géneros, como cine, series o documentales. Es imprescindible aportar experiencia previa en operadores de televisión de pago y/o plataformas o canales de TV , así como un conocimiento sólido del mercado de adquisición de contenidos y de sus principales distribuidores, tanto en el ámbito nacional como internacional.
 Valoraremos formación universitaria en ADE o similar , Ingeniería Superior y/o MBA .
 Competencias clave 
Visión estratégica del negocio audiovisual, capacidad de análisis y síntesis, negociación, iniciativa en la toma de decisiones, orientación a resultados, liderazgo, transversalidad, comunicación, trabajo en equipo, capacidad de conceptualización y un nivel de inglés muy alto .
 Si te motiva formar parte de un proyecto de referencia en el sector audiovisual y contribuir a construir la mejor propuesta de contenidos para nuestros clientes, nos encantará conocerte.

Conectamos el presente. Transformamos el futuro.

 Con una trayectoria de más de 100 años, trabajamos cada día para que la innovación esté al servicio de la sociedad, impulsando una transformación digital responsable, sostenible y con impacto real.

TELEFÓNICA EDUCACIÓN DIGITAL, S.L.U. es una empresa del Grupo Telefónica, especializada en ofrecer soluciones integrales de aprendizaje online para la Educación y Formación, con más de 15 años de experiencia en el mercado nacional e internacional, Telefónica Educación Digital desarrolla procesos de aprendizaje de alto impacto en personas y organizaciones. B uscamos personas con inquietudes con ganas de aprender y desarrollarse en un entorno de trabajo que valora la participación activa de ideas nuevas, para incorporarse a un equipo profesional consolidado y pionero en el aprendizaje online 
 Su sede central está ubicada en España, dentro del Distrito Telefónica en Madrid. 
 Estamos en la búsqueda de un/a Desarrollador/a Full Stack con especialización en Moodle para unirse a nuestro equipo. La persona ideal deberá contar con una sólida experiencia en desarrollo de soluciones PHP, un profundo conocimiento de Moodle y habilidades avanzadas en seguridad web y estándares web. Esta posición es perfecta para un/a profesional apasionado/a por la tecnología y la educación, dispuesto/a a enfrentar retos y contribuir a proyectos innovadores.
 PUESTO : Desarrollador/a Full Stack especializado en Moodle - Talent Pool 
 Vacante no activa, Cuando estemos en búsqueda activa, valoraremos las candidaturas. 
 Funciones 
 Para esta posición buscamos un/a profesional con un mínimo de 3 años de experiencia en el desarrollo de soluciones en PHP y un profundo conocimiento de Moodle, especialmente en sus últimas versiones, incluyendo Moodle 4.x. Debe ser capaz de desarrollar plugins y temas avanzados, optimizar el rendimiento de la plataforma y asegurar la integración con servicios externos. Además, debe estar familiarizado/a con las mejores prácticas de programación, seguridad web y estándares web.
 Buscamos una persona proactiva, con habilidades para trabajar de manera autónoma y en equipo, con una mentalidad de mejora continua y aprendizaje. Debe tener un enfoque analítico y orientado a la resolución de problemas, además de excelentes habilidades de comunicación para colaborar eficazmente con otros departamentos y partes interesadas.
 Formación Requerida 
 Grado en Informatica
 Valorable especialización
 Competencias Genéricas 
 Trabajo en equipo
 Proactividad
 Capacidad de adaptación
 Conocimientos Técnicos e informáticos 
 Conocimientos en Moodle.
 PHP 8.X, JavaScript moderno (promesas, manejo asíncrono, funciones de flecha, destructuración, módulos ES6, manejo del DOM, frameworks como React, Angular, Vue.js), HTML5, CSS3, SASS, frameworks MVC de PHP (Laravel, CodeIgniter, Symfony), bases de datos MySQL/PostgreSQL, aplicaciones SPA's.
 Familiaridad con LAMP/MAMP, uso de Docker, soluciones de alta disponibilidad y concurrencia, sistemas de caché (Redis, Elasticsearch).
 Programación orientada a objetos y principios SOLID, patrones de diseño y arquitectura avanzada, TDD (PHPUnit), BDD (Behat), herramientas de prueba de rendimiento (JMeter), estándares web y accesibilidad (W3C).
 Conocimiento Técnico: Desarrollo de plugins, personalización del núcleo, resolución de problemas en PHP, gestión de bases de datos MySQL/PostgreSQL, personalización de UI con HTML/CSS/JavaScript, uso de AJAX y APIs de Moodle.
 Desarrollo de Plugins y Temas: Creación de plugins personalizados y temas, uso de Mustache.
 Administración: Instalación y configuración, administración de usuarios, roles y permisos, implementación de medidas de seguridad, copias de seguridad y recuperación
 Optimización y Rendimiento: Técnicas de optimización, monitoreo y escalabilidad.
 Integración: Integración con LMS, ERPs, CRMs, uso de web services.
 Metodologías y Buenas Prácticas: Metodologías ágiles (Scrum, Kanban), uso de Git, prácticas de pruebas unitarias y de integración, documentación clara y útil.
 Amplio conocimiento funcional de la solución.
 Experiencia Profesional 
 Entre 3 y 5 años en desarrollo en Moodle.

 Modelo híbrido de trabajo: Cuidamos la flexibilidad, posicionándonos como referente en nuevas formas de trabajo, horarios, jornadas y medidas de conciliación.

items.title: Licensed Optician - Dublin, OH - LensCrafters
items.card: RESPONSIBILITIES • Welcome all customers, set expectations with customers • Custom fit glasses & precisely place prescription in lenses • Acts as a leader in optical acumen • Take & record measurements, accurately adjust/fit eyewear with attention to detail, ensure finished eyewear meets standards & customer needs • Assists team with complex product needs & prescriptions • Accurate & thorough use of technology
items.desc:
Requisition ID: 925220 
 Store # : 008793 Lenscrafters 
 Position: Part-Time
 Total Rewards: Benefits/Incentive Information 
 LensCrafters is a place for visionaries. We’ve got a vision for pairing state-of-the-art technology with a truly personal approach to eye care. 
Everything we do is centered around sight. Because quality care helps us see the joy in life. Because learning from the best, makes us all better. Because continuing our legacy of the highest optical standards helps us innovate the future in optical care. 
 At LensCrafters, we want every person who enters our doors to feel our passion for care. And that's why we’re committed to taking care of you, so you can bring the best quality experience to our patients and customers. 
 LensCrafters is part of EssilorLuxottica, a global leader in the design, manufacture and distribution of world-class vision care products, including iconic eyewear, advanced lens technology and cutting-edge digital solutions. Join our global community of over 200,000 dedicated employees around the world in driving the transformation of the eyewear and eyecare industry. Discover more by following us on LinkedIn! 
 The Licensed Optician delivers the brand value proposition & helps establish LensCrafters as the premier destination for all vision needs within the community. Creates exceptional value in the lives of customers by delivering legendary customer service & perfectly crafted high quality eyewear which exceeds our customers’ expectations. 
 MAJOR DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES
 • Welcome all customers, set expectations with customers
• Custom fit glasses & precisely place prescription in lenses
• Acts as a leader in optical acumen
• Take & record measurements, accurately adjust/fit eyewear with attention to detail, ensure finished eyewear meets standards & customer needs
• Assists team with complex product needs & prescriptions
• Accurate & thorough use of technology despite time pressure & customer volume, exceptional product knowledge, use of appropriate tools
• Proactive, explores root cause of issues, forward thinking, ensures customers are satisfied & expectations are exceeded, solution driven
• Ability to multi-task, prioritize & manage time with competing priorities
• Strive to achieve exceptional results on Brand KPIs & competencies
• Take pride in store appearance, help to keep store clean, attractive & organized
• Inform management of safety opportunities; demonstrates safe work practices
• Resourceful, self-motivated with a desire for continual learning, improvement & results
• Adhere to company policies & procedure, including discounts, promotions & inventory management
 BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
 • High School graduate or equivalent
• State Licensure 
• Optical dispensing experience 
• Strong customer service skills: communicator, listener & team builder
• Knowledge of current store merchandise
• Strong basic math skills
• Awareness of current fashion trends
• Selling skills – ability to use & carry an iPAD/tablet
• Familiarity with POS, computers & calculators
• Embrace new technology & change
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
 • Previous customer service & retail experience
 This posting is for an existing vacancy within our business. Employee pay is determined by multiple factors, including geography, experience, qualifications, skills and local minimum wage requirements. In addition, you may also be offered a competitive bonus and/or commission plan, which complements a first-class total rewards package. Benefits may include health care, retirement savings, paid time off/vacation, and various employee discounts.
 EssilorLuxottica complies with all applicable laws related to the application and hiring process. If you would like to provide feedback regarding an active job posting, or if you are an individual with a disability who would like to request a reasonable accommodation, please call the EssilorLuxottica SpeakUp Hotline at 844-303-0229 (be sure to provide your name, job id number, and contact information so that we may follow up in a timely manner) or email HRCompliance@luxotticaretail.com .

Ponúkame flexibilný spôsob práce – kde to povaha pozície umožňuje, zamestnanci si sami volia, kedy pracujú z domu a kedy z kancelárie. Technológie vnímame ako kľúč k budúcnosti – neustále hľadáme digitálne riešenia, ktoré zjednodušujú prácu a posúvajú nás vpred. Podporujeme vzdelávanie – nielen v oblasti odbornosti, ale aj osobnostného rastu a rozvoja ľudského potenciálu. Uvedomujeme si význam duševného zdravia – preto ponúkame komplexné programy a benefity, ktoré pomáhajú našim kolegom udržiavať psychickú pohodu a rovnováhu. U nás robíme maximum pre to, aby sme vytvárali zdravé, moderné a spokojné pracovné prostredie. Ak chcete byť našou súčasťou, určite sa nám ozvite. 
 Platové podmienky 
 1 500 EUR/mesiac
 Štartovacia základná mzda je 1 300 EUR + mesačné provízie a kvartálne odmeny. Priemerná mesačná provízia po úspešnom adapte sa pohybuje vo výške 200 EUR a závisí od Tvojej šikovnosti, či to bude viac. Kvartálne odmeny sa priemerne pohybujú vo výške 700 EUR v závislosti od plnenia individuálnych aj pobočkových cieľov. Po 6 mesiacoch Ťa čaká jednorázový adaptačný bonus vo výške 50% Tvojej nástupnej základnej mzdy.
 Účel a náplň práce 
 Čo od vás očakávame 
 Ak Ťa zaujíma svet bankovníctva, si komunikatívny/komunikatívna a máš prax v práci s hotovosťou, si skvelý typ na bankára/bankárku vo VÚB!
 Čakajú Ťa u nás možnosti kariérneho rastu aj zaujímavé finančné ohodnotenie.
 Okrem iného, máme pre Teba pripravených množstvo benefitov a ak o nich chceš vedieť viac, scrolluj ďalej.
 Vítame u nás skúsených bankárov, ale ak ešte bankovú prax nemáš, nevadí. U nás vo VÚB Ťa na to pripravíme celkom od začiatku.
 ČO TI DÁME NA ÚVOD?
Vďaka silnej podpore manažérov pobočky, nápomocným kolegom a priateľskému prístupu našich lektorov sa:
 postupne začneš orientovať vo VUB bankových produktoch a službách,
 naučíš pracovať s klientom a zlepšíš svoju komunikáciu a schopnosť argumentovať, čo sa Ti zíde aj v osobnom živote.
 PREČO SA TI PRÁCA VO VÚBKE BUDE PÁČIŤ?
 Budeš pracovať v jednej z najväčších a najvýznamnejších bánk na Slovensku.
 Na pobočke ste jeden tím – obchodné plány plníte spoločne a vzájomne sa podporujete.
 Rozširuješ si odbornosť a získavaš skúsenosti, ktoré využiješ v Tvojej kariére.
 Pri práci s klientom sa zlepšuješ v mnohých oblastiach, ktoré oceníš aj v osobnom živote.
 TVOJOU ÚLOHOU AKO PORADCU KLIENTA BUDE:
 podieľať sa na podpore predaja a spolupracovať s tímom,
 hľadať príležitosti pre predaj všetkých bankových produktov a služieb,
 poskytovať informácie a odborné poradenstvo klientom,
 vykonávať pokladničné a zmenárenské operácie,
 vykonávať servisné klientske operácie, zodpovedne pracovať s hotovosťou,
 podieľať sa na administratívnych činnostiach,
 neustále sa vzdelávať o novinkách vo svete financií a odborne rásť.
 Čo môžete očakávať vy od nás 
 Ako zamestnanec/zamestnankyňa získavaš benefity, ktoré porastú tak, ako budeš rásť spolu s nami. Čím dlhšie u nás budeš pracovať, tým viac výhod získaš!
 Odmenu za výkon. Raz ročne získaš bonus, ktorého výška závisí od splnenia firemných aj Tvojich individuálnych cieľov.
 Stravné plne hradené zamestnávateľom bez doplatku zamestnanca.
 Až do 10 dní plateného voľna nad rámec zákona každý rok.
 Kredit vo VÚB Cafetérii až do výšky 300 eur, ktorý rastie s počtom odpracovaných rokov.
 Až do 100 eur mesačne ako príspevok na doplnkové dôchodkové sporenie (III. pilier).
 Zvýhodnené produkty a služby VÚB banky.
 190 eur ročne ako príspevok na obliekanie.
 Chcete objaviť všetky fantastické výhody, ktoré svojim zamestnancom VÚBka ponúka? Mrknite na našu kariérnu stránku a preskúmajte širokú škálu našich benefitov! 
 Požadované skúsenosti 
 Pozícii vyhovujú uchádzači so vzdelaním:
 stredoškolské s maturitou
 Požadované zručnosti, kvalifikácia a znalosti 
 Si pre nás vhodným kandidátom/kandidátkou ak:
 máš minimálne SŠ vzdelanie s maturitou,
 Ťa baví komunikovať,
 si priateľský/á a vieš pracovať individuálne aj v tíme,
 máš v sebe ducha obchodníka,
 si dôveryhodnou a bezúhonnou osobou,
 chceš hľadať to najvhodnejšie riešenie pre klientov,
 si ochotný/á na sebe pracovať a rozvíjať sa.
 ... všetko ostatné Ťa naučíme my :)

Ak Ťa tento popis zaujal a chceš sa stať naším novým VÚBkárom, stačí už len kliknúť na „Reagovať na ponuku" a my sa Ti ozveme. Všetko dôležité o práci vo VÚB si povieme na osobnom/online stretnutí.
Tešíme sa na Teba !
 Ak Vás tento popis zaujal, pošlite nám svoje CV a my …

Bankunk az olasz Intesa Sanpaolo Csoport leányvállalata. Univerzális hitelintézetként a hazai pénzpiac egyik meghatározó szereplőjeként több mint 45 éves tapasztalattal rendelkezünk. Folyamatosan keressük az innovatív, ügyfeleinkre szabott megoldásokat, melynek kollégáink is aktív részesei. Ha fontos számodra a nemzetközi háttér, a barátságos és szerethető légkör, és egy olyan munkahelyet keresel, ahol a fejlődésed és jólléted tényleges figyelmet kap, ne várj tovább! 
 Feladatok, amikben szakértővé válsz: 
 A terület és munkatársak adminisztratív támogatásában. 
 Adminisztrációs, irattári feladatok ellátásában: bejövő-, kimenő küldemények azonosításában, adatrögzítésben, szkennelésben, iktatásban, irat archiválásban. 
 Dokumentáció lementésében, összekészítésében követeléseladási csomagokhoz. 
 Operációs kérdések kapcsán társterületekkel való kapcsolattartásban, levelezésben. 
 A munkatársakkal való aktív kapcsolattartásban. 
 Neked való mindez, ha: 
 Felhasználói szintű MS Office ismeretekkel rendelkezel. 
 Nem okoz problémát heti 30-40 óra vállalása. 
 Motivált vagy és szeretnél tanulni. 
 Jellemző rád a pontos, precíz munkavégzés. 
 Megfelelő stressztűrő képességgel rendelkezel. 
 Értékeljük a tehetséged: 
 Igazi szakmai feladatokon keresztül fejlődhetsz, ebben támogatnak a munkatársak. 
 Nálunk a gyakornoki program nem csak munkáról szól: tréningek és csapatépítő programok várnak. 
 Gyakornoki juttatást kapsz fizetett szabadságokkal. 
 Hivatalos szakmai gyakorlatként visszaigazoljuk a nálunk töltött idődet a felsőoktatási intézmény felé. 
 Légy te is CIB-es, hogy megtaláld a helyed!

 The Clinical Education Instructor delivers high-quality product training for customers and employees across Europe, both in person and virtually. The ideal candidate is passionate about sharing knowledge, building customer confidence, and helping learners use complex technology safely, effectively, and to its full potential.

 Capture customer feedback and collaborate with Education, Clinical Applications, Service, Product Marketing, Product Management, and Technical Support to keep course content accurate and current.
 Support internal pilots, new course readiness, and the continuous improvement of the EMEA training portfolio.
 Represent the organization professionally and create an inclusive, customer-focused learning environment that supports a consistently high level of satisfaction.
 Required Qualifications and Experience 
 Bachelor’s degree in medical physics, radiation therapy, biomedical engineering, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
 Demonstrated hands-on experience using Siemens Healthineers radiotherapy equipment and/or software in a clinical, technical, applications, or education environment.
 Solid understanding of radiation oncology workflows and the safe and effective use of complex healthcare technology.
 Proven ability to explain complex concepts clearly and confidently to audiences with varied levels of expertise.
 Strong presentation, facilitation, interpersonal communication, and self-management skills.
 Professional fluency in English; additional European languages are an advantage.
 Hands-on experience commissioning linear accelerators.
 Hands-on experience commissioning radiotherapy treatment planning systems.
 Experience performing calibration and quality assurance for imaging systems and linear accelerators.
 Ability and willingness to travel within Europe up to 30–40% of the time, and to meet customer-site access and credentialing requirements.
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience with one or more Siemens Healthineers platforms or solutions such as TrueBeam, Halcyon, Ethos, Eclipse, ARIA, IDENTIFY, or related technologies.
 Previous experience delivering customer, clinical, applications, or technical training in radiation oncology.
 Experience developing blended learning that combines classroom instruction, hands-on practice, virtual delivery, and digital learning resources.
 Experience working across countries and functions in a multicultural European environment.

items.desc:
We are looking for a hands-on and well-organised technician to join our measurement and testing activities in Bologna. The position combines laboratory, warehouse and logistics responsibilities with frequent assignments at customer sites throughout Italy. The successful candidate will work with a high degree of autonomy, while coordinating with project managers, engineers, suppliers and clients. 
 Key responsibilities: 
 Manage measurement instruments and high-speed data acquisition systems, including identification, configuration, functional checks, cleaning, preventive maintenance and controlled storage. 
 Carry out on-site installation, testing, maintenance and dismantling of measurement systems at customer and power-generation sites. 
 Organize national shipments and returns, including packing, labelling, transport documentation, courier coordination and follow-up of deliveries. 
 Plan and coordinate equipment calibration, monitor calibration due dates, maintain certificates and records, and liaise with accredited or approved calibration providers. 
 Provide remote technical support for ongoing measurement campaigns and promptly identify equipment or data-acquisition issues. 
 Perform data analysis and prepare measurement reports according to DNV standards and comply with applicable HSE requirements, risk assessments, site rules and quality procedures. 
 The position requires frequent travel throughout Italy for at least 50% of working time, depending on project workload.
The possibility to join a worldwide company with strong values and commitment.
 Work with a highly engaged team in an environment where trust and teamwork are core values.
 A job in a hybrid working model with a home base in Bologna.
 An attractive benefit package.
 Continuous training and professional improvement.
 The possibility to join DNV’s sanitary insurance, available for all employees.
 Laptop and mobile phone.
 Allowance for travel.
 Salary range between 30.000,00 and 35.000,00 gross per year.
 DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity.
Required qualifications and experience: 
 Technical diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Automation, Mechatronics or a comparable discipline. 
 Practical experience with electrical or electronic measurement equipment, laboratory instrumentation, data loggers or data acquisition systems. 
 Ability to read wiring diagrams and technical documentation and to perform basic electrical checks safely. 
 Ability to use equipment configuration and data-acquisition software. 
 Proficiency in both English and Italian. 
 Valid driving licence and willingness to drive for business travel. 
 Preferred qualification: 
 Previous experience in a measurement laboratory, testing organisation, industrial service company or renewable-energy environment. 
 Experience with high-speed acquisition systems, oscilloscopes, power-quality analysers, current clamps, voltage dividers, sensors and signal conditioning. 
 Knowledge of calibration management, measurement traceability and equipment registers. 
 Experience with warehouse management, shipping documentation and the handling of delicate technical equipment. 
 Understanding of electrical safety and site-based work in power plants, substations, renewable-energy plants or industrial facilities. 
 Personal attributes: 
 Proactive, methodical and committed to a clean, safe and well-organised workplace. 
 Comfortable taking ownership of equipment readiness and logistical deadlines. 
 Calm and solution-focused when working under time pressure or resolving field issues. 
 Professional and collaborative when interacting directly with customers and suppliers. 
 Ability to organise work independently, prioritise tasks and maintain accurate records. 
 Strong attention to detail, reliability and a practical problem-solving approach. 
 Security and compliance with statutory requirements in the countries in which we operate is essential for DNV. Background checks will be conducted on all final candidates as part of the offer process, in accordance with applicable country-specific laws and practices.

 One programme. Three rotations. A world of experience. 
 Why explore just one area when you could experience three?

 Your rotation journey

 Participate in internal audits and compliance assessments, helping identify opportunities for process improvements. 
 Support inspection readiness activities by reviewing documentation, tracking actions, and coordinating with operational teams. 
 Monitor SOP compliance and contribute to initiatives that strengthen quality culture and regulatory adherence across the site. 
 Rotation 3: Advanced QMS & Compliance Projects | Months 17–24 
 In your final rotation, you'll take on more ownership through strategic quality and compliance projects, applying the knowledge and skills developed throughout the programme. 
 Lead or support complex CAPA investigations, identifying root causes and implementing sustainable corrective actions. 
 Coordinate audit activities, working with stakeholders to prepare documentation, track commitments, and support successful outcomes. 
 Contribute to cross-site quality initiatives, such as QMS harmonization projects, process improvements, or compliance enhancement programmes with regional or global impact. 
 Your development focus 
 Throughout the programme, you'll develop knowledge and practical skills to support your future career in Quality Systems and Compliance , building the expertise required to ensure products, processes, and quality systems meet the highest regulatory and operational standards. 
 Develop a strong understanding of quality management principles, regulatory requirements, GMP compliance, and Quality Management Systems (QMS) within a highly regulated industry.

items.desc:
Introduction 
 Are you a process engineer that is a team player looking for a dynamic high-tech work environment with growth potential? We might be looking for you! In this function you will work in multidisciplinary teams all around the globe on challenging projects, developing both your leadership and technical skills.
 NXP Semiconductors N.V. provides High Performance Mixed Signal and Standard Product solutions that leverage its leading RF, Analog, Power Management, Interface, Security and Digital Processing expertise. These innovations are used in a wide range of automotive, identification, wireless infrastructure, lighting, industrial, mobile, consumer and computing applications. A global semiconductor company with operations in more than 35 countries, over 45.000 employees and a revenue of over $12 billion.
 ICN8 is the largest 8“integrated circuits wafer fab in Europe. It is a high-tech environment with many multi discipline challenges, housing over 450 manufacturing tools (ASML, ASM/TEL, Applied Material, LAM) and 150 measurement tools (inline inspections, end of inline testing). Products are made in CMOS, BIMOS, RFCMOS and SOI processes.
 Job Mission 
 Responsible for the maintaining, initiating and implementing improvements of current and new process technologies within ICN8 manufacturing ( 8 ”Fab).
 Job Description 
 You will join the Process Integration group which is part of the PSE organization. This Process Sustaining and Enhancement (PSE) organization is part of ICN8 and has the responsibility to improve and maintain all running process technologies.
 The Process Integration group has 4 technology teams. In total 16 process integration engineers are working in these teams together with colleagues from product & yield engineering, defectivity and equipment & process engineering,. Main task of the section is to sustain released process technologies and improve them on quality, yield, reliability, cost, and cycle time to a benchmark level. The section is also responsible for a smooth introduction and ramp up of new processes and products. Due to the retirement of an engineer and due to the increasing fab workload, we are looking for an additional PI engineer. 
 Key Areas of Responsibility: 
 - support the fab organization to solve complex process integration problems
 - translation of device problems to tool- or process problems
 - root-cause analysis of complex product failures, tracing issues to specific defects or process deviations (in close collaboration with failure analysis engineers and IC designers)
 - monitoring of process quality using Statistical Process Control, initiation and execution of improvement actions
 - execution and management of process improvement actions in the areas of quality, reliability, yield, cost, productivity, defectivity and process performance, often in the form of projects or 8D teams
 - leading projects or 8D teams
 - tailoring product design and test sensitivities to process parameters
 Education: 
 - Master’s degree in electrical engineering (preferred) or applied physics
 Experience: 
 - 2-3 Year work experience in IC technology and device engineering
 - Knowledge of complex production processes
 - Languages: Dutch and Englisch
 Personal skills: 
 - Raising the bar; Analytical, pragmatic, pro-active and result oriented
 - Engages curiosity; Self-assured and able to engage and convince people, also at higher management levels
 - Takes initiative; shows ownership, hands on mentality
 - Working together: is a reliable team player, listens to and absorbs other ideas and opinions. Good social/communication skills on different levels
 - Developing deep core competences; Is a quick learner, able to prioritize and operate independently and adapt to changing circumstances focusing on quality and continuous improvement
 - precise, focus on quality

items.desc: Description de l'entreprise CS, filiale du groupe Sopra Steria, est un acteur technologique de référence dans la conception, l’intégration et l’exploitation de systèmes critiques. Présents dans 7 pays avec plus de 2 600 collaborateurs passionnés, nous intervenons au cœur des enjeux de souveraineté, de sécurité et de performance, dans des secteurs stratégiques tels que la défense, le spatial, l’énergie, l’industrie, le transport, l’aéronautique et la cybersécurité. Notre différence ? Une expertise unique en systèmes temps réel, des solutions souveraines et durables, et une culture d’innovation forte, portée par 15 % de notre chiffre d’affaires investi en R&D. Nous accompagnons nos clients dans la réussite de leurs programmes les plus complexes, du contrôle aérien à la lutte anti-drones, en passant par les systèmes nucléaires et les centres de contrôle satellites. En rejoignant CS, vous intégrez une entreprise humaine et innovante. Nous livrons bien plus que des systèmes, nous bâtissons la confiance. Nous allons au-delà des besoins exprimés, nous préparons les défis de demain. Plus que de simples experts, nous façonnons l’innovation. Engagés à vos côtés, au service de vos enjeux critiques. Accélérer la transformation industrielle, en toute sécurité. Notre Business Unit INDUSTRIE accompagne les leaders des secteurs de l’aéronautique, de l’énergie et du transport dans la conception, la sécurisation et l’optimisation de leurs systèmes critiques. Avec plus de 700 collaborateurs en France et en Amérique du Nord, elle mobilise une expertise reconnue permettant la réalisation de projets innovants dans les domaines des systèmes embarqués, de la simulation numérique, de la cybersécurité, de la data intelligence et de la digitalisation des processus industriels. Rejoindre cette Business Unit , c’est transformer l’industrie avec des solutions à fort impact. Description du poste Nous recrutons un.e stagiaire Ingénieur.e Data Scientist / Data Engineer pour rejoindre notre Business Unit INDUSTRIE au sein de la Business Line Data & Process Intelligence, spécialisée dans l'accompagnement de nos clients dans leurs problématiques associées à la transformation digitale. Nos offres se déclinent autour de la data intelligence & de la maintenance prédictive, de la digitalisation des processus industriels et du SI Métiers. Votre mission : Vous intégrerez notre Pôle Data et participerez à la conception et au développement de solutions innovantes dans le domaine de la data science et de l’intelligence artificielle appliquées à l’industrie. Selon les projets en cours, vos missions pourront inclure : Analyse et valorisation des données : Collecter, préparer et structurer des données issues de sources variées (capteurs, systèmes industriels, logs, etc.) pour en extraire des informations pertinentes. Exploration et veille technologique : Réaliser des études sur les approches et outils récents en IA, machine learning, big data et automatisation, afin d’identifier les solutions adaptées aux problématiques industrielles. Développement de modèles et d’outils : Concevoir et implémenter des algorithmes ou prototypes permettant d’améliorer la performance, la fiabilité ou l’efficacité des systèmes (ex. optimisation, prédiction, automatisation). Visualisation et restitution : Développer des interfaces ou tableaux de bord pour faciliter l’interprétation des résultats par les équipes métiers. Contribution à l’innovation : Participer à des projets exploratoires autour de thématiques stratégiques telles que la maintenance prédictive, l’optimisation éco-énergétique, l’automatisation intelligente, l’analyse de causes racines ou la simulation numérique. Qualifications Étudiant(e) en Bac+5 en data science , informatique ou mathématiques , à la recherche d’un stage d’une durée de 6 mois, vous souhaitez vous spécialiser dans le traitement et l’analyse de données à grande échelle, notamment dans le domaine aéronautique . Vous êtes à l'aise avec les langages de programmation, en particulier Python , PySpark et JavaScript , ainsi que les bibliothèques de traitement de données ( Pandas , NumPy , etc.). Vous avez également des connaissances solides en apprentissage automatique , en algorithmes statistiques et en modèles de Machine Learning , notamment pour la manipulation et la prévision de séries temporelles . Vous disposez d’une compréhension des plateformes Big Data (par exemple Spark , Hadoop , Hive ) et des environnements distribués, ainsi que des compétences en conception d’architectures de pipelines de traitement de données . Une expérience ou un intérêt marqué pour l’ utilisation et le fine-tuning de modèles de langage (LLM) est apprécié. Vous êtes également capable de concevoir des interfaces applicatives pour exploiter et diffuser les différents algorithmes et modèles développés. Votre curiosité pour les technologies émergentes et votre capacité à travailler sur des projets innovants sont des atouts majeurs. Informations supplémentaires Rejoignez une …

items.desc: Project description We are looking for a Technical Data Analyst / Data & AI Platform Specialist to explore and analyse data across our data platform. The role identifies opportunities for new business capabilities, analytical solutions and platform enhancements, and contributes to the design, specification and delivery of new data products, reporting, AI-enabled solutions and platform services. The work supports automation, data quality, data asset enrichment and faster business value from data. Responsibilities Analyse business and technical requirements to define new reporting, analytics and data product capabilities. Design and specify datasets, semantic models, KPIs and Power BI reporting that support business objectives. Validate data structures, transformations and business rules for new data products. Define and implement AI use cases on the Microsoft Fabric platform, such as anomaly detection, reconciliation, classification, metadata enrichment and semantic search. Design and deliver AI-enabled solutions using Microsoft AI tools and Claude, and build reusable AI services and accelerators. Produce functional specifications, technical design documents, prototypes and implementation artefacts. Define data quality, lineage and control requirements for new platform capabilities. Collaborate with business analysts, SMEs, data engineers and architects to translate requirements into platform enhancements. Skills Must have At least 10 years of experience in BI, data product delivery and data platform architecture. Advanced SQL and data analysis skills. Hands-on experience with Power BI, semantic modelling and KPI design. Experience writing functional specifications and technical design artefacts, and working across the full project cycle (specification, design, development, testing). Hands-on experience designing and delivering AI-enabled data solutions with Microsoft Copilot and Anthropic’s Claude. Strong understanding of data quality, governance, metadata and data management principles. Excellent written and verbal communication in English or French, with working knowledge of the other. Nice to have Experience with Microsoft Fabric specifically. Ability to identify functional and technical data gaps and propose platform enhancements. Experience creating reusable analytical or AI assets used across several business domains. Experience analysing data platform architecture, data flows and integration patterns to define future-state capabilities. Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Other Languages English: C1 Advanced Seniority Senior Paris, France Req.
