We work in a fast-evolving environment where curiosity, innovation, and collaboration are encouraged, giving you the opportunity to explore emerging technologies, turn new ideas into globally relevant solutions, and contribute directly to the evolution of Novonesis’ QC
items.desc:
Interested in a career that matters? 
 Are you passionate about transforming laboratory workflows through automation, AI, data science, and emerging technologies? Do you enjoy turning innovative ideas into practical solutions that make a real difference for scientists and technicians? At Novonesis, we are building the next generation of Global Quality Control (GQC) laboratories. Within Global Assay Innovation and Automation, Global LIMS, Automation & Digitalization drives the development and implementation of digital, automated, and data-driven solutions across enzyme, microbial, chemical, and physical analysis methods. You will become part of a multidisciplinary department of 25+ colleagues where scientific expertise meets digitalization, automation, and data. We work in a fast-evolving environment where curiosity, innovation, and collaboration are encouraged, giving you the opportunity to explore emerging technologies, turn new ideas into globally relevant solutions, and contribute directly to the evolution of Novonesis’ QC laboratories. The role & your impact As our new Scientist, you will help challenge traditional ways of working and develop intelligent laboratory solutions that can shape QC in the years to come. You will translate laboratory needs into practical technology solutions and contribute to more automated, aligned, and future-ready workflows across our global QC laboratories. Your key responsibilities in this role Design and implement technology solutions across Novonesis’ GQC laboratories. Align and optimize the use of instruments and technology platforms across laboratories. Drive automation projects and help develop sustainable, future-ready laboratory workflows. Translate operational laboratory needs into effective automated workflows and solutions. Support compliance in digital systems, including software and instrument validation. Take ownership of implemented solutions by providing the necessary support, maintenance, and updates. What you’ll need to be successful in this role We are looking for someone who combines scientific understanding with a genuine interest in laboratory technology, data, and automation and: Holds an MSc or PhD in microbiology, natural sciences, engineering, data science, or a related field. Has a strong interest in laboratory technology, data, and automation. Is comfortable communicating and collaborating in English. Builds strong stakeholder relationships and follows through on commitments. Has project management skills and can drive change in a structured way. Is culturally aware, adaptable, and curious. Takes ownership of the solutions you build, including their ongoing support and development. Additional skills & interests we value It would be an advantage if you bring one or more of the following: Experience with laboratory workflows, documentation, and regulatory environments. A passion for technology, mechatronics, laboratory robotics, and automation platforms. Experience with programming, software development, and/or applying machine learning to develop data-driven solutions. Hands-on experience from regulated industries such as pharma or food. Experience with instrument integration. Familiarity with digital systems used in QC laboratory workflows. An appreciation for the value of strong documentation and structured ways of working. What we offer you You will become part of a multidisciplinary environment where scientific expertise meets technology, automation, and digitalization. You will have the opportunity to explore emerging technologies and develop solutions that can make a real difference across our GQC laboratories. Application deadline: November 15th, 2026. We will screen incoming applications and invite for interviews continuously during the application period, so please apply as soon as possible. Please note that we only accept applications via our Career Site. Contact information: Senior Department Manager Hanne Jarmer at HJR@novonesis.com. Our purpose guides the way In Novonesis, we know that solutions rooted in biology can help solve humanity’s biggest challenges. Since we began more than a century ago, this has been our guide. It’s how we've gotten so far. And it’s how we'll impact the future. Now, more than ever, the world needs change. And with biosolutions, the possibilities for transformation are endless. If our purpose resonates with you, we encourage you to apply. Opportunities for everyone We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunity for all applicants. Therefore we ask you to apply without a cover letter or photo and instead include a few sentences in your CV explaining your motivation for applying. We make all employment decisions based on business needs and welcome candidates with a wide range of backgrounds, including ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or veteran status. items.desc: Nørre Gymnasium søger snarest en årsvikar på deltid i psykologi og dansk frem til sommer. Stillingen omfatter tre-fire hold. Det er en fordel, hvis du kan undervise i begge fag, men det er ikke et krav. Man kan læse mere om kravene til faglig kompetence på Børne- og Undervisningsministeriets hjemmeside her. Pædagogikum er ikke en forudsætning. Om Nørre Gymnasium Nørre Gymnasium er et stort udviklingsorienteret gymnasium beliggende i Brønshøj i København med cirka 1250 elever og 130 ansatte. Vi udbyder stx samt den engelsksprogede IB-uddannelse (IB er ikke relevant i dette stillingsopslag). Vores strategi og vision er, at vi ønsker at uddanne unge mennesker til at møde fremtiden med håb og handling gennem faglig begejstring, kreative tilgange, fællesskaber og handlekompetence. Nørre Gymnasium har en decentraliseret projektorganisation, hvor princippet er, at mange beslutninger træffes så tæt som muligt på dem, beslutningerne vedrører. Den enkelte lærer og teamet/teamlederen omkring en klasse har derfor stort selvstændigt ansvar og råderum. Du kan læse mere på vores hjemmeside: nrgym.dk Ansøgning Hvis du har spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte vicerektor Sebastian Krag Kristiansen på se@nrgym.dk. Ansøgning, CV og eksamenspapirer skal sendes elektronisk via jobopslaget på gymnasiejob.dk. Vi holder ansættelsessamtaler løbende og forbeholder os retten til at ansætte før fristens udløb. Hvis du har søgt stilling hos os tidligere og fortsat er interesseret, vil vi bede dig gensende din ansøgning her. Du skal være indstillet på at fremvise straffeattest, hvis det efterspørges. Ansættelsesvilkår Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår fastsættes i henhold til gældende overenskomst. Alle lærere får stillet en bærbar computer til rådighed. Vi tilbyder desuden lærerarbejdspladser og gode muligheder for faglig udvikling. items.desc: Do you want to help shape the digital applications that support digital manufacturing at VELUX? As our new Technical Product Owner, you will connect manufacturing needs with solutions enabled by our top-tier Industrial IoT platform, turning business priorities into a clear roadmap and delivery-ready work—and helping drive our digitization journey. Meet your future team You will join our growing Industrial IoT Platform Team within the IT & Digital Enablement (IT&DE) department. We work closely with the Operations & Supply (O&S) organization to support the entire VELUX Group globally. This role is a new addition to the team, and you will work alongside the Senior Technical Product Owner who is accountable for ensuring a common approach. You will connect IT and Supply and own an assigned area of manufacturing applications and capabilities within that framework. Your scope can evolve as portfolio priorities and the product model develop, contributing to VELUX’s continuous digitization journey. What we offer As Technical Product Owner, you will have the opportunity to shape your part of an evolving digital manufacturing application landscape. You will own the technical product direction, roadmap, backlog and day-to-day decisions, in close collaboration with the business, translating their needs and priorities into a clear, scalable and sustainable product path. You will connect manufacturing needs with delivery-ready work for technical teams, helping establish a consistent product mindset across your scope. To make that work clear and actionable, you will establish and maintain product requirements, processes and guardrails that support development and delivery. More specifically your tasks will be to: Own and continuously develop the technical product roadmap and backlog for your agreed area of digital manufacturing applications and capabilities. Turn incoming business needs into clearly defined problems and desired outcomes, then shape them into features with acceptance criteria. Keep the backlog structured and sufficiently refined for delivery teams to begin work, meeting the agreed Definition of Ready standards. Coordinate refinement and product preparation for sprint planning, make day-to-day prioritisation decisions within the agreed product direction, and escalate decisions outside your scope. Be the primary product contact for your assigned scope and coordinate dependencies across stakeholders and teams. Escalate cross-domain trade-offs, investment or capacity choices, and scope conflicts that need resolution beyond your remit. Keep manufacturing processes, applications, shared technology capabilities, integrations and deployment requirements aligned from end to end. Shape the roadmap around connected manufacturing needs rather than separate technology silos. Manage the technical capability lifecycle from prioritised business need and validation through delivery, operational feedback and continuous improvement, using agreed measures to inform product-quality and lifecycle decisions. You can be based in Skjern, Østbirk, Kolding or Hørsholm. The role requires regular physical presence in Skjern and at manufacturing locations in Denmark, with occasional travel abroad. When tasks and projects allow, you can work from home up to 2 days per week. What you will bring into the organization You bring experience from product ownership, product management or a comparable business-facing role within digital manufacturing, including evolving or multi-product scopes. You can collaborate with both business and technical colleagues to turn priorities into delivery-ready work, and you are ready to bring structure, accountability and product focus to a development organisation. Moreover, we expect that you: Bring a deep understanding of manufacturing processes, including how operational applications, enterprise systems, machine integration and data interact. Broader knowledge of digital manufacturing landscapes is an advantage. Can create product roadmaps, structure complex demand, and translate desired outcomes into delivery-ready features and backlogs. Take a disciplined, outcome-oriented approach to product ownership, establishing and maintaining clear product requirements, processes and decision guardrails. Balance standardization and short-term delivery needs with long-term product integrity. Have experience working in a complex matrix organisation, using stakeholder collaboration, clear communication and sound decision-making to align colleagues across organisational boundaries. Have the technical fluency to collaborate credibly with architects, technical leads and engineering teams. Ready to apply? Learn more about the VELUX Group online at www.velux.com where you can read more about working at our company and what to expect of our recruitment process. We look forward to receiving your application and CV as soon as possible. We are conducting interviews on an ongoing basis until we have the right match. All …

items.desc: Company Description Apex Logic Lab is a small experimental technology lab focused on understanding sports through reliable data infrastructure and machine learning. The team builds systems that transform real-time information from live events into clearer, more actionable views of games for partners and clients. Working at Apex Logic Lab offers the opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge tools that support analysis, performance insights, and fan experiences. Team members collaborate closely in a fast-paced environment where innovation, accuracy, and curiosity about sports and technology are highly valued. Role Description The Live Sports Data Analyst is a contract, on-site at games role based in the Paris area. In this position, the individual will attend live sporting events or designated venues to capture real-time game data, including plays, statistics, and contextual information, using company tools and applications. Responsibilities include monitoring game flow, entering data with high accuracy and speed, verifying entries against established standards, and reporting any anomalies or technical issues to the operations team. The role also involves collaborating with data engineers and analysts to improve data collection processes, participating in training sessions to refine methods, and following strict quality and timing protocols. This position may require evening and weekend work aligned with live sports schedules. Qualifications Strong Data Collection skills with attention to detail and accuracy in fast-paced, real-time environments. Analytical Skills to interpret game situations, validate data, and recognize patterns or inconsistencies. Clear Communication skills to coordinate with team members, report issues, and follow operational guidelines. Experience with Training and Research to learn new tools quickly, apply standardized methods, and contribute to process improvements. Knowledge of major sports (rules, terminology, game flow) and enthusiasm for live sporting events. Comfort with technology, including mobile apps, data entry interfaces, and basic troubleshooting. Ability to work on-site in the Paris area, including evenings and weekends as available. Previous experience in sports statistics, live event operations, or a related data-focused field is beneficial; relevant education in fields such as sports management, statistics, or computer science is a plus. Pay We pay a base of $100 plus two bonuses based on your speed and accuracy. The first bonus, worth up to $200, is earned by avoiding major mistakes. The second bonus has no cap, and its size depends on how well you handle challenging situations (penalties, red cards, VAR) and how quickly you enter potential goals. Job Type: Contract Work Location: In person

items.desc: Every student on Earth deserves what only the lucky few get today: a brilliant tutor who knows them, believes in them and shows up every day. We are building that for everyone, and we’re on track to become the world’s #1 AI learning companion. Millions of students across 25+ countries already use Knowie, their learning companion, +5x per week. They don’t come back because a teacher told them to. They come back because it helps and they like it. Most of our growth is word of mouth, students truly love it. Why now? AI has made knowledge a commodity, and school systems can’t keep up. Students need motivation, guidance and someone on their side, and AI can finally deliver that one-to-one, at scale. We’re building a companion that feels like the cool older sibling, not another teacher. It’s personal, motivating and something students love. This is creating a totally new market category. Education will become one of the core assets in a future where a whole generation growing up lives on more uncertainty than ever before. Education systems will keep shifting, and we’re the stable layer that families and students rely on through that change. We raised €40mio+, operate with a lean team of +60 hands on builders & are deeply driven to define this new category to bring personalised education to 1bn students globally. For this role, product experience isn’t one part of what we do. It is the whole thing. A brilliant tutor only works if students want to come back every day, and that comes down to how it looks, moves and feels. We need someone to own that: to lead it, push it and iterate on it with millions of students in real time. You’ll take a product students already love to its next stage. Who you are Your portfolio matters more than your years of experience. Show us work that moved metrics & delighted users: Craft-obsessed: The details are the design. You push back until the bar is raised. AI enthusiast : From prototyping to research to shipping. You see AI tools as a multiplier, not a threat. Systems thinker: You care about scaling quality across a product, not a pretty Figma library. Code-first design systems, AI-powered design reviews, whatever works at speed & scale. Simplifier: Education is messy. AI is unpredictable. You turn complicated user journeys into experiences that feel obvious. Biased to action : You move fast by default. Prototypes over presentations, experiments over endless debate. Builder : You like getting your hands dirty. Bonus if you’ve shipped a side project end to end, or opened a merge request. Team-first : Direct feedback, no preciousness, no territory. Engineers prototyping features? More builders means better outcomes. Curious : New tools, new patterns, new ways of thinking. You stay up to date & experiment continuously because you want to, not because someone told you to. What you'll do Raise the bar on everything students see, touch & feel. Make the Knowunity product undeniably world-class. Set the standard : UIs students want to screenshot & details they feel, but can’t name. Your work is the reference point. Scale it : Curated references, stellar components & sharp reviews. Make it easy even for vibe-coding PMs to hit the standard. Pioneer AI-native design : AI changes how we research, ideate, ship, as well as what we ship. You’ll figure out both, from AI-assisted workflows to AI-native product experiences. Idea to production, fast : Work directly with C-level & engineering. Concept on Monday, shipped on Wednesday, live for a million students on Thursday. What we offer Not for everyone, everything for the right one: Impact at scale: Your work reaches millions of students daily. Future generations will know what you build. Elite team, real ownership: +60 exceptional people. Direct access to C-level & founders. You own entire areas from conception to delivery. Compensation & equity: Competitive salary paired with meaningful equity in a company with genuine unicorn potential. Benefits: 28 days annual leave, 40 days work from anywhere, personal development budget, mental health support, Urban Sports Club, monthly retail vouchers, team & company events. Next steps Click “Apply for this job” and submit your CV and LinkedIn profile. We move fast. Intro call : Get to know each other, see if there’s mutual excitement. 5 minute Loom : walk us through something you’re proud of. A feature you shipped, an app you vibe-coded. Your pick. Deep-dive call : Unpack your Loom case with our head of design/CPO, discuss your experience & perspective. On-site day : Meet our CEO, CPO & the team. Work together, get a real feel for the culture. We’ll cover travel. We encourage applications from exceptional talent regardless of traditional background requirements. Knowunity is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of nationality, ethnic origin, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, or marital …

items.desc: Au sein de l'équipe Recherche Avancée d'un grand groupe industriel, vous intervenez sur un projet stratégique axé sur l'écoconception et les matériaux de nouvelle génération. L?objectif de la mission est de concevoir et de déployer des modèles numériques prédictifs afin de simuler l'évolution, le vieillissement et la dégradation de matrices complexes au contact de milieux réactifs et biologiques. Objectifs & LivrablesEn interface directe avec les experts R&D (spécialistes matériaux, chimistes, ingénieurs procédés), vous assurez : Développement de modèles prédictifs multi-échelles : Modélisation couplée associant mécanique des milieux continus, cinétique réactionnelle et phénomènes de transport (diffusion de masse, gradients de concentration). Implémentation via des codes de calcul par éléments finis (FEA) et/ou approches hybrides associant physique et Machine Learning (PINNs, surrogate models). Compréhension des phénomènes d'interface : Modélisation des mécanismes de surface : dégradation, adhésion, sorption/désorption et transferts de matière. Exploitation et intégration des données expérimentales (chimie analytique, spectrométrie, caractérisations de surface) pour le calage et la validation des modèles. Aide à la décision & valorisation scientifique : Restitution des résultats de simulation sous forme de critères de design exploitables par les équipes de formulation. Rédaction de la documentation technique et contribution aux collaborations scientifiques externes. Profil candidat: Formation : Ingénieur ou Docteur (PhD) en Mécanique, Génie des procédés, Physique des matériaux ou Mathématiques appliquées. Compétences clés : Maîtrise éprouvée de la modélisation multiphysique (couplage transport / réaction / mécanique). items.desc: VOS MISSIONS Au sein de la Direction de la Transformation Numérique (DTN), vous assurez la cybersécurité opérationnelle du système d’information d’Aircalin, dans le respect des standards de la Compagnie et de la réglementation en vigueur. À ce titre, vous prenez notamment en charge les missions suivantes : Architecture de sécurité et gestion des accès Définir et maintenir l’architecture de sécurité de référence et la trajectoire Zero Trust ; Définir les principes de cloisonnement, les standards de durcissement et les exigences de sécurité des environnements Cloud, SaaS, API et solutions intégrant de l’IA ; Contribuer à l’intégration de la sécurité dans les projets numériques et à la conception des solutions IAM, PAM et MFA ; Protection, détection et pilotage du SOC managé Définir les politiques de protection et de détection des outils de cyberdéfense (EDR/XDR, pare-feux, VPN, WAF) et en contrôler l’application ; Piloter le SOC managé, définir les modalités d’escalade et analyser et qualifier les alertes escaladées ; Définir la stratégie de détection, exploiter le renseignement sur la menace (CTI) et conduire ou faire conduire des campagnes de Threat Hunting ; Vulnérabilités et réponse à incident Définir et piloter le processus de gestion des vulnérabilités, surveiller la surface d’attaque externe et suivre les actions de remédiation ; Assurer le rôle d’Incident Manager technique, coordonner les équipes et prestataires et engager les mesures d’endiguement relevant des délégations prédéfinies ; Réaliser ou piloter les investigations numériques, préserver les preuves et organiser les retours d’expérience et exercices techniques ; Ingénierie, audits et conformité Concevoir et développer des outils d’automatisation et des agents d’intelligence artificielle au service de la cyberdéfense ; Proposer au RSSI le programme d’audits techniques et de tests d’intrusion, piloter les prestations et suivre les recommandations ; Définir les mesures techniques requises par NIS2 et Part-IS, produire les indicateurs de sécurité et contribuer aux actions de sensibilisation. VOTRE PROFIL Bac+5, diplôme d’ingénieur ou équivalent dans le domaine de la cybersécurité ; Expérience professionnelle de 3 à 4 ans minimum ; une expérience dans le transport aérien ou un environnement fortement réglementé serait un plus ; Maîtrise des systèmes d’information, des réseaux et systèmes, des méthodes d’investigation numérique et de réponse à incident ; Très bonne connaissance des audits et tests d’intrusion, des architectures de sécurité (bastion, VPN, WAF, EDR, SIEM Splunk/ELK) et des méthodes de Threat Hunting ; Certifications appréciées : GCFA, OSDA, CDSA, eCDFP, OSCP, eCPPT, OSTH, eCTHP ou équivalent ; Maîtrise de l’anglais réglementaire et technique ; Force de proposition, anticipation, rigueur analytique, autonomie, sens de la pédagogie et qualités relationnelles ; Sens de la confidentialité, intégrité et éthique. POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE ? Contribuer directement à la protection des systèmes d’information d’une compagnie aérienne internationale ; Intervenir sur des enjeux de cyberdéfense variés, de la détection des menaces à la réponse aux incidents ; Participer à des projets technologiques innovants dans un environnement opérationnel exigeant et fortement réglementé. Vous souhaitez mettre votre expertise technique au service de la sécurité et de la résilience d’Aircalin ? Rejoignez-nous ! Envoyez votre candidature (CV et lettre de motivation) depuis notre site carrière en cliquant sur le lien suivant : http://carrieres.aircalin.com/offre-de-emploi jusqu’au 22 novembre 2026 inclus. Notre contexte Pionnier de la science des matériaux depuis plus de 130 ans, Michelin s’appuie sur une expertise unique pour contribuer significativement au progrès humain et à un monde plus durable. Plus de sécurité, plus de performance, une meilleure expérience de conduite...et plus de prédictivité... Michelin innove en proposant des solutions de pointe pour l'ensemble des marques de pneumatiques, en réponse aux attentes des constructeurs automobiles et des conducteurs. À l’heure où les véhicules deviennent de véritables plateformes numériques, Michelin est convaincu que la connectivité des pneus est un levier essentiel pour atteindre ses ambitions de croissance durable et satisfaire les attentes de ses clients. S’appuyant sur sa capacité à tirer toute la valeur des données d'usage et de la connaissance physique du pneumatique, Michelin est en mesure de proposer un jumeau numérique du pneu aux spécificités uniques. Différent des autres solutions, en effet, car il n'a besoin d'aucun capteur dans le pneumatique et fonctionne quels que soient la marque et le modèle du pneu et du véhicule. L’équipe en charge de la compréhension / prédiction des performances met son savoir et ses compétences au service de la conception des produits , pour proposer une mobilité plus sûre et plus durable. Cette équipe de 25 personnes recrute en CDI un·e ingénieur·e mécanicien·ne / physicien·ne dans le but d’améliorer ses modèles et sa compréhension des performances Comportements Pneus et Véhicules au sein du Centre de R&D Michelin basé à Clermont-Ferrand. Votre mission avec nous Votre mission consiste à comprendre les mécanismes qui pilotent la performance Comportement d’un pneumatique, en lien avec le véhicule , et de la modéliser dans des outils intégrables directement aux nouvelles plateformes S oftware D efined V ehicle (véhicules définis par logiciels). Vous accompagnez les partenaires par votre expertise en perfectionnant les briques physiques de ces modèles . A votre prise de poste, vous bénéficiez d'un plan de formation personnalisé. Votre progression dans le métier se fera grâce à votre entourage (expert performances, experts pneumatiques, expert matériaux) dans un climat de partage de savoirs et savoir-faire mais aussi grâce à une formation continue qui sera définie de manière individuelle. Vos compétences, votre curiosité, votre rigueur d'analyse et votre sens de la physique, vous permettront de gagner en expertise afin de devenir une référence interne sur la performance comportement pneu et véhicule. Vous pourrez ensuite évoluer soit vers un rôle de gestion transverse, soit vers un rôle d'expert dans le développement de nouvelles méthodes. En intégrant Michelin, les perspectives de carrière sont variées, et vous serez acteur·trice de votre développement. N’hésitez plus ! Vous avez envie de participer à une vision ambitieuse de la mobilité durable, rejoignez-nous ! items.desc: WholeHelp vient d'être rachetée par Sage. Et ce n'est que le début. Avec Sage Experience, on rend l'IA accessible à tout type d'entreprise, sur de vrais cas d'usage. Pas des démos de laboratoire : interroger ses chiffres en langage naturel, automatiser les tâches qui font perdre des heures, connecter ses outils, créer des écrans sur-mesure. Le tout branché sur les logiciels de gestion Sage que les PME utilisent déjà. Nos produits SaaS sont pensés nativement pour l'IA, et ils tournent déjà chez les clients. Le poste Product Builder : responsable de produit qui conçoit et construit en personne, avec l'IA, le produit qui lui est confié. Tu es responsable d'une ligne produit Sage Experience, et tu la construis. Une ligne, c'est l'expérience web et IA d'un logiciel de gestion Sage. En binôme avec le développeur référent de ta ligne, tu réponds de ce qu'elle devient chez les clients. Tu dis le besoin, l'ordre et le pourquoi ; ton binôme dit le comment, et quand ce n'est pas raisonnable. Concrètement, tu développes toi-même tes écrans, avec l'IA, dans le code du produit, sur le design system commun et les routes API que les développeurs te fournissent. Ton code suit le circuit de tout le code : merge request, tests, CI. Ton binôme le relit, peut le refuser, puis le fusionne et le met en production. Tu as peut-être déjà construit tes propres outils parce qu'on ne te laissait pas toucher au produit. Ici, c'est le poste. Ton travail continue après la mise en production. À la fin, une question compte : est-ce que les clients restent ? Selon la ligne, tu fais grandir une offre en production, tu en lances une neuve ou tu ouvres une ligne de zéro. Sur Sage 100, utilisé par plus de 40 000 PME en France, plus de trente écrans web tournent déjà. Ce que tu vas faire Développer avec l'IA les écrans, les fonctionnalités et les templates de pages, de widgets et de workflows de ta ligne, avec leurs tests, à partir des specs et en collaboration étroite avec les experts métier (partenaires, clients, collaborateurs de Sage) Tenir avec ton binôme le backlog des routes et des données Produire avec l'IA les formations de ta ligne produit, et y former les partenaires intégrateurs, les équipes consulting et le support Poser sur tes pages des indicateurs d'usage et de friction, dans le respect du RGPD, et t'en servir pour que les clients restent Faire émerger les nouveaux besoins, repérer et proposer les outils tiers à intégrer Présenter ta ligne en public (salon, keynote, webinaire) et appuyer l'avant-vente à la demande du commerce de Sage L'équipe Tu rejoins une équipe de 10 à 15 personnes. Product Builders et développeurs travaillent ensemble au quotidien, sur une même stack : TypeScript, Node ou Bun côté serveur, React côté client. Les routes, les connecteurs et la plateforme commune (Ask, moteur de workflows, console) restent aux développeurs. Dès le premier jour, tu as les outils d'IA validés par Sage au niveau de licence le plus élevé, une usine de formation et nos outils maison, faits pour avancer à la vitesse de l'IA sur les usages d'aujourd'hui. Dans un second temps, tu pourras aussi proposer une expérience mobile first ; passer sur une autre ligne reste possible. Toi Tu construis déjà avec l'IA au quotidien, en vibe coding, des outils qui tournent, et tu vérifies ce qu'elle produit au lieu de la croire. Pas besoin d'un parcours de développement, mais tu sais tester ce que tu livres et l'expliquer. Tu as l'œil UX/UI, et tu sais écrire une spec fonctionnelle. Tu parles d'adoption et de clients avant de parler d'outils, et tu sais expliquer un produit à un public. Tu viens peut-être du produit SaaS B2B, du design produit, d'un éditeur de gestion, d'une agence digitale, du conseil fonctionnel ou de la création d'entreprise. Une culture comptable, de gestion ou d'ERP est un vrai plus. Lire une documentation d'API ou connaître Sage aussi. Ce qui compte, ce n'est pas le nombre d'années, c'est ce que tu as réellement construit. Ce poste n'est pas pour toi si tu n'as rien construit toi-même à montrer Comment on se rencontre Un premier échange, puis tu nous montres ce que tu as dans le ventre : tes réalisations de cette année, projets personnels compris. Enfin, une rencontre avec l'équipe et la direction. CDI. Lieu du poste : Télétravail hybride (92800 Puteaux), trois jours par semaine au bureau, à la tour Hekla Capacité à faire le trajet ou à déménager: 92800 Puteaux: Faire le trajet sans problème ou prévoir un déménagement avant de prendre son poste (Requis) Langue: Anglais (Requis) Lieu du poste : Télétravail hybride (92800 Puteaux)

You will design, build, and maintain the automation frameworks that keep our entire fleet up to date—covering everything from motherboards and Baseboard Management Controllers (BMCs) to high-performance InfiniBand fabrics and GPU clusters. In our "move fast" culture, your job is to build the safety nets (health checks, canary deploys, and automated rollbacks) that allow us to update hardware rapidly without taking down the cloud. Your Responsibilities Fleet-Wide Firmware Orchestration: Design and execute automated, zero-touch firmware update pipelines across our global fleet of servers, switches, and accelerators. Heterogeneous Hardware Management: Own the firmware lifecycle for multiple hardware profiles, including Systemboards (BIOS/UEFI), BMCs, InfiniBand HCAs, Network Switches, and high-performance GPUs. Redfish & API Automation: Leverage Redfish and IPMI APIs to programmatically discover, configure, inventory, and update bare-metal assets at scale. Build Blast-Radius Protections: Architect robust telemetry pipelines to assess hardware health post-flash, and build automated rollback mechanisms to instantly recover from faulty vendor payloads. Tooling & Infrastructure as Code: Integrate firmware management pipelines cleanly into our existing configuration management ecosystems (SaltStack/Ansible) and provisioning workflows. Vendor & Engineering Liaison: Deep-dive into hardware errata and bug reports, collaborating closely with hardware vendors and internal platform teams to patch critical CVEs and performance regressions. Your key competencies Automation at Scale: Proven experience managing and updating firmware across thousands of nodes simultaneously. You don't do "one-off" flashes; you write code to update clusters. Deep Redfish Expertise: Mastery of the DMTF Redfish specification for server management, out-of-band communication, and telemetry collection. Hardware Polyglot: Strong understanding of the architectural differences in managing firmware across systemboards, network stacks (InfiniBand/Ethernet), and GPU architectures. Failure Domain Expertise: A paranoid mindset regarding hardware health. You know how to verify if a device is truly healthy post-boot and how to safely execute an unattended rollback if it isn't. Scripting & Infrastructure Code: Proficiency in Python, Go, or advanced shell scripting alongside configuration management tools (Ansible/Salt) to interact with hardware APIs. Nice-to-Haves Experience working within the OpenBMC ecosystem or building custom BMC firmware images. Deep operational familiarity with NVIDIA/Mellanox firmware management tools (mstflint, mlxup). Experience managing firmware lifecycles specifically within large-scale AI/ML training clusters or high-performance computing (HPC) environments. Innovation, creativity and personal responsibility are not just buzzwords for us—they are part of everyday life. Your health comes first, with ergonomic workstations, subsidies for computer glasses and participation in the JobRad bike‑leasing program. Receive up to €110 per month in childcare support for preschool‑aged children. Enjoy free daily breakfast, fresh fruit, coffee, tea and water, as well as subsidized lunch. You can also look forward to additional gifts to celebrate your birthday and other special occasions. Experience a warm, family‑like work environment with regular team events that are not only fun, but also strengthen our bond. items.desc: A Snapshot of Your Day Join our dynamic team and immerse yourself in the exciting world of power systems and controls! You will build transient models for grid-connected converters and plants, including renewable energy systems, battery energy storage systems (BESS), HVDC, FACTS, and microgrids. Imagine defining and developing controller concepts that enhance the performance of converter-based assets, from inner controls to plant-level energy management. You will investigate the interactions among various systems, ensuring robust performance during normal operations and faults. Your expertise will drive innovation as you apply data analytics and AI/ML methods for predictive maintenance and load forecasting, all while mentoring the next generation of engineers in this critical field. How You’ll Make an Impact Develop and validate transient models for converter-based grid assets, including renewables, BESS, HVDC, FACTS, industrial loads, data centers, and microgrids Design, tune, and assess control strategies from converter inner controls to plant-level energy management and supervisory functions Implement grid-following and grid-forming controls, including synchronization, voltage/frequency support, and fault ride-through capabilities Analyze interactions between converter controls, plant controllers, and protection systems to optimize system performance and reliability Perform dynamic, transient, and small-signal studies to evaluate system behavior and support controller tuning in weak and low-inertia grids Apply advanced analytics and AI/ML techniques for forecasting, anomaly detection, predictive maintenance, while providing technical leadership and mentoring What You Bring Master’s degree or PhD in Electrical Power Systems, Control Engineering, or a related field with a focus on power systems and controls Extensive professional experience in power-system modeling and studies, including development and validation of RMS and EMT models Strong understanding of power-system dynamics, stability, fault response, and control interactions Practical expertise in converter-based technologies and control architectures, including grid-following and grid-forming controls Proficiency with industry-standard simulation tools (e.g., PowerFactory, PSCAD/EMTDC, MATLAB/Simulink) and programming in Python, MATLAB, or similar environments Strong communication and collaboration skills, with experience in data analytics/AI/ML considered an advantage; fluent English required, German a plus About the Team In our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more. Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo Our Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. We started out in Hamburg back in 2014, but we’re now humbled to call the world our playground, with over 260 employees spread across 13 countries (we’re remote-first), 2600+ international clients, delivering research from +190 markets, globally. Want to be a part of the Appinio movement? Here at Appinio, we value transparency in our recruitment process , and we've created a blog to share what to expect during each step of our journey together: here Your mission as a (Senior) Product Designer We’re looking for a (Senior) Product Designer (m/f/d) to help shape the core experiences of our B2B research platform and B2C panel app. You'll work alongside a team of product designers, product managers and engineers to identify problems, explore solutions and ship great products. Take ideas from early concepts and prototypes to polished UIs and shipped features. Prototype in code . Build and test ideas directly in the existing product using tools like Cursor. Raise the bar for craft . Sweat the details, from typography, color and spacing to composition and interaction, to make our products feel polished and considered. You will thrive in this role if You are autonomous and proactive . You don’t need every problem fully specified before you can get started. You take initiative and own features end to end. You are craft-driven . You have a high bar for quality and know how to make software feel polished down to the smallest details. You are experienced in complex software . You’ve designed dashboards and platforms with complex workflows and information structures, not just websites. Ideally with experience in data visualization and dashboarding. You are strong in information design . You know how to turn complex information into clear, easy-to-understand interfaces. You are a systems thinker . You build reusable patterns rather than isolated screens and have experience working with design systems. You are comfortable with motion . You use motion intentionally to communicate state, time and dynamism. You are a collaborative team player . You work closely with product managers and engineers as well as stakeholders across the organization to find the right solutions and bring them to life. You are curious about new technology . You actively experiment with AI tools in your design workflow and look for new ways to work and build. Kind reminder: Please ensure that your application is submitted in English. This post not only outlines our ideal candidate but also serves as an inspiration for what this role can evolve into. Even if you consider yourself an 80% fit but have a genuine passion for this position, we encourage you to apply. We're eager to hear from individuals who share our enthusiasm. Appinio is an equal-opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status. Experience in the operational management of IT infrastructure solutions or in IT Project Management related to network infrastructures. Strong teamwork skills and ability to collaborate effectively within multidisciplinary environments. Flexibility and adaptability to different operational and project requirements. items.card: you will work at the intersection of agility and security: You will benefit from fast decision-making processes, enjoy genuine creative freedom in your projects, and be able to build upon the stable foundation of the Schwarz Group. Here, you will shape the face and services of our cloud: You will develop the STACKIT Portal and Marketplace, the central interface for our customers - from robust backend services to the
items.desc: Location Am Campus 1 74177 Bad Friedrichshall Employment Area IT - Cloud Services Level Experienced professional Working Model Full-time Reference ID 5202 Schwarz Digits creates the technological foundation for digital sovereignty in Europe. As the IT and digital division of the Schwarz Group, we develop and manage the IT infrastructures for the retail divisions Lidl and Kaufland, as well as Schwarz Production and PreZero. At the same time, we operate as an independent provider in the external market to support companies across Europe in their digital transformation. We bundle our core services in the areas of Cloud, Cyber Security, Data & AI, Communication, and Workspace. Join us and contribute to digital sovereignty in Europe. With us, you will work at the intersection of agility and security: You will benefit from fast decision-making processes, enjoy genuine creative freedom in your projects, and be able to build upon the stable foundation of the Schwarz Group. Here, you will shape the face and services of our cloud: You will develop the STACKIT Portal and Marketplace, the central interface for our customers - from robust backend services to the user interface. Your Tasks You build it, you run it! You take responsibility for the design, implementation, and operation of our applications in the STACKIT Marketplace – focusing on Go backend services or acting as a versatile fullstack developer. Go & Backend Specialist: You design and develop scalable backend services and Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) architectures in Go (Golang), providing high-performance REST and gRPC APIs. UX/UI Realizer: In close collaboration with our UX designers, you transform wireframes and prototypes into pixel-perfect, responsive, and accessible user interfaces that delight our customers. Quality First: You don’t just write code; you guarantee the highest software quality through unit tests and end-to-end tests. Teamplayer & Visionary: You work agilely with Product Owners and Backend Engineers to turn technical visions into reality and actively drive the further development of our frontend tech stack. Mentor & Coach: You enjoy sharing your knowledge! You support your colleagues with code reviews and establish best practices in the our domain. Your Profile Backend or Fullstack Engineer: You have several years of experience in professional software engineering, primarily focused on backend development (Go, microservices, API design) or fullstack development. Go & API Enthusiast: You master Go (Golang) or a comparable modern backend language and have deep expertise in REST API design and microservice architecture. Frontend Experience (Optional / Plus): Knowledge of Angular, TypeScript, and modern web architectures is a major plus for fullstack profiles, though optional for pure backend specialists. Tooling Pro: You are familiar with build tools (Webpack, NX), package managers (npm, yarn), and have experience setting up CI/CD pipelines (e.g., with GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps) for frontend deployments. Cloud Affinity: Basic knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes is a plus, as you work in a "You build it, you run it" environment and can deploy your containers yourself. Problem-Solver: Complex UI logic or asynchronous data streams don’t make you sweat – your analytical skills help you find elegant solutions. Teamplayer: You are a communication pro and enjoy working agilely in a team that pushes each other. Communication: English (spoken and written) is a must, as we are positioned internationally. German is a plus. Your contact Heiko Kiefer Recruiter E-Mail:recruiting@mail.schwarz What happens once you applied? 1 Application We love simplicity. Apply quickly and easily digitally, even without registration. 2 Checkup Together with the department, we take a look at your documents. 3 Interview When you first get to know each other, the focus is on both your personality and your professional suitability. 4 Contract offer Have we convinced each other? Then your employment contract is on its way to you digitally by e-mail. 5 Welcome Your first day of work with is about to begin and your individual onboarding in the team begins. We look forward to seeing you!

items.desc: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: Our Implementation Consultants start the customers journey after signature working with our top customers. They own the customer relationship and are responsible for a successful deployment of Samsara's solution. You understand the value they are trying to achieve and work with them to define and deliver a project plan to achieve this. Your role will be cross-functional in nature, working alongside and connecting Sales, Support, Sales Engineering, and Product, enabling you to experience multiple aspects of a hyper-growth company from within. Will require travel to customer sites for up to 30% of the time, which may include overnight stays. You should apply if: You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster. You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable. You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team. You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment. You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there. In this role, you will: Be the Samsara advisor, managing the deployment of Samsara technology to customers, enabling customers to achieve quick time to value in their investment Lead solution workshops to develop L1 processes for business process Guide customers through change management processes including policy, comms and training Run training sessions, demonstrate Samsara's technology, and work through obstacles with executives and day-to-day users of the system across numerous use cases Juggle multiple customer engagements in parallel and work cross-functionally to deliver an exceptional experience for our customers Minimum requirements for the role: 2+ years of experience in an implementation consultant, project manager, or onboarding role. Enterprise SaaS and hardware experience preferred Strong project management skills with ability to follow methodologies 2+ years experience supporting or working with technical products Solutions-oriented with strong problem-solving & project management skills Excellent consultative skills with experience in end-to-end system implementations Experience managing >20 implementations/projects at a time Proven track record of building trust and communicating effectively with a wide variety of stakeholders: executives, Product and Engineering senior management, day-to-day users of our software Passion for going above and beyond the call of duty, taking initiative, and thriving in a fast-paced, change-heavy environment Fluency in English and German (spoken and written) is a mandatory requirement for this position An ideal candidate also has: Strong bias for action, the ability to think big, with insistence on high standards Change management delivery experience Experience using AI or automation into CS workflows to drive measurable productivity improvements. Total Rewards At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, …

As part of BA Wind you will play a key role in one of the most exciting pipelines in the industry with 24GW of capacity
items.desc: Company Description Vattenfall is a European energy company with approximately 20 000 employees. For more than 100 years we have electrified industries, supplied energy to people’s homes and modernized our way of living through innovation and cooperation. We are looking for talented individuals who, in addition to their passion for their own role, also have strong team spirit and want to contribute to supporting a meaningful corporate mission. Job Description Business Area Wind is responsible for Vattenfall’s Onshore and Offshore Wind, as well as other non-hydro renewable initiatives like PV/Solar and batteries. We currently develop, construct and operate wind generation assets across Sweden, Denmark, Germany, the Netherlands and the UK. As part of BA Wind you will play a key role in one of the most exciting pipelines in the industry with 24GW of capacity stretching out more than a decade ahead across our key European markets. You won’t only be involved in developing projects but pioneering cutting-edge innovation, new business models and ways of working with communities and the environment. Working as part of a leading European utility also means you could be helping a growing number of major businesses and brands achieve their own sustainability goals through partnerships. As (Senior) Project Engineer you deliver engineering work packages for a development or execution project by ensuring technical compliance, coordinating technical interfaces with other work packages, communicating with suppliers and stakeholders, and managing quality, risks and documentation throughout the contract lifecycle. You will lead the cable accessories scope, including HV terminations, fibre optic terminations, hang-offs and installation accessories, as well as their associated installation methodologies and technical interfaces. Key Responsibilities : Ensure delivery of assigned work packages per contractual requirements and standards Perform technical review of reports, design and system studies supplied by contractors and third parties (e.g. Accessories Design and Installation Procedures, technical studies and investigations,.) and verify compliance with Vattenfall’s requirements Support supplier qualification activities, factory visits, inspections, testing and technical workshops as required Review and support development of offshore installation, handling, termination and testing procedures Interface with other packages and plant suppliers, to ensure consistency, technical compatibility and quality of the performed works Manage technical queries and coordinate resolution with relevant stakeholders Ensure timely documentation of findings, lessons learned and proactively share knowledge within the department and the wider organisation where relevant Monitor and report on safety, quality, progress, and cost in a structured and timely manner Manage risks, opportunities and mitigation plans for own scope Engage with internal stakeholders to handle deviations from the Employer’s Requirements Collaborate with Legal/Contract Management on claims related to IAC Plan and coordinate assigned technical activities within the project schedule Represent technical interests within cross-functional project discussions We welcome applications from candidates at either Intermediate or Senior level. For Intermediate-level candidates, we are particularly interested in individuals who demonstrate strong technical capabilities, a high level of motivation, and a willingness to learn and develop further Location : The role will be based in one of Vattenfall’s office locations in Amsterdam (Netherlands) or Hamburg (Germany). Some travel to other offices/suppliers shall be expected. items.desc: Join Tylko, Where Design Meets Technology Founded in Warsaw, Poland, in 2015, Tylko is redefining how we design, shop for, and experience furniture. Frustrated by mass-produced, one-size-fits-all solutions, the team created something smarter: bespoke storage that balances cutting-edge technology, premium craftsmanship, and sustainable production. With millimetre-perfect precision, every piece is made-to-order and crafted locally , minimising waste and maximising longevity. The result? A new standard in furniture – one that fits your space, your style, and your life. Why It Matters We’re not just building furniture. We’re changing how people think about living with it. By merging technology and design, we help people create spaces that truly reflect who they are. If you believe that good design can make everyday life better, you’ll feel right at home here. How We Work We believe in small teams, big ideas, and simple processes. No endless paperwork, no silos. Just open communication, shared goals, and a healthy dose of curiosity. We start small, think big, and move fast, because progress always beats perfection . At Tylko, collaboration and trust aren’t buzzwords - they’re how we work. From day one, you’re part of a team that makes real decisions and brings them to life together. You’ll have the freedom to share ideas, turn them into action, and shape the space around you literally. Here, learning isn’t a bonus. It’s part of the job. AI is part of how we work - it's not an add-on here . We treat it like any other tool worth knowing: it helps us think, decide, and move faster. We're not looking for people who "know AI" - we're looking for people curious enough to rethink how they work altogether. You don't need to be an expert on day one - you need the drive to grow. About the Role We’re currently looking for a Design Advisor (minijob position) to join our team in the Berlin flagship store . If you’re passionate about design and love helping people create beautiful, functional spaces, this role is for you. You’ll be the bridge between Tylko’s product innovation and our customers, offering expert advice and a personalized experience rooted in creativity and technology. As a Design Advisor, you’ll be part of a close-knit showroom team, supporting customers through every step of their journey – from exploring personalised furniture options to configuring their ideal piece. Your goal? To make every visit inspiring, informative, and deeply connected to the Tylko brand. Once you join our Team you will be responsible for: Customer greeting and consultation, providing tailored design advice and product recommendations Introduction and explanation of Tylko’s configuration system, materials, sustainability initiatives, and R&D innovations in a clear and engaging manner Guidance through digital configurator and augmented reality tools to help customers visualise and personalise furniture Collaboration with architects, interior designers, and B2B clients visiting the showroom Maintenance of visual merchandising standards to ensure alignment with Tylko’s brand identity Support for in-store events such as talks, workshops, and design activations Collection of customer feedback and sharing insights with HQ and R&D teams Contribution to store performance goals, including customer satisfaction and sales targets What we offer for this particular role: A chance to shape Tylko’s flagship retail presence and influence our physical retail strategy Competitive salary with performance-based bonus Employee discount on Tylko products Inspiring work environment in the heart of Berlin Opportunity to grow within a fast-scaling European design brand Access to training, development, and cross-team collaboration with HQ What we’re looking for: Passion for design, furniture, and architecture – supported by studies or strong personal interest Excellent communication skills in German and English Skilled at explaining technical product details in a simple, engaging, and passionate way Approachable and confident in communication – able to quickly build trust, understand customer needs, and offer thoughtful, personalised design advice Comfortable using digital tools, such as configuration software and CRM systems Team-oriented mindset with a proactive, entrepreneurial approach Motivated by innovation, sustainability, and creating great customer experiences Openess to work in a minijob position; flexibility to work weekends and evenings as required by retail operations It would be an additional plus if you have: Previous experience in a customer-facing role (retail, showroom, hospitality, or service)

items.desc: About the Role As a Quantum Computing Security Researcher, you bring deep expertise in mathematical methods for quantum computing, software development in Python, backed by a minimum MSc in Physics with a quantum physics focus. You have hands-on experience developing software for quantum systems, or quantum technologies within embedded systems. You excel at modeling quantum threats — side-channel attacks, adversarial pertubations, backdoors, … — and translating into practical security defenses. You will be one of Haste's first quantum security researchers pioneering defenses for quantum compute environments alongside HPC and AI workloads. Key Responsibilities Investigate side channels, adversarial perturbations, backdoors and quantum system vulnerabilities. Develop Python research software and proof-of-concept implementations. Translate findings into defenses and production-grade requirements. Document research through reports, whitepapers and demonstrations. Monitor quantum security research, standards and frameworks. Requirements Minimum MSc in Physics focused on quantum physics. Current residence in Germany or Austria. Full-time availability from December 1, 2026, remote from Germany or Austria only. Quantum computing mathematics, Python development, quantum threat modeling and security engineering capabilities.

items.desc: DESCRIPTION AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain, and we're looking for talented people who want to help. You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. As a Global Product Lifecycle Engineer, you will provide electrical infrastructure support to AWS data centers. You will collaborate with the product development team to gain a deep understanding of all facets of each product as they are being developed and tested, then take engineering ownership of the product through its operational life. You will be a global subject matter expert for electrical products deployed in data centers. We are looking for engineers with hands-on design, manufacturing, and installation experience. The right candidate will have led product design efforts, have an understanding of electronics, and know how products should be manufactured to ensure quality. They should be capable of understanding detailed equipment specifications and evaluating the merit and risks of design changes. Amazon has a global presence. Travel will be necessary but is not expected to exceed 30%. International support will be part of the job, and some international travel may be required. Contributions could include leading international projects and developing engineering information packages. An understanding of international electrical product design requirements is helpful but not necessary. Key job responsibilities Review, update, and approve equipment submittals Work with global electrical equipment suppliers and manufacturers Build trust and relationships with different stakeholders (e.g. reliability, operations, design, compliance) Work on concurrent projects, in multiple geographic zones Understand and explain complex systems in clear and concise language Provide support to Field Engineering for root cause analysis, with collaboration with quality team for component-level investigations, maintenance and troubleshooting support, and operating procedure review for both mechanical and electrical issues. Listen to the voice of the customer to understand if there are improvements that can be made to increase product reliability or availability. Work with global supplier and manufacturers to design product improvements, and to oversee root cause analysis. Contribute to our global body of knowledge and drive a cycle of continuous improvement at a global scale A day in the life In this role, you'll focus on the electrical products that form the backbone of AWS data centers worldwide. You might start your day reviewing equipment submittals and specifications, then transition into a collaborative session with our product development team to understand how new electrical systems are being designed and tested. You'll work across multiple geographic zones simultaneously, sometimes supporting field engineering teams through root cause analysis investigations, other times partnering with global suppliers to explore design improvements. Your work includes translating complex electrical systems into clear documentation and guidance for operations teams, while staying connected to how your decisions impact customer reliability and availability. You'll also contribute to our collective knowledge base, sharing insights that help drive continuous improvement across our global infrastructure. About the team The Electrical Products and Services team works to design and develop resilient, cost-effective electrical distribution products and systems. As an engineer at Amazon, we are responsible for achieving world class uptime for our customers. We drive continuous advancements and improvements with our designs and communicate technical direction to Senior Leadership. We seek new ways to enhance the reliability, scalability, and cost effectiveness of our engineering designs. As an engineer at Amazon, you can design, innovate, and improve the products our customers rely on. As the successful candidate you will build trusted scientific relationships with healthcare professionals and research partners in Ireland. You will share clear, evidence-based medical information, gather clinical insights, and support local medical and research activities across the team. We value curiosity, clear communication, collaboration, teamwork and a strong patient focus. This role offers clear growth opportunities, meaningful impact on patient care, and alignment with our mission of uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. You will join a supportive team that values collaboration, clear feedback and professional development. You will expand your scientific and stakeholder engagement skills. Your work will directly influence medical strategy and improve patient care. We create a place where people can grow, be their best, be safe, and feel welcome, valued and included. We offer a competitive salary, an annual bonus based on company performance, healthcare and wellbeing programmes, pension plan membership. In this role you will Build and strengthen trusted, peer-to-peer scientific relationships with healthcare professionals and key stakeholders. Lead balanced, evidence-based scientific exchange, translating complex and emerging data into clear discussions that support informed clinical decisions and patient care. Contribute to clinical development by identifying and qualifying potential investigators and clinical sites. Represent GSK at scientific meetings, congresses, and expert forums, fostering scientific dialogue and bringing relevant knowledge back to the organisation. Maintain a detailed understanding and a deep appreciation of the science and evidence for the treatment options in the therapy area. Identify, develop and execute medical projects and evidence generation activities in collaboration with external experts and internal partners. Display flexibility, which may include working in a different therapeutic area if necessary. Why you? Basic Qualifications & Skills: We are looking for professionals with these required skills to achieve our goals: Degree in medicine, pharmacy, life sciences or a related field. Pharmaceutical-industry experience in Medical Affairs, Medical Science Liaison or a related scientific role. Ability to make complex scientific information clear, relevant, and engaging for healthcare professionals. Demonstrated experience in building trusted, peer-to-peer relationships with experts and healthcare teams. Ability to work independently, take initiative, and organise priorities effectively while complying with relevant regulations and standards. Preferred Qualifications & Skills: Please note the following skills are not necessary, just preferred, if you do not have them, please still apply: Advanced degree in medicine, pharmacy, life sciences or a related field. Experience supporting clinical trials, investigator-initiated studies, or real-world evidence projects. Previous experience with prelaunch and launch medicines. Familiarity with the Irish healthcare system, including hospitals and reimbursement processes. Strong presentation and facilitation skills that encourage meaningful scientific discussion and learning. Proven ability to identify and engage key opinion leaders and academic experts. A collaborative mindset, enthusiasm for continuous learning, and a commitment to contributing within cross-functional teams. Location The role is based in Dublin and offers a hybrid working arrangement, with an expectation of being in the office 2–3 days per week for team collaboration, combined with remote working. Closing Date for Applications – 19th November 2026 (COB) Please take a copy of the Job Description, as this will not be available post closure of the advert. items.desc: What are we building? At Hard Rock Games, we’re not just making games—we’re crafting experiences that connect people, deliver thrills, and celebrate the spirit of Hard Rock. As the social casino gaming arm of Hard Rock Digital, our teams shape every stage of the journey from concept to launch to live operations, giving our teams the ability to innovate, experiment, and make real impact. With the backing of a globally recognized brand, we combine the agility of a startup with the reach of an entertainment powerhouse. Here, creativity thrives, ideas scale, and careers grow. We’re looking for passionate creators, builders, and innovators to join us in shaping the future of free-to- play gaming. Let’s play hard. What’s the position? Hard Rock Games is hiring a Slot Mathematician to design, model, and validate the math behind our slot games across our game portfolio. You will own the mathematical correctness of every game - from design through player-facing release - ensuring models meet target performance metrics and regulatory requirements. Key Responsibilities Design and model slot game math: reel strips, paytables, symbol weights, bonus features, free spins, and jackpots. Tune models to hit target RTP, hit frequency, and volatility, including multiple RTP variants. Analyze simpler games directly using data analysis tools; write and validate simulations in code for more complex games. Playtest game builds and verify that implemented games match the designed model, payouts, and feature behavior. Produce PAR sheets and comprehensive math documentation for internal review and certification labs (GLI, BMM). Support regulatory certification across jurisdictions by answering lab and regulator questions. Partner with game designers early, advising on feature costs in RTP and impact on volatility. Help build a shared Java codebase of simulators, model libraries and math tools, starting from our existing tools. Work closely with developers from specification through release to ensure correct math implementation. Leverage AI tools to prototype ideas, generate code, and explore possibilities - while maintaining full ownership of correctness. What are we looking for? 3+ years designing math models for slot games with shipped titles in iGaming, Social, or Land- Based environments. Experience in a regulated environment is preferred. Ability to build and analyze slot models directly using data analysis tools - comfortable performing direct mathematical analysis. Strong programming and problem-solving skills; Java preferred, but solid Python, C++, or C# is welcome. Comfort with version control systems like Git and working in shared code repositories. Strong grasp of probability, combinatorics, and expected-value analysis. Ability to manually verify, derive, and explain math results. You understand why a model is correct, not just that it runs. Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field. Clear communication skills - explaining math concepts to designers, producers, and regulators. What’s in it for you? Make a visible impact: you’ll own campaigns and events that shape how millions play. Fast-paced execution + brand heritage: build boldly under the Hard Rock name. Competitive compensation with flexible vacation and hybrid work. Be part of a player-obsessed, inclusive team that trusts your autonomy and skills. Influence product strategies, your post-mortems and insights will steer our roadmaps. Roster of Uniques We care deeply about every interaction our customers have with us, and trust and empower our staff to own and drive their experience. Our vision for our business and customers is built on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where regardless of background or beliefs you feel able to be authentic and bring all your talent into play. We want to celebrate you being you (we are an equal opportunity employer).
