items.desc: About COPE Galway COPE Galway has been providing essential social services in Galway for 60 years . We respond to the needs of people experiencing homelessness, women and children subjected to domestic abuse, and we support older people towards healthy, independent ageing. Our vision is for a community where every person is valued, cared for, and supported at every stage of life. COPE Galway is deeply embedded in the Galway community. We are founded on the belief that together we can make a positive difference in the lives of the people we serve and our community. Our People Our People, COPE Galway staff and volunteers, are the driving force behind everything we do. Their passion, commitment, and professionalism enable us to deliver a wide range of services, support more people, and make a real impact in the community. We have a diverse range of roles, from frontline support workers and social care professionals to catering, community engagement and other professional roles. Each role is crucial in ensuring we deliver our services effectively and make a positive impact in the community. Working with COPE Galway Joining our team means you will make a lasting, positive impact on the lives of the families and individuals we support and contribute to driving meaningful social change in the community. Whether you are a frontline worker directly supporting clients or in an administrative role, you are vital to our efforts to address critical issues like homelessness and domestic abuse and to ensure that older people are valued and supported. At COPE Galway, we prioritise the development and wellbeing of our people. We offer a supportive work environment, with opportunities for ongoing training, personal and professional growth, and leadership development. Our Culture We foster an inclusive, supportive and respectful workplace , where diversity is valued. Our team is united by a shared mission and a genuine passion for empowering people and creating meaningful change. We take a trauma-informed approach to the way we work and foster this culture in every aspect of the organisation, including a focus on the health and wellbeing of our staff. Homeless Services COPE Galway Homeless Service supports families and individuals in Galway who are homeless or at risk of becoming homeless. We provide residential and non-residential services, including a day centre, street outreach, supported temporary accommodation and seasonal cold weather responses. Our family services offer family-focused support, emergency accommodation, and specific developmental support for children. Our resettlement service and Housing First programme teams work with individuals moving on from homelessness to secure long-term housing. The Role There is a reliance on private emergency accommodation (PEA) including B&Bs, Hotels, Tourist Hostels, Holiday apartments etc. to meet the emergency accommodation needs of families, individuals and couples who are homeless in Galway. COPE Galway Family Services and the COPE Galway Day Centre organise and facilitate placements on behalf of Galway City Council and Galway County Council in such accommodation with bookings ranging in duration from as little as one night to a number of weeks and months at a time. The overall purpose of this role is to source suitable private emergency accommodation and to co-ordinate and support engagement with accommodation providers in conducting assessment of this accommodation against required standards. The role will involve visiting PEA emergency accommodation on a regular basis including in advance of placements and on foot of complaints and feedback for the purposes of ensuring that required standards are being met and resolving accommodation related issues with families and individuals (in conjunction with another staff member when required). The role was also involve liaising with accommodation providers on behalf of clients, COPE Galway and the local authorities adopting a solutions focused approach. The role will have direct interactions with people in Homeless Services. It is a challenging and also rewarding position focused on finding the best emergency accommodation placements possible for people despite resource challenges/accommodation shortages, working to ensure that the accommodation is maintained at the required standards and striving to support placement sustainment for people experiencing homelessness. The team member will manage relationships with accommodation providers and support the PEA Administrator to deal with the administration tasks associated with these placements. The role includes ensuring that booking forms are accurate and up to date at the point and time of placement and reviewing any changes/adjustments to the bookings. This requires working in close cooperation with the PEA, Family Services and Day Centre teams. With a proprietary software portfolio and deep expertise in vertical domains, TXT Group operates across different markets, with a growing footprint in Aerospace, Aviation, Defense, Industrial, Government and Fintech. The holding company, TXT e-Solutions, has been listed on the Italian Stock Exchange - STAR segment (TXT.MI) - since July 2000. TXT Group headquartered in Milan and has subsidiaries in Italy, Germany, the United Kingdom, France, Switzerland and the United States of America. Junior Automotive UX/UI Designer: TXT E-Tech, part of the TXT Group, is looking for a Junior UX/UI Designer to join the UX team of a leading international automotive group. The successful candidate will contribute to the design and evolution of digital experiences connected to the vehicle ecosystem, supporting the development of infotainment systems, mobile applications, and digital platforms for end users. Responsibilities Define and enhance the user experience of infotainment systems and companion applications. Design user flows, wireframes, interactive mockups, and high-fidelity prototypes. Plan and conduct usability testing with end users, transforming insights into actionable design improvements. Analyse CX/UX metrics, monitor market trends, and benchmark competing solutions. Contribute to the definition and maintenance of the Design System by creating reusable UI components and interaction patterns. Leverage AI-powered tools to support ideation, prototyping, and interface exploration activities. Collaborate with development teams and stakeholders to define, prioritise, and plan new product features and enhancements. Requirements Must-Have Qualifications 1-2 years of experience as a UX/UI Designer. Knowledge of User-Centered Design and Design Thinking methodologies. Strong proficiency in Figma and/or Miro. Understanding of Design Systems, reusable components, and design libraries. Familiarity with AI tools applied to the design process. Good command of both Italian and English. Nice-to-Have Qualifications Experience in the automotive industry, particularly in HMI (Human-Machine Interface) and infotainment systems. Knowledge of vehicle connectivity and telematics technologies. Familiarity with digital ecosystems connecting vehicles and mobile devices. Understanding of Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban). Basic knowledge of cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS. Foundations in project management. Soft Skills Strong communication skills. Ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary and international teams. Analytical mindset and attention to detail. Curiosity, proactivity, and a genuine interest in emerging technologies and AI. Ability to organise workload efficiently and manage multiple priorities. Education Bachelor's or Master's degree in Design, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Equivalent professional experience will also be considered. Why Join TXT Group? Career development opportunities within a fast-growing and evolving company with an international and dynamic environment. Ongoing training and professional development aligned with your role and career goals. Comprehensive corporate benefits package, including private health insurance, welfare programmes, meal vouchers, and employee discounts across the Group. Permanent employment contract. Hybrid working model. Annual gross salary ranging between €30,000 and €33,000, depending on experience and skills. Employment terms and classification defined according to the candidate's profile and the provisions of the Italian Metalworkers' Collective Labour Agreement (CCNL Metalmeccanico). The position is open to all qualified applicants regardless of gender, in accordance with Legislative Decree 198/2006. TXT Group is committed to equal opportunities and values diversity and inclusion in all its forms.

items.desc: L’ IT Technical Support svolge un ruolo fondamentale nel garantire il funzionamento fluido ed efficiente dei sistemi IT aziendali . La figura fornisce supporto tecnico operativo per assicurare il corretto funzionamento dei sistemi informatici e la produttività degli utenti, contribuendo al contempo alla digitalizzazione dei processi aziendali all'interno dell’ecosistema Microsoft e Office 365 e supportando gli ambienti di rete e cloud. L’IT Technical Support riporta all’IT Manager. Provvede all’attivazione e alla manutenzione degli accessi secondo le approvazioni del CISO; non dispone di autorità approvativa sui diritti di accesso. 2. Obiettivo/Missione Mantenere l’infrastruttura IT essenziale: sistemi operativi, strumenti di sicurezza, applicazioni, server, siti web, sistemi di posta elettronica, laptop, desktop, software e hardware. Assumere la responsabilità operativa di progetti e soluzioni nell’ambito di iniziative aziendali più ampie. Gestire attività IT critiche per il business e attività di amministrazione dei sistemi. Ricercare e valutare tecnologie emergenti, hardware e software; monitorare e mantenere aggiornato l’inventario hardware e software. 3. Responsabilità Diagnosticare, analizzare e risolvere problematiche hardware e software segnalate dai dipendenti, fornendo supporto tempestivo tramite telefono, e-mail o di persona. Installare, configurare e mantenere desktop, laptop, stampanti e dispositivi periferici; fornire supporto su sistemi Windows/Linux e sulle più comuni applicazioni aziendali. Creare e gestire account utente, permessi e diritti di accesso secondo le approvazioni del CISO e le richieste di HR o del Team Leader di riferimento. Il CISO approva gli accessi; l’IT Technical Support ne gestisce l’attivazione operativa. Documentare incidenti e relative risoluzioni per garantire la tracciabilità; creare e mantenere documentazione relativa ai sistemi IT, alle procedure e alle guide utente. Eseguire attività di manutenzione ordinaria e aggiornamenti per garantire prestazioni ottimali e adeguati livelli di sicurezza; gestire procedure di backup e disaster recovery. Collaborare con l’IT Manager per l’escalation di problematiche complesse e per modifiche infrastrutturali. Fornire supporto alle infrastrutture di rete e ai dispositivi di accesso alla rete (switch, router, VPN), garantendone configurazione e connettività (requisito preferenziale, non obbligatorio). Supportare iniziative di digitalizzazione (SharePoint, Teams, Power Automate) e attività basilari di gestione delle infrastrutture cloud (Azure, AWS). Facoltativamente, gestire e mantenere il sito web aziendale Drivesec (attualmente basato su WordPress). 4. Autorità L’IT Technical Support riporta all’IT Manager (ITM). Non dispone di autorità decisionale in materia di governance degli accessi: può creare e gestire account utente, permessi e diritti di accesso esclusivamente sulla base delle approvazioni del CISO e delle richieste provenienti da HR o dal Team Leader di riferimento. Opera con autonomia nella risoluzione degli incidenti e nelle attività di manutenzione ordinaria nel rispetto delle policy IT aziendali. 5. Competenze e qualifiche richieste Formazione ed esperienza Diploma o Laurea in Informatica o discipline affini. È preferibile un’esperienza di almeno 2 anni in ruoli di supporto tecnico o help desk, anche in tirocini o progetti personali. Competenze tecniche Solida conoscenza dell’ecosistema Windows e Office 365. Familiarità con i concetti base del networking (TCP/IP, VPN), troubleshooting hardware e configurazione di periferiche. Conoscenza di base delle piattaforme cloud (Azure, AWS), dei sistemi di ticketing e degli strumenti di assistenza remota. Soft Skills Attitudine al problem solving e orientamento al cliente interno. Capacità di definire le priorità e gestire più attività contemporaneamente. Comunicazione chiara ed efficace. Pensiero analitico e capacità di individuare soluzioni pratiche e innovative. items.desc: Since 1994, Microdata Due has been a trusted leader in advanced fire safety technologies for the marine industry. As part of Consilium Safety Group, we develop innovative safety solutions that protect lives, assets, and operations worldwide. Backed by Antin Infrastructure Partners, a leading private equity firm, Consilium Safety Group is on an ambitious growth and transformation journey. Working closely with colleagues in production and engineering, you will carry out testing, troubleshooting and verification activities throughout the manufacturing process. Good practical knowledge of laboratory instruments, including oscilloscopes, multimeters and function generators. Good working knowledge of Microsoft Word and Excel. Experience in manufacturing wiring harnesses, including soldering, crimping and wire-wrap connections. Experience in preparing production and quality documentation, such as Test Reports, Process Flow Charts and Certificates of Conformity (CoC). The team builds systems that transform real-time information from live events into clearer, more actionable views of games for partners and clients. Working at Apex Logic Lab offers the opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge tools that support analysis, performance insights, and fan experiences. In this position, the individual will attend live sporting events or designated venues to capture real-time game data, including plays, statistics, and contextual information, using company tools and applications. Responsibilities include monitoring game flow, entering data with high accuracy and speed, verifying entries against established standards, and reporting any anomalies or technical issues to the operations team. Ability to work on-site in the Milan area, including evenings and weekends as available. Responsibilities: Your responsibilities will include: Designing and simulating transistor-level analog circuits, from individual functional blocks to top-level hierarchical integration. Developing an understanding of semiconductor device operation, limitations, and reliability requirements. Using and developing behavioral models for chip-level simulations. Supporting and reviewing analog and top-level IC layout activities. Contributing to chip floorplanning and package-design activities. Actively participating in technical discussions related to top level architecture and desing reviews. Preparing clear and accurate technical documentation. Performing laboratory evaluation, product validation, characterization, and debugging. Supporting the development of production test solutions to enable successful product qualification and release. Requirements: Strong understanding of fundamental electronics principles and the ability to apply them to circuit-design challenges. Familiarity with analog circuit operation and a basic understanding of digital design concepts. University-level experience in the design and simulation of basic analog circuit blocks is preferred. Ability to collaborate effectively with analog, digital, verification, layout, test, and other engineering teams involved in the product-development process. Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. Willingness to learn, receive feedback, and actively contribute to team activities. Good organizational skills and the ability to work toward project milestones and deadlines. Strong motivation for continuous learning and professional growth. Demonstrates a strong inclination toward innovation and knowledge sharing, with a willingness to present technical results and contribute to internal conferences and technical forums. Minimum Qualifications: Master's degree in Electronic Engineering, Applied Physics - Electronic, or a related technical discipline. items.desc: Job Description Summary Job Description Responsible Investment team and role overview The Aegon Asset Management Responsible Investment team brings together ESG, sustainability and impact expertise at the heart of our investment business. The team plays an important role in investment research and product development, engagement, client discussions and helps both the firm and our clients navigate the evolving sustainability landscape. The team works closely with investment, product and client teams across Continental Europe, while collaborating with Responsible Investment specialists across Aegon Asset Management globally. Based in Amsterdam, the 7-person highly international team works in a hybrid model, combining close in-person collaboration with the flexibility of remote working. This is an exciting opportunity for someone at the start of their career who wants to build a strong foundation in responsible investment. We are looking for someone who is curious, proactive and eager to learn and develop. You will gain hands-on experience across sustainability research, engagement, ESG and impact data, and reporting, working on real investment and sustainability questions from day one. You will learn from an experienced international team and, as your knowledge and confidence grow, have the opportunity to take on increasing responsibility and develop your own areas of expertise. Please note that this is a one-year fixed-term position. Depending on business needs and circumstances, there may be an opportunity to extend the role beyond the initial term. As part of the Responsible Investment team, you will get exposure to different aspects of responsible investment. You will support: Sustainability Research : Working closely with the rest of the RI team. Researching material ESG issues facing potential investment opportunities. This includes analyzing, identifying improvements and monitoring company and sector specific ESG issues. Engagement & Voting: Supporting engagement with companies to encourage improvements identified. Working with the wider team to plan, execute and document engagement efforts (letters, calls, meetings); and provide sector and company analysis to support engagement with corporates, policy makers and investor bodies. Contributing towards voting at the company Annual Meetings. ESG and Impact data Reporting: Carrying out a robust monitoring and reporting processes, supporting other team members with ESG and impact research, reporting and data management. Providing data to various teams and external clients. Start your career in responsible investment, learn from an experienced international team, work directly on real investment and sustainability questions, and progressively build your own areas of expertise. Required Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, management, political science, international development, or related fields Genuine interest in responsible investment; familiarity with ESG issues is an advantage Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, Dutch is a distinct advantage Able to work independently and establish/maintain working relationships internally Proactive and collaborative attitude, comfortable asking questions and learning from others A strong learning mindset, intellectual curiosity and eagerness to develop professionally Preferred Qualifications: Master’s degree in a relevant field Strong verbal and written communication in Dutch are an advantage Company Overview: Aegon Asset Management (Aegon AM) is a leading global investor. Our 350+ investment professionals manage and advise on assets of US $446 billion for a global client base of pension plans, public funds, insurance companies, banks, wealth managers, family offices and foundations. We organize our firm around four investment platforms: fixed income, real assets, equities and multi-asset & solutions, which includes a fiduciary and multi-manager business. Each investment platform has dedicated teams with deep asset-class expertise, organized globally and committed to maximizing client benefit from their specialist areas. We are an international business: Our 1,130 employees work from 16 locations across Europe, the Americas and Asia. We share a common belief in fundamental, research-driven active management, underpinned by effective risk management and a commitment to responsible investment. Compensation/What will you be getting? items.desc: Krijg jij energie van data en wil je bouwen aan iets waar je echt trots op kunt zijn? Bij Prijsvrij Vakanties en D-reizen draait alles om data: van betrouwbare datastromen tot automatiseringen, dashboards en analyses die collega’s helpen betere keuzes te maken. Ons data team groeit, en daarbij geloven we in één ding: de juiste persoon is belangrijker dan de juiste functietitel. Ben jij een echt datatalent? Dan maken we graag een plek voor je. Vertel ons waar jouw krachten liggen, dan kijken we samen hoe jij het beste tot je recht komt in ons team. ✈️ Bij ons data team kun je terecht als: Data Engineer: je bouwt en beheert pipelines, databases en koppelingen, en zorgt dat data klopt en beschikbaar is; AI Engineer: je bouwt toepassingen met LLM’s en AI-agents en zorgt dat AI echt waarde toevoegt in onze processen; Data Scientist: je ontwikkelt voorspellende modellen en zet machine learning en AI in waar het waarde toevoegt; Data Analyst: je vertaalt vragen uit de organisatie naar heldere analyses en bouwt dashboards in Power BI die collega’s dagelijks gebruiken; Business Analyst: je vormt de brug tussen de business en het data team, en zorgt dat de juiste vragen worden beantwoord. Herken je jezelf in een combinatie van deze rollen? Nog beter! Dit krijg jij: De allerbeste deal! De reis van jouw leven met een positie in een informele organisatie, waar harde werkers het verschil maken voor onze klanten. De mogelijkheid om je intern te ontwikkelen en door te groeien. Wij ontvangen je met open armen in een hecht en gezellig team, waar je samen met je collega’s bijdraagt aan onze missie: een zorgeloze reis voor de beste prijs! items.desc: Your mission Will you be our new all-round Front Office employee at the Holiday Inn Express Amsterdam - City Hall? We are looking for a new colleague for one of the most vibrant hotels in Amsterdam, a real all-rounder who likes variety and a challenge. Do you have a heart for the reception and do you like variety? Then this role is really something for you. A work day as an all-round Front Office employee: You enter one of the nicest hotels in Amsterdam, we opened in 2018 and everything still looks spick and span. Your colleagues say hello and you walk to our back office. Here we do a handover, look at the arrivals and check-outs of the day and get started. Today again very nice international guests with whom you can have a chat. You tell them about Amsterdam and what they can do here. There is laughter and the guests see you as a real insider. Some guests come in wanting a drink, so you step behind the bar and pour them a nice drink. It's wonderful to see the variety between different departments and the contact with the guests. Two colleagues come by and you have a chat. The end of your shift is approaching and you ensure that the reports are closed, your cash register is correct and you prepare the handover for your colleagues. The next two days you are off, in the middle of the week while the rest of the Netherlands is at work! Who we are and what defines us About Holiday Inn Express Amsterdam - City Hall In April 2018 we opened our Holiday Inn Express Amsterdam - City Hall and since then we have been delighted to receive many international guests. We have 89 rooms and a cozy bar that is also part of the reception. As a result, we have a lot of personal contact with our guests. We are part of Borealis Hotel Group and managed by Interstate Hotels & Resorts. BHG is a fast growing well known hotel developer with hotels operating in Europe under the brands IHG, Hilton, Accor. So plenty of opportunities to grow. Your profile Do you have the X-press factor? Are you able to follow certain policies and standards, are you precise but at the same time creative to come up with new ideas? Then we would like to welcome you at the Holiday Inn Express Amsterdam – City Hall. What are you bringing? Computer skills, some experience in reception – front office and the desire to work on flexible times and days, just like your colleagues. Benefits Because you become part of a growing hotel group, you get on the personal development train from day one. With us you are immediately on the radar and we take you along in your career, whereby your training and development are our top priority. We pay well and you get a discount at thousands of IHG hotels all over the world! Are you as excited as we are? Then we look forward to receiving your motivation letter & CV About us Borealis Hotel Group Is an expanding European hospitality company which develops, owns, operates and manages select-service, full-service and extended-stay hotels, which are all branded by international hotel chains like InterContinental Hotels Group, Accor, Hilton Hotels & Resorts and Marriott. Founded in 1997 and headquartered in Amstelveen & Wiesbaden, our passionate and experienced team started building todays portfolio in 2016. Being active in the Netherlands, Belgium, France, Germany, Austria, Spain and Denmark and being backed by strong institutional investors, it is our ambition to further grow our portfolio. Our vision and values We consider our values to be self-evident. Nevertheless, they are indispensable to achieve our ultimate goals: To be the most attractive hotel operator for employees, brands & investors, by delivering operational excellence that results in the highest guest satisfaction. What sets us apart The soul of our hotels, which are a result of the behaviour of our employees. That’s where we are proud of. The feeling to be part of one and the same family! Creating joyful people experiences together: for our guests, our colleagues and stakeholders! We love the hotel industry! The combination of high standards of professionalism and quality as well as humanity and closeness. The balance of happy employees, satisfied guests and economic success. A good working atmosphere, opportunities for advancement, appreciation and the chance to make a difference.

items.desc: Bij Scenius bouw je software die je terugziet in het echte leven: betaalplatforms, pin terminals en apps die door miljoenen mensen worden gebruikt. We doen dat voor startups, scale-ups en enterprises in fintech, legaltech, healthtech en daarbuiten, en we zijn erbij van het eerste idee tot na de release. Dat doen we vanuit ons eigen kantoor in Eindhoven, in vaste teams waarin ook de oprichters nog altijd meebouwen. Je werkt bij Scenius en blijft dat ook: naar de klant ga je als het product daarom vraagt, daarna bouw je weer verder met je eigen team. Klanten komen terug met hun volgende product, en daardoor groeien we hard. Die groei investeren we ook in onszelf. Zo staat er op kantoor ons eigen AI-cluster, Codey, met 10 GPU's en ruim 750 GB VRAM, waarop we open source modellen draaien en AI in onze producten bouwen. Projecten waar wij aan werken Voor Pay.nl maken we de telefoon tot kassa, met encryptie, kaartcommunicatie en software voor terminals die dag en nacht moet draaien. Voor in3 bouwen we een modulair betaalplatform met iDEAL- en Rabobank-integraties en een mobiele app op Kubernetes. En voor Appir werken we aan een e-commerceproduct waarin aanbevelingsalgoritmes bepalen welke kleding je ziet. Wat je gaat doen als Software Developer Als Software Developer bouw je mee aan complete digitale producten. Je denkt mee over het product design en de architectuur, schrijft de code en spreekt de klant direct. Je reviewt elkaars code, beslist samen met de mensen die het bouwen en blijft na de oplevering betrokken, zodat je ziet hoe je werk zich in productie houdt. Je werkt aan 2 soorten projecten. Soms bouw je iets vanaf nul, van een eerste MVP tot een volwaardige release. Soms stap je in bij een product dat al draait en moet groeien, met meer gebruikers, betere performance of nieuwe koppelingen. Het eerste vraagt om durven kiezen, het tweede om goed begrijpen wat er al staat. Bij Scenius doe je allebei, of het nu gaat om custom software, een webapplicatie, een mobiele app of een AI-implementatie. Onze stack Backend en architectuur: .NET (C#), Python, Go, microservices, Enterprise Service Bus Frontend en mobile: React, React Native, TypeScript Cloud en DevOps: Kubernetes, Azure, AWS, GCP en Codey Wie jij bent Je bent een productbouwer. Je wilt iets opleveren dat echt gebruikt wordt, en daarna weten hoe het zich houdt bij duizenden mensen tegelijk. We zijn kritisch op wie we aannemen, omdat iedereen hier keihard verantwoordelijk is voor wat de klant krijgt. Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in een professionele softwareomgeving Een hbo- of wo-opleiding, of werk dat laat zien wat je kunt Ervaring met een strict typed, goed gedocumenteerde en goed geteste enterprise stack Ervaring met agile werken in teamverband Goed Nederlands in woord en geschrift Wat we bieden Bij Scenius bepaal je zelf hoe je werkt, zolang je levert wat je belooft. Je groeit door steeds meer van het product in handen te nemen, en je mag daarbij helemaal jezelf zijn, met of zonder gebruiksaanwijzing. Serieus werk, met plezier onderweg. Een goed salaris en direct een vast dienstverband Afwisselend werk: enterprise software voor de ene klant, bleeding edge technologie voor de andere, in B2B en B2C Veel verantwoordelijkheid en direct contact met de product en engineering teams bij de klant zonder lagen management ertussen Altijd toegang tot Codey, ons eigen AI-cluster, om nieuwe modellen te testen en AI in je werk te gebruiken Je eigen pc, werkplek en lichtshow, helemaal naar jouw smaak samengesteld Flexibele werktijden: begin ergens tussen 6 en 11 uur, zolang je je uren maakt en laat weten wat je doet. Hybride werken kan ook Een team dat ook buiten het werk samen optrekt: de gezamenlijke lunch, game-avonden, een racesimulator op kantoor en elk jaar minstens één LAN-party Solliciteren Solliciteren is simpel: stuur je cv via het formulier hieronder. Heb je een product, repo of project waar je trots op bent? Stuur het gerust mee, dan praten we er in het eerste gesprek graag over. Arbeidsvoorwaarden: Bedrijfsfeesten Flexibele werkuren Lunchkorting Werk vanuit huis Taal: Nederlands (Vereist) Toestemming om in Nederland te werken: Nederland (Vereist) Werklocatie: Hybride werken in 5642 Eindhoven

items.desc: The Performance Marketeer We’re looking for a hands-on, experienced Performance Marketeer to join our growth team in Rotterdam. Monday Merch is one of the fastest-growing companies in the Netherlands. We give companies worldwide one place for all their merch: design, production, long-term storage, online stores and events, in 15+ countries. This is an in-house role. You directly own most of our Google and Microsoft Ads accounts and countries, you work with a freelance specialist who runs a few countries, and you work day to day with a founder and the growth team. The team You join the growth team at our Rotterdam office: one founder who leads growth and is your day-to-day counterpart, a UI/UX designer who designs and builds our site, landing pages and shop, and our design and content people. Remote, you work with a freelance Google Ads specialist who runs about 30% of the countries and search budget, a Meta Ads specialist, and our SEO, web and analytics support. Our office in the centre of Rotterdam holds 40+ young, international, bright and hard-working people. Our Megacenter on the edge of the city adds about 60 more, and a remote team of around 100 people works with us worldwide. Your Goal Grow the number of new customers we win through paid search, at a cost that keeps every market profitable, and help us hit our yearly targets. You run the main markets and 70%+ of the budget yourself, and you work with the rest of the team to improve everything around the ads: tracking, landing pages, offers. Your Metrics New-customer ROAS (per market) New opportunities per month (per market) Responsibilities Be the in-house owner of paid acquisition. You run the main markets yourself and keep the whole picture together: a bi-weekly sync with our freelance Google Ads specialist (smaller markets) and our Meta Ads specialist, one shared plan across all markets, and the cross-market work (tracking, feeds, structure) done once for everyone. As you gain more experience, you grow into leading paid acquisition as a whole. Run Google Ads and Microsoft Ads for your markets (about 70% of budget): execute the weekly change list (keywords, negatives, targets, budgets), challenge it when the data says otherwise, and keep the accounts clean. Keep every market on pace against its monthly and yearly plan, and act when it drifts. Own tracking and attribution. Our B2B sales process can be long and complicated. Our CRM sends opportunity and deal values to the ad platforms; you make sure that stays accurate across Google, Microsoft and GA4. Our tech team builds and adjusts, you specify and test. You have all the data and tools at your disposal: Claude, GA4, PostHog, CRM and platform data, and you dig in yourself. Write and test ad copy and assets across languages, with native speakers where needed. Pick landing pages that match the search, brief and run landing-page tests with our UI/UX designer and content people, and keep Merchant Center and the Shopping feeds healthy across markets. Run new experiments: new campaign types, new markets, new offers. Think along on the bigger picture with the growth lead: which market offering we improve next, which product categories we advertise on and how we make them profitable. You pull in the people it takes: UI/UX, product, content, sales. Work with our AI tooling (Claude) every day. Pick up growth work beyond ads when it comes up: outbound campaigns, new channels, content, landing pages. Search stays your core, but nobody here stays only in their own lane. You Work hard, are results-driven, and like being measured on real outcomes. Have 2–4 years hands-on in SEA or performance marketing, on accounts of €50k+ per month. Work in a structured way. Are AI-pilled: you get excited about trying new ideas and finding better ways to work with AI. Communicate clearly in English. Dutch and other languages are a plus. Why Monday Merch? Rapid growth opportunities in a fast-paced scale-up, and one founder as your direct counterpart. One account, €2M+ a year, real ownership of execution and growth across 10+ markets, including US. Work from our beautiful office in the city centre of Rotterdam. Work with great tools (including a brand new MacBook) and bright, hard-working people. Yearly workation (2026 was Gran Canaria). Salary: €3,400–4,100 gross per month on a full-time basis, depending on experience. Paid days off: 23 days per year. Full-time, on-site at our Rotterdam city-centre office, no systematic WFH FD Gazelle 2026 and Deloitte Technology Fast 50 2026: experience working at one of the fastest-growing companies in the Netherlands. How we hire A 20-minute call. Interview at our office: you walk us through an account you ran, and we go through one of our markets in detail. Offer, usually within a week

items.desc: About the role At YoungOnes, you make sure our platform delivers on its promise: stable, reliable and free of surprises for the people who use it every day. As a QA Engineer you don't work at the end of the chain, but right in the middle of our development teams. You think along before any code is written, test smartly where it matters, and act as the bridge between development, product and the rest of the company when it comes to quality. You report to the Teamlead Frontend and work daily with the frontend, mobile and backend teams. What you'll do Think along from the start. You join refinements and help teams see the risks and impact of a feature before they start building; Choose the right test approach. Together with the team, you decide per feature what to test automatically, what to test manually, and why; Build and maintain automated tests. You set up tests for key platform functionality and keep them reliable; Manual and exploratory testing. You go through the app yourself, look for edge cases and find what a script misses; Central point of contact for bugs. Bug reports from across the company come to you. You reproduce them, gather all the information a developer needs to get started, and get them ready in Jira with the right priority; Advise on releases. You map out risks and give clear advice on the quality of a release; Provide insight. You collect test data and show how our software quality is doing; Keep the balance. You help teams weigh fixing bugs against building new features. What you bring A bachelor's level of working and thinking, preferably in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field; At least 2 years of work experience, including at least 1 year as a QA Engineer, Software Tester or Test Automation Engineer; Experience setting up and carrying out a test approach and test plans; Experience with test automation and test frameworks; You're comfortable working with AI tools and use them purposefully: to test faster and better, and to set up automated tests; Experience working in an Agile/Scrum team and with a bug tracking system, preferably Jira. You work independently, make decisions in your own work and give advice, whether asked or not; You're critical and analytical, take initiative and work well with developers, product and business. Nice to have Knowledge of TypeScript/JavaScript and you're comfortable working with code; You look beyond "does it work?": also at accessibility, speed, security and multilingual support. Experience with tests that run automatically on every code change, and you know how to deal with unreliable tests; You enjoy sharing knowledge and helping colleagues test better; Experience testing mobile apps. We're looking for someone who sees quality as something the whole team owns. You don't just perfect your own testing work; you ask yourself what needs to change structurally so the whole team tests better. Our own values guide the way: Own it , Say it , Make it . What we offer A gross salary between €3,400 and €4,800 based on full-time employment; 25 vacation days, 6.5 ADV days and 1 additional holiday per calendar year, based on a 40-hour workweek; 8% vacation pay, a pension plan, and (if you live more than 10 km from the office) a travel allowance; We prioritize mental well-being in collaboration with our partner OpenUp; Great perks such as: a yearly fitness budget, a freshly prepared healthy lunch every day, snacks, bi-weekly afternoon drinks, XL borrels every three months and much more;

items.desc: Company Description Milestone One is a Site Enabling Services organization with global headquarters in Zug, Switzerland. We understand what clinical study sites need and our overall mission is to support sites in stronger study delivery. Job Description The Full-Stack Developer will design, build, and maintain the internal platforms, applications, and integrations that run Milestone One’s business. Our applications have a React/TypeScript front end, an API layer, and a database backend, hosted on Azure and integrated with Microsoft 365. We work data-first: we design and document the data structure, build the API from that specification, and then build the front end. You will work in a small team alongside AI coding agents, with security, data protection, and documented testing built into how we deliver. Role responsibilities: Design and document data models and databases (Azure SQL) for our central data platform, internal applications, and reporting Develop secure REST APIs and backend services (.NET / C#, Azure App Service or Functions), with access checks in the API and permissions enforced at both the API and data layers Build React/TypeScript front ends that integrate with our company intranet and follow the Milestone One design system Build integrations between internal systems and third-party services (APIs, webhooks, data imports) Work in GitHub: pull requests, code reviews, GitHub Actions CI/CD, and automated code and secret scanning Define infrastructure as code with OpenTofu, using Managed Identity and Key Vault instead of stored secrets Write automated tests with Playwright and support business users during acceptance testing Use AI coding agents productively and safely, reviewing, testing, and taking ownership of all generated code Follow our change management and system validation procedures, and keep technical documentation current Collaborate with stakeholders to shape requirements and turn them into working solutions Qualifications Professional experience building web applications with React/TypeScript and a backend language such as C# / .NET (we welcome both experienced and early-career developers) SQL — schema design, data modelling, and writing efficient queries REST API design, authentication and authorization (Entra ID, OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect) Git branching, pull requests, and code review; CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps) Azure fundamentals — App Service, Azure SQL, Blob Storage, Key Vault, Managed Identity Secure coding practices (e.g. OWASP Top 10) and care for personal and sensitive data Willingness to work in a regulated environment: change control, testing evidence, audit trails, and data integrity Fluent in English, written and spoken Nice to Have .NET 8 / C# — REST API development (Entity Framework or Dapper) Infrastructure as code with OpenTofu or Terraform Automated testing with Playwright or similar tools Professional experience working with AI coding agents or assistants Azure Functions, Static Web Apps, API Management, Front Door / WAF v2 Star schema / dimensional modelling (staging dimension fact ETL) Microsoft Graph API and Microsoft 365 integration Clinical trial domain knowledge (sites, studies, patients, financial events) Knowledge of data protection requirements such as GDPR and HIPAA Additional Information If you feel it is time to make your skills and knowledge visible within a developing company with true focus on its people, then Milestone One is the right choice for you.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. items.desc: Your role Salesforce QA Analyst What you'll be doing What We Need Corpay is currently looking to hire a Salesforce QA Analyst within our Fuel division. This position falls under our Vehicle Payments line of business and is located in Poland. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality and functionality of software products of company. This involves the development of test cases, execution of manual, and the identification and documentation of defects. The Tester works closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to ensure the delivery of high-quality software solutions. You will report directly into the QA Lead in this role. How We Work As a Salesforce QA Analyst, Corpay will set you up for success by providing: Company issued equipment Formal, hands-on training Role Responsibilities The responsibilities of the role will include: Analyzing business and technical requirements to develop test plans and test cases. Identifying testing objectives and ensure adequate test coverage. Performing manual testing for functional, regression, and integration scenarios. Analyzing results of automated tests. Identifying, documenting, and reporting defects with detailed steps to reproduce. Working closely with developers to verify fixes and resolve issues. Contributing to the creation and maintenance of automated test scripts. Using testing frameworks and tools to enhance efficiency. Working with the development team to understand system functionality. Participating in Agile ceremonies, such as daily stand-ups and sprint reviews. Maintaining test documentation, including test cases, test plans, and results. Providing detailed testing reports and status updates to stakeholders. Suggesting improvements to testing processes and methodologies Staying updated with the latest tools, trends, and techniques in software testing. Qualifications and Skills : Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 4+ years of software quality assurance experience, including hands-on testing of Salesforce or comparable SaaS and CRM platforms. Demonstrated ability to independently analyze business and technical requirements, define test coverage, and create clear test plans, cases, and test data. Strong experience with manual functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end testing, with the judgment to prioritize risk and release readiness. Experience reviewing automated test results and contributing to automated test scripts using QA tools, frameworks, or CI/CD pipelines. Proficient in defect lifecycle management and Agile delivery practices, with strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business team Benefits & Perks Competitive Salary Pension Contributions 25 days of annual leave Pay during Parental leave Eye examinations and a subsidy for the purchase of glasses (if needed) Pay Transparency The salary range for this position is 12,124 - 15,154 PLN gross per month. The final offer will be determined based on objective, gender-neutral criteria including relevant skills, professional experience, and qualifications. Corpay maintains structured compensation practices and regularly reviews pay to support compliance with equal pay principles and applicable EU legislation. Additional compensation elements, including benefits and variable pay (if applicable), will be discussed during the recruitment process. About Corpay About Corpay Corpay is a global technology organization that is leading the future of commercial payments with a culture of innovation that drives us to constantly create new and better ways to pay. Our specialized payment solutions help businesses control, simplify, and secure payment for fuel, general payables, toll and lodging expenses. Millions of people in over 80 countries around the world use our solutions for their payments. At Corpay, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and respectful workplace where employees are valued for their diverse perspectives, experiences, and contributions. We believe that diversity, equity, and inclusion strengthen our teams, drive innovation, and support our continued success globally. As part of our hiring process, offers of employment may be subject to the successful completion of pre-employment screening conducted by an authorized third-party provider, in accordance with applicable laws and Corpay policies. Screening requirements may include employment references, identity verification, criminal record checks, financial or sanctions screening, and other background checks relevant to the role and permitted by local law. Notice to Recruitment Agencies and Search Firms: Corpay does not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies or search firms without a valid written agreement in place. Any unsolicited candidate submissions will become the property of Corpay, and no fees will be paid related to such submissions. …

Współpraca z jednostkami sprzedaży, obsługi klienta, marketingu i komunikacji, analityki, IT oraz innymi zespołami zaangażowanymi w rozwój i realizację działań dla klientów. Śledzenie działań konkurencji, trendów rynkowych i rozwoju marketingu bezpośredniego; przekładanie obserwacji na konkretne propozycje działań. Przygotowywanie prezentacji, podsumowań i materiałów wspierających decyzje biznesowe; przedstawianie wniosków interesariuszom, również na wyższych szczeblach organizacji. W realizacji zadań pomoże Ci Wykształcenie wyższe. Umiejętność analitycznego i koncepcyjnego myślenia oraz wyciągania wniosków z danych i wyników działań. Umiejętności organizacyjne, samodzielność i odpowiedzialność za powierzone zadania oraz nastawienie na realizację celów. Proaktywność i otwartość na szukanie nowych rozwiązań, połączone z umiejętnością komunikacji i współpracy z różnymi zespołami. Znajomość pakietu MS Office. Znajomość języka angielskiego na poziomie średniozaawansowanym. Mile widziane Doświadczenie w obszarze zarządzania wartością klienta, CVM, CRM, marketingu bezpośredniego, kampanii, utrzymania klienta lub zarządzania relacjami z klientami. Znajomość rynku telekomunikacyjnego. Doświadczenie w pracy z kampaniami CRM, testami A/B, analizą efektywności lub zespołami pracującymi w metodyce Agile. W T‑Mobile wierzymy, że najlepsze doświadczenia klientów tworzą ludzie, którzy mają wpływ na to, jak rozwijamy nasze usługi i sposób działania. Do zespołu CVM szukamy Starszego Specjalisty lub Starszej Specjalistki ds. Zarządzania Wartością Klienta, który/-a pomoże nam rozwijać obszar zarządzania bazą klientów B2C. To rola dla osoby, która chce współtworzyć kierunki rozwoju, prowadzić inicjatywy o dużym znaczeniu i budować długoterminową wartość dla klientów. Jeśli chcesz mieć realny wpływ na produkty, procesy i doświadczenia klientów w T‑Mobile, zapraszamy do aplikowania. Dołączając do CVM, zyskasz: możliwość współtworzenia kierunków rozwoju usług i procesów w T‑Mobile; udział w projektach o strategicznym znaczeniu, w tym inicjatywach międzynarodowych; współpracę z ekspertami z różnych obszarów organizacji; dostęp do nowoczesnych narzędzi (w tym AI), elastyczne środowisko pracy, kulturę feedbacku i partnerską atmosferę; stabilne warunki zatrudnienia i atrakcyjny pakiet benefitów. Na tym stanowisku połączysz perspektywę strategiczną z codziennym wpływem na realizowane inicjatywy. Rozwiniesz swoje kompetencje i zbudujesz widoczność oraz pozycję ekspercką w organizacji. Biorąc udział w naszych rekrutacjach możesz liczyć na uczciwość i transparentność. Dokładnie i sprawiedliwie rozważamy każdą kandydaturę, bez wyjątku. Dla nas nie ma znaczenia Twoja rasa, kolor skóry, Twoja orientacja seksualna, tożsamość płciowa, pochodzenie, niepełnosprawność, poglądy, wygląd, czy religia, która wyznajesz. Liczą się tylko Twoje kompetencje. Gwarantujemy Ci także, że uczestnicząc w rekrutacjach do #MagentaTeam zawsze otrzymasz informacje zwrotną! Jesteśmy firmą technologiczną, a naszym celem jest tworzenie innowacyjnych rozwiązań dla klientów ondywidualnych i biznesowych. W T-Mobile wszyscy żyjemy w świecie magenta! Kolor ten jest nam bliski, bo oznacza wiarę w powodzenie podejmowanych działań, pewność siebie i wytrzymałość. Właśnie tacy jesteśmy jako zespół. W #MagentaTeam stawiamy na wymianę doświadczeń, zwinną pracę i szybko adaptujemy się do zmian! #MagentaTeam to jednak przede wszystkim mix różnych kompetencji i doświadczeń, osobowości, temperamentów i poglądów. items.desc: Job Title: TMF Associate Employment Type: Full time, Permanent Job Reports To : Manager, TMF Operations Department/Unit Name : TMF Operations Job Summary: Responsible for the management of the Trial Master File (TMF) content and associated processes during the study life cycle from study set up to transfer/archiving. Work in partnership with study teams during periodic file reviews and audits to address findings related to the TMF. Manage access and organization of the controlled electronic file repository, in line with the defined file structure and access management framework. Work proactively and successfully within a cross-functional team. Communicate and promote department and company goals and practices. Interact with stakeholders in a way that fosters a positive working atmosphere and encompasses a professional and helpful attitude. Time allocated may be adjusted based on need. Service Delivery Serve as the primary TMF contact for assigned studies. Ensure TMF is complete and “inspection ready” throughout study lifecycle and documents are filed contemporaneously. Work with Team Lead to create study specific TMF management and oversight documents (e.g., File Index, Expected Document Lists and TMF Management Plan) in alignment with study. Develop and maintain study-specific work instructions, as needed. Utilize organization skills to maintain a quality control schedule and perform periodic inventories of study TMF to ensure completeness. Review and communicate out-of-scope and/or incomplete documents to study teams; escalating as needed. Reconcile expected document lists based on study events and milestones. Prioritize and resolve TMF help desk tickets; may include triaging activities. Provide study specific TMF training to internal and/or external stakeholders, as needed. Process and review documents, following applicable scanning and best practices and best practices, and applying ALCOA principles appropriately. File and retrieve TMF documents in a timely manner. Department Support Complete routine administrative tasks in a timely manner (e.g., timesheets, metrics). Participate in discussions, decisions and sharing of knowledge in department meetings, periodic presentations, and smaller working groups. Seek opportunities to assist in the development, implementation and maintenance of internal systems (e.g., databases used to manage records). Provide mentorship and training to junior level staff. Propose suggestions and work on the development and maintenance of department quality system documents to improve efficiencies. Qualifications The successful candidate will possess a college diploma/degree and 3 years of relative related experience or on going training. They will have an understanding of TMF organization, implementation, and archival including relevant regulations and guidance to assure quality and integrity of TMFs. Have the ability to incorporate the principles of ALCOA in relation to TMF oversight. Utilize skills in time management and problem-solving. Identify challenges and problems and take the initiative to identify solutions. Demonstrated computer literacy, proven functional knowledge of Microsoft packages and potential to develop. Working Conditions Home based, with the ability to go into office occasionally if needed. Accommodations for persons with disabilities are available on request in respect of all aspects of the recruitment and selection lifecycle. items.desc: Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide! About Vonage Vonage is a global cloud communications leader in the $100B+ CPaaS market. Customers including Airbnb, Snapchat, and thousands of enterprises depend on our APIs and SDKs to deliver SMS, voice, and messaging at scale. The Technical Routing & Quality team sits at the heart of this — owning the configuration and performance of every message and call that traverses the Vonage network. Why This Role Matters Every OTP SMS, enterprise marketing message, and API-triggered communication travels through routing groups owned and maintained by this team. As a Technical Routing Analyst, you will own the day-to-day quality and cost performance of global SMS and voice routing, ensuring traffic is delivered reliably, efficiently, and at the best possible margin. What You Will Do Monitor and respond to quality alerts (SMSCR, DLR Success Ratio, Rejected/Undelivered, Queue, Bind-down) via Zendesk and Tableau, following established investigation processes Provide 24x5 follow-the-sun routing assurance coverage in rotation with regional peers Perform proactive quality assurance across SMS and voice destinations — identifying degraded suppliers and initiating route changes Manage country-level routing: evaluate supplier performance against cost and quality targets and implement tiered routing decisions Onboard and test new supplier connections (SMPP/MM4/MM7 protocols) in coordination with Connectivity Operations Identify and escalate carrier degradations, encoding errors, and throughput issues, coordinating resolution with CORT and suppliers Contribute to automation initiatives that improve supplier onboarding times, cost management, and quality alerting Participate in regional handover processes and maintain clear handover notes for the next-shift team Support the migration of SMS services from IBM Data Centres to AWS What You Will Bring Solid understanding of SMS routing fundamentals — SMPP protocol, DLR codes, encoding, conversion rates, and delivery ratio metrics Experience working with carrier or telco routing systems and monitoring tools (e.g. Tableau, Zendesk, or equivalent) Analytical mindset with the ability to investigate degradation patterns, cross-reference data sources, and drive root-cause resolution Comfortable working in a fast-paced, 24x5 operational environment with on-call responsibilities Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to coordinate clearly across time zones with suppliers and internal stakeholders Experience collaborating cross-functionally with carrier, product, and engineering teams Nice to Have Familiarity with voice routing metrics (ASR, NER, MOS, PDD) and SIP fundamentals Experience with ML-driven or algorithmic routing systems Knowledge of RCS, Network APIs, or US direct carrier connectivity Background in a CPaaS, wholesale telco, or carrier operations environment About the Team The Technical Routing & Quality team is focused on three objectives: reducing tech debt, automating the core business, and investing in growth areas such as Network APIs, RCS, and US direct connectivity. We operate a follow-the-sun model and work closely with Carrier Partnerships, Product, and Engineering to deliver best-in-class routing services. #LI-WW1 There's no perfect candidate. You don't need all the preferred qualifications to make a valuable impact on our team. Our employees and customers come from diverse backgrounds, so if you're passionate about what you could achieve at Vonage, we'd love to hear from you. To learn how we process your personal data during the recruitment process, please refer to our Privacy Notice . Who we are: Vonage is a global cloud communications leader. And your talent will further help brands - such as Airbnb, Viber, WhatsApp, and Snapchat - accelerate their digital transformation through our fully programmable-based unified communications, contact center solutions, and communications APIs. Ready to innovate? Then join us today. Note: The purpose of this profile is to provide a general summary of essential responsibilities for the position and is not meant as an exhaustive list. Assignments may differ for individuals within the same role based on business conditions, departmental need or geographic location.

Podstawą przetwarzania danych osobowych jest dobrowolnie wyrażona przez osobę aplikującą zgoda, która może być w każdym czasie wycofana (przy czym nie wpływa to na wcześniejszą zgodność z prawem przetwarzania danych), a także prawnie uzasadniony interes administratora (obrona ewentualnych roszczeń). W każdym czasie, w zakresie dopuszczalnym wynikającym z przepisów prawa, przysługuje prawo dostępu do treści danych, prawo ich sprostowania, prawo usunięcia danych, prawo do ograniczenia przetwarzania, prawo do wniesienia sprzeciwu oraz prawo do przenoszenia danych. Oświadczenia w zakresie realizacji praw prosimy składać na adres e-mail: DataProtectionOffice@cargo-partner.com. Jeżeli mimo naszego wsparcia uznają Państwo, że dane osobowe przetwarzane są niezgodnie z przepisami obowiązującego prawa, przysługuje prawo wniesienia skargi do organu nadzorczego (tj. Prezesa Urzędu Ochrony Danych Osobowych). Odbiorcami przetwarzanych przez cargo-partner danych osobowych będą jedynie podmioty dostarczające i wspierające systemy teleinformatyczne cargo-partner. You are the bridge between business users and IT: you keep applications running, users supported and rollouts on track. At one of the world’s largest building materials companies, you’ll gain insight into logistics, manufacturing and finance, work with experts worldwide and learn by taking ownership of topics end to end. You’ll help bring fragmented local application support into a shared service that is scalable, professional and cost-efficient, improving service quality and consistency while reducing duplication. Along the way, you’ll build the skills, network and track record to pursue opportunities in application management, business process management, digital transformation or technology-enabled operations—with the scale and variety of a global company opening up different career paths. e completed by Natalia YOUR NEXT CHALLENGE Run your application portfolio. Take ownership of selected business applications used in Europe, AMWA and APAC, from vendor solutions to locally developed tools. Support users. Be the first contact for users from different countries and functions, by phone, online and via tickets. Understand the issue, give guidance, solve it or route it to the right team (e.g. an invoicing error, a missing user access, a dispatch system outage). Drive incidents, requests and changes. Follow each topic from request to resolution. Prioritise, coordinate with vendors, local IT and global teams, and keep users informed. Roll out and migrate. Support rollouts to new sites and countries and the move from local to global solutions: testing new releases, onboarding users, writing documentation and supporting go-live. Build solutions with AI. Design and build solutions and tools with AI-assisted development and low-code to close gaps in applications and meet recurring user needs, and grow your skills step by step as part of the AI Builders Initiative. Learn new processes fast. Get up to speed quickly on areas such as order-to-cash, logistics, dispatch, plant operations, laboratory and compliance, and on the applications behind them. Document and hand over. Maintain application documentation in LeanIX, runbooks and clear handovers, so knowledge does not depend on single people. Improve our services. Spot recurring issues, fix root causes and help set consistent ways of working in a new shared capability. Travel. Occasional travel within Europe, about one trip every three months at most. Required Qualifications : University degree in Business Informatics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Administration (IT or operations focus), Supply Chain Management, Logistics or a comparable field, with good grades. Early-career profile with motivation shown through relevant student jobs and internships. Excellent communication skills, confident on the phone and online with users from plant operators to senior management. User-oriented and pragmatic, with a hands-on, can-do mentality and end-to-end ownership of results. Strong analytical skills, structured prioritisation and root-cause problem solving. Quick and flexible learner of new processes, applications and tools. Ability to work effectively in international environments, with colleagues and users from more than 30 countries. Good MS Excel and PowerPoint skills. English at B2–C1 level, written and spoken. Nice to have: Experience with ServiceNow, Jira or LeanIX. Experience building small solutions and tools with AI-assisted development (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Codex, Cursor) or low-code (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Power Apps), for example from studies, student jobs or personal projects. Experience in manufacturing companies or software firms and start-ups. German, French or Italian; further languages are welcome. What we offer: Employment contract in well-established company that is part of Heidelberg Materials Group; Comprehensive benefit package, including private medical care, subsidized multisport card, holiday and childrens‘s summer camp allowances, culture and sport subsidies, fresh fruit at work; Extensive range of internal and external training opportunities; Cultural events and sports competitions for employees; Annual Bonus. What’s going to happen next? Once you apply to this job advert, our recruiter will reach out to you within a week. If there is interest on both sides, we will schedule a pre-screening call to learn more about your experience and motivation to join our team.

items.desc: About SpotOn We’re not just building restaurant tech, we’re giving independent restaurants the tools to compete and win. From our award-winning point-of-sale to AI-powered profit tools, everything we do helps operators boost profit, work smarter, and keep their best people. And every solution is backed by real humans who actually give a sh*t about helping restaurants succeed. Named the #1 Restaurant POS by G2 (Summer 2026), based on ratings from real users Rated the top-rated point-of-sale (POS) for restaurants, bars, retail, and small businesses by Capterra users Awarded Great Places to Work and Built In’s Best Workplaces for multiple years running We move fast, care hard, and fight for independent restaurant operators to do what they love, and love doing it. If you’re looking to make an impact with heart and hustle, SpotOn is the place for you. This is a build role. A lot of the tools and processes it needs aren’t built yet. Some don’t exist at all, some live in spreadsheets and inboxes, and nobody is waiting to hand you a playbook. You’ll find the gaps, build what’s missing, get people to use it, and then run it and make it better. You’ll be the right hand to SpotOn’s Partnership & Operations Manager and an instrumental partner to the rest of the company: Sales, Product, Marketing, Engineering, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, and everything in between. We expect this role to grow with the company, and we’re looking for someone who will grow into it. You’ll work hybrid from our Kraków office (3 days per week in the office, 2 days remote after probation), with core hours of about 16:00-00:00 PL time so you overlap with US Central mornings. If you’d rather build the thing than wait for it, this role is for you. On a daily basis, you will: Design and run vendor intake: every request has a sponsor, a budget owner, a clear problem, and a business case before a demo gets booked. Build the path from request to signature through Finance, Security and Privacy, Legal, and Product review, and make it visible, so anyone can see where a request is stuck and why. Build the contract and renewal calendar: owners, terms, notice windows, and auto-renewal dates. Nothing renews by surprise. Pull software and vendor contracts into one view of spend, and go find the spend that sits outside it. Support the commercial side: RFPs, evaluation scorecards, pricing benchmarks, total-cost models, and negotiation prep. Model open purchase orders and hardware commitments, so leadership knows what we’ve committed to buy and when the cash goes out. Help stand up our spend-management workflows: approval routing, thresholds, and review timelines. Prepare the Partnership & Operations Manager for meetings: the context, the open items, and what we need out of the room. Turn meetings into decisions, actions, owners, and due dates. Keep the tracker of open asks and commitments current, and chase what is late. Build deliverables: weekly operations updates, quarterly business reviews, leadership decks, status reports, and executive summaries, with every number traced to its source. Run the analysis behind them: data pulls, cost models, vendor and installation economics, and scenario comparisons. Support SpotOn’s merchant deployment strategy: installation partners, field-service operations, and rollouts of new devices. Track partner performance, cost, and capacity, and find what slows deployments down. Build the tools the team needs with AI and no-code platforms (trackers, intake forms, dashboards, custom assistants, and automations), inside our security and data rules. Find the operations workflows where AI saves real time, pilot them, train the teams, and measure adoption. Go find the people who own the answer, in any department, and build working relationships before you need them. Bring teams together on processes that no single department owns. Turn what you learn into documented, repeatable processes that outlast any one meeting. What skill are we searching for? Builder mindset: you’ve created something from nothing (a process, a tracker, a program, or a tool) and people actually adopted it. Self-starter and go-getter: you find the answer, the owner, or the data without being told where to look. Comfort with ambiguity: you bring structure to messy problems and stay steady when priorities shift. Influence without authority, across departments and levels. Daily, expert use of AI assistants such as Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini for research, analysis, writing, and meeting synthesis. You build reusable prompts, custom assistants, and AI workflows; no coding required. The judgment to check AI output against the source, and to know when not to use it. Comfort reading SaaS contract terms (order forms, MSAs, DPAs, renewal and termination clauses). Strong spreadsheet and modeling skills in Excel or Google Sheets. Clear, concise writing: you can turn a messy thread into a one-page summary. Familiarity with Salesforce, Jira or Confluence, BI dashboards, …

items.desc: Hager Supply Chain & Logistics Bieruń, Poland Permanent Dlaczego warto dołączyć do działu Materials & Planning? Weźmiesz udział w optymalizacji procesów i projektach doskonalących realizowanych w międzynarodowym środowisku Hager Group. Będziesz pracować z nowoczesnymi narzędziami wspierającymi planowanie, analizę danych oraz podejmowanie decyzji. Dołączysz do zespołu, który stawia na współpracę, wymianę wiedzy i ciągłe doskonalenie procesów. Jako Materials & Planning Specialist (k/m/x) będziesz podlegać Plant Material Planning Team Leaderowi z siedzibą w Bierun na podstawie umowy o pracę. Do obowiązków osoby zatrudnionej na tym stanowisku należeć będą: Zarządzanie procesem planowania materiałów oraz wyrobów gotowych w ujęciu end-to-end. Optymalizacja poziomu zapasów materiałowych. Optymalizacja wykorzystania zasobów produkcyjnych w średnim i długim horyzoncie planistycznym. Planowanie oraz harmonogramowanie produkcji z uwzględnieniem ograniczeń maszynowych, materiałowych oraz innych czynników wpływających na realizację planu. Proaktywna identyfikacja ryzyk, ich minimalizowanie oraz zarządzanie sytuacjami kryzysowymi, w tym rozwiązywanie problemów związanych z brakami materiałowymi i opóźnieniami dostaw. Ścisła współpraca z dostawcami oraz działami Produkcji, Industrializacji, Jakości i Demand Planning w celu zapewnienia ciągłości produkcji oraz realizacji potrzeb klientów. Współpraca międzyfunkcyjna, również w środowisku międzynarodowym, w ramach realizowanych projektów. Zapewnianie wysokiej jakości oraz aktualności danych planistycznych. Poszukiwanie praktycznych możliwości wykorzystania narzędzi cyfrowych oraz rozwiązań AI w celu usprawniania procesów planowania, wspierania podejmowania decyzji oraz poprawy jakości danych. items.desc: CloudLinux is a global remote-first company. We are driven by our principles: do the right thing, employees first, we are remote first, and we deliver high-volume, low-cost Linux infrastructure and security products that help companies to increase the efficiency of their operations. Every person on our team supports each other and does what we can to ensure we all are successful. Check out our website for more information: cloudlinux.com We are looking for an Infrastructure Operations Engineer (Linux) to join the CloudLinux Infrastructure Team . Our Operations (L1) team provides access, compute resources, and internal services, operates production infrastructure, and improves recurring operational work through documentation and automation. This job is perfect for you if you: Can independently troubleshoot Linux systems and networked services Take ownership of tickets and incidents through verified resolution or a clear escalation Make standard production changes safely, with rollback and post-change verification Communicate clearly with requesters and remote teammates Look for practical ways to improve recurring work through documentation and automation As part of the Infrastructure team, you will: Handle onboarding, offboarding, and access-management requests under established procedures: least privilege, the right approvals, and a check that the requested action actually works, not just the login Own common Linux and infrastructure requests and incidents from triage through verified resolution or escalation to a named owner Execute and verify standard host provisioning and production-server changes across bare metal, private cloud, and public cloud environments; escalate exceptions Troubleshoot DNS and perform approved DNS and domain-management changes under established procedures Execute approved firewall and operating-system changes with rollback and post-change verification Monitor infrastructure and respond to alerts and incidents. Judge recovery by whether people can do their work, not by a green status page, and send regular updates until recovery is confirmed. Tell alert noise from real damage, and fix the routing or ownership of an alert instead of silencing it Handle Jira requests according to agreed priorities and response times, keeping requesters informed Deploy standard services from approved specifications and runbooks; escalate design decisions Document recurring procedures for backup coverage and improve onboarding, offboarding, and access reviews through small automation changes Requirements Must-have: Hands-on experience troubleshooting Linux systems in a real or production-like environment; RHEL-family systems are preferred Working knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, and TLS, with the ability to isolate OS, network, and application failures Hands-on experience with at least one virtualization or cloud environment Ability to own an incident or ticket: gather evidence, prioritize by impact, communicate progress, verify recovery, and escalate with a clear hypothesis Experience executing standard production changes safely , including rollback and post-change verification Ability to read and adjust existing automation or create a small Bash or Python improvement; practical use of AI assistants for troubleshooting, scripting, and documentation, with verification before production changes Clear spoken and written English for asynchronous remote work Nice-to-have: Experience with OpenNebula, KVM, or another private-cloud or virtualization platform Familiarity with Ansible or another configuration-management tool Familiarity with Terraform, GitLab CI, or Jenkins Familiarity with Git Familiarity with FreeIPA, LDAP, or Google Workspace administration Benefits What's in it for you? A focus on professional development. Interesting and challenging projects. Fully remote work with flexible working hours, which allows you to schedule your day and work from any location worldwide. Paid 24 days of vacation per year, 10 days of national holidays, and unlimited sick leaves. Compensation for private medical insurance. Co-working and gym/sports reimbursement. Budget for education. The opportunity to receive a reward for the most innovative idea that the company can patent. By applying for this position, you consent to the processing of your personal data as described in our Privacy Policy (https://cloudlinux.com/candidate-privacy-notice ), which provides detailed information on how we maintain and handle your data.
