items.desc: SmartLunch to benefit, który naprawdę zmienia codzienność w pracy. Nasza platforma sprawia, że pracownicy mają dostęp do smacznych i zdrowych posiłków, a firmy pokazują, że dbają o ludzi nie tylko zawodowo, ale i na co dzień. Dowiedz się więcej na naszej stronie. Seniority: mid Lokalizacja: Wrocław Forma współpracy: B2B Stawka: 12 000-14 000 zł netto + vat Szukamy Product Designera , który chce mieć realny wpływ na rozwój produktu, a nie tylko projektować makiety. W SmartLunch stawiamy na podejmowanie decyzji w oparciu o dane, badania i bliską współpracę w zespole produktowym. W tej roli będziesz odpowiadać za projektowanie rozwiązań, które odpowiadają na rzeczywiste potrzeby naszych użytkowników: pracowników, firm i restauratorów, a jednocześnie wspierają realizację celów biznesowych. Twoim zadaniem będzie przekładanie problemów i hipotez na sprawdzone, intuicyjne i skuteczne rozwiązania. Co będzie należało do Twoich obowiązków? Prowadzenie pełnego procesu projektowego (end-to-end) - od zrozumienia problemu, przez badania i projektowanie, aż po przekazanie projektu do realizacji (handoff), wdrożenie i analizę efektów. Ścisła współpraca w Product Trio - codzienna praca z Product Managerem i Tech Leadem przy podejmowaniu decyzji o rozwoju produktu, określaniu zakresu MVP oraz szukaniu kompromisów łączących wartość dla użytkownika z możliwościami i kosztami technologicznymi. Samodzielne planowanie i prowadzenie badań użytkowników - realizacja wywiadów, ankiet i testów użyteczności oraz przekładanie wniosków na konkretne rekomendacje projektowe. Projektowanie ścieżek użytkownika (user flows), makiet i prototypów - z uwzględnieniem mikrocopy, stanów brzegowych oraz zasad dostępności cyfrowej. Weryfikacja jakości wdrożenia (Design Sign-off) - bieżąca współpraca z deweloperami i zespołem QA oraz formalna weryfikacja zgodności zakodowanego rozwiązania z makietami i standardami UX przed wypuszczeniem zmian na produkcję. Analizowanie zachowań użytkowników i lejków konwersji - formułowanie hipotez oraz weryfikowanie wpływu wdrażanych rozwiązań na kluczowe metryki produktowe (m.in. konwersja, retencja). Rozwijanie i utrzymywanie design systemu poprzez wykorzystywanie istniejących komponentów, współtworzenie nowych oraz ich dokumentowanie w celu zapewnienia spójności naszych produktów. Czego od Ciebie oczekujemy? Minimum 3 lat doświadczenia w roli Product Designera lub UX/UI Designera przy projektowaniu produktów cyfrowych (mile widziane aplikacje webowe i mobilne). Dobrej znajomości zasad UX, UI oraz standardów dostępności (WCAG 2.1 AA). Umiejętności samodzielnego prowadzenia procesu projektowego – od identyfikacji problemu i opracowania koncepcji po wdrożenie gotowego rozwiązania. Doświadczenia w prowadzeniu badań użytkowników - umiejętności doboru odpowiednich metod badawczych, przeprowadzania wywiadów i testów oraz wyciągania praktycznych wniosków. Bardzo dobrej znajomości Figmy , w tym auto layout, zaawansowanych komponentów, wariantów i prototypowania. Rozumienia perspektywy biznesowej i technologicznej - umiejętności projektowania rozwiązań, które realizują cele biznesowe i są możliwe do wdrożenia, oraz prowadzenia merytorycznych dyskusji w oparciu o dane i wyniki badań. Otwartości na feedback, gotowości do weryfikowania własnych pomysłów i wybierania najlepszych rozwiązań oraz dbałości o szczegóły. Świadomego wykorzystywania narzędzi AI do usprawniania i przyspieszania codziennej pracy. Portfolio , które pokazuje nie tylko efekt wizualny, ale również proces projektowy, sposób rozwiązywania problemów i wpływ proponowanych rozwiązań na biznes. Mile widziane Doświadczenie w projektowaniu produktów B2B lub SaaS. Znajomość języka angielskiego na poziomie minimum B2. Doświadczenie w pracy z narzędziami analitycznymi, takimi jak GA4, Hotjar czy Mixpanel. Co oferujemy? Wynagrodzenie: 12 000 - 14 000 zł netto + VAT, w zależności od Twojego doświadczenia. Elastyczne organizacja pracy: Szukamy osoby z Wrocławia, która ceni współpracę na miejscu. Nasz zespół działa hybrydowo (3 dni z biura, 2 zdalnie), z możliwością samodzielnego wyboru dni obecności. Zapewniamy elastyczność w organizacji dnia, ze wspólnymi godzinami dostępności zespołu (10:00–15:00). Możliwość przystąpienia do programów partnerskich (pakiety medyczne LuxMed, karty Multisport) na preferencyjnych warunkach dla współpracowników B2B.

items.desc: Your role At Aptiv, we develop advanced technologies that make mobility safer, greener, and more connected. As a Sensing Function Owner, you will play a key role in delivering camera-based sensing functions used in Active Safety systems. You will bridge system requirements, software development, validation activities, and stakeholder expectations to ensure our solutions meet the highest quality standards. items.desc: Are you curious about banking, risk management and customer impact? Do you enjoy working with quality, structure and detail-oriented tasks? Would you like to be part of a team that focuses on continuous improvement and strong project delivery? We are looking for an analytical, proactive and structured consultant to support customer-oriented remediation and risk projects across Danske Bank. You will Take ownership of assigned tasks and proactively identify next steps, risks, dependencies and possible solutions Perform quality assurance, controls and validation of project data to ensure accuracy, consistency and auditability Work with data analysis, issue investigation and problem-solving in cooperation with Project Managers, consultants and relevant stakeholders Help ensure that compensation pay-outs and related processes are handled smoothly and with high quality Work according to established methodologies, guidelines and best practice processes while contributing to improvements Be comfortable with both complex analytical tasks and recurring operational or quality assurance activities About you 3+ years of experience from an operational, analytical, administrative, project-related or process-oriented role A strong analytical mindset with the ability to investigate issues, identify solutions and work with data A proactive approach and the ability to drive tasks independently Strong organisational skills and the ability to set priorities across several tasks or projects Good English communication skills and the ability to explain complex topics in a clear and structured way The ability to work with uncertainty in a fast-paced project environment Interest in banking products, customer impact, risk management or remediation processes We offer We provide a comprehensive benefits package that supports your work-life balance and career development. You will work in a workplace that encourages continuous learning, knowledge sharing and professional development. We operate a hybrid model with at least 3 days per week in the office to maintain strong connections and collaboration. Are you ready for the next step? We would love to hear from you if this opportunity sounds interesting. Please submit your application in English as soon as possible, as we are processing applications and inviting candidates for interviews on a continuous basis. If you would like to know more about this opportunity, please contact Leader of Risk Projects, Annemarie Andersen, at annea@danskebank.dk. We look forward to hearing from you!

items.desc: Spektrum supports apex purchasers (NATO, UN, EU, and National Government and Defence) and their Tier 1 supplier ecosystem with a wide range of specialist services. We provide our clients with professional services, specialised aerospace and defence sales, delivery, and operational subject matter expertise. We are looking for personnel to join our team and support key client projects. Who we are supporting The NATO Communication and Information Agency (NCIA) is responsible for providing secure and effective communications and information technology (IT) services to NATO's member countries and its partners. The agency was established in 2012 and is headquartered in Brussels, Belgium. The NCIA provides a wide range of services, including: Cyber Security: The NCIA provides advanced cybersecurity solutions to protect NATO's communication networks and information systems against cyber threats. Command and Control Systems: The NCIA develops and maintains the systems used by NATO's military commanders to plan and execute operations. Satellite Communications: The NCIA provides satellite communications services to enable secure and reliable communications between NATO forces. Electronic Warfare: The NCIA provides electronic warfare services to support NATO's mission to detect, deny, and defeat threats to its communication networks. Information Management: The NCIA manages NATO's information technology infrastructure, including its databases, applications, and servers. Overall, the NCIA plays a critical role in ensuring the security and effectiveness of NATO's communication and information technology capabilities. The program Assistance and Advisory Service (AAS) The NATO Communications and Information Agency (NCI Agency) is NATO's principal C3 capability deliverer and CIS service provider. It provides, maintains and defends the NATO enterprise-wide information technology infrastructure to enable Allies to consult together under Article IV, and, when required, stand together in the face of attack under Article V. To provide these critical services, in the modern evolving dynamic environment the NCI Agency needs to build and maintain high performance-engaged workforce. The NCI Agency workforce strategically consists of three major categorise's: NATO International Civilians (NIC)'s, Military (Mil), and Interim Workforce Consultants (IWC)'s. The IWCs are a critical part of the overall NCI Agency workforce and make up approximately 15 percent of the total workforce. Role ID – 2026-0159 Role Background The NATO Communications and Information Academy (NCI Academy) located in Oeiras, Portugal currently delivers NATO technical and operational training on a variety of hardware and software systems. In the light of these activities, the NCI Academy is looking to outsource the delivery of Logistics Functional Area Services (LOGFAS) training, as well as the development and updates of the training materials, the management of course iterations and to provide SME support to NATO and National HQ as required. The contractor shall make available personnel capable of providing the services specified in this Statement of Work (SoW). The intent is to obtain the services of LOGFAS subject matter experts who can deliver training and update training materials. The work shall involve LOGFAS System Administrator training delivery, iterations management, course material development, including e-learning content and management of existing e-learning content, course update, and LOGFAS Usage Mentoring to customers from the NATO Command Structure, NATO Force Structure, NATO member MODs, and Partner Nations, as well as testing LOGFAS software and provide bug reports. Course iterations delivery shall be conducted at the NCI Academy in Oeiras, and optionally at any of the NATO or National locations. The main objectives of this statement of work can be summarized as follows: Successful delivery of training iterations as a Mobile Training Team (MTT), online and at the NCI Academy in Oeiras (PRT). Successful adaptation and updating of training material in accordance with the latest version the given system updates available remotely. Role Duties and Responsibilities Course Delivery The training iteration preparation and delivery shall be carried out at the NCI Academy Oeiras location, and at NATO and National Headquarters, with the host authority providing the training environment and access to the application. The portfolio of courses covered under this agreement are the following courses (which includes the supporting Course Control Documentation, course schedules, training materials and assessments) A0255 – LOGFAS System Administrator Each course delivery iteration shall include preparation and coordination, course delivery and end of training report on the course conduct, results, and recommendations for continuous improvement of the course. During their initial contract, contractors may serve as assistant instructors, supporting training conducted …

items.desc: Job Description: MISSION Build the inverter's EMT models in PSCAD from the actual control code running on HIL, and automate their testing and validation, so that every model delivered to customers matches the certified firmware and ships with a reproducible validation report. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES • Build and maintain PSCAD models of the inverter and plant: power stage (2-level and 3-level NPC/ANPC), LCL filter, transformer, grid equivalent (SCR, X/R) and protections. • Port the control from the HIL environment to PSCAD: adapt the C control code (Typhoon HIL S-HIL) into a .lib/.dll linked through Blackbox components or the Fortran/C interface. • Define the model–control interface (I/O, parameters, sampling time, interpolation, multirate) and troubleshoot compilation, linking and DLL-loading issues. • Implement grid-support functions: LVRT/HVRT, P/Q control, Volt-VAr, Freq-Watt, ROCOF, GFL and GFM modes. • Develop automated PSCAD test suites (voltage dips and swells, phase and frequency jumps, ROCOF, SCR sensitivity, setpoint changes, control modes) using Python, multiple runs and parametric sweeps. • Post-process results: signal extraction, performance metrics (response time, overshoot, steady-state error, reactive current injection), filtering and comparison against grid-code criteria. • Automate PSCAD vs. HIL and PSS®E vs. PSCAD validation: time alignment, resampling, tolerance bands and fitting KPIs, with automatically generated reports (plots and pass/fail tables). • Integrate the workflow into GitLab CI/CD: library builds, test execution and regression runs on every model change. • Maintain libraries, schematics, centralised parameters and model versioning (REV A.1, A.2, B.1…); write user guides and support customers. REQUIREMENTS • BSc/MSc in Electronic, Electrical, Industrial or Telecommunications Engineering. • 1–3+ years in EMT simulation, model development or validation tooling (junior candidates with a strong PSCAD-based master's thesis are also welcome). • Power electronics: three-phase inverters, PWM/SVPWM modulation, LCL filters. • Converter control: dq transformation, PLL, current and voltage loops, PI tuning. • C programming: pointers, structs, building and linking static and dynamic libraries. • Python: NumPy, SciPy, pandas, Matplotlib; automation-oriented scripting. • Signal processing: FFT, digital filters, phasors and symmetrical components, resampling. NICE TO HAVE • Experience with OEM models for interconnection studies. • PSCAD automation API (mhi.pscad) or Typhoon HIL test automation (TyphoonTest IDE, pytest). • Grid codes and test procedures: IEEE 1547-2018 / 1547.1, UL 1741 SB, NERC, Spanish P.O. 12.2 / NTS. • Grid-forming control: droop, VSM, virtual inertia, black start. • PSS®E (UDM, generic WECC models: REGC/REEC/REPC; psspy). • GitLab CI/CD, build scripting (.bat/PowerShell) and basic Fortran. TOOLS • PSCAD/EMTDC 5.x + mhi.pscad (advanced): EMT modelling, Blackbox components, library linking, scripted execution. • C – GCC/MinGW, MSVC (advanced): control code, .lib/.dll generation. • Python – NumPy, SciPy, pandas, Matplotlib (advanced): automation, post-processing, reporting. • Typhoon HIL + TyphoonTest IDE (intermediate): control source and reference testing. • Visual Studio / VS Code (intermediate): building, debugging, build tasks. • Git / GitLab CI/CD (intermediate): version control and regression pipelines. • MATLAB/Simulink (intermediate): control design and signal analysis. • PSS®E – psspy (desirable): RMS vs. EMT correlation. At Nextpower, we are driving the global energy transition with an integrated clean energy technology platform that combines intelligent structural, electrical, and digital solutions for utility-scale power plants. Our comprehensive portfolio enables faster project delivery, higher performance, and greater reliability, helping our customers capture the full value of solar power. Our talented worldwide teams are redefining how solar power plants are designed, built, and operated every day with smart technology, data-driven insights, and advanced automation. Together, we’re building the foundation for the world’s next generation of clean energy infrastructure. We are Nextpower

items.desc: At Scala, we offer market-leading software for Digital In-store experiences. Scala works with forward-thinking brands, such as Volvo, M&S, J.Lindeberg, and Uniqlo. From our offices in Sweden, Norway, US and the UK, we enable our partners and their customers to design and implement unique Digital In-store solutions. Scala is part of the Vertiseit Group, listed on the Nasdaq First North Growth Market in Sweden. Are you looking for an opportunity to thrive in a forward-thinking product company with a strong team spirit? Scala is expanding and is now looking for a DevOps to join our team in Varberg. The Role As a DevOps at Scala, you will play a central role in building and maintaining the infrastructure and pipelines that power our software platform for Digital In-store experiences. You will ensure that our development and delivery processes are efficient, reliable, and scalable, enabling our teams to move fast without compromising quality or stability. In this role, you will: Design, implement, and maintain robust DevOps pipelines and infrastructure to support scalable, secure, and high-performing applications. Manage and optimize cloud infrastructure to ensure reliability, scalability, and cost-efficiency. Collaborate closely with developers to streamline code deployment, enhance automation, and improve system performance. Drive continuous improvement in DevOps practices, infrastructure as code, and security posture across environments. Operate and maintain our existing infrastructure based on Node.js, NGINX, and Azure, including virtual servers hosted in co-location. Monitor, deploy, and update systems using Octopus Deploy, Azure CLI, and Bicep. Support migration efforts from Bitbucket to GitHub, including repositories and CI/CD pipelines. Create and manage build pipelines in TeamCity and Jenkins, ensuring version control and deployment efficiency. Set up and optimize developer environments in GitHub and other tools to boost productivity and collaboration. Who You Are We are looking for a hands-on and curious DevOps professional who enjoys working in a collaborative environment. You are passionate about automation, scalable systems, and creating smooth developer experiences. Solid knowledge of CI/CD tools such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or GitLab CI. Experience with cloud platforms like Azure or AWS. Proficiency in scripting or programming languages such as Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar. Strong experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and infrastructure as code (Bicep, Terraform, …). A solid understanding of networking, monitoring, and security best practices. Fluent proficiency in both Swedish and English, spoken and written. Nice to have: Experience working in SaaS or product development environments. Familiarity with .NET environments and modern web architectures. Background in software development with a DevOps mindset. Why Join Scala? We offer an inclusive work environment where you will be surrounded by skilled and passionate colleagues. Well-being first – Enjoy health initiatives and a generous wellness allowance. Team spirit & fun – We believe in having fun together and organizing activities to create great memories. Learn & grow – Work alongside talented colleagues in a collaborative and knowledge-sharing environment. Job security & benefits – At Scala, we offer a collective agreement to ensure fair working conditions. Career opportunities – We invest in internal career paths and development opportunities to help you grow with us. Warrants program Practical Information Location: Full-time position at our office in Varberg. Application deadline: 27th November (We recruit on an ongoing basis, so apply as soon as possible!) items.desc: Vill du använda din meteorologiska expertis för att göra skillnad på riktigt? Missa inte möjligheten att bli en del av vårt team och att få bidra till att stärka hela samhällets hållbarhet. SMHI är en svensk expertmyndighet med globalt perspektiv och en livsviktig uppgift i att förutse förändringar i väder, vatten och klimat. På vetenskaplig grund och genom kunskap, forskning och tjänster bidrar vi till att öka hela samhällets hållbarhet. Till enheten Prognos väder söker vi nu en prognosmeteorolog. Enheten Prognos väder är uppdelad i tre grupper, placerade på kontoren i Norrköping, Göteborg och Uppsala och som tillsammans består av ca 75 kunniga och engagerade prognosmeteorologer. Varje kontor har sin specifika nisch, därmed skiljer sig arbetsuppgifterna lite åt beroende på vilket kontor man arbetar vid. Nu söker vi en medarbetare till kontoret i Norrköping där du kommer bli en del av ett härligt team bestående av 25 prognosmeteorologer. Din arbetsplats finns på ett modernt kontor med närhet till restaurang och gym. Hos oss möts du av en trivsam arbetsmiljö och hög professionalism. Om tjänsten I arbetet ingår att ta fram och leverera väder- och varningsinformation till allmänheten och professionella kunder. Vi bistår bland annat kommuner, myndigheter och privata kunder med prognoser och varningsinformation samt levererar innehåll till vår hemsida och sociala medier. Det innebär mycket kontakt och samarbeten bland annat med Sveriges Radio för skriftliga och muntliga väderprognoser, samt med kunder inom sjöfart, bygg- och anläggning, energimarknaden och inom väg- och spårtrafik. Som meteorolog på SMHI har man daglig kontakt med kunder och det ställs därför stora krav på servicekänsla och professionalitet. Utöver kontakt med externa parter kan du även ingå i olika projekt och utvecklingsarbeten med andra delar av SMHI där din kunskap inom meteorologi kommer till användning. Du förväntas också delta i olika typer av verksamhetsutveckling och projekt utanför vakttjänst, där din meteorologiska expertis kan komma till nytta. Arbetet kan även ske utanför den egna gruppen. SMHI ansvarar även för den civila flygväderproduktionen i Sverige och levererar väderprognoser och varningar för luftfarten i samarbete med danska DMI. items.desc: Shape the Future of Secure Connectivity in the largest insurance company in the Nordics Do you want to work hands‑on with Palo Alto firewalls and network security in a modern hybrid environment – and help shape how If connects securely to datacentres, cloud and the internet? We are looking for a Network Security Engineer with senior PaloAlto NGFW experience to strengthen our Connectivity Platform and take our firewall and edge security services to the next level. About the role As Network Security Engineer, you will work with our PaloAlto NGFW’s and security platform across datacentres, cloud hubs and local internet breakouts. Your main responsibility is to help design, implement and operate secure, robust and standardized network security services that support If’s business and our technology strategy. In your daily work you will: Operate and develop our PaloAlto firewalls and related services – not just maintain existing rulebases, but actively improve how we design, structure and manage policies. Drive modernization of our Security Gateways, including adoption of new PaloAlto features and potentially new management solutions, in line with our future architecture. Work with automation and templates (APIs, scripting, IaC tools, etc.) to change how we handle policies and configurations – reducing manual work and the risk of human error. Design and refine security policies for data centers, internet breakouts and cloud hubs, with a clear focus on standardization and reuse. Support projects and migrations with secure connectivity designs and implementation, ensuring new solutions fit our long‑term network security direction. You’ll work both in a team and independently and take responsibility from an idea all the way to a running service. There is room to influence how we work and to grow your skills in cloud, security and identity. We offer In the same way that we place high demands on you as an employee, we also expect you to place high demands on us as an employer. Here are some of the benefits of working at If: An inclusive work environment where everyone is welcome Career and development opportunities in the biggest insurance company in the Nordics Social activities, as well as a highly skilled professional environment Possibility of hybrid workplace Health promoting workplace with e.g., wellness allowance and various sports activities Great insurance benefits About the team The team’s mission is to modernize and operate our network security edge – moving from traditional, manual policy handling to standardized, automated and platform‑oriented services. You’ll work closely with the rest of the Connectivity Platform, as well as with IT Security, IT Engineering and our sourcing partners, in a collaborative and hands‑on environment. The team consists of 7 SME’s based in Copenhagen, Denmark, Turku, Finland and Espoo, Finland. Who are you? You are self-driven and take responsibility. When you see something that needs fixing, you pick it up and follow it through. You like to work with others, explain things in a clear way, and care about doing a good job. You are curious and keep learning new things. You also have: Senior-level experience with PaloAlto NGFW Senior-level experience network fundamentals Senior-level experience designing or operating network security policies in Datacenter and/or cloud environments. Experience and interest in automation and standardization of firewall policies and configurations. Awareness of modern threats and security concepts (IPS/IDS, URL filtering, threat prevention, zero trust) and how they influence network design. Experience troubleshooting complex network/security issues and working in a structured way during incidents. Good command of Danish or Finnish and English It is an advantage if you also have: Experience of working in an enterprise environment Experience of working with Panorama and/or Strata Experience in Cloud(AWS or Azure) Experience with Splunk Experience with ServiceNow Experience with GitHub Enterprise Experience of ADO Additional facts and the recruitment process Application deadline: Screening and interviewing will start immediately. However, application deadline is 20.11.2026 To apply for the position: Please attach your CV and answer the questions in the application form. Work location: Copenhagen, Denmark, Turku or Espoo, Finland. Travelling: Some travelling will be expected Start: 1st of February, 2027 For more information, please contact Frederik Arntzen, Head of Connectivity, frederik.arntzen@if.no It is a requirement for the position that If’s extended fit & proper requirements, including background checks, can be met. We look forward to your application!

items.title: Erfaren systemutvecklare till Bostadsförmedlingen
items.card: Bostadsförmedlingen i Stockholm förmedlar hyreslägenheter i hela Stockholmsregionen och samarbetar med över 200 fastighetsägare. Vi är en länk mellan bostadssökande och fastighetsägare, med mer än 75 års erfarenhet av Stockholms hyresmarknad. Vi är cirka 130 medarbetare och ingår i koncernen Stockholms Stadshus AB som ägs av Stockholms stad. Vår vision är att vara det självklara valet för en effektiv och rättvis
items.desc: Bostadsförmedlingen i Stockholm förmedlar hyreslägenheter i hela Stockholmsregionen och samarbetar med över 200 fastighetsägare. Vi är en länk mellan bostadssökande och fastighetsägare, med mer än 75 års erfarenhet av Stockholms hyresmarknad. Vi är cirka 130 medarbetare och ingår i koncernen Stockholms Stadshus AB som ägs av Stockholms stad. Vår vision är att vara det självklara valet för en effektiv och rättvis bostadsförmedling. Resan mot en mer digital Bostadsförmedling är bara påbörjad och nu söker vi en systemutvecklare som med stort engagemang vill vara med på resan. Är det du? Välkommen till oss Här blir du en del av en kultur som präglas av ett generöst och hjälpsamt arbetsklimat där vi avsätter tid för kompetensutveckling och kunskapsutbyten. Det är viktigt med balans mellan arbete och fritid och vi är måna om att underlätta för dig att göra hälsosamma val. Vi erbjuder därför bland annat massage på arbetet, en friskvårdstimme i veckan och ett generöst friskvårdsbidrag. Vi sitter i lokaler i Slakthusområdet vid Globen men flyttar till nya lokaler i Tensta hösten 2028. Som medarbetare hos oss bidrar du till en trygg och rättssäker verksamhet och till att upprätthålla förtroendet för det offentliga. Vår gemensamma värdegrund sammanfattas i ordet GRETA som står för: Glädje-Respekt-Engagemang-Tillsammans-Ansvar. Vi söker dig som vill utvecklas tillsammans med oss. När du jobbar hos oss är du varje dag med och bidrar till nytta för regionens invånare genom att göra vägen till en ny bostad lite enklare. Läs gärna mer på bostad.stockholm.se. Avdelningen för utveckling och IT Bostadsförmedlingen utvecklar själva sina digitala tjänster för kunderna och använder även ny teknik för att förbättra, förenkla och effektivisera det interna arbetet. Avdelningen för Utveckling och it har en central roll i arbetet. Avdelningen ansvarar för drift och underhåll av våra befintliga system och för att utveckla systemen och deras arkitektur i samarbete med användarna och enligt gällande regler och lagstiftning. Avdelningen samordnar också arbetet med cybersäkerhet, kontinuitetsplanering och informationssäkerhet. Om rollen Som systemutvecklare har du en viktig roll i arbetet med att utveckla och förbättra våra digitala tjänster, både internt och externt. Du får stort ansvar och möjlighet att påverka bolagets digitala inriktning. Du arbetar i ett utvecklingsteam och samarbetar nära med kravställare, kravanalytiker och testare. Tillsammans med dina kollegor planerar du det dagliga och veckovisa arbetet. Du tar eget ansvar för att sätta bolagets kunder och medarbetare i fokus samt bidrar till att utveckla teamets arbetssätt och metoder. Din kompetens och erfarenhet Vi söker dig som har aktuell och flerårig erfarenhet av systemutveckling arbetat med C# med .NET 8 erfarenhet av webbutveckling med ASP.NET MVC, Optimizely CMS, JavaScript och SASS arbetat med blazor WebAssembly erfarenhet av utveckling av REST-api:er med ASP.NETCore arbetat med microsoft SQL Server och NHibernate goda kunskaper i svenska både i tal och skrift. Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av Octopus Deploy kunskaper om UX-design och digital tillgänglighet kunskaper om informationssäkerhet. Som systemutvecklare hos oss behöver du vara kommunikativ, serviceinriktad och nyfiken. Du tar ansvar och bidrar till teamets leveranser. Rollen innebär många kontakter och du behöver kunna samarbeta och skapa goda relationer. Samtidigt kan du arbeta självständigt och driva ditt arbete framåt. Vi vill också att du tar egna initiativ och bidrar till att utveckla verksamheten med ditt engagemang, din kunskap och dina förslag på nya lösningar. Vi lägger vi stor vikt vid dina kompetenser, personliga lämplighet, din motivation och ditt intresse för tjänsten. Övrigt Bostadsförmedlingen arbetar med kompetensbaserad rekrytering som syftar till att se till varje persons kompetens och därmed motverka diskriminering. Din ansökan Vi rekryterar utan personligt brev för att stärka fokus på de kompetenser och erfarenheter som efterfrågas för rollen. Vid bedömningen av din ansökan kommer vi endast att utgå ifrån ditt cv och ett antal frågor som du får besvara i samband med att du söker tjänsten. Vi önskar att du svarar konkret och kortfattat på frågorna, och att det finns en tydlig koppling mellan dina svar och ditt cv. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan! items.title: Systemutvecklare .Net
items.card: Vi söker en senior .NET Fullstack-utvecklare till IT Liv & Pension Folksam Vi fortsätter att utveckla och modernisera våra lösningar inom Liv & Pension och söker nu en senior .NET Fullstack-utvecklare som vill vara med och driva den resan tillsammans med oss. Hos oss får du arbeta nära verksamheten i ett engagerat, tvärfunktionellt team där du är med och påverkar allt från arkitektur och tekniska vägval till hur vi
items.desc: Vi söker en senior .NET Fullstack-utvecklare till IT Liv & Pension Folksam Vi fortsätter att utveckla och modernisera våra lösningar inom Liv & Pension och söker nu en senior .NET Fullstack-utvecklare som vill vara med och driva den resan tillsammans med oss. Hos oss får du arbeta nära verksamheten i ett engagerat, tvärfunktionellt team där du är med och påverkar allt från arkitektur och tekniska vägval till hur vi arbetar och samarbetar. Vi söker dig som trivs med att ta ansvar för helheten, har ett starkt engagemang för kvalitet och vill vara med och skapa moderna lösningar som gör verklig nytta för våra kunder. Det här gör du som senior .NET Fullstack-utvecklare på Folksam Du blir en del av ett tvärfunktionellt team med kompetens inom verksamhet, krav, test och utveckling. Tillsammans ansvarar vi för utveckling, förvaltning och modernisering av system som är centrala för vår affär inom Liv & Pension. I rollen arbetar du genom hela utvecklingskedjan, från användargränssnitt och kundupplevelse till backend, integrationer och databaser. Du förväntas bidra med både teknisk höjd och ett driv att utveckla teamet, våra arbetssätt och våra lösningar. Vi utvecklar och förvaltar vår egenbyggda utvecklingsplattform som vi kallar KPP där våra kunder sköter sin pensionsadministration och sin affär. Du kommer bland annat att: utveckla och vidareutveckla moderna fullstack-lösningar i .NET och React delta i arkitektur- och designbeslut driva tekniska förbättringar och modernisering av befintliga system bidra till hög kvalitet genom automatisering, testning och moderna utvecklingsmetoder coacha och stötta kollegor genom kunskapsdelning och tekniskt ledarskap aktivt bidra till att teamet fortsätter utvecklas och leverera värde till verksamheten Hos oss får du möjlighet att kombinera teknikintresse med verksamhetsförståelse i en miljö där dina idéer och initiativ uppskattas. Är du den vi söker? Vi söker dig som är en erfaren fullstack-utvecklare med flera års erfarenhet av att bygga moderna applikationer och som känner dig trygg i att ta ansvar för både tekniska lösningar och hur arbetet bedrivs i teamet. Du har erfarenhet av: systemutveckling i C# och moderna .NET-versioner moderna frontendramverk, företrädesvis React och TypeScript Microsoft SQL Server design och utveckling av REST-baserade API:er och integrationer CI/CD, releasehantering och pipelines, gärna i Azure DevOps arbete i agila och tvärfunktionella team svenska i tal och skrift Meriterande erfarenhet av Azure och molnbaserade lösningar erfarenhet av .NET Framework 4.8 och modernisering av äldre applikationer erfarenhet av arkitekturarbete erfarenhet av att coacha eller tekniskt leda andra utvecklare Vem är du? För att trivas hos oss tror vi att du är en person som tar initiativ och driver saker framåt. Du är nyfiken, engagerad och tycker om att ta ansvar för både leverans och utveckling. Du har lätt för att samarbeta, bygger förtroende i teamet och delar generöst med dig av din kunskap. Vi söker inte bara en skicklig utvecklare utan också en kollega som bidrar med energi, nya perspektiv och en vilja att göra både teamet och lösningarna bättre varje dag. Här kan du göra skillnad Välkommen till Folksam – här driver du viktiga frågor framåt. Från de avgörande detaljerna till de stora perspektiven, med fokus på att förenkla våra kunders vardag. Det gör att du bidrar till något större, oavsett roll. Här finns det många roliga, utvecklande jobb och du har goda chanser till en spännande karriär. Vi tror på ett hållbart arbetsliv och jobbar aktivt med inkludering och mångfald. Våra moderna kontor bjuder in till samarbete och lärande, här får vi saker att hända! Du har flexibiliteten att kunna varva arbete på kontoret med att jobba hemifrån, utifrån verksamhetens behov. Läs mer och se filmer om livet hos oss på folksam.se/jobb-och-karriar. Så söker du jobbet Välkommen att skicka in din ansökan redan idag, men senast 6 december 2026. Vill du veta mer om jobbet är du välkommen att kontakta gruppchef Tobias Wijk, 070-831 65 04. Här kan du läsa mer om vilka bakgrundskontroller som kan vara aktuella i den här rekryteringen. Fackliga representanter: Akademikerföreningen Per Hansson 070-831 60 67, Forena Mari Leppioja 070-831 54 29 och Handels Mikael Carlsson 070-831 51 32. Kundägda Folksamgruppen erbjuder sedan 1908 försäkringar och sparande som ger trygghet i livets alla skeden. Vi gör det enklare för våra fyra miljoner kunder att känna sig trygga i en hållbar värld genom rätt försäkringar, rätt sparande och rätt hjälp när något händer.

items.title: Kravanalytiker
items.card: Vi söker en erfaren kravanalytiker med god förmåga att navigera i komplexa och föränderliga miljöer. items.desc: Vi söker en erfaren kravanalytiker med god förmåga att navigera i komplexa och föränderliga miljöer. Konsulten kommer att arbeta nära verksamhetsrepresentanter, produktägare, UX-designers, utvecklare och testare för att identifiera behov, utmana antaganden och omsätta verksamhetsmål till tydliga, genomförbara och spårbara krav. I uppdraget ansvarar konsulten för att facilitera och leda kravdialoger, analysera verksamhetsbehov samt formulera konkreta och testbara krav. En viktig del av rollen är att skapa samsyn mellan olika intressenter kring mål, prioriteringar och beroenden samt säkerställa att föreslagna lösningar stödjer affärsnytta, användarbehov och tekniska förutsättningar. Konsulten förväntas bidra aktivt genom hela leveransprocessen, från initial behovsanalys och kravförfining (refinement) till implementation och uppföljning. Rollen kräver ett pragmatiskt, lösningsorienterat och operativt arbetssätt med hög noggrannhet och god samarbetsförmåga. I uppdraget ingår även att identifiera och driva förbättringar av metoder, processer och arbetssätt inom kravhantering, samverkan och leveransflöden. Konsultens ansvarsområden Facilitera och leda kravdialoger med verksamhetsrepresentanter, intressenter och utvecklingsteam för att skapa gemensam förståelse och tydliga mål. Identifiera, analysera och dokumentera verksamhetsbehov samt omsätta dem till tydliga, konkreta och testbara krav med starkt fokus på affärsvärde. Driva krav från ett konkret verksamhetsbehov genom analys, refinement och samarbete med olika kompetenser fram till en genomförbar lösning som är redo för implementation. Agera som brygga mellan verksamhet och IT genom att översätta verksamhetsbehov till konkreta, genomförbara och testbara lösningar. Säkerställa kvalitet, spårbarhet och en lämplig detaljnivå genom hela kravprocessen. Skapa samsyn mellan intressenter samt hantera beroenden och komplexa frågeställningar i en föränderlig miljö. Arbeta nära utvecklingsteamen, produktägare, UX och testare i det dagliga arbetet för att säkerställa att kraven är begripliga, genomförbara och skapar avsett affärsvärde. Säkerställa att leveranser möter affärsmål, användarbehov och tekniska förutsättningar. Tillämpa och vidareutveckla etablerade metoder, arbetssätt och kvalitetsprinciper inom kravhantering samt agera på förbättringsmöjligheter i arbetssätt och leveransflöden. Kompetenskrav Flera års erfarenhet som kravanalytiker, Business Analyst eller i en liknande roll, gärna i en komplex organisation eller digital produktmiljö. Dokumenterad förmåga att facilitera workshops och kravdialoger med intressenter från både verksamhet och IT. Gedigen erfarenhet av att analysera och dokumentera funktionella och icke-funktionella krav. Dokumenterad erfarenhet av kravanalys och kravhantering i en agil, tvärfunktionell miljö. Stark analytisk förmåga, sinne för detaljer och ett strukturerat arbetssätt med fokus på kvalitet och spårbarhet. God förståelse för systemflöden, integrationer och tekniska beroenden samt förmåga att samarbeta effektivt med utvecklingsteam. Erfarenhet av att tillämpa och förbättra etablerade metoder, arbetssätt och kvalitetsprinciper inom kravhantering. Relevant akademisk examen inom systemvetenskap, datavetenskap, företagsekonomi eller närliggande område, alternativt motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet. Mycket god förmåga att kommunicera och dokumentera på svenska och engelska. Passande utbildning Relevant akademisk examen inom systemvetenskap, datavetenskap, företagsekonomi eller närliggande område, alternativt motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet. Kan detta vara ett uppdrag som passar dig? Sök redan i dag eller kontakta oss så berättar vi gärna mer. Vi behöver en ansökan inkluderat CV och personligt brev på svenska som matchar vår kunds krav. Kunden kan fatta beslut tidigare än sista ansökningsdatum, urval och intervjuer sker löpande. NXT Interim och NXT Rekrytering är ett nischat och innovativt företag som är verksamma inom konsult och rekryteringsbranschen. Vi är verksamma inom HR, IT, Ekonomi, Sälj och Marknad och har över 20 års erfarenhet i branschen. Vi erbjuder våra konsulter bl.a sjukförsäkring, remote-arbetsplatser och flera andra förmåner som förgyller deras vardag. Vid anställning tillämpar vi kollektivavtal.

Som person är du analytiskt lagd, har ett stort initiativtagande, gillar att arbeta systematiskt och har båda fötterna på jorden. I ditt arbete som konsult läggs stor vikt på att kunna samarbeta med andra på ett konstruktivt sätt och att kunna leverera projekt på utsatt tid. Vi grundades i Linköping 2005 och har sedan dess expanderat till ytterligare fyra städer, och vi finns idag även i Stockholm, Västerås, Luleå och Göteborg. items.desc: Lund University was founded in 1666 and is repeatedly ranked among the world’s top universities. The University has around 46 000 students and 8 500 staff based in Lund, Helsingborg and Malmö. We are united in our efforts to understand, explain and improve our world and the human condition. Lund University welcomes applicants with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We regard equality, equal opportunities and diversity as a strength and an asset. Description of the workplace The position is based at BMC (Biomedical Center) in Lund, specifically within the Neurobiology Section at the Department of Experimental Medical Sciences (EMV). The research group conducts experimental studies in cell and virus biomechanics, with a focus on nuclear mechanics and mechanoadaptation in disease models. The mission of the group is to advance cutting-edge interdisciplinary research at the interface of cell biology, biophysics, and microscopy. The group is part of the Neurobiology Section, which integrates expertise in molecular cell biology, mechanobiology, advanced microscopy, and biotechnology to understand cellular mechanisms in normal function and disease. The project assistant will be an integrated member of this research environment and will work closely with senior and junior researchers with complementary expertise in microbiology, atomic force microscopy (AFM), fluorescence microscopy, cell biology, and data analysis. The workplace offers modern laboratory facilities and access to advanced infrastructure for cell and molecular biology experiments. The group is characterized by an open, international, and collaborative working style. We actively promote a positive work environment through clear supervision, regular follow-ups, realistic workload planning, and an inclusive culture that prioritizes knowledge exchange and job satisfaction. The project is also part of a Nordic research collaboration within the HALRIC framework, with close interaction between partner laboratories. We offer Lund University is a government agency, which means you receive special benefits, generous vacation, and a favourable occupational pension. Lund University is a public authority, which means that as an employee you receive special benefits such as generous annual leave, parental leave, and an attractive occupational pension. In addition, we offer a stimulating and international research environment with access to advanced research infrastructure, including a newly installed BioAFM. We have a flexible working hours agreement that supports a good work–life balance, and a workplace climate characterized by collaboration, clear supervision, and strong opportunities for professional development. Read more on the university’s website about being an employee at Lunds University, Work at Lund University. Work duties and areas of responsibility You will have primary responsibility for conducting experimental studies of nuclear mechanics in cancer cells using atomic force microscopy (AFM) in combination with fluorescence microscopy. The work includes cell culture, preparation of cells and isolated nuclei, AFM-based force and stiffness measurements, and correlative imaging. You will also contribute to method development and the establishment of a new research line in cancer cell mechanics, including optimization of protocols, documentation of workflows, and analysis of experimental data. The work is carried out in close collaboration with researchers in cell biology, biophysics, and microscopy, and includes regular reporting and presentation of results within the research group. The position may involve short research visits and exchanges within the framework of Nordic collaboration (HALRIC). The work is primarily laboratory-based and follows standard working hours, with some flexibility depending on experimental needs. Qualifications Requirements for the position include: You have a completed Master’s degree (MSc) in molecular biology, virology, biophysics, or a related field with a clear experimental focus. You have experience in analysing the mechanical properties of cancer cells or virus-infected cells. You have practical experience working with herpesvirus-infected cells in a laboratory environment. You have experience in analysing DNA replication in cells using TetO/TetR-based marker systems or equivalent reporter-based systems. You have experience in cell culture and experimental methods relevant to studies of viral or nuclear cell biology. You have a proven ability to work independently in complex experimental projects and to document, analyse, and interpret data in a structured manner. You have very good proficiency in English, both spoken and written. Meritorious for the position: It is considered a merit if you have experience in experimental work related to antiviral development, particularly targeting herpesviruses. It is considered a merit if you have experience working with viral vectors for gene therapy, such as AAV or lentivirus, …

items.desc: Vill du arbeta i ett utvecklingsorienterat uppdrag i gränslandet mellan kvalitet, processer och digitala arbetssätt? Vill du tillhöra Sveriges forskningsinstitut som bidrar till omställningen mot ett hållbart samhälle? Då har vi rollen för dig! Om oss Vi söker nu en Kvalitetskoordinator till avdelningen Hållbara material och förpackningar (HMF) på RISE, där du får en central roll i vårt arbete med kvalitet, ledningssystem, processer och digital utveckling. Du kommer tillhöra gruppen Projekt och processer, som jobbar över hela avdelningen med projektstyrning och utveckling av våra egna processer och interna arbetssätt. Placeringsort är Stockholm. Om rollen Som Kvalitetskoordinator utvecklar du avdelningens kvalitetsarbete. Du får också en viktig roll i HMF:s kommande ISO-certifiering och i den långsiktiga förvaltningen av ledningssystemet, med stöd av relevanta specialister. Tillsammans med chefer, processägare och medarbetare driver du även utveckling av processer, informationsflöden och digitala arbetssätt – från identifierat behov till implementerad och uppföljd lösning. Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter: Kvalitet, ledningssystem och ackreditering Samordna kvalitets- och ledningssystemarbetet, inklusive fyra ackrediterade verksamheter. Leda arbetet inför och efter ISO-certifiering med specialiststöd inom ISO 9001, ISO 14001 och ISO 27001. Vara kontaktperson för Swedac och samordna tillsyner och interna revisioner. Följa upp avvikelser, risker och förbättringsåtgärder samt hålla processer och styrande dokument aktuella. Process- och verksamhetsutveckling Kartlägga och utveckla processer, arbetsflöden, ansvar och gränssnitt. Driva förbättringar från behovsanalys till införande och uppföljning. Stödja chefer och processägare i förändringsarbete. Digitala arbetssätt och utveckling Leda förenkling, digitalisering och automatisering av arbetsflöden. Utveckla användningen av data, digitala verktyg och AI för uppföljning, styrning och förbättring. Vi utgår idag från ett hybridarbetssätt där det går att dela arbetstiden mellan kontoret och hemarbetsplatsen. Vem är du? Du är strukturerad och analytisk och har förmågan att omsätta kvalitetskrav och regelverk till fungerande arbetssätt. Genom ett pedagogiskt och förtroendeskapande sätt får du med dig andra i förändring och kan växla mellan helhet och detaljer. Du ser också möjligheter i digitalisering, data och ny teknik och kan tillsammans med andra omsätta verksamhetens behov till lösningar, utan att själv behöva vara teknisk specialist. Krav: Relevant högskoleutbildning inom exempelvis teknik, naturvetenskap, kvalitet eller verksamhetsutveckling, eller motsvarande kunskaper från arbetslivet. Flerårig erfarenhet av kvalitetsarbete och ledningssystem i komplex verksamhet, inklusive revision, avvikelse- och riskhantering samt systematiskt förbättringsarbete. God kunskap om ISO 9001, erfarenhet av ackrediterad verksamhet och förmåga att omsätta externa krav i praktiska arbetssätt. Erfarenhet av att kartlägga och utveckla processer samt införa nya arbetssätt, med inslag av förändringsledning, digitalisering, automatisering eller datadriven uppföljning. Mycket god svenska och engelska i tal och skrift. Det är meriterande om du har: Kunskap om ISO 17000-serien, exempelvis ISO/IEC 17025, och erfarenhet av kontakt med Swedac eller motsvarande organ. Erfarenhet av ISO 14001, ISO 27001 eller ledning av certifierings- och ackrediteringsprocesser. Erfarenhet från forskning, provning, certifiering eller annan teknisk verksamhet samt kunskap om mätteknik, mätkvalitet och opartiskhet eller oberoende inom ackrediterad verksamhet. Är vi en bra match? Här får du chansen att vara med och bygga upp och utveckla kvalitetsarbetet. Rollen passar dig som trivs med det strukturerade arbetet kring den ackrediterade verksamheten och ISO-certifiering, men som också motiveras av att utveckla processer, arbetssätt och smartare lösningar. Välkommen med din ansökan! Om du är nyfiken på att veta mer är du välkommen att kontakta chef för Projekt och Processer Jeanette Mårtensson, jeanette.martensson@ri.se eller Enhetschef Jenny Adrian Meredith, jenny.a.meredith@ri.se. Sista ansökningsdag är den 27/11. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande under och efter ansökningsperioden. Sök utan personligt brev. Våra fackliga representanter är Ingemar Petermann, Saco, 010 228 41 22 och Linda Ikatti, Unionen, 010-5165161.

items.desc: At Oxford Instruments, we enable the world’s leading industrial companies and scientific research communities to image, analyse and manipulate materials down to the atomic and molecular level. With a sixty-year history, and fourteen Queen’s Awards for Enterprise, our world-class products and technologies are helping our customers to address the greatest challenges of the 21st century. Plasma Technology, as a part of Oxford Instruments Group, offers flexible, configurable process tools and leading-edge processes for the precise, controllable and repeatable engineering of micro- and nanostructures. Our systems provide process solutions for the etching of nanometre sized features, nanolayer deposition and the controlled growth of nanostructures. These solutions are based on core technologies in plasma-enhanced deposition and etch, ion-beam deposition and etch, atomic layer deposition, deep silicon etch and physical vapour deposition. To support the ongoing growth of our business we are hiring a Field Service Engineer in Switzerland. The role is field based but will mainly support customers in the Zurich area. Role Purpose To ensure that Plasma Technology equipment is fully functional and available for customer use. This role can involve regular travel within the wider EMEA Region. Your Key Responsibilities would be: Carry out the commissioning of equipment including any operational and maintenance training requirements Respond to emergency breakdowns for any warranty and service contract work. Report regularly to the EMEA Team Leader on all relevant issues and for PDR objectives. Provide a visit report for each customer visit, detailing work completed, outstanding issues, time spent on site, travelling etc, and help to ensure that all chargeable work is invoiced to the customer promptly. Liaise with technical support and systems engineering on any potential or actual system problems. Help to maintain an accurate record of the status of systems, timing of warranty, parts supplied and service contracts. Keep up to date all relevant enquiries and project files on any significant information. Provide detailed and accurate record of expense incurred on behalf of the Company. Prerequisites: Formal Electrical/Electronic qualification. Experience of Semi-Conductor or closely related high-Tech electronic industry. Ability to interpret Electrical and Mechanical drawings. Good PC skills. PLC experience advantageous. Fluent German / English speaker. Full driving licence. items.desc: Closing date: 18/11/2026 Salary range: £48,337 - £52,788 FTE: 1 (35 hours/week) Term: Fixed (36 months) CMAC is a world-leading multidisciplinary medicines manufacturing research, innovation and translation centre at the University of Strathclyde. To deliver our digital chemistry, manufacturing and control (CMC) vision, we work with leading academic, industrial, technology and public sector partners and integrate experimental and digital capabilities that connect advanced processing, automation, data, modelling and decision support. CMAC is now expanding the engineering capability required to translate research outputs into reliable, interoperable and industrially relevant demonstrators, increase their technology readiness, and enable their deployment across the Centre's process development campaigns and CMC DataFactory™ platforms. As part of our vibrant portfolio, we are establishing the new Glasgow Medicines Foundry, funded with the support of Glasgow City Region and UKRI through the Local Innovation Partnership Fund (LIPF). This exciting new opportunity allows CMAC to accelerate our Translation to Industry (T2I) pillar and build on the pipeline of technologies developed across our research portfolio and mature their function and performance to establish demonstrators (TRL 6). We invite applications for a Research Data Engineer to play a leading role in the development of the data and information infrastructure underpinning CMAC's digital medicines manufacturing vision and the Foundry demonstrators to achieve technology readiness level (TRL) 6. The successful candidate will design and develop data architectures, database schemas and scalable data pipelines that enable the collection, integration, management and exploitation of research and manufacturing data. Working as part of a team, they will develop semantic information models, ontologies and knowledge graph approaches that improve interoperability across digital and physical systems, supporting data-driven decision making and the deployment of advanced digital technologies. Working closely with the CMAC Digital Operations Team and other teams and colleagues as required, the postholder will help establish robust, secure and reusable digital capabilities that accelerate the translation of innovative manufacturing technologies from research into industrial practice. items.desc: As an HCPC registered scientist you will play a pivotal role in supporting one of the busiest stem cell transplantation laboratories in Europe. The Transplantation Programme is licenced by the Human Tissue Authority and accredited by JACIE, making us an attractive centre for a large number of clinical trials investigating cellular therapy products for a range of diseases. In addition, UCLH is also a centre selected to treat patients with licenced commercial products and will soon be participating in the exciting field of Tumour Infiltrating Lymphocyte (TIL) therapies. In order to manage and maintain the high throughput service we provide, strong working relationships with several teams is crucial. The laboratory works very closely with clinical and quality management teams to ensure that we deliver the best possible outcomes for our patients and continue to improve our services. As a dedicated and responsible scientist supporting the laboratory you will find this a challenging and rewarding role. UCLH is one of the largest Haemopoietic Stem Cell Transplant centres in Europe. We perform over 400 transplants per year, provide vital services for UK bone marrow transplant registries and are actively involved in many clinical trials utilising CAR-T therapies. An opportunity has arisen for a responsible and self-motivated HCPC registered scientist to join the laboratory team within the Haemopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation Programme. The team consists of 9 scientists who are all involved in the processing, storage, and distribution of cellular therapy products for patients undergoing transplantation. A rigorous quality management system is in place to ensure that the facility operates within national and international legislation, and provides the best possible care to patients and donors. As part of this small, dedicated team, the post holder will be required to work in a clean-room environment to process bone marrow, stem cells and other cellular therapy products for patient transplant. The post holder will be required to maintain at all times the high standards and quality of this highly regulated service and keep an up-to-date knowledge of Haematology and Stem Cell Transplantation Biology, and current working practices in those areas. University College London Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust (UCLH) is one of the most complex NHS trusts in the UK, serving a large and diverse population. We provide academically led acute and specialist services, to people from the local area, from throughout the United Kingdom and overseas. Our vision is to deliver top-quality patient care, excellent education, and world-class research. We provide first-class acute and specialist services across eight sites: University College Hospital (incorporating the Elizabeth Garrett Anderson Wing) National Hospital for Neurology and Neurosurgery Royal National ENT and Eastman Dental Hospitals University College Hospital Grafton Way Building Royal London Hospital for Integrated Medicine University College Hospital Macmillan Cancer Centre The Hospital for Tropical Diseases University College Hospital at Westmoreland Street We are dedicated to the diagnosis and treatment of many complex illnesses. UCLH specialises in women’s health and the treatment of cancer, infection, neurological, gastrointestinal and oral disease. It has world class support services including critical care, imaging, nuclear medicine and pathology. We are committed to sustainability and have pledged to become a carbon net zero health service, embedding sustainable practice throughout UCLH. We have set an ambitious target of net zero for our direct emissions by 2031 and indirect emissions by 2040. For the full Person Specification and more information regarding the main responsibilities of this role, please refer to the attached Job Description. items.desc: Applications are invited for a Qualitative Research Assistant to join the Medical Sociology and Health Experiences Research Group (MS&HERG) within the Nuffield Department of Primary Care Health Sciences at the University of Oxford. The post is funded for 21 months, from 1 January 2027, by the National Institute for Health and Care Research (NIHR) Policy Research Unit (PRU) in Reproductive Health. The study aims to explore adolescent reproductive health needs and interventions to address these. The Principal Investigators are Dr Abigail McNiven and Professor Katy Vincent, with the wider PRU led by Professor Jenny Hall and Professor Judith Stephenson at University College London (UCL). The post-holder will work closely with Dr Abigail McNiven and Professor Katy Vincent, a post-doctoral researcher at UCL, and the wider PRU team. They will contribute to all aspects of the research study, including ethics and research governance, study recruitment, data collection, qualitative analysis and reporting. Through qualitative analysis, the post-holder will explore adolescent reproductive health concerns through existing literature, survey data and focus groups. There may be opportunities to contribute to additional PRU projects. You will be a qualitative or mixed methods social scientist with a MA or MSc in a relevant social science subject (e.g. sociology, social policy, social geography), demonstrable experience in qualitative and mixed methods, and who is able to use social science theory-driven approaches to analysis. Previous experience of research in reproductive health and/or with young people and/or with policy would be advantageous. The role requires you to have a high level of communication and writing skills appropriate for different audiences. You should have the ability to work autonomously, while collaborating effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team across institutions. The ability to work sensitively and develop rapport and trust with research participants from different backgrounds is also essential. The successful candidate must be able to start in post no later than January 2027. You will be based in the Nuffield Department of Primary Care Health Sciences, Radcliffe Primary Care Building, Woodstock Road, Oxford, OX2 6GG as your normal place of work. Consideration may be given to some remote working days, where appropriate. We expect data collection to be largely face to face, so the research will involve visits to participants across the UK and the necessary travel and overnight stays to enable this. items.desc: At James Cropper, innovation runs through everything we do. As we continue our exciting ERP transformation journey, we're looking for a talented BI, Data & Integration Analyst to join our Information Services team on a 12-month fixed-term contract and play a critical role in shaping how data, reporting and integrations support our future business systems. This is a fantastic opportunity for a data-driven professional who enjoys turning complex data into meaningful insights, building robust reporting solutions, and ensuring systems work seamlessly together. You'll work closely with business stakeholders, technical teams and external partners to help deliver a successful ERP implementation across the James Cropper Group. What You'll Be Doing As our BI, Data & Integration Analyst, you'll be at the heart of our ERP programme, helping to ensure trusted, accurate and timely information flows across the business. You'll support reporting, data migration, integrations and analytics that enable better decision-making and operational excellence. Key responsibilities include: Developing and maintaining Power BI dashboards, reports and analytics solutions. Supporting ERP data migration activities, including extraction, cleansing, mapping and validation. Building and testing integrations between business systems and the new ERP platform. Developing ETL processes, SQL scripts and data pipelines. Working closely with stakeholders to understand reporting requirements and deliver valuable business insights. Supporting testing, cutover and go-live activities throughout the ERP implementation. Ensuring data quality, consistency and governance standards are maintained. Documenting reporting solutions, integrations and data processes to support long-term sustainability. What We're Looking For We're looking for an analytical and curious problem solver who enjoys working with data and collaborating with people across a business. You'll ideally bring: Strong experience developing reports and dashboards using Power BI and DAX. Experience in data migration, data transformation and data quality initiatives. Strong SQL skills and experience working with databases and ETL tools. Experience supporting system integrations and validating data flows. Advanced Excel and data analysis skills. Strong communication skills and the ability to work with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Excellent attention to detail and a passion for high-quality data. Desirable Experience ERP implementation, migration or transformation projects. Manufacturing industry experience. Power Automate, Power Apps or SharePoint expertise. Infor Birst or similar cloud reporting platforms. Knowledge of AWS, Azure, Python or PowerShell. Why Join James Cropper? For more than 180 years, James Cropper has been creating innovative, sustainable materials that are used around the world. Today, we're investing in the future of our digital capabilities, making this an exciting time to join our business. In return, you'll have the opportunity to: Contribute to a high-profile business transformation programme. Work with modern data, BI and integration technologies. Collaborate with talented colleagues across multiple business functions. Develop your skills within a supportive and forward-thinking environment. Make a visible impact on how data drives decision-making across the organisation. Apply today and help shape the future of data and business intelligence at James Cropper.

items.desc: DESCRIPTION Amazon Web Services (AWS) is growing its team of Solutions Architects focused on Education and Research customers within the UK Public Sector. In this role, you will act as a trusted technical advisor, helping universities, research institutions, and other public sector organisations adopt cloud technologies that advance their missions. You will build executive-level technical relationships, serve as the voice of the customer back into AWS, and help these organisations see what is possible with cloud computing. As our Education and Research customer base expands, we need a Solutions Architect who is genuinely curious about emerging technology and motivated to translate that knowledge into practical, well-architected solutions. You will work alongside a supportive Public Sector team, partnering with sales, business development, and specialist teams to guide customers through their cloud journey — from early exploration through production workloads. Key job responsibilities Own the technical relationship with Education and Research customers, providing recommendations on architecture, security, cost optimisation, performance, reliability, and operational efficiency. Build and maintain executive-level technical relationships, understanding each customer's strategic priorities and proactively identifying opportunities where AWS can accelerate their goals. Advocate on behalf of customers internally by translating their feedback into technical requirements for AWS engineering teams and contributing to service improvements. Design cloud-native reference architectures and create technical content such as white papers, blog posts, code samples, and workshops to share best practices with customers and the broader Solutions Architect community. Collaborate with specialist teams across AWS to bring the right expertise into customer engagements and help customers explore new use cases, including generative AI and data analytics. A day in the life You might start your morning reviewing a customer's architecture proposal, preparing recommendations that balance performance and cost. By midday, you could be leading a deep-dive session with a customer's engineering team, walking through design patterns for a migration or new workload. In the afternoon, you may join a peer design review with fellow Solutions Architects, share insights from a recent engagement, or contribute to a workshop you are building. You will regularly connect with specialists across AWS to bring the right expertise to each customer conversation. About the team This role sits within our UK Public Sector team. The team has continued to grow, and we are proud to have welcomed people from different backgrounds who bring unique experiences to our work and to our customers. Our tenured Solutions Architects act as mentors and share their knowledge and experience across the group. We are all passionate about the impact we have on people across the UK, and we care deeply about our customers' missions. We enjoy working together in an environment that is supportive, inclusive, and fun. We respect that everyone has responsibilities and interests outside of work. Our roles afford the flexibility to do your best at work and at home. Working closely with researchers, software developers, designers and domain experts, you will help translate innovative ideas into robust production tools, combining research, technical expertise and strategic thinking to solve complex design challenges across the built environment. Develop AI-powered tools and agents that integrate with design applications and workflows. Take innovative ideas from research and prototyping through to production deployment and measurable impact. items.desc: Description This is an exciting opportunity to join Zinc's Information Security team at a pivotal point in its journey. As an Information Security Analyst, you'll play a key role in shaping and strengthening how we approach security across the business, taking ownership of meaningful projects that will have a real impact on our people, products and technology. You'll have the opportunity to drive improvements, introduce new security practices and work closely with teams across the business to make security a shared priority. It's a hands-on role where you'll have plenty of scope to use your technical expertise, influence how things are done and help build a stronger, more resilient security environment as Zinc continues to grow. Key Responsibilities ️ You'll have the opportunity to make a real impact on how Zinc approaches security. Some of your key responsibilities will include: ️ Driving the Security Roadmap – take the lead on delivering our 2-year security roadmap, covering everything from workplace identity and cyber attack protection to workforce security, ecosystem resilience and secure software development. Strengthening Our Security Standards – tackle outstanding audit findings and recommendations, putting the right improvements in place and helping us stay on top of compliance deadlines. Bringing Teams Along on the Journey – work closely with engineering and other teams across the business to drive security improvements, influence decisions and get everyone moving in the same direction. ️ Getting Hands-On – roll up your sleeves and get stuck into the technical work, from implementing new systems to rolling out important security controls. Building Stronger Identity & Access Management – design, implement or mature IAM controls, including Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), Joiner-Mover-Leaver (JML) processes and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC). Skills, Knowledge and Expertise You'll need hands-on experience with the following, as these are tools and technologies you'll be working with regularly in the role: ️ Google Workspace – practical experience managing and securing Google Workspace environments. ️ AWS – experience working with AWS environments and their security. MDM (Mobile Device Management) – understanding of device management and endpoint security. ️ EDR (Endpoint Detection and Response) – experience using EDR tools to monitor, detect and respond to threats. Threat Intelligence & Vulnerability Management – experience identifying potential threats, assessing vulnerabilities and helping to strengthen security across systems. These are essential requirements rather than nice-to-haves, as you'll be working directly with these tools and technologies as part of your day-to-day responsibilities. Nice-to-Have Experience It would be a bonus if you also have experience with: ️ OWASP SAMM / Secure SDLC maturity models – familiarity with application security frameworks and improving security practices throughout the software development lifecycle. PIM / PAM Implementation – experience implementing Privileged Identity Management (PIM) or Privileged Access Management (PAM) solutions. Industry Certifications – qualifications such as CISSP, CISM or CRISC. These aren't essential, but they'd be a great addition to your experience and help you bring even more to the role! We're looking for someone who can combine strong technical knowledge with the ability to bring people along with them. The following skills are essential to succeed in this role: Cross-functional Leadership – ability to work collaboratively across different teams and drive security initiatives throughout the business. Influencing Without Authority – confidence in influencing and gaining buy-in from teams, particularly engineering, even when they don't report directly to you. Prioritisation Under Pressure – ability to manage competing priorities, balance longer-term security projects with urgent demands and keep things moving. Clear Communication – able to explain technical concepts and security risks in a clear, accessible way to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Pragmatism – able to balance the ideal security approach with practical business needs, finding solutions that strengthen security without slowing down delivery. We take huge pride in our environment and culture within the Club which focuses on development, inclusion and not being afraid to think differently. Federated data ownership: Enable Off-Field departments, including Marketing, Commercial, Finance, Operations and Sustainability, to take appropriate ownership of their data and reporting. Work with departmental data owners to agree responsibilities and shared standards, and provide the access, models, guidance and support needed for teams to maintain trusted self-service reporting. Documentation and certified reporting: Build and maintain the report catalogue, certified reports, data dictionary and data-model documentation as an integral part of delivery. Define and apply clear, proportionate criteria for report certification so colleagues can identify trusted data and understand its meaning and ownership. Data quality and governance: Establish and maintain proportionate data-quality controls, monitoring and reconciliation so the Club can independently verify supplier-delivered data. Apply agreed standards for lineage, metadata, access control, retention and data protection by design, escalating material risks appropriately. Building on our platforms with partners: Act as the Club’s technical counterpart on agreed data-platform programmes by providing source access and data, reviewing technical designs, supporting migration assurance and taking operational ownership of components formally handed over to the Club.
