items.desc: Job Description Job Description About Finance Reinvention Partner Accenture's Finance Reinvention Partner helps CFOs and finance leaders reinvent how finance creates and protects enterprise value - bringing together strategy, operating model, data, AI and technology to improve performance, insight, control and execution. In the UK and Ireland, the practice combines finance strategy and transformation capabilities with the enterprise platforms that enable them, including SAP, Oracle, Workday and enterprise performance management solutions. Our Planning, Performance & Insights team helps clients transform how they plan, forecast, allocate resources, manage performance and make decisions. We connect strategic, financial and operational planning with data, analytics and modern planning technologies to create more integrated, agile and insight-led performance management capabilities. We support the full transformation journey - from planning strategy, process and operating model design through solution architecture, implementation, adoption and value realisation - embedding predictive analytics, machine learning and AI to improve forecast quality, scenario modelling and management insight. Our work is particularly relevant to capital-intensive Products and Resources organisations, where financial plans must connect effectively with demand, production, assets, projects, workforce and capital investment. Why this role This is a hands-on delivery role for someone who wants to build deep expertise in enterprise planning, modern performance-management technology and data-led decision support. You will work with finance, operational and technology stakeholders to understand existing planning processes, turn requirements into practical model designs, and support configuration, data, testing, deployment and adoption. The expertise you'll bring Planning and finance foundations. Experience participating in or supporting a budgeting, forecasting or long-range planning process, with an understanding of how operational drivers affect the income statement, balance sheet and cash flow. At least 4 years of relevant experience either in process and/or planning platform. Requirements and process analysis. The ability to document planning calendars, activities, roles, controls, systems and data flows; gather requirements through interviews and workshops; and converts findings into clear process maps, user stories and functional documentation. Planning model and platform delivery. Hands-on experience with, or strong exposure to, at least one modern planning platform - such as SAP Analytics Cloud, Anaplan, Pigment, CCH Tagetik, Oracle EPM or OneStream - and the ability to support model configuration across dimensions, hierarchies, assumptions, calculations, allocations, workflow, security and reporting. Data and performance insight. Strong numerical and analytical skills, with experience preparing, reconciling and validating data; investigating actual-to-plan variances; and developing reports or dashboards that explain performance and support decisions. Products and Resources or similar industry understanding. Experience or project exposure within Products and/or Resources organisations, ideally where planning is influenced by demand, production, assets, projects, workforce, supply chain or capital expenditure. Predictive planning and machine-learning awareness. An understanding of how predictive forecasting, trend analysis, anomaly detection and machine learning can support planning, together with the curiosity to test outputs, question assumptions and explain how insights should be used. Collaborative delivery skills. The ability to work effectively across finance, business, data and technology teams, produce clear client-ready outputs, manage your own commitments and communicate progress, risks and findings with confidence. Qualification What you'll be accountable for Document current planning processes, calendars, roles, systems, controls, data flows and pain points using interviews, workshops and available evidence. Gather and analyse business requirements, translating them into process maps, user stories, functional requirements and model-design inputs. Analyse financial and operational data to identify key drivers, trends, dependencies and opportunities to improve planning and performance insight. Configure or support the configuration of planning models, including dimensions, hierarchies, assumptions, calculations, allocations, scenarios, workflow, security and reporting. Support data preparation, migration, integration, reconciliation, system testing, user acceptance testing and defect resolution, ensuring outputs are complete and traceable. Develop planning reports, dashboards, variance analysis and forecast-quality measures that help users understand what changed, why it changed and what action may be required. Support predictive-forecasting and machine-learning use cases by preparing data, testing outputs, documenting …

items.desc: Landytech is on a mission to transform the way financial institutions, investment managers, asset owners and their advisers access, manage and use investment data. Powered by our investment technology platform, we help organisations bring together complex investment information, improve data accuracy and control, reduce manual processes and make better-informed decisions. We work with clients across multiple markets and jurisdictions and are continuing to expand our presence with sophisticated financial institutions globally. Team & Role As Revenue Operations Associate, you will connect marketing, partnerships and sales around one set of data, processes and goals, and be the operational engine behind how Landytech goes to market. You will partner daily with leaders across marketing, sales, partnerships and customer-facing teams, and report to the Chief Revenue Officer. As we roll out AI strategies across the organisation, you will turn those ideas into working go-to-market (GTM) systems: cleaner data, faster workflows and sharper forecasting. We are looking for someone with genuine AI expertise and an AI-forward mindset, who can bring colleagues along. What You Will Be Doing Design and maintain lead-to-revenue processes, including lead routing, scoring, handoffs, pipeline stages and deal desk rules. Align marketing, partnerships and sales on shared definitions, funnel metrics and SLAs. Report on territory, quota and compensation plan administration in partnership with Finance. Administer and optimise the GTM technology stack, including CRM, marketing automation, sales engagement, enrichment and BI tools. Keep CRM data clean, governed and trusted, and own data hygiene standards across teams. Evaluate, procure and integrate new tools, and retire those that do not earn their place. Build dashboards and reporting for pipeline, conversion, retention and revenue performance. Lead the forecasting cadence and pipeline reviews with the CRO and GTM leaders. Turn analysis into clear recommendations on where to invest, fix or stop. Identify and prioritise AI use cases across the revenue lifecycle, and run pilots from idea to adoption. Build and document AI-assisted workflows, such as lead research, call summaries, forecasting support and automated data enrichment. Train and coach GTM teams to use AI tools effectively, and measure the impact on productivity and revenue. Partner with IT, Security and Legal to apply sound data privacy and governance standards to AI use. Your Skills & Expertise We are looking for an experienced revenue operations professional who combines strong GTM operational discipline with genuine AI expertise. Ideally, you will have: 3+ years' experience in revenue operations, sales operations or marketing operations at a B2B SaaS, technology or financial technology company. Hands-on CRM administration (HubSpot), plus experience with marketing automation and sales engagement tools. Strong analytical skills, including funnel metrics, forecasting models, BI tools and SQL or spreadsheet modelling. A proven ability to work across marketing, sales and partnerships and to align teams around shared processes and numbers. Process design skills: you can map a messy workflow, simplify it and get people to adopt the new version. Clear communication with senior leaders, able to explain the numbers and the recommendation in plain language. A self-starting, organised and detail-oriented approach, and ease working in a growing, changing environment. In particular, we are looking for an AI-forward operator who uses these tools daily and can bring others along: Practical fluency with generative AI tools (such as Claude, ChatGPT and Copilot), with the skill to write effective prompts and build repeatable workflows. Experience applying AI within GTM work, such as AI features in the CRM and sales stack, automated enrichment, lead and account research, call analysis or forecasting support. Working knowledge of automation and integration tools to connect systems and agents into end-to-end workflows. A test-and-measure mindset: you can scope a pilot, define success metrics and decide whether to scale, adjust or stop. Awareness of AI risks, including data privacy, accuracy and bias, and sound judgement about when to keep a human in the loop. Enthusiasm for change management: you can teach, document and drive adoption, not only build. The following would be advantageous: Experience in fintech, wealth management or other data-heavy B2B software. Partner or channel operations experience, including referral and alliance tracking. Familiarity with revenue intelligence, conversation intelligence or CPQ tools. Basic scripting (Python or similar) for data work and automation. Prior experience launching an AI or automation programme within a GTM team. What Success Looks Like You will be successful in this role if you can combine strong operational execution with a practical, measurable approach to AI across the go-to-market teams. …

From broadband to broadcast, streaming to mobile, SkyQ to Sky Glass, we never stand still. We optimise and innovate. We turn big ideas into the products, content and services millions of people love. And we do it all right here at Sky. The DevOps team provides cloud platforms, automation, and operational capabilities that power modern broadcast and media technology services. Through infrastructure automation, CI/CD, container platforms, and observability, we enable engineering teams to build, deploy, and operate secure, reliable, and scalable solutions that support Sky's content production and delivery platforms. Experience designing, building and maintaining CI/CD and GitOps-based deployment pipelines, using technologies such as Jenkins, Concourse, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD or FluxCD. Strong Linux/Unix administration and troubleshooting skills, together with experience developing infrastructure automation using Python, Bash or comparable scripting languages. Hands-on experience deploying and operating containerised platforms, particularly Kubernetes and Docker, including implementation of monitoring, logging and alerting solutions within production environments. Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues and work effectively within collaborative, cross-functional engineering teams. Desirable Criteria: Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field. items.desc: Description Cyber Defence Analyst Location: Farnborough Clearance - SC to start, DV for role UNLEASH YOUR POTENTIAL Everything we do is built on a commitment to do the right thing for our customers, our people and our community. Our mission and our values guide the way we do business. The foundations of our Leidos culture are our Values, Beliefs and Expectations by which we select, recognise and reward employees. They create the environment that drives us toward our mission. The Cyber Defence Analyst protects customer services by identifying, investigating and helping to contain cyber threats across a 24x7x365 multi-customer CSOC. The role converts security telemetry, threat intelligence and vulnerability information into timely, evidence-led decisions. Success is demonstrated through accurate alert disposition, complete incident records, decisive escalation, effective handovers and practical improvements to detection and response. Typically knowledge of CSOC or security operations experience, or credible transferable cyber security knowledge, qualifications and practical aptitude, supported by the motivation to develop quickly in the role. Your Key Outcomes and Responsibilities Monitor security alerts continuously and take timely, consistent action in line with agreed service priorities, protecting customer services and reducing the time threats remain undetected or uncontained. Analyse alerts and supporting telemetry from SIEM, EDR and XDR platforms to establish the context, scope, severity and potential business impact of suspicious activity. Distinguish true positives from benign or false-positive activity, document an evidence-based rationale and escalate material risk without delay. Create and maintain complete, accurate cyber security incident records in the relevant IT service management (ITSM) tool, ensuring that evidence, timestamps, affected assets, indicators, actions, ownership and escalation decisions support effective response, handover and audit. Correlate logs and events across multiple sources to identify suspicious patterns, likely attack paths and Indicators of Compromise (IOCs), improving investigative confidence and speed. Map observed adversary behaviour to relevant MITRE ATT&CK tactics, techniques and sub-techniques, supporting consistent analysis, clearer communication and visibility of detection coverage. Create, test and tune threat-hunting queries and, where appropriate, convert validated findings into detection rules that improve coverage, signal quality and analyst efficiency. Apply Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) to investigations and hunting, translating relevant indicators, adversary behaviours and affected technologies into practical detection, prioritisation and response actions. Assess vulnerabilities in context, explaining likely impact, exposure, exploitability and available evidence of exploitation so that stakeholders can prioritise proportionate remediation. Recommend proportionate countermeasures and coordinate agreed containment, eradication and recovery actions to reduce risk and restore secure operations. Proactively identify suspicious activity, exploitable vulnerabilities and security misconfigurations, enabling action before they result in material customer impact. Apply incident response processes, playbooks and prioritisation criteria consistently; contribute evidence to root-cause analysis and lessons learned so that repeat risk is reduced. Produce concise, accurate incident records, reports and shift handovers that make decisions, actions, residual risks, ownership and next steps unambiguous. Safeguard customer information and maintain strict separation, confidentiality and professional discretion when working across multiple accounts. Collaborate with technical teams, customers and other stakeholders to drive investigations and agreed response actions to a controlled, documented conclusion. Contribute to tabletop exercises, post-incident reviews and measurable service improvements that strengthen detection, response and operational resilience. Technology and Process Experience Experience investigating security events and incidents in a CSOC or comparable environment, or demonstrable transferable skills and the ability to develop rapidly. Working knowledge of Microsoft Sentinel, Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management, Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS). Experience of proactive threat hunting and of using validated investigation outcomes to improve detection and response. Understanding of the Confidentiality, Integrity and Availability (CIA) triad and its practical application when assessing technical and business impact. Current awareness of malware, ransomware and advanced persistent threat activity affecting cloud and on-premises environments. items.desc: About Euphoric Euphoric builds AI-first employee benefits administration software for the world's largest and most prestigious employers. We spun out of Peppy Health to take on what we believe is the biggest untouched opportunity in enterprise software. Global employers spend $3–5 trillion on benefits every year. It is their second-largest cost after payroll, yet the category still runs on legacy systems and spreadsheets. Incumbents cannot move fast enough, and AI-first startups have mostly overlooked it. We have two products: GAP (Global Administration Platform) for global benefits teams. It uses LLMs to parse and extract policy documents into a structured ontology, and gives admins spend and utilisation tools across every country they operate in. Navigator , the employee-facing product that helps people understand and use their benefits. We are post product-market fit at seed stage, live with some of the world's largest household-name enterprises, and we land and expand country by country. Our big current focus is flexible benefits and open enrollment. We stay deliberately lean so that the people who join own a meaningful piece of what we build. This is also genuine tech for good: better benefits administration directly improves the wellbeing and financial security of millions of employees. The Role As an Associate Deployment Strategist you will spend roughly 80% of your time on client work and 20% on developing our products. You will own a portfolio of approximately 1 to 3 enterprise accounts, depending on size, from post-sale through live launch and beyond. This is not a project management role. With the Euphoric MCP you will build custom agents, automations and workflows for some of the world's largest employers. Drive land and expand. Configure demos and the actual product for potential expansions, from new countries to new employee populations, so clients see working product, not slides. Deliver deployments. Configure GAP and Navigator for each client, build implementation plans, run UAT, manage data and policy-document onboarding, handle support and track adoption on live data. items.desc: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. We lean toward building: less "click through the admin console," more writing the automation, integrations, and services that make those platforms work at scale. The team's priorities span a few ongoing areas of work, including: Platform consolidation and integration as Deliveroo continues to grow, including through acquisition. Employee-focused AI tooling that helps people work more efficiently. The communication and collaboration platforms the whole company relies on (Google Workspace, Slack, Atlassian, and similar). Building tools and automation that remove manual work from how the team and company operate. You'll bring real technical strength in one or more of these areas. Some of the work will be clearly scoped; some of it won't be. Working through ambiguous, not-yet-defined problems is part of the role, this is complex, genuinely challenging territory, and a place to learn and grow. You won't be doing that alone: you'll work with senior engineers to break ambiguous problems down, and build your own ability to do that independently over time. It's a hands-on engineering role: you'll be building real pieces of this work yourself, not primarily administering platforms by hand or managing support tickets. What you'll do Take on projects ranging from clearly scoped to genuinely ambiguous, working with senior engineers to break down the harder ones, and growing your own ability to do that over time. Build automation and tooling that removes manual work from how we run our SaaS and identity platforms. Help administer and support platforms such as Google Workspace, Slack, Atlassian, and our identity systems, including day-to-day troubleshooting. Write clear documentation for the work you do, so others can pick it up. Work with teammates, Security, People, and Corporate Development/M&A stakeholders to understand requirements before you build. Use GenAI tools (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT) to automate repeatable parts of your own work, like scripting, research, and documentation. items.desc: Over the last decade Real-Time Bidding (RTB) created massive efficiency for the digital advertising marketplace in opening large volumes of inventory, driving down prices and creating the opportunity for smaller sites and apps to thrive. Today it has become a large $300B market that continues to grow at an accelerated pace with a supply chain that remains complex, fragmented, partly opaque and could be even more efficient. In a context where decisions are increasingly made by technology, traditional processes do not apply and there is a need to bring a technological solution to what is essentially a technological problem. Fiducia is a UK company with a US subsidiary headquartered in London, that has been developing the platform of TAG TrustNet, a global cross-industry initiative, involving major trade associations in the US and the UK, and taking the industry to the next level. As an always-on "industry transparency utility, TAG TrustNet is providing the tools to certify the supply chain and allow everyone to be accountable make responsible decisions and improve efficiency. TAG TrustNet is enabling this by automating the reconciliation of data across the supply chain and recording it in an immutable ledger as the Shared Truth: a unified record for every singly ad running across the supply chain made available in near real-time. The recorded data can then visualised in the platform Supply Chain Monitor or exported over an open API. Why work for Fiducia? Competitive salary and stock options Experienced and supportive team members Fast track career development with a forward-thinking company Development of advanced high-impact technology Role Overview We are looking for an experienced and talented individual to join our technology team as Quality Assurance Engineer. Your responsibility is to develop and execute exploratory and automated tests to ensure quality, reliability and security of our cloud environment and platform software components. Our platform is used across the digital advertising supply chain to harmonise, match and record billions of ad impression data points across multiple data feeds. We are using AWS cloud services and Java as primary programming language. The Quality Assurance Engineer needs to have hands-on expertise in tracking quality assurance metrics, designing and implementing tests, debugging software and defining corrective actions. To qualify for the role, you need to be a team player with a solid background in the fundamentals of computer science, distributed computing, cloud systems and software quality assurance. Your proven ability to define and implement quality assurance processes and effectively resolve system malfunctions to meet quality standards in a collaborative team environment will be a critical part of the consideration process. Responsibilities Ensure compliance with quality requirements of our software components and AWS infrastructure in line with company goals Review requirements, specifications and technical design documents to provide timely and meaningful feedback Liaise with development and product teams to identify and clarify system requirements Create detailed, comprehensive and well-structured test plans and test cases Estimate, prioritize, plan and coordinate testing activities Design, develop and execute automation scripts Identify, record, document thoroughly and track bugs Perform thorough regression testing when bugs are resolved Develop and apply testing processes for new and existing products and software components to meet client needs and quality requirements Define and track quality assurance metrics, like defect densities and open defect counts Stay up-to-date with new testing tools and test strategies Timely problem solving Qualifications Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience in software quality assurance of complex software platforms in cloud environments Strong knowledge of software QA methodologies, tools and processes Experience in writing clear, concise and comprehensive test plans and test cases Hands-on experience with both white box and black box testing Hands-on experience with automated testing tools Solid knowledge of SQL and scripting Experience working in an Agile/Scrum development process A degree in Computer Science (preferred) or related engineering field

items.desc: What are we building? At Hard Rock Games, we’re not just making games—we’re crafting experiences that connect people, deliver thrills, and celebrate the spirit of Hard Rock. As the social casino gaming arm of Hard Rock Digital, our teams shape every stage of the journey from concept to launch to live operations, giving our teams the ability to innovate, experiment, and make real impact. With the backing of a globally recognized brand, we combine the agility of a startup with the reach of an entertainment powerhouse. Here, creativity thrives, ideas scale, and careers grow. We’re looking for passionate creators, builders, and innovators to join us in shaping the future of free-to- play gaming. Let’s play hard. What’s the position? Hard Rock Games is hiring a Slot Mathematician to design, model, and validate the math behind our slot games across our game portfolio. You will own the mathematical correctness of every game - from design through player-facing release - ensuring models meet target performance metrics and regulatory requirements. Key Responsibilities Design and model slot game math: reel strips, paytables, symbol weights, bonus features, free spins, and jackpots. Tune models to hit target RTP, hit frequency, and volatility, including multiple RTP variants. Analyze simpler games directly using data analysis tools; write and validate simulations in code for more complex games. Playtest game builds and verify that implemented games match the designed model, payouts, and feature behavior. Produce PAR sheets and comprehensive math documentation for internal review and certification labs (GLI, BMM). Support regulatory certification across jurisdictions by answering lab and regulator questions. Partner with game designers early, advising on feature costs in RTP and impact on volatility. Help build a shared Java codebase of simulators, model libraries and math tools, starting from our existing tools. Work closely with developers from specification through release to ensure correct math implementation. Leverage AI tools to prototype ideas, generate code, and explore possibilities - while maintaining full ownership of correctness. What are we looking for? 3+ years designing math models for slot games with shipped titles in iGaming, Social, or Land- Based environments. Experience in a regulated environment is preferred. Ability to build and analyze slot models directly using data analysis tools - comfortable performing direct mathematical analysis. Strong programming and problem-solving skills; Java preferred, but solid Python, C++, or C# is welcome. Comfort with version control systems like Git and working in shared code repositories. Strong grasp of probability, combinatorics, and expected-value analysis. Ability to manually verify, derive, and explain math results. You understand why a model is correct, not just that it runs. Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field. Clear communication skills - explaining math concepts to designers, producers, and regulators. What’s in it for you? Make a visible impact: you’ll own campaigns and events that shape how millions play. Fast-paced execution + brand heritage: build boldly under the Hard Rock name. Competitive compensation with flexible vacation and hybrid work. Be part of a player-obsessed, inclusive team that trusts your autonomy and skills. Influence product strategies, your post-mortems and insights will steer our roadmaps. Roster of Uniques We care deeply about every interaction our customers have with us, and trust and empower our staff to own and drive their experience. Our vision for our business and customers is built on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where regardless of background or beliefs you feel able to be authentic and bring all your talent into play. We want to celebrate you being you (we are an equal opportunity employer).

items.desc: We have an exciting opportunity for a qualified Educational Mental Health Practitioner to join the Northumberland Primary Mental Health Team. This post will work directly into the Northumberland Be you Mental Health Support Teams. We are looking for an enthusiastic, dynamic and self-motivated individual with a passion for delivering early intervention and innovative new models of working in children's mental health. The post holder will be responsible for delivering the 3 core functions of the EMHP role. These roles sit within the 'getting help 'sector of the Thrive model. Our established ‘getting help service' provides excellent clinical, case management and peer led clinical skills supervision arrangements, training and CPD. We support a blended/hybrid model of working recognising the value of home life balance. We will ensure we consider suitable arrangements are made to your work and home base to guarantee suitable travel expenses are provided to support in this role. Please note we reserve the right to close this vacancy prior to the closing date once the required number of suitable applications have been received. The role will involve delivering a range of evidenced based low intensity psychological interventions for children and young people with mild/moderate need. These will be delivered individually and in small group based programmes. This will also include the facilitation of a range of psychoeducation sessions and staff training. The role will provide support to schools to improve their the whole school approach to emotional well-being. The post holder will also deliver a consultation and signposting role to a range of early help, targeted and specialist support services supporting children and young peoples emotional health and wellbeing. Engaging proactively with the wider team and our external partners is fundamental to the role and the delivery of the Mental Health Support Team functions. We manage three major locality hospitals at North Tyneside, Wansbeck and Hexham, plus a number of smaller community hospitals and clinics from Tynemouth to Berwick on Tweed, in addition to our state-of-the-art Northumbria Specialist Emergency Care Hospital, the first of its kind in England. We also care for people in their homes and provide services from facilities in local communities such as health centres. We give people greater choice and control over their care to help them to live independently at home and avoid hospital admission where appropriate. High quality patient care is at the heart of everything we do and we strive to ensure every single patient and service user has an exceptional experience with us. We have one of the most extensive patient experience programmes of any trust in England. The role involves delivering on the 3 core functions of the EMHP role within a Mental Health Support Team: delivering 1:1 low intensity intervention, whole school delivery and providing an advisory and consultative role. The role will involve holding a caseload, managing this in terms of delivering intervention and supporting through to discharge. There will be close working with education settings to support the delivery of the whole school approach. We have a robust supervision structure in place and the post holders will take an active participation in both clinical and case management supervision, group/peer supervision and the service safeguarding supervision arrangements we have in place. Part of the delivery will liaising with our system partners and contributing to the wider contribution across the emotional and mental health pathway in Northumberland. To role model compassionate and inclusive leadership in order to shape the creation of a collective leadership culture within the trust. items.desc: An excellent opportunity has emerged to hire a Band 7 Diabetes Dietitian in the Integrated Diabetes Service- North Mid at RFL NHS Foundation trust (based in Enfield Community), to offer expert assistance in enhancing and improving care for patients with diabetes in the community and acute services. We are looking for passionate professionals to become part of a dynamic team that offers development opportunities to enhance their experience in diabetes within a multidisciplinary workforce. Main Duties: To provide autonomous diabetes care for patients with Diabetes using advanced clinical skills and knowledge of diabetes in the community and acute setting. To lead and autonomously manage a caseload of patients with Diabetes, who have multiple and complex needs including complex Type 1 and 2 Diabetes, ante-natal, renal and CGM/pump/HCL therapy within the inpatient and outpatient Diabetes service. To take responsibility for own evidence-based practice and implement and add to the body of knowledge that supports expert practice within Diabetes. To lead and innovate diabetes related specialist practice, both within the Trust and through local networks. To develop diabetes guidelines, protocols and policies for the Trust To develop all staff within the multidisciplinary team, providing support, advice, formal and informal education. To actively contribute to and participate in the delivery of Trust-wide multi disciplinary mandatory training and teaching. To provide specialist advice to inpatient diabetes service by receiving direct referrals from members of other multi-disciplinary teams The Integrated Diabetes Service is a nurse-led service supported by a multidisciplinary team, including a diabetes consultant, clinical nurse lead, diabetes specialist nurses, dietitian, psychologist, healthcare assistant, and a health and wellbeing coach. The service delivers specialised care for adults with Type 1 and Type 2 diabetes, including support for pregnancy, renal, and preconception clinics. Care is provided through a fully integrated model, with close collaboration between community and acute teams. The service adopts a multidisciplinary team (MDT) approach. Clinical activities include assessment, diagnosis, shared decision-making, and the delivery of personalised treatment and management plans, focusing on achieving the three treatment targets and completing the nine key diabetes care processes. This includes comprehensive assessment of patient history and pathology, management of diabetes-related complications, and review of dietary and lifestyle interventions. The service also provides structured education programmes for individuals newly diagnosed with diabetes. Define and maintain enterprise information models, data domains, business concepts and key data relationships, ensuring critical information is consistently understood and managed across systems, processes and business areas. Establish architectural standards and patterns for metadata, lineage, master data, reference data and interoperability, enabling data to be discovered, understood, governed and reused. Define the architectural foundations needed to support data products and the necessary operating model (eg federated/hybrid), ensuring data can be shared, consumed and reused consistently across business domains and analytical use cases. Work with architecture, engineering and business teams to ensure new solutions align with agreed data principles, information standards and long-term enterprise objectives. Provide data architecture leadership and assurance into portfolios, projects, programmes and governance processes, identifying opportunities to improve reuse, reduce duplication and strengthen information quality and consistency. Support the development of semantic models, business glossaries and knowledge structures that improve understanding of enterprise information and support AI-enabled services. Work with Data Owners, Data Stewards and delivery teams to ensure ownership, governance, quality and life cycle considerations are Embedded into solution design and implementation. Promote enterprise thinking, helping business areas balance local requirements with wider organisational value, reuse and interoperability. Monitor and improve the maturity of enterprise data architecture capabilities, identifying opportunities to strengthen information management, data sharing, governance and AI readiness. Essential knowledge/experience: Significant experience in enterprise data architecture, information architecture or data leadership roles within a complex organisation. Strong data modelling expertise across conceptual, logical and (to a lesser extent) physical data models, including enterprise information and domain modelling. Strong stakeholder engagement and influencing skills, with the ability to communicate complex concepts to technical and non-technical audiences Experience developing semantic models, ontologies, taxonomies, business glossaries or knowledge structures. Strong knowledge of metadata, data lineage, data quality, master data management and data governance. Experience defining enterprise architecture principles, standards and target architectures. Practical understanding of different data architecture paradigms and styles, including Data Warehouse, Data Lake, Data Lakehouse, etc. Understanding of Data Mesh concepts and federated approaches to data ownership and reuse. Experience with integration, interoperability, APIs and reusable data services. Experience using recognised architecture methods and tools such as ArchiMate, UML, ERD, BizzDesign (preferred), Sparx EA or equivalent. Practical experience of Lean tools, including value stream mapping, standard work, line balancing, 5S and kaizen. Structured problem-solving (A3, 5 Whys, fishbone, 8D) and sound statistical analysis. items.desc: The Department of Acute Internal Medicine is a dynamic, collaborative, and forward-thinking service, led by consultants from a diverse range of specialty backgrounds, including Acute Internal Medicine, Respiratory Medicine, Infectious Diseases, Medicine for Older People, and Emergency Medicine. This breadth of expertise creates a stimulating clinical environment that promotes shared learning, innovation, and excellent patient care. The successful applicant will be expected to both contribute to and benefit from this collective knowledge and multidisciplinary approach. We welcome applications from physicians who are GMC registered with accreditation in General Internal Medicine and who are passionate about delivering high-quality acute medical care within a modern acute medicine service. The clinical duties of the post include the following: 8 Direct Clinical Care (DCC) Programmed Activities (PAs) within Acute Medicine, delivered across both hospital sites as required. Duties include the assessment and management of patients within Same Day Emergency Care (SDEC), the Acute Medical Unit (AMU) and the Acute Floor; reviewing patients referred from Primary Care and the Emergency Department; providing advice and guidance to community clinicians regarding acute medical presentations; and delivering senior supervision, support and teaching to junior medical staff. General Internal Medicine (GIM) on-call commitment , currently 1:8, attracting a Category B low-frequency availability supplement (1% of basic salary). The on-call commitment is undertaken overnight (19:00–08:00) and is primarily advisory, providing senior telephone support to the resident medical team. Attendance on site is rarely required but may be necessary in exceptional circumstances. 2 Supporting Professional Activities (SPA) Programmed Activities , providing protected time for appraisal and revalidation, continuing professional development (CPD), clinical supervision, education and training, audit, quality improvement, clinical governance, and other professional or leadership responsibilities. At UHSussex, diversity is our strength, and we want you to feel included to help us always deliver Excellent Care Everywhere, as shown in our Outstanding for Caring CQC rating. Your uniqueness and experiences will be part of our creative and innovative community where everyone is encouraged to succeed. We have a range of staff networks to help break down barriers, and can offer a buddy to help new members settle in. We’re proud to be a Disability Confident Employer (Level 3) and a Veteran Aware Trust. The Acute Medical Unit (AMU) at the Princess Royal Hospital (PRH) is delivered by consultants from the Acute Medicine department on a rotational basis and is supported by a dedicated junior medical workforce. The unit comprises 27 inpatient beds, with a significant proportion of acute medical activity managed through the adjacent Same Day Emergency Care (SDEC) service, reflecting the department’s commitment to ambulatory care and admission avoidance. The service operates in line with the same clinical standards, pathways and consultant-delivered care model as the Royal Sussex County Hospital site, ensuring consistency of patient care and professional practice across the Trust. While the range of on-site specialties is naturally smaller than that available at the Royal Sussex County Hospital, PRH benefits from close collaboration with Respiratory Medicine, Diabetes and Endocrinology, and Medicine for Older People services. In addition, Gastroenterology and Cardiology consultants provide regular on-site input, and patients requiring more complex or urgent specialist interventions can be rapidly transferred to the Brighton campus, ensuring timely access to the full range of tertiary and specialist services available across University Hospitals Sussex. The Royal Sussex County Hospital (RSCH) in Brighton a tertiary referral centre and provides comprehensive acute medical services within a modern Acute Floor environment. The service is centred around a 26-bedded Acute Medical Unit (AMU), which is co-located with the Same Day Emergency Care (SDEC) unit, in close proximity to the Emergency Department and Radiology services, facilitating rapid assessment, investigation and treatment of acutely unwell medical patients. Acute Medicine services at RSCH operate within a well-established consultant-delivered model, providing timely senior clinical decision-making and access to a broad range of specialist and tertiary services. The close integration of the AMU, SDEC and Emergency Department supports efficient patient flow, early specialist input and the delivery of high-quality acute medical care across a diverse range of presentations and levels of complexity. Interviews potentially September 26

The role focuses on preventing and addressing anti-social behaviour (ASB) and environmental crime across the borough through proactive, intelligence-led patrols, engagement with local communities, and the effective use of enforcement powers where appropriate. items.desc: UBDS Group helps organisations deliver meaningful digital transformations through modern technology and ways of working. We work across the public and private sector to design and build products, platforms and services that genuinely make a difference to users. In the public sector, that means helping teams design services that are accessible, inclusive and evidence-led, meeting real user needs while aligning with government standards and constraints. We’re looking for a User Researcher who is passionate about understanding people, confident working in delivery teams, and experienced in applying research to shape better public services. The Role As a User Researcher at UBDS, you’ll work as part of multidisciplinary delivery teams alongside designers, product managers, engineers, analysts and client stakeholders. You’ll plan and carry out user research to inform service design and delivery, ensuring decisions are grounded in evidence rather than assumptions. You’ll operate in fast-moving, sometimes ambiguous public sector environments, balancing rigour with pragmatism and helping teams continuously learn from users throughout delivery. This is a hands-on role focused on doing high-quality research and helping teams turn insight into action. What You’ll Do Plan and conduct user research to understand user needs, behaviours and pain points across digital and non-digital public services. Choose and apply appropriate qualitative and quantitative research methods (e.g. interviews, usability testing, surveys, diary studies). Work closely with product managers and designers to shape problem statements, hypotheses and research questions. Synthesize research findings into clear, actionable insights that inform design and delivery decisions. Communicate research outcomes through clear artefacts such as insight reports, personas, journey maps and playback sessions. Support teams to iterate services based on evidence, testing and learning throughout discovery, alpha, beta and live phases. Ensure research activities are inclusive, ethical and aligned with accessibility and safeguarding considerations. Work in line with Government Digital Service (GDS) standards, supporting service assessments where required. Contribute to building research capability in teams by sharing methods, insights and good practice. What We’re Looking For User Research Skills Experience conducting user research in public sector or complex service environments. Strong understanding of a range of user research methods and when to use them. Experience working across different phases of delivery (Discovery, Alpha, Beta, Live). Ability to synthesise research into clear insights that directly influence product and service decisions. Experience working with or aligning to GDS standards, including Service Standard and accessibility requirements. Awareness of research ethics, data protection and consent, particularly in public-facing services. Ways of Working A user-centred mindset and genuine curiosity about people and how they interact with services. Confidence working in multidisciplinary, Agile teams. Ability to communicate clearly with a wide range of stakeholders, including non-research specialists. Comfortable working in ambiguous problem spaces and helping teams make sense of complexity. Strong organisation and attention to detail, including clear documentation of research plans and findings. Willingness to adapt research approaches to time, budget and operational constraints while maintaining quality. At UBDS Group, employees are given unique opportunities to work on cutting-edge projects across a diverse range of industries, exposing them to new challenges and learning opportunities that are pivotal for professional growth. The Group’s culture emphasises continuous improvement, offering ample training programs, mentorship, and the chance to gain certifications that enhance their skills and marketability. UBDS Group fosters a collaborative environment where creativity and innovation are encouraged, allowing employees to contribute ideas and solutions that have a tangible impact on the company and its clients. This combination of professional development, a culture of innovation, and the opportunity to make meaningful contributions makes UBDS Group an attractive place for those looking to advance their careers and be at the forefront of technological and operational excellence. items.desc: About the Role We are looking for an organised, proactive Stock Controller & Assembly Support to join our manufacturing team in Bridgwater. In this dual-function role, you will be the backbone of our workshop operations—managing raw materials, components, and inventory for our high-capacity AI load banks while actively supporting the assembly line to keep production moving smoothly. You will maintain precise stock control, track incoming/outgoing goods against Bills of Materials (BOMs), and ensure our mechanical and electrical fitters have the parts they need when they need them. Key Responsibilities Stock & Inventory Control: Manage goods in/out, inspect incoming deliveries against purchase orders, and record stock movements accurately. Organise workshop store areas, ensuring parts, fastenings, and components are clearly labelled and safely stored. Kitting up parts and materials for production runs according to Bills of Materials (BOMs) and job sheets. Conduct regular stock counts, audits, and highlight reorder levels to prevent production bottlenecks. Assembly Support: Assist assembly fitters with basic sub-assembly, prep work, and material handling (e.g., frame prep, component organization, brackets). Safely operate hand tools, power tools, and manual handling equipment to transport materials around the facility. Support packaging, palletising, and preparing finished load banks for dispatch and transport. Maintain high standards of workshop housekeeping, organisation, and safety across storage and assembly areas. Adhere strictly to company Health & Safety procedures, PPE requirements, and manual handling guidelines. Essential Previous experience in a stock control, stores, warehouse, or production support role within a manufacturing or engineering environment. Strong organisational skills with high attention to detail in record-keeping and inventory accuracy. Ability to read work instructions, packing lists, and basic engineering Bills of Materials (BOMs). Competent in using computerised inventory systems/spreadsheets and basic workshop hand tools. Practical, hands-on mindset with the physical capability to handle manual tasks safely. Excellent communication skills and a team-player attitude. Qualifications Counterbalance Forklift License (preferred, but training can be provided). GCSEs (or equivalent) in Maths and English. Previous experience in a manufacturing, engineering, or technical warehouse environment preferred. What We Offer Competitive salary. Full training and ongoing career development. Friendly, collaborative, and fast-paced team environment. Stable, long-term employment within a growing high-tech sector. Working Hours 40 hours – 8am – 5pm – Mon to Thurs & 8am - 2pm Friday About Powerload – Who We Are and What We Do Powerload is a fast‑growing engineering and technology company specialising in next‑generation load bank solutions for hyperscale AI data centres and mission‑critical facilities. Our work ensures that some of the world’s most advanced digital infrastructures can operate safely, efficiently, and reliably before they go live. We design, manufacture, and support air‑cooled and liquid‑cooled AI load banks that simulate real‑world electrical and thermal loads. These systems allow data centre operators to test and validate their cooling, power, and commissioning processes under precise, controlled conditions. Our solutions help clients reduce risk, optimise performance, and meet demanding project deadlines. With a team combining over 40 years of experience in building services, commissioning, and cooling technologies, PowerLoad delivers engineering innovation built on deep industry knowledge. We support customers across the UK and Europe, providing rapid‑response commissioning support and bespoke engineered systems tailored to high‑density IT environments. Our mission is simple: to power precision in data centre commissioning. We help clients simulate real‑world conditions with accuracy, giving them complete confidence in their infrastructure before it becomes operational. Whether through load bank sales, rental, maintenance, or commissioning support, we play a critical role in the reliability of the digital world. What This Means for You as a Potential Employee Joining PowerLoad means becoming part of a company at the forefront of the rapidly expanding AI and data‑centre sector. You’ll be working with advanced engineering systems, innovative cooling technologies, and mission‑critical infrastructure used by some of the world’s largest operators. Our environment values precision, problem‑solving, teamwork, and continuous development. If you’re looking for a role where your work directly impacts the performance and safety of cutting‑edge digital facilities, PowerLoad offers a unique and exciting opportunity. Job Types: Full-time, Permanent Pay: £28,000.00-£33,000.00 per year Benefits: Company pension Free parking On-site parking Experience: Mechanical assembly: 3 years (preferred) …

items.desc: Fuse Energy is an energy startup on a mission to make energy abundant and affordable, fast. We combine first-principles thinking with cutting-edge technology to build a radically better energy system. We've raised over $200M from top-tier investors including Balderton, Lakestar, Accel, Creandum, Lowercarbon, Ribbit, 20VC, Hummingbird and Collaborative Fund, alongside strategic angels including Nico Rosberg and GPs behind Meta, Revolut, Spotify and Uber. We're building a fully integrated energy company: developing our own solar, batteries and other generation projects, building our own hardware, improving and developing grid infrastructure, trading power in real time, using AI across the business, and installing distributed energy in homes. By selling directly to consumers we cut out the middleman, lower costs and pass the savings on to our customers. Fuse Energy is looking for an experienced Energy Specialist from the energy sector to own escalated tickets and complaints. You will take on the cases our frontline team can't solve, across billing, switching, payments and smart metering, and see each one through to resolution. This is a shift-based, in-office role in London, with optional overnight shifts, as part of our industry-leading 24/7 customer support. Responsibilities Resolve escalated tickets and complaints end to end, from investigation to fix to customer follow-up. Manage chat and ticket queues during shifts prioritising cases and unblocking the frontline team quickly. Find the root cause behind complaints and spot when a one-off is a wider issue. Solve complex issues outside standard operating procedures (SOPs), escalating only when the fix is beyond your scope. Raise clear, evidence-backed escalations that other teams can act on straight away. Requirements 1–2+ years experience at a UK energy supplier handling tickets, escalations or complaints Strong understanding of energy supply, including switching, billing, payments, industry data flows and smart metering. Comfortable using AI tools and data to investigate cases Strong problem-solving skills and a methodical approach to finding root causes. Exceptional written communication skills. Proven ability to manage multiple workflows across ticketing, live customer support, and queue management simultaneously. Ability to work in-office on a shift pattern, including weekends (overnight shifts optional) Benefits £32,000 salary, performance bonus and overnight pay Fully expensed tech to match your needs Breakfast and dinner allowance for office-based employees

items.desc: Career Area Technology, Digital and Data Job Description Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc. When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it. Who is CAT Digital? What do we do? Big machines require big thinking. Are you looking for your next big challenge? Cat® Digital is the digital and technology arm of Caterpillar Inc., leveraging the latest technologies, data and AI to build industry leading digital solutions for our customers and dealers. With over one million connected assets worldwide, our teams use data, technology, advanced analytics, telematics, and AI capabilities to help our customers build a better world. Working with a Fortune 100 leader, you can build your career on a global scale and take advantage of development opportunities with emerging technologies. We’ve created an inclusive environment for you to explore your passions, make an impact and do the work that really matters. Join Us. Job Opportunity We are seeking talented individuals to join our team to help us grow our presence, organization, culture, which will drive our digital product development efforts. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies and collaborate with top professionals working on very high impact and visibility products. Don't miss this chance to join a forming presence and support digital innovation for a global leader in heavy machinery! What will you do? We are excied to offer one-year fixed-term position at Cat Digital. As Data Scientist , you will work on analytical tasks and projects on huge amounts of data to support data-driven business decisions and development. You will be a part of the team that utilizes AI, data science and statistical analysis to gain insight into asset condition monitoring as well as market and customer behaviors to support aftermarket businesses. Your Responsibility Will Involve Understanding Existing Data Pipelines And Algorithms To Provide Technical And Business Support, With The Goal To Enhance And Optimize Them With New Techniques And Models. You Will As Well Assist the implementation of next-generation techniques (such as weak learning, time series, NLP) supported by AI and agents, including tests, validation and delivery Explore and implement innovative and advanced statistical approaches to improve and transform solutions, including Large Language Model (LLM) concepts and prompt engineering techniques to solve business challenges. Provide support and explainability to technical partners as well as business partners to drive adoption Create documentation, compelling presentations and visualizations to explain complex technical algorithms and impacts into understandable business language What You Have Bachelor/Master or PhD degree (statistics, mathematics, physics, economics, biology or a similar field) Relevant professional experience utilizing quantitative analysis and AI is an advantage Experience with modern GenAI frameworks including LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, and CrewAI is an advantage Experience in using Data visualization tools to convey and simplify complex concepts into business value and actions Solid background in using SQL and Python, knowledge of advanced statistical models and methods, fluency in AI as well as curiosity to explore and learn more. Knowledge of ML operationalization (Airflow, Great Expectations, etc.) is an advantage Ability to clearly communicate complex technical ideas, regardless of the technical capacity of the audience. We are looking for someone who can work independently as well as part of a team, who can communicate effectively and efficiently with business partners, and is willing to take ownership of their work. If you have a passion for problem-solving and are constantly looking for ways to optimize processes, we encourage you to apply for this role. What We Offer From day one, you’re set up to thrive at Caterpillar: helpful training, relatable mentors, global experience, competitive salary package, work-life balance, and the growth opportunities you expect with a Fortune 100 company. You power our success, and we are committed to empowering yours. After all, when your work can impact the entire world, it’s important to do work that matters. Additional Information The position has fixed-term contract (12 months) A valid Swiss work permit or Swiss or EU-25/EFTA citizenship is required for this position. items.desc: Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet. Key Facts: Design and build a generative-AI workflow that helps the Celonis Talent Development team create high-quality learning content — faster, more consistently, and tailored to the learner. Flexible start date. Applications are open! Background: In 2011, three students from TU Munich founded Celonis (www.celonis.com), today the global leader in Process Intelligence. Our mission: make Enterprise AI work. More than 1,400 companies — including ABB, Fujitsu, PepsiCo, and Uniper — use Celonis to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. At the core is the Celonis Context Model, combining process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to give people and AI agents the clarity to act reliably. The Talent Development team enables Celonauts, customers, and partners with the learning experiences and leadership programs they need to be successful with Celonis. The Role: Learning content is one of the most powerful levers Celonis has to enable Celonauts, customers, and partners. But the volume, variety, and velocity of content needed keeps growing faster than it can be produced by hand. Also, as business needs change, it is important the content offered is relevant and tied to those needs. Generative AI now makes it possible to rethink how learning content is designed, drafted, maintained, and personalized, while keeping instructional quality and human expertise at the center of the process. Together with the Celonis Talent Development team, your project team owns the question end to end: How can generative AI augment the learning content creation workflow to produce high-quality learning experiences faster, more consistently, and tailored to the different learner needs? You'll get hands-on exposure to how a world-class enablement team works, and the chance to shape practical AI assisted workflows that could change how learning content is created across t Celonis. Your Goals: Research the current state of the art in generative AI for learning, instructional design, and content creation — including tools, techniques, and best practices Map the current content creation process and identify opportunities where AI can add the most value while maintaining quality and consistency. Identify and prioritize high-value use cases (e.g., turning source documents or materials into micro-learning, drafting scripts and storyboards, generating quizzes and assessment items, supporting localization and translation, refreshing outdated content, creating facilitator guides or other support resources) Design and prototype an AI-assisted learning content creation workflow Evaluate the results by considering content quality, relevance, instructional effectiveness, time and effort saved, usability for content creators and opportunities for personalization. Define recommendations and guardrails for responsible AI adoption, including accuracy, human review, accessibility, brand voice, and governance. items.desc: Safran.AI - De l'IA qui opère dans le réel Filiale de Safran Electronics & Defense, Safran.AI conçoit des solutions d'IA appliquées à des données complexes telles que les images satellite haute résolution, les flux vidéo FMV et les signaux acoustiques. Ces solutions s'appuient sur des algorithmes capables de détecter et d'identifier automatiquement des objets d'intérêt dans les secteurs du renseignement, de la défense et de l'aéronautique. Depuis son intégration à Safran en septembre 2024, Safran.AI contribue également à la transformation du groupe, en appliquant les solutions d’IA aux domaines de l’industrie 4.0. À titre d’exemple, l’analyse d’images automatisée par l’IA peut assister les contrôleurs en charge de l’inspection de pièces critiques en les aidant à détecter les anomalies éventuelles à partir de clichés numériques. Fort de nos 250 collaborateurs, vous évoluerez au sein d’équipes passionnées et pluridisciplinaires, réunissant des talents parmi les plus reconnus du secteur, tous animés par une même exigence d’excellence et d’innovation technologique. Votre équipe Vous rejoindrez l'une des équipes du département AI Production. Le département AI production est en charge de concevoir, développer et maintenir des produits et solutions d’IA allant en production au service de nos clients. Il est composé de 6 équipes (au total environ 50 personnes, essentiellement des deep learning scientist) chacune spécialisée sur un domaine d’application : → Algorithmes pour l’automatisation des contrôles de production dans l’industrie basé sur la computer vision (images radiographiques, ultrasons, vidéos, tomographie, imagerie optique...) → Détection et classification d’objets d’intérêt militaire sur imagerie satellitaire optique ou SAR → Détection d’objets d’intérêt militaire sur vidéos en temps réel Vous intégrerez pour une durée de 6 mois une squad de 4 à 7 personnes composée de Data Scientists, ML-engineers et R&D scientists tout en collaborant étroitement avec nos équipes AI Research et AI Platform. Au sein de votre équipe, vous contribuerez à un ou plusieurs projets visant à développer ou améliorer un algorithme spécifique - par exemple un détecteur d'aéronefs, de navires ou de véhicules sur imagerie satellite, ou d’anomalies sur des pièces industrielles. items.desc: Vil du være med og forme hva vi bygger innen Data & AI? Vi har erfaring og spennende kundeprosjekter å bygge videre på, og nå ser vi etter flere som vil være med og forme veien videre. Derfor ser vi etter deg som har noen års praktisk erfaring som Data Scientist, og som ønsker å bruke data til å løse reelle forretningsproblemer. Hos oss får du jobbe med hele reisen fra å forstå problemet og utforske data, til å utvikle modeller og få løsningene til å skape verdi i praksis. Du får ikke bare en rolle i kundeprosjektene våre, men også muligheten til å påvirke hvordan vi jobber, hva vi satser på og hvordan Data & AI-fagmiljøet vårt utvikler seg. Dette ser vi etter Relevant høyere utdanning innen teknologi, informatikk, statistikk, matematikk eller tilsvarende Noen års praktisk erfaring med Data Science, maskinlæring eller avansert analyse God forståelse for statistikk, prediktiv modellering og evaluering av modeller Erfaring med Python og relevante biblioteker for analyse og maskinlæring Erfaring med å bearbeide, utforske og analysere større datasett Forståelse for hvordan modeller kan tas fra eksperimentering til løsninger som faktisk brukes Evne til å forstå forretningsproblemer og oversette dem til gode analytiske problemstillinger Gode norskkunnskaper, både muntlig og skriftlig Det er et pluss om du også har erfaring med Azure Machine Learning, Databricks eller Microsoft Fabric MLOps og produksjonssetting, monitorering og videreutvikling av modeller Generativ AI, RAG eller utvikling av løsninger basert på store språkmodeller Tidsserieanalyse og prognoser Optimalisering, klassifisering eller andre metoder for beslutningsstøtte Hvorfor Itera? Itera er et teknologidrevet konsulentselskap der teknologi, design og forretning møtes. Vi jobber sammen om komplekse kundeutfordringer, og kombinerer sterke fagmiljøer med korte veier fra idé til handling. Hos oss får du: Faglig utvikling , gjennom kurs, sertifiseringer, faggrupper og læring i prosjekter Tverrfaglighet , med kolleger innen data, AI, software, design og forretning Konkurransedyktige betingelser Aksjeprogram Et sosialt og inkluderende miljø , med både faglige og sosiale aktiviteter Og kanskje viktigst: Du får mennesker rundt deg som liker å dele det de kan, spørre om det de ikke kan og finne løsninger sammen. Kanskje dette er neste steg for deg? Kjenner du deg igjen i det vi beskriver, vil vi gjerne høre fra deg. Du trenger ikke kunne alt på listen. Det viktigste for oss er at du har et godt fundament innen data og analyse, er nysgjerrig på hvordan teknologi kan løse reelle problemer og ønsker å utvikle deg videre sammen med flinke folk. Legg ved CV og svar kort på de to spørsmålene. Relevante kandidater blir kontaktet fortløpende.

items.desc: Date de parution: 15 oct. 2026 Ville: GIF-SUR-YVETTE Pays/Région: FR Type de contrat: Stage N° offre: 13033 STAGE - Biostatistique & Data Science - Patients Virtuels & Biomarqueurs (H/F) Nous sommes un groupe pharmaceutique à dimension humaine, international et indépendant, gouverné par une Fondation. Notre modèle, singulier, fait notre fierté mais, surtout, nous permet de servir pleinement notre vocation : « Engagés pour le progrès thérapeutique au bénéfice des patients ». Aujourd’hui leader mondial en cardiologie, nous avons choisi de devenir un acteur focalisé et innovant en oncologie d’ici 2030, en ciblant des cancers difficiles à traiter et en y consacrant plus de 70 % de notre budget R&D. Nous ? 22 000 passionnés de plus de 50 nationalités, portés par un esprit d’entreprenariat. Chaque jour nous avançons avec et pour les patients, avec et pour nos équipes, portés par l’envie de prendre soin, d’oser, de nous développer, de nous engager pour être utiles à celles et ceux qui en ont besoin. Venez vivre et contribuez à faire vivre notre engagement #MovedByYou www.servier.com Patients virtuels et modèles QSP pour identifier des biomarqueurs prédictifs de la réponse au traitement. Votre mission : La médecine de précision vise à identifier les patients les plus susceptibles de répondre à un traitement. Cela nécessite de détecter le plus tôt possible des biomarqueurs prédictifs de la réponse, idéalement avant les études cliniques. À ce stade du développement, les données disponibles chez les patients sont encore limitées. Les patients virtuels constituent donc une approche prometteuse pour explorer ces biomarqueurs. Ces patients virtuels peuvent être générés à partir de modèles QSP ( Quantitative Systems Pharmacology ), qui représentent les mécanismes de la maladie et le mode d’action du traitement. Déjà utilisés pour accompagner le développement des médicaments, notamment le choix des doses, ces modèles pourraient également aider à identifier les caractéristiques des patients associées à une meilleure réponse au traitement. Au cours de ce stage, vous contribuerez à deux objectifs : 1- Améliorer l’identification de biomarqueurs prédictifs en combinant des méthodes de machine learning et des approches fondées sur les mécanismes biologiques. 2- Évaluer et améliorer la génération de patients virtuels afin d’obtenir des populations biologiquement plausibles, représentatives de la diversité des patients et préservant les relations entre les différentes caractéristiques biologiques. Vous serez amené(e) à analyser des données simulées, à comparer différentes méthodes et à évaluer leur capacité à identifier des biomarqueurs pertinents pour la réponse au traitement. Votre profil : Nous recherchons un(e) étudiant(e) intéressé(e) par la statistique, la data science et la modélisation, avec une forte envie d’apprendre et de contribuer à un projet de recherche appliqué au développement de nouveaux traitements. Compétences requises : Formation : Étudiant(e) en Master 2, en dernière année d’école d’ingénieur ou dans une formation équivalente, avec une spécialisation en biostatistique. Compétences techniques : Première expérience avec des méthodes de machine learning Maîtrise de Python ou R, avec une expérience en analyse de données Une première expérience avec des données biomédicales ou issues des sciences de la vie serait appréciée Niveau d’anglais B2 minimum Qualités recherchées : Autonomie et esprit d’initiative Esprit critique et curiosité Capacité à communiquer clairement des résultats scientifiques Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? #HappyTrainees Nos étudiants sont nos meilleurs ambassadeurs. The driving force behind that work, our people, are diverse, creative, and passionate, raising the bar for excellence on a regular basis. Some of our recent projects: We are creating a multi-agent platform that supports the full data lifecycle of our customers We improve the natural language-to-SQL AI evaluator of a major tech giant We provide several automation solutions for manufacturing clients involving AI and classic ML methods as well We support the MLOps activities for a retail company, we review and optimize their hosted AI and DS solutions on their cloud platform What You Will Do Daily • Creating GenAI applications tailored to the client’s needs, environment, and available data • Writing clean, well-documented and efficient code (mainly in Python) • Building machine learning models (classification, regression, clustering, anomaly detection, etc.) • Presenting results to customers and the community • Improving and refreshing existing data science products • Participate in new project discovery and technical proposal creation Qualifications Apply, If You Have • 3+ years of experience in Data Science / AI • Hands-on experience in Python and data preparation techniques (additional R/SQL knowledge is an advantage) • Understand Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) and the transformer architecture (graph RAG is a plus) • Understand MCPs, comfortably handle model usage monitoring and token utilization concepts in LLM applications • Demonstrated knowledge of a version control tool (preferably git) • Deep understanding of data science and machine learning frameworks • Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into technical requirements • Experience working with cloud-based technologies • Experience with Generative AI technology platform offerings (open-source Lang chain/Llama Index, or other 3rd party platforms) and tools • Hands-on NLP technology experience is a plus • Team player attitude • Well-developed written and oral communication skills both in English and in Hungarian

items.desc: Želiš da tvoja AI rešenja ne ostanu na nivou demoa, nego da ih ljudi svakodnevno koriste? Delta Holding je jedna od najvećih kompanija u regionu, sa kompanijama u auto industriji, distribuciji, logistici, agraru, proizvodnji, nekretninama i ugostiteljstvu. AI je jedan od naših strateških prioriteta, a rešenja koja gradimo rešavaju konkretne poslovne probleme, od rada sa dokumentima i kupcima do prognoza i podrške odlučivanju. Tražimo AI inženjera koji će se pridružiti AI sektoru i sa biznisom graditi rešenja od ideje do produkcije. O ulozi Radiš u AI sektoru, razvijaš AI rešenja za kompanije u okviru Delta Holdinga i vodiš ih od prototipa do produkcije. Rešenja se oslanjaju na centralnu data platformu i podatke iz kompanija u grupi. Šta ćeš raditi • Raditi sa biznisom: razumeti proces, definisati zahteve i meriti efekat rešenja • Razvijati AI rešenja zasnovana na LLM-ovima: AI agente, RAG sisteme, ekstrakciju podataka iz dokumenata i asistente za interne i eksterne korisnike • Razvijati klasične ML modele za probleme zasnovane na brojevima i istorijskim podacima: prognoze prodaje i potražnje, procenu rizika i otkrivanje anomalija • Učestvovati u izboru modela, komercijalnih ili open-weight, prema zadatku, kvalitetu i ceni • Koristiti semantički sloj i podatke sa data platforme, u saradnji sa data timom • Integrisati rešenja sa ERP sistemima i drugim poslovnim aplikacijama • Voditi rešenja od prototipa do produkcije, uključujući deployment i održavanje • Postavljati evaluaciju kvaliteta, monitoring i kontrolu troškova modela u produkciji • Učestvovati u primeni pravila bezbednosti i zaštite podataka u AI rešenjima, uključujući obradu ličnih podataka • Učestvovati u praćenju rada eksternih isporučilaca i code review-u njihovog rada • Sarađivati sa IT sektorom (odeljenja za baze podataka, BI, infrastrukturu, bezbednost i poslovne aplikacije). Šta očekujemo • Najmanje 3 godine iskustva u razvoju softvera ili ML-a, uz praktično iskustvo na LLM rešenjima, od kojih je bar jedno stiglo do produkcije • Odlično poznavanje Pythona (FastAPI ili sličan framework, testovi, čist kod) • Iskustvo sa API-jima vodećih LLM provajdera • Praktično iskustvo sa RAG-om: chunking, embeddings, vektorske baze i merenje kvaliteta odgovora • Iskustvo sa razvojem AI agenata i alata (tool calling, MCP ili slično) • Dobro poznavanje SQL-a i rada sa podacima • Rad sa Docker-om, Git-om i CI/CD procesima • Iskustvo u radu u cloud ili hibridnom okruženju • Engleski jezik za rad sa dokumentacijom i spoljnim partnerima. Prednost • Open-weight modeli i njihov self-hosting • Klasičan ML: prognoze, scikit-learn, LightGBM ili slično • OCR i obrada dokumenata • AI platforme u okviru cloud i data platformi • Iskustvo sa SAP-om ili drugim ERP sistemima • Iskustvo u različitim industrijama • Rad sa eksternim isporučiocima. Šta nudimo • Uloga u središtu AI transformacije. AI je strateški prioritet Delta Holdinga, a rešenja koja gradiš direktno menjaju način na koji kompanije u grupi rade • Rešenja koja idu u produkciju. Ne radiš demo verzije za fioku, nego sisteme koje ljudi u kompanijama svakodnevno koriste • Raznovrsni izazovi. Podaci i AI inicijative iz više industrija: auto industrija, distribucija, logistika, agrar, proizvodnja, nekretnine i ugostiteljstvo • Blizina biznisa. Radiš direktno sa timovima u kompanijama i vidiš kako podaci i AI utiču na stvarne poslovne odluke • Učenje i razvoj. Najnoviji modeli i AI tehnologije, rad uz iskusnije kolege i spoljne partnere i jasan put ka senior poziciji. Lokacija: Beograd, rad iz kancelarije. Ako te ovo zanima, prijavi se putem LinkedIna. Javićemo se kandidatima koji uđu u uži izbor.
