Job Description: 
 The Modelling and Simulation Department is responsible for delivering simulator products, software and hybrid benches to both internal and external customers. These simulators support the development, validation, and operational activities of space business assets, primarily satellites. The department is the reference in simulation for the Space business within Airbus, serving all missions: Earth Observation, Space Exploration & Science, Telecommunications… and working across all home countries. 
 Each numerical simulator is composed of the following elements: 
 Core components: The Simulation Core Product : provides an engine and a framework for the simulation. 
 Onboard Computer Model : virtualized, functional or emulated model capable of running the real flight software. 
 Generic components & models : communication‑bus models and common satellite equipment (battery, solar panels, …). 
 Space Dynamics & Environment model 
 Project specific: Specific satellite-equipment models 
 Satellite Payload model: responder, functional or emulated model (capable of running the real payload software). 
 All these elements are integrated according to the satellite architecture and engineering database. The simulators are then encapsulated into a hardware bench, secured virtual machine or virtual container before delivery. 
 By joining the TSEAS organization, you will contribute to the space business by: 
 Developing and maintaining software such as the simulation core product, the emulators or satellite-equipment models 
 Integrating, validating and deploying these systems: software integration, configuration and validation. Potentially, system integration, deployment and simulator protection 
 Supporting users and customers 
 Contributing to roadmaps and proposals . 
 Mandatory Technical Skills: 
 C++ development of complex software 
 Software anomaly analysis and debugging 
 VCS: Git, Gitlab 
 Build tools: Ant, Maven… 
 CI: Gitlab CI/Jenkins… 
 OS: Linux 
 Ideally, you will also possess knowledge in some of the following areas to complete your profile: 
 Java, Python, Eclipse RCP, EMF 
 Real Time and Embedded systems 
 Communication data buses 
 Software/Hardware integration 
 Simulation and Modelling 
 Validation of critical systems 
 DevSecOps 
 Virtual Machines, Containers and OS hardening 
 IT infrastructure and networks, including cybersecurity-related aspects 
 Software Product cybersecurity: anti-reverse-engineering, anti tampering… 
 Software compilers

 Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Telecommunications, Aerospace Systems, or a related field (or demonstrated strong professional experience in the required topics). A Master's degree is a plus. 
 Experience: 
 Minimum of 2–3 years of experience in industrial software development , ideally for critical-mission systems. Preferably, you can justify an overall software development experience of more than 4 years.

 Advanced proficiency in both French and English is required.

Vous rejoindrez l’équipe SCAO Constellations et Satellite d’Observation de la Terre du département SCAO, GNC et mécanique spatiale pour contribuer au développement d’ une mission basée sur la plateforme dérivée de OneWeb (Arrow) pour un projet de constellation au concept novateur en orbite LEO .
items.desc:
Job Description: 
 Un poste d’ingénieur études SCAO/GNC vient de s'ouvrir au sein d’ Airbus Defence & Space à Toulouse . Vous rejoindrez l’équipe SCAO Constellations et Satellite d’Observation de la Terre du département SCAO, GNC et mécanique spatiale pour contribuer au développement d’ une mission basée sur la plateforme dérivée de OneWeb (Arrow) pour un projet de constellation au concept novateur en orbite LEO . Airbus a été pionnier du Newspace en 2015 en s’associant à l’entreprise OneWeb pour développer, dans le cadre de Joint Venture AOS (Airbus OneWeb Satellites), la 1ière constellation LEO de télécommunication Newspace aujourd’hui en cours de déploiement opérationnel. En capitalisant sur cette expérience, Airbus s’est doté d’une plateforme low cost dérivée de OneWeb, appelée Arrow, proposant à d’autres clients, une capacité d’emport générique et un accès à l’espace et aux orbites LEO plus rapide et moins couteux qu’avec les plateformes traditionnelles. Fort de cette confiance, Airbus vient de se voir confier par un nouvel entrant sur le marché du service en orbite un contrat de constellation au principe novateur. L’objectif de l’équipe que vous intégrerez sera d’analyser les besoins spécifiques de cette mission, de développer les nouvelles fonctionnalités SCAO nécessaires à ce projet et de les intégrer au produit Arrow afin de mettre à poste cette nouvelle constellation.
 De manière générale, le rôle de l’ingénieur études SCAO/GNC est de contribuer, au sein de l’équipe système satellite et de l’équipe avionique fonctionnelle, au développement du SCAO (analyses et logiciels de vol). A la suite de cette première mission, le poste couvre potentiellement tous les domaines d’application que traite le département SCAO, GNC et mécanique spatiale : les missions d’observation de la terre (Pléiades Néo, Co3D, missions export… avec plateforme Astrobus), les constellations (OneWeb, Arrow, Astrobus Se), les missions scientifiques (Bepi Colombo, Biomass, Juice, Mars Sample Return…), et les missions de télécommunication (SES, Astra, Inmarsat… avec plateforme E3000, Eurostar Néo ou OneSat)
 Tâches et responsabilités : 
 Vous serez responsable des activités principales suivantes : 
 Analyses préliminaires pour définir l’architecture hardware et software lié au SCAO afin de finaliser la baseline satellite en étroite collaboration avec le système,
 Design des lois de contrôle, fonctions de guidages et estimateurs SCAO et de tous les algorithmes bords du satellite associés : ingénierie des spécifications système applicable à la chaine SCAO (mission, caractéristiques des environnements et dynamiques satellite, performances des équipements avioniques…), analyses et trade-off sur les solutions de contrôle et d’estimation, analyses des performances préliminaires sur simulateur fonctionnel,
 Définition, spécification et implémentation des modèles représentatifs de senseurs, actionneurs couvrant les aspects fonctionnels, dynamiques et performance. Ces modèles sont implémentés dans le Banc de Validation Fonctionnel (BVF) utilisé par les équipes SCAO pour tester le logiciel de vol en boucle fermée,
 Implémentation des algorithmes de lois de contrôle au format vol dans l’environnement Matlab (via le processus d’autocodage) et validation fonctionnelle sur banc de validation numérique,
 Spécification des algorithmes bord/sol vers les équipes de développement logiciels,
 Analyse de stabilité des boucles de contrôle SCAO et réglages des paramètres du logiciel de vol. Contribution aux budgets système (stabilité de pointage satellite, budget mémoire/CPU…),
 Détermination des performances SCAO par analyse de Monté Carlo du banc numérique,
 Définition et support à l’intégration des cas de validation SCAO pour les bancs avionique et satellites supérieurs,
 Participation aux phases de mise à poste des satellites et aux phases de recette en orbite,
 Expertise SCAO et support à la maintenance des satellites en orbite tout au long de leur mission opérationnelle jusqu’aux phases de fin de vie/désorbitation.
 Le poste nécessite une habilitation de la sécurité (accès au site et aux informations sensibles), en réponses aux exigences de sécurité demandées par les autorités française.
 Des déplacements professionnels sont à prévoir (quelques fois par an) en France/Europe et, de ce fait, vous devez être disposé(e) à vous déplacer en conséquence.
 Compétences requises 
 Vous avez la formation, les expériences et compétences suivantes : 
 Titulaire d'un diplôme d’ingénieur généraliste avec une spécialisation spatiale/Aéronautique,
 Compétences et expériences en automatique, contrôle et traitement du signal,
 Compétences en Matlab/Simulink, 
 Compétences en physique et mécanique élémentaire,
 Compétences en simulation et modélisation numérique,
 Compétence en développement et implémentation d’algorithmes (au sens fonctionnel : mathématique et physique), 
 Capacité à appréhender des sujets système dépassant le métier SCAO (physique spatiale, dynamique …

Job Description: 
 Introduction 
 An opportunity for a National Digital Coordinator - Facility Management & Real Estate has arisen within Airbus Defence and Space, Getafe (Madrid).
 Brief description of the department’s mission 
 The selected candidate will join the Digital Office within Facility Management and Real Estate as the National Digital Coordinator for Spain. Our department is in charge of driving a major transformation from PLM (Aircraft-centric) to BLM (Building Lifecycle Management), digitizing our physical assets and optimizing operations through a robust digital strategy. The team operates in close contact with multi-site, multidisciplinary stakeholders to bridge the gap between global digital roadmaps and local operational realities, deploying innovative solutions (BIM, GIS, IoT, Digital Twin) across all Spanish sites.
 RESPONSIBILITIES The main tasks of the jobholder will be:
 Act as the national focal point for all Digital Office initiatives in Spain, ensuring alignment between global digital strategies and local site requirements.
 Support the roll-out of digital solutions (BIM, GIS, IoT) and manage the cross-site and cross-division Digital Twin supplier for Spain.
 Build, develop, and animate a network of Digital Business Partners across Spanish sites to champion digital transformation and drive on-site adoption.
 Steer the transition of digital solutions from deployment to steady-state operations ("Run" mode), guaranteeing operational support and local autonomy.
 Safeguard the "Single Source of Truth" by supervising data collection, integration (BIM/GIS), and quality control within the BLM ecosystem.
 Collect functional requirements and feedback across service lines, represent Spanish operations in global digital committees, and drive change management through targeted communication and training.
 SKILLS 
 Is your profile aligned to the following list of skills? Apply! We are looking forward to know you:
 Education: University degree in Engineering, Architecture, or Digital Technologies.
 Experience: Proven track record in coordinating digital transformation projects or programs, with experience deploying complex technical solutions across multi-site environments (ideally in industrial or real estate contexts).
 Soft skills: High level of autonomy, leadership, strong problem-solving mindset, and demonstrated ability to build relationships, influence without hierarchical authority, and coordinate decentralized networks.
 Languages: Negotiation level in both English and Spanish.
 Technical knowledge: Solid understanding of data-driven environments (BIM, GIS, CAD/CAFM), data integration, and the ability to connect technical capabilities to operational business needs.
 Valuable / Nice to have: Specialization in BIM, GIS, or Information Systems will be valuable.

 Vacation days plus additional days-off along the year.

Job Description: 
 Our team holds the responsibility on Fuel, Inerting and Fire Protection Systems of our legacy and under-development military platforms (e.g., A400M, C295, Eurofighter, MRTT, EuroDrone, SiRTAP, Saeta II). Along with them, Research, Technology and Development remain a core obligation to sustain, improve and evolve our current portfolio of products as well as our future developments.
 The responsibility of our team spans through the complete life cycle of our systems, from earliest conceptual steps to continuous development and in-service fleet support, under all Systems Engineering stages. Thus system conceptual definition, detailed physical design, performance analysis, functional breakdown and implementation in control and monitoring architectures, systems certification and qualification, testing, requirements validation and verification, data reduction and analysis, maintenance and operational concepts - all of them are our tasks.
 These activities need usually to be performed with a holistic mindset in their relationship with other sister, supplier and higher level (“system of systems”) instances, highly integrated with other stakeholders from which (and to whom) demands need to be accounted for.
 Finally, in the current context of transformation and digitalization, skilful applicants are expected to be fluent and familiar with typical Systems Engineering processes and methods, notably MBSE (Model Based Systems Engineering).
 The environment and context under which these activities are performed, demand flexible, open and adaptable responses, but also offer the opportunity to grow (and help peers grow) professionally in a number of different contexts and disciplines.
 Tasks and accountabilities: 
 In the frame of our portfolio products (Eurofighter, C295, A400M, SiRTAP, Saeta II, Airbus Military Derivatives), the successful applicant main tasks and responsibilities will include:
 - Contribute to the definition of Fuel, Inerting & Fire Protection Systems architecture.
 - Allocation of functions, requirements, performance and integrity level for the subsystems and equipment.
 - Systems, subsystems and equipment specification definition, under the frame of Model Based Systems Engineering (MBSE).
 - Hydromechanic, functional, performance and thermal modelling of system behaviour along with individual system components.
 - Liaison with external partners, vendors and suppliers for the specification of products and followup of industrial and documentary deliverables.
 - Liaison with various groups within Airbus: Flight Test, Safety, Chief Engineer's Office, Programs, Airworthiness, Customer Support, MAP / FAL on-site, Procurement.
 - Elaborating relevant documentation for airworthiness, certification and qualification purposes.
 - Elaborating technical reports and analysis on functional, performance, control and monitoring, zonal safety and physical installation.
 - Support to testing activities: definition of test requirements, support for test execution, test tracking and test reporting (rig, aircraft ground and aircraft flight testing).
 - Analysis of occurrences (In-service fleet, Continuous Airworthiness Support, Equipment Obsolescence) and evaluation of consequences and mitigations.
 Skills 
 As a successful candidate you will be able to demonstrate some or all of the following skills and competencies:
 - Engineering Degree
 - Working knowledge of Modelling tools (Matlab, SIMULINK, SCADE, Amesim, etc.)
 - Experience in Hydromechanical systems is mandatory.
 - Experience in Aerospace Systems Controls and Monitoring is desirable.
 - Experience in Data Analytics is desirable.
 - Experience in Aerospace Hydromechanical Systems is desirable.
 - Negotiation level in English (both written and verbal).

 We are looking for a confident individual with excellent people skills. The ideal candidate will be self-motivated, proactive, and willing to learn about the Airbus philosophy.
 What you will be doing: 
 You will delve into the Tooling and Metrology world within Airbus, using your skills to collaborate with teams and drive change and improvement. Your role will place you at the heart of Wing Jig Recertification, Wing Metrology Measurements, and critical aircraft machining tasks. You will gain comprehensive knowledge of all Airbus variants due to our diverse operations. You will interact with various individuals both within the team and across the plant, managing projects related to Safety, Quality, Cost, Delivery, People, Continuous Improvement, and Strategy.
 During this placement, the activities you may undertake will include:
 Strategic Thinking: Ability to contribute to long-term strategic planning, including the introduction of new technologies and process improvements;
 Project Delivery: Strong organisational skills with the capability to manage and deliver multiple projects effectively across Safety, Quality, Cost, Delivery, People, and Continuous Improvement;
 Data Studio KPI Development: Proficiency in developing data studio dashboards for critical business KPIs, enabling informed decision-making;
 SAP Integration: Willingness to learn and engage with SAP systems to support operational efficiency and data management;
 Communication and Interpersonal Skills: Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work collaboratively within a team and with various stakeholders;
 Innovative Mindset: Appetite for improvement and the ability to bring innovative ideas to enhance processes and operations.
 Your ideas and support will also play a valuable part in defining our long term strategy, including the introduction of new technologies. Working with different areas of the business will help you to develop presentation, networking and stakeholder management skills that will be required and will be valuable in future career opportunities.
 You will also learn about Airbus Operating Systems and Lean principles which will be at the forefront of all projects to ensure the best possible outcomes can be achieved.
 Requirements: 
 Our placements are open to Undergraduates only . Therefore it is mandatory for candidates to be an undergraduate for the whole duration of the placement. Please inform your graduation date on your application. 
 *Your application should include a CV along with a Cover Letter outlining your motivation and suitability for the role.* 
 Successful candidates will be able to demonstrate the following:
 Studying towards a degree in Computer Science, Business, Project Management, Software Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent;
 Good communication and interpersonal skills;
 Appetite for improvement and bringing innovative ideas to a situation;
 Ability to work as part of a team as well as autonomously;
 Organisational skills and ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously;
 Willingness to get involved, learn and immerse yourself in the Airbus ways of working;
 Good computer and data analysis skills.

Job Description: 
 Start date: 16 August 2027
 Location: Broughton, North Wales
 Duration: 12.5 months
 Applications close on 20 November 2026 ! 
 We love your interest in joining Airbus! There is no limit on the number of positions you can apply for, however, please be aware that you can only progress in the selection process for one position at a time . We recommend reviewing all available opportunities and applying to those that best match your experience and aspirations.
 AI Guidance: We know you might be thinking about using AI to help you in your application - before you do, please read our guidelines on the use of AI for recruitment at Airbus https://www.airbus.com/en/careers/faqs#using-ai-in-your-application . 
 Benefits: 
 Salary: £24,246
 35 hours per week // Flexible working hours // Hybrid working options available depending on the role // Half day Fridays! // 25 days holiday plus bank holidays
 About us: 
 AOS (Airbus Operating System) is our daily way of working to improve performance.
 AOS provides teams with a set of standards (called ‘Bricks’) to manage and improve daily activities through routines that align all Functions.
With a proven impact on performance, they cover all the key aspects that have to be managed in the workplace: Manpower, Machines, Materials, Measurement, Methods (5M) and Environment. AOS defines the best ways of working for all Airbus employees. 
 Once standards are in place and variability has been reduced, continuous improvement can be applied to raise the performance level.
The aim of ‘Kaizen’ (or ‘change for the better’) is to identify as a team
the pain points or opportunities, define action plans and quickly implement solutions.
 AOS is involved in a wide range of business improvement topics, which will give you an enriching and thorough experience as an Intern. 
 What you will be doing: 
 - Communication skills enhancement;
 - Lean & Operational Management;
 - Coaching to operations and functions;
 - Exciting site projects enabling the future of wing production.
 Requirements: 
 Our placements are open to Undergraduates only . Therefore it is mandatory for candidates to be an undergraduate for the whole duration of the placement. Please inform your graduation date on your application.
 *Your application should include a CV along with a Cover Letter outlining your motivation and suitability for the role.* 
 Successful candidates will be able to demonstrate the following:
 Studying towards a degree in Business Management, Engineering, or a related discipline;
 Experience in customer-facing roles;
 Experience or exposure to Lean principles or continuous improvement environments;
 Strong communication and interpersonal skills;
 Resilience and the ability to adapt in a fast-paced environment;
 A strong coaching mindset and willingness to support and develop others;
 A continuous improvement mindset with a drive to identify and implement improvements.
 Additional qualifications (preferred but not essential):
 Completion of Lean-related modules as part of your university studies would be advantageous.
 SECURITY CLEARANCE: You will be subject to a BPSS (Baseline Personnel Security Standard) check. You may also need to gain UK SC-level Security Clearance or Export Control, depending on the role.

Job Description: 
 Zur Verstärkung unseres Team in Immenstaad suchen wir einen Cyber-Security-Engineer (d/m/w) 
Wir sind eine voll in Airbus Defence and Space integrierte Businesseinheit mit über 1300 Cyberexperten an unseren europäischen Standorten in Frankreich, Deutschland, Spanien und im Vereinigten Königreich. Mit über 30 Jahren Erfahrung im Schutz komplexer Systeme und Netzwerke von Airbus Defence and Space nutzen wir unsere Airbus-DNA für die Entwicklung von Produkten und Dienstleistungen für Kunden, die mit ähnlichen Herausforderungen wie wir konfrontiert sind, und stützen uns dabei auf hochmoderne zuverlässige Technologien.
 Am Airbus-Standort in Friedrichshafen arbeitest du dort an Innovationen, wo andere Urlaub machen. Genieße den Panoramablick auf den Bodensee, während du in unserer Kantine zu Mittag isst. Und nach der Arbeit schließt du dich einer unserer vielen Betriebssportgruppen an, um zu laufen, zu segeln oder Ski zu fahren.
 Deine Vorteile 
 Attraktive Vergütung und Sonderzahlungen
 30 Tage bezahlter Urlaub und zusätzliche freie Tage für besondere Anlässe
 Ausgezeichnete Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und tolle internationale, konzernweite Entwicklungsperspektiven
 Sonderleistungen: arbeitgeberfinanzierte Altersversorgung, Mitarbeiteraktienoptionen, vergünstigtes Autoleasing, Sonderkonditionen für Versicherungen, Bezuschussung im öffentlichen Personennahverkehr, Mitarbeitervorteile bei kooperierenden Unternehmen
 Vor-Ort-Einrichtungen: Standortnaher Kindergarten, Arzt für Check-ups und andere gesundheitsbezogene Dienstleistungen, Kantine und Cafeteria mit Seeblick
 Betriebssportgruppen und Freizeitaktivitäten wie Segeln, Tennis und Wintersport
 Vereinbarkeit von Familie & Beruf (Jobsharing, Teilzeitmodelle, flexible Arbeitszeiten, individuelle Auszeit) 
 Arbeiten in einem diversen Umfeld, mit mehr als 140 Nationalitäten, in dem jede Stimme gehört wird
 ​ Deine Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten 
 Als Engineer bist du Teil des Center of Competence von Airbus Defence and Space Cyber und deine Aufgabe ist, das Level der Informationssicherheit nachhaltig, zukunftsorientiert und kontinuierlich zu verbessern. 
 In enger Abstimmung mit dem Cyber Security Architekten sind deine Aufgaben die Erstellung und Fortschreibung von Informationssicherheitskonzepten inkl. weiterer sicherheitsrelevanten Dokumente (Richtlinien, Handlungsanweisungen) nach dem aktuellen BSI IT-Grundschutz.
 Beratung von allen relevanten Stakeholdern zu technischen, prozessualen und organisatorischen Themen der Informationssicherheit.
 Teilnahme an internen und externen Workshops und Meetings zum Thema Informationssicherheit, sowie Dienstreisen zu den Kunden im Rahmen der Projekte.
 Gewünschte Fähigkeiten und Qualifikationen 
 Du hast eine erfolgreich abgeschlossene Hochschulausbildung (Bachelor, Master) in der Fachrichtung Informationssicherheit, Informatik, Informationstechnik, Cybersicherheit oder ein vergleichbares Studium
 Du hast idealerweise 2 Jahre fachspezifische, praktische Berufserfahrung im Bereich IT / Informationssicherheit, sowie bei der Beratung von IT-Grundschutz-Anforderungen
 Kenntnisse von Tools zur Modellierung von Informationssicherheits Anforderungen (SAVe, Verinice, HiScout Grundschutz, oder andere ISMS Werkzeugen) sind von Vorteil
 Wünschenswerte Zertifizierungen: BSI IT-Grundschutz Praktiker oder ähnliche Informationssicherheits Zertifizierungen
 Begeisterungsfähigkeit das Thema Informationssicherheit in die Projekte zu tragen
 Du bist ein Teamplayer, verfügst über ein hohes Maß an Kommunikativen Fähigkeiten und möchtest gemeinsam ein vertrauensvolles Arbeitsumfeld schaffen 
 Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch (verhandlungssicher)

items.desc:
Job Description: 
 Envolez-vous avec Airbus Helicopters ! 
 Airbus Helicopters recherche un(e) Responsable Conception de la fonction "Gestion des Défaillances" (f/h) pour rejoindre le département Maintenance & Ground Operation basé à Marignane, France.
 Rejoignez nous pour façonner l'avenir de l'aéronautique et contribuer à protéger des vies lors des missions accomplies grâce à nos hélicoptères.
 Le site de Marignane, 3ème site industriel français, près de Marseille et d'Aix-en-Provence se transforme en profondeur pour offrir un environnement de travail de haute technologie, inclusif et respectueux de l'environnement.
 Vous vivrez une expérience professionnelle unique, au cœur de la fabrication de nos hélicoptères.
 Pour en savoir plus sur notre site et nos activités : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=flu57j6g-0g 
 Vos futures missions :
 En rejoignant notre équipe, vous participerez à différentes missions, toutes orientées vers l'optimisation de la charge de travail de maintenance afin de maximiser la disponibilité de la flotte et de répondre aux attentes de nos clients. Ensemble, nous contribuerons à l’activité du département Maintenance & Ground Operation , une équipe transnationale de 70 personnes (France et Allemagne) en charge de la conception des opérations de maintenance et au sol pour tous les programmes d'hélicoptères.
 Votre objectif sera de concevoir des solutions permettant de minimiser l'impact des opérations de dépannage sur la disponibilité des appareils et les coûts de maintenance.
 Vos principales missions seront les suivantes : 
 Conception de la fonction : Définir et challenger les solutions existantes ou proposées par les fournisseurs ; produire les documents de conception (spécifications fonctionnelles, validation et certification).
 Supervision technique : Superviser la conception de la testabilité (BIT) des équipements avioniques, spécifier les logiques de surveillance des pannes et définir les règles de diagnostic au niveau système.
 Gestion de projet : Piloter le planning, les livrables, les coûts et la qualité, tout en identifiant et en atténuant les risques du projet.
 Gestion de la sous-traitance : Définir les lots d'activités, contractualiser les prestations, assurer le suivi opérationnel et valider les livrables avant paiement.
 Amélioration continue : Contribuer au référentiel technique du métier "Failure Management" en définissant des processus et des règles de validation pour gagner en efficacité.
 Votre profil :
 Formation : Titulaire d’un Master (ou équivalent) en ingénierie système ou dans une discipline connexe.
 Expérience : Vous justifiez d'au moins 3 ans d'expérience en gestion de projet pour le développement de programmes aéronautiques. Des connaissances en développement de systèmes avioniques, testabilité de systèmes embarqués, analyses de sécurité (FMEA/AMDEC) ou maintenance hélicoptère sont de réels atouts.
 Expertise technique : Maîtrise de la gestion de projet et de budget, suivi de sous-traitance, et idéalement une expertise en développement de fonctions hélicoptères (diagnostic système/troubleshooting).
 Langues : Anglais (niveau intermédiaire supérieur minimum requis). La maîtrise du Français ou de l'Allemand est un plus.
 Soft skills : Autonomie, excellente organisation, aisance relationnelle et fort esprit d'équipe.
 3 Raisons pour nous rejoindre :
 Nos Valeurs : Six valeurs essentielles constituent le noyau de notre entreprise. Définies pour les employés par les employés, nos valeurs Airbus façonnent l'ADN de notre activité, en reflétant le mélange unique des qualités que l'on trouve dans chacun des membres de notre famille mondiale.
 Inclusion et diversité : Nous favorisons un cadre de travail inclusif et valorisant, où la diversité de chacun est appréciée et respectée. Une main-d'œuvre inclusive et diversifiée est le moteur de l'innovation chez Airbus. Elle nous rend unique, contribue à une meilleure résolution des problèmes.
 Rémunération et avantages : Chez Airbus, nous construisons l'avenir ensemble et votre succès est notre priorité. Attendez-vous à un package de rémunération global, compétitif et transparent (incluant salaires, primes, intéressement, participation et plan d'actionnariat privilégié), conçu pour récompenser l'impact et la performance que vous apportez, à la fois individuelle et collective. Nous investissons dans votre épanouissement complet : développement professionnel (formation, mentorat, mobilité internationale), couverture santé, retraite, et un engagement pour un équilibre vie pro/vie perso soutenu (soutien à la parentalité, flexibilité).
 Et pour votre quotidien, des avantages qui font la différence : 
 Un CSE dynamique proposant de nombreux avantages (restaurant d'entreprise, centre aéré pour les enfants, associations et complexe sportif, indemnités de voyages, etc.).
 Facilités de transport : Profitez de nos navettes d'entreprise ou du remboursement de votre pass annuel de transport.

 WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU 
 Airbus Belfast Limited offers a generous package of benefits including:
 Holidays: 260 hours paid holiday p/a inc. public holidays

 Employee Assistance Programme (EAP): Mental Health and Wellbeing support platform
 Life Assurance: 2x Basic Salary (whilst a member of the Pension Scheme)

 AIRBUS BELFAST 
 Our world is changing. And at Airbus, so are we. From our commitment to zero-carbon flight ( # ZEROe ) to cleaning up space , sustainability is at the heart of our purpose. So what's your next change?
 To support extensive ramp-up activity in our A220 composite wing programme, we are immediately seeking skilled operatives to expand our production team. This is an opportunity to join Airbus and develop your skills to a whole new level with a highly attractive salary and benefits package.

 Or
 four years’ experience in a skilled role in one of the afore mentioned disciplines with a Level 3 (NVQ, SVQ, IMI, BTEC) in any mechanical engineering discipline (NOT Electrical or Electronic)

Job Description: 
 Airbus Commercial Aircraft is looking for a Configuration & Design Retrofit Solution Engineer (C&D RSE) for Connected Aircraft (f/m) to join our retrofit department based in Toulouse, France.
 You will be part of a team developing Connected Aircraft retrofit projects aiming to provide our customers with a safe and reliable connectivity product in accordance with their requests .
 As part of the Connected Aircraft Retrofit Solution Team , you will be involved in the definition and integration of retrofit design solutions for cross-program family aircraft post-delivery aiming at focusing on complex Connected Aircraft projects/modifications including associated mechanical and electrical interfaces and adaptation of related cabin and cockpit systems .
 Global capital of aeronautics and European capital for space research, Toulouse is a dynamic city in the southwest of France served by an international airport. Ideally located between the Mediterranean sea and the Atlantic ocean and close to the Pyrenees mountains, it offers plenty of options for outdoor activities!
 How we care for you: 
 Financial rewards: Attractive salary, agreements on success and profit sharing schemes, employee savings plan abounded by Airbus and employee stock purchase plan on a voluntary basis.
 Work / Life Balance: Extra days-off for special occasions, holiday transfer option, a Staff council offering many social, cultural and sport activities and other services.
 Wellbeing / Health: Complementary health insurance coverage (disability, invalidity, death). Depending on the site: health services center, concierge services, gym, carpooling application. 
 Individual development: Great upskilling opportunities and development prospects with unlimited access to +10.000 e-learning courses to develop your employability, certifications, expert career path, accelerated development programmes, national and international mobility.
 At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.
 Your challenges: 
 Coordinate all design activities in terms of cost, time and quality
 Manage and validate internal and external engineering work packages, including pre-check of design drawings

items.desc:
Who we are 
 Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards. 
 As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously. 
 We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications. 
 The role 
 As a Systems Engineer for C-UAS System-of-Systems, you own the high-level architecture of a distributed air defence capability.
 You define the top-level architecture (L0 and L1), partitioning the capability into network, sensor, and effector subsystems and the interfaces between them. The architecture is open and hardware agnostic: any qualified node can join the network. It is controlled centrally but is designed to keep operating when nodes are lost or contested, so that no single point of failure breaks the chain. This is the layer that enables engage-on-remote and launch-on-remote, where the effector need not sit with the sensor that cued it.
 This is a role for someone who thinks at the level of the whole system. Your decisions on architecture, networking, and interfaces determine whether a distributed capability performs as one coherent whole under real operational conditions.
 The day-to-day
 Own the top-level (L0/L1) architecture of the C-UAS system-of-systems, partitioning the mission into network, sensor, and effector subsystems
 Specify the network capabilities that let distributed nodes share a common air picture and coordinate engagements, including decentralised operation when the central command node is degraded or absent
 Derive network, sensor, and effector requirements from the operational concept, and own the trade-offs between coverage, resilience, latency, and cost
 Translate operational concepts into a coherent system architecture and clear engagement concepts, then hold that architecture consistent as the design matures
 Keep the architecture open and hardware agnostic, establishing the interfaces that let any qualified node join the network
 Enable engage-on-remote and launch-on-remote by defining how cueing, track handover, and fire control flow across nodes
 Produce a structured architecture that can be exposed externally to partners and customers at the right level of abstraction, without disclosing sensitive detail
 Collaborate daily with the situational awareness and interceptor integration teams, and with AI, software, and hardware engineers, to keep the system-of-systems coherent
 You should apply if you 
 Have hands-on experience architecting distributed systems or systems-of-systems, ideally for defence, air defence, C-UAS, or comparable networked mission systems
 Can define top-level architectures and derive network, sensor, and effector requirements from an operational concept
 Understand distributed and decentralised system design: how nodes share state, degrade gracefully, and coordinate without a single point of failure
 Have a strong foundation in requirements management and interface definition
 Can communicate an architecture clearly to both internal engineering teams and external partners and customers
 Hold a university degree in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace, Computer Science, or a related field
 Are business fluent in German and English
 Are willing to travel
 Your personal values match ours: ownership, initiative, dedication to mission, speed and inclusiveness
 Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points. 
 Nice to Have 
 Working knowledge of tactical networking, mesh communications, or resilient data links in contested environments
 Familiarity with air defence engagement concepts, kill-chain design, or NATO C-UAS framework
 Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields 
 Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns 
 The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world 
 Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical …

items.desc:
Who we are 
 Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards. 
 As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously. 
 We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications. 
 The role 
 As a Systems Engineer for C2 C-UAS, you take our command and control (C2) node from working prototype to a qualified system in the field. C-UAS means Counter Unmanned Aircraft Systems: the detection and defeat of hostile drones and cruise missiles. The C2 node fuses sensor tracks, runs threat evaluation and weapon assignment (TEWA), and controls the effectors. Your job is to prove that it does this safely and reliably, and to get it approved for operational use.
 You own the functional safety case and the qualification path of the C2 node. You decide which norms apply, which evidence is needed, who produces it, and how long it takes. Approval lead times, not engineering effort, often set the date of a fielding. You plan backwards from that date, so that safety, test, and certification work runs alongside development instead of after it.
 This is a hands-on engineering role. You work inside a fast software and autonomy team, write requirements and safety analyses they can build against, run system-level tests yourself, and stand in the field when the system is handed over to its users. Where the system-of-systems architecture defines the network, you make sure the command node in that network can be qualified, fielded, and trusted.
 The day-to-day
 Own the functional safety case for the C2 node, covering the safety-relevant functions from identification through engagement decision to effector control
 Run hazard analyses and turn their results into safety requirements, safety mechanisms, and verification evidence
 Build and maintain the norms and approvals map for the C2 node: applicable norms, required evidence, evidence owner, current status, and lead time
 Plan and run qualification of C2 hardware and software together with test centres and authorities
 Define how the autonomy level per kill-chain step and human approval of engagements are argued in the safety case, and what has to be true before autonomy is raised
 Write and execute system-level verification and test campaigns in test beds, at test ranges, and in field trials, and close findings through root-cause analysis
 Specify the safety and interface evidence the C2 node needs from sensor and effector partners, and review their qualification data
 Prepare fielding: acceptance tests, operational documentation, training input, and support for user approval and handover
 You should apply if you 
 Have taken a defence or safety-critical system through qualification and into operational use, ideally a C2, fire control, or air defence system
 Have hands-on experience with functional safety and system safety for defence or comparable safety-critical systems
 Have written safety cases and hazard analyses for systems with a large software share
 Know military qualification testing and how long it takes to plan and pass
 Have a strong foundation in requirements management, verification, and interface definition across hardware and software
 Are comfortable running your own system-level tests and debugging failures, not only writing documents
 Can keep pace with a fast engineering team and make the safety and qualification work an enabler, not a gate at the end
 Hold a university degree in Systems Engineering, Aerospace, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
 Are business fluent in German and English
 Are willing to travel, including to test ranges and field trials
 Your personal values match ours: ownership, initiative, dedication to mission, speed and inclusiveness
 Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.

 Experience with qualification and approval processes of European armed forces, for example the Bundeswehr
 Familiarity with the safety assurance of software-heavy, AI, or autonomous functions
 Knowledge of air defence C2 concepts, TEWA, IFF, and SHORAD and V-SHORAD (Short Range and Very Short Range Air Defence) systems

items.desc:
The Team 
 As Datadog’s in-house product experts, the Technical Escalation Engineering (TEE) team plays a critical role in driving our global success. We enable our customers, from the world’s most innovative startups to the largest enterprises.
 Through deep technical expertise, relentless problem-solving, and exceptional customer engagement, we educate, guide, and troubleshoot, delivering high-impact solutions that shape the customer experience. Whether through hands-on technical call, in-depth fact findings meeting, or complex investigations, we set the gold standard for technical excellence and customer advocacy.
 As part of our TEE team, you’ll tackle the most challenging technical problems, collaborate directly with Engineering and Product to refine and evolve our platform, and mentor teams worldwide, elevating the technical bar at every level.
 Role Summary 
 As part of the Technical Escalation Engineering (TEE) team, you’ll operate at the heart of Datadog’s ecosystem, working at the intersection of Technical Solutions, Engineering, Product, and our Customers. Every challenge you take on will directly impact the performance, scalability, and success of both our clients and our platform. You’ll be in an environment that moves fast, challenges you daily, and rewards curiosity, ownership, and technical excellence.
 This is your chance to shape the future of observability and security, driving innovation, mentoring teams, and influencing product direction while witnessing your expertise make an immediate and lasting impact.
 At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them. 
 What You’ll Do: 
 Become the global expert on Alerting & Monitoring within the Technical Solutions team, supporting TSEs and customers in building reliable, actionable monitors.
 Own investigations into alert-related escalations, identifying root causes across metric behavior, configuration edge cases, and backend evaluation logic.
 Collaborate with Product and Engineering to flag inconsistent monitor behavior, propose enhancements, and ensure alignment with user expectations.

items.desc:
ABOUT MISTRAL

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.




THE TEAM

Mistral Cloud builds and operates the infrastructure that powers Mistral's AI. The Data Centers team signs long-term leases for data center capacity developed by third-party operators, sources the GPUs that fill those halls, and runs the workloads that train and serve Mistral's models. Today the team is around 40 people, mainly based in Paris with some remote members, and operates roughly 200 MW of existing capacity across France. Key partners include Éclairion in France and EcoDC in Sweden, which is currently delivering Mistral's first Swedish data center.

The team sits at the center of an ambitious roadmap: Mistral has publicly committed to securing one gigawatt of data center capacity globally by 2030. With 200 MW already online, roughly 800 MW remain to be secured over the next five years. 




THE ROLE

This hire acquires the data center capacity that Mistral's next generation of models will run on. Across Europe, you will negotiate co-location agreements and built-to-suit contracts with data center developers, structure master services agreements and order forms, and make sourcing decisions grounded in a deep understanding of what the capacity will actually be used for: training frontier LLMs, serving inference at scale, or both.

The role sits at the intersection of commercial negotiation and technical infrastructure. You will need to translate workload requirements into contract terms, assess whether a given site can deliver the power, cooling, and connectivity Mistral needs, and close deals that lock in capacity years before the GPUs arrive. 




WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Negotiate master services agreements, order forms, and co-location or built-to-suit contracts with data center developers across Europe

 - Structure capacity sourcing decisions based on workload requirements: training, inference, or hybrid

 - Assess data center sites for power delivery, cooling, connectivity, and commissioning timelines

 - Work with Mistral's science and infrastructure teams to align capacity plans with model roadmaps

 - Manage relationships with existing data center partners including Éclairion and EcoDC




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - You have negotiated data center contracts. You have closed master services agreements, order forms, or co-location / built-to-suit deals in the data center or infrastructure sector.

 - You understand capacity delivery. You know what it takes to commission a data hall: power, cooling, connectivity, timelines, and the failure modes that delay go-live.

 - You can translate technical requirements into commercial terms. You have structured sourcing decisions based on workload needs, whether for training clusters or inference serving.

 - You operate across borders. You have worked with counterparties across multiple European jurisdictions and are comfortable with cross-border negotiation.




WHAT WE OFFER

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link.

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

About the Role

We're looking for a hands-on Robotics Operations Specialist to support teleoperation sessions, robot benchmarks, robotics data quality, and evaluation runs. You'll work closely with engineers and operators to ensure sessions run on time and on spec - troubleshooting hardware issues in real time, preparing evaluation environments, and helping improve operational processes.



Responsibilities



Teleoperations Support & Operator Relations

 - Provide hands-on support during teleoperation sessions: setup, monitoring, and real-time troubleshooting

 - Debug equipment issues (connectivity, hardware faults, peripheral failures) and escalate when needed

 - Manage session scheduling, collector onboarding, equipment handoff, and session-readiness checks

 - Travel to client sites and data collection locations to onboard and train operators on teleoperation systems, protocols, and best practices

 - Serve as the liaison between operators and hardware/data collection teams - systematically gathering feedback on equipment usability, workflow friction, and potential improvements

 - Synthesize actionable insights to inform hardware development and process decisions



Benchmark & Evaluation Operations

 - Support execution of robot benchmarks and evaluations alongside research and engineering teams

 - Prepare robots, stations, props, and task environments according to defined protocols

 - Ensure consistent resets, trial conditions, and operator execution across runs

 - Investigate failed or inconsistent runs to identify whether issues stem from the model, robot hardware, environment setup, or operator execution



Data Quality & Annotation

 - Review collected datasets to assess quality, flag inconsistencies, and ensure data meets training standards

 - Onboard annotators on robotics annotations to assess video quality

 - Perform data analysis to identify patterns in collection quality, operator performance, and session outcomes

 - Collaborate with research teams to refine annotation guidelines and quality criteria

 - Maintain quality metrics and contribute to reporting on dataset health across collection campaigns



Validation & System Integration

 - Verify that hardware, software packages, and peripherals work smoothly together across the robotics stack

 - Run tests in lab and staging environments, log bug reports, and contribute to root-cause analysis of recurring or production issues

 - Support test plan execution by following defined acceptance criteria and documenting results

 - Maintain detailed operational documentation for internal quality gates and runbooks



What We're Looking For

 - Comfortable working hands-on with physical hardware: diagnosing, setting up, and maintaining equipment

 - Strong communicator who can work fluidly with both engineers and non-technical operators

 - Able to work autonomously and exercise independent judgment on methods and execution



Nice to Have

 - Familiarity with robotics and teleoperation systems

 - Background in a research or hardware-forward environment

 - Experience writing operational runbooks or technical documentation

Overview 
 In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day and we need you as a Critical Environment Industrial Controls Systems Engineer (CE IE). In the CEIE role, you will have an opportunity to work alongside a dynamic team of industry professionals across the Information Technology (IT) and Critical Environments (CE) spectrum within Microsoft 24x7x365 mission-critical datacenters.
 Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I CE IE, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development for all employees and offers trainings and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion trainings and events, and professional certifications.
 With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our datacenter design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.
 Responsibilities 
 Maintaining ICS availability, data quality, service and change management, reporting, and the security of all ICS systems in the Data Centers.
 Site level ICS program and project management, and both govern and directly participate in the execution of global initiatives related to ICS systems.
 Managing, servicing, and governing Microsoft’s electrical and mechanical industrial control systems (ICS) to include servers, applications, networks, and device infrastructure deployed within Microsoft’s 24x7x365 mission-critical datacenters.
 Governing logical and physical access, approval, and permissions related to all ICS systems, networks, workstations, and servers that provide datacenter monitoring and controls. 
 Empowering a culture of safety and security in global datacenter operations by complying with CO+I’s safety programs and policies and completing compliance knowledge assessments.
 Developing positive working relationships with internal teams and external stakeholders.

 Required Qualifications: 
 Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Data Science, Cybersecurity, or related field AND technical experience in software engineering, network engineering, service engineering, systems engineering, or industrial controls OR equivalent experience.

 Bachelor’s degree or applicable field experience in Critical Environments, Electrical, Industrial, or Mechanical
 Experience in an operational, mission-critical, 24x7x365 facility
 Experience in the design and/or commissioning of Industrial Controls Systems (ICS) in datacenter critical environments including the Modbus and BACnet protocols.
 Experience with the operation and maintenance of building electrical systems (Power distribution, grounding, fire alarm, and related controls systems) and mechanical systems (HVAC, Chilled Water, DX Refrigerant, Evaporative, and related controls systems)
 Project management experience with a focus on agile methodologies.

items.desc:
Overview 
 En tant que Technicien(ne) de Centre de Données Microsoft (Data Center Technician – DCT), vous développerez une compréhension des processus et procédures standard liés à la préparation, l’installation, l’exécution de diagnostics, le dépannage, le remplacement et/ou la mise hors service des équipements, sous la supervision de collègues plus expérimentés du centre de données. Cette opportunité vous permettra de mieux comprendre notre environnement de centres de données, de vous familiariser avec les procédures de sécurité et de gestion des données, tout en accélérant votre évolution professionnelle. 
 Les équipes Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) de Microsoft constituent le moteur qui alimente nos services cloud. En tant que DCT au sein de CO+I, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans la fourniture des infrastructures fondamentales et des technologies de base soutenant les services en ligne de Microsoft, notamment Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive et la plateforme Microsoft Azure. Le groupe CO+I est fortement engagé dans le développement personnel et professionnel de ses employés et offre des formations ainsi que des opportunités d’évolution, notamment des programmes de rotation de carrière, des formations et événements sur la diversité et l’inclusion, ainsi que des certifications professionnelles. 
 Notre infrastructure comprend un vaste portefeuille mondial de plus de 200 centres de données répartis dans 32 pays et comptant des millions de serveurs. Elle repose sur une équipe d’experts techniques qui soutiennent des services destinés à plus d’un milliard de clients et à 20 millions d’entreprises dans plus de 90 pays à travers le monde. 
 Avec la durabilité environnementale et l’optimisation au cœur de la conception et de l’exploitation de nos centres de données, nous poursuivons notre croissance et notre évolution afin de répondre aux besoins changeants des entreprises, tout en maintenant Microsoft parmi les leaders mondiaux des fournisseurs de services cloud. 
 La mission de Microsoft est de permettre à chaque personne et à chaque organisation de la planète d’accomplir davantage. En tant qu’employés, nous adoptons un état d’esprit axé sur le développement, innovons pour permettre aux autres de réussir et collaborons afin d’atteindre nos objectifs communs. Chaque jour, nous nous appuyons sur nos valeurs de respect, d’intégrité et de responsabilité afin de créer une culture inclusive où chacun peut s’épanouir, au travail comme au-delà. 
 Ce poste nécessite des déplacements entre différents sites. Il est donc fortement recommandé de posséder un permis de conduire valide. Le poste est basé sur site et la localisation est desservie de manière limitée par les transports en commun ; disposer de son propre moyen de transport est conseillé. 
 Ce poste exige une maîtrise courante du français et de l’anglais à l’oral, car l’ensemble des opérations commerciales et des communications avec les parties prenantes sont menées dans ces deux langues. 
 *Ce poste est basé dans le sud de Paris* 
 Responsibilities 
 Responsabilités 
 Contribuer au suivi des incidents via les escalades, poser des questions et solliciter les conseils de techniciens plus expérimentés afin de garantir une résolution rapide des problèmes. 
 Participer aux briefings quotidiens sur la sécurité, suivre les formations requises en lien avec les responsabilités du poste, notamment les formations sécurité, et respecter les procédures de sécurité (utilisation des équipements, manutention, risques électriques, utilisation des échelles et escaliers roulants). 
 Traiter efficacement les tickets attribués conformément aux indicateurs clés de performance (KPI) et aux accords de niveau de service (SLA), avec l’accompagnement d’autres techniciens. 
 Respecter les procédures et politiques de sécurité et de gestion des données, avec le soutien d’autres techniciens, et suivre les formations de sécurité obligatoires. 
 Maintenir une forte orientation client afin de comprendre l’impact de son travail lors du traitement des tickets et des tâches assignées. 
 Contribuer à un environnement de travail positif et efficace en partageant les informations, en participant aux réunions d’équipe régulières, en posant des questions et en restant informé de l’avancement du travail des autres. 
 Faire preuve de fierté et d’un fort sens des responsabilités quant à la qualité du service, à l’exhaustivité du travail effectué et à la gestion des installations du centre de données. 
 Incarner la culture et les valeurs de Microsoft. 
 Qualifications 
 Qualifications requises 
 Diplôme de fin d’études secondaires (ou équivalent), GED, formation en apprentissage ou qualification professionnelle, ou expérience équivalente, ainsi que des connaissances de base en matériel informatique et composants informatiques. 
 Exigences relatives aux vérifications d’antécédents 
 La capacité à satisfaire aux exigences de contrôle de sécurité de Microsoft, de ses clients et/ou des autorités …

items.desc:
Overview 
 As a Microsoft Data Center Technician (DCT), you will stage, set up and perform hardware deployments. In addition, you will also perform troubleshooting and diagnostics on equipment, as well as perform hardware decommissions for simple changes and refreshes following Standard Operating Procedures. This opportunity will allow you to deepen your understanding of Data Center standard processes and procedures, develop mentoring skills while providing guidance to peers, familiarizing yourself with security and data management procedures, and accelerate your career growth in the process. 
 Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DCT, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications. 
 Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 Data Centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide. 
 With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider. 
 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. 
 Responsibilities 
 Performs diagnostics and troubleshooting following standard procedures, quickly identifies the cause(s) of issues, and replaces faulty components with minimal customer and business disruption. 
 Performs post-execution quality checks and verifies that grounding, staging, labeling, and cabling are set up properly according to safety protocols, deployment standards, and planned Network Design Tasks (NDTs). 
 Decommissions hardware for simple changes and refreshes (e.g., memory upgrades, rebuilds) following standard procedures with minimal guidance. 
 Follows procedures to communicate, report, and escalate incidents to appropriate Microsoft data center operations management units, Technician Leads, and engineering specialists. 
 Assists and provides guidance to other technicians to complete challenging or complex tasks. 
 Completes required training aligned to the role and workload; observes more experienced technicians to gain hands-on experience and relevant on-the-job training. 
 Contributes to a positive and effective team environment by sharing information with others, contributing to regular team meetings, asking questions, and staying apprised of the status of others' work. 
 Has pride and a sense of accountability for the service quality, completeness, and resulting user experience; displays accountability and ownership of the data center facilities. 
 Embodies our culture and values . 
 Qualifications 
 Required Qualifications : 
 High school diploma, GED, or equivalent and basic knowledge of computer hardware and components AND proven experience supporting IT equipment or related technology. 
 Background Check Requirements: 
 Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: 
 Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter. 
 While not required, we also look for the following Preferred Qualifications: 
 Demonstrated experience supporting IT equipment or related technology. 
 Applicable certifications: CompTIA (A+, Server+, Network+), Basic Structure Cabling (BSC).

items.desc:
Overview 
 Are you passionate about helping customers realize the full value of Microsoft AI, Security, Endpoint, and Productivity investments? Do you thrive in fast-changing environments, enjoy learning new technologies, and excel at connecting business outcomes to technical solutions?  
 The Global Consumption & Delivery Acceleration team is looking for a FastTrack Full Stack Engineer to help accelerate customer deployment, adoption, consumption, and value realization across the Microsoft AI Business Solutions portfolio. As part of Microsoft's consumption engine, you will work directly with customers, partners, engineering, and field teams to remove adoption barriers, drive successful onboarding outcomes, and help customers progress from initial deployment to secure AI transformation.  
 Unlike traditional workload-specific roles, Full Stack Engineers bring breadth across multiple Microsoft technologies and demonstrate the agility to guide customers through interconnected deployment scenarios spanning Microsoft 365, Security, Endpoint Management, Windows 365, Copilot, Agents, Identity, and Data Protection.   
 You are expected to have a depth of specialism, level 400, in either Security or Copilot workloads.
 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
 Responsibilities 
 What You'll Do: 
 Guide customers through onboarding, deployment, and optimization of Microsoft cloud solutions focused on getting customers ready for AI & data security.   
 Deliver consultative technical guidance across multiple Microsoft solution areas while helping customers navigate dependencies between workloads.  
 Drive customer success by identifying and removing deployment blockers, mitigating risks, and accelerating time-to-value.  
 Partner closely with FastTrack Architects, Customer Success teams, Engineering, Product Groups, and Partners to achieve customer outcomes.  
 Enable customers to adopt secure AI experiences by connecting identity, security, compliance, endpoint, productivity, and agent-based solutions into cohesive deployment strategies.  
 Contribute to scalable delivery by sharing practices, improving playbooks, creating reusable guidance, and driving operational excellence.  
 Act as a customer advocate by bringing field insights and feedback into engineering and product improvement discussions.  
 What We're Looking For: 
 Technical professionals who enjoy solving complex customer challenges across multiple technologies rather than specializing in a single workload.  
 Individuals who demonstrate curiosity, adaptability, and a growth mindset in a rapidly evolving AI-first technology landscape.  
 Experience helping customers deploy, adopt, or optimize Microsoft cloud technologies and realizing measurable business outcomes.   
 Collaboration skills with the ability to influence across diverse stakeholders and virtual teams.  
 Effective communication skills capable of translating technical concepts into customer business value.  
 Passion for continuous learning and building expertise across Microsoft 365, Security, Endpoint Management, Copilot, Agents, Identity, Data Security, and related technologies.  
 Why This Role Matters  
 The future of customer success requires technical professionals who can span workloads, connect technologies, and accelerate customer outcomes across end-to-end solution journeys. As a FastTrack Full Stack Engineer, you will help customers move beyond isolated deployments to comprehensive, secure AI transformation while shaping the next generation of Microsoft's delivery model.  
 Qualifications 
 Required Qualifications: 
 Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology (IT), Computer Science, Business Administration, Engineering or related field and technical consulting, information technology (IT) administration, support, project management, customer success management, IT customer-facing experience OR equivalent experience. 
 At least one additional language spoken: Italian, Spanish, German, French, Portuguese or Arabic 
 Preferred Qualifications:

About the Role 
 We’re looking for a Creative Specialist who enjoys developing ideas for social media and transforming strategic briefs into relevant, platform-native content ready for execution. 
 Someone deeply connected to digital culture, with strong creative judgment and the ability to turn concepts into engaging content across platforms such as TikTok, Instagram, Reddit and emerging social channels. 
 What will your mission be? 
 To bring creative strategy to life through social content, developing ideas, assets and platform-specific executions while ensuring the final output remains true to the original creative vision. 
 What are we looking for? 
 Around 3-4 years of experience creating content for social media platforms. 
 Strong understanding of native formats for TikTok, Instagram, Reddit and other social platforms. 
 Ability to develop ideas from concept to storyboard and final execution. 
 Experience in copywriting and visual storytelling. 
 Strong visual judgment and understanding of platform-specific content behaviours. 
 Familiarity with tools such as CapCut, Canva, Adobe Suite or similar. 
 Ability to collaborate effectively with strategy, insights, design, production and project management teams. 
 Organized, proactive and execution-oriented mindset. 
 High level of English, as we work in an international environment. 
 Responsibilities 
 Transform Creative Strategist briefs into creative ideas ready for execution. 
 Develop storyboards, scripts, post concepts, copy and visual proposals. 
 Create, adapt and optimize content for TikTok, Instagram, Reddit and other channels. 
 Develop content proposals for editorial calendars based on defined content territories. 
 Work closely with videomakers to develop short-form video content. 
 Adapt content to the formats, codes and behaviours of each platform. 
 Ensure final assets are consistent with the creative idea, brand tone and channel requirements. 
 Technical Requirements 
 Experience creating content for brands or clients. 
 Strong understanding of social media formats, trends and platform dynamics. 
 Ability to write copy and develop visual narratives across channels. 
 Experience developing storyboards, scripts and social content concepts. 
 Familiarity with content creation and editing tools such as CapCut, Canva and Adobe Suite. 
 We will especially value 
 Experience in social media, content creation or creative agencies. 
 Strong creative sensibility and visual taste. 
 Experience creating short-form video content. 
 Interest in digital culture, emerging platforms and content trends. 
 Ability to collaborate in multidisciplinary teams and fast-paced environments.

 Location: Noth East London

 Car: Essential Car User 
 So what’s it all about:  
 At Zurich, our Engineer Surveyor workforce is central to our continued success, being the ‘Face of Zurich’ to our large and varied client base. You’ll find a fully flexible offering that means you can manage your own diary to service your own client area. This will allow you to broker and develop your relationships whilst representing Zurich Engineering. 
 No two days will ever be the same, as you’ll work in a variety of interesting environments and you will have control over your own work/life balance, as we believe our people are what makes us successful. 
 Our Engineer Surveyor roles allow you to develop your mechanical engineering skills further and work for a market-leading engineering inspection provider. 
 Zurich Engineering is looking to expand our highly skilled, field-based, Engineer Surveyor team, and we currently have a vaca ncy for the North East London area for a Lift and Crane Eng ineer Surveyor. 
 What will I be doing? 
 You’ll start with our industry-leading, bespoke training and move swiftly to carrying out hands-on statutory inspections, providing your expert opinion on a wide range of equipment, enabling our clients to comply with all relevant legislation and to the exacting standards both we and our clients demand. Following your inspection, we’ll need you to report back using a rugged laptop, and then issue electronically to our clients, so good IT skills and high levels of literacy are required. You will be an excellent communicator, and confident in your ability to make sound engineering judgements. 
 What skills/qualifications will I have? 
 You will be an experienced engineer with a sound knowledge of your engineering discipline and be part of our multi-disciplined inspection team within your geographic area. You will report to a Team Manager and be based from home, with your client base a reasonable travelling distance from your home. 
 Because this role is SAFed governed, we need you to ideally have obtained: 
 Ideally a Level 4 qualification (HND / HNC etc.) in a relevant engineering field, minimum level 3 – training will be offered to bring you up to competency and qualification level 
 Either a time served or Modern Apprenticeship 
 Hands-on experience in a relevant engineering discipline 
 A background in working with lifts and/or crane equipment would be an advantage, with hands on experience of working in a role such as manufacturing / repair / maintenance / mechanical / motor trade. 
 A full valid UK driving licence. 
 Be willing and able to work paid overtime.   
 As an inclusive employer we want to ensure that all candidates feel comfortable and are able to perform at their best during the interview. You’ll have the opportunity to let us know of any reasonable adjustment or practical support needed when you apply. 
 What will you get in return? 
 Everyone’s different. That’s why at Zurich, we offer a wide range of employee benefits so our people can choose what fits them and their life. Our benefits provide real flexibility so our people can make considered choices and tailor their benefits throughout the year. Our benefits include 12% defined non-contributory pension scheme, annual company bonus, private medical insurance and the option to buy up to an additional 20 days or sell some of your holiday. 
Follow the link for more information about our benefits - Employee benefits | Working at Zurich Insurance UK 
 As an inclusive employer we want to ensure that all candidates feel comfortable and are able to perform at their best during the interview. You’ll have the opportunity to let us know of any reasonable adjustment or practical support needed when you apply. 
 Who we are 
 At Zurich we aspire to be one of the most responsible and impactful businesses in the world. Together, we’re creating a brighter future for our customers, our people and our planet. 
 With over 65,000 employees, you’ll feel the support of being part of a strong and stable company that is a long-standing player in the insurance industry. 
 We’ve made a promise to each other and every employee: to focus on sustainable impact, to care about each other’s wellbeing, to use our diverse expertise to be curious and optimistic and to develop the skills needed for our future. 
 If you’re interested in working in a dynamic and challenging environment where your creativity, ideas and contributions are recognised and rewarded, Zurich could be just the place for you. Be part of something great. 
 Our culture 
 At Zurich, our strength comes from the diverse experiences, perspectives and talents of our people. Our goal is to create a workplace where every employee can flourish and where everyone feels valued, heard and respected. …
