items.desc: Falck is building one global people landscape, and we're looking for someone who wants to roll up their sleeves and help bring it to life. Do you get energy from moving things forward? Are you curious about how HR processes, systems and data connect, and do you enjoy getting into the details? And would you like to build a career in HR technology while making a visible difference across a global organisation? Then you might be our next Global HRIS Implementation Specialist. About the job PeopleHub is Falck's global people platform, built on Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM, and supporting the way we work with people processes across countries. As we continue the rollout, we are moving from multiple local ways of working towards a more consistent global setup, and every new country and every new capability brings us one step closer. As Global HRIS Implementation Specialist, you will play a key role in our global HRIS initiatives, especially in bringing new countries onto PeopleHub. You will be hands-on throughout the journey, from the first requirements and configuration support to testing, go-live and the smooth handover into daily operations. Several workstreams run in parallel, the pace is high and progress is visible, so you will see the direct impact of your work on employees, managers and P&C colleagues across the organisation. You will join our Global P&C Project & Initiatives team, part of Global People & Culture, where we drive the projects that shape how colleagues across Falck experience work. In your daily work, you will collaborate very closely with colleagues across Global P&C, local P&C teams around the world and Digital Technology, as well as our vendors and implementation partners, making sure that what we build follows our global standards while respecting local legal and business requirements. Together with our Project Manager, Global HRIS Operations Lead, Global Process Owners and Change Management Lead, you form the core of the team that makes PeopleHub succeed. You bring the functional and system expertise that helps colleagues understand, embrace and get real value from the changes we introduce. How you'll create impact Bringing new countries on board You help local P&C teams, Digital Technology and our vendors capture local P&C, legal and business requirements, and you map them against our global process standard. In this way, you help each new country join PeopleHub on solid ground. Making sure it works You prepare and run test scenarios, from system integration to user acceptance testing. When something does not work as expected, you log it, follow it up and keep at it until it is resolved. Taking care of our data You support data migration by validating, cleansing and reconciling data, so that colleagues can trust the information in PeopleHub from day one. Making go-live a success You contribute to go-live preparations, cutover activities and hypercare, helping each country move into PeopleHub with confidence. Helping people embrace new ways of working In close collaboration with our Change Management Lead, you create training materials, user guides and system documentation that help colleagues across the world feel confident using PeopleHub. Keeping things on track You keep a close eye on tasks, dependencies and KPIs and contribute to status reporting, so everyone knows where we stand. When a project closes, you help ensure that documentation and support models are in place for a smooth handover to Global and Regional P&C Operations. What you will gain This is a role where you will grow. You will build in-depth knowledge of Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM, with the opportunity to obtain Oracle certification, giving you a strong foundation for a long-term career in HR technology. Along the way, you will learn from experienced colleagues, take part in a global transformation, and see your work make a real difference for people across Falck. About you We welcome candidates with different backgrounds. You may be an HRIS professional with hands-on experience from working with HR systems, for example as an HRIS analyst, system administrator, super user or consultant, who now wants to be part of global implementations. Or you may come from HR, for example HR operations, HR administration, payroll or recruitment, and have discovered that the system and data side of your work is what you enjoy most. Whatever your path, you genuinely want to work with HR technology and implementations. You understand how HR works in practice and how processes affect employees, managers and HR colleagues. You have a technical nose, you are curious about how systems, data and processes connect, and you are comfortable working with data and Excel. You thrive in project mode and get energy from pace, momentum and many moving parts. You have a can-do attitude and the courage to take on new challenges. You lean in, roll up your sleeves and find a way forward. You take ownership, keep things moving and deliver on your commitments, …

items.desc: Job no: 596842 Contract type: Temporary Appointment Duty Station: Copenhagen Level: P-4 Location: Denmark Categories: Partnerships UNICEF works in over 190 countries and territories to save children’s lives, defend their rights, and help them fulfill their potential, from early childhood through adolescence. At UNICEF, we are committed, passionate, and proud of what we do for as long as we are needed. Promoting the rights of every child is not just a job – it is a calling. UNICEF is a place where careers are built: we offer our staff diverse opportunities for professional and personal development that will help them reinforce a sense of purpose while serving children and communities across the world. We welcome everyone who wants to belong and grow in a diverse and passionate culture, coupled with an attractive compensation and benefits package. Visit our website to learn more about what we do at UNICEF. For every child, the right to Deliver UNICEF Supply Division (SD) works to ensure equitable and inclusive access to essential supplies and services for children and their families across development, humanitarian and fragile contexts. SD brings together global supply chain expertise, market engagement, and partnerships with governments, civil society, the private sector, industry, and other stakeholders to support the needs of children worldwide. This provides a strong operational and partnership foundation for the Humanitarian and Transport Logistics Alliance (HTLA) and its focus on strengthening humanitarian transport and logistics through collaboration across sectors. The Humanitarian Transport and Logistics Alliance (HTLA) is a strategic UNICEF-led initiative designed to strengthen the resilience, efficiency, preparedness, and performance of humanitarian supply chains through structured collaboration between humanitarian organizations, commercial transport and logistics providers, governments, donors, academia, and other strategic stakeholders. Building on UNICEF's role as holder of the United Nations Long-Term Arrangement (LTA) for global freight forwarding and transportation services, its established relationships with global carriers, freight forwarders, and logistics service providers, HTLA provides a coordination and operational mechanism to facilitate faster, more predictable and cost-effective movement of humanitarian goods. Through partnership MoUs with carriers, humanitarian shipments can benefit from priority handling and expedited bookings, alongside preferential conditions that help reduce delays and avoid additional logistics costs. These arrangements provide a strong operational and partnership foundation on which HTLA can build. Building on this established foundation and the value already being delivered, HTLA aims to progressively strengthen and broaden the model into a multi-stakeholder alliance. The intention is to protect and expand the operational benefits already achieved while creating a structured mechanism through which humanitarian and commercial actors, and other strategic partners, can strengthen preparedness, address shared supply chain bottlenecks and develop collective solutions that improve humanitarian logistics resilience and system-wide performance. The Partnerships Coordinator will play a central role in taking this work forward, driving implementation of the HTLA roadmap, coordinating stakeholders and supporting the Alliance's continued development. How can you make a difference? The Partnerships Coordinator will lead the day-to-day implementation and coordination of HTLA, translating its agreed strategic direction and roadmap into a functioning alliance. The role will drive delivery across the HTLA workplan, coordinate internal and external stakeholders, establish fit-for-purpose governance and ways of working, monitor progress and results, and ensure that decisions, dependencies and risks are actively managed. Under the supervision of the Chief, GTLC, the position will work closely with logistics and partnership functions colleagues, and relevant other technical and partnership functions. The post holder will serve as the central coordination and focal point for HTLA and ensure coherence across partnership development, industry engagement, governance, communications, resource mobilization and results monitoring. items.desc: Position description Category Optics and Optronics Contract Fixed-term contract Job title Researcher in Optical Instrumentation for Cryogenic Super-Resolution Microscopy (cryo-PALM) H/F Socio-professional category Executive Contract duration (months) 36 Job description Would you like to develop optical instrumentation and methods for microscopy at very low temperatures? Join us as a researcher on a three-year fixed-term contract within the ANR EPIC project. You will investigate and optimise a cryo-PALM microscope and develop reliable cryogenic sample transfers between fluorescence and electron microscopy at IBS/IRIG! As a researcher, your responsibilities will include: Develop and evaluate optical improvements to the cryo-PALM microscope: excitation and emission paths, photon collection efficiency, spatial sampling, optical alignment and quantitative point spread function (PSF) characterisation. Investigate and optimise illumination and acquisition strategies for cryo-FIB lamellae: spatially targeted activation/excitation, control of sample heating and improved single-molecule localisation precision. Develop and validate procedures for transferring vitrified samples between cryo-FIB/SEM, cryo-PALM and cryo-electron microscopy, maintaining cryogenic conditions and limiting contamination and deformation of the lamellae. Establish calibration methods and assess the performance of the correlative cryo-PALM/cryo-ET workflow with cryo-EM and image processing specialists; contribute to the evaluation of fluorescent proteins within the project. Applicant Profile We primarily seek a specialist in experimental optics or photonics with a PhD in optics, photonics, experimental physics, optical instrumentation or a related field. Hands-on experience designing, aligning and optimising optical or microscopy setups is essential. Knowledge of biophysics or biological applications is an asset; you will work closely with specialists in biology and cryo-EM. Prior PALM or cryo-EM experience is welcome but is not required. Technical skills Strong expertise in experimental optics, photonics and optical instrumentation. Hands-on experience designing, aligning, optimising and quantitatively characterising optical or microscopy setups. Knowledge of fluorescence microscopy, super-resolution imaging, cryogenic instrumentation or biological applications would be an asset. Programming and quantitative experimental data analysis skills would be an asset. Interpersonal skills Independence, scientific rigour and good organisational skills. Initiative, scientific curiosity and the ability to propose solutions to experimental challenges. Ability to work as part of a team and collaborate in a multidisciplinary environment. Good communication skills and the ability to share scientific results. Language skills Good command of spoken and written scientific English to work in an international environment. Knowledge of French is welcome but is not essential. Why join us? …. Vos missions Après une période d’immersion auprès de nos équipes commerciales, achats, logistique et qualité, vous serez amené à : Prendre en main, maintenir et faire évoluer nos outils internes existants. Développer et piloter les interconnexions entre nos différentes applications (API, ERP, plateformes partenaires). Accompagner les équipes dans l’adoption des nouveaux outils. Proposer et piloter, à terme, les évolutions de notre système d’information en fonction des besoins de l’entreprise. Maîtrise d’au moins un langage de développement côté serveur (Python, TypeScript/Node.js ou C#) et de SQL. Capacité à comprendre une architecture existante, à la maintenir et à la faire évoluer. Anglais technique écrit permettant de travailler avec de la documentation et des prestataires internationaux. Au-delà des compétences techniques, nous attachons une importance particulière à votre rigueur, votre capacité d’analyse et votre aptitude à échanger simplement avec des interlocuteurs non techniques. Aucune connaissance du secteur aéronautique n’est nécessaire : nous vous accompagnerons dans la découverte de notre métier. Ce que nous offrons Un poste nouvellement créé, avec de réelles responsabilités et des perspectives d’évolution. La possibilité de construire et de faire évoluer durablement les outils numériques d’une entreprise en croissance. Des projets concrets, dont vous pourrez mesurer directement les résultats sur l’activité quotidienne. Une grande autonomie dans votre travail, avec un accès direct aux utilisateurs et à la direction. Un environnement international, dans un secteur technique et exigeant. Une entreprise à taille humaine, où vos initiatives et vos réalisations auront un impact visible. Responsabilités Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes produit et commerciales afin de leur permettre de développer de nouvelles opportunités et d’étendre l’utilisation chez les clients de toutes les offres technologiques et d’IA de Circana Détenir et entretenir une expertise approfondie et à jour sur les dernières offres technologiques et d’IA de Circana, afin d’agir en tant qu’expert référent (SME) dans les pays couverts Concevoir des supports de démo efficaces, les présenter directement aux clients ou supporter les équipes en contact avec les clients pour qu’ils puissent les présenter en autonomie Être l’ambassadeur des produits, en favorisant leur adoption et en suscitant l’enthousiasme entre les départements et les marchés afin de soutenir une forte pénétration client et le succès commercial des produits Adapter la communication et les supports produit globaux et régionaux à la dynamique et aux organisations des marchés locaux, en particulier lors des lancements et des nouvelles releases Recueillir activement les retours des parties prenantes internes et clients, et les partager en interne et à tous les niveaux de l’équipe Product Management Apporter un soutien aux équipes formation et expérience client interne, notamment par du coaching, la fourniture de supports et un appui régulier aux équipes au contact des utilisateurs finaux Assurer un support technique – de manière ad hoc et prioritaire, assurer la résolution et l’escalade des problèmes clients Participer et faciliter les tests d’acceptation utilisateur (UAT) locaux des nouvelles versions Profil recherché Expérience du travail au sein d’équipes pluridisciplinaires dans un contexte multi-pays. Le français et l’anglais sont requis à un niveau de maîtrise professionnel. Les comportements Circana Au-delà des compétences techniques, de l’expérience et des qualités propres au poste, ces comportements partagés sont fondamentaux pour notre culture et notre réussite. Rechercher la clarté : accueillir la complexité pour créer de la clarté et inspirer l’action. Assumer les résultats : être responsable de nos décisions et assumer nos choix. Placer le client au centre : apporter sans relâche de la valeur à nos clients. Être un challenger : ne jamais se satisfaire de l’existant, toujours viser l’amélioration continue. Défendre l’inclusion : favoriser la confiance dans les relations, avec empathie, respect et intégrité. S’engager les uns envers les autres : contribuer à faire de Circana un excellent lieu de travail pour tous. Localisation : Ce poste est basé à Paris, La Défense (télétravail partiel) #LI-AG1

items.desc: Qui nous sommes Depuis plus de 170 ans, Lagardère Travel Retail offre une expérience unique au service de nos voyageurs et de nos partenaires. Nous concevons et opérons des offres de commerce et de restauration dans les lieux de mobilité, afin d’enrichir l’expérience des voyageurs, autour de trois activités : Travel Essentials, Duty Free & Fashion et Foodservice. Présents dans plus de 50 pays avec 5 000 points de vente, nous réalisons 8 milliards d’euros de chiffre d’affaires et nous appuyons sur l’engagement de 29 000 collaborateurs dans le monde. Filiale du Louis Hachette Group (via le groupe Lagardère), coté sur Euronext Growth, nous combinons puissance d’un groupe international et expertises locales, au plus près des territoires et des voyageurs. Rejoindre Lagardère Travel Retail, c’est intégrer un groupe international en pleine transformation, alliant croissance, développement et ambition durable avec le programme PEPS. items.desc: Technische Assistentin / Technischer Assistent (w/m/d) Das Julius Kühn-Institut (JKI) ist das Bundesforschungsinstitut für Kulturpflanzen im Geschäftsbereich des Bundesministeriums für Landwirtschaft, Ernährung und Heimat (BMLEH). Die Befristung erfolgt gemäß § 14 Absatz 1 Teilzeit- und Befristungsgesetz (TzBfG) zur Durchführung eines zeitlich begrenzten Projekts. Weitere Vorteile: Bei einer Einstellung kann das Deutschlandticket als Jobticket mit Arbeitgeberzuschuss von 23,28 € bezogen werden. items.desc: DEINE AUFGABEN Wir sind keine reine Strategieberatung: Wir gehen von der Strategie bis zur Umsetzung, vor allem bei Banken, Versicherungen und anderen stark regulierten Unternehmen. Als Forward Deployed Engineer bist Du mittendrin: Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Kund:innen zusammen, oft direkt in ihren IT- und Security-Teams, und verstehst ihre Prozesse, Systeme und Probleme. Zusätzlich im Senior Level: Du verantwortest das technische Vorgehen und bist erste Ansprechperson für die Fachseite. Du baust Prototypen und Anwendungen rund um Cybersecurity und KI, von der ersten Demo bis zur Lösung im Betrieb. Zusätzlich im Senior Level: Du entwirfst Architekturen und triffst die technischen Grundsatzentscheidungen. Du bewertest Security-Produkte und Startups und hilfst Kund:innen, begründet zu entscheiden. Wo es gute Lösungen schon gibt, bindest Du sie ein, statt sie nachzubauen. Du arbeitest mit KI-Agenten und Coding-Tools, prüfst ihre Ergebnisse kritisch und verstehst, was sie bauen. Du führst Workshops und Trainings durch, zum Beispiel zur sicheren Nutzung von KI. Du merkst, wo bei Kund:innen das nächste Problem steckt, und baust die Demo, die zeigt, dass wir es lösen können. Zusätzlich im Senior Level: Du machst daraus Angebote und Folgeaufträge und entwickelst unser Leistungsportfolio im Cyber-Bereich weiter. Du bringst Ideen in interne Themen ein und machst gute Lösungen für das ganze Team wiederverwendbar. Security-Tiefe lernst Du bei uns im Projekt und von unserem Cyber-Team. Eine Pentest-Laufbahn, SOC-Erfahrung oder ein Security-Studium brauchst Du dafür nicht. DEIN PROFIL Unsere Kund:innen haben Sicherheitsfragen, die sich nicht mit Folien lösen lassen. Du gehst direkt zu ihnen, verstehst das Problem und baust eine Lösung, die funktioniert. Wir ersetzen keine Security-Hersteller. Wir prüfen, was sie taugen, und bauen, was fehlt. KI macht Dich dabei schneller. Ob das Ergebnis stimmt, entscheidest Du. Dafür bringst Du mit: Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik, einer Ingenieur- oder Naturwissenschaft oder einem anderen Fach, das dich technisch geprägt hat, oder vergleichbare Praxis. Du hast schon Software gebaut, die andere nutzen, auch ohne KI: im Job, als Werkstudent:in, in eigenen Projekten oder in einem Startup. Der Einstieg direkt nach dem Studium ist möglich. Für das Senior Level bringst du mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung mit. Du denkst Dich schnell in komplexe Themen ein, verstehst, was eine KI dir ausgibt, und widersprichst, wenn eine Anforderung oder ein Ergebnis nicht stimmt. Du gehst gerne auf Kund:innen zu und erklärst Komplexes einfach. Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mind. C1 in beiden Sprachen) und bist für Termine bei Kund:innen reisebereit. Ein Plus, aber kein Muss: Erfahrung mit Cloud, Containern oder Identity-Systemen wie Entra ID Erfahrung mit KI-Agenten, MCP oder anderen LLM-Anwendungen Berührungspunkte mit Security, etwa Security Operations, IAM oder Zero Trust Erfahrung in der Beratung oder in einer regulierten Branche Du erfüllst nicht jeden Punkt? Bewirb Dich gerne trotzdem. DEINE BENEFITS Unterstützende Teamkultur : Teamzusammenhalt ist uns wichtig - wir unterstützen uns gegenseitig und pflegen eine gesunde Officekultur. Unser Eventteam plant regelmäßige Afterworks und sorgt für einen Austausch außerhalb des Arbeitsplatzes. Schnelle Verantwortungsübernahme: Du übernimmst ab Tag 1 spannende Aufgaben mit eigener Verantwortung - egal ob auf deinem Projekt oder bei der Einbringung in interne Aufgabe - du gestaltest mit! Klare Karrieremöglichkeiten: Bei uns findest du ein Umfeld, das dich fördert, fordert und weiterbringt. Wir haben klar definierte Karrieremöglichkeiten und ein transparentes Anforderungsmanagement and jedes Level. Kreativer Arbeitsplatz: Wir geben dir die Freiheit und Zeit, kreative Lösungen zu entwickeln und bieten dir dafür die beste und modernste Hardware an (Apple oder Windows). Mitarbeiterbenefits: Flexible Arbeitsmodelle, BahnCard, JobRad, Spendit-Card, Wellpass und betriebliche Altersvorsorge sorgen für dein Wohlbefinden. items.desc: Infrastructure / SRE Engineer Inviso is partnering with one of our clients to find an experienced Backend / Platform Engineer to join their team working remotely. Inviso is managing the recruitment and placement process for this opportunity. This is a remote, direct-hire permanent employee position for our client that is a global multi-billion dollar software conglomerate. The Infrastructure / SRE Engineer is responsible for designing, building, and operating the cloud, infrastructure, deployment, observability, and reliability capabilities that allow platform teams to ship safely and consistently. This role focuses on landing zones, infrastructure-as-code, Kubernetes, CI/CD, observability, incident response, cost optimization, and production readiness. The Engineer treats infrastructure and reliability as products, building repeatable systems that reduce toil, improve delivery speed, and support mission-critical customer environments. The ideal candidate is hands-on, automation-minded, calm under pressure, and comfortable owning systems in production. Experience & Skills Required Experience building and operating production cloud infrastructure with reliability ownership. Strong experience with infrastructure-as-code, landing zones, networking, identity, security, and environment management. Experience with Kubernetes, containerized workloads, CI/CD pipelines, and automated deployment practices. Experience establishing observability using metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, alerting, and actionable operational signals. Experience defining or supporting SLOs, reliability practices, incident response, postmortems, and on-call operations. Ability to automate operational tasks and reduce manual toil through scripts, tools, runbooks, and platform services. Experience preparing software for customer-controlled, hybrid, BYOC, on-premises, or edge environments preferred. Strong understanding of cost and capacity optimization, including expensive compute such as GPU workloads. Strong communication and collaboration skills for client-facing consulting environments. Pragmatic mindset with the ability to balance speed, safety, automation, cost, and operational quality. Desired Qualifications Experience with Azure, Kubernetes, Terraform, Bicep, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or related infrastructure and delivery tools. Experience with Azure Arc, fleet management, pull-based deployment patterns, or version/configuration drift management. Experience supporting regulated, air-gapped, edge, or mission-critical delivery environments. Experience supporting AI/ML platforms, model-serving infrastructure, GPU workloads, or AI development lifecycle operations. Experience building enterprise-scale infrastructure supporting multiple teams, products, or customers. Experience using AI-assisted development tools while maintaining strong review, testing, and operational discipline. Success Criteria Success in this role is measured by reliable platform operations, repeatable delivery, strong observability, reduced operational toil, and the ability to help client teams ship safely into complex customer environments. Infrastructure / SRE Engineers are expected to improve speed and stability at the same time.

Process Optimization: Develop, document and streamline IT workflows and operational processes. Security & Compliance: Support cybersecurity initiatives, endpoint protection, access management and IT compliance. items.desc: Junior Geophysicist, Kilcullen We seek to move the world forward through innovative thinking. Woolpert is an award‑winning, global leader in architecture, engineering, and geospatial services. The role will be responsible for the post processing and interpretation of ground penetrating radar and geophysical data collected in the field and is a great opportunity for someone looking to broaden their experience within the utilities sector to work within the expeditious Geospatial industry. Problem solving solutions to ensure deadlines are maintained. Ensure client work is delivered to the highest quality standards and any deviations are rectified with haste and learnings incorporated through after-action reviews. Ensure accuracy of all information that is reported on the Project Management system. Comply with company health and safety policies and data protection requirements at all times. Support innovation of workflows and technology. Any other duties as required by the business. What You Will Bring Be fully familiar with field survey design and data acquisition using Ground Penetrating Radar. items.desc: At Elanco (NYSE: ELAN) – it all starts with animals! As a global leader in animal health, we are dedicated to innovation and delivering products and services to prevent and treat disease in farm animals and pets. At Elanco, we are driven by our vision of Food and Companionship Enriching Life and our purpose – all to Go Beyond for Animals, Customers, Society and Our People. At Elanco, we pride ourselves on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment. We believe that diversity is the driving force behind innovation, creativity, and overall business success. Here, you’ll be part of a company that values and champions new ways of thinking, work with dynamic individuals, and acquire new skills and experiences that will propel your career to new heights. Making animals’ lives better makes life better – join our team today! Your Role: Qualified Person As Qualified Person, you will oversee the technical review and certification of veterinary medicinal product batches released for the European market. Based in Elanco’s Dublin office, you will also manage the quality system for the Elanco Ireland Marketing Authorisation Holder and Importer entity, ensuring compliance with applicable pharmaceutical regulations, European Union Good Manufacturing Practice and Good Distribution Practice requirements. Your Responsibilities: Conduct technical reviews and certify European finished-product batches in accordance with Regulation 2019/6, Regulation (EU) 2025/2091 and applicable EU Good Manufacturing Practice requirements, including Articles 39 and 40. Manage quality documentation and act as the primary contact for the European Manufacturing and Quality organisation regarding European batch releases, service-quality indicators, deadlines and follow-up actions. Assess critical deviations with relevant stakeholders and support recall decisions, including participation in management notification processes and product-related governance meetings. Maintain and improve the Elanco Ireland quality system by preparing and approving procedures, work instructions, site master file content, Qualified Person declarations and other product-supporting quality documents. Manage change controls, deviations and self-inspections for the Elanco Ireland entity, support audits and inspections, communicate potential market issues to authorities, and share knowledge of European Union pharmaceutical quality expectations across the organisation. What You Need to Succeed (minimum qualifications): Qualified Person status for veterinary medicinal products in accordance with Regulation 2019/6 and applicable veterinary Good Manufacturing Practice requirements. A minimum Master’s degree in a relevant scientific discipline. At least two years of experience in a Quality department within a pharmaceutical site, or equivalent. Demonstrated knowledge of pharmaceutical regulations, Good Manufacturing Practice and Good Distribution Practice. Working knowledge of Microsoft Office, Veeva and SAP. What will give you a competitive edge (preferred qualifications): Experience with veterinary medicinal products and European batch release activities. Practical experience managing quality systems, including change controls, deviations and self-inspections. Experience supporting regulatory authority inspections, audits or market issue notifications. Experience preparing quality documentation such as procedures, work instructions, site master file content or Qualified Person declarations. Experience working with cross-functional European quality organisations and communicating quality information in English. Additional Information: Location: Dublin, Ireland. Work model: 100% onsite from the Dublin office. Don't meet every single requirement? If you think you might be a good fit for a role but don't necessarily meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. È un ruolo fortemente operativo, che combina conoscenza del processo lattiero-caseario, attività sul campo e problem solving tecnico. La persona seguirà le macchine dalla fase di avviamento presso il cliente fino alla messa a punto dei parametri di processo, assicurandosi che la linea raggiunga le performance e le caratteristiche di prodotto attese. Interverrà inoltre su impianti già in esercizio, collaborando con il Service e l’After Sales per analizzare eventuali problematiche di processo e individuare le regolazioni o le soluzioni più appropriate. Le tue principali responsabilità Seguire l’avviamento di nuove linee produttive e singole macchine presso gli stabilimenti dei clienti, prevalentemente all’estero. Impostare e ottimizzare i parametri tecnologici di processo in funzione della materia prima, del prodotto e delle performance richieste. Supportare il cliente nella produzione di mozzarella, pizza cheese e altri formaggi a pasta filata, intervenendo su aspetti quali umidità, pH, temperature, tempi di lavorazione, resa, consistenza e caratteristiche funzionali del prodotto. Analizzare e risolvere problematiche di processo, individuandone le cause e definendo le azioni correttive più appropriate. Formare il personale del cliente sull’utilizzo delle macchine e sui principali parametri di processo. Raccogliere e analizzare dati tecnologici e di processo direttamente sul campo, utilizzando Excel per interpretarli e supportare le decisioni tecniche. Collaborare con il team Service e After Sales negli interventi tecnologici su macchine e linee già installate. Collaborare con Project Management, Engineering e R&D per il miglioramento delle performance degli impianti e delle soluzioni esistenti. Supportare, quando necessario, il team Sales nelle fasi iniziali dei progetti, contribuendo alla definizione delle soluzioni tecniche e dei KPI di performance. Contribuire, sulla base dell’esperienza maturata sul campo, al miglioramento e allo sviluppo futuro delle nostre tecnologie. Il tuo profilo e le tue qualifiche: Cerchiamo una persona con una buona conoscenza pratica dei processi lattiero-caseari e un forte interesse per la tecnologia applicata alla produzione industriale. Il profilo ideale possiede: esperienza nel settore lattiero-caseario, maturata in caseifici, stabilimenti produttivi, reparti tecnologici o aziende produttrici di macchine e impianti per il settore alimentare; conoscenza dei principali processi di produzione del formaggio; preferibilmente, esperienza specifica nella produzione di mozzarella, pizza cheese o altri formaggi a pasta filata; capacità di comprendere l'impatto di parametri quali pH, temperatura, umidità, composizione della materia prima e condizioni di filatura sulla qualità del prodotto finale; capacità di analizzare dati di processo e buona padronanza di Excel; buona conoscenza dell'inglese, necessaria per lavorare quotidianamente con clienti internazionali; disponibilità a frequenti trasferte internazionali, per circa il 60-70% del tempo, minimo 80 giorni all'anno anche per periodi di 2–3 settimane consecutive; autonomia, capacità di adattamento e attitudine al problem solving in contesti produttivi. Una laurea in Scienze e Tecnologie Alimentari, Ingegneria Alimentare o di Processo, Scienze e Tecnologie Lattiero-Casearie, Biotecnologie Alimentari o discipline affini rappresenta un plus, ma non è un requisito indispensabile: siamo interessati anche a candidati che abbiano sviluppato queste competenze direttamente sul campo. Potresti essere la persona giusta anche se oggi lavori in un caseificio o in uno stabilimento lattiero-caseario e hai acquisito un'esperienza pratica completa del processo produttivo, ma non hai ancora lavorato per un costruttore di macchine. Cosa offriamo Un ruolo tecnico con una forte componente internazionale e la possibilità di lavorare direttamente presso clienti in diversi Paesi. L'opportunità di sviluppare competenze sia nella tecnologia casearia sia nell'applicazione industriale su macchine e linee produttive. Un contesto in cui collaborare con Engineering, R&D, Project Management, Sales, Service e After Sales. Un percorso adatto sia a professionisti già esperti sia a profili con solida esperienza pratica e potenziale di crescita. You will be responsible for Support the design and execution of in vivo studies to evaluate novel compounds and clinical candidates within respiratory research programs. Contribute to the development and characterization of animal models of pulmonary diseases to address project needs. Conduct ex vivo analyses, including gene expression, biomarker evaluation, and molecular and biochemical assays. Analyze and interpret experimental data, ensuring accurate organization and reporting of results. Perform literature reviews and communicate findings through presentations at relevant internal meetings. Proven experience in the design and execution of in vivo studies to evaluate novel therapeutic candidates. Experience with respiratory disease models is a plus. Strong hands-on expertise in rodent handling, compound administration, blood/tissue collection, and tissue harvesting. Certification for animal experimentation is required. Experience with molecular and biochemical techniques, including RNA isolation, qRT-PCR, ELISA/MSD, Western blotting, and protein analysis from ex vivo tissues. Experience in data analysis and interpretation, including the use of GraphPad Prism and Microsoft Office tools. Experience in the analysis and interpretation of multi-omics data to support translational research is considered a plus. Ability to independently plan and execute experimental activities while maintaining high-quality laboratory standards. Good scientific communication skills, including literature review, data presentation, and written and spoken English. Collaborative, proactive, and solution-oriented mindset, with good planning and organizational skills. Location The position …

items.desc: Siamo alla ricerca di una persona per il ruolo di IT Operations & Support per la nostra sede di Milano . Cerchiamo una persona che contribuisca alla gestione e all’evoluzione dei sistemi aziendali, rendendo più semplice il lavoro quotidiano dei team di advertising, analytics, consulenza, creatività e sviluppo. Nel team IT ti occuperai di dispositivi, identità digitali, servizi di collaborazione e infrastruttura. Affiancherai all’amministrazione quotidiana alcune attività di base su sistemi Windows, Mac, Linux, cloud, collaborando con i team tecnici e con il responsabile IT per gli interventi più complessi. RUOLO Come IT Operations & Support ti occuperai di: Supporto alle persone e alle sedi . Gestire richieste e incidenti tramite ticket, individuare le cause dei problemi e seguirne la risoluzione; mantenere operative postazioni, periferiche e sale riunioni, anche per chi lavora da remoto. Dispositivi e asset IT. Configurare e mantenere computer Windows e macOS, distribuire software e aggiornamenti tramite strumenti MDM, applicare configurazioni sicure e curare inventario, licenze e ciclo di vita delle dotazioni, coordinandoti con i fornitori. Identità, accessi e collaborazione . Amministrare Google Workspace e i servizi SaaS: account, gruppi, permessi, autenticazione a più fattori e condivisioni. Gestire gli aspetti IT di ingressi, cambi di ruolo e uscite, in coordinamento con HR e referenti dei servizi. Reti e continuità operativa . Diagnosticare problemi di connettività, Wi-Fi, VPN, DNS e DHCP; collaborare alla manutenzione degli apparati di rete, al monitoraggio dei servizi e alla verifica di backup e ripristini. Sicurezza operativa . Gestire aggiornamenti e protezione degli endpoint, verificare log e segnalazioni e collaborare alla risposta agli incidenti. Applicare le procedure di sicurezza e i principi di minimo privilegio e condivisione controllata, tutelando informazioni aziendali e dei clienti. Automazione e integrazioni . Realizzare piccoli script e utilizzare API per semplificare attività ripetitive, controlli e gestione degli account; mantenere le modifiche documentate, verificabili e ripristinabili. Documentazione e miglioramento . Aggiornare procedure e knowledge base, aiutare le persone a usare correttamente gli strumenti e proporre miglioramenti che riducano problemi ricorrenti, tempi di attesa e attività manuali. Requirements Sei la persona che stiamo cercando se hai: Esperienza pratica nell’amministrazione di sistemi o nel supporto IT aziendale, con capacità di gestire richieste e priorità in autonomia e coinvolgere gli specialisti quando necessario. Buona conoscenza di Windows e macOS, dell’hardware e della diagnosi dei problemi; familiarità con la gestione centralizzata dei dispositivi e la protezione degli endpoint. Familiarità con l’amministrazione di Google Workspace o di una suite cloud equivalente e con la gestione di utenti, gruppi, autorizzazioni e autenticazione sicura. Conoscenze operative di networking: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Wi-Fi, VPN e ruolo di switch, router e firewall. Capacità di comunicare con interlocutori anche non tecnici, documentare il lavoro e leggere documentazione tecnica in inglese. Capacità di leggere e modificare semplici script in almeno un linguaggio tra Bash, PowerShell e Python, con attenzione alla gestione sicura di credenziali e dati. Nice to Have: Valorizziamo queste competenze e l’interesse a svilupparle nel tempo: Processi di configurazione automatizzata dei dispositivi. Conoscenze di Google Cloud o AWS, in particolare di identità e permessi, macchine virtuali, storage e monitoraggio. Familiarità con Docker, Git, API REST e semplici flussi di integrazione e deployment. Conoscenza di SSO, strumenti di monitoraggio e logging, backup e ripristino, oppure esperienza nel supporto a team di sviluppo. Caratteristiche personali Cerchiamo precisione e curiosità tecnica. Per noi contano la capacità di ascoltare, collaborare, assumersi la responsabilità delle attività e trovare soluzioni concrete. Saper bilanciare rapidità e sicurezza, dando priorità ai problemi che incidono sul lavoro delle persone e sulla continuità dei servizi, sono aspetti fondamentali per questo ruolo. Initially concentrating on developing Linux-based embedded software for connected vehicles, our journey has evolved launching a cloud division fulfilling the increasing market demand of big data analytics. items.desc: Vacature: User-Centered Design Pionier Maak impact op de werkvloer met design en technologie Bij RoboHouse zoeken we een User‑Centered Design Pionier – iemand die user‑centered design research tot leven brengt en met vernieuwende oplossingen de werkvloer van de toekomst mede vormgeeft. Wij geloven dat technologie het werk van mensen in uiteenlopende werkomgevingen kan versterken. Daarom ontwikkelen we robotica die fysiek werk ondersteunt, ontworpen mét de mensen die dat werk dagelijks doen. Dat realiseren we samen met bedrijven, onderzoekers en startups, vanuit ons fieldlab op de campus van de TU Delft. Als User‑Centered Design Pionier ben je onderdeel van het RoboHouse Innovatieteam. Dit team bestaat uit design- en robotica-engineers die met een learning by doing-aanpak oplossingen ontwikkelen voor concrete situaties op de werkvloer. Je onderzoekt, ontwerpt en co-creëert samen met bedrijven en hun medewerkers. Altijd met maatschappelijke impact als drijfveer. Daarmee maken we samen onze missie waar: 'Robotics voor a better society'. Voel je je aangesproken door deze vacature, maar vink je niet elk hokje af? Gewoon reageren. We leren je graag kennen. Wat je gaat doen Je stapt in ons worker-centric innovatieproces waarin co-creatie, joint decision-making en learning-by-doing centraal staan. In de projecten waar je aan zult werken, maken we robotica tastbaar voor het MKB en grote bedrijven. Samen met het team onderzoek je werkprocessen, voer je user research uit en ontwerp je oplossingen die écht werken. · Je werkt nauw samen met mensen op de werkvloer: van zorgmedewerker tot installateur. · Je begeleidt co-creatie sessies en vertaalt inzichten uit het veld naar ontwerpconcepten. · Je werkt iteratief: kennismaken, observeren, ontwerpen, co-creëren, aanpassen. · Je schakelt met bedrijven, van innovatieve MKB’s tot grote corporates. · Je werkt actief samen met het RoboHouse Innovatieteam én bent met enige regelmaat op locatie bij bedrijven. · Je draagt bij aan maatschappelijke impact: robotics for a better society. Wat we van jou vragen Je hebt ervaring met design thinking of vergelijkbare innovatieprocessen. Je weet hoe je user research opzet en uitvoert. Je bent bekend met werken volgens agile-methodieken, zoals kanban of scrum Je bent minimaal medior in ervaring en kunt zelfstandig een project trekken. Je vindt het leuk en toont betrokkenheid om samen te werken met mensen uit de praktijk in uiteenlopende omgevingen zoals op de werkvloer, in een loods of een fabriek. Je bent proactief, nieuwsgierig en niet bang om te pionieren. Je beheerst zowel de Nederlandse als de Engelse taal goed , in woord en geschrift. Ervaring met robotica is mooi meegenomen, maar zeker geen must. Wat je van ons krijgt Een plek in een praktisch, creatief team dat houdt van aanpakken. Werken aan maatschappelijke innovatie met tastbare impact. Veel vrijheid om je werk en aanpak zelf vorm te geven. Hybride werken is deels mogelijk – maar je bent regelmatig op locatie en werkt nauw samen met het innovatieteam op RoboHouse. Een fijne werkcultuur waarin experimenteren, leren en lachen centraal staan. De praktische zaken Locatie : RoboHouse, TU Delft Campus, met regelmatig werk op locatie bij bedrijven. Fulltime (32-40 uur per week, 0.8–1.0 fte). Hybride werken : De mogelijkheid bestaat om deels thuis te werken, maar je bent regelmatig bij bedrijven en werkt samen met het innovatieteam. Dienstverband : bepaalde tijd (1 jaar), met uitzicht op verlenging. Salaris : afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring met een minimum van € 3.706,- en een maximum van € 5.760,- bruto per maand bij een fulltime aanstelling van 40 uur per week. 41 vakantiedagen (328 uur) bij een fulltime aanstelling (40 uur), bovenop nationale feestdagen. Vakantiegeld in mei én een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,3% in december. Een goede pensioenregeling via ABP. Telefoon en laptop van de zaak. Reiskostenvergoeding. Klinkt dit als jouw volgende stap? Neem gerust contact op met Yvette Entius, Directeur RoboHouse, via 0634115213 of y.h.m.entius@tudelft.nl. items.desc: Application packaging engineer Maak impact op de digitale werkplek van TU Delft! Bouw mee aan slimme Self-Service Software Delivery en maak software eenvoudig toegankelijk voor onderwijs en onderzoek. Functieomschrijving Hoe zorg je ervoor dat duizenden medewerkers en studenten op het juiste moment over de juiste software beschikken? En hoe maak je dat proces betrouwbaar, veilig en zoveel mogelijk geautomatiseerd? Als Software Delivery & Automation Engineer werk je aan het beschikbaar stellen, distribueren en up-to-date houden van software binnen TU Delft. Van software packaging en deployment tot scripting, automatisering en het toepassen van nieuwe technologieën.Je maakt deel uit van Software Delivery (SWD), een compact technisch team binnen de directie ICT. Samen verzorgen we softwaredistributie voor een veelzijdige omgeving, van standaardsoftware tot specialistische applicaties voor onderwijs en onderzoek. Je werkzaamheden zijn afwisselend. De ene dag onderzoek je waarom software niet goed installeert op een onderwijswerkplek. De volgende dag automatiseer je een proces met PowerShell of verbeter je de softwaredistributie via Microsoft Intune of Ivanti Neurons. Je neemt vraagstukken rondom softwaredistributie van analyse tot validatie op je. Je onderzoekt wat nodig is, ontwikkelt of configureert een passende oplossing, test het resultaat en legt je bevindingen vast. Daarbij kijk je verder dan het directe probleem en zoek je naar mogelijkheden om onze softwaredistributie betrouwbaarder, eenvoudiger en slimmer te maken. Je houdt je bezig met het voorbereiden, testen en distribueren van applicaties, het analyseren van installatieproblemen en het automatiseren van werkzaamheden met onder andere PowerShell en API's. Ook werk je aan software-updates, standaardisatie en het verbeteren van onze technische processen. Naast deze ontwikkelingen draag je bij aan de dagelijkse dienstverlening, zoals softwareaanvragen, wijzigingen en incidenten. Onze dienstverlening is volop in ontwikkeling. We onderzoeken hoe nieuwe technologieën, waaronder AI, ons kunnen helpen bij technische analyse, troubleshooting, scripting en automatisering. Daarbij blijft kritisch denken belangrijk: je controleert aannames en test of oplossingen daadwerkelijk werken. Je werkt nauw samen met collega's, beheerders en leveranciers. Binnen het team krijg je ruimte om initiatief te nemen, nieuwe mogelijkheden te onderzoeken en verbeteringen daadwerkelijk door te voeren. We zoeken niet uitsluitend iemand die alle technologieën al beheerst. Ook als je aan het begin van je loopbaan staat of vanuit een andere technische functie wilt doorgroeien, bieden we ruimte om je verder te ontwikkelen. Functie-eisen Je hebt hbo-werk- en denkniveau en een technische basis in Windows-beheer, applicatiebeheer, softwaredistributie of automatisering. Je hebt basiskennis van Windows, software-installaties en technische probleemoplossing. Je bent technisch nieuwsgierig, denkt analytisch en onderzoekt graag hoe systemen en applicaties werken. Je werkt zorgvuldig en gestructureerd, controleert aannames en vindt het belangrijk om oplossingen goed te testen en te documenteren. Je hebt affiniteit met scripting, bij voorkeur PowerShell, en het automatiseren van werkzaamheden. Je kunt zelfstandig werken, communiceert duidelijk, zoekt de samenwerking op en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor het resultaat. Ervaring met Microsoft Intune of vergelijkbare distributieplatformen, software packaging (MSI/MSIX, Win32), PowerShell en troubleshooting is welkom. Kennis van Ivanti Neurons, Microsoft Graph API, REST API's, Git, CI/CD, Microsoft Entra ID, software-lifecyclemanagement, AI-toepassingen of affiniteit met Linux en/of macOS is een pré. Ervaring is welkom, maar ontwikkelpotentieel telt ook. We vinden het vooral belangrijk dat je technisch inzicht hebt, zorgvuldig werkt, graag leert en nieuwe technologie snel eigen maakt. TU Delft Werken bij TU Delft betekent bijdragen aan oplossingen die er echt toe doen. Al meer dan 180 jaar leiden we ingenieurs op die wereldwijd impact maken bij bedrijven, overheden of als ondernemer. Onze alumni zetten kennis om in concrete oplossingen voor de uitdagingen van vandaag en morgen. Die uitdagingen veranderen snel. Daarom werken we elke dag aan thema’s zoals energie, klimaat, digitalisering, AI en slimme mobiliteit. Ons onderwijs en onderzoek sluiten direct aan op wat de samenleving nodig heeft, nu en straks. Bij TU Delft maken mensen het verschil. Met hun kennis en nieuwsgierigheid zorgen zij voor sterk onderwijs, vernieuwend onderzoek en innovaties die verder komen dan de campus. Je krijgt de ruimte om initiatief te nemen, samen te werken en jezelf te ontwikkelen. Wie bij TU Delft werkt, sluit zich aan bij een internationale community van professionals en studenten. Samen bouwen we aan kennis, innovatie en oplossingen die de wereld vooruithelpen. Universiteitsdienst – Directie ICT Bij de directie ICT werken we met circa 200 collega’s verdeeld over een …

items.desc: Techniek begrijpelijk maken én verbeteringen realiseren? In deze rol vertaal je wensen uit de business naar slimme IT-oplossingen die echt het verschil maken. Aalsmeer Product Owner IT Aalsmeer Jouw uitdaging Als IT Product Owner / Portfoliomanager ben je verantwoordelijk voor het optimaliseren van het digitale landschap van de afdeling Real Estate & Facility Management (RE&FM). Je bent sparringpartner om de businesswaarde en systeemcontinuïteit te maximaliseren. Samen met de Business Owners vertaal je de visie en doelen van RE&FM naar haalbare digitale oplossingen. Royal FloraHolland werkt veel met SaaS-oplossingen voor bijvoorbeeld een ticket-management systeem en een oplossing voor fysieke toegangsbeveiliging. Een interessant aspect in het digitale landschap van RE&FM is de combinatie tussen Informatie technologie en Operationele technologie. De integratie van deze twee werelden maakt deel uit van je functie. Jouw Functie Samen met de business bepaal je prioriteiten en beheer je het IT portfolio en de roadmap. Je hebt het overzicht over het totale applicatie landschap en bepaalt de richting waarin dit landschap zich ontwikkelt. Verder: Zorg je voor implementeerbare oplossingen die passen binnen het ICT-landschap en stemt deze af met de verschillende stakeholders. Breng je structuur in projecten met focus op security, compliance, standaardisatie en rationalisatie, ondersteund door Enterprise Architecture. Coördineert je leveranciers en outsourcingpartners zoals Conclusion en Heijmans. Je bewaakt het overzicht van het applicatielandschap en stuurt de ontwikkeling daarvan. Wat jij meebrengt WO werk en denkniveau; Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in een soortgelijke functie in een complexe regie organisatie (IT Project Manager, Business/Informatie analyst en/of -Consultant); Het spreken en schrijven van de Nederlandse taal is een vereiste voor de functie; Je weet regie te nemen en structuur aan te brengen bij de verschillende projecten; Je hebt ervaring met het onderhouden van contacten met leveranciers. Ons Aanbod Een salaris volgens de cao (o.b.v. 38 uur per week) van €5.652,- tot €8.061,- en 8,33% vakantiegeld . Een thuiswerkvergoeding én een budget van €750 voor het inrichten van je thuiswerkplek. Een werkweek van 32, 36 of 38 uur afhankelijk van jouw wens. Hybride werken vanuit onze locaties in Aalsmeer en Naaldwijk, gecombineerd met thuiswerken. 27 vakantiedagen bij een fulltime dienstverband met de mogelijkheid om 10 extra dagen bij te kopen. 5x per jaar een plant cadeau Ontwikkel- en doorgroeimogelijkheden via onze Academy. Toegang tot een uitgebreid online leerplatform voor jouw ontwikkeling. Extra voordelen zoals personeelskorting, een fietsplan en een actieve personeelsvereniging . Meer informatie? Heb je inhoudelijke vragen over de vacature of procedure waar de vacaturetekst je geen antwoord op geeft? Voor meer informatie over het sollicitatieproces kun je contact opnemen met Recruiter Jorieke Hogeland, via joriekehogeland@royalfloraholland.com. Een online screening en referentiecheck maken deel uit van het sollicitatieproces, net als de aanvraag van een verklaring omtrent gedrag (VOG). Werk je bij een bureau en wil je een kandidaat voorstellen voor deze vacature bij Royal FloraHolland? Bedankt, maar hier gaan we niet op in. We werven onze nieuwe collega graag zelf. De afdeling Je staat er misschien niet bij stil, maar de digitale achterkant van Royal FloraHolland is ronduit vernieuwend. Data, machine learning en AI: alles zetten we in voor het perfect servicen van onze klanten en het optimaliseren van (logistieke) processen. Met onze IT-projecten maak je tot ver over de grenzen impact en versterk je onze leidende positie. Zo bouw je mee aan Floriday, het digitale platform dat wereldwijd, 24/7, duizenden kwekers en kopers bij elkaar brengt. Ook beheren we de supply chain waarin dagelijks miljoenen ‘fusten’ – onze beroemde bloemenemmers – verwerkt worden. Naast developers vind je daarom ook architecten, cloud engineers, data scientists, security officers en andere rollen in het team. Onmisbaar bij het ontwikkelen en digitaliseren van processen en systemen. Waar ga jij aan de slag? Royal FloraHolland is de grootste internationale sierteeltmarktplaats van bloemen en planten: een vereniging van kwekers met een bedrijf. Al meer dan 100 jaar streven we samen naar een optimale prijs voor bloemen en planten, met de beste kwaliteit tegen zo laag mogelijke kosten. Een dubbelzijdig Royal FloraHolland platform: een digitaal platform, Floriday, en een logistiek platform, waarmee logistieke, financiële en vastgoeddiensten nauw met elkaar verbonden zijn. We streven naar duurzaam succes voor onze leden en werken samen met alle partijen in de sierteeltsector, zodat de sector blijft groeien. Wij geloven dat we samen meer bereiken dan alleen. We willen waarde toevoegen via ons internationale B2B platform en vanuit een gezonde coöperatie. Via onze diensten zorgen we dat we onze klantbeloftes ook duurzaam waarmaken: …

items.desc: Researcher 32-38 uren € 4050.00 - € 6400.00 per Maand Warmenhuizen Ben jij een nieuwsgierige moleculair plantenwetenschapper die graag de verbinding legt tussen genetica, moleculaire biologie en AI-ondersteunde analyses? Omdat ons onderzoek naar wortelgewassen verder groeit, zoeken we een Researcher Trait Discovery & Genomics die biologische vraagstukken weet te vertalen naar experimenteel gevalideerde genen en concrete mogelijkheden voor de veredeling van wortelen. Jouw baan Binnen de afdeling Trait Discovery & Genomics van Bejo draag je bij aan de verdere verbetering van ons Apiaceae-portfolio, met de nadruk op peen. Je werkt nauw samen met onderzoekers, onderzoeksassistenten, veredelaars en specialisten op het gebied van bio-informatica, fytopathologie, celbiologie en data science. Samen vertalen jullie genetische observaties en biologische hypotheses naar kandidaatgenen, functionele validatie en uiteindelijk toepassing binnen de veredeling. Je volgt wetenschappelijke en technologische ontwikkelingen op de voet, beoordeelt nieuwe methoden en vertaalt kansrijke toepassingen naar robuuste en gebruiksvriendelijke onderzoeksprocessen. Samen met onderzoeksassistenten organiseer je het experimentele werk, leg je methoden en resultaten zorgvuldig vast en weet je complexe onderzoeksresultaten helder over te brengen. Daarbij houd je steeds het uiteindelijke doel voor ogen: onderzoeksresultaten realiseren die praktisch toepasbaar zijn binnen onderzoek en veredeling. Dit krijg je van ons Bij Bejo werk je in een betrokken familiebedrijf met een informele en collegiale sfeer, waar je veel ruimte krijgt om je talent te ontwikkelen en werk en privé goed in balans te houden. We investeren in jouw groei, vitaliteit en duurzame inzetbaarheid, en bieden een arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket dat past bij wat jij nodig hebt om met plezier je werk te doen. Voor de rol van Researcher krijg je onder andere; Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 4.050,00 en € 6.400,00 bij een fulltime dienstverband, aangevuld met een winstdeling en 8,33% vakantiegeld. Flexibel arbeidsvoorwaardenbudget van €800 netto per jaar, vrij besteedbaar aan o.a. sport & vitaliteit, werk‑privébalans, mobiliteit en duurzaamheid. Studie‑ en ontwikkelmogelijkheden, doorgroeikansen en diverse vitaliteitsvoorzieningen (zoals OpenUp en #BejoFit). Goede pensioenregeling en aanvullende verzekeringen Vakantie- en vitaliteitsdagen volgens de Tuinzaden cao Actieve personeelsvereniging die diverse bedrijfsactiviteiten -borrels en uitjes organiseert Maatschappelijke betrokkenheid, met veel aandacht voor duurzaamheid en de wereldwijde voedselvoorziening. Dit gaat over jou Je bent een inventieve en pragmatische plantenwetenschapper die graag onderzoekt hoe genen van invloed zijn op planteigenschappen. Je kunt zelfstandig werken, maar zoekt actief de samenwerking op met collega’s met aanvullende expertise en voelt je thuis in multidisciplinaire teams. Je combineert wetenschappelijke diepgang met een praktische instelling en weet ideeën te vertalen naar goed opgezette experimenten en oplossingen die breder toepasbaar zijn. Voor deze functie zoeken we iemand met: Minimaal een masteropleiding (MSc) en ervaring op het gebied van moleculaire plantenbiologie, genetica, biotechnologie, bio-informatica, computationele biologie of een vergelijkbare richting. Expertise in gene discovery, functionele of translationele genetica, moleculaire veredeling, plantenbiotechnologie of computationele plantenwetenschappen. Kennis van genetische mappingmethoden, zoals QTL-mapping, bulked-segregant analysis (BSA) en GWAS, en inzicht in wanneer je welke methode toepast. Je kunt vanuit gemapte regio’s de stap maken naar kandidaatgenen met behulp van fine mapping, selectie van recombinanten en de integratie van sequentie-, annotatie-, expressie- en biologische gegevens. Ervaring met het identificeren en prioriteren van kandidaatgenen en praktische ervaring met functionele genvalidatie, bij voorkeur in combinatie met data mining en AI-ondersteunde methoden. Ervaring met het analyseren en interpreteren van grootschalige biologische datasets of multi-omicsdata is een pré. Goede organisatorische vaardigheden voor het plannen van experimenteel onderzoek, het vastleggen van methoden en resultaten en het afstemmen met collega’s. Goede communicatieve en samenwerkingsvaardigheden en een professionele beheersing van de Engelse taal. Bereidheid om zowel binnen Nederland als internationaal te reizen. items.desc: Sportradar AS Ferjemannsveien 10, 7042 Trondheim Om jobben Lagre favoritt Type ansettelse Fast, heltid 100% Antall stillinger 2 Arbeidsspråk Engelsk Mulighet for hjemmekontor Delvis hjemmekontor THE CHALLENGE Make security a normal part of how our engineers build software, from secure design and threat modelling to security reviews. Put the right security checks into CI/CD: SAST, DAST, software composition analysis, infrastructure-as-code scanning and supply chain security. Work with Platform Engineering to secure our cloud and Kubernetes environments. Run vulnerability management based on risk, from deciding what matters most to seeing the fix shipped. Help engineering teams build securely without slowing them down, including when they work with AI coding tools. Be the person engineers come to with security questions, and give them answers they can act on. Lead DevSecOps Security Engineer Stay hands-on, and set the technical standard the rest of the team follows. Senior Manager, Information Security Engineering Lead the team: strategy, roadmap, hiring and performance, while staying close to the technical work. Be a trusted voice with engineering and technology leaders. ABOUT YOU You like security best when it helps people ship good software, not when it gets in their way. You are happy working next to engineers, explaining the "why" and then rolling up your sleeves to fix things with them. You keep learning, and you care about getting things done in a global company. Experience in DevSecOps, security engineering, application security or cloud security. Good knowledge of CI/CD and modern development practice. Experience securing cloud-native environments, preferably AWS, and working with Kubernetes and containers. A solid grasp of vulnerability management and the OWASP Top 10. A track record of working with engineering teams as an adviser and enabler. Clear, confident communication in fluent English. For the Senior Manager route: experience leading engineers, setting direction, running hiring and managing performance. Nice to have: CSPM or KSPM tooling, AWS and GCP security, GitLab Ultimate, infrastructure as code, large enterprise experience, security certifications. In your application, add a few lines on which route suits you better and why: Lead DevSecOps Engineer, or Senior Manager (leading a team while staying hands-on). If you are open to either, say so. OUR OFFER A collaborative environment with colleagues from all over the world (Engineering offices in Europe, Asia and US) including various social events and teambuilding. Flexibility to manage your workday and tasks with autonomy. A balance of structure and autonomy to tackle your daily tasks. Vibrant and inclusive community, including Women in Tech and Pride groups which welcome all participants. Global Employee Assistance Programme. Calm and Reulay app (leading well-being apps designed to support focus, quality rest, mindfulness, and long-term mental resilience). Online training videos. Flexible working hours. While we appreciate the flexibility and benefits of working from home, we strongly believe that coming together in person fosters stronger connections, encourages collaboration, and drives innovation - both as individuals and as a company. The energy, shared ideas, and team support we experience in the office strengthen the foundation of our success and culture. For this reason, we are an office-first business operating on a hybrid model, with team members working in the office five days a week to build relationships, exchange ideas, and grow together. Two technical interviews: Meet with the Technical team and Hiring Manager to dive into your solution and your expertise, as well as discuss team fit. Final Steps: Receive feedback and, if successful, an offer! We keep it simple and aim to wrap up the process within 3 weeks. ADDITIONAL INFORMATION At Sportradar, we celebrate our diverse group of hardworking employees. Sportradar is committed to ensuring equal access to its programs, facilities, and employment opportunities. items.desc: Job Summary : Interested in a career where contracts, negotiation, and clinical research come together? Medpace is hosting a virtual information session for individuals interested in learning more about our Contract Specialist opportunities across Europe. During this session, you'll learn more about our office-based Clinical Contract Specialist opportunities at Medpace, with openings in London, Munich, Warsaw, Prague, and Leuven . The world’s largest law firms, corporations, and government agencies rely on Relativity’s legal AI software to securely surface and manage the most relevant and impactful information in their matters. Beyond our commercial impact, we are committed to expanding access to technology and supporting pro bono legal work. WHAT WE DO Relativity aiR is the AI platform for legal data intelligence. We build products that help legal teams use AI to reach insights faster and develop a defensible case strategy through data-driven storytelling. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re looking for a Product Designer to help shape the next generation of Relativity aiR, the AI platform for legal data intelligence. This role is for a designer who loves to build and can take a problem from an initial sketch to a working prototype and production-ready code using AI tools. You will design and implement key features within our core case strategy workflows. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, and UX Research to build products that help legal teams reach insights faster and develop a defensible case strategy through data-driven storytelling. Job Description and Requirements WHAT YOU’LL DO Design and implement key features within Relativity aiR’s core case strategy workflows. Take problems from initial sketches through working prototypes and production-ready code using AI tools. Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, UX Research, and applied science partners to create thoughtful, effective product experiences. Learn the legal discovery domain from internal and external subject matter experts. Build strong working relationships with subject matter experts at Relativity and within our partner organizations. Ask questions, test assumptions about legal discovery workflows, and incorporate domain knowledge into your designs. Participate in customer discovery sessions, demonstrations, conferences, and customer events, including occasional on-site travel. Present your work to stakeholders, gather feedback, and use what you learn to guide subsequent iterations. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR Required 3-5 years of experience as a product or UX designer, with a portfolio demonstrating thoughtful, well-crafted workflow design. A strong bias toward action, with the ability to deliver incrementally and put working solutions in front of users rather than wait for perfect information. items.desc: Posting Description: ATS Integration Consultant Do you enjoy solving complex integration challenges and working directly alongside customers to bring technical solutions to life? Are you experienced in working with RESTful web services and interested in connecting HR technology platforms and systems? Join Aon and help our enterprise clients optimally integrate their technology using the assessment tools available through Aon form! Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What the day will look like As a Consultant for ATS Integration, you will be responsible for client onboarding initiatives from initial requirements through implementation, testing and debut. You will interact directly with customers to understand their ATS environment and workflows and translate their requirements into effective technical integrations. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include: Crafting and implementing integrations between the Aon Assessment Platform and customer ATS systems using web services described by OpenAPI specifications, RESTful endpoints, webhooks, JSON, XML and SFTP-based data exchange. Working directly with customer HR technology and IT teams to understand ATS configurations, authentication requirements, candidate workflows and data exchange needs. Handling integrations beginning with collecting requirements and continuing through configuration, testing, and launch, including troubleshooting API errors, data mapping issues, and workflow exceptions. Crafting clear integration specifications and data mapping documentation and supporting customers throughout testing and implementation. Prioritising multiple customer integration projects while working closely with Engineering, Solution Architects, Technical Support and QA teams. Maintaining integration documentation and helping identify recurring issues and opportunities to improve customer implementations. How this opportunity is different This role gives you the opportunity to combine technical integration work with direct customer engagement. You will work with different ATS environments and customer workflows, solving technical integration challenges while guiding customers through implementation. You will have ownership of integrations from initial discovery through launch and work closely with both customer teams and Aon's technical specialists. It is a superb opportunity for someone who enjoys working with APIs and data, solving integration problems and building positive relationships with customers throughout the implementation process. Skills and experience that will lead to success proven track record in technical integration, solutions engineering or implementation consulting, ideally within HR technology, SaaS or enterprise software. Strong hands-on experience with REST APIs, OpenAPI, JSON/XML and OAuth 2.0 , including troubleshooting integration failures and working with API responses and payloads. Experience delivering customer-facing integration projects end-to-end, from requirements gathering and configuration through testing and launch. Experience with at least one major ATS platform such as Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle Taleo, Greenhouse, iCIMS or SmartRecruiters , combined with an understanding of data mapping, transformation and validation. Good communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain technical requirements clearly and prioritise multiple customer projects at various stages. Experience with Azure, Azure DevOps, SFTP integrations, SQL, OpenAPI specifications, assessment or talent technology platforms, and AI tools used for user documentation and troubleshooting would be an advantage. #LI-KK2 #LI-Hybrid #technologyandsecurity

items.desc: Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better. We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us! Job Description As a Maintenance Specialist, you will support manufacturing operations by ensuring equipment reliability, optimizing maintenance processes, and leading technical improvement initiatives. Reporting directly to the Maintenance Manager, you will work in a skilled and collaborative maintenance team. This team partners with production, engineering, suppliers, and external service providers to improve machine performance, reduce downtime, and drive continuous improvement. In this first-shift position, you will have the opportunity to develop your technical expertise while working with modern maintenance tools, CMMS systems, automation technologies, and AI-supported solutions that enhance troubleshooting, analysis, and decision-making. If you enjoy solving technical challenges, implementing improvements, and continuously expanding your skills in a manufacturing environment, this role is for you. You will report to the Maintenance Team Supervisor and work onsite in Katowice, Poland. Your Responsibilities: Support maintenance teams in ensuring the continuous operation and reliability of manufacturing equipment and production lines. Lead root cause analysis activities and implement corrective and preventive actions to eliminate recurring equipment failures. Develop and execute preventive maintenance strategies, maintenance plans, and equipment improvement initiatives using CMMS systems. Coordinate external contractors, service providers, and suppliers while supporting maintenance and capital investment projects. Drive equipment modernization, cost reduction, and continuous improvement projects to enhance operational efficiency and production uptime. The Essentials - You Will Have: Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automation, Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field. Experience in maintenance, industrial automation, manufacturing engineering, or equipment reliability engineering. Knowledge of PLC-controlled equipment and industrial automation systems. Experience working with CMMS platforms such as Fiix, SAP PM, Maximo, or similar systems. Ability to read and interpret technical documentation, electrical schematics, and mechanical drawings. Communicative English proficiency. The Preferred - You Might Also Have: Experience in managing equipment implementation, modernization, or capital investment projects. Experience coordinating contractors, suppliers, and external service providers.· Knowledge of TPM, Lean Manufacturing, RCA, preventive or predictive maintenance methodologies. Experience with CAD/CAE systems. Experience with CNC machining, metrology equipment, or additive manufacturing (3D printing). What We Offer: Medical Plan - Includes coverage for partners and children. Paid by Rockwell, subject to tax and social security contributions payable by you. Medicover Sport Program - Includes a sports card with weekly entries to sports, recreation and wellbeing facilities within the Medicover network. Pension Scheme - Participation in Employee Capital Plans (PPK), a voluntary long-term retirement savings program provided in accordance with statutory requirements. Life insurance - Group life insurance, including disability coverage. Paid by Rockwell, subject to tax and social security contributions payable by you. MyBenefit Platform - Access to a flexible benefits platform, with monthly points allocated by the employer. Lunch Card – Monthly meal vouchers through the Edenred card. OnTrack - A wellbeing platform that encourages movement and healthy habits. Employee Assistance Program - Access to personal coaching and resources to support physical, mental, and emotional wellbeing goals. Calm Premium - Tools for relaxation, meditation, focus and sleep. At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles. #LI-Hybrid #LI-JS1
