items.desc: Location WARSAW, Poland Category Information Technology Job Id R000161777 Job Type Full time Internships Starting Pay / Salary Range 11,800.00 / month Job Location WARSAW PLANT & GO Job Description As a DevOps Engineer Trainee you will design, build and maintain CI/CD capabilities supporting applications and engineering teams across multiple technology stacks and cloud environments. You will transform engineering requirements into scalable automation, reusable pipeline components and platform capabilities that reduce manual work and make engineering standards easier for application teams to adopt. This is a hands-on technical engineering role. You will work directly with application teams, platform engineers and other engineering stakeholders to understand delivery challenges, identify opportunities for automation and implement solutions that can be reused across teams. You will work with GitHub, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Azure and Google Cloud Platform , using infrastructure-as-code, containers and scripting to automate software delivery and cloud engineering processes. Key Responsibilities Design, develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines that automate build, test, security validation, deployment and release activities across different application technology stacks. Build reusable GitHub Actions workflows and pipeline templates that standardize common delivery patterns and allow application teams to adopt CI/CD capabilities through self-service rather than bespoke implementations. Develop automation using Python, shell scripting and infrastructure-as-code , reducing repetitive operational work and improving consistency across engineering environments. Implement and maintain cloud infrastructure automation across Azure and Google Cloud Platform using tools such as Terraform. Support application teams with CI/CD onboarding and modernization , including assessment of existing pipelines, migration toward standard patterns and resolution of complex pipeline and deployment issues. Integrate SDLC requirements into engineering workflows , helping teams meet engineering, security and application compliance expectations through automation rather than manual controls. This responsibility was explicitly part of the previous role. Implement containerized and cloud-native delivery patterns using technologies including Docker and Kubernetes where appropriate. Improve engineering reliability and developer experience by identifying recurring problems, removing unnecessary manual activities and creating reusable platform solutions. Monitor and analyze CI/CD performance , using engineering metrics and observability capabilities to identify opportunities for improving pipeline reliability and software delivery performance. Troubleshoot software delivery and infrastructure issues , collaborating with development and platform teams to identify root causes and implement sustainable fixes rather than repeated workarounds. Support DevOps capabilities throughout their lifecycle , including implementation, upgrades, maintenance, incident troubleshooting and continuous improvement. Explore and implement AI-assisted DevOps capabilities , including the use of AI coding assistants and engineering agents to accelerate troubleshooting, pipeline management, automation and developer productivity. Collaborate with engineering teams and technical stakeholders to understand development workflows and translate engineering requirements into scalable platform solutions. Document platform capabilities, engineering standards and self-service patterns so that application teams can consume DevOps capabilities consistently and independently. Job Qualifications 3rd, 4th, 5th year students or graduates - with a real passion for business and technology. Strong hands-on experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering or Software Engineering , with demonstrated experience building and operating automated software delivery solutions. Strong experience with Git, GitHub and GitHub Actions , including implementation and maintenance of CI/CD workflows. Practical cloud engineering experience with Microsoft Azure and/or Google Cloud Platform , with the ability to work effectively across cloud services as required by application architectures. Experience with Infrastructure as Code , preferably Terraform, including creation and maintenance of reusable infrastructure components. Experience with Docker and containerized application delivery ; knowledge of Kubernetes or other container orchestration platforms is strongly preferred. Experience developing engineering automation using Python and/or shell scripting . Working knowledge of YAML, JSON and configuration-as-code approaches used by modern CI/CD and cloud platforms. Understanding of modern SDLC and DevSecOps practices , including automated testing, security controls, vulnerability management and compliance within software delivery workflows. items.desc: We’re looking for a Mid Data Engineer to take ownership of our data lake — the system of record for millions of financial events every day, including bets , wallet transactions, and live odds, serving 12M+ active users. You’ll be responsible for designing and maintaining reliable data pipelines and defining how data is ingested, stored, retained, reconciled, and governed across AWS S3 and Snowflake/Databricks. Your work will ensure that Analytics, Finance, and Regulatory teams have access to accurate, consistent, and fully traceable data — with zero drift from source systems. Location: Kraków, Poland. Hybrid — 2 days per week from the office . ﻿What you will do: Own the lakehouse architecture: bronze/silver/gold layers, Iceberg/Delta tables, schema evolution. Land operational data via CDC streaming (Kafka, Debezium), handling late and duplicate events. Design data layout for speed and cost: partitioning, compaction, file sizing, query performance on Trino/Athena/Snowflake. Own retention and archival: storage tiering, regulatory retention, immutability, GDPR deletion. Guarantee correctness: freshness SLAs, drift detection, reconciliation against the source wallet and ledger systems. Own governance: catalog and lineage, row/column access control, PII masking, encryption, audit trails. Monitor ingestion health, data anomalies, and cloud storage/compute spend. Requirements: Must-have: 2 years of hands -on in a production lakehouse environment. Lakehouse architecture — bronze/silver/gold layering, an open table format (Iceberg, Delta, or Hudi), schema evolution. Data layout & query optimization at TB+ scale — partitioning, compaction, file sizing, query performance on Trino/Athena/Snowflake. Cloud lakehouse/DWH in production — Snowflake, Databricks, or BigQuery. CDC & streaming ingestion — Kafka + Debezium or equivalent; late, duplicate, and out-of-order events. Strong SQL and data modeling — enough relational grounding to reason about the OLTP systems you capture from. Critical for financial ledgers. Correctness — freshness SLAs, drift detection, reconciliation against source wallet/ledger systems. Governance — catalogs, lineage, row/column access control, PII masking, retention, GDPR deletion. Cloud object storage — S3 or GCS, plus storage tiering and archival. Python and an orchestrator — Airflow or Dagster, as tools.

items.desc: Established in 1997, Softeq was built from the ground up to specialize in new product development and R&D, tackling the most difficult problems in the tech sphere. Now we've expanded to offer early-stage innovation and ideation plus digital transformation business consulting. Our superpower is to deliver all of this under one roof on a global scale. So let's get started and build a better future together! We're looking for a Automation QA Engineer to join our team and contribute to its continued growth. We are building a new customer portal for a large logistics company. Business users at the company's customers will use it to track shipments, see delays and ETAs, manage invoices and documents, get alerts and reports, and ask an AI assistant about their own data. The portal runs on Azure: React/TypeScript front end (installable PWA), Python/FastAPI services, and an Azure Databricks lakehouse that feeds the application with certified data. Customers from many companies use the same application, so strict data isolation between them is a core requirement. You will build an automation-first test system for the application and its data, and own quality evidence for each release. What you will do Define the test strategy and test plan for each release together with the team and the client. Build and maintain UI end-to-end automation with Playwright, and API and contract tests with pytest against an OpenAPI 3.1 contract. Write cross-tenant negative tests : prove that a user of one customer company can never see or change another company's data, through the UI, the API or exports. Test role-based access and entitlements: admins, internal staff, customer users, delegated access. Run performance and load tests (Azure Load Testing or k6) against agreed targets. Run security tests in the pipeline (DAST with OWASP ZAP) and support remediation and retest after penetration tests. Test accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA) with automated checks (axe) and manual review; test the PWA across the agreed browser and device matrix, including web push on iOS. Test data: reconcile application data against source systems, verify data quality rules, run KPI regression against certified baselines, and prepare evidence packs for data sign-off. Help test AI features: evaluation sets for the assistant, checks that answers stay within the user's data. Integrate all tests into CI/CD (GitHub Actions), keep them fast and stable, and report quality at release gates. Manage defects and give clear, reproducible bug reports. What we expect 4+ years of test automation for web applications and APIs , with code in TypeScript or Python that you maintain like production code. Strong Playwright (or Cypress / Selenium with a clear reason to move to Playwright): page objects or fixtures, test data management, parallel runs, flaky-test control. API testing with pytest or similar: authentication flows (OAuth2 / OIDC, JWT), contract testing against OpenAPI, negative and boundary cases. Experience testing role-based access and multi-tenant isolation . Good SQL : you can write reconciliation queries between a source and a target and explain each variance. CI integration of tests (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps or similar): test reports, quality gates, running tests per pull request. Clear written and spoken English; you can explain a defect and its business impact to developers and to the client. Nice to have Data testing frameworks: Great Expectations, chispa, dbt tests; Databricks or another lakehouse. Performance testing with k6, JMeter or Azure Load Testing. Security testing: OWASP ZAP, OWASP Top 10 and API Top 10. Accessibility testing (axe, screen readers) and PWA / mobile browser testing. Testing LLM features: evaluation sets, groundedness checks, prompt-injection test cases. ISTQB or similar certification. Logistics, transportation or supply-chain domain. Our tech stack Playwright · pytest · k6 / Azure Load Testing · OWASP ZAP · axe · GitHub Actions · React / TypeScript · Python / FastAPI · Azure Databricks · PostgreSQL · Azure Softeq communicates only from @ softeq.com email addresses. We never request payments or fees for any reason during hiring — including trainings or courses to be completed, equipment, onboarding, or background checks — and we will not ask for banking information, cryptocurrency or gift cards. If you receive a message from any other domain or requesting payment, do not respond and report it to abuse@softeq.com

items.desc: Andersen is hiring a Streamlit Data App Engineer in the EU f or a project developing interactive data applications on Databricks to enhance analytics and support drug development. The customer is a global biopharmaceutical organization focused on developing innovative therapies to address evolving healthcare needs. Through advanced research and development capabilities, the company works on specialized treatment solutions aimed at improving patient outcomes and expanding access to modern healthcare. Its activities span multiple therapeutic areas, with ongoing development programs and a commitment to scientific innovation, quality, and long-term growth across international markets. The project is focused on developing and enhancing data-driven applications for the drug development domain, built on top of an existing Databricks data platform. It aims to deliver intuitive user interfaces, interactive data applications, and seamless access to analytical insights, improving data accessibility and user experience for scientific and business stakeholders. Responsibilities: Building, maintaining, and productionizing Python/Streamlit-based data applications hosted on Databricks Apps. Enriching and preparing the existing Lineage Explorer application to full production readiness. Designing and building a new data-entry and data-exposure application for the Competitive Intelligence use case, supporting up to approximately 600 users. Proactively proposing UX and application architecture solutions for new data applications. Collaborating with Databricks and Data Engineering teams responsible for the underlying data foundation. Owning application-level deployment, maintenance, operations, and change management. Requirements: Strong hands-on Python experience for 4+ years. Hands-on experience with Streamlit or similar frameworks for building Python-based data applications. Experience building interactive data applications with business logic, data input, and data visualization/exposure, beyond traditional BI dashboards. Strong UX/product mindset, with the ability to proactively propose intuitive application flows, layouts, and user interactions. Good understanding of backend concepts and data flows, with the ability to work beyond purely frontend/UI concerns. Understanding of application maintenance, operations, deployment, and change management processes. Ability to work independently, proactively, and with strong ownership of solution design and delivery. Level of English – from Intermediate+ and above. Nice to haves: Familiarity with Azure Databricks and data engineering environments. Understanding of dbt / data engineering fundamentals. Experience with React as an alternative or complementary frontend technology. Experience in regulated/compliance-sensitive reporting contexts. Pharma/biotech industry experience. Reasons why this job would be interesting to you: Experience in teamwork with leaders in FinTech, Healthcare, Retail, Telecom, and others. Andersen cooperates with such businesses as Samsung, Siemens, Johnson & Johnson, BNP Paribas, Ryanair, Mercedes, TUI, Verivox, Allianz, T-Systems, etc.. The opportunity to change the project and/or develop expertise in an interesting business domain. Job conditions – you can work both fully remotely and from the office or can choose a hybrid variant. Guarantee of professional, financial, and career growth! The company has introduced systems of mentoring and adaptation for each new employee. The opportunity to earn up to an additional 1,000 EUR per month, depending on the level of expertise, which will be included in the annual bonus, by participating in the company's activities. Access to the corporate training portal, where the entire knowledge base of the company is collected and which is constantly updated. Bright corporate life (parties / pizza days / PlayStation / fruits / coffee / snacks / movies). Certification compensation (AWS, PMP, etc). Referral program. Private health insurance and sports compensation, depending on the type of employment. Your personal data is protected in accordance with GDPR regulations. Learn more: https://andersenlab.com/privacy-policy/pl Join us! Job Type: Full-time Pay: Up to 14,263.00zł per month Work Location: Remote

items.desc: Location: Bucharest, Romania This role is part of a large-scale SAP ECC6 to S/4HANA migration program for a major international organization. As a core member of a dedicated Data Migration Squad, you will be responsible for building and maintaining the transformation and loading pipelines that sit at the heart of the migration delivery. You will work closely with the Technical Lead and your fellow data engineers to ensure that data flows reliably, accurately, and on time from the source ECC6 environment to the target S/4HANA platform. WHO ARE YOU? You have solid hands-on experience designing and building ETL pipelines in complex data environments? You are comfortable working with large volumes of heterogeneous data, and you know how to handle edge cases, rejections, and transformation complexity? You are rigorous and detail-oriented — you care about the quality of what you deliver, not just whether it runs? You enjoy working in a team, sharing knowledge, and improving practices collectively? You are curious about SAP data landscapes, or already have some exposure to them? Then this role is made for you. WHAT WE CAN ACHIEVE TOGETHER You will join a dedicated squad of 4 data professionals, embedded within a broader SAP program team. You will work in close collaboration with the Technical Lead and contribute to the delivery of migration pipelines across all in-scope data objects, in an agile delivery mode with iterative development and regular validation cycles. By joining us, you will play a hands-on role in one of the most technically challenging phases of a major international transformation program. Your mission will include : Designing, developing, and maintaining ETL pipelines for data extraction, transformation, and loading Implementing transformation rules based on mapping specifications defined with the Technical Lead Participating in data quality checks, reconciliation processes, and error handling Documenting pipeline logic, transformation rules, and technical decisions Contributing to the continuous improvement of delivery practices within the squad WHAT YOU BRING Senior Data Engineer 2–4 years of experience in data engineering or ETL-focused roles Comfortable implementing pipelines based on defined specifications Eager to grow in a structured migration context ETL & Data Engineering Solid hands-on experience with at least one ETL platform (Talend, Informatica, SSIS, or equivalent) Strong understanding of data transformation patterns and pipeline design Experience working with large and complex datasets Familiarity with data quality concepts — validation rules, rejection handling, reconciliation Soft Skills Rigorous and detail-oriented approach to delivery Ability to work collaboratively in a small, fast-moving team Good communication skills — able to discuss technical topics with both engineers and functional stakeholders NICE TO HAV E Exposure to SAP data structures or SAP migration projects Familiarity with SAP migration tools (BODS, Syniti/SNP, or equivalent) Experience working in an agile delivery environment Knowledge of cloud-based data platforms (Azure, GCP, AWS) YOUR CAREER AT THALES Future opportunities will allow you to discover other domains or sites. You will be able to evolve and grow your competencies in different areas: Room and attention to personal development Build your talents in another domain of Thales Group, discovering new products, new customers, new country or go to a more complex Solution Choose between a technical expertise or a leadership path Build an international career within a leading Engineering Group At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world. Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of defence and security, aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust. In Romania, we are advancing innovation through software engineering, research and development, delivering solutions in key markets in which Thales Group operates. Our engineers design, develop and integrate solutions that impact global industries – from fully operational systems and subsystems for naval warfare and maritime security operations, to air traffic management systems, satellite-based solutions, tactical indoor simulations, identity and biometric technologies and more.

items.desc: At ENGIE, we are building the energy systems of tomorrow. That takes strong foundations — including the financial controls that protect our operations and keep trust intact across borders. As an Internal Control Officer, you strengthen how we manage risk across Master Data and Invoice-to-Pay processes. You work with teams in Bucharest, Houston and Mexico City. You make controls smarter, more effective and fit for an international environment. What You'll Do Perform risk assessments and control design reviews across Master Data and Invoice-to-Pay processes, identifying gaps and recommending practical improvements. Coordinate control testing and self-assessment activities, review evidence, document conclusions and track remediation to closure. Review controls over supplier records, bank details, access rights, segregation of duties and data quality to support fraud prevention. Assess end-to-end Invoice-to-Pay controls, including invoice capture, three-way matching, payment runs and vendor reconciliations. Prepare clear status reports and risk updates for management, escalating deficiencies and compliance issues through the right governance channels. Build strong working relationships with finance, procurement, IT, audit and compliance stakeholders across Romania, the US and Mexico. Identify opportunities to use data analytics and AI to improve control coverage, speed and efficiency. What You Bring A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Audit, Business Administration, Information Systems, Data Analytics or a related field. Between four and eight years of experience in internal control, internal or external audit, risk management or finance operations. Practical knowledge of Master Data governance and Invoice-to-Pay or Accounts Payable processes. Strong analytical skills and hands-on experience with data tools such as Power BI, SAP, Celonis, HighBond or equivalent platforms. Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt your message to operational and executive audiences. The ability to work with autonomy, apply professional skepticism and influence stakeholders without direct authority. Full professional proficiency in English; Spanish is a plus, and Romanian or French is an additional advantage. Location Bucharest, Romania. This role follows a hybrid working arrangement. It requires approximately 30% international travel, primarily to Houston and Mexico City. What We Offer A stimulating role with real international scope, covering operations across Romania, North America and Latin America. A diverse mix of missions spanning risk assessment, data analytics, process improvement and cross-functional collaboration. A friendly and supportive team environment within ENGIE Global Business Services, where your expertise is valued and your voice is heard. Flexibility and work-life balance through a hybrid working model designed to support both focus and collaboration. Meaningful career development opportunities within a global organisation at the heart of the energy transition, with access to learning resources and internal mobility. Only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted. Technical Skills Proficiency in advanced cooking techniques, food preparation, and presentation. Deep understanding of food safety regulations and kitchen sanitation practices, ensuring full compliance. Assist the Chef de Cuisine in managing food costs, controlling inventory, and maintaining profitability. Skilled in leading and managing kitchen staff, including training, delegating tasks, and maintaining high morale. Ability to streamline kitchen operations and improve efficiency in a high-pressure environment. Ensuring consistency and quality in every dish, from ingredient sourcing to plating. items.desc: Are you looking for a new challenge? Fancy helping us shape the future of motor insurance? Prima could be the place for you. Since 2015, we’ve been using our love of data and tech to rethink motor insurance and bring drivers a great experience at a great price. Our story began in Italy, where we’ve quickly become the number one online motor insurance provider. In fact, we’re trusted by over 5 million drivers. And now we’re expanding to help millions more drivers in the UK and Spain. To help fuel that growth, we need a Product Designer to join our Claims team . Customer Support and Conversion teams, where design, service thinking, and continuous improvement come together to empower our Support teams in Italy, Spain, and the UK and deliver outstanding help to our customers. Excited to make an impact? Here are the details. What you’ll do Analyze user needs through interviews, workshops, and shadowing sessions with both internal teams and end customers Map workflows and pain points, identifying inefficiencies and opportunities across processes like policy management, support interactions, and underwriting flows Design clear and intuitive interfaces that simplify complex tasks such as reviewing documentation, managing customer cases, or supporting operational decisions Create wireframes, interactive prototypes, and mockups to test and validate solutions early with real users Ensure accessibility and usability, following UX best practices and internal guidelines Translate usage data and metrics (e.g., error rates, completion times, frequency of use) into actionable design decisions What we’re looking for Portfolio: A portfolio that demonstrates deep expertise in UX/UI designs, design thinking, creation of user flows with variable complexity Data mindset: Comfortable reading analytics dashboards, understanding funnels and translating data into actions Tools: Proficiency in Figma (Auto Layout, Variants, Tokens, Component Libraries). Knowledge of prototyping and handoff best practices Accessibility: Awareness of accessibility standards (WCAG) and ability to design components and patterns that meet those standards Language: Fluency in English is required Nice-to have Familiarity with A/B testing platforms and experimentation frameworks Previous experience designing management software, chatbots, and basic knowledge of CRM/customer service tools Previous experience designing conversion flows Knowledge of basic understanding of how design components are implemented in code Why you’ll love it here We want to make Prima a happy and empowering place to work. So if you decide to join us, you can expect plenty of perks. Work Your Way: Enjoy hybrid working, with a mix of home and office days. Plus, for up to 30 days per year, work from anywhere. \uD83C\uDFC1 Grow with us: We may move fast at Prima, but we move together. Get access to learning resources, mentorship and a growth plan tailored to you. \uD83C\uDF08 Thrive and perform: Your best work begins when you feel your best. Enjoy private healthcare, gym discounts, wellbeing programs and mental health support. Think you’re a match? Apply now. At Prima, we celebrate uniqueness. If you don’t meet every requirement but are passionate about this role, we still want to hear from you. Innovation thrives on diverse perspectives. Prima is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Need accommodations during the process? Email us at accessible.recruiting@prima.it. Let’s build the future of insurance, together.

items.desc: At SiteMinder, we believe our success comes from our people. We build diverse, inclusive teams where different voices, backgrounds and perspectives are valued. Our differences drive innovation for our customers, and our people bring the ideas, expertise and energy that help us keep moving forward. We’re better together. What We Do... Right now, somewhere in the world, a hotel is taking a booking or increasing their revenue through technology you could help build. SiteMinder is the world’s leading hotel commerce platform. For more than 20 years, we’ve helped hotels attract guests, maximise revenue, forecast demand and perform at their best. Today, our platform supports 56,000+ hotels in 150+ countries, connects to 3,000+ partners and powers more than 140m reservations and AU$85 billion+ in hotel revenue each year. That’s the kind of impact your work can have here. You’ll solve meaningful challenges with AI, simplify complexity and build solutions that help hotels perform. Supported by clear purpose, a strong platform and teams who care about what they’re building, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of an industry that never stands still. About SiteMinder SiteMinder is the world’s leading open hotel commerce platform. We are a global technology company dedicated to empowering hoteliers to sell, market, manage, and grow their business successfully in the digital age. Our award-winning platform serves tens of thousands of hotels worldwide, providing innovative solutions that connect them to every part of the distribution and commercial landscape. About Dynamic Revenue Plus (DR+) Dynamic Revenue Plus (DR+) is SiteMinder’s powerful, intelligent add-on designed to help our existing hotel customers master their pricing and distribution strategy with confidence. DR+ uses real-time market data, demand trends, and competitor insights to recommend optimal room rates, enabling hotels to react faster, make smarter pricing decisions, and significantly improve profitability—all directly within the integrated SiteMinder platform. About the Revenue Growth Consultant (DR+) We are seeking commercially-minded individuals with deep, hands-on hotel revenue management experience who are ready to transition into a consultative technology sales career. Your primary mission is to be the domain expert in the sales team, engaging existing SiteMinder customers to educate them on the value of adopting DR+. This role is focused on selling value and strategic outcome, not just features. You will be leveraging your operational knowledge to conduct highly credible, solution-focused conversations that demonstrate how DR+ solves real-world hotel pricing challenges. What You’ll Be Doing: Consultative Upselling: Proactively reach out to existing SiteMinder customers (warm leads) to initiate in-depth, consultative discussions regarding their current revenue management strategies, pain points, and commercial goals. Value Demonstration: Conduct compelling, data-driven product demonstrations and presentations that clearly articulate how DR+ enhances pricing strategies, improves yield, and delivers a strong Return on Investment (ROI). Expert Education: Utilise your hands-on hotel revenue management background to serve as a credible expert, educating hoteliers on best practices and how DR+ integrates with their commercial strategy to remove guesswork and spreadsheet reliance. Full Sales Cycle Management: Own the end-to-end upsell sales cycle within your defined territory, managing opportunities from initial qualification and discovery through negotiation, contract closing, and ensuring a smooth activation handoff to the Customer Success team. Target Achievement: Consistently achieve and exceed monthly and quarterly upsell revenue targets for the DR+ product. CRM Management: Maintain accurate and timely records of all sales activities, pipeline stages, and customer information within the CRM (Salesforce) to ensure reliable forecasting and pipeline health. Collaboration: Work seamlessly with the Regional Sales Manager, Customer Success, and Marketing teams to align messaging, capture market feedback, and contribute to the continuous refinement of the DR+ Go-to-Market strategy. What We’re Looking For: Hands-on Domain Mastery (Mandatory): A strong background and proven track record in operational hotel revenue management is essential. You must understand the daily, practical challenges of pricing, channel distribution, and forecasting within a hotel environment. Career Transition Drive: A demonstrated ambition to transition from an operational role into a high-growth SaaS commercial environment. You must be keen to expand your experience by learning consultative B2B sales methodologies and GTM strategies. Communication and Persuasion: Clear, confident, and professional communication skills with strong presentation and negotiation abilities. Sales Aptitude: Proven success in an inside sales, account management, or commercially-focused B2B …

items.desc: About Seqera Seqera is on a mission to empower scientists and organizations to solve humanity's biggest challenges through data-driven science. As the company behind Nextflow and the Seqera Platform, we enable global enterprises, biotech innovators, academic institutions, and public sector organizations to scale complex data workflows with confidence. We're a global, remote-friendly team with headquarters in Barcelona and colleagues across the US, UK, and beyond. As we continue to grow, we're strengthening our internal foundations - and that's where you come in. Note: This role is open to candidates located in Spain or the UK. About the role Seqera is hiring a Business Operations Analyst to join our Business Operations team. The team owns the commercial engine behind our go-to-market: sales process, deal desk, quoting, Salesforce, sales reporting, GTM tooling, and revenue analytics. As our deal volume and complexity grow, we need someone to take over the day-to-day operations so that deals keep moving, the data stays reliable, and the team has room to build. You will report to the Director of Revenue Operations and work every day with Sales, Finance, Customer Experience, and Marketing. Within the team, you'll partner closely with our Analytics, GTM Systems, and Marketing Operations colleagues. This is a hands-on role that covers sales operations, commercial operations, analytics, and business systems. You'll support our sales leaders and reps day to day, contribute to the delivery of GTM projects from scoping through rollout, and improve how things work as you go. You’ll enjoy this role if you like understanding how things work end to end, and you get satisfaction from fixing the cause of a problem rather than the symptom. What you'll do Pipeline, forecasting, and reporting Support the operating cadences that keep GTM aligned, including forecast calls, pipeline and renewal reviews, and leadership QBRs, by preparing materials, tracking actions, and keeping the data accurate. Build and maintain Salesforce reports and dashboards, and handle ad-hoc reporting requests from across the business. Audit open pipeline for past-due close dates, stalled stages, and missing next steps, and follow up with owners. Sales process and CRM data Keep account assignments, territories, quotas, price books, and SKUs accurate, and account and contact data clean and de-duplicated. Monitor lead routing, stage criteria, and handoffs from SDR to AE to Customer Experience, and flag where they break down. Reconcile bookings with Finance, including the data behind commission calculations. Deal desk and contracts Review submitted quotes, and work live with AEs to structure complex deals, including multi-year commitments, step-ups, and non-standard terms. Keep approvals moving, and check every closed-won deal against the signed contract before it's booked. Track renewals, opt-out windows, and step-ups, and flag at-risk accounts and coverage gaps early. Analytics Answer ad-hoc questions about customers, products, and usage, analyse win/loss, conversion, sales cycle, and renewal performance, and turn the findings into clear recommendations for the commercial teams. Contribute to the data models and dashboards behind our revenue analytics (Snowflake, dbt, Superset), act on data quality alerts, and provide cover when the analytics lead is away. Review analytics pull requests to build shared context. You don't need to be a data architecture expert. Systems and automation Make Salesforce admin changes, including fields, page layouts, validation rules, and flows, and test new changes and integrations before rollout. Spot recurring friction in GTM workflows, fix the root cause, and build automations, integrations, and AI workflows, including Claude skills and plugins, to remove manual work. Help deliver GTM projects, such as new product launches and process changes, from scoping through rollout and adoption. Keep commercial runbooks, process maps, system documentation, and our GTM tool inventory up to date. Tool support and onboarding Triage questions in our GTM tool support channels, and support GTM office hours. Handle system setup and onboarding for new hires, including access, licenses, and approver coverage. About you Experience and background 2–4 years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, GTM Systems, Deal Desk, Business Operations, or a similar analytical role at a B2B SaaS company. Strong Salesforce experience: you've built reports and dashboards and you're comfortable with admin work on objects, fields, and flows. Admin certification is a plus. You’ve redesigned at least one commercial process end to end, such as quote approvals, renewal tracking, or lead routing. You mapped how it actually worked, documented it so others could follow, fixed where it broke, and can point to what improved (faster turnaround, fewer errors, less manual work). An understanding of how B2B deals work, including quotes, contracts, renewals, and ARR/TCV. …

items.desc: Job Description: An opportunity for an Antennas & RF AIT Engineer has arisen within Airbus Defence and Space, Getafe (Madrid). Airbus Defence & Space Spain is a leading manufacturer of instruments, telecommunication antennas, and satellites, driving the design and production of Europe’s most innovative space products as national prime contractor. The selected candidate will join the Assembly, Integration and Testing (AIT) Department , working in a multidisciplinary, high-technology environment. You will play a key role in the integration and testing activities for state-of-the-art Active Antennas, Microwave instruments, and Satellite subsystems. RESPONSIBILITIES The main tasks of the jobholder will be: Participate in project design phases to guarantee Design for MAIT, reviewing RF and electrical test specifications. Execute electrical and RF integration and flight measurements using automated test systems and standard RF instrumentation (Network Analyzers, Spectrum Analyzers, Power Meters, Oscilloscopes). Develop and run step-by-step procedures, automated test scripts, and sequences tailored to project AIT test specifications. Analyze test results, deliver technical test reports, define Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), and actively support failure investigations. Specify and monitor test equipment/systems follow-on, coordinating scheduled AIT milestones to ensure delivery on time, on cost, and on quality. Represent the team in formal technical reviews with customers, collaborating closely with Design and Engineering departments. SKILLS Is your profile aligned to the following list of skills? Apply! We are looking forward to knowing you: Education: Degree in Telecommunications/RF Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Aeronautical Engineering, or a related discipline. Experience: Hands-on experience in RF and electrical testing, integration processes (AIT), and working within cleanroom environments. Technical knowledge: Solid understanding of RF chains/parameters (S-params, Gain, NF, P1dB, G/T, IM) and RF components (amplifiers, phase shifters, combiners/dividers, switches, mixers).Familiarity with antenna parameters (directivity, gain, VSWR, XPD) and basic electronic circuitry.Proficiency with standard RF and lab equipment (Spectrum/Network Analyzers, Power Meters, Signal Generators, Multimeters).Experience with test languages/environments to execute and automate test sequences. Soft skills: High degree of autonomy, organized and proactive mindset, capability to manage workload across concurrent projects, and strong teamwork in multidisciplinary setups. Languages: Advanced / fluent level in English. Valuable / Nice to have: Prior experience in satellite applications, space systems, or space-grade communication protocols and interfaces. Working Conditions: Flexibility for occasional shift work (morning/late/night), potential weekend interventions during critical test campaigns, and willingness to travel abroad for specific AIT phases. WHICH BENEFITS WILL YOU HAVE AS AIRBUS EMPLOYEE? At Airbus we are focused on our employees and their welfare. Take a look at some of our social benefits: Vacation days plus additional days-off along the year. Attractive salary. Hybrid model of working when possible. Collective transport service subject to working calendar/home location. Benefits such as life insurance, health insurance, employee stock options, retirement plan, or study grants. On-site facilities (among others): free canteen, kindergarten, medical office. Possibility to collaborate in different social and corporate social responsibility initiatives. Excellent upskilling opportunities and great development prospects in a multicultural environment. Option to access special rates in products & benefits. #MYCYM This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief. Definitely, we are moved by our passion to make it fly! In accordance with the proven Candidate skills, she/he will be part of Power, Analog or Digital team and will report/be supported by the relevant Skill Manager. Functionally, the Candidate is also part of the Project, with the main mission of developing/designing electronic units for flight and ground equipment to achieve the unit delivery in accordance with project schedule, cost and quality requirements. In a day-to-day basis, she/he will report to Project Manager. Within each project, the tasks are coordinated by a Technical Responsible in charge of direct reporting to the Project Manager. The Engineer’s tasks comprise the complete development of an electronic equipment: from the analysis of the requirements to the final delivery of the flight model once accepted. The successful applicant will be in charge of the following tasks: Support to the Technical and Test Managers for the analysis of project requirements. Architecture analysis at electronic function or module level. Detailed electronics design based on electrical simulations at function level. Assure of the robustness of the design by means of: part stress analysis, worst case analysis, failure modes and criticality analysis, power budget analysis and Double Insulation requirements compliance. In case of fligth design, to support to Radiation Team to assure the design robustness within the radiation space environment including Single Events Effects (SEE). Documentation of the design. Laboratory and prototype testing. Assure the mechanical and thermal design robustness by supporting the Packaging Team. Support to PCB CAD team during the design of the PCB by the reviewing of the PCB layout. Board test procedures definition. Support to the Technical Manager in the main project reviews (Requirement Review, Preliminary and Architecture Review, Critical Design Review…) Characterization of the design. Support to Test Team for the acceptance of flight equipment, ensuring a close monitoring of any change, evolution or discrepancy from the agreed baseline in the characterization phase. Support to the Technical Manager in the resolution of boards NCRs (Non-conformance) raised during qualification or acceptance test campaign. Background and skills set required We are looking for candidates with the following skills and experience: Educated to Master degree level (or equivalent) in engineering or science discipline. Proven experience in the development of any of the following functions: Power, Analog or Digital electronics. Proven experience using advanced laboratory instrumentation. Good knowledge of design methodologies for space application and tools (Mentor, LTSPice, Matlab, SIMetrix-SIMPLIS). Sound mathematical basis for its application to the electronic design analysis. English and Spanish must be at least mid-level, both written and spoken. Good communication and reporting skills. Strong team working and cooperation spirit. Independent and accurate way of working. Other recommended skills are: Digital mindset (automation of tasks, scripting, use of digital design tools and simulators). Knowledge of space environment constraints. To be familiar with Agile methodologies. For Candidates with skills on Power & Analog electronics: experience on designs using digital control techniques. For Candidates with skills on Digital electronics: experience on designs based on hardware-software interfaces. Fast prototyping techniques. Happy to learn and teach others. Feel like you can't tick some boxes above? If you have most of the skills and experience that we're looking for and are willing to use your talent to learn the rest, we encourage you to apply! items.desc: Job Description: A vacancy for a Systems Engineer has arisen within the Mission A/C & Ground Software Department in Getafe (Madrid). We are seeking a highly skilled Systems Engineer with a strong focus on Linux environments to join our infrastructure team. This role is critical to our development lifecycle, as you will be responsible for two main pillars: Development & Engineering Infrastructure: Managing the platforms, tools, and environments that empower our engineering teams to build, test, and deploy code. Production Infrastructure: Architecting and maintaining the high-availability environments that host our customer-facing products. The ideal candidate has an automation-first mindset and possesses strong programming capabilities. Beyond standard scripting, you will be expected to contribute to the development of internal tooling and performance optimizations, requiring a deep understanding of systems-level programming. RESPONSIBILITIES Systems Administration: Advanced management of Linux environments (SUSE Linux Enterprise Server preferred or equivalent distributions). Automated Provisioning: Design and implement automated deployment and configuration processes (Image management and Configuration Management). Development Infrastructure Management: Maintain and optimize the internal engineering ecosystem, including development servers, testing environments, and deployment pipelines. Tooling & Application Management: Installation, configuration, and lifecycle management of engineering and support tools, including Ticketing systems, Problem Report Repositories, and Atlassian suites (Jira, Confluence, etc.). Production Infrastructure Engineering: Design, deploy, and scale the production environments that host our customer-facing products, ensuring maximum uptime, performance, and scalability. Backup & Disaster Recovery: Design and implement robust backup strategies and disaster recovery plans to ensure data integrity and business continuity. Automation & Tool Development: Develop, maintain, and optimize scripts and custom software to automate repetitive tasks, optimize operational workflows, and enhance infrastructure performance. Virtualization & Orchestration: Administer and scale virtualized environments and containerized workloads. Security & Hardening: Implement system hardening policies and ensure both development and production infrastructures are secure following industry best practices. Observability & Monitoring: Deploy and manage monitoring and logging solutions to ensure system health and rapid incident detection. Incident Response: Participate in on-call rotations and lead incident response efforts to minimize downtime and resolve production issues effectively. SKILLS At least 2 - 3 years of experience in a related field Linux Expertise: Strong experience in Linux system administration (SUSE/SLES experience is a significant plus). Automation & Provisioning: Hands-on experience with tools such as AutoYaST, Ansible, or SUSE Kiwi . Programming & Scripting: Advanced proficiency in Bash and Python . Strong capability in systems-level programming with C++ or Go for developing custom infrastructure tools and automation. Virtualization & Orchestration: Proven experience with vSphere, KVM, Docker, and Kubernetes (K8s) . Networking Fundamentals: Solid understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Firewalls, Load Balancers, and VPNs . Cybersecurity: Solid understanding of System Hardening and infrastructure security principles. Observability: Experience with monitoring stacks (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, Zabbix, etc.). Service & Tool Management: Proven experience installing and configuring enterprise tools such as Ticketing systems, Atlassian products, and database services. Familiarity with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions). Preferred Qualifications (Nice-to-Have) Relevant certifications (e.g., SUSE Certified Engineer, Red Hat, CKA). Experience managing physical hardware and data center operations. Candidates must meet all legal and professional requirements for the role. WHICH BENEFITS WILL YOU HAVE AS AIRBUS EMPLOYEE? At Airbus we are focused on our employees and their welfare. Take a look at some of our social benefits: Vacation days and additional days-off along the year (+35 days off in total). Attractive salary and compensation package. Hybrid model of working when possible, promoting the work-life balance (40% remote work). Collective transport service in some sites. items.desc: Vill du bidra till energiomställningen och vara med och säkerställa att produkter inom energi och inomhusklimat uppfyller krav på kvalitet, säkerhet och prestanda? Vi söker dig som har en ingenjörsutbildning inom energiteknik eller annat närliggande teknikområde och som vill utvecklas inom produktcertifiering. Om oss RISE Certifiering är en av Sveriges ledande aktörer inom produkt-, ledningssystem- och personcertifiering. Vi består av cirka 100 kollegor med bred teknisk kompetens och ett tydligt uppdrag, att skapa förtroende och bidra till ett tryggt och hållbart samhälle. Om rollen Som ingenjör inom produktcertifiering blir du en del av ett engagerat och stöttande team med cirka 30 ingenjörer och administratörer i en utvecklande och prestigelös arbetsmiljö. Genom våra produktcertifieringar hjälper vi företag att visa kravuppfyllnad och få tillträde till nationella och internationella marknader. Du arbetar med hela certifieringsprocessen och är uppdragsledare, från kunddialog och planering till teknisk granskning, certifikat och slutleverans. Rollen passar dig som vill kombinera teknisk analys med kunddialog och relationsskapande. Du arbetar med många olika uppdrag, produkter, tillverkare och tekniska lösningar samtidigt och du möter en stor variation i dessa. Du får en bredare teknisk överblick, bygger spetskompetens inom regelverk och standarder samt får arbeta nära innovativa företag och framtidens tekniska lösningar. Du får successivt med stöd av introduktion och mentorer bygga en bred kompetens inom hur tekniska krav, provningsresultat, standarder och tillverkningsprocesser hänger ihop. På några års sikt har du möjlighet att utvecklas till specialist inom energiprodukters regelverk, standarder och certifiering. För den som vill finns även möjligheter att bidra till utveckling av nya certifieringsområden, regelverk och internationella samarbeten. Här arbetar du med både etablerade produkter och morgondagens innovationer. Du får tidig insyn i ny teknik och framtida krav, samtidigt som du bidrar till kvalitetssäkring och certifiering av produkter som redan spelar en viktig roll i samhället. Genom nära samarbete med ledande tillverkare och branschaktörer bygger du ett unikt nätverk och en bred teknisk överblick. Rollen omfattar bland annat att: Driva och planera uppdrag självständigt. Kundmöten och offertarbete. Utvärdera och granska teknisk dokumentation och provningsresultat. Verifiera överensstämmelse mot relevanta standarder och regelverk. Följa upp tekniska frågor tillsammans med kunder och interna specialister. Framtagande av nya kravspecifikationer och certifieringsregler. Du kan exempelvis komma att arbeta med värmepumpar, ventilationssystem och fjärrvärmecentraler. Bedömningarna kan omfatta egenskaper som energieffektivitet, brandsäkerhet, täthet, hållfasthet och andra krav som regleras genom standarder, byggregler och certifieringsregler. Placeringsort: Borås Vem är du? Vi söker dig som trivs i en roll där du får kombinera självständigt arbete med nära samarbete. Du har en god samarbetsförmåga och bidrar aktivt till ett öppet och konstruktivt arbetsklimat. Med din kommunikativa och relationsskapande förmåga bygger du förtroende både internt och i dialogen med kunder och samarbetspartners. Du arbetar strukturerat och har ett starkt kvalitetsfokus, vilket gör att du kan hantera flera parallella uppdrag och leverera med hög precision. Samtidigt har du en god analytisk och problemlösande förmåga. Du kan tolka krav, identifiera avvikelser och fatta välgrundade beslut i komplexa tekniska frågeställningar. Krav Teknisk högskoleutbildning med inriktning mot energiteknik eller värme- och kylteknik. Några års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet, inom produktutveckling, konstruktion, tillverkningsindustri, provning och certifiering eller teknisk konsultverksamhet inom energi, installation eller ventilation. Förmåga att förstå, analysera och bedöma tekniska krav. God IT-vana och erfarenhet av att arbeta i affärssystem och digitala verktyg. Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i tal och skrift. Meriterande Kunskap inom provning, standarder, regelverk. Kunskap om ekodesign och energimärkning. Välkommen med din ansökan! Låter det intressant? Kontakta gärna gruppchef Stefan Coric, 010-516 60 73 eller gruppchef Anton Falk 010-516 61 36. Sista ansökningsdag är 2026-11-25. Urval & intervjuer kommer att ske löpande under ansökningsperioden. Våra fackliga representanter är; Linda Ikatti, Unionen, 010-516 51 61, och Ingemar Petermann, SACO, +46 10 228 41 22.

As a leading home delivery provider in Sweden, we've grown by 50%+ annually and are approaching SEK 1 billion in revenue. And we're just getting started. We're large enough to operate at real scale, yet small enough for one leader to fundamentally change how the company works. We believe technology should remove complexity, not create it. The Role We're looking for a CTO to lead the next chapter of our technology platform and turn engineering into a lasting competitive advantage. This is a builder-operator role. You'll modernize a business-critical platform while keeping a fast-growing, high-volume operation running every day. Our technology combines a PostgreSQL core, serverless services on AWS, web dashboards and native courier and customer apps. It powers route optimization, live tracking and dynamic ETAs across millions of deliveries. Your challenge is to evolve this architecture into a reliable, scalable and increasingly automated platform, while driving engineering performance through clear priorities, ownership and disciplined execution. Reporting directly to the CEO and serving on the Management Team, you'll have the mandate to shape our technology strategy, make critical architectural decisions and ensure technology delivers measurable business impact. Your mission: enable Airmee to scale faster, without scaling complexity or compromising today's operations. What success looks like Within this role you will: Modernise the platform without disrupting it — lead the decomposition of our central architecture into isolated, resilient building blocks, sequenced around peak season. Make reliability the default — a platform designed for 2x peak volume, with mature observability and real-time systems that hold up under load. Build a data platform the business trusts — clear ingestion, transformation and governance layers, and one version of the truth from operational dashboards to Board reporting. Make reliability and security the default — establish strong observability, engineering standards and security practices and certifications that scale with the business. Build an engineering organisation that absorbs change without losing speed — clear ownership, documentation, modular work and disciplined ways of pausing and restarting. Scale our advantage in AI and automation — build on years of AI-driven optimization to accelerate engineering productivity, automate operations and unlock new capabilities. What you'll own You'll own: Technology strategy and architecture — set the technical direction, make critical architectural decisions and lead platform modernization while balancing long-term investments with business priorities. Engineering, Product and Data leadership — ensure teams deliver results with clear ownership, accountability, high standards and speed of execution. Platform reliability and performance — ensure our systems are scalable, secure, cost-efficient and reliable across business-critical operations. Product and technology delivery — turn business needs into scalable products and capabilities, with predictable delivery, high quality and speed. Security and compliance — establish security by design, robust engineering practices and accountability for regulatory requirements. Who we're looking for We're looking for a technically exceptional leader who loves building, scaling and operating technology. Someone who sees technology as the operating system of the business, not a separate function. Who combines long-term architectural thinking with the urgency to deliver results today. You probably recognize yourself in several of these: You've built and scaled business-critical platforms, ideally through significant architectural transitions while maintaining live operations. You have deep technical expertise and the judgment to challenge architectural decisions, without needing to make every decision yourself. You know how to drive performance and accountability across engineering teams, ensuring priorities translate into measurable results. You combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution — comfortable discussing technology strategy with the Management team and diving into technical problems with engineers. You know how to prioritize ruthlessly, protect engineering focus and deliver at speed without compromising reliability. You believe great systems and strong teams outperform heroic individuals. You have a continuous improvement mindset, always looking for ways to develop yourself and your team, and see AI and automation as tools to accelerate progress. You understand that great engineering is measured by the business outcomes it enables, not technical sophistication alone. Experience we're looking for Proven experience as …

items.desc: Att bygga en säker digital framtid handlar om mer än teknik. Det handlar om att hitta rätt balans mellan innovation, risk och affärsvärde. På SBAB står vi mitt i en spännande utveckling där AI, molnteknik och modern produktutveckling skapar nya möjligheter. Nu söker vi en IT- säkerhetsarkitekt som vill vara med och forma vägen framåt. Vi är tillräckligt små för att du ska kunna påverka på riktigt och tillräckligt stora för att göra skillnad i en hel bransch. Vardagen som IT-säkerhetsarkitekt Du tillhör området Tech Security, som ansvarar för IT-säkerhetsövervakning, incidenthantering, hot- och omvärldsbevakning samt de tekniska verktyg och plattformar som skyddar SBAB. I rollen som IT-säkerhetsarkitekt samarbetar du nära andra arkitekter, utvecklings- och driftteam och arbetar tätt ihop med IT-säkerhetschefen. Utveckla SBAB:s säkerhetsförmåga : Du ansvarar för att vidareutveckla och förvalta SBAB:s tekniska säkerhetsstyrning samt säkerhetsarkitektur. I en miljö präglad av molntjänster, AI och automation säkerställer du att säkerhet integreras tidigt i utvecklings- och förändringsinitiativ och att säkerhetskrav omsätts till lösningar som fungerar i praktiken. Rollen innebär ett stort mandat att påverka hur säkerhet byggs in i framtida lösningar och arbetssätt. Omsätta säkerhetskrav i praktiken : Du kravställer mot övriga IT-verksamheten inom IT-säkerhet. Du kombinerar strategiskt tänkande med ett operativt arbetssätt. Genom att definiera riktlinjer, delta i projekt, genomföra riskanalyser kopplade till tekniska initiativ samt föreslå och driva igenom säkra lösningar säkerställer du att säkerhetskrav integreras i arkitektur, plattformar och tekniska initiativ på ett sätt som skapar affärsvärde. Vara ett rådgivande stöd : Du fungerar som ett viktigt stöd till våra utvecklingsteam, arkitekter och andra intressenter internt. Genom att förankra och förklara säkerhetsrisker och säkerhetskrav på ett tydligt och pedagogiskt sätt bidrar du till välgrundade beslut och hållbara lösningar. Utveckla och stärka bankens leverantörsuppföljning: Ur ett IT-säkerhetsperspektiv arbetar du i ett nära samarbete med exempelvis inköp och juridik för att vidareutveckla vår leverantörsuppföljning. Rollen säkerställer att säkerhetskrav efterlevs i både interna och outsourcade lösningar. Rollen kombinerar strategiskt arbete med praktiskt deltagande i lösningar. Du kommer inte bara att definiera krav och riktlinjer, utan också vara en aktiv part i projekt, riskanalyser och tekniska initiativ. Kollegan vi söker Vi söker dig som har en teknisk förståelse och trivs i en roll som länk mellan säkerhet, arkitektur och verksamhetsstyrning. För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du: Har erfarenhet av teknisk IT-arkitektur och molnarkitektur, gärna AWS. Förstår moderna plattformar, integrationer, IAM, Zero Trust och CI/CD. Har erfarenhet av att ta fram styrning, arkitekturprinciper och tekniska krav. Har kunskap inom säker användning av AI, agentisk AI och ny teknik. Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet från bank-, finans- eller försäkringssektorn, eller om du tidigare varit med och byggt säkerhets- eller AI-plattformar. För att lyckas och trivas i rollen tror vi att du har ett gott omdöme och förmåga att fatta välgrundade beslut även i komplexa situationer där olika perspektiv, risker och behov behöver vägas mot varandra. Du har ett helhetsperspektiv och kan se hur tekniska vägval påverkar såväl arkitekturen som verksamheten i stort. Samtidigt är du pragmatisk och lösningsorienterad, med fokus på att hitta vägar framåt som skapar värde för verksamheten. Du är även skicklig på att kommunicera och förankra dina budskap hos olika intressenter samt kan på ett pedagogiskt och övertygande sätt presentera risker, rekommendationer och beslut.

items.desc: Vill du använda din meteorologiska expertis för att göra skillnad på riktigt? Missa inte möjligheten att bli en del av vårt team och att få bidra till att stärka hela samhällets hållbarhet. SMHI är en svensk expertmyndighet med globalt perspektiv och en livsviktig uppgift i att förutse förändringar i väder, vatten och klimat. På vetenskaplig grund och genom kunskap, forskning och tjänster bidrar vi till att öka hela samhällets hållbarhet. Till enheten Prognos väder söker vi nu en prognosmeteorolog. Enheten Prognos väder är uppdelad i tre grupper, placerade på kontoren i Norrköping, Göteborg och Uppsala och som tillsammans består av ca 75 kunniga och engagerade prognosmeteorologer. Varje kontor har sin specifika nisch, därmed skiljer sig arbetsuppgifterna lite åt beroende på vilket kontor man arbetar vid. Nu söker vi en medarbetare till kontoret i Norrköping där du kommer bli en del av ett härligt team bestående av 25 prognosmeteorologer. Din arbetsplats finns på ett modernt kontor med närhet till restaurang och gym. Hos oss möts du av en trivsam arbetsmiljö och hög professionalism. Om tjänsten I arbetet ingår att ta fram och leverera väder- och varningsinformation till allmänheten och professionella kunder. Vi bistår bland annat kommuner, myndigheter och privata kunder med prognoser och varningsinformation samt levererar innehåll till vår hemsida och sociala medier. Det innebär mycket kontakt och samarbeten bland annat med Sveriges Radio för skriftliga och muntliga väderprognoser, samt med kunder inom sjöfart, bygg- och anläggning, energimarknaden och inom väg- och spårtrafik. Som meteorolog på SMHI har man daglig kontakt med kunder och det ställs därför stora krav på servicekänsla och professionalitet. Utöver kontakt med externa parter kan du även ingå i olika projekt och utvecklingsarbeten med andra delar av SMHI där din kunskap inom meteorologi kommer till användning. Du förväntas också delta i olika typer av verksamhetsutveckling och projekt utanför vakttjänst, där din meteorologiska expertis kan komma till nytta. Arbetet kan även ske utanför den egna gruppen. Arbetsuppgifterna i vakttjänst innebär till stor del skiftarbete med tjänstgöring både vardagar och helgdagar, året om och under dygnets alla timmar. Vilken typ av arbetsuppgifter du kommer att ha beror på verksamhetens behov och vi ser då till alla kontorens produktionsområden, men även personliga intressen och särskilda kompetenser beaktas. SMHI ansvarar även för den civila flygväderproduktionen i Sverige och levererar väderprognoser och varningar för luftfarten i samarbete med danska DMI. Om dig Vi söker dig som har meteorologisk utbildning eller motsvarande, som uppfyller WMO:s kompetenskrav, samt genomgången PMU (Praktisk Meteorologisk Utbildning). Du har god datorvana och mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och goda kunskaper i engelska är ett krav. Andra språkkunskaper är meriterande. Radioframträdanden och briefingar för olika kunder utgör en viktig del i arbetet därför ställs extra krav på presentations- /kommunikationsförmåga. Det är vidare meriterande med: Erfarenhet av meteorologiskt prognosarbete, samt kännedom om hydrologi och oceanografi Erfarenhet av att medverka i radio eller TV- sändningar med väderinnehåll Erfarenhet av energibranschen Erfarenhet av projektarbete och av att ha jobbat som utbildare eller lärare Erfarenhet av att arbeta med sociala medier/rörlig bild/kommunikation/webbsidor Programmeringskunskaper samt kunskap eller erfarenhet av AI/ML Som person behöver du vara kommunikativ, utåtriktad och ha lätt för att samarbeta då mycket av arbetet utförs med dina kollegor eller i kontakt med kunder. Du måste ha ett genuint intresse för meteorologi och väder och en god analytisk förmåga. Eftersom intensitet och arbetsuppgifter varierar är flexibilitet och förmåga att handla rationellt i stressiga situationer av stor vikt. Du ska kunna planera och strukturera effektivt samt uppvisa ett resultatorienterat driv i dina arbetsuppgifter. Vi ser även ett stort värde i förmågan att aktivt driva verksamhetens utveckling och bidra till en trivsam stämning. Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning Arbetstid: Prognosarbete sker enligt fastställda passtider, skifttjänstgöring året runt. Placeringsort: Placering är på vårt kontor i Norrköping. En majoritet av din arbetstid är på kontoret och du har möjlighet att arbeta hemifrån när det passar verksamheten. Sista ansökningsdag: Välkommen med din ansökan senast 2026-11-29 Läs mer om SMHI som arbetsplats och om vårt erbjudande här. SMHI är en svensk expertmyndighet med globalt perspektiv och en livsviktig uppgift i att förutse förändringar i väder, vatten och klimat. Med vetenskaplig grund och genom kunskap, forskning och tjänster bidrar vi till att öka hela samhällets hållbarhet. Varje dag, dygnet runt, året om. SMHI är en beredskapsmyndighet och som anställd kan du komma att krigsplaceras vid myndigheten. Anställningen kan komma att innebära placering i säkerhetsklass. Godkänd …

items.desc: Job Description Hej Software Engineer, Do you want to help shape the digital future of IKEA? With us, you can feel at home at work while sharing that feeling with millions of people around the world. We encourage you to ask questions, share your ideas, learn from mistakes and grow together with others. As our Software Engineer, you’ll have opportunities to try things you haven’t done before, while contributing to digital solutions that support how IKEA brings products to life and creates a better everyday life for the many people. We are on a journey to modernize our landscape, and we are looking for a curious Software Engineer who enjoys solving problems together with others to join the Digital Product Area ‘Range Core - Requirements and Compliance’ within Technology at Inter IKEA, Range Operations. Here you will help develop digital solutions that support product development, manufacturing, suppliers and the movement of IKEA products through our global value chain. We believe good software is created by teams where people bring different perspectives, share knowledge, ask questions and learn together. You don’t need to know everything from day one. Curiosity, collaboration and a willingness to keep learning matter to us. We are growing our team in Malmö and looking for someone who enjoys working with people across different roles, teams, cultures and locations. Qualifications Your new job We’re looking for a curious Software Engineer who enjoys solving problems and learning together with others. Your strengths might be in frontend or backend development, or somewhere in between. What matters to us is your curiosity, willingness to learn and interest in growing and contributing across the stack. You’ll join a cross-functional team building and maintaining digital products across the stack, from backend services, APIs, integrations and databases to web applications and user experiences. You’ll have opportunities to build on your strengths while developing your skills in other areas. Together, we experiment, share knowledge and continuously improve how we design, build, test and deliver software. Your work will have a global impact, helping co-workers, suppliers, and partners collaborate effectively and ensuring trusted IKEA products reach our customers. What we’d like you to bring to the table Experience building software solutions, with strengths in frontend, backend, or across the full stack. Experience with backend development using C#/.NET and REST APIs and/or frontend development using React, TypeScript or similar technologies. A good understanding of software design, data modelling, relational databases and building reliable, maintainable solutions. An ability to understand complex problems, break them down into manageable parts and work with others to find practical solutions. Experience with software testing and modern development practices, such as version control, continuous integration and automated delivery. Experience with cloud technologies such as Azure, GCP or AWS is valuable, but not essential. A collaborative mindset, curiosity and an interest in learning, sharing knowledge and improving together with your team. An interest in understanding the wider product and contributing beyond your main area of expertise. Additional Information Be yourself, a Software Engineer, and more! Inter IKEA Group is the group of companies that connects IKEA franchisees with range development and suppliers and aligns the overall IKEA strategic direction. Every day, we strive to develop, produce and sell products and services that are affordable and accessible to everyone. With us, you contribute to building a democratic brand and workplace that has a positive impact on both the planet and people's lives. Your health, wellbeing, and development matter most to us, and our benefits are designed with you in mind. As a co-worker and a person, you are an essential part of our down to earth, playful, and inclusive culture, collaborating with others across roles, departments, and even across the globe. In this curious and optimistic environment, you’ll find endless opportunities to grow. Make us the home of your career. We welcome your application Get ready to assemble something new! We look forward to receiving your application by 19th of November. Apply by submitting your CV. As part of the application process, you will be asked to answer a few screening questions. When answering the questions, please avoid relying on AI-generated responses. This position is based in Malmö, Sweden. We believe that your presence with the team and working the majority of the time in the workplace is important. Please also note that we only handle applications in English and no applications coming in by email. If you have any questions about the role or the recruitment process, feel free to connect with the Recruiter Monaka Perumal; monaka.perumal@inter.ikea.com. We always recruit based on values, competence, potential and diversity. …

items.desc: About Proxify Proxify is a global network of vetted remote software, data and AI professionals. We help companies scale their tech teams with world-class talent, typically delivering the right match within two days. Only about 1% of the 20,000+ people who apply each month make it into the network. Clients get speed, quality and flexibility, with real technical experts guiding every step, and none of the admin burden or risk of traditional hiring. About the role Do you speak fluent data, from pipelines and warehouses to dashboards and models, and love the idea of turning that knowledge into the perfect team for a client? This is your chance to be the technical expert behind every data match we make. As a Client Engineer (Data) , you'll be part of our client teams. You'll be the technical voice in front of clients and the person who decides which data professionals are right for them. Technical discovery : Run discovery calls with clients to understand their data landscape: stack, architecture, data maturity, team setup and business goals. Turn what you learn into a sharp role profile with the right skills, seniority and scope. Matching : Search and shortlist Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists and ML Engineers from the Proxify network. Interview them to assess technical depth and fit with the client's context. Candidate presentation : Write clear, convincing pitches that explain why each candidate fits, and support the client through interviews and decisions. Client advisory : Act as a trusted technical advisor. Challenge requirements when needed, and help clients shape roles that will actually solve their data problems. Collaboration : Work closely with Client Managers and Account Managers to meet client needs, keep timelines tight and grow long-term partnerships. Client focus : Startups, scaleups and enterprise companies building or scaling their data, analytics and AI capabilities. Why you'll love this opportunity at Proxify Help companies close their data skill gaps and create job opportunities for data professionals worldwide. Stay close to the tech: see dozens of modern data stacks and talk shop with top engineers every week. ️ Be part of a humble, supportive and tech-savvy team. Great opportunities for professional development and personal growth. ️ Work in a truly international team across 39 countries, with occasional in-person meetups. What you bring to be successful in this role 4+ years of hands-on experience as a Data Engineer, Analytics Engineer, Data Scientist or in a similar data role. Solid understanding of the modern data stack: SQL, Python, Spark, dbt, Airflow, and cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks or Redshift. Working knowledge of at least one major cloud (AWS, Azure or GCP). Ability to quickly read a client's data challenge and translate it into the right skills, seniority and profile. Confidence to run technical interviews and judge candidates across data engineering, analytics and ML. Strong ownership mindset with a bias for action and high quality. Naturally curious, sociable and comfortable in client-facing conversations. A humble team player who thrives in a performance-oriented environment. Native-level English. Bonus points : experience in consulting, solutions engineering, technical recruiting or pre-sales; exposure to MLOps, data governance or GenAI/LLM projects; additional languages (e.g. German, Swedish, French or Spanish). Why it may not be your match You prefer to stay heads-down in code. This role is about people and judgment as much as technology, and you'll be talking to clients and candidates every day. You like every day to look the same. We build as we go and keep things agile. You haven't worked hands-on with data yourself. You'll be assessing experienced data professionals, so you need to have been in their shoes. Department : Business · Location : Remote / Stockholm (HQ)
