items.desc:
Who we are 
 Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards. 
 As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously. 
 We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications. 
 The role 
 At Helsing we develop and deliver AI-based capabilities and the enabling infrastructure that allow semi-autonomous platforms to localise, navigate , and perceive the world in real time. We build software that is subject to significant and unorthodox technical constraints, must operate in a wide variety of constantly-changing environments, and has to support an ever-growing list of challenging use-cases. What we build ultimately ends up in the hands of real people in high-risk, high-stress situations, so must be both reliable and frictionless. Taken together, this brings a whole host of interesting engineering challenges across a wide variety of fields that you’ll help us solve. To give some examples :
 Distributed systems (e.g., intermittent connectivity and byzantine actors)
 Embedded computing (e.g., resource-constrained compute and reverse-engineering)
 Robotics (e.g., control systems and tasking)
 Networking (e.g., long-range low-bandwidth radios and cross-medium routing)
 Deployment infrastructure (e.g., air-gapped devices and heterogenous fleets)
 Security (e.g., data sharing in low-trust, no-TLS networks and actually-secret data handling)
 Machine learning (e.g., systems for model development, storage, and dissemination)
 In several of these areas, we are working near the state-of-the-art; we actively read (and sometimes implement) research papers, and often need to push even further to make theory work in practice. In others, we are applying well-known techniques to real-world situations (with real-world limitations) that have never been used in before, which requires skill, diligence, and honing a deep understanding of the underlying technologies.
 The day-to-day 
 Review code contributions, proposals, and RFCs from colleagues. At Helsing we strongly believe that unblocking others takes precedence over spending more time on your own work.
 Propose and implement new features, capabilities, algorithms, infrastructure, or even full products across our stack. We encourage our engineers to look beyond their immediate team for missed opportunities, and to speak up when they identify one.
 Become a mentor, find a mentee, and help support and develop our interviewing pipeline. The people make or break the company, and we want as many engineers as possible to be part of fostering and growing the organisation.
 Share your experience and technical know-how with other Helsingers. We host tech talks, get together for smaller “let’s learn together” groups, run topical office hours (e.g., on Rust), etc. to help each other get better with time.
 Maintain our existing software stack, including working with internal and external customers to identify issues, improving operational reliability and performance, and fending off technical debt. The stack is a mix of Rust and Python, with Python mainly living in the ML-heavy sections.
 Further develop our tests and benchmarks, both at the micro and macro level. We operate in a domain where robustness is of the utmost importance, and an extensive and ever-improving test suite is key to achieving that. And without thorough benchmarks, we would be flying blind.
 Present your work at our weekly demo sessions. We want engineers to come together around what they are working on and to feel like they are not endlessly squirrelling away at something that doesn’t matter. To that end, we host (and actively work towards) demo sessions that allow early feedback, celebration of progress, and a better shared understanding of everything that goes on at Helsing.
 You should apply if you 
 Can write legible, maintainable, and performant code.
 Communicate well in English, both verbally and in writing.
 Enjoy collaborating with others, including reviewing code and pair programming.
 Are comfortable working asynchronously (writing PRs and RFCs, having discussions by email).
 Have backend development experience, ideally with a language like Rust, Java, Go, or C++.
 Are familiar with backend interface tools like REST, GraphQL, gRPC/Protocol Buffers, and Arrow.
 Strive to improve yourself, your peers, and the culture you work in over time.
 Feel like ethical …

items.desc:
Who we are 
 Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards. 
 As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously.

We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications. 
 The role 
 As an Environment Test Engineer, you will be responsible for the design, execution, and analysis of environmental stress test campaigns across the full range of Interceptor sub-systems and Ground Support Equipment (GSE). As a generalist within the Environmental Cluster, you will apply your knowledge to mechanical, thermal, and environmental qualification—across multiple hardware domains. The Environmental Cluster is the "Physical Reality" team within the Test Department. Where other clusters validate functionality, the Environmental Cluster validates survivability and performance under real-world stress.
 The cluster is organized around domain specialists—Launch Systems, Ground Communication Systems—but requires a generalist backbone to ensure test coverage continuity across all sub-systems, absorb campaign overflows from specialist engineers, and extend the cluster's capability into emerging and sensitive hardware domains.
 The day-to-day
 Vibration & Shock Campaigns: Designing and executing vibration test campaigns (sine sweep, random vibration, shock) on drone sub-systems and GSE hardware to simulate transport, operational, and launch-induced dynamic environments.
 Thermal Soak & Cycling: Executing controlled thermal exposure tests across the full operational temperature range on any sub-system assigned by the Head of Testing or cluster lead.
 IP & Ingress Testing: Executing dust and water ingress tests on drone enclosures, connectors, and GSE hardware to validate field survivability.
 Humidity, Salt Spray & Corrosion: Running humidity-controlled and salt-spray campaigns to identify corrosion risks in connectors, structural joints, and electronic housings.
 Altitude Simulation: Validating component behaviour under simulated low-pressure conditions relevant to the operational altitude range of the drone.
 Fatigue & Endurance: Running high-cycle mechanical campaigns to characterize material and joint fatigue over the required operational life of any assigned sub-system.
 Failure Mode Boundary Testing: Deliberately pushing hardware beyond its design limits to physically map the failure envelope and validate safety margins across all assigned sub-systems.
 You should apply if you 
 Environmental Standards Literacy: Working knowledge of applicable standards as the primary frameworks for environmental test campaign design and execution.
 Instrumentation & DAQ: Expert in physical instrumentation—strain gauges, accelerometers, thermocouples, pressure transducers, and load cells. Ability to configure and operate DAQ systems across a wide range of test scenarios.
 Mechanical Systems Understanding: Solid understanding of structural mechanics, material fatigue, vibration dynamics, and shock response for both metallic and composite structures.
 Thermal Testing: Experience with thermal chambers, thermal cycling rigs, IR cameras, and thermocouple mapping.
 Environmental Test Equipment Operation: Hands-on experience operating vibration tables, shock rigs, thermal chambers, IP spray equipment, and salt-spray cabinets.
 Metrology: Proficient with precision measurement tools (load frames, calipers, torque meters, dimensional gauges) for pre- and post-test validation.
 Awareness of ITAR/EAR export control obligations when handling test data and reports related to lethality hardware.

 Bachelor's degree (B.Sc. or B.Eng.) in a relevant engineering discipline.
 Direct experience with environmental chamber operation, vibration testing, and physical instrumentation is mandatory.
 Prior exposure to defense, dual-use, or regulated hardware in a test context is strongly preferred.
 Basic familiarity with Weapons Hardware Constraints: Understanding of the physical and regulatory constraints that govern the environmental testing of defense-related hardware.

 Airworthiness is a system-level requirement. We cannot certify an aircraft if the launcher or the control link hasn’t been rigorously de-risked. This role professionalizes our Ground-Side Engineering, moving our failure rate from the expensive flight-test phase to the low-cost laboratory phase. It is an investment in crash prevention and regulatory compliance.
 The day-to-day
 · Pre-Flight De-risking: Executing high-repetition "burn-in" tests on all new firmware and hardware configurations for the Ground Control Station and data links .
 · Launch System Validation: Engineering tests for mechanical launch systems to ensure repeatable, safe exit velocities and structural integrity .
 · The "Iron Bird" Connection: Acting as the link to the IRB Team by maintaining a ground-based "Iron Bird" to test system-wide reactions to simulated component failures .
 · Regression Library: Building a library of ground-side edge cases and failure cases that must be passed before any new sub-system is cleared for flight integration .
 · Documentation of Proof: Generating technical "De-risking Reports" and managing relevant testing cards in JIRA .

 · Infrastructure & GSE Mastery: Deep technical understanding of Ground Control Stations (GCS), pneumatic/mechanical launchers, tracking antenna arrays, and ruggedized power and control systems.
 · Interface & Protocol Testing: Ability to sniff and analyse communication protocols between ground and air (IRONBIRD) to de-risk command-and-control latency and packet loss.
 · HIL/SIL Setup: Experience building and maintaining Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) and Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) environments to simulate flight triggers on the bench.
 · Environmental & Stress Testing: Competence in vibration, thermal, and EMI (Electromagnetic Interference) "torture tests" on supporting hardware to ensure field survivability.
 · Diagnostic Tooling: Skilled in the use of oscilloscopes, spectrum analysers, and network protocol analysers to perform root-cause analysis on ground-side hardware failures.

items.desc:
Product Engineer 
 Scandit TAMPERE 
 Imagine the What. Build the How.
 Scandit gives people superpowers. Whether enabling delivery drivers to make quicker deliveries, matching a patient with their medication or allowing retailers to make store operations more efficient, our technology automates workflows and provides actionable insights to help businesses in a variety of industries. Join us, as we continue to expand, grow and innovate, and help take Scandit to the next level.
 About the Role 
 As one of Scandit's Product Engineers, you will work as part of the product squad to evaluate and build out our solution capabilities using multi-barcode reading, tracking, augmented reality, and text recognition. You will partner closely across the software engineering and product teams to develop new products and features, as well as continuously optimize our existing products.
 You'll ensure new developments and features meet our performance, user experience, and enterprise-grade standards, while solving customers' challenges along the way. Based on a hypothesis-driven discovery approach with direct customer feedback, you'll collect data and evidence to understand the challenges and product requirements in detail. Daily interaction with our engineering teams will ensure a fast feedback loop and agile development.
 What You Will Do 
 Responsibilities include working with customers to understand their needs, building proof of concepts, and evaluating the technical performance of existing products. This ensures data capture quality and performance meet enterprise-grade standards at every stage of development, including rebuilding setups and replicating customer use cases in our labs.
 Work closely together with engineering and the wider product team to define product quality metrics of prototypes and products
 Build test systems for measuring the quality and performance of new product features or improvements
 Evaluate and drive the analysis of customer feedback and requests
 Who You Are 
 As an ideal candidate, you have initial programming experience, and you're interested in building functional prototypes and test setups with a strong focus on user and customer needs. You're data-driven and thrive in fast-paced evaluation work. You enjoy communicating with technical or business stakeholders, as well as discussing product specifications with the wider product team.
 Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Computer Science, ideally with an industrial engineering or robotics background
 2+ years of industry experience
 Strong customer focus and problem-solving skills
 A metric- and data-driven mindset
 Interest in working on the intersection of engineering and business
 Excellent English communication skills, both oral and written
 Eligible to work in Finland and available to work at our Tampere office at least 3 days per week 
 Our Approach To AI 
 AI is part of how we work. Scandit embraces AI-native engineering, where engineers direct agents to deliver customer outcomes, using the tools they choose. We want to know how you use them, where you’ve hit their limits, and how you keep improving human-agent collaboration. We take pride in our craft, and that means making sure what agents deliver meets our quality bar.
 What We Offer 
 Here are some of the reasons people choose to build their career at Scandit:
 Certified as a Great Place To Work for four years in a row
 Rated 4/5 by our employees on Glassdoor
 Access to Claude Cowork and Claude Code, plus a budget to experiment with other AI tools
 Weekly “How to Use AI” sessions and internal AI Champions to help turn your ideas into reality
 A share in our success through an individual equity plan
 Extra days off on top of your annual leave
 Office shutdown days, global team events and innovation hackathons
 Plus specific benefits depending on the location you are joining.

 For our Helicopters Division we are looking for an Airworthiness Governance Specialist. 
 Key Responsibilities
 Perform risk analyses using qualitative and quantitative safety methodologies to evaluate the probability of risk associated with in-service events (Occurrence Reports) and verify compliance with applicable certification objectives.
 Develop and validate, in collaboration with relevant technical departments, methods and tools supporting risk assessment activities and addressing stakeholder needs within the Continued Airworthiness domain.
 Develop, harmonize, and continuously improve Continued Airworthiness guidelines and procedures in cooperation with internal stakeholders.
 Main Activities
 Perform hazard analyses using the appropriate methodology based on the type of in-service event, including: System Safety Functional Hazard Assessment (FHA), System Safety Analysis (SSA), and Fault Tree Analysis (FTA). Part Detachment Evaluation, assessing the probability of injury to third parties in accordance with applicable guidelines. Quality Alert analyses related to manufacturing or production issues. Statistical analyses using appropriate methods for the scenario under evaluation. Human Factors analyses to assess the contribution of human performance to reported occurrences.
 When an unsafe condition is identified, calculate the applicable Compliance Time for containment actions in accordance with EASA AMC & GM to Part 21 requirements.
 Support discussions with Aviation Authorities regarding Occurrence Report classification and Compliance Time determination.
 Support the Continued Airworthiness Governance Manager in managing: Safety Information Bulletins (SIB). 
 Continued Airworthiness Review Items (CARI), including stakeholder coordination and preparation of supporting documentation. 
 Continued Airworthiness KPIs, including development, monitoring, trend analysis, and reporting.
 Prepare technical documentation supporting the development and implementation of processes and tools aligned with the Continued Airworthiness mission, vision, and applicable regulatory framework.

 Master's Degree in Aeronautical Engineering (or equivalent Aerospace Engineering discipline).
 English language proficiency at B2 level or higher, both written and spoken.
 Key Competencies
 Safety and risk assessment methodologies.
 Analytical and problem-solving skills.
 Stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration.

 Knowledge of Continued Airworthiness principles and aviation regulatory frameworks.

items.desc:
Your contribution to something big: 
 As a Metrology Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the reliability, metrological traceability, and compliance of measuring equipment, data acquisition systems, and test benches.  Your responsibilities will include: 
 Planning and executing calibrations of measuring instruments and testing systems.
 Defining and maintaining calibration plans and periodic verification schedules.
 Ensuring metrological traceability to national and international standards.
 Analyzing calibration certificates and evaluating measurement uncertainties.
 Investigating deviations, instrument drift, and measurement failures.
 Developing calibration procedures, instructions, and best practices.
 Supporting internal and external audits related to metrology and compliance (ISO 9001, ISO/IEC 17025).
 Managing suppliers and external calibration laboratories.
 Validating new sensors, equipment, and data acquisition (DAQ) systems.
 Supporting development, laboratory, and quality teams in interpreting test results.
 Identifying opportunities and actively contributing to the implementation of process enhancements.
What distinguishes you: 
 Education 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, Industrial Engineering and Management (with appropriate specialization), or a comparable field.
 Experience & Know-how 
 Hands-on experience with calibration of temperature, pressure, gas/water flow, humidity, and electrical parameters (voltage, current, resistance, power).
 Experience in applied metrology and traceability management.
 Proficiency in calculating and analyzing measurement uncertainty.
 Familiarity with data acquisition systems (DAQ), industrial instrumentation, and electronics.
 Exposure to applied statistics and data analysis.
 Knowledge of automation and control systems.
 Experience with calibration software, LabVIEW, Excel, Power BI, or equivalent tools.
 Specific training in Metrology or ISO/IEC 17025 is a strong advantage.
 Languages 
 Fluent in English (written and spoken).
 Working Style and Methods 
 Rigorous and detail oriented.
 Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
 Well-organized with the ability to prioritize tasks in a dynamic environment.
 Willingness to travel.

 Strong collaboration skills and ability to work in cross-functional and international teams.

Overview 
 The Global eCommerce and Web team at Microsoft owns the online store experience across Windows, Microsoft 365, Surface, Copilot and Xbox. We put the consumer at the center, helping them discover, learn and buy through Microsoft's direct online channel in more than 120 countries around the world. We are looking for an eCommerce Site Merchandiser for Surface to join our Global eCommerce and Web team supporting the EMEA region. 
 In this role you will own the Surface online shopping experience for the EMEA Microsoft Store, creating and executing merchandising strategies that drive Surface and accessories revenue. You will manage the Surface category pages and buy flows, ensuring every customer can easily discover, compare, configure and buy the right device. You will use personalization and experimentation tactics, together with data, analytics and customer insights, to improve the Surface customer journey and increase conversion, and you will be accountable end to end for Surface onsite merchandising in EMEA. 
 You will work closely with a range of teams, including the Surface Category and Product Marketing teams, EMEA Site Merchandising, Regional Digital Sales, Integrated Marketing, Store Studio and Production Operations, to deliver a cohesive, effective customer experience that supports Surface business priorities and targets. 
 You will also drive SEO planning and implementation for Surface pages in EMEA, in close collaboration with the global SEO team and the EMEA SEO virtual team, executing changes alongside the EMEA Site Merchandising Lead, fellow category site merchandisers and the outsourced site merchandising team. In addition, you will lead EMEA site merchandising for Surface product launches, refreshes and lifecycle moments, driving the testing plan from an EMEA market perspective in line with global strategy and in close collaboration with global partners. 
 We are looking for an action-oriented, out-of-the-box thinker who is comfortable using data, turning it into actionable insights and identifying optimization opportunities. Successful candidates will be able to articulate what drives the Surface business, analyze traffic and web funnel patterns, go deep into conversion metrics, and identify where the customer journey should be improved and how that improvement can impact revenue. The successful Site Merchandiser will combine a detail-oriented approach with a genuine interest in what drives customers to buy premium devices, and a bias for action. 
 At our core, we are a customer-focused team that fosters a diverse and inclusive culture. We are respectful, collaborative and accountable to each other, and we approach our work with a positive attitude. The right candidate can expect opportunities for career growth and development. 
 How you will make an impact 
 Raise and maintain the standards needed for best-in-class onsite strategy and execution across the entire customer journey, putting our customers first

 Develop insight-driven narratives with sound recommendations and solid action plans 
 Build strong relationships with Microsoft teams globally to create exceptional customer experiences, scale programs, establish best practices and share knowledge

 Create, curate and optimize customer journeys that maximize learning and buying for our customers.

 Collaborate with Store Studio and other regions to develop visual mock-ups for Surface pages and launches, ensuring alignment on imagery, messaging and timing. 
 Apply strong project management across a variety of tasks with differing deadlines and priorities, share plans with relevant stakeholders, and manage time effectively to get things done in a fast-paced environment.

Overview 
 As a Critical Environment Technician (CET) in Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) team, you will maintain the critical infrastructure that keeps our Datacenters up and running. This could be anything from coordinating with supplier/vendors, working closely with Management to address operational, risk and safety situations, mentoring other CE Technicians, having a hands-on understanding on how critical environment equipment works, performing various types of maintenance, responding to onsite incidents while coordinating with other critical facilities professionals, and using telemetry and other platforms to monitor equipment performance and operations.
 Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I Critical Environment Technician, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications.
 Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 datacenters in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our datacenter design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider. 
 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. 
 Responsibilities 
 Serve as an operations specialist in one major area of CE operations (e.g., electrical, mechanical, controls, generators) and works on advanced tasks independently.
 Inspect and supervise critical environment-related facility equipment (e.g., controls, heating, ventilation, and air conditioning [HVAC], mechanical systems), building, and grounds regularly for unsafe or abnormal conditions and escalate per applicable policies and standards. 
 Utilize internal computerized maintenance management system (CMMS) to track all equipment assets and to complete work order requests for maintenance work.
 Safely and quickly respond to and leads onsite incident response teams for all abnormal conditions that impact operations, and coordinates with other critical facilities professionals to perform corrective repairs without supervision.
 Enhance, develop new or follow preexisting emergency operating procedures (EOPs), methods of procedure (MOPs), and standard operating procedures (SOPs) in relation to CE operations and incidents.
 Perform various types of maintenance (e.g., planned, predictive, corrective) and repairs following methods of procedure (MOPs), and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for CE equipment (e.g., electrical, mechanical, cooling systems) and escalate when appropriate.
 Have a hands-on understanding of how equipment works and how to troubleshoot equipment, systems, subsystems, and components independently within their trained discipline(s).
 Provides consultation to lower-level colleagues in troubleshooting systems and problems.
 Understands, follows, and ensures safety and security requirements (e.g., job hazard assessments [JHAs], environmental health and safety (EH&S), toolbox talks), and business processes and procedures to properly perform work in a safe, quality, and reliable manner in accordance with applicable federal, state, local, and Microsoft requirements.
 Embody our culture and values .

Vous aimez l’analyse de risques et la relation client, vous avez le sens de la négociation et vous êtes prêt pour un nouveau challenge ! 
 Zurich France, entreprise appartenant à un groupe international de premier ordre, offre aux sociétés des solutions sur mesure et des concepts d’assurance innovants pour le transfert, le financement et la gestion de leurs risques. Nous sommes convaincus que notre développement et nos succès passent par ceux de nos collaborateurs : Formation, évolution de carrière, mobilité internationale sont une réalité pour chacun d’entre-nous. 
 Rôle: 
 Au sein du service Sinistres, et en étroite collaboration avec le Claims Governance Manager et le Chief Claims Officer (CCO), le/la Claims Governance Analyst a pour mission de garantir un cadre de gouvernance robuste sur l’ensemble des activités de gestion des sinistres de la BU. 
 Il/elle veille à ce que les processus et pratiques en place soient conformes aux exigences du Groupe Zurich, aux attentes du Régulateur et aux standards internes de la BU, et qu’ils soient effectivement appliqués par toutes les équipes concernées, qu’elles soient locales ou déléguées. 
 Activités : 
 Gouvernance & Contrôle 
 Veiller au respect des politiques, procédures et standards de gestion des sinistres au sein de la BU. 
 Assurer la conformité des process de gestion des sinistres aux guidelines du Groupe Zurich et aux exigences réglementaires applicables. 
 Participer à la rédaction, la mise à jour et la diffusion des guidelines sinistres (claims policies, procédures, modes opératoires) auprès des équipes concernées. 
 Mettre en place et maintenir un dispositif de contrôle interne sur les activités sinistres (revues régulières, contrôles ciblés, reporting). 
 Suivre, documenter et reporter les manquements aux process auprès des parties prenantes concernées (Claims Governance Manager, CCO, Groupe, fonctions de contrôle), et contribuer au suivi des plans de remédiation. 
 Assurer le suivi des réclamations sinistres reçues de la part des clients de Zurich, en s’assurant du respect des exigences réglementaires et des délais de traitement, et en contribuant à l’identification des causes racines et axes d’amélioration. 
 Audits & Planification 
 Réaliser des audits internes sur les dossiers sinistres (qualité de gestion, conformité aux process, complétude de la documentation, respect des délais, etc.). 
 Identifier les écarts par rapport aux standards, évaluer leur criticité et proposer des plans d’actions correctifs avec les équipes concernées. 
 Suivre les indicateurs de performance (KPI) liés à la gestion des sinistres et à la gouvernance claims (qualité, conformité, délais, réclamations, findings d’audit, etc.), et préparer les reportings réguliers à destination de la BU et/ou du Groupe. 
 Préparer, planifier et superviser la réalisation d’audits chez les délégataires (TPA, prestataires, réseaux) en collaboration avec les équipes sinistres techniques, et suivre la mise en œuvre des recommandations émises. 
 Être l’interlocuteur privilégié des auditeurs internes et des auditeurs du Groupe dans le cadre des audits claims, coordonner la collecte des informations et assurer le suivi des points soulevés. 
 Amélioration des process 
 Proposer des améliorations des process, systèmes et de la qualité de gestion des sinistres sur la base des audits, contrôles et réclamations. 
 Contribuer aux projets d’optimisation (digitalisation, simplification, renforcement des contrôles) du service sinistre et de la BU. 
 Adapter la démarche d’audit/contrôle aux priorités de la BU et des unités opérationnelles. 
 Participer à la mise en place de nouvelles procédures et outils sinistres en intégrant les exigences de gouvernance et de conformité. 
 Formation & Support 
 Accompagner les équipes claims dans la compréhension et l’application des process, guidelines et exigences de gouvernance. 
 Animer des formations, sensibilisations et retours d’expérience sur la gouvernance des sinistres, le contrôle interne et la qualité. 
 Apporter un support méthodologique pour la mise en œuvre des plans d’actions issus d’audits ou de contrôles. 
 Contribuer au développement de la culture de contrôle et de qualité en promouvant les bonnes pratiques. 
 Relations & Coordination 
 Assurer la liaison avec les fonctions Risque, Legal, Compliance, Opérations et les équipes Claims/Governance du Groupe pour coordonner les actions. 
 Collaborer avec l’ensemble des équipes sinistres pour assurer un suivi optimal des process et de la qualité de gestion. 
 Participer aux comités et réunions de gouvernance (sinistres, risques, performance) et y présenter indicateurs, résultats d’audit et recommandations. 
 Maintenir une communication claire avec les délégataires et partenaires externes sur les attentes de gouvernance et suivre les plans d’actions en cas d’écarts. 
 Qualités et compétences requises : 
 Bonne connaissance des process de gestion des sinistres et, idéalement, des activités de contrôle interne …

Do you want your data skills to have a real impact on investment decisions? 
 In this role as Data Operations Specialist – Investment Data , you’ll work side by side with three experienced and supportive team members who are passionate about robust, well designed data platforms. You’ll help run and improve our investment data warehouse, monitor and optimize daily data pipelines in Azure, and make sure our users have clean, consistent data at their fingertips. 
 You’ll get the chance to dig deep into investment data, sharpen your SQL and automation skills, and grow your experience with modern cloud data tools. If you like taking ownership, collaborating closely with business users and continuously improving how things are done, we’d be happy to hear from you 
 What you will do 
 Maintain and further develop the investment data warehouse in an SQL Server environment. 
 Monitor daily data pipelines in Azure Data Factory and other solutions. 
 Ensure high data quality using the automated framework. 
 Using established data quality checks and dashboards 
 Investigating discrepancies and escalating/solving them systematically. 
 Performing data reconciliation 
 Resolve operational issues and questions (e.g. optimize queries, missing data, check consistency) 
 Interact with users to understand the requirements and enhance their data user experience 
 Maintain technical documentation 
 What you bring 
 2–3 years working in data operations, BI support or data warehouse administration (e.g. supporting existing data platforms, scheduled jobs, and reports). 
 Experience in a production environment, including: 
 Monitoring daily data loads and interfaces 
 Handling incidents and service requests 
 Coordinating with users and other team members. 
 Domain knowledge: 
 Experience in the financial services industry or an industry with similar requirements 
 Good understanding of Investment data (e.g. securities, issuers, indices) and related structures (e.g. portfolios, holdings, company hierarchies) 
 T echnical Skills: 
 Strong practical skills in SQL for validating data, query optimization/ performance tuning, and resolving issues. 
 Familiarity with SQL Server environments and data warehouse concepts (comfortable navigating tables and structures). 
 Working knowledge of Azure Data Factory and/or Databricks: monitor pipelines and activities; restart / re-run failed jobs, read logs and identify issues. 
 Working knowledge of cloud data platforms (e.g. Databricks, Microsoft Fabric) for running jobs, checking status, and troubleshooting. 
 Handson scripting skills in Python for automation and operational tasks (e.g. log parsing, small utilities). R is a nice-to-have 
 Working knowledge of Power BI: Developing and maintaining semantic models in Power BI, validating data in the model, and implementing dashboards 
 You belong here.

items.card: you will contribute to the development of innovative hearing instrument systems, from early concepts and prototypes through hardware integration, testing and product development. You will develop product-specific hearing system solutions, integrate electronic and electroacoustic subsystems, define transducers and build prototypes to validate new concepts. Working within interdisciplinary agile R&D teams, you will
items.desc:
As Hardware Development Engineer , you will contribute to the development of innovative hearing instrument systems, from early concepts and prototypes through hardware integration, testing and product development.
 You will develop product-specific hearing system solutions, integrate electronic and electroacoustic subsystems, define transducers and build prototypes to validate new concepts. Working within interdisciplinary agile R&D teams, you will combine expertise in electrical engineering, acoustics, RF and measurement technologies to develop robust, high-quality solutions.
 This role offers the opportunity to work hands-on with sophisticated hearing technology while collaborating with diverse experts across R&D and contributing to innovation, knowledge sharing and intellectual property.
 More about the role: 
 Develop hardware solutions for hearing instrument systems, translating product requirements into robust electronic and electroacoustic designs.
 Integrate hardware subsystems and define electroacoustic transducers to ensure effective performance of the complete hearing system.
 Design and build hearing system prototypes, including hands-on activities such as soldering, gluing and working with small electronic and mechanical components.
 Define and execute hardware measurements and testing, establishing limits, test criteria and quality characteristics for hearing system hardware.
 Develop software tools for measurement systems to support hardware development, testing and validation activities.
 Contribute to the R&D development process, including planning, reviews and refinement of product increments within interdisciplinary agile development teams.
 Collaborate and share knowledge across R&D, actively participating in team activities and technical communities while supporting onboarding and, when required, the hiring process.
 Contribute to innovation and intellectual property, identifying opportunities for new solutions and supporting the IP process while following relevant development procedures and quality standards.
 More about you: 
 BSc or MSc in Electrical Engineering or a related technical discipline; additional education or expertise in acoustics or audiology is an advantage.
 Very good knowledge of electrical engineering, acoustics, measurement technologies and RF engineering, combined with experience in electronic hardware and wireless system design.
 Practical experience with PCB design, wireless technologies, electronic measurements and hardware prototyping, including soldering and handling small components.
 Experience developing software for controlling measurement equipment is an advantage, with knowledge of tools and technologies such as MATLAB, Arduino, C# and Python.
 A structured, system-oriented and quality-conscious approach, combined with creativity, technical curiosity and the ability to develop pragmatic solutions to complex engineering challenges.
 Strong self-leadership and accountability, with a proactive approach to learning, knowledge sharing, continuous improvement and transparent collaboration.
 Excellent teamwork and communication skills, with the ability to contribute effectively within distributed, interdisciplinary and culturally diverse development teams.
 Very good English and German, both written and spoken; experience with project or functional leadership and tools such as Confluence, Microsoft Teams and MS Office is advantageous.
 More about what we offer: 
 As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we’re committed to building an inclusive culture. We want to create an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work, through our flexible hybrid working model. We offer a wide range of training opportunities for both your professional and personal development, and there are exceptional growth opportunities with individual development plans.

items.title: Hörakustiker für audiologischen und technischen Support (m/w/d)
items.card: deine Aufgaben Dein Arbeitsalltag ist wesentlich durch die telefonische Beratung unserer Fachkundschaft geprägt. Über den Tag hinweg stehst du kontinuierlich im direkten Austausch mit Fachkräften aus der Hörakustik und bist für sie eine kompetente fachliche Ansprechperson. Bei audiologischen und technischen Fragestellungen berätst du unsere Kundschaft und unterstützt dabei, konkrete Herausforderungen direkt im
items.desc:
Du hast eine Ausbildung in der Hörakustik oder Audiologie, telefonierst gerne und hast Freude daran, andere mit deinem Fachwissen bei der Lösung audiologischer und technischer Herausforderungen zu unterstützen? Dann kannst du bei uns deine Expertise auf eine neue Art einsetzen.
 In dieser Position bist du eine zentrale fachliche Ansprechperson für unsere Fachkundschaft und unterstützt insbesondere Fachkräfte aus der Hörakustik bei Fragen rund um unsere Hörlösungen der Marken Phonak, Unitron und Hansaton.
 Wenn du gerne kommunizierst, Freude am Telefonieren hast und dein Wissen gerne an andere Fachkräfte weitergibst, bietet dir diese Position eine spannende Perspektive.
 An unserem Standort in Fellbach wirst du Teil eines erfahrenen Teams und eines internationalen Unternehmens mit vielfältigen Möglichkeiten zur fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung.
 Mehr über deine Aufgaben 
 Dein Arbeitsalltag ist wesentlich durch die telefonische Beratung unserer Fachkundschaft geprägt. Über den Tag hinweg stehst du kontinuierlich im direkten Austausch mit Fachkräften aus der Hörakustik und bist für sie eine kompetente fachliche Ansprechperson.
 Bei audiologischen und technischen Fragestellungen berätst du unsere Kundschaft und unterstützt dabei, konkrete Herausforderungen direkt im Gespräch zu analysieren und zu lösen.
 Bei Fragen zur Hörgeräteanpassung, zu unseren Produkten und zur Anpasssoftware sowie bei technischen Problemen und der Fehlerdiagnose unterstützt du kompetent und lösungsorientiert.
 Fachliche Themen rund um Reparaturen, Reklamationen, ITE-/Im-Ohr-Lösungen und Remakes begleitest du und hilfst dabei, die passende Lösung zu finden.
 Ergänzend zur telefonischen Beratung gehören die Bearbeitung schriftlicher Kundenanfragen sowie die Dokumentation relevanter Informationen und Lösungen zu deinen Aufgaben.
 Produktschulungen und interne Trainings führst du eigenständig durch und vermittelst dabei dein Wissen verständlich und praxisnah.
 Feedback und Anforderungen aus dem Markt nimmst du auf und bringst die Perspektive unserer Fachkundschaft in die Organisation ein.
 Mehr über dich 
 Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung im Bereich Hörakustik oder eine Ausbildung bzw. ein Studium im Bereich Audiologie oder eine vergleichbare fachliche Qualifikation bilden die Grundlage für diese Position.
 Fundiertes audiologisches Fachwissen sowie praktische Kenntnisse rund um Hörgeräte, deren Anpassung und typische technische Fragestellungen zeichnen dich aus.
 Telefonieren gehört für dich gerne und selbstverständlich zum Arbeitsalltag: Der intensive telefonische Austausch mit unserer Fachkundschaft macht einen wesentlichen Teil deines Arbeitstages aus. Auch über längere Zeit am Telefon zu beraten und unterschiedliche Anfragen nacheinander zu bearbeiten, liegt dir.
 Freude daran, dein Fachwissen weiterzugeben, zeichnet dich ebenso aus wie die Fähigkeit, auch komplexe audiologische oder technische Zusammenhänge am Telefon verständlich und lösungsorientiert zu erklären.
 Eine ausgeprägte Kunden- und Serviceorientierung sowie Geduld und Kommunikationsstärke gehören zu deinen Stärken.
 Im Umgang mit digitalen Anwendungen bist du sicher und bringst eine gute Software- und Technikaffinität mit.
 Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sind für die Beratung unserer Kundschaft erforderlich; Grundkenntnisse in Englisch sind von Vorteil.
 Mehr über das, was wir bieten 
 Bei uns kannst du deine Erfahrung aus der Hörakustik in einem neuen Umfeld einsetzen: Du bleibst nah an audiologischen Themen und der täglichen Praxis unserer Fachkundschaft. Gleichzeitig gibst du dein Fachwissen an andere Fachkräfte aus der Hörakustik weiter und unterstützt sie kompetent bei audiologischen und technischen Fragestellungen.
 Als Teil eines großen und erfahrenen Teams profitierst du vom regelmäßigen fachlichen Austausch und erhältst gleichzeitig Einblicke in die Arbeit eines der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Hörlösungen. Dabei arbeitest du mit bekannten Marken wie Phonak, Unitron und Hansaton und entwickelst dein Wissen über Produkte, Technologien und moderne Hörlösungen kontinuierlich weiter.
 Als einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter im Bereich Hörversorgung mit Hauptsitz in der Schweiz setzen wir uns für eine inklusive Unternehmenskultur ein. Wir möchten ein Umfeld schaffen, in dem du eine erfolgreiche Karriere mit deinen persönlichen Verpflichtungen und Interessen vereinbaren kannst. Darüber hinaus bieten wir dir vielfältige Möglichkeiten zur fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterbildung sowie individuelle Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

items.desc:
As an RF Design Engineer, you will play a key role in developing the next generation of wireless technologies that power our innovative hearing solutions. 
 Working within our Electronic Systems & RF team, you will contribute to the development of  wireless communication systems—from early concept development through to successful product integration and certification. 
 You'll collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams to transform innovative RF concepts into high-performance products. In return, you'll join an international R&D environment where collaboration, creativity, and continuous learning are encouraged, giving you the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies while making a meaningful impact on the lives of millions of people worldwide. 
 More about the role 
 Define technical specifications for RF functions, including RF circuits and antenna systems 
 Design, develop, and optimize PCB antennas and RF circuits from concept through product integration 
 Create verification strategies, develop test plans, and perform verification , of RF solutions  to ensure performance and reliability 
 Perform RF simulations and evaluate antenna and transceiver performance using industry-leading simulation tools 
 Support the design, development, and verification of next-generation wireless communication platforms 
 Lead RF compliance activities, ensuring product conformance with regulatory standards 
 Manage and support RF certification activities by coordinating with external test laboratories and ensuring successful product qualification 
 Collaborate with internal and external partners on technology assessments, feasibility studies, innovation initiatives, and future wireless platform development 
 More about you 
 Master's degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related discipline 
 Proven experience in RF design within an R&D environment, including antenna design, RF measurements, and wireless system development 
 Strong expertise in RF simulation tools such as CST Studio Suite 
 Hands-on experience with RF laboratory equipment, including Vector Network Analyzers (VNA), Spectrum Analyzers, and antenna measurement systems 
 Experience designing analog electronic circuits and PCB-based RF solutions 
 Familiarity with wireless communication technologies such as Bluetooth, ISM (2.4 GHz), and low-power wireless systems 
 Experience with MATLAB and Altium Designer is considered an advantage 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a structured and solution-oriented mindset 
 Fluent written and spoken English; German or French would be an asset 
 More about what we offer 
 We can offer you a new challenge, working in teams with engineers and experts, with interesting tasks and much more – including an open corporate culture, flat hierarchies, support for further training and development, opportunities to take on responsibility, attractive employment conditions and flexible working time models in various roles . Employment level 80 -100%. 
 Our Talent Acquisition Partner is looking forward to receiving your complete application (cover letter, CV, references , and certificates) via our online job application platform. 
 For this vacancy only direct applications will be considered.

items.desc:
Nekünk a mobilitás jövője. Neked a szakmád csúcsa. 
 A BMW csoportnál minden az elhivatottsággal kezdődik, amely képes egy szakmát hivatássá változtatni. Elhivatottságunk késztet bennünket arra, hogy folyamatosan újra értelmezzük a mobilitást, és innovatív ötleteket vigyünk az utakra. A közös projektek iránti lelkesedés alakít egy csapatot erős egységgé, ahol minden ötletet és véleményt értékelünk. Csak ha a szakértelem, a professzionális folyamatok és a munka élvezete egyesül, akkor alakíthatjuk együtt a jövőt. Olyan kollégákat keresünk, akik ugyanolyan elhivatottak, mint mi. A szakértelmed, a készségeid, a motivációd és az egyéniséged visznek minket előre.
 Mint a BMW Group Gyár Debrecen Foglalkozás-egészségügyi szakorvos munkatársa, kulcsfontosságú szerepet töltesz be abban, hogy forradalmasítsuk azt, ahogyan az autózásról gondolkodunk.
Mi vár rád? 
 Munkakörnyezet – a BMW Group debreceni gyárának Egészségközpontjában fogsz dolgozni, mely a Kommunikációs Központban található.
 Csapat – egy 6-8 fős csapathoz fogsz csatlakozni, mely foglalkozás-egészségügyi alapellátást, sürgősségi ellátást, külföldi munkavégzés esetén utazási tanácsadás végez; aktív tagság a Magyar Orvosi Kamarában (MOK) szükséges
 Megelőző tevékenység – részt veszel a prevenciós programok kidolgozásában, munkahelyi egészségfejlesztésben, oltási kampányok megvalósításában, a magyar jogi előírásoknak és a BMW Group debreceni gyári szabványainak megfelelően.
 Egészségügy jog - jogi megfelelés és naprakész ismeretek elsajátítása az egészségügyi jog, és a foglalkozás-egészségügyi jogszabályok terén.
 Külső szolgáltató partnerek – folyamatos kapcsolattartás külső szolgáltató partnerekkel; részvétel a létesítmények, struktúrák és folyamatok létrehozására irányuló tevékenységek támogatásában
 Auditok – külső és belső MEB auditok támogatása; együttműködés a BMW Group nemzetközi egészségmenedzsmentjével és részvétel a BMW Group nemzetközi egészségügyi kampányaiban
 Mit várunk tőled? 
 Iskolai végzettség – általános orvosi diploma, foglalkozás egészségügyi szakvizsga, opcionálisan második szakirány lehet háziorvos és/vagy sürgősségi orvostan.
 Munkatapasztalat – üzemorvosi és klinikai orvosként szerzett tapasztalat, lehetőleg gyártási környezetben. Sürgősségi orvostanban szerzett tapasztalat. Előnyt jelent a népegészségügyi, munkahelyi egészségfejlesztési, megelőző orvostani vagy ergonómiai projektekben szerzett gyakorlati tapasztalat.
 Munkarend – hajlandó vagy helyszíni munkavégzésre irodai munkaidőben.
 Nyelvtudás – angol és magyar nyelven tárgyalóképes szinten kommunikálsz, írásban és szóban egyaránt.
 További elvárás – jogosítvány (autó).
 Mit kínálunk? 
 Célunk, hogy munkatársainkat motiváljuk és teljesítményüket elismerjük , ezért juttatási csomagunk az alapbéren felül az alábbi elemekből áll:
 Bérfejlesztés – évente, teljesítményértékelés alapján . 
 Bónusz – vállalati és személyes eredmények alapján számított bónusz.
 Cafeteria – éves cafeteria keretösszeg havi folyósítással.
 Támogatott munkába járás – ingyenes, a műszakbeosztáshoz igazított, közvetlen busz és vasút járatok a régió nagyvárosaiból. Gépkocsi használat esetén a törvényben előírt mértékű költségtérítés.
 Egészségügyi szolgáltatások – magas szintű egészségügyi szolgáltatások, fizikoterápia és gyógytorna lehetőség a debreceni gyárban található egészség központban.
 Magán egészségbiztosítás – próbaidő után minden munkatársunk számára elérhető egészségbiztosítás, amely magában foglal járóbeteg szakellátást, labor- és diagnosztikai vizsgálatokat, ambuláns és egynapos sebészetet, szűrővizsgálatokat, betegszállítást.
 Baleset és Életbiztosítás – munkaidőben és azon kívül is bekövetkező eseményekre csoportos baleset és életbiztosítás.
 Kedvezményes étkezés – napi egyszeri támogatott árú melegétel a vállalati étkezdében.

We are looking for an experienced Business Analyst who can independently lead analysis activities across complex business and IT initiatives within BMW Financial Services. The role requires ownership of requirements from discovery through implementation and validation, confident collaboration with senior stakeholders and cross-functional delivery teams, and the ability to challenge unclear or conflicting requirements. 
 What awaits you? 
 Leading end-to-end business analysis activities, including planning, prioritization, stakeholder management, and delivery oversight.
 Gathering, analyzing, documenting, and managing business, functional, and non-functional requirements throughout the project lifecycle.
 Facilitating workshops and requirements sessions with business and technical stakeholders, including senior management.
 Developing and maintaining user stories, acceptance criteria, business rules, and requirements traceability.
 Managing and documenting requirements in Jira and Confluence, ensuring consistency and transparency.
 Collaborating closely with development, testing, architecture, and business teams to clarify and validate requirements.
 Supporting business testing by defining test scenarios, expected outcomes, and acceptance criteria; analyzing and modeling business processes using BPMN/UML, identifying risks and dependencies, and supporting successful solution delivery.
 What should you bring along? 
 University degree in Business, IT, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. 
 3+ years of Business Analysis experience, including leading analysis activities in complex projects, transformations, or system integrations. 
 Practical experience in Agile/Scrum environments, with strong knowledge of requirements management, BPMN, and business process modelling. 
 Hands-on experience with BPMN 2.0, UML, Jira, Confluence, and basic SQL; relevant certifications are a plus. 
 Strong stakeholder management, workshop facilitation, and communication skills, with fluent business English. Experience in financial services or other regulated environments is an advantage. 
 You enjoy working in an international team and are passionate about business analysis? Apply now!

items.desc:
Where do people love what they do, and being great at what they do? 
 At Swisslog, that’s where! Our teams are the heart of a world-leading Robotics company that’s harnessing the power of technology to shape the future of intralogistics. The result? We’re transforming performance and efficiency for customers across the globe, giving them the vital edge in their markets.
 Make an impact 
 Swisslog are currently seeking a Spare Parts Engineer based in Linköping with hybrid and flexible working available. 
 The Spare Part Sales Support Agent serves as the central point of contact for customers in the spare parts business, ensuring efficient, solution-oriented, and service-focused handling of all inquiries and orders. The role is responsible for timely case processing, proactive quotation follow-up, accurate order execution, and maintaining high customer satisfaction. Through structured case and backlog management, close collaboration with the Global Spare Parts Team, and continuous process improvement the Spare Parts Engineer contributes directly to increasing quotation quality and ensuring fast, reliable end-to-end processing in the spare parts workflow. 
 Act as the primary point of contact for customers regarding spare parts inquiries. 
 Receive, prioritize, and process customer cases while ensuring complete and accurate documentation using the provided system landscape 
 Maintain consistent follow-up on open cases, ensuring timely updates and transparency for the customer. 
 Understand customer needs and expectations to drive high satisfaction and customer loyalty. 
 Communicate professionally with customers regarding prices, lead times, technical clarifications, and negotiations. 
 Collaborate closely with the rest of the Global Spare Parts Team to ensure alignment, escalations, and best-practice handling. 
 What you need to succeed 
 We are looking for a customer-focused and detail-oriented Spare Parts Engineer who thrives in a fast-paced environment and takes ownership of delivering excellent customer experience. The ideal candidate is proactive, structured, and capable of managing multiple inquiries simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and service quality. A strong communicator with a solution-driven mindset, you are able to understand customer expectations, negotiate confidently and ensure timely processing of quotations and orders. 
 Previous experience in the Spare Parts business 
 Knowledge of SAP Order Processing (desirable but not essential) 
 Ability to work on own initiative within a team environment.
 Good telephone manner with greeting all customers and being professional whilst resolving queries 
 Ability to prioritise workload 
 Swedish and English language 
 #LI-SM1 
 Our promise to you 
 Swisslog is a world of opportunity for people who can deliver a game changing mission: driving the future of intralogistics, by shaping an era of robotic and data-driven automated solutions that create exceptional customer value.
 Join us on this journey and you’ll be part of a global enterprise that’s proud of its Swiss roots - and hugely excited by the worldwide opportunities open to everyone in the Swisslog family. So come and realize your potential, in a team that’s united by passion and driven by the OneSwisslog team spirit.
 About Swisslog 
 Swisslog is shaping the future of intralogistics. As part of the KUKA Group, we work on the latest technologies that are reimagining the world of logistics. We’re a team of 3,000+ experts from 50 countries, serving some of the world's largest and most exciting brands. Together, we’re implementing smart and innovative approaches - including flexible robot-based and data-driven automation solutions that are transforming the supply chain. So join our team and share your unique perspective.
 Join the journey! 
 If you think a career with Swisslog could be what you are looking for, we´d love to hear from you.
 We´re looking forward to receiving your application!

TELEFÓNICA EDUCACIÓN DIGITAL, S.L.U. ofrece soluciones integrales de aprendizaje para la Educación y Formación, con más de 20 años de experiencia en el mercado nacional e internacional. Desarrolla procesos de aprendizaje de alto impacto en personas y organizaciones. 
 En un mundo cada vez más incierto, uno de los mayores regalos que se le puede hacer a una persona es su formación. La formación es uno de los activos más valiosos que se pueden ofrecer para el futuro: amplía opciones, genera confianza y permite afrontar los cambios con mayor seguridad. En este sentido, el propósito de Telefónica Educación Digital es claro y profundamente relevante: ofrecer este regalo a cada uno de nuestros usuarios. Pocos propósitos tienen un valor mayor o un impacto más duradero que ayudar a las personas a construir su futuro. 
 ¿Quieres colaborar con nosotros como freelance? 
 ¡Nos encantará conocerte! 
 Si te interesa colaborar con nosotros como profesional freelance, pero en este momento no ves una oportunidad publicada que encaje con tu perfil, te invitamos a inscribirte en esta convocatoria abierta. 
 Queremos contar con una red de profesionales especializados con quienes poder colaborar en futuros proyectos, según las necesidades que vayan surgiendo en distintas áreas. 
 ¿Qué puedes hacer? 
Cuéntanos quién eres, cuál es tu experiencia, en qué áreas estás especializado/a y en qué tipo de proyectos te gustaría colaborar. Revisaremos tu perfil y lo tendremos en cuenta para futuras oportunidades freelance que encajen con tu experiencia y disponibilidad. 
 A la hora de rellenar el formulario, no es necesario completarlo todo, solo los campos obligatorios. Sí necesitamos tu CV y contestación a las preguntas planteadas. ¡Gracias!
 ¿POR QUÉ TELEFÓNICA? 
 El futuro de Telefónica está en tus manos. 
 Trabajar en Telefónica es ser parte de una empresa centenaria que aspira a ser una operadora europea de referencia mundial. Una compañía con un propósito claro: ser la mejor vía de acceso de ciudadanos, empresas e instituciones a las tecnologías digitales que están transformando el mundo. 
 Un reto que requiere de los mejores profesionales, de las mejores personas. 
 Nuestra forma de trabajar se basa en tres actitudes que nos definen: 
 Damos lo mejor de nosotros mismos . Creemos en el poder de la simplicidad y en centrarnos en lo que realmente genera impacto. Generamos confianza cuando entendemos al cliente y entregamos lo que marca la diferencia. La excelencia es nuestro estándar para lograr impacto hoy y a largo plazo. 
 Cuestionamos nuestros propios límites . Innovamos y somos transformadores cuando asumimos riesgos inteligentes. Promovemos el debate real, tomamos decisiones claras y actuamos con coraje para que las buenas ideas avancen sin miedo a equivocarse. 
 Nos superamos juntos . El crecimiento ocurre cuando todos asumimos responsabilidad por los resultados, nos involucramos de verdad en lo que alcanzamos como equipo y tomamos la iniciativa para que las cosas sucedan. Evolucionar nuestras capacidades y atrevernos a dar pasos personales audaces es lo que impulsa una Telefónica líder. 
 Porque el presente nos reta. Y estamos preparados. Porque no hay nada más poderoso que un grupo de personas persiguiendo un objetivo común, teniendo claro cómo lograrlo y dándolo todo para conseguirlo. 
 Es necesario que conozcas los Principios de Negocio Responsable que apliquen a tu ámbito de responsabilidad. Buscamos profesionales confiables, con integridad, que se comprometan con una gestión ética y transparente, promoviendo un desarrollo social y ambiental más justo y sostenible. 
 En Telefónica creemos firmemente que promover la diversidad y la inclusión es una gran oportunidad para conectar talento, crecer como compañía y como sociedad. Hay un lugar en Telefónica para todos los tipos de talento, por encima de todo buscamos diversidad de talentos. ¿Cuál es el tuyo?

items.desc:
¿QUÉ ES TELEFONICA TECH? 
 Telefónica Tech es la compañía líder en trasformación digital del Grupo Telefónica. Contamos con una amplia oferta de servicios y soluciones tecnológicas integradas de Ciberseguridad, Cloud, IoT, Big Data, Inteligencia Artificial y Blockchain, con la que acompañamos a nuestros clientes en su transformación digital. 
 Somos un grupo de más de 6200 personas valientes que trabajamos a diario desde distintos puntos del mundo para alcanzar la excelencia, a través de un liderazgo basado en la transparencia y en el espírItu de equipo. Si te identificas con nuestros pilares, ¡estamos deseando conocerte! 
 www.telefonicatech.com 
 ¿QUÉ HACEMOS EN EL EQUIPO? 
 En la unidad de Cloud Service Delivery Center de Telefónica, nos impulsan los desafíos de nuestros clientes, su transformación, su éxito. Nos mueve todo lo que pasa en la Cloud. Vivimos y respiramos un mundo tecnológico complejo, y en él, creamos un espacio en el que diseñamos, integramos y gestionamos soluciones para ayudar a nuestros clientes a alcanzar sus retos. 
 En concreto en esta área la misión que tenemos es: La operación y el soporte de primer nivel a los clientes que confían en nosotros sus sistemas informáticos, centrándose sobre todo en las infraestructuras de cómputo. 
 ¿CÓMO SERÁ TU DÍA A DÍA? 
 Estamos buscando un/a Técnico/a de Soporte de Nivel 1 proactivo/a, resolutivo/a y orientado/a al cliente para unirse a nuestro equipo de soporte técnico en un servicio 24x7. 
 Esta posición se enfoca en ofrecer una primera atención de calidad a usuarios y equipos de soporte, realizando la monitorización de los servicios, gestión y clasificación de tickets, diagnóstico y resolución de incidencias de acuerdo con los procedimientos establecidos, así como la ejecución de cambios definidos.
 Para ello, en tu día a día tendrás varias tareas:
 Realizar la monitorización de consolas y herramientas de supervisión, analizando alertas y eventos y realizando las comprobaciones y acciones necesarias.
 Atención telefónica y vía correo electrónico de las consultas, solicitudes e incidencias recibidas.
 Actuar como primer punto de contacto para la recepción y atención de tickets de soporte.
 Clasificar, priorizar y gestionar tickets según los procedimientos y niveles de servicio establecidos.
 Analizar y resolver incidencias de primer nivel, aplicando los procedimientos y soluciones disponibles.
 Ejecutar las acciones necesarias para la resolución de incidencias y realizar las comprobaciones posteriores para validar su correcta resolución.
 Ejecutar tareas operativas y cambios previamente definidos y autorizados.
 Escalar a los niveles superiores aquellas incidencias que requieran una actuación especializada, proporcionando toda la información necesaria para facilitar su resolución.
 Realizar el seguimiento de las incidencias hasta su resolución o escalado.
 Mantener actualizada la información de los tickets, registrando correctamente las acciones realizadas y la solución aplicada.
 Colaborar con el resto de niveles y equipos del servicio para asegurar una correcta gestión y resolución de las incidencias.
 Mantener actualizada la documentación y contribuir a la mejora de procedimientos y guías operativas.
 Adaptarse de forma ágil a los cambios que puedan producirse en procedimientos, herramientas, tecnologías y necesidades del servicio.
 Y PARA ELLO, CREEMOS QUE SERÍA IDEAL QUE CONTARAS CON… 
 Disponibilidad para trabajar en un servicio 24x7, así como para realizar presencialidad en las instalaciones del cliente. Por la ubicación de las oficinas y los horarios de determinados turnos, será necesario disponer de un medio de transporte propio. 
 Experiencia 
 Experiencia en puestos de soporte técnico. 
 Experiencia en la gestión y resolución de incidencias. 
 Experiencia trabajando con herramientas de ticketing y de monitorización. 
 Formación 
 Necesario: 
 Formación de grado medio en sistemas microinformáticos y redes 
 Deseables 
 Formación de grado superior en Administración de Sistemas Informáticos en Red 
 Conocimientos técnicos 
 Conocimientos en sistemas operativos Windows. 
 Conocimientos en sistemas operativos Linux.
 Conocimientos en BBDD y SQL.
 Conocimientos en MDW.
 Conocimientos en entornos VDI.
 Conocimientos en O365 y Exchange.
 Conocimientos en Almacenamiento y Backup.
 Conocimientos en Virtualización.
 Se valorarán conocimientos en Kubernetes y Openshift.
 Para desempeñar el rol, los skills que encajarían con el equipo serían : 
 Orientación al cliente y vocación de servicio.
 Capacidad resolutiva y orientación a la búsqueda de soluciones.
 Capacidad para seguir procesos y procedimientos de forma rigurosa.
 Proactividad, capacidad de aprendizaje y adaptación ágil a los cambios.
 Buenas habilidades de comunicación, tanto telefónica como escrita.
 Capacidad para trabajar en equipo y colaborar con los diferentes niveles de soporte.
 Organización y capacidad para gestionar prioridades en un entorno dinámico.
 Ganas de aprender, …

 chevron_left 
 Übersicht 
 Wissenschaftliche Assistenz Lehre – Entwurf und Digitales Entwerfen (m/w/d)
 40%-100%, Zürich, befristet 
 print 
 Drucken 
 Die Professur Gramazio Kohler Research am Departement Architektur der ETH Zürich forscht und lehrt an der Schnittstelle von Architektur, computerbasiertem Entwurf und robotischer Fabrikation. Unsere Lehre verbindet das architektonische Entwerfen mit digitalen Methoden, vom ersten Bachelorsemester bis ins Masterstudium.
 Projekthintergrund
 Die Professur trägt folgende Lehrformate im Curriculum des Departements Architektur:
 Digitales Entwerfen I : Kurs mit Prüfung im ersten Semester Bachelor, in dem die Studierenden das parametrische Entwerfen mit Rhinoceros und Grasshopper kennenlernen
 Digitales Entwerfen II : in das Entwurfsstudio Studio Foundations im zweiten Semester integriert
 Coding Architecture I und II : Kernfach im Mastercurriculum, in dem die Studierenden weiterführende Programmiertechniken (Python) und deren Einsatz im architektonischen Entwurf lernen
 Zudem betreut die Professur Vertiefungsarbeiten und führt Seminarreisen durch. Wir verstehen unsere Lehre als laufendes Projekt, das wir als Team stetig weiterentwickeln.
 Stellenbeschreibung
 Per 1. Januar 2027 oder nach Vereinbarung betreuen Sie als Teil unseres Lehrteams Studierende in den laufenden Kursen, leiten Übungen und Kritiken und entwickeln Aufgabenstellungen, Lehrmaterialien und Tutorials mit. Zu Ihren Aufgaben gehören ausserdem die Betreuung von Vertiefungsarbeiten und die Organisation von Seminarreisen. Sie arbeiten mit an der inhaltlichen und didaktischen Weiterentwicklung unserer Lehrformate, insbesondere an der Verbindung von architektonischem Entwurf und digitalen Werkzeugen. Das Pensum beträgt mindestens 40%.
 Profil
 Abgeschlossenes Masterstudium in Architektur
 Ausgeprägte Fähigkeiten im Entwerfen, gerne mit eigener Architekturpraxis, dies ist aber keine Voraussetzung
 Fundierte Erfahrung mit Rhinoceros und Grasshopper und deren Einsatz im architektonischen Entwurf
 Von Vorteil: Programmierkenntnisse (z. B. Python) und Lehrerfahrung
 Freude an der Arbeit mit Studierenden und an der Zusammenarbeit im Team
 Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse
 Arbeitsort
 Arbeitsort
 Wir bieten
 Eine abwechslungsreiche Lehrtätigkeit in einem engagierten, interdisziplinären Team an einer der führenden Architekturschulen. Sie haben die Möglichkeit, die Entwurfs- und Digitallehre im ersten Jahr und im Master aktiv mitzugestalten. Das Pensum lässt sich mit einer eigenen Praxis vereinbaren.

 Votre #FutureInSight avec EssilorLuxottica 
 Êtes-vous prêt à explorer de nouveaux horizons, à favoriser l’inclusivité et la collaboration, l’agilité, à éveiller la passion et à avoir un impact positif sur le monde ? 
 Rejoignez-nous pour redéfinir les limites de ce qui est possible ! 
 Votre rôle : 
 1. Gestion du contrôle documentaire 
 Administrer et maintenir le système global de gestion documentaire. 
 Garantir la création, la révision, l’approbation et l’archivage conformes des documents contrôlés. 
 Accompagner les auteurs et experts métiers dans la structuration et la mise en forme des documents. 
 2. Administration du Système de Gestion des Formations (LMS) 
 Gérer le LMS interne pour assurer la conformité des formations liées au QMS. 
 Maintenir les matrices de formation et garantir l’attribution correcte des modules. 
 Générer des rapports de conformité pour suivre la performance des équipes et des fonctions. 
 3. Opération & Conformité QMS (Quality Management System) 
 Soutenir les opérations quotidiennes du QMS sur le site de Tuam. 
 Participer aux audits internes et externes du système qualité. 
 Contribuer aux enquêtes et aux activités CAPA. 
 4. Référent EQMS & Support 
 Agir en tant qu’expert EQMS dans le cadre du déploiement global du système, en collaboration avec l’équipe projet. 
 Assurer le support des workflows tels que Change Control, CAPA, NCR, gestions des plaintes et gestion des audits. 
 5. Reporting & Suivi des indicateurs 
 Maintenir les fichiers de suivi des indicateurs liés au QMS. 
 Préparer les rapports destinés aux revues de direction. 
 Contribuer à la préparation des audits et au maintien de la conformité réglementaire.

VÚB banka je druhá najväčšia banka na Slovensku a súčasť medzinárodnej skupiny Intesa Sanpaolo – jednej z popredných bankových skupín v Európe. V prvom rade sme komunita zanietených ľudí, ktorí veria v prostredie, kde má každý priestor rásť a rozvíjať svoj potenciál. Našou najväčšou hodnotou sú práve naši ľudia. Firemnú kultúru staviame na rešpekte, empatii a dôvere – vďaka čomu sa naši zamestnanci cítia oceňovaní a podporovaní. Ako prvá banka na Slovensku, ktorá získala medzinárodný titul TOP Employer, sme nastavili nový štandard pracovného prostredia. Ponúkame flexibilný spôsob práce – kde to povaha pozície umožňuje, zamestnanci si sami volia, kedy pracujú z domu a kedy z kancelárie. Technológie vnímame ako kľúč k budúcnosti – neustále hľadáme digitálne riešenia, ktoré zjednodušujú prácu a posúvajú nás vpred. Podporujeme vzdelávanie – nielen v oblasti odbornosti, ale aj osobnostného rastu a rozvoja ľudského potenciálu. Uvedomujeme si význam duševného zdravia – preto ponúkame komplexné programy a benefity, ktoré pomáhajú našim kolegom udržiavať psychickú pohodu a rovnováhu. U nás robíme maximum pre to, aby sme vytvárali zdravé, moderné a spokojné pracovné prostredie. Ak chcete byť našou súčasťou, určite sa nám ozvite. 
 Platové podmienky 
 2 050 EUR/mesiac
 Štartovacia základná mzda je 1 650 EUR + mesačné provízie a kvartálne odmeny. Priemerná mesačná provízia po úspešnom adapte sa pohybuje vo výške 400 EUR a závisí od Tvojej šikovnosti, či to bude viac. Kvartálne odmeny sa priemerne pohybujú vo výške 1 800 EUR v závislosti od plnenia individuálnych aj pobočkových cieľov. Po 6 mesiacoch je možnosť získať adaptačný bonus vo výške 50% Tvojej nástupnej základnej mzdy. 
 Účel a náplň práce 
 Ak pre Vás nie sú bankové a investičné produkty neznáme pojmy, máte v sebe ducha obchodníka, rád/rada komunikujete a dokážete klientom pomôcť nájsť to najideálnejšie riešenie, ste skvelý typ na osobného bankára/bankárku pre VÚB! 
 Čakajú Vás u nás možnosti kariérneho rastu aj zaujímavé finančné ohodnotenie. 
 Na pozícii Osobný bankár/bankárka bude Vašou úlohou:
 starať sa o Magnifica klientov,
 identifikovať potreby klientov, analyzovať ich požiadavky a hľadať pre nich tie najideálnejšie riešenia,
 poskytovať odborné poradenstvo v oblasti produktov a služieb existujúcim a potenciálnym klientom z portfólia afluentných klientov,
 budovať si s klientmi dôverný vzťah,
 neustále sa vzdelávať o novinkách vo svete financií a odborne rásť.
 Čo môžete očakávať vy od nás 
 Ako zamestnanec/zamestnankyňa získavaš benefity, ktoré porastú tak, ako budeš rásť spolu s nami. Čím dlhšie u nás budeš pracovať, tým viac výhod získaš!
 Odmenu za výkon. Raz ročne získaš bonus, ktorého výška závisí od splnenia firemných aj Tvojich individuálnych cieľov.
 Stravné plne hradené zamestnávateľom bez doplatku zamestnanca.
 Až do 10 dní plateného voľna nad rámec zákona každý rok.
 Kredit vo VÚB Cafetérii až do výšky 300 eur, ktorý rastie s počtom odpracovaných rokov.
 Až do 100 eur mesačne ako príspevok na doplnkové dôchodkové sporenie (III. pilier).
 Zvýhodnené produkty a služby VÚB banky.
 190 eur ročne ako príspevok na obliekanie.
 Chcete objaviť všetky fantastické výhody, ktoré svojim zamestnancom VÚBka ponúka? Mrknite na našu kariérnu stránku a preskúmajte širokú škálu našich benefitov! 
 Požadované skúsenosti 
 Pozícii vyhovujú uchádzači so vzdelaním:
 stredoškolské s maturitou
 Prax na pozícii/v oblasti:
 minimálne 2 roky skúsenosti s priamym predajom finančných produktov
 Požadované zručnosti, kvalifikácia a znalosti 
 Si pre nás vhodným kandidátom/kandidátkou ak:
 máte minimálne 2 roky skúsenosti s priamym predajom finančných produktov,
 viete aktívne využívať MS Office a nebojíte sa virtuálneho prostredia,
 Vás baví komunikovať a dokážete pomôcť klientom s nájdením optimálneho riešenia,
 Vám bankové a investičné produkty nie sú cudzie,
 máte argumentačné schopnosti a obchodného ducha,
 ste dôveryhodnou a bezúhonnou osobou,
 výhodou je anglický jazyk a vzdelanie ekonomického zamerania.
 ... všetko ostatné Ťa naučíme my :)
 Informácie o výberovom konaní
Ak Ťa tento popis zaujal a chceš sa stať naším novým VÚBkárom, stačí už len kliknúť na „Reagovať na ponuku" a my sa Ti ozveme. Všetko dôležité o práci vo VÚB si povieme na osobnom/online stretnutí.
Tešíme sa na Teba !

items.desc:
Bankunk az olasz Intesa Sanpaolo Csoport leányvállalata. Univerzális hitelintézetként a hazai pénzpiac egyik meghatározó szereplőjeként több mint 45 éves tapasztalattal rendelkezünk. Folyamatosan keressük az innovatív, ügyfeleinkre szabott megoldásokat, melynek kollégáink is aktív részesei. Ha fontos számodra a nemzetközi háttér, a barátságos és szerethető légkör, és egy olyan munkahelyet keresel, ahol a fejlődésed és jólléted tényleges figyelmet kap, ne várj tovább! 
 Feladatok, amikben szakértővé válsz: 
 A Projektiroda és a projektmenedzserek napi munkájához kapcsolódó adminisztratív és szervezési feladatok ellátásában. 
 Projekt leszállítandók elkészítésének, összegyűjtésének és nyomon követésének támogatásában. 
 Az alkalmazott projekt módszertan és a kapcsolódó eszközök (pl.: PNow, Jira) használatában. 
 Riportok, prezentációk és vezetői szintű riportok és döntés-előkészítő anyagok előkészítésében. 
 Neked való mindez, ha: 
 Heti 30-40 órát tudsz vállalni, hibrid munkavégzésben. 
 Jó szervezőkészség, pontos, precíz munkavégzés jellemez. 
 Erős kommunikációs készséggel és aktív angol nyelvtudással rendelkezel. 
 Magabiztos Microsoft termékek ismeretével rendelkezel (kiemelten PowerPoint és Excel) 
 Motivál, hogy betekintést kapsz banki és transzformációs projektek működésébe. 
 Tapasztalatot szereznél projektmenedzsment módszertanokban (Agile, Waterfall). 
 Értékeljük a tehetséged: 
 Igazi szakmai feladatokon keresztül fejlődhetsz, ebben támogatnak a munkatársak. 
 Nálunk a gyakornoki program nem csak munkáról szól: tréningek és csapatépítő programok várnak. 
 Gyakornoki juttatást kapsz fizetett szabadságokkal. 
 Hivatalos szakmai gyakorlatként visszaigazoljuk a nálunk töltött idődet a felsőoktatási intézmény felé. 
 Légy te is CIB-es, hogy megtaláld a helyed!

items.desc:
