 Overview 
 Entrerai nell'area Telecomunicazioni, all'interno del contesto Networking, contribuendo all'evoluzione e alla gestione delle infrastrutture di rete attraverso soluzioni di Network Automation, Network Infrastructure as Code e pratiche NetDevOps. Affiancherai i team tecnici nelle attività di monitoraggio, troubleshooting, progettazione, sviluppo e gestione di automazioni a supporto di ambienti enterprise e mission critical. 
 Quali saranno le tue attività 
 Supportare progettazione e sviluppo di soluzioni di Network Automation 
 Realizzare script, playbook e pipeline con Python, Ansible, Terraform, Git e API REST 
 Contribuire alle attività NOC: monitoraggio, analisi alert, troubleshooting, incident management ed escalation 
 Analizzare eventi e anomalie di rete, supportando l'identificazione delle cause e il ripristino del servizio 
 Gestire repository Git e documentazione tecnica 
 Integrare le automazioni con CMDB, IPAM, monitoring, CI/CD e sistemi di ticketing 
 Definire template, componenti riutilizzabili e modelli di automazione 
 Supportare test, validazione, audit trail e rollback 
 Collaborare con team di architettura, operation, sicurezza, cloud, applicativi e partner tecnologici 
 Chi stiamo cercando 
 Se hai le seguenti caratteristiche, ti stiamo aspettando: 
 Esperienza di 3 - 5 anni in ambito NOC o Network Operations 
 Esperienza in networking, Network Operations e automazione infrastrutturale 
 Conoscenza di TCP/IP, routing, switching, DNS, VPN, firewalling e subnetting 
 Conoscenza dei processi NOC: monitoring, alerting, incident management, troubleshooting ed escalation 
 Capacità di analisi di anomalie e problematiche di rete tramite strumenti di monitoraggio 
 Conoscenza di Python o altri linguaggi di scripting 
 Familiarità con Ansible, Terraform, REST API, YAML, JSON, Git e CI/CD 
 Conoscenza dei principi di Network Infrastructure as Code 
 Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese 
 Laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria Informatica, Telecomunicazioni o percorsi equivalenti. 
 Costituiscono elementi preferenziali: 
 Certificazioni in ambito networking, cloud, automation, DevOps o programmazione 
 Significative esperienze professionali o di studio in contesti internazionali 
 Cosa ti offriamo 
 Retribuzione annua lorda a partire da 40.000 € 
 Il Gruppo prevede una componente variabile della remunerazione così come disciplinata dalle Politiche di Remunerazione consultabili sul sito di Gruppo 
 Elementi complementari disciplinati dal Contratto Collettivo Nazionale Credito e accordi aziendali di secondo livello 
 Iniziative di sviluppo professionale a supporto della crescita delle nostre persone 
 Ampia offerta formativa tramite la Corporate Academy dedicata allo sviluppo continuo delle competenze professionali, manageriali e trasversali a tutti i livelli 
 Possibilità di aderire al lavoro flessibile e alla settimana corta 4x9 
 Sistema moderno e integrato di welfare aziendale ( link ) 
 Copertura sanitaria e previdenza complementare a decorrere dall’assunzione 
 Vantaggi sui prodotti e servizi bancari del Gruppo 
 Chi siamo 
 Siamo leader in Italia e uno dei principali gruppi bancari in Europa. Unisciti a noi e fai parte della nostra storia di successo! Con oltre 20 milioni di clienti in Italia e all'estero siamo un vero e proprio motore di crescita sostenibile con un forte impegno per l'ambiente e un impatto tangibile sulla società. 
 Le persone sono al centro, ce ne prendiamo cura impegnandoci nel creare una cultura inclusiva all'interno del Gruppo in cui tutti si sentano protagonisti e valorizzati. 
 L’Area Chief Data, A.I. & Technology Officer è la realtà IT del Gruppo che coniuga l’agilità di una fintech con la solidità di un grande gruppo; avrai l'opportunità di lavorare in un contesto innovativo con tecnologie all’avanguardia e con forte spinta alla trasformazione digitale. 
 Unisciti alla nostra realtà internazionale. Il futuro non si aspetta, si sceglie! 
 #sharingfuture 
 Garantiamo un ambiente inclusivo e di pari opportunità. Considereremo tutte le candidature a prescindere da razza, religione, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere, stato civile, età, disabilità o qualsiasi altra categoria protetta nel rispetto dei D.lgs. 198/2006, 215/03 e 216/03. 
 Per la valutazione delle candidature, i dati saranno utilizzati da Intesa Sanpaolo S.p.A. come Data Controller. Ti invitiamo a prendere visione dell’ Informativa Privacy dedicata.

Podporujeme vzdelávanie – nielen v oblasti odbornosti, ale aj osobnostného rastu a rozvoja ľudského potenciálu. Uvedomujeme si význam duševného zdravia – preto ponúkame komplexné programy a benefity, ktoré pomáhajú našim kolegom udržiavať psychickú pohodu a rovnováhu. U nás robíme maximum pre to, aby sme vytvárali zdravé, moderné a spokojné pracovné prostredie. Ak chcete byť našou súčasťou, určite sa nám ozvite. 
 Platové podmienky 
 2200 EUR/mesiac
 Štartovacia základná mzda je 1 800 EUR + mesačné provízie a kvartálne odmeny. Priemerná mesačná provízia po úspešnom adapte sa pohybuje vo výške 400 EUR a závisí od Tvojej šikovnosti, či to bude viac. Kvartálne odmeny sa priemerne pohybujú vo výške 1 800 EUR v závislosti od plnenia individuálnych aj pobočkových cieľov. Po 6 mesiacoch je možnosť získať adaptačný bonus vo výške 50% Tvojej nástupnej základnej mzdy.
 Účel a náplň práce 
 Čo od vás očakávame 
 Ak pre Vás nie sú bankové a investičné produkty neznáme pojmy, máte v sebe ducha obchodníka, rád/rada komunikujete a dokážete klientom pomôcť nájsť to najideálnejšie riešenie, ste skvelý typ na osobného bankára/bankárku pre VÚB!
Čakajú Vás u nás možnosti kariérneho rastu aj zaujímavé finančné ohodnotenie.
Na pozícii Osobný bankár/bankárka bude Vašou úlohou:
 starať sa o Magnifica klientov,
 identifikovať potreby klientov, analyzovať ich požiadavky a hľadať pre nich tie najideálnejšie riešenia,
 poskytovať odborné poradenstvo v oblasti produktov a služieb existujúcim a potenciálnym klientom z portfólia afluentných klientov,
 budovať si s klientmi dôverný vzťah,
 neustále sa vzdelávať o novinkách vo svete financií a odborne rásť.
 Čo môžete očakávať vy od nás 
 Ako zamestnanec/zamestnankyňa získavaš benefity, ktoré porastú tak, ako budeš rásť spolu s nami. Čím dlhšie u nás budeš pracovať, tým viac výhod získaš!
 Odmenu za výkon. Raz ročne získaš bonus, ktorého výška závisí od splnenia firemných aj Tvojich individuálnych cieľov.
 Stravné plne hradené zamestnávateľom bez doplatku zamestnanca.
 Až do 10 dní plateného voľna nad rámec zákona každý rok.
 Kredit vo VÚB Cafetérii až do výšky 300 eur, ktorý rastie s počtom odpracovaných rokov.
 Až do 100 eur mesačne ako príspevok na doplnkové dôchodkové sporenie (III. pilier).
 Zvýhodnené produkty a služby VÚB banky.
 190 eur ročne ako príspevok na obliekanie.
Chcete objaviť všetky fantastické výhody, ktoré svojim zamestnancom VÚBka ponúka? Mrknite na našu kariérnu stránku a preskúmajte širokú škálu našich benefitov!
 Požadované skúsenosti 
 Minimálne dosiahnuté vzdelanie 
 stredoškolské s maturitou
 Prax na pozícii/v oblasti 
 banková prax
 Počet rokov praxe 
 2
 Požadované zručnosti, kvalifikácia a znalosti 
 Si pre nás vhodným kandidátom/kandidátkou ak:
 máte minimálne 2 roky skúsenosti s priamym predajom finančných produktov,
 viete aktívne využívať MS Office a nebojíte sa virtuálneho prostredia,
 Vás baví komunikovať a dokážete pomôcť klientom s nájdením optimálneho riešenia,
 Vám bankové a investičné produkty nie sú cudzie,
 máte argumentačné schopnosti a obchodného ducha,
 ste dôveryhodnou a bezúhonnou osobou,
 výhodou je anglický jazyk a vzdelanie ekonomického zamerania.
 Informácie o výberovom konaní
 Ak Ťa tento popis zaujal a chceš sa stať naším novým VÚBkárom, stačí už len kliknúť na „Reagovať na ponuku" a my sa Ti ozveme. Všetko dôležité o práci vo VÚB si povieme na osobnom/online stretnutí.
Tešíme sa na Teba !
 Ak Vás tento popis zaujal, pošlite nám svoje CV a my sa Vám ozveme. Všetko dôležité o práci vo VÚB si povieme na online/osobnom stretnutí. Tešíme sa na Vás!

 EDISTRIBUCIÓN REDES DIGITALES, S.L.U.
 Description and Requirements
 Descripción y requisitos: 
 Si quieres un nuevo reto profesional, estamos buscando un Especialista Distribución, que se una al equipo de Technical Team La Palma en La Palma. 
 ¿Con quién trabajarás? 
 En la Unidad Territorial se realizan trabajos de revisiones y adecuaciones, aportando y validando los datos necesarios no disponibles en los sistemas, elaborando los informes necesarios para la red MT/BT. 
 En esta Unidad se hacen tareas relativas a certificaciones, puesta en servicio y legalización de las nuevas instalaciones, así como la actualización de los sistemas y bases de datos que corresponda según los procedimientos establecidos. 
 Dentro de la UT se hace una gestión de la red de distribución asignada y también se colabora en el análisis del resultado de las inspecciones y averías y mantenimiento programado y definir los trabajos necesarios de acuerdo con las especificaciones técnicas definidas. 
 ¿De qué te encargarás? 
 Tus tareas principales serán: 
 Realizar y supervisar los trabajos globales de la red de distribución, averías, NNSS, mantenimiento de red, inversión. Colaborar en la revisión de certificaciones, análisis de inspecciones y averías así como en la gestión de la red de su ámbito, de acuerdo con los procedimientos y a la legislación vigentes. Trabajos de revisiones y adecuaciones, aportando y validando los datos necesarios no disponibles en los sistemas, elaborando los informes necesarios. 
 Tareas relativas a certificaciones, puesta en servicio y legalización de las nuevas instalaciones, así como la actualización de los sistemas y bases de datos que corresponda según los procedimientos establecidos. 
 Gestión de la red de distribución asignada. 
 Colaborar en el análisis del resultado de las inspecciones y averías y mantenimiento programado y definir los trabajos necesarios de acuerdo con las especificaciones técnicas definidas. 
 Elaborar informes y proponer trabajos y propuestas para su mejora. 
 Realizar y supervisar a los trabajadores a su cargo, recepcionar los trabajos de reparación efectuados, solicitar descargos, analizar los datos, generar informes desde el terrero de las incidencias (causas, elementos afectados y reparados, plazos, etc.) y definir posibles acciones pendientes. 
 Te contaremos más detalles durante la entrevista. 
 ¿Qué se requiere? 
 Los requisitos indispensables para desempeñar este rol son: 
 Formación: FPII o Ciclo Formativo Grado Superior de electricidad, electrónica o similar/análoga. Inglés nivel básico (A2) 
 Competencias: gestión del cambio, resolución de problemas complejos, comunicación, orientación a resultados, orientación al cliente y colaboración. 
 Se valorará : 
 Conocimiento: Conocimientos de funciones de la Red Eléctrica MT/BT, conocimientos en Subestaciones/Centros de Transformación/Redes eléctricas BT, conocimientos de Montaje/ Reparación de aparamenta eléctrica. 
 ¿Por qué unirse a nosotros? 
 Alguno de nuestros beneficios: 
 ● Rango salarial anual en línea con tu experiencia profesional. 
 ● Seguro médico y plan de pensiones. 
 ● Planes de formación personalizados y oportunidades de desarrollo. 
 ● Bienestar corporativo para un mejor equilibrio entre la vida laboral y personal. 
 ● Otros beneficios (subvención comida, agencia de viajes, transporte, energía …) 
 Diversidad, equidad, inclusión y proceso de selección 
 Para nosotros la diversidad y la inclusión son puntos esenciales en nuestro día a día, por lo que en nuestros procesos de selección siempre contamos con todas las personas que muestran su interés y tienen el perfil que buscamos. Integramos e incluimos la diversidad de las personas en todas sus dimensiones. 
 La confianza, la innovación, el respeto, la flexibilidad y la responsabilidad son el alma de nuestra organización. 
 Si tu perfil cumple con los requisitos de la descripción del puesto, el equipo de Atracción de Talento se pondrá en contacto contigo y te proporcionará más información sobre el proceso. 
 ¿Estás listo para marcar la diferencia y crecer con nosotros? 
 ¡Aplica ahora y siéntete parte de la transición energética! 
 #LI-MC1 
 ¿Quiénes somos? 
 Somos líderes mundiales en generación, distribución y venta de energía, así como el mayor operador privado de energías renovables, gracias a nuestras plantas eólicas, hidroeléctricas, fotovoltaicas y geotérmicas. 
 Generamos, distribuimos y comercializamos energía en 28 países de Europa, América, África, Asia y Oceanía, con un compromiso inquebrantable con el desarrollo de los …

 En Endesa tenemos un firme compromiso con la formación y captación del talento. Por eso ofrecemos un Plan de Becas a recién titulados/as universitarios que quieran formar parte de un modelo de aprendizaje colaborativo orientado a adquirir competencias profesionales. 
 Para esta beca, buscamos personas recién graduadas en Ingeniería Industrial/ Ingeniería Eléctrica/ Ingeniería Electrónica/ Ingeniería Mecánica o que estén a falta de su TFG, para incorporarse a través de una beca al departamento de Technical Team El Hierro en Valverde, El Hierro.

 La Unidad Territorial se realizan trabajos de revisiones y adecuaciones, aportando y validando los datos necesarios no disponibles en los sistemas, elaborando los informes necesarios para la red MT/BT. 
 En esta Unidad se hacen tareas relativas a certificaciones, puesta en servicio y legalización de las nuevas instalaciones, así como la actualización de los sistemas y bases de datos que corresponda según los procedimientos establecidos. 
 Dentro de la UT se hace una gestión de la red de distribución asignada y también se colabora en el análisis del resultado de las inspecciones y averías, mantenimiento programado y definir los trabajos necesarios de acuerdo con las especificaciones técnicas definidas. 
 ¿En qué colaborarás? 
 Tus principales actividades serán las siguientes: 
 Aprender a realizar y supervisar los trabajos globales de la red de distribución, averías, NNSS, mantenimiento de red, inversión. 
 Colaborar en la revisión de certificaciones, análisis de inspecciones y averías, así como en la gestión de la red de su ámbito, de acuerdo con los procedimientos y a la legislación vigentes. 
 Aprender a realizar Trabajos de revisiones y adecuaciones, aportando y validando los datos necesarios no disponibles en los sistemas, elaborando los informes necesarios. 
 Tareas relativas a certificaciones, puesta en servicio y legalización de las nuevas instalaciones, así como la actualización de los sistemas y bases de datos que corresponda según los procedimientos establecidos. 
 Colaborar en el análisis del resultado de las inspecciones y averías y mantenimiento programado y definir los trabajos necesarios de acuerdo con las especificaciones técnicas definidas. 
 Aprender a elaborar informes y proponer trabajos y propuestas para su mejora. 
 ¿Qué formación y conocimientos van a ser considerados? 
 Ingeniería Industrial/ Ingeniería Eléctrica/ Ingeniería Electrónica / Ingeniería Mecánica 
 Inglés C1
 Conocimiento MS Office avanzado
 Conocimientos valorables de tramitación de datos (Presentaciones Power BI, Bases de Datos Oracle, Access, SQL, …) 
 Conocimientos valorables programación (Phyton, Matlab)
 Se valorará conocimiento de italiano 
 ¿Qué ofrecemos? 
 Prácticas en ENDESA, Programa SWING:

You will be the trusted expert responsible for validating complex opportunities, demonstrating the tangible value of our software portfolio (including HP Workforce Experience , Security , and Collaboration solutions), and ensuring our partners are empowered to win.

 Deliver Proof of Concepts (POCs): Lead the end-to-end execution of Proof of Concepts. You will configure software environments, define success criteria with the client, and guide them through the testing phase to prove technical viability and business value.
 Conduct Remote Demonstrations: Orchestrate high-impact, remote demonstrations of HP’s software suite. You must be able to tailor your narrative to your audience—shifting seamlessly from deep-dive technical features for IT Admins to ROI-focused business outcomes for C-Level executives.
 Customer & Partner Training: Design and deliver technical enablement sessions. You will train customers to maximize their investment and run workshops for Channel Partners to ensure they are equipped to position, sell, and support HP software effectively.
 Escalation Support: Act as the primary technical escalation point for critical issues during the sales cycle or early deployment. You will troubleshoot blockers and collaborate with Level 3 Support and Engineering to resolve complex challenges and maintain customer trust.
 Voice of the Customer: Capture insights from the field—including feature requests, competitive intelligence, and deployment friction—and feed them back to Product Management to shape the future roadmap of HP’s digital services.
 What you bring 
 Experience: 3-5+ years of experience in Technical Pre-Sales, Solution Architecture, or a similar customer-facing technical role.
 Technical Proficiency: Strong understanding of SaaS models , Endpoint Management (e.g., MS Intune, VMware Workspace ONE), and Cybersecurity fundamentals. Familiarity with Windows OS architecture and telemetry data is essential.
 Communication Skills: Exceptional presentation abilities. You are comfortable commanding a virtual room and explaining complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
 Language: Fluency in English & Italian is required.
 Problem Solving: A proactive, analytical mindset with the ability to troubleshoot technical issues under pressure and navigate ambiguity.
 What sets you apart 
 Experience with scripting languages (e.g., PowerShell) for automation and device management.
 Industry certifications such as Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate or ITIL Foundation .
 A passion for the "Future of Work" and Digital Employee Experience (DEX) trends.
 Native Italian with fluency in English. Spanish language is a plus.
 Why HP Barcelona? 
 Our Barcelona site is a global center of excellence and one of HP’s most international hubs, hosting employees from over 60 nationalities.
 Flexibility: We offer a hybrid work model that promotes work-life balance.
 Growth: Access to HP’s endless learning platforms, certification paths, and mentorship programs.
 Impact: Join a company recognized as one of the world’s most sustainable corporations.

items.desc:
Lumen Labs | Robotics/Hardware Engineer, Simulation Engineer | San Francisco, CA | ONSITE | Full-time | $150k–200k + equity | https://lumenresearch.co 
Howdy! Lumen Labs is building the cognitive layer for physical AI. Nearly every major robotics effort today teaches machines by showing them thousands of hours of human teleoperation. We think that paradigm has a ceiling, and we’re working on nature-inspired architectures for unstructured environments (construction sites, mining, pipelines, battlefield). Pre-seed, backed by top VC funds and operators from robotics/AI companies. Today we run wheeled navigation, we’re dipping our toes into drones, and we’re eyeing weirder platforms like home inspection.
We’re a small team hiring two engineers who will work closely with each other and with our model engineer:
ROBOTICS / HARDWARE ENGINEER: Own the hardware and infrastructure that keeps our research platforms running: the ROS2 (Humble) stack across onboard and offboard compute, sensor integration and calibration (LiDAR, depth, IMU, encoders), the safety pipeline during autonomous runs, and getting trained policies onto real hardware. Will be hands-on with real mobile robots (UART, encoders, PWM, IMU, LiDAR), strong Python + embedded, comfortable reading code you didn’t write, and can debug hardware and firmware at the same time. Full posting: https://desert-bearskin-26d.notion.site/Robotics-Engineer-Ro... 
SIMULATION ENGINEER: Own “the gauntlet,” our test library for putting new architectures through their paces: a Gymnasium-style interface on both sides (environment and model) so anything built to spec is compatible with everything else. Mostly MuJoCo and Gazebo today, moving toward Isaac Sim, and some other more bespoke sims. You will be building task simulators for training and testing and keeping them running (GPS-denied drone nav, construction sites, boat cleaning, forklifts, abstract control), including physics, honest sensor models, digital twins of our real platforms, domain randomization, and the sim compute. Dungeon Master. If you have built or substantially rebuilt a simulator of some kind (robotics/RL is closest, but a physics-based game, scientific sim, or flight sim mod counts) this would be a good role for you. Comfortable with the Gymnasium/dm_control way of thinking, can pick up GPU-vectorized sim (MJX, Isaac Lab, JAX) quickly, and test-driven. Full posting: https://desert-bearskin-26d.notion.site/Simulation-Engineer-... 
Email hi@lumenresearch.co, mention HN and which role, and tell us about a project you’ve built. If you can link to a trained policy running on real hardware (robotics) or a simulator you built or fixed and something you trained inside it (sim), you go to the top of the pile.

items.desc:
Table Tennis Community Builder 
 Bratislava
 About the role
 Help us build and grow the table tennis category at athme in Bratislava. Table Tennis is a fast, social sport that anyone can pick up, and we want athme to be the easiest way to find a game and the people to play with.
 You will work directly with table tennis clubs, organizers, communities, universities, companies, and informal groups to bring more games onto the platform and turn table tennis into one of athme’s strongest categories.
 This is a hands-on role for someone who wants real startup experience and responsibility. You will work closely with the founding team and receive a clear playbook, support, outreach materials, and weekly priorities.
 You are not expected to build everything from scratch. Your job is to execute, learn quickly, build relationships, and help us understand what makes table tennis grow.
 What you will do
 • Find and connect with table tennis clubs, organizers, communities, universities, companies, and informal groups
 • Help bring new table tennis events and recurring games onto athme
 • Build relationships with hosts, coaches, and community leaders
 • Help existing organizers fill their tables and grow participation in their events
 • Identify new formats, partnerships, venues, and opportunities for table tennis, such as social play nights, level-based matches, round robins, and tournaments
 • Support and occasionally attend table tennis events in Bratislava
 • Work closely with the athme team on growth, outreach, pricing, and event strategy
 • Collect feedback from players and organizers to improve the table tennis experience
 • Take ownership of growing table tennis participation and revenue over time
 What success looks like
 The goal is simple: make table tennis on athme bigger every month.
 Over time, this means:
 • More table tennis events happening regularly
 • Players easily finding opponents at their level
 • More active organizers and hosts
 • More players joining and returning
 • Strong partnerships with table tennis clubs and communities
 • Increasing revenue generated by the table tennis category
 • Building a category that becomes increasingly self-sustaining as it grows
 Who we are looking for
 You do not need previous startup or business development experience.
 You could be a strong fit if:
 • You love table tennis and understand the community around it
 • You enjoy meeting people and building relationships
 • You are comfortable reaching out to organizers and starting conversations
 • You are proactive, reliable, and willing to learn by doing
 • You like taking ownership and seeing measurable results from your work
 • You are interested in startups, marketplaces, community building, or entrepreneurship
 • You are based in Bratislava and can meet organizers and attend events in person
 • You are currently a student and looking for meaningful hands-on experience
 • You speak fluent English, our working language
 Compensation and growth
 We want this role to work for ambitious people who want to grow with athme.
 This role starts as an unpaid student internship. The focus is on gaining hands-on experience, building the category, and proving what works. For the right fit and results, we will create a financial setup around the role.
 This can include revenue share based on the revenue generated by table tennis events, other performance-based compensation, and the possibility of developing the position into a paid, full-time role.
 There is no fixed one-month structure. The setup can evolve depending on your availability, contribution, and the results you create.
 What we offer
 • Play for free at athme events across table tennis, football, padel, volleyball, badminton, and other sports
 • Access to dedicated team sports sessions and activities
 • Be part of a young team that actually spends time together outside work
 • Dedicated team events, sports days, team buildings, and community activities
 • Hands-on experience with business development, marketplaces, events, growth, and community building
 • Real responsibility for growing one of athme’s core sports categories
 • Direct collaboration with the founding team
 • A clear playbook, regular support, and practical guidance
 • Flexibility alongside your studies or other commitments
 • The opportunity to benefit financially from the category you help grow
 • A clear path toward a paid, full-time position for strong performers
 • As athme expands, opportunities to travel, join activities in new cities, and take on larger responsibilities across markets
 • Long-term opportunities to grow into bigger roles within athme

 You will work directly with bouldering gyms, climbing clubs, organizers, communities, universities, companies, and informal groups to bring more games onto the platform and turn bouldering into one of athme’s strongest categories.
 This is a hands-on role for someone who wants real startup experience and responsibility. You will work closely with the founding team and receive a clear playbook, support, outreach materials, and weekly priorities.
 You are not expected to build everything from scratch. Your job is to execute, learn quickly, build relationships, and help us understand what makes bouldering grow.
 What you will do
 • Find and connect with bouldering gyms, climbing clubs, organizers, communities, universities, companies, and informal groups
 • Help bring new bouldering events and recurring games onto athme
 • Build relationships with hosts, coaches, and community leaders
 • Help existing organizers fill their sessions and grow participation in their events
 • Identify new formats, partnerships, venues, and opportunities for bouldering, such as social climbing sessions, beginner intros, meetups, and bouldering competitions
 • Support and occasionally attend bouldering events in Bratislava
 • Work closely with the athme team on growth, outreach, pricing, and event strategy
 • Collect feedback from players and organizers to improve the bouldering experience
 • Take ownership of growing bouldering participation and revenue over time
 What success looks like
 The goal is simple: make bouldering on athme bigger every month.
 Over time, this means:
 • More bouldering events happening regularly
 • More people trying bouldering for the first time and coming back
 • More active organizers and hosts
 • More players joining and returning
 • Strong partnerships with bouldering clubs and communities
 • Increasing revenue generated by the bouldering category
 • Building a category that becomes increasingly self-sustaining as it grows
 Who we are looking for
 You do not need previous startup or business development experience.
 You could be a strong fit if:
 • You love bouldering or climbing and understand the community around it
 • You enjoy meeting people and building relationships
 • You are comfortable reaching out to organizers and starting conversations
 • You are proactive, reliable, and willing to learn by doing
 • You like taking ownership and seeing measurable results from your work
 • You are interested in startups, marketplaces, community building, or entrepreneurship
 • You are based in Bratislava and can meet organizers and attend events in person
 • You are currently a student and looking for meaningful hands-on experience
 • You speak fluent English, our working language
 Compensation and growth
 We want this role to work for ambitious people who want to grow with athme.
 This role starts as an unpaid student internship. The focus is on gaining hands-on experience, building the category, and proving what works. For the right fit and results, we will create a financial setup around the role.
 This can include revenue share based on the revenue generated by bouldering events, other performance-based compensation, and the possibility of developing the position into a paid, full-time role.
 There is no fixed one-month structure. The setup can evolve depending on your availability, contribution, and the results you create.
 What we offer
 • Play for free at athme events across bouldering, football, padel, volleyball, badminton, and other sports
 • Access to dedicated team sports sessions and activities
 • Be part of a young team that actually spends time together outside work
 • Dedicated team events, sports days, team buildings, and community activities
 • Hands-on experience with business development, marketplaces, events, growth, and community building
 • Real responsibility for growing one of athme’s core sports categories
 • Direct collaboration with the founding team
 • A clear playbook, regular support, and practical guidance
 • Flexibility alongside your studies or other commitments
 • The opportunity to benefit financially from the category you help grow
 • A clear path toward a paid, full-time position for strong performers
 • As athme expands, opportunities to travel, join activities in new cities, and take on larger responsibilities across markets
 • Long-term opportunities to grow into bigger roles within athme

items.desc:
Business Development Associate, Bratislava
 About the role
 Help grow athme in Bratislava by connecting people through sports and bringing local communities onto the platform.
 We already have a small but active community of over 200 users around volleyball and football in Bratislava. Your role is to build on that foundation: support existing activities, connect with more organizers, and help grow the range of sports people can join.
 You will be athme’s local representative, working with sports organizers, student communities, clubs, companies, and players. You will work closely with our team in Denmark, with a proven playbook, clear weekly priorities, outreach materials, and regular support.
 The role starts with a one-month unpaid internship and can develop into a paid student assistant position based on performance and mutual fit. 
 What you will do
 Build relationships with sports organizers, clubs, student organizations, universities, and companies in Bratislava
 Support our existing volleyball and football community, helping players return regularly and bring friends
 Help new hosts and organizers bring their events and communities onto athme
 Work with local partners to create recurring activities and grow participation
 Identify opportunities to introduce new sports and reach new communities
 Represent athme at campuses, sports venues, events, and community meetups
 Follow our business development playbook and adapt it to the local market
 Share feedback from players and organizers to improve the platform and local experience
 What success looks like
 Success means building relationships that turn into regular activity. We will agree on realistic priorities and targets together, focusing on:
 More recurring events and reliable, active hosts
 Players returning, bringing friends, and trying more sports
 New organizers and communities joining athme
 Local partnerships that consistently bring people into events
 Growing awareness of athme across Bratislava’s sports and student communities
 Who we are looking for
 You do not need previous business development or startup experience. We care more about your energy, reliability, communication skills, and willingness to learn.
 You could be a strong fit if:
 You are a student living in Bratislava
 You enjoy sports, meeting people, and building relationships
 You feel comfortable approaching organizers and starting conversations
 You are proactive, organized, and follow through on what you start
 You can take ownership and ask for support when needed
 You are curious about business, startups, and community building
 You have participated in sports teams, student organizations, volunteering, or events
 Support and onboarding
 From the beginning, you will receive:
 Structured onboarding and a practical business development playbook
 Clear weekly priorities and realistic targets
 Outreach materials, templates, and relevant contacts
 Regular check-ins and feedback
 Direct support with partner conversations and local challenges
 Close collaboration with the founding team
 You will have real responsibility, with clear direction and support.
 Internship structure and paid opportunity
 The position begins with a one-month unpaid internship , giving both sides time to test the collaboration through practical work.
 You will gain hands-on experience in partnerships, community growth, business development, and marketplace operations.
 If you demonstrate reliability, initiative, and measurable progress, and the collaboration is a strong mutual fit, the role can continue as a paid student assistant position. We will review progress together at the end of the month and discuss the next step.
 What we offer
 Experience growing a live sports platform with an existing local community
 Direct exposure to partnerships, growth, operations, and product
 Close collaboration with the founding team
 A clear playbook and ongoing support
 Flexibility alongside your studies
 Opportunities to build a strong local and international network
 Meaningful responsibility and visible impact
 A path to a paid student position based on performance and mutual fit
 Longer-term growth opportunities, including potential equity for people who grow with athme
 Duration
 Initial period: One-month unpaid internship
 Possible next step: Paid part-time or full time role

items.desc: Chez STMicroelectronics, nous sommes convaincus que la technologie est un moteur d’innovation et a un impact positif pour les entreprises, les personnes et la société. En tant qu’acteur mondial des semiconducteurs, nos technologies de pointe et nos composants électroniques sont invisibles mais au cœur du monde d’aujourd’hui. Rejoindre ST, c’est intégrer une entreprise internationale riche de plus de 115 nationalités, présente dans 40 pays, et rassemblant plus de 50 000 talents passionnés et engagés, tous unis par la volonté de créer et d’inventer la technologie de demain. Innover demande bien plus que des compétences techniques : cela nécessite des personnes inspirantes, qui savent collaborer avec respect et enthousiasme. Des collaborateurs animés par la passion, prêts à remettre en question le statu quo, à faire avancer l’innovation et à révéler leur plein potentiel. Venez vivre cette aventure avec nous et contribuez à construire un futur plus intelligent et plus durable, en alliant responsabilité et innovation. Notre technologie commence avec vous. Contexte : stage de fin d'étude de 6mois A propos de vos missions Dans le cadre de ce stage, vous contribuerez à la création d’un générateur automatisé de composants électroniques passifs Radiofréquence. Votre mission consistera à utiliser l’IA et des algorithmes afin de trouver de nouvelles structures. La boucle de conception devra générer des composants répondant à diverses contraintes géométriques et électriques tout en maximisant leurs performances. Au cours de ce stage, vos objectifs sont les suivants: Étudier et analyser la documentation relative à la génération et à l’optimisation multidimensionnelles, notamment appliquées au dessin de circuits passifs. Comprendre les relations entre géométrie et performances électriques. Proposer une boucle de génération et d’optimisation du dessin (layout) de composants répondant à des contraintes géométriques spécifiques. Implémenter cette boucle et comparer ses performances avec celles d’une approche manuelle. Évaluer les bénéfices concrets d’un tel procédé et proposer d’éventuelles pistes d’amélioration et d’évolution. Ce stage vous permettra d’employer concrètement l’IA afin d’initier la création d’un flot automatisé de conception de composants RF. A propos de vous De formation Bac +5, vous avez de bonnes bases en programmation ainsi qu’une compréhension des fondamentaux de l’électronique. Vous maitrisez les différents outils de programmation (Python, Matlab, …) ainsi que de conception et de simulation électronique (Cadence, Spectre, ...) Vous êtes curieux, proactif et savez présenter et mettre en valeur votre travail ST est fière d’être certifiée parmi les 17 entreprises mondiales « Global Top Employers 2025 » et d’être la première et unique entreprise de semi-conducteurs à recevoir cette distinction. ST a été distinguée dans ce classement grâce à sa démarche d’amélioration continue, se démarquant notamment par son engagement en matière d’éthique et d’intégrité, de sens et de valeurs, d’organisation et de gestion du changement, ainsi que par sa stratégie commerciale et ses performances. En France, ST a également obtenu la labélisation Happy Trainee 2025. Nous cultivons un environnement de travail inclusif et diversifié, où la discrimination n’a pas sa place. Notre ambition est de recruter et de fidéliser des talents reflétant la richesse des sociétés dans lesquelles nous évoluons. Nous nous engageons à l’équité dans le développement des carrières, les opportunités professionnelles et la rémunération. Chez ST, nous encourageons les candidats qui ne remplissent pas forcément tous les critères à postuler, car nous croyons en la richesse des parcours variés et offrons de réelles opportunités d’apprentissage et d’évolution. La diversité, l’équité et l’inclusion sont des valeurs fondamentales qui façonnent notre culture d’entreprise. Pour découvrir toutes nos opportunités, rendez-vous sur st.com/careers.

items.desc: Depuis près de 40 ans, Absys Cyborg s’impose comme un partenaire de confiance des PME et ETI dans la refonte et la modernisation de leur processus de gestion. Historiquement ancré autour des solutions Sage et Microsoft, notre positionnement s’étend aujourd’hui à un écosystème de solutions de gestion innovantes, porté par la dynamique du SaaS (Agicap, Flowwa, Kyriba, Lucca, MyReport, Pennylane, Silae). Avec plus de 600 experts répartis dans 15 agences, nous accompagnons des projets à forte valeur ajoutée au plus près des besoins métiers. Pour nous accompagner dans nos projets de croissance, nous renforçons nos équipes et recrutons un(e) : AI Engineer F/H Ce qui vous séduira dans ce poste… Au sein de la Direction IA d’Absys Cyborg, vous concevez, développez et déployez des agents IA et des automatisations pour optimiser les processus internes. Vous intervenez également sur les données et les connaissances qui alimentent ces solutions, afin de garantir des réponses pertinentes, fiables et traçables. Comprendre les besoins métiers et les traduire en solutions IA et en workflows automatisés Concevoir et développer des agents IA, en sélectionnant les modèles et les technologies adaptés, qu’ils soient issus de solutions tierces ou open source Structurer les données et les connaissances nécessaires aux agents : préparation des sources, bases de connaissances, pipelines RAG, indexation et recherche sémantique Intégrer les solutions au système d’information, notamment aux ERP, CRM et bases documentaires, grâce aux API et connecteurs MCP Tester, déployer et améliorer les solutions en production, en assurant leur documentation, leur maintenabilité, le suivi de leurs performances ainsi que leurs coûts Prendre en compte la sécurité, les droits d’accès et les règles de gouvernance dès la conception Et ce que nous apprécierons chez vous… De formation informatique ou ingénieur avec un parcours obligatoire en IA, un langage de programmation courant en IA et possédez une expérience en IA générative, en création d'agents, RAG et automatisation. Une première expérience en stage ou en alternance peut convenir. items.desc: Contexte Le groupe Siléane, acteur majeur de la robotique adaptative en France, propose des solutions innovantes de robotique associée à la vision et à l’IA pour automatiser les process à hautes exigences technologiques et réglementaires de nombreux secteurs industriels. Le groupe Siléane intervient auprès de ses clients sur des projets de R&D, de machine spéciale ou d’ensemblier, mais propose également une offre de machines de gammes (Flowpick, Rovaldy, Kamido) ainsi que des prestations de service. Dans le cadre d'une collaboration entre Siléane et le LAAS-CNRS, nous proposons un stage de recherche de 6 mois visant à faire progresser l'intelligence artificielle physique (Physical AI) appliquée à la robotique industrielle. Ce stage s'inscrit dans le projet de recherche MAGMA, qui explore comment des agents intelligents peuvent comprendre, décomposer, planifier et exécuter des tâches complexes de manipulation robotique sur de longs horizons temporels. Ce projet a déjà donné lieu à plusieurs contributions scientifiques, notamment MAGMA-GEN [1], accepté à Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL 2026), ainsi que les travaux en cours sur MAGMA-BENCH [2], un environnement d'évaluation d’agents robotiques confrontés à des tâches complexes et dynamiques. Bien que les approches actuelles montrent des capacités prometteuses, des défis majeurs subsistent concernant la coordination de plusieurs robots, l'optimisation de l'exécution des tâches et l'adaptation des plans face aux événements imprévus. L'objectif de ce stage est d'étudier Objectifs de recherche Le stage se situe à l'intersection de l'IA agentique (Agentic AI), de la planification de tâches et des systèmes multi-robots. La principale question de recherche est la suivante : Comment des agents intelligents peuvent-ils combiner des représentations structurées des tâches, des capacités de raisonnement et des méthodes de planification classiques pour coordonner efficacement plusieurs robots dans des environnements dynamiques ? Le stage s'articulera autour de deux axes de recherche principaux. 1. Architecture d'agents et représentation des tâches Étudier et proposer de nouvelles architectures pour la planification de tâches robotiques à long horizon. Explorer différentes représentations structurées des tâches, notamment les graphes de tâches, la planification hiérarchique et les représentations symboliques. Étudier comment les grands modèles de langage (Large Language Models, LLMs) peuvent interagir avec des approches de planification classiques, telles que les planificateurs basés sur PDDL, les méthodes d'optimisation sous contraintes, ainsi que les stratégies d'allocation et d'ordonnancement des tâches pour la coordination multi-robots [3]. Étudier comment les agents peuvent réagir aux événements imprévus, aux échecs d'exécution et à l'évolution des exigences des tâches. Évaluer les compromis entre la qualité de la planification, le coût computationnel et les capacités d'adaptation. 2. Évaluation expérimentale et benchmarking Utiliser MAGMA-GEN et MAGMA-BENCH pour générer des scénarios et évaluer les architectures proposées. Concevoir de nouveaux scénarios multi-robots intégrant des dépendances entre tâches, des ressources partagées et des événements dynamiques. Comparer les approches proposées aux architectures d'agents et aux méthodes de planification existantes. Valider certaines capacités sur de véritables plateformes robotiques industrielles. Le ou la stagiaire sera encouragé(e) à prendre des initiatives, explorer des idées originales et contribuer activement aux orientations scientifiques du projet, depuis l'étude de l'état de l'art jusqu'à l'évaluation expérimentale. Ce stage pourra déboucher sur une publication scientifique et d'éventuelles opportunités professionnelles. Nous recherchons un(e) étudiant(e) motivé(e) en Master 2 (ou équivalent), spécialisé(e) en intelligence artificielle, robotique, informatique ou dans un domaine connexe. Nous apprécions particulièrement les candidatures de personnes ayant déjà exploré l'intelligence artificielle à travers des stages de recherche, des projets universitaires, des contributions open source ou des projets personnels. Compétences requises Bonnes compétences en programmation Python. Bonne compréhension du Machine Learning et des méthodes modernes d'intelligence artificielle. Bonnes pratiques de développement logiciel (architecture modulaire, qualité du code, expérimentation). Capacité à comprendre et implémenter des méthodes issues d'articles scientifiques. Autonomie, curiosité et créativité. Compétences appréciées Expérience avec les LLMs, l'IA agentique ou le fine-tuning de modèles de langage. Connaissances en planification de tâches et de mouvements (Task and Motion Planning), PDDL ou méthodes d'optimisation. Connaissances en apprentissage par renforcement (Reinforcement Learning) ou en apprentissage par imitation (Imitation Learning). items.card: Votre mission Votre mission sera d’identifier, expérimenter et évaluer des cas d’usage de l’IA applicables aux métiers de la conception Hardware. Vous explorerez notamment les possibilités offertes par l’IA dans trois domaines : Conception électronique : analyse de datasheets, recherche et sélection de composants, assistance à la conception et à la revue de schémas, détection d’incohérences. PCB et vérification de
items.desc: Kontron Modular Computers S.A.S., située à Toulon, est une entreprise française de référence dans le domaine des technologies embarquées. Forte de plus de 100 collaborateurs, notre société connaît une croissance soutenue, reflet de notre dynamisme et de notre capacité à innover dans un secteur exigeant. Filiale du groupe international Kontron – acteur majeur avec 7 000 collaborateurs et 1,7 milliard d’euros de chiffre d’affaires – nous bénéficions de la solidité d’un leader mondial tout en conservant l’agilité et la proximité d’une structure à taille humaine. Spécialisée dans la conception de cartes électroniques numériques et de calculateurs embarqués, notre entreprise développe des solutions robustes et innovantes pour des environnements critiques. Nos produits sont intégrés dans des systèmes de Défense, d’Aéronautique et de Transport ferroviaire, et sont reconnus par des clients majeurs en France comme à l’international. Contexte La conception de cartes électroniques complexes fait intervenir de nombreuses activités : définition d’architecture, sélection de composants, analyse de datasheets, conception et revue de schémas, routage PCB, simulations, vérification des règles de conception et préparation à l’industrialisation. Les progrès récents de l’Intelligence Artificielle, notamment de l’IA générative et des modèles de langage (LLM), ouvrent de nouvelles possibilités pour assister l’ingénieur Hardware et automatiser certaines tâches du processus de développement. Dans le cadre de l’amélioration de ses méthodes de conception, l’équipe Hardware souhaite explorer ces nouvelles technologies et évaluer concrètement leur intérêt pour le développement de cartes électroniques. Cette démarche pourra notamment compléter les travaux déjà menés autour du DFx pour les cartes électroniques et de l’industrialisation. Votre mission Votre mission sera d’identifier, expérimenter et évaluer des cas d’usage de l’IA applicables aux métiers de la conception Hardware. Vous explorerez notamment les possibilités offertes par l’IA dans trois domaines : Conception électronique : analyse de datasheets, recherche et sélection de composants, assistance à la conception et à la revue de schémas, détection d’incohérences. PCB et vérification de conception : analyse des contraintes, assistance au placement/routage, exploitation de simulations SI/PI et amélioration des contrôles de conception. Industrialisation et test : analyse de BOM, DFM/DFA/DFT, identification de risques de fabrication et exploitation des données de production et de test. Après une première phase d’exploration, vous sélectionnerez avec l’équipe un ou deux cas d’usage présentant le meilleur potentiel et développerez un Proof of Concept (PoC) permettant d’en évaluer concrètement l’intérêt. Un démonstrateur pourra par exemple consister à fournir à un assistant IA un schéma électronique, une BOM et les datasheets associées afin de réaliser une pré-revue de conception et d’identifier des points de vérification pour l’ingénieur. L’objectif n’est pas de remplacer l’expertise du concepteur ou les outils EDA existants, mais de déterminer quelles activités peuvent être efficacement assistées ou automatisées tout en garantissant la fiabilité et la traçabilité des résultats. Travaux à réaliser Le stage s’articulera autour de quatre étapes principales : État de l’art et analyse des besoins Identifier les solutions IA existantes pour l’électronique et analyser les activités Hardware susceptibles de bénéficier de ces technologies. Expérimentation Sélectionner plusieurs cas d’usage et expérimenter différentes approches, modèles et outils. Développement d’un démonstrateur Réaliser un PoC sur un ou deux cas d’usage représentatifs et le tester sur des données issues d’un développement électronique. Évaluation et recommandations Évaluer la qualité et la fiabilité des résultats, les gains potentiels, les limites de l’approche et les possibilités d’intégration dans le processus de développement Hardware. Étudiant(e) en 4e année d’école d’ingénieur ou équivalent Bac+4, avec une spécialisation en : électronique ; systèmes embarqués ; informatique industrielle ; ou domaine équivalent avec un intérêt pour l’IA et l’automatisation. Compétences appréciées électronique numérique et analogique ; lecture de schémas électroniques et de datasheets ; notions de conception PCB ; programmation Python ; notions d’IA générative et de LLM ; curiosité pour les outils EDA et l’automatisation. Une expertise préalable en IA n’est pas indispensable. Un bon socle en électronique, des compétences en programmation et une forte curiosité technique seront privilégiés.

Alors, postulez et rejoignez l’AMIAD, l’Agence Ministérielle pour l’IA de Défense. Rattachée au ministre des armées, l’AMIAD est une entité en pleine expansion qui mène des projets IA d’envergure, en collaboration avec toutes les entités du ministère et sur de nombreux domaines d'activité (systèmes d’armes, opérations, renseignement, commandement, soutien, administration). Będziesz tworzyć wewnętrzne produkty dla Synthos: platformy analityczne, narzędzia do automatyzacji procesów i aplikacje biznesowe wspierane przez AI. Weźmiesz udział w całym cyklu, od projektu, przez backend w Pythonie lub C# i frontend w React lub Vue, po wdrożenie i utrzymanie. Dużą część pracy stanowią funkcje oparte o AI: LLM, RAG, agenci, integracje z bazami wektorowymi, wyszukiwarkami i zewnętrznymi usługami. Nie chodzi tylko o to, żeby działało na demo. Zależy nam na rozwiązaniach szybkich, niezawodnych, rozsądnych kosztowo i dobrze przetestowanych. Po uruchomieniu pomożesz je monitorować i rozwijać dalej. You will report to our IT Manager and work alongside external developers when a project needs extra capacity. Your first project You'll start with
items.desc: Not another graduate scheme Most graduate tech jobs put you in a team of 200 and give you one ticket a fortnight. This one puts you next to the Managing Director, with a real business to automate and the authority to change how it works. Castlemead Insurance Brokers is a Chartered, independent commercial insurance broker. We were founded in Bristol in 1986, are still owned by the founding family, and today place over £25m of premium for businesses across the UK and Europe. Our clients include hauliers, aerospace engineers, construction firms, tech companies and specialist aviation risks. We have offices in Bristol, Exeter and Compiègne (France). Through GBN Worldwide, TechAssure and the Brokerbility network, we have the international reach of a much larger firm. We are independent by choice. Our clients deal with the same experienced, ACII-qualified people year after year, rather than a call centre run by a private-equity consolidator. We want to stay independent, which means using technology better than the big players do. That is where you come in. The role You will join as our first dedicated automation hire. You will work with our Managing Director and Directors to find the slow, manual and repetitive parts of the business and remove them, so our people spend their time advising clients instead of retyping data. You will report to our IT Manager and work alongside external developers when a project needs extra capacity. Your first project You'll start with our personal lines offering. We insure the homes, cars and private assets of the business owners we already look after, along with their families and connected clients. We also receive a steady flow of enquiries from our partner networks. At the moment all of this is handled manually, from data capture and quoting through to renewal and follow-up. Your job is to change that by building a joined-up, largely automated process that gives clients a faster and smoother experience and frees our team to spend their time advising. What you'll be doing Mapping our broking processes (starting with household and personal lines, then renewals, onboarding, claims and reporting) and identifying what can be automated Building automations in Python, working with APIs and with Microsoft 365, Power Automate and our Insurance broking platform. Putting AI to practical use. We already use Claude across the business for policy checking, contract review and document production, and you will help turn that into reliable, repeatable workflows Producing high-quality client reports and documents in Word and Excel, generated automatically wherever possible Writing clear documentation and prompts (Markdown) so the whole team can use what you build Working with external developers: writing briefs, testing their work and making sure it does what the business needs What you'll learn This role is not just coding. You will learn how commercial insurance broking actually works, including how risks are presented to insurers, how cover is checked and how clients are kept properly protected. You will learn it from people who have done the job for decades. If you want a career in insurance or insurtech, few better starting points exist. What we're looking for A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science or a related subject (2025/2026 graduates welcome) Solid Python, and an understanding of how APIs work Strong Excel and Word skills, or a willingness to become very good at both quickly Hands-on interest in AI tools and large language models You can explain technical things to non-technical people without making them feel stupid You would rather fix a problem than write a report about it No insurance knowledge needed. We will teach you. Why Castlemead? Direct exposure to senior leadership from day one A real problem set, with your work visible across the business within weeks A long-serving, stable team (several colleagues have been with us 10 to 30 years) An independent firm with a 40-year track record and no intention of selling out To apply Send your CV and a short note telling us about something you've built (code, automation, side project, anything) and what it taught you. Castlemead Insurance Brokers Limited is authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority (FRN 303956). Pay: From £28,000.00 per year Work Location: In person

items.card: The Role We build infrastructure for frontier AI, and we use AI to build it. Every team at OLIX works with AI tools, coding harnesses, models and agents, and we intend to use them more. We are hiring an AI Security Engineer to make that adoption safe without slowing it down. You will map our AI footprint, secure our agents and their identities, protect our compute infrastructure, and build the controls that stop our
items.desc: About OLIX AI is growing faster than any technology in history, and the demand has created an infrastructure gap: we can no longer build chips or power stations fast enough to keep up. The industry still relies on a ten-year-old hardware blueprint that has reached its limit. The OLIX Decode Accelerator 1 (DX-1) is the first accelerator architected specifically for decode. Rack-scale co-design of logic, data movement, packaging, optics and interconnect delivers a step change in system-level performance. The Role We build infrastructure for frontier AI, and we use AI to build it. Every team at OLIX works with AI tools, coding harnesses, models and agents, and we intend to use them more. We are hiring an AI Security Engineer to make that adoption safe without slowing it down. You will map our AI footprint, secure our agents and their identities, protect our compute infrastructure, and build the controls that stop our IP and data leaving through AI systems. You will give teams a fast path to adopt new tools and make AI security measurable. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role with the freedom to define AI security at OLIX from the ground up. Responsibilities Map the AI footprint: build and maintain the inventory of AI tools, models, agents and data flows across the company. Secure agents: give every agent a managed identity, least-privilege access, logged actions and the right human approvals. Build controls against AI threats: prompt injection, data leakage, model and package supply chain, unsafe agent actions and shadow AI. Secure AI infrastructure: harden the cloud compute our teams use to build and run AI workloads. Make AI security measurable: run our ISO 42001 self-assessment and feed AI security events into our SIEM. Enable safe adoption: review new AI tools within days and publish the guardrails teams need. Skills and experience 5 or more years in security engineering, application security or cloud security, with at least 2 years securing AI or ML systems, LLM applications or agents. Hands-on knowledge of LLM-specific threats and their mitigations. Experience securing agentic systems: tool permissions, MCP servers, credentials and human approval steps. AWS security experience and identity experience, ideally Okta. Software engineering in Python or TypeScript. Daily use of AI coding tools and agents in your own work. Nice to have: experience with ISO 42001 or the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, or in a hardware or deep-tech company. Compensation and equity Competitive salary: commensurate with your experience, skills and location. Equity and ownership: meaningful stock options. Proximity bonus: an annual Living-Local Bonus if you live within 20 minutes of the office. Retirement benefits: employer-contributed retirement plans. Due to U.S. export control regulations, candidates' eligibility to work at OLIX depends on their most recent citizenship or permanent residency status. We are generally unable to consider applicants whose most recent citizenship or permanent residence is in certain restricted countries (currently including Iran, North Korea, Syria, Cuba, Russia, Belarus, China, Hong Kong, Macau, and Venezuela). Applicants who have subsequently obtained citizenship or permanent residency in another country not subject to these restrictions may still be eligible. Compensation Range: £139K

items.title: Electrical Distribution Engineer
items.card: YOUR IMPACT In this role, you will have the opportunity to shape the electrical architecture of a first-of-a-kind power plant and define how it interacts with both internal consumers and the wider electrical grid. You will drive the modernization of power system monitoring, diagnostics, and predictive maintenance strategies, leveraging data and digital technologies to improve reliability and operational performance.
items.desc: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO Architect a breakthrough energy technology – Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy. Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in fusion – Work across magnet design, HTS technology, manufacturing, structural integration, and controls, turning cutting-edge science into real hardware Move fast and build what matters – Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering, turning bold ideas into real hardware on the path to commercial fusion. YOUR IMPACT In this role, you will have the opportunity to shape the electrical architecture of a first-of-a-kind power plant and define how it interacts with both internal consumers and the wider electrical grid. You will drive the modernization of power system monitoring, diagnostics, and predictive maintenance strategies, leveraging data and digital technologies to improve reliability and operational performance. Beyond the plant itself, you will help develop innovative grid-facing capabilities and online services, exploring new ways for power generation assets to create value through advanced connectivity, flexibility, and participation in the evolving energy ecosystem. WHAT YOU WILL DO Define and develop the plant's electrical architecture, ensuring reliable and efficient operation across diverse electrical loads and systems. Lead grid integration studies and analyses, including load flow, fault, stability, power quality, and protection coordination assessments. Specify and oversee the integration of electrical equipment, including transformers, switchgear, protection systems, and power conversion technologies. Establish monitoring, diagnostics, and condition-based maintenance approaches to improve asset reliability and reduce unplanned downtime. Develop predictive maintenance frameworks using operational and equipment health data. Evaluate and develop opportunities for advanced grid services, including flexibility, ancillary services, demand response, and other emerging market offerings. Explore innovative digital and online services that can enhance plant performance, operational visibility, and value creation within future energy systems. WHO YOU ARE You have a University (Higher education) degree in Electrical Engineering, Control Systems, Computer Science or equivalent You have a strong background in electrical engineering, control systems, or a related field, with hands-on experience in industrial environments You are adaptable and motivated to grow with evolving technologies and increasing system complexity Experience in grid integration, or electrical infrastructure for industrial, utility-scale, or energy-related facilities is a plus Knowledge of reactive power compensation is a plus INTERVIEW PROCESS Recruiter Interview (30-60 min) Technical Screening (30 min) Technical Panel (3x60 min) At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

items.desc: Omschrijving Het Asset & Liability Management (ALM) team bij Belfius Bank is verantwoordelijk voor het beheer van de activa en passiva van de bank, met als doel de winstgevendheid te optimaliseren en tegelijkertijd de financiële en liquiditeitsrisico's te beheersen. Bij een bank omvatten de activa doorgaans de aan klanten verstrekte leningen, terwijl de passiva voornamelijk bestaan uit klantendeposito's en andere financieringsbronnen. Het evenwicht tussen deze activa en passiva is cruciaal voor de stabiliteit en de prestaties van de bank. Als ALM-analist help je onze teams bij het gebruik en de ontwikkeling van financiële, wiskundige en ‘klantgedrags’-modellen om te zorgen voor een optimale afstemming tussen de activa en de passiva van de bank. Naast deze kerntaak ondersteun je ook andere ALM-teams door tools te ontwerpen en te ontwikkelen die op hun behoeften zijn afgestemd – bijvoorbeeld door het creëren van een prijszettingstool voor leningen in Python. Je hebt invloed op de modellen van de bank voor het beheer van renterisico en liquiditeitsrisico, en op de commerciële strategieën met betrekking tot de rentetarieven en liquiditeit van de bank. De job in een notendop Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het gebruik en onderhoud van bepaalde bestaande ALM-modellen en draagt bij aan het onderzoek en de ontwikkeling van nieuwe modellen en tools om het ALM-beheer steeds efficiënter te maken en in te spelen op de evolutie van de financiële markten en het klantgedrag. Je belangrijkste taak is om ons team te helpen op het gebied van ‘data science’ en AI, door nieuwe data te onderzoeken en AI-tools te ontwikkelen om onze klanten beter te begrijpen, evenals het onderhoud en de ontwikkeling van onze wiskundige en financiële modellen. Je team bestaat uit burgerlijke, financiële ingenieurs en wiskundigen. Jouw rol hierin is om nieuwe kennis, ideeën aan te brengen en te helpen bij het beheer van het dagelijkse ALM-beheer van de bank. Een typische werkdag als ALM-analist bestaat bijvoorbeeld uit het programmeren in Python (nieuwe functionaliteiten implementeren voor bestaande tools in Python en nieuwe modellen ontwikkelen), evenals het verkennen (SQL) en onderzoeken van de enorme hoeveelheid data die bij Belfius beschikbaar is om het klantgedrag te analyseren. Er zullen ook informatiedeelname en brainstormsessies zijn met de ALM-, Risk-, ICM (bijvoorbeeld boekhouding), dealingroom-, data- en AI-teams en ook de business. Op sommige dagen heeft u leersessies (Sharing is Caring) en informatiesessies (wekelijkse bijeenkomst). U moet ook bijdragen aan de voorbereiding van presentaties voor bepaalde vergaderingen en in het bijzonder voor het ALCo (Asset-Liability Committee) – zowel presentaties maken als zelf presenteren voor het ALCo. Jij hoeft geen witte raaf te zijn Al kan je er bij ons wel één worden. Bij ons mag je volop je vleugels uitslaan indien je voldoet aan de volgende voorwaarden: je een diploma hebt in finance en/of wiskunde en/of actuariële wetenschappen en/of een eerste werkervaring hebt je interesse hebt in data science en programmeren (Python of andere programmeertalen) je graag in teamverband werkt je van innovatie houdt en het ontwikkelen van nieuwe ideeën. Je scoort extra als: je tweetalig bent (Nederlands/Frans) je goede kennis hebt van het Python-programmeerprogramma Belfius koestert zijn talenten Behalve de kans om elke dag te shinen, bieden wij jou een fulltime contract van onbepaalde duur met: Een mooi loon aangevuld met een innovatief aanbod om een persoonlijk budget samen te stellen dat je kan besteden volgens je voorkeuren (bv. wagen, fiets, pc, smartphone, tablet, huisvesting onder bepaalde voorwaarden) en extralegale voordelen zoals maaltijdcheques, personeelsvoordeel op eigen producten en diensten, en een hospitalisatie- en groepsverzekering. Mogelijkheden te over om je te ontwikkelen door een brede waaier aan opleidingen en carrièrekansen in de hele Belfius-groep. Een goede werk-privé balans dankzij flexibele uren, de combinatie kantoor- en thuiswerk en een aantrekkelijk aantal vakantiedagen. Een moderne werkplek in het hart van Brussel met een coole fitness, een lekker gezond restaurant en gezellige ontmoetingsruimtes, dit alles op wandelafstand van de winkelstraat, het treinstation Brussel-Noord en de metrohalte Rogier.

items.desc: We are looking for a Software Engineer who wants to build and ship new features that quickly reach customers, on top of an engine that already runs at scale. You join our platform team, which owns several live domains that our customers depend on every day. The foundations are solid and well maintained, so your time goes into new use cases and features rather than firefighting. Whether you have a couple of years of experience or a few more, we would like to see your application. What's in it for you? Hear directly from the people using what you build. Customer feedback feeds straight back into the roadmap, and you work on features and product decisions that matter to end users. Build on a system with real scale behind it. The event system spans 8 domains, exposes 20+ event types as webhooks, and powers 10 configurable alert types for our end users - currently ~20k active configurations triggering ~200k events every weekday. The team owns 8+ public APIs end to end, crucial for customers' day-to-day business. Learn from experts who share. You’ll join a talkative team of experienced domain experts who love discussing technical topics. Grow with support. Scoped, well-defined assignments to start, senior colleagues pairing and reviewing your work, and shared ownership of keeping things running. See your work ship. We favour small, frequent releases over long project cycles, so what you build lands in production fast. Who are you ideally? You are a backend developer with strong Java skills who is at home on live production systems. Hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, and REST APIs, in particular building and running your own services in a modern cloud-based microservice and event-driven architecture. You are comfortable working on live production systems with high data volumes and migration paths, keeping quality, observability, reliability, and performance in mind. You enjoy talking tech: you like discussing technical topics widely, learning, and listening in on topics not always directly related to your own tasks. You are motivated by incremental, high-quality delivery on products that are already live, bringing a fresh perspective that helps rework existing infrastructure where it is holding us back, and you treat the tools already in our platform as solid building blocks. Nice to have: Flink and stateful processing (or the willingness to learn it, since it is widely used here), relational databases, and Grafana and Prometheus, our “bread and butter”. You embrace AI as part of how you engineer. From prototyping through to production, you use AI tools as an integrated part of your workflow, not as a shortcut but as a force multiplier. That said, this isn't the main thing we're hiring for: curiosity and a willingness to use it well matter more than deep prior experience. Don't meet every single requirement? No worries, this is what we're looking for ideally. If you're excited about this role but your background doesn't align perfectly with every point above, we encourage you to apply. Primary responsibilities Improve, extend and run the live domains our team owns, including telemetry storage and APIs, the event system, and the alerting engine, without disrupting production. Build and run your own services, with migration paths when architecture or data formats need to change. Work closely with the internal teams building products on top of the platform you help shape. Keep the platform reliable and observable at high data volumes. Our hiring process Don’t waste your time writing the perfect cover letter. We want you to create an impact that matters - and that’s not in the cover letter. Initial phone conversation with a colleague from our P&T team. Virtual meet and greet with your potential new leader and someone from the team, so you’ll get to know the role and team better. Assignment-specific interview with the hiring manager and a lead engineer from the team. We want to give you a real insight into the work. You’ll receive a case to prepare ahead of the interview and present to relevant colleagues - people you’ll also work closely with in the role. If needed, we will obtain references from former employers and conduct background checks at relevant levels. Offer presentation and walk-through. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale. We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products - it’s a way of life at Trackunit. We’re proud to be a truly global team. items.desc: Capital planning sits at the heart of how Danske Bank balances financial resilience with sustainable growth. As part of a close-knit analytical team, you will contribute to decisions that enable the bank to serve its customers and support its strategic ambitions. This is a role where your work genuinely matters and where you will build a solid foundation in capital management. What you will be doing The Capital Planning team is part of Financial Resource Management in Group Treasury, sitting within Danske Bank's CFO area. The team of seven works on capital target setting, capital issuances, dividend decisions and macroeconomic stress testing. Your analyses and reports will receive close attention from the Executive Leadership Team, the Board of Directors and financial regulators. The atmosphere is collaborative, with knowledge sharing and learning woven into everyday working life, and the team takes pride in delivering high-quality work while enjoying the process. More specifically, you will: Support monthly capital and MREL assessments and projections Analyse the effects of regulatory and model changes with relevant teams Contribute to stress tests and assessments of capital targets and buffers Help analyse payout capacity and capital and MREL funding needs Prepare decision material and gradually take ownership of defined deliverables About you Master's degree in economics, finance, business administration or a related field Strong analytical skills and a structured, detail-oriented approach Ability to communicate complex findings clearly in English Curious and collaborative, with an interest in learning and developing within the field Comfortable working independently on defined tasks while contributing to team goals Experience in banking or capital management, and familiarity with Python, SQL or similar tools, would be a welcome addition. We consider candidates at different stages of their career, so we encourage you to apply whether you are just starting out or bring a few years of relevant experience. What we offer you You will join a dedicated team where collaboration and continuous learning are part of daily work. We work in a hybrid model, with three to four days per week in the office to support knowledge sharing and team cohesion. You will have room to develop your analytical skills, deepen your understanding of capital management, and take on increasing responsibility over time. Are you ready for the next step? If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, we would be glad to hear from you. Feel free to reach out to hiring manager Henrik Bang at hban@danskebank.dk if you have any questions about the role before applying. We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible or by 22 November 2026 at the latest. We look forward to hearing from you!

items.desc: NestAI builds the adaptive operating system for modern battlefield operations. Most AI systems are built once, validated at deployment, and expected to stay sufficient after that. That assumption holds until conditions change, and in defence, they always do. Our team develops adaptive intelligence for unmanned and command systems: AI that continuously learns from operational data and adapts to changing conditions, deployed in environments where there is no internet, no GPS, and failure is not an option. NestOS, our open, modular, and interoperable platform, enables this at scale and keeps capability evolution under sovereign European control. Founded in 2025 by Peter Sarlin, whose previous company Silo AI became Europe’s largest AI acquisition, NestAI has grown to over 200 engineers and scientists and partners with leading European defence forces and industry. You’ll work closely with customer project managers and test engineers at test sites and during live operations, bringing deep radio and network expertise to bear on real operational problems.
