How you think, learn, and take ownership matters more to us than ticking every box. Here is what we are looking for: Strong understanding of spectrum and spectrum management, and how RF frequencies behave over the air Solid experience with radio networks, specifically at the radio/RF level, not just the network layer above it Understanding of network management protocols and architecture: how networks are controlled, what data flows through them, and how that’s governed Typically at least 3-5+ years of relevant experience, enough to have built real depth in network management and RF Comfortable working directly with customer project managers and test engineers at test sites and during operations A technical profile with some understanding of the hardware side of RF and network systems Nice to have: Familiarity with 5G/6G mobile network protocols and architecture Experience with tactical communications systems or defence/dual-use RF environments Why join NestAI Work alongside over 200 engineers and scientists, including 60+ PhDs. People who’ve built AI platforms, autonomous systems, and defence technology across Europe. Most of our people say the best thing about NestAI is the people you get to work with. Work with real ownership. You identify what needs building, talk to the right people, and ship. Ownership here is the expectation, not a talking point. Work at a pace where Monday’s idea can be Friday’s deployment. The problems we’re solving are urgent, so the culture reflects it. Work on systems that must operate with no connectivity, no GPS, and no margin for error. The problems we’re solving are technically hard, genuinely novel, and they sit at the intersection of AI and the physical world. Work at a company where the platform, the practices, and the standards are all being built right now. The people here get to define how things work and how they scale. items.desc: The Opportunity Join a leading systematic investment firm in Paris that sits at the intersection of rigorous scientific research and high-performance trading. This role is designed for researchers currently at, or recently from, top-tier quantitative funds, proprietary trading firms, or elite research labs (e.g. multi-strategy hedge funds, global macro/systematic pods, or leading prop trading platforms) who are looking for a more research-intensive environment with deeper autonomy over model design, richer data access, and a stronger emphasis on long-term alpha development. Unlike heavily siloed or execution-driven organisations, this platform is built around collaborative research, rapid experimentation, and direct translation of ideas into production. The Role As a Quantitative Researcher, you will focus on identifying and extracting predictive signals from a broad universe of datasets, including traditional financial inputs and high-dimensional alternative data. You will design, test, and refine systematic strategies that directly contribute to live trading performance. Working within a large, high-calibre research group, you will collaborate closely with data and software engineers to ensure seamless deployment of robust, scalable trading signals. Key Responsibilities Push the research frontier Develop and apply advanced statistical, econometric, and machine learning methods to uncover persistent inefficiencies in complex, noisy datasets. Continuously iterate models with a strong focus on robustness, stability, and real-world performance. Generate and validate alpha ideas Originate differentiated investment hypotheses. Build rigorous research frameworks and conduct deep empirical testing, including large-scale backtesting and out-of-sample validation. Exploit complex datasets Work with large structured and unstructured datasets to identify non-obvious predictive structure. Engineer features and systematically evaluate signal quality across regimes. Deploy research into production Translate validated research into live trading signals. Partner with engineering teams to implement, monitor, and enhance strategies in production environments. Candidate Profile You are likely already operating in a highly quantitative environment and are looking for a step-change in research scope and impact. items.desc: Dans le cadre de l'évolution et de l'industrialisation de ses infrastructures réseau, notre client souhaite renforcer ses équipes avec un Ingénieur Réseau & Automatisation (NetDevOps). L'objectif principal de la mission est d'identifier, concevoir et développer des cas d'usage permettant d'automatiser les opérations et les configurations des infrastructures réseau. À moyen terme, le client envisage également d'intégrer des solutions d'intelligence artificielle (IA) afin d'améliorer l'efficacité opérationnelle, l'analyse et l'automatisation des activités réseau. Le consultant devra donc disposer d'une solide expertise réseau, associée à des compétences en développement et automatisation. Missions et responsabilités 1. Automatisation des infrastructures réseau Identifier et analyser les opérations réseau susceptibles d'être automatisées. Concevoir et développer des solutions d'automatisation à l'aide d'Ansible et de Python. Automatiser les tâches récurrentes de configuration, d'administration et d'exploitation des équipements réseau. Développer des scripts et playbooks réutilisables et maintenables. Participer à la standardisation et à l'industrialisation des configurations réseau. 2. Développement et intégration Développer des scripts Python pour automatiser les opérations techniques. Exploiter les API REST des différentes solutions réseau. Intégrer les automatisations aux outils et processus existants. Utiliser les outils de gestion de versions et, si nécessaire, les pipelines CI/CD. Assurer la documentation technique des développements réalisés. 3. Évolution vers l'intelligence artificielle Participer à la réflexion sur l'intégration de l'IA dans les processus d'exploitation réseau. Identifier les cas d'usage pouvant bénéficier de l'IA : analyse des configurations, détection d'anomalies, diagnostic d'incidents, assistance à l'exploitation. Contribuer à la préparation d'une architecture d'automatisation évolutive et compatible avec de futurs services d'IA. Participer, selon l'avancement du projet, à l'expérimentation de solutions d'IA appliquées aux infrastructures réseau. Compétences indispensables Solides connaissances des infrastructures réseau : TCP/IP, VLAN, routage, switching, BGP, ACL, VPN. Expérience en administration et configuration d'équipements réseau (Akamai Guardicore, Cisco, Fortinet, Juniper, Palo Alto ou équivalents). Maîtrise d'Ansible et du développement de playbooks. Bon niveau en programmation Python. Connaissance des API REST, JSON et YAML. Compétences appréciées Git, GitLab et pipelines CI/CD. Terraform et principes Infrastructure as Code (IaC). Outils d'inventaire et de gestion des configurations réseau. Connaissances des environnements cloud ou hybrides. Notions d'intelligence artificielle générative, de LLM ou d'AIOps. Profil candidat: Formation supérieure en informatique, réseaux et télécommunications ou équivalent. Expérience confirmée en ingénierie et exploitation des infrastructures réseau. Expérience concrète dans le développement de solutions d'automatisation réseau. Capacité à analyser les besoins techniques et à proposer des solutions adaptées. Autonomie, rigueur, esprit d'analyse et bonnes capacités de communication. Intérêt pour l'innovation technologique et les applications de l'IA aux infrastructures IT.

items.desc: Terres & Eaux, notre entreprise Terres & Eaux est une enseigne française spécialisée dans les univers de la chasse, de la pêche, de l’équitation, des animaux et de la nature. À travers ses magasins et ses canaux de vente à distance et en ligne, elle propose des équipements, des conseils et des services adaptés aux passionnés. Son identité repose sur l’expertise métier, la proximité avec les clients, l’esprit d’équipe et le goût du service. Au siège de Seclin comme en magasin, les équipes contribuent à une ambition commune : simplifier le quotidien des collaborateurs et offrir une expérience client de qualité. Finalité du poste Garantir la disponibilité, la sécurité et la performance du système d’information de Terres & Eaux, au service des magasins, du siège, des activités web et de la relation client. Construire progressivement un environnement applicatif et data cohérent, interconnecté, documenté et évolutif. Être un partenaire de proximité des métiers, capable de transformer leurs besoins en solutions simples, fiables et économiquement maîtrisées. Stratégie SI, gouvernance et pilotage – Élaborer et mettre à jour la feuille de route informatique annuelle et pluriannuelle, avec priorités, calendrier, risques, dépendances et indicateurs de résultat. – Préparer, suivre et optimiser les budgets d’exploitation et d’investissement ; challenger les coûts, licences, contrats et prestations. – Arbitrer avec la direction les projets selon leur valeur métier, leur criticité, les ressources disponibles et le coût complet. – Challenger régulièrement les systèmes et outils existants, comparer des alternatives concrètes et proposer les évolutions offrant le meilleur équilibre entre simplicité, valeur pour les métiers, sécurité et coût. – Placer l’expérience client en magasin et la réduction des tâches contraignantes pour les équipes au cœur des arbitrages et des projets SI. – Piloter les fournisseurs, éditeurs et intégrateurs : cahiers des charges, consultations, déploiements, engagements de service et réversibilité. Infrastructure, réseaux, sécurité et continuité – Assurer le maintien en conditions opérationnelles des postes, serveurs, systèmes, réseaux intersites, accès Internet, Wi-Fi, pare-feu et téléphonie. – Organiser la supervision, les mises à jour, la gestion du parc, des habilitations, des sauvegardes et de la documentation technique. – Définir et tester les plans de continuité et de reprise d’activité (PCA/PRA), les restaurations et les procédures de gestion d’incident. – Piloter la cybersécurité, la prévention des vulnérabilités et la sensibilisation des utilisateurs ; contribuer à la conformité RGPD avec les responsables compétents. Applications métiers, ERP et CRM – Administrer et fiabiliser l’écosystème applicatif existant, en lien avec les directions achats, commerce, magasins, logistique, finance et web. – Contribuer au cadrage, au choix, au déploiement et aux évolutions de l’ERP et du futur CRM : processus, interfaces, reprise de données, tests, formation et conduite du changement. – Garantir la cohérence des référentiels partagés : articles, prix, stocks, fournisseurs, clients, commandes, ventes et données comptables, selon les besoins métier. – Formaliser la gestion des versions, droits d’accès, incidents applicatifs et demandes d’évolution, avec validation des métiers. Bases de données, data lake et qualité des données – Superviser l’administration, les performances, les sauvegardes, la sécurité et l’évolution des bases de données, directement ou avec les prestataires. – Concevoir et déployer une architecture de collecte et de centralisation des données de type data lake, adaptée aux moyens et aux usages de l’entreprise. – Organiser l’intégration, l’historisation, la traçabilité, la documentation et la mise à disposition des données pour les reportings, analyses et outils métiers. – Faciliter l’accès de tous les services aux données utiles à leurs décisions, via des jeux de données fiables, des tableaux de bord ou outils de consultation adaptés, dans le respect des droits d’accès et de la confidentialité. – Définir avec les responsables métiers les règles de qualité des données, les responsabilités de mise à jour, les contrôles de cohérence et le traitement des anomalies. items.desc: DATA ENGINEER 1.Contexte RMAN Sync édite RENOVATIO, une plateforme SaaS de deep learning dédiée à la prévision de la demande, à l'optimisation des achats et au pilotage des prix, pour les acteurs du négoce et de la distribution. La particularité de RENOVATIO est d'être agentique : la plateforme exécute des actions — propositions d'achat, décisions de prix (sans validation humaine systématique). La qualité de la donnée n'est donc pas un sujet d'hygiène interne, elle engage directement des décisions d'approvisionnement chez nos clients. Ces données proviennent d'environnements hétérogènes : ERP métiers, référentiels articles mal normalisés, historiques de ventes incomplets, unités de mesure incohérentes d'un fournisseur à l'autre. Chaque nouveau client suppose une reprise et une fiabilisation. Le poste est créé pour industrialiser cette chaîne, aujourd'hui largement traitée au cas par cas. 2.Mission Construire, fiabiliser et exploiter la chaîne de données de RENOVATIO : ingestion des données clients, contrôles de qualité, préparation des jeux de données alimentant les modèles, et exploitation des traitements en production. 3.Positionnement dans l'organisation Le·la Data Engineer est rattaché·e à la Direction des Opérations, au sein du service client, et travaille au contact direct des chefs de projet déploiement. Le poste est positionné au plus près du terrain : c'est dans les projets clients que se révèlent les problèmes de données, et c'est là que se construisent les solutions durables. Le·la titulaire dispose d'un accès direct à la R&D (chercheurs et ingénieurs plateforme) pour les sujets qui relèvent du produit ou des modèles, sans en dépendre pour son activité courante. Interfaces principales : Direction des Opérations · service client et chefs de projet déploiement · accès direct à la R&D (chercheurs et ingénieurs plateforme). 4.Responsabilités INGESTION ET INTEGRATION DES DONNEES CLIENTS - Concevoir et maintenir les connecteurs d'ingestion : ERP, bases de données, API, fichiers plats, dépôts sécurisés. - Industrialiser la reprise de données d'un nouveau client : réduire le délai entre la signature et la disponibilité d'un jeu de données exploitable. - Normaliser les référentiels hétérogènes : articles, fournisseurs, sites, unités de mesure et leurs conversions. - Documenter chaque intégration de façon à ce qu'elle soit reprise par un autre que son auteur. QUALITE ET FIABILITE DE LA DONNEE - Mettre en place les contrôles de qualité à chaque étape : complétude, cohérence, valeurs aberrantes, ruptures d'historique, doublons. - Détecter et signaler les anomalies avant qu'elles n'atteignent les modèles, et non après. - Assurer la traçabilité des transformations : il doit toujours être possible de remonter d'une recommandation produite à la donnée qui l'a produite. - Définir les règles de traitement des données manquantes ou douteuses, en s'appuyant sur la R&D lorsque le sujet touche aux modèles. PIPELINES DE MODELISATION - Construire et maintenir les traitements qui préparent les jeux de données d'entraînement et d'inférence. - Garantir la reproductibilité : versionnement des jeux de données, isolation des environnements, historisation. - Optimiser les temps de traitement et les coûts d'infrastructure à mesure que le volume de clients augmente. EXPLOITATION ET INDUSTRIALISATION - Orchestrer les traitements récurrents : ordonnancement, reprise sur incident, dépendances. - Mettre en place la supervision : suivi d'exécution, alertes, indicateurs de santé des pipelines. - Assurer l'astreinte fonctionnelle sur les traitements critiques, selon les modalités définies avec la Direction des Opérations. Contribuer à l'intégration continue et au déploiement automatisé des traitements. MODELISATION ET STOCKAGE - Concevoir les schémas de données et leur évolution. - Organiser le stockage et l'historisation en tenant compte du cloisonnement entre clients. Arbitrer entre performance, coût et simplicité d'exploitation. APPUI AUX DEPLOIEMENTS - Accompagner les chefs de projet sur la phase de qualification des données chez un nouveau client : audit de l'existant, identification des manques, estimation de la charge de reprise. - Transmettre aux équipes de déploiement les moyens de diagnostiquer seules les problèmes de données courants, afin de limiter les sollicitations récurrentes. - Intervenir sur les projets internationaux, en Europe et aux États-Unis, où les systèmes sources, les formats et les conventions diffèrent de ceux rencontrés en France. SECURITE ET CONFORMITE - Appliquer les exigences de cloisonnement, de chiffrement et de traçabilité définies dans le plan d'assurance qualité et sécurité. - Respecter les engagements de protection des données des clients et les obligations réglementaires applicables. 5.Indicateurs de réussite - 3 MOIS Maîtrise de la chaîne de données existante · reprise autonome d'un pipeline en production · premier connecteur livré - 6 MOIS Contrôles de qualité déployés sur les flux principaux · …

items.desc: Basée à Lille, Lyon, Nantes, Grenoble, Marseille, Paris et Bruxelles, Insitoo Freelances est une société du groupe Insitoo, spécialisée dans le placement et le sourcing des Freelances IT et Métier. Depuis 2007, Insitoo Freelances a su s?imposer comme une référence en matière de freelancing par son expertise dans l?IT et ses valeurs de transparence et de proximité. Actuellement, afin de répondre aux besoins de nos clients, nous recherchons un Data Analyst "H/F" à Lille, France. Contexte : Dans un contexte d?intensification des besoins de pilotage, de contrôle et d?analyse, le Groupe souhaite optimiser et fiabiliser l'exploitation de son patrimoine de données (systèmes de gestion, datamarts, outils décisionnels, fichiers métiers). L'enjeu est de décloisonner des sources hétérogènes, d'harmoniser les règles de gestion pour offrir une lecture partagée des indicateurs, et d'outiller l'aide à la décision face aux dérives ou anomalies opérationnelles. La mission vise à intégrer un Data Analyst qui fera le pont entre les directions métiers, le management, les équipes Data et la DSI, afin de transformer la donnée brute en indicateurs fiables, industrialisés et directement actionnables. Les missions attendues par le Data Analyst "H/F" : 1. Recueil du besoin & Cadrage fonctionnelRecueillir, analyser et formaliser les besoins d?analyse et de pilotage exprimés par les directions métiers et le management. Traduire les problématiques opérationnelles et stratégiques en cas d'usage data et en indicateurs clés de performance (KPI). Assurer l'alignement entre les attentes métiers et la faisabilité technique en lien avec les équipes Data et l'IT. 2. Exploration, fiabilisation & Croisement des donnéesIdentifier, explorer et cartographier les sources de données disponibles (bases de gestion, datamarts, bases décisionnelles, exports métiers). Évaluer la qualité, la cohérence et l'exhaustivité des données sources ; identifier les biais et anomalies d'alimentation. Croiser et modéliser des jeux de données multi-sources pour répondre aux besoins d?analyses transverses. 3. Modélisation des règles de gestion & IndustrialisationDéfinir précisément les règles de calcul des indicateurs pour garantir un référentiel partagé et sans ambiguïté. Concevoir, faire évoluer et industrialiser des tableaux de bord interactifs et des reportings automatisés. Participer à la recette des flux et à la validation des données restituées (tests de non-régression, cohérence inter-systèmes). Profil candidat: Compétences techniques (Hard Skills)Maîtrise des outils de Dataviz / BI : Power BI, Tableau, Qlik Sense ou équivalent (conception de dashboards, DAX, modélisation en étoile/flocon). Manipulation et requêtage de données : Maîtrise avancée du langage SQL (jointures complexes, agrégations, optimisation de requêtes) et de solutions d'analyse tabulaire (Excel avancé / Power Query). Connaissance des architectures décisionnelles : Compréhension des concepts d'ETL/ELT, de datamarts, d'entrepôts de données (Data Warehouse) et de gouvernance de la donnée.

items.desc: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the Role We are looking for a highly technical Embedded Software Engineer specialized in Cybersecurity to define, implement, and verify security measures across our platforms. In this role, you will work directly with embedded software teams, system architects, and product owners to ensure secure design, secure implementation, and compliance with defense-grade cybersecurity expectations. You will help shape how security is integrated from hardware up through the application layer, influence secure architectural decisions, and drive compliance activities across diverse product lines. Responsibilities Define and specify secure embedded architectures such as secure boot, firmware updates, and key management Implement and integrate core cybersecurity features in embedded software (e.g., cryptographic primitives, secure storage, PKI) Collaborate with engineering teams to embed security into design and implementation workflows Validate, test, and harden systems to meet stringent cybersecurity requirements Lead technical cybersecurity risk analysis and threat modeling for embedded products Support and drive cybersecurity compliance efforts, including interaction with external stakeholders and certification bodies Produce clear, actionable documentation that aligns engineering work with compliance expectations. Candidate Requirements Educational Background: Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a related field. Prior work in defense, aerospace, critical infrastructure, or other high-security domains Strong expertise in embedded cybersecurity, secure firmware, or system hardening. Hands-on experience with C/C++ embedded development; Python familiarity is a plus. Solid understanding of hardware-security primitives, TPM/SE integration, cryptographic protocols, and PKI. Complex Project Management: Avid learner with a demonstrated capacity to handle large-scale, complex projects – offering innovative solutions and leading teams to deliver outstanding results. Adaptability & Mobility: Thrives under pressure in a fast-paced, dynamic environment; embraces a “no-task-is-too-small” mentality. Communication & Influence: Excellent written and verbal communication, capable of leading diverse principals, from junior members to senior executives. Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI’s mission, vision, and ambitious growth plans, ready to go the extra mile to ensure operational excellence. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

items.desc: Job offer 11/26 The Leibniz Institute DSMZ-German Collection of Microorganisms and Cell Cultures GmbH, Braunschweig offers the position starting January 1, 2027 for a Software Developer for the MediaDive Database (m/f/d) The position has a salary level according to TV-L 13 and is part of the NFDI4Microbiota project (https://nfdi4microbiota.de/). It is initially limited to 2 years and is offered as full time (39.8 hours per week). The position is located in Braunschweig and is not suitable for full remote work. MediaDive (https://mediadive.dsmz.de/) is the world's largest database for cultivation media, providing standardized recipes and growth conditions for thousands of microorganisms. It serves as a vital resource for microbiologists worldwide. The further development of MediaDive is embedded in the NFDI4Microbiota consortium (https://nfdi4microbiota.de/), which is part of the German National Research Data Infrastructure (NFDI). The consortium's mission is to support the microbiological research community by providing access to data, analysis tools, and standards according to the FAIR principles. As a developer for MediaDive, you will be responsible for maintaining, expanding, and modernizing the web application, APIs, and underlying database infrastructure. Together with the DSMZ team of biologists and software engineers, as well as partners within the NFDI4Microbiota consortium, you will develop new features and align services with the needs of the microbiological research community. Your responsibilities: Further development of the MediaDive web application, backend, and RESTful API Expanding data standardization, ontology integration, and FAIRness of cultivation data within the framework of the NFDI4Microbiota project Coordinate the development of MediaDive with other resources of the DSMZ Digital Diversity platform and external NFDI services Developing user-friendly tools for recipe calculation, media prediction, and data visualization Your profile: Master’s degree (or equivalent) in computer science, bioinformatics, or a related field Strong programming skills in backend and frontend web development Experience with document and relational databases Experience with version control (Git), Linux environments, and containerization (Docker) Interest in microbiological data, data standardization (FAIR principles), and ontologies is beneficial Accuracy, quality-orientation, and a structured way of working Intrinsic motivation and team-spirit Fluent in English / knowledge of German is beneficial Willingness to undertake occasional business travel (e.g., to NFDI4Microbiota consortium meetings) We offer: An interdisciplinary working environment with frequent exchange of experience Participation in building a national research data infrastructure (NFDI) Motivated colleagues and a pleasant working atmosphere in a scientific area Further development and support of scientific data services at the DSMZ Plenty of room for creativity & challenging topics Opportunities for further education and training An employer certified according to audit berufundfamilie®, therefore flexible possibilities to combine work and family life. The position is located in Braunschweig and requires a substantial amount of on-site work. Mobile office work is possible for up to 3 days per week. About the DSMZ and new biodata infrastructure DSMZ Digital Diversity: The Leibniz-Institute DSMZ-German Collection of Microorganisms and Cell Cultures establishes an integrated suite of scientific databases of fundamental relevance for life sciences. The databases include BRENDA, SILVA, LPSN, Bac Dive and TYGS which are developed in a highly coordinated manner. A dedicated team of 22 scientists and software engineers creates a research data infrastructure which will significantly improve the access to curated and standardized biological data. The resulting data platform DSMZ Digital Diversity will provide an integrated resource and will allow to link and comprehensively analyze the different types of scientific data from all domains of life sciences. For more information visit hub.dsmz.de. The DSMZ is funded by the State of Lower Saxony and the German Federal government and is a member of the Leibniz Association. The DSMZ strives to increase the proportion of female scientists and encourages female candidates to apply. At the same time, we are committed to reflecting the diversity of society. We therefore warmly welcome all applications, regardless of gender, cultural or social background, religion, beliefs or sexual identity. items.desc: Ready for a challenge? Then Just Eat Takeaway.com might be the place for you. We’re a leading global online food delivery platform, and our vision is to empower everyday convenience. Whether it’s a Friday-night feast, a post-gym poke bowl, or grabbing some groceries, our tech platform connects tens of millions of customers with hundreds of thousands of restaurant, grocery and convenience partners across the globe. About this role As a part of our collective, you will play a pivotal role in advancing the mobile experience for our global courier network. We are searching for proactive individuals who share our enthusiasm for gaining a deep, comprehensive mastery of our systems to architect premier solutions. Technical Foundation: our codebase is 90% Swift, with a steadfast commitment to Modularization and Clean Architecture principles. What will you bring to the team? Technical Ownership: Exercise complete authority over feature lifecycles, spanning from Microservices API contract definition to final UI delivery. Complex Problem Solving: Navigate sophisticated engineering hurdles including background location persistence, offline data synchronization, and intelligent routing logic. Team Empowerment: Champion rigorous code reviews and contribute to the continuous optimization of our CI/CD deployment pipelines. Location: Hybrid- 3 days a week from our office & 2 days working from home Reporting to: Technology Manager These are some of the key components to the position: Product Definition: Collaborate with engineering teams and Product Managers in workshops to contribute significantly to defining new product features. Technical Ownership: Consistently deliver high-quality software that meets team best practices and expectations. Project Management: Take complete ownership of components you develop, managing timelines and transparently communicating progress towards wider team and organizational goals. Cross-Functional Communication: Share your progress and ideas with your team, and contribute to the growth of the iOS guild by sharing new development practices, patterns, and standards. Inner Source Model Support: As a Trusted Committer , you'll play a vital role in supporting contributing teams to integrate their features into our codebase. What will you bring to the team? We're looking for a collaborative, proactive and detail-oriented individual with a passion for innovation. Your technical toolkit should include: Engineering Excellence: Expertise in crafting object-oriented, high-performance software characterized by exceptional readability and maintainability. Language Mastery: Extensive professional experience with the Swift programming language. Architectural Proficiency: Proven track record implementing diverse design patterns, including MVVM, VIPER, or MVP. Backend Integration: Demonstrated capability in interfacing with server-side APIs within a complex Microservices ecosystem. Modular Design: A profound understanding of building software through decoupled, reusable components. Collaborative Mindset: Enthusiasm for pair programming, rigorous code reviews, and proactive knowledge exchange. Adaptability: Ability to thrive within a high-growth, fast-paced, and evolving technical environment. Articulation: Superior verbal and written communication skills in English. At JET, this is how we play Our teams forge connections internally and work with some of the best-known brands on the planet, giving us truly international impact in a dynamic environment. Being the best at what we do isn’t just about delivering on our strategy. It's a competition for something incredibly valuable – our customers' choice. Every time a customer decides where to order, they're picking a side. At the heart of the JET Customer League are our values and behaviours. They guide every interaction, every decision, every innovation. These are the actions we need to perform consistently and brilliantly, to surpass the competition and earn our customers’ loyalty, again and again. Fun, fast-paced and supportive, the JET culture is about movement, growth, helping one another to succeed and celebrating wins. By truly living our values and embodying our behaviours, we’re building a customer-first culture which enables us to stay one step ahead of the competition. Inclusion, Diversity & Belonging No matter who you are, what you look like, who you love, or where you are from, you can find your place at Just Eat Takeaway.com. We’re committed to creating an inclusive culture, encouraging diversity of people and thinking, in which all employees feel they truly belong and can bring their most colourful selves to work every day. What else is cooking? Want to know more about our JETers, culture or company? Have a look at our career site where you can find people's stories, blogs, podcasts and more JET morsels. Are you ready to take your seat? Apply now!

items.desc: ab 01.01.2027 - Vollzeit - zunächst befristet auf zwei Jahre - WDR mediagroup digital GmbH Werde Teil der WDR mediagroup digital GmbH! Wir sind die WDR mediagroup digital GmbH - ein professioneller IT- und Broadcast-Service-Dienstleister für den öffentlich-rechtlichen Rundfunk. Mit unseren Leistungen sind wir ein verlässlicher und gefragter Partner und sorgen dafür, dass Anwendungssysteme, Basis-Infrastruktur, Arbeitsplatz-IT und Broadcast-Systeme zuverlässig funktionieren und kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt werden. Aktuell erweitern wir unsere Dienstleistung im Bereich ITSM-Tool und sind als Lösungspartner für eine Kooperation im öffentlich-rechtlichen Umfeld gefragt. In diesem Projekt sollen Synergien geschaffen und zunächst zwei weitere Companies auf die von uns betriebene ITSM-Plattform gebracht werden. Dazu brauchen wir Dich! Unser offenes Firmenklima ermöglicht Dir einen guten Start ins Berufsleben oder einen beruflichen Wechsel in ein modernes Unternehmen, das einen wichtigen Beitrag für die Gesellschaft leistet. Und das alles am Standort Köln mit einem attraktiven Mix aus Vor-Ort und remote-Tätigkeit. Deine Vorteile: Arbeitsweg: Sehr gute Innenstadtlage und Anbindung zu öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln sowie ein Deutschlandticket zu günstigen Konditionen Hybrides Arbeiten: Flexibilität durch Möglichkeit des mobilen Arbeitens bis zu drei Tage pro Woche mit firmeneigenem Laptop, Workation, Sabbatical und Vertrauensarbeitszeit Leistungsgerechte Vergütung nach Haustarifvertrag: turnusmäßige Gehaltsstufungen, regelmäßige Tarifsteigerungen, Familienzuschläge und Weihnachtsgeld Altersvorsorge: Bezuschussung der privaten Altersvorsorge in Form einer Direktversicherung Urlaub: 31 Tage Urlaub sowie Arbeitsbefreiung an Heiligabend und Silvester Verpflegung: Möglichkeit zur Nutzung der WDR-Kantine sowie Vergünstigungen in diversen Restaurants in der Kölner Innenstadt. Außerdem: frischen Filterkaffee auf jeder Etage und Kaffee und Kakao auf Knopfdruck aus unserer Kaffeemaschine im Foyer Feiern: Jährliche, von uns geplante, Firmenevents (z. B. WDRmg und WDR Sommerfest) Sport & Wellness: Kooperation mit dem Urban Sports Club Mitarbeiterunterstützung in allen Lebenslagen: Betreuungsangebote für Kinder und pflegebedürftige Angehörige, Coaching-Angebote, Krisenberatung und Gesundheitsprävention Dein Verantwortungsbereich: Du administrierst und konfigurierst unsere BMC Helix ITSM-Plattform im laufenden Betrieb sowie im Rahmen des Onboardings zusätzlicher Partner in jeweils eigenen Mandanten. Du kümmerst Dich um die Benutzerverwaltung (Benutzer, Gruppen, Rollen und mandantenfähiges Berechtigungssetup wie z. B. eine Company-/Tenant-Struktur). Du führst Regressionstests über alle Mandanten zur Absicherung des Bestandsbetriebs durch und kümmerst Dich um Fehleranalyse und Störungsbehebung im 2nd-Level-Support. Deine Arbeit bzw. von Dir erstellte Konfigurationen dokumentierst Du gewissenhaft und übergibst sichere Umgebungen in den laufenden Betrieb. Dein Background: Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung mit BMC Helix ITSM (Smart IT, Mid Tier, AR-System) in einer Administrations- oder Entwicklungsrolle. Das kannst Du durch Praxis/Projekte mit Multi-Tenant-Setups in Helix (Tenant-Konzepte, Company-basierte Datenmodellierung, mandantenfähige Berechtigungen etc.) nachweisen. Deine Zertifizierungen (z. SSO (SAML/OAuth), LDAP, REST-APIs, E-Mail-Management. Deine Kenntnisse in CMDB sowie im SLA-Management und ITSM-Prozessen nach ITIL sind ein Plus. Analytisches Denkvermögen und die Fähigkeit, Anforderungen in tragfähige, wiederverwendbare Lösungen zu übersetzen, zeichnen Dich aus. Du bist ein Teamplayer. items.desc: Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe! Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy. We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide. It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone. Please submit your application in English Kraken Generation Flex The energy industry is undergoing the largest transformation since industrialisation, at an unprecedented rate of change and we are positioning ourselves at the heart of it. In Germany, home to the largest electricity market in Europe and a roadmap toward Net Zero by 2045, we are scaling rapidly to integrate Distributed Energy Resources (DERs) into the grid. Kraken is recognised as a thought leader and innovator. We are building a SaaS business that digitally connects hundreds of thousands of DERs with energy markets. As we expand our footprint in Germany and the wider European market, we are looking for an Electrical Engineer to help turn customer sites into market-connected, controllable assets. Where you’ll fit in and role summary As we enter a stage of rapid commercialisation and customer growth in Germany, we are looking for an Electrical Engineer to support the delivery of our site integrations and grow into owning them, learning the full lifecycle from the early information stage through design, deployment and testing. You’ll work closely with our engineering team based in Manchester as we look to expand our engineering and operations in Germany and across Europe. Together, the team takes an integration project from the very early information stage, designs how it will be integrated into Kraken’s platform and then turns that design into a live, controllable, market-participating asset. The Gateway (Kraken’s IoT Edge Hardware & Software) and other connectivity technologies with their protocol engineering are owned by our UK-based team, who will support you in becoming configuration literate. Over time you will carry out configuration, deployments and testing for sites yourself, and feed back what you learn about hardware, connectivity and grid operator requirements for European countries so the wider team can build on it. Engineering delivery is an innovative and engineering-focused team with a culture that fosters collaboration and fresh thinking to create a new energy system. Alongside design, deployment and testing, they constantly look into ways to improve efficiency through tooling and the automation of repetitive tasks. They collaborate daily with delivery managers and customer success to onboard new sites as well as support the existing ones. What you'll own Integration design contribution: With guidance, analyse provided information and contribute to hardware and software integration approaches for German sites, mainly BESS (grid-scale and C&I) and RES (Wind and Solar). When necessary, exchange information with customer technical representatives in German and English through meetings and emails, and take part in design discussions with other team members. Market access & prequalification support: Support the technical work needed for assets to enter ancillary-service markets (FCR, aFRR, mFRR) and to meet Redispatch 3.0 requirements. With guidance from senior engineers, help prepare the telemetry and control evidence for prequalification (Präqualifikation) with the relevant TSO. (Grid-code and plant-compliance obligations such as VDE-AR-N 4110/4120 remain with the plant/PPC; our focus is enabling market access, telemetry and dispatch.) Technical judgement: Develop your technical judgement, making well-reasoned decisions and trade-offs with support from senior engineers, and contributing technical input to discussions within the team. Developing domain knowledge: Build up your knowledge in one or more technical areas. This could include German grid connection rules and TSO-specific requirements, ancillary services, Redispatch 3.0, industrial communication protocols, industrial networking, internet of things, cyber security and so on. Gateway application & configuration: Learn how the Gateway software (developed by an internal software team) works and how it is configured. Understand the requirements for an integration and judge if the Gateway software is able to support it or will need new development work. The team will help you get Gateway configuration literate and you will carry out deployments and changes independently over time. Hardware and software deployments: Learn the process of our hardware and software deployments. Over time, take ownership of the configuration, deployment and testing of sites with guidance …

items.desc: We are Qualco Group, a leading fintech organisation with over 25 years of experience delivering innovative technology solutions to banks and financial institutions. Serving clients in over 30 countries, we leverage advanced technologies, such as AI and analytics, to develop proprietary software and platforms that accelerate digital transformation and generate lasting value for businesses, society, and the broader economy. We are looking for a highly motivated Financial Reporting & Consolidation Analyst to join our finance team. The role will join a small, high-impact team responsible for the Group’s consolidated financial reporting. Working closely with the Financial Reporting & Consolidation Manager, you will manage consolidation reporting, prepare key consolidated financial statements and supporting analyses, contribute to half-year and full-year reporting, strengthen financial reporting controls, and use AI tools to improve reporting speed, accuracy and control. Responsibilities: Monthly consolidation and reporting: Participate in the monthly consolidation cycle: collecting and reviewing subsidiary reporting packs and following up on queries and discrepancies, perform intercompany reconciliations and eliminations, FX translation, and consolidation adjustments; Support the preparation of the consolidated Income Statement (P&L), Balance Sheet, Equity Movement and Cash Flow Statement, with the related supporting schedules and analyses; Perform variance, flux and trend analyses and prepare commentary for the Manager and senior management; Reconcile consolidation outputs to the ledgers and subsidiary submissions, and investigate and resolve differences. Half-year and full-year financial statements: Support the preparation of IFRS-compliant half-year and annual financial statements, including primary statements and notes, ensuring alignment with the Group’s accounting policies and Athens Stock Exchange reporting requirements; Prepare disclosure schedules and supporting workings, and maintain a clear audit trail; Coordinate with external auditors on information requests, queries and audit support. Controls over financial reporting: Support the Manager in enhancing the financial reporting control framework as well as document reporting and consolidation procedures, process maps and control descriptions; Maintain and update the IFRS Disclosure and Measurement Checklists, monitor new or amended IFRS requirements affecting the Group, and prepare technical accounting memos for new and/or complex transactions, documenting the accounting analysis, conclusions and reporting impact; Perform and evidence key controls (reconciliations, review checks, completeness and accuracy checks) and follow up on gaps or findings; Collaborate with entity finance teams, FP&A, Tax, Treasury and Group Accounting to meet reporting deadlines, while providing subsidiaries with guidance on reporting requirements and consolidation input. Automation and AI-enabled improvement Identify opportunities to automate and streamline reporting tasks and shorten the close; Use AI tools to improve quality, strengthen controls and reduce turnaround time, within the Group’s data security and governance policies; Ensure all activities are carried out in full compliance with regulatory requirements, while supporting the continued implementation of the Group Anti-Bribery and Corruption Policy. Requirements 3 - 5 years of proven financial reporting experience at a listed group or Big 5 firm; Bachelor’s degree or MSc in Accounting, Finance, Economics or a related field; Professional qualification (ACCA, ICAEW, ACA, CPA or equivalent) completed or substantially progressed; Strong working knowledge of IFRS, including consolidation (IFRS 10, IFRS 3), IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition, IAS 21, IAS 7, and disclosure and measurement requirements; Solid understanding of internal controls over financial reporting, including control design, documentation and testing; Good use of AI tools to automate tasks, improve quality and controls, and reduce turnaround time; Advanced Excel skills & experience with consolidation systems and ERPs; Fluency in English and Greek, written and spoken; Excellent attention to detail, analytical thinking & communication skills. Nice to Have: Experience preparing or reviewing IFRS technical position papers or memos; Working knowledge of IFRS 9 Financial Instruments and IFRS 16 Leases; Familiarity with Athens Stock Exchange reporting requirements; Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365 F&O) and IRIS Carbon. items.desc: Cognizant is a world leader in delivering digital transformation solutions to Life Sciences. Through our knowledge and expertise in Automation, MES & Digital, we deliver stable manufacturing systems that are optimized to improve operational efficiencies, whilst maintaining compliance. Our specialist engineering teams have the aptitude to deliver and support Pharma 4.0 architectures and solutions covering all IT, OT and IoT applications, infrastructures and services. Operating across 5 continents and with over 300.000 skilled employees, Cognizant partners with the leading Life Sciences companies globally to provide performance improvements, reduced costs and improve time to market. We are your single end to end partner for consultancy, design implementation, optimization and support for all applications in the Pharmaceutical and Biotechnology Manufacturing stack. We're looking for dedicated, innovative and driven talent to join our expanding team. Job summary The Senior Validation Consultant is a hands-on, strategy-led technical role responsible for the computer system validation (CSV) of larger laboratory systems — including LIMS, the Lab Execution System (LES) built on LabVantage, and other laboratory systems — within the Quality workstream. The primary focus of this role is the validation strategy for systems incorporating artificial intelligence / machine-learning (AI/ML) components, ensuring these are validated for intended use in line with emerging regulatory expectations, including the draft EU GMP Annex 22 (Artificial Intelligence), Annex 11, GAMP 5 (Second Edition) and the ISPE GAMP Guide: Artificial Intelligence. Alongside this AI focus, the consultant defines and owns the validation strategies and plans that govern how these larger systems are validated and maintained in a validated state. The consultant brings direct LIMS / LabVantage experience and sets the validation direction for AI-enabled applications while raising the bar of the broader validation framework. Key Responsibilities: Validation of Larger Laboratory Systems (LIMS and other lab systems) - Lead the computer system validation of larger laboratory systems — LIMS, LES/LabVantage, and other laboratory systems — across their lifecycle. Provide senior CSV oversight for configuration of laboratory platforms to support QC workflows: sample login, testing assignments, instrument integration, specifications management, and results entry. Ensure analytical methods, test plans, and specifications configured within these systems are validated and traceable to approved laboratory SOPs and pharmacopeial methods. Ensure user roles, security permissions, electronic signatures, and audit trail settings are validated in compliance with 21 CFR Part 11 and EU Annex 11. Oversee validation of interfaces between laboratory systems and SAP (QM), MES, instruments, and EDMS. Validation Strategy & Planning (CSV) - This role centres on defining the validation strategies and plans that govern how larger laboratory systems are validated. The consultant will: Define, author and own the overarching validation strategy and Validation Plans across LIMS, LES, MALDI-TOF, APQR and other laboratory systems. Set the risk-based validation approach in line with the GAMP 5 (2nd Ed.) framework, ICH Q9(R1) quality risk management, 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, and data integrity / ALCOA+ principles. Establish the structure and standards for the core validation deliverables — User Requirements Specification (URS), Functional Requirements Specification (FRS), Design Specification, Risk Assessment, Traceability Matrix, IQ/OQ/PQ approach, and Validation Summary Reports (VSR). Define validation scope, acceptance strategy, deliverable set, and the leverage of supplier documentation for each system based on risk and criticality. Define the strategy for periodic review, change-driven re-validation, and ongoing validated-state maintenance post go-live. Define the approach to deviation handling, remediation, and evidence standards so validation packages are consistent, defensible and inspection-ready. Key competencies: Deep technical expertise in LIMS — comfortable in the system configuration layer, not just the user interface. Strong validation-strategy capability: able to define validation approaches and plans for large, complex laboratory systems. Validation mindset: meticulous, evidence-based documentation and zero tolerance for gaps in the validation package. Strong scientific and risk-based acumen — understands the “why” behind analytical methods, laboratory workflows and AI model behaviour, not just the mechanics. Ability to think strategically about emerging regulation (Annex 22) while executing hands-on validation work. Clear, structured technical writing for validation strategies, plans, SOPs and specifications. Collaborative, multidisciplinary approach — works effectively across QC lab teams, IT/data science, quality assurance, and vendors. Self-directed and proactive; …

items.desc: 27 Oct 2026 Dublin, L, IE, D02 KF20 Who we are United by a sense of purpose towards our customers – to be a trusted partner for the long-term – and our universal banking platform in EMEA, SMBC Group has an international growth agenda and award-winning products, meaning we provide exciting opportunities to work on a diverse range of projects and initiatives. We deliver a full suite of corporate finance products and solutions to our customers as well as investment banking and advisory services, and a range of innovative solutions in global capital markets. Read on to find out how you could enhance your skills and gain valuable experience, by joining us to support our clients transition to a sustainable future. Sumitomo Mitsui Finance Dublin Limited (SMFD) is a wholly owned subsidiary of SMBC and is growing rapidly as a Centre of Excellence for the bank’s universal banking business across EMEA. It provides a range of technology and operational support services, aligned to SMBC’s growth, innovation, and transformation strategies. Purpose of Job We are building a dedicated Infrastructure Security Operations function within Technology Infrastructure to design and implement enhanced vulnerabilities management capabilities across the bank’s estate at pace and in line with regulatory expectations. This role leads the design and delivery of vulnerability remediation solution for network and network security technologies, while sharing responsibility for delivering security enhancement across Windows and Linux server remediation across the wider infrastructure estate. The role will initially work alongside Network Engineering on vulnerability-led upgrades, learning the estate and its change processes, before progressively assuming primary responsibility for the design, testing and implementation of vulnerability-led network upgrades and automated patching solutions. The role combines strong networking knowledge, broader infrastructure security capability and analytical skill: turning large volumes of raw vulnerability and configuration data into prioritised remediation plans and delivering them safely in a regulated environment. Background Technology Infrastructure is establishing a dedicated Infrastructure Security Operations capability to improve the pace, consistency and governance of vulnerability remediation across the bank’s technology estate through enhanced processes, technical solutions and automation. The role prioritises network and network security technologies, including enterprise routing and switching, firewalls, application delivery controllers'/load balancers and DNS/DHCP/IPAM platforms. It also carries a material share of Windows and Linux server remediation, including cover for colleagues during absence and participation in the incident on-call rota. The initial focus is to work alongside Network Engineering to understand the estate, standards and change processes before taking primary responsibility for the design, testing and implementation of vulnerability-led upgrades and automated patching and upgrades of network devices. The role works closely with Network Engineering, server and cloud teams, IT Security, Architecture, Service Management, asset and CMDB owners, and regional technology teams. The Company’s asset and royalty aggregation strategy focuses on optimizing positive future cash flows from an emerging portfolio of licensed products such as Ziihera® (zanidatamab-hrii) and other licensed products and product candidates such as pasritamig. We are a global company headquartered in Vancouver BC, with operations in Bellevue WA, Dublin IRE, and Singapore. Coordinate bid defenses, proposal review meetings, and contract lifecycle management. Create purchase requests and modify purchase orders. Coordinate with Clinical Trials Manager (CTM)/Clinical Research Associate (CRA) on parameters for patient reimbursement and involved in approval of reimbursement requests as needed. Be the primary Clinical contact to liaise with Zymeworks legal, finance and cross-departmental teams, as well as CROs across multiple clinical programs to manage clinical site contracts and budgets. Support the day-to-day activities of multiple areas in complex clinical contracting processes. What You'll Bring Post-secondary education in related discipline. A combination of relevant education and applicable job experience may be considered. 3-5 years of related experience in a high growth biotech or pharmaceutical company. Experience working and managing globally is a strong asset. Understanding of clinical trials and clinical operations. Ability to negotiate external provider work/change orders, clinical site budgets, etc. and track for clinical operations. Must demonstrate an understanding of clinical site, vendor budget, and payment terms. Experience in RFI/RFP development, proposal evaluation, and contract and budget management. Excellent organization and time management skills and strong attention to detail, with proven ability to handle multiple tasks efficiently and effectively. Excellent computer skills including advanced knowledge in MS Excel, MS Office. Good business judgement and a strong understanding of the unique aspects of clinical financials. items.desc: Brembo è un leader globale nell’innovazione per la mobilità e sviluppa soluzioni avanzate per veicoli e applicazioni racing. Guidata dal proprio purpose, “Shaping a Zero-Accident Future”, Brembo unisce eccellenza industriale e innovazione digitale per rendere sicurezza, prestazioni e sostenibilità parte integrante dell’esperienza di guida. Attraverso i propri brand – AP Racing, ByBre, Brembo, J.Juan, Marchesini, Öhlins e SBS Friction – il Gruppo offre un ecosistema integrato di tecnologie, che comprende sistemi frenanti, ammortizzatori, frizioni e cerchi, oltre a soluzioni software abilitate dall’intelligenza artificiale. Da oltre 50 anni, il Gruppo Brembo è protagonista nel motorsport ai massimi livelli, fornendo team nei campionati più prestigiosi e contribuendo alla conquista di oltre 1.000 titoli. Fondata nel 1961 in Italia e con sede a Bergamo, Brembo è quotata alla Borsa di Milano dal 1995. Il Gruppo conta circa 16.000 persone in 18 Paesi, con 39 siti produttivi e commerciali, 10 centri di ricerca e sviluppo e 2 Brembo Inspiration Lab. Nel 2025, i ricavi hanno raggiunto i 3,7 miliardi di euro. Siamo alla ricerca di una persona da inserire all'interno della Global Central Function Research & Development che si occuperà di: Garantire l’esecuzione di studi, progetti e disegni complessi di prodotto incluse le analisi FEM di prodotto, attraverso l’utilizzo di software specifici e nel rispetto delle metodologie e degli strumenti definiti da Brembo, nel rispetto dei tempi e delle specifiche del progetto; Assicurare l’esecuzione di disegni su sistemi CAD di componenti complessi, assiemi, disegni in 3D e disegni di sistema, garantendo, laddove necessario, l’esecuzione di calcoli FEM di routine; Collaborare con i Fornitori, Sviluppo Processi / Tecnologie, Sviluppo System & Safety/SW, l’area Testing e l’eventuale Verifica Progetto in ottica di definizione e rispetto delle specifiche di prodotto; Assicurare l’esecuzione di valutazioni circa l’eventuale brevettabilità di soluzioni e di prodotti, supportato dal Responsabile Intellectual Property Rights; Garantire proposte di soluzioni creative e migliorative su particolari elementi e sistemi, in ottica di aumento dell’efficacia del prodotto e riduzione costi; Assicurare la realizzazione e manutenzione delle analisi FMEA di progetto. Minimum Requirements: Laurea in Ingegneria Meccanica, Meccatronica o Aeronautica; Esperienza di almeno 2 anni maturata in area progettazione prodotto; Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese; Disponibilità a trasferte in Italia e all'estero. Sede di lavoro: Stezzano (BG) L'azienda garantisce il trattamento dei dati ai sensi del Regolamento Europeo n. 2016/679, rinviando all’informativa privacy disponibile proseguendo con la presente candidatura. Verrà data risposta alle sole candidature ritenute interessanti sia relativamente alla posizione aperta sia per altre posizioni che di volta in volta potrebbero aprirsi. Brembo ritiene essenziale il rispetto del principio della parità di trattamento, essendo interdetta e preclusa qualsiasi forma di discriminazione o molestia, diretta o indiretta, nei confronti di ogni persona. #LI-GM1 #LI-Hybrid

items.desc: As a QA Engineer , you will be the guardian of our software's reliability and security. Your primary mission is to ensure that every release meets the highest standards of quality, performance, and data integrity. You will collaborate closely with frontend and backend developers to build a robust testing ecosystem , transforming complex requirements into comprehensive test strategies. We are looking for a proactive professional who doesn't just find bugs, but actively helps prevent them by suggesting improvements in the development lifecycle and advocating for a security-first approach in a cross-functional environment. ‍ Your responsibilities Develop and execute comprehensive test plans , focusing on both the AI interface and internal tools. Design, maintain, and optimize automated test suites for frontend (UI/UX) and backend (API) components. Validate security implementations such as XSS/CSRF protections, secure authentication flows, and data encryption standards. Lead the adoption of QA best practices , from unit testing guidance to end-to-end (E2E) automation, in collaboration with technical leadership. Define acceptable quality gates and key metrics to measure software quality, ensuring a balance between high standards and delivery velocity. Identify, document, and track defects, working closely with developers to ensure timely resolution and prevent regressions. Conduct load and stress testing to ensure the scalability of our AI-driven solutions. Partner with Engineering and DevOps teams to integrate testing into the CI/CD pipeline and promote a "quality-first" culture. ‍ Requirements Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Proficiency with modern testing tools and advanced API testing . Strong understanding of TypeScript/JavaScript and familiarity with Java/Spring Boot backend environments. Expertise in testing secure authentication flows and ensuring compliance with standards. Mastery of Git and extensive experience with bug-tracking systems like Jira. Ability to drive the adoption of testing best practices across the development lifecycle, from unit testing frameworks to complex end-to-end (E2E) automation strategies. Capability in defining and implementing rigorous quality gates that balance high software standards with the need for continuous delivery and team velocity. Proficiency in establishing and monitoring technical KPIs and quality metrics to objectively evaluate and improve software reliability and performance. Excellent communication skills in English (written and spoken), with the ability to explain complex problems to different stakeholders. ‍ Bonus Points Hands-on experience with GitLab Pipelines or similar CI tools. Knowledge of SQL (MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB) to validate data integrity. Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes , and testing applications hosted on AWS or on-premises. Experience with performance and load testing methodologies to ensure system stability under stress. Familiarity with ISO 27001:2022 / SOC 2 Type II or cybersecurity audit practices.

Effettuazione delle consegne giornaliere ad Abano Terme e comuni limitrofi, seguendo percorsi ottimizzati. Gestione della documentazione di trasporto (DDT) e raccolta firme. Mantenimento del veicolo aziendale in buone condizioni e segnalazione di eventuali necessità. Supporto alle operazioni di magazzino
items.desc: Per una consolidata attività di vendita al dettaglio ad Abano Terme, specializzata in prodotti per la casa, cerchiamo un/una Addetto/a ai Trasporti. Il ruolo è cruciale per il rinforzo del nostro team in vista del periodo festivo, garantendo efficienza nella movimentazione delle merci. La persona selezionata si occuperà della gestione delle consegne, assicurando che i nostri prodotti arrivino puntualmente ai punti vendita e ai clienti. Le principali mansioni includono: Carico e scarico del furgone aziendale, verificando la corretta disposizione della merce. Effettuazione delle consegne giornaliere ad Abano Terme e comuni limitrofi, seguendo percorsi ottimizzati. Gestione della documentazione di trasporto (DDT) e raccolta firme. Mantenimento del veicolo aziendale in buone condizioni e segnalazione di eventuali necessità. Supporto alle operazioni di magazzino durante i periodi di minor attività di trasporto. Requisiti: Patente B in corso di validità e esperienza di guida di furgoni. Non è richiesta esperienza pregressa Ottima conoscenza del territorio di Abano Terme e zone limitrofe. Affidabilità, precisione e attenzione al rispetto delle tempistiche di consegna. Flessibilità oraria e disponibilità a lavorare anche nei weekend e festivi. Forte senso di responsabilità e orientamento al servizio clienti. Offerta e benefit: Inserimento diretto con contratto a tempo determinato di 6 mesi, finalizzato alla stabilizzazione. Retribuzione lorda mensile indicativa: 1450-1800 € (CCNL Commercio). Utilizzo di furgone aziendale e cellulare aziendale per le consegne. Ambiente di lavoro collaborativo, con un team affiatato. Prevediamo un disponibilità immediata per coprire il picco di lavoro stagionale. Orario full-time, 40 ore settimanali, con turni distribuiti su 6 giorni, inclusi weekend e festivi. Sede di lavoro: Abano Terme.

items.desc: Do you have the technical skills to support our customers around Italy ? Join Traka’s team, part of the ASSA ABLOY Group, in Italy, and enjoy a collaborative culture that empowers you to build a career you can be proud of. What you would do as our Field Technician Reporting to the Italy Country Manager and the Regional Technical Director of Traka South Europe, you will join a growing Italian team, gaining deep expertise in Traka key-management systems and playing a strategic role in consolidating the launch and growth of Traka’s brand-new Italian branch, directly contributing to customer success. This position is a field-based role, with frequent travels across Italy (~ 70%). You would also be responsible for: • Reviewing and preparing Traka equipment prior to delivery. • Performing preliminary electrical installations on customer sites and train end-users on the Traka application and best-practice workflows. • Installing and commissioning key cabinets and locker systems and assisting with software installation & configuration, ensuring seamless integration. • Delivering exceptional customer assistance by diagnosing and resolving incidents, including performing on-site repairs and component replacements. • Continuously upskill, staying at the forefront of Traka product developments. The skills and experience you need We are looking for someone who: • Has a technical qualification in Electricity/Electronics (FP II / Diploma or higher), or equivalent relevant hands-on experience in electronic and mechanical assembly. • Is willing to travel across Italy, has a valid driving license and excellent command of English, both spoken and written. • Dynamic and curious personality, able to cooperate in cross-functional teams with a highly professional attitude. • Self-motivated and comfortable working with minimal supervision. • IT knowledge for user/assist level and a valid Workplace Safety certificate (Electrical or Construction) are a strong plus. What we offer We’re passionate about providing amazing opportunities and benefits, so you can continue and progress a lifelong career with us – here’s what we have to offer: Sincere and cooperative work environment, focused on achieving results while fostering a strong team spirit and a "one team" mindset. • Competitive salary, commensurate with your profile and experience, plus incentive schemes. • Hybrid working, Holiday Flex, Cycle-to-Work, employee discount portal, recognition scheme and wellbeing program. • Extensive learning & career-development resources—online courses, leadership programs and technical certifications. • Fast-track career growth opportunities: as part of a scaling business unit within Italy, you’ll be first in line for expanded duties and leadership paths. • Being part of the ASSA ABLOY Group opens doors to global mobility and cross-divisional career moves across our 70 + country network. We review applications regularly, so don’t wait We are building diverse, welcoming teams, and encourage applications from everyone who can see themselves working with us. To make sure your personal data is safe, we don’t look at any applications sent by email or post. If you have any questions about the role or the process, email Giulia Virde at giulia.virde@assaabloy.com Let’s create a safer and more open world - together! To find out more about us, visit www.assaabloy.com We are the ASSA ABLOY Group Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access. As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally. As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences. #LI-WGIE

The new state-of-the-art facility will feature the latest technologies such as ASTAROME™, to enable the use of liquid flavors in dry blends, and the production of more cost-effective reaction flavors. With automated packaging lines and modern warehouse, sampling, QC lab, and expansion capacity to ship, the site will be a state-of-the-art place to help fulfill the ambition of Taste, Texture & Health of dsm-firmenich. It will be a place where talent and technology come together to fulfill our ambition: shaping the future together and driving the progress of food innovation. We’re looking for a motivated and hands-on QC Technician to support the setup and day-to-day operation of the quality control laboratory at our new Collecchio site. Record analytical results and laboratory activities accurately and completely, promptly escalating atypical, out-of-specification or out-of-trend results. Support timely product release by completing assigned testing in line with priorities, production needs and customer requirements. Perform routine checks, calibration and verification of laboratory instruments, and maintain reference standards, reagents and consumables. Follow laboratory procedures and contribute to method transfer, troubleshooting, investigations, non-conformances and corrective actions as required. Support laboratory improvement activities and develop proficiency across a broad range of analytical techniques and testing methods. Maintain good housekeeping, safe working practices, data integrity and compliance with applicable quality and food safety requirements. A chance to impact millions of consumers every day – sustainability embedded in all we do. Practical understanding of laboratory sampling, routine testing, instrument operation and accurate results documentation; experience with LIMS or similar systems is desirable. Department Introduction The Non-Volatile NAND Design Engineering group is responsible for the design and optimization of analog, digital and mixed-signal circuits enabling advanced NAND Flash memory products. Close collaboration with cross-functional teams ensures scalable, manufacturable, and reliable solutions across technology nodes. Position Overview As a Design Engineer in the NVE Design Engineering Core group at Micron Semiconductor Italia, you will contribute to the development of memory products that are best-in-class, using your specialized knowledge and Micron proprietary methods of designing and analyzing core and mixed circuits used in the development of memory products. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve power efficiency, manufacturability, and overall product performance. Develop and leverage automation solutions (e.g., Python-based workflows, AI-assisted tools) and maintain technical documentation. Minimum Qualifications M.S. or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, or a related field. Proven experience in analog and/or mixed-signal CMOS circuit design. Solid understanding of device physics, variability, reliability, and power integrity. Hands-on experience with SPICE-based simulation tools and circuit verification methodologies. Strong problem-solving and communication skills, with ability to work in global cross-functional teams. Preferred Qualifications Experience in NAND Flash or other non-volatile memory technologies. Familiarity with design automation, scripting (e.g., Python), or AI-assisted design approaches. Understanding of layout constraints and interaction with physical design flows. items.desc: Compensation Range: Job Title: R&D Engineer / Chillers Location: Ronchi dei Legionari (GO) Company: Munters Corporation – DCT / Geoclima Travel: Yes About Us: Munters is a global leader in climate solutions for mission-critical processes. We offer innovative, efficient and sustainable solutions for customers in industries where controlling indoor humidity, temperature and energy efficiency is mission critical. Climate control systems often account for a large percentage of energy consumption in many of our customers’ operations. With an optimal climate system, we can help them to more efficiently use energy or water resources and thereby reduce their climate and environmental impact. Sustainability is an important part of Munters’ business strategy and value creation. We pride ourselves on fostering a dynamic and inclusive work environment where interns are valued members of the team and are given meaningful projects to work on. Primary Job Summary: The R&D Engineer leads the development and design of standard and special chillers with a focus on sustainability, efficiency and cost-effectiveness. Duties and Responsibilities: The R&D Engineer configures and manages chiller models with performance checks in coordination with the testing department. The role involves: direct responsibility for selecting appropriate components, such as compressors, heat exchangers and fans, to meet design specifications and performance requirements. staying up to date with industry trends, technologies and regulations to ensure that designs are cutting-edge and compliant. working closely with customers and stakeholders to understand their needs and provide solutions that exceed their expectations. Communication & Coordination The R&D Engineer communicates regularly with other departments regarding technical clarifications, design modifications, and feedback from production. This role provides technical support to the sales and testing departments, proactively reports recurring issues and contributes to identifying engineering improvements and design optimizations. Skills and Qualifications: Thermodynamics: Mastery of the fundamental laws of thermodynamics, particularly with regard to reverse cycles (refrigeration cycle). Plant engineering: analysis and reading of hydraulic and refrigeration circuit diagrams; the ability to read electrical diagrams, even if not in depth, is a plus. Reading and interpreting technical specifications: Ability to analyze and interpret technical documents, specifications and functional specifications. Work management: A methodical, precise and organized approach to carrying out activities is required. Problem solving: Ability to identify and solve technical problems effectively and proactively. Industry regulations: Knowledge of national and European regulations in the sector (Machinery Directive, EN2014-68 EU , EN3781,2,3,4), preferably also ASMEVIII and UL for foreign markets. Teamwork: Willingness to collaborate with other departments to ensure project consistency. Experience: Preferably experience in the design and engineering of HVAC systems Education Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering Benefits: Competitive Salary Professional development opportunities State-of-the-art equipment and tools to support your work Equal Opportunity Employer: Munters are equal opportunity employers and are committed to diversity in the workplace. We encourage applications from all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status. Interested to join? If you are excited about this opportunity, please submit your application as soon as possible To help us place the right people in the right role, we believe in we follow a competence-based, structured interview process where your skills, knowledge and attributes relevant to Munters will be assessed. At Munters, you get the chance to influence and solve meaningful problems for society . We lead with an obsession for climate, with people in the core and sustainability as part of the DNA.

items.desc: As a Product Designer , you will be responsible for creating intuitive, user-friendly digital experiences by combining deep UX research with high-fidelity UI design. You will work within a cross-functional team to transform complex systems into accessible, visually appealing, products. We are looking for a product designer who is thrilled by the challenge of translating AI complexity into simple, effective interfaces and stunning data visualizations. ‍ Responsibilities End-to-End Design: Lead features from ideation and UX research to prototyping, usability testing, and final production. Systemic Product Design: Approach design as a scalable system rather than isolated screens; architect logic-driven functionalities and ensure every new feature seamlessly integrates into the broader product ecosystem. Design System Evolution: Contribute to and maintain our Design System, not just as a UI kit, but as a shared language between design and engineering to improve consistency, scalability, and development velocity. Data Visualization: Translate complex AI-driven data into meaningful and simple visualizations that help our clients make informed decisions. Tech-Savvyness & Trend Adaptation: Stay at the forefront of industry trends and emerging technologies; quickly adapt design workflows and product features to leverage new tech capabilities (e.g., AI interaction patterns, new prototyping tools). User Advocacy: Conduct user interviews, surveys, and A/B testing; maintain user journey maps and personas to advocate for the user's point of view within the development team. Collaboration & Feasibility: Partner daily with developers and PMs as a "bridge" between design and code, ensuring technical feasibility while pushing the boundaries of what the system can achieve. UX Logic: Focus on the functional "under-the-hood" UX, managing state changes, edge cases, and user flows that define the product's core utility. ‍ Requirements Bachelor’s degree in the Design field or a related discipline. Expert proficiency in Figma. Skilled in wireframing and creating interactive prototypes to test ideas quickly. Prototyping with AI. Deep empathy for users, creative problem-solving, and excellent communication skills in English (written and spoken). ‍ Bonus Points AI & FinTech: Previous experience building UX/UI for AI-based platforms or financial products. Advanced DataViz: Deep experience with data visualization libraries or complex financial charting. AI driven design processes : experience in integrating AI tool into the design workflow. Copywriting: Experience writing clear and consistent UI copy to improve the overall UX.
