items.desc: About IS-Wireless IS-Wireless is a European deep-tech and dual-use company developing software-defined mobile networking technologies for resilient, secure and efficient communications. With offices in Poland and the Netherlands, we are a NATO DIANA company and a member of the Dutch 6G Future Networks Services programme. The Role We are looking for a hands-on CEO Associate to help run cross-company initiatives and improve how work gets done at IS-Wireless. Working directly with the CEO, you will take ownership of practical business projects, coordinate colleagues across functions and follow through until agreed actions are completed. Around two-thirds of the role will focus on operational execution: organising work, resolving blockers, improving processes and keeping priorities on track. The remaining part will involve analysis, financial modelling and forward planning to support business decisions. You should enjoy taking a topic from an initial discussion through to implementation, including doing the practical work yourself where needed. This is a business operations position, not an executive assistant role. The role could suit someone with experience in startup or scaleup operations, business projects or a CEO or founder’s office. Consulting, advisory and investment experience is also relevant where it includes implementation or hands-on work with businesses. You do not need to arrive as a ready-made Chief of Staff. The role offers the potential to grow towards Chief of Staff and broader operating leadership responsibilities as your contribution and company needs evolve. Key Responsibilities Take ownership of selected business projects, from defining the next steps to implementation and completion. Turn CEO decisions into clear actions, owners and deadlines, and follow up until commitments are fulfilled. Coordinate cross-functional work across Sales, Product, Technology, Finance and Operations, managing dependencies and resolving blockers. Manage and improve business processes, building practical operational systems and applying continuous improvement principles, including Total Quality Management (TQM) and Kaizen. Coordinate company-wide planning, budgeting and other activities that require input and follow-through across teams. Maintain a clear view of company priorities, milestones and execution gaps, raising issues early and helping resolve them. Prepare the CEO for key meetings, negotiations and external engagements; join selected meetings and take responsibility for follow-up and implementation. Prepare financial models, budgets and business cases to support decisions and forward planning. Conduct focused analysis of customers, partners, investors, competitors and markets, translating findings into concise recommendations and decision materials. What We Expect Experience taking ownership of business projects or operational processes and seeing them through to completion. You can explain what you personally implemented and what changed as a result. Relevant experience in business operations, cross-functional project delivery, a CEO or founder’s office, or another hands-on business role. Consulting, advisory or investment experience with practical implementation responsibility is also relevant. Strong organisation and follow-through: you can break an unclear task into manageable steps, coordinate others and keep work moving without constant reminders. A practical approach to problem-solving and the willingness to handle detailed execution as well as planning. The ability to work across functions, clarify responsibilities and raise issues constructively when priorities compete or progress stalls. Excellent communication skills, including speaking, writing and presenting. Excellent written and spoken English. Excellent financial modelling skills, including preparing budgets and business cases. The ability to understand unfamiliar business and technology topics quickly, ask useful questions and seek input when needed. Initiative, discretion and confidence working with senior executives, customers, investors and partners. Availability to work regularly on site with the CEO in Warsaw. Interest in deep-tech, telecom, defence, dual-use technology or critical infrastructure is a strong advantage. IS-Wireless DNA We value commitment, team spirit and honest communication. We look for people who take initiative, help colleagues and follow through on agreed actions. Be open about what you know, ask when you need context and raise problems early. A genuine “How can I help?” attitude means taking useful action and seeing it through. What Success Looks Like Agreed initiatives reach completion, with clear ownership and fewer unresolved dependencies. Teams spend less time chasing updates because actions, deadlines and progress are visible. Processes become easier to follow, and improvements continue to work after they are introduced. The CEO can delegate selected topics to you with confidence that you will …

items.desc: Overview We are looking for a Technical Solutions Consultant to help prospects and customers navigate technical complexity, make good architectural decisions and become successful with Full Fabric. This is a hands-on, customer-facing technical advisory role. You should be equally comfortable discussing an institution’s architecture with an IT director, explaining and testing an API integration, and helping diagnose an SSO or DNS configuration issue. Your primary focus is technical discovery and solution architecture, supported by selective troubleshooting and practical enablement. You will work with Sales, Customer Success, Product, Engineering and implementation partners, but will not own routine technical support or implementation delivery. You will also implement and operate the AI solutions Full Fabric uses in its interaction with prospects and customers, ensuring technical knowledge is captured, accurate and reusable. Key Responsibilities 1. Advise — primary focus Lead technical discovery with prospects and customers to understand their requirements, existing systems, IT constraints and integration needs. Recommend sound, maintainable architectures, including how Full Fabric integrates with CRMs, student information systems, identity providers and other institutional platforms. Partner with Sales on technical evaluations, architectural discussions, relevant demonstrations, feasibility assessments and responses to technical or security questions. Use AI conversation intelligence solutions to analyse technical discovery and evaluation calls, identify recurring requirements and improve internal technical processes and guidance. 2. Unblock — targeted specialist involvement Help resolve selected complex or high-impact technical blockers, such as SAML SSO, identity providers, OAuth/OIDC, API authentication, DNS, TLS certificates and permissions. Investigate issues hands-on by reproducing failures, testing requests, examining relevant responses or logs and identifying whether the cause is configuration, integration design or a product defect. Configure and maintain AI-assisted support for technical topics, so that common SSO, API and configuration questions are resolved automatically, and complex cases reach you with clear context. Provide clear guidance and coordinate escalation where needed; do not become the default owner of support tickets, routine troubleshooting or support SLAs. 3. Enable — reusable guidance and best practices Demonstrate Full Fabric’s REST APIs, webhooks and authentication using tools such as Postman or cURL; advise on integration patterns, error handling and data flows. Guide customer IT and implementation teams through technical decisions, configuration approaches and validation, helping them become capable and self-sufficient. Create concise technical guidance, architecture diagrams, API examples and troubleshooting playbooks; share recurring friction with Product and Engineering; structure this content as the knowledge source for the AI solutions used internally and keep it accurate and current. Role Boundaries Solutions Engineering owns technical discovery, solution recommendations and specialist technical enablement—not delivery. Customer Support owns day-to-day support and support SLAs. Professional Services and implementation partners own customer-specific integrations, migrations and implementation projects. Engineering owns product defects and platform development. You may help diagnose problems and advise on implementation choices, but are not expected to build bespoke integrations, manage deployments, own ongoing support or act as a general-purpose escalation queue. Priorities should favour technical discovery and architecture, with targeted involvement when your expertise materially unblocks a customer. Requirements Essential Experience in a customer-facing technical role in B2B SaaS, such as Solutions Engineer, Technical Consultant or Implementation Engineer; ideally with a prior software engineering or integration background. Hands-on fluency with REST APIs, HTTP, JSON, webhooks and API authentication; able to test and debug requests with Postman, cURL or similar tools. Practical understanding of SAML 2.0, SSO, identity providers, OAuth 2.0/OIDC, DNS and HTTPS/TLS, including common configuration and troubleshooting scenarios. Good architectural judgement across SaaS platforms, integration patterns, system boundaries, data flows and security considerations. Ability to investigate technical problems independently and know when to advise, resolve or escalate. Strong communication and consultative skills, with confidence engaging senior IT stakeholders and explaining technical trade-offs to mixed audiences. Excellent written and spoken English, with the organisational skills to manage multiple stakeholder needs. Experience using AI solutions to improve technical workflows, such as maintaining knowledge sources for AI assisted support or analysing customer conversations, …

items.desc: Potentiam is a fast-growing global offshore solutions provider connecting top talent with leading UK and European businesses. With offices across South Africa, Romania, India, and Brazil, we offer international exposure, real career progression, and the opportunity to work with high-performing global teams. We combine global opportunity with local support - giving you the chance to grow, make an impact, and build a long-term career in a business that’s scaling fast. Global clients. Clear progression. Real opportunity. We are an equal opportunity employer. We encourage applications from people with disabilities and will provide reasonable accommodations during the hiring process. Purpose of Role As a Data Engineer, you will be at the core of advancing and scaling our procurement data initiatives. Your primary focus will be to evolve and maintain our data lake, built on Google Cloud-native technologies, transforming complex, raw procurement data into structured, insightful outputs that drive strategic and operational decision-making across the company and our client organizations. You’ll collaborate closely with analysts, data scientists, and procurement experts to integrate, optimize, and govern procurement data. Your role blends technical data engineering expertise with business intelligence skills and procurement domain knowledge. Roles & Responsibilities Data Pipelines & Integration : Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines to ingest structured and semi-structured data into the data lake. Use Google Cloud, Cloud Composer, and Apache Airflow to orchestrate and manage complex workflows, ensuring reliability, scalability, and data lineage. Data Transformation: Transform raw data into analytics-ready formats using SQL, Python, dbt and Vertex AI Pipelines. Build modular and testable transformations that support analytics, reporting, and AI/ML use cases. Data Modelling: Design efficient and maintainable data models to optimize query performance and enable self-service analytics. Work with analysts and data scientists to align models with business logic and key metrics. Data Quality & Security: Implement error handling, anomaly detection, data quality checks, monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure data integrity and pipeline reliability. Apply GDPR-compliant security measures, including data masking, access control and encryption. CI/CD & Workflow Automation: Develop and manage CI/CD pipelines using Git/version control, peer reviews, and automated deployment processes to ensure traceability, auditability and reliable releases. Data Governance: Support data governance through metadata management, data cataloguing, access provisioning, and data standards, working closely with technology and business teams. Innovation & AI/ML : Explore new technologies and data sources to enhance the data platform. Collaborate with data scientists on AI/ML pipelines, predictive procurement and risk forecasting. Data Products & Collaboration : Partner with business stakeholders, analysts, data scientists, privacy, and infrastructure teams to develop scalable data products and solutions aligned with business and technical requirements. Documentation : Maintain clear documentation of data models, pipelines, workflows, and processes to support maintainability, scalability, and knowledge sharing. Skills, Qualfications & Abilities Solid understanding of procurement processes, sourcing strategies, and supply chain dynamics. Proven experience in AI and data science, preferably within a professional services or procurement environment. Strong understanding of data architecture, integration, and management, including data lakes, ETL processes, cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), and data warehousing. Strong proficiency in SQL and Python, with knowledge of data visualization tools such as Power BI. Experience designing and maintaining automated data pipelines using Airflow, Cloud Composer, or similar workflow orchestration tools. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to use data and insights to support decision-making and identify process improvements. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data findings into actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders. Passionate about innovation in procurement and data-driven solutions. Self-motivated and proactive, with the ability to work accurately and efficiently to deadlines. Data Privacy Notice The personal information you provide during the application and recruitment process will be used solely for recruitment purposes, in accordance with our data protection policies. For any questions regarding data processing related to HR activities, please contact Chantal Endemann at careers@potentiam.co.uk. All data shared with third parties complies with applicable confidentiality and retention requirement.

items.desc: The Junior Data Analyst supports the data and reporting activities of the TA&A Department. The role involves working with team members and stakeholders to understand reporting needs, prepare and analyse data, and contribute to the development of dashboards and performance indicators. The role also contributes to data quality controls and the maintenance of the department's data environment. With support and guidance from experienced colleagues, the Junior Data Analyst progressively develops knowledge of TA&A processes, data management principles and data analysis tools. Key duties and responsibilities: Support the collection, preparation and analysis of data from different sources. Assist with data cleansing, transformation and quality controls. Contribute to the design and enhancement of dashboards, reports and data capture solutions by applying user-centric design principles to improve usability, data understanding and stakeholder adoption. Help maintain dashboards, KPIs and recurring performance reports. Support the development and maintenance of data tables and reporting datasets. Work with business teams to understand reporting needs and data definitions. Help document data sources, business rules, KPIs and reporting processes. Perform initial analyses to identify trends, inconsistencies or unusual results. Contribute to ad hoc analyses for specific business questions or new initiatives. Assist in the preparation of presentations and reports for management and other stakeholders. Identify simple opportunities to improve or automate recurring reporting activities. Support the testing of new dashboards, reports and data solutions. Develop an understanding of TA&A activities, processes and systems. Share progress, results and potential issues clearly with the manager and team members. Experience and Technical Skills: Initial experience with data analysis, reporting or data preparation through an internship, apprenticeship, academic project or first professional experience. Basic knowledge of Excel and an interest in data analysis and reporting. Familiarity with at least one data visualisation tool, such as Power BI, Tableau or Qlik. Basic understanding of SQL, Python, Power Query or another data analysis tool would be an advantage. Basic knowledge of data cleansing and transformation principles. Interest in learning how to work with structured and unstructured data. Previous experience in insurance, reinsurance, accounting or finance is helpful but not required. Personal Competencies: Curious and willing to learn. Good analytical and problem-solving skills. Attention to detail and commitment to data quality. Ability to communicate information clearly and simply. Comfortable asking questions and seeking guidance when needed. Able to work collaboratively within a team. Reliable, organised and able to manage priorities. Interested in understanding business processes in addition to technical data topics. Able to work in an international and multicultural environment. Required Education Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Analytics, Information Technology, Statistics, Business, Finance, Accounting, Economics or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Applications from recent graduates and candidates completing an apprenticeship are welcome. As a leading global reinsurer, SCOR offers its clients a diversified and innovative range of reinsurance and insurance solutions and services to control and manage risk. Applying “The Art & Science of Risk,” SCOR uses its industry-recognized expertise and cutting-edge financial solutions to serve its clients and contribute to the welfare and resilience of society in around 160 countries worldwide. Working at SCOR means engaging with some of the best minds in the industry – actuaries, data scientists, underwriters, risk modelers, engineers, and many others – as we work together to find solutions to pressing challenges facing societies. As an international company, our common culture is defined by “The SCOR Way.” Serving both to build momentum that drives the Group forward and as a compass to guide our actions and choices, The SCOR Way is anchored by five core values, reflecting the input of employees at all levels of the Group. We care about clients, people, and societies. We perform with integrity. We act with courage. We encourage open minds. And we thrive through collaboration. SCOR supports inclusion and the diversity of talents, and all positions are open to people with disabilities.

items.desc: apeirum is recruiting on behalf of maxon for a DevOps Security Engineer in Barcelona. This is a permanent position employed directly by maxon ; apeirum runs the selection process. maxon is a global provider of world-class precision drive systems. Its drives are used wherever extreme precision and the highest quality standards matter – on Earth, and on Mars. maxon offers creative minds and passionate doers a global yet trusted environment, where people who question what is possible and challenge themselves can grow. As DevOps Security Engineer you join maxon's Group Software Development as the full-time security anchor of its on-premise OpenShift platform. You secure how software is built and run – from the first commit to the running container – and keep the platform hardened, compliant and resilient. You work every day with a small platform engineering team at maxon's Swiss headquarters (GitOps, four-eyes reviews, a fixed weekly sync), and in Barcelona you share the office with maxon's Cloud Security Engineer. Several tool decisions are still open: you will shape the security stack rather than inherit it. Hybrid in Barcelona (3 days office, 2 remote), with regular on-site weeks in Switzerland (approx. 5–10 %, more during onboarding). Tasks Build security into the CI/CD pipelines and GitOps deployments to OpenShift: static analysis, dependency and secrets scanning, container image scanning and image integrity checks – running as smoothly as every other quality gate. Define the security baseline for the OpenShift clusters (Security Context Constraints, RBAC, network policies, admission control, compliance profiles), implement it as GitOps changes reviewed by the platform engineers, and verify it continuously. Support development teams early: threat modeling, security user stories, secure-coding guidance and training. Run vulnerability management for the container platform: advisories, registry and runtime scan results, scoping application penetration tests and driving remediation with the teams. Turn ISO 27001 requirements and group security policies into automated checks, so audit evidence comes out of the pipeline instead of a spreadsheet. Automate the pipeline side of security response – blocking vulnerable releases, triggering rollbacks, feeding findings into the central incident and vulnerability process. Document the platform's security runbooks and build up deputy capability for cluster operations together with the platform engineers. Requirements – must have 3+ years of hands-on experience in DevSecOps or container-platform security. Experience securing OpenShift or a comparable enterprise Kubernetes distribution in production – or a strong Kubernetes background and the drive to go deep on OpenShift quickly. Hands-on experience building security gates into CI/CD pipelines. Confident with GitOps, policy as code, container image scanning and secrets management – tool-agnostic, because you know the principles behind the products. Scripting in Python, Bash or PowerShell; a solid understanding of the software development lifecycle. Knowledge of security frameworks such as OWASP, ISO 27001 or CIS Benchmarks. You enjoy coaching developers and turning security topics into practical guidance. You work well with colleagues in another location – written, asynchronous and structured – and like spending on-site weeks with the team in Switzerland. University degree in computer science or comparable vocational training. Fluent English. Based in Spain (Barcelona). Nice to have German – a real advantage for working with the Swiss platform team. Red Hat certifications (e.g. OpenShift Administration or Security specialisations). Software supply-chain security (SBOM, signing, attestation). Azure fundamentals. What maxon offers A permanent employment contract directly with maxon, competitive compensation based on your experience, flexible annual working hours and a hybrid model. Real ownership: you are the full-time security anchor of the container platform and influence open tool decisions. A dynamic and friendly workplace in maxon's Barcelona tech hub, combining startup energy with the stability of a Swiss industrial leader. International collaboration with teams in Switzerland and other locations, including regular on-site weeks at the Swiss headquarters. Continuous learning and growth through the maxon academy and professional development programs. Additional benefits such as Club Natació de Barcelona membership and the Cobee program. Interested? Apply with your CV. apeirum reviews every application personally and will get back to you; shortlisted candidates then interview with the maxon team, and the offer and contract come from maxon.

items.desc: Grid-Side Converter Control Engineer At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. YOUR ROLE As a Grid-Side Converter Control Engineer , you will contribute to the development and validation of advanced control solutions for grid-connected power converters used in renewable energy systems. Working with grid-forming (GFM) and grid-following (GFL) technologies, you will support the design, simulation, testing, and optimization of converter control strategies, ensuring reliable operation and compliance with grid requirements. You will collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to improve system performance, stability, and integration throughout the product lifecycle. What you can expect in the role: Develop and optimize grid-forming and grid-following converter control algorithms. Create and maintain converter and grid models using MATLAB/Simulink. Perform stability, harmonic, synchronization, and converter-grid interaction studies. Validate control solutions through HIL and real-time simulation platforms. Support system integration, testing, troubleshooting, commissioning, and grid compliance activities. YOUR PROFILE Master's or Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, Control Systems, Energy Systems, or a related field. Minimum 3 years of experience in power electronics, converter control, renewable energy systems, or grid integration engineering. Strong knowledge of grid-forming and grid-following control strategies, synchronization techniques, PLLs, and power converter control systems. Hands-on experience with MATLAB/Simulink and familiarity with HIL platforms such as dSPACE, RTDS, Typhoon HIL, or OPAL-RT. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and collaboration skills, with professional proficiency in English. WHAT YOU’LL LOVE ABOUT WORKING HERE Join a multicultural and inclusive team environment. items.desc: Job Description: An opportunity for a Production Control Specialist has arisen within Airbus Defence and Space, Getafe (Madrid). The selected candidate will join the Spacecraft Production Spain team within the Spacecraft MAIT (Manufacture, Assembly, Integration, and Test) perimeter. This multidisciplinary and international team oversees the execution, planning, and operational flow required to deliver flight hardware for major space programs. The jobholder will act as a pivotal link between shop-floor assembly lines and project stakeholders, driving digitalization, standardization, and delivery milestones under demanding production schedules. RESPONSIBILITIES The main tasks of the jobholder will be: Drive operational production planning: Manage end-to-end Work Orders (from release to closure using pull flow logic) and run daily routines to monitor assembly progress, parts availability, and priority realignment. Control material flow and inventory: Execute MRP management, plant warehouse tracking, stock control, and Kanban replenishment to ensure component readiness for critical assembly phases. Mitigate material and logistic risks: Proactively identify parts shortages, manage non-conformities, resolve parasitic flows (cannibalization, missing parts, delivery discrepancies), and steer mitigation protocols. Coordinate cross-functional interfaces: Partner continuously with AIT Managers, Manufacturing Engineering, Supply Chain, and Logistics to unblock operational bottlenecks and manage transfer of work responsibilities. Deliver operational reporting: Track and report EAC (Estimate at Completion), supply performance, and manufacturing KPIs to secure program visibility and schedule compliance. Lead continuous improvement and digitalization: Implement activity standardization, lean manufacturing initiatives, and digital shop-floor tools to enhance production control efficiency. SKILLS Is your profile aligned to the following list of skills? Apply! We are looking forward to meeting you: Education: Degree in Industrial, Mechanical, or Aerospace Engineering, or equivalent technical qualification/vocational training in Production Management or Logistics. Experience: Demonstrated experience in production control, shop-floor planning, or supply chain within a manufacturing or industrial environment. Technical knowledge: Proficiency in ERP systems (specifically SAP / MRP management), inventory control methodologies (Kanban, pull flows), and production KPI tracking. Soft skills: Dynamic problem-solver with high resilience, strong priority-management skills under tight deadlines, and the ability to collaborate effectively in transnational, multicultural teams. Languages: Advanced level in English (essential for transnational coordination). Valuable / Nice to have: Familiarity with cleanroom environments, aerospace/spacecraft MAIT standards, or shop-floor digitalization tools. WHICH BENEFITS WILL YOU HAVE AS AIRBUS EMPLOYEE? At Airbus we are focused on our employees and their welfare. Take a look at some of our social benefits: Vacation days plus additional days-off along the year. Attractive salary. Hybrid model of working when possible. Collective transport service subject to working calendar/home location. Benefits such as life insurance, health insurance, employee stock options, retirement plan, or study grants. On-site facilities (among others): free canteen, kindergarten, medical office. Possibility to collaborate in different social and corporate social responsibility initiatives. Excellent upskilling opportunities and great development prospects in a multicultural environment. Option to access special rates in products & benefits. #MYCYM This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth. As a Computer Operator you will be on the technical frontline – performing batch operations as per service agreements, analyzing first-level issues across systems, and resolving/routing issues as appropriate. You will also have the opportunity to develop support system management processes specific to customer requirements, ensuring that we provide the highest level of service to our customers. If you have a passion for technology and a desire to continually improve your skills – this is the position for you. You will work with a talented team of professionals and collaborate on exciting projects that are shaping the future of our industry. Your Future at Kyndryl As a Computer Operator, you will be interacting and collaborating with cross-functional teams which makes identifying career paths with Kyndryl easy. Whether you want to delve into the intricacies of automating complex processes, drive essential systems, or ensure top-notch delivery to our customers, there is a path for you – and we’re invested in paving the way. Who You Are You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others. Required Technical and Professional Expertise Experience with scheduling software, reporting, and logging Proficient with Operating Systems (Windows or Mac) Preferred Technical and Professional Experience Experience with Troubleshooting, Backup/Recovery and Basic Networking Being You The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way. What You Can Expect Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best. From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth. We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success. We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next. Get Referred! If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

As a Backend Engineer, you'll play a pivotal role in utilising the latest technologies to craft cloud-based, distributed, scalable, and fault-tolerant microservices capable of handling a staggering volume of gaming transactions—approximately 1.3 billion per month. Collaborating closely with stakeholders, including the Regulatory Reporting Team and game operations teams, you'll spearhead innovative projects such as LeoJackpot while ensuring seamless API integrations and optimising performance for an unparalleled gaming experience. This role is perfect for software craftspeople who thrive in an environment of continual learning, value effective communication, and are eager to push the boundaries of technology within the gaming industry. YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR: Developing and maintaining microservices using Java, Spring Boot and JPA Integrating new gaming providers into the platform via APIs Collaborating with frontend teams to expose game data via APIs Optimising the performance and scalability of backend systems Ensuring services are production-ready, observable and maintainable through monitoring and alerting Taking ownership, solving problems and collaborating across teams OUR SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE: ESSENTIAL SKILLS 3+ years of backend development with Java, Spring (Boot) and JPA/Hibernate Hands-on experience building highly scalable RESTful microservices Experience with relational databases such as MySQL Experience implementing resilience patterns (e.g. retries, circuit breakers, graceful degradation) Experience designing monitoring dashboards (metrics, logs, traces) and alerts to detect issues proactively NICE TO HAVES Messaging and data: Kafka, Elasticsearch, Hazelcast Languages and frameworks: Kotlin, Node.js, Akka, GraphQL Infrastructure: Docker, Kubernetes, Google Cloud Platform, Consul Observability: Datadog Online gaming or gambling experience AI-assisted development (ideally with Claude Code) WHO ARE WE? At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. Our culture is our foundation and is what enables us to innovate, build, and lead as we trailblaze our way through the igaming industry. We’re a team of over 2000 innovators, initiators, and groundbreakers working in a fast-paced and agile environment across 19 offices worldwide. In our pride, we empower our teammates to find their roar and run with their wildest ideas. We don’t wait for things to happen; we pounce and make it happen! Think you’d be a good fit for the Leo Pride? Give us a roar! As our company working language is English, please submit your CV in English

items.desc: Lund University was founded in 1666 and is repeatedly ranked among the world’s top universities. The University has around 46 000 students and 8 500 staff based in Lund, Helsingborg and Malmö. We are united in our efforts to understand, explain and improve our world and the human condition. Lund University welcomes applicants with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We regard equality, equal opportunities and diversity as a strength and an asset. MAX IV is looking for a collaborative and well-organised Operations Coordinator to join the User Office, a part of the Access & Collaborations group. Your team The Access & Collaboration group plays a crucial role in enabling researchers from around the world to access and benefit from MAX IV Laboratory. The User Office supports user access to MAX IV through the coordination of key operational processes, user support services and the development of efficient tools and practices. Working closely with MAX IV colleagues, researchers and other stakeholders, you will help ensure a professional, efficient and transparent user experience. As the User Office continues to evolve its ways of working, you will contribute both to daily operations and to the development of services, routines and team practices. Would you like to work at one of the brightest light sources in the world? While individual ownership may be assigned to specific processes or areas of responsibility, success depends on teamwork, knowledge sharing and a shared commitment to delivering high-quality services. As an Operations Coordinator, you will play an active role in strengthening this way of working and helping to build a flexible, resilient and service-oriented operational function. Provide guidance and support to users, staff and other stakeholders regarding User Office services and systems. Contribute to the development and improvement of User Office services, systems and operational practices. Proficiency in Swedish, or the ability to communicate effectively in a Swedish-speaking environment. The ability to adapt to changing priorities and contribute positively to organisational development and improvement initiatives. Beroende på din bakgrund och dina intressen finns möjligheter inom exempelvis fullstackutveckling, embeddedutveckling och Androidutveckling. Du blir en del av en teknikdriven organisation där mjukvara, hårdvara och användarupplevelse möts. Här får du arbeta nära produkten och vara delaktig i hela utvecklingsprocessen – från idé och kravställning till implementation, testning och vidareutveckling. Du arbetar i en platt organisation med korta beslutsvägar där samarbete, innovation och kunskapsdelning står i fokus. Tillsammans med dina kollegor bidrar du till att utveckla lösningar som skapar verkligt värde för användaren. Arbetsuppgifter Beroende på din inriktning kan du bland annat arbeta med att: Utveckla och underhålla mjukvara för uppkopplade produkter Bygga backendtjänster, API och moderna webbapplikationer Utveckla embeddedmjukvara och arbeta nära hårdvara, styrsystem och kommunikation Utveckla Androidapplikationer och digitala användargränssnitt Delta i hela utvecklingsprocessen, från kravställning och design till implementation, test och verifiering Arbeta med systemintegration, felsökning, testning och kvalitetssäkring Samarbeta nära utvecklare, testare och andra tekniska specialister Vi söker dig som Har en relevant högskole- eller civilingenjörsexamen inom exempelvis elektronik, mekatronik, datateknik eller liknande Har minst tre års erfarenhet inom utveckling Har goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i både tal och skrift Trivs i en produktnära miljö där du får ta ansvar och bidra med egna idéer Är nyfiken, lösningsorienterad och tycker om att samarbeta med andra Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet inom ett eller flera av följande områden: Go, TypeScript, React eller andra moderna utvecklingstekniker Androidutveckling Embeddedutveckling i C eller C++ Databaser, exempelvis PostgreSQL API, systemarkitektur och systemintegration Docker, AWS eller andra molnmiljöer Styrsystem, CAN, I/O eller reglerteknik Continuous integration, testning och verifiering Linuxmiljöer Du behöver inte ha erfarenhet av samtliga områden. För att trivas i rollen tror vi att du är driven, kommunikativ och har ett genuint intresse för teknik. Du är prestigelös i samarbetet med andra, samtidigt som du tar ansvar för dina egna arbetsuppgifter. Du motiveras av att arbeta i en innovativ miljö där teknik och produktutveckling står i centrum. Om Friday På Friday brinner vi för att ge dig som Tech-talang en riktigt bra start på karriären. Vi värderar ambition och potential högt och arbetar aktivt för en fördomsfri rekrytering, där alla ges samma chans att lyckas. Vi finns i Stockholm, Göteborg, Malmö, Linköping och Örebro. Varje år genomför vi över 5 000 karriärmöten och matchar kandidater med allt från globala företag till innovativa startups.

items.desc: Vi på Iver brinner för innovationer och god laganda, vi är särskilt intresserad av dig som gillar att tänka nytt och dela med dig av dina tankar. Vi söker en Nätverkstekniker som vill bidra till bättre IT-lösningar för våra kunder. Är du vår nya kollega? We empower our Nordic society Iver är en ledande nordisk helhetsleverantör av IT-tjänster med spetskompetens inom drift, cybersäkerhet, cloud och innovation. Våra tjänster är kritiska inte bara för våra kunder utan för digitaliseringen av samhället i stort. Med huvudkontor i Stockholm verkar Iver främst i Norden med en agenda att fortsätta expandera. Iver omsätter drygt 3 miljarder SEK och har cirka 1 300 anställda som arbetar på ett av våra 23 kontor i Norden. Din roll på Iver Vi söker en erfaren Nätverkstekniker med goda kunskaper inom nätverk till vår vertikal Financial Services and Fintech på Iver. I denna roll kommer du att arbeta med drift, underhåll och utveckling av en av våra kunders IT-miljöer, med fokus på nätverksinfrastruktur. Du kommer att vara en nyckelperson i att säkerställa hög tillgänglighet, stabilitet och säkerhet. Tjänsten innebär både operativt och strategiskt arbete, där du får möjlighet att påverka och förbättra våra kunders IT-miljö. Du kommer att vara en del av ett kundteam med ansvar för en av våra kunders tjänsteleverans. Vi arbetar med områden så som arkitektur, projekt, drift/förvaltning av våra kunders infrastruktur och nät. Våra kunder är ofta stora nordiska företag, fintech, startups eller myndigheter med krav på hög nivå av informationssäkerhet och lösningar i teknisk framkant. Exempel på arbetsuppgifter: -Beställning, felsökning och problemlösning inom nätverk och wi-fi. -Övervakning och optimering av nätverksinfrastruktur (LAN/WAN, brandväggar, switchar, VPN) -Säkerhetsarbete, inklusive patchhantering och skydd mot intrång -Dokumentation och förbättring av IT-processer Vad erbjuder vi dig? På Iver får du möjlighet att arbeta med den senaste tekniken och vara med på en spännande tillväxtresa. Vi är inkluderande och strävar efter ett genuint samarbete mot gemensamma mål. Inom Iver finns stora möjligheter till utveckling och vi finns här för att inspirera dig till att nå dina yrkesmässiga mål. Vi står bakom dig när du vill lära dig mer inom ditt specialområde, ledarskap eller nya områden. Hos Iver är du också en del av ett ambitiöst och innovativt företag, vilket innebär att förbättra, testa, utvärdera och våga ändra hur vi gör saker är viktiga ingredienser för att vi ska utvecklas. Vi på Iver ger samma löfte till våra kollegor som till våra kunder. Löftet är att alltid vara ”beside you”, ”behind you” och ”before you”. Vi kallar det för "The Iver way". Förmåner hos oss: Kollektivavtal & trygga villkor Hybridarbete Friskvårdsbidrag Terminalglasögon ⏳ Tidsbank – 24 h extra ledighet/år Privat sjukvårdsförsäkring Tjänstepension (ITP) & flexpension Vi söker dig med: Flera års erfarenhet av datacenternätverk (främst Extreme, Cisco och Fortinet). Goda kunskaper inom nätverkssegmentering och säkerhetsanpassade nätverksmiljöer. Flera års erfarenhet av BGP/eBGP och andra routingprotokoll. Goda Linuxkunskaper. Grundläggande programmeringskunskaper i Bash och Python. Erfarenhet av Kubernetes-relaterade nätverkslösningar. Erfarenhet av hybrida nätverkslösningar mellan on-premises-miljöer och AWS För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har minst fem års erfarenhet av nätverksarbete, gärna inom större och mer komplexa miljöer. Du har ett starkt tekniskt intresse och ett socialt engagemang, och trivs både med att arbeta i team och att ta eget ansvar. Du behärskar svenska och engelska obehindrat i både tal och skrift. Vidare motiveras du av att arbeta i ett högpresterande team där du får vara med och utveckla och förbättra tekniska lösningar i framkant. Det är meriterande om du har certifiering inom Fortigate samt erfarenhet från arbete i säkerhetsklassade verksamheter eller inom bank- eller fintechbranschen. Placeringsort: Iver finns på 23 orter i Norden. För denna roll ser vi att du utgår från huvudkontoret i Solna. Övrig information: Vi har kunder inom alla branscher och sektorer inklusive säkerhetsklassad verksamhet, därför genomför vi bakgrundskontroller i samtliga av våra rekryteringsprocesser. Sök till oss! Urval sker löpande, tjänsten kan tillsättas före sista ansökningsdag. Iver eftersträvar en jämn könsfördelning och värdesätter etnisk och kulturell mångfald. Sista ansökningsdag: 2026-12-30 Start: Enligt överenskommelse Välkommen att kontakta kajsa.holzwart@iver.se vid frågor eller funderingar kring tjänsten. Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

Vi söker en Platform Engineer som vill bidra till bättre IT-lösningar för våra kunder. Är du vår nya kollega? We empower our Nordic society Iver är en ledande nordisk helhetsleverantör av molnbaserade IT-tjänster med spetskompetens inom drift, cybersäkerhet, cloud och innovation. Våra tjänster är kritiska inte bara för våra kunder utan för digitaliseringen av samhället i stort. Med huvudkontor i Stockholm verkar Iver främst i Norden med en agenda att fortsätta expandera. Iver omsätter drygt 3 miljarder SEK och har cirka 1 300 anställda som arbetar på ett av våra 23 kontor i Norden. Din roll på Iver Du arbetar som del i Ivers affärsområde Financial Services and Fintech med ansvar för tjänsteleverans av kritisk kundinfrastruktur. Du ansvarar för tekniska lösningar i framkant, samt deltar aktivt i kunddialoger för ständig förbättring och effektivisering. Våra kunder är ofta stora nordiska företag, fintech, eller myndigheter, med krav på hög nivå av informationssäkerhet och infrastruktur som kod. Vissa av dem utgör samhällskritisk verksamhet och/eller har en särskild hotbild. Du kommer att ha en viktig roll där du är drivande i arbetet med att ta fram nya lösningar och guida våra kunder framåt. Du kommer att ha en nära dialog med utvecklare och kunderna för att förbättra och effektivisera våra plattformar. Arbetsuppgifterna är varierande och du kommer att hantera tekniska system i framkant och ansvara för deras utveckling och förbättring över tid. Teamet driver projekt där de utforskar nya tekniker och implementerar kontinuerligt nya lösningar i våra plattformar. Vi arbetar agilt och strukturerat i olika projekt tillsammans med kunden, och i den här rollen har du goda möjligheter att utforma din roll utifrån dina intressen och kunskaper. Vi arbetar bland annat med tekniker och metoder som Kubernetes / OpenShift, Linux, AI, IaC, CI/CD, Bash, Python, GitOps. Här får du möjlighet att utvecklas och bidra till vårt team, samtidigt som du jobbar med moderna verktyg och tekniker. Vad erbjuder vi dig? På Iver får du möjlighet att arbeta med den senaste tekniken och vara med på en spännande tillväxtresa. Vi är inkluderande och strävar efter ett genuint samarbete mot gemensamma mål. Inom Iver finns stora möjligheter till utveckling och vi finns här för att inspirera dig till att nå dina yrkesmässiga mål. Vi står bakom dig när du vill lära dig mer inom ditt specialområde, ledarskap eller nya områden. Hos Iver är du också en del av ett ambitiöst och innovativt företag, vilket innebär att förbättra, testa, utvärdera och våga ändra hur vi gör saker är viktiga ingredienser för att vi ska utvecklas. Vi på Iver ger samma löfte till våra kollegor som till våra kunder. Löftet är att alltid vara ”beside you”, ”behind you” och ”before you”. Vi kallar det för "The Iver way". Förmåner hos oss: Kollektivavtal & trygga villkor Hybridarbete Friskvårdsbidrag Terminalglasögon ⏳ Tidsbank – 24 h extra ledighet/år Privat sjukvårdsförsäkring Tjänstepension (ITP) & flexpension Vem söker vi? Du har ett stort tekniskt intresse och en vilja att förstå hur saker fungerar på djupet. Kanske var du den som plockade isär din första dator eller spenderade otaliga timmar med att bygga Lego. Du trivs i ett högpresterande team och drivs av viljan att effektivisera med automation, samtidigt som stabil drift är grundläggande för dig. Vi ser att du är prestigelös, ansvarstagande och har en förmåga att förmedla lösningar på problem. Du har även en social sida och trivs med att diskutera och kommunicera, både internt och externt. Cybersäkerhet och informationssäkerhet är områden du tycker är intressanta, och du förstår vikten av att ständigt utveckla och säkra komplexa system. Vi söker dig som har: Erfarenhet av OpenShift Virtualization / Vmware Erfarenhet av Kubernetes/OpenShift och tillhörande IaC-verktyg God förståelse för IT-infrastruktur och utvecklingsprocesser Kunskaper inom Git, ArgoCD eller andra CI/CD-lösningar Förmåga att kommunicera effektivt med utvecklare, kunder och operations-team Intresse för OpenSource och GitOps-principer Extra meriterande om du även har: Erfarenhet av OpenShift AI Erfarenhet av on-prem installationer av Nvidia GPU: er Erfarenhet av att använda / bygga AI-verktyg för utveckling Erfarenhet av automatisering av applikationstester Erfarenhet av applikationsdeployment (via ArgoCD t.ex) Kunskaper inom Grafana, Karma, Zabbix eller andra övervakningslösningar PKI och AWS-erfarenhet God pedagogisk förmåga att förklara komplexa problem Placeringsort: Iver finns på 23 orter i Norden. För denna roll ser vi att du utgår från ett av våra kontor i Solna. Övrig information: Vi har kunder inom alla branscher och sektorer inklusive säkerhetsklassad verksamhet, därför genomför vi bakgrundskontroller i samtliga av våra rekryteringsprocesser. Sök till oss! items.desc: Company Description We are on the journey to transform our digital capabilities, bringing core business processes, people, data and technology together to enable IKEA to become an even better home furnishing retailer. This journey requires passionate people who embrace change, challenge the status quo and want to make a difference. As part of Data & Engineering, we are establishing a new Data Enablement team with a mission to make it easy for coworkers, digital products and AI solutions to find, trust and consume data across IKEA. The team will build a unified experience layer connecting platforms such as Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Collibra, SAP, M3 and other enterprise systems. Together, we are creating the products, services and experiences that make trusted data easier to discover, understand and use across the organisation. Job Description As a Software Engineer in Data Enablement, you will help build the products and services that sit at the intersection of software engineering, data and user experience. You will work on capabilities that help users navigate IKEA's data landscape, discover trusted data products, understand data through metadata and lineage, and access data through intuitive self-service experiences. Working as part of a newly established product team, you will contribute to building a strategic platform that brings together data platforms, governance capabilities and enterprise systems into a seamless experience for consumers of data. As part of this role, you will: Design, build and operate software products, services and APIs that enable data discovery and consumption. Develop integrations across platforms such as Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Collibra, SAP, M3 and other enterprise systems. Build capabilities that improve metadata visibility, data lineage, self-service access and trusted data consumption. Create reusable platform services, automation and engineering tooling that simplify the user experience. Contribute to modern engineering practices including CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, automated testing and observability. Partner closely with Data Engineers, Data Management specialists, architects and platform teams to create integrated solutions. Help establish engineering standards, patterns and best practices within the team. Continuously improve scalability, reliability, performance and usability across the platform. This is not a traditional software engineering role. You will be part of building a completely new capability that sits at the heart of IKEA's data, analytics and AI journey. Rather than developing a single application or supporting a specific business process, you will help create the products and experiences that thousands of coworkers and digital solutions rely on to find, trust and consume data. You will work across a broad technology landscape, connecting modern cloud platforms, metadata solutions and enterprise systems into a unified experience. The challenges are complex, the impact is significant and the opportunity to influence both the product and the engineering culture is substantial. Most importantly, you will help shape how data is used across IKEA for years to come. Qualifications We believe you are a curious and pragmatic software engineer who enjoys building products that simplify complex technology and create value for others. To be successful in this role, you have: Strong experience in software engineering and modern development practices. Experience building applications, APIs, microservices or platform capabilities. Strong programming skills in one or more languages such as Python, TypeScript, Java, Go or similar. Experience working with cloud platforms such as Azure and/or AWS. Experience with CI/CD, automation, Infrastructure as Code and DevOps practices. Understanding of distributed systems, system integration and scalable software architecture. Interest in data platforms, metadata, governance and developer experience. Strong collaboration and communication skills. A genuine passion for building products that enable others to succeed. Additional Information Application date will finish on 18th November. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible .If you have any questions about the role or the recruitment process, or if you have a special need that requires accommodation in the recruitment process, feel free to contact the Recruiter Jas.garcha@inter.ikea.com. Please also note that we only handle applications in English and do not accept applications coming in by email. At IKEA, we are looking for people who believe everyone deserves a seat at the table. You’re welcome no matter where you come from, what you believe, and what you look like. We don’t even care how you have furnished your home. We’re interested in you simply because you’re you. Vi utgår från dig och matchar dig mot rätt arbetsgivare i stället för tvärtom. Vi lyssnar in vad du vill (och inte vill) och matchar dig mot de bolag som passar dig bäst bland våra 300+ konsultbolag. Dina erfarenheter och din önskade karriärriktning är givetvis centrala, men för en långsiktigt god match är det minst lika viktigt att värderingar, kultur, arbetsvillkor och kanske framför allt personkemi stämmer. När allt detta klaffar blir det helt fantastiskt bra, och vår målsättning är alltid att det ska bli fallet. Om rollen Som Data Engineer bygger och förvaltar du de dataflöden och plattformar som gör data tillgänglig för analys, rapportering och AI. Uppdragen finns hos konsultbolagens kunder inom bland annat bank och försäkring, handel, industri och offentlig sektor. Exempel på arbetsuppgifter Designa, bygga och förvalta datapipelines för batch och streaming Modellera data i lakehouse- och datalagermiljöer Integrera källsystem och API: er Säkerställa datakvalitet, övervakning och driftsäkerhet Automatisera med CI/CD och infrastruktur som kod Samarbeta med analytiker, data scientists och verksamheten Vi tror att du har Minst fem års erfarenhet som Data Engineer eller i liknande roll Mycket goda kunskaper i SQL och Python (eller Scala) God erfarenhet av minst en modern dataplattform, till exempel Snowflake, Databricks eller Microsoft Fabric. Det är en stor fördel och efterfrågas av många av bolagen Erfarenhet av molnmiljö, till exempel Azure, AWS eller GCP Flytande svenska och god engelska i tal och skrift Meriterande dbt, Airflow eller Azure Data Factory Spark och erfarenhet av streaming, till exempel Kafka Terraform eller annan infrastruktur som kod Certifieringar inom Databricks, Snowflake eller Azure Tidigare erfarenhet av konsultrollen Du är strukturerad och lösningsorienterad, kommunicerar tydligt med både tekniker och verksamhet och trivs med att sätta dig in i nya miljöer. Det här får du Villkoren varierar mellan bolagen, men gemensamt för dem är att du får: En tillsvidareanställning hos ett konsultbolag med kollegor inom ditt område Varierande uppdrag hos kunder i olika branscher, med möjlighet att påverka vilka uppdrag du tar Kompetensutveckling och ett nätverk som växer för varje uppdrag Ett bolag som säljer in dig och har din rygg mellan uppdragen Så går det till Du ansöker via länken i annonsen och bifogar ditt CV. Vi hör av oss för ett första samtal om vad du söker och vad som är viktigt för dig. Vi föreslår vilka bolag vi tror passar dig. Du väljer själv vilka du vill bli presenterad för. Bolagen tar det vidare i sin ordinarie rekryteringsprocess, och vi finns kvar som stöd hela vägen. Urval sker löpande, så skicka gärna in din ansökan redan i dag.

items.desc: We’re Hiring: Experienced Frontend Developer – TypeScript | Svelte | Playwright Company: Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB Role: Frontend Developer Specialisation: TypeScript | Svelte | React | Frontend Architecture | Test Automation Languages: Fluent in Swedish and English About the Role Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB is looking for an experienced Frontend Developer to contribute to the development of modern, scalable and high-performance web applications. You will work in a collaborative engineering environment, building and maintaining frontend applications, developing reusable UI components and improving application performance and user experience. The role offers an opportunity to contribute to the development of a next-generation digital ecosystem focused on condition monitoring, working closely with developers and cross-functional product teams. Key Responsibilities Design, develop and maintain modern frontend applications using TypeScript and Svelte. Build reusable widgets, UI components and scalable frontend solutions. Develop responsive and accessible user interfaces that work seamlessly across different screen sizes and devices. Monitor, measure and continuously optimize frontend application performance. Identify performance bottlenecks and implement improvements. Write, maintain and execute automated frontend tests, including Playwright tests. Make sound technical decisions considering overall product architecture, usability and maintainability. Collaborate with backend developers and other engineering teams to deliver integrated solutions. Participate in code reviews, technical discussions and frontend architecture decisions. Share technical knowledge and support other developers within the team. Explore and apply AI-powered development tools, including GitHub Copilot and reusable AI workflows. Contribute to continuous improvement of development practices and engineering processes. Required Skills & Experience Significant professional experience in frontend application development. Strong programming skills in TypeScript. Hands-on development experience with Svelte. Experience building reusable UI components, widgets and frontend modules. Strong knowledge of HTML, CSS and modern frontend development practices. Experience developing responsive web applications. Understanding of frontend performance optimization, profiling and troubleshooting. Experience with automated testing and maintaining test suites using Playwright. Practical understanding of Kubernetes and containerized applications, including services running as pods. Ability to make independent technical decisions and understand wider product requirements. Good understanding of Git and collaborative software development practices. Strong communication and teamwork skills. Fluency in both Swedish and English is mandatory. Meritorious Experience & Technologies Experience with the following technologies and tools will be advantageous: Frontend & UI Development React Three.js Advanced TypeScript development Component-based frontend architectures Testing & Development Tools Playwright GitHub Copilot Automated testing and CI/CD practices Cloud & Infrastructure Kubernetes / K3S Docker AWS Azure DevOps Backend & Databases Golang PostgreSQL MongoDB Design & Collaboration Figma Miro Agile development methodologies What We’re Looking For We are looking for a proactive and technically strong frontend developer who enjoys building high-quality digital products and solving complex engineering challenges. The ideal candidate should be comfortable taking ownership of frontend solutions, contributing to architectural decisions and collaborating within autonomous development teams. We particularly value developers who are curious, share knowledge, support their colleagues and are interested in exploring how AI tools can improve software development productivity. Interested in This Opportunity? Are you an experienced Frontend Developer with strong TypeScript and Svelte skills? We would be happy to hear from you! items.desc: HAYPP GROUP We address one of the world’s biggest problems – how to end smoking. There are 1,1 billion smokers in the world. Around 8 million people die every year from smoking-related diseases. Our goal is to significantly reduce death rates, save lives and inspire people to choose smoke-free enjoyment. How? By offering people other nicotine products online. Haypp Group is one of the Nordics’ leading e-commerce groups with eleven store brands, present in seven countries where we serve more than 1 million active consumers. Through brands such as Snusbolaget.se, Northerner.com, Nicokick.com etc., we sell nicotine pouches, Swedish style snus online as well as disposable vapes. With our headquarters located on Östgötagatan in Stockholm we are 300 team members mainly but not exclusively based in Sweden. Also, we are an innovative and fast-moving company that is growing rapidly, driving sustainable business and are changing the world in the process. We are currently on an exciting expansion journey, converting more and more smokers to smoke-free alternatives across all our markets globally. READY TO BUILD THE CLOUD FOUNDATION OUR DATA RUNS ON? Want to help shape the cloud infrastructure behind our internal platforms? As Cloud Infrastructure Engineer at Haypp, you’ll design, build and run secure, scalable infrastructure on Google Cloud (GCP) and AWS, working hand in hand with our Data Team to deliver the internal platforms they rely on every day. If you love infrastructure as code and solving hard problems with an engineering mindset, this is your chance to make a real impact. WHAT YOU'LL DO Your role as a Cloud Infrastructure Engineer will be diverse and hands-on. Working closely with our colleague Khan and the rest of our Group IT team to deliver top-of-the-line cloud infrastructure, you’ll: Design, build and operate cloud infrastructure on GCP and AWS, covering networking, compute, storage, and managed services, with security, reliability, and cost efficiency built in. Codify everything with Terraform using reusable modules, remote state, and automated plan/apply pipelines (e.g. GitHub Actions), with peer review for every change. Partner with the Data Team to deliver the internal infrastructure behind our data platform, creating secure, self-service environments for storage, pipelines, and analytics using services such as BigQuery, Cloud Storage, and Pub/Sub. Drive our move from AWS to GCP by assessing workloads, mapping services, and executing migrations with clear cutover and rollback plans. You’ll also decommission infrastructure we no longer need. Build security in from day one through least-privilege IAM, workload identity, secrets and key management, network segmentation, encryption, and policy-as-code guardrails across both clouds. Automate repetitive work with scripting in Python, Bash, or Go, while keeping documentation, runbooks, and architecture decisions up to date. Keep our platforms observable and resilient through monitoring, logging and alerting, backup and disaster recovery, incident response, and continuous cost optimization. EXAMPLES OF PROJECTS YOU MIGHT MANAGE Migrating selected workloads from AWS to GCP. For example, moving data from Amazon S3 to Cloud Storage and re-platforming services onto GKE, with minimal downtime. Building a secure GCP landing zone in Terraform: resource hierarchy, shared VPC networking, IAM, organization policies, and centralized logging. Delivering self-service infrastructure for the Data Team: Terraform modules and templates that let them spin up compliant environments quickly and consistently. Implementing centralized secrets management with Google Secret Manager and AWS Secrets Manager. Designing backup and disaster recovery strategies across clouds and running regular failover tests. Building observability dashboards and alerting (e.g., Grafana, Datadog) for platform health, cost, and security posture. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR The essentials 4+ years of experience in Cloud, Platform, DevOps, or Infrastructure Engineering, working with production environments. Strong hands-on experience with GCP and AWS , with deep expertise in at least one of them. Strong experience with Terraform and infrastructure as code. A solid understanding of cloud security , including IAM, network security, encryption, and secrets management. Good knowledge of cloud networking and Linux . Experience with scripting or programming in Python, Bash, or Go . Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to communicate technical topics clearly. Nice to have Experience with cloud migrations, especially from AWS to GCP. Experience with data platforms and services such as BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, or Airflow. Familiarity with Azure or Cloudflare. Relevant cloud or infrastructure certifications, such as Google Cloud, AWS, Terraform, or Kubernetes certifications. items.desc: About the Role You love making things work. You're not in love with a specific solution or technology, but rather delivering value to users. At Tandem, Software Engineers are the ones who turn ideas into products that make a real difference for clinicians and patients. You’ll take on whatever stands in the way of our product’s real-world impact, from designing and building new functionality to debugging complex systems, improving integrations, and making sure everything runs smoothly. The learnings and abstractions you build along the way will set the foundation for the next generation of the product offering. You’ll see firsthand how the tech you build actually changes how healthcare works, and you’ll become one of the people who truly understand both the technical and operational sides of what we do. This role is perfect for someone who’s obsessed with solving problems, who codes because they love it, and who cares more about impact than which part of the stack they work in. It’s a role for builders – people who want to learn fast, ship fast, and see their work make a difference immediately. If that sounds like you, we’d love to meet you. What You Will Do Design, build, deploy, and improve software that delivers real value to our users. Debug and solve complex, real-world problems across infrastructure, APIs, data flows, RPA, and configuration. Write clean, pragmatic code to build and extend our systems. Collaborate with clinicians, partners, and our internal teams to understand problems, remove blockers, and deliver effective solutions. Shape the next generation of our product through thoughtful engineering and rapid iteration. Continuously identify, automate, and improve painful or inefficient processes so we can scale smarter. What You Bring Deep love for programming and problem-solving. Curiosity that borders on obsession - you like understanding why things work (or don’t). A bias toward action - you’d rather get things done than talk about them. Comfort working in ambiguity and high velocity. A mindset that leans toward ownership, creativity, and energy. Key nice-to-haves Experience with authentication and authorization RPA experience Any other language skills than a fluency in English is a plus, especially German. Solid experience coding in Python, TypeScript, or C#. Benefits Competitive salary and company stock options. 30 days of paid holiday each year. 5,000 SEK wellness allowance, plus 6,000 SEK each year for other health-related initiatives. Parental leave top-up for new parents. Private medical insurance. Mental health support through Mindler. Pension programme. Regular social and team activities, including off-sites and seasonal events. We review our benefits regularly and may change them from time to time.

items.desc: Sellpy’s vision is to empower everyone to live circularly. We believe that every item deserves a second life, and we see huge financial, social and environmental value in making sure this happens. We look for those who share this vision and have the grit to tackle the challenges of building a circular future. CRM & Growth Specialist at Sellpy Sellpy recently moved our customer relationship management (CRM) and communication stack from Voyado to Sanity, a system we build and own ourselves. The core flows are in place, but there is plenty of room to make them smarter, more personal and more effective. This is a dual-role split evenly between building and analysis. You will combine building and improving customer communication with using data and testing to drive growth. Sellpy has a unique inventory of millions of items and a huge customer base of buyers and sellers. Your job is to get that inventory discovered and to activate our customers through CRM. This is a central role with global scope, covering all Sellpy markets. You will own large-scale automations and flows that touch every market, working with our General Managers and Marketing Development Managers to bring in local market knowledge, and with Product and Engineering to decide what gets built next. You will join our Central Growth Team of ten people, reporting to the Director of Growth and Retention. As the main point of contact for CRM, you will have real ownership and the opportunity to shape how Sellpy communicates with its customers. In short, you will Build and execute (half of your time) Build and refine emails and push notifications, testing creative execution (imagery, copy, layout) as well as timing and targeting Design and build new CRM flows that drive key business results, targeting sellers, buyers and different lifecycle stages Own the processes that connect General Managers, Marketing Development Managers and Product/Engineering, so local teams can shape communication for their markets and Product/Engineering has a prioritized backlog of what to build Analyze and test (half of your time) Form hypotheses about what drives customer behavior and run A/B tests to prove or disprove them, across creative, timing, targeting and logic Analyze test results with statistical rigor and turn them into clear next steps for CRM strategy Dig into customer data to understand what sellers and buyers need from us, when to nudge them and how to support their journey with Sellpy Build dashboards that give the commercial organization transparency and insight into CRM performance We use Sanity, our in-house CRM and communication platform Google Sheets for trackers and analysis SQL to extract data Claude and Claude Skills as a force multiplier in your day-to-day work. You are not expected to have prior AI experience, but using AI well is part of meeting expectations once you are up and running Requirements Between 3-5 years worth of work experience in relevant roles Previous hands-on experience working with CRM, for example building and running email or push flows Analytically strong and hypothesis-driven: you use data to make decisions, not just to report on them, and you know when a result is statistically significant and when directional evidence is enough to act on Deep customer understanding, with the ability to create flows for different audiences such as sellers, buyers and lifecycle stages Creative with language, visuals and test ideas, and comfortable testing imagery, copy and layout as levers for click-through rate Strong ability to use Google Sheets or Excel to build trackers and do advanced analysis Able to work cross-functionally and hold your own with commercial teams, product and engineers alike Written and spoken fluency in English, as this is our company language We’d be impressed if you have Experience in second-hand, resale or e-commerce SQL knowledge You get to Be part of a tech-minded company that's driving the change towards a sustainable lifestyle. In return, you will get direction, energy, and work on meaningful challenges daily Enjoy a vibrant office culture at Medborgarplatsen, balanced with hands-on experience at our production sites Work with highly skilled and motivated colleagues Gain new skills with unlimited access to a learning platform Make use of prepaid vacation Enjoy Sellpy credits and staff discounts at Sellpy and the H&M brands (Arket, COS, Other Stories, Weekday and more) Save up with a monthly pension plan Engagement in Sellpy’s social traditions with game nights, interactive planning days, guest speakers and other activities Location This specific role is based at our Medborgarplatsen office. Hybrid work We value being together. After an on-site onboarding, we aim for a balanced office presence, with flexibility based on your team and tasks. items.desc: Är du i början av din karriär inom IT och vill ha en roll där du får kombinera teknik, problemlösning och kontakt med verksamheten? Då kan det här vara en spännande möjlighet för dig. Vi söker nu en Systemutvecklare till vårt IT-team. Rollen är ett föräldravikariat och passar dig som nyligen avslutat din utbildning och vill få möjlighet att utvecklas brett inom IT i ett företag där du får arbeta nära både verksamheten och externa IT-partners. OM ROLLEN I rollen arbetar du framför allt med förvaltning och underhåll av våra system, med särskilt fokus på Elitfönsters kundportal och CRM. Du bidrar till att systemen fungerar stabilt i vardagen och ger support till interna användare. Du kommer bland annat att: arbeta med systemunderhåll och löpande förvaltning av portal och CRM ge support och stöd till interna användare felsöka och hantera frågor kopplade till systemen ha kontakt med externa konsulter och systemleverantörer beställa och följa upp utveckling som genomförs av externa partners samarbeta nära kollegorna inom IT och andra delar av verksamheten. Det är en varierad roll där du kommer att ha flera frågor på gång samtidigt och får en bra möjlighet att bygga upp både din tekniska kompetens och din förståelse för hur IT stödjer en verksamhet. VEM ÄR DU? Vi tror att du är nyutexaminerad eller i början av din karriär och har ett stort intresse för IT och system. Du behöver inte kunna allt från början. För oss är din vilja och förmåga att lära dig, ta ansvar och utvecklas minst lika viktig. Vi ser gärna att du har: eftergymnasial utbildning inom systemvetenskap, IT eller motsvarande kunskap inom databashantering grundläggande kunskaper i Microsoft Office en grundläggande förståelse för hur det är att arbeta i en organisation och tillsammans med andra. Som person är du framför allt serviceinriktad, samarbetsorienterad och har en god problemlösande analysförmåga. Du lyssnar in, hjälper andra och hittar lösningar även i komplexa frågor. Du arbetar självständigt och strukturerat, behåller lugnet under press och driver uppgifter vidare tills resultat är uppnådda. Vi uppskattar också att du är nyfiken och bidrar med nya idéer och praktiska angreppssätt. DÄRFÖR SKA DU VÄLJA OSS Hos oss får du en bra start på din karriär och möjlighet att lära dig och utvecklas inom IT. Du blir en del av vårt IT-team och får arbeta nära både verksamheten, interna användare och externa specialister. För rätt person finns goda möjligheter att utvecklas och växa inom företaget. Vi erbjuder en inkluderande arbetsplats, kollektivavtal och flera förmåner som du har nytta av både på jobbet och på fritiden. OM ELITFÖNSTER Elitfönster är Sveriges ledande fönstertillverkare, med 100 år av småländsk hantverkstradition och verksamhet över hela landet. Bolaget har cirka 800 medarbetare, ingår i Inwido-koncernen och hade 2025 en omsättning på 1,7 miljarder kronor. Elitfönster står för enkelhet, hållbarhet och kvalitet - på småländska. BRA ATT VETA Placering: Vårt nybyggda kontor på Hejaregatan 14 i Växjö. Efter introduktionsperioden finns möjlighet till visst distansarbete. Rapporterar till: Chef Systemutveckling, Tomm Ilbratt, 072-211 08 70, tomm.ilbratt@elitfonster.se Rekryteringsprocess: Vi använder oss av personlighets- och kapacitetstester Ansökan: Visa ditt intresse senast 6 december. Urval sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas före sista ansökningsdag. Välkommen med din ansökan!
