items.desc: ERP Business Analyst Vi söker en erfaren ERP Business Analyst med specialistkompetens inom IFS Cloud och god förståelse för Procurement & Supply Chain. Du får en central roll i att utveckla och effektivisera organisationens inköps-, planerings- och försörjningsprocesser genom digitalisering, systemutveckling och processförbättringar. Du arbetar nära Procurement, Planning, Manufacturing, Supply Chain och Group IT, där du omsätter verksamhetens behov till konkreta systemlösningar. Rollen kräver gedigen praktisk erfarenhet av IFS Cloud och förmåga att självständigt driva initiativ från analys till implementation. Om uppdraget Som ERP Business Analyst arbetar du tvärfunktionellt med att analysera och förbättra processer inom inköp, planering och Supply Chain. Arbetet omfattar bland annat att: Analysera och effektivisera inköps- och Supply Chain-processer genom ett bättre nyttjande av IFS Cloud. Översätta verksamhetskrav till funktionella specifikationer och systemförbättringar samt stödja implementation och testning. Optimera prognostisering, MRP, materialplanering, leverantörsplanering och påfyllnadsprocesser. Förbättra planeringsparametrar, leverantörsdata och materialtillgänglighet. Identifiera möjligheter till automatisering genom ERP-funktionalitet, integrationer, RPA och Power Automate. Säkerställa datakvalitet inom masterdata samt använda SQL, Business Intelligence och KPI för verksamhetsuppföljning. Utveckla EDI-lösningar och informationsflöden mellan verksamhetssystem. Utvärdera möjligheter med AI och avancerad dataanalys. Facilitera dialoger med intressenter samt stödja utbildning och förändringsledning. Dokumentera krav, processer och lösningar. Målet är att minska manuellt arbete, korta ledtider och förbättra prognosprecision, materialtillgänglighet och leverantörernas leveransprestanda. Vi söker dig som har Gedigen praktisk erfarenhet av IFS Cloud inom Procurement, Planning, Manufacturing eller Supply Chain. God förståelse för prognostisering, MRP, materialplanering och leverantörssamverkan. Erfarenhet av verksamhetsutveckling och processförbättringar samt att omsätta verksamhetsbehov till IT- och systemlösningar. Erfarenhet av processautomation och effektivisering av arbetsflöden. Goda kunskaper i SQL och dataanalys. Erfarenhet av Business Intelligence, KPI-utveckling och rapportering. Förståelse för EDI, systemintegrationer och informationsflöden. God kommunikativ förmåga och vana att samverka med verksamhet och IT. Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift. Vi prioriterar kandidater med dokumenterad specialistkompetens inom IFS Cloud i kombination med praktisk erfarenhet av Procurement och Supply Chain. Generell ERP-erfarenhet utan relevant IFS Cloud-erfarenhet är inte tillräcklig. Som person är du analytisk, nyfiken, strukturerad och pragmatisk. Du är självgående, tar ägarskap och har förmåga att förstå komplexa behov och driva förändring som skapar konkret verksamhetsnytta. Meriterande Det är extra meriterande om du har: Erfarenhet av Power BI, Qlik eller liknande BI-plattformar. Praktisk erfarenhet av RPA, Power Automate och automatiserade arbetsflöden. Erfarenhet av leverantörsscheman och materialpåfyllnad. Erfarenhet av AI, generativ AI eller avancerad dataanalys. Erfarenhet av ERP-transformationer eller större IFS Cloud-implementationer. Kunskap om API, integrationsplattformar och systemarkitektur. Erfarenhet av masterdata governance och datakvalitet. Erfarenhet av process mining och arbetsflödesanalys. Övrigt Uppdraget erbjuder möjlighet till hybridarbete. Uppdragsperiod: 1 januari 2027–31 december 2027. Uppdraget omfattas av krav på säkerhetsprövning och säkerhetsskydd. För säkerhetsklassade tjänster kan särskilda medborgarskapskrav förekomma. Vad vi erbjuder 32 dagars semester Full tjänstepension Friskvårdsbidrag Kompetensutveckling Ett stöttande team

items.desc: Job Title: Learning Portfolio Consultant (f/m/d) Department: Sales Enablement & Activation Location: Flexible / Siemens Global Overview Sales Enablement & Activation defines and governs the sales motion architecture, orchestrates adoption and change for all tool rollouts and process changes, and designs shared standards and content for cross-unit enablement – unlocking cross-unit value and turning strong local capabilities into shared, scalable enterprise advantage. Within it, Sales Enablement defines enablement design standards and partners with SMEs and Sales Units to create sales-specific cross-unit content – governing what content exists, where it lives, and when it is used, while consolidating, standardising, and retiring low-value material to keep the sales asset base focused and current. The Big Picture As our Learning Portfolio Consultant, you will own, govern, and streamline our cross-unit enablement catalogue. You will be the architect of portfolio clarity—turning local materials and central assets into a lean, credible, and easily accessible enablement engine that empowers sales teams globally. How You’ll Make an Impact Build the Single Source of Truth: Establish and maintain the comprehensive cross-unit enablement catalogue—mapping existing learning assets across all Sales Units and mapping them against real sales roles and skill baselines. Rationalize & Reduce Overload: Hunt down overlap, duplication, and conflicting materials. Partner with stakeholders to consolidate resources, retire low-value assets, and keep our content landscape clean and high-impact. Drive Content Governance: Apply lifecycle frameworks to audit currency and relevance. Coordinate regular reviews with content owners to ensure everything in the catalogue is up-to-date and tied directly to active sales motions. Collaborate Across Boundaries: Engage with Sales Units, subject matter experts, and regional teams to build shared visibility and ensure local innovations feed into our broader enterprise advantage. What You Bring to the Table Portfolio Expertise: Hands-on background managing, auditing, and rationalizing learning or content portfolios at scale across diverse stakeholder groups. Governance Know-How: Deep familiarity with content lifecycle management—knowing how to review, consolidate, and gracefully retire out-of-date assets. Analytical Mindset: Demonstrated ability to map learning content against competency frameworks and role catalogues to spot coverage gaps instantly. A Builder's Pragmatism: You thrive in a greenfielding environment where frameworks are still taking shape. You know how to apply structure and drive momentum without waiting for perfection. Communication & Collaboration: Exceptional coordination and influencing skills across time zones, backed by high proficiency in written and spoken English. items.desc: Applications are invited for a Clinical Researcher (Data Curator), to work with a team working with Professor Simon de Lusignan and Dr Gavin Jamie at the Clinical Informatics and Health Outcomes Research Group. The successful applicant will provide their expertise in clinical coding within the Clinical Informatics and Health Outcomes Research Group. The successful candidates will demonstrate the ability to map clinical concepts in research studies to the relevant coding system/clinical terminology. The focus of our work is primary care data using SNOMED CT, but we also work with hospital, cancer and other data sources. Responsibilities will include independently review all study protocols, identify variables required to answer the research questions, develop and deliver relevant sets of clinical terms and concepts ready for data to be extracted by the data scientists. This will build on existing libraries. Work with study teams and investigators to ensure that any resulting searches of clinical data are valid. Work within the team to establish increase external access to data and tools according to the principles of Open Science. Work as part of a multi-disciplinary team. You will be based in the Nuffield Department of Primary Care Health Sciences, Radcliffe Primary Care Building, Woodstock Road, Oxford, OX2 6GG as your normal place of work and there will be the opportunity for remote working. The position is funded by the portfolio held my the Clinical Informatics and Health Outcomes Research Group, in the first instance until March 2027. items.desc: About Wahed: The global financial system wasn't built for everyone. For millions of people, its reliance on interest (riba) creates a barrier to managing money and building wealth without compromising their values. At Wahed, we're changing that. We are a global fintech company on a mission to build a new financial system—one that is ethical, accessible, and entirely interest-free. From our offices across the globe, our team is building products that were once deemed impossible, from pioneering Shariah-compliant equity ETFs, creating riba-free alternatives to high yield savings accounts, to creating no-leverage real estate investments for truly interest-free income producing assets. If you're driven to solve complex problems and believe finance should empower, not exclude, join us in building a more equitable financial future. Job Brief: We are seeking a skilled and proactive Full Stack Engineer to join Wahed's Country Expansion team, supporting the development and launch of our investment platform across new international markets. You will play a key role in developing and adapting frontend and backend systems, building scalable technical solutions, and supporting localized customer onboarding, funding, and investment journeys across different markets. Working closely with Product Managers, Engineering, Operations, and Compliance teams, you will help translate business and regulatory requirements into secure, reliable, and scalable solutions. We are looking for a self-motivated engineer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, takes ownership of delivery, and thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced environment. Job Responsibilities: Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable frontend and backend solutions to support new country launches and existing market operations. Build and enhance backend services, APIs, and microservices, preferably using Golang, while contributing to frontend applications using React, React Native, and TypeScript. Develop and maintain third-party API integrations with KYC providers, payment gateways, banking partners, brokers, custodians, and other financial infrastructure providers. Build and localize customer onboarding, identity verification, account funding, investment, and withdrawal workflows to meet country-specific requirements. Collaborate with Product Managers, Engineering, Operations, and Compliance teams to translate business and regulatory requirements into effective technical solutions. Support end-to-end technical delivery for new market launches, including development, integration testing, deployment, and post-launch troubleshooting. Proactively identify and resolve defects, improve system architecture, and enhance application security, performance, and reliability. Contribute to automated testing, technical documentation, and continuous improvements that enable efficient and scalable future country launches. Job Specification: Minimum 3 years of commercial experience in full stack software development, ideally within fintech, financial services, or a technology-driven environment. Strong backend development experience, preferably in Golang, with the ability to write clean, maintainable, and testable code. Proficiency in TypeScript and React, with experience contributing to React Native applications being advantageous. Experience designing, developing, and integrating RESTful APIs, microservices, and third-party platforms. Experience working with SQL and NoSQL databases, preferably including Elasticsearch or Cassandra. Comfortable working in a Linux environment, with experience using AWS services and cloud infrastructure. Experience integrating third-party APIs and financial technology platforms, ideally within fintech or financial services, would be highly advantageous. Strong understanding of automated testing, debugging, software security, and performance optimization. Ability to work independently and collaboratively with cross-functional teams, manage competing priorities, and deliver against project timelines. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with a practical and product-minded approach to engineering. Eager to learn new technologies, adapt to changing requirements, and contribute to Wahed's mission of making ethical investing accessible globally. We are private equity-backed and scaling fast, with 300 active customers across 10 countries and more than 1,750 implementations. We connect people, technology, and AI to turn fragmentation into performance, partnering with global leaders to modernize how marketing, CRM, content, AI & Data connect. At BPX, we hire operators and specialists who thrive at the intersection of commercial strategy and technical execution. What We Do: Cutting Complexity Across the Front Office We help the world's most ambitious companies, including Uber Eats, BNY, and Xerox, untangle the operational complexity that slows enterprise growth. As a Gold Adobe Solution Partner and Salesforce Summit Partner, we deliver strategy and implementation across the full front office. Our proprietary methodology builds sustainable enabled ecosystems that maximize ROI and accelerate speed to market. By embedding AI into commercial workflows, we help clients move faster and stay ahead. The Role As a Strategic Growth Partner, you will own the pursuit and closure of Bluprintx’s most strategic net-new enterprise opportunities across the EMEA region. Operating at the intersection of enterprise sales and alliance ecosystem partnerships, you will leverage tier-1 partner relationships—including Adobe, Salesforce, Braze, and Databricks—to originate, co-sell, and close high-impact transformation programmes. You will drive high-value enterprise engagements, initially managing a select interim portfolio while aggressively originating net-new deals through a sell-with and sell-through motion. Based in the UK with regular engagement in London, you will collaborate directly with executive leadership, alliance partner lead teams, and client CxOs to modernize complex front-office commercial architectures. Responsibilities Own the pursuit and closure of strategic net-new enterprise engagements across EMEA, targeting 7-figure (£1M+ ACV) deal sizes. Build, activate, and scale joint go-to-market motions with strategic alliance counterparts across Adobe, Salesforce, Braze, and Databricks. Maintain an active pursuit list of 8 to 12 named enterprise target accounts while developing a qualified £15M+ strategic pipeline. Lead executive commercial strategy and positioning at C-suite and C-1 levels (CMO, CRO, CIO, CDO, CTO). Manage and stabilize a small inherited account portfolio in the interim, driving retention and capturing expansion/upsell opportunities. Position integrated, multi-platform propositions across the broader martech, data, and hyperscaler (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) landscape. Formulate and execute a structured 30/60/90-day plan to rapidly map partner ecosystems, establish executive networks, and activate early-stage pipeline. Requirements Demonstrated enterprise B2B commercial sales track record with complex, multi-stakeholder deal cycles and professional services/consultancy selling. Proven experience executing sell-with and sell-through alliance sales motions alongside major vendors or GSIs. Strong startup/scale-up mentality with the ability to originate net-new opportunities from scratch rather than relying solely on inbound demand. Fluency across multi-vendor enterprise ecosystems spanning marketing technology, CRM, data platforms, and AI/ML tooling. Comfortable managing 3- to 9-month sales cycles with 6- to 7-figure contract values. Why this opportunity is unique You are joining a high-performing commercial engine where 100% of the team is currently hitting or exceeding quota, backed by established tier-1 alliance relationships and an industry-leading accelerator structure where top performers can earn well above typical market caps.

About the Role We’re looking for a Middle Backend Engineer to join our Backoffice team. Backoffice is the technical foundation behind our growing business: the internal systems, workflows and integrations that Operations, Compliance and Business teams rely on every day. As the company scales, there are more processes to automate and more systems to strengthen than the current team can deliver. This isn’t a role for fast ticket execution. You’ll own problems end-to-end: understand how a back office process actually works, find where it can be automated or made more reliable, design a sound solution, align with the teams who depend on it and drive it through to production. How We Work We’re a lean, collaborative engineering team where developers have real influence on architecture, product direction and engineering culture. You’ll have autonomy, trust and support while working on business-critical systems that scale with the company, without micromanagement or unnecessary bureaucracy. What We Offer Impact from day one on the systems that keep the business running Growth opportunities and increasing responsibility over time Influence on architecture and the long-term development of our platform Modern stack: Python 3.11, Django, MySQL, Redis, AWS, GitHub, TeamCity Fully remote, work from anywhere Unlimited vacation A supportive and experienced engineering team Hiring Process HR interview with our Talent team Technical interview with the Backend team Gamified cognitive assessment to understand how you think and problem-solve Final conversation with our CTO

items.desc: Description Moore Kingston Smith is seeking an experienced penetration tester to join our NCSC-recognised cyber security team within our Risk Advisory practice, supporting a diverse portfolio of clients across multiple sectors. This is a hands-on role focused on delivering penetration tests across web applications, APIs, and internal and external network infrastructure. You will also support Cyber Essentials Plus assessments and wider technical security reviews, including vulnerability assessments, configuration reviews against recognised benchmarks, and cloud security reviews. You will identify and safely validate security weaknesses, explain the associated business risks clearly, and provide practical remediation advice tailored to each client. We are looking for an individual with strong technical fundamentals, sound professional judgement and a genuine interest in helping clients improve their security posture. Alongside developing your offensive security expertise, you will have the opportunity to contribute to the growth of the cyber security practice and increasingly take ownership across technical delivery, knowledge-sharing and the development of our services. While technical delivery will remain the core focus, if interested, you will also have the opportunity to contribute to broader cyber security engagements, including cyber maturity assessments, security control reviews, audit readiness activities and security design advisory work. Key Responsibilities Lead and support penetration testing engagements across web applications, APIs, and internal and external network infrastructure. Work with clients to define objectives, agree scope and rules of engagement, and plan testing that meets their assurance needs. Apply manual and tool-assisted testing techniques aligned with recognised methodologies and frameworks, including the OWASP Web Security Testing Guide, PTES, and MITRE ATT&CK. Deliver Cyber Essentials Plus assessments, including scoping, conducting the required technical tests, verifying remediation and supporting clients through to certification in line with current NCSC and IASME scheme requirements. Deliver wider technical security assessments, including vulnerability assessments, cloud security reviews, and build and configuration reviews against CIS Benchmarks and vendor hardening guidance. Produce clear, high-quality deliverables and present findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Apply appropriate risk ratings, explain business impact, and support clients with remediation and retesting. Support general advisory engagements such as cyber risk assessments, security control reviews, audit readiness, remediation planning and security design advice. Build strong client relationships and contribute to business development, supporting proposals, scoping, tenders and thought leadership, and identifying opportunities to expand our services. Maintain current knowledge of the threat landscape, emerging attack techniques, testing methodologies, and scheme requirements, while contributing to peer review and quality assurance. Contribute to the continuous improvement of our methodologies, tooling, delivery processes, and technical capability. Skills, Knowledge and Expertise Essential Professional experience delivering client-facing penetration tests across web applications, APIs, and internal or external network infrastructure, independently and/or as part of a team. Strong manual testing capability and sound judgement in selecting and using automated tools, with practical experience of Kali Linux, Burp Suite, Nmap, and Qualys or Nessus. Familiarity with recognised penetration testing methodologies and frameworks, together with the ability to script or automate tasks using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or a comparable language. Good knowledge of modern web architecture, common web and API vulnerabilities, TCP/IP, Windows and Linux security, and Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID attack paths. Experience delivering, or the ability to deliver, wider technical assessments such as vulnerability assessments and configuration reviews against recognised benchmarks such as CIS. Working knowledge of the Cyber Essentials and Cyber Essentials Plus schemes. Existing assessor experience is beneficial; appropriate training will be provided where required. Ability to manage engagements within agreed scope, rules of engagement, timescales, budget, and quality standards, while maintaining clear testing evidence and protecting client systems and data. Strong written communication skills, including the ability to produce clear, accurate, and actionable technical reports. Strong verbal communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to explain technical findings, risk, and business impact to technical and non-technical audiences. items.desc: Are you interested in how the brain produces behaviour? We are looking for a Research and Innovation Associate to join us on a fixed-term basis. You will work on an exciting collaborative project, ‘AI-enabled models for whole-brain functional connectomics’, funded by the Leverhulme Trust and led by Maarten Zwart in the School of Psychology and Neuroscience, University of St Andrews. Understanding how the brain works requires more than simply watching it in action or examining its structure under a microscope. We need to know how individual nerve cells are physically connected and how these connections give rise to behaviour and thought. Current tools can reveal either the structure of the brain or its activity, but rarely both together in a practical and scalable way. This project aims to solve this by combining different kinds of data -structural, functional, and causal- into a single AI-centred computer model. We focus on the larval zebrafish, a small transparent animal whose entire brain can be imaged while it is alive and behaving. By combining information about where neurons are located, how they fire over time, and how they respond to targeted stimulation, we will develop an approach that can infer the brain’s wiring with far less cost and effort than today’s gold-standard techniques. The successful applicant will have a degree in Neuroscience or a related discipline, with expertise in wet-lab neuroscience and community engagement. The post is available for 9 months starting December 14th, 2026, or as soon as possible thereafter. For further information and informal enquiries please contact Maarten Zwart at mfz@st-andrews.ac.uk. In addition to the salary on offer for this position, there are a wide range of benefits for staff working at the University of St Andrews: Financial contribution to relocation (subject to eligibility) Membership of the USS Pension Scheme with a generous employer contribution of 14.5% A hybrid working environment, including partial homeworking where appropriate and a range of family friendly policies, supporting work-life balance Staff discount scheme for local and national goods and services Free staff parking, employee Carshare and Cycle to Work Schemes and subsidised local bus travel Subsidised sports membership, reduced tuition fees on degree programmes for staff, access to training and development opportunities including LinkedIn Learning, access to library facilities, salary sacrifice scheme 34 Days Annual Leave plus 5 Public Holidays. items.card: About the Role We’re looking for a Photonic Component Modelling Engineer to build and qualify behavioral and compact models that accurately capture the underlying device physics. items.desc: About Us Salience Labs is building an industry-defining approach to optical circuit switching for AI infrastructure, engineered for real latency reduction and cost savings. We’re moving towards real-world deployment, and joining at this stage means genuine ownership over that next chapter, working alongside a highly technical team on one of the most consequential problems in AI infrastructure today. About the Role We’re looking for a Photonic Component Modelling Engineer to build and qualify behavioral and compact models that accurately capture the underlying device physics. Your models will be the foundation for system-level verification of systems that combine photonic and electronic components. You’ll need to understand how a component’s behavior shifts with its surrounding optical and electrical circuitry and with operating conditions. What You’ll Do Working closely with the system verification, photonic design, and photonic characterization teams, you will: Develop and maintain models of optical primitives (modulators, switches, photodetectors, couplers, etc.) for simulation and system verification environments Verify that models accurately represent device physics across process, voltage, and temperature (PVT) corners Release models that pass defined QA criteria Verify PDK component libraries so that PDK updates and process variations don’t break circuit-level simulations Extract model parameters from lab measurements and work with characterization to correlate simulation with measurement Build and maintain automated tooling (Python and/or MATLAB) for parameter extraction, model fitting, and regression tracking Maintain regression suites so model and PDK changes are checked against reference data before release Resolve model discrepancies found at system level and feed model-based design risks back to photonic design Keep reproducible records: version-controlled models, scripts, reference data, and QA results What You Bring Required MS/PhD (or equivalent experience) in photonics, electrical engineering, applied physics, or a related field 3+ years of experience in photonic component design and/or simulation Solid understanding of integrated photonic building blocks, both passive and active, and their electrical drive requirements Strong scripting ability (Python and/or MATLAB) for model fitting, data analysis, and simulation/measurement correlation Comfortable working in Linux and with version-controlled repositories Strong documentation habits, including model specifications, QA reports, and traceability from reference data to released models Clear communication and a collaborative approach across disciplines Nice to have Experience modelling signal propagation in photonic integrated circuits Hands-on experience with silicon photonics platforms Experience with optical/photonic simulation tools (e.g., FDTD, mode solvers, circuit-level simulators) Familiarity with foundry PDK-based photonic design flows Tcl scripting

items.desc: To work within the Nottinghamshire multi-disciplinary Community Child and Adolescent Mental Health Team (CAMHS) to improve outcomes for children and young people experiencing emotional and mental health difficulties. This predominantly non-patient-facing role sits within the CAMHS Single Point of Access (SPA) and is responsible for the clinical triage of referrals. The post holder screens referrals, gathers information from multiple sources, and applies clinical judgement to assess the nature, severity, urgency, and risk of presenting concerns. The role includes identifying safeguarding issues, providing consultation, psychoeducation, risk management advice, and signposting children, young people, families, carers, and professionals to appropriate services. Working within a multi-disciplinary and multi-agency framework, the post holder ensures referrals are directed to the most appropriate internal or external service based on clinical need, risk, safeguarding considerations, and service criteria, supporting timely access to the right care at the right time. The post holder will work within the SPA team, providing specialist mental health expertise in the screening, triage, referral processing, delivering psychoeducation, risk management, safety advice to CYP, families & professionals. The role requires an experienced practitioner to triage & formulate a broad range of emotional, mental health, behavioural, and neurodevelopmental presentations. Using clinical expertise via telephone & virtual interventions, they triage risk, respond to safeguarding concerns, & identify urgent mental health needs. Working within a formulation-informed, needs-led model, they support timely decision-making, triage, and pathway allocation, guided by the THRIVE Framework to ensure CYP receive the right support at the right time. Working within a multi-agency framework, collaboration with Social Care, Education, Health Services, hospitals, community & voluntary organisations, & Adult Mental Health Services to facilitate holistic triage & timely access to appropriate support, assessment & intervention. Knowledge of CAMHS pathways, NICE guidance, research, and evidence-based practice to support clinical decision-making, consultation, and signposting. Promote integrated working, challenge mental health stigma & advocates for compassionate, accessible, child-centred care, while maintaining a strong commitment to safeguarding, professional accountability, service development, continuous improvement & positive outcomes for CYP & families. #TeamNottsHC comprises over 11,000 dedicated colleagues who #MakeADifference every day. We deliver intellectual disability, mental health, community health, forensic, and offender healthcare services across Nottinghamshire, Leicestershire, Lincolnshire, and South Yorkshire. Our care is provided from over 200 sites, spanning community locations, acute settings, and secure environments, including prisons. We are one of the largest mental health and community Trusts in the East Midlands and one of Nottinghamshire's biggest employers. We also host national and regional services, such as the National High Secure Deaf Service and the Nottingham Centre for Transgender Health. We offer a variety of employee-led staff networks, including Equality, Diversity, and Inclusion (EDI) groups, the Green Champions network, the Freedom to Speak Up network, the Health and Wellbeing Champions network, and the Menopause Champions network. These networks play a vital role in supporting our diverse workforce and promoting a culture of inclusivity. The health and wellbeing of colleagues is a top priority. We invest significantly in this through our in-house occupational health and staff counselling services, supported by a dedicated Health and Wellbeing team. The Trust is committed to reducing its carbon emissions, with a specialised Energy and Environmental team working to ensure compliance with environmental legislation, enhance our environmental performance, and achieve our net-zero commitment. The CAMHS Specialist Practitioner will work as an integral member of the multidisciplinary Single Point of Access (SPA) Team, providing specialist mental health expertise in the screening, triage, and processing of referrals into Child and Adolescent Mental Health Services (CAMHS). The post holder will deliver timely and effective consultation, psychoeducation, safety advice, risk management support, and emotional containment to children, young people, their families/carers, and professionals, ensuring that individuals are directed to the most appropriate service based on clinical need and evidence-based decision making. The role requires a skilled and experienced practitioner with the ability to identify, triage, and formulate a wide range of emotional, mental health, behavioural, and neurodevelopmental presentations. items.desc: Join Our Team at Mid and South Essex NHS Foundation Trust! Mid and South Essex NHS Foundation Trust is a leading Acute Hospital in the East of England, renowned for its commitment to delivering exceptional healthcare through innovation and teamwork. We are proud to host the St Andrews Centre for Burns and Plastic Surgery — an internationally acclaimed regional centre of excellence serving a population of 3.2 million, with our specialised burns service extending care to nearly 10 million people across the region. We’re excited to invite an enthusiastic Band 5 Scrub Nurse to join our friendly, dedicated, and forward-thinking theatre team. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone eager to take on new challenges and advance their skills within a dynamic and supportive environment. Our department features five dedicated plastics surgery theatres, performing a wide range of elective plastic procedures and regional trauma cases. We are leaders in breast reconstruction and privileged to operate an internationally recognised burns unit that cares not only for the local community but also receives patients from across the globe. If you’re passionate about making a real difference and developing your expertise in a specialised field, we’d love to hear from you! Previous applicants need not apply. Main Duties of the Role: Work closely with the multidisciplinary team to ensure perioperative patients receive high-quality, evidence-based nursing care. Assess, plan, implement, and evaluate holistic and individualised care that respects each patient’s dignity, values, and beliefs. Promote and maintain a safe environment for patients, staff, and visitors in line with health and safety standards. Communicate effectively with colleagues, patients, families, and visitors to support safe and compassionate care. Serve as a clinical and professional role model, demonstrating specialist knowledge and consistently high standards of practice. Provide support and guidance to students and newly qualified staff, acting as a mentor, educator, and assessor to promote evidence-based practice. Assist in managing the theatre budget, including maintaining appropriate stock levels and ensuring cost-effective use of resources. Maintain a professional portfolio and take responsibility for ongoing personal and professional development in line with the NMC Code, hospital policies, and procedures. Our ambition is to deliver excellent local and specialist services, to improve the health and well being of our patients, and provide a vibrant place for staff to develop, innovate and build careers. We aim to make the most of our skills and experiences so we can become the best we can be. As one organisation we will recruit the finest and retain more specialist staff due to more employment opportunities across our Trust. Are you looking for an exciting new role using your unique qualities, then we want to hear from you. For full details about this varied and rewarding role, please see attached job description. We look forward to your application.

In line with the government's priority to increase access and availability of mental health and wellbeing support for children and young people, the new Mental Health Support Teams (named by children and young people in the region as Wellbeing in Mind teams) are an exciting opportunity to deliver evidence-based early interventions for children and young people, working across both educational settings and healthcare sectors in England. We offer a low intensity service model, predominantly using cognitive-behavioural therapy. Each function accounts for a third of the team's workload. items.desc: More Details: Salary: £30,000 - £35,000, depending on experience Working Hours: Monday to Friday 08:30 - 17:00 Location: Aldridge, West Midlands Contract Type: Permanent Start Date: ASAP Job Description We’re looking for a Project Design Engineer to join our engineering team in Aldridge. Working predominantly within our multi-award-winning Conversions Division , you’ll take bespoke shipping container conversions from initial concept through to production. This is a varied, hands-on design role combining 3D modelling and technical drawing with project planning, procurement and close work with our workshop. If you have a strong grounding in mechanical engineering or product design and enjoy seeing your designs built, this could be the role for you. About the Role S Jones Containers is a leader in bespoke shipping container conversions. These large fabrications are designed, manufactured and modified on site in Aldridge to suit each customer’s bespoke requirements. As Project Design Engineer, you’ll work on new projects and existing product ranges, taking responsibility for robust design from concept through to production validation. You’ll produce the technical information our workshop builds from, including 3D models, 2D general arrangement and manufacturing drawings, technical specifications and bills of materials. Beyond the design itself, you’ll plan how each project comes together. That means breaking designs down into materials and component lists, sourcing suppliers and purchasing project-specific materials, and creating task sequences that help the workshop plan production efficiently. You’ll work closely with the shop floor, engineering colleagues and customers to make sure every design meets the customer’s requirements and is correctly interpreted in production. What You’ll Be Doing Undertaking design work on new projects and existing product ranges, from concept through to production validation. Creating designs and technical CAD general arrangement and manufacturing drawings for container modification and general fabrication projects. Preparing project engineering data for new assemblies and components, including technical specifications, BOMs and 3D/2D drawings. Investigating design factors and taking responsibility for the robust design of products. Ensuring designs meet customer requirements and liaising with customers on technical and design matters. Breaking down designs to produce materials and components lists for pricing and purchasing. Identifying where goods, services and subcontract elements are required, sourcing suppliers and best prices, and purchasing project-specific materials, ensuring they are correctly identified for each project on delivery. Creating ‘order of events’ task lists for each project, organising factors such as materials lead times and sub-assembly production to support workshop planning. Working with the shop floor and engineering colleagues to ensure technical information is correctly interpreted, resolving any discrepancies and putting methods in place to prevent recurrence. Maintaining an organised library of drawings and sketches for proposed and live projects and for common components such as doors, windows and frames. Helping to develop and improve working methods, standard documents, procedures and systems within the technical design area. Supporting colleagues and other appropriate duties during periods of absence and as the business grows. About You We’re looking for someone with a solid foundation in mechanical engineering and product design who is self-motivated, works accurately, and enjoys being part of a small team in a busy manufacturing environment. You’ll also bring: An HND or degree in an engineering discipline, ideally mechanical engineering or product design. Knowledge of mechanical engineering principles and product design processes. Experience of 3D modelling using Autodesk Inventor 2026. Experience of working within a busy manufacturing environment. The ability to complete work accurately, completely and to agreed deadlines. An organised, methodical approach to managing drawings and project information. Confident communication skills and the ability to build strong working relationships with the shop floor, engineering colleagues and customers. A strong awareness of customer needs and a professional approach when representing the business. A commitment to health and safety and a willingness to continually develop your knowledge of the business. Why Join Us? We’re investing in both equipment and skills to secure a strong future for the business. This is an opportunity to play a central part in that, working on bespoke projects where you’ll see your designs through from first concept to finished fabrication. You’ll gain broad experience across design, project planning and procurement, with training provided on our company software. items.desc: Job summary IPS (Individual Placement and Support) is an evidence-based approach to helping people with mental health conditions find and keep a paid job. Having a job can bring numerous benefits. We know having a job can help people with mental health conditions to recover. At present, only around 8% of people receiving support from secondary mental health services are in paid employment, while studies suggest almost 90% of people with serious and enduring mental health conditions want to work. Following further investment and expansion of the IPS service an exciting opportunity has arisen for a number of permanent IPS Employment Specialists in the following area: York, Northallerton, Harrogate and Ripon, Scarborough, Whitby and Ryedale. The IPS worker will be working with people who have a mental illness and support them into employment and then enabling them to retain that employment. As an IPS worker you will be looking for paid employment opportunities for clients who are currently involved with secondary care adult mental health services. This will involve developing opportunities with local employers and supporting them as well as the client, to ensure the right person is in the right job. You must have the Right to Work in the UK in order to be successfully appointed to this role. Please note, this role does not meet the required eligibility criteria for sponsorship under the Skilled Worker visa and therefore the Trust is unable to offer sponsorship for this particular role. Main duties of the job The successful postholders will support clients with job searching, completing CV's and application forms and interview preparation. Working with our clients, you will liaise and signpost to a range of employment and training programmes within the local area, to include Job Centre Plus. Within your role, you will develop your knowledge and networks of employment related support services and inclusive employers within the local area is essential to this role. Employment opportunities would include those within TEWV itself. This role is part of a wider employment support service, working closely with people with moderate to severe common mental health problems and their clinicians. The postholders will support service users to gain or return to competitive (paid) employment following the Individual Placement and Support process, aiming for fidelity to this delivery model. The role will involve working directly with Jobcentre Plus, employers, trade unions and employment agencies to secure paid employment opportunities, including supporting them and their employers to retain these opportunities for up to one year once gained. About us We are the Mental Health & Learning Disability NHS Trust for County Durham and Darlington, Teesside, North Yorkshire, York and Selby. From education and prevention, to crisis and specialist care -our talented and compassionate teams work in partnership with our patients, communities and partners to help the people of our region feel safe, understood, believed in and cared for. We nurture the recovery journey of anyone in need of our help. In Our Trust, everyone has a say in how they are supported and treated because we listen to every person in our care until they feel understood. We connect with our communities and partners to get mental health care right, in areas that really need it. We won't rest until everyone in our region has the mental health care they need, to lead their best possible life. You’ll get directly into the source data, using SQL to query and profile datasets, understand tables, keys, joins and relationships, identify data quality issues, and trace how data moves from source systems through ingestion and transformation into downstream data products, reporting and analytics. You’ll need to be genuinely comfortable interrogating complex datasets and using your findings to influence the solution. Working closely with Data Product Managers, Data Modellers, Data Architects and Data Engineers, you’ll translate that analysis into clear data requirements and development-ready user stories. You’ll help define how source data should be mapped and transformed into our enterprise data models, while making sure requirements are technically sound, scalable and understood by everyone involved. You’ll thrive here if you bring strong, hands-on SQL skills alongside solid Data Business Analysis experience. You’ll be confident analysing source systems and database schemas, reading and interpreting conceptual, logical and physical data models, and understanding SQL and Python code well enough to follow how data is being transformed through pipelines. You’ll also bring knowledge across areas such as Data Management, Data Migration, Data Quality, Data Governance and Data Architecture. We’re looking for someone who can bridge the gap between business requirements and complex data. You’ll need experience working on data-centric initiatives or large-scale transformation programmes, ideally involving areas such as data migration, MDM, reporting and analytics or enterprise data modelling, alongside experience working within Agile delivery teams. If you’re a Data BA who enjoys rolling up your sleeves, writing SQL, interrogating source data and turning what you discover into clear requirements and scalable data solutions, we’d love to hear from you. items.desc: We started building Marshmallow in 2017. Since then, we’ve grown from 3 to 700+ people, gained unicorn status, raised ~£140M over three funding rounds, turned profitable, insured millions of drivers and lent millions in car loans. But we’re only just getting started. Our goal is to become one of the largest financial services providers in the world. Over the next 10 years we’ll grow exponentially, not only by scaling our existing products, but also by building new ones. To achieve our goals we need incredibly ambitious, commercially driven people who never settle for ‘good enough’. Marshmallowers are hungry for autonomy and ownership, and would rather improve than coast. Everyone raises standards and has an impact, with a focus on collective success over self-interest. We’ve created an environment where curious, tenacious people win and grow together. If that sounds motivating, this could be the place for you. London (hybrid, 3 days in office) We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this position. Marshmallow makes insurance work for everyone, including people the industry has overlooked. Your difference makes the difference, and we design for it. We’re looking for a Product Designer to join our Telematics team. Telematics is a key part of Marshmallow’s future that sits within Acquisition and how we grow our user base. In a nutshell, you’ll help more people get onboarded into Marshmallow by reducing friction in our sign up and activation flow. Longer term, you’ll be part of the team that build customer stickiness by working out how to reward and engage customers for being good drivers. You’ll work with a team that will back you up, and you’ll own problems from day one. What you’ll be doing Starting with the problem. You’ll shape what we’re solving by doing research with customers, spotting patterns, and turning what you hear into clear themes and needs the team can act on. Designing the whole journey. Wireframes, prototypes, flow to polished screens. You’ll be translating complex concepts into clear, benefit-led experiences. You’ll be thinking about the content on the screen and edge cases too. It’s primarily customer facing, web and app but if your work touches our internal tools, you’ll be thinking about that too. Letting data point the way. You’ll use funnel and analytics data to find where customers get stuck and where we could be causing harm. Then you’ll work with your team to fix it. Building with engineers. You’ll work alongside them from the first idea to what’s shipped. Clear specs and smooth handoffs. If a design tweak is quicker to ship yourself, you can raise the PR. Working in a cross-functional team. Product managers, engineers, operations, data and other designers. You’ll continuously challenge and learn from each other. Bringing stakeholders with you. Acquisition gets a lot of attention here. You’ll form your own opinions, explain your thinking, and keep people in the loop. You won’t be doing it alone, and we’ll help you build the skill. Looking after the design system. Contribute to it, keep things consistent with our brand, and flag anything that doesn’t fit so we can sort it. Using AI every day. For research, analysis and production. Try tools, keep what works, and share it with the team. You should apply if You have a commercial instinct. You have good gut instinct on what makes a product work and a portfolio that backs up what you’ve shipped having good business impact. You have a proactive mind-set. You look to make continuous improvement to the products that you are working on. You find issues and features, write up tickets and ship them when they’re ready. You are actively using AI. You’ve used AI to optimise your workflow and create efficiency gains whether that’s building prototypes, shipping to production, analysing data or conducting research. You prefer to ship quickly and learn. We like to move quickly and learn from real data. This means being able to spot when good is good enough and iterating. Perks of the job Bonus scheme designed to reward high performance Private medical insurance with Vitality, mental health support with Oliva Personal learning budget and 2 dedicated L&D days a year Monthly flexible benefits budget to spend as you choose 25 days holiday plus bank holidays 4 weeks Work From Anywhere per year Our process Initial call with a member from our Talent Team (30 mins) Past Experience interview with Hiring Manager (60 mins) Onsite Case Study session with a couple of the team (90 mins) Culture interview (60 mins) Diversity of thought We know the best ideas come from having different perspectives in the room - and we're committed to hiring fairly, regardless of background, identity or experience. If you see yourself in this role, we'd encourage you to apply.

items.desc: Company ALPINE RACING LIMITED Job Description Software Engineer: About the job At Alpine Formula One Team, we're on a mission to return to the top of the Formula One grid. Software more than ever is playing a pivotal role within this objective, with every aspect of the F1 car depending on in-house systems, from design and manufacture through to simulation and performance analysis at the track. The Software Engineering and Data team is responsible for building and evolving cutting-edge software solutions into a competitive advantage. We are looking for a Software Engineer to join the team at our headquarters in Enstone, Oxfordshire, where you will play a crucial role in helping to achieve this goal. The Role You'll join a team of Software Engineers working across systems in a multitude of domains, rather than being tied to a single project. You'll work directly with our users, such as design, performance and race engineers who rely on our software daily, at the factory and at the track, owning your work from the first conversation with them through to release and beyond: Working with users to understand their workflows, challenge assumptions and turn what they need into well-defined pieces of work. Designing solutions that fit the existing architecture cleanly, without over-engineering and without cutting corners. Writing high-quality, testable code that handles edge cases and failure modes, and giving reviews that make other people's code better. Releasing your own work with confidence: tested, communicated and monitored. Once it's live, you use operational data to see how it actually behaves. Maintaining and evolving existing systems as well as building new ones. Paying down technical debt is part of the job, not something for later. Using AI-assisted development tools as part of how you engineer, and holding what they produce to the same standard as any other code. The Person You take ownership of your work, communicate clearly and approach disagreement with curiosity rather than defensiveness. You'd rather spend another hour at the whiteboard than a week reworking something that was rushed. You care about doing things properly because you've seen what happens when corners are cut, not because someone told you to. You're at ease with people who aren't software engineers. You can turn a vague problem into a clear plan and explain trade-offs in terms that matter to the person asking. We don't require certifications, and we don't have a laundry list of frameworks you must have used. If you've built and shipped real software in C# and you bring the right instincts, such as being quality-minded, pragmatic and focused on the user, we want to hear from you. We are looking for individuals who have Proven commercial experience developing in C# and .NET. Most of our codebase is C#, so this is our one firm technical requirement. Experience building web services (gRPC, REST or similar) and working with relational databases, ideally SQL Server. A good grasp of software design and design patterns, and the judgement to know when not to use them. Experience across the full development lifecycle: requirements, design, implementation, testing, release and support. A systematic approach to debugging and supporting production systems. Clear written and verbal communication, including technical and user documentation. A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience. It would be an advantage if you also have: Experience with Blazor or another modern web UI framework. Experience with Python, C++, or MATLAB, which we use alongside C#. Hands-on use of AI coding assistants such as Claude Code or GitHub Copilot, or experience integrating LLM capabilities into applications. Exposure to CI/CD, containerisation or ETL processes. An interest in engineering, scientific or data-heavy domains. Motorsport experience isn't needed. we offer This is Formula 1. The software our teams build directly shapes how the car is designed, developed and run, so your work has a direct influence to the grid. We believe that without the right software we won't be world champions, and we aim to build the best software on the grid. You'll join a group that values technical excellence, long-term thinking, and real collaboration. Everyone understands how their work fits into the bigger picture. We offer a competitive remuneration package, private medical healthcare, a company pension scheme, and flexible working opportunities including hybrid arrangements. You'll have access to excellent on-site facilities at our Enstone headquarters, including a free gym and subsidised restaurant, as well as additional benefits. items.desc: At inspiring vet care, our people are at the heart of everything we do. As the UK’s number one vet care provider, we're trusted with the care of over 2 million animals, delivering our purpose of healthier animals and happier owners. We are seeking an organised, personable Client Care Administrator to join our team at Southern Counties on a full-time permanent basis. SCVS is a specialist-led small animal hospital with the expertise and resources to handle the most complex cases. As a large multidisciplinary referral hospital, we boast impressive facilities and cutting-edge equipment, allowing us to deliver exceptional care from the initial consultation through to patient discharge. Conveniently located in Ringwood, Hampshire, just off the A31, we are ideally positioned for our clients. Our recent expansion features a newly purpose-built theatre complex, a two-storey facility with an expansive client reception and waiting area, 10 additional consulting rooms, and a new rehabilitation centre. And we’re not stopping there — future enhancements include a new diagnostic suite, an ICU area, and more. How You’ll Make a Difference As a Client Care Administrator, you will be the first point of contact for clients, playing a key role in delivering a welcoming, professional and compassionate experience at every interaction. You’ll support the smooth running of the practice by managing appointments, handling enquiries, supporting client communications and working closely with clinical and non-clinical colleagues to ensure a positive client and patient journey. Working Pattern This is a 40 hour per week position with shifts being Monday to Sunday between the hours of 8am and 6pm as per the rota. Key Responsibilities Overseeing the practice email inbox, prioritising and efficiently responding to urgent communications from clients and referring veterinary practices. Providing efficient and professional telephone support, addressing client and referring practice enquiries. Communicating with clients to arrange timely appointments for new referrals. Thoroughly reviewing clinical histories to extract and summarise information pertinent to the referred condition, supporting clinical decision-making. Coordinating the retrieval of outstanding documents and addressing queries from our clinicians. Processing payments (telephone and email). Managing and prioritising emergency cases to facilitate prompt clinical care, working closely with the clinical floor coordinator, clients and referring veterinary practices. Providing professional front-desk support and assisting clients face to face at reception. Accurately performing end-of-day cash reconciliation and balancing financial transactions. Preparing and organising client documentation packs ahead of scheduled appointments to ensure smooth consultations.  Családbarát munkahelyet, kötetlen munkaidővel, rugalmas hozzáállással.

items.card: You will work with visionaries across multiple industries to improve the hybrid cloud and AI journey for the most innovative and valuable companies in the world. Your ability to accelerate impact and make meaningful change for your clients is enabled by our strategic partner ecosystem and our robust technology platforms across the IBM portfolio; including Software and Red Hat. Curiosity and a constant quest for
items.desc: Introduction A career in IBM Consulting is rooted by long-term relationships and close collaboration with clients across the globe. You will work with visionaries across multiple industries to improve the hybrid cloud and AI journey for the most innovative and valuable companies in the world. Your ability to accelerate impact and make meaningful change for your clients is enabled by our strategic partner ecosystem and our robust technology platforms across the IBM portfolio; including Software and Red Hat. Curiosity and a constant quest for knowledge serve as the foundation to success in IBM Consulting. In your role, you will be encouraged to challenge the norm, investigate ideas outside of your role, and come up with creative solutions resulting in ground-breaking impact for a wide network of clients. Our culture of evolution and empathy centers on long-term career growth and development opportunities in an environment that embraces your unique skills and experience. In this role, you will work in one of our IBM Consulting Client Innovation Centers (Delivery Centers), where we deliver deep technical and industry expertise to a wide range of public and private sector clients around the world. Our delivery centers offer our clients locally based skills and technical expertise to drive innovation and adoption of new technology. Your Role And Responsibilities This position will be based within the Hybrid Cloud & Data service line. Responsibilities As an Associate Data Scientist at IBM, you will work to solve business problems using leading edge and open-source tools such as Python, R, and TensorFlow, combined with IBM tools and our AI application suites. You will prepare, analyze, and understand data to deliver insights, predict emerging trends, and provide recommendations to stakeholders. In your role, you may be responsible for: Analysis, preparation and management of complex data sources Implementing and validating predictive and prescriptive models and creating and maintaining statistical models with a focus on big data & incorporating machine learning techniques in your projects Writing programs to cleanse and integrate data in an efficient and reusable manner Development of scalable and robust data and machine learning pipelines Application of traditional machine learning algorithms as well as modern deep learning approaches (such as GenAI) Implementation, integration and monitoring of AI / ML models Working in an agile, collaborative environment, partnering with other scientists, engineers, consultants and database administrators of all backgrounds and disciplines to bring analytical rigor and statistical methods to the challenges of predicting behaviors Documentation and communication with internal and external clients (e.g. business and IT departments) and stakeholders to understand and define business needs and appropriate modelling techniques to provide analytical solutions as well as presentation of proposed solutions and results. Evaluating modelling results and communicating the results to technical and non-technical audiences. Preferred Education Master's Degree Required Technical And Professional Expertise Strong fundamentals in Mathematics and/or Computer Science (algorithms). Solid knowledge and experience in GenAI and agentic AI architectures (RAG, agentic patterns, etc.), AI and ML frameworks (e.g. PyTorch), DevOps and MLOps (CI/CD pipelines, ML lifecycle / deployment, etc.). Strong technical and analytical abilities, a knack for driving impact and growth and experience with programming/scripting in a language such as Python. You're great at solving problems by looking at things differently, debugging, troubleshooting, and designing & implementing solutions for complex technical issues. You thrive on teamwork, you have excellent verbal and written communication skills and, importantly, a consulting mindset. Excellent verbal and written German language skills (minimum C1 level). Preferred Technical And Professional Experience You have a good understanding of cloud and container technology (such as Red Hat OpenShift, AWS, Azure, etc.). You have experience in AI governance and monitoring.

items.desc: Depuis près de 40 ans, Absys Cyborg s’impose comme un partenaire de confiance des PME et ETI dans la refonte et la modernisation de leur processus de gestion. Pour nous accompagner dans nos projets de croissance, nous renforçons nos équipes et recrutons un(e) : AI Engineer F/H Ce qui vous séduira dans ce poste… Au sein de la Direction IA d’Absys Cyborg, vous concevez, développez et déployez des agents IA et des automatisations pour optimiser les processus internes. Vous intervenez également sur les données et les connaissances qui alimentent ces solutions, afin de garantir des réponses pertinentes, fiables et traçables. Comprendre les besoins métiers et les traduire en solutions IA et en workflows automatisés Concevoir et développer des agents IA, en sélectionnant les modèles et les technologies adaptés, qu’ils soient issus de solutions tierces ou open source Structurer les données et les connaissances nécessaires aux agents : préparation des sources, bases de connaissances, pipelines RAG, indexation et recherche sémantique Intégrer les solutions au système d’information, notamment aux ERP, CRM et bases documentaires, grâce aux API et connecteurs MCP Tester, déployer et améliorer les solutions en production, en assurant leur documentation, leur maintenabilité, le suivi de leurs performances ainsi que leurs coûts Prendre en compte la sécurité, les droits d’accès et les règles de gouvernance dès la conception Et ce que nous apprécierons chez vous… De formation informatique ou ingénieur avec un parcours obligatoire en IA, un langage de programmation courant en IA et possédez une expérience en IA générative, en création d'agents, RAG et automatisation. Une première expérience en stage ou en alternance peut convenir. Vous travaillerez avec des IA connectées à des systèmes d'entreprise, des LLM propriétaires ou open source ainsi qu'une ou plusieurs plateformes agentiques. items.desc: On site Full time Your future team We’re looking for a motivated Junior Software Developer to join our GenAI Innovation Team . You’ll work on cutting-edge projects that leverage large language models, AI agents, and automation to transform how our people work, learn, and collaborate. From internal assistants and copilots to AI-driven productivity tools, you’ll help design and build solutions that put generative AI into the hands of users across the organization. Guided by experienced engineers and project managers, you’ll be involved in end-to-end development activities and exposed to real-world GenAI use cases from day one. You’ll join a dynamic team where experimentation, rapid prototyping, and continuous learning are part of the culture. This is an opportunity to grow your skills in modern software engineering while working at the forefront of applied AI. Your advantages of joining us Career Growth, Your Way Start your journey in a team that invests in your development: access to structured training on GenAI, hands-on mentoring, and clear growth paths from junior developer to more advanced technical roles. Impactful AI, Real Users Build solutions that are actually used by colleagues across the firm. Your work will help streamline daily tasks, improve knowledge access, and enable new ways of working powered by AI. Innovative, Supportive Culture Join a culture where experimentation is encouraged, new ideas are welcome, and you’re supported in exploring emerging technologies and frameworks. Build Your Network Collaborate with software engineers, data scientists, product owners, and business stakeholders, expanding your technical and professional network within an international environment. How you’ll contribute to o ur success Develop GenAI-powered applications using modern technologies (e.g., TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, .NET, Node.js) and integrate them with large language models and AI APIs. Implement features for AI assistants and copilots, such as conversational interfaces, workflow automation, and smart integrations with internal tools and platforms. Contribute to end-to-end solutions, from backend services and APIs to frontend components, focusing on performance, usability, and security. Support integration with cloud and data platforms, helping connect AI services to internal data sources in a safe and compliant way. Participate in Agile delivery, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, demos, and code reviews, while collaborating closely with senior developers and product owners. Help improve existing GenAI solutions, troubleshooting issues, refining prompts, optimizing models, and incorporating user feedback. Stay up to date with the GenAI ecosystem, researching new tools, frameworks, and best practices and sharing insights with the team. Your Skills Must Have Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related field. 0–2 years of professional experience (or equivalent through internships, academic projects, or personal projects) in software development. Solid programming skills, with proven track record. Fundamental understanding of software engineering principles: version control (Git), clean code practices, testing, and documentation. Strong interest in Artificial Intelligence, especially Generative AI (LLMs, prompt engineering, AI agents) and its practical applications. Familiarity with web development (frontend or backend) and RESTful APIs through studies or projects. Exposure to cloud platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS) via courses, labs, or academic projects. A proactive, tech-savvy mindset, with attention to detail and a genuine desire to learn and experiment with new technologies. Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate in a multicultural, cross-functional environment. Nice to Have Experience working in Agile framework (Scrum, Kanban) through projects, internships, or coursework. Hands-on experience with LLM APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic) or open-source models and frameworks. Basic knowledge of MLOps / AI tooling, such as vector databases, prompt orchestration frameworks, or model monitoring tools. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, containers (Docker), and orchestration tools (Kubernetes). Exposure to security and compliance considerations when working with data and AI solutions. Contributions to academic, open-source, or hackathon projects related to AI or automation. Interested? items.title: Stage Bac+5 - IA et Machine Learning H/F
items.card: vos missions. Description Du Poste Notre laboratoire développe des systèmes d’ imagerie optique couplés à des algorithmes d’intelligence artificielle pour l’analyse d’objets biologiques. Au cours d’un précédent projet sur le diagnostic des bactériémies en milieu à faibles ressources, une large base d’images de colonies bactériennes a été constituée en Afrique sub-saharienne sur plusieurs centaines de patients
items.desc: Rejoignez-nous en Stage ! En tant que stagiaire au CEA, vous aurez l'opportunité de travailler au sein d'un environnement de recherche de renommée mondiale. Nos équipes sont composées d'experts passionnés et dédiés, offrant un cadre propice à l'apprentissage et à la collaboration. Vous aurez accès à des équipements de pointe et à des ressources de recherche de premier ordre pour mener à bien vos missions. Description Du Poste Notre laboratoire développe des systèmes d’ imagerie optique couplés à des algorithmes d’intelligence artificielle pour l’analyse d’objets biologiques. Au cours d’un précédent projet sur le diagnostic des bactériémies en milieu à faibles ressources, une large base d’images de colonies bactériennes a été constituée en Afrique sub-saharienne sur plusieurs centaines de patients atteints d’infection sanguine. À partir de cette base de données et des algorithmes déjà développés par notre équipe, l’objectif du stage sera d’explorer de nouvelles approches d’IA afin d’améliorer la robustesse , la fiabilité et l’ interprétabilité des modèles d’identification bactérienne. Le stage s’articulera autour de trois axes correspondant à des problématiques actuellement majeures et particulièrement actives de l’IA appliquée à la médecine et à l’imagerie biologique : le préentraînement et l’apprentissage de représentations, la détection des données hors distribution (Out-of-Distribution, OOD), et l’ explicabilité des modèles. Pour aller plus loin : https://www.itg.be/fr/research/projets/systeme-dhemoculture-simplifie-simble https://doi.org/10.1155/2024/6465280 Profil du candidat Étudiant(e) en dernière année d’école d’ingénieur ou de Master 2, avec une formation en intelligence artificielle, informatique, traitement d’image, vision par ordinateur, mathématiques appliquées ou domaine proche. Solides bases en machine learning et deep learning , et une bonne maîtrise de Python ; expérience sur des jeux de données expérimentaux appréciée. Rejoignez-nous, venez développer vos compétences et en acquérir de nouvelles ! Vous avez encore un doute ? Nous vous proposons : L'opportunité de travailler au sein d'une organisation de renommée mondiale dans le domaine de la recherche scientifique, Un environnement unique dédié à des projets ambitieux au profit des grands enjeux sociétaux actuels, Une expérience à la pointe de l’innovation, comportant un fort potentiel de développement industriel, Des moyens expérimentaux exceptionnels et un encadrement de qualité, De réelles opportunités de carrière à l’issue de votre stage Un poste au cœur de la métropole grenobloise, facilement accessible via la mobilité douce favorisée par le CEA, Une participation aux transports en commun à hauteur de 85%, Un équilibre vie privée – vie professionnelle reconnu, Un restaurant d'entreprise, Une politique diversité et inclusion, Conformément aux engagements pris par le CEA en faveur de l'intégration des personnes handicapées, cet emploi est ouvert à toutes et à tous. Le CEA propose des aménagements et/ou des possibilités d'organisation pour l'inclusion des travailleurs handicapés. Localisation du poste Site Grenoble Localisation du poste France, Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes, Isère (38) Ville Grenoble Critères candidat Langues Anglais (Intermédiaire) Diplôme préparé Bac+5 - Master 2 Demandeur Disponibilité du poste 01/03/2027

items.desc: Objectif du stage : L'objectif principal du stage sera de poursuivre et d'étendre cette approche afin de prédire, en complément du gonflement, les propriétés mécaniques des aciers austénitiques irradiés et de développer une description plus robuste de leur évolution sous irradiation. Une première étape consistera à enrichir la base de données existante avec des résultats de caractérisation mécanique disponibles dans la littérature et dans les bases expérimentales du CEA. Selon les données disponibles, différentes propriétés pourront être considérées : limite d'élasticité, résistance maximale, allongement à rupture, dureté, etc. À partir de cette base expérimentale enrichie, différentes stratégies de machine learning seront développées, avec notamment l’exploration d’une approche de Physics-Guided Machine Learning (PGML) visant à intégrer les connaissances disponibles sur le comportement des matériaux sous irradiation. Le modèle pourra s’appuyer sur des lois décrivant la dépendance du gonflement et des propriétés mécaniques à la dose et à la température, afin d’identifier des paramètres interprétables tels que la dose d’incubation, la vitesse de gonflement ou l’amplitude du durcissement. L’utilisation de Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINN), une approche particulière du PGML dans laquelle des contraintes physiques sont directement introduites dans l’apprentissage du réseau, pourra également être étudiée. Environnement de travail et méthodes à mettre en œuvre : Au sein du Service d'Études des Matériaux Irradiés (SEMI), vous intégrerez le Laboratoire de Microscopie et d'Études de l'Endommagement (LM2E), dédié à la caractérisation et à l'étude de l'évolution de la microstructure des matériaux soumis à irradiation, en lien avec leur propriétés mécaniques. Le laboratoire étudie ainsi les mécanismes de fragilisation, notamment la corrosion, afin d’optimiser les modèles prédictifs de comportement des matériaux en réacteur. Les analyses réalisées couvrent des échelles allant du millimètre à l’échelle atomique, à l'aide de différents microscopes de dernière génération et le développement d’outils de traitement de données. Profil du candidat Étudiant(e) de Master 2 ou de dernière année d'école d'ingénieur en science des matériaux, physique des matériaux ou domaine proche, avec un intérêt pour la modélisation, l'analyse de données et le machine learning. Des connaissances en Python sont souhaitées. Conformément aux engagements pris par le CEA en faveur de l'intégration des personnes handicapées, cet emploi est ouvert à toutes et à tous. Le CEA propose des aménagements et/ou des possibilités d'organisation pour l’inclusion des travailleurs handicapés. items.desc: ¿Quiénes somos? En Datision desarrollamos soluciones de Inteligencia Artificial a medida para resolver problemas reales de negocio mediante Machine Learning, Deep Learning y tecnologías avanzadas de IA. Nuestro día a día combina investigación aplicada, desarrollo de modelos y construcción de soluciones que llegan a producción . Y hay algo que caracteriza especialmente a Datision: somos un equipo técnico relativamente pequeño , lo que permite que cada persona tenga un impacto real en los proyectos, participe en decisiones técnicas y pueda trabajar en problemas muy diferentes.
