items.desc:
Job Description: 
 In order to support the Manoeuvre Loads Team in Hamburg, Airbus is looking for a 
 Aerodynamics Engineer for Manoeuvre Loads Calculation (d/f/m) 
 As Flight Physics we are at the heart of aircraft design and deal as part of the engineering organisation with the key flight sciences. 
 In the Manoeuvre Loads Team in Hamburg we perform load calculations covering our fleet from a very early design stage until certification and finally during airline operations. We are responsible for build model activities such as aerodynamics modelling for the manoeuvre loads models and integrating model bricks. We subsequently perform manoeuvre loads calculation and provide the loads data to our component loads colleagues. In addition to this, the team is strongly involved in performing loads in-service support, research and technology aspects with new aircraft configuration assessments, new services, model based system engineering, automation, and machine learning. 
 Having the transverse view of the whole aircraft, our main mission is to deliver suitable aircraft design and configuration for optimum performance. As such we are fully part of the current and future challenges in designing a safe aircraft meeting the highest sustainability and operational standards. 
 We are present throughout the full aircraft life-cycle: supporting sales campaigns from early definition phase through the core design phase and onwards into supporting manufacture, flight testing and the aircraft in service. By this we ensure the best-operational and safe use of the aircraft and create value for our customers. 
 We are aeronautical engineers, developers and innovators. We make use of cutting edge technologies in our tools as digital enablers are key to ensure our success. 
 Your location 
 You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy. 
 Our Benefits for You 
 Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines. 
 Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities. 
 Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives. 
 Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations. 
 Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA. 
 Your tasks and responsibilities 
 Your main focus will be on performing build model activities such as aerodynamics modelling for the manoeuvre loads computation models and supporting modelling methodology development and harmonization/ improvement projects. 
 You will perform manoeuvre loads calculations covering our fleet from a very early design stage until certification. 
 You will support research and technology aspects with new aircraft configuration assessments, new services, model based system engineering, automation, and machine learning. 
 You would also support airlines through Airbus Customer Services by carrying out L&A analyses of in-service events: Contribute to Loads In-Service Support with trouble shooting activities in the L&A design office context for development and production flight test and in-service aircraft, perform related L&A assessments. 
 Engage for timely response to engineering queries as on-call engineer for Loads In-Service Support. 
 Desired skills and qualifications 
 You have several years of working experience in aerodynamics and/ or steady state aeroelasticity or a PHD in the same field

Job Description: 
 The Finance NextGen Programme is an Airbus Defence & Space wide development programme. This programme is designed to identify and develop talented Leaders for the Airbus Finance Community who will contribute significantly towards achieving our business goals. The FinanceNextGen Programme - sponsored by Airbus Defence & Space CFO - enables its participants to enhance financial know-how and expertise, combined with further learning in management and leadership competencies.

The scope of responsibility includes finance controlling, consolidation and costing activities related with New Programmes mainly.  As a Financial Analyst you will be a vital part in the Finance community to gather and consolidate the data to enable educated decision making on management level and give visibility about performance versus targets in an international environment.

 Consolidating, supporting and preparing finance exercise as Operational Planning, EAC, Forecast, End of Year Estimation, Budget within the Operations & Engineering F&C team in Getafe.
 Implement the standardization strategy for monthly closing reporting at TFAO Perimeter level, automatization of activities, co-pilot the finance strategy with the operational improving communication and better finance understanding.
 Focal point for Internal Finance Customer demand, as general queries, deep analysis on specific matter, new way of working implementation, task request by the business.

 Technical responsibility for a defined range of tasks.
 Decision on the costing methodology and the references to be assumed.
 Assessment of risks and opportunities in costing; identification of cost drivers (e.g. processes, design premises); providing recommendations regarding the optimisation of the analysed cost basis; including full documentation of the costing result and presentation of the results to the customer.
 Knowledge management: maintaining and sharing expertise and current knowledge of the processes, methods, and industrial set-up of the internal customers (e.g. Programmes, Procurement, Production), the suppliers.
 Supporting and actively contributing to improvement measures (e.g. processes, tools), also with regard to sustainability.
 Internal and cross-divisional harmonisation of cost models, methods, and tools. Continuous development of cost models and data analyses that can be used by other costing actors.
 Accomplishment of all business activities in compliance with all relevant internal and external regulations/legislation; escalation of occurring Ethics & Compliance issues.
 Supporting supplier negotiations, contributing to the supplier strategy and internal strategic go/no-go decisions.
 Cost by destination oriented, providing management with transparent information vital to the decision-making process, advancing recovery measures in case of potential deviations in a changing and volatile environment (development programs with a multi-companies and multi-countries set-up).

 Master’s degree in mechanical or electrical Engineering or equivalent.

 Airbus Commercial Aircraft is looking for a Industrial Cyber Sec. Specialist (f/m) to join our Industrial Cybersecurity Operations department based in Toulouse, France. 
 You will be part of a team protecting aircraft manufacturing processes against cyber threats. As part of the local ICS operations, you will be involved in bridging plant operations with security technologies aiming at systematically controlling and mitigating risks for the Toulouse St. Martin manufacturing facilities). 
 Your working environment: 
 Global capital of aeronautics and European capital for space research, Toulouse is a dynamic city in the southwest of France served by an international airport. Ideally located between the Mediterranean sea and the Atlantic ocean and close to the Pyrenees mountains, it offers plenty of options for outdoor activities! 
 How we care for you:
 Financial rewards: Attractive salary, agreements on success and profit sharing schemes, employee savings plan abounded by Airbus and employee stock purchase plan on a voluntary basis.

 At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

 Carry out industrial cyber solutions (such as ISP) and service implementation projects in cooperation with plant stakeholders. 
 Conduct Industrial Cyber Security Maturity Assessments (ICMA) and deliver resulting local initiatives. 
 Coordinate local response actions to cybersecurity incidents and supervise change control for OT and IACS. 
 Manage local resources, budgets, work packages, and support the vulnerability management process. 
 Maintain plant security metrics and develop communication plans to periodically report the cybersecurity posture to local management. 
 Your boarding pass: 
 Degree in Cybersecurity, Systems Engineering, Industrial Automation, IT, or equivalent practical experience. 
 Proven expertise in Industrial Control Systems (ICS) and Operational Technology (OT) cybersecurity. 
 Solid background in cyber incident detection, response, and information systems security architectures. 
 Strong grasp of NIST CSF (Manufacturing Profile, 800-53, 800-82) and ISA/IEC 62443 standards. 
 Familiarity with regulatory frameworks (EASA PART-IS, NIS2, EBIOS) and Security-by-Design principles.

 Testia, filiale du groupe Airbus, est une entreprise internationale spécialisée dans l’intégrité et les inspections d’aérostructures et le contrôle non destructif aéronautique.

Job Description: 
 Take off with Airbus Helicopters! 
 Airbus Helicopters is looking for a Drive System Design Responsible to join our Engineering departement based in Marignane, France. 
 You will join Transmission Design & Dynamic Systems Architecture department, which is in charge of the whole Airbus Helicopters fleet. Your missions will be operational.
 Join us to shape the future of aeronautics and help protect lives during missions accomplished thanks to our helicopters.
 The Marignane site, the 3rd largest industrial site in France, near Marseille and Aix-en-Provence, is undergoing a deep transformation to offer a high-tech, inclusive, and environmentally friendly working environment.
 You will live a unique professional experience, at the heart of the manufacturing of our helicopters.
 To learn more about our site and our activities: Airbus Helicopters - Marignane 
 Your future missions: 
 As System Design Responsible (SDR), you will be in charge of :
 - defining technical objectives of transmission systems (specification writing) ;
 - following detailed design & compliance to requirements of performance, manufacturing, assembly & reliability for any design change and/or new certification ;

Job Description: 
 Airbus Defence & Space recherche un Ingénieur d'Essais Radiofréquences (f/h) pour rejoindre notre Département Assemblage, Intégration et Tests (AIT) basé à Toulouse , France.
 Vos missions : 
 Vous ferez partie d'une équipe qui développe des satellites de télécommunications de haute technologie . Au sein du département d'Assemblage, Intégration et Tests (AIT), vous serez impliqué(e) dans la conception et le pilotage des campagnes d'essais hyperfréquences visant à garantir la performance et la fiabilité des équipements spatiaux avant leur lancement.
 Vos responsabilités : 
 Ingénierie et conception des tests 
 Définir les stratégies de tests et concevoir les configurations techniques (setups) sur l'ensemble du cycle de vie du satellite.
 Concevoir les méthodologies d'essais et définir les architectures de tests automatisées pour répondre aux exigences de conception complexes
 Optimiser les processus et les outils de mesure en analysant les retours d'expérience.
 Pilotage opérationnel et expertise technique 
 Orchestrer le déroulement des campagnes d'essais en coordination avec les services de planification et de production.
 Assurer l'expertise technique lors des phases de tests en environnements critiques, notamment en Vide Thermique (simulation de l'espace) et en CATR (Compact Antenna Test Range - chambre de mesure d'antennes).
 Diriger les investigations techniques et les analyses de causes profondes en cas d'anomalie sur les sous-systèmes de la Charge Utile (équipements de mission du satellite).
 Coordination et gestion de projet 
 Coordonner les opérations en lien étroit avec les responsables d'essais et les planificateurs.
 Piloter le reporting technique, analyser les écarts de performance et garantir la validation des résultats auprès de la direction et des clients.
 OBLIGATOIRE 
Ce poste nécessite une habilitation de sécurité ou nécessite d'être éligible à une habilitation par les autorités reconnues. 
 Votre profil : 
 Compétences et expérience : 
 Minimum 2 ans d'expérience professionnelle en ingénierie ou essais hyperfréquences dans un environnement industriel complexe.
 Maîtrise des techniques de mesure Radiofréquence (utilisation d'analyseurs de réseau, analyseurs de spectre, etc.).
 Capacité à piloter des projets techniques en autonomie, avec une aptitude à l'arbitrage décisionnel en environnement critique.
 Anglais niveau avancé (usage quotidien en contexte international) et Français niveau professionnel.
 Atouts supplémentaires : 
 Maîtrise de la programmation (ex: Java, LabVIEW) ou expertise du cycle d'intégration de satellites.

Des déplacements professionnels sont à prévoir ( 1 à 2 fois par an en Europe ou sur site de lancement, durée 2 à 3 semaines )
Vous serez amené(e) à travailler le samedi et en astreinte le dimanche ( 12 week-ends par an , planning discuté en équipe et communiqué 2 semaines en avance minimum)

 Capitale mondiale de l'aéronautique et capitale européenne de la recherche dans le spatial, Toulouse est une ville dynamique du sud-ouest de la France desservie par un aéroport international. Idéalement située entre la mer Méditerranée et l'océan Atlantique et à proximité des Pyrénées, elle offre de nombreuses possibilités d'activités de plein air !

 Avantages financiers : Salaire attractif, accords d’intéressement et de participation, plan d'épargne salariale abondé par Airbus, plan d’actionnariat salarié sur la base du volontariat, avec attribution d'actions gratuites en fonction du nombre d'actions souscrites.

We deploy Forward Strategists against the highest-leverage
items.desc:
Who we are 
 Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards.
 As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously.
 We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.
 The role 
 Forward Strategists at Helsing sit at the intersection of Product, Engineering, and Operations. Where engineering builds the system, the Forward Strategist works alongside it: landing in ambiguity, understanding the technical shape of the problem, and building a path through it that engineering, product, and operations teams can execute against. We deploy Forward Strategists against the highest-leverage problems in the company, where you will embed deeply in the technical and product work, take full ownership of outcomes, and leave behind systems, tooling, and clarity that keep delivering long after you have moved on.
 The day-to-day 
 Take a poorly-defined technical or product problem, establish what it actually is, and build a structured path to resolution, setting direction through the ambiguity
 Deliver on that path end-to-end, prioritising ruthlessly, working across product, engineering, operations, commercial, hardware, and legal domains, and owning the outcome until it ships
 Make sound, well-evidenced calls on technical and product trade-offs under uncertainty, commit to them, and adapt when the facts change, without deferring decisions or sitting on the fence
 Work close to the codebase and system architecture, translating ambiguous requirements into technical specifications that engineering teams can build against
 Build alignment across product, engineering, and operations teams without relying on formal authority, communicate a clear technical vision, and coach others toward it
 Leave the organisation permanently better, building tooling, processes, and technical documentation that scale beyond what you can personally produce
 You should apply if you 
 Are product-obsessed, and dig into a product roadmap, spotting gaps and shaping new opportunities before anyone else sees them
 Have landed in an ambiguous, high-stakes technical environment with no predefined strategy and turned it into a shipped, structured outcome
 Have built tools, systems, or software that outlasted your involvement and continued to generate value for engineering and product teams
 Reason from first principles into unfamiliar technical domains quickly, whether distributed systems, deployment infrastructure, or product architecture, and become the person others come to for the answer
 Have a track record of making clear, well-reasoned calls, backing them with evidence, and holding to them while remaining genuinely open to changing your view when the facts shift
 Have brought engineering and product teams with you without formal authority, built alignment across technical and non-technical stakeholders, and shaped how others think about a problem or outcome
 Are comfortable working close to a codebase, engineering trade-offs, and technical roadmaps, even if you are not the one writing the production code
 Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points. 
 Nice to have 
 Experience operating within or alongside a product or engineering function, with a working understanding of software development lifecycles, deployment pipelines, and technical trade-offs
 Exposure to a high-ambiguity environment, whether as a founder, early operator, or technical consultant to growth-stage companies, where the job description mattered far less than the systems and outcomes you owned
 Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields 
 Helsing's work is important. You'll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns.
 The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world.
 Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, …

ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We're scaling from 1,000 → 4,000 employees across 50+ countries, and the complexity of how we support our people through performance, conflict, and change is growing quickly. Our Employee Relations (ER) Partners protect fairness, consistency, and trust as we grow. You'll own our most sensitive and complex People cases, so that leads can act early.

As an ER Partner at ElevenLabs, you'll lead formal performance processes, investigations, grievances, and disciplinary matters from start to finish, working closely with Legal and outside counsel across many jurisdictions. You'll also coach leads through difficult conversations before they become formal cases, and turn what you see into playbooks, frameworks, and training that reduce risk and case volume over time.

This is our first ER hire. We're building a dedicated ER function, and we want someone who can help shape and build it out: how cases are triaged and escalated, how we work with counsel, and how we measure what's working.

This is a high-impact role for someone who can handle sensitive situations with discretion, make sound judgment calls, and bring clarity and calm to fast-moving environments.




YOU WILL

 - Lead formal performance processes, including back on track plans, end to end, in partnership with Leads and People Partners.

 - Run fair, well-documented investigations into misconduct allegations, grievances, and complaints, from fact-finding through to outcome.

 - Manage disciplinary, dismissal, and exit matters, drafting outcomes and communications with Legal.

 - Partner with in-house employment counsel and, when necessary, outside counsel to assess risk.

 - Triage incoming cases with People Partners using clear escalation criteria, so the right cases reach ER at the right time.

 - Keep the case log and report on patterns, risks, and trends by team, region, and case type.

 - Build playbooks, templates, and training that raise lead capability and cut avoidable cases.

 - Build out a self-serve ER flow for leads, so that common ER cases become scalable.

 - Partner with People Ops & Compliance teams to ensure smooth execution of terminations, local requirements, and compliance-heavy workflows.


REQUIREMENTS

 - Hands-on experience leading employee relations cases, including performance management, …

items.desc:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.



We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.



Here’s what this particular role covers.

 

🛠️ About our Robotics Team

The Robotics team is responsible for bridging the gap from our model to our vehicle platforms, in order to let the model focus on making driving decisions. We aim to provide high quality data to the model for making such decisions, whilst abstracting away platform-specific aspects. We combine specialisms across the robotics domain, blending strong theoretical foundations with solid engineering practice to span the spectrum from research to production.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

 - Develop, integrate, tune, and validate control, trajectory-generation, and action-processing algorithms across different vehicle platforms, operating modes, and challenging driving conditions, ensuring robust real-world performance

 - Maintain and evolve our controls software architecture that connects AI Driver outputs to real-time vehicle actuation and feedback

 - Own requirements, release readiness, and in-field performance and issue triage

 - Implement and maintain production-quality, latency-sensitive control software in C++ for deployment to prototype, reference and production vehicles

 - Use simulation, closed-loop evaluation and on-road testing to characterize controller behaviour, diagnose performance issues and validate improvements

 - Work with teams across Wayve to define controller interfaces, integrate with adjacent systems and enable new vehicle platforms and product features (Ownership through the full lifecycle)

 - Define and track quality metrics (e.g., comfort, tracking error, and safety margin KPIs, and regressions against them)

 - Contribute to safety artefacts: provide evidence for safety cases, work with the safety team to ensure compliance with required standards

🧩 What you’ll be working on:

In this role you will develop and improve the vehicle trajectory and motion controllers that translate the Wayve AI Driver outputs into safe, smooth and robust vehicle motion across different vehicle platforms and applications (both ADAS and AV). You’ll tackle cutting-edge challenges: developing principled controls approaches, implementing real time systems, testing in complex scenarios and refining our evaluation pipelines. This is a great chance to make an impact on the AV industry and grow alongside a focused team of passionate experts at the forefront of autonomous driving technology.



🙌 You should apply if you have:


REQUIRED SKILLS/EXPERIENCE

 - Strong fundamentals in control theory, with applied experience in one or more of optimization, model-predictive control, numerical methods or dynamical systems

 - Practical experience developing, tuning and validating motion control on complex real world physical systems (e.g., direct experience with mobile robotics and/or autonomous vehicles)

 - Experience with test and validation discipline: unit and integration tests, simulation regression suites, closed-loop metrics.

 - Strong software engineering skills, with experience building reliable production-quality systems in C++

 - Experience with latency-sensitive or real-time software

 - Ability to reason about and debug system-level behaviour in complex robotic systems across software and hardware


DESIRED SKILLS/EXPERIENCE

 - Applied machine learning experience, or experience developing systems that integrate with ML components

 - Vehicle dynamics and actuation. Steering, braking and powertrain interfaces, actuator delay models, and CAN or similar vehicle bus experience

 - Experience in the automotive industry, including ADAS or vehicle controls

 - Experience with safety-critical systems, validation, and relevant industry standards (e.g. ISO 26262)

 - Experience with monitoring and diagnostics: Logging, fault detection, and on-platform debugging tools, ideally with experience investigating field issues

 - Experience across multiple platforms or vehicles. The team supports vehicle-to-vehicle variation, such as accounting for parameter identification, calibration, and keeping one software stack across hardware variants

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban …

Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​

 Notre savoir-faire technologique
 Notre attention portée à l’équilibre des collaborateurs
 Un environnement inclusif et bienveillant
 Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu (Thales Solidarity, indice CAC 40 ESG…)
 Votre quotidien 
En nous rejoignant à Mérignac, à proximité de Bordeaux, vous intégrez un site dynamique regroupant nos activités de services numériques permettant d’opérer les systèmes d’informations critiques de nos clients et de les accompagner dans leur transformation numérique sécurisée. 
 Dans le cadre du développement de nos solutions analytiques, nous recherchons un stagiaire en Data Science pour rejoindre notre équipe et rechercher des méthodes différentes de clustering actuellement utilisées pour une recherche de pattern, ou des méthodes de prédictions différentes de celles du projet. Vous aurez l’opportunité de travailler sur des algorithmes de machine Learning, en comparant leur pertinence et performance par rapport aux approches existantes, notamment les solutions basées sur le clustering traditionnel.
 Vos missions
 Étudier et analyser les algorithmes de clustering actuellement en place sur nos données
 Mettre en œuvre différents modèles de machine learning (clustering, analyses topologiques, etc.) afin d’identifier des méthodologies plus pertinentes et performantes
 Évaluer et comparer la qualité des clusters obtenus selon différents critères (cohérence, densité, séparation, topologie, etc.)
 Proposer des recommandations pour optimiser les méthodes de segmentation et de partition des données
 Documenter les résultats et présenter les conclusions à l’équipe
 Votre profil
 Vous préparez une formation de n iveau Bac+5 en Data Science, Statistiques, Informatique , vous recherchez un stage de 6 mois et avez des connaissances en :
 Algorithmes de machine learning , notamment le clustering (k-means, DBSCAN, clustering hiérarchique, etc.)
 Concepts d’analyse topologique des données (TDA).
 Python (scikit-learn, pandas, numpy)
 Anglais

Tous nos stages sont conventionnés et soumis à une gratification dont le montant est déterminé selon votre niveau d’études.

 Au sein d’une équipe travaillant sur l’exploitation d’images satellitaires issues de capteurs innovants, vous contribuerez au développement de méthodes de recalage entre images visible et infra-rouge . 
 e stage vous permettra d’intervenir sur des problématiques avancées de traitement d’image, de vision par ordinateur et d’intelligence artificielle appliquées au domaine spatial.
 La qualité de la mise en correspondance entre les différentes bandes spectrales est un enjeu majeur pour de nombreuses applications, notamment la génération de modèles 3D, l’observation de la Terre et les traitements scientifiques réalisés à partir de données satellitaires.
 Vous serez amené à :
 Analyser les difficultés spécifiques liées au recalage d’images multi-bandes, notamment les différences géométriques, radiométriques, de contraste et de résolution.
 Étudier les méthodes existantes de mise en correspondance entre images visible et infra-rouge .
 Concevoir et développer en Python une chaîne de traitement permettant le recalage robuste d’images satellitaires.
 Mettre en œuvre et évaluer des approches basées sur l’ intelligence artificielle et le Deep Learning .
 Comparer les performances des approches IA avec des méthodes plus classiques de traitement d’image.
 Valider les résultats obtenus sur des données satellitaires issues de capteurs innovants et analyser les performances des différentes solutions.
 Documenter les travaux réalisés et présenter les résultats obtenus aux équipes techniques.
 Votre profil
 Votre priorité est de réaliser un stage de fin d’études à la frontière entre l’ imagerie satellitaire , le traitement d’image et l’ intelligence artificielle ?
 Vous avez l’ambition de développer vos compétences sur des problématiques scientifiques et techniques appliquées à l’exploitation de données spatiales ?
 Vous avez envie de travailler sur des données réelles issues de capteurs satellitaires innovants ?
 Vous préparez votre dernière année d’école d’ingénieur ou un Master 2 Bac+5 avec une spécialisation en traitement d’image , vision par ordinateur ou intelligence artificielle, et vous avez des connaissances sur :
 Le traitement d’image .
 Le développement en Python .
 Les méthodes de vision par ordinateur et d’analyse d’images.
 L’ intelligence artificielle et le Deep Learning .
 Un intérêt pour le domaine spatial, l’imagerie optique ou les données satellitaires serait particulièrement apprécié.
 Votre autonomie, votre curiosité, votre rigueur et votre capacité d’analyse sont des atouts que l’on vous reconnait ?
 Alors ce stage est fait pour vous !
 Le mot de l’équipe
 Vous aurez l’opportunité de travailler sur un sujet concret et exigeant, à la frontière entre l’imagerie satellitaire et l’intelligence artificielle.
 Rejoignez-nous pour relever ce défi technique et contribuer au développement des futures générations de traitements d’images spatiales.
Tous nos stages sont conventionnés et soumis à une gratification dont le montant est déterminé selon votre niveau d’études. 
Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

items.title: Talent Partner
items.card: ABOUT THE ROLE As a Talent Partner at Faculty, you will own the end-to-end recruitment process, attracting and engaging exceptional talent to power our high-growth business goals. Operating within our People team, you will serve as a strategic advisor to hiring managers across all levels while driving an inclusive, world-class candidate experience within the commercial space and across our Central Functions. This is
items.desc:
WHY FACULTY? 


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here https://faculty.ai/impact.



We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.



Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.



AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.




ABOUT THE ROLE 



As a Talent Partner at Faculty, you will own the end-to-end recruitment process, attracting and engaging exceptional talent to power our high-growth business goals. Operating within our People team, you will serve as a strategic advisor to hiring managers across all levels while driving an inclusive, world-class candidate experience within the commercial space and across our Central Functions. 



This is an opportunity to shape our hiring strategy, solve complex talent challenges, and directly contribute to building a world-leading AI organisation.




WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:

 - Owning the recruitment lifecycle from initial scoping through to interviewing, offer management, and candidate onboarding.

 - Sourcing passive talent creatively across platforms like LinkedIn, networking channels, and referrals to build diverse candidate pipelines.

 - Partnering closely with business leaders as a trusted advisor, offering data-backed insights and guiding recruitment strategy.

 - Designing structured interview packs and assessment criteria to ensure objective, high-quality hiring decisions.

 - Driving diversity and inclusion initiatives throughout every step of the hiring funnel.

 - Analysing recruitment data and pipeline metrics to identify bottlenecks and optimize process performance.

 - Amplifying Faculty’s employer brand by representing the company at industry events, conferences, and meetups.
   
   


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

 - You bring experience managing end-to-end talent acquisition processes, ideally within a fast-moving, in-house environment within the commercial and/or GTM space.

 - You possess strong direct-sourcing skills and know how to leverage modern applicant tracking systems to engage top-tier passive candidates.

 - You excel at stakeholder management, building authentic relationships across all levels while balancing support with constructive challenge.

 - You take an agile, problem-solving approach to recruitment, adapting quickly to change while upholding high standards of confidentiality and compliance.

 - You prioritise quality over volume, demonstrating resilience and a dedication to delivering an outstanding, inclusive candidate experience.

 - You are a confident, articulate communicator who thrives as a brand ambassador, passionately sharing our culture and ambition with prospective talent.




OUR INTERVIEW PROCESS

 1. Initial Talent Screen (30 mins)

 2. Introductory interview with the Hiring Manager (45 mins) 

 3. Competency & Scenario based interview (60 mins)






OUR RECRUITMENT ETHOS




We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.



If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours. 



A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

The mandate of the MME group, within the Engineering Department (EN), is to provide to the CERN community specific engineering solutions combining mechanical design, fabrication and material sciences. Historically the group maintains and develops the know-how on the mechanical construction of beam accelerator components and physics detectors.  Continuously improve designs based on feedback and testing results.

 Governance e applicazione operativa del processo di Configuration Management (configuration identification, change control e status accounting)

 Conoscenza del pacchetto Office (Word, Excel, Powerpoint, ecc.).

items.desc:
Tu Negocio con Zurich | Programa de Desarrollo de Nuevos Agentes
 ¿Buscas algo más que un empleo? ¿Y si tu próximo paso profesional fuera construir tu propio negocio con el respaldo de Zurich? 
 Si buscas algo más que un trabajo tradicional, quieres tener más autonomía y te atrae la idea de desarrollar tu propio proyecto profesional, estás en el lugar correcto.
 En Zurich lanzamos nuestro Programa de Desarrollo para Agentes Exclusivos en Andalucía 
 Se trata de una oportunidad para desarrollar tu propio negocio como autónomo siendo agente exclusivo para Zurich, creando así tu propia agencia, con el respaldo, la formación, las herramientas y el acompañamiento de una compañía sólida, reconocida y con una apuesta clara por el crecimiento de su red de agentes.
 Esta oportunidad no va solo de vender seguros.
 Va de crear tu propia actividad profesional, desarrollar una cartera de clientes y crecer acompañado desde el primer día.
 ¿Cómo será tu día a día? 
 Asesoramiento de alto valor: Asesorarás a personas, familias y empresas para ayudarles a proteger lo que más les importa, ofreciendo soluciones aseguradoras adaptadas a sus necesidades.
 Desarrollo de tu propio negocio 
Construirás tu propia cartera de clientes y desarrollarás una actividad profesional con recorrido, apoyándote en una marca reconocida y en un modelo pensado para crecer.
 Una propuesta de valor pensada para ayudarte a crecer 
Tendrás una propuesta de valor sólida y servicios de apoyo pensados para que puedas centrarte en lo importante: generar confianza, asesorar bien a tus clientes y hacer crecer tu negocio.
 Gestión comercial con herramientas digitales 
Contarás con herramientas, datos y recursos comerciales que te ayudarán a gestionar oportunidades, hacer seguimiento de clientes y dedicar más tiempo a generar negocio.
 Autonomía con acompañamiento 
Organizarás tu actividad con autonomía, pero no estarás solo. Tendrás el apoyo de profesionales expertos que te acompañarán en tu arranque, planificación comercial y evolución como agente.
 ¿Encajas en esta propuesta? 
 No buscamos la perfección, ¡buscamos actitud, iniciativa y ganas reales de construir algo propio!
 Este plan es ideal si tienes estudios mínimos (Bachillerato, FP o Grado), aptitudes comunicativas y en servicio al cliente y tienes vocación comercial.
 Valoramos la experiencia previa en el sector asegurador o en posiciones comerciales, pero no es imprescindible.
Lo importante es que tengas ambición, compromiso y ganas de aprender.
 ¿Qué te ofrecemos en Zurich? 
 Un programa para ayudarte a construir tu propio negocio
 No se trata solo de empezar como agente. Se trata de hacerlo acompañado, con un programa diseñado para ayudarte a arrancar, aprender, ganar confianza comercial y crecer paso a paso.
 Formación y certificación oficial
 Financiamos tu curso homologado de mediación (Nivel 2 DGSFP) y te acompañaremos para que puedas iniciar tu actividad profesional con una base sólida.
 Acompañamiento desde el primer día
 Contarás con apoyo experto para orientarte en tus primeros pasos, ayudarte a planificar tu actividad comercial y acompañarte en el desarrollo de tu negocio
 Tranquilidad Financiera Inicial y elevado potencial de crecimiento: modelo de comisiones e incentivos altamente competitivo, complementado con un esquema de apoyo económico durante el arranque
 Una carrera con futuro 
Queremos acompañarte para que puedas construir una cartera, consolidar tu actividad profesional y desarrollar una agencia con recorrido.
 ¿Por qué Zurich? 
 Porque no queremos que seas un agente más. 
 Queremos acompañarte en la construcción de tu propio negocio, con formación, herramientas, apoyo comercial y una marca que apuesta por el desarrollo de nuevos agentes como una palanca clave de crecimiento. 
 Estamos construyendo la nueva generación de agentes Zurich. 
 Y queremos contar con personas que quieran formar parte de este proyecto desde el inicio. 
 ¿Sientes que esto es para ti? 
 Si te ves construyendo tu propio negocio, no lo pienses más, haz clic en inscribirte. Estaré encantada de conocerte, tomar un café (virtual o real) y contarte cómo puedes empezar a construir tu carrera como agente profesional independiente con el respaldo de Zurich.
 Empieza a construir tu propio negocio con Zurich.
 Por qué elegir Zurich 
 En Zurich, nos gusta pensar con originalidad y desafiar el statu quo. Adoptamos un enfoque optimista centrándonos en los aspectos positivos y preguntándonos constantemente ¿Qué puede salir bien?
 Somos un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades y que sabe que cada colaborador es único ¡lo que hace que nuestro equipo sea el mejor! 
 Colabora con nosotros mientras exploramos constantemente nuevas formas de proteger a nuestros clientes y al planeta .

items.card: 137388 | 80 - 100% | Oerlikon, Zürich | Hybrid Motiviert dich der Gedanke, anspruchsvolle rechtliche Fragestellungen rund um die berufliche und private Vorsorge zu bearbeiten und dabei insbesondere unsere französischsprachigen Kundinnen und Kunden zu unterstützen? Möchtest du deine juristische Expertise in einem erfahrenen Spezialisten-Team einbringen und dich langfristig im Vorsorge- und Versicherungsrecht
items.desc:
137388 | 80 - 100% | Oerlikon, Zürich | Hybrid
 Motiviert dich der Gedanke, anspruchsvolle rechtliche Fragestellungen rund um die berufliche und private Vorsorge zu bearbeiten und dabei insbesondere unsere französischsprachigen Kundinnen und Kunden zu unterstützen? Möchtest du deine juristische Expertise in einem erfahrenen Spezialisten-Team einbringen und dich langfristig im Vorsorge- und Versicherungsrecht weiterentwickeln?
 In dieser Rolle verstärkst du bei Zurich Schweiz den Geschäftsbereich Claims im Bereich Leistungen Leben, Rechtsdienst Leben, und leistest einen wichtigen Beitrag zu unserem gemeinsamen Erfolg. Als Teil eines eingespielten Teams von Juristinnen und Juristen bearbeitest du selbstständig rechtliche Fragestellungen und Fälle aus der beruflichen Vorsorge, Säule 3a und Lebensversicherung, mit einem besonderen Fokus auf die französischsprachige Schweiz, und führst Gerichtsverfahren. Gleichzeitig unterstützt du unsere Claims Teams sowie weitere Fachbereiche mit deiner rechtlichen Expertise und bringst dich in Projekte und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Vorsorgethemen ein. Referatstätigkeiten bei Schulungen und Kundenanlässen runden die herausfordernde und vielseitige Tätigkeit ab. 
 Das erwartet dich 
 Du bearbeitest selbstständig anspruchsvolle Rechtsfälle in der beruflichen und privaten Vorsorge, insbesondere in französischer Sprache 
 Du führst Gerichtsverfahren und vertrittst die Interessen von Zurich in rechtlichen Auseinandersetzungen 
 Du berätst Claims Teams und weitere Fachbereiche bei rechtlichen Fragestellungen rund um Kollektivleben, Einzelleben und Vorsorge 
 Du arbeitest in fachübergreifenden Projekten mit und bringst die juristische Perspektive in die Entwicklung von Lösungen und Prozessen ein 
 Du arbeitest mit internen und externen Anspruchsgruppen wie Kundinnen und Kunden, Vertrieb, Rechtsvertretungen, Vertragspartnern und Behörden zusammen 
 Das zeichnet dich aus 
 Juristischer Hochschulabschluss (Master of Law oder lic. iur.) einer Schweizer Universität, vorzugsweise mit Anwaltspatent 
 Sehr gute Französischkenntnisse sowie gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift 
 Ausgeprägtes Interesse an der beruflichen und privaten Vorsorge sowie an versicherungs- und steuerrechtlichen Fragestellungen 
 Fähigkeit, komplexe rechtliche Sachverhalte selbstständig zu analysieren und verständliche, praxisorientierte Lösungen zu entwickeln 
 Überzeugende Kommunikations- und Verhandlungsfähigkeit sowie eine strukturierte und verantwortungsbewusste Arbeitsweise 
 Gut zu wissen 
 Teilzeit oder Vollzeit: 80 - 100% 
 Arbeitsort: Oerlikon, Zürich 
 Stellenantritt : ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung 
 Reisetätigkeit: Keine 
 Hybrides Arbeiten: bis zu 40% 
 Alles rund um deine Bewerbung 
 Du kannst dich in einem ersten Schritt direkt online bei uns bewerben – dafür benötigst du nur deinen Lebenslauf. Weitere Informationen zum Bewerbungsprozess findest du hier . 
 Wir legen Wert auf einen effizienten und wertschätzenden Bewerbungsprozess. Das Talent Acquisition Team prüft deine Bewerbung persönlich, ohne Einsatz künstlicher Intelligenz. Ab deinem ersten persönlichen Kennenlernen mit der zuständigen Führungskraft erhältst du von uns immer eine individuelle Rückmeldung. Denn wir sind überzeugt: Aussagekräftiges Feedback basiert auf dem persönlichen Austausch. 
 Für diese Position arbeiten wir nicht mit Personalvermittlungen zusammen. Unaufgefordert eingereichte Bewerbungen werden weder berücksichtigt noch vergütet. 
 Hast du noch Fragen? Bernd, Senior Talent Acquisition Consultant steht dir unter +41 44 628 42 14 gerne zur Verfügung.

items.desc:
About us: 
Zurich Insurance is a leading insurance company based in the Benelux, where we specialize in non-life insurance for businesses. Our ambition is to become one of the most responsible and impactful businesses in the world. To get there, we hire and develop some of the world’s best talent. With Zurich, you can expect meaningful and impactful work that will help you grow, and to collaborate with a diverse and inclusive global team. We are now looking for a trainee to join our Underwriting Services (UWS) department in Belgium, Zaventem.
 Traineeship overview 
 The UWS department is crucial to our company. After an insurance deal is closed, the department takes care of all the administration from A to Z. Within about 1 year, you will be fully immersed in the Underwriting Services department. You get to do 3 rotations in 3 different sub-teams (Domestic, International and European team), each with their own specialization. You’ll get the opportunity to discover your strengths, and we will provide an environment where you can develop your professional skills.
 Your responsibilities: 
 Collecting data and drawing up policies & endorsements
 Processing financial data and issuing invoices
 Working closely with different departments and providing the right service to customers and insurance brokers
 Coordinating international insurance programs for large Belgian multinationals
 Continuously looking at how processes can be improved, which you present to your team
 What you can expect from us: 
 Opportunities for professional growth and development. After the traineeship of 1 year, you’ll stay on board at Underwriting Services where you can further develop your career.
 Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package.

items.title: TCAD simulation & modeling engineer
items.card: you will be part of a global business with more than 115 nationalities, present in 40 countries, and comprising over 50,000 diverse and dedicated creators and makers of technology around the world. Developing technologies takes more than talent: it takes amazing people who understand collaboration and respect. People with passion and the desire to disrupt the status quo, drive innovation, and unlock their own
items.desc:
OUR STORY 
 At STMicroelectronics, we believe in the power of technology to drive innovation and make a positive impact on people, businesses, and society. As a global semiconductor company, our advanced technologies and chips form the hidden foundation of the world we live in today. 
 When you join ST, you will be part of a global business with more than 115 nationalities, present in 40 countries, and comprising over 50,000 diverse and dedicated creators and makers of technology around the world. 
 Developing technologies takes more than talent: it takes amazing people who understand collaboration and respect. People with passion and the desire to disrupt the status quo, drive innovation, and unlock their own potential. 
 Embark on a journey with us, where you can innovate for a future that we want to make smarter and greener, in a responsible and sustainable way. Our technology starts with you. 
 YOUR ROLE 
 The candidate will contribute to the modeling and TCAD simulation of elementary components in smart-power technologies, with a strong focus on reliability. He will develop and apply advanced computational models and tools to predict degradation mechanisms such as hot-carrier-induced degradation, dielectric breakdown, carrier transport in insulators, and electromigration in metals. This role will play a key part in the design and optimization of devices and technologies by helping to shorten development cycles, reduce fabrication costs, and improve performance. The candidate will also use machine learning methods and artificial intelligence to accelerate model calibration and performance optimization.
 YOUR SKILLS & EXPERIENCES 
 Master’s degree in Physics, Physical Engineering, Electronic Engineering, or Materials Science
 Strong knowledge of semiconductor physics and physics of semiconductor devices
 Experience in TCAD simulation, numerical modeling and data science
 Business proficiency in English
 Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work effectively in a team
 The expected salary range for this position is €38,000 – €45,000 gross annual salary (RAL). 
 In accordance with the EU Pay Transparency Directive and applicable Italian legislation, this compensation range has been determined based on objective, gender-neutral criteria, including job responsibilities, required skills, relevant experience, qualifications, and market benchmarks. Placement within the range will depend on the candidate’s profile and demonstrated competencies. We are committed to equal pay for equal work and equal opportunities for all candidates.​ 
 ST is proud to be one of the 17 companies certified as a 2025 Global Top Employer and the first and only semiconductor company to achieve this distinction. ST was recognized in this ranking thanks to its continuous improvement approach and stands out particularly in the areas of ethics & integrity, purpose & values, organization & change, business strategy, and performance.
 At ST, we endeavor to foster a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we do not tolerate discrimination. We aim to recruit and retain a diverse workforce that reflects the societies around us. We strive for equity in career development, career opportunities, and equal remuneration. We encourage candidates who may not meet every single requirement to apply, as we appreciate diverse perspectives and provide opportunities for growth and learning. Diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) is woven into our company culture. 
 To discover more, visit st.com/careers.

items.desc:
LA NOSTRA STORIA 
 Noi di ST crediamo nel potere della tecnologia di guidare l’innovazione e avere un impatto positivo sulle persone, sulle imprese e sulla società. Siamo un'azienda globale di semiconduttori e la nostra tecnologia avanzata e i nostri chip costituiscono la parte nascosta del mondo in cui viviamo oggi. 
 Entrando in ST farai parte di un'azienda di oltre 115 nazionalità e presente in 40 paesi, con oltre 50.000 creatori di tecnologia in tutto il mondo! 
 Lo sviluppo di tecnologie richiede più del solo talento: siamo infatti alla ricerca di persone straordinarie che comprendano la collaborazione e il rispetto. Persone con passione e il desiderio di rompere lo status quo, guidare l'innovazione e sbloccare il proprio potenziale. Intraprendi un viaggio con noi, dove puoi innovare per un futuro che vogliamo rendere più intelligente e più verde, in modo responsabile e sostenibile. La nostra tecnologia inizia con te.. 
 YOUR ROLE 
 The candidate will join a new design team working on discrete power transistors in GaN (Gallium Nitride) and Smart Power technology.They will be responsible for carrying out and managing the layout of power transistors, based on technical guidance from the designer.
 They will therefore be responsible for:
 Receiving technical guidance from the designer
 Developing the layout floor plan
 Interacting with the CAD team to gain full command of the layout drafting and verification tools
 Interacting with the technology team to obtain the information needed for the correct layout design and for interpreting the rules of the Design Rule Manual
 Interacting with the package team to ensure the layout is compatible with assembly rules
 Managing and carrying out the archiving procedures for the generated layout
 YOUR SKILLS & EXPERIENCES 
 Upper secondary school diploma or bachelor's degree in Electronics, Computer Science, or a related technical-scientific field
 In-depth knowledge of Excel, office suite software, etc.
 Good command of English, both written and spoken
 The expected salary range for this position is €29,000 – €36,000 gross annual salary (RAL). 
 In accordance with the EU Pay Transparency Directive and applicable Italian legislation, this compensation range has been determined based on objective, gender-neutral criteria, including job responsibilities, required skills, relevant experience, qualifications, and market benchmarks. Placement within the range will depend on the candidate’s profile and demonstrated competencies. We are committed to equal pay for equal work and equal opportunities for all candidates.​ 
 ST è orgogliosa di essere una delle 17 aziende certificate come Top Employer Globale 2025 e la prima e unica azienda di semiconduttori a raggiungere questa distinzione. ST è stata riconosciuta in questa classifica grazie al suo approccio di miglioramento continuo e si distingue particolarmente nelle aree di etica e integrità, scopo e valori, organizzazione e cambiamento, strategia aziendale e performance. 
 In ST, ci impegniamo a promuovere un ambiente di lavoro diversificato e inclusivo, e abbiamo tolleranza zero per la discriminazione. Miriamo a reclutare e mantenere una forza lavoro diversificata che rifletta le società intorno a noi.  At STMicroelectronics, we believe in the power of technology to drive innovation and make a positive impact on people, businesses, and society. As a global semiconductor company, our advanced technologies and chips form the hidden foundation of the world we live in today. 
 When you join ST, you will be part of a global business with more than 115 nationalities, present in 40 countries, and comprising over 50,000 diverse and dedicated creators and makers of technology around the world. 
 Developing technologies takes more than talent: it takes amazing people who understand collaboration and respect. People with passion and the desire to disrupt the status quo, drive innovation, and unlock their own potential. 
 Embark on a journey with us, where you can innovate for a future that we want to make smarter and greener, in a responsible and sustainable way. Our technology starts with you. 
 VOTRE ÉQUIPE 
 L'équipe Demand Management joue un rôle central dans l'alignement entre les besoins du marché et la planification de la production. En étroite collaboration avec les équipes Commerciales, Marketing, Supply Chain et Product Management, elle consolide les prévisions d'activité, accompagne les prises de décision et apporte de la visibilité sur les tendances du marché afin de soutenir la performance de l'entreprise.

 Vous travaillerez en collaboration avec les équipes régionales afin de :
 Suivre l'évolution de la demande et des tendances du marché ;
 Garantir la fiabilité et la qualité des données de prévision ;
 Préparer des analyses et des reportings destinés aux équipes Sales & Marketing ;
 Contribuer à l'identification et au suivi des principaux indicateurs business ;
 Participer aux processus de planification de la demande et aux échanges avec les différentes parties prenantes.
 Vous interviendrez sur un périmètre international, en lien avec plusieurs équipes commerciales et lignes de produits stratégiques, ce qui vous permettra de développer une compréhension globale des enjeux business, marché et supply chain de ST.

 Vous êtes récemment diplôme de niveau Bac+5 (école d'ingénieur, école de commerce, université ou équivalent)
 Une première expérience (stage, alternance, projet académique) en analyse de données, supply chain, planification ou dans un domaine similaire serait un plus.
 Vous avez une bonne appétence pour l'analyse de données et souhaitez développer vos compétences dans ce domaine.
 Vous maîtrisez Excel et appréciez travailler avec des données chiffrées.
 Vous êtes curieux(se), rigoureux(se) et avez envie d'évoluer dans un environnement international.
 Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et possédez de bonnes capacités de communication.

items.desc:
Short Description
 Are you a robotics engineer who enjoys explaining technology, engaging with industry and helping researchers develop meaningful collaborations? The EPFL Robotics Center seeks a professional with a solid robotics background, hands-on engineering experience and strong presentation skills to act as the technical bridge between its laboratories and industrial partners.
 Your technical expertise will underpin the role: understanding laboratory capabilities, assessing industrial challenges, preparing and presenting robotics demonstrations, and supporting the development of relevant research opportunities. You will combine practical engineering with the ability to communicate clearly and confidently with researchers, industrial partners and visitors.
 Mission 
 Your mission is to apply your robotics expertise to make the Center's laboratory capabilities visible, accessible and ready for collaboration — and to help translate industrial needs into relevant research opportunities. Working closely with laboratory teams, you will develop and maintain a thorough technical map of their expertise. You will prepare and run live demonstrations during visits, workshops and events, prepare audience-adapted technical materials with the lab teams, and help scope technical follow-up.
 Main duties and responsibilities 
 Develop, adapt, and improve prototypes and demonstrators to showcase robotics technologies and maintain technical documentation, software configurations, setup procedures, and operating instructions to ensure systems can be operated reliably.
 Integrate lab demonstrators into event and visit setups, including on-site installation, interfacing, calibration and troubleshooting.
 Build and maintain detailed hands-on knowledge of the participating laboratories’ robotic platforms, software stacks, prototypes and experimental setups.
 Keep an up-to-date technical map of lab capabilities, including technology readiness levels, available demonstrators, equipment and key contacts among PhD students and postdocs.
 Work with lab engineers and researchers to keep demonstrators operational, transportable and ready to show.
 Act as the technical contact for industry requests: clarify the need, check feasibility and identify the matching labs.
 Write short technical pre-assessments and involve professors only when there is a clear research fit.
 Set up and run live demonstrations during visits, workshops and events, and explain what the systems can and cannot do.
 Prepare technical materials with the lab teams, adapted to each audience.
 Help scope technical follow-up, such as feasibility studies, tests and proposal content, and coordinate practical next steps with labs, companies and EPFL services.
 Profile 
 Master’s or PhD degree in robotics or a closely related engineering field, with a demonstrated specialisation in robotics.
 Demonstrated hands-on engineering experience in robotics, including the integration, programming, testing, and troubleshooting of robotic systems.
 Strong practical skills in robotics software and hardware, with experience in areas such as ROS/ROS 2, C++ or Python, sensors, actuators, control systems, robotic perception.
 Ability to understand research contributions, discuss industrial requirements and assess the fit between technical challenges and laboratory expertise.
 Strong speaking and presentation skills, with the ability to demonstrate technologies and explain complex concepts accurately to different audiences.
 Good organisational skills and the ability to work autonomously within agreed priorities.
 Familiarity with Swiss and European research and innovation ecosystems is an asset.
 Excellent command of English, German and French.
 Please note that only applications meeting the criteria of the advertisement will be considered.
 We offer 
 At EPFL, we believe that people achieve great results when they feel supported, respected and enabled to succeed. By joining our community, you will help shape the future of society through education, research and innovation. 
 We offer an inspiring, international and collaborative environment where your work has real impact and your ideas are valued. Combined with flexible ways of working and attractive employment conditions, we aim to create an environment where everyone can contribute, grow and make a difference.
 Beyond work, our campuses host a vibrant community and unique environment, enriched by initiatives promoting equality, inclusion, diversity, well-being and sustainability as well as an engaging program of cultural, sports and community activities throughout the year.

 Phonak, a brand of Sonova, is seeking a Clinical Trainer to provide clinical education, product training, and ongoing support to hearing healthcare professionals within an assigned region. In this role, you will work closely with audiologists, hearing aid dispensers, physicians, universities, hospitals, and other hearing healthcare partners to support the successful use of Phonak hearing solutions. You will collaborate with regional sales teams, deliver engaging product presentations, and build strong customer relationships while helping hearing care professionals deliver exceptional patient care.

 Deliver clinical training, product demonstrations, and educational presentations to hearing healthcare professionals, supporting new product launches and ongoing product knowledge.

 Conduct individual and group training sessions, including in-person presentations, virtual training, and remote customer support. 
 Represent Phonak at regional, state, and national conferences, customer events, open houses, and educational meetings. 
 Meet established customer visit expectations, maintain accurate CRM documentation, and manage territory expenses in accordance with company guidelines. 
 Support the onboarding and mentoring of new Clinical Trainers while collaborating with internal teams to ensure customer satisfaction and continued clinical education. 
 More about you: 
 Doctor of Audiology (Au.D.) or Master's degree in Audiology required. 
 Minimum of 3 years of hearing aid sales or dispensing experience in a clinical, territory sales, or training environment. 
 Strong knowledge of hearing aid technology, clinical applications, and hearing healthcare industry practices. 
 Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to effectively educate and engage both small and large audiences. 
 Strong organizational, time management, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and manage competing priorities. 
 Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications; experience with CRM systems and fitting Phonak products is a plus.

items.desc:
Telefónica Defensa y Seguridad es la compañía del Grupo Telefónica especializada en el diseño, desarrollo, implantación y gestión de soluciones tecnológicas avanzadas en los ámbitos de la defensa y la seguridad. Contribuimos al propósito del Grupo de ser la mejor vía de acceso de ciudadanos, empresas e instituciones a las tecnologías digitales, acercando la innovación a la protección de personas, infraestructuras críticas y activos esenciales.
 Acompañamos a las Fuerzas Armadas, las Fuerzas y Cuerpos de Seguridad, las administraciones públicas y las organizaciones de sectores estratégicos con soluciones adaptadas a sus necesidades. Integramos tecnología, inteligencia y capacidad operativa para anticipar y responder a amenazas, reforzar la continuidad operativa y la resiliencia, y generar confianza en entornos de alta exigencia www.telefonica.es 
 Buscamos un/a Ingeniero/a Preventa para proporcionar soporte técnico y consultivo a las distintas áreas de negocio de la compañía, participando en el análisis de necesidades, el diseño de soluciones y la elaboración de propuestas de valor para nuestros clientes. La persona seleccionada será responsable de definir la solución técnico-funcional más adecuada en cada oportunidad, colaborando con equipos multidisciplinares para garantizar propuestas competitivas, innovadoras y alineadas con los requisitos de calidad, alcance y plazo establecidos.
 Funciones 
 Análisis de necesidades y requisitos: estudiar las necesidades de los clientes y analizar pliegos técnicos, especificaciones y documentación de licitaciones, identificando requisitos funcionales, técnicos y operativos.
 Diseño de soluciones tecnológicas: definir y dimensionar arquitecturas y soluciones de seguridad física y electrónica e integración de sistemas, seleccionando las tecnologías más adecuadas para cada proyecto.
 Elaboración de propuestas técnico-económicas: preparar memorias técnicas, presupuestos, estimaciones de costes, matrices de cumplimiento y el resto de documentación necesaria para la presentación de ofertas.
 Gestión integral de oportunidades: asumir la responsabilidad técnica de las propuestas, coordinando su desarrollo desde el análisis inicial hasta la presentación final y garantizando el cumplimiento de requisitos, calidad y plazos.
 Coordinación con fabricantes y partners: identificar y evaluar alternativas, solicitar y analizar propuestas técnicas y económicas y colaborar con proveedores y socios tecnológicos para construir soluciones competitivas.
 Colaboración con equipos multidisciplinares: trabajar conjuntamente con las áreas comerciales, ingeniería, operaciones y especialistas de otras disciplinas para garantizar la viabilidad técnica, económica y operativa de las soluciones.
 Análisis de viabilidad y riesgos: identificar riesgos técnicos, económicos y de ejecución, proponiendo alternativas y medidas de mitigación.
 Interlocución y defensa técnica: participar en reuniones con clientes, presentaciones técnicas y sesiones de aclaración, defendiendo las soluciones propuestas y dando respuesta a las necesidades planteadas.
 Versatilidad tecnológica y desarrollo de nuevas capacidades: participar en proyectos de diferentes ámbitos tecnológicos, adquiriendo los conocimientos necesarios para analizar requisitos, plantear soluciones y coordinar su desarrollo con los equipos especialistas correspondientes.
 Innovación y mejora continua: mantenerse actualizado sobre la evolución tecnológica e identificar nuevas soluciones y oportunidades que contribuyan a mejorar la competitividad de las propuestas.
 Formación y experiencia 
 Titulación universitaria en Ingeniería de Telecomunicaciones, Informática, Industrial o disciplinas técnicas afines.
 Experiencia profesional mínima de 5 años en preventa tecnológica, ingeniería de soluciones o elaboración de propuestas técnicas .
 Experiencia demostrable en el diseño y dimensionamiento de soluciones de seguridad física y electrónica , especialmente sistemas de videovigilancia, control de accesos, detección de intrusión y plataformas de gestión e integración de sistemas.
 Capacidad para definir arquitecturas y soluciones integradas, combinando diferentes tecnologías, fabricantes y plataformas.
 Experiencia en preparación de ofertas técnicas y económicas , incluyendo dimensionamiento, elaboración de presupuestos, estimaciones de costes y análisis de viabilidad.
 Experiencia en el análisis e interpretación de pliegos técnicos y participación en procesos de licitación.
 Capacidad para gestionar propuestas de forma autónoma, coordinando diferentes interlocutores y garantizando el cumplimiento de requisitos y plazos.
 Capacidad de interlocución técnica con clientes, fabricantes, partners y equipos internos.
 Buenas habilidades de comunicación y redacción técnica.
 Nivel de inglés B2 , con capacidad para interpretar documentación técnica y mantener reuniones con fabricantes, proveedores y socios internacionales.
 Conocimientos y Experiencia valoraremos

Conectamos el presente. Transformamos el futuro. 
 ¿Alguna vez te has preguntado qué hace posible que millones de personas estén conectadas al mismo tiempo, desde cualquier lugar del mundo, sin que nada falle?

 Somos una compañía global de telecomunicaciones y tecnología que conecta a personas, empresas y comunidades a través de redes de última generación y soluciones digitales avanzadas como cloud, inteligencia artificial, IoT o ciberseguridad. 
 Con una trayectoria de más de 100 años, trabajamos cada día para que la innovación esté al servicio de la sociedad, impulsando una transformación digital responsable, sostenible y con impacto real. 
 Aquí no solo diseñamos infraestructuras, diseñamos el futuro . Buscamos personas que tengan inquietudes, entusiasmo y pasión por lo que hacen, que no se conformen y que quieran crear la Telefónica del mañana. 
 Si te apasiona la tecnología que transforma vidas, este es tu lugar. 
 Ser parte de esta transformación también implica medir y comunicar con rigor nuestro impacto en la sociedad y el medioambiente y cómo las cuestiones ESG impactan en el desempeño financiero del Grupo. Esta función recae en el área de ESG Reporting de Telefónica, responsable de coordinar el proceso de reporte de sostenibilidad del Grupo. Nuestro equipo lidera el cumplimiento de las regulaciones de reporte de sostenibilidad, coordinando con múltiples áreas y países para asegurar una información rigurosa, transparente y de alta calidad para reguladores y otros grupos de interés. Trabajamos en un entorno internacional, dinámico e innovador, contribuyendo directamente a la estrategia de sostenibilidad de la compañía. 
 ¿Cuál será tu misión? 🎯 
 Desarrollar y complementar los conocimientos adquiridos durante la etapa formativa mediante la participación activa en los procesos de reporting de sostenibilidad del Grupo Telefónica. El becario colaborará en la elaboración del Informe de Sostenibilidad, contribuyendo al cumplimiento de la normativa europea CSRD y los estándares ESRS, así como de la Ley 11/2018 a nivel nacional, al tiempo que adquiere experiencia práctica en la gestión de información ESG, la coordinación transversal de equipos y el uso de herramientas avanzadas de reporte en un entorno corporativo internacional.

 Seguir creciendo y aprendiendo

 Comunicación efectiva

 Curiosidad

 Análisis de datos/reporting

 Sostenibilidad

 Análisis de requisitos ESG 
 Flexibilidad y adaptabilidad 
 Abrazar la diversidad 
 Nivel alto de inglés requerido (oral y escrito) 
 Recuerda que las skills indicadas, deben formar parte de la taxonomía global de Telefónica

 Apoyo en la elaboración del Informe de Sostenibilidad de Telefónica, gestión y revisión de información ESG, coordinación con áreas corporativas, seguimiento del calendario de reporting, análisis de datos en Excel y soporte en el cumplimiento de los requisitos regulatorios CSRD/ESRS y los procesos de verificación externa. Colaboración en la adaptación de controles internos de reporte que se adapten a los nuevos avances que están teniendo lugar en materia regulatoria. 
 ¿Qué otros aspectos valoramos? 📚 
 Formación académica o conocimientos en sostenibilidad corporativa, ESG, reporting no financiero y financiero, contabilidad, auditoría, finanzas o áreas afines. Asimismo, será valorable el conocimiento de marcos y normativas de sostenibilidad (CSRD, ESRS, GRI), así como la capacidad analítica, el interés por la gestión de datos y la elaboración de informes en entornos corporativos e internacionales.

 Jornada de 25 horas semanales. 
 Ayuda al estudio de 850€ mensuales. 
 Duración de la beca mínima de 6 meses y máxima de 12 meses. 
 Modelo híbrido. 
 Podrás formar parte de un equipo dinámico y ser parte de proyectos retadores. 
 … ¡Y plan formativo durante la beca!

 ¡Y mucho más! 
 #UnidadesGlobales # [Consolidación y Políticas Contables] 
 En Telefónica tenemos el compromiso de construir un entorno de trabajo diverso, inclusivo y sostenible, donde cada persona se sienta valorada, respetada y libre. Nuestra cultura se basa en la igualdad de oportunidades y en la inclusión, porque tenemos la responsabilidad de transformar la sociedad y hacer un mundo mejor. 
 Si quieres formar parte de un equipo innovador y contribuir a un futuro mejor, ¡te estamos esperando!

Our approach is grounded in Cloud Solution Provider acceleration, cc-sell precision, and performance accountability—executed consistently across all solution areas and every stage of the MCEM Win Formula. We are committed to delivering on our segment and revenue accountabilities by aligning execution with measurable impact, fostering partner transformation, and enabling scalable, outcome-driven growth.

 As a Cloud Solution Architect, you will guide the development of business solutions, provide deep technical insights, and accelerate the growth of Microsoft Tech priorities. You will work closely with partners to understand their technical requirements and business objectives, and guide them through architectural design sessions, developing proof of concepts, and help them transition from legacy systems to modern cloud environments, ensuring that their solutions are optimized for performance and cost-efficiency. Join our team as a Cloud Solution Architect and play a pivotal role in guiding our most significant partners to designing and implementing innovative scalable, secure, and efficient cloud architectures that meet market needs.  Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on Our values Of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture Of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
