items.desc: Do you want to take ownership of the devices and tools that colleagues rely on every day? Are you as comfortable diving into technical details as you are understanding the needs of the business? And would you like to help shape and improve the digital workplace across a global organisation? Then join BESTSELLER TECH as our new Tech Specialist in Digital Workplace. YOUR TEAM You will join Workplace, part of Digital Workplace in BESTSELLER TECH. We work across three service lines: Workplace, Network and Collaboration, developing and maintaining the technology that supports colleagues across our global organisation. You will become part of a team of six colleagues working with Scrum and collaborating closely with our Product Owner and stakeholders across the business. We value technical expertise, knowledge sharing and finding the right solutions together. YOUR ROLE As our new Tech Specialist, you will combine hands-on technical work with close collaboration across the business. Some weeks, you will dive deep into a technical problem. Other weeks, you will be in dialogue with the business about what would make their workday better. Most weeks, it will be both. More specifically, you will: Develop, manage and improve our client environment, ensuring solutions that work for our colleagues. Troubleshoot complex technical issues, identify root causes and find sustainable solutions. Build strong relationships with stakeholders across the business, understanding their needs and translating them into better workplace services. Contribute to the wider workplace environment, including printing and meeting room technologies. Work closely with your team and Product Owner to align technical improvements with business needs and priorities. Share your expertise and document solutions, ensuring that knowledge is accessible across the team. Depending on your experience and interests, there may also be an opportunity to take on a broader coordinating role within the team. This could include helping prioritise the backlog, translating roadmap priorities into concrete tasks and supporting the flow of work across the team. YOUR BENEFITS At BESTSELLER TECH, you will have the opportunity to work with technology that makes a difference to colleagues across a global business. You will join a collaborative team where you can develop your expertise, take ownership and contribute to how our digital workplace evolves. Here's what you can look forward to: A varied role where you can combine technical depth with close collaboration across the business. The opportunity to influence and improve workplace solutions used across our organisation. A supportive team where knowledge sharing, professional sparring and learning from one another are part of everyday work. Your workplace can be either our headquarters in Brande or our office in Aarhus. We value spending time together in person, while offering flexibility to work from home when it fits the tasks and the team's needs. YOUR PROFILE You are a specialist who likes getting to the root of things and can explain complex topics simply to people who aren't technical. You are curious about new technology and careful with the solutions that already exist. You build trust easily, stay calm when priorities compete and prefer pragmatic solutions where the colleague's perspective comes first. We imagine that you bring: Hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune and Windows client management. Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to identify and resolve complex technical issues. Experience with 2nd and 3rd level support. Experience collaborating with business stakeholders and understanding their needs. Good written and spoken English. Experience with Mac/Apple environments, MDM, SCCM, Citrix, printing, meeting room technologies or security is an advantage, but we don't expect you to know everything. What matters is your technical foundation, curiosity and willingness to learn. WE LOOK FORWARD TO HEARING FROM YOU If you have questions about the position, feel free to contact Karl Busk Jacobsen +45 28 35 78 09 Otherwise, please send your application and CV no later than 1 December 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis and reserve the right to take down the ad when we find the right candidate. LOCATION: Brande or Aarhus, Denmark ABOUT BESTSELLER TECH We are more than 400 people strong, located in Denmark, Spain and Rwanda. We are excited about what we do, but there’s more to us than our tech stack. We are young at heart and thrive in a flat organization. Our teams are agile and empowered with end-to-end responsibility. We want to be at the forefront of the newest technologies, and we move forward together. Every day. If you want to play a significant part in empowering our business, then welcome to BESTSELLER TECH. BESTSELLER TECH is part of the worldwide fashion company BESTSELLER. For more information, please go to www.bestseller.com.

items.desc: Your mission: You join our Advanced Manufacturing team and spend more than half of your time on customer demos. The rest of the time, you work with our process engineers on the next generation of printing processes. Print customer samples on our Nazca printers: lines, dots, and patterns in silver, gold, or polymer inks, on glass, silicon, films, or the customer’s own parts. Write the demo report that goes back to the customer. It is often the first proof they see of what Hummink can do for them. Prepare pipettes and inks for each job, keep the printers calibrated and ready, and help keep the lab safe and tidy (5S). Run experiments with the process engineers: new inks, new substrates, expand our capabilities Make demos faster and more reliable Why you will like it: A rare skill. Very few people in the world know how to print at this scale. You will. A new challenge almost every week. Displays, semiconductors, sensors, research labs: every customer brings a different problem. Visible impact. Your results go straight to customers and to our sales team. Room to grow. A small team of chemists, engineers, and application engineers to learn from, in a company that is scaling up. Profile and skills: Bac+2/3 in physics, materials science, chemistry or measurement (BTS, BUT Mesures Physiques, licence pro or equivalent). 2 to 5 years of hands-on lab, cleanroom, or production experience. An apprenticeship counts. At ease with microscopes and lab instruments. SEM, profilometry, or electrical testing is a plus, and experience in the semiconductor or electronics industry would be appreciated. Careful and precise: you like getting the same result twice, and you write down how you did it. Good written English, since our customer reports are in English. French is a plus. Curious and practical, happy in a young startup where priorities can move. Our team and company are young. We value proactivity, creativity, and all the soft skills you can come up with to build the success of Hummink with us. Send your CV and a few lines about a lab result you are proud of to achille.guitton@hummink.com. Rémunération : 28 000,00€ à 34 000,00€ par an Lieu du poste : En présentiel

items.desc: Qui sommes-nous ? Nous sommes l'autorité organisatrice des mobilités en Île-de-France. Notre objectif : construire les solutions de mobilité du quotidien pour mieux vivre l’Île-de-France Comment : en mettant notre expertise et notre savoir-faire au service de l'organisation, du pilotage et du développement de la mobilité sur le territoire francilien. Intégrer Ile-de-France Mobilités c’est rejoindre un établissement dynamique et porteur de sens avec plus de 9,4 millions de déplacements au quotidien, un collectif fédéré autour du service public …. Ça vous parle ? Nous recherchons notre futur « Chef de pôle SI Métiers » au sein du Département Ingénierie Digitale de la Direction du Numérique. La Direction du Numérique porte la stratégie numérique d’Île-de-France Mobilités. Son objectif est d’améliorer les services aux usagers, d’appuyer l’ouverture à la concurrence et de faire du numérique un levier de transformation. Elle a pour missions : La définition d’une stratégie globale de transformation numérique alignée avec les missions et les enjeux métiers d’IdFM ; Le conseil et l’appui des directions concernant les enjeux numériques ; La conception, le développement, la performance et le maintien en conditions opérationnelles et de sécurité des applications et produits numériques ; La gouvernance, la collecte, la valorisation et le partage des données utilisées par les métiers et les écosystèmes ; Le développement de la connaissance des systèmes d’information des opérateurs et l’accompagnement des métiers dans les chantiers impactant ces systèmes d’information ; Le pilotage de l’administration, de l’exploitation et de la supervision des infrastructures et des systèmes d’informations ; Le pilotage du risque cyber et de la sécurité des systèmes d’information ; L’assistance et l'appui aux utilisateurs (à distance et à proximité) ; L’urbanisation du système d’information dans une approche de recherche d’efficacité opérationnelle ; Ainsi que le pilotage des ressources affectées aux applications et aux systèmes d’information et du portefeuille des projets. La Direction du Numérique est structurée en quatre Départements (Ingénierie Digitale, Infrastructures SI et production, Data & IA, Systèmes d’Information opérateurs) et deux Pôles (Pilotage Ressources et Portefeuille Projets, Sécurité des Systèmes d’Information et Conformité). Le département Ingénierie Digitale (ID) conçoit, développe et déploie les nouveaux SI et services numériques, garantit la cohérence d’ensemble et veille à la sécurité des SI. Le pôle « SI Métiers » du Département gère l’ensemble des systèmes d’information internes d’Ile-de-France Mobilités (SI RH, SI Finance, Data, SIG, SI Pilotage Opérateurs, solutions SI internes…) ainsi que les sites institutionnels et de concertations. items.desc: Vous aimez challenger le status-quo, le travail avec des équipes transverses, dans un contexte d'innovation technologique ? items.desc: We’re looking for an Information Security Specialist to help shape the future of business messaging at LINK Mobility - Europe’s leading mobile messaging and CPaaS provider. At LINK, we power communication that keeps everyday life moving. From flight check-ins and delivery alerts to SMS authentication, WhatsApp support messages, and mobile coupons - chances are you’ve already interacted with our technology without even knowing it. We help businesses engage and delight customers through scalable, end-to-end communication solutions. This is an exciting moment to join LINK. The mobile communications industry is evolving fast, and we’re expanding our award-winning CPaaS offerings to match the pace of innovation. ABOUT THE ROLE As Information Security Specialist you will have an important role in the continuous development of our security and compliance framework across an international technology environment. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Maintaining and improving the Information Security Management System (ISMS) in line with ISO/IEC 27001. Performing and supporting information security risk assessments and tracking remediation activities. Supporting internal and external security audits, certification activities and compliance assessments. Supporting vulnerability management, including follow-up of findings, remediation status and risk acceptance. Monitoring implementation and effectiveness of security controls across systems, products and business units. Supporting third-party and supplier security assessments, including security questionnaires and contractual security requirements. Reviewing and responding to customer security questionnaires, RFPs and due diligence requests. Supporting security reviews of new systems, services, suppliers and technical solutions. Maintaining security policies, standards, procedures, control documentation and evidence. Supporting security incident management, investigations and lessons-learned activities. Supporting security awareness initiatives and communication with employees. Collecting and analysing security metrics and contributing to management reporting. Working with technical teams on topics such as identity and access management, endpoint security, vulnerability remediation, logging and monitoring, cloud security and data protection. Supporting continuous improvement of the organization's overall security maturity. REQUIRED EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS 2+ years of professional experience in information security, cybersecurity, IT risk, IT audit or a related field. Practical understanding of information security risk management and security controls. Familiarity with ISO/IEC 27001 and ISO/IEC 27002 Understanding of common security areas such as: o Identity and access management o MFA and privileged access o Endpoint security and EDR o Vulnerability and patch management o Network security o Logging and monitoring o Backup and recovery o Cloud security Ability to review technical and organizational information and identify security risks and control gaps. Strong analytical and documentation skills. Ability to communicate security topics clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Good written and spoken English. Ability to work independently while collaborating across international teams. OPTIONAL SUPERPOWERS Experience or knowledge in one or more of the following areas would be an advantage: ISO 27001 implementation or certification audits. NIS2, DORA, GDPR or similar regulatory frameworks. Security frameworks such as NIST Cybersecurity Framework, CIS Controls or SOC 2. Microsoft security technologies, including Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, Defender and Purview. Cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS or Google Cloud. Vulnerability management platforms and security monitoring/SIEM solutions. Third-party security risk management. Incident response or security investigations. Data classification, DLP and information protection. Pas des démos de laboratoire : interroger ses chiffres en langage naturel, automatiser les tâches qui font perdre des heures, connecter ses outils, créer des écrans sur-mesure. Le tout branché sur les logiciels de gestion Sage que les PME utilisent déjà. Nos produits SaaS sont pensés nativement pour l'IA, et ils tournent déjà chez les clients. Le poste Tu es le développeur référent d'une ligne produit Sage Experience, et tu la développes. En binôme avec le Product Builder de ta ligne, tu relies un logiciel de gestion Sage à son expérience web et IA, de l'API aux écrans, et tu réponds de ce qui part en production. Le Product Builder dit le besoin, l'ordre et le pourquoi ; toi, tu dis le comment, et quand ce n'est pas raisonnable. Concrètement, tu construis les services MCP de ta ligne : ce qui permet à nos produits de lire et d'agir dans le logiciel de gestion. Ils alimentent trois briques : Les écrans : créer des écrans web sur-mesure à partir des données du logiciel. Ask : un assistant IA qui répond en langage naturel sur les chiffres de l'entreprise, et agit pour l'utilisateur. Les workflows : des automatisations qui enchaînent les tâches qui font perdre des heures. Selon la ligne, le moment n'est pas le même : faire grandir une offre déjà en production chez les clients, lancer une offre neuve jusqu'à ses premiers clients, ou ouvrir une nouvelle ligne de zéro. Dans tous les cas, tu construis. Ce que tu vas faire Développer et tenir la connexion à l'API du logiciel de ta ligne : authentification, accès et droits par profil, gestion des erreurs, évolutions de l'API Concevoir et livrer les routes et les données de ta ligne, documentées, à partir du backlog tenu avec le Product Builder Construire les outils que l'assistant IA (serveur MCP) et les workflows utilisent pour lire et agir dans le logiciel Intégrer les écrans avec le Product Builder, relire et fusionner son code, mettre en production, et revenir en arrière si besoin Mettre en place et tenir les tests de bout en bout de ta ligne, joués dans la CI à chaque modification et vérifiés contre l'API réelle du logiciel, pour qu'aucune livraison ne casse ce qui marche déjà Poser le diagnostic technique du support de niveau 3, travailler avec les équipes API de Sage et conseiller les partenaires intégrateurs L'équipe Tu rejoins une équipe de 10 à 15 personnes. Product Builders et développeurs travaillent ensemble au quotidien, sur une même stack : TypeScript, Node ou Bun côté serveur, React côté client. À terme, chaque logiciel a toujours un second développeur capable d'y intervenir : tu pourras aussi travailler sur une deuxième ligne. Toi Tu es un développeur full-stack solide en TypeScript, côté serveur comme côté client. Tu as déjà livré en production des intégrations d'API tierces, et tu les as tenues dans la durée : OAuth, OIDC, pagination, gestion des erreurs, REST, GraphQL, OpenAPI, tests automatisés. Tu développes avec l'IA tous les jours, et tu vérifies ce qu'elle produit au lieu de la croire. Tu as déjà travaillé sur un ERP ou un logiciel de gestion : c'est indispensable. Tu en connais les données, les contraintes et les utilisateurs. Tu maîtrises les principes comptables et financiers : écritures, balances, échéances, TVA, rapprochements, facturation. C'est indispensable aussi : tu recoupes les montants par réflexe. Tu sais trouver les défauts d'une merge request et argumenter ta décision. Ce qui compte, ce n'est pas le nombre d'années, c'est ce que tu as réellement construit. Ce poste n'est pas pour toi si tu n'as jamais travaillé sur un ERP, si la comptabilité ne te parle pas, si tu n'as jamais livré d'intégration d'API en production, ou si le support technique de tes clients ne fait pas partie, pour toi, du travail. Lieu du poste : Télétravail hybride (92800 Puteaux)

Il transforme progressivement les activités de test en une chaîne de vérification automatisée couvrant l’ensemble du cycle de développement, depuis la compilation du logiciel jusqu’à l’exécution automatique des campagnes de tests. Plus qu’un expert du test, il agit comme un véritable leader technique de l’automatisation. Il définit les architectures de test, met en place les outils permettant l’exécution automatique des vérifications à chaque build, pilote l’amélioration de la couverture de tests et fournit aux équipes de développement des indicateurs fiables sur la qualité des produits. Il intègre une équipe de 3 à 4 ingénieurs validation et contribue activement à l’amélioration des pratiques de développement, de qualité logicielle et de livraison continue. Dans un contexte d’adoption croissante de l’intelligence artificielle, il exploite les assistants et agents IA afin d’accélérer la génération, la maintenance et l’analyse des tests automatisés, tout en conservant la responsabilité des choix techniques, de la validation et de la qualité des résultats obtenus. Nous recherchons un leader technique capable d’industrialiser la validation logicielle, de réduire drastiquement les efforts manuels et de construire une plateforme de tests automatisés capable d’accompagner durablement le développement de nos futurs produits. Concevoir les architectures de test et développer des frameworks d’automatisation robustes, maintenables et réutilisables. Industrialiser la chaîne de vérification logicielle, depuis la compilation jusqu’à l’exécution des campagnes de tests. Exploiter les assistants et agents d’intelligence artificielle pour accélérer la génération, la maintenance et l’analyse des tests, tout en validant rigoureusement les résultats obtenus. Je suis reconnaissante d’évoluer dans un cadre où l’on se sent valorisée et soutenue, et j’ai à cœur de contribuer au succès de notre équipe. » — Oriane, Collaboratrice Comptable. « RSM me permet de vivre mes ambitions puisque je vois tous les jours des dossiers divers et variés. » — Nicolas, Juriste. Chez RSM, chaque jour est une opportunité de grandir. Nous avons à cœur de faire évoluer nos équipes tout en accompagnant nos clients avec excellence. Ainsi, 95% des collaborateurs nous recommandent. Votre rôle : Intégrateur(trice) Pennylane & Data Analyst H/F au sein de notre pôle Expertise. Dans le cadre du développement de son activité de conseil en digitalisation, RSM renforce son équipe avec un poste à la croisée de la comptabilité et de la data. Un logiciel, c’est de la donnée : où elle se trouve, comment on la range, ce qui est important ou non. Vous aidez nos clients à choisir, déployer et tirer parti de leurs outils, puis à faire parler leurs données . En ce sens, votre contribution portera sur deux missions complémentaires : Intégration de logiciels (environ 50 % de votre temps) : Vous collectez le besoin du client, migrez ses données, paramétrez Pennylane, puis assurez le suivi et l’accompagnement à l’utilisation, y compris par des formations sur site auprès de nos clients. Vous intervenez à la fois pour les clients du cabinet et pour des entreprises qui nous sont adressées par Pennylane, notre partenaire. Vous savez expliquer au client ce qui est possible ou non dans l’outil, et lui répondre avec pédagogie. Vous échangez avec le réseau d’intégrateurs RSM et avec le support technique de Pennylane. À terme, le périmètre s’élargira à d’autres outils (CRM, suivi de trésorerie, facturation) : si vous n’y êtes pas formé(e), nous vous formerons. Data analyst (analyse de données) : Vous identifiez où se trouve la donnée, la structurez et la croisez entre plusieurs outils pour la faire parler sous forme de tableaux de bord. Nous utilisons Power BI, sans exclusivité : aucune connaissance préalable de cet outil n’est exigée. Vous répondez aux demandes de nos équipes et de nos clients, en les questionnant : « Qu’est-ce que la marge pour vous ? Où la trouve-t-on ? » Vous personnalisez au maximum, même quand la définition du client diffère de la vôtre. Une approche IA sans code : Nous ne cherchons pas un(e) développeur(se). Vous utilisez les outils d’IA et d’automatisation sans code pour gagner du temps et simplifier la vie de vos interlocuteurs. À terme , selon votre évolution, vous pourrez contribuer au développement commercial de l’activité (prospection, développement du portefeuille), sans que ce soit une urgence. Formation initiale : Issu(e) d’une formation orientée vers la data, l’informatique, la gestion ou la comptabilité, vous disposez de solides connaissances en matière de structuration et d’organisation des données. Une appétence particulière pour les outils numériques et les nouvelles technologies est essentielle. Expérience : Vous bénéficiez idéalement d’une première expérience d’1 à 2 ans dans les domaines de l’intégration logicielle (cabinet, éditeur, ESN), de la data / BI ou de la comptabilité. Une connaissance de Pennylane, Power BI ou d’autres outils de BI constitue un atout, sans être indispensable. Une formation à Pennylane et à nos méthodes de travail vous sera dispensée. Qualités personnelles : Curieux(se), adaptable et doté(e) d’un bon relationnel, vous appréciez les échanges humains et le travail en équipe. Vous savez écouter et questionner les clients afin de comprendre leurs besoins, vulgariser les aspects techniques et proposer des solutions concrètes et adaptées. Votre esprit d’analyse et votre capacité à structurer l’information seront de véritables atouts. Mobilité : Le poste implique des déplacements fréquents chez les clients de la région, notamment pour assurer les formations sur site. Le permis B est donc indispensable. Ce que nous vous offrons : Un accompagnement sur-mesure : Formation aux outils et méthodologie RSM, accompagnement pour se former et évoluer, diversités des dossiers. Un environnement de travail dynamique : Un séminaire annuel, participation à des évènements initiés par la direction, les collaborateurs ou le CSE, des conférences, une charte de télétravail. Une rémunération fixe (sur 12 mois) et une part variable selon votre performance individuelle. Des avantages : 12 jours de congés supplémentaires, carte Ticket Restaurant®, mutuelle et prévoyance, flexibilité des horaires. RSM est engagé, au travers de sa politique …

items.title: Junior Cloud Engineer (m/f/d) - STACKIT Cloud-Accelerator Program (Start 01.04.2027)
items.card: you will work at the intersection of agility and security: You will benefit from fast decision-making processes, enjoy genuine creative freedom in your projects, and be able to build upon the stable foundation of the Schwarz Group. At Schwarz Digits Cloud, we shape the future of Europe: With STACKIT, our cloud and colocation offering, we build the secure infrastructure for an independent, digitally leading Europe.
items.desc: Location Am Campus 1 74177 Bad Friedrichshall Employment Area IT - Cloud Services Level Entry-level professional Working Model Full-time Reference ID 5143 Schwarz Digits creates the technological foundation for digital sovereignty in Europe. As the IT and digital division of the Schwarz Group, we develop and manage the IT infrastructures for the retail divisions Lidl and Kaufland, as well as Schwarz Production and PreZero. At the same time, we operate as an independent provider in the external market to support companies across Europe in their digital transformation. We bundle our core services in the areas of Cloud, Cyber Security, Data & AI, Communication, and Workspace. Join us and contribute to digital sovereignty in Europe. With us, you will work at the intersection of agility and security: You will benefit from fast decision-making processes, enjoy genuine creative freedom in your projects, and be able to build upon the stable foundation of the Schwarz Group. At Schwarz Digits Cloud, we shape the future of Europe: With STACKIT, our cloud and colocation offering, we build the secure infrastructure for an independent, digitally leading Europe. With server locations in Germany and Austria, we offer companies of the Schwarz Group and external customers a European alternative to international cloud providers. The STACKIT Cloud Accelerator Program is more than a traditional trainee program: In nine months, our company's engineers teach you the cloud – embedded in our culture, our teams, and our real daily work routine. You will become part of the Product Engineering STACKIT business unit, where our cloud products are developed, tested, and improved. After the program, you will start full speed as a Junior Cloud Engineer there. What Expects You Your Nine-Month Plan – from day one to real everyday cloud life: Arriving (2–3 days): Onboarding at Schwarz Digits – arrive in peace, set up everything, and play a programming game with prizes at the kick-off. Get Ready (6 weeks): In numerous technical training courses, you will get everything you need for everyday cloud life – Git, HTTP Basics, Linux Basics, Docker, Golang, Kubernetes, HTTP From Scratch in Go, Microservices in Go – and much more. Taught by the best engineers of the company. Innovation Lab (8 weeks): You implement Long Standing Ideas of the domains in practice – using the agile methods, teamwork, and pair programming you learned in Get Ready. Grow Together (2 days, offsite): You present the lab results, experience team building and a hackathon, and learn your future team assignment. Develop & Grow (6 months): Everyday life in the expert team. You implement real projects and are systematically developed through monthly check-ins and soft-skill training courses. Finals: The joint, successful completion of your program – with a certificate. Time for further education and training so you can grow both professionally and personally. A network of cloud experts who accompany and support you on your way. From day 1 an indefinite employment contract – you are a permanent part of Schwarz Digits right from the start. That's You Must-Haves: You have completed a degree in Computer Science or Software Engineering (Bachelor / Master) or are a graduate of the 42 Coding School. You have already demonstrably implemented initial projects in software engineering – whether privately or professionally. You have a solid theoretical understanding of software architecture, microservices, and scaling from your studies. You have initial experience in developing REST APIs and know the underlying principles – such as HTTP methods and resource-based design. You have basic knowledge in Git, web development, and databases. You communicate confidently in English and can exchange ideas in technical discussions. You can participate on site (Bad Friedrichshall) for the first 12 weeks in the training courses / workshops. Nice to have: You have initial experience in Go and TypeScript. You have initial experience in Docker, Kubernetes & Observability. You have initial experience in Infrastructure as Code, deployment, and operation of applications. You are at home in the terminal. You communicate confidently in German. Further Information Your Documents: CV / Resume Project list University academic transcript GitHub Our Application Process in Three Selection Steps: 1. Online Assessment 2. Telephone Interview 3. Selection Day The Schwarz Digits - STACKIT Recruiting Team assigns you one of the predefined dates. Subject to positive feedback after selection steps 1 and 2. Dates following invitation to the Coding Challenge on site in Bad Friedrichshall at the Schwarz Digits Campus. Expected dates: 02/12/2026; 09/12/2026; 16/12/2026; 13/01/2027; 20/01/2027; 27/01/2027; 03/02/2027; 10/02/2027; 17/02/2027; 24/02/2027; 03/03/2027; 10/03/2027; 17/03/2027. Your contact Heiko Kiefer Recruiter E-Mail:recruiting@mail.schwarz

Location: Frankfurt This role will primarily support Nike’s retail marketplace across Frankfurt and the surrounding region . WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR We are looking for a Visual Merchandising & Styling Specialist (m/f/d) to elevate Nike’s retail experiences across Austria, Germany and Switzerland. The role translates Nike’s seasonal strategies and VMS directives into locally relevant store experiences across Inline, Value and Partner doors within the assigned portfolio. Elevate the consumer journey: Review zoning, assortment and styling to build cohesive stories, identifying gaps and opportunities across physical and digital touchpoints. Develop store capabilities: Coach store and partner VMS teams through practical training, clear guidance and hands-on support. Support business performance: Use consumer insights, retail KPIs and store feedback to inform priorities and measure impact. WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH You will report to the VMS Manager, AGS and collaborate with AGS Retail Marketing, Nike Direct, marketplace partners and store teams. WHAT YOU BRING Relevant visual merchandising experience, with a strong foundation in retail, styling and retail marketing. Understanding of consumers across the AGS marketplace and the relationship between product, presentation and commercial performance. Ability to translate brand direction into clear store actions and coach teams effectively. Awareness of how physical and digital experiences connect across the consumer journey. Strong planning, communication and collaboration skills, with ownership of delivery and follow-through. items.desc: ZEISS Semiconductor Manufacturing Technology Enabler for smaller, more powerful, and more energy-efficient microchips Working for tomorrow today. Around 80 percent of all microchips worldwide are produced using ZEISS technologies. As the centerpiece of every electronically controlled system, they have become an integral part of our everyday lives – whether in smartphones, smart homes or smart factories. ZEISS is a technology leader in the field of semiconductor manufacturing equipment. With high-precision lithography optics, photomask systems and process control solutions, ZEISS enables the production of ever smaller, increasingly powerful, and more energy-efficient microchips, and thus plays a pivotal role in the age of micro- and nanoelectronics. The Maintenance Management area (SMT-OM) is responsible for maintenance processes of SMT secondary equipment and consolidates all manufacturing-related topics. The setup and integration of equipment into the SMT core competencies—such as optical metrology systems and interferometry—create an optimal interface to R&D. In addition, these assets must be kept in good working order through preventive maintenance and repairs. Your Role Perform mechanical maintenance, inspection, and repair work on complex production, metrology, and assembly systems; analyze mechanical disturbances, systematically isolate root causes, and implement countermeasures. Support the setup, integration, and commissioning of new machines and equipment. accompany the ramp-up of Anlagen (systems) and identify technical weaknesses and improvement potential early. Carry out repairs, modifications, adjustments, and replacement of mechanical components; participate in preventive maintenance, retrofit, and optimization measures. Document completed work, fault patterns, and technical solutions in the designated systems in a traceable manner; create and update work instructions, checklists, and maintenance documentation as needed. Coordinate actions with system operators, internal departments, and external service partners. Adhere consistently to applicable safety, quality, and cleanliness standards. Your Profile Successfully completed vocational training leading to the status of state-certified master craftsman or technician (m/f/x) in Mechanical Engineering / Mechatronics / Electrical Engineering or an equivalent qualification and field. Professional experience in mechanical maintenance, mechanical engineering, special purpose machinery, or technical service is advantageous. Good knowledge in at least several of the following areas: mechanics and precision mechanics, pneumatics and possibly hydraulics, assembly and adjustment of mechanical subsystems, technical drawings and bill of materials, systematic fault analysis. Ideally, experience with complex or automated production equipment. Independent, structured, and solution-oriented working style, with a strong emphasis on quality and safety. Strong teamwork and communication skills, and willingness to pursue ongoing professional development. Willingness to work in required shift models or on-call duties if applicable to the role. Our Added Value We provide stability and security! The long-standing success, strong market position of ZEISS, and the continuously growing demand for IT components offer security for every ZEISS employee and a reliable long-term perspective you can count on. Your work-life balance matters to us! Benefit from flexible working time models (including flexible shift systems), the option to work remotely, and a range of childcare support services. Your skills are highly valued! At ZEISS, we offer a wide range of opportunities for professional development, including qualification programs, our internal online learning platform CurioZ, external training opportunities, and attractive career paths. With individually defined annual development goals, we support our employees in achieving their career ambitions. Your work is valuable! As part of our team, you will benefit from a variety of attractive employee benefits, such as corporate benefits programs, subsidies for the Germany ticket and company bicycles, as well as an award-winning pension scheme. In addition, you will of course receive collectively agreed special payments, including holiday pay, Christmas bonuses, transformation payments, and additional collective bonuses (T-Zug), as well as an annual performance-based bonus tied to the fiscal year. We invest in your health & well-being! Our health management program includes online fitness classes, webinars, partnerships with gyms, ZEISS sports groups and running clubs, occupational health physicians, and a unique health partnership with Barmer, offering health courses and a personal contact. In our company restaurants, you will enjoy healthy and diverse meals, including daily vegetarian and vegan options as well as regional organic products. People are at the center of everything we do! items.desc: Cloudevo is a technology company working at the intersection of data, artificial intelligence and digital growth. Since 2018, we’ve helped leading organizations in Greece and internationally build data foundations they can trust, and use them to power smarter marketing, better products and AI-driven decisions. Our work spans data engineering, analytics, machine learning, conversational AI, cloud architecture and performance marketing. We take on complex, high-stakes problems for companies and public-sector organizations where data quality really matters. We are a team that values growth, empathy and ownership. We learn fast, challenge assumptions and build things that last. The role Measurement is changing fast. Browsers restrict cookies, privacy regulation tightens, and platforms rely more and more on modeled data. The companies that win are the ones that own their first-party data and know exactly how it flows. As a Measurement Engineer , you’ll design and build the measurement infrastructure behind that shift. You’ll own the full data lifecycle, from event design and collection to warehousing, modeling and activation, across a range of technologies and client environments. You’ll work alongside our data, AI and growth teams, and act as a trusted technical advisor to client stakeholders. What you’ll do Architect end-to-end measurement strategies for web, apps and e-commerce, from tracking plans to reporting. Design and implement server-side and first-party data collection architectures that are resilient to browser restrictions and ad blockers. Lead migrations between tag management and analytics platforms with zero data loss. Build conversion API integrations with major ad platforms, including event deduplication and match-quality optimization. Design event schemas and data contracts that keep data consistent across teams and tools. Build pipelines into cloud data warehouses and model raw event data into analysis-ready datasets. Implement privacy-by-design measurement: consent management, data minimization and regulatory compliance (GDPR, ePrivacy). Audit complex setups, find the root cause of data discrepancies and fix them for good. Explore how modeled conversions, AI and advanced attribution can close the gaps that deterministic tracking can’t. Turn technical work into clear insight and guidance for decision-makers. Requirements [3+] years of experience in digital analytics engineering, tracking or measurement. Deep hands-on experience with at least one major tag management system (e.g. Google Tag Manager, Tealium, Adobe Launch). Proven experience building server-side tracking in production environments. Strong experience with at least one major analytics platform (e.g. GA4, Adobe Analytics, Amplitude, Mixpanel, Piwik PRO). Advanced SQL and experience with a cloud data warehouse (e.g. BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, Databricks). Solid JavaScript ; Python is a plus. Experience with at least one cloud platform (GCP, AWS or Azure). A solid grasp of browser privacy changes, consent frameworks and their impact on data. A rigorous, analytical mindset and the habit of questioning every number. Clear communication with both engineers and business stakeholders. Fluency in English; Greek is a plus. Nice to have Experience with CDPs and event pipelines (e.g. Segment, RudderStack, Snowplow). Experience with data modeling and transformation tools (e.g. dbt, Dataform). Knowledge of attribution modeling, incrementality testing or marketing mix modeling (MMM) . Experience with BI tools (e.g. Looker, Power BI, Tableau, Looker Studio). Experience with reverse ETL and activating warehouse data into marketing platforms. Interest in applying AI and machine learning to measurement problems. items.desc: About Fairlo The story of Fairlo began when our founders, Jimmy and Shamon, saw first-hand how unfair and predatory lending practices can trap people in cycles of debt. Their mother had been misled by a large bank, and instead of being offered a lifeline, she was pushed further into financial difficulties. That injustice sparked something: to build a company that reimagines credit – rooted in transparency, flexibility, and respect. That company became Fairlo. Where we are now Since launching in 2018, Fairlo has helped tens of thousands of customers access responsible credit when life happens. With approximately 50,000 active customers, a 4.7 Trustpilot rating from 4,700+ reviews, and an incredibly low churn rate, we're proving that transparency and flexibility aren't just the right things to offer – they're a winning model. We're a tight-knit team of around 50 people across Stockholm, Crete, and the UK. Backed by some of Sweden's most experienced investors and driven by a culture that values kindness, courage, collaboration, and common sense, we're incredibly proud of what we've built so far. Where we're going We're now entering the most exciting chapter in our journey so far: Fairlo is becoming a bank. With this, technology is becoming even more central to our mission – scaling our platform, launching new products, and ensuring reliability and security at every step. At the same time, Fairlo's AI transformation is already under way. We have a plan in place and people across the company are actively working on it, with the goal of becoming a truly AI-native organisation. We believe AI is fundamentally changing how great technology is built, and we want to be at the forefront of that change. For us, being AI-native isn't just about using the latest tools. It's about rethinking how we work, solve problems, collaborate, and create value. We want AI to become a natural part of our everyday work, helping us move faster, think bigger, experiment more, and spend more time on what really matters. That's why we're looking for curious, ambitious Fullstack Engineers who want to join that work, and who are excited not only about building great technology, but also about exploring new ways of building it. You'll join our Fairlo Tech Hub in Heraklion, working alongside talented engineers in a cross-functional team closely integrated with our product organisation in Sweden. You'll have the opportunity to make a real impact on our technology, our ways of working, and the future of Fairlo. We're investing deeply in people, technology, and community, with the ambition of building one of Europe's most exciting and respected tech hubs. What you'll do As a Fullstack Engineer at Fairlo, you'll be part of a team where collaboration, curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning shape how we work. We're looking for engineers who love solving meaningful problems, take pride in building intuitive user experiences and scalable systems, and are excited to challenge traditional ways of working. You'll have the freedom to influence technical decisions, explore new approaches, and help shape how we build software in an increasingly AI-native world. In this role, you'll: Build across the full stack. Design, develop, and maintain everything from intuitive, responsive user interfaces to reliable backend services, APIs, and integrations. Own the full development cycle. Take responsibility from requirements and architecture through coding, testing, deployment, and monitoring. Create great customer experiences. Work closely with Product and Design to turn complex financial services into simple, seamless, and trustworthy digital experiences. Build for quality and scale. Develop secure, maintainable, and high-performing solutions that can grow with Fairlo as we become a bank. Embrace AI in engineering. Join the AI work already happening in our teams and help take it further. Explore how AI can improve the way we design, develop, test, debug, and maintain software. Experiment with new tools and approaches, and help turn what we learn into better ways of working. Collaborate across disciplines. Work closely with engineers, product managers, designers, and other colleagues in our cross-functional crews to turn ideas into real customer value. Be product- and feature-focused. Have a strong understanding of the value you’re creating for users. Challenge and improve. Bring new perspectives, question existing solutions, share knowledge, and contribute to a culture where we're constantly learning and evolving. Who you are We believe great engineers are defined by more than the technologies they know. We're looking for people who combine strong technical foundations with curiosity, ownership, and a genuine desire to keep growing. We think you'll thrive at Fairlo if you: Are curious and enthusiastic about AI, already experimenting with AI-powered development tools and interested in how they can fundamentally improve engineering practices. Have hands-on …

items.desc: FP&A Specialist/Group FP&A Lead: Build Our Forecasting Function from Scratch Remote (Ireland or UK) | Reporting to the Group CFO | Yomali Why This Role Exists Yomali has never had a formal forecasting capability, and that's about to change. We're a privately-held group of e-commerce businesses (HelpGrid, BuyGoods, MaxWeb and more). Today our leaders don't have a consistent way to forecast revenue and costs, understand variance, or be held accountable to their numbers. We're building that capability from the ground up. The forecasting model will be built in Excel and loaded into Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central for reporting against actuals. We need someone who has built models like this before to lead the build. This isn't a role where you inherit a working model and keep the lights on. You're building the model. What You'll Own Design, build and maintain our driver-based Excel forecasting and budgeting model, starting with HelpGrid, BuyGoods and MaxWeb Load the outputs into Business Central and report forecast versus actual Own the accountability loop, making sure business leaders understand, use and stand behind their forecasts Build visibility of the cost base down to supplier level, working with our Financial Controllers Run what-if and scenario analysis for leadership Evolve the model as we grow, so it scales and can move into a dedicated planning platform when the time is right You'll work directly with our Group CFO, Financial Controllers and business unit leaders, with real autonomy and real visibility into how the business runs. What Success Looks Like First 3–6 months: The foundations of the Excel forecasting model are in place. The revenue and cost drivers for HelpGrid, BuyGoods and MaxWeb are built and tested, and the outputs are loading into Business Central. 12 months: A full 12-month budget is built and loaded. There's a regular rhythm of forecast-versus-actual conversations between Finance and business leaders, who use Finance's numbers in their own performance reviews. Supplier-level spend reporting is live. What We're Looking For Substantial hands-on FP&A experience , including having personally built a driver-based forecasting or budgeting model in Excel from scratch, not just maintained or administered one that already existed Advanced Excel financial modelling: scenario analysis, clear model structure and integrity checks. You should also be comfortable reviewing and improving a model someone else built Comfortable owning forecast-vs-actual conversations directly with business stakeholders, including pushing back when the numbers don't add up Able to explain the numbers clearly to non-finance leaders Genuinely energised by complex "what-if" modelling, not just running the base forecast but exploring what a new market or acquisition could look like Able to work autonomously, without a team beneath you or an established playbook to follow Experience loading budget or forecast data into an ERP and reporting against actuals is helpful. Business Central or NAV is a plus, but any ERP (Oracle, SAP, Sage, Workday, NetSuite or similar) is fine Experience with a dedicated planning platform (Anaplan, Vena, Planful, Adaptive, Datarails, Pigment or similar) is a bonus, not a requirement Professional finance qualification (CIMA/CGMA, ACCA, ACA or equivalent) preferred, not required Who Thrives Here You'll do well here if you're the kind of person who gets excited by ambiguity rather than overwhelmed by it. There's no existing FP&A team to lean on. You'll be it, with our CFO backing you up. You'll need to be strategic about sequencing (one business at a time, not all three at once) and comfortable holding your ground with senior stakeholders who are new to forecasting. This role won't suit someone who needs an established process, a team of analysts to delegate to, or quick, fully-validated wins in the first few months. It will suit someone who wants to point at a forecasting capability in a year's time and say "I built that." Why People Stay / Love Working Here Our finance team spans Malta, Switzerland, the Philippines and the UK & Ireland, around 11 people in Finance and roughly 600 across the wider Group. The culture is genuinely open: people want to evolve how things are done, there's no bureaucracy slowing you down, and our CFO leads by trusting people to own their remit rather than micromanaging it. What's In It For You Genuine ownership: you're not maintaining someone else's model, you're building the Group's forecasting capability from day one Direct access and visibility: you'll work closely with the Group CFO and business unit leaders, not buried in a large finance function Fully remote, 9am–5pm UK/Ireland time Competitive salary: Ireland: €68,000–€92,000 base | UK: £62,000–£82,000 base A rare chance to shape how an entire Group forecasts and makes decisions. Supportare, quando necessario, l’organizzazione di iniziative aziendali specifiche, come attività benefiche o eventi interni. Restituire: Aiutarci a continuare a generare cambiamenti positivi a livello locale e globale attraverso il volontariato, il sostegno alla comunità e pratiche aziendali sostenibili.

items.desc: TXT Group is an international, IT end-to-end provider of consultancy, software solutions and services, supporting the digital transformation of customers’ products and core processes. With a proprietary software portfolio and deep expertise in vertical domains, TXT Group operates across different markets, with a growing footprint in Aerospace, Aviation, Defense, Industrial, Government and Fintech. The holding company, TXT e-Solutions, has been listed on the Italian Stock Exchange - STAR segment (TXT.MI) - since July 2000. TXT Group is headquartered in Milan and has subsidiaries in Italy, Germany, the United Kingdom, France, Switzerland and the United States of America. Embedded Software Engineer: TXT e-Tech, part of the TXT Group, is seeking an Embedded Software Engineer to work at one of our clients’ sites within the Aerospace & Aviation division. As part of the European MALE RPAS programme, the successful candidate will join the development team for the Airborne Armament Computer (AAC), a component of the AAS system, and will be involved in all phases of the software development cycle: from the elicitation of system requirements through to the writing, integration and configuration management of the application code, working within a real-time embedded environment certified to the DO-178C aeronautical standard. Key responsibilities: Involvement in the elicitation of AAS system requirements to feed into the software development process. Involvement in the development of software requirements (High-Level Requirements) based on the system requirements. Involvement in the development of the Detailed Design, including the production of low-level requirements (where necessary) for the AAS system. Writing and maintaining requirements in the DOORS database. Involvement in the development, integration and configuration management of the AAS system’s application code. Technical requirements: Knowledge of the C programming language; Experience in programming real-time embedded applications in the avionics sector. Optional technical requirements: Knowledge of the RTCA DO-178C standard; Experience in preparing software requirements (HLR) for real-time embedded applications in the avionics sector; knowledge of the IBM Rational Rhapsody tool (SysML/UML); Knowledge of the IBM Rational DOORS tool; Knowledge of the Serena Dimensions tool; Knowledge of the Integrity 178B ARINC 653 real-time embedded operating system; Knowledge of the MathWorks Polyspace tool (Bug Finder and Code Prover). Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, Mechatronics or Electronics. The ideal candidate will also demonstrate attention to detail, an aptitude for teamwork and a keen interest in learning and developing within complex, multidisciplinary technological environments. Why choose TXT GROUP: Career opportunities in a fast-growing and profoundly changing company with international staff; Training on business-related topics; Corporate Benefits (health insurance, welfare, Ticket Restaurant, discounts as a group employee). The contract offered for this position is a permanent one, and the salary range for this position is between EUR 28.000 € and EUR 30.000 € gross per year. The grading/level will be defined during the selection process based on the candidate's profile and in accordance with the National Collective Labor Agreement (Metalworking Industry). This position is open to all applicants regardless of gender in accordance with Legislative Decree 198/2006. The company promotes equal opportunities and values diversity in all its forms.

Sarai il punto di riferimento per la qualità del prodotto durante il turno, sia all’interno sia all’esterno della Clean Room. Raccoglierai e condividerai le informazioni relative allo stato delle linee, collaborando con le altre funzioni coinvolte nella gestione della produzione. Registrerai i risultati dei controlli e le informazioni richieste attraverso software e modulistica dedicata. Riconoscerai e segnalerai eventuali non conformità e situazioni fuori specifica, collaborando alla valutazione dei difetti e alla verifica dell’efficacia delle azioni correttive. Fornirai supporto nelle attività di selezione e rilavorazione collegate alle non conformità. Contribuirai alla formazione e all’affiancamento del personale sulle attività e sulle procedure di qualità. Ti impegnerai a mantenere elevati standard di ordine, pulizia e sicurezza nelle aree di lavoro. Lavorerai su turni a ciclo continuo, secondo calendario 3-2. Qualifications Chi cerchiamo Hai conseguito almeno un diploma di scuola secondaria. Hai maturato esperienza in contesti produttivi strutturati, preferibilmente in attività di controllo qualità o controllo di processo. Possiedi una buona dimestichezza nell’utilizzo del computer e degli strumenti digitali. Sei una persona responsabile, precisa e attenta ai dettagli. Sai comunicare in modo chiaro e collaborare efficacemente con persone e funzioni differenti. Affronti le anomalie con spirito pratico e orientamento alla risoluzione dei problemi. Sei disponibile al lavoro su turni a ciclo continuo. Un’esperienza nei settori farmaceutico, biomedicale, cosmetico o alimentare rappresenta un plus. Cosa troverai Un ambiente strutturato e in continua evoluzione Formazione e affiancamento per sviluppare le tue competenze Un team collaborativo e orientato al miglioramento continuo L'opportunità di contribuire a prodotti destinati al mondo farmaceutico e della salute Cosa offriamo In Stevanato Group, crediamo che risultati sostenibili nel tempo nascano dalla giusta combinazione di strumenti, supporto, benessere e sviluppo continuo. Come parte della nostra offerta in Italia, potrai beneficiare di: Buoni pasto da 8€ , a supporto della tua esperienza quotidiana in azienda. Accesso alla nostra piattaforma welfare, con 800 € all’anno da utilizzare per benefit flessibili a supporto del benessere, delle esigenze familiari e dello stile di vita, oltre a sconti esclusivi per i dipendenti. Per questo ruolo, la retribuzione prevista parte da €23.000 con maggiorazioni medie di €5.000. La retribuzione effettiva dipenderà da diversi fattori legati al ruolo, tra cui la sede geografica, l’esperienza professionale, il percorso di studi e il livello di competenze. Il nostro impegno Se questa opportunità ti sembra interessante, ti invitiamo ad approfondirla e a candidarti, anche se la tua esperienza non corrisponde perfettamente a tutti i requisiti. In Stevanato Group , ci impegniamo a costruire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo e diversificato, e crediamo che potenziale, approccio e motivazione siano importanti tanto quanto l’esperienza. About Us At the heart of the Stevanato Group’s vision is the desire to develop innovative solutions to solve complex problems for our customers across the pharmaceutical industry providing them products, processes and services that guarantee the integrity of parenteral drugs in a way that is far superior to anything that has been achieved before. With a worldwide presence, Stevanato Group employs more than 3,200 people who share this commitment towards customer satisfaction and patient well-being. Joining Stevanato Group you become part of a group of highly dedicated people who pursues its business goals driven by an e thical and transparent mindset, fostering innovation.

items.desc: Job Description: Closer to Space, closer to the Future: join Telespazio – Leonardo Space Division! Leonardo is a leading global industrial group in Aerospace, Defence and Security, delivering advance multi-domain technologies across Helicopters, Aircraft, Aerostructures, Electronics, Cybersecurity, and Space. As part of the Leonardo Space Division, Telespazio a joint venture between Leonardo (67%) and Thales (33%) , is a global reference in the field of satellite solutions and services. With a workforce of over 3.500 professionals across its offices in Europe and around the world, Telespazio operates an international network of Space Centres and Teleports, offering cutting-edge solutions in Geoinformation Services, Satellite Systems and Operations, and Satellite Communications. Join us as we continue to push the boundaries of what’s possible in Space. The candidate will be employed in the Telespazio product line department located in the Fucino Space Centre (Italy) and will take part in EASE-Mission software development. EASE-Mission product concerns different module related to space mission ground segment such as Satellite Control Centre, Flight dynamics module, Antenna scheduler module and Network operation centre module. The entire software is based on cloud native technologies and the microservices architecture plays an important role in the landscape. Responsibilities/ Duties /Tasks requirements analysis; software development; SW configuration control; unit testing; integration testing; system testing and validation; SW corrective maintenance; drafting documentation or contributing to project documentation (manuals, architectural drawing, user stories and test documents); participation in technical and progress meetings. Qualification: University degree in computer science or other relevant discipline Mandatory Skills & Experience: Knowledge of the Angular programming language Professional experience of at least 2 years in structured contexts, on back-end WEB projects where the following technologies have been used: Java 11+, Spring, Spring boot. Experience in building back-end architectures; Front-end graphical interface design; Experience in designing RestFul services; Knowledge of version control tools such as SVN and GIT; Knowledge of tools such as Maven, Jenkins, Kafka; Knowledge of relational and non-relational databases; Use of debug browser console; Knowledge of microservice architectures; Knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes. Knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, Javascript, JSON and Python;Knowledge of UX/UI fundamentals; Good knowledge of the English language complete the profile. Working place: Fucino Space Centre, occasionally remotely. Strengths in analysis, synthesis and presentation, coupled with very good interpersonal skills and a proven ability to apply these to the interactions within a team and between teams. Availability to work abroad for a limited period Additional Skills & Experience: Knowledge of system engineering standards and methodologies in aspects relevant to space operational systems Linux operating system What We Offer: Our applicable collective labor agreement is the CCNL for the Private Metalworking Industry and Plant Installation Sector . items.desc: Jurist contractenrecht & Intellectueel Eigendomsrecht (IE) Met juridisch advies en sterke contracten maak jij baanbrekend onderzoek en innovatie mogelijk. Als jurist contractenrecht met expertise in intellectueel eigendomsrecht draag je bij aan juridisch sterke samenwerkingen en de bescherming van kennis en innovatie. Functieomschrijving Bij TU Delft werken wetenschappers, studenten, bedrijven en maatschappelijke organisaties samen aan oplossingen voor de grote uitdagingen van onze tijd. Van de energietransitie tot gezondheid en digitalisering: ons onderzoek heeft impact op de samenleving. Om deze ambities waar te maken, werken we samen met uiteenlopende nationale en internationale partners. Als jurist contractenrecht en intellectueel eigendomsrecht zorg jij dat deze samenwerkingen juridisch goed zijn geregeld. De belangen van TU Delft en haar samenwerkingspartners lopen niet altijd gelijk. Bovendien hebben internationale partners, verschillende financieringsvoorwaarden en de aard van het onderzoek invloed op de afspraken die nodig zijn. Hoe bescherm je de belangen van TU Delft en zorg je tegelijkertijd voor werkbare afspraken die ruimte bieden aan samenwerking en innovatie? En hoe ga je om met intellectueel eigendom dat tijdens gezamenlijk onderzoek ontstaat of wordt ingebracht? Je overziet de juridische en organisatorische belangen en kijkt daarbij verder dan de formulering van een contract. Je hebt oog voor de bredere context en het doel van de samenwerking, brengt de verwachtingen van partijen samen en vertaalt deze naar juridisch houdbare afspraken die ruimte bieden aan onderzoek en innovatie. Jouw taken en verantwoordelijkheden: Je adviseert faculteiten, ondersteunende diensten en het College van Bestuur over uiteenlopende privaatrechtelijke vraagstukken. Je adviseert over samenwerkingsconstructies en de juridische voorwaarden waaronder onderzoek kan plaatsvinden. Daarbij heb je oog voor juridische risico’s en vertaal je deze naar praktische oplossingen en heldere afspraken. Je voert contractonderhandelingen met nationale en internationale samenwerkingspartners, stelt overeenkomsten op voor gesubsidieerd en commercieel gefinancierd onderzoek en beoordeelt bestaande contracten. Je adviseert over intellectueel eigendom in onderzoeks- en samenwerkingsovereenkomsten en bent binnen het cluster Civiel het aanspreekpunt voor complexere IE-vraagstukken. Je deelt je kennis met collega's en draagt bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van het contractbeleid en de modelovereenkomsten van TU Delft. Je werkomgeving Je wordt onderdeel van het cluster Civiel binnen Legal Affairs, samen met drie andere juristen. Binnen het cluster verdelen jullie de specialisaties en interessegebieden op basis van kennis en ervaring. Zo vullen jullie elkaar aan en kunnen jullie ook bij complexe juridische vraagstukken op elkaars expertise terugvallen. Je behandelt zelfstandig je eigen dossiers, maar zoekt actief de samenwerking op wanneer dat nodig is. Legal Affairs bestaat uit achttien juristen en adviseert de hele universiteit. Je werkt daardoor samen met uiteenlopende collega's en stakeholders, zoals onderzoekers, beleidsmedewerkers, bestuurders en andere juridische specialisten. Ook heb je regelmatig contact met externe advocaten en internationale samenwerkingspartners. Een omgeving waarin je veel verschillende belangen bij elkaar brengt, inhoudelijk wordt uitgedaagd en volop ruimte krijgt om je juridische expertise verder te ontwikkelen. Functie-eisen Je bent een ervaren jurist die complexe juridische vraagstukken snel doorgrondt, vanuit verschillende invalshoeken analyseert en vertaalt naar heldere, praktische adviezen. Je werkt zelfstandig, stelt de juiste prioriteiten en weet verwachtingen goed te managen. Je combineert juridische scherpte met een oplossingsgerichte aanpak en zoekt actief de samenwerking op wanneer een dossier daarom vraagt. Daarnaast beschik je over: Een wo-diploma Nederlands recht. Minimaal zeven jaar ervaring met het (internationaal) contractenrecht. Gedegen kennis van het intellectueel eigendomsrecht en ervaring met allerlei IE-gerelateerde transacties. Je bent bereid je in het staatssteunrecht te verdiepen. Goede communicatieve vaardigheden, advieskracht en gevoel voor bestuurlijke verhoudingen. Uitstekende mondelinge en schriftelijke vaardigheden in zowel het Engels als het Nederlands. TU Delft Werken bij TU Delft betekent bijdragen aan oplossingen die er echt toe doen. Al meer dan 180 jaar leiden we ingenieurs op die wereldwijd impact maken bij bedrijven, overheden of als ondernemer. Onze alumni zetten kennis om in concrete oplossingen voor de uitdagingen van vandaag en morgen. Die uitdagingen veranderen snel. Daarom werken we elke dag aan thema’s zoals energie, klimaat, digitalisering, AI en slimme mobiliteit. Ons onderwijs en onderzoek sluiten direct aan op wat de samenleving nodig heeft, nu en straks. Bij TU Delft maken mensen het verschil. Met hun kennis en nieuwsgierigheid zorgen zij voor sterk …

items.desc: Jouw baan Wij zoeken een veelzijdige Back-up & restore Engineer voor het beheren van onze datacenters en het ontwikkelen en onderhouden van een stabiele en veilige back-up & restore infrastructuur waarmee we al onze bedrijfsdata kunnen veiligstellen en herstellen. Samen met je collega’s maak je een goed plan voor de selectie van nieuw te gebruiken hardware die voldoet aan onze requirements waardoor afgeschreven hardware tijdig vervangen kan worden. Je bent als back-up & restore specialist primair verantwoordelijk voor het veiligstellen, herstellen en optimaliseren van alle bedrijfsdata binnen onze entreprise omgeving. Je beheert een volledig redundant back-up platform gebaseerd op VEEAM, verspreid over twee eigen datacenters. Jij zorgt ervoor dat onze data altijd beschikbaar, beschermd en compliant is - ook in de meest kritische situaties. Je hebt een sterk gevoel voor security, omdat onze data maximaal beschermd moet worden en zelfs in de meest extreme situaties (hacking attacks, natuurrampen, datacenter down) veilig en herstelbaar moet zijn. Jouw taken en verantwoordelijkheden als Back-up & restore Engineer zijn: het beheren en onderhouden van onze backup & restore omgeving; het zorgen voor een correcte backup van onze data binnen de WUR; het bewaken van de performance en de capaciteit van de backup omgeving; het bedenken en onderhouden van onze disaster recovery scenario’s; het opstellen van een roadmap voor tijdige vervanging en uitbreiding om de toenemende vraag voor te blijven. Je bent in staat om ver vooruit te kijken om ontwikkelingen in de technologie goed mee te kunnen nemen in ons datacenter ontwerp; regulier beheer zoals incident afhandeling, troubleshooting, monitoring en onderhoud; lifecycle management en het patchen, upgraden en migreren van hard- en software, zowel op Linux als Windows; het automatiseren van taken en werkzaamheden; het verlenen van consultancy en advies; documenteren van technische architectuur, beheerprocedures en runbooks. Jouw team Wij zijn het Multidisciplinair Team Datacenter management & Storage Services, onderdeel van DIAS (Digitalisation, Information & Archiving Services). We zijn met 10 medewerkers verantwoordelijk voor het inrichten en beheren van onze datacenters, het installeren en beheren van rackmount servers, storage omgevingen en het beheren van de back-up infrastructuur. Je werkt nauw samen met gebruikers, Security en IT-teams om de continuïteit van onze bedrijfsprocessen te garanderen. Met jouw ervaring weet je risico’s vroegtijdig te signaleren en verbeteringen door te voeren in processen, tooling en architectuur. Je maakt IT-infrastructuur ontwerpen waarmee het team Infrastructure-as-a-Service kan bieden aan haar gebruikers. Je denkt mee over manieren om de dienstverlening en het beheer waar mogelijk te automatiseren en je analyseert aanwezige kwetsbaarheden om ze waar nodig zo snel mogelijk op te kunnen lossen. Je bekijkt samen met onze leveranciers welke hardware we gebruiken en welke firmware versies nodig zijn om onderlinge compatibiliteit, stabiliteit en veiligheid te borgen. Ook ben je bedreven in het aanmaken van cases bij onze leveranciers, kun je snel de benodigde informatie vinden en opleveren en weet je druk te zetten waar nodig. Je geeft richting aan onze leveranciers met je visie op het gebruik van onze infra. Het werk is zeer divers: zowel beheer als ontwikkeling en zowel tactisch als operationeel. Hier ga je werken Je komt te werken in een professionele IT-organisatie met meer dan 200 IT specialisten waar je veel kunt leren en jezelf goed kunt ontwikkelen. We hebben twee eigen datacenters op onze mooie, groene en ruime campus en we zetten ons in voor digitale soevereiniteit, het gebruik van open source oplossingen en een duurzaam gebruik van onze omgeving. Je werkt met state-of-the-art technologie en krijgt veel ruimte om te innoveren. De werkzaamheden vinden hoofdzakelijk plaats tijdens kantooruren, maar je zult waar nodig ook gevraagd worden mee te werken aan onderhoud buiten kantoortijden (’s avonds of in het weekend). Daarnaast loop je samen met je collega’s volgens een afgesproken rooster 7x24 stand-by voor security incidenten (maximaal een week per maand). In overleg kan er een deel van de tijd vanuit huis worden gewerkt. Jouw kwaliteiten Jij bent een zelfstandige en leergierige IT-professional. Je werkt graag samen met andere professionals en verschillende stakeholders in een agile omgeving. Je bent een verbinder en durft je uit te spreken en door te vragen. Je bent een echte doorpakker, communicatief sterk en draagt onderwijs- en onderzoek een warm hart toe. Daarnaast ben je analytisch ingesteld maar ook oplossings- en klantgericht. Je bent initiatiefrijk en beschikt over de drive en het organisatietalent om dingen als kartrekker voor elkaar te krijgen. Je bent creatief en zoekt steeds naar nieuwe oplossingen om bestaande omgevingen effectiever en nieuwe functionaliteiten mogelijk te maken. Verder heb je een goed oog voor de …

items.card: About the role As Junior Vegetable Oils Trader, you will be part of AAK’s European Sourcing & Trading team, supporting the sourcing and trading of vegetable oils across our European business. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with up to three years of experience in commodity trading, sourcing, procurement or a related commercial role who is looking to build a long-term career in international trading.
items.desc: Junior Vegetable Oils Trader Our story goes back more than 150 years, to the chilly southern coast of Scandinavia. From our early success in Sweden and Denmark, we’ve grown into the world’s leading specialist producer of plant-based oils, employing more than 4,000 people across the globe. We work with our customers to make the products you love even better. The oils we produce go into making your chocolate extra-creamy or putting the crunch into your croissant. And it’s not just food - we work across industries to make products that are higher quality, healthier and better for the planet. Everything we do is about Making Better Happen™ . AAK Location This role is based in either Rotterdam or Zaandijk, The Netherlands. About the role As Junior Vegetable Oils Trader, you will be part of AAK’s European Sourcing & Trading team, supporting the sourcing and trading of vegetable oils across our European business. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with up to three years of experience in commodity trading, sourcing, procurement or a related commercial role who is looking to build a long-term career in international trading. Working alongside experienced traders, you will develop market knowledge, commercial judgement and disciplined trading skills while gaining exposure to the fast-moving world of agricultural commodities. You will monitor market developments, support trade execution and help ensure reliable supply across AAK’s European operations. As your experience grows, you will take increasing ownership of selected trades, supplier relationships and purchasing decisions, all within agreed trading mandates and risk frameworks. Responsibilities Monitor vegetable oils markets, including prices, supply and demand trends, freight, currencies and relevant geopolitical or regulatory developments. Support the execution of physical vegetable oils trades, including quotations, contract confirmations, delivery coordination and trade follow-up. Maintain accurate trading positions, pricing records and exposure reporting, escalating risks or discrepancies where required. Contribute to pricing analysis, hedging preparation and trading recommendations under the guidance of senior traders. Build strong relationships with suppliers, brokers, customers and internal stakeholders to support reliable supply and identify commercial opportunities. Collaborate with Supply Chain, Finance, Quality, Sustainability, Sales and Operations to resolve commercial and operational issues. Develop your understanding of commodity markets, trading disciplines and risk management while progressively taking ownership of selected categories and trades. Ensure compliance with trading governance, contractual obligations and sustainability requirements across all activities. About you Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Economics, Finance, Supply Chain, Agribusiness or a related field. Up to three years of relevant experience in commodity trading, sourcing, procurement, logistics, market analysis or a similar commercial environment; internships and graduate experience are also valued. Strong numerical and analytical skills, with the ability to interpret market data and draw clear commercial conclusions. A genuine interest in vegetable oils, agricultural commodities and international physical trading. Commercial mindset combined with strong attention to detail and a proactive approach to learning. Ability to work within structured risk and governance frameworks while developing sound trading judgement. Strong communication skills and the confidence to build relationships with colleagues, suppliers and market partners. Fluent in English; additional European languages are an advantage. In return AAK offers Join a pioneering company in specialty oils and fats, driving innovation and sustainability. In AAK you can work across 25+ countries, gaining international exposure and collaborating with a diverse team. AAK invests in your development with training, mentorship, and clear career paths. You will contribute to a greener world with AAK's sustainability-focused approach. Join a diverse and inclusive workplace that values every individual's perspective and talents. Contact and information For further information about the position, please contact Paul Engwell, Talent Acquisition Specialist: paul.engwell@aak.com About AAK Everything AAK does is about Making Better Happen™ . We specialise in plant-based oils that are the value-adding ingredients in many of the products people love to consume. We make these products better tasting, healthier, and more sustainable. At the heart of AAK’s offer is Customer Co-Development, combining our desire to understand what better means for each customer with the flexibility of our production assets and deep knowledge across multiple industries, including Chocolate and Confectionery, Bakery, Dairy, Plant-based Foods, Special Nutrition, Foodservice and Personal Care.
