items.desc: Business Consultant / Analyst Collateral Management Lifecycle (hay 10) At a glance Are you ready to be a part of the exciting changes happening in ABN Amro's Corporate Credit Landscape? We are seeking individuals who are passionate about learning and developing their skills while designing future-proof end-to-end lending processes within Financing Solutions. ABN AMRO is committed to enriching and renewing the lending landscape by simplifying and accelerating processes to better identify customer risks and serve them transparently. As part of the Credits Capability Grid department, we are digitizing customer data and building a new central credit platform. Your role will be crucial in identifying business needs and translating them to our IT department. If you are ready to contribute to the credit landscape of the future and be a part of our mission to serve our customers better, then we want you on our team. Join us as a Business Consultant / Analyst in building a brighter future for lending! Your job We are looking for a Business Consultant / Analyst to design and continuously improve our new digital end-to-end lending processes. In this position, you will have the opportunity to make a positive impact on the future of lending. You will be working for the Collateral Management Lifecycle team within Corporate Banking, responsible for a new digital end-to-end customer journey. Your role will involve driving requirement gathering from end-users and specialist teams , such as Lenders, Credit Risk, Contracting, Operations and Regulatory. Turning these into technical designs for our Salesforce credit origination platform. Balancing regulatory requirements with practical, day-to-day operational feasibility to ensure compliant yet workable solutions for end-users. As the bridge between end-users and our developers, you will learn the end-to-end journey of corporate credits and the daily tasks of our end-users. In order to excel at this job, you need to be creative, good at stakeholder management, organized, empathetic towards users, like a challenge, and eager to learn about our software and processes. Examples of day-to-day tasks include: Analysing services, business processes, information flows, user and system requirements to identify opportunities. Translating product roadmap features into concrete user stories by identifying and prioritizing technical and functional requirements. Creating system and/or data model designs which you translate in clear documentation to develop a shared understanding of the topic and improve organizational learning. Supporting implementation, helping the development team to deliver quality by collaborating on test design and user acceptance tests. Working environment We are excited to welcome you to our devops team within the Collateral Management Lifecycle shop. You will work closely with colleagues from other streams, such as Integrations, Business Implementation, Regulatory, and subject matter experts from departments such as Lending, Risk and FR&R. Collaboration is key to our success, and we are committed to create a supportive and inclusive workplace culture. A healthy work-life balance is essential for you to thrive and succeed in your role where we strive to be between 2 a 3 days a week at the office. Your profile You are passionate about devops, driven to learn and grow and eager to contribute to our mission of shaping the future of lending. If you are a team player who enjoys working collaboratively, then we would love to hear from you. Join us in making a positive impact on the world of Collateral Management! As a problem-solver, you enjoy tackling complex challenges and providing structure to problems. You take ownership of challenges and can translate requirements into Salesforce functionalities in collaboration with our IT teams. You are a connector, building bridges and bringing others together. We welcome candidates of all backgrounds and experiences, including those without professional working experience in banking. We are looking for someone who is eager to learn and can bring a positive attitude to the team. We will provide you with the necessary training and support to excel in the role. Whether your background is in life sciences, finance, IT, sales or another area, your skills will play an important role in the work we perform. Job Overview Wegens uitbreiding van onze werkzaamheden zijn wij op zoek naar diverse; CYTOLOGISCHE ANALISTEN De afdeling Discovery & Environmental Sciences bestaat uit circa 40 medewerkers. Binnen deze afdeling wordt onderzoek uitgevoerd naar de veiligheid van bestaande en nieuwe stoffen. Kenmerkend voor het werk is de grote diversiteit aan testen, teststoffen en klanten. Je taken De taken voor de cytologische/cytogenetische analisten bestaan uit het microscopisch beoordelen van preparaten behorende bij mutageniciteitsonderzoeken (bijvoorbeeld in vitro en in vivo micronucleus studies). De werkzaamheden kunnen grotendeels vanuit huis worden uitgevoerd. Hiervoor ontvang je een microscoop van Charles River. Voor specifieke studies wordt gebruik gemaakt van een fluorescentiemicroscoop. In overleg is het dan mogelijk om gedurende een vooraf afgesproken periode gemiddeld één dag per week op onze locatie. Uiteraard wordt dit tijdig afgestemd. Je profiel Afgeronde MLO- of HLO/HBO-opleiding; Ervaring met GLP is gewenst; Goede communicatieve en sociale vaardigheden; Accuraat, zelfstandig en flexibel; Vaardigheden op cytologisch gebied gewenst; Bereidheid om voor specifieke onderzoeksprojecten gedurende een afgesproken periode één dag per week op locatie te werken. Wat bieden we jou: De mogelijkheid je verder te ontwikkelen in je vakgebied; Passend uurloon, inclusief vakantieuren en vakantiegeld; Reiskostenvergoeding van € 0,25 per kilometer met een maximum van 100 kilometer per dag. Collectieve ziektekostenverzekering bij CZ. 10 % korting op elke aanvullende verzekering. Physical Requirements About Safety Assessment Charles River is committed to helping our partners expedite their preclinical drug development with exceptional safety assessment services, state-of-the-art facilities and expert regulatory guidance. From individual specialty toxicology and IND enabling studies to tailored packages and total laboratory support, our deeply experienced team can design and execute programs that anticipate challenges and avoid roadblocks for a smooth, efficient journey to market. Each year approximately 300 investigational new drug (IND) programs are conducted in our Safety Assessment facilities. About Charles River Charles River is an early-stage contract research organization (CRO). We have built upon our foundation of laboratory animal medicine and science to develop a diverse portfolio of discovery and safety assessment services, both Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) and non-GLP, to support clients from target identification through preclinical development. Charles River also provides a suite of products and services to support our clients’ clinical laboratory testing needs and manufacturing activities. Utilizing this broad portfolio of products and services enables our clients to create a more flexible drug development model, which reduces their costs, enhances their productivity and effectiveness to increase speed to market. With over 20,000 employees within 110 facilities in over 20 countries around the globe, we are strategically positioned to coordinate worldwide resources and apply multidisciplinary perspectives in resolving our client’s unique challenges. Our client base includes global pharmaceutical companies, biotechnology companies, government agencies and hospitals and academic institutions around the world. Ønsker du i tillegg å bidra til å gjøre Norge tryggere? Da er du kanskje den vi ser etter! Avdelingen for taktisk og teknisk innhenting er PSTs øyne og ører utad og henter inn informasjon, slik at PST er i stand til å oppdage trusler og gjøre de riktige vurderingene når det gjelder landets sikkerhet. Avdelingen har et nasjonalt ansvar for innhenting og analyse av informasjon fra åpne kilder samt for utvikling av fagområdet OSINT og av metoder for informasjonsinnhenting fra internett. PST bygger opp et nytt miljø innenfor innhenting og analyse fra åpne kilder, og vi søker derfor nye kollegaer med varierte bakgrunner og ferdigheter til stillinger som utvikler. Vi ser etter deg som liker å samle store datamengder og hente ut merverdi av disse. Arbeidsoppgaver Som OSINT-utvikler vil du løse komplekse oppgaver som krever kreativitet, og du vil få en stor grad av innflytelse over utviklingen av metoder og verktøy innen fagdisiplinen - også direkte rettet mot de aktuelle sakene vi jobber med. Du vil jobbe sammen med researchere og analytikere, samt øvrige innhentings- og teknologimiljøer i organisasjonen, for å utvikle verktøy og metoder i takt med utviklingen av ny teknologi og digitale muligheter. Arbeidsoppgavene omfatter blant annet å: innhente, bearbeide og tilgjengeliggjøre data i en rekke ulike formater sette opp og prosessere datastrømmer samt utvikle eller utnytte AI-modeller, plattformer, metoder og verktøy På grunn av kompleksiteten i arbeidsoppgavene og som ansatt i en sikkerhets- og etterretningstjeneste, forstår du kanskje at vi ikke har mulighet til å jobbe hjemmefra, men vi har desto bedre muligheter for å støtte oss på, sparre med og utvikle oss faglig i samarbeid med gode kolleger. Endringer i stillingsinnhold, arbeidstid og organisatorisk tilhørighet kan forekomme. Kvalifikasjoner Vi ser fortrinnsvis etter utviklere med fullført og relevant høyere utdanning innen et teknisk fagområde. For oss er likevel dine tekniske ferdigheter, kreativitet og interesse det aller viktigste, og relevant erfaring med tilsvarende arbeidsoppgaver kan derfor kompensere for utdanningskravet. For å kvalifisere til stilling som overingeniør/rådgiver må du ha: relevant høyere utdanning på bachelornivå eller flerårig erfaring med utviklingsprosjekter relevant erfaring med prosessering og analyse av store datamengder relevant erfaring med programmering og utvikling av systemer på ulike plattformer For å kvalifisere til stilling som senioringeniør/seniorrådgiver må du i tillegg ha: relevant høyere utdanning på masternivå eller flere års erfaring med kompliserte utviklingsprosjekter relevant erfaring på høyt nivå og relevant spesialkompetanse og har hatt ansvar for teknologivalg og håndtering av uforutsette utfordringer gjerne fungert som faglig mentor for mindre erfarne utviklere, eventuelt også organisert og strukturert utviklingsprosjekter Til begge stillingene er det er en fordel om du har relevant erfaring med og/eller kjennskap til et eller flere av disse fagområdene: programmering i ulike språk skraping og automatisert innhenting stordata og datasjøer arkitektur nettverk databaser og datastruktur API-integrasjon dataanalyse cybersikkerhet styring, struktur og kontroll av utviklingsprosjekter UI/UX- og interaksjonsdesign maskinlæring og natural language processing identifisering og søk i åpne informasjonskilder (sosiale medier, offisielle registre, karttjenester o.l.) rammeverk og beste praksis innen OSINT Personlige egenskaper Vi ser etter deg som er kreativ, initiativrik og nysgjerrig. Du har gode analytiske evner og en metodisk tilnærming til å vurdere og strukturere komplekse mengder informasjon. Du søker innsikt og kunnskap proaktivt for å holde deg oppdatert på relevante trender og utvikling. Du har gode samarbeidsevner og arbeider effektivt både selvstendig og i team, og du håndterer tidsfrister godt. Du har god skriftlig og muntlig fremstillingsevne og formidler kjernen i problemstillinger og løsninger på en forståelig måte til ulike målgrupper. PSTs mandat stiller store krav til din faglige integritet og etiske vurderingsevne, samt til din evne til å følge etablerte rammebetingelser. PST er underlagt sikkerhetsloven, og det stilles strenge krav til at våre ansatte har en sikkerhetsbevisst atferd. For en stilling i PST vil personlig egnethet vektlegges i stor grad, og du må som ansatt ha egenskaper som pålitelighet, dømmekraft og lojalitet. Videre må du tilfredsstille kravene til sikkerhetsklarering for STRENGT HEMMELIG og NATO SECRET og for autorisasjon. Som ansatt i en sikkerhets- og etterretningstjeneste forventes det at du er fleksibel i oppgaveløsningen og villig til å yte …

items.desc: Reklamy, które oglądasz w telewizji i internecie, często powstają właśnie u nas. TELEVISOR to studio postprodukcji, animacji i AI. Pracujemy dla dużych marek i agencji reklamowych w dwóch budynkach na zielonej Sadybie, z ogrodem i basenem. Nasi klienci często spędzają u nas cały dzień. Chcemy, żeby czuli się jak u dobrych znajomych i chętnie do nas wracali. Kogo szukamy Szukamy osoby, która zadba o studio jak o swój dom. To Ty będziesz pierwszą osobą, którą zobaczą nasi goście. Lubisz ludzi, masz oko do szczegółów i dobry gust. Zauważasz, co można zrobić lepiej, i po prostu to robisz. Prowadzisz kilkuosobowy zespół recepcji. Jeśli cieszy Cię, kiedy goście wychodzą zadowoleni, a w biurze wszystko działa, to miejsce jest dla Ciebie. Czym się zajmiesz — Przyjmowaniem klientów i gości oraz opieką nad nimi w trakcie wizyty. — Prowadzeniem zespołu recepcji, przygotowywaniem grafiku pracy, rozliczaniem godzin, wdrażaniem nowych osób. — Przygotowaniem spotkań razem z produkcją, tak żeby wszystko było gotowe na czas. — Dbaniem o atmosferę w studiu, w tym o kwiaty, rośliny i wystrój. — Dbaniem o porządek i wygląd budynków, kuchni i ogrodu. — Zamawianiem cateringu, kawy i zaopatrzenia. — Współpracą z dostawcami (sprzątanie, woda, kawa, ogród, basen) i zlecaniem drobnych napraw. — Bieżącymi sprawami biura: zakupy, kurierzy. — Comiesięcznym zbieraniem i opisywaniem faktur oraz rozliczeń kart firmowych dla księgowości. Czego oczekujemy — Min. 2 lata doświadczenia jako koordynator recepcji, office manager, na recepcji, w hotelu, gastronomii lub przy eventach. — Doświadczenia w koordynowaniu pracy innych osób, formalnego lub nie. — Samodzielności i dbałości o szczegóły. — Spokoju i dobrej organizacji, nawet gdy dużo dzieje się naraz. — Swobody w pracy z arkuszami i dokumentami. — Angielskiego na poziomie swobodnej rozmowy z klientem. — Gotowości do zadań praktycznych, nie tylko przy biurku. — Sympatii do psów. Co oferujemy — Umowę o pracę na pełny etat. — Pracę 8 godzin dziennie, ze startem między 7:00 a 9:00, ustalanym z wyprzedzeniem pod wizyty klientów. — Realny wpływ na to, jak wygląda i działa studio, oraz własny budżet na bieżące decyzje. — Kartę Multisport. — Prywatną opiekę medyczną Medicover. — Studio z ogrodem i basenem, z którego możesz korzystać na zielonej Sadybie. — Pyszną kawę i zawsze pełną miskę owoców. — Psie towarzystwo na co dzień. — Życzliwy zespół, który doceni Twoją pracę. Jak aplikować Wyślij nam CV i kilka zdań o tym, co udało Ci się zmienić na lepsze w poprzedniej pracy. Proces: krótka rozmowa telefoniczna, spotkanie w studiu, potem płatny dzień próbny. Do zobaczenia na Okrężnej!

Lekcje angielskiego? Naturalnie, z platformą eTutor! Wsparcie całego zespołu nie tylko w okresie wdrożenia. Dofinansowanie do żłobka przedszkola lub wyprawka do szkoły, jeśli jesteś rodzicem Czas na Twój ruch! Jesteśmy Benefit Systems! Odpowiedzialność społeczna i zrównoważony rozwój, to nasze DNA i rdzeń działalności biznesowej. Chcemy być najlepsi dla świata. Z pasją tworzymy nasze programy dla tych, którzy chcą być aktywni i w pełni korzystać z życia. Dołączając do nas, staniesz się częścią globalnego ruchu B Corp , czyli spółek społecznie odpowiedzialnych. Przygotuj się na Zdrową Przygodę Życia!

items.desc: At Media Miami, we believe every brand has a story worth telling—and we’re here to turn that story into something powerful, memorable, and impactful. We operate as a specialised team of A-players who move fast, think strategically, and take ownership. We’re not about bureaucracy—we're about execution, growth, and doing meaningful work that drives real outcomes. Role Overview We are looking for a hands-on Automation & Infrastructure Engineer to build, maintain, and continuously improve the technical infrastructure behind our growing digital publishing and newsletter operation. This is not a traditional DevOps role and not a purely operational support position. We need someone who can understand a manual workflow, work through it when necessary, and then turn it into a reliable, scalable system using code, APIs, automation tools, and AI. As the number of newsletters, domains, accounts, and operational workflows grows, your responsibility will be to reduce manual work, improve reliability, and build technical systems that allow the operation to scale without increasing headcount at the same rate. We are looking for someone who can turn unclear operational problems into reliable technical solutions, troubleshooting unfamiliar systems independently in a fast-changing environment where not every process is documented. You will bring a strong focus on edge cases, logging, error handling, and data integrity to everything you build. Key Responsibilities Automation & Integrations Build and maintain automations for recurring operational workflows Integrate internal and third-party systems using APIs, webhooks, and custom scripts Build workflows in n8n and similar automation platforms Develop lightweight internal tools and utilities using Python and/or Node.js/TypeScript Integrate LLMs and AI agents into internal workflows where they provide measurable value Infrastructure & Platforms Configure and maintain domains and DNS records, including SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MX, TXT, and A records Work with Cloudflare and other domain/infrastructure management tools Work with newsletter platforms, ESPs, CRM systems, and publishing tools Automate account creation, configuration, status tracking, and operational checks where possible Work with databases and structured operational data Reliability, Improvement & Collaboration Build monitoring, alerts, validation checks, retries, and error-handling mechanisms Troubleshoot technical issues across APIs, domains, integrations, accounts, and automation workflows Identify repetitive manual work and propose technical solutions to eliminate or reduce it Maintain clear technical documentation for systems and automations Collaborate closely with Operations, Marketing, QA, and other internal specialists Requirements Must Have 1+ year of strong hands-on experience with Python, Node.js/TypeScript, or a similar backend/scripting language Experience working with REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, authentication, and third-party integrations Experience with proxies, isolated browser environments, or large-scale account operations Understanding of databases and ability to work with SQL Practical experience with LLM APIs, AI agents, structured outputs, tool/function calling, or AI-powered automation Basic infrastructure knowledge: domains, DNS, HTTP, authentication, servers, networking concepts Nice to Have Experience with Cloudflare, cPanel, AWS Route53, or similar tools Experience with newsletter platforms or ESPs such as Ghost, Mailchimp, ActiveCampaign, etc. Practical experience with workflow automation tools such as n8n, Make, Zapier, or similar — including automations that go beyond simple no-code workflows CRM integration experience Social media account creation and boosting Experience managing large numbers of accounts, domains, or digital properties Experience building internal admin panels, dashboards, or operational tools Previous experience in digital publishing, affiliate marketing, e-commerce, or marketing technology What Success Looks Like You will not be measured by how many repetitive tasks you can perform manually. You will be successful if, over time: Fewer workflows require manual intervention Recurring operational tasks become automated and standardized Technical incidents are detected earlier New newsletters and accounts can be launched faster Systems are documented and maintainable The operation can scale significantly without a proportional increase in manual work Who We're Looking For You will probably enjoy this role if your natural reaction to a repetitive process is: “I can do this manually first, understand how it works, and then build something so we don’t have to keep doing it manually.” We're looking for someone who: Is a curious, pragmatic builder who takes ownership Is comfortable moving between code, APIs, automation platforms, infrastructure, and business operations Understands unfamiliar systems quickly, experiments, and builds reliable solutions Solves problems independently …

items.desc: Job Description Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International? Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Possible. You will support end-to-end logistics (physical flows from plants to customers), including all warehouse, transport and co-packing operations, in terms of service, cost, health and safety, quality, food defense, sustainability, legal requirements and policies compliance. You will provide team leadership and direction for the logistics organization. In this role, you will implement logistics strategy and effectively execute operations to ensure optimum logistics solutions while supporting various routes-to-market, and balancing service and cost. You will work collaboratively with internal and external (third-party logistics vendors) business partners to ensure effective management, timely solutions and execution. How you will contribute You will: Be accountable for warehouse, transportation, international logistics (import/export) and co-packing operations Ensure the implementation of the business plan by delivering a consistent service level, adapting the supply chain to the demanding and changing customer environment and ensuring sufficient operational capacity to deliver business needs Be accountable for delivering logistics operational cost budget, ensuring that best-in-class controls and governance are in place Foster, initiate and lead continuous improvement programs that reduce cost and our carbon footprint and improve the service performance of the operation Ensure successful project implementation Select, manage and develop long-term relationships with third-party service providers Ensure adherence to health and safety, quality, food defense and legal requirements and policies Establish a business continuity plan for logistics operations. Support best-practices sharing and adoption What you will bring A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career and the following experience and knowledge: Solid background in logistics with experience leading operations in an FMCG/CPG environment Team leadership experience, with proven ability to build effective teams and develop people Drive for results with proactive, dynamic and action orientated approach, identifying areas where business change is required and excellence in project management Strong collaboration skills with strong business and financial acumen and the ability to forge senior level strategic partnerships with both internal and external stakeholders Strategic thinking plus excellent presentation, communication, influencing and motivational skills Strong negotiating skills with ability to negotiate in tough situations with both internal and external groups More about this role As our Poland logistics operations grow in complexity and scope, we are creating a Logistics Operations Supervisor role to provide dedicated senior operational leadership across the LogOps Polish team. This person will own day-to-day operational coordination across domestic distribution — from inbound through storage to outbound. The role drives process discipline, resolves escalations, and leads the LogOps side of our SAP 4 HANA transformation and continuous improvement agenda, ensuring these deliver real operational gains. Main Responsibilities: Manage priorities and workload allocation across the LogOps PL team — ensure balanced capacity, clear ownership, and timely execution across inbound, storage, and outbound. Own escalation resolution — act as the first decision point for operational issues; assess, decide, and drive resolution or escalate with a clear recommendation. Coordinate with 3PL operational counterparts — ensure smooth daily execution, flag issues early, and drive joint resolution with the Logistics Operations Manager. Lead LogOps preparation, testing, and go-live execution as the team's S4H Super User Additionally, drive adoption of S4H processes within the team — train, troubleshoot, and maintain process integrity post-go-live. Own and maintain LogOps process workflows — document, challenge, and improve standard operating procedures with input from process owners. Lead continuous improvement initiatives end-to-end (e.g. process mapping, waste elimination) — from problem identification through implementation to measured results. Own cost monitoring, invoice verification and accruals — ensure accuracy and timeliness in coordination with finance and external partners. Deliver operational input for budget preparation and forecasting Provide data, analysis, and operational insight to support Logistics Operations Manager. Requirements: Great Communications Skills - clearness, structure, and assertiveness. Challenging constructively, escalating effectively, and keeping people aligned. Confidence in working with data, building analyses, and translating findings into decisions and actions. Strong Excel skills; Power BI or similar is a plus. items.desc: We are looking for a QA Engineer who combines manual testing, end-to-end test automation, and basic DevOps knowledge with AI-assisted workflows. The role focuses on maintaining software quality while using AI tools to improve testing efficiency, accelerate routine tasks, and support problem-solving. OUR PERFECT CANDIDATE Experience in manual software testing; Understanding of software testing principles, testing levels, and software development methodologies; Experience creating and maintaining test documentation, including test cases, checklists, and bug reports; Practical experience testing web and mobile applications; Experience identifying, documenting, and tracking defects; Experience with end-to-end (E2E) test automation; Ability to review requirements and specifications and identify potential issues before implementation; Basic understanding of DevOps practices and the software development lifecycle; Experience using AI tools to support test design, test automation, troubleshooting, and other QA activities; Ability to analyze problems, identify quality risks, and take ownership of testing activities; Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with developers and other team members. KEY QUALIFICATIONS / RESPONSIBILITIES Estimate tasks provided by a Project Manager (PM) or Technology Lead (TL); Complete tasks from PM or TL within the estimated time; Participate in the SCRUM process; Participate in project development; Perform technical research; Keep technical documentation of the project; Prepare reports; Communicate with customers; Work on improvements of the current project. EMPLOYMENT CONDITIONS FOR THIS ROLE A friendly team of professionals: Strong technical specialists who are ready to help solve problems. Professional development: Financial and 1-to-1 meetings to discuss development plans; Individual Development Plan; Paid conferences and certifications; Lectures and other events where senior specialists share their knowledge with junior and middle specialists; Knowledge Bases with useful information for development. Vertical development: Opportunity to grow and become a coordinator and a Technology Lead further. Improving the English level: English courses. Work-life advantages: Flexible working hours; Opportunity to work remotely with necessary hardware and furniture provided by the company anywhere in Ukraine; 24 calendar days of vacation per year and paid sick leaves; Financial support and gifts for important events.

items.desc: OTC Derivatives Specialist Poland Operations Group Functions Job Reference # 344602BR City Wroclaw Job Type Full Time, Temporary / Contract Key responsibilities Are you well-organized and detail-oriented? Do you have a high client service orientation and risk awareness? Do you want the chance to work in a dynamic, fast paced and exciting field? items.desc: Warsaw Full-time Permanent employee Tech stack you’ll work with About the role We are hiring an IT Administrator to own our internal IT and security operations: endpoints, identity, aaccess, networking and core SaaS tools. You will keep every laptop, account and system secure, compliant and running smoothly, so our teams can build and operate financial products with confidence. You will be the go-to person for Google Workspace, Jamf, Jira, GitHub and our Wazuh SIEM, and you will work closely with engineering, security and compliance. In a regulated fintech environment, that means getting the details right: least-privilege access, auditable changes and fast response when something looks wrong. Key responsibilities Endpoint management (Jamf) Administer Jamf Pro for the full macOS (and iOS, where applicable) fleet: enrollment, zero-touch provisioning via Apple Business Manager, and offboarding. Build and maintain configuration profiles, policies and smart groups for FileVault encryption, firewall, screen lock, Gatekeeper and OS update enforcement. Deploy and patch applications, and keep the fleet aligned with CIS benchmarks. Manage hardware inventory, device lifecycle and remote lock or wipe for lost or compromised devices. Identity and access management (Google Workspace) Administer Google Workspace as the primary identity provider: users, groups, organizational units and SSO (SAML/OIDC) to connected apps. Enforce MFA (security keys or passkeys preferred), password policies, context-aware access and session controls. Own joiner, mover and leaver processes, with access granted on least-privilege and role-based principles. Run periodic access reviews and keep auditable records of approvals and changes. Configure Gmail security (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), DLP rules and Drive sharing restrictions. Jira and GitHub administration Administer Jira: projects, workflows, permission schemes, user provisioning and integrations. Administer the GitHub organization: teams, repository permissions, SSO enforcement, branch protection rules and required reviews. Manage GitHub security features such as secret scanning, Dependabot and audit log monitoring, in partnership with engineering. Security monitoring (Wazuh SIEM) Operate and maintain Wazuh: agent deployment across endpoints and servers, rule tuning and log source onboarding (Google Workspace, GitHub, cloud and network logs). Triage alerts, investigate suspicious activity and escalate or handle incidents following our response runbooks. Use Wazuh for file integrity monitoring, vulnerability detection and compliance reporting. Network and VPN Manage the corporate VPN or zero-trust network access solution, including client deployment, access policies and certificate management. Maintain office network infrastructure: Wi-Fi (WPA3-Enterprise), firewall rules, network segmentation and guest isolation. Security and compliance Implement and document security controls that support our compliance obligations (for example SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, DORA and GDPR). Collect evidence for audits and help answer security questionnaires from partners and regulators. Write and maintain IT policies, runbooks and system documentation. Run security awareness basics, such as phishing simulations and onboarding training. IT support Provide day-to-day IT support to employees, and onboard new joiners with a ready-to-use, secure setup on day one. Evaluate, purchase and manage SaaS tools and licenses, keeping costs and shadow IT under control. Required qualifications 3+ years in IT administration or systems administration, ideally in a fast-growing or regulated company. Hands-on experience administering Google Workspace, including SSO, MFA, groups and security settings. Hands-on experience with Jamf Pro (or a comparable MDM) managing a macOS fleet. Working knowledge of Jira and GitHub administration: permissions, SSO and user lifecycle. Experience with a SIEM (Wazuh strongly preferred) and basic incident triage. Solid networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, firewalls and VPN technologies. Comfort with scripting for automation (Bash, Python or similar) and with APIs. A security-first mindset: least privilege, change control, documentation and audit trails. Clear written communication and a helpful, service-oriented attitude. Fluent English. Nice to have Experience in fintech, banking or payments, and familiarity with SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS or DORA audits. Experience with zero-trust access tools (for example Tailscale, Cloudflare Zero Trust or similar). Cloud fundamentals on AWS, GCP or Azure, especially IAM and logging. Infrastructure-as-code or configuration-as-code experience (Terraform, GAM, Jamf API). Certifications such as Jamf Certified Admin, Google Workspace Administrator, CompTIA Security+ or similar. Some Windows or Linux endpoint management experience. What we offer Ownership of IT and security operations, with real influence over tools and processes. Close collaboration with …

items.desc: SD Worx is a leading European provider of Payroll & HR services with global reach. We have offices in Europe and an office in Mauritius. Our goal? We bring people solutions to life, so companies of any size can turn Human Resources into a source of value for the business and the people in it. Our people solutions span the entire employee journey, from getting people paid to attracting, rewarding, and developing talent. Are you ready to join us? Scrum Master Responsibilities: As a Scrum Master, you are a key enabler of effective, sustainable delivery. You strengthen team dynamics, foster psychological safety, and help squads continuously improve how they work. By combining coaching, facilitation, and systems thinking, you ensure that teams operate in line with Product OS expectations while continuously improving flow, collaboration, and outcomes. Your key responsibilities include: Establishing and reinforcing Product OS–aligned ways of working, including rhythms, ceremonies, artefacts, and decision making patterns. Partnering closely with the ProdOps Center of Excellence to implement agreed practices, while providing continuous feedback from teams to evolve and improve them. Improving overall squad effectiveness by identifying delivery bottlenecks, enabling systemic problem solving, and improving end to end flow of value. Driving continuous practice improvement by helping teams regularly inspect and adapt their processes, behaviors, and delivery patterns. Strengthening team dynamics by fostering open communication, constructive conflict, and healthy collaboration. Building and maintaining psychological safety, enabling team members to speak up, experiment, challenge assumptions, and take ownership. Coaching individuals and teams on self management, collaboration skills, delivery habits, and continuous improvement mindsets. Supporting clearer goals, priorities, and shared understanding within and across teams. Result Areas: Your impact is visible through the following outcomes: Effective and Sustainable Delivery Flow – smoother value delivery with improved predictability. Strong Team Dynamics & Psychological Safety – teams that collaborate openly, learn, and improve together. Product OS–Aligned Ways of Working – consistent, transparent, and scalable delivery practices. Continuous Practice Improvement – teams that actively inspect, adapt, and evolve. Cross Team Collaboration & Coordination – improved alignment across squads and stakeholders. Clear Goals & Shared Understanding – focus on what matters most and why. Flow Based Delivery Improvements – measurable gains in cycle time, focus, and throughput. Outcome Driven Product Thinking – stronger linkage between work, value, and customer outcomes. Healthy Communication Patterns – constructive feedback, trust, and accountability. Job Requirements: Technical & Professional Requirements: Deep expertise in agility across multiple frameworks such as Scrum, Kanban, Lean, and flow based delivery, with the ability to adapt practices to team maturity and context. Strong understanding of flow metrics (e.g. cycle time, WIP, predictability) and the ability to coach teams in using data to improve delivery. Experience leading continuous improvement and change, supporting teams and stakeholders through new practices and behaviors. Solid understanding of modern product development, including discovery, value hypotheses, and outcome driven prioritization. Awareness of engineering practices such as DevOps, CI/CD, and quality engineering principles. Interest in emerging practices and AI assisted ways of working. Skills & Competencies: Excellent coach of self managing, autonomous teams, fostering ownership and accountability. Skilled facilitator who enables alignment, decision making, and constructive conflict resolution. Strong communicator able to influence, challenge, and support teams and leaders at different levels. High emotional intelligence with a strong focus on psychological safety and team health. Systems thinker who connects team behavior and delivery patterns to broader organizational flow and goals. Continuous learner with a growth mindset and curiosity for improvement. We want to make the hiring process as smooth and transparent as possible. Here’s what you can expect after submitting your application: Application – Submit your application quickly and easily through our career page or directly through Teamtailor. Assessment/Case Study – Some roles may include a case interview or assessment. Decision : if selected for the role, HR will take on the administrative part of your internal mutation. items.desc: The AI-powered OS for beauty, wellness and self-care About Fresha Fresha is the AI-powered operating system for the global beauty, wellness and self-care industry, connecting and powering everything from salons and barbers to spas, medspas, fitness studios and health practices. Trusted by millions of consumers and businesses worldwide. Fresha is used by 140,000+ businesses and 450,000+ stylists and professionals worldwide, processing over 1 billion appointments to date. The company is headquartered in London, United Kingdom, with 15 global offices located across North America, EMEA and APAC. Fresha allows consumers to discover, book and pay for beauty and wellness appointments with local businesses via its marketplace, while beauty and wellness businesses and professionals use an all-in-one platform to manage their entire operations with an intuitive business software and financial technology solutions. Fresha’s ecosystem gives merchants everything they need to run their business seamlessly by facilitating appointment bookings, point-of-sale, customer records management, marketing automation, loyalty, beauty products inventory and team management. The consumer marketplace unlocks revenue potential for partner businesses by leveraging the power of online bookings and automated marketing through mobile apps and advanced integrations with major tech brands including Instagram, Facebook and Google. Location: Warsaw, Poland — Onsite (5 days on-site) Contract: B2B · 16–22 k PLN net / month + RSUs UoP: 12,800 - 17,600 PLN gross/month + RSUs Role overview Given our exciting and progressive growth plans, we are looking for an exceptional Analytics Engineer, Product to come and join our global business. Reporting to the Senior Analytics Engineer , and working collaboratively with Product Managers , Engineers , Analysts and Commercial Leadership , you will be accountable for modelling data to provide clean, accurate data to power both decision-making and the product itself. This also entails transforming, testing, and validating data. This is a great opportunity for someone looking to work in a fast-paced, ever-changing environment who likes to work autonomously, enjoys a challenge, and wants to make an impact . What you will be doing: Develop, test, and maintain robust dimensional data models from diverse data sources, including first-party data, data from third-party APIs, SFTPs, and other external data sources Enhance the efficiency and performance of data models, focusing on improving ease of use, increasing accessibility of data, reducing runtimes, and eliminating waste Build and maintain the highest quality of our data products, both internal and external Advise product development on analytical requirements with new feature releases, and ensure data warehouse incorporates development changes from new feature releases effectively Use your knowledge of Fresha's product and data models to analyse the performance of features and support product operations - through analytical queries and dashboards Develop comprehensive data documentation to maintain consistency in understanding and communication across the team. This list is not exhaustive and there may be other activities you are required to deliver. Skills, experience & qualifications required: Expert knowledge of SQL Experience with building and testing high-quality data modelling pipelines An understanding of data platform and data warehousing concepts Familiarity with modern data stack components - dbt is a must An interest in improving the performance and efficiency of data models and systems, with support and guidance from senior team members Good communication skills in English (C1 or higher), with a willingness to collaborate with team members and stakeholders to understand requirements and share progress A desire to contribute to product development decisions through data architecture best practices and analytical insights Creative thinking and problem-solving abilities, with a proactive and autonomous approach to work Responsible AI tool proficiency - use AI to deliver impressive and reliable results, maintaining control Bonus points: Good Polish language skills Experience in driving product decisions and taking ownership of features Familiarity with the following systems: Fivetran, Airflow, Snowflake, Plotly, Starrocks, Metabase Experience in writing ELT pipelines with SQL and Python Experience working in fast-paced companies Experience in fine-tuning and controlling AI tools Inclusive workforce At Fresha, we are creating a culture where individuals of all backgrounds feel comfortable. We want all Fresha people to feel included and truly empowered to contribute fully to our vision and goals. Everyone who applies will receive fair consideration for employment. items.desc: KittySpout / DoggySpout is looking for a hands-on CRO Lead to join our team! You will own every conversion test across our site, landing pages, paid-acquisition funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells. This is an all-in-one role: you set the strategy and you do the work – building the backlog, briefing and QA-ing tests, launching them and shipping the winners. We spend $2,000,000+ per month on Meta , so your tests reach significance fast. We are looking to hire someone with 3–4+ years running CRO programs for Shopify DTC brands. The ideal candidate has deep hands-on Intelligems experience, has built and tested paid-acquisition funnels, and can show the data behind tests that lifted conversion rate, AOV or revenue per visitor. The mission of this role Own every conversion test on both of our brands (site, landing pages, funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells) so each visitor is worth more every month. Success is a steady, well-run test program that lifts conversion rate, AOV and revenue per visitor across every page, funnel and offer. Who are we? KittySpout is a premium DTC brand selling stainless steel cat water fountains, filters and accessories. We sell across Shopify, Amazon and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest-growing brands in the pet space – $50M+ in annual revenue and scaling to $100M+. We recently launched DoggySpout, expanding into an entirely new vertical and customer base. We're a 100% remote, lean, senior team that moves fast, and every person here has a massive impact on the business. What is our culture like & who is a good fit? Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We use creativity to do more with less – and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by four core values: Better Everyday – keep a live test on each brand, write down the learning from every result, and improve the test plan, QA checklist and agency process after every round. Speed Is King – move from idea to live test in days, call finished tests on time, ship winners the week they win, and flag a conversion drop the same day. Work Smart – AI and automation first. Use Claude to turn Clarity recordings, reviews and surveys into test ideas and draft test briefs; automate reporting and drop alerts. Overdeliver – catch a conversion problem before anyone asks, bring the cause and the fix, and reuse winning patterns across both brands without being told. If you want a stress-free corporate 9–5 job, this isn't it. If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founder, and play a big role in scaling it to $100M+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, being hands-on and active – then you've come to the right place. Outcomes (what success looks like) 90-day targets for each outcome are agreed with you before your start date. Conversion rate and revenue per visitor rise on both brands – measured weekly by brand (Intelligems, Shopify) Paid-acquisition landing pages and funnels that convert – CVR and RPV per funnel (Intelligems, Northbeam) Continuous improvement across the website – tests live every week; winners shipped AOV and post-purchase upsell take rate rise – AOV (Shopify), upsell take rate (AfterSell) No conversion drop goes unnoticed – drops caught and raised the same day Key Objectives Own the CRO test plan and backlog for both brands, ranked by expected impact, so the biggest wins run first. Build, test and launch paid-acquisition funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells. Brief, QA and launch tests every week – then call results honestly and ship the winners. Drive measurable lifts in conversion rate, AOV and revenue per visitor. Catch conversion drops the same day and bring the cause and the fix. Manage our CRO agency and decide with the Head of Growth when work moves in-house. Report CRO KPIs weekly and run the weekly CRO & Funnels meeting. Requirements Fully remote, full-time Fluent in English CRO Experience: 3–4+ years running CRO programs for Shopify DTC brands is a must. Proof of Results: A record of tests and funnels that lifted CVR, AOV or RPV – with the data to back it up. Funnels: Experience building and testing paid-acquisition funnels and landing pages. Tools: Deep hands-on Intelligems experience, plus AfterSell (or similar), Microsoft Clarity and Shopify analytics. You can set up and QA a test without help. Briefing & Agencies: Experience briefing developers and designers, and managing a CRO agency. Experiment Design: You write clear hypotheses, size tests properly and call results on an agreed significance rule. Offer Sense: You know how bundles, discounts, subscriptions and upsells change conversion, AOV and margin. No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You are passionate about your work. Excellent cultural fit as per …

items.desc: Hey, we’re BRAINR. Our mission is to build the intelligent brain for every food factory, with the only AI powered factory operating system for the food industry, bringing together machines, sensors, software, and people. Profitable from day one, we’ve recently secured a record breaking €12.5M Seed Round, the largest in Portugal’s history, to take our mission global. And we’re getting there, because today over 30% of all meat production in Portugal is already managed by BRAINR. Along the way, we’ve been recognized as the Best Factory Digitization Solution at Food 4 Future in Spain, selected for EUROPA’s 100 most promising startups, and named a Top Cloud Based MES Solution by Manufacturing Tech Insights. What sets us apart isn’t just the tech. It’s the people. Our leadership team combines deep industry know how with world class tech expertise, giving you the chance to learn and grow faster than anywhere else. The mission is massive. The ambition is real. And we need talent like you to bring our vision to every food factory on earth. The Challenge We’re looking for a UX/UI Designer to shape intuitive, effective experiences across BRAINR’s AI-powered factory operating system. You’ll turn complex industrial workflows and user needs into clear, accessible interfaces that help people across food factories make confident, informed decisions. This is a hands-on product design role at the intersection of user research, interaction design, visual design, and technology. You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success, learning from factory teams and translating real-world challenges into thoughtful digital experiences. You’ll take ownership of well-defined features, with guidance from our Design Leader on more complex design challenges. As you deepen your understanding of our product and users, you’ll have opportunities to grow your skills and take on broader responsibilities. This role is based at our headquarters in Leiria, Portugal. What you’ll own: Design well-defined features from understanding requirements through to delivery, exploring solutions and refining them with Product, Engineering, and the Design Lead. Create user flows, wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity UI designs in Figma for responsive web and mobile experiences. Help translate industrial workflows into clear, intuitive interfaces, working with the team to understand factory operations and user needs. Participate in user research, usability testing, and feedback sessions, applying findings to improve your designs. Work closely with developers to understand technical constraints, communicate design intent, and review implementation quality. Use and contribute to BRAINR’s design system and reusable components, helping keep product experiences consistent. Participate in design reviews, explain your design decisions, and give and incorporate constructive feedback. Keep developing your craft through feedback, team learning sessions, and exploration of relevant design practices and tools. What success looks like: The features you work on help factory teams complete their tasks more clearly and efficiently. Your designs are thoughtful, consistent with the design system, and ready for implementation. You use user feedback and design reviews to improve your work and explain the reasoning behind your decisions. You collaborate effectively with Product and Engineering, following your designs through implementation. You build confidence and autonomy as you learn more about our product, users, and industrial workflows.

items.desc: A Snapshot of Your Day We are looking for talented Project Engineer Water Treatment Systems (f/m/d) to join our team at Siemens Energy in Bucharest to support the transition to a more sustainable and energized world! Your day begins with dedicated focus time to outline your agenda. Next, you prepare for meetings with international colleagues to discuss upcoming negotiations with your client. As a key player in the engineering process, you are responsible for managing costs, quality, and timelines for bids or execution projects, coordinating various disciplines to design efficient solutions. Soon, you’ll receive calls via Microsoft Teams, collaborating with your mechanical engineering team on improvements for power plants, decarbonized, or hybrid projects. Your afternoon kicks off with a customer meeting where you present the chemical concept outlined in your previous report, aiming to convince them of our solutions and address any questions. Following this, you will meet with the internal project team to define next steps, evaluate customer requirements, and adjust the chemical concept as needed. You will then calculate the costs for the mechanical/chemical water treatment scope and assess the impact on the project schedule. How You’ll Make an Impact Manage and participate in execution of respective sub systems / components of power plant projects e.g. chemical sampling and dosing systems, water treatment packages, etc. Evaluation of customer contract (specifications and requirements) Preparation of technical specifications, chemical operation concepts for different types of power plants and inquiry documentation Coordination and optimization of interfaces (piping, electrical, I&C, layout) Supervision of contractor time schedules and costs and reporting of engineering hours, deadlines, quality and costs for the respective mechanical/chemical scope Participation in design review process Review of contractors engineering manufacturing- and quality documentation Claim Management and negotiation and troubleshooting What You Bring A college degree in mechanical, process, or chemical engineering, or an equivalent combination of education, specializing in mechanical/chemical water treatment systems. Several years of professional experience in plant engineering, supplier handling, and execution of international projects, with a preference for experience in power generation. Strategic orientation with in-depth knowledge of products, plant components, materials, water chemistry, and the industrial power plant & Combined Heat and Power solution markets. Strong customer focus, with the ability to adapt strategies and actions to a dynamic environment. Self-motivated with a high energy drive and business acumen, capable of delivering optimal solutions regarding budget, quality, and timelines. Excellent organizational skills, intercultural sensitivity for working in international teams, and proficiency in English, with a willingness to travel for business. Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo Our Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. items.desc: REQ-10124117 03/11/2026 Customer Journey Bucharest, Romania ING Hubs Discover ING Hubs Romania ING Hubs Romania offers 130 services in software development, data management, non-financial risk & compliance, audit, and retail operations to 24 ING units worldwide, with the help of over 2000 high-performing engineers, risk, and operations professionals. We started out in 2015 as ING’s software development hub, then steadily expanded our range to include more services and competencies. Now we provide borderless services with bank-wide capabilities and operate from our office in Bucharest. Our tech capabilities remain the core of our business , with more than 1800 colleagues active in Data Management, Touchpoint Channels & Integration, Core Banking, and Global Products. We enjoy a flexible way of working and a highly collaborative environment, where fair and constructive feedback is encouraged. For us, impact isn't a perk. It's the driver of our work. We are guided and rewarded by a shared desire to make the world a better place, one innovative solution at a time. Our colleagues make it their job to do impactful things and they love doing it in good company. Do you? The Mission GAIDP (Global AI & Data Platforms) tribe has a purpose to build data analytics products that benefit ING’s employees, clients and the bank overall. With an enthusiastic team of about 300 - engineers, data scientists, UXers and product owners we build solutions that make the bank more data driven. We are a group of data enthusiasts with a mission to create an end-to-end Data Analytics Platforms called Vista for ING Bank. We are part of the ING Analytics (INGA) department, under the GAIDP tribe. Vista is an internal Data Analytics Platform with over 500+ high value projects across the domains of Fraud, Wholesale Banking, Retail, and others. We have over 1000+ users, 100s of models in our Exploration environment and dozens in Production/Execution. And this is just the start for us! Your day to day We are looking for an experienced Product Owner to lead our Vista Core Data Layer squad and facilitate seamless journeys for our users. This is a joined effort between ING units, and you are going to be part of a distributed international and multi-cultural team. Each of our squads is responsible for some of the components of our Platform, be that in Exploration or Execution, in our Private Cloud or within a Public Cloud provider; all contribute to the overall vision of building a scalable, secure and performant platform to enable advanced analytics and AI for ING. There is plenty of work and fun down this road. Role & Responsibilities Lead your squad's discovery and delivery roadmap: find (data) problems, prioritize ideation backlog, design and execute experiments to decide what problems need solving; Work with a squad of Engineers, SRE, and Data engineers to discover the potential of a product idea, the user problem (user research) and validate and prototype; Ability to develop structured product concepts and features from abstract ideas and increased user demands with complex challenges; Manage all the stakeholders in the tribe; Work closely with area Product Manager and Tech Lead on product strategy and vision; Understanding and enthusiasm for technology, advanced analytics and data science methods. What you’ll bring to the team Experience : 3+ years of experience with Product Owner or Product Manager role, with a good understanding of product management methodologies such as Lean, Agile and Design Thinking. Customer Journey Experts with relevant experience and a strong interest in transitioning into a Product Owner role are also encouraged to apply. Knowledge: You are familiar with Data, Advanced Analytics and Data-driven Products; You are comfortable with technical components and software engineering: Apache Airflow, Apache Spark, Apache Kafka for streaming ingestions, ETL methodologies, Kubernetes, Distributed Data Systems/Distributed Computing/Data migration, SQL, Python/Scala, CI/CD pipelines; You have good background in Big Data and/or Software Development; You are great with people, being able to shape cooperation, keeping communication smooth and clear; You know how to react under priority changes and unexpected situations in a team. Nice to have: You have been working in complex team setups; You have experience with product design, experimentation and discovery; You’ve been a part of a Platform team; You have worked with an Analytics enablement team; You are familiar with cloud technologies; You’ve used Azure Boards/Azure DevOps before. Foreign languages: English (advanced). Education : nice to have bachelor’s degree (or higher) in an IT related field. items.desc: REQ-10124118 03/11/2026 Customer Journey Bucharest, Romania ING Hubs Discover ING Hubs Romania ING Hubs Romania offers 130 services in software development, data management, non-financial risk & compliance, audit, and retail operations to 24 ING units worldwide, with the help of over 2000 high-performing engineers, risk, and operations professionals. Now we provide borderless services with bank-wide capabilities and operate from our office in Bucharest. Our tech capabilities remain the core of our business , with more than 1800 colleagues active in Data Management, Touchpoint Channels & Integration, Core Banking, and Global Products. Together, we contribute to the broader ambition of building a scalable, secure and high-performing platform that enables advanced analytics and AI across ING. Your responsabilities will include: Acting as a dedicated project and change management expert for migration initiatives, supporting the PO and PL in driving successful execution. Developing and maintaining detailed migration plans, milestones, dependencies and deliverables, initially focused on VISTA Fusion. Coordinating across teams, ING units and stakeholders to ensure required activities are aligned, prepared and approved, and can be incorporated into squad planning and execution. This is not a Product Owner role. The primary focus is project and change management, supporting change and migration activities required to successfully onboard the organization to the VISTA platform. Nice to have: You have been working in complex team setups; You have experience with product design, experimentation and discovery; You’ve been a part of a Platform team; You have worked with an Analytics enablement team; You are familiar with cloud technologies; You’ve used Azure Boards/Azure DevOps before. items.desc: About Aleph Aleph is a global leader accelerating digital advertising, and fintech solutions across more than 130 high-growth markets. With more than 20 years of experience and strategic partnerships with over 50 of the world's leading digital platforms, Aleph connects media, payments, and local market expertise to enable platforms and businesses to grow and operate globally with speed and compliance. With teams in more than 90 offices worldwide, Aleph combines global scale with deep local execution. Beyond business impact, Aleph drives digital inclusion through its education initiative, Digital Ad Expert, member of UNESCO’s Global Skills Academy. Are you a proactive, curious, organized and multilingual person looking to kickstart a career in Talent Acquisition (reclutamiento y selección de personal)? Do you thrive in an international environment and enjoy connecting people with great opportunities? Are you curious about how TikTok, Google or Amazon Ads actually work behind the scenes? Do you want real global business experience before you graduate? Then our Global Talent Sourcing internship in Madrid is for you. Join Aleph’s Global Sourcing Internship Program, a six-month, immersive learning experience where you will partner with our dynamic Global Talent Acquisition team and with hiring managers from four continents. This is not a classroom or a university program. It is your first step into the real world of Talent Acquisition, in a company that is truly global. About the Role As a Talent Sourcing Specialist intern, you will be at the forefront of identifying and attracting top talent for our vacancies worldwide. This is more than an internship: it is a foundational learning experience where you will gain hands-on expertise in direct search and sourcing in a truly global context. You will learn best practices, build a solid understanding of the Talent Acquisition lifecycle, and become skilled at finding the right people for the right roles, wherever they are. This role offers a unique opportunity to: Master direct sourcing: Learn the art and science of proactive talent identification, including advanced search techniques (such as Boolean search) and sourcing tools. Embrace global collaboration: Work with teams and candidates from various cultures and regions, expanding your global perspective and communication skills. Develop Talent Acquisition expertise: Build a strong foundation in recruitment processes, candidate engagement and employer branding. Make a real impact: People are our core business. Contribute directly to building our future talent pipeline by bringing in the best talent on the market. What You Will Do Conduct direct sourcing activities to identify potential candidates for Aleph in 100+ countries. Use a variety of sourcing techniques to build a robust candidate pipeline. Engage potential candidates globally through appealing outreach methods. Collaborate with hiring managers and recruiters to understand specific candidate needs and profiles. Maintain and update candidate databases. Partner with our Talent Advisors to support global searches and strengthen the business. What We Are Looking For English fluency is a must. Proficiency in additional languages is a significant advantage, as it allows you to connect with a wider pool of global talent. A genuine desire to understand new cultures and learn innovative sourcing strategies. A proactive mindset: you create opportunities rather than wait for them. The ability to communicate ideas clearly and engagingly, both verbally and in writing. A keen eye for detail and the ability to manage multiple tasks effectively. Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Human Resources (Relaciones Laborales y Recursos Humanos), Business Administration (ADE), International Relations (Relaciones Internacionales) or a related field. Why Join Aleph Impact: Your sourcing work feeds real hiring pipelines for Aleph teams in 100+ countries, so you contribute to meaningful projects from the start. Growth: Mentorship from experienced Talent Acquisition professionals and hands-on training in direct sourcing, outreach and the full recruiting lifecycle. Team culture: A stimulating, international team working across four continents, where curiosity is welcome and you will have fun along the way. items.desc: Industry Travel & Tourism Category Services & Hospitality Experience Mid level Applications are considered on a rolling basis Location: Las Palmas Visit website Follow Apollo Destination Contact Person Mari Yilmaz Mari.Yilmaz@apollo.se Job Description We offer an opportunity for those who thrive in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment where your work truly makes an impact. If you’re organized, responsible, solution-oriented, and passionate about delivering outstanding service, this role is for you. As a Contact Center Representative, you will be a vital part of the operations at our Contact Center abroad, delivering exceptional customer service both online and over the phone according to established guidelines and processes. You will become an expert in all the destinations covered by the Contact Center, knowledgeable about local traditions, customs, religions, and events. Your primary goal will be to ensure the highest level of customer satisfaction, quality, and productivity by addressing customer needs and resolving their problems. Additionally, you will work toward meeting sales targets by promoting ancillary products and services. This role also involves regular collaboration with stakeholders at the destinations you serve, including hotels, suppliers, and other employees. Skills & Requirements What we’re looking for: Education: Completed 3-year upper secondary education Work Experience: Experience working in a Call/Contact Center or Customer Service role Technical Skills: Proficiency in computer systems, including the Microsoft Office suite Language Skills: Fluency in a Nordic language, along with fluent spoken and written English A natural sense of service is crucial for this role. As the first point of contact for customers, you will respond to their questions, fulfil their wishes, and enhance their overall experience. To succeed in this position, you should have strong communication skills in both your native language and English, with the ability to express yourself clearly in both writing and speaking. You must be organized, detail-oriented, and possess good problem-solving skills. The ability to work independently is essential, along with being customer-oriented and business-minded. Academic qualifications, a background in tourism, and fluency in an additional Scandinavian language are also considered advantageous. About the company Apollo is one of the Nordic region’s leading travel operators, with around one million travelers each year. We have approximately 200 employees across our Nordic offices, and during our summer and winter seasons, the team expands with an additional 100–250 seasonal staff. We offer customers the opportunity to explore the world—whether they dream of a relaxing beach holiday, an energizing training week in sunny destinations, or an exciting city adventure over a weekend. We arrange package holidays, training trips, cruises, and city breaks to meet all travel needs. In addition, we offer flexible flight and hotel bookings for those who prefer to tailor their own trip. Since 2015, Apollo has been part of DERTOUR Nordic AB together with Golf Plaisir and Lime Travel. We are also part of the German REWE Group, which employs over 300,000 people. Our mission is to make our customers’ holiday dreams come true by delivering outstanding service and experiences. To achieve our vision of becoming Northern Europe’s most engaging and obvious choice for holidays, we are always looking for driven and innovative employees—whether as a tour representative at one of our destinations or working in the production and sales of our trips. Apollo also strives for sustainable travel and social responsibility through partnerships with organizations such as SOS Children’s Villages, Ecpat, and the Swedish Olympic Committee (SOK). Since 2016, we have proudly held our Travelife certification. For more information, visit apollo.se.

items.desc: Job Description: An opportunity for a Master Production Scheduler has arisen within Airbus Operations, Illescas (Toledo) . The selected candidate will join the Planning & Scheduling Team , responsible for the mid- and long-term planning (18 months) for MDCD A350F. The role operates across two core axes: leading the monthly finite capacity planning routines alongside manufacturing and program stakeholders, and steering the planning IT ecosystem (APC Jaguar and SAP). In this position, you will drive scenarios, simulate program updates for MCA & Elementary Parts, and provide the decision-making backbone for resources, buffer levels, and delivery priorities across the plant. RESPONSIBILITIES The main tasks of the jobholder will be: Evaluate program and production requirements , analyzing recovery scenarios and plant calendar constraints to propose optimized production plans. Lead Master Production Schedule (MPS) routines and stakeholder reviews , challenging delays to secure firm operational commitments. Design and simulate capacity scenarios within assembly lines to absorb program cascades and minimize lead-time disruptions. Build, track, and analyze execution KPIs measuring deliveries and schedule compliance, defining and driving targeted recovery action plans. Maintain and calibrate planning models and parameters across core systems (APC Jaguar, SAP, and APC-ARP interface). Coordinate logistics alignment and resource availability , actively mitigating supply disruptions to guarantee smooth assembly execution. SKILLS Is your profile aligned to the following list of skills? Apply! We are looking forward to knowing you: Education: Degree in Engineering (Aeronautical, Industrial, Mechanical) or a related technical discipline. Experience: Hands-on background in production planning, scheduling, or manufacturing operations within industrial or aerospace environments. Technical Knowledge: Mandatory advanced proficiency in APC Jaguar (and APC-ARP interface) as well as Google Sheets / advanced spreadsheets; working familiarity with SAP . Soft Skills: Strong negotiation, conflict resolution, active listening, proactive prioritization, and ability to coordinate multi-functional stakeholders under time constraints. Languages: Negotiation level / fluent in both English and Spanish (written and spoken). Valuable / Nice to have: Direct experience managing assembly lines planning or aerostructures manufacturing environments. WHICH BENEFITS WILL YOU HAVE AS AIRBUS EMPLOYEE? At Airbus we are focused on our employees and their welfare. Take a look at some of our social benefits: Vacation days plus additional days-off along the year (approx. 35 days per year in total). Attractive salary. Hybrid model of working (up to 40% per quarter when possible), promoting work-life balance. Collective transport service subject to working calendar/home location. Benefits such as life insurance, health insurance, employee stock options, retirement plan, or study grants. On-site facilities (among others): free canteen, kindergarten, medical office. Possibility to collaborate in different social and corporate social responsibility initiatives. Excellent upskilling opportunities and great development prospects in a multicultural environment. Option to access special rates in products & benefits. This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth. Company: Airbus Operations SL Employment Type: Permanent - Experience Level: Professional Job Family: Production Planning & Scheduling <JF-MA-PP> By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus. Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief. Airbus is, and always has been, committed to equal opportunities for all. As such, we will never ask for any type of monetary exchange in the frame of a recruitment process. Any impersonation of Airbus to do so should be reported to emsom@airbus.com . At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.
