items.desc: About Fairlo The story of Fairlo began when our founders, Jimmy and Shamon, saw first-hand how unfair and predatory lending practices can trap people in cycles of debt. Their mother had been misled by a large bank, and instead of being offered a lifeline, she was pushed further into financial difficulties. That injustice sparked an idea: to build a company that reimagines credit, rooted in transparency, flexibility, and respect. That company became Fairlo. Since launching in 2018, we've helped tens of thousands of people access fairer, more flexible credit. Today, we have around 50,000 active customers, an outstanding Trustpilot rating, and a team of passionate people across Stockholm, Crete, and the UK. We've built something we're incredibly proud of. But what comes next is even more exciting. The next chapter. And why you should be part of it. Fairlo is becoming a bank. And we're rethinking how we build technology along the way. We're entering a new phase where technology will play an even bigger role in everything we do. New products, new possibilities, more complex challenges, and an opportunity to build financial services that genuinely make people's lives better. At the same time, our AI transformation is already under way. There's a plan, and people across Fairlo are working on it every day as we become an AI-native organisation. We want to challenge old assumptions about how software gets built. Experiment with new tools and ways of working. Move from idea to impact faster. And create an engineering culture where curiosity, creativity, and great judgment matter more than ever. We're looking for a Fullstack Engineer who wants to join that work and help shape where it goes next. You'll join our Stockholm team, working closely with CTO, Product, Design, and our engineering colleagues in Crete. We're a small organisation with big ambitions, which means you'll be close to the decisions, the challenges, and the impact of what you build. This isn't a role where you'll simply pick up tickets and write code. We want you to understand the problems we're solving, challenge how we approach them, and help turn ambitious ideas into great products. You'll have the freedom to experiment, the responsibility to own your work, and the opportunity to influence both our technology and how we work with it. What you'll do As a Fullstack Engineer at Fairlo, you'll work across the entire product experience, from the interfaces our customers interact with to the services and systems powering them. You'll be part of a cross-functional crew with real ownership, working together to solve meaningful problems and deliver value to our customers. Here's what that looks like: Build products that matter. Design and develop intuitive customer experiences, scalable backend services, APIs, and integrations that make financial services simpler, smarter, and fairer. Own problems, not just code. Be involved from the first idea to the finished product. Understand the customer's needs, contribute to the solution, build it, ship it, and learn from the results. Build on the AI work already under way. Explore how AI can fundamentally improve the way we build software, from prototyping and development to testing, debugging, and delivery. Experiment, challenge existing practices, and help turn new possibilities into everyday ways of working. Make great technical decisions. Balance speed, simplicity, scalability, and security as we build technology that needs to perform today and grow with us tomorrow. Work close to the business. Collaborate directly with Product, Design, and colleagues across Fairlo. Your ideas and perspectives will matter, and you'll have the opportunity to influence what we build and why. Raise the bar together. Share knowledge, challenge assumptions, bring fresh ideas, and help create an engineering culture where talented people continuously learn and get better. Who you are We're looking for someone who loves building things, gets excited about solving real problems, and is genuinely curious about what's next in technology. You're comfortable moving between frontend and backend, enjoy taking ownership, and care just as much about the customer experience as you do about the code behind it. And while you're a strong engineer today, you're even more interested in what you could become tomorrow. We believe you'll thrive at Fairlo if you: Have solid professional experience in fullstack development, with strong skills across both frontend and backend. Are comfortable with modern frontend technologies such as React and TypeScript, as well as backend frameworks such as Node.js, Express.js, NestJS, .NET, or similar. Have experience building APIs, working with relational databases, and developing scalable, cloud-based applications, preferably using AWS. Are already exploring how AI can make you a better engineer, and are excited to push beyond traditional development practices. Care about building great products, not just great code. …

items.title: DevOps-ingenjör till konsultbolag i Stockholm
items.card: Är du DevOps-ingenjör och nyfiken på vad nästa steg kan vara? Just nu ser vi ett tydligt behov av din kompetens hos flera av konsultbolagen i vårt nätverk i Stockholm. Det här är därför en samlingsannons: i stället för att du ska söka till varje bolag för sig har vi samlat behoven här. Ett samtal med oss kan leda till flera möjliga arbetsgivare, men målsättningen är framför allt att det leder till rätt arbetsgivare.
items.desc: Är du DevOps-ingenjör och nyfiken på vad nästa steg kan vara? Just nu ser vi ett tydligt behov av din kompetens hos flera av konsultbolagen i vårt nätverk i Stockholm. Det här är därför en samlingsannons: i stället för att du ska söka till varje bolag för sig har vi samlat behoven här. Ett samtal med oss kan leda till flera möjliga arbetsgivare, men målsättningen är framför allt att det leder till rätt arbetsgivare. Vi utgår från dig och matchar dig mot rätt arbetsgivare i stället för tvärtom. Vi lyssnar in vad du vill (och inte vill) och matchar dig mot de bolag som passar dig bäst bland våra 300+ konsultbolag. Dina erfarenheter och din önskade karriärriktning är givetvis centrala, men för en långsiktigt god match är det minst lika viktigt att värderingar, kultur, arbetsvillkor och kanske framför allt personkemi stämmer. När allt detta klaffar blir det helt fantastiskt bra, och vår målsättning är alltid att det ska bli fallet. Om rollen Som DevOps-ingenjör gör du det möjligt för utvecklingsteam att leverera snabbt, säkert och stabilt. Du bygger och automatiserar plattformar, pipelines och infrastruktur och är en viktig länk mellan utveckling och drift. Exempel på arbetsuppgifter Bygga och förvalta CI/CD-pipelines Automatisera infrastruktur med infrastruktur som kod Driva och vidareutveckla container- och Kubernetesmiljöer Arbeta med övervakning, loggning och incidenthantering Införa säkerhet i hela leveranskedjan (DevSecOps) Vi tror att du har Minst fem års erfarenhet av DevOps, plattforms- eller driftarbete God erfarenhet av minst en molnplattform, till exempel Azure, AWS eller GCP Erfarenhet av Terraform, Bicep eller liknande Erfarenhet av Docker och Kubernetes Erfarenhet av CI/CD-verktyg, till exempel GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI eller Jenkins Flytande svenska och god engelska i tal och skrift Meriterande Erfarenhet av Prometheus, Grafana eller liknande Skriptning i Python, Bash eller PowerShell Certifieringar inom Azure, AWS, GCP eller Kubernetes Erfarenhet av platform engineering Tidigare erfarenhet av konsultrollen Du är prestigelös, tycker om att automatisera bort manuellt arbete och tar ansvar för att saker fungerar även efter driftsättning. Det här får du Villkoren varierar mellan bolagen, men gemensamt för dem är att du får: En tillsvidareanställning hos ett konsultbolag med kollegor inom ditt område Varierande uppdrag hos kunder i olika branscher, med möjlighet att påverka vilka uppdrag du tar Kompetensutveckling och ett nätverk som växer för varje uppdrag Ett bolag som säljer in dig och har din rygg mellan uppdragen Så går det till Du ansöker via länken i annonsen och bifogar ditt CV. Vi hör av oss för ett första samtal om vad du söker och vad som är viktigt för dig. Vi föreslår vilka bolag vi tror passar dig. Du väljer själv vilka du vill bli presenterad för. Bolagen tar det vidare i sin ordinarie rekryteringsprocess, och vi finns kvar som stöd hela vägen. Urval sker löpande, så skicka gärna in din ansökan redan i dag.

Ett samtal med oss kan leda till flera möjliga arbetsgivare, men målsättningen är framför allt att det leder till rätt arbetsgivare. Vi utgår från dig och matchar dig mot rätt arbetsgivare i stället för tvärtom. Vi lyssnar in vad du vill (och inte vill) och matchar dig mot de bolag som passar dig bäst bland våra 300+ konsultbolag. Dina erfarenheter och din önskade karriärriktning är givetvis centrala, men för en långsiktigt god match är det minst lika viktigt att värderingar, kultur, arbetsvillkor och kanske framför allt personkemi stämmer. När allt detta klaffar blir det helt fantastiskt bra, och vår målsättning är alltid att det ska bli fallet. Om rollen Som DevOps-ingenjör gör du det möjligt för utvecklingsteam att leverera snabbt, säkert och stabilt. Du bygger och automatiserar plattformar, pipelines och infrastruktur och är en viktig länk mellan utveckling och drift. Exempel på arbetsuppgifter Bygga och förvalta CI/CD-pipelines Automatisera infrastruktur med infrastruktur som kod Driva och vidareutveckla container- och Kubernetesmiljöer Arbeta med övervakning, loggning och incidenthantering Införa säkerhet i hela leveranskedjan (DevSecOps) Vi tror att du har Minst fem års erfarenhet av DevOps, plattforms- eller driftarbete God erfarenhet av minst en molnplattform, till exempel Azure, AWS eller GCP Erfarenhet av Terraform, Bicep eller liknande Erfarenhet av Docker och Kubernetes Erfarenhet av CI/CD-verktyg, till exempel GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI eller Jenkins Flytande svenska och god engelska i tal och skrift Meriterande Erfarenhet av Prometheus, Grafana eller liknande Skriptning i Python, Bash eller PowerShell Certifieringar inom Azure, AWS, GCP eller Kubernetes Erfarenhet av platform engineering Tidigare erfarenhet av konsultrollen Du är prestigelös, tycker om att automatisera bort manuellt arbete och tar ansvar för att saker fungerar även efter driftsättning. Det här får du Villkoren varierar mellan bolagen, men gemensamt för dem är att du får: En tillsvidareanställning hos ett konsultbolag med kollegor inom ditt område Varierande uppdrag hos kunder i olika branscher, med möjlighet att påverka vilka uppdrag du tar Kompetensutveckling och ett nätverk som växer för varje uppdrag Ett bolag som säljer in dig och har din rygg mellan uppdragen Så går det till Du skickar in din ansökan med ditt CV. Vi hör av oss för ett första samtal om vad du söker och vad som är viktigt för dig. Vi föreslår vilka bolag vi tror passar dig. Du väljer själv vilka du vill bli presenterad för. Bolagen tar det vidare i sin ordinarie rekryteringsprocess, och vi finns kvar som stöd hela vägen. Urval sker löpande, så skicka gärna in din ansökan redan i dag. Arbetsort: Delvis på distans i 113 31 Stockholm

items.desc: I rollen får du arbeta med att utveckla och vidareutveckla automationer som stödjer verksamhetens processer. Du blir samtidigt en viktig del i att bygga upp våra interna förmågor och tjänster kring automationsplattformen, exempelvis självbetjäning och gemensamma tekniska komponenter som gör det enklare för verksamheten att använda automation som tjänst. Om jobbet Du blir en del av sektionen Automatisering och Digitalisering i en sektion med 16 engagerade medarbetare som arbetar tillsammans på olika orter mellan Göteborg och Gävle. Vi ansvarar för utveckling och förvaltning av digitala lösningar som stödjer Trafikverkets verksamhet och arbetar nära produktägare, verksamhetsspecialister och andra utvecklingsteam. Vi tillhör tåget Data- och Analyståget och uppdragen ingår i tåget. Vi arbetar enligt agila principer och tillämpar bland annat samarbete, kunskapsdelning och kontinuerlig förbättring är en naturlig del av vårt arbetssätt. Rollen kombinerar systemutveckling, automation och teknisk utveckling av vår automationsplattform. Det innebär att du både får bygga konkreta automationer och vara med och utveckla de gemensamma tjänster och förmågor som gör att organisationen kan använda automation på ett effektivt och hållbart sätt. Du får möjlighet att arbeta med tekniker inom RPA, integration, AI, intelligent dokumenthantering och agentbaserad automation i en miljö där säkerhet, kvalitet och långsiktig förvaltning är centrala delar. Som systemutvecklare kommer du bland annat att: utveckla, testa och vidareutveckla automationer, främst med UiPath Automation Suite omsätta verksamhetens behov och processer till robusta och förvaltningsbara automationslösningar arbeta med integrationer mot olika system, API:er och datakällor bidra till utveckling av gemensamma komponenter, ramverk och tekniska lösningar för automation vara med och utveckla interna tjänster och självbetjäningslösningar kopplade till automationsplattformen bidra till plattformens tekniska utveckling och etablering av nya förmågor arbeta tillsammans med produktägare, processägare, arkitekter och andra tekniska kompetenser bidra till test, dokumentation, livscykelhantering och förvaltning av utvecklade lösningar Incidenthantering av utvecklade automationer Jag som tf. chef tror på att ge människor förtroende, ansvar och utrymme att använda sin kompetens, ta egna initiativ och hitta egna lösningar. För mig handlar ledarskap om att skapa rätt förutsättningar för att du ska lyckas, utan att detaljstyra. Jag vill finnas där som stöd och bollplank när du behöver mig, samtidigt som du får möjlighet att utveckla din självständighet. Jag vill uppmuntra dig att våga prova nya idéer, anta utmaningar och fortsätta utvecklas. Vi ska kunna lära av både framgångar och misstag. Vad kan vi erbjuda dig Hos Trafikverket får du möjlighet att arbeta i en samhällsviktig verksamhet där digitalisering och automation bidrar till att utveckla framtidens infrastruktur. Du blir en del av ett engagerat team med hög kompetens och får arbeta med modern systemutveckling, komplexa integrationer och kontinuerlig förbättring i en agil miljö. Kvalifikationer Vem är du? Vi söker dig som är analytisk och lösningsorienterad, med ett intresse för att förstå både tekniken och verksamhetens behov. Du är nyfiken på hur automation och digitalisering kan bidra till smarta och effektiva lösningar. Med ett strukturerat arbetssätt och fokus på kvalitet tar du ansvar för ditt arbete och driver det självständigt framåt. Du trivs i ett tvärfunktionellt team där samarbete och kunskapsutbyte är en naturlig del av arbetet. Genom din goda kommunikativa förmåga kan du omsätta verksamhetens behov till fungerande tekniska lösningar. Samtidigt vill du utvecklas inom nya teknikområden och bidra till teamets gemensamma mål. items.desc: TRATON is a group of strong brands with a shared mission: transforming transportation together to create the future of sustainable transport solutions. Within TRATON, we include MAN, Scania, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International. As part of a global team of industry experts, you get to think bigger, experience more, and reach further. Together, we have the power to transform transportation - Let´s make a difference together. Find out more: www.traton.com Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do. Role Summary Join us at TRATON Group R&D and become part of a team that is shaping the future of secure and sustainable transportation. As an PSIRT Operational Analyst, you will play a key role in protecting connected vehicles, digital platforms, and services from evolving cyber threats. Working within the Product Security Incident Response Team (PSIRT), you will move between incident response, vulnerability management, threat intelligence, and cybersecurity risk mitigation across our products and ecosystems. This role combines both operational and tactical responsibilities. You will collaborate with experts across Vehicle Security Operations, Cybersecurity Testing, Product Development, Safety, Compliance, and Engineering to ensure the highest level of cybersecurity resilience throughout the product lifecycle. If you are passionate about cybersecurity, enjoy solving complex challenges, and want to contribute to products that impact millions of people worldwide, this is your opportunity to make a real difference. Job Responsibilities As an PSIRT Operational Specialist, you will: Analyze cybersecurity incidents, vulnerabilities, and risks, including assessment of CVEs, CPEs, and CVSS scores, as well as disclosure management. Contribute to, and when ready coordinate or lead, cross-functional incident triage, forensic investigations, and response activities. Contribute to the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of PSIRT playbooks, security procedures, and incident readiness plans. Configure, validate, and support our security tools and technologies. Support in compliance activities related to cybersecurity regulations and standards such as ISO 21434 and UNECE R155. Stay informed about emerging cyber threats, technology trends, and industry developments to proactively develop our security capabilities. Who You Are You are a driven and proactive cybersecurity professional who thrives in a technical environment and enjoys collaborating across teams, functions, and cultures. You can balance tactical thinking with hands-on execution and remain calm in critical situations. We believe you have: Experience from cybersecurity operations, incident response, vulnerability analysis, PSIRT, SOC, or automotive cybersecurity environments. A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities. Experience from evaluating security risks, threats, or vulnerabilities. A structured and detail-oriented approach combined with strong integrity and professionalism. Fluent English communication skills, both written and spoken. And, a strong interest in emerging technologies and cybersecurity threats It is a plus if you have: Experience from working with automotive EE systems, connected vehicles, or embedded systems software. Knowledge of ISO 21434, UNECE R155, CRA, digital forensics, or threat intelligence. Security certifications such as CISSP, GIAC, OSCP, or CompTIA Security+. Experience contributing to security communities such as FIRST, ENISA, CSIRT networks, or similar. This Is Us We are a collaborative and skilled cybersecurity team responsible for protecting TRATON's products and services from evolving cyber threats. Expanding across brands, technologies, and international teams, we combine deep technical expertise with a strong culture of trust, continuous learning, and teamwork. Our mission is not only to respond to cybersecurity incidents, but also to proactively strengthen security capabilities, improve resilience, and support the secure development of future transportation solutions. With us, your actions will have a direct impact on the company’s cybersecurity status. Who Is Your Manager I am here to support you and the whole team in being successful and taking the necessary steps toward fulfilling our goals and stakeholders' expectations. I believe in creating a safe, transparent, and collaborative environment where everyone feels empowered to share ideas, challenge assumptions, and contribute to better solutions. Our work is challenging yet meaningful, which is why I prioritize trust, teamwork, and personal development and growth. Just as important, I value work-life balance and the well-being of every individual in the team. TRATON Offers We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace …

items.desc: Combine quantitative expertise, technology and valuation in one of the Nordics’ largest asset managers! SEB Asset Management is one of the largest asset managers in the Nordics, offering a broad range of funds and mandates across most asset classes to private and institutional investors. We combine deep expertise with a strong customer focus, a commitment to quality and trust, and an entrepreneurial mindset. Here, you will join an international environment where collaboration, continuous development, and the opportunity to make a meaningful impact are part of everyday work. Since SEB was founded in 1856, our focus on customers and long-term relationships has been at the heart of our success. We aim to drive positive change by providing capital to help everyone reach their goals and accelerate progress towards a sustainable tomorrow. As a leading financial services group in northern Europe, we'll help you grow and empower you to take on more responsibility to create a real difference. Welcome to SEB. About the role As a Quantitative Valuation Analyst, you will join the Risk & Performance Analytics team within Risk & Performance. The team works across risk, performance and valuation, in close collaboration with portfolio managers and other specialists across SEB Asset Management. In this role, you will have a particular focus on valuation and valuation processes, both within SimCorp Dimension and for instruments and processes handled outside the system. You will combine financial and mathematical understanding with strong technical skills to analyse, develop and improve how valuation is performed and controlled. The role sits at the intersection of financial instruments, systems, data and quantitative analysis. You will work with large datasets and databases, use Python to develop analytical and valuation solutions, and contribute to the continued development and automation of our valuation processes. Some of your responsibilities will include: Working with valuation of financial instruments in SimCorp Dimension and in valuation processes outside the system Analysing and developing valuation methodologies, models and processes Working with databases and data flows supporting valuation and quantitative analysis Developing tools and solutions in Python to support analysis, controls and automation Investigating valuation differences and supporting the understanding of underlying data, models and methodologies Collaborating closely with portfolio managers and other stakeholders across Asset Management Supporting the continued development of a robust, efficient and increasingly automated valuation environment To thrive in this role, we believe you have Previous hands-on experience with SimCorp Dimension, preferably within valuation, pricing, financial instruments or closely related areas A strong understanding of financial instruments and valuation Experience working with databases and large datasets Good programming skills in Python A strong mathematical and quantitative foundation A relevant academic degree within engineering, mathematics, finance, economics or another quantitative field and/or equivalent experience An analytical and structured approach, with the ability to investigate complex problems across systems, data and financial instruments Strong communication and collaboration skills and an interest in working closely with both technical specialists and investment professionals Fluency in spoken and written Swedish and English What we offer A key role in developing valuation processes within one of the Nordics’ largest asset managers The opportunity to combine finance, mathematics, data and technology in your daily work Work with a broad range of financial instruments, systems and valuation challenges An international learning environment in central Stockholm Close collaboration with experienced specialists and portfolio managers The opportunity to influence how we develop and automate our valuation processes An inclusive, value-driven culture focused on trust, quality and continuous development Do you want to be part of SEB? It is our fundamental belief that inclusion and diversity is crucial for our future success. We strive to have an inclusive, value-driven culture where employees feel valued, respected, and involved irrespective of who they are, what they believe or where they come from. Since we select candidates continuously, feel free to send in your application today via the link in this ad, but no later than November 22, 2026. items.desc: Om oss På Techrytera AB börjar rekryteringen med dig. Vi är ett bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag med spetskompetens och ett tydligt fokus inom IT och Engineering. Med vår branschkunskap och nära dialog med både kandidater och kunder skapar vi träffsäkra matchningar där rätt kompetens möter rätt behov. Vi tror att en riktigt bra matchning inte bara handlar om en rollbeskrivning – utan om dina erfarenheter, din potential och vad du faktiskt vill utvecklas inom. Därför utgår vi alltid från individen. Genom att förstå din bakgrund, dina drivkrafter och dina ambitioner kan vi koppla ihop dig med uppdrag och roller hos våra kunder där du får rätt förutsättningar att utvecklas och göra skillnad. Vårt mål är att bygga långsiktiga och meningsfulla samarbeten – både för dig som kandidat och för våra kunder. Arbetsbeskrivning Vi söker en erfaren Business Analyst som tillsammans med verksamheten ska definiera framtida rapporterings- och analysbehov kopplade till införandet av ett nytt ERP-system (SAP S/4HANA) inom energibranschen. Uppdraget omfattar att identifiera, analysera och dokumentera verksamhetens behov av rapporter, dashboards, KPI och beslutsunderlag inom följande områden: Inköp Project Portfolio Management Asset Management Underhåll Finans Fokus ligger på att definiera vilka rapporter och analyser som ska utvecklas i organisationens analysplattform samt rekommendera vilka rapporter som lämpar sig för direkt användning i ERP-systemet. Uppdraget omfattar även att kartlägga, verifiera och vid behov komplettera målgrupper och användningsområden för befintlig och framtida rapportering. Arbetet inleds med en inventering av befintlig rapportering och identifierade målgrupper. Ansvarsområden Genomföra en nulägesinventering av befintlig rapportering inom ERP-system, analysplattformar och relevanta självservicelösningar. Dokumentera informationsbehov och rapporteringskrav. Etablera en övergripande förståelse för befintliga KPI, nyckeltal och affärsregler. För prioriterade rapporteringsområden definiera, förankra och dokumentera mätetal och verksamhetsregler som krävs för framtida rapportering. Genomföra gap-analyser mellan befintlig och framtida rapportering. Samverka med verksamheten, ERP-programmet, analysteam och andra relevanta utvecklings- och dataorganisationer. Leverabler Rapportkatalog med identifierade rapportbehov, målgrupper och prioriteringar. Dokumenterade verksamhets-, informations- och rapporteringskrav. Rekommendation om vilka rapporter som ska hanteras direkt i ERP-systemet respektive i analysplattformen. Definition och dokumentation av KPI, nyckeltal, affärsregler och rapporteringskrav som underlag för utveckling. Kravspecifikationer för nya rapporter. Required Skills and Education Kompetenskrav Minst 5 års erfarenhet som Business Analyst, Requirements Analyst eller motsvarande inom Business Intelligence. Erfarenhet av ERP-system och rapporteringslösningar. Dokumenterad erfarenhet av kravinsamling inom rapportering, BI och analys. Mycket god kommunikativ förmåga på svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift. Flytande svenska är ett obligatoriskt krav. Meriterande kompetenser Erfarenhet av SAP ERP eller SAP S/4HANA, gärna inom inköp, finans, Asset Management, underhåll eller projektstyrning. Erfarenhet av Power BI. Erfarenhet från energibranschen. Tidigare erfarenhet av arbete inom större energibolag. Ansökan När du söker via Techrytera AB söker du inte bara ett jobb – du påbörjar en dialog om din fortsatta karriär. Vi vill lära känna dig, din erfarenhet och dina ambitioner för att kunna matcha dig med rätt möjligheter hos våra kunder. Låter det intressant? Skicka in din ansökan eller hör av dig till oss så berättar vi mer. Vi ser fram emot att hitta nästa steg i din karriär tillsammans med dig.

items.desc: Företagsbeskrivning Vattenfall är en av Europas största producenter och återförsäljare av el och värme. Våra huvudmarknader är Sverige, Tyskland, Nederländerna, Danmark och Storbritannien. Inom Vattenfallkoncernen finns cirka 20 000 anställda. Vi har elektrifierat industrier, levererat energi till bostäder och förvandlat tillvaron genom innovation i över hundra års tid. Vi driver på övergången till ett hållbart energisystem. Jobbeskrivning Är du en systemförvaltare som gillar utmaningar? Då kan du vara vår nya kollega! Som systemförvaltare/systemutvecklare ansvarar du för att både underhålla och vidareutveckla IT-system i vår komplexa IT-miljö. Vi arbetar i en miljö präglad av mycket högt ställda krav på IT-säkerhet. Du kommer arbeta inom området Dokumenthantering där uppgiften är att vidareutveckla samt förvalta våra egenutvecklade applikationer likväl som förvaltning av inköpta standardapplikationer. Vi strävar efter att hitta strategiskt hållbara lösningar och där ser vi dig som en viktig spelare. Du blir en del av ett team av systemutvecklare som samarbetar över geografiska gränser och stöttar varandra i det dagliga arbetet. Rollen innebär nära samarbete med förvaltningsledare och projektledare, samtidigt som du arbetar självständigt inom ditt teknikområde. Du kommer framför allt att: Ansvara för systemförvaltning inklusive kontakt med användare, felsökning, proaktivitet samt åtgärder på kort och lång sikt Delta som utvecklare i projekt och uppdrag av varierande omfattning Installera, konfigurera och anpassa programvaror Arbeta löpande med underhåll av förvaltningsdokumentation Kvalifikationer Vi söker dig som har: Akademisk utbildning inom IT eller motsvarande kunskaper Erfarenhet av och goda kunskaper inom Java, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, SQL, Windows och Linux Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift Det är meriterande om du har: Erfarenhet av kvalitetsprocesser, exempelvis ITL, samt testning Erfarenhet av plattformen Documentum och dess produkter Som person är du nyfiken, analytisk och trivs med att lösa tekniska utmaningar. Du har ett strukturerat arbetssätt med förmåga att se både helheten och detaljer. Du tar ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter, driver ditt arbete framåt och planerar din tid på ett effektivt sätt. Du samarbetar gärna med andra och är lyhörd för kundernas behov. Vi är ett företag i förändring och med stora utmaningar framför oss, vilket ställer krav på en flexibel organisation och medarbetare som har förmågan att hantera förändringar genom en positiv inställning. Ytterligare information Förutom att du får vara med och forma framtidens smarta energisamhälle erbjuder vi dig ett utvecklande och omväxlande arbete med många kontaktytor. För oss på Vattenfall är det viktigt att arbete och privatliv har en god balans, därför erbjuder vi flexibilitet i arbetet samt möjlighet till att arbeta hemifrån vid behov. Vi har även en hel del andra personalförmåner som exempelvis arbetstidsförkortning, förmånliga tjänstepensionsavtal, föräldraledighetstillägg med mera. Läs mer om våra förmåner här. Placeringsort : Ringhals, Forsmark eller Solna För mer information om tjänsten kontakta rekryterande chef Linda Ahlbom, linda.ahlbom@vattenfall.com. För frågor om rekryteringsprocessen kontakta rekryterare Lea Skånberg, lea.skanberg@vattenfall.com. Fackliga representanter är Sofi Wadström (Akademikerna), Christer Gustafsson (Ledarna), Juha Siipilehto (SEKO) och Patricia Ek (Unionen). Du når samtliga via Vattenfalls växel, 08 739 50 00. Välkommen med din ansökan senast den 22 november 2026. Vi tar inte emot personligt brev i ansökan. Du söker snabbt och enkelt genom att svara på urvalsfrågor och bifoga ditt CV. Vi tar endast emot ansökningar via vår webbplats. I den här rekryteringsprocessen kommer tester att förekomma. På Vattenfall värdesätter vi att vara aktiva, positiva, öppna och säkerhetsmedvetna. Vi söker medarbetare som delar vår vision och kan bidra till att stärka vår företagskultur. Vi är övertygade om att mångfald bidrar till att bygga ett mer lönsamt och tilltalande företag och strävar efter att vara goda förebilder när det gäller mångfald. Vattenfall arbetar aktivt för att alla medarbetare ska ha samma möjligheter och rättigheter oavsett ålder, etnisk eller kulturell bakgrund, könstillhörighet, religion/tro, sexuell läggning eller funktionsvariation. En eventuell krigsplacering sker med stöd i anställningsavtalet och lagen om totalförsvarsplikt.

items.desc: When Anyfin goes down, someone’s loan payment doesn’t go through. Make sure it doesn’t. You open your laptop on Monday and find out the primary database failed at 3am on Sunday. Services reconnected in seconds and no customer noticed a thing. We’d practised exactly that failover the week before. If that’s your idea of a good weekend, we should talk. The foundation is built. Now it needs to scale. Anyfin helps people refinance expensive consumer credit on better terms. Since 2017 we’ve helped people across Sweden, Finland and Germany take back control of their finances. We’re profitable, we have a banking licence that lets us operate across the EU, and we’re getting ready to launch new products and enter new markets. Our ambition is to be a pan-European company by 2030. Every one of those steps puts more weight on our platform: more traffic, more integrations, more markets and more regulators who expect us to prove that we’re resilient, not just say it. The team is small and intentionally so. We’d rather grow what each engineer can do than how many engineers we have. The actual job You’ll own reliability across the platform. That covers how our services run on Kubernetes and GCP, how we deploy, how we scale and how we recover when something breaks. You’ll decide what “reliable enough” means for each part of the system and make it measurable. You’ll make problems visible before customers feel them. That means monitoring, alerting and logging that tell us what’s wrong and why, not dashboards nobody opens. When an alert fires, it should matter. You’ll make incidents boring. You’ll shape how we respond, who gets paged, how we communicate and how we learn. That means blameless reviews that lead to real changes, not just documents. You’ll build the paved road. Engineers should be able to ship safely and quickly without thinking about infrastructure every time. You’ll work on CI/CD, infrastructure as code and the tooling that makes the right way the easy way. You’ll help us meet the bar a bank is held to. As a regulated lender, operational resilience isn’t optional. You’ll help us turn requirements like DORA into systems and practices that actually work, not just policies we can point to. You’ll keep an eye on cost. Scaling into new markets shouldn’t mean scaling our cloud bill at the same rate. Reliability in an AI-native company AI isn’t a side tool here. It’s built into how we work across engineering, analytics, operations and product, and our tech team has built an AI-connected data and code environment on frontier models. That shows up in reliability work too. AI can help read logs, trace incidents and draft runbooks faster than any of us. It also means more systems in production act on data without questioning it, and more automation can change things on its own. Part of this role is working out what reliability means in that world: where AI makes us faster, where it needs guardrails, and how we make sure we’re never the last to know when something goes wrong. The people You’ll work closely with backend engineers, data engineers, product teams and our engineering managers, who care a lot about getting things right. Sometimes a little too much. Propose a new alert and someone will ask how many times it would have fired last month. We prefer it that way. They’re also generous with what they know, quick to laugh and happy to change their minds when you make a better case. As long as you can back it up. This sounds like you if… You have solid experience in SRE, platform or infrastructure engineering, ideally in a product company where reliability directly affects customers. You’ve run production workloads on Kubernetes in a cloud environment and are comfortable with infrastructure as code. You write real code, not just YAML. Our main stack is TypeScript, Node.js, Python and Go, running on Kubernetes and GCP. Experience with GCP and Terraform is a plus, but you don’t need to know every technology in our stack. You’re comfortable reading, debugging and improving services, and the judgment you bring matters more than ticking every box. You’ve built observability that people actually use, and you’ve been on call for systems that mattered. You know the difference between an alert and noise. You’re pragmatic. You care about reliability, but you know 100% uptime isn’t the goal and that over-engineering has a cost too. You can explain that trade-off to engineers and non-engineers alike. Experience from fintech, banking or another regulated environment is a plus, but not a requirement. More than anything, you can tell us about a system you made more reliable. Not just what you changed, but what it made possible for the team and the business. A few practical notes This role is based at our office on Drottninggatan 92 in Stockholm, and we work from the office. We think great teams and culture are built when people meet in person, especially at this stage. EU work authorisation is required. If you’d rather prevent the next …

items.desc: Har du flera år som digital strateg på byrå bakom dig och vill jobba där strategi, varumärke, design, teknik och innehåll finns under samma tak? Vi söker en senior digital strateg till vår fullservicebyrå, som använder AI i sitt eget arbete och hjälper kunderna att göra detsamma i sin affär. Om KAN KAN är en kreativ byrå som hjälper företag inom främst B2B, men också B2C, med webb, varumärke, innehåll, marknadsföring, Hubspot och AI. Våra kunder är allt från snabbrörliga scaleups till stora organisationer som medlemsorganisationer, fastighetsbolag och energibolag, och vi har även kunder inom offentlig sektor. Vi har kontor i Skrapan i Stockholm och vid Stortorget i Malmö, och vi jobbar utifrån vår devis Working With Friends. Om rollen Som digital strateg hjälper du kunder att hitta var affären kan växa och arbetet bli mer effektivt, och hur de kommer dit. Det kan vara en ny webbstrategi, ett bättre samspel mellan sälj och marknad i HubSpot eller ett första steg med AI där det faktiskt sparar tid eller ger bättre resultat. Du har en central roll i uppdragen och binder ihop våra kompetensteam inom varumärke, design, utveckling, innehåll och marknadsföring, så att kunden möter en helhet där allt hänger ihop. AI är en naturlig del av ditt eget arbete, från research och analys till koncept och prototyper. Rollen är bred och spänner över UX, webbstrategi, digital marknadsföring, martech och affärsutveckling. Vi räknar med att du har din spetskompetens inom ett eller två av dem och tillräcklig överblick över resten för att se helheten och veta när du ska ta in en kollega. Det här kommer du att göra Ta fram digitala strategier åt kunder, med AI där det gör nytta Leda workshops och analyser kring webb, UX och martech Hjälpa kunder att prioritera vad som ska göras först och vad det ska leda till Vara med i försäljningen och ta fram förslag tillsammans med kollegor Följa utvecklingen inom AI och dela med dig internt Vi tror att du Har runt tio års erfarenhet som digital strateg, UX-strateg, affärsutvecklare eller liknande, på byrå eller i en större organisation, och är van att på egen hand leda strategiarbete och vara kundens närmaste rådgivare Har god förståelse för UX, webbstrategi, digital marknadsföring och affärsutveckling och är särskilt stark inom minst ett av dem Använder AI dagligen och kan förklara för en kund hur det kan användas i deras verksamhet Utgår från affären och kopplar digitala insatser till mål som går att följa upp Trivs med kundkontakt och är bekväm med att leda möten eller workshops Har erfarenhet av HubSpot och vet hur plattformen kan användas för att effektivisera en organisation Vi erbjuder En roll där du får stort utrymme att påverka, både i kunduppdragen och i hur KAN utvecklar sitt arbete med digital strategi. Du får varierade uppdrag, cirka 100 kollegor som gärna delar med sig, friskvårdsbidrag och hälsoförsäkring, och eftersom vi har kollektivavtal får du även alla förmåner som följer med det. Ett par gånger om året samlas hela gänget för fest, resa eller någon annan aktivitet tillsammans. Du utgår från vårt kontor i Skrapan i Stockholm. Ansökan Låter det som du? Skicka ditt CV och några rader om varför rollen lockar dig. Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

items.desc: Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably. Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions. Apply now for the position of Product Verification Engineer, where you will apply your clinical experience in radiotherapy to system-level verification, helping ensure that our medical device systems support safe and effective clinical workflows. Your role You apply your radiotherapy experience to develop realistic test scenarios that reflect clinical workflows and intended use. You contribute to planning system-level verification for product releases and projects, considering requirements, design changes, risks and regression impact. You design and review test cases with a focus on clinically relevant workflows and perform hands-on formal and informal verification testing on complex medical device systems. You analyze test results, document complete and traceable objective evidence, report defects and support troubleshooting and problem analysis together with engineering teams. You contribute to requirement, design and risk reviews and collaborate with local and international stakeholders from Engineering, Product Management, Risk Management and other relevant areas. You contribute to the continuous improvement of verification methods, tools and processes and support knowledge sharing across the organization. You are willing to travel up to 10% as required. Your expertise A degree or equivalent professional qualification in a relevant clinical discipline, medical technology or a comparable field. Several years of hands-on clinical experience in radiotherapy, with a strong understanding of clinical workflows and the practical use of radiotherapy systems. Ability to translate clinical workflows and practical experience into structured test scenarios and clearly documented results. An analytical, structured and proactive approach, with the willingness to build technical expertise and work independently on complex systems. Strong commitment to product safety and quality. Fluent spoken and written English; German is an advantage. Experience creating radiotherapy treatment plans is an advantage. items.desc: We are seeking a Research Assistant to the Translational Neuropathology Group (TNG) led by Professor Laura Parkkinen, in the Nuffield Department of Clinical Neurosciences (NDCN), University of Oxford. The post is part of “Deciphering the Aggregatome: Unravelling Alpha-Synuclein Seeding Drivers in Parkinson’s Disease”, an international research programme supported by Aligning Science Across Parkinson’s (ASAP). The project brings together Oxford, the Max Planck Institute of Biochemistry and LMU Munich to investigate why Parkinson’s disease progresses differently between individuals and to identify molecular determinants of α-synuclein seeding. Misfolded α-synuclein aggregates are a defining pathological feature of Parkinson’s disease and related synucleinopathies. Seed amplification assays (SAAs), including RT-QuIC, can detect disease-associated α-synuclein seeding activity in human samples. The TNG group in Oxford has contributed to the development and application of these approaches in cerebrospinal fluid [1, 2] and to the biochemical characterisation of human brain-derived α-synuclein aggregates [3]. However, it remains unclear which molecular features explain differences in seeding activity and clinical progression. The collaborative project will investigate the “aggregatome”, the molecular environment associated with α-synuclein aggregates, including interacting proteins, post-translational modifications, lipids and glycosaminoglycans. Complementary SAAs will be combined with biochemical and structural analyses, spatially resolved measurements and multi-omics data across brain tissue, cerebrospinal fluid, blood and skin. By comparing matched and longitudinal samples, the consortium aims to distinguish factors associated with seeding from those that functionally modify it, and to identify potential biomarkers and therapeutic targets. At Oxford, the postholder will contribute primarily to the experimental characterisation and quantification of α-synuclein seeding and to the preparation and analysis of human biosamples. Working with Professor Parkkinen and under the day-to-day supervision of Dr Livia Civitelli, they will collaborate with scientists in Oxford and across the ASAP Collaborative Research Network. This is an opportunity to develop specialist skills in translational neuropathology, quantitative assays, reproducible data analysis and open science within a multidisciplinary international programme. The postholder will optimise, perform and quality-control α-synuclein SAAs on cerebrospinal fluid and brain-derived material, and, as required by the study plan, other human biomaterials. They will support complementary assay formats, including quantitative, recursive and in situ approaches [4-6], where appropriate to their training and project priorities; compare assay kinetics and seeding profiles; and assist with biochemical and morphological characterisation of native and amplified aggregates. They will maintain rigorous sample traceability, experimental records and reproducible analysis workflows, and contribute data and protocols to consortium-wide analyses and outputs. Whether it’s a Friday-night feast, a post-gym poke bowl, or grabbing some groceries, our tech platform connects tens of millions of customers with hundreds of thousands of restaurant, grocery and convenience partners across the globe. Messaging is the central nervous system of our software and microservices, as the team tasked to enable integrations in this space we take pride in being innovative, efficient and reliable. Our vision is to make messaging easy, to give our product and engineering teams time back so they can focus on what our customers needs. Take responsibility for supporting your changes all the way through to proving that they work well – and continue to work well – in production. Support our components in production, being part of an on-call rota. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. Role Overview As a Junior Application Security Analyst in the Information Security team, you will help secure Checkout.com’s software applications throughout the Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC). You will work closely with developers and product teams to integrate security early in the development process, identify and oversee the remediation of vulnerabilities, and ensure adherence to secure coding practices and application security standards. This role focuses on practical, hands-on security support while also growing your expertise in application security. Key Responsibilities SSDLC & Secure Coding Assist in integrating security controls into the SSDLC. Support the creation and maintenance of secure coding guidelines (e.g., OWASP Top 10, CERT Secure Coding Standards). Application Security Testing Run a Static Application Security Testing (SAST) and Software Composition Analysis (SCA) scans. Conduct API security testing. Support CI/CD pipelines to keep secure and effective integration. Threat Modeling & Application Security Analysis Participate in threat modeling sessions. Document identified threats, assess risks and provide mitigation recommendations. Assist in code and system reviews to analyse security in company’s products. Vulnerability Management Triage and prioritise vulnerabilities from automated scans. Track, verify and ensure security flaws remediation. Assist to automate an AppSec pipelines Collaboration & Awareness Collaborate with engineering teams to integrate security into product design and improve existing systems. Help deliver training and awareness on SSDLC best practices and secure coding. Contribute to security documentations. Required Skills & Experience 1–3 years in application security, secure software development, or related IT/security role. Understand basic network technologies and protocols (HTTP, TCP/IP, DNS and the OSI model). Understanding of common software vulnerabilities and their mitigations. Basic programming experience in a popular language (e.g., Python, JavaScript, Golang). Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps principles. Basic understanding of cloud technologies (AWS, GCP or Azure) and GitHub security features. Strong attention to detail in documentation and assessments. Preferred Familiarity with SAST/DAST/SCA tools and API security testing platforms. Exposure to cloud-native application security (AWS, Azure, GCP). Understanding of container security (Docker, Kubernetes). Experience of participating in Capture The Flag (CTF) competitions. Key Competencies Eager to learn and expand technical skills in application security. Effective communicator with both technical and non-technical audiences. Collaborative and proactive problem solver. Ability to prioritise work. It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable. Life at Checkout.com We understand that work is just one part of your life. items.desc: Are you caring, compassionate and committed to delivering patient-centred care? An exciting opportunity has arisen for a nurse working as a band 6 or 7, who are looking for a new challenge or to progress to a Guided Care Matron. In Hillingdon we are transforming our model of case management as part of the North West London - Integrated Care model. You will work as part of a Care Connection Team (CCT) in Hillingdon, providing anticipatory care to patients to prevent escalation of their health and or social care needs, thereby reducing the risk of emergency hospital admissions. The service works with patients over the age of 18 years with one more or of the following conditions; COPD, Stroke, Cardio Vascular Disease, Dementia, Social Isolation and Diabetes Mellitus. You will work to develop care plans for the patients on the CCT caseload, and proactively seek to identify at risk patients. You will be part of a once weekly huddle meeting with each of your CCT's, to discuss patients on your caseload and formulate their care plans. Where appropriate, you will make referrals to key stakeholders such as other community services e.g. district nurses, geriatrician, social services and third sector. The distance nurses travel each day is considerable and you will need to use a motor vehicle to carry out domiciliary visits. You will work autonomously to provide a full range of services predominantly to house bound patients including care homes and supported living, and will be skilled in carrying out Holistic assessments. The role also involves managerial aspects such as attending key meetings and supervision of junior staff such as Healthcare Support Workers, Senior Administrative Co-ordinators and Student nurses. The GCM will work closely with GPs to proactively identify patients (aged 18+) with high risk complex needs. They will provide a proactive, holistic approach to managing patients with long-term conditions that is centered on primary care and the prevention of avoidable hospital admissions. The focus will be on providing comprehensive assessments, individualized care plans and coordination for complex patients in their usual place of residence including care homes. The GCM will enable the patient, carers/care home staff and families to understand their disease or condition, how to recognize early symptoms and proactively manage their care decisions. The GCM will work as part of a multi- disciplinary team and will develop care plans for the patients on the Care Connection Team (CCT) caseload, supported by the CCT. GCMs will attend once or twice weekly huddles with the CCT to discuss patients on their caseload and formulate care plans. Where appropriate, referrals will be made to key stakeholders such as other community services e.g. district nurses, geriatrician, social services and third sector. The distance nurses travel each day is considerable and the GCM nurses use of their own car to carry out their domiciliary visits. The GCM works autonomously to provide a full range of services predominantly to house bound patients including residential and nursing homes and will be skilled in carrying out Holistic assessments.

Because that’s who we’re doing it for – the communities and businesses that make our town great. As part of the Council, you’ll support a friendly local authority making decisions with real impact. It’s all for better public services. Better processes. And a better quality of life, for everyone. Join us, and Swindon will be better with you. Your next role This is an exciting time to join an established team, within the education service. The role will involve cyclical data returns and review of data, as well as fast paced capital delivery. As a key member of the Education Place Planning Team, the role involves undertaking a range of planning functions, including school place planning, the client role for the implementation of building schemes, the delivery of education reorganisations, and many Capital projects for primary and secondary phases. This involves taking the strategic lead role for long-term planning for education in Swindon and ensuring that the implication of future demand is thoroughly researched and planned for. The role will require data interrogation to develop co-ordinated responses to drive school places to where they are needed. The Team works closely with several partners and stakeholders, including schools, Multi Academy Trusts, the Department for Education, and other council directorates such as Planning, Architecture and Construction, Property and Legal services, Council Members, and Parish Council. The successful candidate will require the following skills and experience – You will need to have excellent and successful customer service skills. Previous extensive experience of working with Schools, Governing Bodies, Members and other customers in a constructive way with excellent stakeholder management skills. Be keen to work as part of a team but also under your own initiative. Be a conscientious person, willing to go that extra mile and take responsibility and accountability for your area of work. Possess excellent and proven communication and interpersonal skills at all levels. Able to use IT packages and will be able to analyse and interpret data. You will be required to have good attention to detail skills and also strategic vision. Ability to obtain an Enhanced Disclosure and Barring Service is required for the postholder. The ability to travel throughout the Borough will be required and access to a car to attend meetings and visit school projects to monitor progress . The team operates a hybrid working model with team members expected to be in the office for a minimum of three days per week. You must be fluent in the English language (as a requirement of Part 7 of the Immigration Act “for the effective performance of a customer-facing role”). Your next package Please see our Rewards and Benefits offer for more details. As an employee, you will receive a diverse and exciting environment in which to work, encouraging creativity and innovation whilst recognising the need to support ongoing personal development and a flexible work life balance. For Swindon to thrive in the future, we need to lay the foundations now. It’s why our regeneration and transformation programmes are already underway. So, you’ll be joining us at an exciting time on our journey. We’ll look to you to share your knowledge, influence decisions and drive real, positive change. With your contributions, we’ll achieve our vision of a prosperous, revitalised Swindon together. And you’ll be proud to say it was made better with you. Please see our Vision and Values page for more details and our new Swindon Plan. Potential applicants are sometimes put off if they don’t meet 100% of the requirements. We think individual experience, skills and passion make all the difference, so if you meet the majority of the criteria, we’d love to hear from you. Your next steps Please read the role profile, which is available in the documents section to the righthand side of the page. To submit an application for this role, select Quick Apply. As an inclusive employer, we welcome applications from a diverse range of communities, and in particular disabled people and people from ethnic minorities. Read our statement of commitment to equality & inclusion. items.desc: Please Note - Lived Experience is a Requirement For This Role East Ayrshire Churches Homelessness Action (EACHa) is an ecumenical and registered Scottish charity of over 20 years dedicated to tackling homelessness, poverty, addiction, and social exclusion. Rooted in values of compassion, dignity, inclusion, and justice, we unite churches, faith groups, community members, professionals and those with lived and living experience in a shared mission - to support those facing complex life challenges. We are currently delivering a pioneering One Stop Shop model in the heart of Kilmarnock — a holistic, trauma-informed service hub that integrates recovery, crisis response, harm reduction, peer support, digital inclusion, and access to practical essentials, all under one welcoming roof. Our model removes traditional barriers to support by creating a space where individuals can drop in, be heard without judgment, and receive the care, connection, and consistency they need to begin or sustain their recovery journey. This approach recognises that no single service can meet every need in isolation. By blending professional expertise with lived experience and co-produced solutions, our One Stop Shop brings together people, services, and opportunities in a way that is truly person-led. It is a bold reimagining of how recovery, inclusion, and community resilience can be built from the ground up. Through partnership, innovation, and a firm belief in the potential of every individual, EACHa is working to create a more connected, compassionate society where everyone has the opportunity to recover, rebuild, and thrive. Role Overview The Peer Outreach Worker will play a vital role in reaching individuals not yet engaged with formal services and supporting their transition into the East Ayrshire Recovery Community and RADAR (Rapid Access to Drug and Alcohol Recovery). Using lived experience as a foundation, the postholder will offer non-judgmental support, guidance, and encouragement to people facing challenges related to alcohol or drug use. The role will focus on outreach to those most at risk, building trust through shared experience, and helping individuals take their first steps into recovery. Working alongside the wider EACH Recovery Matters team, the Peer Outreach Worker will deliver peer mentoring, support activities, and connection to services that promote hope, inclusion, and long-term change. Key Responsibilities Outreach & Engagement Identify and connect with individuals at risk or disengaged from services, particularly those with problematic alcohol or drug use. Offer outreach support in community settings, including streets, hostels, homes, or informal drop-ins. Build trusting, non-judgmental relationships based on empathy, confidentiality, and shared experience. Pathways to Recovery Encourage and support individuals to access EACH Recovery Matter, RADAR and the wider East Ayrshire Recovery Network. Provide personalised support to help individuals navigate recovery services, including attendance at initial appointments or group activities. Signpost to other support including housing, health, harm reduction, and welfare rights where needed. Peer Support & Advocacy Act as a mentor and positive role model for individuals beginning their recovery journey. Create a safe and welcoming recovery environment, encouraging self-worth, empowerment, and mutual aid. Advocate on behalf of individuals to ensure their voice is heard and needs are met. Activity & Community Development Support the planning and delivery of therapeutic and social recovery activities that foster connection and self-esteem. Assist in developing community initiatives and events that promote recovery, raise awareness, and reduce stigma. Co-produce recovery solutions with local people, organisations, and communities. Partnership & Collaboration Build strong working relationships with treatment services, community groups, harm reduction teams, and other partners. Help bridge gaps between statutory services and community recovery options. Contribute to a trauma-informed, recovery-oriented system of care across East Ayrshire. Essential Criteria Lived experience of recovery from problematic alcohol or drug use is mandatory Must be a minimum of 12 months clear of problematic alcohol use and/or illicit or non-prescribed drug use Knowledge of Scotland’s Medication-Assisted Treatment (MAT) Standards and commitment to the principles of the Charter of Rights Experience supporting others in their recovery, either formally or informally Understanding of trauma, stigma, and the barriers people face when engaging with services Ability to work flexibly and independently in community-based and outreach settings Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build trust quickly Commitment to recovery, inclusion, and equality PVG Scheme membership and satisfactory disclosure Flexibility to work occasional evenings/weekends as needed Desirable Criteria Experience of …

items.desc: About Us Salience Labs is building an industry-defining approach to optical circuit switching for AI infrastructure, engineered for real latency reduction and cost savings. We’re moving towards real-world deployment, and joining at this stage means genuine ownership over that next chapter, working alongside a highly technical team on one of the most consequential problems in AI infrastructure today. About the Role We’re looking for a Photonic Component Modelling Engineer to build and qualify behavioral and compact models that accurately capture the underlying device physics. Your models will be the foundation for system-level verification of systems that combine photonic and electronic components. You’ll need to understand how a component’s behavior shifts with its surrounding optical and electrical circuitry and with operating conditions. What You’ll Do Working closely with the system verification, photonic design, and photonic characterization teams, you will: Develop and maintain models of optical primitives (modulators, switches, photodetectors, couplers, etc.) for simulation and system verification environments Verify that models accurately represent device physics across process, voltage, and temperature (PVT) corners Release models that pass defined QA criteria Verify PDK component libraries so that PDK updates and process variations don’t break circuit-level simulations Extract model parameters from lab measurements and work with characterization to correlate simulation with measurement Build and maintain automated tooling (Python and/or MATLAB) for parameter extraction, model fitting, and regression tracking Maintain regression suites so model and PDK changes are checked against reference data before release Resolve model discrepancies found at system level and feed model-based design risks back to photonic design Keep reproducible records: version-controlled models, scripts, reference data, and QA results What You Bring Required MS/PhD (or equivalent experience) in photonics, electrical engineering, applied physics, or a related field 3+ years of experience in photonic component design and/or simulation Solid understanding of integrated photonic building blocks, both passive and active, and their electrical drive requirements Strong scripting ability (Python and/or MATLAB) for model fitting, data analysis, and simulation/measurement correlation Comfortable working in Linux and with version-controlled repositories Strong documentation habits, including model specifications, QA reports, and traceability from reference data to released models Clear communication and a collaborative approach across disciplines Nice to have Experience modelling signal propagation in photonic integrated circuits Hands-on experience with silicon photonics platforms Experience with optical/photonic simulation tools (e.g., FDTD, mode solvers, circuit-level simulators) Familiarity with foundry PDK-based photonic design flows Tcl scripting

items.desc: Hi We're Legl. Legl is building the operating system for modern legal services. We help law firms and regulated businesses replace manual, fragmented workflows with intelligent software, from client onboarding and compliance to payments, risk, and reporting. Legal work is high-stakes: it's regulated, complex, and deeply impactful. Our mission is to help regulated firms grow faster, run their businesses more profitably, manage risk intelligently, and deliver great client experiences. We're backed by leading European VCs, scaling quickly, partnered with over 600 law firms including 50 of the UK's top 200, launched in the UK and Australia, and entering our next phase of growth. We Work Best When AI is the central operating model: not a tool or a future plan, but the way we run. Decisions live with people: you're trusted to make calls and own them. Think deeply, execute quickly: speed and rigour, not speed or rigour. What You'll Do As a Technical Solutions Engineer at Legl, you’ll play a crucial hands-on role at the intersection of product, engineering and customer delivery. Embed with customers to map how they work. At kick-off, sit with the customer's teams, IT and third parties to understand their workflows, systems and data, then design how Legl connects into them. Stand up the deployment. Scope the integration, coordinate the customer's IT and partners, configure and deploy, and verify it actually works before and after go-live. You own the technical workstream inside every launch. Build and tune what each customer needs. Craft configurations, data mappings and lightweight integrations, writing simple scripts or API calls where it helps. Nothing requiring a CS degree, but you're not afraid of a terminal. Drive adoption across the installed base. Find the workflows that prove value fast, help existing customers switch integrations on, and monitor usage so their teams are getting everything they can out of them. Support commercial teams. Join prospect and customer calls as the technical voice, run discovery with customer developers and help Sales and CS scope integration requirements. This Role Is a Great Fit If You… Are as happy sitting with a customer's developer team working through a data sync as you are presenting to their partners about what it will do for them. Obsess over understanding customer goals, timelines and problems, and measure yourself on whether the thing you set up actually gets used. Are comfortable owning the customer-facing side of our technical deployments, and collaborating heavily across Sales, Customer Success, Support, EPD and our partners. Have some Python, or experience with no-code / low-code tooling, and have worked directly with founders or senior leadership in a scale-up. Love the complexity of technical delivery and commercial customer problems at the edge of legaltech operations. This Role Is Not a Great Fit If You… Would rather develop in isolation instead of getting stuck in with customer teams. Are lost when it comes to APIs and integration patterns. Dislike ambiguity. Every day is a school day! Can't adapt to new tooling, platforms and ways of working. We work across a broad tech stack with our customers, and ship every day.

For QA assignments, review completed work, check its quality, and provide feedback based on project guidelines. Qualifications Requirements: Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree in a relevant field, such as: Geographic Information Science (GIS) or Geospatial Science. Strong geospatial expertise gained through professional experience, academic research, or both. Experience working with geospatial data and tools such as QGIS, ArcGIS, GeoPandas, Google Earth Engine, or Google Earth. Experience applying geospatial analysis to real-world problems or research projects. Ability to evaluate complex questions, identify missing information, and explain analytical assumptions and methods. Strong written communication skills in English.  Department: Sales Enablement & Activation

 Overview   
 Sales Enablement & Activation defines and governs the sales motion architecture, orchestrates adoption and change for all tool rollouts and process changes, and designs shared standards and content for cross-unit enablement – unlocking cross-unit value and turning strong local capabilities into shared, scalable enterprise advantage.  
 Within it, Sales Enablement defines enablement design standards and partners with SMEs and Sales Units to create sales-specific cross-unit content – governing what content exists, where it lives, and when it is used, while consolidating, standardising, and retiring low-value material to keep the sales asset base focused and current.  
 The Big Picture 
 As our Learning Portfolio Consultant, you will own, govern, and streamline our cross-unit enablement catalogue. You will be the architect of portfolio clarity—turning local materials and central assets into a lean, credible, and easily accessible enablement engine that empowers sales teams globally. 
 How You’ll Make an Impact 
 Build the Single Source of Truth: Establish and maintain the comprehensive cross-unit enablement catalogue—mapping existing learning assets across all Sales Units and mapping them against real sales roles and skill baselines. 
 Rationalize & Reduce Overload: Hunt down overlap, duplication, and conflicting materials. Partner with stakeholders to consolidate resources, retire low-value assets, and keep our content landscape clean and high-impact. 
 Drive Content Governance: Apply lifecycle frameworks to audit currency and relevance. Coordinate regular reviews with content owners to ensure everything in the catalogue is up-to-date and tied directly to active sales motions. 
 Collaborate Across Boundaries: Engage with Sales Units, subject matter experts, and regional teams to build shared visibility and ensure local innovations feed into our broader enterprise advantage. 
 What You Bring to the Table 
 Portfolio Expertise: Hands-on background managing, auditing, and rationalizing learning or content portfolios at scale across diverse stakeholder groups. 
 Governance Know-How: Deep familiarity with content lifecycle management—knowing how to review, consolidate, and gracefully retire out-of-date assets. 
 Analytical Mindset: Demonstrated ability to map learning content against competency frameworks and role catalogues to spot coverage gaps instantly. 
 A Builder's Pragmatism: You thrive in a greenfielding environment where frameworks are still taking shape. You know how to apply structure and drive momentum without waiting for perfection. 
 Communication & Collaboration: Exceptional coordination and influencing skills across time zones, backed by high proficiency in written and spoken English. 
 You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!

Our technology is powered by innovation, fueled by the diverse thinking and the unique merits of our people.  Einstellort ist unser Standort in Chemnitz. Die Einarbeitung erfolgt an unserem Standort in Berlin.

 Verändere die Welt von morgen: 
 Du führst selbstständig metallographische Untersuchungen an metallischen Werkstoffen durch, indem du beispielsweise Schliffpräparationen und Ätzungen vornimmst sowie lichtmikroskopische Verfahren einsetzt
 Im Anschluss bewertest du Gefügestrukturen und identifizierst mögliche Schadensbilder, um fundierte Aussagen über den Zustand und die Eigenschaften der Werkstoffe zu treffen
 Darauf aufbauend dokumentierst und analysierst du die Untersuchungsergebnisse gemäß relevanter Normen wie DIN EN ISO und stellst deren Nachvollziehbarkeit sicher
 Zusätzlich unterstützt du bei werkstofftechnischen Prüfungen und trägst aktiv zur Schadensanalyse bei, um die Qualität und Sicherheit unserer Produkte zu gewährleisten
 Abschließend arbeitest du eng mit den Abteilungen Entwicklung, Qualitätssicherung und Produktion zusammen, um Untersuchungsergebnisse zielgerichtet weiterzugeben und Prozesse kontinuierlich zu verbessern
 So überzeugst du uns: 
 Ausbildung : Du hast eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Metallograph/in oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit langjähriger einschlägiger Berufserfahrung. Alternativ verfügst du über eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung mit Weiterbildung zum Meister/in und mehrjähriger einschlägiger Berufserfahrung
 Erfahrungen und Kenntnisse : Du hast umfassende Erfahrung in der Präparation und Analyse metallischer und keramischer Werkstoffe
 Du bist sicher im Umgang mit lichtmikroskopischen Verfahren
 Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse in der Werkstoffkunde und relevanten Normen wie DIN EN ISO
 Arbeitsweise : Du überzeugst durch sorgfältige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise, Teamfähigkeit und eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität
 Sprachkenntnisse : Du verfügst über verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; Englischkenntnisse sind wünschenswert
 Du bist viel mehr als deine Qualifikationen und wir glauben an das Potential jeder einzelnen Person. Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!
 Bei Siemens sind wir überzeugt: Wer sich wertgeschätzt und zugehörig fühlt, kann das eigene Potenzial voll entwickeln. Deshalb schaffen wir ein inklusives Arbeitsumfeld, in dem jede Person ein Gefühl der Zugehörigkeit erfährt und in dem individuelle Perspektiven und Erfahrungen geschätzt werden. Unser Engagement für Fairness und Respekt gilt für alle Bewerbenden.
 Wir legen Wert auf Chancengleichheit und freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, ausdrücklich auch von Menschen mit Behinderung. Bei gleicher Qualifikation werden schwerbehinderte und gleichgestellte Bewerberinnen und Bewerber bevorzugt berücksichtigt.
 Über Uns Bist du bereit, die Energiewende voranzutreiben?
 Unsere Mission ist es, innovative und nachhaltige Lösungen zu entwickeln, die sowohl Energieeinsparungen ermöglichen als auch den CO₂-Fußabdruck von Gebäuden und Infrastrukturen reduzieren. Deshalb setzen wir bei Siemens im Bereich Smart Infrastructure Electrification & Automation alles daran, eine grünere Zukunft zu gestalten und unsere Lebens- und Arbeitsweise zu revolutionieren.

Depuis 170 ans, Abeille Assurances protège et accompagne près de 3 millions de clients (particuliers et entreprises) à chaque étape de leur vie. Abeille Assurances, en quelques chiffres, c’est près de 9 milliards de CA en 2025, en progression de plus de 23% ; et désormais 3 900 collaborateurs en France. Nous sommes intégrés à AEMA Groupe. Nous rejoindre, c’est intégrer un collectif moderne, engagé pour le climat, les territoires et les actions fortes de RSE. C’est aussi adhérer à une entreprise qui promeut l’inclusion, l’égalité et la diversité. Votre environnement de travail Au sein de la Direction Dommage et Santé, l’équipe R&D Data Science réalise des travaux de détection et de lutte contre la fraude. A partir de données structurées provenant de sources internes et externes, l'équipe R&D Data Science réalise des modèles en utilisant des techniques Statistiques ou de Machine Learning. Vos Missions Le/La stagiaire aura pour mission, en collaboration avec les équipes et directions métier concernées, de : Analyser et préparer les données fraude afin de construire un socle de données fiable pour la modélisation. Améliorer et enrichir les modèles supervisés de détection de fraude existants, en étudiant notamment l'apport de techniques de rééquilibrage des classes (SMOTE, données synthétiques, etc.) et en comparant leurs performances. Mettre en œuvre des algorithmes de détection d’anomalies pour identifier des comportements atypiques ou des schémas de fraude émergents. Construire des indicateurs d’incertitude des prédictions afin de repérer les dossiers nécessitant une expertise complémentaire. Combiner les différents scores (modèle supervisé, anomalie, incertitude) pour élaborer une stratégie de classification des dossiers en trois catégories : non fraude, fraude et suspicion de fraude. Développer un prototype d’aide à la décision et évaluer sa performance en vue de son intégration dans le processus de génération d’alertes à destination des équipes de lutte contre la fraude. Votre profil Vous êtes actuellement en formation supérieure en Master 2 Data Sciences, IA ou Ecole d’Ingénieur. Vous maitrisez Python. Vous souhaitez intégrer une équipe jeune et dynamique et travailler sur des sujets en lien avec des problématiques concrètes. Votre rigueur, votre esprit de synthèse, votre motivation et votre aisance relationnelle seront indispensables pour réussir ce stage. Vous devrez également faire preuve d’autonomie et de proactivité pour mener à bien les missions qui vous seront confiées. Rejoindre Abeille Assurances, c’est intégrer une entreprise qui prend soin de ses talents autant que de ses clients. Nous offrons un cadre de travail équilibré et pensé pour favoriser votre développement professionnel et personnel. Nous offrons, notamment : Une gratification fixe, Un remboursement de transport flexible, encadré par un forfait mobilité durable, pour favoriser les mobilités douces. Un environnement de travail chaleureux et convivial 100 % en flex-office, facilement accessible en transport.
