Integrate identity data from the WAVE ERP system to drive Joiner/Mover/Leaver (JML) processes. Manage synchronization and identity federation between Microsoft Active Directory and Azure Active Directory (Entra ID). Define and implement access governance, including role modelling, segregation of duties (SoD), and access review campaigns. Develop automated workflows for account provisioning, deprovisioning, and entitlement management across all ICT platforms. Collaborate with HR, Information Security, and Compliance teams to enforce identity related policies. Enforce Just-In-Time (JIT) access for sensitive operations. Monitor and respond to identity-related incidents and service requests. Create and maintain IAM documentation including architecture diagrams, SOPs, and audit records. Supervise the IAM team and conduct effective performance management and promote a cooperative work environment. MICROSOFT ACTIVE DIRECTORY AND ENTRA ID Ensure correct operation of hybrid identity sync from AD to Entra ID via Azure AD Connect and monitor sync health and conflict resolution. Define entitlement management with access packages for joiners/movers/leavers. Enforce naming conventions and OU placement standards. Manage service accounts with lifecycle governance (preferably with expiration controls). Manage access using Azure AD roles, administrative units, and custom roles. Assign privileged roles via Privileged Identity Management (PIM) with time-bound or approval-based access. Define Conditional Access Policies based on risk, device, location, and user sensitivity. items.desc: Autoguidovie | Digital, Innovation & AI Vuoi vedere i tuoi modelli diventare strumenti utilizzati ogni giorno? In Autoguidovie lavoriamo per portare dati, software e intelligenza artificiale nel cuore della mobilità. Cerchiamo una persona con 4–5 anni di esperienza in Data Science , che voglia seguire progetti completi: dalla comprensione del problema allo sviluppo, fino alla messa in produzione. Dati diversi, sfide diverse La varietà dei problemi è uno degli aspetti più interessanti del ruolo. Potrai sviluppare soluzioni in ambiti diversi: Clienti: segmentazione, churn prediction, modelli di propensione all’acquisto e al rinnovo, next best action e personalizzazione delle interazioni. Persone e HR: analisi di turnover e retention, competenze, talent management e percorsi di crescita. Servizio e territorio: previsione della domanda, regolarità delle corse, analisi dei ritardi e supporto alla pianificazione. Flotta e operations: rilevazione di anomalie, analisi dei consumi, manutenzione e individuazione dei fattori associati alla sinistrosità. La sfida sarà anche collegare questi ambiti, costruendo strumenti utili a chi ogni giorno prende decisioni e gestisce il servizio. Cosa farai Tradurrai le esigenze aziendali in problemi affrontabili con i dati, definendo risultati attesi e criteri di successo. Preparerai dataset e feature, curando qualità, tracciabilità e aggiornamento dei dati. Svilupperai e validerai modelli statistici e di machine learning, valutandone robustezza, interpretabilità e utilità. Trasformerai modelli e logiche analitiche in API e servizi richiamabili da applicazioni e agenti AI : scoring, previsioni, stime del rischio di abbandono e next best action. Contribuirai a rilascio, containerizzazione e monitoraggio delle soluzioni, seguendone le prestazioni anche dopo la messa in produzione. Renderai i risultati fruibili attraverso dashboard, prototipi e semplici interfacce, raccogliendo feedback dagli utenti. Con chi lavorerai Entrerai nel team Digital, Innovation & AI , in un ambiente basato su Azure e Databricks , collaborando con: Data Engineer , per fonti, pipeline e qualità dei dati. Forward Deployment & Eval Engineer , per integrare modelli e strumenti nei processi e nei sistemi agentici, valutarne il comportamento su task completi e affrontare i problemi che emergono nell’utilizzo operativo. Business Analyst e referenti aziendali , per comprendere i processi, definire i requisiti e misurare i risultati. Avrai autonomia tecnica sui progetti assegnati, con il supporto e il confronto delle altre competenze del team. Cosa cerchiamo 4–5 anni di esperienza in Data Science , con progetti portati in produzione. Solida conoscenza di Python e SQL , statistica, machine learning e metodi di validazione. Capacità di scrivere codice strutturato, testabile e manutenibile, utilizzando Git. Esperienza con REST API e servizi di inferenza, ad esempio FastAPI o Flask. Familiarità operativa con Docker e ambienti cloud, preferibilmente Azure. Autonomia, curiosità per i processi aziendali e capacità di comunicare con interlocutori tecnici e non tecnici. Laurea in una disciplina quantitativa o percorso professionale equivalente. Un valore in più: esperienza con Databricks, Spark/PySpark, MLflow, MLOps e CI/CD; customer o people analytics; forecasting, ottimizzazione, dati geospaziali o telemetria; LLM, tool calling e applicazioni analitiche come Streamlit, Dash o Power BI. Perché unirti a noi Potrai lavorare su problemi diversi, confrontarti direttamente con chi utilizzerà le tue soluzioni e seguirne l’evoluzione oltre il primo rilascio. Un’opportunità per ampliare le tue competenze e vedere il contributo del tuo lavoro sui servizi di mobilità. Retribuzione annua lorda indicativa fra 45 e 55 mila euro, secondo esperienza. Candidati e raccontaci un tuo progetto: il problema iniziale, il tuo contributo, come hai portato la soluzione in produzione e cosa hai imparato dal suo utilizzo. Se disponibili, puoi condividere repository o demo privi di informazioni riservate.

items.desc: V České republice i na Slovensku nám důvěřuje více než 3 miliony klientů, o které společně pečujeme. Jsme různorodý tým – propojujeme generace, ženy tvoří 33 % našeho managementu a mezi kolegy máme i osoby se zdravotním znevýhodněním. Právě na této rozmanitosti si zakládáme, protože nás posouvá dál a pomáhá nám být každý den lepší. I díky tomu jsme získali další významná ocenění. Naše pojištění domova, životní pojištění, produkty pro krytí kybernetických rizik i spořicí řešení ve 2. pilíři byly oceněny Zlatou mincí 2025. Produkt Pojištění snížené soběstačnosti navíc získal titul Objev roku na Slovensku. Práce v UNIQA. Better works for me. V současné době hledáme vhodného kandidáta či vhodnou kandidátku na pozici: AI Operations Specialist Umělá inteligence má smysl tehdy, když přináší konkrétní výsledky. Pojďme je společně hledat a realizovat. Pokud vás baví hledat příležitosti, kde může AI odvést práci efektivněji, rozumíte procesům a dokážete propojit potřeby byznysu s technologiemi, rádi vás poznáme. Co bude náplní vaší práce? Hledání příležitostí pro využití AI – budete analyzovat procesy a požadavky jednotlivých týmů a navrhovat, kde může AI omezit manuální práci, zvýšit produktivitu nebo zlepšit zákaznickou zkušenost. Tvorba a rozvoj AI řešení – budete navrhovat, konfigurovat a spravovat AI agenty, chatboty, voiceboty a mailboty na firemních platformách – od prvotního návrhu přes testování až po nasazení a další optimalizaci. Nastavení toho, jak AI funguje – budete vytvářet konverzační scénáře, definovat business logiku, pravidla zpracování požadavků a způsob předávání složitějších případů zaměstnancům. Práce se znalostmi a kvalitou odpovědí – postaráte se o to, aby AI řešení pracovala s aktuálními a relevantními informacemi. Vyhodnocování výsledků – budete sledovat výkonnost a přínosy AI řešení, hledat možnosti jejich zlepšení a připravovat podklady pro další rozhodování. Spolupráce napříč týmy – propojíte potřeby Operations s kolegy z IT, Data & AI, IT architektury a bezpečnosti i s externími partnery. Spolupracovat budete na úrovni Česka a Slovenska i celé skupiny UNIQA. Rozvoj AI v každodenní praxi – budete sledovat nové trendy v generativní AI a autonomních AI agentech a hledat způsoby, jak je využít v praxi. Důležité bude nejen nové řešení vytvořit, ale také zajistit jeho spolehlivost, bezpečnost, soulad s interními pravidly a skutečný přínos pro uživatele. Co od vás očekáváme? Znalosti AI, generativní AI a jazykových modelů (LLM) a rozumíte jejich využití v praxi. Orientaci v návrhu, konfiguraci a testování AI agentů, chatbotů, voicebotů a mailbotů. Porozumění principům Conversational AI, návrhu dialogů, prompt engineeringu a práci se znalostními bázemi (RAG). Znalosti moderních AI technologií a nástrojů, například vektorové databáze, dokumentové inteligence, STT/TTS a Microsoft Power Platform. Přehled o cloudových platformách, zejména Microsoft Azure, a o integraci podnikových systémů prostřednictvím API. Schopnost analyzovat procesy, hledat příležitosti k automatizaci a navrhovat efektivní AI řešení podle potřeb zákazníka. Analytické a kritické myšlení, schopnost srozumitelně prezentovat své návrhy a výsledky zákazníkům, odborníkům i managementu. Angličtinu na komunikativní úrovni Co vám nabízíme? Zajímavou práci v silné a stabilní společnosti skupiny UNIQA Příjemné pracovní prostředí a přátelský kolektiv Férový a transparentní přístup Možnost obdržet roční bonus ve výši až 2násobku mzdy Zkrácený pracovní týden na 37,5 hodiny, 5 týdnů dovolené, 3 dny osobního volna za rok, pružná pracovní doba, home office Bezplatné psychologické, právní, finanční a sociální poradenství pro vás i vaše blízké Bezplatná online lékařská péče, konzultace a objednávání ke specialistům Skupinové životní pojištění UNIQA plně hrazené zaměstnavatelem Restart Break – příležitost načerpat nové síly po 5 letech u nás Celou řadu dalších atraktivních firemních benefitů (stravenkový paušál, systém Cafeterie a/nebo Multisport karta, příspěvek na výuku AJ, firemní akce, pitný režim na pracovišti, zvýhodněné firemní produkty, příspěvek na penzijní připojištění/doplňkové penzijní spoření/dlouhodobý investiční produkt, benefit pro spolurodiče po narození dítěte, odměna za pracovní výročí, den volna pro rodiče prvňáčka v první školní den, příspěvek na tábory, školy v přírodě a sportovní výcviky dětí, atd.) Možnost osobního rozvoje a profesního růstu Lokalita: Praha nebo Brno nebo Bratislava Zaujala vás naše nabídka? Těšíme se na vaši reakci včetně zaslání profesního životopisu!

items.desc: Job Description Who we are ADC is a boutique data and AI consultancy with offices in the Netherlands, Sweden and Denmark, and an award-winning data design studio (CLEVER°FRANKE) embedded in the group. We help organisations turn data and AI into real impact, leading a mission to accelerate the responsible use of data and AI. We bring the full data value chain under one roof: from strategy and engineering to analytics, data science and design. This way, we turn complex data into clear roadmaps, scalable foundations, AI-powered tools, and experiences people actually enjoy using. Freelance Data & AI Engineering opportunities Are you a freelancer interested in applying your data, engineering, cloud or AI expertise to real business challenges? We are always looking for talented freelance professionals to join the project teams driving this work forward. How This Connects To Our Current Work Our teams are actively working across the following areas: Data engineering: designing, building and maintaining scalable data pipelines that turn complex, high-volume datasets into reliable, production-ready foundations for analytics, models and AI. Data and AI in regulated environments: building solutions where data quality, traceability and reproducibility are essential, helping clients upgrade their data infrastructure and stay audit-ready. Credit risk analytics: supporting model development and validation for frameworks such as IRB and IFRS 9, and connecting regulatory risk models to strategic business outcomes. Generative AI and agentic systems: developing custom AI systems such as agentic workflows, RAG-based systems and domain-specific AI assistants. MLOps and model monitoring: building end-to-end AI pipelines and monitoring frameworks that keep models performing at their best, managing drift and retraining needs. We build these solutions with technologies such as Python and Docker, on cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure and Google Cloud. What You Bring We’re not just consultants: we’re leading experts in Data & AI, using our expertise in AI, Data, Cloud Engineering and Financial Risk Management. What unites us is a shared way of working: breaking down complex challenges to change how organisations operate. We don’t expect you to have everything on this list. What matters is where you can add value now and where you want to grow. 3+ years of experience in data engineering, AI engineering or data science, ideally gained in consulting or project-based work A quantitative academic background, such as AI, Econometrics, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, Computer Science, Engineering, Quantitative Finance or a related field Hands-on experience with Python and at least one cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP) A strong grasp of the modern GenAI landscape (LLMs, RAG, embeddings and vector search, tool/function calling, agentic patterns, and protocols like MCP) and the judgement to know when to apply each Experience with, or interest in, financial services and its regulatory context The ability to communicate with anyone in the room, explaining complex ideas to technical and non-technical audiences A collaborative spirit: you believe the best solutions come from diverse perspectives and supporting each other to raise the bar Fluency in English; Dutch is a plus. What’s In It For You At ADC, we value our freelance partners as true extensions of our collective. We bring you on board for your expertise, giving you the space to deliver exceptional work on projects that matter. That means: Impact you can point to: you’ll see your work in action, directly shaping how our clients build, run and rely on their data and AI solutions. The freedom to innovate: we bring you in for your expertise. You’ll have the autonomy to recommend better ways to build pipelines, models and AI systems, propose smarter approaches, and challenge the status quo. True partnership: you won’t be working in a silo. You’ll collaborate closely with our internal experts and our clients’ data, risk and business teams, sparring on complex challenges at a high technical and practical level. Competitive compensation and flexibility: we offer competitive freelance rates that match your experience, along with the flexibility to manage your working hours and deliver on clear, structured project goals. An inclusive culture: even as a freelancer, you’re part of the team. You are always welcome to join our daily lunches, Friday drinks and social events whenever you are at the office. What To Do Next If you believe in building with heart, thrive on collaboration, and want to grow with a team that challenges and supports you, we want to meet you! If this sounds like your next challenge, apply through the link below. Amsterdam Data Collective is an equal opportunity employer. To shape a better future, we value diversity and promote equality. No characteristics are discriminated against, as indicated in Directive 2000/78/EC. We encourage and welcome all applications. Additional …

items.desc: 🌍 About Flyboard We Make Voice AI Work. We ship production-ready agents that automate real sales and operations. Flyboard.ai builds and operates custom AI voice agents that automate high-volume, repeatable workflows across commercial and operational processes. Our customers include fast-moving SMEs, corporates, and mid-market leaders across Europe and LatAm. We are execution-obsessed, customer-ROI-driven, and deeply committed to operational excellence. 🚀 Mission As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer , you will work at the intersection of our customers, Delivery team, and Core Platform engineering team. Your mission is to ensure the technical success of our customer deployments: understanding technical requirements, building production integrations, configuring and improving AI agents, and translating recurring customer needs into platform improvements. The Delivery team will lead the overall customer engagement, while you will own the technical execution. You will write production Python code, work directly with customer technical teams, and contribute to the platform that powers all our AI voice agents. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who combines strong technical ability with clear communication, structured thinking, and genuine interest in working with people. You will report directly to the Technical Co-Founder. 🔧 What You Will Do Technical Delivery: Implement the technical components of customer deployments, from initial technical definition through production launch and stabilization. Customer Collaboration: Work directly with technical stakeholders on the customer side to understand their systems, clarify requirements, explain technical trade-offs, and coordinate integrations. Production Engineering: Write clean, maintainable Python code for customer implementations and reusable platform capabilities. API & Integration Development: Build and maintain integrations using APIs, webhooks, databases, and external business systems. AI Agent Implementation: Configure and improve AI voice agents, including their workflows, tools, prompts, integrations, and operational behavior. Platform Contribution: Identify recurring requirements across customer deployments and work with the Core Platform team to turn them into scalable product capabilities. Deployment Reliability: Test, monitor, troubleshoot, and improve customer deployments to ensure they are stable and reliable in production. Cross-functional Collaboration: Act as the technical link between Delivery, Platform Engineering, and customer technical teams, ensuring information and technical decisions flow clearly between them. Technical Documentation: Document integrations, implementation decisions, and reusable technical patterns to improve future deployments. 🎯 Ideal Profile We are looking for a strong engineer who enjoys both building systems and working with people. You will thrive in this role if you are comfortable moving between writing production code, investigating technical problems, discussing requirements with customers, and collaborating with internal teams. What you need Typically 2–5 years of relevant experience, although we care more about demonstrated ownership and technical ability than time in role. Strong Python and backend engineering skills. Experience building, deploying, and operating production software. Experience working with APIs, webhooks, integrations, databases, and cloud infrastructure. The ability to understand customer requirements and translate them into clear technical implementations. Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts, limitations, and trade-offs to different audiences. A structured and methodical approach to debugging and solving technical problems. Comfort working across multiple projects and collaborating with engineering, delivery, and customer teams. Professional proficiency in both English and Spanish. Practical experience using AI coding tools such as Codex, Cursor, or Claude Code. Nice to have Previous experience as a Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Implementation Engineer, technology consultant, or in another customer-facing engineering role. Experience with voice AI, conversational agents, real-time audio, or telephony systems. Experience integrating LLM, speech-to-text, or text-to-speech providers. Experience designing prompts, tools, workflows, and evaluation processes for AI agents. AWS and CI/CD experience. Working knowledge of JavaScript and a modern frontend framework. Strong product judgment and the ability to distinguish between a customer-specific requirement and a reusable product capability. 🧠 Why This Role Matters Customer deployments are where Flyboard’s technology becomes real business value. items.desc: Vous serez accueilli·e au sein de l’IRESNE, institut de la DES, où vous intégrerez l’équipe du laboratoire et participerez pleinement à ses activités. Participez vous aussi à des projets qui dessineront le monde de demain ! Les codes de simulation utilisent la méthode Monte Carlo qui reproduit numériquement les aléas subis par les particules lorsqu’elles interagissent avec la matière les environnant. Typiquement, étant donnée une source de particules (source radioactive, générateur de neutron, accélérateur de particules, …) et son environnement (murs, sol, blindages, …) on cherche par exemple à déterminer la réponse d’un détecteur à ces particules. Optimiser les dimensions, la position ou la nature d’un détecteur requiert de nombreuses itérations de calculs [1] qui sont chronophages, car il faut modifier les paramètres un à un et relancer à chaque fois les simulations. L’utilisation d’un agent IA permettrait d’automatiser ces étapes. De la même façon, on peut aussi vouloir optimiser des épaisseurs et natures de matériaux pour minimiser le bruit de fond associé à des sources radioactives parasites [2], ou construire des méta-modèles à partir d’un grand nombre de simulations comportant plusieurs paramètres à faire varier, pour faire du Machine Learning [3]. Ces tâches seront soumises à l’agent IA en utilisant le langage naturel. Le stage consistera à prendre en main un code en open source [4] et à l’adapter aux besoins du laboratoire afin de tester ses performances, notamment pour l’automatisation des tâches. Dans un premier temps, le travail du stagiaire consistera à reproduire les exemples décrits dans la publication de référence [4], en testant éventuellement l’impact de différents LLM. Ensuite, le package devra être adapté pour pouvoir être utilisé avec un code de calcul Monté Carlo différent de celui présenté dans la publication de référence. Enfin, les performances de l’agent seront évaluées sur des cas tests représentatifs de certaines tâches effectuées au LMN. L’agent fonctionnera en local avec un supercalculateur d’IA de bureau, donc sans aucune connexion à internet, en utilisant une LLM disponible en open source qui aura été préalablement téléchargée et installée dans le supercalculateur. items.desc: DESCRIPTION DE POSTE En tant que AI Product Specialist, vous êtes responsable de la qualité et de la performance de nos agents IA en production . Votre mission : faire en sorte que ce que nos agents répondent à nos clients soit juste, utile et fiable, et étendre ces agents à de nouvelles lignes d’assurance, dans un contexte exigeant : données sensibles et marché réglementé. Vous évoluez au sein de l’équipe Produit, en binôme étroit avec le senior software engineer de l’équipe IA, qui construit le socle technique et l’architecture de nos agents. Il construit et intègre, vous améliorez et garantissez la qualité de ce qui est livré. Vous faites aussi de l’IA une compétence partagée dans l’équipe. 💻 Missions Améliorer la qualité et la performance de nos agents IA Itération sur les prompts : concevoir, tester et améliorer les prompts, le contexte fourni et les garde-fous de nos agents, avec une démarche d’expérimentation rigoureuse et mesurée. Optimisation du RAG : analyser et améliorer la pertinence des informations récupérées et du contexte fourni aux agents, afin de garantir des réponses fiables, précises et fondées sur les bonnes sources. Analyse des conversations : exploiter les traces de nos agents (via LangSmith) pour comprendre ce qui fonctionne, ce qui échoue et pourquoi, du point de vue du client. Jeux de tests et critères de qualité : construire et faire évoluer les jeux de tests et les évaluateurs automatisés (notamment LLM-as-a-Judge) pour mesurer objectivement la qualité des réponses, identifier les axes d’amélioration et détecter les régressions. Suivi de la qualité : définir et suivre les indicateurs de qualité de nos agents (exactitude, pertinence, satisfaction etc), et animer des revues régulières. Gestion de l’incertitude : définir avec les équipes concernées les cas où l’agent doit s’abstenir ou passer la main à un humain, et les cas critiques à ne jamais manquer. Étendre nos agents à de nouveaux périmètres Nouvelles lignes d’assurance : préparer l’extension de nos agents à de nouveaux produits. Exemple concret : passer de l’agent qui répond aux questions de nos clients en assurance auto à l’assurance santé, puis à d’autres lignes (moto, emprunteur, MRH). Connaissance métier : travailler avec les experts métier pour fournir les contenus, les cas d’usage et les cas limites propres à chaque périmètre. Critères de mise en production : définir les critères de qualité à atteindre avant chaque ouverture, et s’assurer qu’ils sont respectés. Ouverture progressive : accompagner les phases pilotes (mode shadow, ouverture progressive) et analyser les résultats pour décider de la suite. Diffuser la compétence IA dans l’équipe Transmission : former l’équipe Produit à lire les conversations, comprendre les évaluations et itérer sur les prompts, pour que cette compétence ne repose pas sur une seule personne. Documentation : documenter les bonnes pratiques, les jeux de tests et les décisions, pour qu’elles soient réutilisables. Travailler au cœur d’une équipe Binôme avec la Tech : travailler au quotidien avec le senior software engineer de l’équipe IA. Partenaire du Produit et des métiers : collaborer avec les PM et les équipes commerciales et marketing. Conformité : respecter notre gouvernance IA et la réglementation applicable (RGPD, AI Act, devoir de conseil). 🎯 PROFIL RECHERCHÉ Expérience : Expérience concrète sur des produits basés sur des LLM avec une pratique avérée de l’itération sur les prompts et de l’évaluation de la qualité des réponses. Une expérience dans un contexte régulé ou sensible (assurance, finance, santé) est un plus. Hardskills Prompting et optimisation : maîtrise des techniques d’amélioration d’un agent (rédaction et structuration de prompts, contexte, garde-fous), avec une démarche de test comparatif. Évaluation de la qualité : expérience concrète de conception de jeux de tests et de critères d’évaluation d’un assistant IA. Lecture des traces : capacité à analyser des conversations et des traces (LangSmith) pour diagnostiquer les problèmes et les prioriser. Compréhension des LLM : bonne compréhension de leur fonctionnement et de leurs limites (hallucinations, RAG, variabilité des réponses). Analyse de données : capacité à tirer des conclusions fiables de données d’usage et à relier la qualité d’une réponse à un résultat business. Conformité : sensibilité aux enjeux de données personnelles et de réglementation IA Softskills Rigueur et honnêteté intellectuelle : capacité à dire qu’un agent n’est pas prêt, preuves à l’appui, même sous pression de calendrier. Culture produit et orientation business : comprendre ce qu’est une bonne réponse pour un client et pour le business, et pas seulement pour un modèle. Communication : rendre des résultats techniques lisibles pour des équipes non techniques et pour des décideurs. Pédagogie : goût pour la transmission, capacité à rendre l’IA accessible à des équipes non expertes. Collaboration : étroite collaboration avec la Tech et les métiers …

items.desc:
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas quickly become extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences. Bring passion and dedication to your job, and there's no telling what you could accomplish. Smart people and inspiring, innovative technologies are the norm here. 
Our team is responsible for validating the RF performance of top-notch, monolithic, cellular transceivers and the RF subsystems built around them. In order to expand our team's validation capability towards future Apple products, we are looking for a passionate RF engineer with strong RF transceiver system understanding, complemented by AI/ML and programming skills. The world-class cellular RF sub-systems developed in our labs are enabling Apple mobile devices to deliver uncompromised cellular network connectivity at the lowest possible battery drain, enabling long hours of an enjoyable customer experience. 
Thus, join us and leverage your passion for RF excellence and innovation, bringing your advanced education and drive to the world's most innovative company!
In the position of Receiver RF Silicon Validation Engineer, you will work on market-leading, cutting-edge cellular transceivers. The broad scope of responsibilities includes definition of test strategy and test plan creation derived from receiver system specification, characterization, and optimization of key RF parameters, the analysis of functional or performance issues encountered during different verification phases, and the development of scripts for test automation. You will work in an agentic engineering flow — scoping the problem and defining pass/fail criteria, delegating implementation and execution to AI agents, and verifying every result against the specification — applying innovative AI/ML-based methods to advance our measurement and analysis capabilities and to scale our regression environment. Your work style is very collaborative; you manage your deliveries and dependencies self-contained, and your execution enables you to meet your commitments.
Master’s degree in electrical engineering, Communication/ Embedded Systems, or equivalent paired with several years of relevant industry work experience 
• In-depth knowledge of RF fundamentals and RF measurement techniques
• Working knowledge of AI/ML, able to apply AI/ML methods to achieve results, with a solid grasp of the fundamentals
• Programming skills, leveraging modern AI-coding assistants to generate scripts, debug logic, and optimize code, with languages such as Python, C/C++, and MATLAB
• English language proficiency is required for this position
• PhD in Electrical Engineering, Communication/ Embedded Systems, or equivalent; industrial RF silicon-validation experience (e.g., internship, working student or industry project) is a plus
• Familiarity with RF transceiver system definition and architecture, including RF impairments (e.g., I/Q imbalance, DC offset, phase noise, nonlinearity) and their impact on receiver performance — ability to derive validation strategy, test plans, and pass/fail criteria from system specifications
• Knowledge of 3GPP standards with a focus on RF transceiver aspects and receiver RF requirements
• Hands-on experience applying AI/ML techniques and agentic engineering (delegating tasks to AI agents and verifying their output) to RF, signal-processing, or lab-automation problems
• Hands-on experience (from PhD work, thesis, internships or industry) in characterizing and debugging RF cellular systems and components, including root cause analysis, and in creating test automation scripts to run in the lab and/or regression environment
• Ability to collaborate technically with a variety of teams (Design, Firmware, System, etc.)
• Team spirit, excellent communication skills, and the desire to accept diverse challenges are essential

Job Description: 
 In order to support our Engineering department, Airbus Helicopters is looking for a
 Mechanical System Installation Design Engineer (d/f/m) 
You will join the department Installation Mechanical Equipment and Fuel System, which is part of the Design and Integration organization within the Airbus Helicopters design office. The team is responsible for the development of parts and assemblies for the installation of external Outboard Equipment. It supports the complete Airbus Helicopters product range, including commercial and governmental helicopters, as well as research demonstrators, throughout the complete helicopter life cycle (design, prototype and serial production, in-service support). The outboard equipment installation is done for the full scope of helicopter missions, including public transport, public services, emergency medical services, police and parapublic missions, Search and Rescue, military and VIP transport.
 The department is transnationally organized with team members in Marignane and Donauwörth. Team members work in modern agile project teams together with members of Airframe Design, Vehicle Systems, Electrical System and Stress departments, among others.
 Your location 
 At our Donauwörth site, located on the banks of the river Danube, we develop helicopters from the initial idea to the airworthy product. Watch them take off and touch down on our own on-site test airfield. 
 Our Benefits for You

 Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives. 
 Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations. 
 Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA. 
 Your tasks and responsibilities 
 Designing and verifying Mechanical System Installations
 Performing concept studies
 Designing 3D parts in CATIA
 Creating and modifying 2D drawings
 Performing data management in tools such as SAP, Windchill, ENOVIA VPM
 Preparing documents for certification and qualification
 Defining and planning of development projects and Design Changes, including change analysis, identifying requirements, defining deliverables, workload estimation
 Defining of subcontracting work packages and doing follow-up on subcontractor activities
 Supporting manufacturing, including Non-Conformity Management (NCM) and support of the industrialization process
 Supporting technical customer support
 Supporting the Continuing Airworthiness process, including Major Incident investigations
 Desired skills and qualifications 
 Completed studies (Bachelor with additional qualification or Master) in the field of aerospace engineering, electrical engineering or comparable course of study
Alternatively: three-year completed vocational training with qualified further training as a technician and related extended experience
 Advanced Proficiency within mechanical part design or fuel system component design, preferably using CATIA
 Preferably experience with technical Change Management processes and product data management with software tools such as ENOVIA VPM, SAP, Windchill or similar
 Working in an agile team, welcoming challenges, eager to take on responsibility, contribute to continuous improvement
 Deep understanding of prompt engineering and highly experienced in working with LLMs and image generators
 Language skills: English - negotiation level, German and French - skills are a plus

THEORETISCH DIE BESTE ENTSCHEIDUNG. PRAKTISCH AUCH. 
 TEILE DEINE LEIDENSCHAFT. 
 Nur hochprofessionelle Abläufe in dynamischen Teams produzieren innovative Spitzentechnologie. Aber Fahrfreude wird bei uns von der Entwicklung bis zur Fertigung vor allem auch mit Spaß an der Arbeit und Begeisterung für das gemeinsame Projekt realisiert. Deshalb geben wir Studierenden bei uns nicht nur die Gelegenheit zum Zuhören, sondern auch zum Mitreden und Weiterdenken.
 Unser Team bei der BMW Group gestaltet die Zukunft KI-gestützter Entwicklungsprozesse für Energieeffizienz, Fahrwerk und Gesamtfahrzeug. Im Rahmen deines Praktikums wirkst du an innovativen KI-Lösungen mit, die den Umgang mit Entwicklungswissen und Entwicklungsdaten grundlegend verändern. Dabei unterstützt du bei modernen KI-Agenten, Large Language Models (LLMs) und automatisierten Analyseprozessen für die Fahrzeugentwicklung der Zukunft.
 Was erwartet dich? 
 Du gestaltest aktiv mit an der Zukunft KI-gestützter Entwicklungsprozesse in einem innovativen Umfeld.
 Außerdem erhältst du Einblicke in die Themen Gesamtfahrzeugeffizienz und Simulationsmethoden.
 Darüber hinaus unterstützt du bei der Entwicklung von KI-Agenten auf Basis moderner Large Language Models (LLMs) zur Unterstützung von Entwicklungs- und Entscheidungsprozessen.
 Zudem unterstützt du den Einsatz moderner Agent-Frameworks und Automatisierungsplattformen wie n8n und bindest Entwicklungsdaten über Model Context Protocol (MCP) Schnittstellen an.
 Außerdem wirkst du mit bei der Entwicklung intelligenter Workflows zur automatisierten Analyse von Simulations-, Mess- und Fahrzeugdaten.
 Zudem unterstützt du mit deinen Programmierkenntnissen bei der Entwicklung von Prototypen und produktiven Lösungen für die datengetriebene Fahrzeugentwicklung.
 Außerdem bringst du dich in interdisziplinäre Teams ein und ergänzt aktuelle KI-Anwendungsfälle mit neuen Ideen.
 Was bringst du mit? 
 Studium der Informatik, Data Science, Elektrotechnik, Fahrzeugtechnik, Maschinenbau oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs.
 Fortgeschrittenes Bachelor- oder Masterstudium mit Erfahrung in der Programmierung, vorzugsweise mit Python.
 Interesse an Künstlicher Intelligenz, Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI und Datenanalyse.
 Erste Kenntnisse im Umgang mit KI-Frameworks, API-Anbindungen oder Automatisierungsplattformen (z.B. n8n, LangChain, OpenAI, Azure AI Services) sind von Vorteil.
 Begeisterung für moderne Softwareentwicklung und die Anwendung von KI im Engineering-Umfeld.
 Analytisches Denkvermögen, hohe Eigeninitiative und eine proaktive Herangehensweise.
 Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse.
 Möchtest du die nächste Generation intelligenter Entwicklungswerkzeuge mitgestalten und KI-Agenten entwickeln, die reale Engineering-Prozesse unterstützen? Dann bewirb dich jetzt!
 Was bieten wir dir? 
 Umfassendes Mentoring & Onboarding.
 Persönliche & fachliche Weiterentwicklung.
 Flexible Arbeitszeiten.
 Mobilarbeit.
 Attraktive & faire Vergütung.
 Apartments für Studierende (nach Verfügbarkeit & nur am Standort München).
 Und vieles mehr siehe bmw.jobs/waswirbieten

items.desc: We are looking for an AI Engineer who pairs strong hands-on engineering with excellent communication skills and a real appetite for working directly with the business. You will work closely with users across different teams, connect new tools and data sources into the agentic platform, help people get genuine value from it, and turn repetitive manual work into reliable automations. This is a business-facing engineering role, where success is measured as much by adoption and user outcomes as by the code you ship. Key responsibilities Integration and new data sources Design, build and maintain integrations that connect internal tools and data sources to AI agents in a secure, reliable and well-documented way. Onboard new tools and data sources end to end, covering discovery with the business, access and entitlements, data mapping, tool design, testing, documentation and release. Build and curate knowledge sources, including documentation, reference data and business context, so agents respond with the right context for each team. Ensure integrations meet business controls, including appropriate access permissions, clear separation of read and write actions, user confirmation before changes, and full auditability. Monitor integration health, performance and cost, and resolve issues quickly. Business enablement and user support Act as a first point of contact for users across the business, triaging questions, issues and feature requests and resolving them quickly. Onboard new users and teams through demos, training sessions and drop-in clinics, and produce clear guides, examples and best practices tailored to different user groups. Work side by side with users to understand their workflows, pain points and terminology, and translate these into clear integration and automation requirements. Gather feedback and usage insights and use them to shape the platform roadmap with product and engineering leads. Workflow automation Identify high-value, repetitive workflows such as reporting, reconciliations, monitoring, alerting and data movement, and turn them into reliable automations. Build reusable skills and templates that business users can run themselves, reducing reliance on bespoke engineering work. Measure the impact of automations, including time saved, errors avoided and adoption, and continuously improve them. Quality, safety and governance Design evaluations and test cases for agent behaviour and tool usage, and monitor accuracy and regression risk as models, prompts and integrations change. Apply the organisation’s standards for information security, data privacy, AI governance and change management, ensuring confidential and commercially sensitive information is handled appropriately. Maintain clear technical and user-facing documentation for every integration and automation delivered. Collaboration and communication Build strong working relationships with business users, technology teams and control functions, communicating clearly and confidently with technical and non-technical audiences. Manage expectations and priorities across multiple stakeholders, explaining trade-offs, timelines and risks in plain language. Work within an agile team, contributing to planning, reviews and continuous improvement. Essential experience Strong software engineering experience in C#/.NET, building production-grade services and integrations. Hands-on experience building applications with large language models, for example tool and function calling, agentic workflows, retrieval-augmented generation, prompt design and evaluation. Proven experience integrating systems through APIs and data platforms, including REST, authentication, streaming, SQL and cloud data services. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with demonstrable experience working directly with business users on requirements, training, support and influencing. A user-centric, pragmatic mindset, comfortable in a fast-paced business environment and focused on what delivers value to users. Experience with modern engineering practices, including source control, CI/CD, automated testing, code review and cloud deployment on AWS. Desirable experience Experience in trading, energy or financial services environments, with an understanding of trading, risk and operations workflows. Experience with workflow automation, scheduling and event-driven architectures. Experience building simple dashboards or data visualisations. Experience running training, user communities or change management activities for new technology. Awareness of responsible AI practices and AI governance. Job Type: Freelance Application question(s): Have you designed, built and deployed production solutions on AWS? items.desc: About HappyRobot HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $200M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide. Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto. Role Overview We are looking for a Deployment Strategist to join our team. In this role, you'll partner with Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) across the full deployment lifecycle, from first discovery conversation to live production. You'll lead use case discovery and scoping with senior customer stakeholders, ship prototypes hands-on to prove value early, then stay close to the build through delivery to bring the strategic, business-value lens to every decision. You're the partner who keeps the work pointed at the highest-impact outcomes, ready to pick up the keyboard alongside the FDE when the moment calls for it. We're looking for engineers with strategic instincts: people who can write code, but whose deepest strength is the strategic, opinionated lens they bring across every phase of a deployment - spotting where value lives, scoping it realistically, and partnering with engineers to capture it from prototype to production. At HappyRobot, there's no role seniority or hierarchy. We operate as a team of builders. We execute, we build, we own, and we care deeply about our customers and their success. What You'll do Strategic Leadership and Use Case Discovery: Partner with Global and Regional C-Level executives and VPs to assess AI opportunities and prioritize the highest-impact use cases. Lead curiosity-driven discovery that surfaces the workflows where AI creates the most business value, well beyond what the customer thought to ask for. Build the trusted relationships that let you present findings and challenge assumptions at the most senior levels, keeping technical delivery aligned with their business priorities. Scoping : Frame impact versus effort with rigor on both axes. On business value, pressure-test the realistic upside, question whether the use case as posed will actually deliver the most impact, and explore whether reframing it or pivoting to an adjacent process would unlock more. The art is deeply understanding how to maximize value of this use case for the customer, not just delivering what was asked for. On technical effort, map integrations, data, and platform constraints, and surface the edge cases and dependencies that shape timelines. Land on a plan that's realistic on both. Prototyping : Build prototypes and demos hands-on. Use our platform and AI-powered coding tools to test ideas end-to-end at light scope. Prove value early, before the customer commits. Program Management : Coordinate work across the active deployments in an account. Be the escalation point for the customer and the watchout partner for the FDE. Stay close enough to the build that you both understand the use case deeply, spot opportunities to capture more value, and catch when work is drifting from the highest-impact path. Prioritization : Sequence use cases within an account so each deployment compounds the next. Make the call on what gets built when, what gets parked, and where to invest discovery and building time. Customer Partnership : Be the main business-side point of contact for the account. Build trust with operational and executive stakeholders day-to-day. Translate AI capabilities into language they can act on. Onsite Embedding : Travel onsite for kickoffs, mapping sessions, and key moments where being on the ground changes the outcome. Product Feedback Loop : Bring field signal back to Product and Engineering. Identify reusable patterns, common edge cases, and where the platform needs to evolve. Must Have Background that mixes technical depth with strategic instinct, and a real history of building things. Common paths include engineering (Computer Science, electrical, industrial, systems), data science, founding a tech startup, product management, or technical / strategic consulting. Comfortable coding -mostly Python- using LLMs and AI-powered tools like Claude Code to ship prototypes fast. Working understanding of APIs, integrations, and how AI agents sit inside enterprise workflows. Strategic instinct: ability to spot the business value behind a workflow and translate it into impact, effort, and prioritization terms a C-level can act on. Excellent communication skills with both executives and operators. Comfortable translating between …

Bring your energy, take ownership, and build with us. How we work We operate like athletes. High standards, high output, and we enjoy the ride together. items.desc: Chcesz rozwijać cyberbezpieczeństwo w dużym środowisku IT i mieć realny wpływ na ograniczanie ryzyka? Dołącz do Departamentu Cyberbezpieczeństwa jako Cybersecurity Specialist. Będziesz rozwijać procesy zarządzania podatnościami, hardeningu i ekspozycji bezpieczeństwa oraz automatyzować ich kluczowe elementy. Twój wpływ w NN: czym będziesz się zajmować W tej roli połączysz wiedzę techniczną z praktycznym zarządzaniem podatnościami. Będziesz pracować z narzędziami bezpieczeństwa, analizować podatności i jakość skanów oraz wspierać zespoły IT w ich usuwaniu. Jednocześnie będziesz rozwijać automatyzację z wykorzystaniem API, skryptów i Agentic AI. Twoja praca pomoże nam skuteczniej identyfikować i ograniczać ryzyka techniczne. Twoje kluczowe zadania: Prowadzenie i rozwój procesów Vulnerability Management oraz hardeningu (TSCM), w tym monitorowanie KPI/KRI i wsparcie procesu akceptacji ryzyka. Administracja Tenable.io/Tenable.sc oraz przygotowywanie i nadzorowanie skanów, w tym kontrola ich jakości i pokrycia infrastruktury. Analiza nowych podatności, CVE/CVSS oraz ich wpływu na środowisko, a następnie współpraca z właścicielami systemów i zespołami IT przy remediacji. Konfiguracja i troubleshooting agentów, sensorów oraz innych narzędzi cyberbezpieczeństwa i ich integracji z ekosystemem IT. Automatyzacja powtarzalnych działań z wykorzystaniem REST API, PowerShell lub Python oraz rozwiązań Agentic AI. Z kim będziesz pracować Dołączysz do Departamentu Cyberbezpieczeństwa i będziesz blisko współpracować z właścicielami systemów oraz zespołami IT. Wspólnie będziecie analizować podatności, planować działania naprawcze i ograniczać ryzyko techniczne. Rola daje możliwość łączenia pracy technicznej z komunikacją z różnymi zespołami, także w środowisku międzynarodowym. Co oferujemy W NN chcemy wspierać pozytywne zmiany i tworzyć środowisko, w którym możesz rozwijać swoje umiejętności oraz współpracować z innymi. Globalne EVP NN opiera się na czterech elementach: rozwoju kompetencji, wspólnym działaniu, znaczeniu wykonywanej pracy oraz kształtowaniu przyszłości. Nowoczesne biuro na Powiślu oraz elastyczny model pracy hybrydowej. Prywatną opiekę medyczną, ubezpieczenie oraz benefity dostępne w systemie kafeteryjnym. Kompleksowy program wdrożeniowy oraz program poleceń pracowniczych. Możliwości rozwoju zawodowego wewnątrz organizacji i w ramach grupy NN, a także dostęp do platformy szkoleniowej. Inicjatywy wspierające różnorodność i inkluzywność, aktywności sportowe oraz dzień na wolontariat. Dodatkowy płatny urlop ojcowski i atrakcyjne zniżki na produkty naszych partnerów. Kim jesteś Masz minimum 2–3 lata doświadczenia w cybersecurity lub IT security oraz praktyczną znajomość Vulnerability Management i hardeningu. Potrafisz pracować z narzędziami do skanowania podatności, takimi jak Tenable.io, Tenable.sc lub Nessus, oraz analizować wyniki skanów, CVE i CVSS. Znasz bezpieczeństwo systemów Windows i Linux oraz podstawy bezpieczeństwa sieci, protokołów i usług. Potrafisz samodzielnie analizować i rozwiązywać problemy techniczne. Korzystasz z REST API i automatyzacji oraz potrafisz tworzyć skrypty w PowerShell lub Python. Umiesz także tworzyć i analizować raporty, np. w Power BI. Potrafisz jasno komunikować ustalenia techniczne, bierzesz odpowiedzialność za swoje działania i swobodnie korzystasz z dokumentacji w języku angielskim. Mile widziane: doświadczenie z EDR/XDR, ServiceNow lub Jira, SIEM i procesami Security Operations, dużymi środowiskami enterprise lub sektorem regulowanym, szczególnie finansowym, a także znajomość OWASP Top 10. Nie spełniasz wszystkich wymagań w 100%? Mimo wszystko zachęcamy Cię do aplikowania. Chętnie poznamy Twoje mocne strony, umiejętności i perspektywę. Dołącz do grona osób wspierających zmiany w NN W NN jesteśmy supporter of change. Wykorzystujemy wiedzę, współpracę, innowacje i nowe technologie, aby tworzyć pozytywne zmiany dla klientów, pracowników i społeczeństwa. Jeśli chcesz rozwijać cyberbezpieczeństwo, automatyzować procesy i pomagać nam lepiej zarządzać ryzykiem technicznym, zaaplikuj. Chcemy poznać Ciebie, Twoją motywację i to, co możesz wnieść do naszego zespołu.

Our market-leading platform for real-time interactive apps enables customers to efficiently and effectively build, manage, and optimize engaging apps that captivate and delight users. Founded in 2012, PubNub is backed by notable investors like The Raine Group, Sapphire, Scale, Relay, Cisco, Bosch, Ericsson, and HPE. To date, over 2,000 companies worldwide, including Amazon, RingCentral, Gameloft, and DAZN, choose PubNub to build and enhance large-scale apps that launch quickly to engage, monetize, and retain users. At PubNub, you'll enjoy the freedom of a remote-first environment paired with a collaborative culture designed to support your unique work style, so you can do your best work. About Blocks.ai Blocks.ai is a new initiative being built by PubNub, focused on connecting AI agents with the people, applications, and other agents that need to reach them. The team combines early-stage product ownership and experimentation with PubNub's infrastructure and engineering expertise. This role is part of PubNub and is dedicated to Blocks Network. About the Role We're looking for a technically hands-on Developer Advocate to help developers discover, build with, and successfully adopt Blocks.ai. You'll work at the intersection of engineering, developer education, community engagement, and product feedback. From building AI agents and sample applications to creating tutorials, engaging with technical communities, and supporting developer adoption, you'll play an important role in growing the Blocks.ai ecosystem. You'll collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Growth to make the platform more accessible and useful for developers and enterprise technical teams. Success in this role means enabling more developers to build and connect working AI agents, increasing engagement with the platform, and turning developer feedback into practical improvements. Key Responsibilities Build working AI agents, demos, sample applications, and reusable templates that demonstrate real-world Blocks.ai use cases. Create technical tutorials, articles, videos, workshops, and developer education materials. Engage with developers through GitHub, Discord, technical forums, community events, and hackathons. Help developers troubleshoot integrations and successfully connect agents, applications, and services. Identify onboarding friction and provide actionable feedback to Product and Engineering, including reproduction steps and improvement recommendations. Collaborate on documentation, SDKs, APIs, and developer tooling improvements. Support technical workshops, demos, and developer discussions with prospective enterprise customers. Track developer engagement, successful integrations, active agents, and ecosystem adoption. About You Minimum Requirements Experience in Developer Relations, Developer Advocacy, Software Engineering, or a similar developer-facing technical role. Practical experience building AI agents, LLM-powered applications, or integrations using APIs and frameworks. Strong problem-solving skills and a developer-first mindset. Experience collaborating with Engineering and Product teams to improve developer experiences. Strong English communication and presentation skills. Nice to Have Familiarity with MCP, agent-to-agent communication, or multi-agent architectures. What sets us apart is our people-first culture and strong sense of collaboration. We're committed to fostering collaboration, professional growth, and opportunities to make a meaningful impact. items.desc: Welcome to Eficode! We’re building the future of software development - driving innovation across Cloud, DevOps, Agile, Service Management, and AI-powered transformation. Our mission is to help organizations evolve into truly software-driven enterprises, empowering them to deliver faster, smarter, and more sustainably through modern technology and intelligent automation. At Eficode, we help some of the world’s leading organizations modernize the way they build software by combining DevOps culture, platform engineering, AI-assisted software development, and cloud-native tooling. From intelligent automation to agentic workflows and AI-enhanced SDLC practices, we are at the forefront of helping teams transform how software is delivered. As an Atlassian Platinum Solution Partner, we have been recognized multiple times as Atlassian Partner of the Year, most recently for Software Solutions, 2026. We are also proud to be a two-time GitHub Partner of the Year in EMEA, a GitLab Select Partner, and an Azure Managed Service Provider. With over 600 experts across 10 countries, we bring together leading talent from the Nordics, continental Europe, the UK, and the Americas. About the role As an experienced Atlassian Consultant at Eficode, you won’t just be configuring tools - you’ll help shape the future of software development for our customers. You’ll work closely with enterprise organizations to design and implement modern, scalable development platforms and collaborative ways of working across the software development lifecycle. While Atlassian technologies will be at the core of your work, you’ll also have the opportunity to work across the wider DevOps and AI ecosystem, including GitHub, GitLab, Azure, and more. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys combining technical expertise with consultative problem-solving, and who is excited by the evolving world of AI-assisted development, intelligent automation, and platform engineering. This is a hybrid role based in Sweden or Denmark, with an expectation of approximately 2–3 days per week on-site. Your key responsibilities Your main responsibilities as our experienced Atlassian Consultant will include (but won’t be limited to): Leading discovery workshops and designing enterprise-scale Atlassian solutions across Jira, Confluence, and Jira Service Management. Acting as a technical lead for migrations from Atlassian Server/Data Center to Atlassian Cloud. Designing customized integrations within modern DevOps toolchains such as GitHub, GitLab and related systems as e.g. ServiceNow. Helping customers modernize their SDLC through automation, AI-assisted workflows, and platform engineering best practices. Supporting customers in adopting modern ways of working across Agile, Service Management and DevOps. items.title: AI Platform Engineer
items.card: The role We are building the AI platform for freight forwarding and expanding our product surface, and we are hiring software engineers across product, AI and platform to do it. You will build products that do freight forwarding work alongside our customers' teams, operating across the entire shipment lifecycle. You will work across the stack in Python, TypeScript and React, and directly with customers and founders
items.desc: About us People assume the supply chain is an automated, algorithmic system. It is not. It is a large number of people acting as the glue between organisations and systems, doing work the world depends on with tools that have barely changed in decades. Nexcade builds AI agents for those people, starting in freight forwarding, a $210BN industry. Our agents are live in production with some of the leading global forwarders, pricing millions in freight every week, and we are expanding the platform deeper into the shipment lifecycle. We have raised $8.5M to make this a reality. Our founders, Dan and Tasho, spent years at Sedna and Palantir working with supply chain companies on problems like this one. We are backed by top VCs and angels who backed or founded Synthesia, n8n and other world-class companies. How we work Everybody codes, founders included. The whole company is technical, commercial team included, and runs on coding agents. Closely with customers and design partners, so what we ship changes how they operate. At pace. Fast cycles and quick iterations, on the product and on how we work. End to end. If you see something broken or missing, you have the freedom (and the responsibility) to fix it. In person, 4+ days a week in London. We value synchronous communication. Debate rigorously, decide quickly, execute relentlessly. Enjoy the journey. Hard problems, good colleagues. The role We are building the AI platform for freight forwarding and expanding our product surface, and we are hiring software engineers across product, AI and platform to do it. You will build products that do freight forwarding work alongside our customers' teams, operating across the entire shipment lifecycle. You will work across the stack in Python, TypeScript and React, and directly with customers and founders on what gets built. Everyone here works across the stack, but each engineer has a spike: the area where they set the bar for the team. You spend most of your time where yours is, and lean on your colleagues where theirs are. Product: You build best in class products for the core jobs in freight forwarding, one job at a time. You work as a design partner with our customers to understand the work deeply, turn that understanding into a product they would choose over anything else, and feed what you learn back into the platform everyone builds on. AI: You raise the ceiling on what our AI can do and the floor on how reliably it does it. That spans high volume tasks like classification and extraction and deep workflow tasks that run for hours. You design for performance, reliability, explainability and control, set up the gyms and evals to measure them, and build the harness that runs our agents in all of our products. Platform: You own the foundation every product stands on: the runtime for thousands of concurrent agents and workflows, the way they communicate and scale, the controls for how they access data with permissions that hold, and the observability to see and measure all of it. You ensure the rest of the team can move fast without fear. What we look for A spike, with evidence. Something you have been exceptional at and proof of it. We hire on slope rather than years, so there is no experience threshold in either direction. Strong fundamentals. In the AI-assisted era, having good technical judgement is key. You have shipped production systems people depend on, seen them fail and learned from it. High agency and ownership. You take an ambiguous problem, make a call, and see it through. Humility and learning velocity. You want to get better and you change your mind when the evidence says so. Interest in the problem. You do not need a freight background, but you need to find messy real-world operations interesting rather than a chore. Why join You will shape the product, the architecture and the company, working alongside an engineering team from Palantir, Raft, Faculty, UnlikelyAI and Oxford. You will work directly with the businesses using what you build, on AI applied to an industry that has resisted software for decades. You will get meaningful equity, so when this works you share in it.

We are deeply client-centric. Most important of all we are human - we create an inclusive environment where people feel trusted, supported and able to be themselves. items.desc: Job Title Junior Analytics Engineer Job Description Summary Job Description Junior Analytics Engineer London We’re looking for a Junior Analytics Engineer to join the Analytics Engineering pillar of our EMEA Business Intelligence team. You’ll help build and maintain the data foundation behind BI delivery across EMEA, supporting senior Analytics Engineers on semantic models, curated datasets and reusable data assets on our central data platform. You’ll work closely with the BI and Data Science & Engineering teams, and start to build the business context to turn real needs into well-structured data. As more of our data supports AI and agentic use cases alongside traditional BI, you’ll help lay that groundwork. This is a learning role for someone technically curious. You’ll be guided throughout, with clear routes to take on more responsibility and grow toward a more senior role. Key responsibilities: Build and maintain: contribute to semantic models and curated datasets under the guidance of senior engineers. Standardise: help make datasets, business logic and data models consistent and reusable across BI teams and markets. Onboard market data: assist with bringing market-specific datasets onto the central platform, working with local stakeholders to understand sources and requirements. Support BI delivery: work with senior colleagues to make sure data assets meet the needs of BI products from the BI Development team. Learn the business: develop an understanding of the context behind data requests and help translate needs into data structures and logic. items.desc: Haluatko varmistaa, että tekoälyn ehdottama, kirjoittama, testaama tai dokumentoima lopputulos on oikea, turvallinen, jäljitettävä ja hyväksyttävä? Etsimme AI Quality & Evaluation Engineeriä rakentamaan laadunvarmistusta ja evaluointia AI-first-ohjelmistokehitykseen vaativiin enterprise- ja finanssisektorin asiakkuuksiin. Tässä roolissa et vain testaa valmista, vaan määrität, miten tekoälyn tuotoksia arvioidaan ja milloin ne ovat hyväksyttäviä. Mitä pääset tekemään Rakennat arviointimalleja tekoälyn tuotoksille, LLM-ratkaisuille ja agentic workflow’ille. Suunnittelet laatuportteja (quality gates), review-kriteerejä ja käytäntöjä laadun todentamiseen. Kehität testiautomaatiota ja validointia AI-avusteiseen ohjelmistokehitykseen. Tunnistat riskit ja määrität, milloin AI-avusteinen työ pitää pysäyttää tai eskaloida. Työskentelet kehittäjien, arkkitehtien, DevOpsin ja agentic engineering -roolien kanssa. Autat varmistamaan, että tekoäly nopeuttaa tekemistä ilman laadun ja kontrollin heikkenemistä. Rakennat käytäntöjä vaativiin ja säänneltyihin asiakasympäristöihin. Sinulta löytyy Kokemusta quality engineeringistä, testiautomaatiosta tai ohjelmistotestauksesta. Kiinnostusta tekoälyn ja LLM-ratkaisujen arviointiin sekä vastuulliseen tekoälyyn. Ymmärrystä DevOpsista, CI/CD:stä ja tuotantovalmiista palveluista. Analyyttinen ja käytännönläheinen työote. Kyky rakentaa selkeitä hyväksymis- ja arviointimalleja. Sujuva suomen ja englannin kielen taito. Plussaa Python, Azure, GitHub Copilot. RAG-, LLM- tai generatiivisen tekoälyn ratkaisujen evaluointi. MLOps, LLMOps, mallien validointi. Kokemus finanssialan tai muista säännellyistä ympäristöistä. Työskentely Tehtävässä työskennellään hybridimallilla, jossa työ jakautuu lähityöhön pääkaupunkiseudulla ja etätyöhön. Lähityön määrä tarkentuu asiakkuuden tarpeiden mukaan, joten toivomme sinulta valmiutta joustavaan hybridityöskentelyyn. Huomioithan, että työskentely asiakkuudessa voi edellyttää turvallisuusselvitystä sekä muita taustaselvityksiä, kuten luottotietojen tarkistusta. Miksi HiQ? Pääset rakentamaan AI-first deliveryn luotettavuutta ja laatua käytännössä. Tämä rooli on keskeinen, jotta tekoälystä tulee turvallinen ja mitattava osa ohjelmistokehitystä. HiQ:lla missiomme on yksinkertaistaa ihmisten elämää. Syvän ja monipuolisen teknologia- ja toimialaosaamisemme sekä luovan ajattelun avulla taklaamme asiakkaidemme haasteita ja luomme entistä toimivampia ratkaisuja. HiQ:lla rakennetaan aidosti arvokkaita palveluita asiakkaalle. Meillä pääset rakentamaan yhteiskunnallisesti merkittäviä palveluja, asiakkaiden tarpeet täyttäviä end-to-end -ratkaisuja, kriittisiä taustajärjestelmiä ja meidän kaikkien käyttämiä kuluttajapalveluita. Haluamme olla ylpeitä työstämme, ja pyrimmekin aina parhaimpaamme. Siitä tulee nimemmekin, HiQ, High Quality. Mitä tarkoittaa olla HiQlainen? Se on mielenkiintoisia projekteja, afterwork-kaljoja, uuden oppimista ja toinen toisemme tukemista. Työkavereita, joista tulee aitoja ystäviä. Lapset saa lähteä hakemaan kotiin etuajassa ja välillä taas puristetaan loppukiri porukalla. Haluamme olla yhteisö, jossa haluat olla vuodesta toiseen. Paikka, jossa voit kehittyä työnantajaa vaihtamatta. Jokainen meistä vaikuttaa siihen, mitä tarkoittaa olla HiQlainen. Hae nyt Mikäli tunnistit itsesi suurimmasta osasta edellä mainituista kohdista, haethan rohkeasti – kuulisimme erittäin mielellämme sinusta lisää! Voit laittaa hakemuksesi alla olevan lomakkeen kautta. Jos sinulla heräsi kysymyksiä meidän suuntaan, voit olla yhteydessä Anjuli Jaakkolaan (anjuli.jaakkola@hiq.fi).

items.desc: Description de l'entreprise Filiale du Groupe BPCE, 2e acteur bancaire français, CEGC est spécialisée dans les cautions et garanties financières pour toutes sortes de clientèles, particuliers, professionnelles, entreprises et principalement dans le secteur de l'immobilier. Notre mission ? Proposer à nos clients des solutions pour réaliser leurs projets, développer et sécuriser leur activité. Nous garantissons les crédits à l'habitat des familles et les crédits d'investissement des professionnels, ou des opérateurs de l'économie sociale et du logement social en partenariat avec nos réseaux bancaires. Nous proposons des garanties aux entreprises, comme les cautions de marché dans le secteur du bâtiment et enfin, nous apportons des garanties financières aux professionnels de l'immobilier tels que les constructeurs de maisons individuelles, les promoteurs immobiliers, les administrateurs de biens et les agents immobiliers. Nous sommes fiers d'être, depuis plus de 50 ans, un acteur de confiance qui allie dynamisme et solidité. CEGC, c'est aussi et surtout plus de 400 collaborateurs experts et engagés, des équipes soudées, proches de leurs clients. Nous agissons au cœur de secteurs très impliqués dans les enjeux environnementaux et sociétaux : le logement, la construction ou encore la rénovation de bâtiments, nos actions et engagements ont donc un véritable impact ! Vous cherchez une entreprise avec une dynamique collective et une mission qui a du sens ? Alors vous êtes au bon endroit ! Poste et missions Au sein du département Data & IA de CEGC, nous exploitons le potentiel des données pour transformer nos produits et nos processus. Vous intégrerez une équipe dynamique axée sur le développement de fonctionnalités innovantes et l''amélioration continue de nos outils internes. Exploration et intégration de modèles d''IA : Vous serez amené.e à explorer, évaluer et intégrer des modèles de langage de grande taille (LLMs) existants pour des besoins spécifiques de l''entreprise. Vous développerez une expertise en "prompt engineering" afin de concevoir des requêtes efficaces permettant d''extraire le maximum de valeur des LLMs pour nos problématiques métiers (ex: résumé de documents, génération de contenu, extraction d''information). Mise en place de pipelines de données : vous concevrez et mettrez en œuvre des pipelines de données pour collecter, nettoyer et structurer des informations provenant de sources hétérogènes : documents PDF, rapports d''activité, sites web, bases de données, etc. Développer des modèles de machine learning Maintenir et faire évoluer des outils de RAG Vous participerez à l''optimisation de ces processus pour assurer la fiabilité et l''efficacité de la préparation des données destinées aux analyses et aux modèles Profil et compétences requises Vous avez une bonne maîtrise du langage de programmation Python / SQL / SAS Vous montrez un réel intérêt pour les domaines de l''IA, des LLMs, du traitement automatique du langage naturel (TALN) et de l''analyse de données. Vous faites preuve d''autonomie dans la gestion de vos tâches, d''une approche rigoureuse et d''un bon esprit d''équipe. La capacité à documenter votre travail et à communiquer vos avancées sera utile.

items.desc: Lieu : Cholet, France Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. items.desc: AI Engineer | Den Bosch Wil jij bouwen aan AI-oplossingen die niet alleen technisch uitdagend zijn, maar ook daadwerkelijk maatschappelijke impact hebben? Voor een organisatie die software ontwikkelt voor de lokale overheid zoek ik een AI Engineer die innovatieve AI-toepassingen ontwikkelt en naar productie brengt. De organisatie werkt aan de digitalisering van gemeentelijke dienstverlening. Met software die door meer dan 300 gemeenten wordt gebruikt, draag je bij aan een overheid die efficiënter werkt en inwoners sneller en beter kan helpen. Wat ga je doen? Als AI Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor de technische ontwikkeling en implementatie van AI-oplossingen. Je kijkt verder dan alleen het ontwikkelen van modellen: je zorgt ervoor dat AI-toepassingen betrouwbaar, schaalbaar en daadwerkelijk bruikbaar worden binnen bestaande software. Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit: Ontwerpen, bouwen en implementeren van LLM-integraties en RAG-pipelines. Ontwikkelen van AI-oplossingen voor automatische documentverwerking en data-extractie. Automatiseren van controles op basis van actuele wet- en regelgeving. Vertalen van functionele ontwerpen naar schaalbare AI-services. Analyseren van datasets en logbestanden om processen te verbeteren. Meedenken over de schaalbaarheid en veiligheid van AI-oplossingen. Onderzoeken en toepassen van nieuwe AI-technieken. Je werkt samen met Product Owners, Business Analisten, een Solution Architect en UX-designers. Er is veel ruimte om eigen ideeën aan te dragen en nieuwe toepassingen te ontwikkelen. Wat breng je mee? Aantoonbare ervaring met het ontwikkelen en deployen van AI-oplossingen in een productieomgeving. Goede kennis van LLM-integraties, RAG-architecturen en prompt engineering. Ervaring met het vertalen van AI-experimenten naar robuuste en schaalbare software. Een goed begrip van softwarearchitectuur en de impact van AI op bestaande applicaties. Je kunt technische keuzes helder uitleggen aan collega's. Je bent ondernemend, nieuwsgierig en denkt graag mee over nieuwe mogelijkheden. Wat krijg je? Een goed salaris passend bij jouw kennis en ervaring. Een riante winstuitkering. 8% vakantiegeld. 26 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om 10 extra dagen bij te kopen. Flexibele werktijden en hybride werken. Laptop, telefoonbudget en simkaart. €45 netto internetvergoeding per maand en een thuiswerkvergoeding. Een goede pensioenregeling. Toegang tot een online leerplatform voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Een leasefietsregeling. Over de organisatie Je komt terecht bij een organisatie die software ontwikkelt voor gemeenten en de lokale overheid. De oplossingen ondersteunen gemeentelijke processen en dragen bij aan de verdere digitalisering van de publieke sector. Binnen het team wordt volop geïnvesteerd in innovatie. Zo wordt een bestaand platform voor gegevensuitwisseling tussen gemeenten volledig opnieuw opgebouwd, waarbij AI vanaf de basis wordt geïntegreerd. De maatschappelijke impact is concreet: door repetitieve controles en zoekwerk te automatiseren, kunnen ambtenaren efficiënter werken. Dit vermindert de kans op fouten en zorgt ervoor dat inwoners sneller en beter geholpen worden. Je krijgt de kans om als AI Engineer mee te bouwen aan toepassingen die op grote schaal binnen de Nederlandse overheid worden ingezet. Interesse? Ben jij de AI Engineer die graag bouwt aan innovatieve technologie met maatschappelijke impact? Of ben je benieuwd naar de mogelijkheden? Neem gerust contact met mij op. Ik vertel je graag meer over de functie en organisatie.

items.desc: Kas tahad panustada AI-põhise tarkvaraarenduse arendamisse? Otsime oma tiimi AI-põhist tarkvaraarenduse inseneri , kes tegeleb tehisintellekti rakendamisega tarkvaraarenduse protsessides. Sinu ülesanne on arendada ja automatiseerida AI-põhiseid töövooge, ühendades LLM-id, AI-agendid, arendustööriistad ja CI/CD protsessid. Eesmärk on muuta tarkvaraarenduse protsess efektiivsemaks, parandada loodava tarkvara kvaliteeti ning automatiseerida arendajate igapäevatööd. Kui tahad ehitada mitte lihtsalt AI-põhist tarkvara, vaid süsteeme, mis aitavad tarkvaraarendust ennast kiirendada ja täiustada, siis kandideeri juba täna. SINU ROLL Disainid ja juurutad AI-agente, automatiseeritud töövooge ja prompt engineering'u lahendusi tarkvaraarenduse eri etappides. Integreerid LLM-e olemasolevate süsteemide ja arendusprotsessidega, kasutades näiteks RAG-i, API-sid ja väliseid tööriistu. Arendad lahendusi, mis automatiseerivad ja toetavad arendajate igapäevatööd. Arendad AI-põhiseid koodiloome ja kvaliteedikontrolli lahendusi ning tagad nende töökindluse ja turvalisuse. Katsetad uusi AI-tehnoloogiaid ning viid toimivad lahendused prototüübist reaalsesse kasutusse. MIDA ME SINULT OOTAME? Varasemat kogemust tarkvaraarenduses ning teadmisi tarkvaraarhitektuurist ja erinevatest arhitektuurimudelitest. Praktilist kogemust AI-raamistike ja LLM-põhiste lahendustega. Arusaama CI/CD protsessidest, pilvetehnoloogiatest (AWS/GCP/Azure) ja DevSecOps põhimõtetest. Uudishimu ja valmisolekut katsetada kiiresti arenevaid AI-tehnoloogiaid ning rakendada neid praktiliste probleemide lahendamisel. Oskust näha tervikpilti – mõista, milliseid protsesse tasub automatiseerida ja miks. Väga head eesti ja inglise keele oskust. MIDA MEIE PAKUME? Võimalust osaleda projektides, kus arendame AI-põhiseid tarkvaraarenduse lahendusi ja autonoomseid süsteeme. Tehniliselt huvitavaid väljakutseid ja võimalust töötada lahendustega, mille jaoks ei pruugi veel valmis lähenemisi olemas olla. Kaasaegset tehnoloogiaparki ning võimalust valida ja katsetada uusi tööriistu ja tehnoloogiaid. Paindlikku töökorraldust, konkurentsivõimelist töötasu ja võimalust areneda koos AI-valdkonna arenguga.
