items.desc: Role Description We are looking for an AI Engineer focused on Generative AI, with the aim of transforming complex workflows and data into intelligent, automated solutions that drive our business operations. In this role, you will design, implement, and orchestrate advanced LLMs and autonomous agents to guide strategic decisions, enhance customer experiences, and solve challenging business problems, partnering closely with cross-functional teams. Main Responsibilities Design and Implement AI Solutions: Develop and deploy Generative AI models, autonomous agents, and conversational interfaces to address complex business challenges and automate internal workflows. Model Optimization: Fine-tune existing foundation models and build robust Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines to ensure highly accurate, context-aware AI outputs. Prompt Engineering & Orchestration: Craft and optimize prompts and utilize orchestration frameworks to build multi-agent systems that handle complex, multi-step tasks. Business Alignment: Partner with domain experts to translate ambiguous business questions and operational bottlenecks into actionable GenAI frameworks. Production & LLMOps: Partner with the MLOps/DevOps teams to ensure seamless model deployment, monitor for latency, quality, and hallucinations, and adhere to CI/CD and automated testing best practices. Experimentation: Design and analyze rigorous A/B and multivariate experiments to validate the efficacy and user adoption of new AI-driven features. Stakeholder Communication: Communicate AI concepts, system capabilities, and limitations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Integration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including software engineers, product managers, and data scientists, to integrate your AI agents and models into production systems. Continuous Learning: Stay up-to-date with the rapidly evolving advancements in the Generative AI, LLM, and NLP landscape. Requirements: Agentic AI Expertise: Solid, proven track record in agentic workflows, multi-agent orchestration, and advanced prompt engineering. System Integration: Clear understanding of how to connect LLMs to execution layers (RPA robots, webhooks, REST APIs) to drive automated actions in enterprise systems. Business-Facing Mindset: Strong curiosity and willingness to immerse themselves in operational business realities to co-design effective solutions. Pragmatism & Speed: A test-and-learn attitude geared toward fast prototyping, evaluation, and iterative delivery. Language Requirement: Native or full professional proficiency in Italian, which is essential for handling Italian-language documentation, local process nuances, and direct collaboration with SMEs. This engineer will serve as the core technical engine of a dedicated, cross-functional team, with direct visibility and a measurable impact on the company's P&L.

items.desc: Som AI-utvecklare hos B3 Cloud får du arbeta med att utveckla och implementera AI-lösningar som hjälper våra kunder att effektivisera processer, automatisera arbetsflöden och skapa nya möjligheter med AI. Du kombinerar din erfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling med modern AI-teknik och omsätter idéer och verksamhetsbehov till fungerande lösningar. Du arbetar med att utveckla AI-agenter, RAG-lösningar och applikationer baserade på generativ AI, främst inom Microsofts ekosystem. Det kan exempelvis handla om att integrera språkmodeller med verksamhetssystem, utveckla API och automatiserade flöden eller bygga lösningar med Azure AI Foundry och Azure OpenAI. Vi tror att du är nyfiken, lösningsorienterad och tycker om att utforska ny teknik. Du har ett stort intresse för AI, trivs med att lösa komplexa problem och drivs av att utveckla lösningar som skapar konkret nytta för verksamheten. Vi Söker Dig Som har minst 4 års erfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling, gärna med fokus på backendutveckling och molnbaserade lösningar. har praktisk erfarenhet av att utveckla AI-baserade lösningar, exempelvis med generativ AI, språkmodeller eller AI-agenter. har erfarenhet av Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI och Claude. är väl insatt i Python, C# eller .NET och har erfarenhet av att utveckla applikationer och tjänster. har god förståelse för LLM, RAG och prompt engineering samt hur dessa används i praktiska lösningar. är van vid att arbeta med API, integrationer och databaser. har erfarenhet av Microsoft Azure och molnbaserad applikationsutveckling. kan arbeta med Git, CI/CD och moderna utvecklingsmetoder. kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska i tal och skrift, då det krävs i det dagliga arbetet. Meriterande: Konsultvana, med erfarenhet av kunddialog och att omsätta verksamhetens behov till tekniska lösningar. Erfarenhet av agentramverk, exempelvis Semantic Kernel eller Microsoft Agent Framework. Erfarenhet av maskininlärning (ML), exempelvis utveckling, träning och utvärdering av AI-modeller. Kunskap om containerteknik, exempelvis Docker eller Azure Container Apps. Erfarenhet av AI-utvärdering, övervakning och säkerhet i AI-baserade applikationer. Vilka är vi? Vi är B3 Cloud, ett härligt gäng med specialistkunskaper inom molntjänster utspridda i Göteborg och Stockholm. Vi tror på att dela kunskap, stötta varandra och ständigt utvecklas tillsammans – både som team och som individer. Som en del av B3 Consulting Group har vi resurser, kompetens och stöd i ryggen samtidigt som vi bibehåller dynamik och flexibilitet med korta beslutsvägar. Vi är stolt över att vara del av en verksamhet som präglas av inkludering och en strävan efter att ha en positiv påverkan på samhället, människor och miljön. Vi värdesätter olikheter och erfarenheter och arbetar kontinuerligt med inkludering och kultur för samarbete och respekt. Vi Erbjuder Frihet och flexibilitet att påverka din utveckling, arbetstider och uppdrag Kompetensutveckling genom utbildningar, certifieringar och lunchföreläsningar Konkurrenskraftig lönemodell och en otroligt flexibel samt förmånlig RAM modell. En givande företagskultur med konferensresor, AW:s och wellness-aktiviteter Vår ambition inom AI På B3 Cloud bygger vi nu upp flera starka erbjudande inom AI, med utgångspunkt i det vi redan kan väl: molnet, Microsofts plattformar och nära samarbete med kundernas verksamheter. Som AI-utvecklare blir du en central del av den här satsningen. Du får möjlighet att påverka hur vårt AI-erbjudande växer, vilka områden vi satsar på och hur vi arbetar framåt. Här finns utrymme att testa nya idéer, dela kunskap med kollegor i hela B3 och bygga något tillsammans från tidigt skede.

items.title: Técnico Sénior de IA – Área de Tecnologia (Lisboa)
items.card: Função: Neste contexto, procuramos um(a) Técnico Sénior de IA , que terá como missão desenvolver, implementar e otimizar soluções de Inteligência Artificial que potenciem a transformação digital, a automação e a inovação nos processos da organização. items.desc: Função: Neste contexto, procuramos um(a) Técnico Sénior de IA , que terá como missão desenvolver, implementar e otimizar soluções de Inteligência Artificial que potenciem a transformação digital, a automação e a inovação nos processos da organização. Terá um papel prático na integração eficaz de modelos de IA nos sistemas existentes, assegurando o alinhamento das iniciativas com a estratégia do negócio e promovendo uma adoção responsável, segura e ética da tecnologia. Trabalhará no Colombo - Lisboa e terá como principais responsabilidades: PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES Projetar, desenvolver e implementar soluções de IA para resolver desafios de negócio; Identificar oportunidades de aplicação de IA e propor soluções inovadoras alinhadas com os objetivos estratégicos da organização; Capacidade para programar, corrigir erros (debug), propor melhorias, realizar revisões de código e apresentar soluções para problemas sistémicos, atuando de forma prática e orientada para resultados; Apoiar o desenvolvimento de APIs orientadas para LLM- based prompt engineering , com foco na análise de entradas do utilizador e identificação de intenções; Desenvolver e validar agentes de IA individuais, contribuindo para a criação de protocolos de comunicação que suportem a colaboração entre agentes; Integrar agentes com ferramentas e serviços externos, utilizando protocolos padrão como MCP; Colaborar com equipas multidisciplinares para levantamento de requisitos, validação de soluções e acompanhamento da implementação; Assegurar a conformidade com políticas internas, regulamentação aplicável e princípios de ética, segurança, privacidade e proteção de dados em IA; Manter-se atualizado sobre tendências, frameworks e ferramentas de IA, promovendo a inovação contínua e a aplicação de novas abordagens tecnológicas. Requisitos: Licenciatura e/ou Mestrado em Engenharia Informática, Ciência de Dados, Matemática, Estatística ou áreas similares; Conhecimentos gerais de Tecnologias de Informação e de Office; Conhecimentos transversais de Banca; Capacidade de desenho em soluções escaláveis e seguras; Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento e implementação de soluções de Inteligência Artificial; Domínio de Python e programação com foco na qualidade de código, melhores práticas, capacidade de debugging, revisão de código e melhoria contínua; Conhecimento de LLMs, algoritmos e frameworks, nomeadamente LangGraph, LangChain, FastMCP e FastAPI; Conhecimentos de integração de APIs REST/SOAP para ingestão de dados e conexão entre sistemas; Conhecimentos de containers e familiaridade com plataformas Cloud como Azure ou GCP e respetivos serviços de IA; Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis e ferramentas de colaboração, nomeadamente Jira e Confluence; Familiaridade com sistemas de versionamento de código, como Git, e experiência com Azure DevOps para CI/CD e gestão de pipelines; Conhecimentos de Inglês e Espanhol (preferencial); Pensamento analítico e capacidade de resolução de problemas. Caso queira participar neste desafio, envie-nos o seu CV atualizado indicando no Assunto a vaga para a qual se está a candidatar: Técnico Sénior de IA – Área de Tecnologia dando nota das razões da sua candidatura, para o e-mail: gestaodepessoas.pt@bankinter.com. Para saber tudo sobre o Bankinter por favor aceda a: https://webcorporativa.bankinter.pt/

items.desc: Love what you do – we make employment happen! Are you a passionate AI Engineer eager to build AI solutions that will reshape the European job market? We’re looking for an AI Engineer to join our cross-functional AI Hub , working across teams and products to turn the latest advances in AI into solutions used by our customers and internal teams. In this high-impact role, you’ll design, build and deploy AI-powered applications and services , working with technologies such as LLMs, Generative AI, RAG and intelligent agents . You’ll experiment with new approaches, rapidly turn ideas into prototypes, and take the most promising solutions all the way into production. WHAT IS JOBCLOUD HR TECH? JobCloud HR Tech is the Porto, Portugal based company of JobCloud, Switzerland’s number 1 job ads brand and the company behind jobs.ch and jobup.ch. We build software that helps companies spend their hiring budget efficiently and get their job ads in front of the right candidates. Millions of job seekers and thousands of companies use our platform to find each other. WHAT IS IT LIKE TO WORK AT JOBCLOUD? We work as one team of experts in our field. Our culture is inclusive and respectful, and it is built on openness and collaboration. Your skills and motivation count. Your skin colour, gender and beliefs do not matter to us. Come as you are. Our purpose is “Love what you do.” WHAT WILL YOU DO IN THIS ROLE? Design, build, and operate production AI applications that connect language models with enterprise data, APIs, and business workflows. Develop conversational and AI-assisted experiences using tool calling, structured outputs, orchestration, state management, and appropriate combinations of deterministic workflows, RAG, and agentic behavior. Integrate and prepare data from APIs, databases, document repositories, and event-driven systems, ensuring it remains secure, current, and suitable for AI use. Establish automated evaluation, testing, monitoring, tracing, feedback, and safe fallback mechanisms covering quality, groundedness, reliability, latency, and cost. Collaborate with platform and security teams on deployment, CI/CD, observability, access control, privacy, auditing, and prompt-injection defenses. Own technical designs, communicate trade-offs, review code, mentor colleagues, and turn ambiguous business needs into maintainable solutions. WHAT SKILLS & EXPERIENCE WILL HELP YOU SUCCEED? Strong Python and production software-engineering skills, including backend APIs, containers, CI/CD, cloud deployment, and observability. Experience delivering LLM-powered, machine-learning, or data-intensive applications beyond proof-of-concept work. Experience integrating heterogeneous enterprise data sources and building reliable data-preparation and synchronization workflows. Practical experience with grounded AI applications, tool or function calling, structured outputs, and evaluation of nondeterministic systems. Understanding of authentication, authorization, privacy, and secure data handling. Sound architectural judgment and the ability to lead technical discussions with technical and nontechnical stakeholders. WHAT DO WE OFFER? 1 day per month to tackle challenges inside the project, or test new ideas Tech training and human skills training and, budget for conferences Opportunity to travel and collaborate in our various office locations for workshops or team-building events (Zurich, Geneva, Belgrade or Vienna) A dynamic work environment that highly fosters a sense of fun while maintaining a productive atmosphere A competitive salary & career ladder Our Hiring Process Video call with People & Culture (30 mins) Technical conversation with the hiring manager (45 to 60 mins) Tech challenge (async) Challenge presentation (60 mins) Offer WHAT ARE OUR BENEFITS? 10 days fully paid sick leave per year 25 days of annual vacation leave Full private health coverage (employee + up to 2 children to age 20) Gym allowance Hybrid & flexible working (team-based arrangement) Learning & Development Workation

At Aubay Portugal, we work daily with some of the largest organisations across sectors such as banking, insurance, telecommunications and energy, helping to build and evolve critical systems that support millions of users. More than technology, we build close relationships and deliver real-impact projects. What will you do? Design and build agentic development workflows, tools, and automation across the entire SDLC; Develop and integrate AI agents, encompassing orchestration, tool use, MCP servers, and context engineering; Implement robust evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and quality checks to ensure reliable agent outputs; Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure automation, and developer tooling; Integrate AI-powered workflows with enterprise systems like Jira, source control, and CI platforms. items.desc: Über den Bereich Das AI Platform Engineering Team (HMAT1) verfügt über umfassende Erfahrung im Design, in der Integration sowie im Betrieb von KI- und Datenplattformen und deren Komponenten. Durch seine breite Aufstellung ist das Team in der Lage, sowohl bestehende FOSS- und COTS-Komponenten sowie Modelle auszuwählen und zu optimieren als auch neue Lösungen zu entwickeln bzw. Modelle zu trainieren. Die Teammitglieder bringen fundiertes Verständnis in der Verarbeitung großer Mengen sicherheitskritischer Daten in regulierten und eingeschränkten Umgebungen mit. HMAT1 deckt dabei folgende Spezialisierungen ab: AI Platform Engineering, Data Platform Engineering, Applied AI Engineering, Reliability Engineering, UX Engineering und Software Architecture. Sie gestalten die technologische Grundlage einer KI-gestützten Datenplattform - von der semantisch angereicherten Erfassung heterogener Sensordaten bis zur Echtzeit-Fusion und Kontextualisierung komplexer Datenströme. Als Senior Engineer bringen Sie ein tiefgreifendes System-Know-how ein, treiben Architekturentscheidungen auf Basis fundierter technischer Analyse voran und setzen den Qualitätsmaßstab für Implementierung und Design im Team. Ihre Aufgaben Design, Entwicklung und Integration skalierbarer Agentic AI Systeme in Sensor- bzw Defense-Anwendungen Integration und Erweiterung eines Domain-Specific Agentic Harness Ausbau des Semantic Layers für Sensor-, Missions- und Domänendaten Weiterentwicklung von Agentic Governance mit Policies, Guardrails, Auditability und HITL/HOTL Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Datenplattform- und Sensorik-Teams Integration und Optimierung von Sensor Fusion, Edge AI und verteilten AI-Komponenten Evaluierung neuer Technologien und Überführung geeigneter Ansätze in bestehende Produkt- und Systemarchitekturen Ihr Profil 5+ Jahre Erfahrung in AI Engineering, Software Engineering oder Platform Engineering Praktische Erfahrung mit LLMs, Agentic AI, RAG und AI-Workflows Verständnis von AI Governance, Evaluation, Observability und sicheren AI-Systemen Erfahrung mit Semantic Layers und Knowledge Graphs Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Python und idealerweise auch einer Systemsprache (Rust, Go oder C++) Interesse an Defense, Sensorik und sicherheitskritischen Systemen Kenntnisse in Streaming-Technologien wie Apache Kafka, Flink oder Spark Kommunikationsstärke in Deutsch und Englisch; Bereitschaft, Verantwortung für technische Entscheidungen zu übernehmen Ein stark ausgeprägtes Interesse an kontinuierlicher Weiterbildung kann Defizite in einzelnen Kompetenzbereichen ausgleichen Wir bieten Jobticket Parkplatz Individuelles Budget für Kurse, Konferenzen, Zertifizierungen Flexible Arbeitszeiten Home Office Regelmäßiges gemeinsames Frühstück Zugang zu internen und externen Learning-Plattformen Gratis Kaffee, Softdrinks und Obst Mindestgehalt lt. Today the team is small and tight-knit, and every hire meaningfully shapes what we build and how we build it. You will work across our full agentic surface: chat, meeting preparation, recommendations, and voice . This is a hands-on role at the intersection of reasoning, tool-use, and memory, designing intelligent agents that operate in complex environments, interact with APIs and structured data, and drive real-world outcomes. It goes well beyond prompt engineering: you will build robust decision pipelines and ship product-ready agents across both text and voice modalities . Proven experience building voice agents is an important requirement for this role. Voice is one of the most exciting frontiers of our product, and we want someone who has done it to help the whole team excel there. That said, this is not a voice-only role: you will contribute across the Intelligence Layer, and your voice background will be a force multiplier for everything we build together. Your Mission Design & Optimize Workflows: Design, implement, and optimize agentic workflows using LLMs across chat, meeting prep, and recommendations. Build Tool-Using Agents: Create agents that interact with external APIs, databases, and environments. Advance our Voice Agents: Push our voice-enabled agents forward, including pipeline design for real time conversation, transcription (ASR), speech synthesis (TTS), turn-taking, and dialogue management, with a focus on low latency and reliability. Integrate Memory & State: Implement retrieval, long-term memory , and state tracking into agent architectures. Deploy in Production: Collaborate with product teams to deploy agents in production and keep them healthy. Evaluate & Improve: Design and run experiments to evaluate agent performance, correctness, latency, and hallucination rates. Translate Product Needs: Turn high-level product requirements into scalable, testable agentic features. Your Profile – What you need to succeed Voice AI (important requirement): Proven, hands-on experience building voice agents in production and working with ASR , TTS , or real-time/streaming voice pipelines. Voice is a core focus of this hire, and we expect you to bring real depth here. LLM Expertise: Strong experience building with LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, Claude, Mistral, open-source models). Agentic Frameworks: Familiarity with agentic frameworks (e.g. LangChain, LangGraph). Programming Proficiency: Proficient in Python and modern ML tooling (e.g., Hugging Face, PyTorch, Ray, etc.). Tool Integration: Experience with tool integration , calling APIs, managing memory/state, or SQL query generation. Simulation-Based Testing: Experience with simulation-based testing and evaluation of conversational and voice agents (e.g. Coval , Bluejay ), used to measure agent performance, correctness, and regressions at scale. Startup Mindset: Comfortable in an iterative, fast-paced product environment, and energized by helping a small team level up. Why Acto? Development Opportunities : Steep development opportunities without entrenched hierarchies. Culture: We are an ambitious team that wants to achieve a lot with Acto, but we don't take ourselves too seriously and like to have fun together, be it working together or at regular team events. Flexibility: Enjoy a flexible work schedule and a remote set up with the option to work from our Berlin Office. Health & work-life balance: Enjoy 30 days of vacation and an attractive Wellhub membership. Ownership: Whether you are an intern or a full-time acto-naut, Acto instills a deep sense of ownership, where every team member is entrusted with meaningful responsibilities and the autonomy to make impactful decisions. Equipment: You will receive a state-of-the-art hardware setup with a choice between Mac and Windows. About Us Acto is building the AI Revenue OS for industrial companies – the system that decides where revenue is created and what needs to happen next. Today, the most important commercial decisions are still made manually: which customer deserves attention, where revenue is being lost, which opportunity is emerging and which team needs to act. We're changing exactly that. Acto connects ERP, CRM and behavioural data into a shared context, derives concrete decisions from it and ensures those decisions get executed in day-to-day operations. No reporting. No additional dashboard. A system that actively steers and orchestrates revenue. Our customers use Acto to generate measurably more revenue from existing customer relationships – with results like +5-11% revenue growth in existing business. We're starting in wholesale – one of the largest and least digitalised industries in the world – and building from there the central revenue control layer for the entire industrial economy. items.desc:
Who we are 
 About Stripe 
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.
 About the team 
 The UI Platform team, known as Sail, builds the foundations behind Stripe’s Dashboard and many other user interfaces. Sail Services owns the systems that evaluate feature flags and experiments, ingest frontend analytics, and improve Dashboard load times for Stripe’s largest merchants.
 We build backend-for-frontend capabilities that connect Stripe’s backend systems to its UI platform. This gives product teams a consistent way to build and operate user experiences without recreating the same infrastructure.
 What you’ll do 
 As a Backend Engineer on the Sail Services team, you’ll help build and evolve the systems that power Stripe’s user interfaces. You’ll independently drive software projects from problem definition through production, working closely with other UI Platform engineers, product teams, and infrastructure partners. Your work will range from APIs and GraphQL integrations to edge systems, architectural migrations, and the tooling needed to operate them safely at scale.
 Responsibilities 
 Take end-to-end ownership of software projects, aligning on priorities and then independently scoping problems and carrying solutions through design, implementation, testing, rollout, and operation
 Design, build, and operate reliable, scalable APIs and backend systems that support Stripe’s Dashboard, mobile applications, and other user interfaces
 Help modernize Stripe’s UI architecture through incremental migrations, automated validation, shadow traffic, and carefully controlled production rollouts
 Improve the reliability, observability, performance, and operability of services on critical user paths
 Partner with frontend, backend, and infrastructure engineers to understand their needs and turn recurring problems into reusable platform capabilities
 Use AI-assisted and agentic development workflows to improve implementation, testing, validation, and delivery
 Contribute thoughtful code reviews, technical discussions, documentation, and runbooks that improve the quality of the team’s work
 Who you are 
 We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
 Minimum requirements 
 Fluency in using AI-assisted and agentic development tools as part of day-to-day software engineering, including critically reviewing, validating, and improving generated code
 2+ years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent practical experience, building, shipping, and operating production systems
 Strong knowledge of backend technologies and infrastructure, including the fundamentals of APIs, data storage, distributed systems, and production operations
 Ability to independently scope and deliver open-ended software projects, making practical technical and product tradeoffs with limited oversight
 Strong problem-solving and debugging skills, with attention to testing, maintainability, reliability, and user impact
 Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with frontend engineers, product engineers, and infrastructure partners
 Preferred qualifications 
 Experience building backend-for-frontend systems, UI platform services, developer platforms, or shared infrastructure
 Experience designing or integrating APIs, including GraphQL APIs
 Experience with high-throughput event ingestion, feature flag or experimentation systems, or other latency-sensitive platform services
 Familiarity with caching, asynchronous systems, configuration systems, or data-consistency tradeoffs
 Experience executing large migrations using automated validation, shadow traffic, feature flags, or staged rollouts
 Experience using data, developer feedback, or operational signals to improve a platform or developer-facing product

items.desc:
Who we are
 About Stripe
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. 
 About the team
 Supportability Decisions is a Dublin-based engineering team within Supportability Engineering, part of Risk Engineering. We own the “how a business sells” side of Supportability: determining whether a user’s declared business, web presence, account configuration, and observed transaction behaviour align with Stripe’s standards.
 Our core domain includes transaction-laundering detection and decisioning, web-presence and URL-policy controls, and low-quality e-commerce detection. We consume the signals and evaluations that support decisions in these spaces and convert them into evidence-based and auditable determinations that can be shared with the rest of the Supportability platforms.
 The pitch is: join a high-ownership team solving some of Stripe’s hardest risk problems. We build technology that helps Stripe distinguish legitimate businesses from bad actors at scale, combining sophisticated engineering, AI-assisted investigation, and meaningful real-world impact.
 What you’ll do
 You will own a meaningful part of a risk-decisioning problem from investigation and design through implementation, rollout, measurement, and iteration. You will help build both the domain capabilities and the modern agentic infrastructure required to make Supportability decisions consistent, stateful, explainable, and appropriate to the business, product, and moment in time. Depending on team priorities and the candidate’s experience, this may include:
 Responsibilities
 Building the Supportability Decision Layer: a durable service and API through which automated systems, agents, and human reviewers can request, produce, retrieve, and understand canonical decisions.
 Developing the infrastructure that enables agentic investigations to synthesize policy, business identity and history, product context, risk appetite, and multiple assessment signals into explainable, confidence-calibrated decisions.
 Improving the transaction-laundering agent’s policy grounding, evidence quality, risk tiering, precision and recall, and use of behavioural, dispute, and other relevant signals.
 Designing durable decision state and history, including traceability from supporting evidence through reasoning and applied consequence, and validity and refresh policies that prevent stale outcomes from persisting.
 Building governed, reusable configuration and integration patterns that adapt decision capabilities across products, partners, countries, and permitted risk appetites without creating bespoke systems for each use case.
 Building reliable backend workflows on shared Supportability and Risk Platform infrastructure.
 Making complex risk decisions explainable to reviewers and affected users.
 Using data and feedback from outcomes, appeals, and corrections to improve decision quality while balancing the identification of bad actors against avoiding unnecessary harm to legitimate businesses.
 Modernising URL enforcement, including when and how URL checks run, reducing unnecessary review volume and user friction, and supporting migration away from legacy systems.
 Expanding shared SAE/SPO decisioning foundations, including due-diligence support and product-scoped remediation and appeal capabilities.
 Improving the Process Orchestration Framework and moving workflow code into more maintainable platform packages.
 Contributing to future work in automated LPM URL screening, low-quality e-commerce detection, wider web intelligence, and active test charges.
 Who you are 
 We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. 
 Minimum requirements
 2 - 7 years of industry software engineering experience (does not include internships or co-ops)
 You work effectively across the stack from top to bottom, comfortably navigating codebases with different languages and tools
 You're equally comfortable shipping user-facing experiences as you are writing custom queries to analyze experiment results
 Strong coding skills in any programming language (we understand new languages can be learned on the job, so our interview process is language-agnostic)
 Strong collaboration skills, with the ability to work across workstreams within your team and contribute to your peers' success
 Ability to thrive on a high level of autonomy and responsibility, and think of yourself as entrepreneurial

This will mean applying, extending, and building on the latest AI-powered tools to design and implement key systems, owning their architecture, implementation decisions, and validation methodology across new and existing designs.

items.desc:
About us
 Re-architecting Engineering for the Age of Intelligence
PhysicsX is the physics AI company for industrials. The company’s mission is to accelerate hardware innovation by overhauling what industrial engineering and manufacturing look like today. PhysicsX is building a new simulation software stack to deliver deep physics AI enablement across the entire engineering lifecycle. The company partners with leading organisations in aerospace & defence, automotive, semiconductors, materials, and energy & renewables, supporting them on some of their most critical and complex challenges. PhysicsX is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with offices in London, New York, and Singapore and an expanding presence in the Bay Area.
 The role
 You will build the LLM access layer for agents on the PhysicsX platform. That layer serves self-hosted open models and routes each task to the model, or combination of models, that best fits its constraints.
 We want to bring deep, production experience in self-hosted LLM serving and model routing into PhysicsX. You will establish the capability to run open models reliably and choose between self-hosted and external models according to the needs of each workload. You will set the technical direction for inference engines such as vLLM and SGLang, and serving platforms such as KServe. You will build foundations that product, delivery and customer teams can rely on.
 You will own both. You will learn our requirements and define the implementation, rather than inherit a prescribed gateway design. You will wire serving and routing into the existing platform, identity and observability systems.
 In the near term, you’ll make the platform’s agentic capabilities work out of the box, with no customer-supplied API key needed. Longer term, you’ll build the serving layer into a flexible routing foundation that balances competing priorities, such as cost, quality and data sensitivity, as our needs change.
 What you will do
 Make self-hosted serving and model routing work in air-gapped deployments, including sites where the hardware, connectivity and operational setup force constrained solutions.
 Own LLM packaging, registration, deployment, health checks, upgrades, rollback and retirement for supported LLMs.
 Evaluate and integrate serving platforms such as KServe, including inference services, serving runtimes, model loading and rollout controls.
 Define, model, and implement service levels for availability, quality, and performance metrics (e.g. time to first token, inter-token latency, and tail latency).
 Measure and improve throughput, GPU utilisation, memory use and cost per token under representative agent workloads.
 Tune continuous and chunked batching, KV and prefix caching, quantisation, speculative decoding and tensor, data or expert parallelism where appropriate.
 Evaluate advanced techniques such as cache-aware routing and prefill/decode disaggregation when workload evidence justifies their complexity.
 Build autoscaling, admission control and capacity management around GPU and serving signals rather than generic CPU metrics.
 Make every routing decision observable and explainable, and use evaluation evidence before adding specialist routes.
 Work with Research and Post-Training specialists to move candidate and tuned models through evaluation into supported production routes.
 Help determine how this capability should grow and, over time, shape the team around it.
 What you bring
 Where you need to be strongest
 You have operated inference engines such as vLLM or SGLang, or serving platforms such as KServe, under production traffic, latency and reliability constraints.
 You can explain the boundary between serving orchestration and inference execution, including how deployment, scaling and runtime configuration affect performance.
 You have built or operated model routing across more than one provider, and can explain how you balanced cost, quality, latency, failure and policy.
 You can describe the serving architecture you operated, the bottlenecks you found, the changes you made and the measured effect on latency, throughput, reliability or cost.
 You understand LLM inference as a systems problem: batching, scheduling, KV-cache behaviour, memory pressure, model parallelism and GPU utilisation.
 You have built and operated GPU workloads on Kubernetes, including deployment, scaling, observability and failure recovery.
 You can turn fast-moving open-source engines and provider APIs into a supportable product with versioning, compatibility testing, rollback and clear operational boundaries.
 You are a strong systems engineer who remains hands-on in architecture, implementation, profiling and production debugging.
 Your experience goes materially beyond local model runners or demonstrations; tools such as Ollama are not a substitute for production serving ownership.
 Foundations
 Strong Python plus a systems language such as Go, Rust or C++.

items.desc: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. What you'll build and who you'll work with Every Alan product, in every country, runs on the same backend: events, queues, cache, data shared between components, transactions. More than 200 engineers build on it every day. It carries more than 1 million members today. It must carry 10 million, in more countries, with more regulated health data. You would join Backend Platform , a new team in our engineering organisation. Our job is to rethink the backend of a fully grown company, while it keeps running. Today almost everything runs in one Python monolith on one database. We are moving it towards big services that scale on their own, one pilot at a time. We build the tools that make this possible, and we set the rules for how Alan builds backends. This is a rare kind of project. The codebase serves real members and customers every day, and we have the mandate to change how it is built. What we decide now will shape how hundreds of engineers work for years. You will learn a lot, and your work will have a real impact. The team is small and growing: 3 engineers today, 6 next year. Its mission: Own the backend building blocks every Alan product depends on, and make them simple enough that product teams use them without needing us. Your scope The events pipeline. How our components and services talk to each other asynchronously: a Postgres outbox, Redis Streams, an S3 archive. It is in production for about 20 components. You make it a product that teams use on their own. Data replication between services. A service publishes read-only tables. Other services keep a local, fresh copy and join on it. This replaces slow joins across components. Towards big services. The tools to take capabilities out of the monolith: a service template, APIs between services, traces across services, dependency management. We start with a pilot and turn it into a playbook. The shared runtime. Queues, cache, the transaction layer. Their limits, their SLOs, their headroom. The backend direction. The rules for how we build backends at Alan, written with the other engineering teams. The stack Python, Flask, SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL, Redis, RQ, Datadog, all in a monorepo. New services are async-first. We deploy daily and believe in distributed ownership: you build it, you own it. You don't need prior Python experience. Is it you we're looking for? Experience we value 5+ years of backend engineering, with code other teams depend on: libraries, frameworks, pipelines, internal platforms. You ran it in production and owned it. Distributed systems as a daily tool: events and messaging (delivery guarantees, ordering, idempotence, retries), data replication, consistency, transactions. PostgreSQL in depth: transactions, locks, replication, query plans. You have split a monolith or built services, step by step, while production kept running. You measure before you optimise, and you set SLOs and alerts for what you own. English working proficiency. French is not required. Mindset we value Product mindset. Product teams are your customers. Adoption is how you measure success. Enabler. You build things others use on their own, instead of doing the work for them. You write to think and align. Short framing docs and decision records are how this team works with the rest of engineering. Influence without authority. You get other teams to change how they build, with no reporting line. Incremental. One pilot first, then the playbook. No big-bang rewrites. Strong plus : you worked in a platform team that served product teams · event-driven architecture at scale · CDC or logical replication · async Python (asyncio, FastAPI) · multi-region or data residency · health, payments or other regulated data. Not required : frontend · Kubernetes and cluster operations · database administration · LLM or AI expertise. Other teams own those. What we’re looking for …

items.desc: We Do Consulting Differently Open to all genders (m/f/d) About the role We are seeking Forensic Consultants across all experience levels to join our Düsseldorf-based team. You will support investigations and disputes by combining digital evidence, data analytics and technology-enabled solutions to establish facts and deliver clear, actionable findings. We welcome junior candidates with relevant internships and a genuine interest in these areas, as well as experienced professionals who can independently deliver workstreams or lead complex engagements. Your areas of work Depending on your experience and specialization, you will contribute to one or more of the following areas: IT Forensics: Identify, preserve, collect and analyze digital evidence. Examples include creating forensic images of laptops, collecting email and cloud data, recovering deleted files, and analyzing metadata or user activity to reconstruct events, while maintaining evidence integrity and chain-of-custody documentation. eDiscovery: Support the management of electronic information from collection and processing through document review and production. Examples include processing and deduplicating email collections, developing keyword searches, configuring review workflows, applying redactions and preparing document productions using platforms such as Relativity, Nuix or comparable solutions. Structured Data Analytics: Analyze transactional and business data from SAP and other ERP systems to identify anomalies and support investigations. Examples include examining general-ledger entries, procurement transactions and vendor master data; identifying duplicate payments or unusual journal entries; and reconciling data across systems using tools such as SQL, Python, Alteryx, Power BI or advanced Excel. AI Agents and AI Implementation: Develop, implement or evaluate AI-enabled solutions for investigative and analytical workflows. Examples include building assistants that search investigation documents and provide source-linked answers, automating document classification and information extraction, or developing agents that query approved transactional datasets and flag anomalies for human review. Solutions should incorporate appropriate confidentiality safeguards, access controls, accuracy testing and human oversight. What you bring Junior / entry-level candidates You demonstrate a genuine interest in one or more of the areas above, supported by relevant internships, working-student roles or comparable practical experience. For example, you may have assisted with digital-evidence collection, supported a document-review exercise, analysed transactional data or developed an AI prototype during an internship or university project. You are keen to develop your technical expertise and learn how to apply it to investigations. Prior independent engagement delivery is not expected. Experienced consultants You bring demonstrable hands-on experience in one or more of the areas above and can independently deliver defined workstreams. For example, you may have conducted forensic collections, managed eDiscovery processing, analyzed SAP transactions for potential irregularities or implemented an AI-supported review workflow. You can document your methods, validate your results and explain findings clearly to colleagues and clients. Senior candidates through SMC You bring substantial relevant experience and can design approaches, lead engagements, supervise teams and oversee quality. For example, you may have defined a digital-evidence collection strategy, led a large-scale eDiscovery engagement, designed a transactional analytics programme or overseen the implementation of an AI solution with appropriate governance. You can manage client relationships, budgets and deadlines, and communicate complex findings to legal counsel, management and other stakeholders. German-language proficiency Native-level or equivalent fluency in written and spoken German is required—for example, to review German-language business records, discuss findings with clients and legal counsel, and prepare clear reports in German. Candidates are not expected to have experience in every area or with every named tool. We will assess the breadth and depth of your expertise against the seniority and focus of the role. Our culture centers on agility and connectivity which sets us apart and gets you ahead. At BRG, our professionals include specialist consultants, industry experts, renowned academics, and leading-edge data scientists. Together, they bring a diversity of real-world experience, data, and human and artificial intelligence, to economics, disputes, and investigations; corporate finance; and performance improvement services that address the most complex challenges facing organizations across the globe. Perché scegliere il gruppo OVS? In OVS SpA troverai un'azienda strutturata, un ambiente dinamico e fortemente orientato al risultato. Stiamo innovando la tradizione, con un forte investimento sulle nuove tecnologie, per offrire a clienti e dipendenti un'esperienza sempre più completa e digitale, senza trascurare l'attenzione per l'ambiente, il futuro e la sostenibilità. Inoltre, avrai accesso a: Welfare aziendale e percorsi di Wellbeing e Parenting Area wellness con corsi gratuiti di yoga, pilates, functional training Percorsi di formazione sia tecnico specialistici che manageriali Ristorante aziendale Sconti del 25% su tutti i nostri brand Accesso a vantaggi riservati ai dipendenti del gruppo (viaggi, elettronica...) items.desc: JOB DESCRIPTION Liquidity risk sits at the heart of every financial institution's resilience, and the team behind it rarely gets the spotlight it deserves. This role puts you squarely in that spotlight: you will own the data that drives regulatory submissions to the FED, PRA, ECB, and APAC regulators, directly influencing how the firm demonstrates its financial strength to the world's most demanding supervisors. As a Liquidity Data & Reporting Senior Analyst in the Liquidity Risk Reporting team you will have a chance to support daily and monthly liquidity risk reporting processes. You will work in collaboration with other Team members validating, reconciling and correcting various liquidity risk data followed by their consumption into liquidity reporting and regulatory submission to FED/PRA/ECB and APAC regulators. You will work in Warsaw based Team and additionally cooperate with Team members in Bangalore, London, Hong-Kong, Delaware, New Jersey providing support to stakeholders around the Globe. Job responsibilities Perform financial product day to day data analysis to identify & resolve liquidity reporting data issues within extensive size data sets. Support and ownership of the production of internal and external liquidity regulatory reporting (ie. LCR, ALMM, NSFR, Stress) in line with Basel guidance Perform product reconciliations & assist with daily variance analysis Identify improvements and leverage available toolsets (Alteryx, Tableau, Excel) to own and implement changes through to completion Support development and work within the Reporting AI Agent infrastructure Improve timeliness and reduce operational risk to the firm Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills 1+ year of continuous experience in the reporting area or large data sets operations An experience with working on large data sets and advanced literacy maneuvering within those An experience or interest with financial instruments like Deposits, Loans Bonds, Derivatives An experience or interest within liquidity risk management in financial institutions Bachelor degree required (Engineering, Finance or Business degree) Strong analytic acumen, attention to details Strong MS Excel Ability to adjust to changing environment and assigned book of work Ability to work in frequently changing environment of what and how is being delivered. Teamwork attitude Adherence to 5 days a week work from the office model supported with Firmwide rules defined managerial exceptions. ABOUT US J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives. We also offer a range of benefits and programs to meet employee needs. Benefits include comprehensive health care coverage, a retirement savings plan, insurance benefits, a discount program including sportscard benefit, an Employee Assistance Program, wellness benefits and more. Eligible employees may also access the company's social fund for financial support. Additional details about total compensation and benefits will be provided during the hiring process. We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation. ABOUT THE TEAM Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we're setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success. Risk Management helps the firm understand, manage and anticipate risks in a constantly changing environment. The work covers areas such as evaluating country-specific risk, understanding regulatory changes and determining credit worthiness. Risk Management provides independent oversight and maintains an effective control environment.

Your tasks will include: Data analysis - scrape, clean and model complex datasets to support strategic hypotheses Field research - conduct field research and interviews with market experts to gather qualitative insights Strategic recommendations - shape hypotheses and visualize findings to present clear, data-driven recommendations to leadership teams Required Qualifications Student in a top-tier business or engineering school/university At least one prior relevant experience in consulting, data science or AI Proven proficiency in Python is required: you must be comfortable reading code, developing scripts and working with data and LLM inference libraries (Pandas, NumPy, vLLM, Ollama, etc.) Full-stack literacy (a plus, not a must): a sense of how a project is architected end to end (back, front, database), ideally with some hands-on exposure Familiarity with relational (SQLite, PostgreSQL) and vector databases (e.g. Qdrant), and an interest in semantic search and RAG pipelines Full fluency in English; proficiency in French or German is a strong advantage, and a good working knowledge of other European languages is a plus Soft Skills You have a "consultant mindset": analytical, rigorous, and able to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders You enjoy sitting with users, watching how consultants actually work, and turning their feedback into shipped improvements You are proactive and comfortable being handed a problem rather than a spec, taking ownership, diving in, brainstorming solutions and building tools with a tangible impact on business performance

items.desc: Van slimme AI-modellen naar oplossingen die écht werken. Een AI-model bouwen is één ding. Zorgen dat het betrouwbaar draait, gekoppeld is aan echte data en waarde toevoegt bij een klant: daar wordt het interessant. Bij adesso werk je aan AI-oplossingen die verder gaan dan experimenten, van machine learning en MLOps tot generatieve AI, LLM's en agents. Je bouwt, implementeert en verbetert oplossingen die organisaties echt gebruiken. Wat ga je doen? Als Medior AI Engineer werk je samen met senior AI Engineers en Forward Deployed Engineers aan klantprojecten. Je pakt zelfstandig onderdelen op en groeit in architectuur en end-to-end verantwoordelijkheid. AI ontwikkelen: je bouwt ML-modellen, LLM-toepassingen en agentic workflows. Van idee naar productie: je bouwt data- en ML-pipelines, automatiseert deployments en zorgt voor monitoring en betrouwbaarheid. Slim integreren: je koppelt AI aan bestaande systemen, API's en cloud- en dataplatformen. Meedenken met de klant: je vertaalt vraagstukken naar praktische, schaalbare oplossingen. Kennis delen: je legt herbruikbare patronen vast en deelt wat je leert met je collega's. Projecten die verder gaan dan het model We richten ons op retail en e-commerce, finance en utilities. Denk aan: Prognoses waar planners op durven te sturen, van retailassortiment tot netbelasting. Intelligente documentverwerking, zoals KYC-dossiers of inspectierapporten, met herleidbare bronnen. Agents die werk voorbereiden in klantenservice en backoffice, met evals en guardrails. Computer vision, zoals in de fitnessbranche, waar we onveilige situaties in onbemande 24/7-locaties herkennen. De uitdaging zit niet alleen in het model, maar ook in betrouwbaarheid, integratie en de werking in de praktijk. Je kiest steeds de techniek die bij het probleem past. Wat breng je mee? Ervaring met het ontwikkelen en in productie brengen van ML- of GenAI-oplossingen. Goede kennis van Python, SQL en machine learning. Ervaring met MLOps en/of LLM's, RAG en AI-agents. Kennis van minimaal één cloudplatform (Azure, AWS of GCP) en een dataplatform zoals Databricks, Snowflake of Fabric. Je werkt met coding agents en beoordeelt kritisch wat ze opleveren. Je denkt vanuit de klantvraag en legt technische keuzes helder uit. Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels. Wat dit níet is Geen individuele detachering. Je werkt aan projecten namens adesso, met een team achter je. Geen notebook-kerkhof. Een model is pas af als het in productie draait en gebruikt wordt. Geen GenAI omdat het kan. Soms is een klassiek model beter, soms een LLM; jij kiest wat past. Geen werk op afroep. Je denkt vanaf de klantvraag mee, niet pas als het ontwerp al vastligt. Het team Je wordt onderdeel van ons AI Engineering-team: AI engineering consultants in twee rollen. De Forward Deployed AI Engineer (FDE) is eigenaar van het klantprobleem en ontwerpt de oplossing, inclusief de agentic architectuur. Jij gaat als AI Engineer de diepte in op bouw, data, MLOps en schaal, en denkt vanaf de klantvraag mee over de juiste aanpak. Je krijgt ruimte om je eigen werk vorm te geven, maar je bent nooit alleen verantwoordelijk voor alle specialismen. Heb je diepe kennis van finance, retail of utilities en wil je dichter op de klant zitten? Kijk dan ook naar onze FDE-vacatures. Twijfel je? Solliciteer dan gewoon; we kijken samen welke rol het best past. Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen. Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt. We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief. Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen. AI-native: wij omarmen AI, ook in ons eigen werk We geloven dat AI fundamenteel verandert hoe we software bouwen, met data werken en klanten helpen. Daarom bouwen we niet aan losse experimenten, maar aan dataplatformen, AI-first applicaties en agentic oplossingen die echt onderdeel worden van bedrijfsprocessen. Dat geldt ook voor hoe we zelf werken. Met onze Agentic Delivery-aanpak en eigen tools kun je echt vliegen: Context en kennisbank: agents werken met wat er écht speelt bij de klant, en kennis en beslissingen blijven herleidbaar voor mens én agent. AgentOps en governance: zicht op wat agents doen en controle over wat ze mogen, zodat ze veilig en binnen de regels werken. adSCAILE: ons eigen framework waarmee je samen met AI-agents bouwt, geïntegreerd, veilig en traceerbaar, in cycli van twee tot vier dagen in plaats van sprints van weken. Je gebruikt deze tools dagelijks en helpt ze verder te ontwikkelen. adesso is bovendien Select Partner in het Claude Partner Network van Anthropic. En we …

items.desc: Between AI possibilities and engineering reality, there is usually a gap. ➡️ Your job is to close it! Some of the most valuable expertise at Etteplan has been built over years of solving complex engineering challenges, designing plants and delivering successful projects. Every day, our engineers make critical decisions, solve complex problems and create value for our customers. Your mission is to identify where AI can support that work, remove unnecessary effort and help engineering teams focus on what they do best. As an Applied AI Engineer, you bring AI into the day-to-day reality of engineering projects. You work with experienced engineers, understand their challenges and identify where AI can accelerate workflows, improve consistency and create measurable value. From specifications and datasheets to drawings and engineering documentation, you build practical solutions that help project teams work smarter and deliver faster. The result is not another AI prototype. It is measurable value in real customer projects: fewer hours per work package, more consistent output, and solutions the project teams keep using after you have moved on to the next case. What you'll step into: Smart Factory Germany: more than 200 colleagues at five German sites, working across automation, digitalisation and IT/OT Your base is Leverkusen, Berlin, Brunsbüttel, Oberhausen or Wiesloch, hybrid, with the freedom to work where the use case is. Direct access to decision makers: you report to the Vice President Smart Factory Germany and work closely with our Group AI organisation in Finland. Your starting point is electrical engineering and instrumentation, where the opportunity for impact is highest. You are the first person in this role in Germany. The blank page is part of the offer. Your Mission 🔧 Turn AI into an engineering advantage You evaluate emerging AI technologies and identify where they can create tangible value for engineering teams. Rather than introducing tools for the sake of innovation, you focus on solutions that improve the way projects are executed. 🧩 Turn engineering challenges into AI opportunities You work closely with engineering teams to understand where time is lost, information is difficult to access or repetitive tasks slow projects down. Together, you identify high-value use cases and translate them into practical AI-supported solutions that fit naturally into existing engineering workflows. ⚙️ Prove AI where it matters You bring AI solutions into live customer projects and validate their impact under real-world conditions. You establish baselines, measure outcomes and demonstrate tangible improvements in efficiency, consistency and delivery performance. Success isn't determined by how impressive a solution looks. It's determined by whether project teams continue using it after the pilot ends. 🤝 Make it work without you Everything you build is documented, versioned and handed over so that engineering colleagues can run and extend it themselves. You support our regional network of AI champions with building blocks and hands-on help. A solution that only works while you are in the room does not count. items.desc: Between AI possibilities and engineering reality, there is usually a gap. ➡️ Your job is to close it! Some of the most valuable expertise at Etteplan has been built over years of solving complex engineering challenges, designing plants and delivering successful projects. Every day, our engineers make critical decisions, solve complex problems and create value for our customers. Your mission is to identify where AI can support that work, remove unnecessary effort and help engineering teams focus on what they do best. As an Applied AI Engineer, you bring AI into the day-to-day reality of engineering projects. You work with experienced engineers, understand their challenges and identify where AI can accelerate workflows, improve consistency and create measurable value. From specifications and datasheets to drawings and engineering documentation, you build practical solutions that help project teams work smarter and deliver faster. The result is not another AI prototype. It is measurable value in real customer projects: fewer hours per work package, more consistent output, and solutions the project teams keep using after you have moved on to the next case. What you'll step into: Smart Factory Germany: more than 200 colleagues at five German sites, working across automation, digitalisation and IT/OT Your base is Leverkusen, Berlin, Brunsbüttel, Oberhausen or Wiesloch, hybrid, with the freedom to work where the use case is. Direct access to decision makers: you report to the Vice President Smart Factory Germany and work closely with our Group AI organisation in Finland. Your starting point is electrical engineering and instrumentation, where the opportunity for impact is highest. You are the first person in this role in Germany. The blank page is part of the offer. Your Mission 🔧 Turn AI into an engineering advantage You evaluate emerging AI technologies and identify where they can create tangible value for engineering teams. Rather than introducing tools for the sake of innovation, you focus on solutions that improve the way projects are executed. 🧩 Turn engineering challenges into AI opportunities You work closely with engineering teams to understand where time is lost, information is difficult to access or repetitive tasks slow projects down. Together, you identify high-value use cases and translate them into practical AI-supported solutions that fit naturally into existing engineering workflows. ⚙️ Prove AI where it matters You bring AI solutions into live customer projects and validate their impact under real-world conditions. You establish baselines, measure outcomes and demonstrate tangible improvements in efficiency, consistency and delivery performance. Success isn't determined by how impressive a solution looks. It's determined by whether project teams continue using it after the pilot ends. 🤝 Make it work without you Everything you build is documented, versioned and handed over so that engineering colleagues can run and extend it themselves. You support our regional network of AI champions with building blocks and hands-on help. A solution that only works while you are in the room does not count. Who we're looking for We are looking for a builder. Someone who enjoys turning ideas into working solutions and who is equally comfortable discussing engineering challenges and AI technologies. You are curious about what AI can do, but even more interested in what it can achieve in practice. Most importantly, you care about outcomes, not hype. What You Bring ✔ Understanding of plant engineering, ideally electrical engineering, instrumentation or automation ✔ Strong affinity for AI, prompting, agents, retrieval and modern AI workflows ✔ Experience working with Python and integrating data sources, tools and APIs ✔ Something you have actually shipped into real use, at work or on your own time ✔ A pragmatic mindset focused on delivery and impact ✔ The ability to bridge engineering expertise and technology ✔ Strong collaboration skills and the patience to work side-by-side with experienced domain experts ✔ Fluent German and English Nice to have ➕ Experience in process industries such as chemicals, pharmaceuticals or energy ➕ Familiarity with engineering software ecosystems and their interfaces ➕ Experience working with RAG, agents, multimodal AI or retrieval-based solutions ➕ Experience capturing and operationalising expert knowledge ➕ Projects, experiments or side initiatives that demonstrate your curiosity and builder mindset Between AI possibilities and engineering reality, there is usually a gap. items.desc: Lieu : Rungis, France Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. Nos engagements, vos avantages Notre savoir-faire technologique Notre attention portée à l’équilibre des collaborateurs Un environnement inclusif et bienveillant Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu (Thales Solidarity, indice CAC 40 ESG…) Votre quotidien Nous fournissons et soutenons des systèmes pour la gestion et la protection de l'espace aérien. Nous travaillons avec passion dans un cadre architectural moderne, et s'efforce de repousser les limites de la technologie dans nos secteurs clés. Au sud de Paris, notre site est facilement accessible en transport en commun. Vous intégrerez un bureau d’études dans le cadre du déploiement de technologies d’intelligence artificielle de confiance pour le développement de produits de haute technologie. Vous contribuerez à l’intégration d’outils d’IA aux logiciels de simulation électronique et de compatibilité électromagnétique, afin d’améliorer les performances globales et les méthodes de travail des équipes d’ingénierie. Vous serez dans un premier temps basé sur le site de Rungis, puis sur le site de Vélizy-Villacoublay. En nous rejoignant, vous vous verrez confier les missions suivantes : Réaliser une recherche bibliographique sur les outils d’intelligence artificielle de confiance de Thales et leurs exigences d’utilisation, et contribuer à l’enrichissement du fonds documentaire IA du département Hardware ; Développer des couplages entre des outils d’IA et le logiciel de simulation LTspice pour l’étude et l’optimisation de phénomènes électromagnétiques ; Coupler des outils d’optimisation basés sur l’IA avec les outils d’ingénierie utilisés pour les études de performance radio de systèmes multisenseurs ; Mettre en place une base de connaissance et former les collaborateurs aux procédures et aux outils IA mis en œuvre ; Développer des solutions d’IA générative pour analyser automatiquement les rapports de tests CEM, produire des avis techniques et faciliter la prise de décision ; Explorer les applications de l’IA générative à l’analyse documentaire, notamment pour l’exploitation des normes, des guides techniques et de la documentation scientifique, ainsi que pour l’aide à la rédaction et à la formalisation de rapports (prompting, bases de données documentaires, procédures, etc.). Votre Profil Vous préparez un BAC+5 (école d’ingénieur ou université) en éléctronique ou télécommunication avec une spécialisation en IA ou Mathématiques et recherchez un stage de 6 mois ? Vous avez un fort attrait pour les outils d'IA et pour la programmation informatique ? Vous avez déjà développé des applications ou des outils utilisant l’intelligence artificielle ? Vous avez des connaissances en électronique, radio et électromagnétisme ? Vous avez déjà rédigé des procédures techniques ou des rapports ? Vous avez un bon niveau d’anglais, à l’écrit comme à l’oral ? Vous avez déjà utilisé le logiciel LTSpice pour réaliser des simulations électroniques ? Vous avez déjà travaillé sur du traitement mathématique ou développé des modèles analytiques ? Vous savez faire preuve de rigueur, d’autonomie et d’esprit d’initiative dans un projet ? Alors ce poste est fait pour vous ! Mot De L'équipe Le service Bureau d’Etudes intervient sur un large éventail de disciplines (Mécanique, Thermique, Electrotechnique, CEM) dans le développement de systèmes de défense, et accueille régulièrement des stagiaires ou des apprentis qui travaillent sur des sujets d’amélioration ou d’innovation. L’introduction des outils de l’IA dans les méthodes de travail au quotidien et dans l’utilisation d’outils d’ingénierie est un axe de développement important pour les projets en cours et à venir. L’équipe a à cœur de mettre les stagiaires dans les meilleures conditions pour réussir leurs missions. Tous nos stages sont conventionnés et soumis à une gratification dont le montant est déterminé selon votre niveau d’études. Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !
