Konzeption und Entwicklung moderner AI-Lösungen auf Basis von Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP und Generative AI Entwicklung intelligenter Anwendungen mit Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI
items.desc: Als Data & AI-Engineer konzipierst und entwickelst du Datenstrukturen, KI-Modelle und überführst sie in skalierbare, produktive Systeme. Du gestaltest Lösungen von der technischen Architektur über die Modellierung bis hin zur Integration in reale Anwendungsumgebungen. Gemeinsam mit unserem Engineering Team sitzt du am Puls der Zeit und arbeitest an modernen AI-Technologien – von klassischen ML-Verfahren und Deep-Learning-Ansätzen bis hin zu LLM-/GenAI-basierten Systemen (z. B. Retrieval-Augmented Generation oder agentenorientierten Ansätzen). Du analysierst komplexe Daten und baust skalierbare Dateninfrastrukturen. Große Datenmengen, anspruchsvolle Modelle und moderne AI-Technologien motivieren dich mehr als sie dich abschrecken? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen. Vollzeitstelle in Linz oder Wien mit Home Office Möglichkeit Deine Aufgaben Als Fullstack AI Engineer gestaltest du anspruchsvolle AI-Projekte von der ersten technischen Konzeption über die Softwareentwicklung bis zum stabilen produktiven Betrieb. Konzeption und Entwicklung moderner AI-Lösungen auf Basis von Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP und Generative AI Entwicklung intelligenter Anwendungen mit Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI Agents und automatisierten AI-Workflows Entwicklung und Integration von Backend-Services, APIs und Frontend-Komponenten für ganzheitliche AI-Anwendungen Konzeption skalierbarer Software- und AI-Architekturen in Cloud-, On-Premises- und hybriden Umgebungen Integration von AI-Modellen und AI-Services in bestehende Softwareprodukte und IT-Landschaften Verarbeitung und Anbindung strukturierter und unstrukturierter Daten als Grundlage leistungsfähiger AI-Anwendungen Aufbau automatisierter Testing-, Evaluierungs-, Deployment- und Monitoring-Prozesse für produktive AI-Systeme Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden – von der strukturierten Anforderungsanalyse bis zur produktiven Lösung Eigenständige technische Verantwortung für Arbeitspakete und abhängig von deiner Erfahrung auch gesamte Projekte Dein Profil Fundiertes Wissen im Bereich Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, NLP und Software Engineering mit nachweislicher praktischer Erfahrung in AI-Projekten Sehr gute Programmierkenntnisse in Python, Java oder vergleichbaren Hochsprachen sowie fundierte Erfahrung in der professionellen Softwareentwicklung Praktische Erfahrung mit LLMs, Generative AI und modernen AI-Konzepten wie RAG, Embeddings, Vector Databases oder AI Agents Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Backend-Services, REST APIs und der Integration unterschiedlicher Systeme Kenntnisse moderner Frontend-Technologien und Frameworks wie React, Angular oder Vue.js Erfahrung im Design skalierbarer Softwarearchitekturen sowie mit Deployment-Strategien und dem produktiven Betrieb von AI-Anwendungen Sicherer Umgang mit SQL- und NoSQL-Datenbanken sowie strukturierten und unstrukturierten Daten Know-how im Umgang mit Docker, CI/CD und Cloud-, On-Premises- oder hybriden IT-Umgebungen Verständnis für Clean Code, Testing, Security und die Entwicklung wartbarer, produktionsreifer Software Unser Angebot End-to-End AI Engineering: Entwickle intelligente Systeme und gestalte die gesamte technische Umsetzung – von der AI-Architektur bis zur produktiven Softwarelösung Volle technologische Gestaltungsfreiheit bei der Entwicklung innovativer AI-Lösungen – keine vorgegebenen Blueprints Teil eines Expertenteams im Bereich Artificial Intelligence und Software Engineering Umsetzung gesellschaftsrelevanter Projekte mit spürbar positiven Auswirkungen Junges, hochkompetentes und unternehmenslustiges Team Hochmodernes Arbeitsumfeld und Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Partnern und Universitäten Learn forever: Zahlreiche Weiterbildungs- und Vertiefungsmöglichkeiten in AI, Software Engineering und modernen Technologien Flexible Arbeitszeiten, Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten und regelmäßige Team-Events Nach Vorgaben des Gesetzgebers weisen wir auf das kollektivvertragliche Mindestgehalt 3.267 (14 mal p.a.) für die angebotene Stelle des Fullstack AI Engineers hin. Dein Startgehalt wird sich an deinen Qualifikation und Erfahrungen orientieren, Überbezahlungen sind bei uns daher möglich. Werde Teil des FiveSquare-Teams und gestalte gemeinsam mit uns die KI-Landschaft in Österreich. Wir freuen uns auf dich!

items.title: Ingénieur MLOps Cloud IA (H/F)
items.card: missions : Participer à la conception et à la mise en place d’une nouvelle infrastructure Cloud intégrant des briques d’Intelligence Artificielle. Définir l’architecture MLOps de la plateforme et les standards d’intégration des modèles d’IA au sein de l’infrastructure. Dimensionner et déployer les ressources de calcul dédiées à l’IA (GPU, stockage, réseau) sur Cloud public, privé ou environnements hybrides.
items.desc: Ingénieur MLOps Cloud IA (H/F) Vous souhaitez contribuer au déploiement d’une nouvelle infrastructure intégrant l’Intelligence Artificielle pour l’un de nos clients grands comptes du secteur de la Défense ? Ce poste est fait pour vous ! 👇 🚀 Vos principales missions : Participer à la conception et à la mise en place d’une nouvelle infrastructure Cloud intégrant des briques d’Intelligence Artificielle. Définir l’architecture MLOps de la plateforme et les standards d’intégration des modèles d’IA au sein de l’infrastructure. Dimensionner et déployer les ressources de calcul dédiées à l’IA (GPU, stockage, réseau) sur Cloud public, privé ou environnements hybrides. Industrialiser le déploiement et l’inférence des modèles de Machine Learning et d’IA générative (LLM, RAG) sur Kubernetes ou OpenShift. Construire et automatiser les pipelines de données et de modèles (CI/CD/CT), ainsi que le versioning des données, des modèles et des expérimentations. Mettre en place la supervision des modèles et de l’infrastructure : performance, dérive, consommation des ressources et coûts. Garantir la sécurité, la traçabilité et la conformité de la plateforme, en lien avec les équipes DevSecOps et cybersécurité. Accompagner les équipes Data Science et de développement dans l’intégration de leurs cas d’usage IA sur la nouvelle infrastructure. Participer aux choix d’architecture, à la veille technologique et à l’amélioration continue des pratiques MLOps. 🎓 Parlons un peu de vous : Formation : Diplôme d’ingénieur ou Bac+5 en informatique, intelligence artificielle, data science, cloud computing ou domaine équivalent. Expérience : Minimum 5 ans d’expérience en MLOps, DevOps, Data Engineering ou ingénierie plateforme Cloud, dont une expérience significative dans la mise en production de modèles d’IA. Compétences clés : Maîtrise des environnements Cloud (Azure, AWS ou Cloud privé) et expérience dans la conception ou le déploiement d’infrastructures dédiées à l’IA. Expertise sur les outils MLOps tels que MLflow, Kubeflow, DVC, Airflow ou équivalents. Expérience en déploiement et serving de modèles, notamment d’IA générative (LLM, RAG, inférence sur GPU). Maîtrise de Python et des principaux frameworks de Machine Learning (PyTorch, TensorFlow). Maîtrise de la conteneurisation et de l’orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift). Bonne connaissance des chaînes CI/CD (GitLab CI, Jenkins, ArgoCD) et de l’Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible). Solides connaissances en sécurité, observabilité, haute disponibilité et optimisation des coûts d’infrastructure. Rigueur, autonomie, esprit d’équipe et capacité à vulgariser auprès d’interlocuteurs variés. 👥 Qui sommes-nous ? Savant mélange entre le savoir-faire allemand et la créativité à la française, Technology & Strategy est une société d’ingénierie résolument tournée vers l’innovation et spécialisée dans le développement de systèmes embarqués intelligents, sécurisés et responsables. Notre agence est composée d’une équipe de passionnés, chaleureuse et à taille humaine. Elle déploie tout son savoir-faire pour accompagner nos clients, PME ou grands industriels, dans différents domaines (Système, logiciel, safety, cyber,...). Depuis nos bureaux d’études jusqu’aux centres R&D de nos clients, nos experts relèvent les défis technologiques de demain. Aussi passionnantes qu’exigeantes, nos activités rayonnent dans des secteurs variés tels que l’énergie, le médical, l’IOT, les transports... 🚗⚡ En pleine expansion depuis notre création en 2008, nous sommes déjà implantés dans 8 pays en Europe et à l’international, au travers de 22 agences qui regroupent près de 3600 ingénieurs. 🚀 📌 Processus de recrutement : 📞 Prise de contact téléphonique 👩 💼 Entretien avec un(e) RH 👨 💼 Entretien avec un(e) manager 👩 💻 Entretien technique Nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes bénéficiant d’une Reconnaissance de la Qualité de Travailleur Handicapé (RQTH). T&S Groupe encourage la diversité et l’égalité sur le lieu de travail. Tous les candidats qualifiés H/F sont pris en considération pour un emploi sur un pied d’égalité.

items.desc:
Who we are 
 About Stripe 
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. 
 About the team
 Specialist Solutions Architects (SSA) are domain experts aligned to specific Stripe solutions and customer buying centers. We have in-depth knowledge of specific solution offerings and a deep understanding of customer challenges. We align with specialist product sellers on deals, advise the broader pre-sales team on complex opportunities, support pipeline development and revenue attainment, serve as an advisor on go-to-market sales plays, and provide critical insights to our product and engineering teams.
 Stripe Radar is Stripe's fully integrated fraud and risk management platform. The Radar team's mission is to evolve from a best-in-class payment fraud product into a unified risk intelligence platform that protects businesses from all forms of financial loss—from sophisticated payment fraud and account takeovers to first-party misuse and policy abuse. With Radar, businesses can confidently navigate the evolving fraud landscape, accept more good revenue, and focus on growth.
 What you’ll do 
 You will collaborate closely with sales and pre-sales teams to drive pipeline and revenue targets, while also educating the product and engineering teams on market trends and strongly influencing the product roadmap. You will develop deep relationships with senior customer business leaders and grow Stripe's solution offerings with new and existing customers. As a subject matter expert, you will scale the broader organization by creating reusable assets and coaching others on complex, high-value opportunities. You will serve as the domain and product expert to our users and GTM team for Stripe Radar globally.
 Responsibilities 
 Act as a subject matter expert on Stripe's Radar product suite to accelerate opportunities globally
 Demonstrate a deep understanding of trends in the fraud and risk management ecosystem, including AI-powered detection, processor-agnostic architectures, and the shift from payment fraud to holistic business risk (policy abuse, account takeover, first-party misuse)
 Develop expertise with the functional and architectural patterns for deploying advanced fraud systems, including the lifecycle of rule management, ML model tuning, and manual review optimization
 Understand the ecosystem of risk and identity integrations (device fingerprinting, identity verification, bot mitigation, case management) Stripe must support for users to be successful
 Define, share, and learn best practices and reusable assets with the broader GTM organization to enhance the quality and efficiency of the team
 Create reference architectures to uplevel the team and refine reference solutions based on product enhancements and customer feedback
 Partner closely with the Radar product sales team on Stripe's largest and most complex Radar opportunities, leading solution strategy and owning key customer relationships
 Partner closely with the Radar product team to get early exposure to new products and features
 Serve as a "Voice of the Customer" internally to drive product and feature request prioritization, providing actionable insights on the competitive landscape and emerging fraud vectors
 Act as an escalation point to drive complex technical issues to resolution with Stripe's engineering team
 Stay current on competitive analysis and market differentiation
 Support marketing events including executive briefings, conferences, user groups, and trade shows
 Who you are 
 We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
 Minimum Requirements 
 7+ years of experience in a pre-sales, technical consulting, product, or risk strategy role focused on e-commerce fraud prevention, risk management, or trust and safety
 Deep working knowledge of the fraud and risk ecosystem, including payment fraud (CNP), account takeover (ATO), first-party misuse (friendly fraud), and policy/content abuse
 Demonstrated knowledge of risk management architectures, including the role of rules engines, machine learning models, and manual review queues in fraud decisioning
 Strong knowledge of the signals and data used in fraud detection: device/IP data, behavioral biometrics, identity verification, and graph-based analysis
 Strong knowledge of software engineering and architecture patterns, with the ability to understand how a wide variety of technologies …

items.desc:
At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.
 This position reports to: 
Innovation Enablement Manager 
 __
 As a Solution Architect, you will be accountable for defining and overseeing the end-to-end architecture of a strategic transformation program that replaces a business-critical legacy Product Configurator solution with a modern cloud-native platform
 You will establish the target architecture, migration strategy, integration landscape, and technology roadmap while ensuring the future solution is scalable, maintainable, secure, and aligned with business objectives. You will collaborate closely with business stakeholders, project managers, business analysts, developers, UX designers, external vendors, and enterprise architects. 
 This role requires deep knowledge in product configurator solutions, enterprise application modernization, Azure cloud services, and large-scale migration programs
 You will be mainly accountable for: 
 Owning the target solution architecture and technical vision for the Product Configurator transformation program, ensuring alignment with business and technology objectives.
 Assessing the existing legacy solution, including its architecture, integrations, business rules, data structures, and technical dependencies, and defining a migration strategy covering transition phases, coexistence, risk mitigation, and decommissioning plans.
 Managing architecture decisions across Azure cloud services, .NET Core applications, APIs, integrations, security, data management, monitoring, and DevOps, while designing scalable and highly available cloud-native solutions.
 Managing the modernization of legacy business logic, configurator rules engines, product models, and user interaction patterns to support the future-state solution.
 Defining the future-state integration architecture with ERP, CPQ, PLM, CRM, pricing systems, engineering solutions, and other enterprise applications, ensuring security, compliance, performance, reliability, maintainability, and scalability requirements are addressed.
 Supporting delivery teams during implementation by providing architectural guidance and technical knowledge, identifying technical risks, architecture constraints, and migration challenges early, and defining mitigation actions.
 Collaborating with Business Analysts to translate business requirements into solution designs and implementation roadmaps, ensuring alignment between business needs and technical solutions.
 Supporting the adoption of modern engineering practices, including CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, automated testing, and cloud-native development patterns.
 Qualifications for the role: 
 You have a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or an equivalent qualification.
 You have at least 10 years of experience in software architecture and enterprise application delivery.
 You have demonstrated experience managing the modernization and migration of legacy applications to Azure cloud environments, including defining migration strategies for complex enterprise solutions leveraging AI 
 You have extensive experience working with Product Configurator, CPQ, engineering-to-order, or manufacturing solutions.
 You possess advanced knowledge of Azure architecture and cloud-native design patterns, including microservices, event-driven architecture, distributed systems, and API-first approaches.
 You demonstrate effective stakeholder management and communication skills, enabling collaboration across business and technical teams.
 You have the ability to evaluate and question technical assumptions, provide recommendations, and shape strategic decisions.
 You demonstrate ownership and accountability for end-to-end solution delivery, with a structured and solution-oriented approach.
 Your benefits: 
 Enjoy flexible working hours to support your work-life balance.
 Benefit from the possibility of working from home, including a financial contribution to support your home office setup.
 Receive an annual financial bonus and benefit from an annual salary review.
 Explore opportunities for career growth and professional development within an international organization.
 Take advantage of a MultiSport card to support your health and well-being.
 Benefit from private medical care (including offers for family members) and life insurance.
 Access learning and development opportunities, including internal and external professional training and language courses.
 Choose from various benefits in kind, ranging from healthy lifestyle offerings and knowledge sharing to team-building activities.

Bring your biotech and data expertise to the heart of biopharmaceutical manufacturing. As a Biotech Engineer/PAT Specialist, you will take a leading technical role in developing and implementing Process Analytical Technologies (PAT) for real-time analytics and process control. You will apply your experience in biotech processes,Multivariate Data Analysis (MVDA) and statistical process control to turn complex process data into practical solutions for manufacturing. Working with automation engineers, process experts and scientists, you will help implement data-driven tools that strengthen decision-making and improve manufacturing efficiency. 
 Job Description 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Implement high-throughput approaches for real-time bioprocess monitoring and optimization, leveraging automation, online analytics and advanced data analysis.
 Lead technology development and continuous improvement initiatives supporting process intensification.
 Develop and deploy spectroscopy-based Process Analytical Technology methods, including Raman and dielectric spectroscopies.

 Apply multivariate data analysis methods for model development, validation and ongoing maintenance.
 Partner with Production, , Engineering and Automation teams to integrate new technologies in commercial manufacturing processes
 Analyze and communicate complex datasets through clear technical reports and presentations to support informed decision-making.
 Essential Requirements 
 University degree in Biotechnology, Chemical Engineering or a related scientific field.
 2–5 years of experience in the biopharmaceutical industry, with practical experience in biotechnology processes.
 Strong knowledge of advanced statistical methods and Multivariate Data Analysis, applied within a biotechnology environment.
 Proven experience with cell culture and/or purification processes, including process scale-up and scale-down.
 Experience working with complex process and spectral datasets, including developing, validating and interpreting data models.
 Good understanding of the pharmaceutical regulatory environment, including Good Manufacturing Practices, Quality Assurance, Quality Control and International Council for Harmonisation guidelines.
 Fluent English, with strong communication, problem-solving and cross-functional collaboration skills.
 Desirable Requirements 
 Experience with Raman spectroscopy or other spectroscopy-based Process Analytical Technology methods.
 Experience with online biomass monitoring or related real-time bioprocess analytical technologies.
 Previous experience with technology integration in GMP environments is a plus.

items.desc:
Apple's Software Localization & Release Engineering team makes sure our software works well for people in every language and region. We're looking for an ML Engineer to apply LLMs and machine learning to how we test and release software for our international users.
You'll own the model-facing side of AI-powered quality systems: designing LLM-based solutions, evaluating their accuracy, and improving them. Your goal is to make these systems reliable, efficient and trustworthy. You'll work on a fast-moving effort with real internal users that depend on it.
You'll work alongside automation, quality and localization engineers, and with international quality engineers, translators and project managers across several time zones. Your work will help Apple ship better software to people around the world.
Experience building production applications on top of LLMs, including tool use, structured output or agentic designs.
Hands-on experience with prompt engineering and systematic model evaluation, such as writing rubrics or graders and measuring precision and false-positive rates.
Strong programming skills in Swift / Python, and experience building backends for ML applications.
Ability to improve model behavior iteratively, based on measured results.
Hands-on experience fine-tuning or training models.
Experience with computer vision or object detection, such as detecting elements in screenshots or documents.
Experience with open-weights models and local inference.
Experience with multi-agent systems.
Familiarity with LLM serving infrastructure, such as model gateways, retries and cost-aware model selection.
Experience building feedback loops that turn model failures into improved prompts, classifiers or training data.
Familiarity with software test automation concepts, such as test execution, pass/fail grading and CI/CD.
Experience in software localization or internationalization.
Experience mentoring other engineers.

Our engineers are offered a foundation to work on cutting-edge technologies such as Foundation IP Design, Mobile SoCs, Storage Solutions, AI/ML, 5G/ 6G solutions, Neural processors, Serial Interfaces, Multimedia IPs and much more.

Job Description: 
 Une offre intitulée "Préparateur Industrialisation ensemble composite dynamique (H/F)" vient de s'ouvrir au sein d'Airbus Helicopters à Paris Le Bourget 
 Vous intégrerez une équipe dynamique et bienveillante aux profils et aux expériences variés qui vous permettront de progresser sur les aspects techniques et organisationnels du postes mais aussi sur vos soft skills. 
 Les ensembles composites dynamiques (Pales et sous ensemble composite) sont les ensembles tournant des hélicoptères pour lesquels les exigences qualité et sécurité sont très élevées. 
 Au sein du service industrialisation vous aurez comme mission pour l’ensemble de la gamme d’hélicoptères: 
 Le développement prototype des premières pièces 
 L’industrialisation de la fabrication série des ensembles composites 
 La contribution à l’amélioration continue et à l’intégration de nouvelles technologies et méthodes 
 TACHES & ACTIVITES 
 En charge de l’industrialisation vos tâches principales seront de: 
 Challenger, critiquer et valider les données d’entrées issues du bureau d’étude (plans, directives, design changes…) 
 Imaginer & optimiser les processus et séquences de fabrication et de contrôle . 
 Analyser les impacts processus, outillages, moyens, layout, flux, documentation. 
 Chiffrer et planifier l’implémentation d’une industrialisation 
 Réaliser et valider l’industrialisation en assurant la coordination de l’ensemble des acteurs associés : bureau d’étude, production, qualité, outillage… et en respectant les objectifs qualité, coûts, délai 
 Mesurer la performance de l’industrialisation livrée vs souhaitée : qualité, coût, délai de production 
 Assurer le reporting d’avancement vers les secteurs clients/demandeurs (KPI…) 
 Formaliser le retour d’expérience 
 Assurer le support technique aux ateliers internes pendant la phase d'industrialisation 
 Assurer l’amélioration continue des processus des ensembles dynamiques composites 
 Participer à l’amélioration continue des processus d’industrialisation, de support et du référentiel métier associé 
 Les atouts du postes 
 Être en interface avec de nombreux acteurs internes comme externes (bureau d’étude, production, qualité, industrie, projet, supply chain…) 
 Appréhender les secteurs de la production série ainsi que les processus d’industrialisation associés. 
 Renforcer vos compétences en matériaux composites et procédés. 
 D’être proche du produit et de son cycle de vie grâce à un contact quotidien avec les ateliers mettant en oeuvre la fabrication et le controle des pièces. 
 Développer de nouveaux concepts, process, pour la mise en œuvre des composites. 
 COMPETENCES 
 Savoir faire 
 Titulaire d’un bac +2/3 dans le domaine de l’ingénierie mécanique ou apparenté 
 Au moins 5 ans dans l’ingénierie de production 
 Connaissances composite (Connaissance des différents procédés , lecture de plan, nomenclature…) 
 Connaissance en ingénierie de production (mode opératoire, gamme de fabrication, documentation, moyens, outillages) 
 Outils : SAP, wiplink, , Suite office, NC Simul, DElmia 
 Langues : Français & anglais

 Agilité relationnelle importante, bonne communication (écrite et orale)

 Piloter les projets dans toutes leurs dimensions et étapes du cycle de vie depuis l’expression de besoins pour les premiers concepts jusqu’au déploiement de solutions « clef en main » sur les lignes de production en intégrant la maintenance.

Job Description: 
 Airbus Helicopters, a division of Airbus, is a global leader in the civil and military rotorcraft market. 
 Its mission is to provide civil and military helicopter solutions to its customers who serve and protect citizens, save lives and safely carry passengers in highly demanding environments. 
 Airbus Helicopters masters the complete helicopter value chain, from design and development, to industrialisation, production and support and services. It aims to ensure safety, quality, competitiveness and mission availability. 
 Airbus Helicopters España S.A. (AHE) integrates the Rotorcraft activities in Spain being a tractor company of other Spanish entities that participate in the Rotatory wing Aircraft Industry.
 EBSTIF perform Design and Stress activities participating in all the phases of the product, from specification to customer in-service support: conceptual and detail design, support to production (non-conformity assessment, generation of documentation needed for manufacturing, etc.), support to testing activities, generation of evidences for certification/qualification purposes and costumer support.
 In this context, EBSTIF is looking for candidates with:
 - Ability to design Helicopter structure components and assemblies that are optimized in terms of weight, cost, performance,production/assembly requirements while highest safety of the Product is assured using appropriate design tools.
 - Ability to verify the compliance of a detailed design solution toward baseline of validated requirements for a single sub-system / equipment / component / module.
 - Ability to develop modifications and retrofits within timescales as part of an integrated, multidisciplinary team.
 - Ability to adapt design solutions to real Helicopter configuration in a brief period of time
 - Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities and requirements. 
 - An innovative mindset and a natural curiosity about new technology. 
 Technical skills 
 - Mandatory: 5 years of experience in Composite and Metallic Helicopter Structure Design, CATIA V5, Microsoft Office user, Configuration management (VPM), Change management (ECR/ECP management), Knowledge of AH Manufacturing processes
 - Desirable: CATIA V4, Composite repair design
 - Ability to communicate technical subjects effectively and accurately to non-specialists.
 - Technical team lead experience would be a plus
 Soft skills 
 - Team spirit
 - English: advanced level. French: valuable
 - Proactive person with continuous improvement spirit
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
 - Open and curious mindset as well as a practical and agile approach

Job Description: 
 Airbus Commercial Aircraft is looking for a Wind tunnel model designer and stress calculation specialist (f/m) to join our Flight Physics / Aerodynamics department based in Toulouse , France. 
 You will be part of a team developing sophisticated wind tunnel models for research and development programmes. As part of the Wind Tunnel Technology team, you will be involved in designing and manufacturing aerodynamic test models aiming at delivering accurate aerodynamic data and airflow pattern evaluations for tests at Airbus and external wind tunnels. 
 Your working environment: 
 Global capital of aeronautics and European capital for space research, Toulouse is a dynamic city in the southwest of France served by an international airport. Ideally located between the Mediterranean sea and the Atlantic ocean and close to the Pyrenees mountains, it offers plenty of options for outdoor activities! 
 How we care for you: 
 Financial rewards: Attractive salary, agreements on success and profit sharing schemes, employee savings plan abounded by Airbus and employee stock purchase plan on a voluntary basis. 
 Work / Life Balance: Extra days-off for special occasions, holiday transfer option, a Staff council offering many social, cultural and sport activities and other services. 
 Wellbeing / Health: Complementary health insurance coverage (disability, invalidity, death). Depending on the site: health services center, concierge services, gym, carpooling application. 
 Individual development: Great upskilling opportunities and development prospects with unlimited access to +10.000 e-learning courses to develop your employability, certifications, expert career path, accelerated development programmes, national and international mobility. 
 At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking. 
 Your challenges: 
 Design wind tunnel models using Catia V5 while ensuring efficient manufacturing, assembly & instrumentation integration. 
 Perform structural analyses of wind tunnel models primarily using the Catia FEM module and hand calculations. 
 Liaise closely with suppliers to secure on-time, on-cost delivery and manufacturability of components. 
 Lead and coordinate tasks for other designers within the internal team and the external supply chain. 
 Define and optimize aerodynamic testing facilities and techniques in collaboration with programme stakeholders. 
 Your boarding pass: 
 Master degree in aeronautics, specialised in mechanical engineering. 
 This position requires at least 5 years of experience in an industrial environment. 
 Hands-on mechanical CAD design skills, ideally in Catia V5. 
 Structural analysis expertise via Finite Element Analysis (Catia FEM module) and hand calculations. 
 Knowledge of design for manufacture (DFM) of metallic structures (composites know-how is a plus). 
 Familiarity with aerodynamic testing and wind tunnel terminology would be an advantage. 
 Advanced level both in French and in English.

Job Description: 
 Envolez-vous avec Airbus Helicopters ! 
 Airbus Helicopters recherche un Ingénieur Systèmes pour l’architecture des données de Maintenance (f/h) pour rejoindre le Maintenance et Operations sol basé à Marignane, France . 
 Rejoignez-nous pour façonner l'avenir de l'aéronautique et contribuer à protéger des vies lors des missions accomplies grâce à nos hélicoptères. 
 Le site de Marignane, 3ème site industriel français, près de Marseille et d'Aix-en-Provence se transforme en profondeur pour offrir un environnement de travail de haute technologie, inclusif et respectueux de l'environnement. 
 Vous vivrez une expérience professionnelle unique, au cœur de la fabrication de nos hélicoptères. 
 Pour en savoir plus sur notre site et nos activités : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=flu57j6g-0g 
 Vos futures missions : 
 En rejoignant notre équipe, vous participerez à différentes missions, toutes orientées vers la définition des activités de Maintenance sur hélicoptères chez nos clients. 
 Les opérations de maintenance sur les hélicoptères sont des activités clés pour les clients d'Airbus. Par conséquent, la charge de travail de maintenance doit être optimisée afin de maximiser la disponibilité de la flotte d'hélicoptères et de répondre aux attentes des clients. 
 Pour concrétiser cette ambition, et dans un environnement où des solutions basées sur les données sont nécessaires, un poste d'Ingénieur en architecture des données de maintenance vient de s'ouvrir au sein d'Airbus Helicopters à Marignane. 
 Vous intégrerez le département « Maintenance & Ground Operations » (Maintenance et Opérations au sol) du bureau d'études d'Airbus Helicopters, et ferez partie de l'équipe transverse « Maintenance Data Management ». 
 L'objectif de cette équipe est de définir et de mettre en œuvre des solutions au sol optimisées et basées sur les données d'hélicoptères pour nos utilisateurs finaux de maintenance, ainsi de soutenir les offres de services connectés d'Airbus Helicopters. L'équipe « Maintenance & Ground Operations » est basée à Marignane (France) et à Donauwörth (Allemagne) ; les deux équipes travaillent en étroite collaboration pour harmoniser les méthodes et partager les expériences. 
 Missions et responsabilités 
 Vos principales missions seront : 
 Contribuer à la définition de la politique de produit des solutions de maintenance d'hélicoptères basées sur les données avioniques. 
 Piloter le concept d'utilisation de l'avionique en maintenance pour les hélicoptères civils et militaires en développement, en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec : Les responsables du support produit (Product Support Officers) et l'architecte de maintenance de chaque hélicoptère concerné. 
 Les équipes d'essais en vol d'Airbus Helicopters et les équipes CAMO en tant que « voix » internes des clients. 
 Les responsables « Santé et Utilisation » (Health and Usage). 
 Les responsables de la gestion des pannes (Failure management). 
 Les architectes avioniques embarqués. 
 Soutenir la construction d'offres futures basées sur les données de maintenance des hélicoptères. 
 Soutenir le développement de produits au sol impliqués dans la maintenance et basés sur les données des hélicoptères. 
 Vous ferez le lien entre les besoins des clients et les équipes techniques, en traduisant la stratégie et les processus métier en une architecture logique pour le système d'information : 
 Modéliser la circulation des informations et des flux de travail au sein de l'organisation. 
 Définir ce que le système doit faire (règles métier, cas d'utilisation, dépendances) et garantir la cohérence globale de la solution. 
 Transformer des exigences complexes en spécifications fonctionnelles claires pour les équipes de développement. 
 Garantir que les développements servent activement la vision stratégique globale. 
 Compétences et qualifications requises 
 Vous êtes ingénieur systèmes ou avionique avec 5 à 10 ans d'expérience. 
 Vous avez de l'expérience en maintenance aéronautique. 
 Vous avez des connaissances sur les opérations et missions d'hélicoptères. 
 Vous êtes capable de naviguer dans des environnements complexes avec de multiples parties prenantes tout en gardant un état d'esprit centré sur le client. 
 Vous possédez des compétences d'écoute active associées à une communication persuasive. 
 Vous êtes autonome, organisé et résilient pour mener à bien des projets de bout en bout, et vous possédez de solides compétences en gestion de projet. 
 Un anglais courant est indispensable pour évoluer dans cet environnement international.

items.desc:
In our R&D group, we develop hearing solutions and services for hearing impaired people and hearing care professionals in the form of hearing instruments, accessories, web services, mobile applications and PC software. 
 In a team of electrical and software engineers, you will contribute to the design, development and maintenance of modern C++ embedded software and tools. 
 The development is focused on hardware abstraction embedded C++ software to abstract the multi-processor hardware for efficient embedded software application development and specific applications for platform integration and verification. 
 Your work will build the foundation for all Sonova hearing instrument product applications, developed by Sonova teams worldwide. You will work close to hardware while developing modern embedded software on the edge of the constraints of a deeply embedded system. 
 More about the role : 
 Develop reliable, high-performance, real-time embedded software in modern C++ for hardware abstraction and service layers 
 Contribute to design and architecture for drivers and service layers in close collaboration with software engineers and architects. 
 Develop software which requires a deep understanding of custom SoCs 
 Develop abstraction layers that enable efficient usage of simulators. 
 Close collaboration with engineers across disciplines in product and platform teams 
 Contribute to our agile development process 
 More about you : 
 MSc or BSc in electrical engineering, computer science or comparable qualifications 
 Strong expertise in low power embedded software engineering, including RTOS, concurrency and distributed systems 
 5+ years of professional experience in C and C++. Experience with modern C++ standards, including C++23, is a plus 
 Strong understanding of object-oriented design and its application in embedded and resource-constrained environments 
 Experience with Python is a plus 
 Experience or interest in AI coding agents, continuous integration, and automated test frameworks 
 A structured, methodical approach and a passion for solving complex technical problems 
 Fluent in English; German is a plus 
 More about what we offer :

 Farai parte dell'unità Group Consolidation di Enel S.p.A., all'interno della funzione Amministrazione che riporta al CFO di Gruppo. L'unità è responsabile della predisposizione del bilancio consolidato annuale e della relazione finanziaria semestrale del Gruppo Enel secondo i principi contabili internazionali IFRS, del reporting consolidato periodico e della definizione delle regole e delle procedure di consolidamento applicate da tutte le società del Gruppo, in Italia e all'estero (Europa, America Latina e Nord America). 
 Avrai l'opportunità di lavorare con un team composto da 8 professionisti con background in ambito IFRS, revisione e bilancio consolidato, in costante interazione con le funzioni amministrative delle società del Gruppo, con le altre unità di Amministrazione, Finanza e Controllo della Holding e con la società di revisione. 
 Cosa farai 
 In questo ruolo, ti occuperai insieme al team delle seguenti attività: 
 Bilancio consolidato: predisposizione del bilancio consolidato annuale, della relazione finanziaria semestrale e del reporting consolidato trimestrale, curando le scritture di consolidamento (eliminazione delle partecipazioni, elisioni infragruppo, interessenze di terzi, conversione dei bilanci in valuta estera, valutazione con il metodo del patrimonio netto).

 Analisi e informativa: predisposizione di analisi degli scostamenti e di approfondimenti per il management, a supporto della comunicazione finanziaria del Gruppo. 
 Revisione e controlli: interazione con la società di revisione e supporto alle richieste degli organi di controllo e delle autorità di vigilanza, nel rispetto del sistema di controllo interno sull'informativa finanziaria. 
 Miglioramento continuo: partecipazione a progetti di evoluzione dei processi e dei sistemi di consolidamento, con focus su automazione, efficienza e qualità del dato.

Role highlights:
 Role: Radio Frequency Engineer
 Department: Space Systems
 Location: Valencia, Spain
 Reports to : Engineering Manager, Space Systems
 Working type: Hybrid
 Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required) 
 The Mission of the Radio Frequency Engineer
 As an RF Engineer, you will be at the heart of designing and advancing the next generation of ICEYE's satellites — pushing the boundaries of what small sensing satellites can achieve. Working closely with cross-functional engineering teams, you will own the design, testing, and continuous improvement of satellite RF and microwave hardware, from PCB design and component selection to link budget analysis and advanced measurements. When things go wrong, you will be the one to diagnose why — conducting root-cause analysis and providing hands-on technical support for an ever-expanding fleet of operational satellites in orbit.
 Who are we?
 ICEYE delivers space-based intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) capabilities to governments and allied nations. This includes sovereign and turnkey ISR missions leveraging ICEYE's world-leading synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite technology, as well as access to data from the world's largest SAR satellite constellation. These capabilities enable partners to detect and respond to critical changes anywhere on Earth with unprecedented speed and accuracy – day or night and in any weather, supported by ultra high-resolution imagery and high-frequency revisits.
 As a trusted partner for defense, intelligence, security, and maritime domain awareness, ICEYE's near real-time data creates a tactical advantage for mission-critical operations. ICEYE operates internationally with offices in Finland, Poland, Spain, Japan, the UAE, Greece, Germany, and the US. The company has more than 1000 employees, inspired by the shared vision of improving life on Earth by becoming the global source of truth in Earth Observation.
 Day to day responsibilities:
 You will work closely with engineers from other domains to design a new generation of satellites and ensure continuous improvements of them.
 Your responsibilities will include designing and testing satellite RF hardware, tackling the challenges inherent in the new space engineering approach, and pushing the boundaries of what small sensing satellites can achieve.
 You will also be involved in the design of both passive and active microwave systems, and provide technical support for our expanding fleet of satellites. If you're ready to take on these exciting challenges, we’d love to have you on board.
 Requirements:
 Must have skills 
 Master's degree in Radio/RF/Communications/Signal/Electrical engineering.
 5 years + of experience in RF and microwave engineering (including PCB board design, link budget, component selection).
 Familiar how to use common measurement equipment and skilled to do advanced measurements.
 Proficient problem-solving and debugging skills. Capability to tackle unconventional tasks and problems.
 Ability to perform root-cause analysis on failures.
 Ability to communicate clearly in English (written and spoken).
 Ability to work independently, but also a co-operative team player.
 Suits well in a multicultural environment.
 Capability to drive a new project from the technical side, facing unknown issues and collaborating with people from different domains to solve it.
 Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
 Willingness to be involved in the whole life cycle of the satellite
 Nice to have skills 
 Prior experience in aerospace systems.
 Prior experience with high frequency (5+ GHz) systems.
 Capability to manage basic projects.
 Prior experience in Altium, CST, Python.

As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. Your growth, wellbeing, and success are a priority, with continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a culture where collaboration is how we win.

Role highlights:

 Location: Athens

 Reports to: Manager, Mission Assurance & Reliability
 Employment type: Permanent

 Why this role matters: 
 This role is responsible for assuring the reliability and quality of ICEYE’s subassembly production line, ensuring that assemblies meet design intent, space-grade quality requirements, and operational standards. The Production Reliability Engineer works closely with AIT engineering, production technicians, and integration teams to prevent quality escapes, ensure proper operator self-verifications, and drive proactive improvements through risk-based quality assurance methods.
 The position reports to the Reliability & Mission Assurance team and serves as the quality assurance representative embedded in the subassembly production line. It plays a key role in maintaining product reliability, manufacturability, and compliance with space standards by implementing preventive quality practices, monitoring key metrics, and fostering a culture of quality ownership at the production level.
 Who We Are 
 ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.
 ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.
 ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.
 Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.
 Your day-to-day responsibilities 
 Oversee subassembly production activities, ensuring compliance with quality requirements, approved processes, and product specifications.
 Manage and support quality-related change management activities, including impact assessments, implementation follow-up, and effectiveness verification.
 Review, approve, and disposition non-conformances, ensuring timely resolution through use-as-is, rework, repair, or corrective actions as appropriate.
 Lead and support corrective and preventive action (CAPA) activities, including planning, implementation, and effectiveness monitoring.
 Perform and oversee final inspection activities, including visual inspections, configuration verification, and confirmation of inspection and test results.
 Prepare and review Acceptance Data Packages (ADPs) to ensure completeness, accuracy, and compliance with customer and regulatory requirements.
 Plan and conduct process audits, perform spot checks of newly implemented procedures, and follow up on corrective actions to verify sustained compliance.
 Develop, maintain, and continuously improve inspection plans, checklists, quality requirements, and inspection procedures in collaboration with Engineering and Production teams.
 Monitor production and quality performance indicators, including non-conformance trends, yields, rework, and process effectiveness, to drive continuous improvement.
 Provide guidance and training to production personnel on quality requirements, inspection standards, ESD/FOD control, cleanliness, and product handling practices.
 Ensure production readiness by verifying that required inspections, verifications, approvals, and quality gates are completed before manufacturing activities proceed.
 Collaborate with Engineering, Production, and Quality teams to identify risks, resolve quality issues, and improve manufacturing and inspection processes.
 What we’re looking for 
 Must haves: 
 Bachelor’s degree in Electronics, Mechatronics, or Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience in a high-reliability production environment.
 Minimum 5 years of experience in production quality assurance, manufacturing engineering, or process reliability within electronics, aerospace, or high-reliability manufacturing.
 Solid understanding of subassembly production processes (gluing, soldering, assembly, and testing), process control, ESD/FOD/cleanliness requirements, and space or electronics manufacturing standards.

items.desc: Date de publication : Nov 06, 2026, 12:50PM Durée du contrat : 6 mois Le contexte et la mission Le plateformes prend en charge communication vocal pour service VoIP, une flotte de véhicules connectés dans un environnement télécom de production où la charge est principalement liée à la signalisation SIP. Le stage vise à exploiter les données techniques des plateformes, données financier et les technologies GenAI/LLM avec Dashboard /Business Intelligence afin d’accélérer le diagnostic, de faciliter la synthèse des événements opérationnels et d’améliorer l’efficacité du RUN, developés documentation pour les lancement des nouveau produit, la profitabilité des produit. Les missions Structurer les données d’exploitation : compteurs réseau, logs IMS, événements OpenShift, alarmes et tickets Jira, CDR pour les appelles, documentation fournisseurs, HLD solution, documentation produit/avant-vente Sélectionner et intégrer un outil de data pipeline compatible avec un agent GenAI (Prefect, Airbyte, Dagster, Airflow…). Choisir une base de données temps réel adaptée (InfluxDB, PostgreSQL, Pinot,..). Développer des agents GenAI/LLM pour assister le diagnostic d’incidents multi-vendor et générer des synthèses opérationnelles et évaluer sa fiabilité. Mettre en place des tableaux de bord Superset pour suivre les KPI opérationnels, financier, reseaux Améliorer les runbooks et automatiser les tâches récurrentes du RUN. Développer, tester et industrialiser les composants via Git, CI/CD et GitOps, avec une interface front-end React ou Angular si nécessaire. L’environnement technique Télécoms : réseau mobile 4G/5G, réseau fix VoIp Cloud et platform : Red Hat OpenShift, CNF, conteneurs et Kubernetes. GenAI : LLM, prompt engineering, agents IA, orchestration, RAG Data pipeline et temps réel : Prefect, Airbyte, Dagster, Airflow, InfluxDB, PostgreSQL, Pinot ou Redis. Développement et DevOps : Python,Java, Git, GitLab CI/CD, Jira, Docker, GitOps et ArgoCD ou Flux. Front-end et supervision : React ou Angular, Superset et Grafana POWER BI, QLIK Le profil recherché Étudiant(e) en dernière année d’école d’ingénieur ou master M2, de niveau Bac+5, vous disposez de connaissances en développement Python et manifestez un intérêt marqué pour les technologies GenAI, les LLM et les agents intelligents. Des connaissances en développement front-end, notamment avec React ou Angular, sont attendues. Une curiosité pour les environnements cloud, DevOps, les data pipelines et les bases de données temps réel est appréciée. Une connaissance du domaine télécom constitue un atout, sans être indispensable. Autonomie, rigueur, esprit de synthèse et capacité à présenter des résultats techniques à des interlocuteurs non experts sont attendus. Un bon niveau d’anglais technique, est requis. Ce que le stage permettra de développer Ce stage permettra de développer une expérience concrète dans l’intégration de solutions GenAI et d’agents LLM au sein d’un environnement télécom cloud-native de production. Il offrira également l’occasion de travailler sur la sélection d’architectures data, les pipelines d’exploitation, les bases temps réel, le développement Python et front-end, ainsi que l’industrialisation CI/CD et GitOps. Vous bénéficierez d'unerémunération brute comprise entre 1306,91 et 1680,32 euros. Orange Wholesale est un acteur majeur des infrastructures, réseaux et services de connectivité pour les opérateurs et les entreprises du numérique. Présente dans 30 pays, l’entreprise compte 3 500 collaborateurs et réalise près de 6 milliards d’euros de chiffre d’affaires. Elle conçoit, exploite et sécurise des infrastructures mondiales, des câbles sous-marins aux satellites, afin de garantir la résilience et la performance des communications. Au sein d’Orange Wholesale, OINIS (Orange International Networks Infrastructures & Services) réunit plus de 1 500 salariés. Cette direction technique pilote la conception, la planification, le déploiement et l’exploitation des réseaux internationaux et longue distance, dans un environnement international, diversifié et innovant. La direction Services assure l’ingénierie, l’exploitation et l’amélioration continue de plateformes cloud-native, multiconstructeurs et géoredondées dédiées aux communications numériques : VoLTE, SMSoIP, voix et IoT. Ses activités couvrent la conception et le déploiement des solutions, la supervision, l’analyse de capacité, le diagnostic d’incidents ainsi que l’automatisation des processus THINK/BUILD/RUN. Date de début souhaitée : Feb 01, 2027, 12:00AM Chez Orange, seules vos compétences comptent. Quel que soit votre âge, genre, origine, parcours, religion, orientation sexuelle, handicap, neuroatypie, ou apparence, nous encourageons activement la diversité au sein de nos équipes, car elle constitue une force pour le collectif et un vecteur d’innovation. Orange est une entreprise handi-accueillante : n’hésitez pas à nous faire part de vos besoins spécifiques.

items.card: Vos missions Conception et développement : construire en Python des assistants, des agents et des chaînes RAG qui répondent à des besoins métier précis. Cas d’usage : faire évoluer des solutions existantes, ou en porter une de bout en bout, du cadrage technique à son intégration dans l’outil ou le processus visé. Optimisation : améliorer la pertinence des réponses, les temps de traitement et la maîtrise des coûts,
items.desc: Description de l'entreprise ASI (Au Service de l’Impact) est un cabinet d’expertises numériques français de 350 collaborateurs, réparti en 7 agences. Nos équipes couvrent le développement, l’architecture, la data, le pilotage, la conduite du changement, les processus, la stratégie, le marketing et le design. Société à Mission, nous défendons un numérique aux impacts positifs, sur les plans social, environnemental et sociétal. Notre raison d’être est « Agir pour un monde numérique responsable au service de l’humain », et nos choix de projets et de missions la reflètent. L’agence de Lyon compte 30 collaborateurs aux profils variés. Elle accompagne des acteurs de l’assurance, de la mutuelle et du courtage dans leur transformation digitale, leurs projets d’innovation et l’amélioration de l’expérience client. Vous y trouverez un cadre moderne et convivial, où l’on partage ses pratiques et où l’on progresse ensemble. Description du poste Vous voulez de l’IA générative qui tourne en production, pas seulement dans un notebook ? Vous aimez coder en Python et transformer un besoin métier en solution fiable, réellement utilisée ? Dans le cadre d’une mission chez l’un de nos clients, un acteur international de l’assurance, vous rejoignez une équipe IA qui développe des solutions à base de LLM pour plusieurs entités du groupe : automatisation de processus métier et outils destinés aux clients et aux partenaires. Vous évoluez dans une équipe attachée à la qualité du code, où les pratiques se partagent et où le socle technique est tenu avec rigueur. Vos missions Conception et développement : construire en Python des assistants, des agents et des chaînes RAG qui répondent à des besoins métier précis. Cas d’usage : faire évoluer des solutions existantes, ou en porter une de bout en bout, du cadrage technique à son intégration dans l’outil ou le processus visé. Optimisation : améliorer la pertinence des réponses, les temps de traitement et la maîtrise des coûts, et accompagner les changements de version des modèles. Roadmap : livrer les nouveaux cas d’usage dans les échéances fixées avec l’équipe. Qualité logicielle : produire un code testé, documenté et maintenable, et participer aux revues de code. Bonnes pratiques : appliquer les standards de l’équipe, notamment sur la sécurité et la confidentialité des données. Qualifications Vous êtes diplômé(e) d’une école d’ingénieur ou d’un master en informatique (Bac+5), ou vous avez un parcours équivalent. Vous avez au moins 2 ans d’expérience en développement logiciel sur des projets d’envergure, avec une pratique significative de Python. Vous avez déjà travaillé avec des LLM sur un projet réel : appel d’API de modèles, RAG ou agent. Le périmètre peut être limité, ce qui compte, c’est d’avoir affronté les contraintes du terrain. Au-delà du parcours, nous cherchons une personne curieuse et rigoureuse, qui apprend vite, sait avancer seule et se montre à l’aise en équipe. Vos principaux atouts Une bonne maîtrise de Python et des pratiques associées : tests, revues de code, documentation Une première expérience de projets LLM (RAG, agents, API OpenAI ou Anthropic) Une sensibilité DevOps : CI/CD GitLab, Docker, déploiement cloud Idéalement, Azure (Container Apps, AI Services) et des frameworks comme LangChain ou LlamaIndex L’usage d’outils de développement assisté par IA, comme Claude Code ou équivalent Des bases en SQL (PostgreSQL) et en NoSQL (MongoDB) De l’autonomie, de l’initiative et l’envie de progresser Informations supplémentaires Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Pour travailler sur des usages concrets de l’IA générative, utilisés chaque jour par des équipes métier et des clients, dans un secteur où la fiabilité des réponses n’est pas négociable. Chez ASI, vous intervenez sur des projets innovants, au sein d’équipes pluridisciplinaires, avec de la place pour l’initiative et la montée en compétences. Et aussi : Un parcours d’intégration structuré pour bien démarrer Des projets de fond dans des environnements exigeants Une équipe experte, bienveillante et collaborative Un mode de travail hybride Un suivi de carrière local et personnalisé Notre processus de recrutement Environ trois semaines, en trois étapes : un échange téléphonique avec une chargée de recrutement, un entretien avec un Business Manager, puis un entretien avec le Directeur de l’agence de Lyon. Ce poste vous parle ? Écrivez-nous : nous serons heureux de découvrir votre parcours et les projets sur lesquels vous voulez vous investir. Pour en savoir plus sur l’agence de Lyon et nos opportunités, rencontrons-nous. Pour connaître ASI, rendez-vous sur notre page LinkedIn et notre site internet.

Je werkt
items.desc: Uren per week 32-36 uur Plaatsingdatum 06-11-2026 Vacaturenummer CA10062712 Werk- en denkniveau HBO Salarisniveau € 4.520,- tot € 6.422,- Aantal fte 1 Sluitingsdatum 29-11-2026 Je werkt binnen team AI Development aan ChatAmsterdam: een AI-chatbot van de gemeente die als denkpartner ambtenaren helpt hun werkefficiëntie en -kwaliteit te verbeteren, in een veilige omgeving waarin hun privacy wordt beschermd. Je werkt aan AI-oplossingen voor de hele stad. Je ontwikkelt ChatAmsterdam verder en bouwt mee aan de uitbreiding van het AI-landschap van de gemeente. Je ontwikkelt slimme, schaalbare software in Python, verdiept je in de laatste AI-ontwikkelingen en vertaalt ze naar nieuwe functionaliteiten in de AI-oplossingen. Samen met team AI Development werk je in een betrokken en technisch team bestaande uit 9 collega's, die elkaar helpen, waar je werkt aan AI en waar je rekening houdt met verschillende belangen en veranderingen in de grote Amsterdamse stadspolitiek. De functie Amsterdam gebruikt steeds meer data om betere beslissingen te nemen en de dienstverlening te verbeteren. De vakgroep Data Science & AI speelt hierin een belangrijke rol, vooral met voorspelmodellen en AI-oplossingen. Dit thema krijgt de komende jaren veel aandacht in de stad. Je komt terecht in team AI Development, een agile team met Software Engineers, Data Scientists, een Business Analist, een Product Owner en een Scrum Master. Zij maken AI-oplossingen en applicaties voor collega’s binnen de gemeente, zoals ChatAmsterdam en De Raadsbot, zodat zij sneller informatie vinden en Amsterdammers beter kunnen helpen. Ook werken zij aan vragen over veilig gebruik van AI, privacy, betrouwbare antwoorden, toegankelijkheid en duidelijke uitleg over hoe AI werkt. Daarbij werken ze samen met onder andere beleidscollega’s, juristen, informatiebeveiliging, privacy-experts en gebruikers uit de organisatie. In deze functie sta je midden in deze ontwikkelingen: je bouwt mee aan AI die technisch goed werkt én past bij de waarden van Amsterdam. Je ontwerpt en ontwikkelt robuuste AI-oplossingen, waaronder RAG-systemen, in Azure en Databricks. Daarbij werk je met o.a. Python en LangChain. Dit doe je op een gemiddelde dag Ontwerpen en bouwen van generieke en schaalbare data en AI-oplossingen, zoals de toevoeging van databronnen aan ChatAmsterdam en de ontwikkeling van nieuwe functionaliteiten voor de eindgebruikers, zoals een document hub. Samen met het team keuzes maken over de inrichting van data- en AI-oplossingen, met speciale aandacht voor het modelleren van RAG-systemen. Afstemmen van ontwikkelingen met onder andere het AI-platformteam en het Dataplatformteam. Actief bijdragen aan een inclusieve, veilige en duurzame manier van data en AI-ontwikkeling, waarbij betrouwbaarheid en transparantie centraal staan. Hier ga je aan de slag We willen een goede werkgever zijn die ervoor zorgt dat alle collega’s zich gezien en gewaardeerd voelen. We koesteren verschillen tussen collega’s, al die verschillen zorgen voor betere resultaten voor onze organisatie én onze stad. We streven daarbij naar een personeelsbestand dat een afspiegeling is van de beroepsbevolking van Amsterdam. Dus wie jij ook bent: bij ons ben je van harte welkom! Cluster Digitalisering, Innovatie en Informatie Het cluster Digitalisering, Innovatie en Informatie (DII) ondersteunt de gemeente Amsterdam met betrouwbare digitale producten, diensten en kennis. We helpen de organisatie bij veranderingen, bieden kaders voor verantwoorde digitalisering en werken aan innovatie en informatievoorziening. Dat doen we actief, open en integer. Zo is DII de betrouwbare digitaliseringspartner van de gemeente Amsterdam. De vakgroep Data Science & AI bestaat uit specialisten die data- en AI-oplossingen en voorspelmodellen maken voor verschillende onderwerpen in Amsterdam. Het team Chat Amsterdam werkt aan het uitbreiden van het gen AI-landschap. Dit breng je mee Voor deze functie van Data Scientist/ AI Engineer beschik je over: Minimaal 3 jaar relevante ontwikkelervaring als Software Engineer, AI Engineer of Data Scientist, met aantoonbare ervaring in het ontwikkelen en in productie brengen van applicaties met AI-functionaliteit. Aantoonbare ervaring met Python, softwareontwerp, backend ontwikkeling en API’s, waarbij je onderhoudbare, modulaire code schrijft en best practices toepast, zoals Git, geautomatiseerde tests en code reviews. Aantoonbare ervaring met het ontwikkelen, evalueren en in productie brengen van LLM-applicaties en agents, met praktische ervaring met LangChain, LangGraph en Langfuse. Ervaring met clouddeployment en productiebeheer, waaronder Kubernetes, Infrastructure-as-Code, CI/CD, logging, monitoring en het oplossen van storingen. Bovengenoemde dient duidelijk te blijken uit het cv en/of de motivatie. Aan competenties breng je mee: Inventiviteit: Genereert verschillende, soms originele ideeën en oplossingen. items.desc: Are you interested in turning complex business needs into data products that make a real difference? As a Product Owner within our Commercial Data Products and Reporting team, you will own and develop data products that help our Commercial and Commercial Finance teams make better, faster and more consistent decisions. You will manage a portfolio of data products, including datasets and data cubes used for commercial analysis and reporting. Sitting between business and technology, you will translate stakeholder needs into clear requirements, shape solutions with our technology teams, and ensure we focus our efforts on the work that creates the greatest value. Our team brings together Product Owners based in Copenhagen and reporting colleagues in Pune, and you will collaborate with colleagues across business, data and technology. Please note that this role is based in Copenhagen and requires onsite presence in the office five days per week. What you’ll be doing Own the vision, roadmap and backlog for your assigned commercial data products. Work closely with Commercial, Commercial Finance and other stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into clear requirements and user stories. Apply your understanding of data models, data sourcing and transformation processes to ask the right questions and constructively challenge proposed solutions. Support the development and evolution of datasets, data cubes, KPIs and reporting foundations. Identify and shape opportunities to embed AI and automation into our data products, while also using AI to improve how we explore, design and deliver solutions. Collaborate closely with our reporting team and other Product Owners to ensure our data products work effectively across the wider organisation. Promote consistent KPI definitions, strong data quality and trusted reporting in line with our One Set of Numbers principle. Drive adoption, monitor product performance and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. You do not need to be a hands-on data engineer, but you should understand how data is sourced, transformed, structured and delivered well enough to engage with and challenge technical colleagues when needed. Your background could be in product ownership, data engineering, business intelligence, analytics, finance, commercial performance or another related field. We welcome different career paths and are interested in the capabilities and experience you bring. We’re looking for someone with: Approximately 5+ years’ experience working with data products, BI, analytics, data engineering, reporting or product ownership. Experience translating business needs into user stories, requirements and prioritised backlogs. A good conceptual understanding of data models, datasets and data-transformation processes such as ETL. AI-enabled product development: Experience or a strong interest in delivering AI-enabled products and using AI tools throughout the product lifecycle, from exploring requirements and shaping solutions to improving delivery and ways of working. You bring curiosity about emerging AI capabilities and can identify where they can create meaningful business value. Experience working with technical teams using Agile principles and tools such as JIRA, Azure DevOps or similar. Strong stakeholder skills and the ability to communicate technical concepts in a clear and accessible way. Good business acumen and curiosity about how data can improve commercial decisions. items.desc: NestAI builds the adaptive operating system for modern battlefield operations. Most AI systems are built once, validated at deployment, and expected to stay sufficient after that. That assumption holds until conditions change, and in defence, they always do. Our team develops adaptive intelligence for unmanned and command systems: AI that continuously learns from operational data and adapts to changing conditions, deployed in environments where there is no internet, no GPS, and failure is not an option. NestOS, our open, modular, and interoperable platform, enables this at scale and keeps capability evolution under sovereign European control. Founded in 2025 by Peter Sarlin, whose previous company Silo AI became Europe's largest AI acquisition, NestAI has grown to over 200 engineers and scientists and partners with leading European defence forces and industry. We're ambitious about what we're building and honest with each other. The bar is high, and so are the standards we hold ourselves to. But this is also a place built on humility, trust, and looking after each other. If that sounds like the kind of work you want to do, keep reading. Join us as a HW Camera and Sensor Engineer You'll join our hardware engineering team as the person who takes camera and sensor work so it scales with the rest of the business. You'll own sensor selection, calibration, and integration end to end, working mainly on-site with experienced colleagues who are quick to collaborate and pitch in. At a company this size, you'll have real influence over how this area of the business is built. What you'll work on This role gets to develop the camera/sensor capability at NestAI, from choosing the right hardware to making sure it performs reliably once it's integrated. In this role, you will: Own the evaluation and selection of cameras and sensors against our technical requirements Build and maintain calibration procedures and tooling for single- and multi-camera setups Define and run benchmarking and validation plans, from lab testing through to field trials Integrate cameras and sensors into hardware systems together with electrical, mechanical, and firmware teams, covering mounting, interfacing, synchronisation, and power Partner with perception and software teams to make sure image quality, timing, and calibration accuracy meet their pipeline needs Diagnose image quality, synchronisation, and calibration-drift issues Document selection criteria, calibration procedures, and integration specs What we're looking for If your background doesn't match every requirement but the work resonates with you, we'd encourage you to apply. How you think, learn, and take ownership matters more to us than ticking every box. Here is what we are looking for: Deep expertise equivalent to 10+ years working with cameras or sensors in hardware, robotics, or embedded systems Experience with commercial camera interfaces such as USB3 Vision, GigE Vision, or MIPI CSI-2, along with their vendor SDKs Experience evaluating and selecting commercial camera modules and gimbals, rather than designing custom sensors Solid grasp of optics fundamentals: lens selection, field of view, distortion, exposure, and sensor characteristics Proficiency in Python and/or C++ for test tooling, automation, and calibration setups Experience leading technical projects and prioritising across competing demands as requirements shift Professional fluency in Finnish is a plus, though not required Nice to have: Experience with multi-camera or stereo rigs, or camera-lidar/IMU sensor fusion and calibration Familiarity with embedded Linux camera stacks such as V4L2 or GStreamer Experience with camera calibration and tuning, both intrinsic and extrinsic, using tools such as OpenCV, ROS camera_calibration, Kalibr, or ISP tooling Understanding of LiDAR, radar, or sonar technologies Why join NestAI Work alongside over 200 engineers and scientists, including 60+ PhDs. People who've built AI platforms, autonomous systems, and defence technology across Europe. Most of our people say the best thing about NestAI is the people you get to work with. Work with real ownership. You identify what needs building, talk to the right people, and ship. Ownership here is the expectation, not a talking point. Work at a pace where Monday's idea can be Friday's deployment. The problems we're solving are urgent, so the culture reflects it. Work on systems that must operate with no connectivity, no GPS, and no margin for error. The problems we're solving are technically hard, genuinely novel, and they sit at the intersection of AI and the physical world. Work at a company where the platform, the practices, and the standards are all being built right now. The people here get to define how things work and how they scale. items.desc: Alice & Bob is developing the first universal, fault-tolerant quantum computer to solve the world’s hardest problems. The quantum computer we envision building is based on a new kind of superconducting qubit: the Schrödinger cat qubit \uD83D\uDC08‍ . In comparison to other superconducting platforms, cat qubits have the astonishing ability to implement quantum error correction autonomously! We're a diverse team of 250+ brilliant minds from over 35 countries united by a single goal: to revolutionise computing with a practical fault-tolerant quantum machine. Are you ready to take on unprecedented challenges and contribute to revolutionising technology? Join us, and let's shape the future of quantum computing together! About the Mission Every chip Alice & Bob builds starts as Python code. As we scale from tens of qubits to thousands, our chip-design software becomes the backbone of the entire design pipeline, and it has to support chips that could never be drawn by hand. About the Role As a Scientific Software Engineer in the Design and Implementation team , you’ll own the internal framework our engineers use to turn a quantum circuit into a layout and send it to electromagnetic and circuit simulators. You’ll keep it robust and fast, grow its component library, and build the automation our layout and scale-up engineers need to design large chips. Responsibilities Own and maintain the internal design backend API and qubit design framework: code quality, testing, CI, releases, documentation Develop new parametric components and layout primitives with the chip designers who use them Extend and harden the export pipeline to electromagnetic and circuit simulation tools Build the automation layer for large-scale, hierarchical chip layouts in close partnership with our physical-design and scale-up engineers Support internal users: onboarding, debugging, API design, and turning recurring pain points into features Requirements 5+ years of professional Python development, with strong software engineering fundamentals: testing, packaging, versioning, CI/CD, code review Solid experience building and maintaining a library or framework used by other engineers, and a taste for clean, well-documented APIs Comfort with computational geometry or CAD/layout data (GDSII, polygons, transformations) — or eagerness to learn it fast Ability to work closely with hardware engineers and translate their needs into software Fluent English and excellent written and verbal communication skills Nice to have: Experience with gdstk, gdsfactory, KLayout, or other layout tooling Familiarity with electromagnetic simulation tools (HFSS/AEDT, Palace) or circuit simulators Background in superconducting circuits, RF/microwave engineering, or semiconductor design automation (EDA) Recruitment Process Screening Call with Grace, Talent Acquisition Specialist (30 min) Hiring Manager Interview with Felix (45 min) Technical Interview/Presentation with the Team (120 min) Leadership Team Interview (30 min) Fit Interview (45 min) Reference check Benefits: Our success is your success: own it with our BSPCE plan Direct IP Compensation: Earn substantial bonuses for driving the core patents that define our quantum architecture.
