items.desc: Ijinus est le spécialiste de l’instrumentation connectée. Elle fabrique des systèmes de mesure et d’enregistrements autonomes et communicants pour le monitoring de l’eau, et développe les interfaces de communication et de supervision. Elle intervient dans le suivi des eaux naturelles, le diagnostic des réseaux d’eau potable et d’assainissement, et propose des équipements de métrologie, des préleveurs d’eau automatiques, des capteurs et loggers reliés à une application et à une plateforme de supervision. Ijinus est basée en Bretagne. Historiquement, la société s’est développée autour de la mesure de niveau, un des quatre paramètres physiques les plus mesurés au monde. Sa raison d’être repose sur la technologie sans fil. Précurseur dans l’IIoT (Industrial Internet of Thing), Ijinus s’est toujours attachée à développer des capteurs autonomes en énergie, paramétrables sans activation, capables d’enregistrer les données, puis de les transmettre à distance, le tout dans un boitier compact. Ijinus maîtrise l’ensemble de la chaîne de mesure, de la technologie des capteurs aux nouvelles technologies des communications. Aujourd’hui, la R&D représente le 1/3 de l’effectif, composée d’ingénieurs aux compétences complémentaires : électronique, systèmes embarqués, logiciels et web services, tests et validation… Ijinus intervient dans la mesure de nombreux paramètres dans le secteur de l’environnement, notamment les réseaux d’assainissement, d’eau potable et les eaux naturelles. Les capteurs et enregistreurs sont conçus et fabriqués sur le site d’Ijinus. Une vigilance particulière est accordée à l’assemblage des produits, afin de s’assurer de leur étanchéité sur le terrain. Une zone spécifique est consacrée à la location d’équipements de mesure. On y retrouve tous les moyens de nettoyage, de remise en état… pour remettre à disposition le matériel. Chaque retour fait l’objet d’une procédure particulière pour assurer une nouvelle campagne de mesure, fiable et efficace. Ijinus dispose d’un service SAV, un espace dédié où les techniciens renseignent les installateurs sur l’utilisation des produits. vous avez pour mission principale de développer des interfaces utilisateurs (front-end) et des back-ends de nos solutions logicielles pour la surveillance de l'eau et la configuration de nos capteurs. Par votre activité inventive vous contribuez à l’innovation de la société Ijinus. Mission du Développeur systèmes embarqués H/F Rattaché au pôle Logiciel, à partir des orientations, instructions et priorités données par le responsable projets R&D et dans le respect des objectifs (coûts, qualité, délai) du projet vous serez en charge des tâches suivantes : Analyser les besoins fonctionnels pour créer des solutions techniques adaptées Concevoir et développer les solutions à travers des développements WEB reposant sur des méthodes robustes et documentées Sélectionner et mettre en œuvre des composants et/ou bibliothèques adaptés aux besoins Mettre en œuvre les essais et tests de fonctionnement et en conditions réelles Apporter une assistance technique à l'industrialisation du produit Participer à la gestion des projets de développement de produits Rédiger la documentation technique nécessaire à la bonne gestion du projet et la documentation R&D des produits Assurer une veille technologique et réglementaire Diplômé d'un Bac+5, master2 ou ingénieur Expérience de 3 à 5 ans dans le développement de systèmes embarqués et connectés Vous maîtrisez les outils et matériels nécessaires (ou équivalent) à la réalisation du développement, notamment : Développement FW Routage et design PCBA Langages : C/C++, Python, RISC-V, OpenCV, AI, Debian, Linux driver, Dart, Bash ARM, RISC-V RF : BLE, Wi-Fi, M2M, Lora, Sigfox Systèmes bluetooth et wifi Vous avez un niveau d'anglais B2 minimum Vous aimez travailler en équipe sur des solutions applicatives et concrètes

Connaissance des bases de données (SQL/NoSQL) et des outils DevOps (Docker, Kubernetes). Expérience en développement d’API RESTful et en intégration de services.

Je m'engage sur une proximité réelle et une écoute active pour que votre mission soit une réussite totale pour votre carrière. "Le socle de RKS, c’est la relation humaine. Je ne vous vends pas du rêve, je vous propose un partenariat professionnel solide et bienveillant." — Fondateur de RKS Consulting. Description du poste A. Conception et Architecture Définir l'architecture globale de la PKI (Infrastructure à Clés Publiques) et de la gestion des certificats (Lifecycle Management - CLM) pour l'ensemble du périmètre (on-premise, cloud, hybride). Concevoir les hiérarchies de certificats (AC Racines, AC Subalternes) en garantissant la conformité avec les standards de l'industrie (RFC, NIST, ANSSI). Intégrer la PKI avec les solutions de gestion des identités et des accès (IAM/PAM), les orchestrateurs de conteneurs (Kubernetes, Docker), et les services cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP). B. Gouvernance, Politiques et Sécurité Rédiger et faire évoluer les politiques de certification (CP) et les déclarations de pratiques de certification (DPC / CPS). Définir les règles de gouvernance, d'attribution et de renouvellement des certificats pour l'ensemble des cas d'usage (SSL/TLS, authentification forte, chiffrement de e-mails, signature de code, mTLS). Assurer la sécurité des HSM (Hardware Security Modules) abritant les clés maîtresses de l'infrastructure. C. Industrialisation et Automatisation Piloter l'automatisation du cycle de vie des certificats via des protocoles standard (ACME, EST, SCEP) et des outils de CLM (Certbot, Venafi, HashiCorp Vault, Keyfactor, etc.) pour éviter les ruptures de service liées à l'expiration des certificats. Mettre en place des tableaux de bord de supervision et d'alerte proactive. D. Support N3 et Expertise Agir en tant qu'expert de référence (Niveau 3) sur les incidents complexes liés à la cryptographie et à la chaîne de confiance. Réaliser une veille technologique et réglementaire (quantum-safe cryptography / post-quantique, innovations en gestion des secrets). 3. Profil recherché Formation : Bac +5 (École d'ingénieurs ou Master en Informatique / Spécialisation Cybersécurité ou Cryptographie). Expérience : 5 à 8 ans minimum d'expérience en cybersécurité, avec une solide expérience pratique dans la conception et l'exploitation d'architectures PKI en milieu critique ou d'entreprise. Qualifications Compétences techniques requises (Hard Skills) : Maîtrise des concepts cryptographiques (algorithmes symétriques et asymétriques, RSA, ECC, fonctions de hachage, PKCS). Expérience avérée avec des logiciels de PKI du marché (Microsoft Active Directory Certificate Services - AD CS, EJBCA, OpenSSL, HashiCorp Vault). Maîtrise des modules matériels de sécurité ( HSM ) des principaux fabricants (Thales, Utimaco, etc.). Connaissance des protocoles associés (ACME, SCEP, EST, OCSP, CRL, LDAP, RADIUS, mTLS). Scripting et automatisation (Python, Bash, Ansible) et intégration CI/CD. Bonnes connaissances des environnements Cloud et conteneurisés (Kubernetes, AWS/Azure/GCP).

items.desc: About us ATOSS Software SE is one of Germany's most successful tech growth stories. As the market leader in Workforce Management Software, we help companies work more intelligently, creatively, and humanely optimizing the balance between profitability and people. We're a rare company: according to Handelsblatt (10/24), just 309 public companies worldwide achieved over 20% return on sales for ten consecutive years. Only one based in Germany: ATOSS Software SE. With 20 years of record breaking growth, over €2 billion market cap, and listings in SDAX and TecDAX, we're scaling globally and we're growing. If you're ready to drive impact in a high-performing B2B SaaS environment, this is your chance to elevate your career. Why this role matters At ATOSS, we help organisations around the world plan their people fairly and efficiently, and data sits at the core of our products. We hold ourselves to the same standard internally. We are building one trusted data foundation for sales, marketing, HR and finance, and you will help build it. You will join our team of data engineers and work side by side with our analysts. They bring the business question, and together we make sure the right data is there: correct, documented and on time. Your work decides whether leaders discuss what to do, or whose number is right. What you will do Bring together data from relational databases, flat files, Excel, big data systems, analytical databases and APIs in Snowflake. Design, build and maintain scalable transformation pipelines with dbt on Snowflake. Turn our KPI definitions into tested, documented dbt models, so every metric has one definition. Automate and orchestrate data workflows for reliable delivery to BI and reporting. Monitor, troubleshoot and tune dbt and Snowflake for reliability, performance and cost. Work closely with analysts to understand business needs and specify data requirements. What you bring At least 5 years of hands-on experience with dbt and Snowflake in data engineering and/or data analysis. Strong knowledge of Sales, Marketing, HR and ERP data, including the KPIs and reporting that matter. Extensive experience with modern data engineering: pipelines, orchestration and data modelling. Experience integrating data from APIs. Strong SQL and experience with Git and CI/CD for dbt projects. Business-fluent English. Nice to have German language skills. Airflow, Dagster, dbt Cloud, Fivetran, Airbyte or similar tools. Python for integration and automation. Experience with a semantic or metrics layer, or with the Salesforce data model. dbt or Snowflake certification. You will feel at home with us if you Ask which business question the data must answer before you start modelling. Would rather deliver a correct number tomorrow than a wrong one today. Speak up early when you see a data quality issue, even in someone else's system. Prefer simple, maintainable models and enjoy cleaning up what nobody uses. Write documentation that your colleagues actually read. Enjoy code reviews and learning from fellow engineers as much as building on your own Our Benefits Competitive Rewards: Including profit-sharing and employee stock program. Structured Onboarding & Continuous Leadership Development: Clear career paths onboarding through Expert & Leadership Tracks, plus access to ATOSS Academy. Flexible Work Culture: Hybrid options (remote within the EU) and 30 days of vacation. Engaging Team Environment: Seasonal company events, team retreats, and an in-house barista in Munich. Health & Wellbeing: Including regular check-ups, corporate wellness programs, and Wellhub membership. Stability & Growth: Company listed on SDAX & TecDAX, with 19+ years of record-breaking revenue and a 30%+ EBIT margin. Certified Top Employer© for the 7th year in a row. At Atoss, great talent knows no limits. We welcome professionals from all backgrounds and empower their growth through an inclusive, skill focused environment. Join us and be part of a high-growth, future-focused company!

items.desc: Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. About the role We're looking for the top 1% - engineers who treat their craft like athletes treat performance, and who want to work alongside people who do the same. The world has changed dramatically in the last quarter. What used to take a team of consultants six months now takes a sharp engineer a few days. The momentum is unreal, and we're growing into it fast. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you're embedded directly in our customers' environments, taking a messy enterprise problem from first conversation to a working production system in days - not quarters. You work as part of a small senior team - alongside a Senior Consultant and other FDEs - and you own the technical solution end-to-end: architecture, integrations, agent and workflow logic, frontend where needed, evals, deployment. The work starts and ends with the customer, not the codebase. Feedback cycles are measured in hours, the bar is high, and the people you ship with will push you to raise it. What you'll do Sit with end-users, process owners, and client engineers to understand the real workflow - and the real problem underneath the stated one Translate the target-state process into a concrete technical solution: architecture, data model, integrations, agent and workflow design - and ship it in days and weeks, not quarters Demo early and often, rough edges included, and fold real feedback into the next iteration Make speed / quality / cost trade-offs in real time. Choose build vs. buy vs. configure existing platform capability Own observability and evals once live. Iterate until the system is reliable in the customer's real conditions Earn trust with the client's own engineering and security teams - API access, data flows, deployment, reviews Bring patterns back - reusable components, prompt structures, integration approaches - so the next engagement ships faster What you'll bring Builder background with real shipping experience - you've taken systems from zero to production and kept them running Fluent with modern AI tooling: LLM APIs, tool and function calling, agent frameworks, evals, prompt engineering as a real discipline Strong with TypeScript on the backend. Comfortable with APIs, auth, queues, and integrating with legacy systems Daily, fluent use of Claude Code, Cursor, or similar - expected to ship meaningfully faster than a traditional engineer because of them Customer-facing instinct - you genuinely enjoy being in the room with users, asking sharp questions, and pushing back respectfully when needed You move fast, communicate clearly, and operate well with ambiguity. Comfortable being dropped into an unfamiliar domain and coming back with a working prototype Fluency in English. German is a plus MUST : experience automating business processes in the ERP space (SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle, NetSuite, or similar), or prior background in consulting, solutions engineering, or founding/building products end-to-end What you'll get Ship in days, not quarters. Watch a messy enterprise problem become a working production system inside a single engagement. Work at the frontier. We use and build with state-of-the-art tech, the latest LLMs, agent frameworks, and AI coding tools, with the budget and mandate to keep up as the field moves. Build with the best tools. No legacy stack to drag around. Big responsibility, fast. You own customer engagements end-to-end from day one: architecture, build, delivery, and the relationship. A team that raises the bar. You're working alongside other FDEs and senior consultants who were hired for exactly this pace. Learn more about blp and our values at blp.digital/company/careers.

items.desc: Life changing therapies. Global impact. Bridge to thousands of biopharma companies and their patients. We are PCI. Main Purpose of Job The Production Training Specialist is responsible for improving the competencies of employees by designing, delivering, and maintaining training programs that enhance workplace performance in alignment with the company’s core values. This role manages all phases of training interventions, conducts training needs assessments, develops curriculum and learning materials, and ensures training programs support both short‑term operational needs and long‑term organisational development. The Training Specialist will work closely with Operations, Human Resources, Quality, and Compliance to ensure training is robust, standardised, and aligned with site‑specific requirements. Ultimately, this role enhances individual and collective skills, performance, productivity, compliance, and quality of work produced. Translate organisational and regulatory requirements into effective training programs that enhance knowledge, proficiency, and personnel development. Direct structured learning experiences and monitor their results to ensure training effectiveness. Develop or oversee the creation of classroom handouts, instructional materials, training aids, and manuals. Design, expand, and adjust training and development programs based on organisational needs and site‑specific tasks. Review and update training curricula to reflect new processes, procedures, equipment, and operational changes. Review and track the progress of On‑The‑Job (OTJ) training and classroom‑based training to ensure timely completion and competency sign‑off. Update SOPs and Training Aids for new site‑specific processes and procedures in collaboration with Operations and Quality. Training Compliance & Evaluation Assess training effectiveness to ensure incorporation of taught skills and techniques into daily work behaviours. Evaluate training and development programs using relevant data and recommend changes to instructional objectives and methods. Coordinate and perform administrative functions necessary to deliver, document, and maintain training records in compliance with regulatory expectations. Devise, track, and update individual learning plans and departmental curricula. Present training and compliance metrics to PDN Managers and other stakeholders to support performance oversight and decision‑making. Advance and support compliance‑related and professional development training delivery on site. Compile and deliver Toolbox Talk training to operators and managers to reinforce safety, compliance, and operational standards. Cross‑Functional Collaboration & Leadership Establish cross‑functional partnerships to ensure alignment and standardisation of training processes across the business. Assist with talent management, succession planning, and personnel development initiatives. Deputise for the Training and Compliance Manager in his absence, ensuring continuity of training governance and compliance oversight. Interface with Operations, Quality, Engineering, and HR to proactively address training needs and support operational readiness. Quality, CI & Operational Support Complete Action Items and CAPAs generated following the closure of Quality EVENTS, ensuring timely and compliant execution. Identify, evaluate, and implement Continuous Improvement (CI) strategies across the business to enhance training effectiveness, operational performance, and employee competency. Support the development of a strong quality culture by reinforcing GMP standards and encouraging peer‑to‑peer challenge. Understand e‑learning techniques and, where appropriate, create and/or deliver e‑learning packages or blended learning solutions. Other Duties Research new technologies and methodologies in workplace learning and incorporate improvements into training programs. Perform other duties as assigned by the Supervisor/Manager. Education and Experience Requirements Bachelor’s degree or 3–5 years of work experience in a regulated environment. Strong English language comprehension and communication skills. Strong mathematical/statistical skills. Strong troubleshooting and computer/software skills. Join us and be part of building the bridge between life changing therapies and patients. Your
items.desc: Job ID JR117199 Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all . Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. Job Description As a Member of Technical Staff in NAND Module Process Integration Team the Singapore R&D department at Micron Semiconductor Operation Pte Ltd, you will be responsible for designing, developing, integrating, and implementing innovative and effective process solutions to improve next-generation 3D NAND Product Yield and Quality with competitive cost and performance within the required timeline. Your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to, the following: Module Ownership : Lead one or more process modules related to the development and operation of a 3D NAND semiconductor integrated circuit. Specification definition : Define structural specifications and process requirements for assigned modules. Strategic Direction: Set a clear direction and vision for the module and have a well-defined continual improvement plan. Proactive Issue Resolution: Be proactive in identifying potential structure, electrical and reliability issues and addressing them early with process control. Solve problems with a model-based approach. Performance Optimization: Focus on structural development, electrical performance, parametric verification, and process control and manufacturability assessment and optimization. Material Innovation: Analyze materials physically, electrically, etc. and work with process groups, etc to select new material for development. Drive material changes from research into production. Design Experiments : Design and implement device and process experiments to perform process development and process integration. Extract, analyze, report and draw logical conclusions on experiments and clarify the statistical significance of the data. Team Leadership : Provide team leadership in module development with assembling and coordinating a development team including process engineers, etc. Decision-Making & Goal Setting: Make key decisions for the team, as well as provide clear direction, goals and metrics for success of the team. Innovation & IP Generation: Innovate to address complex problems through both design and process. And consider new options for improving and developing new technologies or devices. Patent disclosures are expected on a regular basis. Multi-functional Coordination : Coordinate activities such as reticle tape outs, flow/traveler changes, lot management, etc. across multi-functional teams to enable a project to proceed in a rapid and low error manner. Technology Transfer : Support the transfer of new technology from R&D to high volume manufacturing. Communication & Influence : Communicate key information and projects via presentations and group discussion and drive decisions. Continuous Development : Continually grow technical and management skills and pursue continued education via on-job training and training class. Integrates Artificial Intelligence (AI)-assisted tools and insights into daily work to improve efficiency, quality, or effectiveness, exercising sound judgment and complying with organizational standards and legal requirements. Successful candidates for this position will have: Must have: Passionate about semiconductor technology and innovation. Adept at data analysis, problem-solving, and process integration optimization. Excellent communication skills and capacity to collaborate within multi-functional teams. Requirements: Education : PhD 8 yrs, or Master’s 11 yrs, or Bachelor’s 13 yrs in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Physics, or related field with semiconductor industry experience Proficiency in scripting/programming/engineering/business intelligence/Analytics software, such as Python, SolidWorks, Tableau, Power BI, etc. is desirable. Ability to develop a strong comprehensive end-to-end understanding of particular PI modules on new NAND technologies and related structural & electrical fail mechanisms. In-depth knowledge and direct experience with non-volatile memories (NAND) along with good understanding of the NAND process flow, the interaction of process & device, common yield & reliability issues are desirable. Experience in R&D and technology transfer within Semiconductor industry Committed to quality, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Ability to be self-motivated, and self-governing with proven track record to work in a demanding & dynamic environment. This announcement is intended to build a talent pipeline of professionals based in Europe who may be interested in future international career opportunities within Micron Technology Inc. and its affiliated group companies worldwide. We believe in fair, merit-based recruitment and assess all candidates exclusively on the basis of their qualifications, skills, experience and suitability for the role. Job Reference: CGS13683

As our Product Designer , you will be the dedicated voice of the customer, bridging user research and behavioral insights directly into our product strategy, user flows, and front-end design. Your role As our Product Designer, you will be embedded across key Multidisciplinary Teams (MDTs) taking direct ownership of our website, onboarding flows, and initial borrowing journeys. items.desc: For this role, we will only consider candidates who are currently based in the Netherlands. About SkinVision Skin cancer is highly treatable when caught early, but limited access to specialist care and long wait times delay diagnosis, increasing the risk of late-stage cases and driving up treatment costs. SkinVision, founded in Amsterdam in 2012, exists to close that gap. Our proprietary AI — certified as a Class IIa medical device under EU regulation, with over 90% sensitivity and 89% specificity — has already helped nearly 3 million people worldwide detect early signs of skin cancer. Today, SkinVision has a database of more than 6 million skin spot assessments and can reach 20 million people through insurer partnerships. High-risk cases are reviewed by a team of dermatologists, who support users in taking the right next step — from urgent care to a specialist referral. We are extending this further, connecting users faster to the specialist care they need. We're a focused, international team, active globally, united by one goal: making early detection accessible to everyone, everywhere. If you join us, you're not just building a product — you're helping close the gap between a person noticing something and getting the care they need. items.desc: Job Title: Infrastructure Security Engineer Location: Glasgow, City of Glasgow (G2 / Hybrid) Job Type: Full-time, Permanent Salary: £64,000 – £68,000 per year + Annual Bonus & Benefits Schedule: Monday to Friday About the Role We are seeking a highly analytical, technical Infrastructure Security Engineer to join our cybersecurity and IT operations team in Glasgow. Operating out of our modern security engineering hub in the International Financial Services District (IFSD) on Bothwell Street (G2), you will design, harden, and defend network architectures, system infrastructure, and cloud environments against modern cyber threats across Scotland and the UK. In this hands-on security role, you will bridge IT systems administration and cybersecurity operations—implementing Zero Trust security principles, managing firewall and perimeter defenses, orchestrating vulnerability remediations, and securing enterprise cloud workloads (AWS / Azure). Key Responsibilities Infrastructure Hardening & Defense: Design, configure, and maintain enterprise security controls across firewalls (Palo Alto, Fortinet, Check Point), Intrusion Detection/Prevention Systems (IDS/IPS), Web Application Firewalls (WAF), and Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR/MDR) solutions. Identity & Access Management (IAM): Enforce strict IAM protocols, Privileged Access Management (PAM), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) across Active Directory, Entra ID, and cloud service tenants. Incident Response & Forensics: Support Security Operations Center (SOC) incident escalation workflows, perform root-cause technical analysis during security events, and assist with forensic investigations and containment procedures. Technical Proficiency: Deep knowledge of TCP/IP, routing, switching, VPNs, micro-segmentation, and Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA). Strong technical experience with SIEM platforms (Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk), EDR tools (CrowdStrike, Defender for Endpoint), and network firewalls. Hands-on scripting capability (PowerShell, Python, or Bash) for automating security checks and configuration audits. Certifications & Accreditations: Professional security certification required (e.g., CompTIA Security+, CySA+, CISSP, CCSP, GIAC, or AWS/Azure Security Specialty). Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Cyber Security, Computer Science, Computer Networks, or equivalent practical industry experience. Location & Setup: Ability to work from our Glasgow office (G2 postcode area) on scheduled hybrid days. items.desc: Deine Aufgaben – gestalte mit uns die Zukunft: Big Data, Künstliche Intelligenz und moderne Analysemethoden sind die Basis, um unser Vertriebsmodell zukunftsorientiert weiterzuentwickeln. In der Big Data Organisation entwickeln wir KI-Agenten, von der automatischen Auftragskorrektur bis hin zur intelligenten Preisverhandlung, die unseren Vertrieb aktiv unterstützen. Unser nächster Schritt: ein KI-Agent, der mit Vertriebsmitarbeitern, strukturiert, regelbasiert und auf echten Geschäftsdaten, über Preisanpassungen verhandelt. Dafür setzen wir auf das Strands Agents SDK auf Amazon Bedrock und integrieren den Agenten in unsere bestehende SAP-AWS-Architektur. Im Anschluss an das Praktikum bieten wir gerne die Möglichkeit einer Werkstudententätigkeit im Team. Deine Aufgabe: Du konzipierst und entwickelst einen KI-Agenten, der Preisanfragen von Vertriebsmitarbeitern bewertet und strukturierte Verhandlungsdialoge führt. Der Agent nutzt Foundation Models (Amazon Bedrock / Claude), orchestriert über das Strands Agents SDK, und integriert sich in die bestehende AWS-Infrastruktur mit echten SAP-Auftragsdaten. Dazu gehören Tätigkeiten wie: Der Aufbau von Tool-Use-Patterns (Strands Tools), die den Agenten mit Preisregeln, Kundenhistorie und Rabattgrenzen verbinden. Die Entwicklung von Gesprächsflüssen, die den Vertrieb zu genehmigten Preiskorridoren führen und Einwände professionell behandeln. Du integrierst den Agenten in die bestehende AWS-Infrastruktur (Lambda, DynamoDB, API Gateway) mit echten SAP-Auftragsdaten. Die Evaluation der Agent-Performance: Verhandlungsergebnisse messen, Genehmigungsraten tracken, Fehlerfälle identifizieren. Insgesamt kannst du dich auf enge eine Zusammenarbeit mit den Vertriebskanälen und Fachabteilungen freuen und Business-Anforderungen in technische Lösungen übersetzen. items.desc: From smart models to AI that actually helps people make decisions Picture complex automated systems running 24/7 for customers all over the world. When something goes wrong, every minute counts. Maintenance engineers and operators need fast, reliable answers: what’s happening, why, and what to do next. That’s where you come in. For an international high-tech organisation, we’re looking for a Data Scientist with strong AI engineering skills . You’ll join a product team that builds AI assistants to support maintenance and operations. These aren’t chatbots for show. They’re agentic systems that analyse a situation, pull in the right data and documents, use tools and recommend the next step, with a human always in control. What you’ll work on Building AI agents and multi-step workflows that combine operational data, APIs, models and business rules Creating RAG and knowledge-grounded solutions using documents, events and knowledge graphs Developing predictive maintenance and decision-support models, and turning them into products Using AI for root-cause analysis, anomaly investigation and process mining Taking prototypes all the way to secure, scalable production with CI/CD, testing and monitoring You’ll work in an international team of data scientists, engineers, domain experts and UX specialists, using Scrum and DevOps. It’s an exploratory environment: problems change, data isn’t always complete, and you help shape which use cases are worth building. What you bring A BSc/MSc in Computer Science, AI, Data Science or similar, or equivalent experience Strong Python and PySpark, plus solid software engineering (APIs, testing, Git) Experience with Azure and Databricks for ML and MLOps Hands-on experience building GenAI or agentic AI applications with LangGraph, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen or similar Experience with LLM platforms such as Azure OpenAI, and a good grasp of embeddings, vector search and evaluating AI output A security-first mindset (prompt injection, data leakage, responsible AI) The ability to explain complex ideas clearly to non-technical colleagues Fluent English (Dutch is a plus) Bonus points if you’ve built predictive maintenance models or worked with Kafka, time-series data or industrial automation. Why this role? You’ll build AI that people rely on in their daily work, in a team that cares about turning new technology into products that work, not just demos.

items.desc: Je werkt binnen team AI Development aan ChatAmsterdam: een AI-chatbot van de gemeente die als denkpartner ambtenaren helpt hun werkefficiëntie en -kwaliteit te verbeteren, in een veilige omgeving waarin hun privacy wordt beschermd. Samen met team AI Development werk je in een betrokken en technisch team bestaande uit 9 collega's, die elkaar helpen, waar je werkt aan AI en waar je rekening houdt met verschillende belangen en veranderingen in de grote Amsterdamse stadspolitiek. De functie Amsterdam gebruikt steeds meer data om betere beslissingen te nemen en de dienstverlening te verbeteren. De vakgroep Data Science & AI speelt hierin een belangrijke rol, vooral met voorspelmodellen en AI-oplossingen. Dit thema krijgt de komende jaren veel aandacht in de stad. Je komt terecht in team AI Development, een agile team met Software Engineers, Data Scientists, een Business Analist, een Product Owner en een Scrum Master. Zij maken AI-oplossingen en applicaties voor collega’s binnen de gemeente, zoals ChatAmsterdam en De Raadsbot, zodat zij sneller informatie vinden en Amsterdammers beter kunnen helpen. Ook werken zij aan vragen over veilig gebruik van AI, privacy, betrouwbare antwoorden, toegankelijkheid en duidelijke uitleg over hoe AI werkt. Daarbij werken ze samen met onder andere beleidscollega’s, juristen, informatiebeveiliging, privacy-experts en gebruikers uit de organisatie. Je ontwerpt en ontwikkelt robuuste AI-oplossingen, waaronder RAG-systemen, in Azure en Databricks. Daarbij werk je met o.a. Python en LangChain. Zo is DII de betrouwbare digitaliseringspartner van de gemeente Amsterdam. De vakgroep Data Science & AI bestaat uit specialisten die data- en AI-oplossingen en voorspelmodellen maken voor verschillende onderwerpen in Amsterdam. Het team Chat Amsterdam werkt aan het uitbreiden van het gen AI-landschap. Aantoonbare ervaring met Python, softwareontwerp, backend ontwikkeling en API’s, waarbij je onderhoudbare, modulaire code schrijft en best practices toepast, zoals Git, geautomatiseerde tests en code reviews. Aantoonbare ervaring met het ontwikkelen, evalueren en in productie brengen van LLM-applicaties en agents, met praktische ervaring met LangChain, LangGraph en Langfuse. Ervaring met clouddeployment en productiebeheer, waaronder Kubernetes, Infrastructure-as-Code, CI/CD, logging, monitoring en het oplossen van storingen. Nos équipes couvrent le développement, l’architecture, la data, le pilotage, la conduite du changement, les processus, la stratégie, le marketing et le design. Société à Mission, nous défendons un numérique aux impacts positifs, sur les plans social, environnemental et sociétal. Notre raison d’être est « Agir pour un monde numérique responsable au service de l’humain », et nos choix de projets et de missions la reflètent. L’agence de Lyon compte 30 collaborateurs aux profils variés. Elle accompagne des acteurs de l’assurance, de la mutuelle et du courtage dans leur transformation digitale, leurs projets d’innovation et l’amélioration de l’expérience client. Vous y trouverez un cadre moderne et convivial, où l’on partage ses pratiques et où l’on progresse ensemble. Description du poste Vous voulez de l’IA générative qui tourne en production, pas seulement dans un notebook ? Vous aimez coder en Python et transformer un besoin métier en solution fiable, réellement utilisée ? Dans le cadre d’une mission chez l’un de nos clients, un acteur international de l’assurance, vous rejoignez une équipe IA qui développe des solutions à base de LLM pour plusieurs entités du groupe : automatisation de processus métier et outils destinés aux clients et aux partenaires. Vous évoluez dans une équipe attachée à la qualité du code, où les pratiques se partagent et où le socle technique est tenu avec rigueur. Vos missions Conception et développement : construire en Python des assistants, des agents et des chaînes RAG qui répondent à des besoins métier précis. Cas d’usage : faire évoluer des solutions existantes, ou en porter une de bout en bout, du cadrage technique à son intégration dans l’outil ou le processus visé. Optimisation : améliorer la pertinence des réponses, les temps de traitement et la maîtrise des coûts, et accompagner les changements de version des modèles. Roadmap : livrer les nouveaux cas d’usage dans les échéances fixées avec l’équipe. Qualité logicielle : produire un code testé, documenté et maintenable, et participer aux revues de code. Bonnes pratiques : appliquer les standards de l’équipe, notamment sur la sécurité et la confidentialité des données. Qualifications Vous êtes diplômé(e) d’une école d’ingénieur ou d’un master en informatique (Bac+5), ou vous avez un parcours équivalent. Vous avez au moins 2 ans d’expérience en développement logiciel sur des projets d’envergure, avec une pratique significative de Python. Vous avez déjà travaillé avec des LLM sur un projet réel : appel d’API de modèles, RAG ou agent. Le périmètre peut être limité, ce qui compte, c’est d’avoir affronté les contraintes du terrain. Au-delà du parcours, nous cherchons une personne curieuse et rigoureuse, qui apprend vite, sait avancer seule et se montre à l’aise en équipe. Vos principaux atouts Une bonne maîtrise de Python et des pratiques associées : tests, revues de code, documentation Une première expérience de projets LLM (RAG, agents, API OpenAI ou Anthropic) Une sensibilité DevOps : CI/CD GitLab, Docker, déploiement cloud Idéalement, Azure (Container Apps, AI Services) et des frameworks comme LangChain ou LlamaIndex L’usage d’outils de développement assisté par IA, comme Claude Code ou équivalent Des bases en SQL (PostgreSQL) et en NoSQL (MongoDB) De l’autonomie, de l’initiative et l’envie de progresser Informations complémentaires Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Pour travailler sur des usages concrets de l’IA générative, utilisés chaque jour par des équipes métier et des clients, dans un secteur où la fiabilité des réponses n’est pas négociable. Chez ASI, vous intervenez sur des projets innovants, au sein d’équipes pluridisciplinaires, avec de la place pour l’initiative et la montée en compétences. Et Aussi Un parcours d’intégration structuré pour bien démarrer Des projets de fond dans des environnements exigeants Une équipe experte, bienveillante et collaborative Un mode de travail hybride Un suivi de carrière local et personnalisé Notre processus de recrutement Environ trois semaines, en trois étapes : un échange téléphonique avec une chargée de recrutement, un entretien avec un Business Manager, puis un entretien avec le Directeur de l’agence de Lyon. Ce poste vous parle ? Écrivez-nous : nous serons heureux de découvrir votre parcours et les projets sur lesquels vous voulez vous investir. Pour en savoir plus sur l’agence de Lyon et nos opportunités, rencontrons-nous. Pour connaître ASI, rendez-vous sur notre page LinkedIn et notre site internet.

At Wyndham Hotels & Resorts, we're investing in the future of enterprise AI. We are looking for an Agentic AI Engineer to join our Global Innovation Hub in Dublin and help establish the foundations of our emerging enterprise AI ecosystem. This is an exciting opportunity for a curious and hands-on engineer who thrives on experimentation, rapid prototyping and solving complex challenges. You'll work at the intersection of AI, automation and software engineering, building intelligent agents, reusable frameworks and innovative AI capabilities that can support associates, franchisees and guests across a global organization. If you're passionate about Large Language Models (LLMs), AI agents, prompt engineering and the future of human-AI collaboration, we'd love to hear from you. What You'll Do As an Agentic AI Engineer , you will transform innovative ideas into practical AI solutions. Working within our AI Innovation Hub, you'll design, build and test next-generation AI agents and reusable capabilities that can create value across our business. Your work will include: Designing and building AI agents, autonomous workflows and reusable enterprise AI capabilities. Creating prompt frameworks, tool integrations, memory architectures and reasoning workflows that enable agents to perform complex tasks. Developing prototypes using technologies such as Python, AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude and modern AI orchestration frameworks. Experimenting with model selection, routing logic and multi-agent collaboration patterns. Building Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions and enterprise knowledge integrations. Developing secure, governed approaches to AI tool usage and enterprise system connectivity. Evaluating AI performance through testing, benchmarking, model comparisons and quality assessments. Partnering with business stakeholders to identify opportunities where agentic AI can deliver measurable business value. Contributing to enterprise AI standards, reusable templates, governance frameworks and best practices that support long-term scalability. What We're Looking For Required Skills & Experience Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems or similar technical discipline 3+ years of experience in software engineering, AI engineering, cloud development, automation or related technical fields Strong hands-on experience with Python development Experience building AI applications, GPTs, copilots, agents, automation workflows or API-driven solutions Understanding of agentic AI concepts including: Prompt engineering Function and tool calling RAG architectures Context management and memory Model orchestration AI evaluation and testing Experience working with cloud platforms, particularly AWS Strong problem-solving and analytical skills Excellent communication skills and ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders Nice to Have Experience with AWS Bedrock, AgentCore or similar AI platforms Experience working with OpenAI and Anthropic APIs Knowledge of vector databases, OpenSearch or enterprise search solutions Exposure to MCP (Model Context Protocol) concepts Experience in AI innovation, R&D, proof-of-concept development or emerging technologies Understanding of responsible AI, governance, privacy and risk management frameworks Why Join Us? This role offers the opportunity to: Help define the future of AI within one of the world's largest hotel franchising companies Work with emerging AI technologies before they become mainstream Build solutions that could impact thousands of associates, franchise partners and guests globally Experiment with cutting-edge models, frameworks and orchestration techniques Collaborate with engineering, architecture, product, security and business leaders Influence the development of enterprise AI platforms and governance practices Grow your expertise in one of the fastest evolving fields in technology What Success Looks Like In this role, you'll create working AI prototypes that demonstrate real business value, establish reusable patterns for future development, and contribute to a scalable enterprise framework for agentic AI. Your work will help transform innovative concepts into practical solutions while maintaining the highest standards of security, governance and responsible AI. Ready to help shape the future of enterprise AI? Join Wyndham Hotels & Resorts and be part of building the next generation of intelligent agents that empower people to work smarter, faster and more effectively.

Samen ontwikkelen we intelligente AI-workflows, virtuele assistenten, autonome agents en slimme applicaties die bedrijven écht veranderen. Wat is je focus? Je geeft, samen met een team, vorm aan AI-gedreven producten – van idee tot implementatie. Je blijft mee met de snel-veranderende wereld van LLMs, agents, kennis van RAG is nice to have. You will define how we measure ourselves: precision by outcome, time to detect, runtime of unauthorized resources, and the cost a model prevented. - Own models that detect and block fraudulent activity in real time, protecting
items.desc:
Own the detection models and the measurement science that find fraudulent and compromised AWS accounts in real time. Join a team of scientists and engineers whose analysis decides how fraud is detected and stopped, and how fast.
The AWS Payments and Fraud Prevention organization keeps AWS a safe place to build for millions of customers. Our team owns the science behind fraud and compromise detection on AWS. Account compromise is the case where a legitimate customer's credentials are stolen or exposed and an attacker uses the account to run unauthorized workloads. Fraud is the case where an account exists to consume resources with no intent to pay. Most accounts our models score belong to legitimate customers, so every decision has to stop fraud while leaving their work undisturbed. As a Data Scientist you will own detection models end to end, from the first look at an emerging pattern through feature design, training, shadow evaluation, production launch and the weekly performance review. You will define how we measure ourselves: precision by outcome, time to detect, runtime of unauthorized resources, and the cost a model prevented.
- Own models that detect and block fraudulent activity in real time, protecting customers and AWS.
- Turn a pattern spotted in a handful of accounts into a model that screens millions.
- Define the metrics your models and systems are measured by and discuss them in weekly and monthly business reviews.
- End-to-end ownership, from the first signal to the enforcement action and the cleanup after it.
Key job responsibilities
- Own detection models and rules end to end: frame the problem with partners, source and engineer features from large-scale activity, sign-in and usage data, train and validate, run shadow evaluations, launch, and monitor performance after launch.
- Investigate new fraud and compromise patterns as they emerge, quantify their scale and design the detection response, from a fast rule to a trained model, with the trade-off between speed and precision stated.
- Define and audit the metrics that measure our systems: outcome-based precision and recall, time to detect, runtime of unauthorized resources, prevented cost. Own the analysis behind weekly and monthly business reviews.
- Evaluate agentic and LLM-based systems: build labeled evaluation sets, measure error rates in both directions, and set the thresholds under which automation is allowed to act.
- Extend detection to new AWS services as they launch, including AI services where spend accrues in minutes.
- Write clear technical documents for scientists and for non-technical partners in operations, engineering and leadership, and present them in science reviews.
- Mentor junior scientists and analysts on method, and help interview for the team.
A day in the life
You begin with the performance review of the models you own: what they caught, what was later overturned, and what slipped past every layer. You pull the misses, find that three share a pattern you have not seen before, size it in the data, write a shadow-mode rule, and put a one-page analysis in front of the team with the precision you expect and the cost of waiting for a full model. In the team's planning session for the next quarter, that analysis becomes a proposal for a new model and you make the case for its place on the roadmap against the other layers of the detection stack. You also audit the cases your agentic system resolved on its own and adjust its evaluation set and thresholds. You use AI coding assistants daily, for SQL, Python and documentation, and you check their work. Your stakeholders are the fraud engineering teams that power your models, the teams that act on their decisions, the AWS service teams whose customers we protect, and the leadership that reads your numbers every week.
About the team
We are a team of scientists, analysts, software and data engineers and a program manager, with close partners across AWS Fraud Prevention worldwide. We own the science behind fraud and compromise detection on AWS, from signal and detection through decision, enforcement, cleanup and reinstatement. We follow a layered detection strategy with online and offline machine learning models and agentic investigation systems. Our models also run in the AWS European Sovereign Cloud, where they must work under EU data-residency constraints.
We invest in the growth of every team member through mentorship, careful code and document reviews, and projects sized to stretch you. We celebrate promotions, and new members ship their first project within their first quarter.

Job Description: 
 An opportunity for a CAMO Services Engineer has arisen within Airbus Defence and Space, Getafe (Madrid). 
 The department is in charge of ensuring the continuing airworthiness, maintenance status, technical records and configuration of customer aircraft in accordance with applicable regulations, approved procedures and contractual requirements. 
 The role covers three main areas: Airworthiness, Review Certificate (ARC) support, second-hand aircraft transitions and Entry Into Service (EIS) projects.
 RESPONSABILITIES 
 Support the control of continuing airworthiness, aircraft maintenance status, configuration and technical records.
 Perform technical and documentary reviews and identify, report and follow up discrepancies.
 Support ARC, aircraft transition and EIS activities while ensuring compliance with applicable regulatory and contractual requirements.
 Provide technical support to customers and internal stakeholders and contribute to safe, efficient and cost-effective fleet management.
 MAIN ACTIVITIES 
 1. AIRCRAFT TRANSITIONS
 Support aircraft acquisition, delivery, acceptance, lease transition and redelivery projects through detailed documentary reviews.
 Assess aircraft historical records, maintenance status, AD/SB/modification/repair compliance and configuration.
 Verify the status and recording of ADs, SBs, modifications, repairs and applicable engineering documentation.
 Review records for aircraft, engines, APU, landing gear and relevant components.
 Manage discrepancy reports, support records handover and identify technical or contractual risks affecting acceptance or redelivery.
 Support maintenance planning, technical queries and the resolution of documentary discrepancies.
 2. AIRWORTHINESS REVIEW ACTIVITIES
 Review aircraft and component records for airworthiness compliance.
 Verify maintenance status, mandatory requirements, aircraft configuration and life-limited components.
 Identify and manage findings and discrepancies, coordinating their resolution with customers and relevant stakeholders.
 Support ARC procedures and associated documentary activities within the individuals assigned authority and organizational approvals.
 3. CAMO ENTRY INTO SERVICE (EIS)
 Support service preparation, customer coordination and analysis of requirements and documentation.
 Support the development or tailoring of key CAMO processes: CAMO organisation, Operator Maintenance Programme, Maintenance Control and Fleet Management, Configuration Control and Maintenance Planning.
 Support the development of procedures for Reliability Monitoring, Mandatory Engineering DocumentControl, Non-mandatory SB Policy, Structural Damage Chart Management and ARC.
 Prepare high-quality technical deliverables and presentations and support knowledge transfer to customers.
 Candidates must meet all legal and professional requirements for the role. 
 SKILLS 
 Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Aeronautical/Aerospace Engineering or an equivalent technical qualification.
 Experience: Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in CAMO, continuing airworthiness management, or aircraft maintenance engineering.
 Regulatory Knowledge: Comprehensive mastery of EASA Part-CAMO / Part-M ; working knowledge of Part-145 ; familiarity with military frameworks ( EMAR ) is an asset.
 Technical Expertise: Proven capability in evaluating ADs, SBs, major/minor modifications, structural repairs, and life-limited components.Direct experience handling aircraft technical records, maintenance planning systems, and configuration baselines.
 Asset Experience: Prior involvement in transitions, ARCs, or EIS is strongly preferred; platform experience on A330 MRTT , C295 , or A400M is a distinct advantage.
 Soft Skills & Leadership: Strong analytical abilities, professional integrity, and polished stakeholder management. Ability to lead and mentor junior engineering teams during transition projects.
 Languages: Professional working proficiency in English (written and verbal).
 Additional Information 
 Work Location: Based at company or customer operational facilities, subject to project needs.
 Travel Flexibility: Willingness to travel is required. Assignments may involve off-site deployments lasting up to six months.
 Assignment Scope: Assignments dynamically span Transitions, ARC audits, and EIS deployments based on business needs and individual authorizations.

Location: Amsterdam, Hullenbergweg 81-135 (Office), Netherlands 
 Job Title: AI Platform Engineer 
 Locatie: Amsterdam - Hybride (met een team bijeenkomst in Hengelo kantoor per week)
 Talen: Nederlands & Engels
 Dienstverband: Fulltime
 Role Overview 
 Ben jij een DevOps of Platform Engineer die de sprong wil maken naar de wereld van Generative AI, binnen een van de meest hoogbeveiligde software-omgevingen van Nederland?
 Bij Thales Nederland bouwen we in Hengelo aan onze eigen geavanceerde AI-ecosystemen die draaien in volledig air-gapped infrastructuren . Als AI Platform Engineer word jij de spin in het web die ervoor zorgt dat onze software engineers en systemen veilig gebruik kunnen maken van lokale taalmodellen, geavanceerde multi-agent netwerken en systemen voor contextgebaseerde informatie-ophaling. Omdat we geen gebruik kunnen maken van publieke cloud-API's, bouwen, hosten en beheren we alles zélf on-premise op onze eigen high-performance GPU-clusters.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Beheer van AI-Containerapplicaties: Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het deployen, updaten en onderhouden van cruciale AI-hulpprogramma's en developer-tools binnen de on-premise container-orkestratieplatforms. Je zorgt voor optimale performance, resource-allocatie en hoge beschikbaarheid voor de development teams.
 Air-Gapped RAG & Codebase Infrastructure: Je bouwt en onderhoudt de on-premise Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) infrastructuur. Je zorgt dat applicaties via lokale data-pijplijnen, tekst-segmentatie (chunking) en vector-indexering veilig en razendsnel context kunnen ophalen uit onze interne codebases.
 On-Premise Model Routing & Lifecycle: Je richt de tooling in voor lokale model-serving en helpt bij het bouwen van een flexibele routing-laag. Hierdoor kunnen applicaties binnen het afgesloten netwerk dynamisch schakelen tussen verschillende lokale modellen op basis van de complexiteit van de specifieke taak.
 Agent Orchestration & Tooling: Je ondersteunt het opzetten van lokale raamwerken voor multi-agent systemen (zoals gespecialiseerde code-, architectuur- en debugging-agents). Je helpt bij het integreren van lokale geheugensystemen en interfaces waarmee agents externe tools kunnen aanroepen.
 Air-Gapped Observability: Je implementeert monitoring- en tracing-dashboards die volledig lokaal binnen het netwerk draaien. Je meet hiermee het token-verbruik, de verwerkingstijd (latency) en infrastructuurkosten per team of gebruiker, zonder dat er data naar buiten lekt.
 Strikte AI Safety & Security Rails: Samen met onze security-experts implementeer je harde vangrails en beveiligingsinfrastructuren om kwaadwillige invoer (prompt-injecties) te voorkomen en te garanderen dat agents zich strikt houden aan datacompartimentering en autorisatieniveaus.
 Required Skills & Qualifications 
 Ervaring met On-Premise & DevOps: Goede ervaring met Linux-omgevingen, containerisatie en container-orkestratie in een on-premise datacenter-setting.
 Software Engineering: Sterke programmeervaardigheden in Python (ervaring met andere systeemtalen of scripting is een pre) en ervaring met het bouwen en integreren van lokale API's.
 GenAI Interesse & Conceptuele Kennis: Je begrijpt de theorie achter vector-indexering, embeddings en de werking van grote taalmodellen (LLM's). Je hebt hier bij voorkeur al op hobbymatige of projectmatige basis mee geëxperimenteerd met open-source middelen.
 Talen: Uitstekende beheersing van zowel de Nederlandse als Engelse taal in woord en geschrift.
 Veiligheidsonderzoek: Aangezien je werkt aan defensie-gerelateerde projecten, is het succesvol doorlopen van een nationale veiligheidsscreening (Verklaring van Geen Bezwaar) een vereiste.
 Wat Thales biedt 
 Een unieke kans om te pionieren met state-of-the-art GenAI-technologie in een high-security enterprise-omgeving.
 Een flexibele hybride werkomgeving met een gezonde balans tussen thuiswerken en samenwerken op het High Tech Systems Park in Hengelo.
 Uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden volgens de CAO Metalelektro, waaronder een zeer competitief salaris en 40 vakantiedagen per jaar (27 vakantiedagen + 13 ADV-dagen).
 Ruimte en budget om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen tot een expert in AI-infrastructuur.
 #LI-NB1

Job Description: 
 Leonardo è un gruppo industriale internazionale che realizza capacità tecnologiche multidominio in ambito Aerospazio, Difesa & Sicurezza. Con oltre 60.000 dipendenti nel mondo, l’azienda ha una significativa presenza industriale in Italia, Regno Unito, Polonia, e Stati Uniti, e opera in 150 paesi anche attraverso aziende controllate, joint venture e partecipazioni. Protagonista dei principali programmi strategici internazionali è partner tecnologico e industriale di Governi, Amministrazioni della Difesa, Istituzioni e imprese. Innovazione, ricerca continua, digitalizzazione e sostenibilità sono i pilastri del suo business nel mondo.
 Leonardo è uno dei partner industriali strategici del programma GCAP (Global Combat Air Programme), insieme alla britannica BAE Systems e alla giapponese Mitsubishi Heavy Industries, finalizzato allo sviluppo e alla realizzazione di un sistema aereo di nuova generazione, definito come “sistema di sistemi”. Impiegato per operazioni multidominio in ambito difesa, il sistema sarà caratterizzato da una “core platform” connessa con altri sistemi periferici “adjuncts”, pilotati e non pilotati.
 Il programma, tra i più sfidanti e avveniristici per l’industria dell’aerospazio e della difesa, guiderà la rivoluzione tecnologica che caratterizzerà il settore nei prossimi cinquant’anni. Una sfida finalizzata a rafforzare la sovranità tecnologica e industriale dei paesi coinvolti, perché punta a identificare e a rendere disponibili quelle tecnologie innovative, dette abilitanti, che assicureranno il salto generazionale, generando ritorni positivi e progresso economico e sociale per l’intero sistema Paese, a beneficio delle nuove generazioni.
 Le risorse che lavoreranno all’interno di questo programma avranno l’opportunità di accedere ad un percorso di crescita professionale in un contesto internazionale e tecnologicamente avanzato.
 Nell'ambito dell'ingegneria della Div Aeronautica, B.U. Velivoli, nella U.O. Gcap Chief Engoneering, stiamo ricercando un/a system modeller/system engineer presso la sede di Torino.

 - Design del sistema GCAP, i.e. design a livello velivolo e Through Life Support dello stesso

How do you turn engineering changes into well-managed projects and continuously better manufacturing processes?
 As our Product and Process Engineer based in Tullamore, Ireland , you will take ownership of post-launch engineering and Product Lifecycle Management activities, coordinating changes across products, materials and manufacturing processes.
 With around 90% of the role focused on project and process management, you will bring structure to complex engineering initiatives, align cross-functional stakeholders and keep projects moving toward their goals. In return for your engineering expertise, strong organization and project leadership skills, you will have the opportunity to drive meaningful improvements across products and manufacturing processes while working in an international environment.
 More about the role 
 Lead and coordinate post-launch and Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) activities, ensuring engineering projects and changes are delivered effectively and on time.
 Manage cross-functional engineering projects involving changes to products, raw materials and manufacturing processes, bringing together stakeholders across Engineering, Operations, R&D, Procurement and other functions.
 Own and coordinate Engineering Change activities, including Engineering Change Orders (ECOs), supplier Product Change Notices and the associated documentation and ERP processes.
 Drive continuous improvement across products and manufacturing processes using Lean and Six Sigma methodologies to improve quality, efficiency, cost and delivery.
 Identify and lead cost-saving and Value Analysis/Value Engineering (VAVE) initiatives across products and production processes.
 Maintain accurate product master data and ensure engineering changes are properly documented, implemented and communicated.
 Manage multiple priorities simultaneously, bringing structure to change, keeping stakeholders aligned and ensuring teams remain focused on the most important project deliverables.
 More about you 
 Bachelor’s degree in Industrial, Mechanical, Manufacturing Engineering or a related engineering discipline – an engineering degree is essential for this position.
 At least 3–5 years of relevant experience within Manufacturing, Process, Industrial or Product Engineering, ideally in a production environment.
 Strong background in project management , with demonstrated experience independently coordinating complex, cross-functional engineering projects and leading change.
 Practical experience with Lean and/or Six Sigma methodologies and a track record of applying continuous improvement principles in an engineering or manufacturing environment.
 Experience with Engineering Change Management and working with ERP systems; experience with SAP, JD Edwards or similar platforms is an advantage.
 Highly organized, autonomous and solution-oriented, with strong communication skills and the ability to prioritize, adapt to change and keep teams and stakeholders focused.
 Fluent English and confidence working across functions and cultures; AutoCAD, automation experience, project management certification, Lean/Six Sigma certification and German are considered advantages.

items.desc:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.
 At NVIDIA, we are helping public-sector organizations use accelerated computing and artificial intelligence (AI) to improve government services, research and national capabilities. The Global Public Sector team is seeking a Solutions Architect based in France to turn sovereign AI priorities into scalable technical solutions. This hands-on role collaborates with solutions partners, government entities, research organizations, integrators and NVIDIA engineering and product teams to develop architectures, build proofs of concept and move validated workflows toward production. The work spans generative and agentic AI, model adaptation, GPU-accelerated inference, containerized platforms and machine learning operations. Travel within France and occasionally across Europe may be required for customer engagements.
 What you’ll be doing: 
 Translate public-sector mission goals, data constraints and operational requirements into technical architectures for generative and agentic AI solutions.
 Collaborate with partners to build and demonstrate working prototypes using Python and PyTorch. Then define practical paths from proof of concept to production deployment on NVIDIA accelerated computing platforms.
 Build containerized deployment patterns using Kubernetes, including model serving, scaling, integration and lifecycle considerations for customer environments.
 We lead hands-on discovery sessions, technical workshops and field trials with customer engineers and ecosystem partners, with clear success criteria and measurable technical outcomes.
 Guide model adaptation and inference workflows for large language models, then solve performance, compatibility and deployment issues with partner and technical teams.
 We create reusable notebooks, code samples, architecture guidance and technical presentations that connect customer requirements with implementable solutions.
 Bring structured customer and partner feedback to NVIDIA product and engineering teams to inform product requirements and remove adoption barriers.
 What we need to see: 
 Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Applied Statistics, Physics, Mathematics or another relevant engineering field or equivalent experience.
 5 or more years of meaningful experience in solutions architecture, technical consulting, software development or a closely related technical role.
 Strong hands-on programming skills in Python and practical experience using PyTorch to build, test and debug machine learning workflows.
 Proven work with generative or agentic AI, including domain adaptation or deployment of agent-based solutions.
 Practical experience packaging and deploying AI applications with containers and Kubernetes.
 Ability to turn sophisticated customer requirements into clear solution architectures, working prototypes, and ready-to-implement technical plans.
 Clear written, verbal and technical presentation skills, including the ability to communicate through code, notebooks, architecture documents and workshops.
 Proven teamwork across customer, engineering, research, product, sales and partner teams in an international environment.
 Ways to stand out from the crowd: 
 Development experience with NVIDIA GPUs, software libraries or high-performance computing systems.
 Applied knowledge of continuous integration and delivery, AI model lifecycle management, and repeatable deployment pipelines for AI systems.
 Technical depth in one or more areas such as multimodal AI, computer vision, edge deployment, digital twins or data analytics.
 Consulting or delivery experience with government customers, sovereign technology programs or AI startups.
 Professional communication skills in French and English; additional Western European languages are a plus.
 Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family www.nvidiabenefits.com/ 
Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary ranges for this position are:
69,000 EUR – 119,600 EUR for Level 3; and 87,750 EUR – 152,100 EUR for Level 4.

items.desc: IRB Barcelona is seeking a proactive and motivated AI Software Engineer to join the Biomedical Genomics Lab (BBGLab) led by Dr. Núria López-Bigas at IRB Barcelona (bbglab.irbbarcelona.org). The lab studies the mutations and mechanisms that drive cancer development, and translates this knowledge into computational tools for research and precision cancer medicine. AI is becoming a central part of this work, both to accelerate scientific discovery and to make the lab's tools more useful to researchers and clinicians. The successful candidate will join a team of bioinformaticians and software engineers to build AI-powered systems, with a strong focus on LLMs and agentic systems. Current projects include an agentic AI system for human-AI scientific collaboration, co-developed with the lab's researchers to uncover the molecular mechanisms of tumorigenesis across genes and tissues, and a chatbot embedded in the Cancer Genome Interpreter to support the interpretation of mutations. The role is mainly focused on engineering, with some support to research projects. Prior experience in cancer genomics or bioinformatics is not essential, but it is considered an asset; we are looking for someone curious about the biology behind our work and willing to learn it. This position is financed by the project “Data-driven cancer genome interpretation for personalised cancer treatment” from the European Union (Acronim: CGI-Clinics. Grant Agreement: 101057509). KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Design, develop, deploy and maintain LLM-based and agentic applications for the lab's projects, such as the agentic system for scientific collaboration and the Cancer Genome Interpreter chatbot. Integrate AI components with the lab's tools, databases and knowledge sources. Evaluate and improve the quality and reliability of LLM-based systems (prompting, context management, tool use, evaluation). Apply software engineering best practices: version control, testing, code review and documentation. Keep up to date with advances in AI and propose how to apply them to the lab's projects. Provide technical support to research projects, participate in project meetings, and contribute to technical reports. YOU HAVE Highly proactive profile, with a strong willingness to learn and to stay constantly up to date with a rapidly changing AI landscape (models, frameworks, tools and AI coding assistants). Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Bioinformatics, Computational Sciences, Physics, Mathematics or similar. At least 1 year of experience in software development. Hands-on experience with LLMs and agentic systems (e.g. LLM APIs, prompt and context engineering, RAG, tool use, agents). Strong Python programming skills and familiarity with software development best practices. Experience with collaborative software development using Git and platforms such as GitHub. Excellent English (written and spoken). Excellent communication skills and ability to work within a collaborative team. Strong analytical skills, ability to work independently, and adaptability to new challenges. YOU MIGHT ALSO HAVE Extensive, proven experience building LLM-based applications and agentic systems (RAG, MCP, multi-agent frameworks, evaluation). Experience with AI coding assistants and modern AI development workflows. Experience with machine learning or deep learning. Experience in bioinformatics or cancer genomics, particularly in NGS data analysis. Experience with pipelines (Nextflow), high-performance computing, containers (Docker, Singularity), cloud environments (e.g. AWS), and databases. Experience with full-stack development. A Master’s degree or a PhD in a related field. Experience working in international teams. Our mission is to carry out research of excellence to cure cancer and other diseases linked to ageing. items.desc: Votre mission Intégré(e) à nos équipes Cyber, vous travaillerez au contact des experts techniques et des métiers pour identifier des besoins concrets et les transformer en solutions. Vous serez notamment amené(e) à : comprendre et formaliser les besoins des équipes internes et de nos clients ; analyser les usages et identifier les tâches pouvant être automatisées ou augmentées par l'IA ; réaliser un benchmark des solutions IA du marché et sélectionner les technologies les plus pertinentes en fonction des cas d'usage ; traduire un besoin utilisateur en spécifications fonctionnelles et techniques ; concevoir et développer des outils, assistants ou agents combinant Cyber, IA et automatisation ; exploiter des API et développer des automatisations en Python, PowerShell ou Bash ; tester les solutions auprès des utilisateurs et mesurer leur valeur ajoutée ; étudier leur sécurité, leur robustesse, leur maintenabilité et leur capacité à passer à l'échelle ; pour les solutions les plus prometteuses, réfléchir à leur industrialisation et à leur transformation en offre commercialisable auprès de nos clients. Quelques terrains d'expérimentation Selon les besoins identifiés, vous pourriez par exemple imaginer : un assistant Cyber intelligent facilitant l'accès à la connaissance et aux procédures ; un outil d'analyse et de priorisation des vulnérabilités ; des agents permettant d'automatiser certaines tâches ou contrôles Cyber ; un dispositif permettant de collecter, analyser et restituer automatiquement des données de sécurité ; un outil générant des rapports et recommandations personnalisés à partir de données techniques ; ou encore un nouveau service IA répondant à un besoin Cyber identifié auprès de nos clients. Nous ne vous imposons pas la solution : nous attendons aussi de vous que vous nous aidiez à l'imaginer. Le profil que nous recherchons Vous préparez un Bac+5 en école d'ingénieur ou Master, avec une dominante Cybersécurité, Informatique, IA/Data, Cloud ou Infrastructure. Au-delà de votre formation, nous recherchons un profil disposant déjà d'une bonne culture de l'écosystème IA et de ses usages. Vous connaissez ou avez déjà expérimenté plusieurs technologies du marché : LLM, IA générative, agents IA, RAG, API, automatisation, outils no-code/low-code… Vous êtes capable de comprendre les possibilités mais également les limites d'une technologie, et surtout d'identifier le bon outil pour répondre au bon besoin. Vous avez également : de solides bases en Cyber, systèmes et réseaux ; une pratique du développement, idéalement Python ; une bonne capacité d'écoute, d'analyse et de reformulation du besoin ; une sensibilité aux problématiques utilisateurs et clients ; suffisamment de curiosité pour explorer de nouvelles technologies et challenger l'existant. Mais surtout, nous recherchons quelqu'un qui ne se contente pas de développer ce qu'on lui demande. Vous aimez comprendre le besoin, challenger la demande, proposer une solution puis la concrétiser. Et si votre PFE permettait de transformer une idée IA en une nouvelle solution Cyber pour nos clients ? L’intelligence artificielle transforme les pratiques de la cybersécurité : automatisation des tâches, analyse de données, qualification des vulnérabilités, assistants intelligents, génération de rapports, exploitation de la connaissance… Chez Axians, nous souhaitons aller plus loin : identifier les usages réellement créateurs de valeur, développer les outils associés et imaginer comment certains d’entre eux pourraient devenir demain de véritables solutions commercialisables auprès de nos clients. Votre challenge sera donc autant technologique que métier et business. Dans un monde en évolution permanente, VINCI Energies accélère la transition environnementale en concrétisant deux mutations majeures, numérique et énergétique. Ses équipes déploient des technologies et des solutions multitechniques sur mesure, de la conception à la réalisation, l'exploitation et la maintenance. Ancrées dans leurs territoires, agiles et innovantes, ses plus 2 100 entreprises sont au cœur des choix énergétiques de leurs clients, de leurs infrastructures et de leurs process pour les rendre chaque jour plus fiables, plus efficients et plus durables. VINCI Energies vise une performance globale, attentive à la planète, utile aux hommes et solidaire des populations.

items.desc: Stage BAC+5 - Data Science - Solutions logicielles et data pour la spectrométrie de masse - F/H/D Localisation: Marcy l'Etoile, France Type de Contrat: Stage Fonction: Bioscience R&D Acteur mondial dans le domaine du diagnostic in vitro depuis plus de 60 ans, bioMérieux offre des solutions de diagnostic qui déterminent l’origine d’une maladie ou d’une contamination pour améliorer la santé des patients et assurer la sécurité des consommateurs. Rejoindre bioMérieux, c’est choisir une société familiale et humaniste, portée par une vision long terme, au service de la santé publique dans le monde. Vous avez idéalement une première expérience avec les modèles d’IA générative et les frameworks (e.g. LangGraph, HuggingFace, LlamaIndex). Vous connaissez les bases de la création d’images Docker et de leur déploiement sur un cluster Kubernetes. Vous êtes autonome, rigoureux(se), et faites preuve d’une curiosité technique et scientifique. Vous avez le sens de la communication écrite et orale dans un environnement multidisciplinaire. Vous êtes intéressé(e) par le domaine des biotechnologies et des sciences du vivant. Vous possédez un bon niveau d’anglais vous permettant d’échanger et de travailler efficacement au quotidien.
