items.desc:
Who we are 
 About Stripe 
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.
 About the team
 Metronome is a usage-based billing platform and a Stripe product. It helps modern software companies launch products faster, offer flexible pricing models, and streamline finance workflows.
 The Metronome Integration Engineering team sits at the intersection of sales, growth, product, and research and development. We own the technical aspects of the customer lifecycle after a sale and before the customer transitions to our post-implementation teams.
 What you’ll do
 As an Integration Engineer, you’ll help customers implement Metronome successfully and realize value quickly. You’ll lead technical work across requirements gathering, solution and integration design, configuration, testing, data migration, launch, and handoff.
 Responsibilities
 Conduct discovery and scoping to understand customers’ challenges across billing, product launches, pricing and packaging, quote-to-cash, customer experience, and related areas.
 Support customers throughout the implementation lifecycle, including requirements gathering, technical design, integration design, testing, data migration, and launch.
 Provide expert guidance on usage-based pricing and consumption-based business models.
 Configure Metronome’s platform on behalf of customers.
 Design integrations between Metronome’s APIs and customers’ business systems—including CRM and CPQ platforms, payment and tax systems, ERP and billing providers, and reporting and analytics tools—in alignment with Metronome best practices.
 Serve as a liaison between customers and Metronome’s research and development teams, advocating for customer needs and feature requests.
 Partner with implementation managers and other project-team members to provide visibility into progress and proactively identify risks and issues.
 Build relationships across customer organizations, from day-to-day operators to C-suite executives. Meet customers in person when doing so will improve the engagement.
 Advise customers on integrating Metronome into their systems and help shape their pricing and packaging strategies.
 Ensure an effective handoff to Customer Success and Technical Support.
 You’ll work with some of Metronome’s most strategic customers. These engagements will be complex, deep, and highly technical. Metronome directly influences how modern software companies monetize their products, and this team is on the front lines of that work.
 Metronome operates with a startup mindset within Stripe. There is a significant opportunity for people with initiative to influence our direction, build processes from zero to one, and make a meaningful impact.
 Who you are
 We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements below. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are helpful but not required.
 Minimum requirements
 7+ years of experience in technical or customer-facing roles involving SaaS products, such as sales engineering, solutions architecture, technical account management, or deployment strategy.
 Experience leading complex implementations for enterprise technology companies.
 Experience working in fast-moving environments that value initiative and ownership.
 Ability to quickly learn and communicate technical concepts to technical, go-to-market, and finance stakeholders.
 Interest in building and improving go-to-market playbooks, processes, and reusable assets.
 Ability to travel approximately 30% of the time, depending on customer needs.
 Preferred qualifications
 Knowledge of quote-to-cash processes, including experience integrating with or working alongside platforms such as Salesforce, NetSuite, CPQ systems, and the Stripe ecosystem.
 Experience as a software engineer, product manager, or in another technical role.
 Strong understanding of project- and program-management fundamentals.
 Experience working with stakeholders in finance, engineering, product, sales operations, or billing operations.
 Experience with logs, metrics, billing, finance, infrastructure, or financial tooling and concepts.

items.desc:
Grow with us
 The Cloud System Integrator is responsible for the end-to-end integration, configuration, verification and handover of Ericsson cloud infrastructure solutions (SDI, CEE, CCD and CNIS) into customer environments. The role ensures that delivered systems are implemented according to approved architectures, Ericsson reference solutions and customer requirements, with a strong focus on reliability, performance and operational readiness. 
 The role is hands-on and execution-focused, working across multiple parallel cloud build, expansion, migration and lifecycle management projects, collaborating closely with Solution Architects, product units and customer technical teams. 
 What you will do
 System Integration and Implementation 
 Plan and execute end-to-end integration of Ericsson SDI, CEE, CCD and CNIS solutions according to approved solution designs and implementation plans.
 Install, configure and validate compute, storage, networking, security and management components across cloud infrastructure PODs and sites.
 Implement high-level and low-level design artefacts (HLD, LLD, configuration templates, Method of Procedure (MoP)) into working, tested environments.
 Integrate VNFs and CNFs (for example 5G Core, IMS, Packet Core, Cloud RAN) on Ericsson cloud infrastructure, ensuring correct onboarding, lifecycle management and performance.
 Conduct functional, non-functional and integration testing, capturing and resolving defects and deviations in collaboration with design and product teams. 
 Delivery, Governance and Quality 
 Act as the primary technical integrator in delivery projects, ensuring on-time, high-quality execution of build, integration, migration and acceptance activities.
 Prepare and maintain integration plans, MoPs, rollback procedures and configuration baselines in line with agreed architecture and customer standards.
 Support troubleshooting and complex problem resolution during build, test, acceptance and early operation phases to meet performance, stability and SLA expectations.
 Provide accurate and timely progress reporting, risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies to project managers and technical leads.
 Contribute to continuous improvement of reusable integration patterns, scripts, templates and deployment accelerators for CNIS and NFVI projects. 
 Standards, Compliance and Security 
 Implement solutions in compliance with Ericsson security guidelines, CNIS Security Overview and customer-specific security and regulatory requirements.
 Apply best practices for high availability, disaster recovery, backup and restore, and data protection in line with solution design and customer policies.
 Promote and adopt automation, infrastructure-as-code and standardized O&M models for deployment and lifecycle management (for example using Ansible, Helm, CI/CD pipelines).
 Ensure delivered configurations, documentation and handover materials are complete, accurate and align with Ericsson and customer audit requirements. 
 Collaboration, Knowledge Sharing and Continuous Improvement 
 Work closely with Solution Architects to refine designs based on integration feedback, constraints and findings from lab and field deployments.
 Act as a subject matter expert in cloud integration topics for Ericsson SDI, CEE, CCD and CNIS, supporting and mentoring other integration engineers in the team.
 Provide structured field feedback to product units and portfolio teams on product behaviour, defects and feature gaps, contributing to roadmap evolution.
 Contribute to communities of practice, reference integration guides, best-practice documentation and internal knowledge sharing sessions. 
 The Skills You Bring
 Required Experience and Qualifications 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Telecommunications or equivalent practical experience.
 7+ years of experience in telecom, IT or cloud infrastructure, with at least 4+ years in hands-on system integration, deployment or implementation roles.
 Proven experience integrating and delivering large-scale telco cloud or NFVI/CNIS-based solutions in operator environments (preferably multi-vendor).
 Hands-on experience with Ericsson SDI, CCD, CEE and CNIS, or strong experience with equivalent telco cloud stacks with readiness to ramp up quickly.
 Experience working in project-based delivery environments, including interaction with customers, partners and cross-functional internal teams. 
 Technical Skills 
 The Cloud System Integrator is expected to have solid, practical knowledge in the following areas: Ericsson Telco Cloud Portfolio Good understanding of Ericsson Software Defined Infrastructure (SDI) concepts (PODs, vPODs, data/control fabrics, computer systems) and their deployment considerations.
 Working knowledge of Ericsson Cloud Container Distribution (CCD) and Kubernetes-based CNF hosting, including cluster configuration and integration with CNIS.
 Experience with Ericsson Cloud Execution Environment (CEE) for VNF …

items.desc:
As a Requirements Engineer, you will join our international Requirements Engineering organization and help shape the next generation of hearing solutions. Based in Warsaw and working closely with our R&D teams in Stäfa, you will translate diverse stakeholder needs into clear, high-quality product requirements and contribute to products that make a meaningful difference in people's lives. 
 More about the role 
 In this role, you will act as a bridge between business, engineering, verification, quality, and other R&D stakeholders, facilitating alignment on what our products need to deliver. You will take ownership of requirements throughout the product development lifecycle, from elicitation and analysis through documentation, traceability, and maintenance, while contributing to the continuous improvement of our Requirements Engineering practices. 
 Tasks & Responsibilities 
 Elicit, analyze, document, and maintain product requirements and specifications for hearing solutions throughout the development lifecycle. 
 Facilitate understanding and agreement between stakeholders across product management, engineering, verification, quality, and other relevant functions, adapting your communication to different audiences. 
 Contribute to the planning and development of new functionalities and product features across hearing devices, charging solutions, and the broader hearing solutions ecosystem. 
 Ensure requirements comply with applicable medical device regulations and internal procedures, working closely with Requirements Engineers, Requirements Managers, and Quality stakeholders. 
 Create and maintain end-to-end traceability between user needs, product requirements, test cases, and risks. 
 Collaborate within interdisciplinary product development teams across hardware and software domains and contribute to effective cross-functional ways of working. 
 Contribute to the definition, improvement, and documentation of Requirements Engineering practices, processes, and tools. 
 More about you 
 We're looking for a person who enjoys connecting people, technology, and different perspectives. Person who brings strong analytical and communication skills, feel comfortable working independently in an international environment, and know how to turn complex technical discussions into clear, pragmatic solutions. 
 Essential qualifications: 
 Engineering degree or comparable higher technical education. 
 5+ years of relevant engineering experience, preferably including hands-on Requirements Engineering or Systems Engineering responsibilities. 
 Practical knowledge of requirements elicitation, analysis, documentation, maintenance, and traceability. 
 Experience with product development processes and collaboration with stakeholders across hardware, software, verification, and quality disciplines. 
 Strong analytical, problem-solving, and conceptual-thinking skills, with the ability to navigate change, uncertainty, and technical complexity. 
 Strong communication and collaboration skills. 
 Fluency in English (minimum B2 level). 
 Good to have qualifications: 
 Experience in the medical device industry or another regulated product development environment. 
 IREB Foundation Level certification and/or INCOSE certification. 
 Previous experience in system verification or close collaboration with verification teams. 
 Understanding of regulatory affairs, risk management, and risk mitigation in medical device development. 
 Experience with tools such as Polarion, Confluence, Jira etc. 
 German language skills. 
 We understand that you may not meet every requirement listed. If you believe this role aligns with your skills and aspirations, we encourage you to apply - even if you don’t fulfill 100% of the qualifications. 
 What we offer 
 As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we’re committed to building an inclusive culture. We want to create an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work, through our flexible hybrid working model. We offer a wide range of training opportunities for both your professional and personal development, and there are exceptional growth opportunities with individual development plans. 
 Why Join Sonova? 
 At Sonova, we offer more than just a job — we offer a chance to make an impact. You’ll join a collaborative, inclusive environment where your ideas matter and your leadership shapes how we serve our customers. With our modern office spaces, focus on employee development, and strong company values, you’ll be empowered to grow both personally and professionally. 
 Make an impact that resonates. Join Sonova and help us bring the world closer through better hearing.

Join our Engineering team in Tullamore and help develop the mechanical solutions that enable our products to move successfully from development into production. You will work across new product introductions and ongoing manufacturing, turning engineering challenges into practical, reliable solutions. 
 More about the role 
 As a Mechanical Design Engineer, you will work closely with Development, NPI and local Engineering teams to design, prototype, validate and industrialize mechanical solutions for our manufacturing environment. Your work will range from supporting new product launches to solving existing production challenges through the development of jigs, fixtures, test hardware and other production aids. 
 Tasks & Responsibilities 
 Design and develop mechanical engineering solutions, jigs, fixtures, production tools and equipment to support new product introductions and existing manufacturing processes. 
 Use CAD to create detailed 3D designs and drawings, taking solutions from initial concept through prototyping, validation and introduction into production. 
 Develop and evaluate prototypes using 3D printing and other appropriate manufacturing technologies. 
 Work closely with Development, NPI, local Engineering, Control & Test Engineering and other functions to deliver effective production solutions, including the integration of electrical components where required. 
 Create detailed component and machine specifications, drawings, BOMs and supporting documentation required for manufacturing and industrialization. 
 Collaborate with and manage external manufacturers and suppliers, supporting quotation, sourcing and delivery of components and solutions according to project timelines. 
 Troubleshoot production and process issues, identify root causes and implement robust engineering solutions while contributing to continuous improvement and process optimization. 
 More about you 
 We’re looking for a hands-on Mechanical Engineer who enjoys turning ideas into practical solutions and can take ownership of projects from concept through implementation. You are comfortable working autonomously while collaborating across multidisciplinary teams, and you can effectively manage priorities between NPI projects and manufacturing improvement activities in a fast-paced environment. 
 Essential qualifications 
 Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechanical Design, Mechatronics, Electromechanical Engineering or a related discipline. 
 Around 3–5 years of experience in a similar mechanical design, manufacturing engineering, production engineering or NPI role. 
 Strong CAD experience, for example CATIA, SolidWorks or Inventor, with the ability to produce detailed 3D models and technical drawings. 
 Practical experience designing jigs, fixtures, production aids or other mechanical solutions for manufacturing environments. 
 Knowledge of manufacturing and prototyping technologies, particularly 3D printing, and experience designing for manufacture. 
 Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities and deliver against deadlines while collaborating effectively as part of a wider engineering team. 
 Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with internal stakeholders and external manufacturers and suppliers. 
 Good to have qualifications 
 Experience with CATIA and/or Formlabs SLA 3D printing. 
 Knowledge of CNC machining, laser cutting or toolmaking/machine workshop processes. 
 Experience with automation or continuous improvement projects within a manufacturing environment. 
 Knowledge of acoustics or acoustic engineering. 
 Experience using Keyence 3D scanning technology or reverse-engineering mechanical components. 
 Project management skills and experience coordinating engineering activities with external partners.

Telefónica España 
 ¿Quieres unirte a una empresa líder en la industria tecnológica? 
 Buscamos personas con criterio técnico, capacidad de ingeniería y orientación a resolver problemas, capaces de moverse desde la definición de una solución hasta el detalle técnico necesario para conseguir que funcione en producción.

 ¿QUÉ BUSCAMOS? 
 Personas con muchas ganas de darlo todo y marcar la diferencia. Apasionadas de la innovación y las tecnologías punteras. 
 Con esta oportunidad podrás adentrarte en el apasionante universo tecnológico y ser parte del cambio: un mundo más conectado, más humano, y lleno de historias que transforman vidas.
 Recuerda adjuntar tu CV actualizado en formato PDF. 
 QUEREMOS GENTE COMO TÚ… 
 Tu reto será liderar técnicamente la construcción y evolución de soluciones de Inteligencia Artificial , trabajando junto a los equipos de desarrollo desde la definición del caso de uso hasta su puesta en producción. 
 Buscamos un perfil con una sólida base de ingeniería de software, capaz de entender problemas complejos, definir la solución técnica, acompañar y orientar los desarrollos y resolver los principales bloqueos que aparezcan durante su construcción. 
 No será un puesto centrado en desarrollar de forma continua, pero sí buscamos una persona cercana al código, capaz de prototipar, revisar, depurar o desarrollar componentes cuando sea necesario. 
 QUÉ RETOS ENFRENTARÁS EN TU DÍA A DÍA 
 Reto 1: Liderazgo técnico de soluciones de Inteligencia Artificial 
 Trabajar con los equipos de gestión de proyecto y tecnología para entender los casos de uso y transformarlos en soluciones técnicas.
 Definir el diseño técnico y acompañar su construcción hasta su puesta en producción.
 Orientar y supervisar técnicamente los desarrollos realizados por equipos internos e integradores.
 Resolver bloqueos técnicos y participar directamente en la solución cuando la complejidad del problema lo requiera.
 Reto 2: Arquetipos y patrones de desarrollo 
 Diseñar y evolucionar arquetipos, componentes comunes y patrones reutilizables para la construcción de soluciones y agentes.
 Definir patrones para integrar modelos, herramientas, APIs, datos y sistemas corporativos.
 Identificar soluciones repetibles y convertirlas en capacidades que puedan reutilizar otros equipos.
 Establecer buenas prácticas que permitan desarrollar soluciones mantenibles, seguras y preparadas para evolucionar.
 Reto 3: Agentes, conocimiento e integración 
 Participar en el diseño de soluciones basadas en agentes, definiendo patrones de uso de herramientas, contexto, memoria e interoperabilidad.
 Diseñar soluciones de acceso al conocimiento mediante RAG, búsqueda y otras capacidades de recuperación de información.
 Resolver los retos de integración entre las soluciones de IA y APIs, eventos, datos y sistemas corporativos.
 Evaluar nuevas capacidades y tecnologías relacionadas con agentes e Inteligencia Artificial y aplicarlas cuando aporten valor.
 Reto 4: Ciclo de vida y calidad de las soluciones 
 Participar en la definición y evolución del ciclo de vida de desarrollo de las soluciones de Inteligencia Artificial.
 Definir prácticas de GitHub, versionado, revisión de código, CI/CD y promoción entre entornos.
 Establecer mecanismos de testing, evaluación y observabilidad para modelos, agentes y soluciones.
 Asegurar la trazabilidad de los cambios y la calidad técnica durante la evolución de las soluciones.
 Reto 5: Ingeniería práctica y resolución de problemas 
 Construir prototipos que permitan validar rápidamente nuevas aproximaciones o casos de uso.
 Analizar y depurar soluciones cuando aparezcan problemas complejos de comportamiento, integración o rendimiento.
 Revisar código y diseños técnicos para identificar mejoras o resolver bloqueos.
 Desarrollar puntualmente componentes, herramientas o capacidades comunes cuando sea necesario para acelerar o desbloquear los proyectos.
 ¿TE IDENTIFICAS? ¡ES EL MOMENTO DE DAR EL SALTO!

 Titulación en Ingeniería Informática, Telecomunicaciones o disciplina técnica equivalente, o experiencia práctica equivalente.
 Al menos 5 años de experiencia profesional en desarrollo, ingeniería de software o construcción de soluciones tecnológicas.
 Experiencia participando en el diseño y evolución de soluciones software en entornos empresariales.
 Experiencia trabajando con APIs, integración de sistemas y procesos de desarrollo colaborativo.
 Experiencia acompañando técnicamente desarrollos y resolviendo problemas de ingeniería de cierta complejidad.
 Experiencia práctica en soluciones basadas en Inteligencia Artificial generativa, agentes o tecnologías relacionadas.
 CONOCIMIENTOS Y HABILIDADES QUE SUMAN: 
 Sólida base de programación, especialmente Python, con capacidad para entender, revisar y desarrollar código cuando sea necesario.
 Git, GitHub, CI/CD y prácticas DevOps.
 Diseño de APIs, servicios y patrones …

items.desc: Description du poste Présentation des activités de l’équipe : Au sein de la Direction Tech & Produit, la Data Factory a pour objectifs de piloter, définir, déployer et opérer les meilleures solutions technologiques répondant aux cas d’usage data et d’automatisations de processus de la banque au travers de plateformes. Vos missions quotidiennes Vous réaliserez un état de l'art sur les dernières avancées en matière d'agents IA, d'interfaces utilisateur génératives (Generative UI, MCP apps). Vous participerez à la conception et au prototypage d'applications agentiques, en imaginant les interactions de demain entre l'humain et l'IA. Vous développerez des prototypes fonctionnels de "Generative UI", en explorant différentes approches techniques pour créer ces expériences personnalisées. Vous collaborerez avec les équipes métiers pour comprendre leurs cas d'usages et vous assurer que les solutions développées répondent à leurs besoins spécifiques. Vous testerez et évaluerez la pertinence et la performance des interfaces générées, en analysant comment elles répondent aux attentes de chaque persona. Un projet concret pour vous projeter Vous aurez l'opportunité de transformer une application web existante en y intégrant un copilote intelligent. Votre défi sera de développer un agent conversationnel capable non seulement de dialoguer avec l'utilisateur en langage naturel, mais aussi d'interroger, d'analyser et de présenter les données de l'application pour offrir une assistance proactive et sur-mesure. Les compétences que vous aurez l'opportunité de développer grâce à ce poste Ce stage sera pour vous une occasion unique de monter en compétence sur des sujets à la pointe de l'innovation. Vous développerez une expertise concrète dans le domaine de l'intelligence artificielle agentique et des interfaces génératives, en maîtrisant des frameworks comme LangChain. Au-delà de la technique, vous apprendrez à gérer un projet de A à Z, de la phase d'étude et de conception jusqu'au prototypage et aux tests utilisateurs. Vous renforcerez également votre capacité à collaborer au sein d'une équipe pluridisciplinaire et à transformer un besoin métier en une solution technologique fonctionnelle et innovante. Vous préparez actuellement un diplôme de niveau Bac+5 (Master ou école d'ingénieur) dans le domaine de l'informatique, du développement logiciel ou de l'intelligence artificielle, et vous êtes à la recherche d'un stage de fin d'études d'une durée de 6 mois. Vos hard skills Vous avez une solide maîtrise du langage de programmation Python. Vous possédez des connaissances sur les frameworks dédiés à l'IA et aux LLMs, tel que LangChain/LangGraph. Vous avez des compétences en développement web front-end, notamment avec JavaScript, React et/ou TailwindCSS. Le développement back-end ne vous est pas inconnu, en particulier avec JavaScript et Next.js. Vous comprenez le fonctionnement des API REST et savez comment les utiliser. Une première expérience avec les technologies de conteneurisation (Docker, Kubernetes) serait un plus très apprécié. Vos soft skills Au-delà de vos compétences techniques, nous serons particulièrement attentifs à votre curiosité et à votre passion pour les nouvelles technologies, notamment l'intelligence artificielle. Votre autonomie, votre esprit d'initiative et votre capacité à proposer des solutions innovantes seront des atouts majeurs pour mener à bien vos missions. Vous êtes également doté(e) d'un excellent esprit d'analyse et d'une approche créative pour résoudre des problèmes complexes. Enfin, votre bon relationnel et votre esprit d'équipe vous permettront de collaborer efficacement avec les différentes parties prenantes et de confronter vos idées à la réalité du terrain, en répondant directement aux douleurs et besoins des utilisateurs. Les avantages de l'offre Un sujet à la pointe de l'innovation : Travaillez sur des technologies d'avenir (IA, Generative UI) qui sont au cœur de la stratégie d'Orange. Un impact concret : Participez à la création de solutions qui seront réellement utilisées et qui répondent à des besoins concrets. Un environnement de travail stimulant : Rejoignez une équipe d'experts passionnés et bénéficiez d'un encadrement de qualité pour monter en compétences. Les perspectives d'évolution Ce stage est une véritable opportunité de mettre un pied dans le monde de l'innovation chez Orange. En fonction des opportunités et de la réussite de vos missions, ce stage pourra potentiellement ouvrir la voie à un parcours au sein du Groupe, notamment sur des postes d'ingénieur en développement, de spécialiste en intelligence artificielle ou de chef de projet innovation. C'est une excellente porte d'entrée pour construire votre carrière dans la tech. L'équipe Vous rejoindrez une équipe dynamique et bienveillante, où le partage de connaissances et l'entraide sont au cœur de notre fonctionnement. Engagés dans la transformation de nos pratiques, nous plaçons l'usage responsable de l'intelligence artificielle au centre de notre démarche. Notre objectif commun : créer des solutions concrètes qui apportent une réelle valeur ajoutée aux utilisateurs et à nos métiers. …

items.desc: Är du AI-Engineer och nyfiken på vad nästa steg kan vara? Just nu ser vi ett tydligt behov av din kompetens hos flera av konsultbolagen i vårt nätverk i Stockholm. Det här är därför en samlingsannons: i stället för att du ska söka till varje bolag för sig har vi samlat behoven här. Ett samtal med oss kan leda till flera möjliga arbetsgivare, men målsättningen är framför allt att det leder till rätt arbetsgivare. Vi utgår från dig och matchar dig mot rätt arbetsgivare i stället för tvärtom. Vi lyssnar in vad du vill (och inte vill) och matchar dig mot de bolag som passar dig bäst bland våra 300+ konsultbolag. Dina erfarenheter och din önskade karriärriktning är givetvis centrala, men för en långsiktigt god match är det minst lika viktigt att värderingar, kultur, arbetsvillkor och kanske framför allt personkemi stämmer. När allt detta klaffar blir det helt fantastiskt bra, och vår målsättning är alltid att det ska bli fallet. Om rollen Som AI-Engineer tar du AI från idé till produktion. Det kan handla om lösningar byggda på stora språkmodeller, AI-agenter eller maskininlärningsmodeller som integreras i kundens system och arbetssätt. Efterfrågan är stor och växer i de flesta branscher. Exempel på arbetsuppgifter Bygga och integrera lösningar med stora språkmodeller, till exempel RAG, AI-agenter och verktygsanrop Träna, utvärdera och förbättra maskininlärningsmodeller Driftsätta, övervaka och utvärdera modeller i produktion (MLOps/LLMOps) Säkerställa informationssäkerhet, dataskydd och kostnadskontroll Arbeta nära verksamheten för att hitta och prioritera användningsfall Vi tror att du har Minst fem års relevant erfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling, data eller maskininlärning, varav en del med AI-lösningar i produktion Mycket goda kunskaper i Python Erfarenhet av LLM-API: er och ramverk, till exempel LangChain, LlamaIndex eller Semantic Kernel Erfarenhet av AI-tjänster i molnet, till exempel Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock eller Vertex AI Flytande svenska och god engelska i tal och skrift Meriterande Vektordatabaser och sökteknik Finjustering och utvärdering av modeller MLflow, Docker och Kubernetes Kunskap om regelverk som EU: s AI-förordning och GDPR Tidigare erfarenhet av konsultrollen Du är nyfiken och pragmatisk, gillar att bygga saker som faktiskt används och kan förklara tekniken för personer utan teknisk bakgrund. Det här får du Villkoren varierar mellan bolagen, men gemensamt för dem är att du får: En tillsvidareanställning hos ett konsultbolag med kollegor inom ditt område Varierande uppdrag hos kunder i olika branscher, med möjlighet att påverka vilka uppdrag du tar Kompetensutveckling och ett nätverk som växer för varje uppdrag Ett bolag som säljer in dig och har din rygg mellan uppdragen Så går det till Du ansöker via länken i annonsen och bifogar ditt CV. Vi hör av oss för ett första samtal om vad du söker och vad som är viktigt för dig. Vi föreslår vilka bolag vi tror passar dig. Du väljer själv vilka du vill bli presenterad för. Bolagen tar det vidare i sin ordinarie rekryteringsprocess, och vi finns kvar som stöd hela vägen. Urval sker löpande, så skicka gärna in din ansökan redan i dag.

items.desc: Are you eager to join a pharmaceutical company, where you can make a difference in advancing tomorrows medicines? And are analytical methods your passion? Then we have a unique opportunity now to join our QC Analytical Development team, as we are looking for a scientist who shares our passion, drive, and energy – what we call Genki. About the position FUJIFILM Biotechnologies is a world leading Contract Development Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) serving customers in the pharmaceutical industry – from pre-clinical investigations to commercial GMP production. In order to support our costumers and technology transfer programs, we are looking for a scientist to play a key role in the implementation of multiple chemistry methods to support our technology transfer programs between our customers and FUJIFILM Biotechnologies. We work in a high paced and dynamic environment where we support the biologics Drug Substance (DS) production by implementation of methods like UV, SoloVPE, SDS-PAGE, icIEF, CE-SDS, SEC, CEX, icIEF, U/HPLC-based methods, PS80, Titer and PepMap. In addition, we support the global release of commercial products (both DS and Drug Product) for our clients, where our focus is on methods like appearance, pH, color, clarity, sub-visible particle testing and break loose gliding force. Primary Responsibilities · Author and review transfer, qualification and validation protocols, reports and SOPs · Data analysis and data evaluation as well as method trouble shooting · Handing over transferred and validated methods to our QC testing teams · Analytical method support to the QC testing teams, including OOS investigational support as a subject matter expert · Change control assessment of for example method changes or specification changes · Support validation and implementation of new instruments in collaboration with the QC Instrument Supporting team · Ensure compliance with cGMP and participate in audits and inspections as needed Qualifications We value teamwork and a can-do attitude and are looking for a new colleague with: A MSc or PhD degree within Pharmaceutical Sciences, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, or other relevant fields, combined with at least 5 years of work experience from the pharmaceutical or biotech industry, preferably in a QC environment Solid understanding of GXP guidelines, and familiar with the United States Pharmacopoeia, the European Pharmacopoeia and ICH guidelines Broad analytical background and experience with several of the above-mentioned methods, as well as knowledge of using JMP® or other statistical software Experience with method transfers and validations is a clear advantage Proficiency in both written and spoken English You are quality focused, analytical, and pragmatic, with a structured approach that is easy to follow. You thrive in a fast-changing environment, where you juggle multiple tasks simultaneously with the ability to plan your projects and deliverables in a structured way. Collaborating across departments and projects comes naturally to you. In addition, you value knowledge sharing and communicating openly and professionally. Finally, you welcome working from home. The QC Analytical Development department Our Quality Control (QC) department at site Hillerød consists of approximately 260 employees divided into Analytical Development (AD), different support teams, and several testing teams. The QC Analytical Development department is divided into 4 teams – 2 Chemistry teams, a Bioassay team and a Project Manager team. You will be part of one of the Chemistry teams which consists of 11 scientists. The primary focus of the team is to ensure timely transfer and implementation of new analytical test methods from our customers, to be used for release testing. You will interact with many different stakeholders – both internally from QC testing teams and DS & DP production, as well as external stakeholders such as contract laboratory organizations. Furthermore, you will also work closely together with your colleagues in the team – chemists as well as laboratory technicians, so good communication and collaborative skills are a necessity. In QC we strive towards a OneQC team spirit where we help and support each other across teams. The pillar is our employees – our success is only possible due to competent and dedicated colleagues, who wants to make a difference for QC, our site, our customers, and patients all over the globe. What we offer The culture at FUJIFILM Denmark (FDBD) is key if you ask our employees and besides a competitive salary and bonus package, we offer health insurance, massage and physiotherapy, health check, fitness center and possibility to work from home. items.desc: We are looking for an Experienced Mechanical Designer to join Coolbrook’s Technology & Engineering team. As Experienced Mechanical Designer, you create and own the design definition of our RDH and RDR components and assemblies: 3D models, drawings, tolerances and bills of materials. Suppliers must be able to make it right the first time, and our teams must be able to assemble and maintain it safely. You receive the flow-path geometry from aero, and margins and design feedback from stress and rotor dynamics. Requirements come from systems, field service, and customers. You deliver released models, drawings, BOMs, interface definitions, and assembly instructions. You run simple sizing checks, but you leave the detailed analysis to the specialists Coolbrook offers you an exciting role in an international, dynamic, growing company with a real opportunity to make an impact and make history. In this permanent role, you will preferably be based in the UK or Finland offices and report to our Engineering Manager while collaborating with multiple internal and external stakeholders. As Experienced Mechanical Designer, your responsibilities would include: Layout and integration: general arrangement and module layouts, space claims, and interface control drawings to the motor, skid, piping, and foundation. Detail design: rotating and static parts (blades, vanes, discs, shafts, casings, bearing housings, seals and fasteners), with materials, coatings and processes chosen together with materials engineering. Design for maintainability: service access, field-replaceable modules, lifting and special tooling for site work, and spare parts definition, assembly trials and field feedback Drawings and GD&T: fully toleranced drawings to ISO GPS (ISO 1101 / 8015), BS 8888 or ASME Y14.5, with a clear datum strategy, fits to ISO 286, and identified critical characteristics. Tolerance and clearance analysis: 1D and 3D stack-ups, cold and running clearances (using temperatures from the thermal analysts), and assembly sequence. Design for manufacture and assembly: machining, forging, casting, welding and additive processes. Answer supplier queries, support first-article inspection, and disposition non-conformances with stress. Guide internal teams and coordinate with external engineering service providers. Assembly, tooling and service: assembly and maintenance procedures, special tooling, lifting fixtures and test rig hardware. Configuration management: PLM (such as Teamcenter), engineering change requests and notices, BOM structure and drawing release. Safety and compliance: DFMEA, design reviews, and input to the risk assessment (EN ISO 12100) for the Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 and PED, where applicable. For success in this role, you will need: A BSc or MSc in mechanical or aerospace engineering, or an equivalent technical qualification with a strong design track record. Expert use of a major 3D CAD system (Siemens NX, CATIA V5 or Creo) on large assemblies, and working knowledge of PLM. Command of GD&T and tolerance stack-ups, and a solid understanding of machining, forming, joining, and heat treatment. Strong knowledge of machine elements: bearings, seals, couplings, bolted joints, keys and splines, interference fits. Capability to guide internal teams and coordinate with external engineering service providers. Desirable would be: Experience designing turbomachinery or other high-speed, high-temperature rotating equipment. Leadership experience as a team leader or group manager in Mechanical Design. 3D tolerance-analysis tools (such as CETOL or 3DCS), and design for additive manufacturing. Experience working directly with suppliers, from the RFQ stage through to first article inspection. Experience levels: For the advanced level: 6+ years designing turbomachinery or large rotating equipment. You own complete modules and their interfaces, and check other people's drawings. For the senior level: 12+ years. As design authority, you set design standards and drawing practice, and lead the layout of new product variants. At Coolbrook, we are passionate about building teams where unique perspectives and backgrounds are valued and where everyone feels equally included. If this resonates with you, we are looking forward to receiving your application. With inquiries about the role, please reach out to Dr. Mark Wilson (mark.wilson@coolbrook.com) or Dr. Frank Eulitz (frank.eulitz@coolbrook.com). About Coolbrook: Coolbrook is a transformational technology and engineering company on a mission to decarbonize major industrial sectors: petrochemicals and chemicals, iron and steel, and cement. Our RotoDynamic technology combines space science, turbomachinery, and chemical engineering to replace the burning of fossil fuels in high-temperature industrial processes with electricity. The technology has two main applications: the RotoDynamic Heater (RDH), which provides carbon-free process heat for iron and steel, cement, and chemicals …

L'ouverture à la concurrence du réseau des communications nous permet d'entrer dans le monde du paiement avec un objectif : le révolutionner grâce à de nouvelles technologies et un business model novateur. Rapidement, nous devenons leader dans la sécurisation des paiements grâce à notre propre technologie made in France. En 2009, nous développons notre service de paiement en ligne et en 2018, nous rentrons dans l'ère des Fintech avec notre établissement de paiement : Lyra Collect. Notre promesse ? Faire de chaque paiement une petite révolution, en phase avec les dernières tendances de consommation et les avancées technologiques. Notre secret ? Plus de 20 ans d’expertise, qui font que, aujourd’hui, il y a une chance sur deux pour que nos chemins se croisent lors d’une transaction en France ou à l’international. Mission Avec la croissance de l’entreprise, nous avons aujourd'hui une forte expansion des sujets liés à la sécurité. Et c’est pour mieux les adresser que nous avons créé notre nouvelle équipe Sécurité Opérationnelle . Son rôle : intervenir aussi bien sur la sécurité applicative, la cybersécurité ou encore la sécurité des réseaux . Le tout avec une approche « secure by design » pour être présent dans les projets tirés par les différents services de l’entreprise. Le service SecOps, c'est une dizaine de collaborateurs, chacun avec son domaine d'expertise, accompagnés par Joël, le responsable de service. Pour renforcer cette équipe, nous recherchons un Chef de Projet Cybersécurité. Vous venez en appui au pilotage des actions de sécurité des systèmes d'information pour l'ensemble de Lyra. Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec toutes les équipes opérationnelles de la DSI dans la réalisation des actions de sécurité, et assurez le suivi des plans d'actions. Vos missions s'articulent autour de deux axes : la gestion des vulnérabilités et la coordination des remédiations techniques. Gestion des vulnérabilités : Identifier, évaluer et prioriser les vulnérabilités tout en modernisant le processus mis en place, Étudier les outils de sécurité dans la chaîne d’intégration, de déploiement et de gestion de vulnérabilités, Maintenir à jour les procédures de bonnes pratiques de développement sécurisé, Contribuer activement au développement et l’enrichissement de notre activité cybersécurité, Participer à l’obtention des certifications (PCI-DSS, ISO27001…) au côté de l'équipe Gouvernance Sécurité. Coordination des remédiations techniques : Accompagner les équipes DSI à mettre en place des remédiations de vulnérabilités, Planifier et coordonner des projets de sécurité opérationnelle liés à la mise en œuvre de la PSSI, Assurer le déroulé des projets en termes de respect des jalons et de la gestion des ressources, Animer les instances de pilotage, produire la documentation et le reporting des projets. On parle probablement le même langage : Outils de sécurité : Proxy, EDR, XDR, MFA, PKI… IAM : PAM, Annuaires, revues des habilitations, certificats Infrastructure : Windows Server, Linux, bases de données, virtualisation, sauvegardes Cloud : AWS, Azure Supervision : Centreon, ELK, Dynatrace, Grafana/Prometheus Tracker : JIRA / git Forge : Jenkins, GitLab, Nexus, Sonar, Terraform, Ansible, Trivy, Dependancy track Conteneur : Docker/Podman, Vagrant, Kubernetes, OpenShift Méthodologies : Agile (Scrum) Profil Prêt.e à relever le défi ? Ce que l'on attend de vous : Vous avez une formation supérieure en informatique (Bac +5, ingénieur, master), Vous avez au moins 5 ans d'expérience sur un poste similaire, Vous possédez des compétences sur la gestion des vulnérabilités. Votre relationnel, votre pédagogie et votre bonne communication, qui vous permettent de travailler avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires, Votre esprit d'analyse et de synthèse, Votre capacité d'anticipation et d'organisation, ainsi que votre rigueur, qui vous permettent de mener à bien vos projets, Vous avez un bon niveau d'anglais, qui vous permettra de réaliser nos audit PCI-PIN et PCI-DSS avec les auditeurs.

items.desc: L'offre en un coup d'oeil L'unité Laboratoire lorrain de recherche en informatique et ses applications Type de Contrat IT en contrat CDD Temps de Travail Complet Lieu de Travail 54506 VANDOEUVRE LES NANCY Durée du contrat 9 mois Date d'Embauche 01/01/2027 Rémuneration 3143 euros Date limite de candidature : mercredi 25 novembre 2026 23:59 Description du Poste Les Missions Lors de ce projet, nous voulons concevoir un assistant virtuel intelligent, spécifiquement conçu pour guider un expert métier dans un processus de découverte de connaissances en s'appuyant sur l'analyse formelle de concepts (FCA) et les outils afférents, en particulier ceux développés dans le projet SmartFCA. Cette mission combine les avantages de la FCA et de l’IA générative pour rendre l’analyse de données plus accessible et plus efficace pour ses experts métier. L'Activité Architecture et graphe de connaissances : L’assistant s’appuiera sur un modèle de langage (LLM) open-source déployé localement. Il exploitera les connaissances natives du modèle qui devra intégrer la littérature scientifique de la FCA, combinées à un guide méthodologique structuré que nous développerons. Cette spécialisation technique sera réalisée via des architectures de type RAG -Retrieval-Augmented Generation- ou, si nécessaire, par un fine-tuning ciblé. La constitution d’un graphe de connaissances et son utilisation par le modèle (au lieu des documents utilisés par la RAG) seront également étudiées. Interaction et Exécution : L’interface adoptera une structure de type "Model Context Protocol (MCP)". L’expert métier pourra soumettre son jeu de données et sa problématique en langage naturel. Le LLM le guidera de manière itérative et interactive dans le choix de la méthode FCA la plus adaptée, sélectionnera l’algorithme adéquat et sera capable d’en piloter l’exécution. Extensibilité : Cette approche logicielle sera intégrée à la plateforme SmartFCA actuelle et servira de point d’accès unique, modulaire et extensible. Une procédure standardisée permettant d’ajouter et de déclarer de nouveaux agents logiciels (ou algorithmes) sera fournie pour garantir la pérennité de l’outil. Votre Profil Compétences L'ingénieur attendu doit posséder un Master ou un diplôme d'ingénieur avec une spécialisation en informatique et en intelligence artificielle. De bonnes connaissances en Python, en modèles de langages (LLMs), en FCA, en apprentissage et en fouille de données seront très appréciées. Votre Environnement de Travail Le projet ANR SmartFCA vise à rendre l’Analyse Formelle de Concepts (FCA) plus opérationnelle pour des usages réels en combinant avancées théoriques, développement logiciel et expérimentation métier. L’ambition est de fournir une méthodologie et des recommandations pratiques pour aider des experts de domaine à analyser des données complexes avec des outils FCA robustes et réutilisables. Contraintes et risques Il n'y a pas de contraintes ou risques particuliers qui concernent ce travail d'ingénieur. items.desc: Unsere Mission ML-Forschung in die Anwendung bringen dida entwickelt individuelle Machine-Learning-Software für den öffentlichen Sektor, die Wissenschaft sowie Industrie- und Enterprise-Kunden, darunter Siemens, Deutsche Bahn, idealo, klöckner.i und Enpal. Unser Team verbindet wissenschaftliche Exzellenz mit realen Business-Anforderungen und setzt sich für eine bewusste Entwicklung von KI ein. Viele unserer Industrie-Projekte beginnen mit einem Konzept- oder Evaluationsworkshop. Gemeinsam mit den Entscheidungsträger:innen bewerten wir Use Cases und Datenlage und machen aus vagen Ideen einen konkreten Projektfahrplan. Dieses Workshop-Format bauen wir gerade zu einem eigenen Beratungsangebot aus. Dafür suchen wir eine Person mit eigener Data-Science-Praxis und Erfahrung in Kundenprojekten, die in dieser frühen Projektphase die technische Verantwortung übernimmt. Deine Rolle: technische Verantwortung in der Konzeptphase Du bist die technische Stimme von dida in der Phase, in der ein Projekt entsteht. Im Workshop sitzt du mit Fachbereich und IT des Kunden am Tisch. Du schaust dir die Daten an und schätzt ein, welcher Projektumfang realistisch ist. Dabei arbeitest du im Tandem mit unserem Sales- und Account-Management und stimmst Lösungsansätze und Aufwände mit unseren ML-Scientists ab, die die Umsetzung größerer Projekte übernehmen. Mit der Zeit wirst du für einzelne Branchen das technische Gesicht von dida. Deine Aufgaben Workshops technisch leiten : Du bereitest Konzept- und Evaluationsworkshops inhaltlich vor und führst sie gemeinsam mit dem Account-Management durch. Dein Part ist die technische Tiefe: Du bewertest Use Cases anhand der Datenlage und schätzt die Machbarkeit ein. Selbst in die Daten schauen und bauen : Du analysierst Beispieldaten des Kunden in Python und baust klickbare Prototypen oder kleine Demos, mit denen Workshop-Ergebnisse greifbar werden. Bei kleineren Projekten übernimmst du die Umsetzung auch selbst. Der Anteil wächst mit den Projekten, die wir gewinnen. T echnische Nachbereitung : Du übersetzt Workshop-Ergebnisse in eine technische Roadmap und verantwortest den technischen Teil des Angebots inklusive Aufwandsschätzung. Vertrieb technisch begleiten : In Discovery Calls und bei Machbarkeitsfragen bist du die technische Ansprechperson. Die kommerzielle Verantwortung für Accounts, Angebote, Preise und Verhandlungen liegt beim Account-Management. Standards weiterentwickeln : Du baust unsere Workshop-Frameworks und Templates aus, die wir bei jedem neuen Kunden wiederverwenden. Dein Profil Für diese Rolle brauchen wir beide Seiten: eigene Praxis in Data Science und Erfahrung in Kundenprojekten, vorzugsweise aus der Beratung. Insgesamt bringst du 2 bis 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung mit. Data Science aus eigener Praxis : Du hast in Projekten selbst mit ML-Modellen gearbeitet und bist sicher in Python und im Umgang mit Datenbanken. Du kannst einschätzen, welche Methode zu einem Use Case passt und welche Daten sie braucht, von klassischem ML bis zu LLM-basierten Ansätzen. Erfahrung in Kundenprojekten : Du hast Projekte direkt mit Kunden umgesetzt und Termine mit Fachbereichen und Management selbst vorbereitet und moderiert. Das kann in einer Beratung gewesen sein, bei einem IT- oder KI-Dienstleister, in einer Solutions- oder Pre-Sales-Rolle oder in angewandter Forschung mit Industriepartnern. Ausbildung : Sehr gut abgeschlossenes Studium in einem quantitativen Fach, zum Beispiel Informatik, Mathematik, Physik, Data Science oder Ingenieurwesen. Auftritt vor Kunden : Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu und moderierst Diskussionen souverän. Technische Inhalte erklärst du so, dass Fachbereich und IT gleichermaßen folgen können. Sprachen : Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch (C2), weil Workshops und Angebote bei uns überwiegend auf Deutsch laufen. Für die interne Zusammenarbeit brauchst du fließendes Englisch. Hands-on-Mentalität: Du probierst Dinge direkt aus und hast Spaß daran, schnell einen ersten Prototyp zu bauen. Teamarbeit : Du arbeitest gern eng im Team. Wissen teilen und direktes Feedback gehören für dich dazu. Auch wenn du nicht jeden Punkt erfüllst, freuen wir uns über deine Bewerbung. Wenn du vor allem entwickeln oder forschen möchtest, passt eine unserer Stellen als Machine Learning Scientist vermutlich besser. Warum du dich für uns entscheiden solltest? items.desc: About the Role Xtremepush is a global leader in customer engagement, providing a cutting-edge platform that empowers brands to understand, engage, and influence their customers across multiple channels. Specialising in the Sports Betting & Gaming (SBG) industry, Xtremepush enables businesses to drive growth and enhance customer experiences through data-driven insights, personalisation, and omni-channel marketing. We also partner with organisations in financial services and other regulated sectors. Our innovative Customer Data Platform and engagement tools help organisations create highly targeted campaigns, optimise conversions, and maximise revenue. Xtremepush is the only platform that combines real-time CDP, Omnichannel Activation, AI Optimisation, Gamification Engine, and Advanced Intelligence in a single platform. We are seeking an experienced Data Analyst to maintain the predictive models that power customer decisioning, determining which customers to prioritise and how to personalise their experience. Working across a number of clients, you will set the data structure and attribute requirements the wider team builds to, creating a foundation that supports simple models today and more sophisticated modelling as data volume and maturity grow. You will work closely with business users and technical stakeholders. This is a hybrid role based in Dublin. #LI-Hybrid Key Responsibilities Own production models end to end, including churn, customer lifetime value (CLV), propensity and similar customer models. Validate performance against holdout data and live outcomes, and monitor models for drift, bias and degradation. Define the data structure, entities and attribute design across each client’s full customer dataset, and document the data requirements that our Data Modeller implements and maintains. Identify data gaps and quality issues, and agree fixes with client and internal teams. Document models, features and assumptions to a standard suitable for a regulated environment. Explain model results clearly to non-technical stakeholders, and feed learnings back to Product to help shape the product roadmap. Your Experience and Qualifications 5+ years’ experience in an ML-focused role, ideally in financial services or another regulated sector. A degree in a quantitative field such as statistics, computer science, mathematics or economics. A track record of building, deploying and maintaining customer models in live environments, not just for research purposes. Strong Python, plus experience with common ML libraries. Advanced SQL, including window functions, complex joins and query optimisation. Strong data modelling skills, including dimensional modelling, fact and dimension design, and handling data that changes over time. Experience with ClickHouse or another columnar database, including table design, ordering keys, partitioning, and choosing between materialized views and scheduled refreshes. Solid grounding in model and data validation, including metric selection, holdout design, calibration and reconciling results against source data. Experience defining and documenting metrics so they are used consistently, and building BI dashboards and the datasets behind them, ideally in Metabase. Experience with cloud data platforms such as AWS or Snowflake. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills and excellent written communication. Desirable Experience with customer engagement, CRM or marketing decisioning platforms, or with marketing and campaign data. Experience with MLOps tooling, such as experiment tracking, model registries and CI/CD for models. dbt or a similar SQL modelling framework, using Git for version control. Experience with MySQL as a source system. Location This is a hybrid role based in Dublin. About us Headquartered in Ireland with offices in the UK and US, Xtremepush is an Omnichannel Customer Engagement Platform powered by a built-in CDP. It enables high-velocity companies to build, grow, and retain strong customer relationships through personalised, relevant, and timely communication. With a true single customer view at its core, Xtremepush provides actionable customer intelligence that drives engagement, conversion, and revenue across all channels, while putting customer retention first. Nscale are developing cutting-edge sovereign generative AI solutions, powered by a new generation of high-performance, sustainable data centres and GPUs built specifically for AI workloads. The growth of artificial intelligence is driving unprecedented global demand for compute and GPU infrastructure. Nscale is positioned at the heart of this transformation, building the platforms that will enable superintelligence. Nscale are working closely with the world's most advanced AI technology providers, integrating next-gen compute hardware and GPU clusters in both partner and Nscale built facilities. This is an opportunity to join Nscale's journey, play a key role in delivering transformative AI infrastructure, and help shape a company designed to scale rapidly across Europe and beyond. Purpose Nscale is seeking an OT Network Subject Matter Expert to support the design, deployment, validation, and operation of highly available OT networks across Nscale data centers. This role owns the industrial networking layer that connects PLC systems, field devices, and SCADA platforms, ensuring that network architectures meet Nscale requirements for resiliency, cybersecurity, determinism, and maintainability. The role works closely with Controls Engineers, SCADA SMEs, IT/network teams, system integrators, and commissioning teams to ensure OT networks are deployed as mission-critical infrastructure. Accountabilities Support the design and review of OT network architectures including EtherNet/IP, VLAN segmentation, zone-based design, managed switches, firewall boundaries, and redundancy strategies appropriate for critical facilities. Validate OT network designs for resilience, determinism, maintainability, and elimination of single points of failure, including review of PRP, DLR, or equivalent redundancy topologies where applicable. Review vendor and integrator network designs, switch configurations, addressing plans, cabinet layouts, and documentation for compliance with Nscale OT design standards. Coordinate with cybersecurity teams to ensure OT network segmentation, remote access controls, firewall policies, authentication requirements, and secure operational practices are properly implemented. Participate in FAT, SAT, commissioning, and failover testing for OT network infrastructure, including switch redundancy, network recovery, and communications validation between PLC and SCADA layers. Support troubleshooting of OT network performance, configuration, or communications issues during deployment and live operations. Partner with SCADA, controls, and IT teams to ensure clean interfaces between the OT network, control system devices, and upstream monitoring platforms. Maintain network documentation including topology diagrams, VLAN and IP plans, firewall rules, redundancy diagrams, standards, and turnover records. Scope and boundaries Loading model: this role loads 80% on projects and 20% on the operations support model in the operations support model — MOC approval, patch testing, and dispatch and ticketing. Qualifications and experience Required: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 5+ years of experience supporting industrial or OT networks in manufacturing, industrial, utilities, or mission-critical environments. Strong understanding of industrial networking concepts including EtherNet/IP, managed switches, VLANs, routing and switching fundamentals, network segmentation, and redundancy design. Experience supporting PLC and SCADA environments and understanding how OT network design impacts system performance and availability. Familiarity with OT cybersecurity practices including segmentation, access control, patch coordination, and secure remote support. Experience supporting field testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting of industrial network infrastructure. Preferred: Experience with PRP, DLR, or similar industrial redundancy protocols. Experience supporting data center BMS, EPMS, or other critical infrastructure OT networks. Hands-on familiarity with industrial networking vendors such as Cisco Industrial, Stratix, Hirschmann, or similar platforms. CCNA, industrial networking certification, or equivalent technical credentials. Key competencies OT network architecture · Resiliency and redundancy · Cybersecurity alignment · Vendor design review · Commissioning and failover testing · Troubleshooting · Documentation discipline For information on how Nscale handles candidate personal data, please see our Employee & Candidate Privacy Notice: Here. We see the Deputy CDO as a full-fledged successor to the CDO: a leader who can take over the function when needed. Together, the CDO and the Deputy CDO make sure we do the right things and that these things reach measurable results fast and predictably. The Deputy CDO owns execution across the function, leads part of the strategic initiatives personally and works directly with C-level executives. This is not a chief of staff or program manager role: we need a leader who goes deep into the substance of analytics, ML, data engineering, marketing analytics, UX research and experimentation, and turns strategy into business results. Your main tasks will be: Lead part of the Research Center's strategic initiatives end-to-end — from business case and prioritization to delivery and measurable impact. Own the execution of key cross-functional initiatives across the Research Center: data platform and BigQuery migration, ML projects with complex dependencies, experimentation process, AI for analytics, UX research, data quality / SLA / freshness. Unblock stalled projects: when work is stuck between teams or has no clear owner, define scope, owners, next steps and blockers, escalate early and drive it to delivery. Manage resources and backlog across teams: prioritize by business value, allocate capacity, manage dependencies between ML, backend, product and analytics, stop or rethink initiatives that don't deliver. Build and run the operating system of the function: monthly reviews, quarterly planning, project reviews, retros, commitment tracking, escalation process and a single status dashboard — working with or without any single person. Measure everything in business terms: translate initiatives into numbers, benefits and expected impact; track ROI and results against plan; make sure “we shipped the task” is never mistaken for “the business changed”. Strengthen the team leads (Product Analytics, Data Engineering, ML, UX Research): help them set goals, prioritize, give honest feedback and grow as managers. Own the operational health of the function: data freshness, platform uptime, ML platform stability, delivery predictability and experimentation throughput. Experience as a CDO, Deputy CDO or Head of Data / Analytics in a mid-size or large product organization is highly desirable. Readiness and ambition to grow into the CDO role: strategic thinking combined with the willingness to own day-to-day execution. A broad understanding of all Research Center domains: product and marketing analytics, A/B testing and experimentation, the ML lifecycle from idea to production, data platforms, data quality and SLA, BI / self-service, unit economics. Hands-on depth in at least one of them. Proven track record of execution: concrete examples of delivering complex cross-functional data / ML projects to measurable results. Strong operational management skills: project decomposition, planning, resource and backlog management, risk management, clean escalation, running many parallel initiatives. Business leader mindset: thinks in numbers, benefits and business impact; understands trade-offs between speed, quality, value and risk; always asks “what changed for the business?”. items.desc: Job Overview: We are looking for a dynamic Product Owner to lead the translation of clinical operations needs and opportunities into innovative digital products and capabilities. The Product Owner will partner with clinical operations stakeholders, end users, Product Management, and technology teams to understand business problems, envision future-state solutions, design product functionality and workflows, and translate validated concepts into actionable requirements and delivery priorities. The role will take an active, hands-on approach to product discovery and design, including developing mock-ups, prototypes, and proofs of concept to explore ideas, demonstrate proposed functionality, and obtain rapid user feedback. The Product Owner will own and prioritize the product backlog, provide ongoing direction and context to Agile development teams, and ensure delivered solutions achieve their intended user, business, quality, and compliance outcomes. Reporting to the Executive Director - Clinical Technology Platforms, the Product Owner will play a key role in shaping leading-edge digital solutions that improve study monitoring and enable the clinical trials of the future. Summary of Responsibilities: Partner with clinical operations stakeholders and end users to understand business needs, operational challenges, user workflows, and opportunities for technology-enabled improvement. Help shape the product vision and define the future-state user experience, capabilities, workflows, and functionality required to achieve desired business outcomes. Lead product discovery activities, including stakeholder interviews, workflow analysis, design sessions, and evaluation of potential solution approaches. Translate business problems and ideas into product concepts, functional designs, process flows, mock-ups, prototypes, and other artifacts that enable stakeholders to visualize and validate proposed solutions. Rapidly develop or coordinate prototypes and proofs of concept using appropriate technologies, including low-code, no-code, and AI-assisted development tools, to test ideas and accelerate product discovery. Conduct product demonstrations with business stakeholders, end users, and leadership to communicate product concepts, demonstrate evolving functionality, gather feedback, and refine product direction. Collaborate with Product Management to establish product objectives, roadmaps, priorities, and measurable outcomes. Translate validated product concepts and business needs into clearly defined features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and enabling capabilities. Define, prioritize, and continuously refine the product backlog based on business value, user needs, regulatory requirements, technical considerations, and product strategy. Ensure backlog items provide Agile Teams with sufficient business context, functional clarity, and acceptance criteria to enable effective solution development. Make day-to-day product decisions and clarify intended functionality, workflows, and user experience throughout the development lifecycle. Balance new capabilities, enhancements, technical needs, defects, compliance requirements, and other priorities when managing the product backlog. Serve as the primary connection between clinical stakeholders, Product Management, and technology delivery teams. Actively participate in PI Planning and other Agile planning activities to establish priorities, dependencies, risks, and delivery objectives. Collaborate closely with Agile Teams throughout design, development, testing, validation, and release. Review evolving solutions and provide timely product decisions and feedback to ensure development remains aligned with the intended product experience. Evaluate completed functionality through demonstrations and acceptance activities to ensure it meets the intended business requirements, user experience, and acceptance criteria. Ensure applicable regulatory, quality, security, privacy, and clinical-system requirements are incorporated into product design and delivery, including GxP and 21 CFR Part 11 requirements where applicable. Act as the voice of the customer throughout product discovery, design, development, and delivery. Build strong working relationships with clinical research associates, centralized monitors, study teams, project leaders, regulatory stakeholders, and other product users. Communicate product direction, priorities, progress, risks, dependencies, and key decisions to stakeholders and leadership. items.desc: A profitable DTC pet brand doing $50M+ a year, scaling to $100M+, fully remote is looking for a really experienced Web Designer with great taste to help our brands be more unique and stand out. Our first major project is a full revamp and upgrade of our websites. This isn't a rebrand: you build on our current branding and make the look and feel more unique, more elevated and better at standing out from everyone else in pet, while every page is still designed to convert. You'll work with our Head of Brand & Community and our CRO Lead, and you must be very experienced designing with AI so you move fast. The revamp is about 40–80 hours over 4–8 weeks, with more design work after it as we keep raising the bar. You'll leave us a Figma design system that our team then extends with AI to build new sections. We're looking for someone with 5+ years designing websites and a portfolio of ecommerce sites (ideally Shopify) that shows real taste, including work elevating existing brands. The mission of this role Elevate our websites so both brands look as good as our products and stand out from everyone else in pet, while every page is still designed to convert. This isn't a rebrand: we keep our current branding and build on it, so it feels more unique and more premium. The first project, a full revamp and upgrade: elevate the web look, create a Figma design system for both brands, and design a set of signature sections for each brand, all built on conversion principles. After handover, our web team and CRO Lead build new sections with AI from this system. Success is a more unique, more elevated website that converts better than today, documented well enough that every new section still looks like us. Who are we? We're a profitable, premium DTC pet brand. We sell across Shopify, Amazon and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest-growing brands in the pet space – $50M+ in annual revenue and scaling to $100M+. We recently launched a second brand, expanding into an entirely new vertical and customer base. We're a 100% remote, lean, senior team that moves fast, and every person here has a massive impact on the business. What is our culture like & who is a good fit? Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We use creativity to do more with less – and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by four core values: Better Everyday: use split-test results from the new sections to refine the system before handover. Speed Is King: present first directions within two weeks and turn feedback around the same day. Work Smart: use AI to explore directions and produce assets faster, and design the system so AI can extend it after handover. Overdeliver: leave the team a system it can keep building on for years, not just a set of good-looking pages. If you want a stress-free corporate 9–5 job, this isn't it. If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founder, and play a big role in scaling it to $100M+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, being hands-on and active – then you've come to the right place. Outcomes (what success looks like) Targets for each outcome are agreed with you before the first project starts. Both brands look premium and distinctive: final look signed off by the CEO and the Head of Brand & Community The new sections convert better than what they replace: conversion rate and revenue per visitor vs the old version (split tests with the CRO Lead) The revamp lands on time and on budget: delivery date and hours vs the agreed project plan New sections built with AI still look like us: review of the first new sections built from the system after handover Key Objectives Review both sites, our brand guidelines and the competitors we want to stand apart from, then present 2-3 web directions per brand in the first two weeks. Build the web design system in Figma for both brands, mobile first, keeping each brand clearly distinct. Design 8-10 signature sections per brand for mobile and desktop. Design every section to convert, and launch major new sections as split tests with the CRO Lead. Hand over clean Figma files, simple usage rules and a short walkthrough so our team can extend the system with AI. Requirements Fully remote, freelance, ongoing (the first project, a full website revamp, is about 40–80 hours over 4–8 weeks) Fluent in English Experience: 5+ years designing websites is a must. Portfolio: Live ecommerce sites (ideally Shopify) that show real taste and creativity, and look better than most of what is on Shopify today. items.desc: Deputy Chief Data Officer (Deputy CDO) Cyprus / Worldwide – Remote (Any Location) · Full-Time · Research Center Social Discovery Group (SDG) is a group of social discovery companies. SDG solves the problems of loneliness, isolation, and disconnection - transforming virtual intimacy into the new normal. SDG's products redefine the way people interact and connect with one another. Our portfolio includes social entertainment platforms designed to connect people online across different cultures and regions of the world. We bring together a team of like-minded people and IT professionals who specialize in creating and developing globally impactful social discovery products. Our international team of digital nomads works remotely from all over the world. We're proud to be a two-time “Great Place to Work” winner (USA & Japan, 2024–2025) and a Top-5 Company for Work-From-Anywhere Jobs (FlexJobs, 2025). We are looking for a Deputy Chief Data Officer for the Research Center of the Core Business Unit — the #2 role in a data function that directly drives company P&L. We see the Deputy CDO as a full-fledged successor to the CDO: a leader who can take over the function when needed. Together, the CDO and the Deputy CDO make sure we do the right things and that these things reach measurable results fast and predictably. The Deputy CDO owns execution across the function, leads part of the strategic initiatives personally and works directly with C-level executives. This is not a chief of staff or program manager role: we need a leader who goes deep into the substance of analytics, ML, data engineering, marketing analytics, UX research and experimentation, and turns strategy into business results. Your main tasks will be: Lead part of the Research Center's strategic initiatives end-to-end — from business case and prioritization to delivery and measurable impact. Work directly with C-level executives and business heads: align priorities, commitments and trade-offs, negotiate resources and timelines with clear, numbers-based arguments. Own the execution of key cross-functional initiatives across the Research Center: data platform and BigQuery migration, ML projects with complex dependencies, experimentation process, AI for analytics, UX research, data quality / SLA / freshness. Unblock stalled projects: when work is stuck between teams or has no clear owner, define scope, owners, next steps and blockers, escalate early and drive it to delivery. Manage resources and backlog across teams: prioritize by business value, allocate capacity, manage dependencies between ML, backend, product and analytics, stop or rethink initiatives that don't deliver. Build and run the operating system of the function: monthly reviews, quarterly planning, project reviews, retros, commitment tracking, escalation process and a single status dashboard — working with or without any single person. Measure everything in business terms: translate initiatives into numbers, benefits and expected impact; track ROI and results against plan; make sure “we shipped the task” is never mistaken for “the business changed”. Strengthen the team leads (Product Analytics, Data Engineering, ML, UX Research): help them set goals, prioritize, give honest feedback and grow as managers. Own the operational health of the function: data freshness, platform uptime, ML platform stability, delivery predictability and experimentation throughput. We expect from you: 7+ years in data, analytics or ML in product tech companies, including 4+ years in leadership roles managing strong specialists and team leads. Experience as a CDO, Deputy CDO or Head of Data / Analytics in a mid-size or large product organization is highly desirable. Readiness and ambition to grow into the CDO role: strategic thinking combined with the willingness to own day-to-day execution. A broad understanding of all Research Center domains: product and marketing analytics, A/B testing and experimentation, the ML lifecycle from idea to production, data platforms, data quality and SLA, BI / self-service, unit economics. Hands-on depth in at least one of them. Proven track record of execution: concrete examples of delivering complex cross-functional data / ML projects to measurable results. Strong operational management skills: project decomposition, planning, resource and backlog management, risk management, clean escalation, running many parallel initiatives. Business leader mindset: thinks in numbers, benefits and business impact; understands trade-offs between speed, quality, value and risk; always asks “what changed for the business?”. Experience working with and negotiating with C-level executives: confident, precise with numbers, persuasive through facts. Influence without formal authority: earns trust through competence and results; able to push hard and handle conflict without becoming toxic. Systematic, disciplined and persistent; comfortable with ambiguity and multitasking. Fluent Russian and English are a …

items.desc: Job Description: An opportunity for a Flight Operations Services Engineer has arisen within Airbus Defence and Space, Getafe (Madrid). The selected candidate will join the Flight Operations Services Team within Military Aircraft Customer Support. The department is in charge of delivering critical operational services and data products to military transport aircraft fleets worldwide.
