RESPONSIBILITIES The main tasks of the jobholder will be: Deliver core Flight Operations Services: Lead the On-Time, In-Quality, and In-Cost (OTQC) delivery of operational services and queries resolution for worldwide military operators, including flight performance, mission planning, and aerodata products (NavDB, terrain databases). Drive Business Development & Service Design: Design, integrate, and deploy new flight operations service packages tailored to customer needs, directly supporting business growth and operational readiness. Lead Technical Project Management: Define and execute Project Management Plans (scope, budget, scheduling, KPIs, and deliverables) balancing cost and quality targets while adhering to aeronautical regulatory standards. Coordinate Cross-Functional Interfaces: Establish and steer technical collaboration across internal stakeholders (Design Offices, Service Programme Managers, Procurement, Legal) to align services with broader program objectives. Supervise External Technology Providers: Serve as the technical focal point for tier-1 avionics and data suppliers (e.g., Honeywell, Thales, Collins Aerospace, Navblue, GE, Jeppesen) to ensure technical compliance and SLA adherence. SKILLS Is your profile aligned to the following list of skills? Apply! We are looking forward to meeting you: Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Aeronautical/Aerospace Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Experience: At least 3–5 years of technical experience in aerospace customer services, flight operations, or technical project management within the aeronautical sector. Soft skills: Strong interpersonal and stakeholder-management skills, ability to pitch value propositions, structured problem-solving mindset, and agility to thrive in a fast-paced, multidisciplinary environment. Languages: Advanced / Negotiation level in English (C1 or equivalent), both written and spoken. Technical knowledge: Robust background in flight operations engineering, mission planning concepts, project management methodology (budget, KPIs, scheduling), and technical supplier management. Valuable / Nice to have: Operational or systems knowledge of military transport aircraft (such as A400M or C295), prior experience within Airbus processes/tools, and availability for occasional international travel. items.desc: Etraveli Group is a leading global flight technology provider, specializing in flight sales and offering flight content delivery and fintech products. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers across the globe, from search and selection to trip and beyond. We partner with major global platforms such as Booking.com, Google Flights, Skyscanner, and Kayak, providing seamless flight booking and related services. Our B2B portfolio includes Precision, our specialist in travel fintech; Tripstack, our B2B Flights as a Service Provider and world leader in virtual interlining, serving as the gateway to Etraveli Group’s flight content and fulfillment services; Wenrix, the AI Infrastructure for profitable growth in air; and Flygresor.se, Sweden’s leading flight comparison site. We also operate our own online travel agency brands including Gotogate, Mytrip, and Flightnetwork. Every day we strive to make the world smaller for our customers and bigger for our people. Our diverse team of more than 3200 passionate professionals is what makes us the industry’s tech wonder and the best in the world at what we do. Major offices in Sweden (HQ), Greece, India, Canada, Israel, Poland, UK, and Uruguay. The Role Etraveli Group relies on a massive scale of data to drive decision-making, analytics, and machine learning across Finance, Customer Service, Sales, and Data Science. To support our ambitious growth targets and the ongoing transformation of our data platform, we are looking for a skilled Data Engineer to serve as a pivotal technical engine in our Data Platform team. You will work closely with our business stakeholders, analysts and data scientists defining data solutions and implementing data products that solve their needs. You will bridge the gap between raw, distributed data sources and high-performing data products, bringing critical data into our lakehouse platform and preparing it for diverse users. You will support the growth of our modern, scalable data warehouse solutions, ensuring our data pipelines are reliable, secure and deeply integrated into our tech ecosystem. This is not a purely isolated technical role. The right person can understand underlying business needs – from pricing and conversion to revenue optimization – and answer questions on feasibility by selecting the right industry-leading frameworks, ETL patterns and orchestration tools. You will build solutions that don't just look conceptually good, but actually deliver robust data quality and solve high-stakes complexities within Etraveli. The role will be based in Gothenburg. Main tasks Design, develop, and maintain robust batch and streaming pipelines tailored to business intelligence, machine learning and other stakeholders needs. Interpret, analyse and ingest data from a variety of cloud and on-premise source systems into our expanding data lakehouse platform. Evaluate, integrate, and configure industry-leading frameworks and tooling for our Data Engineering platform, prioritizing scalability, optimization/performance and maintainability. Define and enforce rigorous data quality standards, implementing relevant monitoring and alerting solutions to ensure high data integrity. items.card: The Role We are hiring a Security Engineer to own the security of the systems every OLIX employee depends on: identity, devices, email, collaboration tools and our cloud estate. Our IP is the company, and protecting it is a hands-on engineering job. You will own detection and response, harden our tooling, run vulnerability management and build the technical controls behind our ISO 27001 certification in 2027. You
items.desc: About OLIX AI is growing faster than any technology in history, and the demand has created an infrastructure gap: we can no longer build chips or power stations fast enough to keep up. The industry still relies on a ten-year-old hardware blueprint that has reached its limit. The OLIX Decode Accelerator 1 (DX-1) is the first accelerator architected specifically for decode. Rack-scale co-design of logic, data movement, packaging, optics and interconnect delivers a step change in system-level performance. The Role We are hiring a Security Engineer to own the security of the systems every OLIX employee depends on: identity, devices, email, collaboration tools and our cloud estate. Our IP is the company, and protecting it is a hands-on engineering job. You will own detection and response, harden our tooling, run vulnerability management and build the technical controls behind our ISO 27001 certification in 2027. You will work alongside our AI Security Engineer and IT Systems Engineer, and you will use automation and AI to make a small team cover a fast-growing company. This is a high-ownership role with the freedom to define how security engineering works at OLIX. Responsibilities Own detection and response: triage every security alert, work incidents end to end with our managed detection and response partner, and fix the root cause. Harden the core estate: configure and baseline security across identity, endpoints, Google Workspace, Slack, Atlassian, GitHub and AWS. Run vulnerability management: set remediation service levels, close vulnerabilities in order of real risk, and report progress every week. Build certification controls: operate and evidence the controls for ISO 27001, SOC 2 and NIST CSF. Extend detection coverage: connect new log sources to our SIEM and write the detection rules for them. Automate security work: build the scripts, agents and workflows that remove manual security tasks. Skills and experience 5 or more years in security engineering or security operations, owning controls end to end. Hands-on experience running a SIEM and writing detection rules. Hands-on experience administering EDR and responding to incidents on macOS and Windows. Working knowledge of identity security, ideally Okta. Experience securing SaaS platforms and AWS accounts. Technical controls delivered for at least one certification audit (ISO 27001, SOC 2 or Cyber Essentials). Scripting in Python or a similar language, and a habit of using AI to automate work. Nice to have: experience in a hardware, semiconductor or deep-tech company. Compensation and equity Competitive salary: commensurate with your experience, skills and location. Equity and ownership: meaningful stock options. Proximity bonus: an annual Living-Local Bonus if you live within 20 minutes of the office. Retirement benefits: employer-contributed retirement plans. Due to U.S. export control regulations, candidates' eligibility to work at OLIX depends on their most recent citizenship or permanent residency status. We are generally unable to consider applicants whose most recent citizenship or permanent residence is in certain restricted countries (currently including Iran, North Korea, Syria, Cuba, Russia, Belarus, China, Hong Kong, Macau, and Venezuela). Applicants who have subsequently obtained citizenship or permanent residency in another country not subject to these restrictions may still be eligible. Compensation Range: £139K

Today’s clinical-stage biopharma model is broken, and as a result promising treatments never reach patients. Our mission is to fix this: we’re building the next generation of biopharma by in-licensing clinical-stage therapeutic assets and developing them through Lindus Health’s integrated, technology-first clinical trial infrastructure. items.desc: Im AI & Data Team bei Accenture vereinen wir einzigartige Persönlichkeiten und zukunftsgerichtetes Know-how, um gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden die datengetriebene Transformation voranzutreiben und die Zukunft durch Künstliche Intelligenz (KI) zu gestalten. Wir begleiten unsere Kunden End-to-End: von der strategischen, KI-nativen Neuausrichtung über die Konzeption und Entwicklung von KI-Lösungen bis zum technischen Design und zur Implementierung von KI- und Datenplattformen. Dabei verbinden wir Fachexpertise, moderne KI-Technologien (insbesondere Generative AI und Agentic AI und tiefes Technologieverständnis, um messbaren Geschäftswert zu schaffen. Deine Mission Du bringst eine datengetriebene, analytische Denkweise und Affinität für moderne KI-Lösungen mit und möchtest spannende Herausforderungen verschiedener Industrien meistern? Dann bist du in der Data Science Practice genau richtig. Angesiedelt zwischen Strategy und Technology kombinieren wir Branchenerfahrung mit technischem Know-how. Du identifizierst relevante Use Cases, setzt Lösungen vom Prototyp bis zur produktiven Anwendung um und siehst, wie deine Arbeit Unternehmen, Industrien und Menschenleben verändert. Bei Accenture gestaltest du dir selbst das Umfeld, in dem du aufgehst - mit Arbeitsweisen, die zu dir passen. Du bleibst flexibel. Und wirst Teil eines Teams voller einzigartiger Menschen, die gemeinsam etwas bewegen. Das erwartet dich Innovative KI-Lösungen: Du entwickelst mit analytischem Verstand und Kreativität die nächste Generation von Data-Science-Lösungen und treibst den Einsatz von Generative AI und Agentic AI voran. Wertschöpfung aus Daten: Im interdisziplinären Team identifizierst du Verbesserungspotenziale und entwickelst zielgerichtete Analysen, damit Daten echten Mehrwert schaffen. Realer Impact: Du arbeitest mit weltweit führenden Unternehmen und Institutionen und bringst datengetriebene Anwendungsfälle von der ersten Idee bis zur Skalierung in die Praxis. Kundenorientierte Umsetzung: Du stehst im engen Austausch mit Entscheidungsträger:innen und sorgst dafür, dass KI-Lösungen in realen Umgebungen erfolgreich implementiert und skaliert werden. Darauf freuen wir uns Abgeschlossenes Master- oder PhD-Studium in Physik, Mathematik, Informatik, Ingenieur- oder Wirtschaftswissenschaften Erste praktische Data-Science-Erfahrung (Machine Learning, Deep Learning oder Reinforcement Learning) sowie fundierte Python-Kenntnisse mit gängigen Frameworks (z. B. Pandas, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch) und Datenaggregation (z. B. SQL, Spark) Grundverständnis von Generativer KI (z. B. Retrieval-Augmented Generation/RAG); erste Erfahrungen mit Agentic AI und Frameworks wie LangChain oder LangGraph sind ein Plus Von Vorteil: Kenntnisse in Datenbanken (SQL, NoSQL, Vektor- oder Graphdatenbanken), BI- und Visualisierungstools (z. B. Tableau, Power BI, Qlik) sowie Cloud-Erfahrung (z. B. Azure, AWS, Google Cloud Platform) Analytisches Talent, Kundenorientierung und Kommunikationsstärke, projektbezogene Mobilität, eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten sowie sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Was wir dir bieten Flexibles Arbeitsmodell mit mobilem Arbeiten und der Möglichkeit, deine Arbeitszeit aktiv selbst zu gestalten Umfassende Weiterbildung zu neuesten Technologie-Trends und Soft Skills Diverse, gleichberechtigte Teams und regelmässige Team-Events, die den Zusammenhalt stärken Attraktives, marktkonformes Vergütungspaket, das du durch individuelle Zielerreichung mitgestalten kannst Die Accenture-Kultur: Hier machst DU den Unterschied Deine Fähigkeiten, dein Naturell und deine Ambitionen machen dich einzigartig. Wenn unterschiedlichste Talente und Sichtweisen aufeinandertreffen, entstehen Ideen, die etwas bewegen. Deshalb setzen wir auf Diversität und freie Entfaltung: mit Aufgaben, die dir am Herzen liegen, einem Workload, der zu dir passt, und einer Arbeitsweise, die sich an deinen Zielen orientiert. Wie du dich vernetzen, weiterbilden und wachsen willst, liegt bei dir. Es ist deine Karriere, und wir helfen dir, sie so zu gestalten, wie du es dir vorstellst. Dein Kontakt Du hast Fragen? Wende dich an unser Recruiting Team: recruiting.ch@accenture.com. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

items.desc: Elegir Capgemini significa elegir una empresa donde tendrás la libertad de diseñar tu carrera profesional como desees, con el respaldo y la inspiración de una comunidad colaborativa de colegas en todo el mundo. Aquí podrás reinventar lo que es posible. Únete a nosotros y ayuda a las organizaciones líderes en el mundo a descubrir el valor de la tecnología y construir un mundo más sostenible e inclusivo. Tenemos un equipo de Data & AI que estará encantado de contar contigo. ¿Te apetece sumarte? ¿Cuál será tu rol? Buscamos un/a Junior AI & Generative AI Engineer apasionado/a por la inteligencia artificial y con experiencia práctica en el desarrollo de soluciones basadas en modelos de Machine Learning y Generative AI. Esta es una excelente oportunidad para seguir creciendo profesionalmente en un entorno dinámico, colaborativo y con una fuerte apuesta por la innovación. · Desarrollar, probar y desplegar soluciones basadas en Inteligencia Artificial y Generative AI. · Participar en la construcción de aplicaciones basadas en LLMs (Large Language Models). · Diseñar y optimizar prompts para casos de uso de negocio. · Implementar arquitecturas RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation). · Integrar modelos de IA mediante APIs y servicios cloud. · Colaborar con equipos de negocio, producto y desarrollo para identificar oportunidades de automatización e innovación. · Realizar pruebas, validaciones y seguimiento del rendimiento de los modelos. · Contribuir a la documentación técnica y buenas prácticas de desarrollo. · Mantenerse actualizado/a sobre nuevas tendencias y avances en IA Generativa. Tu perfil: · Alrededor de 1 año de experiencia profesional desarrollando soluciones de IA, Machine Learning o GenAI. · Conocimientos sólidos de Python. · Experiencia con librerías y frameworks como: LangChain o LlamaIndex. Hugging Face. OpenAI, Azure OpenAI o servicios equivalentes. · Conocimientos de APIs REST. · Familiaridad con bases de datos vectoriales (FAISS, Pinecone, ChromaDB o similares). · Conocimientos básicos de Git y metodologías ágiles. · Nivel de inglés alto. Requisitos valorables: · Experiencia en entornos cloud (Azure, AWS o Google Cloud). · Conocimientos de MLOps. · Experiencia desarrollando asistentes virtuales o copilots. · Conocimientos de Docker y Kubernetes. · Experiencia con frameworks de evaluación de modelos y observabilidad de LLMs. · Certificaciones relacionadas con IA o Cloud. Valoramos todas las candidaturas y ofrecemos formación presencial, online y certificaciones. Aunque no cumplas el 100% de los requisitos, ¡queremos conocerte! ¿Qué te gustará de trabajar aquí? •Proyectos variados y desafiantes: Trabajarás en retos multisectoriales, evitando la rutina y exponiéndote a tecnologías diversas. •Flexibilidad y modelo híbrido: Cultura orientada al equilibrio vida‑trabajo. •Aprendizaje continuo: Formación en tecnologías cloud, data governance, visualización… Participación real en proyectos con IA generativa, Business AI y tecnologías emergentes del dato. •Diversidad de clientes e innovación constante: Proyectos de impacto real con organizaciones líderes. •Entornos colaborativos e inclusivos: Equipos dinámicos, multiculturales y orientados al crecimiento. •Crecimiento profesional y “challenge” técnico: Autonomía, mentoring, certificaciones y oportunidades de ampliar tu rol dentro del área de Data & AI. ¿Por qué Capgemini? Nuestros compromisos y prioridades Nuestro Plan de Igualdad y Código Ético garantizan procesos inclusivos y libres de discriminación, potenciando el talento, en un entorno multicultural y accesible para personas con discapacidad (valoramos positivamente disponer de certificado de discapacidad). Capgemini es un socio global en transformación empresarial y tecnológica, que ayuda a las organizaciones a acelerar su doble transición hacia un mundo digital y sostenible, generando un impacto tangible tanto en las empresas como en la sociedad. Somos un grupo responsable y diverso, con 340.000 profesionales en más de 50 países. Con más de 55 años de trayectoria, nuestros clientes confían en Capgemini para aprovechar el valor de la tecnología y cubrir todas sus necesidades de negocio. Ofrecemos soluciones completas que abarcan desde la estrategia y el diseño hasta la ingeniería, impulsadas por nuestras capacidades líderes en inteligencia artificial, IA generativa, cloud y datos, junto con un profundo conocimiento del sector y una sólida red de partners. MAKE IT REAL. ¡Únete al equipo! www.capgemini.com/es-es

Grâce à l'ensemble de ses expertises, notre entreprise accompagne ses clients en leur proposant des offres sur mesure pour contribuer à la décarbonation et à la performance des systèmes électriques . Dans nos différentes géographies, nos équipes s'engagent au quotidien pour accélérer la transition énergétique . Description De L'offre Stage en présentiel - Nanterre Durée souhaitée 6 mois Démarrage entre janvier et Avril 2027 Vous intégrez la direction des systèmes d'information et du numérique de EDF power solutions. Au coeur de notre siège à Nanterre vous rejoignez une équipe de 6 personnes. Rattaché(e) au responsable du Pôle Data Platform, vos missions consisteront à : Concevoir et prototyper des agents IA répondant à des cas d'usage métiers concrets liés à l'exploitation de la donnée industrielle Réaliser les tests de performance, fiabilité et précision des modèles et workflows mis en place Collaborer étroitement avec les chefs de projet et référents métier pour comprendre les besoins et identifier les opportunités d'assistance par l'IA Explorer les solutions de connexion de l'IA aux données d'entreprise (RAG, MCP, ...) en collaboration avec les référents techniques, architecture et CloudOps Compétences et qualités recherchées Formation : Dernière année d'école d'ingénieur ou Master en informatique, idéalement dans une spécialité Data ou IA Qualités recherchées : Soft skills : Curiosité technique, écoute active, capacité de vulgarisation et bon esprit d'équipe. Stack technique : Databricks, AWS, Python Bureautique : Office365 Langues : Français courant, Anglais courant Dans le groupe EDF accueillir des personnes en situation de handicap fait partie de notre ADN. Notre objectif est d'ouvrir nos portes à toutes les compétences, toutes les énergies et toutes les personnalités sans exclusion. Le poste proposé est donc ouvert à toutes et à tous.

items.desc: Important! To make sure your application is considered, please submit it before the end of the day on (dd.mm.yyyy): 18.11.2026 We encourage candidates to apply as soon as possible. What does the job involve? Build the next generation of AI-powered solutions Agentic AI is changing how organisations operate. At Equinor, we're building intelligent systems that bring together language models, enterprise knowledge, data and business processes to help people work smarter and make better decisions. We're looking for a Data Scientist who wants to work at the forefront of generative and agentic AI, delivering real solutions to real users. Why join us? This is not a research-only role and it is not a software engineering role. You'll sit at the intersection of data science, AI engineering and product development, helping develop AI solutions that are deployed and used across the company. You'll have the freedom to experiment, learn and apply new techniques as the field continues to evolve. What will my tasks be? Within This Position, Your Key Tasks Will Be To Design, develop and test agentic AI solutions. Develop prompting strategies, retrieval systems and evaluation approaches. Work with large language models and multimodel AI technologies. Collaborate closely with engineers, architects and business experts. Contribute to production deployment of AI solutions. Measure and improve solution performance, quality and user adoption. Help identify new opportunities where AI can create business value. Here's What We Expect From You At Equinor, there are some overall qualities we regard as essential. We want you to identify with the values that guide our decisions and help us succeed and grow: open, collaborative, courageous and caring. We expect you to make safety your priority and to contribute to our zero-harm culture. And for this specific position, we are also looking for: What we think you bring Masters or PhD in operations research, applied mathematics, computer science, data science, control/automation, engineering or a related discipline. Proven hands-on experience in data science, machine learning and AI development/deployment in production environment. Practical knowledge of modern language models, generative and Agentic AI. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Programming experience, preferably Python. Interest in emerging AI technologies and a desire to keep learning. Nice to have LangGraph, Microsoft Agent Framework (MAF), CrewAI or similar frameworks. Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI services and cloud-native development. Responsible AI, model safety and governance. This Role Will Give You Opportunities to work with some of the most challenging AI use cases in industry. Access to large-scale enterprise and industrial data and access to modern AI platforms and technologies. Strong technical communities and collaboration with experts across multiple disciplines. A culture that values experimentation, learning and innovation. The opportunity to shape how AI is applied within a company that plays an important role in European energy security and in the energy transition. What can we offer you? We want you to have a rewarding and fulfilling work life. That’s why we offer: Not just a job - a career In Equinor, your development begins on day one. You will build your competence through a wide range of learning activities while being empowered to build your career across multiple disciplines and geographies. Our internal job market allows a wide range of opportunities for development and growth within your own field, or even in other areas you find interesting and relevant. Attractive rewards We give you a comprehensive benefits package with a competitive salary, global parental leave, bonus scheme and pension plan. Wellness and work-life balance We care about and prioritise our employees’ well-being. We know that for you to be the best version of yourself in the workplace, being able to collect your children, attend a class or simply enjoy social time can be invaluable. That’s why we encourage you to make use of our flexible work arrangements wherever possible. An inclusive culture We believe embracing our differences makes us stronger. For us, true inclusion means being able to bring your whole self to work, and for you and everyone else to feel accepted and valued. Equal opportunities for everyone Equinor is an equal-opportunity employer. We make all employment decisions, which include hiring, promotion, transfer, demotion, termination, and training, without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, marital status, parental status, veteran status, or any other protected status. As part of this commitment, reasonable adjustments will be made during the recruitment process for candidates with disabilities or long-term health conditions. If you have any specific requirements, please clarify this in your application and our team will be in contact …

items.desc: Coop Teknologi, Albertslund Vil du bygge AI-løsninger i en af Danmarks største detailkoncerner og være med til at sætte retning for, hvordan vi arbejder med agenter, RAG og LLM'er? AI med direkte impact i en af Danmarks største virksomheder Som AI Engineer hos os arbejder du med agenter, processer og kolleger på tværs af koncernen – og de løsninger, du bygger, kan ses og mærkes i butikkerne, på hovedkontoret og i den daglige drift. Du bliver en del af Coop Teknologis AI-team. Vi rådgiver kolleger, prototyper løsninger, bygger agenter og sikrer, at AI bruges værdiskabende og ansvarligt. Vi arbejder tæt sammen med vores integrationsteams, vores digitale afdeling og SRE-området, der driver on-prem Kubernetes og miljøer i Azure. Dit nye team Du bliver en del af Coop Teknologis AI-team, som arbejder med de mere avancerede AI-løsninger i Coop. Vi bygger agenter, prototyper og andre AI-baserede løsninger, når standardværktøjerne ikke er nok, og hjælper forretningen med at omsætte nye muligheder inden for AI til praktisk værdi. Teamet er stadig under opbygning, og du bliver en af de første faste profiler i teamet. Det giver dig mulighed for at få indflydelse på, hvordan vi arbejder, og de løsninger, vi bygger. Om rollen Du er med til at bygge konkrete AI-løsninger fra første idé og prototype til kørende agent i produktion. Hverdagen blander hands-on udvikling, sparring med forretningen og udforskning af nye værktøjer. Vi arbejder blandt andet med LLM'er, RAG, agent-frameworks, MCP'er og andre teknologier, der gør AI anvendelig i praksis. Vores løsninger udvikles og driftes i moderne cloud- og containerbaserede miljøer på Kubernetes og Azure, og du får mulighed for at arbejde med hele værdikæden fra idé til produktion. Helt konkret kommer du blandt andet til at bygge AI-løsninger og agenter fra idé til produktion udvikle løsninger baseret på LLM'er, RAG og andre AI-teknikker, når de skaber værdi for opgaven lave hurtige prototyper, teste idéer og afprøve nye teknologier arbejde med MCP'er og andre capabilities, der gør AI-løsninger mere anvendelige i praksis evaluere AI-løsninger og hjælpe med at sikre kvalitet, relevans og en god brugeroplevelse deploye og vedligeholde løsninger på Kubernetes og i Azure fejlfinde, monitorere og videreudvikle løsninger i produktion rådgive og sparre med kolleger på tværs af Coop om muligheder og begrænsninger ved AI bidrage til, at de løsninger, vi bygger, lever op til vores governance- og sikkerhedskrav Hvem er du? Du er nysgerrig på AI, der ændrer sig fra måned til måned, og du er ikke bange for at prøve ting af, når svaret ikke står i en manual endnu. Du deler din viden, fordi vi bliver klogere som team. Du taler med mange forskellige kolleger – fra SAP-specialister og integrationsudviklere til forretningsfolk uden teknisk baggrund. Derfor kan du forklare AI, så det giver mening for modtageren, og lytte efter, hvad de egentlig har brug for, før du bygger. Vi forestiller os, at du Har nogle års erfaring som softwareudvikler og motiveres af at omsætte idéer og forretningsbehov til stabile løsninger, der skaber værdi. Du behøver ikke være ekspert i alle de teknologier, vi arbejder med, men du har lyst til at udvikle dig inden for AI og moderne softwareudvikling. Måske har du allerede arbejdet med generativ AI, RAG, evaluering, agent-frameworks som LangChain, LangGraph eller Semantic Kernel, eller måske har du opbygget erfaring med cloud-platforme, containere og løsninger i produktion. Derudover trives du med at tage ansvar for det, du bygger, og med at samarbejde på tværs af fagligheder. Du er nysgerrig af natur, opsøger ny viden og ser muligheder i at afprøve nye teknologier og arbejdsmetoder. Du behøver ikke kunne sætte flueben ved det hele. Det vigtigste er, at du kan se dig selv i rollen og har lyst til at udvikle både produktet og dig selv sammen med os. Du refererer til Julie Kopp, Digital Udviklingschef for Store Applications, Digital & AI. Coop tilbyder Hos Coop får du et udfordrende job i en af Danmarks største detailvirksomheder, hvor vi arbejder målrettet på at skabe fremtidens Coop. Du får indsigt i en branche i konstant udvikling og mulighed for at være med til at sætte retningen for vores 900 butikker og 38.000 medarbejdere. Vi tilbyder en attraktiv lønpakke med pensionsordning og sundhedsforsikring samt en række personalegoder, herunder rabat i Coops butikker, sommerhusudlejning, personaleklubber og indkøbsfordele. Derudover tilbyder vi fleksible arbejdstider og mulighed for én ugentlig hjemmearbejdsdag. Dit arbejdssted bliver Coops Hovedkontor i Albertslund, IT-Huset. Interesseret? Er du klar til at forme fremtidens AI-løsninger sammen med os, så send dit motiverede CV via vores online ansøgningssystem senest den 24. november. Vi holder løbende samtaler og tager annoncen ned, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat, så vi opfordrer dig til at søge hurtigst muligt. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen eller rekrutteringsprocessen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Jonas …

items.desc: Forward Deployed AI Engineer (H/F) Quickscale AI, Paris (hybride) CDI | Expérience : 2 à 5 ans (hors stages et alternance) | Package : 55 à 75 K€ (fixe + variable) selon profil QUI SOMMES-NOUS ? Fondé en 2023 à Paris, Quickscale AI est un cabinet de conseil spécialisé en IA agentique, labellisé Jeune Entreprise Innovante et autofinancé. Nous mettons des agents IA en production pour des secteurs exigeants : finance, luxe, grande consommation et secteur public. Nous aidons nos clients à concevoir et déployer des solutions d’IA fiables, auditées et réellement utilisées en production. Notre équipe combine excellence technique, rigueur scientifique et sens produit. Nous croyons à une IA utile, explicable et responsable, au service de la transformation des organisations. Rejoignez-nous pour façonner l’avenir de l’IA en Entreprise ! VOTRE RÔLE Nos Forward Deployed AI Engineers mettent l’IA agentique en production, là où c’est exigeant. Vous concevez, développez et déployez des agents IA pour nos clients, et vous portez le résultat de bout en bout, du besoin métier jusqu’à la production. Concrètement, votre rôle couvre : le développement de systèmes agentiques (LLM, RAG, multi-agents, évaluation) ; le delivery chez nos clients, du cadrage jusqu’au déploiement ; l’accompagnement des équipes métier dans l’adoption des solutions. Vous travaillez en équipe chez le client, au sein d’une squad, avec un lead technique. Vous êtes son interlocuteur technique au quotidien, et vous proposez des solutions sans attendre qu’on vous les demande. VOS MISSIONS Conception et développement Traduire un besoin métier en solution agentique concrète. Développer des agents IA : tool calling, workflows multi-étapes, RAG, intégration aux systèmes du client. Participer aux choix d’architecture avec le lead technique. Appliquer les standards techniques et les bonnes pratiques du cabinet. Delivery et industrialisation Mettre en production les solutions que vous développez (CI/CD, conteneurs, sécurité). Mettre en place les tests, l’observabilité et le monitoring des agents. Mesurer sur les données réelles du client la qualité, le coût, la latence et l’adoption. Améliorer les agents dans la durée et répondre de la qualité de vos livrables. Relation client Animer des ateliers de cadrage avec les équipes métier. Présenter des démonstrateurs et faire le point sur l’avancement des travaux. Présenter vos arbitrages de façon claire et percutante aux décideurs. Accompagner les utilisateurs dans la prise en main des solutions. Exemples de projets Banque d’investissement : agent pour analystes crédit sur infrastructure GPU self-hosted. Luxe : agent qui raisonne sur le catalogue, les stocks et les boutiques. Secteur public : plateforme d’inférence LLM souveraine à grande échelle. Grande consommation : analyse d’insights consommateurs pour arbitrer un portefeuille de marques. Formation et transmission Participer à la création du contenu de nos formations en IA générative et agentique. Intervenir lors de formations auprès des équipes de nos clients. Partager vos retours d’expérience avec l’équipe lors des revues techniques. R&D et innovation Suivre l’évolution des modèles, des agents et des outils d’évaluation. Transformer vos apprentissages en démos, composants et accélérateurs réutilisables. Prendre part à nos travaux de R&D sur les architectures agentiques (Ex: self-learning agent) VOUS ÊTES AU BON ENDROIT SI VOUS AVEZ … Compétences techniques 2 à 5 ans d’expérience dans un poste technique, en AI engineering, ML engineering ou développement logiciel, idéalement face à des clients. Les anciens fondateurs techniques sont aussi les bienvenus. Un français courant et un anglais professionnel. Une expérience des LLM en production : agents, RAG, évaluation et déploiement réel, avec au moins un système que vous avez mis en production. De solides compétences en développement : Python, idéalement un autre langage comme TypeScript, ainsi que Docker, CI/CD, cloud ou on-premise, et des applications réellement livrées. Un vrai sens de l’initiative : vous avancez même quand le sujet est flou, et vous proposez sans attendre qu’on vous le demande. L’esprit d’équipe : vous travaillez avec des interlocuteurs aux priorités différentes, et vous signalez tôt un blocage. L’envie de construire une IA utile et fiable, et l’exigence de ne rien livrer dont vous ne seriez pas fier. Une communication structurée et directe : vous savez faire parler un métier sur son besoin et défendre vos choix devant un décideur, avec de l’assurance et sans ego. Une formation d’excellence : diplôme de Grande École d’Ingénieurs (Rang A/A+) ou parcours universitaire scientifique de haut niveau. Une expérience en conseil ou dans la finance, le luxe, la grande consommation ou le secteur public : c’est un plus. Une expérience des systèmes d’information des grands groupes ou du déploiement de l’IA en entreprise : c’est un plus. Posture et savoir-être Vous êtes à l’aise face à un client : animer un …

items.desc: Important! To make sure your application is considered, please submit it before the end of the day on (dd.mm.yyyy): 18.11.2026 We encourage candidates to apply as soon as possible. What does the job involve? Build the next generation of AI-powered solutions Agentic AI is changing how organisations operate. At Equinor, we're building intelligent systems that bring together language models, enterprise knowledge, data and business processes to help people work smarter and make better decisions. We're looking for a Data Scientist who wants to work at the forefront of generative and agentic AI, delivering real solutions to real users. Why join us? This is not a research-only role and it is not a software engineering role. You'll sit at the intersection of data science, AI engineering and product development, helping develop AI solutions that are deployed and used across the company. You'll have the freedom to experiment, learn and apply new techniques as the field continues to evolve. What will my tasks be? Within This Position, Your Key Tasks Will Be To Design, develop and test agentic AI solutions. Develop prompting strategies, retrieval systems and evaluation approaches. Work with large language models and multimodel AI technologies. Collaborate closely with engineers, architects and business experts. Contribute to production deployment of AI solutions. Measure and improve solution performance, quality and user adoption. Help identify new opportunities where AI can create business value. Here's What We Expect From You At Equinor, there are some overall qualities we regard as essential. We want you to identify with the values that guide our decisions and help us succeed and grow: open, collaborative, courageous and caring. We expect you to make safety your priority and to contribute to our zero-harm culture. And for this specific position, we are also looking for: What we think you bring Masters or PhD in operations research, applied mathematics, computer science, data science, control/automation, engineering or a related discipline. Proven hands-on experience in data science, machine learning and AI development/deployment in production environment. Practical knowledge of modern language models, generative and Agentic AI. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Programming experience, preferably Python. Interest in emerging AI technologies and a desire to keep learning. Nice to have LangGraph, Microsoft Agent Framework (MAF), CrewAI or similar frameworks. Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI services and cloud-native development. Responsible AI, model safety and governance. This Role Will Give You Opportunities to work with some of the most challenging AI use cases in industry. Access to large-scale enterprise and industrial data and access to modern AI platforms and technologies. Strong technical communities and collaboration with experts across multiple disciplines. A culture that values experimentation, learning and innovation. The opportunity to shape how AI is applied within a company that plays an important role in European energy security and in the energy transition. What can we offer you? We want you to have a rewarding and fulfilling work life. That’s why we offer: Not just a job - a career In Equinor, your development begins on day one. You will build your competence through a wide range of learning activities while being empowered to build your career across multiple disciplines and geographies. Our internal job market allows a wide range of opportunities for development and growth within your own field, or even in other areas you find interesting and relevant. Attractive rewards We give you a comprehensive benefits package with a competitive salary, global parental leave, bonus scheme and pension plan. Wellness and work-life balance We care about and prioritise our employees’ well-being. We know that for you to be the best version of yourself in the workplace, being able to collect your children, attend a class or simply enjoy social time can be invaluable. That’s why we encourage you to make use of our flexible work arrangements wherever possible. An inclusive culture We believe embracing our differences makes us stronger. For us, true inclusion means being able to bring your whole self to work, and for you and everyone else to feel accepted and valued. Equal opportunities for everyone Equinor is an equal-opportunity employer. We make all employment decisions, which include hiring, promotion, transfer, demotion, termination, and training, without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, marital status, parental status, veteran status, or any other protected status. As part of this commitment, reasonable adjustments will be made during the recruitment process for candidates with disabilities or long-term health conditions. If you have any specific requirements, please clarify this in your application and our team will be in contact …

items.desc: Als beratende Ingenieurgesellschaft steht seit unserer Gründung die Zusammenarbeit im Team im Mittelpunkt. An unseren Standorten in München, Berlin, Halle, Düsseldorf, Hamburg und Regensburg arbeiten rund 400 Expertinnen und Experten. items.desc: Rejoignez l’équipe R&D de xHighlight, au cœur du développement d’une application 3D interactive permettant de créer et d’expérimenter des expériences immersives. Vous évoluerez dans un environnement à la croisée de la 3D temps réel, du développement web, de l’interactivité et de l’intelligence artificielle, en collaboration avec des profils techniques et créatifs. Vos missions En tant que stagiaire R&D chez xHighlight, vous aurez pour mission d’explorer et de développer un moteur de workflows agentiques qui génère des plans d'actions, les montre avant de les exécuter, puis les persiste pour les rejouer et les réutiliser, en faisant évoluer le recipe runner existant pour qu'il supporte ces capacités. Génératif : un agent produit un workflow structuré (étapes, paramètres, dépendances) à partir d'une intention utilisateur. Déterministe : un même workflow, avec les mêmes entrées, produit toujours le même résultat. L'IA planifie, l'exécution ne dépend plus du modèle. Prévisualisable : chaque action est simulée et affichée (dry-run, diff de scène) pour validation avant d'être appliquée. Persistant : les workflows validés sont stockés, versionnés et rejouables. Réutilisable : un workflow devient un modèle paramétrable, composable avec d'autres. Vos Qualifications Étudiant·e en dernière année d'école d'ingénieur ou de master en informatique ou IA. Compétences requises Solide maîtrise de TypeScript/JavaScript ou Python Bonne compréhension des LLM et du tool calling (function calling) Goût pour la conception logicielle : schémas de données, API, machines à états Rigueur sur les tests et la reproductibilité Compétences appréciées Expérience avec MCP (Model Context Protocol) ou un framework d'agents (LangGraph, Agent SDK…) Notions de 3D web (Three.js, Babylon.js) ou de formats déclaratifs Connaissance de l'event sourcing, du versioning ou des moteurs de workflows (Temporal, etc.) Savoir-être : autonomie, curiosité, capacité à prototyper vite puis à consolider. Nous rejoindre c'est aussi Intégrer une entreprise scientifique au cœur de l’innovation technologique, portée par une forte croissance depuis plus de 40 ans. Principaux avantages et bénéfices : Environnement collaboratif et innovant Collaboration internationale Diversité des technologies, produits et solutions Engagement en faveur de la diversité et de l’inclusion Inclusion statement As a game-changer in sustainable technology and innovation, Dassault Systèmes is striving to build more inclusive and diverse teams across the globe. We believe that our people are our number one asset and we want all employees to feel empowered to bring their whole selves to work every day. It is our goal that our people feel a sense of pride and a passion for belonging. As a company leading change, it’s our responsibility to foster opportunities for all people to participate in a harmonized Workforce of the Future.

items.desc: Your next challenge Bring your AI engineering expertise to a role where you can turn complex commercial challenges into practical, scalable solutions. As an AI Agentic Engineer/ AI Forward Deployment Engineer, you’ll design and deploy cloud-native AI systems that help global business teams improve pricing and channel management. Working in a hybrid model, you’ll collaborate with product and business stakeholders, connect technical decisions to commercial outcomes, and see your solutions through from design to deployment. What you’ll do: Take ownership of AI-enabled solutions from design through deployment, using AWS Bedrock and major cloud platforms to tackle pricing and channel management challenges for global business units. Design secure, scalable environments across AWS, GCP, and Azure, supporting high-availability AI workflows and data pipelines for revenue optimization. Build reliable PHP backend services that connect cloud APIs and internal systems, bringing pricing rules and channel partner programs into operation. Use Python automation to connect data ingestion, model execution, and reporting—helping pricing teams spend less time on manual tasks and make decisions faster. Turn machine learning and generative AI capabilities into working Python applications, with the monitoring, logging, and error handling needed for consistent performance across hybrid environments. Work alongside pricing analysts and channel managers to translate their needs into solutions for margin management, discount structures, and partner incentives. Shape the dataflows behind pricing and channel management, creating clean data models, efficient storage, and timely access for analytics and day-to-day operations. Help establish coding standards, configuration management, and deployment practices that make AI and automation solutions easier to maintain, observe, and operate reliably. Tune cloud applications and automation workflows to meet latency, throughput, and cost-efficiency targets linked to commercial objectives. Partner with product, finance, and sales operations to validate outcomes and refine AI models using market feedback. Make your work reproducible by creating clear solution architectures, operational runbooks, and technical decision records that others can build on. Share your expertise with junior engineers through design reviews, pair programming, and guidance on cloud-native AI patterns. Build security, compliance, and governance into your cloud and automation work, reducing operational risk while supporting strategic pricing initiatives. What you’ll bring: Extensive experience designing and deploying AWS solutions, including hands-on use of AWS Bedrock and broader AWS services for production AI workloads. Strong practical expertise in at least one additional major cloud platform—GCP or Azure—with experience in networking, storage, identity, and managed data services. Solid PHP development skills, with the ability to build reliable REST-based services, integrations, and business logic for pricing and channel management workflows. Advanced Python and automation skills, including scripting libraries, testing frameworks, and orchestration tools for large-scale data and AI operations. Deep knowledge of pricing and channel management, including discount models, deal structures, partner tiers, and performance measurement. The ability to collaborate effectively in a hybrid, day-shift role, combining remote teamwork with onsite engagement to keep delivery moving. What you can learn and develop: Deepen your hands-on experience with AWS Bedrock and production AI workloads, while broadening your cloud engineering practice across AWS, GCP, and Azure. Develop your ability to take machine learning and generative AI applications into operation, with a focus on monitoring, reliability, security, and governance. Build a stronger understanding of how pricing strategies, discount structures, partner incentives, and channel programs influence commercial outcomes. Sharpen your automation and data engineering skills by connecting data ingestion, model execution, and reporting in Python-based workflows. Strengthen your stakeholder collaboration and technical leadership through cross-functional delivery, design reviews, pair programming, and mentoring junior engineers.

Production LLM & Agentic Integration Skills: You have hands-on experience integrating major LLM APIs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Google Gemini) into real software projects, using structured outputs, function/tool calling, RAG patterns, evaluation frameworks, and agent protocols (such as MCP). Strong Systems & Architecture Fundamentals: You have a solid grasp of REST APIs, webhooks, relational databases (SQL/PostgreSQL), data modeling, event-driven architectures, Docker, Linux, and CI/CD pipelines on cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP). Engineering Rigor Over "Vibe-Coding": You know the difference between a quick hack and a maintainable service. High-Agency Problem Solver: You thrive on talking directly to engineers, operations teams, and customer-facing stakeholders, translating messy real-world bottlenecks into elegant software solutions. items.desc:
Who we are
 About Stripe
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. 
 About the team
 The Collaboration team helps Stripe employees work smarter and more efficiently, get to know each other, and request and receive help from one another. The team is nimble and creative. We work across a wide stack; on any given day, we discuss user interface design, data models, API design, infrastructure maintenance, agentic integrations, or all of the above. We’re excited to innovate in a space that traditionally isn’t thought of as in the forefront of innovation.
 Being a small team, we carefully choose what we work on to have the highest leverage. This is not always easy—we work very cross-functionally, partnering with groups from engineering to Communications to senior leadership. But one of our greatest rewards is getting to sit next to and see the impact our work has on our users: our fellow Stripe employees.
 What you’ll do
 As an engineer on Stripe’s Collaboration team, you will be a key member of a team that acts as a force multiplier on the internal tools that Stripe uses. You will focus on building innovative AI-native experiences that help Stripe employees be more productive across various tasks and activities. You’ll collaborate with other teams across Stripe, combine traditional hands-on engineering with emerging AI capabilities, and experiment with different ideas and approaches to empower and delight your users.
 Responsibilities
 Work with a team of smart, motivated engineers who put their users first.
 Own solutions from end to end, managing complexity and engaging directly with stakeholders to think through everything from success metrics to MCP tooling to the nitty-gritty implementation details of the products you build.
 Leverage the latest AI tooling to refine and optimize both your users’ workflows and your own.
 Use both qualitative and quantitative metrics to determine priorities and measure effectiveness.
 Uphold Stripe’s high standards for engineering and product quality and mentor newer team members to do the same.
 Who you are 
 We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. 
 Minimum requirements
 You have 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 2+ years of industry experience building rich web experiences using modern frameworks such as React, Vue, etc.
 You work well across a full stack, from user experience to workflow automations to reliability. 
 You enjoy working directly with users and cross-functional partners to build creative solutions that address their problems.
 You are able to think rigorously, navigate ambiguity, and make hard decisions and tradeoffs.
 You enjoy working together with your team toward common goals, but are also able to drive your work forward autonomously
 Preferred qualifications 
 You have a passion for enabling people to do their best work.
 You have an interest in partnering with creative, non-technical teams, such as those responsible for Stripe’s creative communications and publishing efforts.
 You have a track record of shipping LLM-powered experiences with a strong understanding of how underlying technologies work.
 You have industry experience working with Ruby, TypeScript, and React.
 You are experienced with using AI tools to maximize your technical throughput while maintaining a high bar for quality.
 You never lose sight of the end user, and you enjoy the quick feedback loops made possible by working (sometimes literally) next to your users.

items.desc:
Job Description: 
 Vous aimez les environnements dynamiques et opérationnels? 
 Vous souhaitez travailler au plus proche des satellites ? 
 Rejoignez notre équipe ! 
 Airbus Defence & Space recherche un Ingénieur d'Essais Environnementaux et Thermiques (f/h) pour rejoindre notre Département Ingénierie des Tests Thermiques basé à Toulouse , France.
 Vos missions : 
 Vous ferez partie d'une équipe qui teste sur des moyens sous vide thermique des satellites de haute technologie (télécommunications, observation de la Terre, sciences). Au sein de l'équipe Ingénierie des Tests Thermiques, vous serez impliqué(e) dans la conception, la préparation et la mise en œuvre des moyens d'essais en environnement extrême (vide thermique et climatique) visant à garantir la performance et la fiabilité des satellites avant leur lancement. 
 Vos responsabilités : 
 Référent technique des aménagements d'essais : Agir en tant que référent technique et point focal auprès du secteur Assemblage, Intégration et Tests (AIT) pour la définition, la personnalisation et le suivi des aménagements d'essais montés sur les satellites. 
 Ingénierie, conception et préparation technique : Analyser les exigences clients, piloter les études de faisabilité (instrumentation, chaînes de mesure de température/pression, moyens de chauffe), définir les besoins spécifiques avec les bureaux d'études et rédiger la documentation d'ingénierie (plans d'essais, spécifications) en veillant au respect des coûts et plannings. 
 Gestion et anticipation des moyens d'essais : Garantir le suivi et la mise à jour du parc d'équipements sous vide et environnementaux, évaluer leur disponibilité au regard du calendrier de tests et anticiper les développements ou adaptations nécessaires. 
 Support opérationnel, expertise et résolution d'anomalies : Apporter un soutien technique d'expertise lors des phases critiques d'essais, analyser les dérives et non-conformités, définir et piloter les plans d'actions correctives et participer à la continuité opérationnelle via des astreintes. 
 Vous serez amené(e) à assurer un support en astreinte lors des phases d’essais . Des déplacements professionnels occasionnels sont également à prévoir en France, et à l’étranger.
 OBLIGATOIRE : 
 Ce poste nécessite une habilitation de sécurité ou nécessite d'être éligible à une habilitation par les autorités reconnues. 
 Le candidat doit posséder la nationalité française conformément à l’IGI 1300 du 9 Août 2021 (§1.2.2.1). 
 Votre profil : 
 Formation en Ingénierie / en génie mécanique, thermique, instrumentation ou discipline scientifique apparentée.
 Expérience professionnelle minimum de 5 ans dans un environnement de production ou d'essais (secteur spatial souhaité).
 Expertise technique en environnements de vide thermique et en instrumentation (capteurs, thermocouples, chaînes de mesure).
 Maîtrise de la conduite de projets techniques (suivi des jalons, gestion des coûts, de la qualité et tenue des délais). 
 Anglais : niveau avancé requis (usage quotidien).
 Votre environnement de travail : 
 Capitale mondiale de l'aéronautique et capitale européenne de la recherche dans le spatial, Toulouse est une ville dynamique du sud-ouest de la France desservie par un aéroport international. Idéalement située entre la mer Méditerranée et l'océan Atlantique et à proximité des Pyrénées, elle offre de nombreuses possibilités d'activités de plein air ! 
 Parce que nous prenons soin de vous :

Job Description: 
 Take off with Airbus Helicopters! 
 Airbus Helicopters is looking for a Drive System Design Responsible to join our Engineering departement based in Marignane, France. 
 You will join Transmission Design & Dynamic Systems Architecture department, which is in charge of the whole Airbus Helicopters fleet. Your missions will be operational.
 Join us to shape the future of aeronautics and help protect lives during missions accomplished thanks to our helicopters. 
 The Marignane site, the 3rd largest industrial site in France, near Marseille and Aix-en-Provence, is undergoing a deep transformation to offer a high-tech, inclusive, and environmentally friendly working environment. 
 You will live a unique professional experience, at the heart of the manufacturing of our helicopters. 
 To learn more about our site and our activities: Airbus Helicopters - Marignane 
 Your future missions: 
 As System Design Responsible (SDR), you will be in charge of :
 - defining technical objectives of transmission systems (specification writing) ;
 - following detailed design & compliance to requirements of performance, manufacturing, assembly & reliability for any design change and/or new certification ;
 - managing activities in compliance with Airbus Helicopters AH applicable processes
 - writing (flight and bench) tests requests & conclusions, preparing, following-up these tests ;
 - certifying transmission systems (documents writing, discussions with EASA)
 You will belong to a Squad organization & will be interfaced with a lot of different AH entities (stress analysis, work preparation, quality, production, lab tests, flight tests, project, configuration, airworthiness, other design offices, program, customer support...) and transmission equipments suppliers.
 In order to succeed in this challenging transmission systems environment , you will use your experience within Airbus Helicopters engineering. You will also be closely supported by the whole Métiers organization (overall, design, gears & splines, bearings & freewheels, wear & phydical laws, spalling & chip detectability, sealing & TBO extension, Dynamic Systems architecture, stress analysis, lubrication & thermics), experts, CVE and TVE.
 You will also have deep interactions with physical parts, whatever it is linked to production (workshops, manufacturing, assembly, MRO), bench tests or helicopters.
 Your profile 
 - Educated to 5 years' degree level (or equivalent) in mechanical engineering.
 - A first experience in aeronautical domain or in gearbox design would be a plus
 - Synthesis spirit, rigorous
 - Good communication skills
 - Language Skills: Advanced level in English and negotiation level in French ; German would be a plus

items.desc:
Location: Hengelo, Netherlands 
 About Us: 
 Thales Nederland is a top provider of high-tech jobs, active in the Aerospace, Defense, and Security sectors. We design extremely modern radar systems and optical sensors that form part of complete, integrated defense systems. Within the Engineering cluster, our software engineering department is responsible for the software that makes these radar systems tick.
 These complex systems are used worldwide to protect lives in critical situations.
 The Team: SIMS (Radar Core Processing) 
 Testing a cutting-edge naval radar system does not always mean spinning up a massive physical antenna or flying real fighter jets through the air. The SIMS team within the Radar Core Processing (RCP) department builds the sophisticated sensor equipment simulators and Video Injection Units (VIU), powered by our in-house developed SESx framework, that make isolated, high-fidelity radar testing possible.
 Our software enables internal teams to test specific components of the radar chain by injecting synthetic data that mimics previous hardware or software stages. For example, we can bypass the heavy physical hardware (like the radar dish and receiver) by injecting simulated radar 'video' (raw non-visual RF/digital data streams) directly into the Signal Processing stage. Further down the chain, we inject synthetic plots and tracks, allowing downstream teams to validate how their systems react to complex, high-stakes scenarios that are nearly impossible to stage in real life, such as massive drone swarms or supersonic threats.
 The Role: 
 We are looking for a strong C++ Software Engineer who enjoys working at the crossroads of complex system architecture, real-world simulation, and cross-team collaboration.
 Because our simulators must mimic real radar components and feed exact data structures into live products, our software has to integrate tightly with the systems built by other RCP teams. You will spend your time not only writing clean, high-performance C++ code within the SESx framework, but also actively collaborating with engineers across the department to align interfaces, data formats, and injection points. Additionally, while our team has dedicated physics and math specialists who design the underlying environmental and target models, you will work closely alongside them to implement these models in code, meaning a solid grasp of physics and mathematics will help you hit the ground running.
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Design, develop, and maintain sensor equipment simulators and Video Injection Units (VIU) in modern C++ using our proprietary SESx framework.
 Build software components capable of injecting synthetic data at various stages of the radar chain, ranging from raw hardware-level radar 'video' up to processed plots and tracks.
 Collaborate closely with stakeholders and engineers from other radar product teams to align architectural interfaces and ensure tight, accurate integration with target radar systems.
 Partner with domain and physics specialists within the team to translate real-world mathematical and physical models (such as target kinematics, radar cross-sections, and environmental clutter) into reliable, performant C++ code.
 Develop complex test scenario capabilities (e.g., multi-target fighter jet maneuvers, coordinated drone swarms) to push the boundaries of our radar verification capabilities. Participate in the full Agile software lifecycle, ensuring simulator releases stay synchronized with evolving radar product roadmaps.
 About You: 
 We are looking for an engineer who combines strong C++ craftsmanship with the communication skills needed to connect different teams and disciplines. You should have:
 A completed Bachelor’s or Master’s degree (HBO/WO) in Computer Science, Technical Informatics, Electrical Engineering, Physics, or a related technical discipline.
 Strong, proven experience (5+ years) in modern C/C++ software engineering within a Linux environment.
 Strong stakeholder and interpersonal skills; you enjoy reaching out to other teams to align technical implementations and solve integration challenges together.
 A solid foundational understanding of—and affinity for—physics and mathematics, allowing you to effectively collaborate with modeling specialists and understand real-world simulation concepts.
 Experience with object-oriented design, modular software architectures, and real-time or high-throughput data streams.
 Familiarity with modern software development tooling, such as Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile/Scrum methodologies.
 What We Offer: 
 An interesting job in a high-tech environment at our Hengelo campus.
 An open and flexible working environment where work-life balance is considered very important.

items.desc:
This is Adyen 
 Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition. 
 For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster. 
 At Adyen, the supply chain is not just about moving physical goods—it's about fueling our global momentum. We work across the business to bring clarity, optimize payment terminal and accessories inventory, and help teams scale our global operations faster. We are now looking for an EPM Solution Architect (Supply Chain) to join our growing team in Amsterdam. In this role, you will own our supply chain planning, inventory, and Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) models in Pigment, raising the bar on data quality, forecast automation, scenario analysis, and scalable supply chain execution. This role sits at the intersection of supply chain operations, enterprise data, and advanced systems modeling. As one of the founding technical members of our internal Planning Center of Excellence (CoE), you will build the foundational models that help us predict demand, optimize stock visibility, and run a world-class supply chain with absolute confidence.
 What you'll do 
 ● Own Pigment for Supply Chain Planning: Build, maintain, and continuously improve our core supply chain models (S&OP, Demand & Supply Planning, Terminal Registry, Lifecycle Tracking, and Stock Visibility).
 ● Lead the Co-Build Phase: Partner directly with our implementation consultants during the IMS project build phases to actively configure logic, supply source definitions, and translate complex supply chain rules into scalable multi-dimensional Pigment models.
 ● Fix Supply Chain Data at the Root: Identify recurring discrepancies in inventory tracking and planning outputs. Trace them back through data pipelines, lookups, and warehouse APIs (in partnership with our Data Engineering team) to drive root-cause fixes.
 ● Drive Strategic Autonomy: Own and modify supply chain routing rules, serial attributes, and forecasting parameters directly within the planning platform post-implementation, ensuring we run a self-sufficient ecosystem without relying on external consultants.
 ● Enable and Upskill Planners: Champion platform adoption across the organization. Design training resources and upskill demand and supply planners to become "Level 2" model builders so they can serve as first-line administrators.
 ● Build Scenario Planning & Stress Testing: Establish advanced scenario simulation models to stress-test our supply chain against global market disruptions, lead-time changes, and warehouse expansion impacts.
 Who you are 
 ● You bring 4–8 years of experience in supply chain analytics, operations planning, business intelligence, or systems-focused roles.
 ● You understand core supply chain dynamics (S&OP, lead times, safety stock, inventory valuation, and warehouse logistics) and can translate these mechanics into robust model logic.
 ● You are an experienced planning modeler—hands-on experience with Pigment or Anaplan is a strong plus. If you have experience in other multi-dimensional planning tools (Adaptive, Jedox, TM1), you have the drive and capacity to become a Pigment expert rapidly.
 ● You are strong in data: you can structure large supply chain datasets, validate complexbusiness logic, build automated system validation controls, and write SQL.
 ● You are a natural platform owner: you architect for system performance, scalability, governance, and pristine user experience, not just individual outputs.
 ● You are an excellent communicator who can distill complex supply chain logic into simple, intuitive planning screens for business users.
 ● You are familiar with numerous AI models and embed AI usage in your daily work.
 Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments 
 Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen. 
 Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application! 
 What’s next? 
 Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you …

Splash Tech | DevOps Mid/Senior / Frontend | Remote (LATAM and EU) | Full Time | https://splash.tech/ 
We're a small UK-based free-to-play gaming company with a distributed team, growing fast after recent success and scaling our backend platform. We’re looking for a DevOps engineer with 5+ years of experience.
Most of the work is AWS-focused. You should have hands-on experience with:
- AWS, particularly EKS, EC2, Application Load Balancers, RDS, and IAM.
- Terraform and managing infrastructure as code.
- Kubernetes, including troubleshooting workloads and cluster issues.
- CI/CD and GitOps workflows using GitHub Actions and Flux.
- Monitoring, alerting, and tracing with tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, Alertmanager, Jaeger, and OpenTelemetry.
- DNS, TLS, and Cloudflare.
Strong AWS networking knowledge, including VPC design, routing, private connectivity, and troubleshooting is highly desirable.
Our stack includes AWS, Kubernetes (EKS), PostgreSQL, Trino, Flux, Terraform, and GitHub Actions. You don’t need to know every tool already, but you should be comfortable learning what the job requires.
You should be comfortable owning work from identifying a problem and proposing a solution through implementation, rollout, documentation, and ongoing operation.
You should be comfortable investigating issues across applications, Kubernetes, networking, and databases. We also value clear thinking and communication: you should be able to explain your ideas and trade-offs using simple architecture or flow diagrams—just boxes and lines, nothing formal.
To apply, email lucas[at]splash.tech with the subject “DevOps Engineer 2026”. Include a brief introduction and a link to a repository or project that demonstrates your infrastructure or automation work. If you don’t have work you can share, we may ask you to complete a small practical test.
We're also hiring for a FE engineer that can create good looking games. Our stack is Angular, JavaScript, CSS.
To apply, email jack[at]splash.tech with the subject "FE Engineer 2026". Include a link to something visual you've built that you're proud of - a game, site, or UI. If you don't have shareable work, we may ask you to complete a small practical test.

items.desc: Do IT Now est une entreprise spécialisée dans le calcul haute performance (HPC) et l'Intelligence Artificielle. Nous accompagnons des organisations de toutes tailles, des PME aux grandes multinationales, en leur fournissant des solutions sur mesure : conseil stratégique, installation d’infrastructures, optimisation des performances et support technique avancé. Dans le cadre de son développement, Do IT Now recrute un(e) Ingénieur(e) Application IA pour renforcer son équipe technique. Vous participerez à la conception, au développement et à l’industrialisation d’applications IA à fort impact, en lien avec nos environnements cloud et nos expertises HPC. Chez Do IT Now, nous valorisons l'excellence technique, la collaboration et l'engagement. Nous croyons à la force du collectif, dans un environnement fondé sur la confiance, l’inclusion et la responsabilité. Résolument tournés vers l’avenir, nous plaçons la performance et la satisfaction client au cœur de nos actions. ENVIRONNEMENT DE TRAVAIL Vous intégrerez une équipe engagée et passionnée, rassemblant des experts en HPC/AI reconnus pour leur savoir-faire. Vous évoluerez dans un environnement de travail flexible, adapté à une organisation à distance. Ce poste est ouvert à des candidats basés partout en France. MISSIONS Concevoir et développer des applications IA robustes et industrialisées. Développer le backend d’applications IA basées sur des agents en Python/FastAPI. Concevoir des architectures de services robustes, testables et évolutives (API RESTful, gestion des erreurs, observabilité). Construire des pipelines d’ingestion et d’indexation de données structurées et non structurées. Concevoir des agents IA : gestion du contexte, mémoire, orchestration d’outils. Mettre en place le monitoring des applications IA : latence, coût d’inférence, qualité des réponses, alerting, tableaux de bord. Sécuriser les usages LLM : protections contre l’injection de prompt, sandboxing des outils, prévention d’exfiltration, gestion des secrets, quotas. Participer à la mise en production et à l’optimisation des performances applicatives. Rédiger la documentation technique et assurer le transfert de connaissances. Collaborer avec les équipes techniques et métier pour garantir la qualité et l'efficacité des solutions. Réaliser une veille technologique (IA/agents (innovations, outils, pratiques, sécurité) et proposer des innovations concrètes. COMPETENCES Python avancé. FastAPI. Conception d’API RESTful et architecture de services. Bonnes pratiques de développement : tests, robustesse, qualité de code. Notions AWS (IAM, EC2, EKS). Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD. PostgreSQL (ou équivalent). Bases vectorielles. Bases de graphes. Ingestion et indexation de données. Développement applicatif IA : agents, orchestration, frameworks type HuggingFace, LangChain ou équivalent. Sensibilité à la cybersécurité LLM : injection de prompt, détournement d’outils, fuites de données, séparation des droits. QUALITES PERSONNELLES Esprit d’équipe et bonnes compétences en communication. Curiosité et goût pour l’innovation autour de l’IA et du cloud. Rigueur, autonomie et esprit analytique. Envie d’apprendre et de contribuer à des projets IA concrets et visibles. PROFIL RECHERCHE Ingénieur confirmé avec expérience concrète de mise en production d’application IA. Une expérience dans le secteur pharmaceutique, notamment en essais cliniques et en affaires réglementaires, serait un atout. Formation Bac+5 (Master) ou Doctorat en informatique, ingénierie ou discipline scientifique équivalente. Au moins d’expérience en ingénierie logicielle, avec déploiement applicatif IA en production. Habitude de travailler dans des environnements techniques exigeants, avec une forte orientation résultats et performance. Maîtrise de l’anglais professionnel (écrit et oral). POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE Culture d'entreprise axée sur la technologie. Des projets d'envergure avec des partenaires industriels de premier plan. Croissance rapide de l'entreprise et possibilités d’évolution de carrière. Programmes de formation continue et de développement des compétences techniques et managériales. Environnement de travail dynamique et multiculturel. Team building régulier. Des opportunités d’évolution de carrière au sein d’une entreprise en forte croissance. Cadre de travail stimulant. 100% remote. Mutuelle prise en charge à 100% . Prime d'intéressement. Sport : Wellpass. Tickets restaurant ou Carte restaurant (10€/jour). RTT . PROCESSUS DE RECRUTEMENT Le processus de recrutement chez Do IT Now est structuré en trois étapes : un entretien avec la Responsable des Ressources Humaines pour discuter de votre parcours et de vos aspirations, un second entretien avec le Directeur Technique pour évaluer vos compétences et votre adéquation avec le poste, et un entretien final avec le PDG pour échanger sur votre vision et votre potentiel au sein de Do IT Now. Nous étudions chaque candidature avec attention. Sans retour de notre part dans un délai de 6 …
