items.desc: Delen Private Bank is gespecialiseerd in discretionair vermogensbeheer en vermogensplanning. Onze missie? Het vermogen van onze klanten op een actieve en doordachte manier beheren en plannen, met het oog op een evenwichtige groei en een vlotte overdracht naar de volgende generaties. Persoonlijk contact, een langetermijnvisie en een duurzame aanpak kenmerken onze filosofie. Groep Delen is actief in vijf landen en telt meer dan 1000 medewerkers. Met meer dan 200 IT-collega's binnen Delen Private Bank is technologie een belangrijke drijfveer achter onze dienstverlening en verdere groei. Het AI Lab binnen Delen Private Bank De gedeelde missie van business, IT en het AI Lab is het vereenvoudigen en ondersteunen van processen, zodat collega’s minder administratieve lasten ervaren en meer tijd kunnen besteden aan persoonlijk contact met klanten en een uitstekende dienstverlening. In het AI Lab luisteren we naar onze collega’s om hun uitdagingen in processen en werkmethoden te begrijpen, en verkennen we waar AI hen echt kan ondersteunen. Daarna bouwen we AI‑oplossingen om de meerwaarde voor onze collega’s concreet te maken. Wanneer die duidelijk is en er vraag ontstaat, neemt IT de oplossing over voor verdere uitwerking binnen onze systemen. AI Engineer binnen het AI Lab Als AI Engineer speel je een sleutelrol in het onderzoeken, ontwerpen en bouwen van AI‑oplossingen en capabilities die bijdragen aan efficiëntie, kwaliteit en schaalbaarheid van onze dienstverlening. Je opereert op het kruispunt van business, data, software engineering & AI. Je bouwt end‑to‑end AI‑oplossingen: van data‑ingestion en modelontwikkeling tot concrete applicaties waarmee we de business versneld kunnen ondersteunen. Wanneer een oplossing succesvol is en de business er klaar voor is, dragen we deze over aan IT voor volledige integratie. Onze rol is dan puur adviserend. Je bouwt AI‑services die veilig, uitlegbaar en performant zijn, en je waakt over stabiliteit, monitoring en lifecycle management van modellen in productie. Je denkt actief mee over architectuurkeuzes, herbruikbare componenten en best practices binnen het AI Lab. Jouw profiel Wat breng je high-level mee? Je hebt passie voor je vak en gaat van nature de extra mile in een dynamische, voortdurend evoluerende omgeving. De collega’s zijn onze klanten. Je bent gemotiveerd om met hen samen te werken, duurzame relaties op te bouwen en steeds in tandem te werken. Wij bieden Aantrekkelijke voorwaarden: je ontvangt een competitief salaris aangevuld met een uitgebreid pakket extralegale voordelen, zoals hospitalisatie- en tandzorgverzekering, groepsverzekering, ecocheques, gsm met abonnement, optieplan, extra verlofdagen (bank holidays), Benefits at Work, restaurant met versbereide maaltijden, keuze uit bedrijfswagen of andere (mobiliteits)oplossingen via het mobiliteitsbudget. Ontwikkelkansen & intrapreneurship: jouw groei staat centraal. We luisteren naar je ambities en helpen je actief om stappen te zetten binnen onze organisatie. Via opleidingen, interne mobiliteit en intrapreneurship krijg je de ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen en nieuwe uitdagingen aan te gaan. Jij bent de architect van je loopbaan – wij zorgen voor de juiste ondersteuning. Persoonlijke aanpak: als familiebedrijf sinds 1936 …

Aujourd'hui, les scénarios de test sont généralement spécifiés en langage naturel et constituent le point d'entrée des essais de validation. Cette représentation est adaptée
items.desc: Dans une démarche d'amélioration continue visant à réduire les délais de développement et à accroître l'efficacité des activités de validation, les constructeurs automobiles s'orientent de plus en plus vers l'automatisation des chaînes de tests. Aujourd'hui, les scénarios de test sont généralement spécifiés en langage naturel et constituent le point d'entrée des essais de validation. Cette représentation est adaptée aux essais physiques, car les opérateurs peuvent interpréter directement les instructions décrites. En revanche, elle ne répond pas aux exigences des environnements de validation numériques en automatique de type xIL (MIL, SIL, HIL). Un outil interne à l'équipe permet actuellement d'effectuer cette transformation entre langage naturel et scénarios numériques. Pour être exploitables, la plupart des scénarios générés nécessitent des ajustements qui ne sont pas systématiquement capitalisés par l'outil, limitant son automatisation. L'émergence des modèles de langage (LLM) et de l'IA générative ouvre aujourd'hui de nouvelles perspectives pour automatiser et fiabiliser cette chaîne de transformation. Au sein de l'équipe de validation numérique ADAS L2, le stagiaire aura pour mission d'analyser la chaîne existante, d'identifier les cas d'usage où l'IA peut apporter le plus de valeur, puis d'étudier et comparer différentes approches avant de prototyper la solution la plus pertinente. Les Travaux Pourront Notamment Explorer Deux Approches Agent IA d'amélioration continue : concevoir un agent capable de capitaliser sur les corrections des experts, de rechercher des cas similaires et de proposer de nouvelles corrections afin d'enrichir progressivement les connaissances métier et d'améliorer la génération des scénarios. Génération de scénarios par LLM : étudier et comparer différentes approches de génération de scénarios numériques et de post-traitements à partir des gammes en langage naturel, en explorant notamment le Prompt Engineering, le RAG, l'exploitation des connaissances métier existantes et, si pertinent, le fine-tuning. Le candidat travaillera sur des scénarios réels utilisés quotidiennement pour la validation ADAS et aura l'opportunité de mesurer concrètement l'impact de ses travaux sur la qualité, la robustesse et la rapidité de numérisation des scénarios de test. Il bénéficiera également d'un accès à l'ensemble de la chaîne de validation numérique afin de valider ses développements dans un environnement industriel représentatif. Profil Nous Recherchons Un Profil En Dernière Année D'école D'ingénieurs (généraliste Ou Spécialisée) Ou Master 2, Avec Une Spécialisation En Intelligence Artificielle Machine Learning Data Science Traitement du Langage Naturel Vous disposez idéalement de compétences en programmation Python et en développement de solutions basées sur l'Intelligence Artificielle (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn ou équivalent). Des connaissances en traitement de données textuelles, analyse de données, automatisation logicielle ainsi qu'en méthodes d'apprentissage supervisé et non supervisé seront particulièrement appréciées. Vous êtes force de proposition, doté d'un esprit d'analyse et capable de comprendre les enjeux d'intégration des systèmes développés. Chez Stellantis nous évaluons les candidats selon leurs qualifications, leurs mérites et les besoins du métier Nous accueillons les candidatures des personnes de tout genre, âge, ethnie, nationalité, religion, orientation sexuelle, et handicap. La diversité de nos équipes nous permettra de mieux appréhender l'évolution des besoins de nos clients et de notre environnement futur. Durée du contrat 6 mois At Stellantis, we assess candidates based on qualifications, merit and business needs. We welcome applications from people of all gender identities, age, ethnicity, nationality, religion, sexual orientation and disability. Diverse teams will allow us to better meet the evolving needs of our customers and care for our future.

items.desc: ¿Quiénes somos? / About us En Teros (producto nacido en el corazón de Secture) estamos construyendo una nueva forma de trabajar con IA. No queremos que la IA se limite a responder preguntas. Queremos que haga el trabajo : agentes capaces de conectarse con las herramientas que ya utilizan las empresas, entender procesos y ejecutar tareas de principio a fin. Estamos en una fase especialmente emocionante: estamos construyendo el producto y el equipo que queremos que lo haga crecer. Y buscamos un/a AI Engineer que quiera construir la inteligencia que hay detrás de Teros. Alguien que disfrute experimentando con LLMs, agentes y nuevas arquitecturas, pero que tenga claro que el objetivo no es hacer una demo impresionante: es conseguir que funcione de verdad, en producción y para usuarios reales. Aquí vas a poder probar, romper, medir, iterar y construir muy rápido. Tu día a día Desarrollar soluciones basadas en IA Generativa y LLMs. Construir sistemas RAG, agentes y automatizaciones para proyectos internos y de clientes. Integrar modelos y herramientas de IA en productos reales. Participar en decisiones técnicas y explorar nuevas tecnologías relacionadas con IA. ¿Qué esperamos de ti? Must Have Experiencia desarrollando proyectos o productos con IA Generativa. Buenos conocimientos de Python. Experiencia trabajando con LLMs y sistemas RAG. Familiaridad con herramientas y frameworks del ecosistema de IA (LangGraph o similares). Capacidad para aprender rápido, proponer soluciones y trabajar de forma autónoma. Nice To Have Experiencia con agentes, MCP o automatizaciones basadas en IA. Conocimientos de observabilidad y evaluación de aplicaciones de IA. Experiencia con Docker, cloud (AWS, GCP o Azure) o bases de datos vectoriales. Interés por mantenerse al día de las novedades del ecosistema de IA. ¿Qué buscamos más allá de la tecnología? Nos interesan tanto las personas como el conocimiento técnico. Buscamos perfiles curiosos, con ganas de aprender constantemente, experimentar con nuevas tecnologías y compartir conocimiento con el resto del equipo. Valoramos especialmente a quienes disfrutan resolviendo problemas complejos, cuestionando el estado actual de las cosas y proponiendo mejoras continuas. La Inteligencia Artificial evoluciona cada semana, por lo que buscamos personas cómodas en entornos dinámicos, capaces de adaptarse rápidamente y mantener una mentalidad de aprendizaje permanente. Beneficios IA como parte de tu día a día. Acceso a las últimas herramientas y modelos de IA para experimentar, automatizar y encontrar nuevas formas de trabajar mejor. Budget para formación. Presupuesto anual para seguir aprendiendo y creciendo: cursos, certificaciones, eventos, libros o herramientas que te ayuden a llevar tus skills al siguiente nivel. Mucho espacio para construir. Aquí tu job description no es una frontera. Si quieres meterte en producto, automatizaciones, growth, tecnología o cualquier otra área donde puedas aportar, queremos que lo hagas. Impacto desde el día uno. Somos un equipo pequeño construyendo algo grande. Tus ideas, decisiones y trabajo tendrán impacto directo en el producto y en cómo crece la compañía. Modelo híbrido. En esta primera etapa queremos construir un equipo unido y trabajar juntos en persona. A medida que el equipo se consolide, evolucionaremos hacia un modelo híbrido, con días de teletrabajo y mayor flexibilidad. Construye tu propio camino. Muchas de las posiciones que necesitaremos dentro de dos años todavía no existen. Si Teros crece y tú creces con nosotros, tendrás la oportunidad de convertirte en una de las personas que las lidere. Startup de verdad. Velocidad, autonomía, pocas barreras y mucha capacidad para proponer, probar y cambiar cosas. Preferimos una buena idea puesta en marcha que tres meses hablando sobre ella. ¿Te interesa? Si te apasiona la Inteligencia Artificial, disfrutas construyendo productos reales y quieres formar parte de un equipo que está apostando fuerte por crear una línea de negocio especializada en IA, estaremos encantados de conocerte :). Queremos personas que no solo utilicen herramientas de IA, sino que disfruten entendiendo cómo funcionan, cómo mejorarlas y cómo llevarlas a producción de forma robusta y escalable.

items.title: Data Scientist
items.card: What You'll Do Identify product and business opportunities by analyzing the structure, quality, and capabilities of Yext's data sources. Design data models and metrics to power innovative customer-facing features and decision-making. Lead high-impact data science and ML research from problem framing through prototyping to engineering handoff. Leverage AI-first tools and agentic workflows (e.g., Codex, Claude, Coco)
items.desc: Yext (NYSE: YEXT) is the enterprise agentic marketing platform. Built on the world's most comprehensive structured data platform for local businesses, Yext gives brands and their partners the visibility intelligence to win every moment of discovery – across AI and traditional search. Yext's API-first architecture connects structured data to APIs, MCP servers, and generative interfaces, so partners and developers can build purpose-built experiences on the same infrastructure powering Yext's own products. Thousands of brands and digital marketing partners in financial services, healthcare, retail, hospitality, and food rely on Yext to manage, measure, and optimize visibility at scale. For more information, visit yext.com. In 2024, Yext acquired Hearsay Systems, bringing together two industry leaders to form one unified organization. By combining Yext’s brand visibility expertise with Hearsay’s best-in-class compliant engagement solutions, we’re delivering even greater value to our customers. Our integrated approach unlocks a deeper set of data, insights, and recommendations — empowering brands to convert prospects into customers faster and more effectively. As an AI-first organization using modern AI and agentic workflows, we seek a Data Scientist to transform data assets into measurable business value and product capabilities by designing reliable data products, methodologies, and cross-functional features from concept to production. What You'll Do Identify product and business opportunities by analyzing the structure, quality, and capabilities of Yext's data sources. Design data models and metrics to power innovative customer-facing features and decision-making. Lead high-impact data science and ML research from problem framing through prototyping to engineering handoff. Leverage AI-first tools and agentic workflows (e.g., Codex, Claude, Coco) for efficient research, coding, and testing. Develop and evaluate statistical, ML, and GenAI/LLM solutions across structured and unstructured data. Build reproducible prototypes and validate model quality, coverage, and business impact prior to production deployment. Partner with Product, Engineering, and business stakeholders to turn ambiguous opportunities into production solutions. Collaborate with Engineering to enhance data pipelines, data quality, and overall data stack architecture. Clearly communicate findings, trade-offs, and promote evidence-based, responsible AI adoption. Mentor teammates and continuously explore emerging AI methods to boost team capabilities. What You Have 3+ years of experience in data science, machine learning, or data analytics. Proficiency in Python and SQL for data analysis, modeling, and experimentation. Solid understanding of statistics, supervised/unsupervised learning, and model validation techniques. Experience with data modeling, data warehousing, and preparing datasets for analytical and product use. Familiarity with generative AI/LLM applications (e.g., RAG, prompt engineering, agentic workflows, evaluation). AI-first mindset utilizing AI coding assistants (e.g., Codex, Claude) while ensuring quality and security. Hands-on experience in cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure). Strong problem-solving ability and comfort working independently through ambiguity. Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills. Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Engineering, Math, or equivalent practical experience. Yext is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a results-driven, engaging culture where every employee has the opportunity to contribute to the success of the Company, perform at the highest possible level, and grow their skills and capabilities. Yext welcomes employees and applicants of all backgrounds and demographics, and does not engage in discrimination on the basis of any protected characteristic recognized under applicable law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. The Company believes a broad variety of life experiences across the Yext team is critical to its mission to help every business in the world be visible everywhere customers search. By seeking out fresh perspectives and fostering a positive interview experience and employee experience, Yext can remain at the forefront of innovation, and better serve its customers. It is Yext’s policy to provide reasonable accommodations to people with disabilities as required by applicable law. If you have a disability that requires an accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, or participating in the employee selection process, please complete this form. Security Alert All legitimate Yext communications come from @yext.com email addresses. Messages from other domains (for example, @yext.team) are not authorized and are likely fraudulent. If you receive a message that seems suspicious, do not share personal information, click on links, or provide payment. …

Attività Progettare e sviluppare soluzioni basate su AI/ML e LLM (RAG, agenti, integrazione di API come OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI) Integrare le componenti AI in applicazioni e servizi backend Java (Spring Boot, microservizi, API REST) Gestire pipeline di dati, embedding e vector database Collaborare con team di sviluppo, prodotto e clienti per tradurre i bisogni di business in soluzioni concrete Curare deploy, monitoraggio e ottimizzazione dei modelli in ambienti cloud Esperienza Almeno 2 anni nello sviluppo software, con buona padronanza di Java (Spring / Spring Boot) Esperienza concreta su progetti AI/ML: Python, framework come LangChain, LlamaIndex, Spring AI, PyTorch o TensorFlow Conoscenza di LLM, prompt engineering, RAG e vector database (es. pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate) Familiarità con cloud (AWS, Azure o GCP), Docker, CI/CD e Git Laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria o discipline STEM (o esperienza equivalente) Costituiscono un plus Esperienza con Kubernetes e pratiche MLOps Conoscenza di architetture a microservizi ed event-driven (Kafka) Progetti AI open source o portfolio GitHub Sede di lavoro: Taranto (Prov.)

items.desc: Présentation de l’entreprise Cette startup early-stage, récemment financée à hauteur de plusieurs millions d'euros, redéfinit les standards de la cybersécurité en développant une plateforme souveraine d'IA offensive. Leur mission ? Transformer le test d'intrusion (pentest) en une capacité continue grâce à des agents d'IA capables de simuler des attaques réelles sur des systèmes complexes. Déjà adoptée par des leaders du marché, l'équipe est composée d'experts de l'IA et de la sécurité travaillant sur des problématiques de raisonnement et de planification autonome. Aujourd'hui, ils recherchent leur futur AI Engineer (F/H) pour bâtir l'intelligence au cœur de cette plateforme de rupture. Le Poste En tant qu'AI Engineer, tu es le concepteur des systèmes agentiques qui pilotent les offensives. Tu travailles à l'intersection du Machine Learning appliqué et de la sécurité pour permettre à des agents de raisonner, planifier et exécuter des workflows d'attaque complexes dans des environnements réels. Missions : Conception d'agents : Développer et améliorer les systèmes agentiques (raisonnement, planification, utilisation d'outils) dédiés à la sécurité offensive. Mise en production : Intégrer des LLMs et d'autres modèles dans des systèmes de production robustes et scalables. R&D Appliquée : Benchmarker et implémenter des idées de recherche pour transformer des techniques d'attaque complexes en workflows autonomes. Collaboration transverse : Travailler main dans la main avec les Software Engineers et les OffSec Engineers pour assurer la fiabilité et la performance des systèmes. Fine-tuning : Optimiser le comportement des modèles pour des tâches spécifiques de cybersécurité (un gros plus). Stack Technique : Langages : Maîtrise de Python . Frameworks : LangChain / LangGraph, SDK. Concepts : Systèmes agentiques, LLMs, RAG, évaluation de modèles. Bonus : Expérience en MLOps, bases de données vectorielles ou infrastructure Cloud. Profil recherché Expérience : 3-7 ans d'expérience dont minimum 2 en IA appliquée. Expérience probante dans la construction de systèmes IA en production (Production-grade AI systems). Une expérience préalable chez un acteur comme Mistral (même en stage) est un atout majeur. Compétences & mindset : Expertise technique : Tu possèdes une compréhension approfondie des stacks et des fondamentaux au-delà de l'usage simple d'assistants de code. Doer & Passion : Tu aimes construire à partir de zéro et tu cherches constamment à te dépasser. Problem Solver : Tu t'épanouis dans la résolution de problèmes ouverts et ambigus. Esprit d'équipe : Tu es reconnu pour tes qualités humaines et ton envie de collaborer. Formation : Diplôme d'ingénieur ou équivalent (Bac+5) obligatoire. Langues : Anglais courant indispensable pour la veille technologique et le contexte international.

items.desc: Description De L'entreprise Qui sommes-nous ? CMB Monaco est une banque privée de premier plan basée à Monaco. Fondée en 1976 par des institutions bancaires internationales et des investisseurs locaux, elle s’inscrit depuis plusieurs décennies dans une démarche d’excellence au service de la gestion de patrimoine. Forte de ses racines monégasques et de son ouverture internationale, CMB Monaco se positionne comme un acteur de référence en matière d’investissement, alliant expertise globale et ancrage local. Son offre s’articule autour de la gestion de fortune, de la gestion d’investissements et du financement, avec une gamme complète de solutions sur mesure destinées à une clientèle exigeante composée de particuliers fortunés, d’entrepreneurs et de familles. Partenaire de confiance des gérants d’actifs indépendants et des multi-family offices, la banque accompagne également des structures patrimoniales complexes. Résolument tournée vers l’avenir, CMB Monaco incarne le dynamisme de la place financière monégasque et investit activement dans des projets technologiques innovants afin d’enrichir l’expérience client. Pourquoi venir travailler chez nous ? La culture de notre établissement est ancrée dans nos valeurs fondamentales : > PACE : Passion, Agilité, Care, Excellence. Nous aimons évoluer à un rythme rapide : nous nous efforçons constamment d'innover, de trouver des moyens plus efficaces de faire notre travail et de passer d'une approche conservatrice à une approche dynamique. Vous n'avez pas besoin de rejoindre la plus grande banque pour vivre en grand. Chez CMB Monaco, vous rejoindrez des équipes diverses et inclusives qui se soutiennent mutuellement et vous donneront les moyens d'atteindre votre plein potentiel. Description Du Poste Dans le cadre d'un recrutement, nous ouvrons un poste de Analyste IA appliquée & ingéniérie des processus. Analyste IA appliquée & ingéniérie des processus Nous recherchons un candidat/candidate qui possède les compétences ci-dessous : Bac +5 en école d'ingénieurs, data science, informatique, mathématiques appliquées ou équivalent. Expérience : 5 ans d’expérience dans un poste similaire Expérience pratique des outils d'automatisation des processus, notamment Microsoft Power Automate Certification Lean Six Sigma Green Belt au minimum (Black Belt apprécié), avec realisations chiffrées Expérience démontrée des LLM en contexte professionnel : ingénierie des prompts, RAG, Evaluation, intégration par API; connaissances des architectures agentiques. Connaissance des principes de gouvernance de l'IA et de gestion du risque de modèle. Atouts : Certification Anthropic Vous Serez Amené(e) à Effectuer Les Missions Ci-dessous : Processus : modéliser les processus de bout en bout et chiffrer la situation de référence (temps de cycle, volumes). Identifier avec les utilisateurs les points de friction, conduire les chantiers d'amélioration et prioriser les cas d'usage selon la valeur, la faisabilité et le risque. Conception et déploiement de solutions d'automatisation : concevoir, prototyper et industrialiser des cas d'usage d'IA générative (assistants métiers, RAG) et des flux agentiques (API, MCP). Automatiser les traitements via les systèmes de la Banque, puis rédiger et versionner prompts, plugins, jeux de tests et critères d'évaluation. Gouvernance, risques et conformité : documenter chaque solution (cas d'usage, risques) selon le cadre de gouvernance IA de la Banque, le règlement européen sur l'IA et DORA. Travailler avec la Compliance, les Risques, la Sécurité des SI et le DPO, et suivre la production (qualité, coûts). Valeur et adoption : mesurer les gains par rapport à la situation de référence et les restituer au management. Former les utilisateurs, produire la documentation,animer le réseau de référents IA et assurer une veille technologique et réglementaire. Pour réussir dans ses missions, le candidat/la candidate devra démontrer les qualités suivantes : Rigueur, organisation et autonomie Esprit d'initiative et force de proposition. Esprit critique et capacité à identifier rapidement les incohérences Capacité à travailler en mode projet Curiosite intellectuelle et capacité d'adaptation dans un environnement en évolution permanente. Esprit d'équipe et collaboration transverse. Conditions d’embauche Statut : Cadre Langues souhaitées Réf: 99c00a54-dacd-47bc-a284-420ffea9ca3a

items.card: Vos missions ? Concevoir l'architecture des applications LLM (RAG, agents simples, chaînes de traitement) Préparer et structurer les données sources : découpage, métadonnées, indexation vectorielle Intégrer les API de modèles (OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, modèles open source) Écrire, versionner et tester les prompts Construire des jeux d'évaluation et suivre la qualité des réponses dans le temps Exposer les services
items.desc: Le contexte Depuis 2025, nous avons fait de l'IA un axe stratégique, sur deux volets complémentaires : l'adoption de l'IA par les métiers (cadrage des cas d'usage, déploiement, conduite du changement) et le développement accéléré par l'IA (agents de code, spécifications exécutables, plateformes d'agents). Nous pratiquons nous-mêmes ces méthodes au quotidien, et nous les apportons chez nos clients, d'abord en assistance technique, puis en projets que nous pilotons de bout en bout. Pour accompagner cette croissance, nous constituons notre équipe IA : des profils fonctionnels et techniques qui travailleront ensemble sur les missions de nos clients. Nos clients ne veulent plus de démonstrateurs : ils veulent des applications IA qui tournent en production, qui citent leurs sources, dont on mesure la qualité et qui s'intègrent proprement dans leur système d'information. C'est votre métier. Vous concevez et développez des applications à base de modèles de langage : assistants métier, moteurs de recherche documentaire (RAG), services d'extraction et de classification, API mises à disposition des équipes. Vous travaillez avec un Product Owner IA et, selon les missions, avec un ingénieur MLOps pour l'industrialisation. Exemples de missions Chez un prestataire de confiance numérique, construire un assistant de recherche dans les procédures de certification : ingestion de plusieurs milliers de documents, pipeline RAG avec citations, jeu d'évaluation de plus d'une centaine de questions, mise à disposition par API aux équipes support Chez un éditeur de logiciels, intégrer des fonctions d'IA générative dans un produit existant : résumé, aide à la saisie, recherche en langage naturel, avec maîtrise des coûts et des temps de réponse Vos missions ? Concevoir l'architecture des applications LLM (RAG, agents simples, chaînes de traitement) Préparer et structurer les données sources : découpage, métadonnées, indexation vectorielle Intégrer les API de modèles (OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, modèles open source) Écrire, versionner et tester les prompts Construire des jeux d'évaluation et suivre la qualité des réponses dans le temps Exposer les services par API et accompagner leur intégration dans le SI du client Et vous ? Vous avez au minimum 3 ans d'expérience en développement Python ou TypeScript, et vous avez livré au moins un projet à base de LLM en production (pas seulement un prototype). Vous savez expliquer pourquoi un RAG répond mal et comment le mesurer. La curiosité pour un domaine qui change tous les trimestres est indispensable. Stack : Python ou TypeScript, LangChain, LlamaIndex ou équivalent, bases vectorielles (pgvector, Qdrant, Weaviate, Elasticsearch), API LLM, cloud Azure, AWS ou GCP, Docker. Rejoignez-nous ! Notre société SpikeeLabs est une entreprise de services du numérique spécialisée dans la conception, le développement et l’intégration de solutions logicielles métiers. Elle conçoit des solutions logicielles durables, adaptées aux enjeux métier de ses clients et parfaitement intégrées à leurs systèmes d'information. Sa vocation : faire du numérique un levier concret et efficace au service de la performance des entreprises. Notre expertise s’articule autour de 6 piliers complémentaires : Réalisation logicielle : développement d’applications sur mesure, back-end et front-end Intégration de solutions métiers : mise en œuvre de progiciels et plateformes spécifiques Architecture & Urbanisation : conception d’architectures robustes, évolutives et sécurisées Infrastructure et Cloud : automatisation, cloud, conteneurisation, supervision, DevOps/SRE Data & IA : valorisation des données, data engineering, machine learning Design UX/UI : design d’interfaces intuitives centrées sur les usages Rejoindre SpikeeLabs, C’est Intégrer une ESN à taille humaine qui grandit vite, mais garde sa convivialité. Travailler dans une ambiance chaleureuse, exigeante mais bienveillante. Pouvoir proposer, expérimenter et contribuer activement à la vie de l’entreprise. items.desc: Le contexte Depuis 2025, nous avons fait de l'IA un axe stratégique, sur deux volets complémentaires : l'adoption de l'IA par les métiers (cadrage des cas d'usage, déploiement, conduite du changement) et le développement accéléré par l'IA (agents de code, spécifications exécutables, plateformes d'agents). Nous pratiquons nous-mêmes ces méthodes au quotidien, et nous les apportons chez nos clients, d'abord en assistance technique, puis en projets que nous pilotons de bout en bout. Pour accompagner cette croissance, nous constituons notre équipe IA : des profils fonctionnels et techniques qui travailleront ensemble sur les missions de nos clients. Nos clients ne veulent plus de démonstrateurs : ils veulent des applications IA qui tournent en production, qui citent leurs sources, dont on mesure la qualité et qui s'intègrent proprement dans leur système d'information. C'est votre métier. Vous concevez et développez des applications à base de modèles de langage : assistants métier, moteurs de recherche documentaire (RAG), services d'extraction et de classification, API mises à disposition des équipes. Vous travaillez avec un Product Owner IA et, selon les missions, avec un ingénieur MLOps pour l'industrialisation. Exemples de missions Chez un prestataire de confiance numérique, construire un assistant de recherche dans les procédures de certification : ingestion de plusieurs milliers de documents, pipeline RAG avec citations, jeu d'évaluation de plus d'une centaine de questions, mise à disposition par API aux équipes support Chez un éditeur de logiciels, intégrer des fonctions d'IA générative dans un produit existant : résumé, aide à la saisie, recherche en langage naturel, avec maîtrise des coûts et des temps de réponse Vos missions ? Concevoir l'architecture des applications LLM (RAG, agents simples, chaînes de traitement) Préparer et structurer les données sources : découpage, métadonnées, indexation vectorielle Intégrer les API de modèles (OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, modèles open source) Écrire, versionner et tester les prompts Construire des jeux d'évaluation et suivre la qualité des réponses dans le temps Exposer les services par API et accompagner leur intégration dans le SI du client Et vous ? Vous avez au minimum 3 ans d'expérience en développement Python ou TypeScript, et vous avez livré au moins un projet à base de LLM en production (pas seulement un prototype). Vous savez expliquer pourquoi un RAG répond mal et comment le mesurer. La curiosité pour un domaine qui change tous les trimestres est indispensable. Stack : Python ou TypeScript, LangChain, LlamaIndex ou équivalent, bases vectorielles (pgvector, Qdrant, Weaviate, Elasticsearch), API LLM, cloud Azure, AWS ou GCP, Docker. Rejoignez-nous ! Notre société SpikeeLabs est une entreprise de services du numérique spécialisée dans la conception, le développement et l’intégration de solutions logicielles métiers. Elle conçoit des solutions logicielles durables, adaptées aux enjeux métier de ses clients et parfaitement intégrées à leurs systèmes d'information. Sa vocation : faire du numérique un levier concret et efficace au service de la performance des entreprises. Notre expertise s’articule autour de 6 piliers complémentaires : Réalisation logicielle : développement d’applications sur mesure, back-end et front-end Intégration de solutions métiers : mise en œuvre de progiciels et plateformes spécifiques Architecture & Urbanisation : conception d’architectures robustes, évolutives et sécurisées Infrastructure et Cloud : automatisation, cloud, conteneurisation, supervision, DevOps/SRE Data & IA : valorisation des données, data engineering, machine learning Design UX/UI : design d’interfaces intuitives centrées sur les usages Rejoindre SpikeeLabs, C’est Intégrer une ESN à taille humaine qui grandit vite, mais garde sa convivialité. Travailler dans une ambiance chaleureuse, exigeante mais bienveillante. Pouvoir proposer, expérimenter et contribuer activement à la vie de l’entreprise. items.desc:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
 The Position
 Please note that we already have a pre-identified candidate for this position. 
 Global Customer Support (GCS) is the global organization responsible for best-in-class service excellence in the Diagnostics Division. GCS supports the regional and local service organizations of Roche Diagnostics by providing training, knowledge, spare parts, and digital tools to meet their needs for successful enablement of customer operations. We are the voice, and the bridge between the service teams and the Global Business teams, ensuring customer satisfaction is at the center of product designs and updates.
 Within GCS, the Digital Service Solutions (DSS) chapter is managing a state-of-the-art service and data management IT portfolio. We drive innovation by bringing together and developing highly skilled business experts, with the ability to translate complex business needs into efficient digital solutions, and run agile teams for delivery and support. To do what really matters, we co-create with customers, both internally and externally.
 For our customer-facing portfolio in digital service solutions, DSS is looking for a senior professional (m/f/d) with passion for service business and sound background in the design of advanced information systems. In this role you will orchestrate digital business transformation and oversee critical deliverables; such as business capability model and product backlog. A Senior Business Product Owner will take a leading role in bringing the vision of their respective product in the portfolio to life while finding synergies and optimizations within the entire ecosystem. 
 The opportunity:
 Leverages market landscape knowledge, innovative thinking, and automation concepts to deliver novel business solutions that enable business strategy 
 Drives innovation and efficiency of digital process chain and customer journey, end-to-end, within DSS and across product and domain boundaries
 Is accountable for Business Program related demand exploration, analysis, and roadmap delivery. Contributes to the domain roadmap plan
 Collaborates across programs and value streams, to build efficient end-to-end processes, data models or products, and ensuring functionality
 Who you are:
 Strong communication and (senior) stakeholder management skills - you are able to inspire and motivate others
 Excellent English (verbal and written)

items.desc:
ABOUT MISTRAL

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.




ABOUT THE JOB

As a Forward Software Engineer, you will build the systems behind some of the hardest problems Mistral takes on.

You join our team of engineers in Applied AI. We gravitate towards hard problems, decide how to solve them, and ship fast. You work closely with our customer-facing teams, and what works goes into production with our customers and across the company. When a project needs it, you work directly on customer engagements.

We're looking for a strong software engineer who has shipped agentic or GenAI systems to production. You've felt the pain of agents that work in the demo and fall apart on real tasks: tool calls that fail silently, loops that never end, and quality that drifts after launch. That production depth is your edge. You build across the stack, and you'd rather ship a plain UI on a solid foundation than a polished UI on a fragile one.

You think like a founder. You start from the customer's problem, not the technology. You measure success by the value you deliver, and you care about building experiences people love to use. You like working at the edge of what AI can do today, and you push past it.

Your scope is end to end, from first prototype to production. You help set the standard for how the team builds agents that are reliable, observable, and safe to run against sensitive systems.

Security is a big part of where we're heading. If you're drawn to it, that's a strong plus. You might come from security with a real interest in AI engineering, or from AI engineering with a real interest in security. Both paths fit. Curiosity about how systems break, and a habit of learning fast from the people who know the domain, matter. Experience at a security company counts too.





WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Build AI systems end to end, from first prototype to production.

 - Design the agent architecture: orchestration, tool use, memory, retrieval, and the interfaces between agents and the systems they act on.

 - Build across the stack, from backend services and APIs to the interfaces people use to work with agents.

 - Turn what works for one customer into patterns and platforms that work across many, without rebuilding each time.

 - Make systems hold up under real load: throughput, latency, cost, and failure recovery are part of the design from the start.

 - Build security into agents from day one: permissions, sandboxing, prompt-injection defenses, and audit trails for agents that touch sensitive systems.

 - Build the evaluation loop: task-level evals, tracing, and checks that catch agent failures and quality drift before customers do.

 - Work with researchers, engineers, and customer-facing teams to turn hard problems into systems people rely on.





WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - You have 5+ years building production software, with at least one agentic or GenAI system shipped to production that you ran after launch.

 - You have full ability to ship across the stack: proficient NodeJS e.g. NextJS/Express/Fastify or similar or Python e.g. FastAPI. You are confident with TypeScript + React/NextJS or similar. Solid beats polished.

 - You have hands-on depth in agent design: orchestration, tool use, retrieval, evaluation, and the ways agents fail in the real world.

 - You work autonomously: you find the problem, decide the approach, and own the outcome.

 - You communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences, and are fluent in English.

 - You ship in increments and are obsessed with time to value

 - You have product judgment: you learn what users need through customer-facing teams, cut scope hard, and care how the result feels to use.




IDEALLY YOU HAVE

 - Open-source contributions, particularly in agents or LLMs.

 - Experience deploying and running what you build: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and AWS, GCP, or Azure.

 - A security background in application, cloud, or AI security, such as prompt injection, securing agents, or supply chain (SBOM, SLSA). If that's you, flag it in your application.

 - Experience building for security workflows, such as alert triage, threat hunting, or investigation agents, or with SIEM, XDR, or SOAR tooling.

 Windows + Devices (W+D) is hiring Software Engineers in Dublin across two teams that share a commitment to making Windows a trusted, intelligent, and reliable platform for customers, enterprises, and partners worldwide.

The team builds innovative, AI-driven solutions that enable product agility, enterprise-scale automation, intelligent decision systems, trustworthy development, and responsible AI use. This is Adyen 
 Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition. 
 For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster. 
 Senior Software Engineer - Java Application Core Components (JACC) 
 Adyen provides a global, unified platform built by Java application teams across the company. The Java Application Core Components (JACC) team plays a key role in this: we build and maintain the shared frameworks and components that define how other Adyen teams design, structure, and deploy their Java applications.
 As part of JACC, you will build and maintain the core Java tools and components used across all of Adyen, shaping how other engineering teams build their services. You'll work on some of the largest ongoing efforts in the company, including 3 large-scale migrations that will shape the future of Adyen's application architecture. You'll join a lean team of 6 Java experts, working in a Kanban-like way with minimal process overhead, and gain real influence over the architecture of one of the leading players in the payments space.
 What you will do 
 Design, build, and evolve the internal and open source Java frameworks and components used by every Java application team at Adyen.
 Play an active role in one or more of the team's 3 large-scale migrations that are reshaping Adyen's application architecture.
 Provide hands-on technical guidance to other engineering teams, by guiding them on how the frameworks and libraries we provide can be used to solve Adyen's business problems.
 Design and evolve workflows used by other engineering teams across Adyen, working closely with them to identify pain points and improvement opportunities.
 Collaborate with partner platform teams (Kubernetes infrastructure, deployment, security) to make sure our components integrate well across Adyen's tech stack.
 Advocate for best practices across Adyen and define boundaries/guidance on how the frameworks/libraries we maintain can be used. This should be achieved by creating code validation rules, running workshops and giving presentations to other development teams.
 What you bring 
 7+ years of experience with Java backend development
 Strong skills in core Java and code/API design
 Track record of building high-quality software, with testing at all levels
 A communicative, proactive team player who takes ownership, is decisive under ambiguity, and can act as a technical influencer with a multiplier mindset
 Comfortable being a driver: able to build alignment with stakeholders and partners while pushing initiatives for our customers
 Nice to have 
 Experience with Kubernetes/cloud migrations, legacy application modernization, security-related work or platform development experience
 Experience developing and maintaining libraries/frameworks used by many other developers (either open source or internal)
 Experience with build tools, ideally for Java (Gradle/Maven)
 Broader architecture sense across distributed systems
 Familiarity with Spring, Jersey, Feign, OpenAPI
 Understanding of Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and Test-Driven Development (TDD)
 Exposure to AI agent workflows and a DevOps mindset
 Developer advocacy experience: public speaking or training/facilitation skills
 Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments 
 Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen. 
 Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application! 
 What’s next? 
 Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here . Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility. 
 This role is based out of our Amsterdam office. We are an office-first company and value in-person collaboration; we do not offer remote-only roles.

items.desc: AI-First Senior PHP Developer Avrillo | Remote (UK-based) The short version Avrillo is a conveyancing firm that builds its own technology. We don't bolt software onto legal processes, we rebuild how conveyancing works from the ground up, using AI as a core part of how we develop and how our platform operates. We're looking for a Senior PHP Developer to join our established development team and help us continue transforming one of the most paper-heavy, frustrating industries in the UK. You'll work on real systems that are live today, processing documents, verifying identities, integrating with lenders and estate agents, not prototypes or proof-of-concepts. Full AI-assisted development is already how we work. We're looking for someone who operates the same way. What you'd actually be working on We're mid-journey on a significant platform evolution. You'd be joining a team that's actively delivering: CRM and case management rebuild — migrating away from legacy systems to something we own and control AML and compliance automation — source of funds verification, identity checks, fraud detection, integrating with leading providers Document intelligence — processing, extracting, and understanding legal documents at scale Third-party integrations — estate agent portals, lender APIs, payment systems This isn't theoretical. These systems handle real transactions for real clients, every day. What "AI-driven" means here AI isn't a line item on our roadmap, it's embedded in how we build. We use AI-assisted development workflows as standard. We integrate LLMs and automation into the platform itself, document processing, decision support, compliance checks. If you're already working this way and have opinions about how to do it well, you'll fit right in. The team You'd be joining a small, close development team that owns what it builds. We're not a tech department serving "the business", we're part of the same thing. Developers here have direct input into what we build and why. You'd work alongside teammates covering Laravel, Vue, integrations, and infrastructure. You will report to the Team Lead, who'll be your main point of contact day-to-day. What we're looking for Technically: Production experience in AI-assisted development and LLM integration Strong PHP and Laravel experience (5+ years) Comfortable with Vue.js or willing to get there Strong Architectural skills, planning for the future not just the present Experience with APIs, integrations, and working with third-party systems Familiarity with AWS or similar cloud environments Mindset: You take ownership. When something needs doing, you do it. You're comfortable with ambiguity. We're building the plane while flying it, you won't always have a spec. You communicate clearly. We're a remote team, writing well and speaking up matters. You care about quality but also about shipping. Pragmatism over perfectionism. What we offer Fully remote (UK-based) 25 days holiday Contributory pension Private healthcare Death in service insurance AIG Smart Health app Who this probably isn't for If you want a role where requirements are handed to you fully formed, tickets are perfectly groomed, and you can work in isolation, this won't suit you. If you're energised by building something that matters, working closely with a team that gives a damn, and seeing your work go live and make a difference, let's talk. Apply now — or reach out if you want to chat first. We are committed to making reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process and welcome applications from all candidates. To help ensure the recruitment process is accessible and that you can participate fully, please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments, equipment, software, or support for the interview, or if you are successful, for the role. As an equal opportunities employer, we will consider any such requests and discuss them with you as needed. For context, the role operates between 8am and 5pm, Monday to Friday. The earlier start allows time to prepare before client communications begin and to participate in internal support and team discussions. Client-facing communication is managed within structured timeframes during the day, which helps protect your time, reduce interruptions, and manage client expectations effectively. The role also involves speaking with clients over Teams using video as part of delivering our service. If there are any practical issues with this or the way the role is structured, please let us know. Job Types: Full-time, Permanent Work Location: Remote

items.desc: We’re looking for an (Senior) Analytics Engineer to join Knowit’s Services team. In this role, you’ll combine business understanding with practical data platform development, working with our clients and helping shape Knowit’s own internal data platform. You might already be a senior professional or ready to take the next step towards that level. What matters most is your ability to understand business needs, translate them into technical solutions and take those solutions into practice. What the role is about You’ll join a close team of seven professionals whose expertise spans data engineering, data modelling and BI. We work together across client accounts, sharing knowledge and helping each other solve problems. Our way of working brings continuity to client relationships and gives you colleagues who understand the context of your work. Our clients typically need broad support: from clarifying a business problem to integrating source data, building data models and making the results usable. You’ll work across several accounts, with your responsibilities shaped by your strengths and the clients’ needs. We develop data platforms in close cooperation with our maintenance colleagues. Your focus will be on developing and improving solutions, with an understanding of how they can be maintained over time. Alongside client work, roughly half of your role will focus on developing Knowit’s internal data platform. Here, you’ll work closely with technical colleagues and business stakeholders, helping identify development needs and turn them into working solutions. Your work could include: Discussing business needs with stakeholders and identifying the problems worth solving. Building and improving data pipelines , source integrations and maintaining cloud data platforms . Designing data models and semantic and context layers that give data a clear, shared business meaning. Developing data applications with Streamlit and making data accessible through suitable analytics tools. Developing our internal platform , particularly with Snowflake and dbt, alongside Tableau. Exploring and implementing capabilities for AI applications and agents , including Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations and capabilities within Snowflake. Building data platforms for analytics and AI Our development direction is towards platforms that serve a wider range of uses, including AI applications and agents alongside reporting and dashboards. For you, this means thinking about how data should be structured, described and made accessible so it can support both today’s business questions and emerging use cases. Semantic modelling is an important part of this work: helping people and applications interpret data consistently. You don’t need to arrive with all the answers. We’re looking for curiosity, sound technical judgement and a willingness to develop these approaches together with the team. What do we expect from you? You have several years of relevant experience in analytics engineering, data engineering or a similar role combining business needs with technical delivery. You’re comfortable taking responsibility for your work, asking questions and involving colleagues when their expertise will help. We’re particularly interested in: Business understanding and stakeholder collaboration . You can explore the need behind a request, clarify requirements and explain technical choices to different audiences. Strong practical data modelling skills . You can turn source data and business concepts into clear, maintainable models. Experience with semantic and context modelling is especially valuable. Experience with modern cloud data platforms , such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery or Fabric. Experience with data transformation and modelling tools . We use dbt extensively, so hands-on experience is valuable. A strong modelling background and readiness to learn dbt also give you a good foundation. Familiarity with Git and CI/CD practices , and a basic understanding of AWS and/or Azure . An interest in developing data applications, including working with Streamlit. Good communication skills in English. Finnish is welcome, but it is not required. You’ll likely enjoy this role if you like variety, working closely with business stakeholders and following a solution from the initial question through to implementation. We also value experience with integration tools such as Fivetran, Frends or native AWS and Azure components, as well as established BI tools such as Tableau or Power BI or YAML-based ones such as Lightdash or dbt charts. What do we offer you? At Knowit, we value broad expertise as well as the willingness to explore and master new areas. We take pride in our hands-on way of working and our deep technical expertise. And because we don't want this to be just a one-sided wish list, we want you to have the opportunity to shape your role as an expert and take ownership of your professional development, with our support. Everyone is welcome to be …

items.desc: About us We are Valis - a company building an institutional AI operating layer for mid-market companies: shared company memory, workflow mining and agentic automation. Why this role exists Product Designer owns the end-to-end experience of Valis: from the first time a CEO sees it, through the admin setting it up, to the moment an employee uses it every day. What you will do Customer journey Map the journey for each type of user: CEO and founder, client admin, end user, and our own deployment team. Keep it current as the product changes. Sit in on client rollouts and install sessions. Watch real people use the product, and turn what you see into clear, prioritised problems for engineering. Define and track experience metrics with the product and deployment teams: activation, adoption, time to first value. Product design Design the core surfaces end to end: the desktop app (daily brief, meetings library, calendar, chat), the mobile app and the admin panel. Design the onboarding: first install, connecting data sources, first useful answer. Write specs and prototypes that engineers and AI agents can build from directly. Review what ships, and send it back when the experience is not right. Questions we have heard: “Why can I only hide a task, not close it?”, “How do I switch between my personal and company workspace?”, “What changed in the app since I last opened it?” Design system Build the Valis design system from scratch, so engineers and their AI agents produce a consistent interface without a design review on every change. Keep it in the codebase, not only in Figma. The agents need to be able to use it. Product communication Own how the product talks to users: in-app notifications, release notes, user guides and trainings. Tailor them to the reader: a CEO needs to see which of their problems a release solves, and an employee needs to know what changed in their app. Requirements Must have 7+ years in product design, including 3+ years owning the experience of a B2B SaaS product end to end, not a single feature inside a large team. A portfolio that shows complex products made simple: data-heavy tools, admin and permission flows, desktop and mobile apps. Strong in both UX and UI: research, journey mapping, information architecture, and high-quality visual and interaction design. You have built a design system from scratch and got engineers to adopt it. You have designed onboarding and in-product communication, and can show the effect in numbers. Hands-on with AI tools in daily work: you prototype with Claude, Claude Code or similar, and write specs an agent can execute. You use them yourself, not only read about them. You shape the product rather than wait for a brief. The product changes daily. Fluent English. Nice to have Experience designing AI-native products: assistants, agents, chat, generated content. Prototyping in code (React / TypeScript), working in GitHub alongside engineers. Experience with enterprise users: admins, IT, security and access settings. Good working knowledge of RU language Benefits We offer competitive base, performance-based bonus, and the opportunity to join the team during fast growth.

items.desc: Deine Rolle Gutes Design bemerkt man meistens erst, wenn es fehlt: beim Bestellprozess, der sich zieht, oder im Portal, in dem niemand findet, was er sucht. Als Experience Designer bei Turbine Kreuzberg sorgst du dafür, dass es gar nicht so weit kommt. Du gestaltest, wie Menschen mit Software arbeiten, in B2B-Commerce-Plattformen, Kundenportalen, PIM- und Content-Systemen oder internen Tools. Unser Leitmotiv heißt »From Intent to Code«. Mit AI und Agentic Engineering setzen wir neue Capabilities auf bestehende Systeme und machen aus einer Absicht früh lauffähige Software. Du gestaltest, wie Menschen diese Capabilities erleben und nutzen, und siehst deine Ideen schnell im Code und vor echten Nutzer:innen. Dabei arbeitest du im Team mit Consultants, Engineers und Architekt:innen. Deine Arbeit vertrittst du vor dem Dev-Team genauso überzeugend wie vor dem Vorstand. Deine Aufgaben Design-Verantwortung: Du übernimmst die Experience in Kundenprojekten oder Workstreams und führst sie eigenständig vom ersten Problemverständnis bis zum Go-live. User Research: Du gehst zu den Menschen, die die Software später nutzen: in Interviews, Usability-Tests und vor Ort. Was du dort lernst, verdichtest du zu Insights, mit denen ein Team arbeiten kann. Discovery & Workshops: Du holst Fachbereiche, Management und Engineering an einen Tisch und machst aus einer unklaren Lage eine klare Fragestellung. Experience-Konzeption: Du übersetzt komplexe B2B-Prozesse in Journeys, Informationsarchitekturen und User Flows, die einfach wirken, obwohl sie es nicht sind. UI Design & Prototyping: Du gestaltest Interfaces, arbeitest mit Design Systems und baust Prototypen, gern auch code-nah mit AI-Tools. AI-Experiences: Du gestaltest AI-gestützte Funktionen so, dass Menschen ihnen vertrauen und sie gern nutzen. Umsetzungsbegleitung: Du bleibst bis zum Schluss dran, im Handover, bei Akzeptanzkriterien und in der Design-QA mit unseren Engineers. New Business: Du erkennst, wo bei Auftraggeber mehr möglich ist, und hilfst, daraus neue Projekte zu machen. Was du mitbringst Erfahrung: Du hast mindestens 5 Jahre als Experience, UX, Product oder Service Designer gearbeitet, am besten in einer Beratung oder einem Produktteam. Erfahrung mit Commerce-, PIM- oder Content-Plattformen ist ein Plus. Portfolio: Dein Portfolio zeigt den Weg vom Problem zur umgesetzten Lösung und was diese Lösung bewirkt hat. Konzeptionsstärke: Verschachtelte Abläufe und Datenmodelle reizen dich, weil am Ende etwas Einfaches daraus werden soll. Gestaltungsqualität: Typografie, visuelle Hierarchie und Barrierefreiheit (WCAG) beherrschst du, Figma sowieso. Technologieverständnis: Du verstehst genug von Frontend, APIs und Design Tokens, um mit Engineers über Machbarkeit zu sprechen. AI Fluency: Du nutzt AI täglich in Research, Synthese und Prototyping und weißt, wo ihre Grenzen liegen. Präsentation & Storytelling: Deine Decks bringen komplexe Inhalte auf eine Story, die im Workshop überzeugt und im Pitch gewinnt. Ownership: Du wartest nicht auf das perfekte Briefing. Du fragst nach, machst Risiken sichtbar und bringst die Arbeit voran. Check, check, check… Halt! Du erfüllst nicht alle Kriterien – oder einfach andere? Lass dich davon nicht abhalten. Entscheidend sind deine Neugier, dein Urteilsvermögen und deine Fähigkeit, AI in echte Ergebnisse zu übersetzen. Wir freuen uns auf die Möglichkeit, neue Skills zu lernen und beizubringen. Das erwartet dich bei uns AI mit Wirkung: Du verbindest Beratung, Pitches und implementierte AI-Lösungen mit messbaren Geschäftsergebnissen. Consulting und Engineering als Einheit: Du arbeitest mit Consultants, Engineers, Architekt:innen und den Teams unserer Auftraggeber an Lösungen, die funktionieren. Zwei plus drei: Hybrides Arbeiten mit zwei Tagen im Office in Berlin und drei Tagen flexibel. Frischer Wind für deine Ideen: In unseren Breakout- und Hackout-Sessions entwickelst du neue Ideen und testest neue Wege. Meerblick statt Bürowand: Pack deinen Laptop ein und arbeite eine Zeit lang aus unserer Agentur-Wohnung in Faro, Portugal. Wachse über dich hinaus: Wir geben dir Zeit und Budget für deine persönliche Weiterbildung. Fit bleiben, wie du willst: Wir bezuschussen deine Mitgliedschaft im Urban Sports Club Exklusive Vorteile: Über unser Corporate-Benefits-Programm bekommst du Rabatte bei vielen bekannten Marken. items.desc: About Agent F Agent F is building an autonomous finance function: software that takes on the work of keeping a company’s finances in order. That means bringing information together from different systems, recording transactions correctly, preparing useful reports, and helping people understand what needs their attention. Today, much of this work depends on spreadsheets, repeated data entry and people checking one system against another. Our ambition is to make that work increasingly automatic, while keeping every number explainable and every consequential action under clear control. We are building towards a complete business management system for growing companies. These founding roles will shape both the product and the way we build it. About the role You will own how customers experience Agent F, from landing pages and product demonstrations through onboarding and migration to the work they do every day. A founder looking at their finances for the first time and a controller investigating a discrepancy need different levels of detail. Both should understand where they are, what a number means and what to do next. This combines product design with hands-on front-end engineering. You will talk to customers, shape the journey, design the interactions and ship them in the product. You will use AI coding agents to help implement changes, and take responsibility for reviewing the code and checking the finished experience. Your work will connect the product into a coherent whole: consistent navigation, familiar controls and clear explanations across features. You will also own the steps that turn an interested visitor into an active, paying customer. What you will build and improve An engaging path from first interest to a useful result. Connect landing pages and product demonstrations to sign-up, account setup and the first session so a customer understands what to provide and what they will get back. Measure where people abandon the process and address the causes. A migration experience people can follow. Help customers bring in their history from accounting software or spreadsheets. Make upload progress, missing information, validation errors and next steps understandable. A consistent product experience. Develop the design language, navigation and reusable components used across the product. Make tables, forms and reports behave predictably, including loading, empty and error states. Useful decision screens. Design views that help customers compare recommendations, understand costs and choose what happens next. Our planned evidence board brings this information together as customers describe their needs. Interfaces that earn trust. Help users see where a figure came from, understand a proposed change and review it before approval. Include accessibility, keyboard use and clear language in the implementation. Improvements grounded in actual use. Keep up with the customer pipeline, from interested prospects to customers onboarding or migrating. Observe customer sessions and work with the customer-facing team. Turn recurring questions into product changes, then check whether those changes helped. For example, a customer uploads a file and sees a different total from the one they expected. You would design the journey that explains what was imported, what needs checking and how to resolve the difference, working with the data engineer on the underlying evidence. What you bring You have five or more years of experience designing and shipping software, including business-to-business software sold as a service (B2B SaaS). You may come from product design with strong engineering skills, or from front-end engineering with substantial design ownership. You can show a product journey you improved, explain the choices you made and describe the effect on customers. You have owned an onboarding, activation or conversion measure: whether people got started, reached a useful result or became paying customers. Core experience Product design across information architecture, interaction design and visual design. Production front-end work with React, TypeScript, CSS and reusable components, including reviewing and debugging code generated by agents. Building or maintaining a design system that other people use. Customer research, usability testing and product analytics that inform what you ship. Daily use of AI coding agents, with a clear approach to specifications, review and verification. Clear written explanations of design decisions and their trade-offs. Useful additional experience Financial software, complex tables and dashboards, or products where people need to inspect the source of a result. Experience with configuration-driven interfaces, where shared rules and data determine how a screen is assembled, would also be useful. items.desc: Meet the Team Cisco Collaboration Design is defining the next generation of product experiences across hardware and software. We are a global, cross-disciplinary team of designers, researchers and technologists who care deeply about how people work together and how our products can make collaboration better. Our work spans collaboration devices, software and intelligent workplace experiences, with particular attention to the administrators who enable, manage and support them and the people who use them every day. We’re committed to a creative, supportive design culture where you can experiment, learn and do meaningful, impactful work. Designers contribute across products and experience areas as priorities evolve, bringing different strengths to a shared design practice. Your Impact We are looking for a Product Designer who can bring clarity to complex systems and work closely with product and engineering to turn user needs, technical constraints and product strategy into intuitive, reliable, scalable and accessible experiences. You will help shape the future of the intelligent workplace, making it easier for administrators to enable effective collaboration while delivering useful, coherent experiences for end users. In this role, you will: Design end-to-end experiences across collaboration devices, software and intelligent workplace services, including the workflows administrators use to enable, manage and support collaboration. Understand how multiple data sources connect to create meaningful experiences. Partner with product managers, engineers, architects, researchers and other designers to define user journeys, interaction models and implementation-ready designs for administrators and end users. Explore how AI-assisted and agentic workflows can improve collaboration and workplace experiences while reducing friction and preserving user trust and control. Showcase how you use emerging technologies and AI tools for design exploration, prototyping and research synthesis, applying human judgment in close collaboration with engineering. Create prototypes at the right level of fidelity, from quick explorations to detailed concepts for team alignment, usability testing and engineering handoff. Use Cisco’s design system to create consistent experiences, identifying gaps and contributing patterns across device, workplace and administrator workflows. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s degree with 5+ years of related experience or a master’s degree with 3+ years of related experience, or equivalent related work experience. A portfolio or work samples demonstrating product design projects, including user insights, interaction flows, individual contribution and evaluation of proposed solutions. Experience working end-to-end within the design process from exploration to launch and iteration using Figma and any additional design tools. Experience working with product management and engineering on product design projects. Preferred Qualifications Experience designing for collaboration devices, workplace technology or experiences spanning desktop, web, mobile and connected hardware. Experience with enterprise administrator workflows, such as deployment, configuration, management, monitoring or support. Experience designing AI-assisted workflows, automation or intelligent recommendations, with attention to user understanding, trust and control. Ability to frame user problems, explain design decisions and build agreement through feedback and collaboration. Strong interaction design skills, with experience translating complex information and system behavior into clear workflows, interfaces and visualizations Collab Hiring Why Cisco? At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Own your software in production. That includes monitoring, fixing defects, investigating incidents and learning from how the system behaves in production. Use CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code so deployments and recoveries are repeatable and safe. Prefer small batches and short feedback loops. Coach and mentor engineers through code reviews, pair programming and design discussions. Encourage open, constructive technical debate. Use AI tools across design, coding, testing, debugging and refactoring. Review AI-generated work critically before accepting it. items.card: At Cerrion, we’re building the future of AI-enabled manufacturing. Headquartered in Zurich with more than $25M in funding from Creandum, Y Combinator, and top Silicon Valley investors, we’re building the industrial AI platform to deploy AI Agents that can see what’s happening on the production floor, automatically spot problems, and instantly intervene to keep lines running smoothly, at scale. Our technology is live
items.desc: At Cerrion, we’re building the future of AI-enabled manufacturing. Headquartered in Zurich with more than $25M in funding from Creandum, Y Combinator, and top Silicon Valley investors, we’re building the industrial AI platform to deploy AI Agents that can see what’s happening on the production floor, automatically spot problems, and instantly intervene to keep lines running smoothly, at scale. Our technology is live in factories across 18+ countries, helping leading manufacturers in glass, beverage, food, CPG, building materials, and wood cut downtime by up to 50%. We are looking for an independent Installation Engineer to work with us on a long-term B2B contract. The Opportunity You are the person who gets our AI camera systems installed right. Working from Poland, you travel to customer sites (glass plants, food factories, packaging facilities), lead the installation, and make sure every deployment meets our technical standard. You also help build the playbook: site documentation, floor plans, cable routing standards, and installation checklists that can be reused across future deployments. Most of the work happens hands-on in the field, with frequent international travel, mainly across Europe and occasionally to the US. You have seen most of what can go wrong on an industrial site. When a cable goes missing at a factory in the US, you drive to the nearest electrical shop and solve it. This is a contract engagement for an established professional running your own business (JDG or equivalent). You own your installations from the first site visit to the final debrief, organize your own work, and invoice Cerrion monthly for your services. Travel and accommodation costs for deployments are included in your invoice. Scope of Work Lead on-site installations: install cameras and hardware at industrial facilities, mainly across Europe with occasional projects in the US. Deliver to standard: complete each installation to Cerrion’s technical specification and share learnings that improve future deployments. Build the playbook: produce installation documentation, including floor plans, cable schematics, and configuration notes, plus reusable checklists. Optimize the process: spot inefficiencies in how installations are done today and propose better hardware solutions. Coordinate on site: work with local contractors and facility engineers, and solve logistical and technical problems independently, from sourcing materials locally to adapting mounting solutions. Report back: debrief after each deployment on what worked, what didn’t, and what to improve. We’d love to hear from you if You run your own registered business in Poland (JDG or equivalent) and can invoice on a B2B basis. You are a licensed electrician, certified to work in electrical cabinets operating above 24V (e.g. SEP G1 E). This is mandatory. It is a legal and safety requirement for our deployments. You bring 5+ years of hands-on electrical or field installation experience. You can read and produce floor plans and wiring diagrams. You are resourceful and independent, and solve problems on the ground without needing every next step spelled out. You are comfortable with everyday collaboration tools: shared spreadsheets, project trackers, and Slack. You are available for frequent international travel. You speak and write fluent English. Nice-to-Have Experience in manufacturing, automation, or building systems. German, Spanish, or French. Why work with Cerrion Impact: Every camera you mount and cable you route powers AI Agents running on real production lines in factories across 18+ countries. Steady, long-term work: A growing deployment pipeline across Europe and the US, with your scope growing as our footprint grows. Compensation: Competitive B2B rate, invoiced monthly, with travel costs covered through your invoice. Autonomy: You plan your own work around agreed project timelines, with minimal bureaucracy. Team: Collaborate with AI PhDs, ex-Googlers, and serial entrepreneurs from around the world.

You will find the root cause and then fix the structural problem so it doesn't come back. Strong command of at least one general-purpose language ( Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Java/Apex or PHP ) and willingness to learn others quickly. Experience designing and consuming REST/GraphQL APIs , webhooks and asynchronous processes, and handling their failure modes. Experience with design of automated solutions, special machines or test benches is a benefit Ideally, experience in several different phases: design, build, integration, test, and operation. Good communication skills, proactive attitude, and problem-solving skills. The ability to work to strict timescales as part of an integrated, multidisciplinary team and autonomously.
