items.desc: About the Role The Destinus engineering team is looking for a highly motivated and hands-on mechanical engineer capable of delivering engineering solutions as part of the research and development in the rocket motor department. In this role you will design and develop automated solutions for production. The ideal candidate will have at least 3 years of experience as a mechanical engineer with experience in automation projects, mechanical design and DFM with a demonstrated ability to take ownership during development and drive technical solutions. Responsibilities Take the technical lead for the automation and special machines development Review product designs from a production point of view Understand and evaluate the production steps and automation possibilities Research existing off-the-shelf components and combine them to an automation solution Design and prototype special machines and automation solutions that replace manual production processes and plan their manufacturing. Create 3D CAD models, drawings, BOMs, and the documentation needed for manufacturing, integration, and testing. Document your design decisions with clear calculations, analyses, and assumptions. Work with suppliers and manufacturers to answer technical questions and resolve issues during production. Select standard parts, fasteners, equipment, and consumables according to best practices and industry standards. Commission finished machines and hand them over to our production team. Coach junior engineers and interns in mechanical design, manufacturing, and CAD. Take part in design reviews and technical discussions throughout development. Work closely with mechanical, automation and testing engineers to ensure the machines integrate and function reliably. Requirements Qualifications and Experience BSc in Mechanical Engineering, Design Engineering, or a related field. Technical training as a mechanical designer or drafter (preferred). At least 3 years of mechanical engineering experience with close ties to automation. Experience designing automated solutions, special machines, or test benches (an advantage). Experience across several project phases: design, build, integration, test, and operation (preferred). Strong communication skills, a proactive attitude, and a problem-solving mindset. Ability to meet tight deadlines, both independently and within a multidisciplinary team. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, fast-changing environment. Willingness to travel to Destinus sites in Switzerland (up to 20%). Fluent English and German.

items.desc: The closing date is 20th Nov 2026 Job summary Medina Healthcare is looking for an enthusiastic Advanced Clinical Practitioner Nurse Lead to act as a senior clinical and professional lead responsible for delivering high-quality, patient-centred care with a focus on frailty, complex care, long term conditions, prevention and proactive care. This role combines expert autonomous clinical practice with operational, professional and strategic nursing leadership. You will work as an advanced autonomous practitioner, undertaking comprehensive assessment, diagnosis, treatment, prescribing and management of patients with acute, chronic and complex health needs across primary and community settings. You will provide expert clinical decision making, lead multidisciplinary care planning, work collaboratively with GPs, consultants, community teams, social care and voluntary sector partners to improve patient outcomes and reduce avoidable hospital admissions. As Nurse Lead, you will provide visible professional leadership to nursing and clinical staff, supporting development, quality improvement, governance, education and service transformation. You'll lead the development of innovative models of care that support population health management, integrated care, frailty pathways, virtual wards, care homes and proactive management of high-risk patients.You will ensure the service demonstrates the highest standards of clinical excellence, patient safety and governance while creating a positive, compassionate and learning focused culture. About us Hampshire and Isle of Wight Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust is a newly established organisation, bringing together expertise from across mental health, learning disabilities, community, and physical health services. We are dedicated to delivering compassionate, high-quality, and accessible care to the diverse communities of Hampshire and the Isle of Wight. With over 13,000 dedicated staff working across more than 300 sites, we place patients and staff at the centre of everything we do. Our goal is to create an integrated healthcare system that improves accessibility and ensures more consistent care for patients. By working together, we aim to improve patient outcomes, drive innovation, and meet the unique needs of the populations we serve. Our Trust unites services from Southern Health, Solent NHS Trust, Isle of Wight NHS Trusts community and mental health teams, as well as Hampshire CAMHS, originally part of Sussex Partnership NHS Foundation Trust. This transformation enables us to deliver more seamless care across the region, ensuring that patients receive the right support, in the right place, at the right time. Join us as we embark on this exciting journey to shape the future of healthcare across Hampshire and the Isle of Wight. We are deeply committed to our CARE values of compassion, accountability, respect, and excellence, and offer outstanding opportunities for career development, training, and collaborative working. items.title: AI/ML Engineer
items.card: Привіт! Ми OBRIO — команда, яка завжди хоче більшого: від себе, від життя, від роботи. Якщо тобі теж замало «достатньо добре» — ти вже розумієш, про що ми. Тут сильні люди притягують сильних — і разом ми розвиваємо компанію, що будує продукт № 1 у ніші spiritual wellness — Nebula. Зараз ми шукаємо AI Engineer до Tech команди. Ти будуватимеш внутрішні AI-рішення з нуля — від архітектури до продакшену. Твої системи
items.desc: Привіт! Ми OBRIO — команда, яка завжди хоче більшого: від себе, від життя, від роботи. Якщо тобі теж замало «достатньо добре» — ти вже розумієш, про що ми. Тут сильні люди притягують сильних — і разом ми розвиваємо компанію, що будує продукт № 1 у ніші spiritual wellness — Nebula. Зараз ми шукаємо AI Engineer до Tech команди. Ти будуватимеш внутрішні AI-рішення з нуля — від архітектури до продакшену. Твої системи напряму впливатимуть на ефективність команд, що працюють з 70M+ користувачами по всьому світу. Це не підтримка і не супровід — це реальна розробка, яка формує фундамент AI в компанії. У команді ти працюватимеш разом з Антоном Водолазьким (СТО OBRIO). Працюючи напряму з ним, ти матимеш реальний вплив на технічну стратегію продукту, швидкі рішення та можливість будувати AI-рішення на рівні бізнесу. Які виклики тебе чекають? Побудувати внутрішні AI-рішення з нуля . Перетворювати бізнес-запити команд у ефективні LLM-архітектури (RAG, embeddings, vector search). Закласти фундамент AI-інфраструктури, яка зростатиме разом із бізнесом. Твій вплив ми бачимо в: Скороченні часу команд на рутинні задачі завдяки AI-автоматизації процесів. Формуванні AI як реального бізнес-інструменту, а не експерименту. Створенні довгострокової цінності — AI-систем, які напряму впливають на ефективність компанії. Підвищенні швидкості прийняття рішень через кращий доступ до даних і знань. Що сприяє твоєму успіху у цій ролі? Ти маєш 1+ рік досвіду у розробці та інтеграції AI/LLM-рішень Ти реалізовував RAG, embedding-процеси або налаштовував векторні БД Ти розбираєшся в LLM, prompt engineering і контекстному менеджменті Володієш Python та/або JavaScript Маєш досвід із LangChain, PydanticAI, LlamaIndex або схожими фреймворками Працював з N8N, Diffy чи іншими automation/оркестраційними платформами Володієш знаннями класичних ML-алгоритмів (Regression, Tree-based, Clustering) Розумієш основи MLOps, CI/CD, контейнеризації Впевнено читаєш технічну документацію, API, працюєш із логами та observability. Що ти отримаєш в OBRIO? Свободу у форматі роботи — можливість працювати з офісу в Києві, Львові, Варшаві або remote, з підтримкою надкомфортних умов у трьох містах. Сильне середовище для зростання — 75% команди формують Middle та Senior спеціалісти, тож ти швидко зростаєш через складні задачі та сильних колег. Підтримку фізичного та ментального ресурсу — участь в OBRIO Wellness Club або покриття індивідуальних занять спортом та Spiritual Allowance для твого балансу (дивись, як це працює в нас). AI Workation — до 5 робочих днів на квартал, які ти можеш повністю присвятити створенню масштабованих AI-інструментів. Час на відновлення — 20 оплачуваних днів відпустки, необмежені лікарняні та можливість sabbatical leave. Щоб досягати якнайкращих результатів потрібно якнайкраще почуватись. Причетність до соціально важливих ініціатив — участь у благодійних проєктах, волонтерстві та підтримці мобілізованих колег і їхніх сімей. Один з наших проєктів OBRIO Innovation Space x КПІ нещодавно номінований на DOU Awards. Інвестиції у твій професійний розвиток — окремий бюджет на навчання, менторство та участь у топових українських і міжнародних конференціях (IT Arena, DOU Days, Web Summit, TikTok & Meta Summits). Круті колаборації — об’єднуємось з українськими брендами (СЕНС, Matcher, Syndicat, KURAZH) і даруємо стильний OBRIO-мерч не лише з нагоди святкових дат. Ми — OBRIO, продуктова IT-компанія з екосистеми Genesis, яка створює Nebula — найбільший spirituality бренд із 70M+ користувачів. З вісьмох ентузіастів ми виросли у команду з 300+ професіоналів, які створюють рішення, що впливають на життя людей у всьому світі. OBRIO — Lovemark brand з найвищим eNPS за версією Forbes. За 7+ років наш продукт Nebula виріс з ідеї у платформу і став частиною життя мільйонів користувачів у понад 60 країнах. На платформі працюють 1500+ експертів. Ми створили складну операційну модель і щодня обробляємо тисячі запитів від користувачів по всьому світу. Амбіція OBRIO — стати першим українським юнікорном у ніші spirituality. Як виглядає наш наймаючий процес: Інтро-кол з TA Specialist ➡️ Тестове завдання ➡️ Технічне інтерв’ю з СТО ➡️ Job Offer Do Big. Be Great.

items.desc: A propos d’Atos Atos est la marque d’Atos Group dédiée aux services numériques de bout en bout, sécurisés et accélérés par l’IA. Atos conçoit, développe et opère des environnements numériques essentiels à la performance, à la résilience et à la souveraineté. L’entreprise aide les organisations publiques et privées du monde entier à garder la maîtrise de leurs données et de leurs infrastructures, tout en répondant à leurs exigences de conformité. Avec plus de 52 000 collaborateurs au service de plus de 4 500 clients dans 54 pays, Atos accompagne la modernisation des systèmes IT, accélère la transformation cloud et data, renforce la cybersécurité et déploie des environnements de travail numériques sécurisés, au bénéfice de ses clients, de leurs collaborateurs et de la société. Atos propose également des services de conseil et d’accompagnement à travers sa marque Atos Amplify. Partenaire de confiance dans la gestion d’environnements complexes et critiques, Atos accompagne les organisations dans des contextes hautement réglementés et souverains. A propos d’Atos Group Atos Group est un leader international de la transformation digitale avec près de 54 000 collaborateurs et un chiffre d’affaires annuel de près de 7,2 milliards d’euros. Présent commercialement dans 54 pays, il exerce ses activités sous deux marques Atos pour les services et Eviden pour les produits et systèmes. Numéro un européen de la cybersécurité et leader dans le domaine du cloud, Atos Group s’engage pour un avenir sécurisé et décarboné. Il propose des solutions sur mesure et intégrées, accélérées par l’IA, pour tous les secteurs d’activité. Atos Group est coté sur Euronext Paris. Au sein des équipes Atos impliquées dans plusieurs programmes européens majeurs du secteur spatial, vous contribuerez à la conception de nouvelles générations de services exploitant l'intelligence artificielle agentique pour transformer des données spatiales complexes en informations directement exploitables par les utilisateurs. Ces solutions combinent données d'observation de la Terre, modèles géospatiaux, modèles de fondation spécialisés et systèmes multi-agents afin d'assister les experts dans la compréhension et l'analyse de problématiques liées à l'agriculture, à l'environnement, à la gestion des risques, à l'aménagement du territoire et à l'adaptation au changement climatique. Vous intégrerez une équipe mêlant expertise spatiale, intelligence artificielle, data science et cloud computing dans un environnement d'innovation à forte visibilité européenne. Vos missions Votre mission consistera à concevoir et développer des chaînes de traitement agentiques capables d'exploiter de multiples sources de données et de connaissances pour répondre à des besoins métiers complexes. Analyser des cas d'usage métiers et les traduire en workflows agentiques ; Identifier et intégrer les sources de données pertinentes (observation de la Terre, données géospatiales, documents techniques, bases de connaissances, services externes) ; Concevoir des architectures reposant sur des Small Language Models (SLM) et Large Language Models (LLM) ; Développer des mécanismes d'orchestration d'agents spécialisés ; Mettre en œuvre des modèles de fondation géospatiaux (Geospatial Foundation Models) et des modèles physiques ou scientifiques ; Évaluer et améliorer la qualité des raisonnements, des inférences et des résultats générés ; Concevoir des mécanismes de validation, de traçabilité et d'explicabilité des résultats ; Participer au déploiement de démonstrateurs et de prototypes innovants. Au cours du stage, vous pourrez intervenir sur différentes composantes des projets conception système, IA générative, orchestration multi-agents, développement logiciel, data science ou encore interaction homme-machine. Profil Vous préparez un diplôme de niveau Bac+5 en école d'ingénieurs ou en cursus universitaire équivalent et recherchez un stage de fin d'études d'une durée minimale de 4 mois. Vous possédez idéalement des connaissances dans plusieurs des domaines suivants Développement Python ; Conception logicielle et architectures distribuées ; Données géospatiales et observation de la Terre ; Intelligence artificielle générative ; LLM, SLM et systèmes RAG ; Architectures agentiques et multi-agents ; Frameworks d'orchestration tels que LangChain, LangGraph ou équivalents ; Protocoles et mécanismes d'interopérabilité d'agents (MCP, A2A ou technologies similaires) ; Méthodes de développement logiciel en contexte projet. Une bonne maîtrise de l'anglais écrit est nécessaire pour l'exploitation de documentations scientifiques et techniques dans un contexte international. items.desc: AI Solution Engineer – Private & Sovereign AI About NTT DATA NTT DATA is a global IT services and consulting company helping organizations transform their businesses through technology, innovation, and data-driven solutions. As part of a global technology organization, NTT DATA combines international expertise with strong local capabilities to deliver secure, scalable, and business-focused solutions to enterprise customers. About the Team We are building a new Private AI / Sovereign AI team focused on positioning, demonstrating, designing, and implementing next-generation enterprise AI platforms. The team will work closely with NTT Hungary's Data Center, Customer Experience, and Networking business areas, developing AI solutions that can be integrated into existing enterprise environments and services — from contact centers and text-to-speech solutions to broader AI-powered business applications. Our vision is to design, scale, demonstrate, and deliver enterprise AI platforms that provide the foundation for a growing portfolio of AI services and solutions. As an AI Solution Engineer , you will play a hands-on role across the entire solution lifecycle — from customer discovery, pre-sales and proof-of-concepts through technical validation, deployment, and early production implementation. Given that the position is part of the Hungarian subsidiary/organizational unit, and that the role supports medium and large corporations, as well as Hungarian state-owned enterprises, fluent knowledge of both Hungarian and English, as well as a location in Hungary—preferably Pest County/Budapest—is essential What You Will Do Build and deploy AI solutions — configure, integrate, validate, and troubleshoot enterprise AI platforms across on-premises, private cloud, hybrid, and public cloud environments. Develop hands-on AI prototypes and PoCs using LLMs, open-weight models, model APIs, embeddings, vector databases, RAG, and agentic AI workflows. Translate customer requirements into technical solutions by contributing to solution concepts, architecture, sizing, technical designs, and implementation approaches. Integrate AI platforms with enterprise environments , including APIs, data sources, identity and authentication services, security controls, and existing business applications. Lead the technical delivery of successful PoCs and sales engagements , transitioning validated solutions toward secure, scalable, and operable implementations. Create and deliver technical demonstrations and workshops , explaining complex AI technologies and demonstrating their practical business value to customers and internal stakeholders. Troubleshoot and optimize solutions across applications, AI platforms, containers, infrastructure, integrations, and model-serving environments. Develop reusable technical assets , including reference architectures, deployment patterns, configurations, documentation, runbooks, and demo environments. Collaborate across disciplines , working with AI architects, cloud and infrastructure teams, networking, security, delivery, sales, and technology partners. Stay current with enterprise AI technologies and evaluate emerging platforms, frameworks, model-serving technologies, and cloud-native capabilities. What You Bring 3–5 years of hands-on IT experience in software engineering, DevOps, cloud engineering, platform engineering, solution engineering, systems integration, or a comparable technical role. Strong practical experience with Linux, Python, REST APIs, Git, scripting, and technical troubleshooting , with the ability to develop and integrate working solutions rather than focusing solely on operations. Hands-on experience with containers and deployment technologies , particularly Docker, with working knowledge of Kubernetes or comparable orchestration platforms; OpenShift experience is a strong advantage. Practical understanding of modern Generative AI , including LLM APIs or model inference, embeddings, vector search, RAG, and agentic AI concepts. Professional AI/ML experience is a plus, but not mandatory. Experience integrating and deploying software across enterprise environments , including on-premises, private cloud, hybrid cloud, or public cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud. Understanding of enterprise AI infrastructure and operations , including model serving, inference, GPU-based workloads, security, identity, networking, monitoring, and production-readiness considerations. Customer-facing and solution-oriented mindset , with an ability to participate in pre-sales, technical workshops, proof-of-concepts, solution validation, and early-stage implementations. Strong communication, problem-solving, ownership, and continuous-learning skills , with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly and collaborate effectively with architects, engineers, sales teams, and customers. items.desc: What is Box? Box (NYSE:BOX) is the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Our platform enables organizations to fuel collaboration, manage the entire content lifecycle, secure critical content, and transform business workflows with enterprise AI. We help companies thrive in the new AI-first era of business. Founded in 2005, Box simplifies work for leading global organizations, including JLL, Morgan Stanley, and Nationwide. Box is headquartered in Redwood City, CA, with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia. By joining Box, you will have the unique opportunity to continue driving our platform forward. Content powers how we work. It’s the billions of files and information flowing across teams, departments, and key business processes every single day: contracts, invoices, employee records, financials, product specs, marketing assets, and more. Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations. With the combination of AI and enterprise content, the opportunity has never been greater to transform how the world works together and at Box you will be on the front lines of this massive shift. Why Box needs you: We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to design, build, and operate reliable machine learning systems that deliver meaningful product impact at enterprise scale. In this role, you will combine strong software engineering and applied machine learning skills to take solutions from idea through production. You will work closely with engineering, product, data, and infrastructure partners to develop scalable ML and agentic capabilities, improve model quality, and ensure that systems are secure, observable, and dependable for Box customers. The Metadata Extraction team builds AI-powered capabilities that transform unstructured enterprise content into structured, usable metadata. The team works on the platform and machine learning layer of document understanding, developing and operationalizing technologies such as OCR and LLM-based extraction agents. These capabilities help understand document layout, tables, handwriting, semantic content, and other complex information within enterprise documents. As a Machine Learning Engineer, you will build reliable, scalable systems that support the development, evaluation, deployment, and operation of these AI capabilities. You will collaborate with engineers, product partners, and adjacent platform teams to bring document intelligence features to Box customers at enterprise scale. What you'll do: Design, build, deploy, and maintain production LLM agents, machine learning models and services. Develop robust data preparation pipelines, prompt and tool design, and agentic workflows. Write high-quality, maintainable, and well-tested Python code for production systems. Evaluate and improve agents quality using appropriate offline and online metrics, eval sets, experiments, and feedback loops. Monitor production ML systems for quality, reliability, latency, cost, and data or model drift; investigate and resolve issues as needed. Contribute to the architecture of scalable services and pipelines that support real-time and batch ML workloads. Create clear technical designs, documentation, tests, and operational runbooks. Share knowledge, contribute to engineering best practices, and help raise the bar for code quality and operational excellence. Participate in an on-call rotation and help triage production issues when on call. Who you are: We are an AI-first company. This means you approach your work with a growth mindset and find ways to leverage AI to help make faster, smarter decisions that will 10X your impact at Box. You have 3+ years of experience building, deploying, or operating production software, data, or machine learning systems. You have strong programming skills in Python and are comfortable writing production-grade, readable, testable, and maintainable code. You have practical experience with the LLM based agents lifecycle: data and eval-set preparation, prompting and tool schemas, RAG, evaluation, deployment and monitoring. You have experience with LLM application frameworks and libraries, such as LangChain, LangGraph, PyTorch, Pydantic, Pandas, or NumPy, and are comfortable calling LLM APIs (e.g. Gemini, Claude, OpenAI). You understand core machine learning concepts and can make pragmatic trade-offs between model performance, reliability, latency, scalability, and cost. items.card: In this role, you will work cross functionally with Design, Firmware, and System teams to ensure our silicon meets rigorous specifications. As an RF TX Silicon Validation Engineer, you will own the bring-up and
items.level: Silicon Validation Engineering ICT4 – Silicon Validation Engineering ICT5
items.desc:
Imagine what you could do here. At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion, dedication, and a no-excuse mindset to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish. Smart people and inspiring, innovative technologies are the norm here.
Our team is responsible for validating the RF performance of top-notch, monolithic cellular transceivers. We are looking for an experienced RF engineer to lead the validation of complex PLL and frequency synthesis subsystems. In this role, you will work cross functionally with Design, Firmware, and System teams to ensure our silicon meets rigorous specifications. You will drive our shift to agentic engineering, scaling validation throughput with AI agents without compromising the quality bar, to enable uncompromised connectivity in future Apple products.
As an RF TX Silicon Validation Engineer, you will own the bring-up and characterization of frequency generation subsystems in market-leading transceivers. Your work style is collaborative and proactive, driving technical solutions across interdisciplinary teams.
Strong cross-functional leadership skills; ability to communicate complex technical findings clearly to Chip Design, Firmware, System Engineering and System Validation teams.
Expertise in Python for test automation and data analysis (NumPy/Pandas), and demonstrated experience working with AI coding agents beyond script generation: delegating multi-step tasks, defining acceptance criteria, and validating agent output against specifications.
Proven track record in systematically debugging complex silicon issues and isolating root causes across hardware, firmware, or test setups.
Deep understanding of RF transceiver architecture with specific expertise in cellular transmitter architecture and key metrics like ACRL, SEM, EVM and Cross-Talk Isolation.
Mastering requirements for cellular standards (e.g. 5G NR, LTE) and mixed-signal building blocks (ADCs/DACs) is highly desirable.
Experience with 3GPP spectrum emission and network signalling requirements is definitely a plus.
Hands-on mastery of RF lab equipment including Spectrum/Phase Noise Analyzers, VNAs, and high-speed Oscilloscopes.
Master's or PhD in Electrical Engineering or equivalent with 5+ years of relevant experience in RF/Mixed-Signal validation, system engineering or design.

items.desc:
Play a part in the next revolution of machine learning technology! Siri assists hundreds of millions of people, in dozens of languages, every day, and Global Siri is the team that teaches Siri each one of them.
We own the product end-to-end, from Speech Recognition and Natural Language Understanding through to Response. We are looking for an engineer with deep expertise in either Machine Learning or Software Engineering, and practical working knowledge of the other, to shape the future of Siri for Hebrew users.
Your work will range across multiple disciplines, including employing advanced Large Language Models (LLMs), adopting models for global markets, running data experiments, and engineering scalable software to deliver highly personalized, culturally relevant experiences for our customers.
As a member of our dynamic and fast-paced group, you will play a key role in crafting innovative, end-to-end solutions that delight millions of customers across the globe. You will act as the technical anchor for the Hebrew market, leading work streams to design and implement large-scale ML and GenAI solutions that advance our customer experience.
This position sits squarely at the intersection of Machine Learning, Data, and Software Engineering. Whether you are a strong Software Engineer who has applied ML to production systems, or an ML expert with solid coding skills, you will leverage large language models (LLMs), agentic approaches to tasks, and data generation methods to build real-world systems.
You will work with partner teams across Apple, sharing your expertise and bringing architectural proposals that account for international market nuances, so that Siri feels genuinely native to Hebrew users.
Join us as we build the foundation of Siri AI for users around the world!
Professional-level fluency in Hebrew, with deep familiarity with the culture and idiom of Hebrew-speaking regions.
Experience in applying machine learning and NLP techniques to deliver products, with a solid understanding of ML concepts
Strong skills in software design and programming across different paradigms, including testing and maintainability, with experience contributing to large production code bases.
Experience working with data at scale, including building or curating datasets, analyzing results, and making data-driven decisions.
Hands-on experience with large language models: fine-tuning, prompt and context engineering, evaluation, and inference optimization, including agentic systems, tool calling, or retrieval-augmented generation.
Experience with speech technologies such as ASR, TTS, or pronunciation modeling.
Experience adapting models or products across languages and markets — multilingual and cross-lingual modeling, transfer learning, or low-resource settings.
Ability to formulate a research problem, design, experiment, implement and communicate solutions.
Product focus with a strong emphasis on end-user experience.
Experience writing software in Python, Swift, Objective-C, C++ or C; experience on Apple platforms preferred.
M.S, Ph.D. in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

You’ll help engineering teams use electronic systems and test equipment safely and effectively. Your preventative maintenance and troubleshooting will help keep laboratory
items.desc:
About the job
 Keep Graphcore’s Bristol laboratories safe, reliable and ready for engineers to test AI hardware.
 As a Lab Technician in DC Engineering, you’ll support the facilities behind hardware bring-up, validation and characterisation. You’ll help engineering teams use electronic systems and test equipment safely and effectively.
 Your preventative maintenance and troubleshooting will help keep laboratory equipment available for engineers’ work. By checking electrostatic discharge controls, you’ll help protect the hardware being developed and tested.
 You’ll set up and calibrate test equipment, manage laboratory assets, and support board, cable and wire modifications. You’ll also oversee goods coming into and leaving the laboratories.
 Beyond equipment support, you’ll shape standard operating procedures for multidisciplinary laboratory teams. Your technical guidance will help colleagues meet safety, quality and regulatory requirements in their everyday work.
 The team and culture
 The Laboratory team supports engineering groups with installations, repairs and equipment modifications. You’ll work with engineers to understand their technical requirements and get test benches ready within project timescales.
 The team maintains accurate technical documentation and works to defined laboratory practices. You’ll contribute practical guidance and help junior colleagues develop their skills.
 What we’re looking for
 Experience working in an electronics laboratory and a practical, resourceful approach to technical problems.
 Ability to set up, calibrate and troubleshoot electronic test equipment, including oscilloscopes, logic analysers and power supplies.
 Understanding of electrostatic discharge (ESD) controls and laboratory health and safety requirements, with experience applying safe working practices.
 Experience repairing and modifying PCB assemblies to IPC-7711/21 and J-STD-001 standards, and inspecting assemblies to IPC-A-610.
 Experience assembling cables and wire harnesses from drawings to IPC-620 standards.
 Clear communication across engineering disciplines, with the ability to meet project timescales and mentor junior colleagues.
 While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. We also welcome engineers returning to the profession after a career break, including through returnship routes.
 Benefits
 Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility
 Generous leave: Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work
 Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension
 Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success
 Workplace experience: Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day
 Peace of mind protection: Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones
 Electric Vehicle Scheme: Choose an electric vehicle and lease it through salary sacrifice
 Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme and dental cover
 We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.
 We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you.
 Sponsorship
 Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa applications for this role.
 Access to controlled technology 
 Some roles at Graphcore involve access to technology subject to U.S. export control regulations. Depending on the role, we may need to assess whether export authorisation is required, taking account of factors such as work location, citizenship and immigration status. Where authorisation is required, this may affect whether or when you can start the role. We’ll explain any relevant requirements during the recruitment process.
 Join the Team at Graphcore
 Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.
 As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.
 Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings …

items.desc:
The role translates business, technology and market developments into clear marketing choices: where Nokia should play, which audiences and opportunities matter most, how Nokia should position itself and where GMC should focus its investment and resources.
 Operating across Nokia's businesses and GMC, the strategist connects market intelligence, customer needs, technology developments, competitive dynamics and Nokia's portfolio into a compelling and differentiated strategic narrative.
 This is a senior strategic role. It is not primarily responsible for campaign or programme execution. Instead, it sets the direction that enables Marketing Planners, Campaign teams, Communications, Brand, Field Marketing and specialist teams to build integrated plans and execute effectively.
Lead the development and execution of Nokia’s global Cloud & AI marketing strategy, ensuring alignment with business and technology priorities.
 Identify strategic growth opportunities, investment priorities, and competitive positioning to strengthen market leadership.
 Analyze customer, market, competitor, and technology trends to inform strategic decision-making and future direction.
 Develop a differentiated Cloud & AI point of view that establishes Nokia as a trusted industry leader.

 Establish success metrics, evaluate market impact and performance, and continuously optimize strategy based on data-driven insights.

 Extensive experience in B2B technology marketing, marketing strategy, portfolio strategy, or similar strategic leadership roles.

items.desc: Localisation : Lille (3j présentiel, 2j remote)Démarrage : ASAP CONTEXTE: 1 300 utilisateurs équipés de Gemini Enterprise, 10 directions métier impliquées et une communauté de 60 ambassadeurs à faire grandir. L'objectif ? Que l'IA soit un réflexe du quotidien.En binôme avec le pilotage du déploiement, vous êtes le moteur terrain de cette transformation. MISSIONS: L'Acculturation & la Formation Concevoir et animer des sessions (du collaborateur terrain au Comex). Rendre la technique simple : prompting, cas d'usage, bonnes pratiques et pièges (éthique, RGPD). Créer des contenus qui donnent envie (guides, tutos vidéo, bibliothèque de prompts). L'Animation de Communauté Animer nos 60 ambassadeurs (ateliers, retours d'expérience, challenges d'agents IA). Identifier les vrais besoins métier et assurer un support de proximité (FAQ, permanences). Le Pont Technico-Fonctionnel Prototyper des assistants, agents ou automatisations simple (no-code). Traduire les besoins métier en specs claires pour les dev/techs. Profil candidat: Vous avez 2 à 5 ans d'expérience (conseil en transfo digitale, PO, rôle data/IA avec une vraie brique formation/animation/pédagogie). Un vrai sens de la pédagogie : Vous savez expliquer ce qu'est un RAG ou un agent à un Directeur Financier en 1 minute sans jargon. Un pied dans le métier, un pied dans la tech : Vous comprenez une API, un flux de données ou un workflow sans forcément coder. Daily user de l'IA : Vous utilisez les LLM au quotidien et vous suivez l'actu du secteur avec curiosité. Vous avez une première expérience dans le Retail / Grande distribution. Nice to have: Maîtrise de l'écosystème Gemini Enterprise / Workspace ou NotebookLM. Connaissances sur Claude, n8n (automatisation) ou le prototypage assisté par IA.

items.title: Applied AI Course Author
items.card: you will be required to complete a test assignment after your Online Introductory Call. Project details are shared after signing an NDA. Requirements: 5+ years of recent professional experience in applied AI/ML, data, AI automation, or a related field, including hands-on experience with LLMs. A master’s degree or PhD in a relevant field, or 10+ years of senior professional experience in AI or a related industry.
items.desc: TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We’ve been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners (people with no prior tech background) through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions. We’re looking for an experienced Course Author in Applied AI to help design and develop a graduate-level online program in Applied Artificial Intelligence, delivered in partnership with a US university. The program is built for working professionals in fields such as marketing, operations, finance and HR. They learn to evaluate, build, integrate, deploy and govern AI solutions using modern no-code and low-code tools. You’ll turn approved course syllabi into engaging, rigorous learning materials and help shape how a new generation of AI practitioners learns to make sound, defensible decisions. This is a part-time, project-based opportunity for subject matter experts who are passionate about teaching, curriculum design and helping learners succeed. Please submit all resumes or CVs in English. After applying for this position, you will be required to complete a test assignment after your Online Introductory Call. Project details are shared after signing an NDA. Requirements: 5+ years of recent professional experience in applied AI/ML, data, AI automation, or a related field, including hands-on experience with LLMs. A master’s degree or PhD in a relevant field, or 10+ years of senior professional experience in AI or a related industry. Practical knowledge of AI tools and workflows, including prompt engineering, RAG, AI agents, automation, APIs, and LLM evaluation. Experience applying AI to real business problems, considering business value, cost, risk, and reliability. Experience teaching, mentoring, or creating educational content, with the ability to explain complex concepts to non-technical audiences. Strong English communication skills (C1+), including clear professional and educational writing. Strong organizational and collaboration skills, with the ability to work proactively, incorporate feedback, and meet agreed deadlines. Nice-to-have Experience designing courses or learning materials for higher education or online programs. Familiarity with AI strategy, business cases, or responsible AI practices or governance. Experience with EdTech or learning platforms, or contributions to the AI community through publications, talks, or open-source projects. Brand: TripleTen What you will do: Develop graduate-level course content in Applied AI based on approved syllabi: guided lessons, hands-on labs, case studies, weekly assignments and final projects, mostly in text and video format. Write clear assignment briefs and analytic rubrics for all graded work, including explicit rules on when and how students may use AI tools. Design practical labs on current AI platforms (LLM assistants, RAG applications, workflow automation, AI agents, APIs and monitoring tools), and make sure every graded task can be completed with free or open-source tools. Curate reading lists of research papers, standards and vendor documentation, and explain why each source matters. Create supporting materials: preparatory (non-credit) modules for learners without a technical background, a program glossary, templates and worked examples. Collaborate with the LX designer and the student experience team on learning objectives, course structure and assessment design (if you don’t have experience with this, that’s ok). Consult on Applied AI-related questions, and keep content up to date as tools and regulations change. Revise content based on academic review by the partner university’s faculty, and make sure it meets graduate-level academic standards. What we can offer you: Fully remote, part-time collaboration (at least 25h/week). Compensation: fixed fee per course package, paid in milestones. A diverse team across Europe, the US, Latin America and more. Modern digital tools for seamless collaboration.

items.desc: At Verisure, we do something amazing every day. By protecting what matters most, we change lives for the better. Technology is at the heart of everything we do, and we like to stay ahead of the curve. We don’t wait for new technologies to become mainstream: we explore, test and research them before they reach the market, so our customers always benefit from the latest innovation. About The Role We now have the opportunity for an AI Engineer - Agentic Systems & LLMs to join our Technology Department. Location : Verisure Tech Hub - Alicante. The role will be based at our new technology site in Alicante. Backed by over 1,700 technologists worldwide and powered by one of Europe’s largest IoT platforms. Your Future Team You will join our IT Telephony team , the team responsible for Verisure’s contact center platform across 18 countries. The team designs and delivers AI-powered conversational solutions that enhance customer interactions and support our teams, combining agentic AI with our contact center ecosystem to deliver scalable, secure and multilingual solutions. The Opportunity Design, build and operate AI agents and multi-agent conversational solutions for voice and digital channels, from prototyping through to production. Develop agentic workflows and RAG solutions , integrating LLMs with business systems, internal platforms and cloud services. Optimize real-time conversational experiences, focusing on latency, reliability, accuracy, error recovery and seamless human handover . Define and monitor AI quality and performance, continuously improving solutions across multi-country and multilingual environments . ️ Tech Stack Python 3.10+ | AWS Bedrock | SageMaker | Lambda | Step Functions | EventBridge | LangGraph | Strands Agents | CrewAI | LangChain | Genesys Cloud | RAG | Vector Databases | MCP | REST APIs | STT/TTS | WebSockets | Git | CI/CD Required Qualifications 3+ years of software development experience with Python , including at least 1 year building AI/ML or LLM-based applications. Experience building AI agents and agentic workflows , ideally using LangGraph, CrewAI, Strands Agents, LangChain or equivalent frameworks. Hands-on knowledge of RAG pipelines, embeddings, vector databases, retrieval techniques and LLM-based application patterns . Experience with conversational AI, chatbots or voice solutions , ideally deployed in production environments. Experience working with AWS and serverless architectures , plus Git and CI/CD practices. Fluent technical English , and Spanish , both written and spoken. Soft Skills & Mindset Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset , with the ability to adapt quickly in fast-moving environments. Customer-centric approach , with attention to how AI interactions perform and feel for real customers. High ownership and accountability , comfortable working autonomously and driving solutions forward. Collaborative and continuous-learning mindset , able to work across technical, business and multi-country teams. If you’re not sure you meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway — you might have a good fit for this role or another opportunity within our team. Verisure is an equal-opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from diverse backgrounds. What Verisure Offers You ️ Hybrid Work Model – Split your time between home and our offices in Alicante. Plus, benefit from two fully remote weeks per year and shortened Fridays all year round (until 15h). Dynamic Culture – Work in a collaborative and supportive team. Global Impact – Your solutions will scale internationally. Team Environment – Strong Scrum practices, clear ownership, and real team support. Continuous Learning – Tech Learning and Tech Career Plans. ️ Lunch & coffee included at our offices – You won’t need to pay for your daily meal when you are at the office! :) Paid time off: 23 days and an additional bank of extra hours for even more flexibility. Join Us! At Verisure, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that collaboration, trust, and different perspectives make us stronger. Interested in building great tech solutions? Apply today and be part of our team. For questions regarding this position, please contact: Elvira Torres elvira.torres.benavente@verisure.com Claudia Sanz claudia.sanzabia@verisure.com Our Company DNA Passionate in Everything We Do Committed to Making a Difference Always Innovating Winning as a Team With Trust & Responsibility

items.desc: Summary Andersen is hiring a Backend & DevOps Engineer (Medusa, Node.js/TypeScript) for a project developing a B2B e-commerce platform, integrating business systems, and automating operations. The customer is an established international organization offering a diverse range of products and services across multiple markets. Its activities focus on supporting business needs, improving operational processes, and delivering effective solutions. The company continues to develop its capabilities, adapt to changing market requirements, and pursue long-term growth. The project is focused on developing and maintaining a B2B e-commerce platform based on a headless commerce architecture. It includes extending platform functionality, integrating external business systems, and implementing process automation and AI-based capabilities to support business operations. Responsibilities Evolving the Medusa-based commerce backend: custom modules, data models, module links, API routes, workflows. Extending Medusa Admin with widgets and custom routes. Implementing B2B features: company accounts, customer groups, customer-specific price lists, quotes, approval flows, bulk ordering. Integrating ERP, CRM, PIM and back-office systems via workflows, event subscribers and scheduled jobs. Designing, building and deploying AI agents and tools working through Medusa APIs and workflows. Owning cloud infrastructure for Medusa: PostgreSQL, Redis, containerized server and worker instances, CI/CD. Finding manual bottlenecks and automate them. Writing clean, tested, secure code. Requirements Experience in backend development with Node.js and TypeScript for 5+ years. Hands-on production experience with Medusa (v2 preferred): custom modules, workflows SDK incl. compensation logic, subscribers, Admin customizations for 1+ years. B2B e-commerce logic in practice: price lists, customer groups, company accounts, quotes or approval flows. Integrations with third-party systems (ERP, payment, fulfillment, CRM or PIM) using event-driven / asynchronous patterns. PostgreSQL and Redis in production. Docker, CI/CD pipelines, at least one major cloud (AWS, GCP or Azure) and infrastructure as code. Level of English – from Upper-Intermediate and above. Desired skills Deploying and scaling Medusa with separate server and worker modes. Kubernetes. AI integration, LLM workflows, autonomous AI agents for business processes. Next.js storefronts or multi-platform frontends. GraphQL API design. Medusa plugin development. Reasons to join us Experience in teamwork with leaders in FinTech, Healthcare, Retail, Telecom, and others. Andersen cooperates with such businesses as Samsung, Siemens, Johnson & Johnson, BNP Paribas, Ryanair, Mercedes, TUI, Verivox, Allianz, T-Systems, etc.. The opportunity to change the project and/or develop expertise in an interesting business domain. Job conditions – you can work both fully remotely and from the office or can choose a hybrid variant. Guarantee of professional, financial, and career growth! The company has introduced systems of mentoring and adaptation for each new employee. The opportunity to earn up to an additional 1,000 EUR per month, depending on the level of expertise, which will be included in the annual bonus, by participating in the company's activities. Access to the corporate training portal, where the entire knowledge base of the company is collected and which is constantly updated. Bright corporate life (parties / pizza days / PlayStation / fruits / coffee / snacks / movies). Certification compensation (AWS, PMP, etc). Referral program. Private health insurance and sports compensation, depending on the type of employment. Join us! Locations Austria, Azerbaijan, Belgium, Bulgaria, Croatia, Cyprus, Czech Republic, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Georgia, Germany, Hungary, Italy, Latvia, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden, The Netherlands

items.desc: Safir Consulting est un cabinet de conseil spécialisé dans les métiers de la Banque et de la Finance. Nous accompagnons les grandes institutions financières françaises et internationales dans leurs projets de transformation : réglementation, systèmes d'information, risques, finance de marché, conformité et données. Fondé sur des valeurs d'excellence, de proximité et d'engagement, Safir Consulting se distingue par la qualité de son vivier de consultants et par la profondeur de sa connaissance sectorielle. Rejoindre Safir, c'est intégrer une équipe soudée, ambitieuse, qui place l'humain au cœur de sa stratégie de développement. Pour accompagner notre croissance, nous recherchons un : Consultant Data / IA - Refonte des Référentiels de Sanctions Financières - H/F/X Localisation : Paris 19e - Organisation hybride (50 % sur site) N'hésitez pas, Safir Consulting vous attend ! Votre quotidien : Un Consultant Data / IA chez Safir, c'est un expert au cœur des enjeux de transformation des dispositifs de conformité, de fiabilisation des données et d'innovation technologique dans le secteur bancaire. Vous intervenez au sein d'une direction de la Conformité spécialisée en Sécurité Financière, dans le cadre d'un projet stratégique de refonte du référentiel des listes de sanctions. L'objectif : transformer un processus aujourd'hui largement manuel en un dispositif innovant, fiable et évolutif, capable d'identifier les personnes morales détenues ou contrôlées par des personnes désignées dans des programmes de sanctions. Votre rôle : analyser les solutions et les données disponibles sur le marché, concevoir une approche permettant de croiser différentes sources d'information et explorer les possibilités offertes par l'intelligence artificielle pour automatiser et fiabiliser l'identification des liens capitalistiques et de contrôle. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Conformité, Data et les fournisseurs de données afin de proposer une solution opérationnelle répondant aux exigences de qualité, de traçabilité et de réactivité. Ce poste n'attend que vous : Analyse des données & évaluation des fournisseurs Identifier et analyser les différentes sources de données relatives aux personnes désignées dans les programmes de sanctions. Échanger avec les fournisseurs spécialisés dans les listes de sanctions et les données de conformité. Étudier les offres des prestataires disposant d'informations sur les liens capitalistiques et les relations de contrôle. Évaluer les solutions permettant de croiser les informations issues de plusieurs fournisseurs. Analyser la qualité, la fiabilité, la couverture et la fraîcheur des données disponibles. Comparer les capacités de mise à jour et les limites des différentes solutions. Conception d'une solution Data & IA innovante Définir une approche cible permettant d'automatiser l'identification des personnes détenues ou contrôlées par des personnes sanctionnées. Explorer les possibilités offertes par l'intelligence artificielle, notamment le prompting IA, pour exploiter les données. Concevoir des mécanismes permettant d'identifier les informations pertinentes au sein de bases de données hétérogènes. Définir les règles de croisement entre les listes de sanctions, les liens capitalistiques et les relations de contrôle. Proposer une architecture fonctionnelle capable d'intégrer plusieurs sources de données. Garantir l'évolutivité et la maintenabilité du dispositif. Fiabilisation & qualification des données Définir les critères permettant de distinguer les liens avérés des correspondances non confirmées. Concevoir les mécanismes de qualification et de filtrage des résultats. Réduire les faux positifs tout en limitant les risques d'omission. Construire une base structurée de noms vérifiés et documentés. Définir les informations nécessaires à la validation des résultats par les équipes de Conformité. Garantir la cohérence et la fiabilité des données proposées. Traçabilité & auditabilité du dispositif Définir les règles de traçabilité entre les différentes sources de données. Mettre en place des mécanismes d'identification et de rapprochement des enregistrements. Documenter les sources, les règles de traitement et les résultats des analyses. Associer chaque décision de qualification à une piste d'audit exploitable. Garantir la transparence des résultats produits par les traitements automatisés. Contribuer à la robustesse du dispositif de contrôle. Automatisation & amélioration continue Concevoir un processus de mise à jour rapide et fiable du référentiel. Identifier les traitements pouvant être automatisés. Réduire les interventions manuelles dans la collecte et le croisement des informations. Définir les modalités d'intégration de nouvelles sources de données. Anticiper les évolutions fonctionnelles et technologiques du dispositif. Proposer des améliorations permettant de renforcer son efficacité opérationnelle. Coordination & restitution des travaux Organiser et animer les échanges …

The ideal candidate combines experience in AI strategy, business transformation, solution architecture, automation, and operational improvement and is comfortable
items.desc: AI Strategy & Transformation Architect Job Type: Full-Time Work Setup: Remote Work Hours: Pacific Standard Time (PST) Overview Satellite Teams is looking for an AI Strategy & Transformation Architect to help businesses identify, design, and implement practical AI-enabled solutions that improve operations, productivity, scalability, and cost efficiency. In this role, you will work directly with business owners and executives to understand their operations, identify high-impact opportunities for AI, automation, and offshore teams, and translate those opportunities into practical transformation strategies. The ideal candidate combines experience in AI strategy, business transformation, solution architecture, automation, and operational improvement and is comfortable translating complex technology concepts into clear business recommendations. ResponsibilitiesBusiness Discovery & AI Opportunity Assessment Partner with business owners and executives to evaluate existing operations and workflows. Map current processes across sales, marketing, operations, finance, customer support, and back-office functions. Identify manual processes, bottlenecks, cost inefficiencies, and scalability challenges. Assess organizational AI readiness across people, processes, data, systems, and technology. AI Strategy & Transformation Develop practical AI roadmaps aligned with business objectives. Identify and prioritize AI and automation opportunities based on impact, feasibility, and ROI. Determine which processes should be automated, AI-assisted, handled by offshore teams, or supported through a combination of human and AI workflows. Translate AI capabilities into practical recommendations for business leaders. AI Solution Architecture & Technology Selection Evaluate and recommend AI technologies, including Generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, copilots, RPA, analytics, and automation platforms. Assess SaaS platforms and potential system integrations. Design high-level solution architectures and data flows. Consider data governance, security, scalability, and cost when recommending solutions. Ensure AI solutions can be effectively adopted by remote and offshore teams. Implementation & Change Management Support and oversee AI and automation implementation initiatives. Develop implementation roadmaps, success metrics, and KPIs. Create playbooks, SOPs, and training materials to support adoption. Work with stakeholders to drive change management and successful implementation. Executive & Stakeholder Communication Act as a trusted AI and transformation advisor to business owners and executives. Facilitate discussions around AI adoption, workforce transformation, organizational design, risk, and AI governance. Present technical concepts and recommendations clearly to non-technical stakeholders. Continuous Improvement Monitor the performance of AI-enabled workflows and solutions. Identify opportunities to improve existing systems and processes. Stay current with emerging AI technologies, automation platforms, regulatory considerations, and industry trends. Continuously identify new AI and offshore use cases that can create measurable business value. Qualifications 3–5 years of relevant experience in AI solutions, digital transformation, technology consulting, automation, solution architecture, or a related field. items.desc: Overview Home. There's no place like it. And there's no feeling like helping people create the joy of feeling truly at home. At Dunelm, that's what we do. We're the UK's number one choice for homewares because we make home life lovelier for our customers. And we've crafted a workplace that feels just as welcoming – where you can bring your ideas, be yourself, and feel right at home. Work your way, together. We're a hybrid business, which means you'll have flexibility alongside time together with your team. Observability is a first-class concern that shapes how we build and support services across the business. Message From the Principal Engineer: "Hi! I'm Dan, the Principal Site Reliability Engineer here at Dunelm. The SRE team has evolved quite a bit since I started three years ago. We have moved from an engineer-per-team 'embedded' engagement model to a combination 'tools & consulting' model. This has allowed us to scale our coverage more effectively and deliver more meaningful impact throughout Dunelm's service teams. I'm looking forward to receiving your application and hopefully welcoming you into our team." Interview Process 1. Introductory video call (around 45 minutes) with the Principal Engineer and Product Delivery Lead to get to know each other, explain the role, and hear about your experience, goals, and approach to work. 2. You will work through scenario-based questions designed to help you to highlight your knowledge, specific approaches and where you feel any improvements could be made. However, please read this job description carefully. What you'll be doing 1. Engineering & Automation Build automation and reliability tooling using well-architected, maintainable, testable, and easy to read & understand code. Contribute to shared libraries, observability components, and internal platforms. 2. Observability Instrumentation Help evolve our observability strategy across systems and services. Drive how we collect, process, sample, and surface logs, distributed traces and metrics using OpenTelemetry. Focus on high-quality telemetry that enables fast diagnosis, cost efficiency, and meaningful visibility across the stack. 3. Service Levels & Ownership Help teams truly own their services by helping to define and adopt meaningful SLIs and SLOs. Guide product teams in using observability data to make reliability measurable. 4. Incident Response Participate in on-call investigations when issues arise. Drive blameless post-incident reviews and help to identify observability gaps, recommend mitigating actions that stem losses, but also permanent fixes that prevent recurrence. 5. Infrastructure & Pipelines Model infrastructure using tools such as Pulumi, CDK, and Terraform in AWS and other PaaS and SaaS providers. Improve pipelines and support safe deployment strategies (e.g. canary, blue / green). 6. Mentoring & Team Growth Help support and coach other engineers. Participate in technical discussions and share knowledge through pairing, planning, and documentation. 7. Continuous Learning and Innovation Stay ahead of emerging practices in observability. Lead team proof-of-concepts and introduce new patterns or tools that improve our platform. 8. Strategic Development Contribute to the prioritisation of the SRE roadmap. items.desc: Job Description Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International? Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Uniquely Yours. About The Role The Media Data Platform (MDP) team is looking for a Data & AI Engineer to join a growing squad building MDLZ's in-house media ecosystem. You will design and deliver data pipelines, integrations, and AI-driven solutions that ingest, transform, and activate data from external media platforms — enabling smarter media investment decisions at global scale. The role sits at the intersection of data engineering, cloud infrastructure, and applied AI, working closely with Product, Engineering, and Architecture teams across Marketing & I&A Products. Key Responsibilities Design, build, and optimise data pipelines that ingest, transform, and serve media data from external platforms (DSPs, SSPs, ad servers, social media, measurement partners) using Python, Databricks, GCP (BigQuery, Dataflow), and AWS. Develop and deploy AI/ML models and LLM-based workflows — including RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, and agent orchestration — to generate media performance insights and activation intelligence. Build and maintain APIs and backend services that surface media data and AI-generated insights to business users and downstream applications. Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting for pipelines and models to ensure reliability, performance, and cost-efficiency in production. Collaborate with Product Owners, Engineering, and Architects across Marketing & I&A Products to translate business requirements into scalable, reliable technical solutions. Contribute to platform architecture decisions including infrastructure-as-code (Terraform), containerisation (Docker), and CI/CD practices. Write clean, tested, well-documented code; participate in code reviews, sprint ceremonies, and knowledge-sharing across the team. How You Will Contribute We Are Looking For Candidates With Strong proficiency in Python and experience building production-grade data pipelines or applications. Hands-on experience with GCP (BigQuery, DBT, Cloud Storage) and AWS, plus Databricks (Spark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog). Solid understanding of data engineering — ETL/ELT, SQL, data modelling, and working with structured and unstructured data at scale. Exposure to AI/ML engineering — LLM integration, prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, or agent-based architectures. Experience with data integration patterns: REST APIs, streaming, orchestration (Airflow/Cloud Composer), and DBT. Solid software engineering fundamentals: Git, CI/CD, testing, Docker, and Terraform. Strong communication skills; able to work cross-functionally and translate technical topics to business stakeholders. Intellectual curiosity and a bias for learning in a fast-moving data and AI environment. Nice to Have Experience in media data engineering and adtech integrations (DSPs, SSPs, ad servers, social platforms, Experience with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g. LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI). Familiarity with the Databricks ecosystem (MLflow, Feature Store, Genie). Exposure to NLP or multimodal AI. Experience with monitoring/observability tools (e.g. Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch). Prior experience in a CPG/FMCG environment. The responsibilities of this position are performed within the framework of a regional business model that is defined and managed by Mondelēz Europe GmbH, Switzerland . No Relocation support available Business Unit Summary At Mondelez Europe, we are proud, not only of the iconic brands we make, but also of the people who make them. Our delicious products are created in 52 plants across Europe by more than 28,000 passionate people. We are the top maker of chocolate and biscuits and a leading maker of gum and candy. We make sure our powerful global brands and local jewels like Cadbury, Milka and Alpen Gold chocolates, Oreo, belVita, LU and Tuc biscuits get safely into our customers hands—and mouths. Great people and great brands. That’s who we are. Join us on our journey to continue leading the future of snacking around the world by offering the right snack, for the right moment, made the right way.  Join a team of cybersecurity professionals and help Swiss Re fulfil its mission to make the world more resilient.

 What's more, you'll be working in a hybrid setup, perfectly balancing work from home and the office premises.  
 About the team  
 The Penetration Testing team simulates real-world cyberattacks on Swiss Re's computer systems, networks, applications, services and platforms. As part of the Group Security & Technology Platforms (GSTP) division, the team detects security weaknesses and fixes them before malicious hackers can exploit them.   
 We're looking for an experienced Penetration Tester who's ready to help us protect our digital assets through comprehensive testing, research, fixing and reporting. If this sounds like you, we'd like to hear from you!  
 About the role  
 Nobody is perfect and meets 100% of our requirements. If you, however, meet some of the criteria below and are curious about the world of penetration testing inside a large reinsurance company, we'll be more than happy to meet you!   
 Execute penetration tests across multiple attack surfaces: web applications, APIs, networks, mobile, thick clients and AI/LLM-based systems 
 Efficiently own, perform and deliver security assessments 
 Develop, maintain and validate AI-driven agents and tools to automate recurring testing tasks, reducing false positives and improving accuracy 
 Communicate service capabilities and test results effectively to IT owners and stakeholders 
 Compile "lessons-learnt" sessions and educational material for IT developers and other relevant parties  
 Cooperate closely with global teams from IT application owners, information security specialists and chief information security officers  
 Be someone who believes in continuous innovation, is curious and relentless in finding a better way every day  
 Use your knowledge of Open Web Application Security Project (OWASP) Top 10 Vulnerabilities, testing procedures and remediation recommendations  
 About You /Your qualification 
 What we need from you  
 At least 5 years of experience in information security and penetration testing  
 Good understanding of software development and architecture  
 Have good knowledge of programming and scripting languages 
 Sound understanding of security frameworks (ISO27001/2, NIST, OWASP Top 10)  
 Experience with vulnerability management and penetration testing tools (Burp Suite, nmap, Qualys, Bruno/Swagger, SQLMap, Kali Linux etc.)  
 Experience cloud security and testing cloud environments.  
 Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly and unambiguously to both business and technical audiences  
 Good communication and writing skills; proficiency in English is required, other languages are a plus  
 Experience working in an international environment 
 Nice-to-have  
 Industry-relevant certifications (SANS, CEH, Offensive Security, eLearn Security, etc.)  
 Knowledge of advanced persistent threats and modern attack techniques 
 Experience in agentic development and deploying/hosting AI tools (containers, servers, APIs) 
 Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK, SAST/DAST, cloud testing, and reverse engineering 
 For Spain the base salary range for this position is between EUR 42,000 and EUR 70,000 (for a full-time role). The specific salary offered considers: 
 the requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role,

items.desc: Vous souhaitez vivre une expérience unique, au sein d’un chantier naval centenaire et reconnu depuis 1897, situé dans le cadre privilégié du bassin d’Arcachon ? Rejoignez-nous ! Le Chantier Naval Couach, acteur pionnier dans la construction de navires professionnels et de plaisance, conçoit, construit et suit des bateaux d'exception. Notre standard : l'excellence ! A travers l’innovation technologique, la transformation énergétique, et une offre globale de services à l’international, Couach ambitionne de vous faire vivre la mer autrement. Dans ce cadre, nous souhaitons renforcer notre département « Recherche et Développement » et recherchons un(e) Ingénieur Intelligence Artificielle et Développement Logiciel H/F DESCRIPTIF DU POSTE : Rattaché au département Recherche et Développement, vous aurez pour mission de concevoir, développer et déployer des solutions d'intelligence artificielle adaptées aux besoins des différents métiers de l'entreprise. De l'analyse des besoins à la mise en production, vous travaillerez avec les services métiers et informatiques afin de proposer des solutions performantes, sécurisées et évolutives. ACTIVITÉS CLÉS SPÉCIFIQUES AU POSTE : Analyser les processus métiers, recueillir les besoins et identifier les opportunités d'automatisation. Évaluer et prioriser les cas d'usage selon leur faisabilité, leurs coûts et les gains attendus. Assurer une veille technologique, tester les solutions IA et proposer des recommandations. Concevoir et développer des applications IA : assistants métiers, recherche documentaire, extraction et synthèse d'informations, automatisations. Mettre en œuvre des solutions basées sur les LLM : prompting, RAG, embeddings, indexation et évaluation des réponses. Collecter, structurer et traiter les données ; développer des API, connecteurs et pipelines de données. Concevoir et exploiter des bases de données et index vectoriels en garantissant la qualité et la traçabilité des informations. Développer, tester, déployer et maintenir les applications, interfaces et services backend. Définir avec le service informatique les architectures techniques et les conditions de déploiement et de sécurité. Mesurer les performances, les coûts et les gains opérationnels afin d'améliorer les solutions. Garantir la confidentialité, la cybersécurité et la conformité des usages de l'IA. Rédiger la documentation technique, accompagner les utilisateurs et former les référents métiers. MISSIONS COMPLÉMENTAIRES : Contribuer à la stratégie et à la feuille de route IA de l'entreprise. Participer au choix des fournisseurs et à l'évaluation des coûts et solutions technologiques. Développer des connecteurs et automatisations entre les outils métiers (ERP, GED, logiciels techniques). Expérimenter de nouvelles technologies : agents IA, OCR, reconnaissance d'images et modèles spécialisés. Participer aux tests, recettes, revues de sécurité et à l'accompagnement au changement. PROFIL RECHERCHÉ CONNAISSANCES ET COMPÉTENCES REQUISES : Maîtrise de Python, des API REST, de Git et des tests logiciels. Connaissance des LLM, du prompt engineering, des embeddings et du RAG (LangChain, LlamaIndex ou équivalent). Maîtrise de SQL et connaissance des bases vectorielles. Compétences en traitement documentaire, indexation et recherche sémantique. Pratique de Linux, Docker et des outils de déploiement. Capacité à concevoir des architectures sécurisées. Connaissance du RGPD et de la gouvernance des données. Capacité à piloter un projet IA jusqu'à sa mise en production. CONNAISSANCES ET COMPÉTENCES FACULTATIVES : Expérience en MLOps/LLMOps. Connaissance de l'inférence locale (Ollama, vLLM), des GPU et du cloud. Compétences en développement frontend et automatisation. Connaissances en machine learning, vision par ordinateur et traitement du langage. Expérience en environnement industriel, systèmes embarqués ou applications navales. Connaissance des risques de sécurité liés aux LLM et agents IA. QUALITÉS RECHERCHÉES : Esprit d'analyse, curiosité et compréhension des besoins métiers. Autonomie, rigueur, initiative et esprit critique. Pragmatisme et capacité à concevoir des solutions fiables. Bon relationnel, pédagogie et esprit d'équipe. Sens de la confidentialité et de la sécurité. Capacité à prioriser selon la valeur ajoutée des projets. FORMATION ET EXPÉRIENCE SOUHAITÉES : Bac+5 en informatique, IA ou science des données. Expérience confirmée en Python et projets IA, idéalement avec déploiement de solutions LLM/RAG. Une expérience industrielle est un atout. Doté(e) d’un état d’esprit agile, vous aimez travailler en équipe tout en faisant preuve d’autonomie ? Vous comptez parmi vos atouts un excellent relationnel, une volonté d’apprendre, l’envie de fournir un travail de qualité et d’être force de proposition ? Vous vous reconnaissez dans cette annonce ? Si la réponse à ces questions est oui, alors rejoignez nos équipes passionnées par l'environnement maritime ! De notre côté, nous vous guidons dans la découverte …
