items.desc: Hello ✨ We’re HappyScribe, a profitable, 100% bootstrapped AI company based in Barcelona. We built one of the web’s most accurate multilingual transcription platforms, trusted by hundreds of thousands of users each month . That product funds our freedom to create what’s next—no investors, no burn rate, just focus. Now we’re taking that same tech and expertise to a bigger frontier: turning conversations into intelligence. We’re building the layer where speech becomes memory, insights become action, and teams work with more clarity and speed. You’d be joining a team of ~17 people, close-knit and pragmatic. Some of us are scaling a mature, revenue-generating platform. Others are prototyping new products that push the limits of speech and agentic AI . We move fast but think long-term. There’s room here to shape, ship, and own real products — not pitch decks. About The Role… We're looking for an AI Engineer to work on the AI layer that powers HappyScribe Intelligence features. You will work on building features that bring together LLMs, speech models, and retrieval systems to address real user problems. This role is for builders obsessed with making AI actually work — engineers who'd rather ship a clever prompt chain that solves a real problem than debate model architectures in Slack or over-engineer multi-agent frameworks that become quickly obsolete. What you will do… Own AI features end-to-end — from problem discovery to prompt design to production. You'll build the systems that turn conversations into intelligence: summaries, search, actions, memory. Build and maintain our evaluation framework. You'll design evals that actually catch regressions, iterate on prompts with confidence, and keep quality high as models change under us. Optimize our AI infrastructure for speed, cost, and reliability. Provider routing, caching strategies, chunking approaches, latency budgets — you'll own the trade-offs. Stay dangerously current. The field moves weekly. You'll bring new techniques to the team and know when a new model or approach is worth the migration cost. Ship with the product team. You'll work closely with designers and engineers to integrate AI features that feel native, not bolted on. items.desc: Beschrijving Rol en context Als QA & AI Evaluation Engineer waak je over de kwaliteit, betrouwbaarheid en veiligheid van het AIHub Platform . Dit is het centrale, intern ontwikkelde AI-platform van Delen Private Bank, dat geïntegreerd is in de processen en systemen van de bank. AI-oplossingen gedragen zich niet altijd voorspelbaar. Daarom gaat kwaliteit hier verder dan alleen de vraag: “Werkt de functionaliteit zoals bedoeld?” Jij bepaalt hoe we meten of een AI-toepassing correct, consistent, veilig en bruikbaar is. Daarnaast zorg je ervoor dat dit ook zo blijft na wijzigingen aan modellen, prompts of data. Je werkt nauw samen met AI Engineers, developers, business analysts, domeinexperten en stakeholders . Daarbij combineer je sterke QA-expertise met analytisch inzicht in AI-systemen . Je vertaalt verwachtingen vanuit de business naar meetbare evaluatiecriteria, bouwt en onderhoudt evaluation datasets en integreert geautomatiseerde evaluaties in onze delivery pipelines. Verantwoordelijkheden Analyse & Evaluation Design Je werkt samen met business analysts en domeinexperten om verwachtingen rond het gedrag van AI te vertalen naar meetbare acceptatie- en evaluatiecriteria . Je definieert evaluation datasets (golden datasets) die realistische gebruiksscenario’s weerspiegelen, inclusief edge cases en failure scenarios. Je bepaalt evaluation rules , zowel: deterministisch : bijvoorbeeld format validation, schema checks, exacte of gestructureerde matches, verplichte bronvermelding en correcte tool calls; non-deterministisch : bijvoorbeeld LLM-as-a-judge, semantic similarity, groundedness en relevance. Je kalibreert LLM-as-a-judge evaluations ten opzichte van menselijke beoordelingen, zodat geautomatiseerde scores betrouwbaar blijven. Je helpt mee de evaluation strategy, coverage en quality thresholds te bepalen, zowel per use case als voor het platform als geheel. Test Execution & Validation Je voert functionele en non-functionele tests uit op verschillende platformcomponenten, zoals API’s, integraties, dataverwerking en user interfaces. Je evalueert RAG applications op retrieval quality, groundedness en correcte bronvermelding. Je test agentic flows , waaronder correcte tool selection, parameters, multi-turn behaviour en error handling. Je voert adversarial testing en red teaming uit, bijvoorbeeld rond prompt injection, jailbreaks, het lekken van vertrouwelijke of persoonlijke gegevens en ongewenste of misleidende output. Je valideert of guardrails en content filters correct werken. Je registreert bugs in Azure DevOps , volgt de oplossing ervan actief op en valideert opgeloste issues. Je faciliteert UAT-sessies met eindgebruikers en verzamelt gestructureerde feedback. Automation & Continuous Improvement Je monitort regression bij model upgrades en prompt changes en vergelijkt verschillende versies op een objectieve manier. Je onderhoudt evaluation datasets op basis van online evaluations en feedback uit productie . Onvoorziene edge cases zet je om in permanente test cases binnen de standaard eval sets. Je volgt de kwaliteit in productie op via monitoring & tracing , bijvoorbeeld aan de hand van quality scores, drift en gebruikersfeedback, en signaleert achteruitgang tijdig. Je gebruikt zelf AI tooling om test cases en synthetische testdata te genereren en resultaten sneller te analyseren. Collaboration & Platform Enablement Je helpt bij het uitbouwen van herbruikbare evaluation standards, templates en guidelines , zodat teams die op AIHub bouwen zelf de kwaliteit van hun use cases kunnen meten. Je schrijft annotation guidelines en betrekt domeinexperten bij het reviewen en labelen van output. Je communiceert bevindingen helder naar zowel technische als niet-technische stakeholders. Profiel en competenties Je hebt een uitstekende kennis van het Nederlands en een goede kennis van het Engels. Kennis van het Frans is een plus, onder andere met het oog op meertalige evaluaties. Je hebt ervaring als QA Engineer binnen een agile IT-omgeving en beschikt over sterke analytische vaardigheden. Je hebt hands-on ervaring met het testen of evalueren van LLM applications , of je kunt aantonen dat je binnen dit domein al een sterke maturiteit hebt opgebouwd. Je begrijpt de uitdagingen van non-deterministic systems en weet hierover op een betrouwbare en statistisch onderbouwde manier te rapporteren. Je hebt een kritische en creatieve “break it”-mindset waarmee je actief op zoek gaat naar edge cases en abuse scenarios. Je werkt nauwkeurig, gestructureerd en kwaliteitsgericht. Je bent een echte teamplayer met uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden. Basiskennis van of ervaring met Python voor test automation en evaluation scripts, bijvoorbeeld pytest; LLM evaluation frameworks , zoals LangSmith, Azure AI Foundry Evaluations, promptfoo, DeepEval, Ragas en Langfuse; concepten zoals RAG, embeddings, prompt engineering, agents en tool calling ; API testing , bijvoorbeeld met Postman, REST en OpenAPI; Azure DevOps voor test …

Beyond ecommerce, Zonos supports carriers, postal operators, marketplaces, and customs agencies with AI-driven tools that infer and validate key customs data, including HS codes, country of origin, and customs value, alongside licensed customs brokerage services that ensure goods move compliantly and efficiently across borders. Overview We're looking for a Software Engineer to join our growing team in Utrecht, Netherlands. You'll be part of our global engineering organization, working alongside engineers in the United States and Australia to build and maintain the systems that power international commerce. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys solving real problems, writing reliable code, and seeing their work make it into production. Our systems process complex, real-time transactions, and the work requires both technical skill and an understanding of how software impacts customers. Our backend runs primarily on Java/JVM, but we're more interested in strong engineering fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to learn than experience with any one framework. You don't need to be a senior engineer or have years of experience leading architecture decisions. We do expect you to have enough professional experience to contribute independently, investigate problems, and take ownership of your work. Being based in Utrecht also puts you in an important position within our global team. You'll collaborate across time zones, contribute to engineering coverage during European business hours, and work closely with our EMEA team when technical expertise is needed. How We Work We take a product-minded approach to engineering. We don't have traditional product managers handing engineers detailed specifications. Instead, engineers work closely with technical leads, customers, and internal teams to understand problems and build practical solutions. As a member of the team, you'll have guidance from experienced engineers and technical leads while being encouraged to take ownership of your work. We value engineers who ask questions, think critically, communicate clearly, and care about what happens after their code ships. We also actively use AI-assisted and agentic development tools. We see these tools as a way to move faster and spend more time solving meaningful problems, while maintaining strong standards for code quality, security, and reliability. What You'll Do Develop, test, and maintain backend services and APIs supporting Zonos products and platforms. Work primarily within our Java/JVM backend environment, contributing to systems that handle high volumes of real-time transactions. Collaborate with engineers in the US and APAC on product development, technical improvements, and shared engineering initiatives. Investigate and troubleshoot production issues, helping maintain reliable systems during EMEA business hours. Work with technical leads to understand requirements, evaluate approaches, and implement effective solutions. Use AI-assisted and agentic development tools to improve productivity while reviewing, testing, and validating the resulting code. Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and continuous improvements to our engineering practices. Collaborate with our EMEA Customer Success and Solutions teams when issues require deeper engineering investigation or product changes. Take ownership of assigned features and fixes from development through deployment and follow-up. Build an understanding of cross-border ecommerce, payments, customs, and logistics as you grow within the company. You Might Be a Great Fit If You... Have at least 2 years of professional software engineering experience, preferably working with backend services or APIs. Have experience with Java, Kotlin, or another backend programming language and are comfortable learning our Java/JVM environment. Understand REST APIs, databases, service integrations, and modern software development practices. Have experience developing, debugging, and supporting applications running in production. Can work independently on defined problems while knowing when to ask questions or involve other engineers. Enjoy understanding why something needs to be built, not just how to build it. items.desc: Most AI internships ask you to write prompts or do bite-sized changes here and there. This one asks you to rebuild how a deep-tech company works, including proving it worked. Full-time · on-site in Delft · 4–6 months, starting January 2027 · €750/month + commute + vacation days Why this internship You’ll be coached daily by an experienced generalist whose career spans aerospace deep-tech, AI transformation for enterprise clients, and leading the computational modelling at a major nonprofit from inception through >€200M funding to date. You’ll work inside a fast-moving deep-tech startup with more ownership than most interns ever get, on real company infrastructure, with real engineers who will tell you very quickly if something doesn’t work. The learning curve will be steep. If you want six months that move your skill set a few levels up, keep on reading. About us At Emergent we build counter-drone solutions and autonomy systems for teams of drones working together in the real world - defense and emergency response. Bad thinking gets exposed fast in our line of work so we embrace complexity and handle it pragmatically. Small team, high standards, real room to try things and break them intelligently. The role: two streams Stream A - AI Enablement (~60–70%) We’re making Emergent AI-native: redesigning how we work around what AI now makes possible, not just adding AI to existing processes. The groundwork and underlying analysis are done, the first systems are running, and the next phase is yours. Four scoped example sub-tracks (exact tasks will be determined based on immediate priority at the moment of onboarding): A1 - The AI coding harness. Build the scaffolding that makes AI-assisted development reliable: layered instruction files (AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md as a navigable table of contents, not a monolith), well-designed tools for just-in-time codebase retrieval, mechanical CI invariants that enforce architecture boundaries, a plan-execute-verify loop, and explicit governance - permission separation, human approval gates for destructive actions, cost ceilings. Done right, this is a direct path to ~2× productivity per engineer. Phase 1 is built; phases 2–7 are approved and need to be implemented A2 - Integration testing. Today, getting a build from sim to field takes a myriad of fragile manual steps. Miss one and the field testing day is lost. The fix is disciplined systems engineering - containerization, vertical integration, versioned scenarios, CI-gated integration tests - with AI used to accelerate building the pipeline and to triage failures, not to execute test logic. Target: collapse the number of steps to 1–3. A3 - The AI reviewer. As AI speeds up code production, verification becomes the binding constraint. Phase 2 (yours): take it to production: extend it across the codebase, add cross-repo impact checks, tune it against real reviewer feedback, and measure whether it actually shortens review. Target: reviewers start from checked findings, not a blank page. A4 - The company brain. Critical knowledge lives in people’s heads, chat threads and meetings, and leaves when they do. The fix is a company knowledge base with low-friction capture (automated pipelines from the tools we already use, structured records instead of free-text notes, standard handover files), built to be queried by engineers and AI agents alike. Least friction wins: if it needs a form, nobody fills it in. Phase 2 (yours): connect the sources into one knowledge base that people and agents actually use. All four are the same problem: scattered components and scattered knowledge that need a reliable harness around them. You’ll be the one building that harness. Stream B - Product & Strategy Support (~30–40%) The work a small deep-tech startup always needs: research feeding strategy and product decisions, roadmap input, market analysis, pitch materials, turning messy technical ideas into clear visuals and narratives, supporting demos and external conversations. One week you’re inside a codebase, the next you’re shaping how we pitch it. You’re a fit if you… Black belt common sense and critical thinking: you can tell what matters from what doesn’t Think from first principles and apply Pareto ruthlessly (80% of the outcome, then stop) Understand the basics of coding and how LLMs work well enough to design scaffolding for them: you don’t write production C++, but you know what’s possible and what isn’t Think about verification, governance and failure modes, not just speed Can get busy engineers to adopt something new, sceptics included (especially the sceptics) Handle ambiguity without freezing, and bring structure to messy things Write and communicate clearly (and timely!) Are curious, proactive and want high expectations with real support Are working toward a BSc/MSc in engineering, AI, CS, business informatics, or similar (you must be enrolled in a Dutch university for the whole duration of the internship) Nice to have Hands-on with LLMs, …

Avec l’IA, ça change : un service client bien construit devient un levier de rétention (et parfois d’acquisition). Encore faut-il avoir la bonne matière : une connaissance structurée, maintenue, testée ; et des agents IA qui s’améliorent au fil des tickets. La plupart des intégrations s’arrêtent là où l’outil s’arrête. Nous, on pousse plus loin : quand il manque une brique, on la crée (connecteurs, logique métier, automatisations sur-mesure, QA). Résultat : on peut traiter des cas simples… comme des environnements enterprise avec des contraintes réelles. Chez Qwokka, on aide des e-commerces, SaaS et marketplaces à automatiser une grande partie de leur support en quelques mois, en appliquant une logique simple : un support qui s’améliore en continu . On structure la connaissance, on connecte les outils, on automatise ce qui est répétitif, on mesure ; et on itère. Objectif : moins de tâches manuelles, des réponses plus rapides, et une satisfaction assurément plus haute. Contexte du stage Tu rejoins une boîte au tout début , avec de la traction et des clients actifs, et tu travailleras en direct avec le fondateur (ex-CTO et cofondateur d’une startup e-commerce, 7 ans d’expérience sur l’automatisation et les systèmes ops). items.desc: Senior AI Engineer | Gen AI Overview We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to design, build and operationalise AI-powered solutions that deliver measurable business value. You will take ownership of AI capabilities from technical design and experimentation through to production deployment and continuous improvement. Working closely with software engineers, data teams, product owners and business stakeholders, you will develop reliable AI applications, integrate them into existing platforms and help shape the organisation’s AI engineering practices. A key part of the role will be exploring how Generative AI and Agentic AI can support complex workflows, automate tasks and improve decision-making. Responsibilities Design, develop and deploy production-ready AI and Generative AI applications. Build LLM-powered solutions, including RAG pipelines, AI assistants and intelligent information retrieval. Design and implement agentic workflows using tool calling, orchestration and multi-step task execution where appropriate. Develop robust backend services and APIs, primarily using Python, to integrate AI capabilities with business applications and enterprise systems. Evaluate foundation models and AI frameworks based on quality, performance, security, latency and cost. Build AI evaluation frameworks, automated tests and feedback loops to improve model and application reliability. Implement monitoring, observability and tracing for AI systems in production. Apply security, privacy, access controls and responsible AI principles throughout the development lifecycle. Collaborate with cloud, data and software engineering teams on deployment, CI/CD and scalable architecture. Take ownership of deployed AI solutions, troubleshooting issues and continuously improving performance. Contribute to technical standards, architecture decisions and knowledge sharing across the engineering team. Requirements Proven experience as a Senior AI Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, GenAI Engineer or in a similar technical role. Strong Python development skills and solid software engineering fundamentals. Hands-on experience building and deploying LLM-based applications in production. Strong understanding of Generative AI, LLM architectures, prompt engineering and RAG. Practical experience with agentic AI concepts, including agent orchestration, tool/function calling and multi-step workflows. Experience developing APIs and integrating AI solutions with databases, applications and external services. Knowledge of vector databases, embeddings and semantic search. Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS or Google Cloud. Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD, automated testing and production monitoring. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate business needs into technical solutions. Comfortable working with multidisciplinary teams and taking technical ownership.

items.desc:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
 The Position
 Make a Global Impact on Life-Saving Healthcare Logistics 
 At Roche, we believe every patient deserves access to innovative treatments without delay and outstanding quality. To make that happen, our supply chain must operate with absolute precision and cutting-edge technology.
 We are looking for an experienced Senior SAP EWM Solution Architect to take end-to-end technical ownership of one of the Roche Pharma division’s largest and most highly automated distribution hubs. Serving patients worldwide, this site relies on high-throughput automation running on a mission-critical, validated SAP landscape.
 In this role, you will be embedded within an agile product team, making independent product-level decisions, driving technical strategy, and collaborating directly with global stakeholders to ensure continuous innovation and reliability.
 What You Will Do 
 Architect & Deliver High-Impact Solutions: Lead the technical design, configuration, and implementation of complex enhancements across our SAP EWM landscape, including Material Flow System (MFS) and custom user interfaces (WebDynpro).
 Own Technical Problem-Solving: Tackle end-to-end operational challenges, perform root-cause analyses, debug complex workflows, and translate nuanced business logistics into robust system architecture.
 Bridge Business & Technology: Act as a strategic partner to warehouse operations, engineering, and business leaders—managing expectations, presenting technical roadmaps, and turning operational bottlenecks into automated solutions.
 Ensure Quality in a Regulated Environment: Champion compliance, computer system validation (CSV), and change management within a validated GxP environment, maintaining the highest standards for patient safety.
 Drive Agile Excellence & Mentorship: Work within a Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) environment, leading knowledge-sharing sessions, and elevating the technical maturity of the team.
 On-Site Collaboration: Travel occasionally to Switzerland for collaborative workshops, key go-lives, and direct stakeholder engagement.
 Who You Are 
 Must-Haves: 
 5+ years of hands-on SAP EWM experience with extensive exposure to complex production environments, custom logic, and configuration.
 Life Sciences or Regulated Industry Background: Solid experience navigating strict validation (GxP/CSV), structured change management, and technical documentation standards.
 Agile Mindset: Practical experience working within modern agile operating models (preferably SAFe / Scrum).
 Autonomous Decision-Maker: Proven track record of independently owning complex product-level decisions and communicating clearly across technical and operational teams.
 Language: Professional working proficiency in English (written and verbal).
 Nice-to-Haves (A Big Plus): 
 Direct, hands-on experience implementing or optimizing SAP EWM-MFS (Material Flow System) connected to automated high-bay warehouses or automated guided vehicles (AGVs).
 Strong technical literacy with ABAP debugging and integration technologies.
 Professional working proficiency or fluency in German .
 Why Join Us? 
 Mission-Driven Scale: Work on EWM systems where your code and designs directly safeguard the global supply of critical medicines.
 Cutting-Edge Automation: Gain exposure to one of the most advanced automated warehouse environments in the pharmaceutical industry.
 Autonomy & Influence: High trust, product-centric culture where your technical voice shapes the roadmap.
 Compensation & Benefits 
The expected salary range for this position, based on the primary location of Warsaw Grafit is 170,100.00 PLN - 315,900.00 PLN. Final compensation will be determined by a number of factors, including your skills, experience, qualifications, and location. In addition to base pay, this role may be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus with a target of 15% subject to both individual and company performance. 
 This position also offers an attractive benefits package .
 Learn more about how we reward our employees at Roche.

Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. items.desc:
ABOUT MISTRAL

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.




ABOUT THE JOB


As a Forward Software Engineer, Data, you will build the systems behind some of the hardest problems Mistral takes on.

You join our team of engineers in Applied AI. We gravitate towards hard problems, decide how to solve them, and ship fast. You work closely with our customer-facing teams, and what works goes into production with our customers and across the company. When a project needs it, you work directly on customer engagements.

We're looking for a strong software engineer who builds end to end and has shipped ML or GenAI systems to production. You've felt the pain of models that pass every eval and fail on real data, and of quality that drifts after launch. You've also felt the data engineering pain: pipelines that break silently, schemas that change under you, and backfills that take a weekend. Data engineering is your edge. You turn messy, large-scale data into systems that hold up.

You think like a founder. You start from the customer's problem, not the technology. You measure success by the value you deliver, and you care about building experiences people love to use. You like working at the edge of what AI can do today, and you push past it.

Your scope is end to end, from first prototype to production. Your depth in data architecture helps set the standard for how the team designs and delivers systems. You know lakehouse and data mesh patterns well enough to know when they fit and when they're overkill. You've designed ontologies and data models, and you know that getting them right is as much art as science.




WHAT YOU WILL DO

 - Build AI systems end to end, from first prototype to production.

 - Design the data architecture underneath them: ingestion, processing, storage, and the data models and ontologies that make messy data usable.

 - Build distributed pipelines that process large volumes of documents, code, logs, and multimodal content for retrieval, agentic workflows, and fine-tuning.

 - Turn what works for one customer into patterns and platforms that work across many, without rebuilding each time.

 - Make systems hold up under real load: throughput, latency, cost, and failure recovery are part of the design from the start.

 - Build data governance into the systems themselves: ownership, access control, lineage, retention, and privacy for sensitive enterprise data.

 - Build the evaluation loop: labeling with LLMs and humans, versioned eval datasets, and checks that catch quality drift before customers do.

 - Set the standard for how the team designs and ships data systems.

 - Work with researchers, engineers, and customer-facing teams to turn hard problems into systems people rely on.





WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - You have full ability to ship across the stack: proficient NodeJS e.g. NextJS/Express/Fastify or similar or Python e.g. FastAPI. You are confident with TypeScript + React/NextJS or similar. Solid beats polished.

 - You have 5+ years of experience building and running production data-intensive pipelines with distributed processing (for example Spark, Ray, Beam, or Dask) and orchestration tools (for example Airflow, Dagster, or Prefect) with structured and unstructured data.

 - You have experience with retrieval-augmented generation, agentic use cases, or LLM evaluation, and a clear view of how data quality drives model quality.

 - You work autonomously: you find the problem, decide the approach, and own the outcome.

 - You communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences, and are fluent in English.

 - You ship in increments, are obsessed with time to value and are comfortable making and articulating product-technical tradeoffs.




IDEALLY YOU HAVE

 - A passion for graph-based systems (e.g. Neo4j) and ontology design

 - Hands-on experience building data pipelines for LLM training, fine-tuning, or evaluation, and contributions to open-source projects, particularly in data or LLMs.

 - Hands-on experience with data governance and privacy requirements (for example GDPR), secure data handling, CI/CD and infrastructure as code, or an affinity for security engineering.




HOW WE WORK IN APPLIED AI

 - We care about people and outputs.

 - What matters is what you ship, not the time you spend on it

 - Bureaucracy is where urgency goes to vanish. You talk to …

As an AI Security Governance Architect , you will help design and operationalize cybersecurity governance frameworks for AI, Generative AI and agentic AI , working closely with security, architecture and business teams. You will act as a cybersecurity subject matter expert for AI governance , translating emerging AI risks into practical security
items.desc: Are you passionate about helping organizations turn complex AI security challenges into clear strategies and practical solutions? At Plain Concepts , our AI Security Studios team helps organizations adopt AI securely and responsibly by defining how risks, controls and responsibilities should be managed throughout the AI lifecycle. As an AI Security Governance Architect , you will help design and operationalize cybersecurity governance frameworks for AI, Generative AI and agentic AI , working closely with security, architecture and business teams. You will act as a cybersecurity subject matter expert for AI governance , translating emerging AI risks into practical security controls, requirements, processes and architecture patterns that organizations can actually implement. Key Responsibilities Define and evolve AI security governance frameworks , covering AI use case registration, risk classification, security controls, approvals, exceptions, monitoring and periodic reassessment. Align AI security governance with recognized standards and regulations , including NIST AI RMF, NIST Generative AI Profile, ISO/IEC 42001, OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and the EU AI Act. Assess AI, GenAI and agentic AI use cases from a cybersecurity perspective , considering risks such as prompt injection, sensitive data leakage, identity and access management, excessive agent permissions, model exposure, third-party AI services, data residency and AI supply chain risks. Translate AI risks into practical security controls , including security policies, technical requirements, architecture patterns, guardrails, evidence requirements, ownership and acceptance criteria. Define security requirements and architecture patterns for different AI scenarios , including internal copilots, Microsoft 365 Copilot, custom GenAI applications, RAG systems, AI agents, ML models, vendor AI solutions and low-code/no-code AI automations. Integrate AI security governance with existing security tooling and processes , including solutions such as HiddenLayer, Sentra and Zenity, as well as GRC, IAM, DLP, SIEM/SOC, cloud security, CMDB and data governance environments. Define and improve AI security governance deliverables , including AI security control frameworks, use case classification models, security requirements, architecture patterns, risk acceptance processes, security review templates, KPI/KRI dashboards and maturity roadmaps. Requirements 8+ years of experience in cybersecurity , with a strong background in security governance, security architecture, risk management, AppSec or Cloud Security. Strong understanding of AI and GenAI security risks , including LLM application security, prompt injection, sensitive data leakage, RAG security, AI agent permissions, model/API exposure, model supply chain and third-party AI services. Experience designing and operationalizing security governance and control frameworks , with the ability to turn policies and risk requirements into practical controls, processes and security requirements. Knowledge of AI security and governance frameworks , such as NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and related AI risk and security standards. Ability to work across security, architecture and business teams , translating complex cybersecurity risks into clear requirements and recommendations for both technical and executive stakeholders. Excellent communication and documentation skills , with the ability to create executive-ready materials as well as detailed security and control documentation. Fluent in English and Spanish. Nice to have Experience with AI governance programs, GenAI security assessments or AI Security Posture Management (AISPM). Experience securing enterprise AI environments such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, custom GenAI applications, RAG solutions or AI agents. Knowledge of cloud security architecture, Secure SDLC/DevSecOps, DSPM, GRC or AI-related SOC monitoring. Familiarity with tools such as HiddenLayer, Sentra, Zenity, Wiz, Microsoft Purview, Defender, CSPM/CWPP, DLP or SIEM/SOAR platforms. Knowledge of third-party AI risk management and security control evidence automation. Understanding of privacy and AI regulatory requirements, including GDPR, DPIAs, data classification and the EU AI Act. I settori in cui operiamo principalmente sono quello ambientale (gestione e trattamento dei rifiuti), idrico (acquedotto, fognature e depurazione) ed energetico (distribuzione e vendita di energia elettrica, gas e servizi energia), ma offriamo anche servizi per l'illuminazione pubblica e telecomunicazioni, adottando sempre un modello di business orientato alla creazione di valore condiviso per tutti gli stakeholder. Cerchiamo persone curiose, innovative, che condividano con noi mission e valori. Persone pronte ad affrontare le sfide che il nostro contesto, in continua trasformazione, ci pone ogni giorno: ambientali, di business, tecnologiche. Chi siamo AcegasApsAmga S.p.A. società controllata al 100% dal Gruppo Hera, è la prima multiutility del Nordest e opera nei settori ambientale, idrico e nella distribuzione di gas ed energia elettrica in Veneto e Friuli-Venezia Giulia. Inoltre, grazie all'attività delle società controllate HSE ed Hera Luce, realizza progetti di efficientamento energetico e di illuminazione pubblica sull'intero territorio nazionale. Il tuo nuovo ruolo Entrerai a far parte del team di Data Management e Data Science di AcegasApsAmga S.p.A., dove contribuirai allo sviluppo di sistemi di Intelligenza Artificiale su piattaforme cloud (Databricks e AWS), lavorando su casi d'uso reali in team di progetto interfunzionali. Con il supporto di un tutor aziendale, parteciperai a tutte le fasi di un progetto: dalla qualificazione e modellazione del problema alla definizione del design della soluzione, fino alla prototipazione, alla valutazione e al rilascio in un ambiente cloud governato. items.desc: Job Description: Role Summary The ITO Linux Engineer (Level 3) is the Linux technical authority across DXC-managed customer environments, accountable for platform integrity, complex troubleshooting, performance optimisation and architectural improvements for mission-critical workloads. They design, validate and maintain secure OS baselines and oversee patching and vulnerability management to ensure stability, security, performance and audit readiness in regulated environments. They partner with security and compliance teams to enforce enterprise hardening standards and maintain audit-ready documentation and evidence. The role demands deep technical expertise, architectural judgement and calm, authoritative decision-making under pressure in regulated, mission-critical environments. Due to the nature of the work and the customers we support, the successful candidate must be eligible to meet UK Government and contractual personnel security requirements, including the applicable residency requirements for the role, and have the right to work in the United Kingdom. Some roles may also be subject to nationality requirements where these are necessary to meet UK Government or contractual security obligations. Please note the roles will require attendance on-site in Hampshire 5 days a week. Define and regularly review secure RHEL, CentOS, Oracle Linux and SUSE baselines aligned with CIS, STIGs or equivalent standards. Plan patching and vulnerability cycles, including sequencing, risk assessment and rollback, to maintain service continuity within constrained change windows. Identify end-of-life distributions, kernels and dependencies and recommend upgrades or migrations to maintain supportability and compliance. Maintain accurate Linux CMDB records and configuration management discipline across operations and changes. Analyse incidents, performance data and vulnerability scans to identify systemic weaknesses and improvement opportunities. Own root-cause analysis for major and recurring incidents, implementing corrective actions and embedding prevention in procedures and baselines. Automate repetitive tasks with advanced shell scripting, Ansible, Puppet or equivalent tools to improve consistency, accuracy and efficiency. Update runbooks, procedures and knowledge articles with current practice, known errors and lessons learned. Evaluate containerisation, immutable infrastructure and infrastructure-as-code, recommending adoption where reliability, security or efficiency improves. Lead or support platform modernisation aligned with organisational strategy and industry best practice. Advise customers, service delivery, security and compliance stakeholders in service reviews, governance forums and risk discussions. Partner with security teams to enforce hardening standards, deliver prioritised vulnerability remediation and maintain audit evidence. Coordinate with application, database, network, storage and virtualisation teams on Linux dependencies affecting performance, connectivity and high availability. Lead major-incident technical bridges, updating incident managers and stakeholders on root cause, impact and recovery. Mentor junior engineers through technical guidance, work reviews, knowledge sharing and structured development. Design, validate and maintain secure OS baselines and repeatable, auditable builds that meet regulatory and contractual requirements. Review high-risk kernel, clustering, storage and baseline changes, assessing risk and giving technical approval before CAB submission. Design, test and document clustering and HA using Pacemaker, Corosync, DRBD, Oracle RAC dependencies and application-level clustering, including failover. Design and oversee enterprise storage integration across Fibre Channel, iSCSI, DM-Multipath, NFS and GFS2/OCFS2 shared storage. items.desc: Job Description: Role Overview A senior, multiskilled engineer responsible for the design, deployment, optimisation, and day-to-day operation of enterprise endpoint-management and Windows platforms. The role spans Windows client and Server OS build and lifecycle, Remote Desktop Services (RDS) and RDP remote-access management, patch management and compliance (WSUS, SCCM/MECM, and Ivanti), software packaging and deployment, OS deployment (OSD), and supporting Windows Server and virtualisation environments. As a Level 10 specialist, the engineer provides advanced troubleshooting and strategic guidance, leads root-cause analysis for major incidents, drives automation, and mentor junior (L1/L2) team members — working within ITIL-aligned service delivery and corporate security standards. Due to the nature of the work and the customers we support, the successful candidate must be eligible to meet UK Government and contractual personnel security requirements, including the applicable residency requirements for the role, and have the right to work in the United Kingdom. Some roles may also be subject to nationality requirements where these are necessary to meet UK Government or contractual security obligations. Please note this role will require attendance on-site 5 days a week. Key Responsibilities Windows Server & Remote Desktop Services (RDS / RDP) Design, build, configure, patch, and maintain enterprise Windows Server platforms — including Windows Server 2016/2019/2022 and 2025 — covering Active Directory, GPO, DNS, and DHCP. Manage and support Remote Desktop Services (RDS) — Session Host, Connection Broker, Gateway, Web Access, and Licensing — including farm design, session management, and user-profile/FSLogix configuration. Administer, secure, and troubleshoot the Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP) — connectivity, certificates, encryption/NLA, Group Policy controls, and remote-access performance. Endpoint Management — SCCM/MECM, WSUS & Ivanti Design, implement, and maintain the SCCM/MECM hierarchy (Primary/Secondary sites, Distribution Points, Management Points, Software Update Points); define and enforce policies, standards, and operating procedures. Administer WSUS and Software Update Points; manage Ivanti (and comparable endpoint/patch-management platforms) for patching, software distribution, and endpoint control. Monitor site/endpoint health and client status; maintain boundaries, collections, and client settings; perform site backup and disaster-recovery validation. Patch Management & Compliance Plan and execute enterprise patching strategies for Windows client/Server OS, Office, and third-party applications using WSUS, SCCM ADRs, and Ivanti. Configure, test, and deploy Automatic Deployment Rules (ADRs) and Compliance Baselines; monitor compliance reports and remediate non-compliant endpoints and servers. Collaborate with IT Security to align patching with corporate security policies and vulnerability-remediation targets. Software Deployment & Application Packaging Package, test, and deploy applications across enterprise endpoints and RDS hosts using SCCM task sequences; automate deployments with PowerShell and advanced techniques. Resolve deployment issues including application conflicts and installation failures; maintain software inventory, license tracking, and reporting. Operating System Deployment (OSD) & Windows Lifecycle Manage Windows OS imaging, boot images, driver packages, and task sequences; lead in-place upgrades, bare-metal deployments, and device/server refresh cycles. Maintain a library of standardised enterprise images (client and Server) aligned with IT standards; optimise OSD workflows for reliability and minimal downtime. Automation, Reporting & Incident Leadership Drive automation for patching, provisioning, monitoring, and compliance using PowerShell (and tools such as Ansible/PowerCLI where applicable). Develop SQL queries and SSRS reports for inventory, compliance, deployment, and patch status; track KPIs (patch-compliance rate, deployment success rate, client/server health). Lead root-cause analysis for major incidents across Windows, RDS, and endpoint environments; mentor L1/L2 engineers and maintain accurate documentation (CMDB integrity, runbooks). Technical Skills & Experience Essential: Advanced Windows Server administration — Windows Server 2016/2019/2022 and 2025 — including Active Directory, GPO, DNS, and DHCP. Hands-on management of Remote Desktop Services (RDS) — Session Host, Connection Broker, Gateway, Web Access, Licensing — and the Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP), including secure configuration and troubleshooting. Proficient in Windows client OS, networking, and endpoint security. Expert knowledge of SCCM/MECM — hierarchy, client deployment, site maintenance, task sequences, ADRs, and compliance baselines. WSUS administration and enterprise patch management. Ivanti (or comparable endpoint/patch-management platform) for patching and software/endpoint control. PowerShell …

Overview: We are looking for a senior CX Chapter Designer to own CX standards, journey and persona templates, service blueprint patterns and CX onboarding and training content for product and business teams, delivered as reusable, technology-enabled assets. The role is a direct report tothe Experience Platforms Lead, with an emphasis on connecting CX work to data, analytics and AI-assisted insight tooling. Main Accountabilities: Create and maintain CX standards, journey templates, persona templates, service blueprint patterns and customer/farmer experience artefact guidance. Define golden path content for CX activities, including problem framing, journey mapping, pain point analysis, opportunity framing, service blueprinting and value hypothesis definition, incorporating AI-assisted data synthesis where relevant. Support product, business and domain teams with reusable CX templates, onboarding materials, facilitation guidance and platform self-service content. Partner with UX Chapter Designer to connect journeys, personas and service blueprints to UX flows, prototypes and handover artefacts. Collaborate with Design System Lead and Experience Platforms Lead to ensure CX templates connect to Design System patterns, APIs and POC Hub workflows. Provide training, office hours, community sessions and quality reviews for CX and Service Design practices, including AI/automation tooling literacy. Build and engage the CX design community through knowledge sharing, peer learning, reusable resources and regular community initiatives that strengthen capabilities and adoption of common standards and ways of working. Document reusable journey and service patterns that can be reused across products, domains and regions via the platform's template library. Prepare CX artefacts for future integration with Research Platform, Experience Analytics, AI-driven personalization and CMS capabilities. items.desc:
DataPipeline CA SW 
 Description - 
 Tier 4 Software Customer Assurance Engineer (HP PWP)
 Organization: PWP GBU Operations Engineering / Customer Assurance
 Role Type: Technical escalation & reliability engineering (customer production environments)
 Role Summary 
 The Tier 4 Software Customer Assurance Engineer is a senior technical escalation owner for HP PageWide Web Press customer incidents and systemic reliability issues, with deep expertise spanning press compute platforms, networking/connectivity, and print electronics/press subsystems . This role resolves complex, cross-domain problems quickly to restore customer production, drives root cause and prevention, and partners closely with internal engineering (R&D) and service teams(IPCS) to reduce recurrence. Tier 4 work includes managing elevated tasks, performing remote diagnostics and (when required) customer site support, and leading mitigation of top issues through trend analysis and continuous improvement.
 Key Responsibilities 
 1) Tier 4 Escalation Ownership & Resolution 
 Own and drive resolution of Tier 4 elevated tasks/incidents , collaborating with Tier 1–3 support, Field Service, and partners to restore press operations.
 Provide remote diagnostics and troubleshooting using logs, press state reports, and system data; request/clarify missing data and direct next steps.
 For critical/press-down situations, provide timely technical leadership, clear status updates, and structured escalation as required by process.
 2) Compute/network & OS / Software Environment Expertise 
 Troubleshoot and resolve issues involving press compute stacks (server hardware, OS images/bundles, virtualization/containers where applicable, storage, performance, diagnostics).
 Diagnose and resolve connectivity, remote access, firewall/VPN, routing/DNS and other network-related issues impacting press operations, serviceability, and tooling.
 Create clear, customer-ready technical guidance for network prerequisites and collaborate with service/account teams to unblock access.
 4) Print Electronics & Press Subsystem Troubleshooting 
 Lead complex investigations spanning print electronics, press control subsystems, and integration points (e.g., electrical/control cabinet behaviors, sensors, boards, interlocks, vision/adjacent electronics interfaces).
 Partner with hardware/WS and R&D teams for deep root cause and corrective action when defects require engineering fixes.
 5) Problem Management, Trend Analysis & Prevention 
 Identify systemic issues through trend analysis , define “top problems,” and drive mitigations that reduce repeat cases and improve fleet reliability.
 Produce crisp RCAs, document learnings, and improve knowledge assets/playbooks to accelerate future resolutions. 
 6) Customer Centricity & Stakeholder Management 
 Engage professionally with customers and internal stakeholders with a “production-first” mindset: fast containment, clear communication, and durable prevention.
 Translate technical complexity into actionable choices and risks for non-technical audiences.
 Required Qualifications 
 Bachelor’s Engineering degree, preferable computer science, with at least 5 years of experience in Support organizations
 Strong hands-on troubleshooting background across compute platforms + networking + hardware/electronics-adjacent systems in production environments.
 Ability to perform structured debug: hypothesis → evidence gathering → isolation → mitigation → prevention.
 Experience working escalations and coordinating across multiple teams under time pressure.
 Excellent written/verbal communication; ability to produce customer-ready summaries and internal technical notes.
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience with industrial equipment , printing systems, or complex electromechanical platforms.
 Familiarity with Tiered support models and escalation/task workflows (ServiceNow-style task elevation and closure discipline).
 Exposure to reliability engineering, problem management, and operational excellence methods (Pareto, 5-Why, fault tree, etc.).
 Core Competencies 
 Customer Centricity: prioritizes restoring production; communicates clearly and respectfully.
 Systems Thinking: connects compute/network/electronics/press behaviors end-to-end.
 Execution Under Pressure: decisive containment + disciplined follow-through.
 Collaboration: effective across Service, Engineering, and Partner organizations.

items.desc: DataPipeline CA SW Description - Tier 4 Software Customer Assurance Engineer (HP PWP) Organization: PWP GBU Operations Engineering / Customer Assurance Role Type: Technical escalation & reliability engineering (customer production environments) Role Summary The Tier 4 Software Customer Assurance Engineer is a senior technical escalation owner for HP PageWide Web Press customer incidents and systemic reliability issues, with deep expertise spanning press compute platforms, networking/connectivity, and print electronics/press subsystems . This role resolves complex, cross-domain problems quickly to restore customer production, drives root cause and prevention, and partners closely with internal engineering (R&D) and service teams(IPCS) to reduce recurrence. Tier 4 work includes managing elevated tasks, performing remote diagnostics and (when required) customer site support, and leading mitigation of top issues through trend analysis and continuous improvement. Key Responsibilities 1) Tier 4 Escalation Ownership & Resolution Own and drive resolution of Tier 4 elevated tasks/incidents , collaborating with Tier 1–3 support, Field Service, and partners to restore press operations. Provide remote diagnostics and troubleshooting using logs, press state reports, and system data; request/clarify missing data and direct next steps. Translate technical complexity into actionable choices and risks for non-technical audiences. Ability to perform structured debug: hypothesis evidence gathering isolation mitigation prevention. Experience working escalations and coordinating across multiple teams under time pressure. Excellent written/verbal communication; ability to produce customer-ready summaries and internal technical notes. Preferred Qualifications Experience with industrial equipment , printing systems, or complex electromechanical platforms. Familiarity with Tiered support models and escalation/task workflows (ServiceNow-style task elevation and closure discipline). Exposure to reliability engineering, problem management, and operational excellence methods (Pareto, 5-Why, fault tree, etc.). Core Competencies Customer Centricity: prioritizes restoring production; communicates clearly and respectfully. Systems Thinking: connects compute/network/electronics/press behaviors end-to-end. Execution Under Pressure: decisive containment + disciplined follow-through. Collaboration: effective across Service, Engineering, and Partner organizations. items.desc: We are growing. And we are looking for talented people. At Decskill, we believe that technological excellence is driven by human talent. We are an IT consulting company with more than 10 years of consolidated experience in the market, focused on building long-term relationships with both our clients and our people. Today, we are a community of over 800 professionals, working from Lisbon, Porto, and Madrid, contributing to impactful technology initiatives. As part of the Astek Group, we combine a strong local culture with a global presence, being active in around 23 countries across 4 continents. This allows us to offer an international context, diverse challenges, and long-term career opportunities, while staying close to our teams. We are looking for an AI Engineer | GenAI ! Mission: As part of an Intelligent Automation and AI team, you will be responsible for designing, developing and continuously improving production-grade AI agents supporting business operations. You will work on agent reasoning flows, tool integration, prompts, evaluation and observability, while adapting general-purpose AI solutions to specific business requirements. Responsibilities: Develop and maintain AI agents using Python, LangGraph, LangChain and internal AI frameworks. Design agent workflows, including task decomposition, tool and function calling, memory and state management. Implement appropriate guardrails and human-in-the-loop checkpoints for controlled business processes. Engineer, test and version prompts, ensuring proper configuration and release management. Build and maintain AI evaluation frameworks using real business cases and golden datasets. Develop regression test suites and quality metrics, including accuracy, groundedness and escalation rates. Perform shadow testing and validation before production rollout. Adapt general-purpose AI agents to specific business requirements, including terminology, formats, workflows and controls. Instrument AI agents for observability, including structured logging, token usage, latency and failure analysis. Contribute to model lifecycle management, including model and provider changes and context window considerations. Analyse cost and latency trade-offs when selecting and implementing AI solutions. Collaborate closely with Business Analysts and technical teams to translate business processes and operational knowledge into AI agent behaviour. Ensure the reliability, scalability and quality of AI solutions in production environments. Work collaboratively within a multicultural and international team. Requirements: 3–6 years of experience in Python development. At least 1–2 years of experience working with LLM/Generative AI applications. Practical experience with at least one AI agent framework, such as: CrewAI LangGraph LangChain AutoGen Similar frameworks Understanding of ReAct-style agent loops, tool calling and structured outputs. Strong knowledge of prompt engineering. Experience with RAG patterns and LLM evaluation techniques. Experience consuming REST and/or gRPC APIs. Knowledge of JSON Schema design. Experience with asynchronous Python. Working knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes. Ability to deploy applications, read logs and safely manage Kubernetes ConfigMaps. Strong testing culture and experience with pytest. Experience mocking LLM calls and designing deterministic tests for non-deterministic AI systems. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to translate business requirements into reliable technical solutions. Strong collaboration and communication skills. Fluent English. Are you looking for an environment that values curiosity and commitment? Here, your contribution has real impact and individual growth is taken seriously. Find with us the right opportunity to grow! What you can expect from us Long-term projects with national and international context. Opportunities to grow technically and professionally. A people-first culture, focused on transparency and trust. Teams that value ownership, collaboration and stability. The opportunity to work with cutting-edge Generative AI and Agentic AI technologies. Exposure to real-world AI use cases and production environments. A collaborative and multicultural working environment. The opportunity to contribute to the evolution of AI solutions from development to production. If you’re interested in this job, please send your CV to cesaltina.abreu@decskill.com with reference “CA/AIAGENT”. Your next challenge might start here. Construire des pipelines d'ingestion documentaire : connecteurs, parsing de documents (PDF, Office, HTML, documents scannés), découpage, embeddings et synchronisation incrémentale. Améliorer les mécanismes de recherche : recherche vectorielle et hybride, reranking, réécriture de requêtes et filtrage par métadonnées. Mettre en ?uvre une recherche multilingue et gérer les droits d'accès aux documents. Intégrer les modèles de langage et d'embeddings via une passerelle IA. Mesurer et améliorer la qualité des résultats : pertinence, précision, fidélité et fiabilité des réponses. Architecture et industrialisation Garantir la performance, la scalabilité et la disponibilité des services. Participer à la supervision, aux tests de charge et à la gestion des incidents. Contribuer aux choix d'architecture et aux études de solutions (développement interne, achat ou open source). Développer des outils, SDK et templates facilitant l'intégration de nouvelles bases documentaires. IA agentique et pratiques de développement Exposer les fonctionnalités RAG sous forme d'outils et de serveurs MCP utilisables par des agents IA. Développer des mécanismes de recherche agentique et multiétapes. Rédiger des spécifications précises, déléguer les tâches aux agents et contrôler rigoureusement les résultats. Contribuer aux bonnes pratiques de développement, aux revues de code, aux tests automatisés et à la documentation. Participer à l'amélioration continue des pratiques de l'équipe et au partage de connaissances. items.desc: Your work days are brighter here. We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too. About the Team The Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) organization sits at the intersection of Product, Engineering, and customer execution across Agent Factory, Sana, Products, and the Developer Platform. When Workday launches new AI agents and products, early deployments surface complex real-world challenges—from unstructured tenant data and intricate configurations to edge-case enterprise workflows. FDE pods deploy directly into active customer engagements to resolve technical friction, debug complex setups, and build lightweight integrations. Crucially, FDEs serve as the primary feedback engine for Product and Engineering: field insights, recurring customer friction, and configuration patterns are converted directly into scalable, out-of-the-box product capabilities. It's a team where deep technical skill meets real customer impact, every day. About the Role As a Principal Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll bridge hands-on software development with high-impact customer technical strategy — taking on the most complex, ambiguous engagements where no existing playbook applies. You will partner with enterprise customers, often at the executive level, to architect, deploy, debug, and optimize Workday's AI agents and developer platform solutions inside live customer environments. You'll work across the full deployment lifecycle alongside AI Deployment Architects, Product Managers, and Workday Services leads. Beyond delivering for individual customers, you'll help set the technical direction for the FDE practice itself: turning field-tested solutions into scalable product capabilities and mentoring other engineers along the way. What you'll do: Technical Deployment & Engineering: Architect, deploy, configure, and debug AI agents and integrations inside the most complex live enterprise tenant environments, frequently in situations with no established precedent. Customer Discovery & Solution Architecture: Lead technical discovery sessions with senior leaders at customer organizations, translating ambiguous business requirements into robust product configurations, POCs, and integration specs. Product Feedback & Influence: Synthesize field telemetry, edge-case failures, and recurring customer friction into insights that directly shape the product roadmap and engineering backlog. Productization of Field Insights: Identify patterns across many engagements and lead the work of turning custom fixes into standardized, automated, out-of-the-box product capabilities. Cross-Functional & Executive Alignment: Act as a trusted technical advisor to Workday Services leads, AI Deployment Architects, Account Teams, and customer executives, keeping every engagement focused on core product strength. Engagement Leadership & Mentorship: Own the most strategically important or technically complex engagements end-to-end — from kickoff through graduation — within standard 6-month deployment cycles, while coaching other FDEs on technical approach and customer engagement. About You Basic Qualifications Experience: 10+ years of experience in Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Technical Consulting, or Software Development, including experience leading complex, high-stakes enterprise technical engagements. Technical Execution: Hands-on coding and debugging skills (for example, Python, Java, or similar), with deep knowledge of REST APIs, object-oriented design, system architecture, and integration patterns. Workday Knowledge: Working knowledge of Workday, including business processes, security and permissions, tenant configuration, integrations, and how customers implement and govern Workday, so you can read a customer's tenant and understand how agentic features and agents will behave inside it. Travel: Willingness and ability to travel to customer sites as needed. Other …

items.desc:
Overview 
 Shape the Future of AI. Transform Partners into Frontier Leaders. Scale Business Impact. 
 Join Microsoft's high-performing Cloud & AI Partner Architects team in DACH and play a pivotal role in accelerating AI innovation and business transformation across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland through our strategic partner ecosystem.
 As a Senior Cloud Solution Architect - Data & AI , you will combine deep technical expertise, architectural leadership, and strategic business acumen to help our most influential partners design, build, and scale innovative AI-powered solutions. You will act as a trusted technical advisor, guiding partners through complex architectural decisions, solution development, and the adoption of Microsoft's latest cloud, data, and AI technologies.
 A key part of your mission is to accelerate the evolution of our partners into Frontier Partners -helping them move beyond traditional technology services and isolated AI experiments toward AI-first business models, intelligent agent-based solutions, differentiated intellectual property (IP), and scalable, repeatable offerings that deliver measurable customer outcomes.

By combining technical leadership with a strong understanding of partner business models, you will help partners turn innovation into sustainable growth and scale successful solutions across customers and markets.
 Leveraging technologies such as Microsoft Foundry, Microsoft Fabric, Azure AI Services, Azure SQL, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure App Service, Azure Functions, Azure API Management, and GitHub , you will drive the development of scalable, secure, and enterprise-ready AI and data architectures.
 We are looking for a senior technical leader who can connect technology with business impact -someone who challenges conventional thinking, influences strategic decisions, inspires technical teams, and helps shape the next generation of AI-powered partner businesses.
 Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day, we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 Business Impact

Connect technology innovation with measurable business outcomes, accelerating partner growth and customer transformation.

Collaborate across Microsoft sales, engineering, and partner organizations to accelerate pipeline creation, solution adoption, and sustainable business impact at scale.
 Influence Strategic Technology Decisions: Challenge conventional approaches, guide partners through complex architectural and business decisions, and translate emerging technology trends into actionable transformation strategies. Proactively address technical and business risks, including security, data governance, privacy, responsible AI, and operational resilience.
 Partner Specialization 
 Build Frontier Partner Capabilities: Lead the technical transformation of strategic partners by developing their Data & AI practices, architectural capabilities, and technical readiness. Help partners establish differentiated AI offerings, agentic solutions, and scalable delivery models that enable them to compete and grow in the evolving AI market.
 Accelerate Solution Innovation & Specialization: Guide partners in designing and delivering secure, scalable, production-ready Data & AI solutions, leveraging Microsoft Foundry, Fabric, Azure AI Services, and modern cloud architectures. Lead architectural design sessions, technical workshops, and strategic customer engagements while accelerating relevant Microsoft Solutions Partner designations and specializations, including Frontier AI.
 Scale Repeatable Partner Solutions: Enable partners to move beyond individual projects and proofs of concept by developing differentiated IP, reusable architectures, industry solutions, and repeatable offerings.
